CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[Fn_31_GetClaimTypeName] (
  @LGNo NVARCHAR(50)
)
RETURNS nvarchar(200)
AS
BEGIN
RETURN
      (SELECT ct.ClaimTypeName 
	  FROM DataLG lg
      LEFT JOIN SystemClaimTypeMaster ct on ct.ClaimTypeId = lg.ClaimTypeId
      WHERE lg.LGNo = @LGNo )

END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FN_CheckDebtorHasActiveCase] (
  @DebtorId NVARCHAR(100)
)
RETURNS [BIT]
AS
BEGIN

  Declare @Result BIT = 0
  
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM LTDataCaseMainDebtor d
        WHERE d.DebtorId = @DebtorId
          AND d.IsActive = 1
    )
    SET @Result = 1;
    

  RETURN @Result;

END

modules.name: Fn_CheckOfficer
modules.definition:
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[Fn_CheckOfficer]
(
    @LGNo NVARCHAR(100)
)
RETURNS BIT
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @DebtorId NVARCHAR(100);
    DECLARE @Result BIT = 0;  -- default FALSE

    -- ดึง DebtorId
    SELECT @DebtorId = b.DebtorId
    FROM DataAssignment a
    JOIN DataDebtorRelate b ON a.DebtorRelateId = b.DebtorRelateId
    WHERE a.LGNo = @LGNo 
      AND b.DebtorTypeId = 1;

    -- ถ้า @DebtorId เป็น NULL ให้ return 0 ทันที
    IF @DebtorId IS NULL
        RETURN 0;

    -- เช็คว่ามี CollectorUserId หรือไม่
    BEGIN
        -- เช็คว่ามี LG อื่นที่มี CollectorUserId จริง
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM DataAssignment a
        JOIN DataDebtorRelate b ON a.DebtorRelateId = b.DebtorRelateId
        WHERE b.DebtorId = @DebtorId
          AND b.DebtorTypeId = 1
          AND a.LGNo <> @LGNo
          AND a.CollectorUserId IS NOT NULL
          AND a.CollectorUserId <> 0
          AND NOT (
                a.UpdateDate >= CONVERT(date, GETDATE())
            AND a.UpdateDate <  DATEADD(day, 1, CONVERT(date, GETDATE()))
          )
    )
        SET @Result = 1;
    END
  
    RETURN @Result;
END

CREATE   FUNCTION [dbo].[Fn_CheckOfficerOA] (
  @LGNo NVARCHAR(100)
)
RETURNS [int]
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @DebtorId NVARCHAR(100);
    DECLARE @Result BIT = 0;  -- default FALSE
  -- Routine body goes from this line...
    -- ดึง DebtorId
    SELECT @DebtorId = b.DebtorId
    FROM DataAssignment a
    JOIN DataDebtorRelate b ON a.DebtorRelateId = b.DebtorRelateId
    WHERE a.LGNo = @LGNo 
      AND b.DebtorTypeId = 1;

    -- ถ้า @DebtorId เป็น NULL ให้ return 0 ทันที
    IF @DebtorId IS NULL
        RETURN 0;

    -- เช็คว่ามี CollectorUserId หรือไม่
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM DataAssignment a
        JOIN DataDebtorRelate b ON a.DebtorRelateId = b.DebtorRelateId
        WHERE b.DebtorId = @DebtorId
          AND a.LGNo <> @LGNo   -- แก ้ NOT @LGNo → เป็น <> @LGNo
          AND ISNULL(a.CollectorOAUserId, 0) <> 0
    )
        SET @Result = 1;

    RETURN @Result;
END

modules.name: FN_DCS_02_PayableAmount
modules.definition:
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FN_DCS_02_PayableAmount]
(
	-- หาจำนวนเงินที่ต้องจ่าย ของแต่ละประเภทค่าใช้จ่าย
	@DebtorCardId NVARCHAR(150) = ''
	,@PayableAmountName NVARCHAR(100) = ''
)
RETURNS decimal(20,4)
AS
BEGIN

	RETURN 
	(SELECT 
	CASE WHEN @PayableAmountName = 'CourtFee' THEN CourtFeeTotal --ค่าธรรมเนียมศาล
	WHEN @PayableAmountName = 'LawyerFee' THEN LawyerFeeTotal --ค่าทนาย
	WHEN @PayableAmountName = 'OtherExpenses' THEN OtherExpenseTotal --ค่าใช้จ่ายอื่น
	WHEN @PayableAmountName = 'InitialMargin' THEN InitialMarginTotal --เงินวางประกัน
	
	WHEN @PayableAmountName = 'DefaultInterest' THEN DefaultInterestTotal --ดอกเบี้ยผิดนัด-คงเหลือ
	WHEN @PayableAmountName = 'PlannedInterest' THEN PlannedInterestTotal  --ดอกเบี้ยตามแผน-คงเหลือ
	WHEN @PayableAmountName = 'Principal' THEN PrincipalTotal  --เงินต้น

	WHEN @PayableAmountName = 'SuspendInt' THEN SuspendIntTotal --ดอกเบี้ยตั้งพักใหม่(แขวน)-คงเหลือ
	WHEN @PayableAmountName = 'SuspendedDefaultInterest' THEN SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal  --ดอกเบี้ยแขวนผิดนัด-คงเหลือ


	--WHEN @PayableAmountName = 'Installment' THEN InstallmentsAmount --ค่างวด
	WHEN @PayableAmountName = 'DeferredInterestTotal' THEN DeferredInterestTotal --ดอกเบี้ยตั้งพัก-คงเหลือ
	--WHEN @PayableAmountName = 'InstallmentPrincipal' THEN InstallmentPrincipal --ค่างวดค้าง ยังไม่เสร็จ

	ELSE '' END

	FROM DataDebtorCard 
	WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId)
END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FN_DCS_04_Assignment]
(
	-- กรณีผู้ค้ำประกันธนาคาร หาจำนวนผู้ค้ำทั้งหมด ของ LG และ +1 (บสย.)
	@LGNo NVARCHAR(20) = ''

)
RETURNS INT
AS
BEGIN

	RETURN 
	(select 
--lg.LGNo
--,a.ProvinceId
--,ar.OrgSectionId
--,p.FirstName
--,lg.ClaimPayAmount
--,c.ClaimTypeName
--,
isnull(case when lg.ClaimPayAmount <= 200000 or c.ClaimTypeName like '%พ.ร.ก.%' then  (select PersonalInfoId from DataPersonalInfo where IsManager = 1 and OrgSectionId = 27) 
else p.PersonalInfoId end,1)
--,(select PersonalInfoId from DataPersonalInfo where IsManager = 1 and OrgSectionId = 27)
--,*
from DataAssignment d
left join DataDebtorRelate r on r.DebtorRelateId = d.DebtorRelateId
left join DataDebtorAddress a on a.DebtorId = r.DebtorId and a.DebtorAddressTypeId = 7
left join DataLG lg on lg.LGNo = r.LGNo
left join SystemResponsibleAreaMaster ar on ar.ProvinceId = a.ProvinceId
left join DataPersonalInfo p on p.OrgSectionId = ar.OrgSectionId and IsManager = 1
left join SystemClaimTypeMaster c on c.ClaimTypeId = lg.ClaimTypeId

where
r.DebtorTypeId = 1
and lg.Grade = 'F1'
and lg.LGNo = @LGNo
and NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM DataBankrupcy B 
    WHERE B.LGNo = lg.LGNo
)
)
END

modules.name: FN_DCS_05_GenFormatBarcode
modules.definition:
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date, ,>
-- Description:	<Description, ,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FN_DCS_05_GenFormatBarcode]
(
	-- 

	--1.Prefix 
	--2.TAX ID No. 
	--3.Reference1
	--4.Reference2
	--5.Amount
	@Reference1 NVARCHAR(20) = ''
	,@Reference2 NVARCHAR(20) = ''
	,@Amount decimal(18,2) = ''
)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(200)
AS
BEGIN
--1.Prefix 
declare @Prefix nvarchar(1) = '|'
--2.TAX ID No. เลข บสย. + 00
declare @TAXIDNo nvarchar(15) = '01055370646090100'

--declare @UpdateReference1_1 nvarchar(1) = substring(@Reference1,1,1)
--declare @UpdateReference1_13 nvarchar(1) = substring(@Reference1,13,1)
--declare @UpdateReference1_Mid nvarchar(11) = substring(@Reference1,2,11)

declare @UpdateReference1 nvarchar(20) = @Reference1
declare @ReplaceReference1_Round1 nvarchar(50) = replace(@UpdateReference1,'0','R_ONE')
declare @ReplaceReference1_Round2 nvarchar(50) = replace(@ReplaceReference1_Round1,'9','R_TWO')
declare @ReplaceReference1_Round3 nvarchar(50) = replace(@ReplaceReference1_Round2,'R_ONE','9')
declare @ReplaceReference1_Round4 nvarchar(50) = replace(@ReplaceReference1_Round3,'R_TWO','0')

declare @Seq1 nvarchar(1) = substring(@ReplaceReference1_Round4,1,1)
declare @Seq2 nvarchar(1) = substring(@ReplaceReference1_Round4,2,1)
declare @Seq3 nvarchar(1) = substring(@ReplaceReference1_Round4,3,1)
declare @Seq4 nvarchar(1) = substring(@ReplaceReference1_Round4,4,1)
declare @Seq5 nvarchar(1) = substring(@ReplaceReference1_Round4,5,1)
declare @Seq6 nvarchar(1) = substring(@ReplaceReference1_Round4,6,1)
declare @Seq7 nvarchar(1) = substring(@ReplaceReference1_Round4,7,1)
declare @Seq8 nvarchar(1) = substring(@ReplaceReference1_Round4,8,1)
declare @Seq9 nvarchar(1) = substring(@ReplaceReference1_Round4,9,1)
declare @Seq10 nvarchar(1) = substring(@ReplaceReference1_Round4,10,1)
declare @Seq11 nvarchar(1) = substring(@ReplaceReference1_Round4,11,1)
declare @Seq12 nvarchar(1) = substring(@ReplaceReference1_Round4,12,1)
declare @Seq13 nvarchar(1) = substring(@ReplaceReference1_Round4,13,1)








--เพิ่มเลข 1 + Reference1 (เลขบัตรประชาชน) ที่แปลงแล้ว
set @UpdateReference1 = '1' + @Seq13 + @Seq12 + @Seq11 + @Seq10 + @Seq9 + @Seq8 + @Seq7 + @Seq6 + @Seq5 + @Seq4 + @Seq3 + @Seq2 + @Seq1 
declare @UpdateAmount nvarchar(10) = RIGHT(REPLICATE('0', 10) + REPLACE(FORMAT(@Amount, 'N2'), '.', ''), 10)

declare @UpdateReference2 nvarchar(20) = @Reference2



	RETURN 

	(SELECT @Prefix + @TAXIDNo + ' ' + @UpdateReference1 + ' ' +  @Reference2 + ' ' +  @UpdateAmount)
END

									left join SystemConditionMaster c on m.ConditionId = c.ConditionId

(select top 1 cast(m.ConditionItemMapingValue as decimal(20,4))
									from SystemConditionItemMappingValueMaster m
									left join SystemConditionMaster c on m.ConditionId = c.ConditionId
									left join SystemCampaignConditionMaster cc on cc.ConditionId = c.ConditionId
									left join SystemMeasureCampaignMaster cm on cm.CampaignId = cc.CampaignId
									left join SystemMeasureMaster mm on mm.MeasureId = cm.MeasureId
									where mm.MeasureId = @MeasureId
									and m.ConditionItemId =13)

-- =============================================

-- Create date: <Create Date, ,>
-- Description:	<Description, ,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FN_DCS_08_GetPercentAllInstallments]
(
	-- รหัสมาตรการที่เลือก
	@MeasureId int = ''
	--จำนนวนเงินรวม ที่ระบบส่งมา
	,@SumAllInstallments decimal(20,4) = 0
	--เงินต้นคงเหลือ
	,@Balance decimal(20,4) = 1000000
	--รหัสเงื่อนไข
	,@ConditionId int = 4555
)
RETURNS nvarchar(5)
AS
BEGIN
--ค่างวดทุกปีรวมกัน มากกว่า เท่ากับ 
declare @Value int = (select m.ConditionItemMapingValue
									from SystemConditionItemMappingValueMaster m
									left join SystemConditionMaster c on m.ConditionId = c.ConditionId
									left join SystemCampaignConditionMaster cc on cc.ConditionId = c.ConditionId
									left join SystemMeasureCampaignMaster cm on cm.CampaignId = cc.CampaignId
									left join SystemMeasureMaster mm on mm.MeasureId = cm.MeasureId
									where mm.MeasureId = @MeasureId
									and m.ConditionItemId=23
									--and m.ConditionGroupId =7
									and m.ConditionId = @ConditionId)

--94=เปอร์เซน, 95=บาท
declare @TypeId int = (select m.ConditionItemMapingValue
									from SystemConditionItemMappingValueMaster m
									left join SystemConditionMaster c on m.ConditionId = c.ConditionId
									left join SystemCampaignConditionMaster cc on cc.ConditionId = c.ConditionId
									left join SystemMeasureCampaignMaster cm on cm.CampaignId = cc.CampaignId
									left join SystemMeasureMaster mm on mm.MeasureId = cm.MeasureId
									where mm.MeasureId = 123
									and m.ConditionItemId=24
									--and m.ConditionGroupId =7
									and m.ConditionId = @ConditionId)

declare @BalanceValue decimal(20,4) = case when @TypeId = 94 then @Balance * @Value/100 else @Value end

--select @Value, @TypeId,@BalanceValue
	RETURN 
	(case when @SumAllInstallments >= @BalanceValue then 'true' else 'false' end)
	
END

modules.definition:
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FN_DCS_12_GetDebtorAddress]
(

	@DebtorId nvarchar(150) = ''
	,@AddressTypeId int = 1
)
RETURNS nvarchar(1000)
AS
BEGIN

	RETURN (select top 1 * from 
	(select top 1 N'เลขที่ ' + isnull(a.AddressNumber,'-')  
+ N' สถานที่ ' + case when isnull(a.PlaceName,'') = '' then '-' else a.PlaceName end
	+ N' หมู่ที่ ' + case when isnull(a.Moo,'')  = '' then '-' else a.Moo end 
	+ N' ซอย' + case when isnull(a.Soi,'')  = '' then '-' else a.Soi end 
	+ N' ถนน' + case when isnull(a.Road,'')  = '' then '-' else a.Road end 

	+ ' ' +(case when p.Code = '10' then  N' แขวง' else N'ตำบล' end) + isnull(sd.[Name],'-')
	+ ' '+ (case when p.Code = '10' then  N' เขต' else N'อำเภอ' end)  + d.[Name]
	+ N' จังหวัด' + p.Name + N' ' +a.PostalCode as AddressName

	from DataDebtorAddress a
	left join SystemProvinceMaster p on p.ProvinceId = a.ProvinceId
	left join SystemDistrictMaster d on d.DistrictId = a.DistrictId
	left join SystemSubDistrictMaster sd on sd.SubDistrictId = a.SubDistrictId

	where a.DebtorId = @DebtorId
	and a.DebtorAddressTypeId = @AddressTypeId
	order by a.IsDefault desc
	) t)
	
END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FN_DCS_19_GetAllDebtorByCIF]

)

modules.name: FN_DCS_24_GetLastApprover
modules.definition:
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date, ,>
-- Description:	<Description, ,>
-- =============================================
create FUNCTION [dbo].[FN_DCS_24_GetLastApprover]
(
    @ID NVARCHAR(150)
   , @TypeId INT = 4   -- 1=คำขอรับสภาพหนี้, 2=TDR, 3=เอกสารคดี
   , @TypeApproveId int = 43 -- 43 ตรวจ, 44 พิจารณา,  45 อนุมัติ
)
RETURNS INT
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @Result INT = NULL;

    IF (@TypeId = 1)
    BEGIN
        -- คำขอรับสภาพหนี้
        SELECT TOP (1) 
            @Result = a.ApproverId
        FROM dbo.DEBDataDebtRequestApprover AS a
        WHERE a.DebtRequestId = @ID
		and a.ApproverTypeId = @TypeApproveId
        ORDER BY a.Seq DESC;
    END
    ELSE IF (@TypeId = 2)
    BEGIN
        -- TDR
        SELECT TOP (1)
            @Result = a.ApproverUserId   -- ถ้าต้องการเป็น ApproverUserId ให้เปลี่ยนตรงนี้
        FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractApprover AS a
        WHERE a.CompromiseContractId = @ID
		and a.ApproverTypeId = @TypeApproveId
        ORDER BY a.Seq DESC;
    END
    ELSE IF (@TypeId = 3)
    BEGIN
        -- เอกสารคดี
        SELECT TOP (1)
            @Result = a.ApproverId
        FROM dbo.LTDataCaseMainApprover AS a
        WHERE a.CaseMainId = @ID
		and a.ApproverTypeId = @TypeApproveId
        ORDER BY a.Seq DESC;
    END

    RETURN ISNULL(@Result, 0);
END;

modules.name: FN_DCS_27_GetAccruedInterestTDRCal
modules.definition:
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FN_DCS_27_GetAccruedInterestTDRCal]
(
    @FirstDate date = '2025-07-25'
	,@DebtorCardId nvarchar(150)= ''

)
RETURNS decimal(20,4)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @Year nvarchar(4) = cast(year(@FirstDate) as nvarchar)
	DECLARE @DaysInYear INT = DATEDIFF(DAY, @Year +'-01-01', @Year +'-12-31') + 1;

	RETURN
   

(select top 1 
PrincipalTotal * (InterestRate/100) * 
(DATEDIFF(DAY, dateadd(day, 1, InterestEndDate) ,DATEADD(DAY, -1, @FirstDate)) + 1)
/@DaysInYear + DebtBalance as AccruedInterest

from DataDebtorCardMovement
where DocDate < @FirstDate
and DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
order by DocDate desc)

END

declare @PaymentSeq int = (SELECT top 1 m.ConditionItemMapingValue

        LEFT JOIN SystemCampaignConditionMaster cc ON cc.ConditionId = c.ConditionId

        LEFT JOIN SystemMeasureMaster mm ON mm.MeasureId = cm.MeasureId
        WHERE m.ConditionItemId = 20

		from SystemPaymentSeqDetailMaster s
		left join SystemLookupMaster m on m.LookupId = s.PaymentSeqTypeId
		where PaymentSeqId = @PaymentSeq)

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FN_DCS_30_GetORG]
(
      @UserId    INT = 1
    , @OrgTypeId INT = 1   -- 1=OrgGroup, 2=OrgStructure, 3=OrgSection
)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(200)
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @Result NVARCHAR(200);

    ;WITH base AS
    (
        SELECT TOP (1)
              p.OrgGroupId
            , p.OrgStructureId
            , p.OrgSectionId
        FROM DataPersonalInfo p
        WHERE p.UserId = @UserId
    )
    SELECT @Result =
        CASE 
            WHEN @OrgTypeId = 1 THEN ISNULL(g.OrgGroupName, '')
            WHEN @OrgTypeId = 2 THEN ISNULL(st.OrgStructureName, '')
            WHEN @OrgTypeId = 3 THEN ISNULL(sec.SectionNameTH, '')
            ELSE ''
        END
    FROM base b
    LEFT JOIN SystemOrgGroup g ON g.OrgGroupId = b.OrgGroupId
    LEFT JOIN SystemOrgStructure st ON st.OrgStructureId = b.OrgStructureId
    LEFT JOIN SystemOrgSectionMaster sec ON sec.OrgSectionId = b.OrgSectionId;

    RETURN @Result;
END

modules.name: FN_DCS_39_GetDebtorAddressComponent
modules.definition:
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FN_DCS_39_GetDebtorAddressComponent]
(

	@DebtorId nvarchar(150) = ''
	,@AddressTypeId int = 1
	,@TypeId int = 1 --1=เลขที่, 2=Moo, 3=PlaceName, 4=Road, 5=Soi, 6=Provinc, 7=District, 8=SubDistrict, 9=PostalCode
)
RETURNS nvarchar(400)
AS
BEGIN

	RETURN 
	(select top 1 
	case when @TypeId = 1 then isnull(a.AddressNumber,'')
	when @TypeId = 2 then isnull(a.Moo,'')
	when @TypeId = 3 then isnull(a.PlaceName,'')
	when @TypeId = 4 then isnull(a.Road,'')
	when @TypeId = 5 then case when isnull(a.Soi,'') = '' then '' else 'ซ.' + isnull(a.Soi,'') end  
	when @TypeId = 6 then isnull(p.[Name],'')
	when @TypeId = 7 then isnull(d.[Name],'')
	when @TypeId = 8 then isnull(sd.[Name],'')
	when @TypeId = 9 then isnull(a.PostalCode,'')
	else '' end
	
	

	from DataDebtorAddress a
	left join SystemProvinceMaster p on p.ProvinceId = a.ProvinceId
	left join SystemDistrictMaster d on d.DistrictId = a.DistrictId
	left join SystemSubDistrictMaster sd on sd.SubDistrictId = a.SubDistrictId

	where a.DebtorId = @DebtorId
	and a.DebtorAddressTypeId = @AddressTypeId
	order by a.IsDefault desc
	)
	
END

modules.name: FN_DCS_40_GetSubstitute
modules.definition:
CREATE   FUNCTION [dbo].[FN_DCS_40_GetSubstitute]
(
     @PersonalInfoId INT = 410
    ,@CurrentDate    DATE = '2025-12-26'
)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(400)
AS
BEGIN


    DECLARE @Result NVARCHAR(400);

	declare @Count int = (select count(*) 
						from DataPersonalInfo p left join SystemSubstituteMaster ti on ti.ApproverUserId = p.PersonalInfoId 
						where PersonalInfoId = @PersonalInfoId 
						and @CurrentDate between ti.SubstituteStartDate and ti.SubstituteEndDate) 
	
	if(@Count >0) 
	begin
		-- ถ้ามีตัวแทนในช่วงวันที่ที่กำหนด ให้คืนชื่อผู้ทำการแทน
		SELECT TOP (1)
			   @Result = dbo.FN_DCS_10_GetOfficerUserNameTH(ti.SubstituteApproverUserId) + N' (ทำการแทน)'
		FROM SystemSubstituteMaster ti
		WHERE ti.ApproverUserId = @PersonalInfoId AND @CurrentDate BETWEEN ti.SubstituteStartDate AND ti.SubstituteEndDate
		ORDER BY
			ti.SubstituteStartDate DESC,  -- เลือกอันล่าสุด
			ti.SubstituteEndDate   DESC;
	end
	else if (@Count = 0)
	begin
		
		SELECT TOP (1)
			   @Result = dbo.FN_DCS_10_GetOfficerUserNameTH(p.UserId) 
		FROM DataPersonalInfo p
		WHERE p.PersonalInfoId = @PersonalInfoId 
		
	end


    RETURN @Result; -- ถ้าไม่เจอจะเป็น NULL
END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FN_DCS_46_GetCollectorName]
(
	@DebtorRelateId nvarchar(150) = ''
    


)
RETURNS nvarchar(500)
AS
BEGIN

	RETURN
   
        (select  top 1
 case when a.TypeAssignId = 1 then t1.TitleShortName + p1.FirstName + ' ' + isnull(p1.LastName,'')
 when a.TypeAssignId = 2 and a.CollectorOAUserId !=0 then isnull(t2.TitleShortName,'') + p2.FirstName + ' ' + isnull(p2.LastName,'')
 else 'รอจ่ายงาน OA' end

from DataDebtorRelate r 
left join DataAssignment a on a.DebtorRelateId = a.DebtorRelateId
left join DataPersonalInfo p1 on p1.UserId = a.CollectorUserId
left join SystemTitleMaster t1 on t1.TitleId = p1.TitleId

left join DataPersonalInfo p2 on p2.UserId = a.CollectorOAUserId
left join SystemTitleMaster t2 on t2.TitleId = p2.TitleId
where r.DebtorRelateId = @DebtorRelateId
)

END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FN_DCS_Card_01_CalInterimInterest]
(
    @DataDebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = '053143CD-8393-4ACB-9F19-60BF9288A546'
		,@InterestStartDate date = '2026-05-01'
		,@InterestEndDate date = '2026-05-31'
)
RETURNS INT
AS
BEGIN

DECLARE @DaysInYear INT = DATEDIFF(DAY, cast(year(getdate()) as nvarchar) + '-01-01', cast(year(getdate()) as nvarchar) + '-12-31') + 1;

DECLARE @InterestQuantity INT = (DATEDIFF(DAY, @InterestStartDate,  @InterestEndDate ) + 1)

	RETURN 







(select 
 cast(PrincipalTotal * (InterestPlannedRate/ 100) * cast(@InterestQuantity AS DECIMAL(20,2))/ (CAST(@DaysInYear AS DECIMAL(20,2))) as decimal(20,2)) as InterimInterest

from DataDebtorCard c
where c.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId)

END

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.fn_diagramobjects() 
	RETURNS int
	WITH EXECUTE AS N'dbo'
	AS
	BEGIN
		declare @id_upgraddiagrams		int
		declare @id_sysdiagrams			int
		declare @id_helpdiagrams		int
		declare @id_helpdiagramdefinition	int
		declare @id_creatediagram	int
		declare @id_renamediagram	int
		declare @id_alterdiagram 	int 
		declare @id_dropdiagram		int
		declare @InstalledObjects	int

		select @InstalledObjects = 0

		select 	@id_upgraddiagrams = object_id(N'dbo.sp_upgraddiagrams'),
			@id_sysdiagrams = object_id(N'dbo.sysdiagrams'),
			@id_helpdiagrams = object_id(N'dbo.sp_helpdiagrams'),
			@id_helpdiagramdefinition = object_id(N'dbo.sp_helpdiagramdefinition'),
			@id_creatediagram = object_id(N'dbo.sp_creatediagram'),
			@id_renamediagram = object_id(N'dbo.sp_renamediagram'),
			@id_alterdiagram = object_id(N'dbo.sp_alterdiagram'), 
			@id_dropdiagram = object_id(N'dbo.sp_dropdiagram')

		if @id_upgraddiagrams is not null
			select @InstalledObjects = @InstalledObjects + 1
		if @id_sysdiagrams is not null
			select @InstalledObjects = @InstalledObjects + 2
		if @id_helpdiagrams is not null
			select @InstalledObjects = @InstalledObjects + 4
		if @id_helpdiagramdefinition is not null
			select @InstalledObjects = @InstalledObjects + 8
		if @id_creatediagram is not null
			select @InstalledObjects = @InstalledObjects + 16
		if @id_renamediagram is not null
			select @InstalledObjects = @InstalledObjects + 32
		if @id_alterdiagram  is not null
			select @InstalledObjects = @InstalledObjects + 64
		if @id_dropdiagram is not null
			select @InstalledObjects = @InstalledObjects + 128
		
		return @InstalledObjects 
	END

create   FUNCTION [dbo].[Fn_FormatDateAD] (
  @Date date
)
RETURNS nvarchar(100)
AS
BEGIN
    -- guard: year > 9456 overflow เมื่อ +543 (เกิน .NET datetime max 9999)
    RETURN CASE
        WHEN @Date IS NULL THEN N''
        WHEN @Date = CAST('1900-01-01' AS DATE) THEN N''
        --WHEN YEAR(@Date) > 9456 THEN N''
        ELSE FORMAT(@Date, 'dd/MM/yyyy')
    END
END

CREATE  FUNCTION [dbo].[Fn_FormatFullDate] (
  @Date date

)
RETURNS nvarchar(100)
AS
BEGIN

    declare @Month nvarchar(2) = month(@Date)
	return 
	
	case when @Date = cast('1900-01-01' as date) then ''
	else 
	
	
	CONCAT(CONCAT(day(@Date) ,
	(case when @Month = '1' then N' มกราคม ' 
	when @Month = '2' then N' กุมภาพันธ์ ' 
	when @Month = '3' then N' มีนาคม ' 
	when @Month = '4' then N' เมษายน ' 
	when @Month = '5' then N' พฤษภาคม ' 
	when @Month = '6' then N' มิถุนายน ' 
	when @Month = '7' then N' กรกฎาคม ' 
	when @Month = '8' then N' สิงหาคม ' 
	when @Month = '9' then N' กันยายน ' 
	when @Month = '10' then N' ตุลาคม ' 
	when @Month = '11' then N' พฤศจิกายน ' 
	when @Month = '12' then N' ธันวาคม ' 
	else '' end))
	, year(dateadd(year, 543, @Date)))
	
	end

 
END

)
RETURNS [DECIMAL]
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @ClaimPayAmount DECIMAL(18,2)
    
    SELECT @ClaimPayAmount = a.ClaimPayAmount 
    FROM DataLG a

    return @ClaimPayAmount
  

END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FN_TDR_01_GetApproverTDR]
(

	@ID nvarchar(150) = ''
	,@TypeId int = 0
	,@IsShow int = 0 --1=แสดงหมด, 0=ไม่แสดง ถ้าไม่อนุมัติ
)
RETURNS int
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @Result INT;

    IF (@IsShow = 0)
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 
            @Result = CASE 
                          WHEN a.ApproverStatusId = 40 
                               THEN a.ApproverUserId 
                          ELSE NULL 
                      END
        FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractApprover a
        LEFT JOIN DataPersonalInfo d 
               ON d.UserId = a.ApproverUserId 
        LEFT JOIN SystemTitleMaster t 
               ON t.TitleId = d.TitleId
        WHERE a.CompromiseContractId = @ID
          AND a.ApproverTypeId = @TypeId
        ORDER BY a.Seq DESC;
    END
    ELSE IF (@IsShow = 1)
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 
            @Result = a.ApproverUserId
        FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractApprover a
        LEFT JOIN DataPersonalInfo d 
               ON d.UserId = a.ApproverUserId 
        LEFT JOIN SystemTitleMaster t 
               ON t.TitleId = d.TitleId
        WHERE a.CompromiseContractId = @ID
          AND a.ApproverTypeId = @TypeId
        ORDER BY a.Seq DESC;
    END

    RETURN @Result;
END;

modules.name: FN_TDR_03_GetAgeDebtorAll
modules.definition:
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FN_TDR_03_GetAgeDebtorAll]
(
    @ID NVARCHAR(150) = '20f20af9-e57e-475c-92de-f61ffb626862'
)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS
BEGIN

    DECLARE @Result NVARCHAR(MAX);

    ;WITH DebtorGroup AS
    (
        SELECT
              r.DebtorId
            , r.DebtorTypeId
            , CASE 
                  WHEN d.PersonGroupId = 117 
                      THEN d.BirthDate
                  ELSE d.RegistrationDate
              END AS ReferenceDate
            , c.CreateDate
        FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractRelated clg

        LEFT JOIN dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContract c
            ON c.CompromiseContractId = clg.CompromiseContractId

        LEFT JOIN dbo.DataDebtorRelate r
            ON r.DebtorRelateId = clg.DebtorRelateId

        LEFT JOIN dbo.DataLG lg
            ON lg.LGNo = clg.LGNo

        LEFT JOIN dbo.DataDebtor d
            ON d.DebtorId = r.DebtorId

        WHERE clg.CompromiseContractId = @ID
          AND CAST(lg.ClaimDate AS DATE) <= CAST(clg.CreateDate AS DATE)
          AND r.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 4)

          -- บุคคลธรรมดา ใช้วันเกิด
          -- กรณีอื่น ใช้วันที่จดทะเบียน
          AND CASE 
                  WHEN d.PersonGroupId = 117 
                      THEN d.BirthDate
                  ELSE d.RegistrationDate
              END IS NOT NULL

          AND CAST
              (
                  CASE 
                      WHEN d.PersonGroupId = 117 
                          THEN d.BirthDate
                      ELSE d.RegistrationDate
                  END AS DATE
              ) <> CAST('1900-01-01' AS DATE)

        GROUP BY
              r.DebtorId
            , r.DebtorTypeId
            , CASE 
                  WHEN d.PersonGroupId = 117 
                      THEN d.BirthDate
                  ELSE d.RegistrationDate
              END
            , c.CreateDate
    ),
    AgeData AS
    (
        SELECT
              DebtorId
            , DebtorTypeId
            , DATEDIFF(YEAR, ReferenceDate, CreateDate)
              - CASE
                    WHEN DATEADD
                         (
                             YEAR,
                             DATEDIFF(YEAR, ReferenceDate, CreateDate),
                             ReferenceDate
                         ) > CreateDate
                    THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END AS Age
        FROM DebtorGroup
    )
    SELECT
        @Result = STRING_AGG
                  (
                      CAST(Age AS NVARCHAR(10)),
                      N'/ '
                  ) WITHIN GROUP
                    (
                        ORDER BY DebtorTypeId, DebtorId
                    )
    FROM AgeData;

    RETURN ISNULL(@Result, N'');

END

modules.name: FN_TDR_04_GetRemark
modules.definition:
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FN_TDR_04_GetRemark]
(
    @ID NVARCHAR(150) = ''
)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(1000)
AS
BEGIN

    DECLARE @Result NVARCHAR(1000)

    DECLARE @Count INT = 
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*) 
        FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractLG 
        WHERE CompromiseContractId = @ID
    )

    DECLARE @IsHairCut INT = 
    (
        SELECT m.IsHairCut
        FROM TDRDataCompromiseContract c
        LEFT JOIN SystemMeasureMaster m 
            ON m.MeasureId = c.MeasureId
        WHERE c.CompromiseContractId = @ID
    )


    IF (@IsHairCut = 0)
    BEGIN

        SELECT TOP 1 
            @Result = m.RemarkCA 
                    + N' ' 
                    + FORMAT(
                        CAST(SUM(TotalInstallment) AS DECIMAL(18,2)),
                        'N2'
                      ) 
                    + N' บาท (คิดเป็น ' 
                    + CAST(PercentCondition AS NVARCHAR) 
                    + ' %)'

        FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractLG lg
        LEFT JOIN TDRDataCompromiseContract c 
            ON c.CompromiseContractId = lg.CompromiseContractId
        LEFT JOIN SystemMeasureMaster m 
            ON m.MeasureId = c.MeasureId
        WHERE c.CompromiseContractId = @ID
          AND lg.Grade = 'F1'
        GROUP BY 
            m.RemarkCA,
            TotalInstallment,
            PercentCondition
        ORDER BY PercentCondition

    END


    IF (@IsHairCut = 1)
    BEGIN

        SELECT TOP 1 
            @Result = m.RemarkCA 
                    + N' ' 
                    + FORMAT(
                        CAST(SUM(HaircutAmount) AS DECIMAL(18,2)),
                        'N2'
                      ) 
                    + N' บาท (คิดเป็น ' 
                    + '[HaircutPercents]' 
                    + ' %)'

        FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractLG lg
        LEFT JOIN TDRDataCompromiseContract c 
            ON c.CompromiseContractId = lg.CompromiseContractId
        LEFT JOIN SystemMeasureMaster m 
            ON m.MeasureId = c.MeasureId
        WHERE c.CompromiseContractId = @ID
          AND lg.Grade = 'F1'
        GROUP BY 
            m.RemarkCA,
            TotalInstallment,
            PercentCondition
        ORDER BY PercentCondition

    END


    RETURN @Result

END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date, ,>
-- Description:	<Description, ,>
-- =============================================

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[Fn_ThaiBaht] (@Number1 Money)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS BEGIN
DECLARE @number Numeric(38 , 0)
DECLARE @decimal INT
DECLARE @loops INT
DECLARE @bigLoops INT
DECLARE @counter INT
DECLARE @bigCount INT
DECLARE @mod INT
DECLARE @numbersTable TABLE (number CHAR(1), word NVARCHAR(10))
DECLARE @numbersDigit TABLE (number CHAR(1), word NVARCHAR(10))
DECLARE @inputNumber NVARCHAR(38)
DECLARE @inputNumber1 NVARCHAR(38)
DECLARE @inputDecimal NVARCHAR(2)
DECLARE @charNumber CHAR(1)
DECLARE @outputString NVARCHAR(MAX)
DECLARE @outputString1 NVARCHAR(MAX)
DECLARE @outputChar NVARCHAR(10)
DECLARE @outputChar1 NVARCHAR(10)
DECLARE @nextNumber CHAR(1)
IF @number1 = 0 RETURN N'ศูนย์บาทถ้วน'
 --insert data for the numbers and words
INSERT INTO @NumbersTable
SELECT N'',  N''UNION ALL SELECT N'0', N''
UNION ALL SELECT N'1', N'หนึ่ง' UNION ALL SELECT N'2', N'สอง'
UNION ALL SELECT N'3', N'สาม' UNION ALL SELECT N'4', N'สี่'
UNION ALL SELECT N'5', N'ห้า' UNION ALL SELECT N'6', N'หก'
UNION ALL SELECT N'7', N'เจ็ด' UNION ALL SELECT N'8', N'แปด'
UNION ALL SELECT N'9', N'เก้า'
INSERT INTO @NumbersDigit
SELECT N'1',N'' UNION ALL SELECT N'2', N'สิบ'
UNION ALL SELECT N'3', N'ร้อย' UNION ALL SELECT N'4', N'พัน'
UNION ALL SELECT N'5', N'หมื่น' UNION ALL SELECT N'6', N'แสน'
SET @number = FLOOR(@number1)
SET @decimal = FLOOR((@number1 - FLOOR(@number1))* 100)
SET @inputNumber1 = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(38), @number)
SET @inputDecimal = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(2), @decimal)
SET @bigLoops = FLOOR(LEN(@inputNumber1) / 6) + 1
SET @mod = LEN(@inputNumber1) % 6
SET @bigCount = 1
SET @outputString = N''
WHILE @bigCount <= @bigLoops BEGIN
IF @bigCount = 1 BEGIN
SET @inputNumber = LEFT(@inputNumber1,@mod)
SET @inputNumber1 = RIGHT(@inputNumber1,LEN(@inputNumber1)-@mod)
END
ELSE BEGIN
SET @inputNumber = LEFT(@inputNumber1,6)
IF @bigCount < @bigLoops
SET @inputNumber1 = RIGHT(@inputNumber1,LEN(@inputNumber1)-6)
END
SET @outputString1 = N''
SET @counter = 1
SET @loops = LEN(@inputNumber)
SET @nextNumber = N''
WHILE 1 <= @loops BEGIN
SET @charNumber = SUBSTRING(@inputNumber,@loops,1)
SET @nextNumber = SUBSTRING(@inputNumber,@loops-1,1)
SELECT @outputChar = word FROM @NumbersTable
WHERE @charNumber = number
SELECT @outputChar1 = word FROM @NumbersDigit
WHERE CONVERT(CHAR(1),@counter) = number
IF @charNumber = N'1' AND LEN(@inputNumber) > 1 AND @counter = 1 AND @nextNumber > N'0'
SET @outputChar = N'เอ็ด'
IF @charNumber = N'1' AND LEN(@inputNumber) >= 2 AND @counter = 2 SET @outputChar = N''
IF @charNumber = N'2' AND LEN(@inputNumber) >= 2 AND @counter = 2 SET @outputChar = N'ยี่'
IF @charNumber = N'0' SET @outputChar1 = N''
SELECT @outputString1 = @outputChar + @outputChar1 + @outputString1,
@counter = @counter + 1,
@loops = @loops - 1
END
IF @bigCount < @bigLoops
IF @outputString1 <> N''SET @outputString = @outputString + @outputString1 + N'ล้าน'
IF @bigCount >= @bigLoops SET @outputString = @outputString + @outputString1 + N'บาท'
SET @bigCount = @bigCount + 1
END
-- Decimal
IF LEN(@inputDecimal)= 1 SET @inputDecimal = N'0' + @inputDecimal
SET @inputNumber = @inputDecimal
SET @counter = 1
SET @loops = LEN(@inputNumber)
SET @outputString1 = N''
SET @nextNumber = SUBSTRING(@inputNumber,@loops-1,1)
WHILE 1 <= @loops BEGIN
SET @charNumber = SUBSTRING(@inputNumber,@loops,1)
SELECT @outputChar = word FROM @NumbersTable
WHERE @charNumber = number
SELECT @outputChar1 = word FROM @NumbersDigit
WHERE CONVERT(CHAR(1),@counter) = number
IF @charNumber = N'1' AND LEN(@inputNumber) > 1 AND @counter = 1 AND @nextNumber > N'0'
SET @outputChar = N'เอ็ด'
IF @charNumber = N'1' AND LEN(@inputNumber) >= 2 AND @counter = 2 SET @outputChar = N''
IF @charNumber = N'2' AND LEN(@inputNumber) >= 2 AND @counter = 2 SET @outputChar = N'ยี่'
IF @charNumber = N'0' SET @outputChar1 = ''
SELECT @outputString1 = @outputChar + @outputChar1 + @outputString1,
@counter = @counter + 1,
@loops = @loops - 1
END
IF @inputDecimal = N'00'
SET @outputString = @outPutString + N'ถ้วน'
ELSE SET @outputString = @outputString + @outputString1 + N'สตางค์'
RETURN @outputString -- return the result
END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[GenerateBarcode]
(
    @Text NVARCHAR(200)
)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(1000)
AS
BEGIN
    RETURN N'https://quickchart.io/barcode?type=code128&text=' 
           + @Text 
           + N'&width=500&height=60&includeText=true'
END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[GenerateQRCode](@text NVARCHAR(MAX))
RETURNS NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS
BEGIN
    RETURN N'https://quickchart.io/chart?cht=qr&chs=' 
           + CAST(250 AS NVARCHAR(10)) + N'x' + CAST(250 AS NVARCHAR(10))
           + N'&chl=' + @text
           + N'&chld=L|1' ;
END

modules.definition:
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[DS_LT_04_DebtorPortfolioStatus]
    -- บังคับ
    @StartDate DATE = NULL,
    @EndDate   DATE = NULL,
    -- ไม่บังคับ
    @LGNo        NVARCHAR(20)  = 'null',
    @DebtorCode  NVARCHAR(20)  = 'null',
    @DebtorName  NVARCHAR(400) = 'null',
    @PrintUserId INT = 0, -- ผู้สั่งพิมพ์
    @CollectorUserId  INT = 0,  -- เจ้าหน้าที่ผู้รับผิดชอบ (ติดตามหนี้)
    @DebtorTypeId INT = 0
    
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- NULL safety
    SET @LGNo       = ISNULL(@LGNo, 'null');
    SET @DebtorCode = ISNULL(@DebtorCode, 'null');
    SET @DebtorName = ISNULL(@DebtorName, 'null');

    -- BE -> CE
    SET @StartDate = CASE WHEN YEAR(@StartDate) > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @StartDate) ELSE @StartDate END;
    SET @EndDate   = CASE WHEN YEAR(@EndDate)   > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @EndDate)   ELSE @EndDate   END;

    ;WITH
    -- Count ผู้กู้หลักต่อ CIF
    CIFCount AS (
        SELECT
            CIFNo,
            COUNT(DISTINCT DebtorRelateId) AS CntByCIF
        FROM DataDebtorRelate
        WHERE DebtorTypeId = 1
        GROUP BY CIFNo
    ),
    -- ผู้ค้ำ 1 คนแรกต่อ LG
    GuarantorInfo AS (
        SELECT
            r2.LGNo,
            ISNULL(t2.TitleName + N' ', N'') + ISNULL(d2.DebtorName, N'') AS GuarantorName,
            ISNULL(d2.CntMobileNumber, d2.CntPhoneNumber) AS GuarantorPhone,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY r2.LGNo
                ORDER BY r2.DebtorRelateId
            ) AS rn
        FROM DataDebtorRelate r2
        JOIN DataDebtor d2
            ON d2.DebtorId = r2.DebtorId
        LEFT JOIN SystemTitleMaster t2
            ON t2.TitleId = d2.TitleId
        WHERE r2.DebtorTypeId = 3
    ),
    -- ผู้กู้ร่วม 1 คนแรกต่อ LG
    CoDebtorInfo AS (
        SELECT
            r3.LGNo,
            ISNULL(t3.TitleName + N' ', N'') + ISNULL(d3.DebtorName, N'') AS CoDebtorName,
            ISNULL(d3.CntMobileNumber, d3.CntPhoneNumber) AS CoDebtorPhone,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY r3.LGNo
                ORDER BY r3.DebtorRelateId
            ) AS rn
        FROM DataDebtorRelate r3
        JOIN DataDebtor d3
            ON d3.DebtorId = r3.DebtorId
        LEFT JOIN SystemTitleMaster t3
            ON t3.TitleId = d3.TitleId
        WHERE r3.DebtorTypeId = 2
    ),
    -- สถานะล่าสุดต่อ DebtorRelateId
    LatestStatus AS (
        SELECT *,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY DebtorRelateId
                   ORDER BY ISNULL(UpdateDate, CreateDate) DESC, DebtorStatusUpdateId DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM DataDebtorStatusUpdate
    ),
    -- ผู้ติดตามล่าสุดต่อ DebtorRelateId
    LatestAssign AS (
        SELECT
            DebtorRelateId,
            CollectorOAUserId,
            LegalUserId,
            LawOfficeUserId,
            UpdateDate,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY DebtorRelateId
                ORDER BY ISNULL(UpdateDate, CreateDate) DESC, AssignmentId DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM DataAssignment
    ),
    -- ที่อยู่ทะเบียนบ้าน default 1 แถวต่อ DebtorCode
    LatestAddress AS (
        SELECT
            DebtorCode,
            AddressNumber,
            Soi,
            Road,
            SubDistrictId,
            DistrictId,
            ProvinceId,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY DebtorCode
                ORDER BY ISNULL(UpdateDate, CreateDate) DESC, DebtorAddressId DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM DataDebtorAddress
        WHERE DebtorAddressTypeId = 7
          AND IsDefault = 1
    ),
    -- ข้อมูลบุคลากร 1 แถวต่อ UserId
    -- prefer: not deleted -> active -> latest row
    LatestPersonalInfo AS (
        SELECT
            UserId,
            FirstName,
            LastName,
            OrgStructureId,
            OrgSectionId,
            OrgSubSectionId,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY UserId
                ORDER BY
                    CASE WHEN ISNULL(IsDelete, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                    CASE WHEN ISNULL(IsActive, 0) = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                    ISNULL(UpdateDate, CreateDate) DESC,
                    PersonalInfoId DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM DataPersonalInfo
    ),
    -- ข้อมูลคดีล่าสุดต่อ DebtorRelateId
    LatestAssignCase AS (
        SELECT
            DebtorRelateId,
            CaseMainId,
            LegalUserId,
            LawOfficeUserId,
            CaseTypeId,
            EffectiveDate,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY DebtorRelateId
                ORDER BY ISNULL(UpdateDate, CreateDate) DESC, AssignCaseId DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM LTDataAssignCase
        WHERE ISNULL(IsCancel, 0) = 0
    ),
    -- สัญญา TDR ล่าสุดต่อ DebtorRelateId
    LatestTDR AS (
        SELECT
            t.DebtorRelateId,
            t.CompromiseContractId,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY t.DebtorRelateId
                ORDER BY
                    ISNULL(
                        NULLIF(c.ApproveDate, '1900-01-01'),
                        ISNULL(NULLIF(c.TDRDate, '1900-01-01'), ISNULL(t.UpdateDate, t.CreateDate))
                    ) DESC,
                    t.CompromiseContractLGId DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractLG t
        LEFT JOIN TDRDataCompromiseContract c
            ON c.CompromiseContractId = t.CompromiseContractId
        WHERE t.DebtorRelateId IS NOT NULL
          AND t.DebtorRelateId <> ''
    ),
    -- อายุหนี้ระดับ CIF
    LoanAgeCIF AS (
        SELECT
            r4.CIFNo,
            DATEDIFF(YEAR, MIN(dc4.ClaimPayDate), @EndDate) AS LoanAgYearsByCIF
        FROM DataDebtorRelate r4
        JOIN DataDebtorCard dc4
            ON dc4.DebtorRelateId = r4.DebtorRelateId
        WHERE r4.DebtorTypeId = 1
        GROUP BY r4.CIFNo
    ),
    -- เงินต้นคงเหลือรวมระดับ CIF
    PrincipalByCIF AS (
        SELECT
            r5.CIFNo,
            SUM(ISNULL(dc5.PrincipalTotal, 0)) AS PrincipalTotalByCIF
        FROM DataDebtorRelate r5
        JOIN DataDebtorCard dc5
            ON dc5.DebtorRelateId = r5.DebtorRelateId
        WHERE r5.DebtorTypeId = 1
        GROUP BY r5.CIFNo
    ),
    -- ยอดจ่ายชดเชยรวมระดับ CIF
    ClaimPayByCIF AS (
        SELECT
            r6.CIFNo,
            SUM(ISNULL(dc6.ClaimPay, 0)) AS ClaimPayByCIF
        FROM DataDebtorRelate r6
        JOIN DataDebtorCard dc6
            ON dc6.DebtorRelateId = r6.DebtorRelateId
        WHERE r6.DebtorTypeId = 1
        GROUP BY r6.CIFNo
    ),
    -- ยอดรับชำระปีปัจจุบันต่อ DebtorRelateId
    ReceiptAggCurrentYear AS (
        SELECT
            DebtorRelateId,
            SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ReceiptDate) = YEAR(@EndDate) AND ISNULL(IsCancel, 0) = 0 THEN ISNULL(PaymentAmount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS Amount_CurrentYear,
            SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ReceiptDate) = YEAR(@EndDate) AND MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 1  AND ISNULL(IsCancel, 0) = 0 THEN ISNULL(PaymentAmount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS Amount_M01,
            SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ReceiptDate) = YEAR(@EndDate) AND MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 2  AND ISNULL(IsCancel, 0) = 0 THEN ISNULL(PaymentAmount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS Amount_M02,
            SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ReceiptDate) = YEAR(@EndDate) AND MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 3  AND ISNULL(IsCancel, 0) = 0 THEN ISNULL(PaymentAmount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS Amount_M03,
            SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ReceiptDate) = YEAR(@EndDate) AND MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 4  AND ISNULL(IsCancel, 0) = 0 THEN ISNULL(PaymentAmount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS Amount_M04,
            SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ReceiptDate) = YEAR(@EndDate) AND MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 5  AND ISNULL(IsCancel, 0) = 0 THEN ISNULL(PaymentAmount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS Amount_M05,
            SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ReceiptDate) = YEAR(@EndDate) AND MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 6  AND ISNULL(IsCancel, 0) = 0 THEN ISNULL(PaymentAmount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS Amount_M06,
            SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ReceiptDate) = YEAR(@EndDate) AND MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 7  AND ISNULL(IsCancel, 0) = 0 THEN ISNULL(PaymentAmount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS Amount_M07,
            SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ReceiptDate) = YEAR(@EndDate) AND MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 8  AND ISNULL(IsCancel, 0) = 0 THEN ISNULL(PaymentAmount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS Amount_M08,
            SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ReceiptDate) = YEAR(@EndDate) AND MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 9  AND ISNULL(IsCancel, 0) = 0 THEN ISNULL(PaymentAmount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS Amount_M09,
            SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ReceiptDate) = YEAR(@EndDate) AND MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 10 AND ISNULL(IsCancel, 0) = 0 THEN ISNULL(PaymentAmount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS Amount_M10,
            SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ReceiptDate) = YEAR(@EndDate) AND MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 11 AND ISNULL(IsCancel, 0) = 0 THEN ISNULL(PaymentAmount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS Amount_M11,
            SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ReceiptDate) = YEAR(@EndDate) AND MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 12 AND ISNULL(IsCancel, 0) = 0 THEN ISNULL(PaymentAmount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS TotalPay_12,
            SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ReceiptDate) = YEAR(@EndDate) AND MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 12 AND ISNULL(IsCancel, 0) = 0 THEN ISNULL(PrincipalPay, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS CapitalPay_12,
            SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ReceiptDate) = YEAR(@EndDate) AND MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 12 AND ISNULL(IsCancel, 0) = 0 THEN ISNULL(AccruedInterestPay, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS IntPay_12,
            SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ReceiptDate) = YEAR(@EndDate) AND MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 12 AND ISNULL(IsCancel, 0) = 0 THEN ISNULL(CourtFeePay, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS CourtFeePay_12,
            SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ReceiptDate) = YEAR(@EndDate) AND MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 12 AND ISNULL(IsCancel, 0) = 0 THEN ISNULL(LawyerFeePay, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS LawyerFeePay_12,
            SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ReceiptDate) = YEAR(@EndDate) AND MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 12 AND ISNULL(IsCancel, 0) = 0 THEN ISNULL(OtherExpensePay, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS OtherPay_12,
            SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ReceiptDate) = YEAR(@EndDate) AND MONTH(ReceiptDate) BETWEEN 10 AND 12 AND ISNULL(IsCancel, 0) = 0 THEN ISNULL(PaymentAmount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS Payment_OctToDec
        FROM ACCDataReceipt
        GROUP BY DebtorRelateId
    ),
    -- ยอดชำระ ต.ค.-ธ.ค. ระดับ CIF
    ReceiptAggByCIF AS (
        SELECT
            rr.CIFNo,
            SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ar.ReceiptDate) = YEAR(@EndDate) AND MONTH(ar.ReceiptDate) BETWEEN 10 AND 12 AND ISNULL(ar.IsCancel, 0) = 0 THEN ISNULL(ar.PaymentAmount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS Payment_OctToDec_ByCIF
        FROM ACCDataReceipt ar
        JOIN DataDebtorRelate rr
            ON rr.DebtorRelateId = ar.DebtorRelateId
        WHERE rr.DebtorTypeId = 1
        GROUP BY rr.CIFNo
    )

    SELECT
        CAST(
            RIGHT('0' + CAST(DAY(@EndDate) AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2)
          + RIGHT('0' + CAST(MONTH(@EndDate) AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2)
          + CAST(YEAR(@EndDate) + 543 AS NVARCHAR(4))
            AS INT
        ) AS Asof,
        d.DebtorCode AS DebtorCode,
        d.DebtorCode AS Dup,
        r.CIFNo AS CIFCode,
        cc.CntByCIF AS [Count],
        r.LGNo AS LGNo,
        CASE
            WHEN ssm_c.StatusName IS NOT NULL THEN N'ประนอมหนี้'
            WHEN ssl.StatusLegalName IS NOT NULL THEN N'ดำเนินคดี'
            WHEN dc.CloseDate IS NOT NULL AND YEAR(dc.CloseDate) <> 1900 THEN N'ปิดบัญชี'
            ELSE ISNULL(spm.StatusPortName, N'unknown')
        END AS Group_112567_By_LG,
        CASE
            WHEN ssl.StatusLegalName IS NOT NULL THEN N'ดำเนินคดี'
            WHEN ssm_c.StatusName IS NOT NULL THEN N'ประนอมหนี้'
            WHEN dc.CloseDate IS NOT NULL AND YEAR(dc.CloseDate) <> 1900 THEN N'ปิดบัญชี'
            ELSE ISNULL(spm.StatusPortName, N'unknown')
        END AS Group_112567_By_CIF,
        ISNULL(ssl.StatusLegalName, ISNULL(ssm_c.StatusName, ISNULL(spm.StatusPortName, N'unknown'))) AS Group_Report_112567_Tris,
        ISNULL(spm.StatusPortName, N'unknown') AS Group_112567_By_MC,
        ISNULL(ssl.StatusLegalName, ISNULL(ssm_c.StatusName, ISNULL(spm.StatusPortName, N'unknown'))) AS Group_112567_By_MC_Detail,
        CASE
            WHEN ssm_c.StatusName IS NOT NULL THEN N'ประนอมหนี้'
            WHEN ssl.StatusLegalName IS NOT NULL THEN N'ดำเนินคดี'
            WHEN dc.CloseDate IS NOT NULL AND YEAR(dc.CloseDate) <> 1900 THEN N'ปิดบัญชี'
            ELSE ISNULL(spm.StatusPortName, N'unknown')
        END AS Group_122567_By_LG,
        CASE
            WHEN ssl.StatusLegalName IS NOT NULL THEN N'ดำเนินคดี'
            WHEN ssm_c.StatusName IS NOT NULL THEN N'ประนอมหนี้'
            WHEN dc.CloseDate IS NOT NULL AND YEAR(dc.CloseDate) <> 1900 THEN N'ปิดบัญชี'
            ELSE ISNULL(spm.StatusPortName, N'unknown')
        END AS Group_122567_By_CIF,
        ISNULL(ssl.StatusLegalName, ISNULL(ssm_c.StatusName, ISNULL(spm.StatusPortName, N'unknown'))) AS Group_Report_122567_Tris,
        ISNULL(spm.StatusPortName, N'unknown') AS Group_122567_By_MC,
        ISNULL(ssl.StatusLegalName, ISNULL(ssm_c.StatusName, ISNULL(spm.StatusPortName, N'unknown'))) AS Group_122567_By_MC_Detail,
        dc.CardType AS CardStatus,
        NULLIF(CAST(dc.CloseDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS AccountCloseDate,
        CASE WHEN dc.CloseDate IS NULL OR YEAR(dc.CloseDate) = 1900 THEN NULL ELSE YEAR(dc.CloseDate) END AS Y_AccountCloseDate,
        CASE WHEN dc.CloseDate IS NULL OR YEAR(dc.CloseDate) = 1900 THEN NULL ELSE MONTH(dc.CloseDate) END AS M_AccountCloseDate2,
        NULLIF(CAST(dc.BadDebtDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS Date_BadDebtWriteOff,
        CASE WHEN NULLIF(d.CompanyType, '') IS NOT NULL THEN N'นิติบุคคล' ELSE N'บุคคลธรรมดา' END AS BorrowerType_Column2,
        ISNULL(tm.TitleName + N' ', N'') + ISNULL(d.DebtorName, N'') AS Borrower,
        tm.TitleName AS BorrowerTitle,
        d.DebtorName AS BorrowerName,
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS T06Card_ID,
        gi.GuarantorName AS GuarantorName,
        ISNULL(d.CntMobileNumber, ISNULL(d.CntPhoneNumber, gi.GuarantorPhone)) AS BorrowerOrGuarantorContact,
        cdi.CoDebtorName AS CoBorrowerName,
        cdi.CoDebtorPhone AS BorrowerOrCoBorrowerContact,
        b.BankName AS BankNameFull,
        b.BankName AS BankName,
        b.GroupBank AS BankType,
        b.BankAbbrName AS BankShortName,
        bb.BankBranchName AS BankBranch,
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS BankBranchPhone,
        NULLIF(CAST(lg.LGDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS LGDate,
        bb.BankBranchName AS BranchOffice,
        bb.BankBranchName AS BranchOfficeNew,
        bb.BankBranchId AS BranchGroup,
        ct.ClaimTypeName AS MainGuarantorType,
        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(ct.IsMicro, 0) = 1 OR ct.ClaimTypeName LIKE N'%Micro%' THEN N'Micro'
            ELSE ISNULL(ct.ClaimTypeGroup, N'unknown')
        END AS Project,
        pt.ProjectTypeName AS ProjectType,
        CASE WHEN ISNULL(ct.IsManageFee, 0) = 1 THEN N'Subsidize' ELSE N'Non-Subsidize' END AS GuaranteeType,
        CASE WHEN ISNULL(ct.PortfolioTypeId, 0) = 1 THEN N'Package Guarantee' ELSE N'Individual Guarantee' END AS GuaranteeType_I,
        lgcbs.PayCoditionCode AS PaymentConditionCode,
        lgcbs.PayCoditionDetail AS PaymentCondition,
        NULLIF(CAST(dc.ClaimPayDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS PaymentDate,
        CASE WHEN dc.ClaimPayDate IS NULL OR YEAR(dc.ClaimPayDate) = 1900 THEN NULL ELSE YEAR(dc.ClaimPayDate) + 543 END AS PaymentYear,
        CASE WHEN dc.ClaimPayDate IS NULL OR YEAR(dc.ClaimPayDate) = 1900 THEN NULL ELSE MONTH(dc.ClaimPayDate) END AS PaymentMonth,
        DATEDIFF(YEAR, dc.ClaimPayDate, @EndDate) AS SomeFlag,
        CASE
            WHEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, dc.ClaimPayDate, @EndDate) > 10 THEN N'มากกว่า 10 ปี'
            WHEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, dc.ClaimPayDate, @EndDate) >= 7 THEN N'7-10 ปี'
            WHEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, dc.ClaimPayDate, @EndDate) >= 4 THEN N'4-6 ปี'
            WHEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, dc.ClaimPayDate, @EndDate) >= 1 THEN N'1-3ปี'
            ELSE N'น้อยกว่า 1 ปี'
        END AS LoanAgeGroup_MC,
        CASE
            WHEN lac.LoanAgYearsByCIF > 10 THEN N'มากกว่า 10 ปี'
            WHEN lac.LoanAgYearsByCIF >= 7 THEN N'7-10 ปี'
            WHEN lac.LoanAgYearsByCIF >= 4 THEN N'4-5 ปี'
            WHEN lac.LoanAgYearsByCIF >= 1 THEN N'1-3ปี'
            ELSE N'น้อยกว่า 1 ปี'
        END AS LoanAgeGroup_MC_ByCIF,
        lg.ClaimAmount AS GuaranteeBurden,
        dc.ClaimPay AS CutCompensationOnClose,
        dc.ClaimPay AS CompensationAmount,
        pp.PrincipalTotalByCIF AS PrincipalBalance_ByCIF,
        dc.PrincipalTotal AS PrincipalBalance,
        lgcbs.GradeCompare AS Grade,
        NULLIF(CAST(dc.ClaimPayDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS GradeRecognizeDate,
        NULLIF(CAST(dc.UpdateDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS GradeRecordDate,
        lgcbs.StatusLGCompare AS LGStatus,
        lgcbs.StatusDateCompare AS LGStatusDate,
        d.BusinessType AS BusinessCode,
        d.BusinessTypeName AS BusinessType,
        d.CompanyType AS BusinessCategory,
        d.CompanyTypeDescription AS BusinessDescription,
        da.AddressNumber AS HouseNumber,
        da.Soi AS Alley,
        da.Road AS Road,
        dbo.FN_GetSubDistrictName(da.SubDistrictId) AS SubDistrict,
        dbo.FN_GetDistrictName(da.DistrictId) AS District,
        pv.Name AS Province,
        cm.StatusProsecutionId AS CaseProcessCode,
        ssl.StatusLegalName AS CaseProcessDescription,
        d.FixedAssetValue AS NetFixedAssets,
        lg.EmploymentQty AS Employment,
        lg.IncEmploymentQty AS EmploymentIncrease,
        d.ISICCode AS ISICCode,
        N'unknown' AS BusinessType1,
        lg.Income AS Revenue,
        N'unknown' AS BusinessSize_SME_OSMEP,
        N'unknown' AS PaymentGroup,
        dc.InterestRate AS InterestRate,
        dc.AccruedInterest AS AccruedInterest,
        dc.SuspendInt AS SuspendedInterest,
        ISNULL(dc.SuspendInt, 0) - ISNULL(dc.SuspendIntPay, 0) AS SuspendedInterestBalance,
        dc.DeferredInterest AS HangingInterest,
        dc.DeferredInterestPay AS HangingInterestPaid,
        ISNULL(dc.DeferredInterest, 0) - ISNULL(dc.DeferredInterestPay, 0) AS HangingInterestBalance,
        scam.CampaignName AS Campaign,
        dc.InterestRate AS InterestRate1,
        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(la.CollectorOAUserId, 0) > 0
                THEN ISNULL(pi_coll.FirstName + N' ', N'') + ISNULL(pi_coll.LastName, N'')
            ELSE CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(200))
        END AS TK_OfficerName,
        NULLIF(CAST(la.UpdateDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS TK_LastFollowUpDate,
        ssm_d.StatusName AS TK_DebtorStatus1,
        NULLIF(CAST(su.StatusDebtorDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS TK_DebtorStatus1RecordDate,
        scm.StatusCollectorName AS TK_DebtFollowUpStatus2,
        NULLIF(CAST(su.StatusCollectorDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS TK_DebtFollowUpStatus2RecordDate,
        ssm_c.StatusName AS TK_RehabilitationStatusByLG,
        NULLIF(CAST(su.StatusCompromiseDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS TK_RehabilitationStatusByLGRecordDate,
        ssl.StatusLegalName AS TK_CaseStatus,
        NULLIF(CAST(su.StatusLegalDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS TK_CaseStatusRecordDate,
        tcc.ContractNo AS TK_RehabilitationNumber,
        NULLIF(CAST(tcc.DebtRequestDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS TK_DebtStatusLetterDate,
        NULLIF(CAST(tcc.ApproveDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS TK_StructuralApprovalDate,
        CAST(scam.CampaignId AS NVARCHAR(20)) AS TK_CampaignCode,
        scam.CampaignName AS TK_CampaignName,
        ct.ClaimTypeName AS TK_ProjectName,
        d.DebtorName AS TK_DebtorName,
        ssm_c.StatusName AS TK_RehabilitationStatusByCIF,
        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(ac.LegalUserId, 0) > 0
                THEN ISNULL(pi_legal.FirstName + N' ', N'') + ISNULL(pi_legal.LastName, N'')
            ELSE CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(200))
        END AS Case_Officer,
        ctm.CaseTypeName AS Case_Type,
        N'unknown' AS Case_GroupByCIF,
        ssl.StatusLegalName AS Case_ReportGroupTris,
        ssl.StatusLegalName AS Case_ReportGroupMC,
        ssl.StatusLegalName AS Case_ReportGroupMC_Insurance,
        N'unknown' AS Case_PortStatus,
        N'unknown' AS Case_GuaranteeStatus,
        NULLIF(CAST(ac.EffectiveDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS Case_ApprovalDate,
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.EnforcemetApproveDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS Case_ApprovalDate_Usurpation,
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.EnforcemetApplyDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS Case_PetitionDate_Usurpation,
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.PetitionDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS Case_CourtOrderDate_Usurpation,
        ssl.StatusLegalName AS Case_BOTStepStatus,
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.SendLawyerDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS Case_DocumentSentToLawyerDate,
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.FilingDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS Case_LawsuitFilingDate,
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.FirstTrialDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS Case_FirstTrialDate,
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.FrozenAssetDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS Case_BaSoiAssetProtectionDate,
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.JmTrialDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS Case_FirstJudgmentDate,
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.WarrantDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS Case_WarrantIssueDate,
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.AppealDueDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS Case_AppealDeadlineDate,
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.AppealDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS Case_AppealFilingDate,
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.JmAppealDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS Case_AppealJudgmentDate,
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.SupremeDueDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS Case_SupremeDeadlineDate,
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.SupremeDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS Case_SupremeFilingDate,
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.JmSupremeDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS Case_SupremeJudgmentDate,
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.NoticeAssetDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS Case_AssetInvestigationNoticeDate,
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.InvestigationDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS Case_AssetInvestigationDate,
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.NoticeSeizePropertyDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS Case_AssetSeizureNoticeDate,
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.SeizePropertyDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS Case_AssetSeizureDate,
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.OtherFrozenAssDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS Case_OtherAssetProtectionDate,
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.ReqRepayDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS Case_DebtPaymentRequestDate,
        cm.BlackCaseNo AS Case_CivilCaseNumber,
        cm.RedCaseNo AS Case_CriminalCaseNumber,
        cm.JudgementNote AS Case_Remarks,
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.RoyalDecreeDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS Case_MunicipalAnnouncementDate,
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.AlertDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS Case_CaseSuspensionDate,
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.AcknowDebtDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS Case_DebtAcknowledgementDate,
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.WithdrawDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS Case_BaSoiCaseWithdrawalDate,
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.PayOffDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS Case_FullPaymentDate,
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.BadDebtDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS Case_WriteOffDate,
        cm.CapitalFile AS Case_LawsuitPrincipalAmount,
        cm.IntToFileAmount AS Case_InterestUntilFilingDate,
        ISNULL(cm.CapitalFile, 0) + ISNULL(cm.IntToFileAmount, 0) AS Case_LawsuitValue,
        cm.CapitalAppeal AS Case_AppealValue,
        cm.CapitalSupreme AS Case_SupremeCourtValue,
        cm.RedCaseNoBank AS Case_CriminalCaseNumber_Usurpation,
        N'unknown' AS Case_PlaintiffBank,
        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(ac.LawOfficeUserId, 0) > 0
                THEN ISNULL(pi_law.FirstName + N' ', N'') + ISNULL(pi_law.LastName, N'')
            ELSE CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(200))
        END AS Case_LawyerOffice,
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.JudgmentBankruptcyDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS Case_BankruptcyJudgmentDate,
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.BankruptcyDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS Case_BankruptcyReleaseDate,
        d.BusinessStatus AS Case_BusinessStatus,
        NULLIF(CAST(d.BusinessStatusDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01') AS Case_BusinessStatusDate,
        ISNULL(ry.Amount_CurrentYear, 0) AS Amount_2567,
        ISNULL(ry.Amount_M01, 0) AS Amount_M01_2567,
        ISNULL(ry.Amount_M02, 0) AS Amount_M02_2567,
        ISNULL(ry.Amount_M03, 0) AS Amount_M03_2567,
        ISNULL(ry.Amount_M04, 0) AS Amount_M04_2567,
        ISNULL(ry.Amount_M05, 0) AS Amount_M05_2567,
        ISNULL(ry.Amount_M06, 0) AS Amount_M06_2567,
        ISNULL(ry.Amount_M07, 0) AS Amount_M07_2567,
        ISNULL(ry.Amount_M08, 0) AS Amount_M08_2567,
        ISNULL(ry.Amount_M09, 0) AS Amount_M09_2567,
        ISNULL(ry.Amount_M10, 0) AS Amount_M10_2567,
        ISNULL(ry.Amount_M11, 0) AS Amount_M11_2567,
        ISNULL(ry.TotalPay_12, 0) AS TotalPay_12,
        ISNULL(ry.CapitalPay_12, 0) AS CapitalPay_12,
        ISNULL(ry.IntPay_12, 0) AS IntPay_12,
        CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS DefaultIntPay_12,
        ISNULL(ry.CourtFeePay_12, 0) AS CourtFeePay_12,
        ISNULL(ry.LawyerFeePay_12, 0) AS LawyerFeePay_12,
        ISNULL(ry.OtherPay_12, 0) AS OtherPay_12,
        smeas.MeasureName AS ColorMeasure,
        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(la.CollectorOAUserId, 0) > 0 AND pi_coll.OrgStructureId = 47 THEN N'OA'
            WHEN ISNULL(la.CollectorOAUserId, 0) > 0 AND pi_coll.OrgStructureId = 34 THEN N'ฝ่ายบริหารหนี้'
            WHEN ISNULL(la.CollectorOAUserId, 0) > 0 THEN ISNULL(os_coll.OrgStructureName, N'unknown')
            WHEN ISNULL(ac.LegalUserId, 0) > 0 AND pi_legal.OrgStructureId = 34 THEN N'ฝ่ายบริหารหนี้'
            WHEN ISNULL(ac.LegalUserId, 0) > 0 THEN ISNULL(os_legal.OrgStructureName, N'unknown')
            ELSE N'unknown'
        END AS BU,
        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(la.CollectorOAUserId, 0) > 0 AND pi_coll.OrgStructureId = 47 THEN N'OA'
            WHEN ISNULL(la.CollectorOAUserId, 0) > 0 THEN ISNULL(sec_coll.SectionNameTH, N'unknown')
            WHEN ISNULL(ac.LegalUserId, 0) > 0 THEN ISNULL(sec_legal.SectionNameTH, N'unknown')
            ELSE N'unknown'
        END AS DebtTrackingTeam,
        CASE WHEN ISNULL(pp.PrincipalTotalByCIF, 0) > 200000 THEN N'>0.2MB' ELSE N'<=0.2MB' END AS CreditLimitCategory,
        ISNULL(ry.Payment_OctToDec, 0) AS Payment_OctToDec,
        ISNULL(rcif.Payment_OctToDec_ByCIF, 0) AS Payment_OctToDec_ByCIF,
        CASE WHEN tclg.CompromiseContractId IS NOT NULL THEN N'Y' ELSE N'N' END AS EverTDR,
        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(la.CollectorOAUserId, 0) > 0
                THEN ISNULL(pi_coll.FirstName + N' ', N'') + ISNULL(pi_coll.LastName, N'')
            WHEN ISNULL(ac.LegalUserId, 0) > 0
                THEN ISNULL(pi_legal.FirstName + N' ', N'') + ISNULL(pi_legal.LastName, N'')
            ELSE CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(200))
        END AS CurrentOfficer,
        ISNULL(ssm_c.StatusName, N'unknown') AS Status_TDR_230168,

        N'วันที่พิมพ์ : ' + dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(GETDATE()) AS PrintDate,
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(200)) AS PrintName
    FROM DataDebtorRelate r
    JOIN DataDebtor d
        ON d.DebtorId = r.DebtorId
    JOIN DataLG lg
        ON lg.LGNo = r.LGNo
    JOIN DataDebtorCard dc
        ON dc.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId
    JOIN CIFCount cc
        ON cc.CIFNo = r.CIFNo
    LEFT JOIN LatestStatus su
        ON su.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId
       AND su.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN DataLGCBS lgcbs
        ON lgcbs.LGNo = r.LGNo
    LEFT JOIN SystemBankMaster b
        ON b.BankId = lg.BankId
    LEFT JOIN SystemBankBranchMaster bb
        ON bb.BankBranchId = lg.BankBranchId
    LEFT JOIN SystemClaimTypeMaster ct
        ON ct.ClaimTypeId = lg.ClaimTypeId
    LEFT JOIN SystemProjectTypeMaster pt
        ON pt.ProjectTypeId = ct.ProjectTypeId
    LEFT JOIN SystemTitleMaster tm
        ON tm.TitleId = d.TitleId
    LEFT JOIN LatestAddress da
        ON da.DebtorCode = d.DebtorCode
       AND da.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN SystemProvinceMaster pv
        ON pv.ProvinceId = da.ProvinceId
    LEFT JOIN SystemZoneMaster zn
        ON zn.ZoneId = pv.ZoneId
    LEFT JOIN SystemStatusPortMaster spm
        ON spm.StatusPortId = su.StatusPortId
    LEFT JOIN SystemStatusCollectorMaster scm
        ON scm.StatusCollectorId = su.StatusCollectorId
    LEFT JOIN SystemStatusLegalMaster ssl
        ON ssl.StatusLegalId = su.StatusLegalId
    LEFT JOIN SystemStatusMaster ssm_d
        ON ssm_d.SystemStatusId = su.StatusDebtorId
    LEFT JOIN SystemStatusMaster ssm_c
        ON ssm_c.SystemStatusId = su.StatusCompromiseId
    LEFT JOIN LatestAssignCase ac
        ON ac.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId
       AND ac.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN LTDataCaseMain cm
        ON cm.CaseMainId = ac.CaseMainId
    LEFT JOIN SystemCaseTypeMaster ctm
        ON ctm.CaseTypeId = ISNULL(cm.CaseTypeId, ac.CaseTypeId)
    LEFT JOIN LatestPersonalInfo pi_legal
        ON pi_legal.UserId = ac.LegalUserId
       AND pi_legal.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN SystemOrgStructure os_legal
        ON os_legal.OrgStructureId = pi_legal.OrgStructureId
    LEFT JOIN SystemOrgSectionMaster sec_legal
        ON sec_legal.OrgSectionId = pi_legal.OrgSectionId
    LEFT JOIN LatestPersonalInfo pi_law
        ON pi_law.UserId = ac.LawOfficeUserId
       AND pi_law.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN LatestAssign la
        ON la.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId
       AND la.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN LatestPersonalInfo pi_coll
        ON pi_coll.UserId = la.CollectorOAUserId
       AND pi_coll.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN SystemOrgStructure os_coll
        ON os_coll.OrgStructureId = pi_coll.OrgStructureId
    LEFT JOIN SystemOrgSectionMaster sec_coll
        ON sec_coll.OrgSectionId = pi_coll.OrgSectionId
    LEFT JOIN LatestTDR tclg
        ON tclg.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId
       AND tclg.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN TDRDataCompromiseContract tcc
        ON tcc.CompromiseContractId = tclg.CompromiseContractId
    LEFT JOIN SystemCampaignMaster scam
        ON scam.CampaignId = tcc.DebtRequestId
    LEFT JOIN SystemMeasureMaster smeas
        ON smeas.MeasureId = tcc.MeasureId
    LEFT JOIN GuarantorInfo gi
        ON gi.LGNo = r.LGNo
       AND gi.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN CoDebtorInfo cdi
        ON cdi.LGNo = r.LGNo
       AND cdi.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN LoanAgeCIF lac
        ON lac.CIFNo = r.CIFNo
    LEFT JOIN PrincipalByCIF pp
        ON pp.CIFNo = r.CIFNo
    LEFT JOIN ClaimPayByCIF pcif
        ON pcif.CIFNo = r.CIFNo
    LEFT JOIN ReceiptAggCurrentYear ry
        ON ry.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN ReceiptAggByCIF rcif
        ON rcif.CIFNo = r.CIFNo
    WHERE r.DebtorTypeId = 1
      AND CAST(dc.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
      AND (@DebtorCode = 'null' OR d.DebtorCode = @DebtorCode)
      AND (@LGNo = 'null' OR r.LGNo = @LGNo)
      AND (@DebtorName = 'null' OR d.DebtorName LIKE N'%' + @DebtorName + N'%')
      AND (@CollectorUserId = 0 OR la.CollectorOAUserId = @CollectorUserId)
    ORDER BY r.LGNo, d.DebtorCode;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[RP_TDR_04_ContractCancel]
	-- นำเข้าข้อมูลลูกหนี้ DataDebtor

	@ID nvarchar(150) = 'b857ec57-bfb2-4f4f-b7b3-aff329d9c2ff'
	
AS
BEGIN

   Select
	     dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(c.RequestDate) AS  contract_start_date
		,cd.DebtorName AS  contractor_name
		,case when cast(d.BirthDate as date) = cast('1900-01-01' as date) then '' else DATEDIFF(YEAR, d.BirthDate, c.RequestDate) end AS  age
		,CAST('โสด'		AS VARCHAR(20))									AS  employment_status
		,d.IDCard AS	citizen_id
		,CAST('ที่ 28/16 ซอย พหลโยธิน 19 ถนน พหลโยธิน'  AS VARCHAR(255))		AS	address_no
		,CAST('ลาดยาว'		AS VARCHAR(255))								AS	subdistrict
		,CAST('จตุจักร'		AS VARCHAR(255))								AS	district
		,CAST('กรุงเทพมหานคร'	AS VARCHAR(255))								AS	province
		,CAST('10900'		AS VARCHAR(10))								AS	postal_code
		,CAST('ห้างหุ้นส่วนจำกัดสุทธิพงษ์ทัวร์'		AS	VARCHAR(20))				AS	contract_company_name
		,b.BankName AS	contract_bank_name
		,clg.LGNo AS	guarantee_no
		,dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(c.RequestDate) AS	contract_date
		,dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(lg.ClaimDate) AS	payment_date
		,lg.ClaimAmount AS	payment_amount
		,dbo.Fn_ThaiBaht(lg.ClaimAmount) AS	payment_amount_text

		from TDRDataCompromiseContractDebtor cd
		left join TDRDataCompromiseContractLG clg on clg.CompromiseContractId = cd.CompromiseContractId
		left join TDRDataCompromiseContract c on c.CompromiseContractId = cd.CompromiseContractId
		left join DataLG lg on lg.LGNo = clg.LGNo
		left join SystemBankMaster b on b.BankId = lg.BankId
		left join DataDebtor d on d.DebtorId = cd.DebtorId
		where cd.IsMain!=1
		and cd.CompromiseContractDebtorId = @ID
		
END

-- ============================================================
-- SP_ACC_002_eStatementTransactionTransfer
-- รับ @InformPaymentId แล้ว INSERT ข้อมูลโอนลอย/bill ref ผิด เข้า Output_eStatementTransfer
-- [แก้ 2026-07-22] UpdateDate เดิมดึงจาก ACCDataInformPayment.UpdateDate (วันที่เก่าในอดีต)
--       ทำให้แถวที่ถูก insert จาก reconciliation job (SP_INTERFACE_015) ไม่มีทางถูก
--       export ออกไปในไฟล์รายวันเลย เพราะ UpdateDate ไม่ตรงกับวันที่ insert จริง
--       แก้ให้ใช้ GETDATE() ตรงๆ เหมือน SP_ACC_003_eStatementReceipt
-- ============================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_ACC_002_eStatementTransactionTransfer]
    @InformPaymentId nvarchar(150)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    ;WITH SourceRows AS
    (
        SELECT
            e.StatementNo               AS BillPaymentNo,
            p.InformPaymentNo           AS DocNo,
            e.PaymentDate               AS PayDate,
            r.CIFNo                     AS CIFNo,
            e.CustomerName              AS CustomerName,
            e.Amount                    AS PayAmount,
            e.BankCode                  AS BankCode,
            e.BankName                  AS BankName,
            e.BankBranchCode            AS BranchCode,
            e.BankBranchName            AS BranchName,
            1                           AS [Status],
            '01'                        AS TransactionStatus,
            GETDATE()                   AS UpdateDate,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER
            (
                PARTITION BY
                    p.InformPaymentId,
                    e.StatementNo,
                    p.InformPaymentNo,
                    e.EStatementId
                ORDER BY
                    CASE WHEN r.CIFNo IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
                    e.UpdateDate DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM [dbo].ACCDataInformPaymentEStatement ed
        INNER JOIN [dbo].ACCDataInformPayment p
            ON p.InformPaymentId = ed.InformPaymentId
        INNER JOIN [dbo].DataEStatement e
            ON e.EStatementId = ed.EStatementId
        OUTER APPLY
        (
            SELECT TOP (1)
                pd.LGNo
            FROM [dbo].ACCDataInformPaymentDetail pd
            WHERE pd.InformPaymentId = p.InformPaymentId
        ) pd
        OUTER APPLY
        (
            SELECT TOP (1)
                r0.CIFNo
            FROM [dbo].DataDebtorRelate r0
            WHERE r0.LGNo = pd.LGNo
        ) r
        WHERE p.InformPaymentId = @InformPaymentId
          AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(p.InformPaymentNo)), '') IS NOT NULL
    )
    INSERT INTO [dbo].[Output_eStatementTransfer]
    (
        [eStatementTransferId],
        [BillPaymentNo],
        [DocNo],
        [PayDate],
        [CIFNo],
        [CustomerName],
        [PayAmount],
        [BankCode],
        [BankName],
        [BranchCode],
        [BranchName],
        [Status],
        [TransactionStatus],
        [UpdateDate]
    )
    SELECT
        NEWID(),
        s.BillPaymentNo,
        s.DocNo,
        s.PayDate,
        s.CIFNo,
        s.CustomerName,
        s.PayAmount,
        s.BankCode,
        s.BankName,
        s.BranchCode,
        s.BranchName,
        s.[Status],
        s.TransactionStatus,
        s.UpdateDate
    FROM SourceRows s
    WHERE s.rn = 1
      AND NOT EXISTS
      (
          SELECT 1
          FROM [dbo].[Output_eStatementTransfer] o
          WHERE o.DocNo = s.DocNo
            AND ISNULL(o.BillPaymentNo, '') = ISNULL(s.BillPaymentNo, '')
            AND ISNULL(o.[Status], '') = ISNULL(s.[Status], '')
            AND ISNULL(o.TransactionStatus, '') = ISNULL(s.TransactionStatus, '')
      );
END

-- ============================================================
-- SP_ACC_002_eStatementTransactionTransfer
-- รับ @InformPaymentId แล้ว INSERT ข้อมูลโอนลอย/bill ref ผิด
-- เข้า Output_eStatementTransfer
-- ============================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_ACC_002_eStatementTransactionTransfer_Backup]
    @InformPaymentId nvarchar(150)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    INSERT INTO [dbo].[Output_eStatementTransfer]
    (
        [eStatementTransferId],
        [BillPaymentNo],
        [DocNo],
        [PayDate],
        [CIFNo],
        [CustomerName],
        [PayAmount],
        [BankName],
        [BranchName],
        [Status],
        [TransactionStatus],
        [UpdateDate]
    )
    SELECT
        NEWID()                     AS eStatementTransferId,
        e.StatementNo               AS BillPaymentNo,
        p.InformPaymentNo           AS DocNo,
        e.PaymentDate               AS PayDate,
        r.CIFNo                     AS CIFNo,
        e.CustomerName              AS CustomerName,
        e.Amount                    AS PayAmount,
        e.BankName                  AS BankName,
        e.BankBranchName            AS BranchName,
        1                           AS [Status],    -- โอนลอยจาก DCS / bill ref ผิด
        '01'                        AS TransactionStatus,
        p.UpdateDate                AS UpdateDate
    FROM [dbo].ACCDataInformPaymentEStatement ed
    LEFT JOIN ACCDataInformPayment p
        ON p.InformPaymentId = ed.InformPaymentId
    LEFT JOIN SystemLookupMaster l
        ON l.LookupId = p.InformPaymentTypeId
    LEFT JOIN DataEStatement e
        ON e.EStatementId = ed.EStatementId
    LEFT JOIN ACCDataInformPaymentDetail pd
        ON pd.InformPaymentId = p.InformPaymentId
    LEFT JOIN DataDebtorRelate r
        ON r.LGNo = pd.LGNo
    WHERE p.InformPaymentId = @InformPaymentId;
END

create PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_ACC_005_eStatementReceipt_Cancel]


@InformPaymentId nvarchar(150) = '4d21270a-801d-4b54-ab04-6324b24c35b4'

	
AS
BEGIN

INSERT INTO [dbo].[Output_eStatementReceipt]
           ([eStatementReceiptId]
           ,[MappingReceiptId]
           ,[BillPaymentNo]
           ,[No]
           ,[ReceiptNo]
           ,[RequestNo]
           ,[LGNo]
           ,[ReceiptAmount]
           ,[ReceiptDate]
           ,[ReceiptType]
           ,[StatusReceipt]
           ,[CheckDate]
           ,[PaymentDes2]
           ,[StatusES]
           ,[CreateUser]
           ,[Type1]
           ,[Type2]
           ,[BankCode]
           ,[TanReceiptNo]
           ,[Status]
           ,[TransStatus]
           ,[CreateDate]
           ,[UpdateDate]
           ,[IsUpdateCard]
           ,[InformPaymentNo]
					 ,[EStatementId])

select 
newid() as eStatementReceiptId
,e.StatementNo as MappingReceiptId
,e.StatementNo as BillPaymentNo
,'' as [No]
,r.ReceiptNo as ReceiptNo
,'' as RequestNo --ส่งค่าว่าง ระบบ DCS ไม่ใช้ ของระบบอื่นใช้
,r.LGNo as LGNo
,r.PaymentAmount as ReceiptAmount
,r.ReceiptDate as ReceiptDate
,'' as ReceiptType
,1 as StatusReceipt --fix 1 ตลอด
,dateadd(year, 543, r.ReceiptDate) as CheckDate
,dateadd(year, 543, r.ReceiptDate) as PaymentDes2
,'' as StatusES --ส่งค่าว่าง ระบบ DCS ไม่ใช้ ของระบบอื่นใช้
,1 as CreateUser
,'' as Type1 --ส่งค่าว่าง ระบบ DCS ไม่ใช้ ของระบบอื่นใช้
,'' as Type2 --ส่งค่าว่าง ระบบ DCS ไม่ใช้ ของระบบอื่นใช้
,e.BankCode as BankCode
,'' as TanReceiptNo
,2 as [Status]
,'01' as TransStatus
,getdate() as CreateDate
,getdate() as UpdateDate
,0 as IsUpdateCard
,i.InformPaymentNo as InformPaymentNo
,ep.eStatementId as EStatementId


from ACCDataInformPaymentEStatement ep
left join DataEStatement e on e.EStatementId = ep.eStatementId
left join ACCDataReceipt r on r.ReceiptId = e.ReceiptId
left join ACCDataInformPayment i on i.InformPaymentId = ep.InformPaymentId
where ep.TypeId = 3
and ep.InformPaymentId = @InformPaymentId


		   

END

--begin

SELECT top 1

      ,0 as [InstallmentPay]
