CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_ACC_Adjust_002_10_InsertAdjust_AccruedInterestClosed]
	-- insert ดอกเบี้ย ทุกมาตรการ
	@GetDate date = '2025-09-30'
	,@DebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = 'E4133024-F1A7-4E3F-9A4C-35B4732C2213'
	,@TypeId int = 24 -- 24 ปรับปรุงรายการดอกเบี้ยค้างรับ (ปิดบัญชี)
	,@IsMonth int = 0 --0=ตรงเดือน, 1=ข้ามเดือน
	
	,@CreateBy int = 1 --ผู้สร้าง


	
	
AS
BEGIN


DECLARE @TypeCode nvarchar(2) 
DECLARE @TypeName nvarchar(100) 
DECLARE @PrincipalPay decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @PlannedInterestPay decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @DefaultInterestPay decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @AccruedInterestPay  decimal(20,4) = 0

DECLARE @CourtFeePay decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @LawyerFeePay decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @OtherExpensePay decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @InitialMarginPay decimal(20,4) = 0

DECLARE @SuspendIntPay decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @DeferredInterestPay decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @SuspendedDefaultInterestPay decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @TotalPay decimal(20,4) = 0

 (select @TypeName = PaymentTypeName 
 , @TypeCode = PaymentTypeCode
 from SystemPaymentType 
 where PaymentTypeId = @TypeId)

 DECLARE @DefaultDate date = '1900-01-01'

declare @SeqNext int = (select SeqNext from DataDebtorCard where DataDebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId)
declare @SeqCurrent int = (select SeqCurrent from DataDebtorCard where DataDebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId)
declare @SeqNo int = (select top 1 SeqNo+3 from DataDebtorCardMovement where DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId order by SeqNo desc)
select @SeqCurrent
--select top 1
-- @PlannedInterestPay = PlannedInterestTotal
--, @DefaultInterestPay = DefaultInterestTotal
--, @AccruedInterestPay = AccruedInterestTotal

--, @CourtFeePay = CourtFeeTotal
--, @LawyerFeePay = LawyerFeeTotal
--, @OtherExpensePay = OtherExpenseTotal
--, @InitialMarginPay = InitialMarginTotal

--, @SuspendIntPay = SuspendIntTotal
--, @DeferredInterestPay = DeferredInterestTotal
--, @SuspendedDefaultInterestPay = SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal
--, @TotalPay =  AccruedInterestTotal 
--from DataDebtorCardMovement
--where SeqNo = @SeqCurrent
--and DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
--order by SeqNo desc

if(@IsMonth = 0)
begin
		

		select top 1
		  @PrincipalPay = PrincipalTotal
		, @PlannedInterestPay = PlannedInterestTotal
		, @DefaultInterestPay = DefaultInterestTotal
		, @AccruedInterestPay = AccruedInterestTotal

		, @CourtFeePay = CourtFeeTotal
		, @LawyerFeePay = LawyerFeeTotal
		, @OtherExpensePay = OtherExpenseTotal
		, @InitialMarginPay = InitialMarginTotal

		, @SuspendIntPay = SuspendIntTotal
		, @DeferredInterestPay = DeferredInterestTotal
		, @SuspendedDefaultInterestPay = SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal
		, @TotalPay = PrincipalTotal + AccruedInterestTotal + CourtFeeTotal + LawyerFeeTotal + OtherExpenseTotal + InitialMarginTotal
		from DataDebtorCardMovement
		where DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
		order by SeqNo desc
end
if(@IsMonth = 1)
begin
		select top 1
		  @PrincipalPay = PrincipalTotal
		, @PlannedInterestPay = PlannedInterestTotal
		, @DefaultInterestPay = DefaultInterestTotal
		, @AccruedInterestPay = AccruedInterestTotal

		, @CourtFeePay = CourtFeeTotal
		, @LawyerFeePay = LawyerFeeTotal
		, @OtherExpensePay = OtherExpenseTotal
		, @InitialMarginPay = InitialMarginTotal

		, @SuspendIntPay = SuspendIntTotal
		, @DeferredInterestPay = DeferredInterestTotal
		, @SuspendedDefaultInterestPay = SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal
		, @TotalPay = PrincipalTotal + AccruedInterestTotal + CourtFeeTotal + LawyerFeeTotal + OtherExpenseTotal + InitialMarginTotal
		from TDRDataCompromiseContractRecalCard
		where DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
		and SeqNo = @SeqNo-1
end


--============= 1 insert ลง tmp

SELECT top 1 [DebtorCardMovementId]
      ,[DebtorCardId]
      ,getdate() as [DocDate]
      ,@GetDate as [PayDate]
      ,[LGNo]
      ,[DebtorId]
      ,[DebtorCode]
      ,[DebtorCardCode]
      ,[DebtorCardName]
      ,@TypeId as [TypeId]
      ,@TypeCode as [TypeCode]
      ,@TypeName as [TypeName]
      ,[FlagAutoPay]
      ,@DefaultDate as [DFDDate]
      ,@DefaultDate as [DFDStartDate]
      ,@DefaultDate as [DFDEndDate]
      ,0 as [DPD]
      ,@TotalPay as [TotalPay]
      ,1 as [IsAdjust]
      ,[AdjustRefDocNo]
      ,0 as [IsDelete]
      ,[MeasureId]
      ,[MeasureCode]
      ,[MeasureName]
      ,0 as [InterestRate]
      ,0 as [InterestPlannedRate]
      ,0 as [InterestDefaultRate]
      ,PrincipalTotal as [DebtBalance]
      ,@TotalPay as [ReceivePayment]
      ,[Installment]
      ,[InstallmentPay]
      ,[InstallmentTotal]
      ,[Principal]
      ,0 as [PrincipalPay]
      ,[PrincipalTotal]
      ,0 as [InterimInterest]
      ,[AccruedInterest]
      ,@AccruedInterestPay as [AccruedInterestPay]
      ,0 as [AccruedInterestTotal]
      ,[CourtFee]
      ,@CourtFeePay as [CourtFeePay]
      ,[CourtFeeTotal]
      ,[LawyerFee]
      ,@LawyerFeePay as [LawyerFeePay]
      ,[LawyerFeeTotal]
      ,[OtherExpense]
      ,@OtherExpensePay as [OtherExpensePay]
      ,[OtherExpenseTotal]
      ,[InitialMargin]
      ,@InitialMarginPay as [InitialMarginPay]

	,@TypeId int = 25 -- 25 ปรับปรุงรายการ (ส่วนลดจากการHaircut)
	,@PrincipalPay decimal(20,4) = 0
	,@IsMonth int = 0 --0=ตรงเดือน, 1=ข้ามเดือน
	
	,@CreateBy int = 1 --ผู้สร้าง


	
	
AS
BEGIN


DECLARE @TypeCode nvarchar(2) 
DECLARE @TypeName nvarchar(100) 
-- DECLARE @PrincipalPay decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @PlannedInterestPay decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @DefaultInterestPay decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @AccruedInterestPay  decimal(20,4) = 0

DECLARE @CourtFeePay decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @LawyerFeePay decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @OtherExpensePay decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @InitialMarginPay decimal(20,4) = 0

DECLARE @SuspendIntPay decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @DeferredInterestPay decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @SuspendedDefaultInterestPay decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @TotalPay decimal(20,4) = 0
declare @SeqNo int = (select top 1 SeqNo+3 from DataDebtorCardMovement where DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId order by SeqNo desc)
 (select @TypeName = PaymentTypeName 
 , @TypeCode = PaymentTypeCode
 from SystemPaymentType 
 where PaymentTypeId = @TypeId)

 DECLARE @DefaultDate date = '1900-01-01'
 declare @SeqNext int = (select SeqNext from DataDebtorCard where DataDebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId)
if(@IsMonth = 0)
begin
		

		select top 1
		  @PrincipalPay = PrincipalTotal
		, @PlannedInterestPay = PlannedInterestTotal
		, @DefaultInterestPay = DefaultInterestTotal
		, @AccruedInterestPay = AccruedInterestTotal

		, @CourtFeePay = CourtFeeTotal
		, @LawyerFeePay = LawyerFeeTotal
		, @OtherExpensePay = OtherExpenseTotal
		, @InitialMarginPay = InitialMarginTotal

		, @SuspendIntPay = SuspendIntTotal
		, @DeferredInterestPay = DeferredInterestTotal
		, @SuspendedDefaultInterestPay = SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_ACC_Adjust_002_13_UpdateAdjust]

	@GetDate date = '2026-04-27'
	,@DebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = '8BC13A0E-91D7-4F65-918C-E2B5CB5754D4'

	,@CreateBy int = 1 --ผู้สร้าง


	
	
AS
BEGIN

DECLARE @GetMeasureId INT= (SELECT TOP 1 MeasureId FROM SystemMeasureMaster WHERE IsDefault=1)
DECLARE @GetInterestRate decimal(20,4)= (select top 1 IntRate from SystemInterateMaster where IsActive = 1 and InterateTypeId = 111) 
DECLARE @GetInterestDefaultRate decimal(20,4)= (select top 1 IntRate from SystemInterateMaster where IsActive = 1 and InterateTypeId = 112) 
DECLARE @GetMeasureName nvarchar(200) = (SELECT TOP 1 MeasureName FROM SystemMeasureMaster WHERE MeasureId = @GetMeasureId)

DECLARE @TypeCode nvarchar(2) 
DECLARE @TypeName nvarchar(100) 
DECLARE @PrincipalPay decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @PlannedInterestPay decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @DefaultInterestPay decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @AccruedInterestPay  decimal(20,4) = 0

DECLARE @CourtFeePay decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @LawyerFeePay decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @OtherExpensePay decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @InitialMarginPay decimal(20,4) = 0

DECLARE @SuspendIntPay decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @DeferredInterestPay decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @SuspendedDefaultInterestPay decimal(20,4) = 0

------------------------------------------------------------------

DECLARE @PlannedInterest decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @DefaultInterest decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @AccruedInterest  decimal(20,4) = 0

DECLARE @SuspendInt decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @DeferredInterest decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @SuspendedDefaultInterest decimal(20,4) = 0


DECLARE @PrincipalTotal decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @PlannedInterestTotal decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @DefaultInterestTotal decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @AccruedInterestTotal  decimal(20,4) = 0

DECLARE @SuspendIntTotal decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @DeferredInterestTotal decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal decimal(20,4) = 0

DECLARE @Installment decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @InstallmentInterestTotal decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @InstallmentPrincipal decimal(20,4) = 0

DECLARE @TotalPay decimal(20,4) 


 DECLARE @DefaultDate date = '1900-01-01'

declare @SeqNext int = (select SeqNext from DataDebtorCard where DataDebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId)
declare @SeqNo int = (select top 1 SeqNo from DataDebtorCardMovement where DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId order by SeqNo desc)

select top 1


-----------------------
 @PrincipalTotal = PrincipalTotal

, @PlannedInterest = PlannedInterest
, @PlannedInterestTotal = PlannedInterestTotal

, @DefaultInterest = DefaultInterest
, @DefaultInterestTotal = DefaultInterestTotal

, @AccruedInterest = AccruedInterest
, @AccruedInterestTotal = AccruedInterestTotal

, @SuspendInt = SuspendInt
, @SuspendIntTotal = SuspendIntTotal

, @DeferredInterest = DeferredInterest
, @DeferredInterestTotal = DeferredInterestTotal

, @SuspendedDefaultInterest = SuspendedDefaultInterest
, @SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal = SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal

, @Installment = Installment
, @InstallmentInterestTotal = InstallmentInterestTotal
, @InstallmentPrincipal = InstallmentPrincipal

from DataDebtorCardMovement
where DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
and SeqNo = @SeqNo
--order by SeqNo desc

--Update 

Update c
set c.SeqCurrent = @SeqNo
, c.SeqNext = @SeqNo + 1
, c.InterestStartDate = cm.InterestStartDate
, c.InterestEndDate = cm.InterestEndDate

, c.MeasureId = cm.MeasureId
, c.MeasureCode = cm.MeasureCode
, c.MeasureName = cm.MeasureName

, c.InterestRate = cm.InterestRate
, c.InterestPlannedRate= cm.InterestPlannedRate
, c.InterestDefaultRate = cm.InterestDefaultRate

, c.AccruedInterest = @AccruedInterestTotal
, c.AccruedInterestTotal = @AccruedInterest

, c.PlannedInterest = @PlannedInterest
, c.PlannedInterestTotal = @PlannedInterestTotal

, c.DefaultInterest = @DefaultInterest
, c.DefaultInterestTotal = @DefaultInterestTotal

, c.DeferredInterest = @DeferredInterest
, c.DeferredInterestTotal = @DeferredInterestTotal
 
, c.SuspendInt = @SuspendInt
, c.SuspendIntTotal = @SuspendIntTotal

, c.SuspendedDefaultInterest = @SuspendedDefaultInterest
, c.SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal = @SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal

, c.PrincipalTotal = @PrincipalTotal
, c.InstallmentPrincipalTotal = @InstallmentPrincipal



from DataDebtorCardMovement cm
left join DataDebtorCard c on c.DataDebtorCardId = cm.DebtorCardId
where c.DataDebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
and cm.SeqNo = @SeqNo


END

	  --,[SeqNo] --ถัาไม่ใช้ ให้ comment
      ,[DebtorPaymentId]
      ,[DebtorPaymentCode]
      ,[CompromiseContractGroup]
      ,null as [ReceiptId]

      ,0 as [InstallmentPrincipalPay]

           ,[ReceiptId]
           ,[InstallmentPrincipal]
           ,[InstallmentPrincipalPay]
           ,[InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
           ,[InstallmentInterest]
           ,[InstallmentInterestPay]
           ,[InstallmentInterestTotal]
           ,[InterestStartDate]
           ,[InterestEndDate]
           ,[InterestQuantity]
           ,[DPDAccumulate]
           ,[OverdueAmount]
           ,[PrincipalOverdueAmount]
           ,[AccruedInterestOverdueAmount]
           ,[TotalOverdue]
           ,[TotalPrincipalOverdue]
           ,[TotalAccruedInterestOverdue]

           ,[IsCancel])
 select
 newid() as [CompromiseContractRecalCardId]
           ,newid() as [DebtorCardMovementId]

           ,[InterestEndDate]

           ,[DPDAccumulate]

           ,[PrincipalOverdueAmount]
           ,[AccruedInterestOverdueAmount]

           ,[TotalAccruedInterestOverdue]
           ,[CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId]
           ,[IsUpdateHistory]
		   ,0 as [IsCancel]
		   --,SeqNoOld
		   from #tmp_DataDebtorCard

	--3 Update ดอกเบี้ย
	if(@CheckDefaultMeasureId = 1)
	  begin
		  Update c
		  set InterimInterest = (PrincipalTotal * (InterestRate/100) * @InterestQuantity / @DaysInYear)
		  , PlannedInterest = (PrincipalTotal * (InterestPlannedRate/100) * @InterestQuantity / @DaysInYear)
		  , PlannedInterestTotal = PlannedInterestTotal + (PrincipalTotal * (InterestPlannedRate/100) * @InterestQuantity / @DaysInYear)

		  , DefaultInterest = (PrincipalTotal * (InterestDefaultRate/100) * @InterestQuantity / @DaysInYear)
		  , DefaultInterestTotal = DefaultInterestTotal + (PrincipalTotal * (InterestDefaultRate/100) * @InterestQuantity / @DaysInYear)

		  , AccruedInterest = (PrincipalTotal * (InterestRate/100) * @InterestQuantity / @DaysInYear)
		  , AccruedInterestTotal = AccruedInterest + (PrincipalTotal * (InterestRate/100) * @InterestQuantity / @DaysInYear)

		  from TDRDataCompromiseContractRecalCard c
		  where DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
		  and SeqNo = @SeqNoUse;

		  Update c
		  set DebtBalance = PrincipalTotal + AccruedInterestTotal
		  from TDRDataCompromiseContractRecalCard c
		  where DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
		  and SeqNo = @SeqNoUse;
	  end

	  if(@CheckDefaultMeasureId != 1)
	  begin
		  Update c 
		  set InterimInterest = (PrincipalTotal * (InterestPlannedRate/100) * @InterestQuantity / @DaysInYear)
		  , SuspendInt = (PrincipalTotal * (InterestPlannedRate/100) * @InterestQuantity / @DaysInYear)
		  , SuspendIntTotal = SuspendIntTotal + (PrincipalTotal * (InterestPlannedRate/100) * @InterestQuantity / @DaysInYear)

		  , PlannedInterest = (PrincipalTotal * (InterestPlannedRate/100) * @InterestQuantity / @DaysInYear)
		  , PlannedInterestTotal = PlannedInterestTotal + (PrincipalTotal * (InterestPlannedRate/100) * @InterestQuantity / @DaysInYear)

		  , DefaultInterest = (InstallmentPrincipal * (InterestDefaultRate/100) * @InterestQuantity / @DaysInYear)
		  , DefaultInterestTotal = DefaultInterestTotal + (PrincipalTotal * (InterestDefaultRate/100) * @InterestQuantity / @DaysInYear)

	  
		  from TDRDataCompromiseContractRecalCard c
		  where DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
		  and SeqNo = @SeqNoUse;

		  Update c
		  set AccruedInterest = SuspendInt + DefaultInterest + DeferredInterest
		  , AccruedInterestTotal = SuspendIntTotal + DefaultInterestTotal + DeferredInterestTotal

		  from TDRDataCompromiseContractRecalCard c
		  where DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
		  and SeqNo = @SeqNoUse;

		  Update c
		  set DebtBalance = PrincipalTotal + AccruedInterestTotal

		  from TDRDataCompromiseContractRecalCard c
		  where DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
		  and SeqNo = @SeqNoUse;
	  end



	 delete from #tmp_DataDebtorCard

		   --return CurrentDate

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_ACC_Adjust_002_17_InsertAdjust_RecalCalculate]

@GetDate date = '2025-09-05'
,@DebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = '52D02661-6ED6-491B-9ADD-FCF91807A71A'
,@SeqNoStart int = 4
,@SeqNoEnd int = 16
,@MeasureMasterId int = 1
,@CreateBy int = 1



AS
BEGIN
--set @SeqNoStart = 9
DECLARE @TypeCode nvarchar(2)
DECLARE @TypeName nvarchar(100)
-- DECLARE @PrincipalPay decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @PlannedInterestPay decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @DefaultInterestPay decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @AccruedInterestPay  decimal(20,4) = 0

DECLARE @CourtFeePay decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @LawyerFeePay decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @OtherExpensePay decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @InitialMarginPay decimal(20,4) = 0

DECLARE @SuspendIntPay decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @DeferredInterestPay decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @SuspendedDefaultInterestPay decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @TotalPay decimal(20,4) = 0

declare @SeqNoBefore int = @SeqNoStart-2
declare @PrincipalTotal decimal(20,2)
declare @AccruedInterestTotal decimal(20,2)
declare @CourtFeeTotal decimal(20,2)
declare @LawyerFeeTotal decimal(20,2)
declare @OtherExpenseTotal decimal(20,2)
declare @InitialMarginTotal decimal(20,2)
declare @SuspendIntTotal decimal(20,2)
declare @DeferredInterestTotal decimal(20,2)
declare @SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal decimal(20,2)
declare @PlannedInterestTotal decimal(20,2)
declare @DefaultInterestTotal decimal(20,2)
declare @Installment decimal(20,2)
declare @InstallmentInterest decimal(20,2)
declare @InstallmentPrincipal decimal(20,2)
declare @DebtBalance decimal(20,2)
declare @InterestStartDate date = (select top 1  case when cast(@GetDate as date) = cast(cd.ClaimPayDate as date) then cd.ClaimPayDate else cm.InterestStartDate end FROM [DataDebtorCardMovement] cm
left join DataDebtorCard cd on cd.DataDebtorCardId = cm.DebtorCardId
where DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
and cm.SeqNo = (@SeqNoStart-2) )


(select @TypeName = PaymentTypeName
, @TypeCode = PaymentTypeCode
from SystemPaymentType
where PaymentTypeId = 7)

DECLARE @DefaultDate date = '1900-01-01'
declare @SeqNext int = (select SeqNext from DataDebtorCard where DataDebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId)
declare @CheckDefaultMeasureId int = (select top 1 IsDefault from SystemMeasureMaster where MeasureId = @MeasureMasterId)
DECLARE @DaysInYear INT = DATEDIFF(DAY, cast(year(@GetDate) as nvarchar) + '-01-01', cast(year(@GetDate) as nvarchar) + '-12-31') + 1;
declare @InterestQuantity int
declare @ClaimPayDate date = (select top 1 ClaimPayDate from DataDebtorCard where DataDebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId )
declare @SeqNo int = (select top 1 SeqNo+1 from DataDebtorCardMovement where DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId order by SeqNo desc)
declare @Principal decimal(20,2) = (select top 1 Principal from DataDebtorCard where DataDebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId )

select 
 
	  @InterestQuantity = datediff(day, InterestStartDate, @GetDate) +1

from DataDebtorCardMovement
where DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
and SeqNo = @SeqNoStart-1

select 
 
	  @PrincipalTotal = case when @SeqNoStart-3 < 1 then cd.Principal else cm.[PrincipalTotal] end
	  ,@AccruedInterestTotal = cm.[AccruedInterestTotal]

	  ,@CourtFeeTotal = cm.[CourtFeeTotal]
	  ,@LawyerFeeTotal = cm.[LawyerFeeTotal]
	  ,@OtherExpenseTotal = cm.[OtherExpenseTotal]
	  ,@InitialMarginTotal = cm.[InitialMarginTotal]

	  ,@SuspendIntTotal = cm.[SuspendIntTotal]
	  ,@DeferredInterestTotal = cm.[DeferredInterestTotal]
	  ,@SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal = cm.[SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal]
	  ,@PlannedInterestTotal = cm.[PlannedInterestTotal]
	  ,@DefaultInterestTotal = cm.[DefaultInterestTotal]
	  ,@AccruedInterestTotal = cm.[AccruedInterestTotal]

	  ,@DebtBalance = cm.[DebtBalance]

	  ,@Installment = cm.Installment
	  ,@InstallmentInterest = cm.InstallmentInterest
	  ,@InstallmentPrincipal = cm.InstallmentPrincipal
from DataDebtorCardMovement cm
left join DataDebtorCard cd on cd.DataDebtorCardId = cm.DebtorCardId
where DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
and cm.SeqNo = @SeqNoStart-3


--============= 1 insert ลง tmp

SELECT  min([DebtorCardMovementId]) as [DebtorCardMovementId]
,[DebtorCardId]
,getdate() as [DocDate]
,@GetDate as [PayDate]
,[LGNo]
,[DebtorId]
,[DebtorCode]
,[DebtorCardCode]
,[DebtorCardName]
,30 as [TypeId]
,@TypeCode as [TypeCode]
,@TypeName as [TypeName]
,[FlagAutoPay]
,@DefaultDate as [DFDDate]
,@DefaultDate as [DFDStartDate]
,@DefaultDate as [DFDEndDate]
,0 as [DPD]
,0 as [TotalPay]
,1 as [IsAdjust]
,null [AdjustRefDocNo]
,0 as [IsDelete]
,max([MeasureId]) as [MeasureId]
,max([MeasureCode]) as [MeasureCode]
,max([MeasureName]) as [MeasureName]
, case when @GetDate = @ClaimPayDate then 0 else min([InterestRate]) end  as [InterestRate]
,case when @GetDate = @ClaimPayDate then 0 else min([InterestPlannedRate]) end  as [InterestPlannedRate]
,min([InterestDefaultRate]) as [InterestDefaultRate]
,@DebtBalance as [DebtBalance]
,max([ReceivePayment]) as [ReceivePayment]
,0 as [Installment]
,0 as [InstallmentPay]
,0 as [InstallmentTotal]
,case when @GetDate = @ClaimPayDate then @Principal else min(PrincipalTotal) end  as [Principal]
,0 as [PrincipalPay]
,case when @GetDate = @ClaimPayDate then @Principal else @PrincipalTotal end  as [PrincipalTotal]
, - sum(InterimInterest) as [InterimInterest]
,- sum([AccruedInterest]) as [AccruedInterest]
,0 as [AccruedInterestPay]
,@AccruedInterestTotal as [AccruedInterestTotal]
,0 as[CourtFee]
,0 as [CourtFeePay]
,0 as [CourtFeeTotal]
,0 as [LawyerFee]
,0 as [LawyerFeePay]
,0 as [LawyerFeeTotal]
,0 as [OtherExpense]
,0 as [OtherExpensePay]
,0 as [OtherExpenseTotal]
,0 as [InitialMargin]
,0 as [InitialMarginPay]
,0 as [InitialMarginTotal]
,- sum([SuspendInt]) as [SuspendInt]
,0 as [SuspendIntPay]
,@SuspendIntTotal as [SuspendIntTotal]
,- sum([DeferredInterest]) as [DeferredInterest]
,0 as [DeferredInterestPay]
,@DeferredInterestTotal as [DeferredInterestTotal]
,- sum([SuspendedDefaultInterest]) as [SuspendedDefaultInterest]
,0 as [SuspendedDefaultInterestPay]
,@SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal as [SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal]
,- sum([PlannedInterest]) as [PlannedInterest]
,0 as [PlannedInterestPay]
,@PlannedInterestTotal as [PlannedInterestTotal]
,- sum([DefaultInterest]) as [DefaultInterest]
,0 as [DefaultInterestPay]
,@DefaultInterestTotal as [DefaultInterestTotal]
,@CreateBy as [CreateBy]

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_ACC_Adjust_002_2_InsertAdjust_Closed_2]


	@DataDebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = 'FB40C807-7A3C-4CEA-B1F3-B4BA52E4F5C1'

	,@CreateBy int = 1 --ผู้สร้าง


	
	
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE @MeasureId int = (select top 1 MeasureId from SystemMeasureMaster where IsDefault = 1 and IsActive = 1)

DECLARE @MeasureCode nvarchar(400) 
DECLARE @MeasureName nvarchar(400) 
declare @SeqNoLast int = 0

select  @MeasureCode = MeasureCode
, @MeasureName = MeasureName
from SystemMeasureMaster where MeasureId = @MeasureId


select top 1
@SeqNoLast =  cm.SeqNo 
from DataDebtorCardMovement cm
left join DataDebtorCard cd on cd.DataDebtorCardId = cm.DebtorCardId
where cd.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
order by cm.SeqNo desc

Update cd
set cd.PrincipalTotal = cm.PrincipalTotal 
, cd.PlannedInterest = cm.PlannedInterest
, cd.DefaultInterest = cm.DefaultInterest
, cd.AccruedInterest = cm.AccruedInterest
, cd.PlannedInterestTotal = cm.PlannedInterestTotal
, cd.DefaultInterestTotal = cm.DefaultInterestTotal
, cd.AccruedInterestTotal = cm.AccruedInterestTotal

--, cd.DefaultInterestTotal = cm.DefaultInterestTotal
, cd.DebtBalance = cm.DebtBalance
, cd.SeqCurrent = cm.SeqNo
, cd.SeqNext = cm.SeqNo +1
, cd.InterestStartDate = cm.InterestStartDate
, cd.InterestEndDate = cm.InterestEndDate
, cd.InterestRate = cm.InterestRate
, cd.InterestPlannedRate = cm.InterestPlannedRate
, cd.InterestDefaultRate = cm.InterestDefaultRate
, cd.DPD = cm.DPD
, cd.DFDDate = cm.DFDDate
, cd.MeasureId = cm.MeasureId
, cd.MeasureCode = cm.MeasureCode
, cd.MeasureName = cm.MeasureName
, cd.MeasureDate = getdate()
, cd.InstallmentPrincipal = cm.Installment
, cd.InstallmentPrincipalPay = cm.InstallmentPay
, cd.InstallmentPrincipalTotal= cm.InstallmentTotal
, cd.SuspendInt = cm.SuspendInt
, cd.SuspendIntPay = cm.SuspendIntPay
, cd.SuspendIntTotal = cm.SuspendIntTotal
, cd.DeferredInterest = cm.DeferredInterest
, cd.DeferredInterestPay = cm.DeferredInterestPay
, cd.DeferredInterestTotal = cm.DeferredInterestTotal
, cd.SuspendedDefaultInterest = cm.SuspendedDefaultInterest
, cd.SuspendedDefaultInterestPay = cm.SuspendedDefaultInterestPay
, cd.SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal = cm.SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal
, cd.CompromiseContracApproveDate = '1900-01-01'
, cd.CompromiseContractId = null
,cd.RequestDebtorApproveDate = '1900-01-01'
--, cd.DPDAccumulate = cm.DPDAccumulate

from DataDebtorCardMovement cm
left join DataDebtorCard cd on cd.DataDebtorCardId = cm.DebtorCardId
where cm.DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
and cm.SeqNo = @SeqNoLast

declare @SeqNoInterateLast int
select top 1
@SeqNoInterateLast =  ci.Seq
from DataDebtorCardInterate ci
left join DataDebtorCard cd on cd.DataDebtorCardId = ci.DebtorCardId
where cd.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
order by ci.Seq desc

Update DataDebtorCardInterate
set EndDate = dateadd(day, -1, getdate())
where DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
and Seq = @SeqNoInterateLast

INSERT INTO [dbo].[DataDebtorCardInterate]
           ([DebtorCardInterateId]
           ,[DebtorCardId]
           ,[MeasureId]
           ,[Seq]
           ,[InterateRate]
           ,[DefaultInterest]
           ,[StartDate]
           ,[EndDate]
           ,[IsActive]
           ,[CompromiseContractGroupId]
           ,[CreateDate]
           ,[CreateBy]
           ,[UpdateDate]
           ,[UpdateBy]
           ,[IsDefaultInterest]
           ,[RequestNoTDR])
					 
select top 1 
newid() as [DebtorCardInterateId]
           ,c.DataDebtorCardId [DebtorCardId]
           ,c.[MeasureId]
           ,@SeqNoInterateLast+1 [Seq]
           ,c.InterestPlannedRate [InterateRate]
           ,c.InterestDefaultRate [DefaultInterest]
           ,getdate() as [StartDate]
           ,'3000-12-31' [EndDate]
           ,1[IsActive]
           ,null [CompromiseContractGroupId]
           ,getdate() [CreateDate]
           ,@CreateBy [CreateBy]
           ,getdate()[UpdateDate]
           ,@CreateBy [UpdateBy]
           ,1[IsDefaultInterest]
           ,null [RequestNoTDR]
					 from DataDebtorCardInterate i
					 left join DataDebtorCard c on c.DataDebtorCardId = i.DebtorCardId
					 where c.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId

END

	@GetDate date = '2026-03-16'

	,@TypeId int = 16 --16	ปรับปรุงรายการเงินต้นจากการ์ดหลัก
	,@TotalPay decimal(20,2) = 300
	,@PrincipalPay decimal(20,2) = 0
	,@PlannedInterestPay decimal(20,2) = 0
	,@DefaultInterestPay decimal(20,2) = 0
	,@CourtFee decimal(20,2) = 0
	,@LawyerFee decimal(20,2) = 0
	,@OtherExpense decimal(20,2) = 0
	,@InitialMargin decimal(20,2) = 0
	,@CourtFeePay decimal(20,2) = 0
	,@LawyerFeePay decimal(20,2) = 0
	,@OtherExpensePay decimal(20,2) = 0
	,@InitialMarginPay decimal(20,2) = 0
	,@SuspendIntPay decimal(20,2) = 0
	,@DeferredInterestPay decimal(20,2) = 0
	,@SuspendedDefaultInterestPay decimal(20,2) = 0
	,@CreateBy int = 284 --ผู้สร้าง
	,@LGNo nvarchar(150) = ''
	,@Amount decimal(20,2) = 0 --เงินคงเหลือ ของการ์ดหลัก


	
	
AS
BEGIN


DECLARE @TypeCode nvarchar(2) 
DECLARE @TypeName nvarchar(100) 
set @LGNo = (select LGNo from DataDebtorCard where DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId)
set @Amount = (select PrincipalTotal from DataDebtorCard where LGNo = @LGNo and DebtorRelateTypeId = 1)
DECLARE @GetCountCard int = (select count(*)+1 from DataDebtorCard where LGNo = @LGNo and DebtorRelateTypeId = 2) --and CardStatusId != 1
DECLARE @PrincipalTotalMain decimal(20,2) = @Amount/@GetCountCard
DECLARE @PrincipalTotal decimal(20,2) = (select  PrincipalTotal
 from DataDebtorCard 
 where DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId)
DECLARE @SeqNo int 



set @TotalPay = @PrincipalTotal - @PrincipalTotalMain


 (select top 1 @SeqNo = min(SeqNo)
 from DataDebtorCardMovement
 where DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
 and (cast(PayDate as date) <= @GetDate
  or cast(DocDate  as date) <= @GetDate)
  and TypeId !=2 
  and IsAdjust !=1

  )

  select @SeqNo, @Amount, @GetCountCard, @PrincipalTotal
  

 (select @TypeName = PaymentTypeName 
 , @TypeCode = PaymentTypeCode
 from SystemPaymentType 
 where PaymentTypeId = @TypeId)

 DECLARE @DefaultDate date = '1900-01-01'

declare @SeqNext int = (select SeqNext from DataDebtorCard where DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId)
set @SeqNext = case when month(@GetDate) < month(getdate()) and year(@GetDate) <= year(getdate()) then @SeqNext+1 else @SeqNext end




--============= 1 insert ลง tmp
SELECT 
newid() as [DebtorCardMovementId]
      ,[DebtorCardId]
      ,getdate() as [DocDate]
      ,@GetDate as [PayDate]
      ,[LGNo]
      ,[DebtorId]
      ,[DebtorCode]
      ,[DebtorCardCode]
      ,[DebtorCardName]
      ,@TypeId as [TypeId]
      ,@TypeCode as [TypeCode]
      ,@TypeName as [TypeName]
      ,[FlagAutoPay]
      ,@DefaultDate as [DFDDate]
      ,@DefaultDate as [DFDStartDate]
      ,@DefaultDate as [DFDEndDate]
      ,0 as [DPD]
      ,0 as [TotalPay]
      ,1 as [IsAdjust]
      ,0 as [AdjustRefDocNo]
      ,0 as [IsDelete]

 (select @TypeName = PaymentTypeName 
 , @TypeCode = PaymentTypeCode

 where PaymentTypeId = @TypeId)

      ,'1900-01-01' as [InterestStartDate]

 (select @TypeName = PaymentTypeName

 where PaymentTypeId = @TypeId)

 DECLARE @DefaultDate date = '1900-01-01'

	  , DebtBalance = PrincipalTotal

	  --ผิดนัด

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_ACC_Adjust_002_7_InsertAdjust_AccruedInterest]
	-- insert ดอกเบี้ย ทุกมาตรการ
	@GetDate date = '2026-06-14'
	,@DataDebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = 'BAA0065A-5F2F-4E76-B7A3-99FF02B6540C'
	,@TypeId int = 21 --ปรับปรุงรายการดอกเบี้ยค้างรับ
-- 	,@TotalPay decimal(20,2) = 300
-- 	,@PrincipalPay decimal(20,2) = 0
	,@PlannedInterestPay decimal(20,2) = 100
	,@DefaultInterestPay decimal(20,2) = 0
-- 	,@CourtFee decimal(20,2) = 0
-- 	,@LawyerFee decimal(20,2) = 0
-- 	,@OtherExpense decimal(20,2) = 0
-- 	,@InitialMargin decimal(20,2) = 0
-- 	,@CourtFeePay decimal(20,2) = 0
-- 	,@LawyerFeePay decimal(20,2) = 0
-- 	,@OtherExpensePay decimal(20,2) = 0
-- 	,@InitialMarginPay decimal(20,2) = 0
	,@SuspendIntPay decimal(20,2) = 0
	,@DeferredInterestPay decimal(20,2) = 0
	,@SuspendedDefaultInterestPay decimal(20,2) = 0
	,@CreateBy int = 1 --ผู้สร้าง
	,@LGNo nvarchar(150) = ''
	,@Amount decimal(20,2) = 0 --เงินคงเหลือ ของการ์ดหลัก
--  ,@AccruedInterestTotal decimal(20,2) --ดอกเบี้ยค้างรับ
-- 	,@SuspendIntTotal decimal(20,2)--ดอกเบี้ยตั้งพักใหม่(แขวน)-คงเหลือ
-- 	,@DeferredInterestTotal decimal(20,2)--ดอกเบี้ยตั้งพัก-คงเหลือ
-- 	,@SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal decimal(20,2)--ดอกเบี้ยแขวนผิดนัด-คงเหลือ
-- 	,@PlannedInterestTotal decimal(20,2)--ดอกเบี้ยตามแผน-คงเหลือ
-- 	,@DefaultInterestTotal decimal(20,2)--ดอกเบี้ยผิดนัด-คงเหลือ


	
	
AS
BEGIN


DECLARE @TypeCode nvarchar(2) 
DECLARE @TypeName nvarchar(100) 
DECLARE @GetCountCard int = (select count(*)+1 from DataDebtorCard where LGNo = @LGNo and DebtorRelateTypeId = 2 ) --and CardStatusId != 1
DECLARE @PrincipalTotalMain decimal(20,2) = @Amount/@GetCountCard

 (select @TypeName = PaymentTypeName 
 , @TypeCode = PaymentTypeCode
 from SystemPaymentType 
 where PaymentTypeId = @TypeId)

 DECLARE @DefaultDate date = '1900-01-01'

declare @SeqNext int = (select SeqNext from DataDebtorCard where DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId)
--============= 1 insert ลง tmp
SELECT
top 1 
newid() as [DebtorCardMovementId]
      ,[DebtorCardId]
      ,getdate() as [DocDate]
      ,@GetDate as [PayDate]
      ,[LGNo]
      ,[DebtorId]
      ,[DebtorCode]
      ,[DebtorCardCode]
      ,[DebtorCardName]
      ,@TypeId as [TypeId]
      ,@TypeCode as [TypeCode]
      ,@TypeName as [TypeName]
      ,[FlagAutoPay]
      ,@DefaultDate as [DFDDate]
      ,@DefaultDate as [DFDStartDate]
      ,@DefaultDate as [DFDEndDate]
      ,0 as [DPD]
      ,@SuspendIntPay + @DeferredInterestPay + @SuspendedDefaultInterestPay + @PlannedInterestPay +  @DefaultInterestPay as [TotalPay]
      ,1 as [IsAdjust]
      ,0 as [AdjustRefDocNo]
      ,0 as [IsDelete]

      ,[MeasureId]
      ,[MeasureCode]
      ,[MeasureName]

      ,InterestRate as InterestRate
      ,InterestPlannedRate as InterestPlannedRate
      ,InterestDefaultRate as InterestDefaultRate

      ,PrincipalTotal  + 
	  [AccruedInterestTotal] -  (@SuspendIntPay + @DeferredInterestPay + @SuspendedDefaultInterestPay + @PlannedInterestPay +  @DefaultInterestPay)
	  as [DebtBalance] 
      ,@SuspendIntPay + @DeferredInterestPay + @SuspendedDefaultInterestPay + @PlannedInterestPay +  @DefaultInterestPay as [ReceivePayment]

      ,[InstallmentTotal] as [Installment]
      ,0 as [InstallmentPay]
      ,[InstallmentTotal] as [InstallmentTotal]

      ,PrincipalTotal as [Principal]
      ,0 as [PrincipalPay]
      ,PrincipalTotal as [PrincipalTotal]

      ,0 as [InterimInterest]
      ,0 as [AccruedInterest]
      ,@SuspendIntPay + @DeferredInterestPay + @SuspendedDefaultInterestPay + @PlannedInterestPay +  @DefaultInterestPay as [AccruedInterestPay]
      ,[AccruedInterestTotal] -  (@SuspendIntPay + @DeferredInterestPay + @SuspendedDefaultInterestPay + @PlannedInterestPay +  @DefaultInterestPay)
	  as [AccruedInterestTotal]

      ,0 as [CourtFee]
      ,0 as [CourtFeePay]
      ,[CourtFeeTotal]

      ,0 as [LawyerFee]
      ,0 as [LawyerFeePay]
      ,[LawyerFeeTotal]

      ,0 as [OtherExpense]
      ,0 as [OtherExpensePay]
      ,[OtherExpenseTotal]

      ,0 as [InitialMargin]
      ,0 as [InitialMarginPay]
      ,[InitialMarginTotal]

      ,0 as [SuspendInt]
      ,@SuspendIntPay as [SuspendIntPay]
      ,[SuspendIntTotal] - @SuspendIntPay as [SuspendIntTotal]

      ,0 as [DeferredInterest]
      ,@DeferredInterestPay as [DeferredInterestPay]
      ,[DeferredInterestTotal] - @DeferredInterestPay  as [DeferredInterestTotal]

      ,0 as [SuspendedDefaultInterest]
      ,@SuspendedDefaultInterestPay as [SuspendedDefaultInterestPay]
      ,SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal - @SuspendedDefaultInterestPay  as SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal

      ,0 as [PlannedInterest]
      ,@PlannedInterestPay as [PlannedInterestPay]
      ,[PlannedInterestTotal] - @PlannedInterestPay  as [PlannedInterestTotal]

      ,0 as [DefaultInterest]
      ,@DefaultInterestPay as [DefaultInterestPay]
      ,[DefaultInterestTotal] - @DefaultInterestPay as [DefaultInterestTotal]

      ,@CreateBy as [CreateBy]
      ,getdate() as [CreateDate]
      ,@CreateBy as [UpdateBy]
      ,getdate() as [UpdateDate]

      ,null as [ReceiptNo]
      ,0 as [IsEstatement]
      ,null as [EStatementRef]
      ,[PaymentTypeId]
      ,@SeqNext as SeqNo
	  --,[SeqNo] --ถัาไม่ใช้ ให้ comment
      ,[DebtorPaymentId]
      ,[DebtorPaymentCode]
      ,[CompromiseContractGroup]
      ,null as [ReceiptId]

      ,[InstallmentPrincipalTotal] as [InstallmentPrincipal]
      ,0 as [InstallmentPrincipalPay]
      ,[InstallmentPrincipalTotal] as [InstallmentPrincipalTotal]

      ,[InstallmentInterestTotal] as [InstallmentInterest]
      ,0 as [InstallmentInterestPay]
      ,[InstallmentInterestTotal]

      ,@DefaultDate as [InterestStartDate]
      ,@DefaultDate as [InterestEndDate]
      ,0 as [InterestQuantity]
      ,[DPDAccumulate]
      ,0 as [OverdueAmount]
      ,0 as [PrincipalOverdueAmount]
      ,0 as [AccruedInterestOverdueAmount]
      ,0 as [TotalOverdue]
      ,0 as [TotalPrincipalOverdue]
      ,0 as [TotalAccruedInterestOverdue]
      ,[CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId]
      ,0 as [IsUpdateHistory]
	  ,[SeqNo] as SeqNoOld

 	  into #tmp_DataDebtorCard
  FROM [DataDebtorCardMovement]
  where DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
  and cast(PayDate as date) < @GetDate
  and cast(DocDate  as date) < @GetDate
  and TypeId != 2
  and IsCancel = 0
 order by cast([SeqNo] as int) desc
  --and cast(PayDate as date) < @PayDate
  --and cast(DocDate  as date) < @PayDate


  select * from #tmp_DataDebtorCard


  --============= 2 insert ลง DataDebtorCardMovement

   INSERT INTO [dbo].[TDRDataCompromiseContractRecalCard]
            ([CompromiseContractRecalCardId]
            ,[DebtorCardMovementId]
            ,[DebtorCardId]
            ,[DocDate]
            ,[PayDate]
            ,[LGNo]
            ,[DebtorId]
            ,[DebtorCode]
            ,[DebtorCardCode]
            ,[DebtorCardName]
            ,[TypeId]
            ,[TypeCode]
            ,[TypeName]
            ,[FlagAutoPay]
            ,[DFDDate]
            ,[DFDStartDate]
            ,[DFDEndDate]
            ,[DPD]
            ,[TotalPay]
            ,[IsAdjust]
            ,[AdjustRefDocNo]
            ,[IsDelete]
            ,[MeasureId]
            ,[MeasureCode]
            ,[MeasureName]
            ,[InterestRate]
            ,[InterestPlannedRate]
            ,[InterestDefaultRate]
            ,[DebtBalance]
            ,[ReceivePayment]
            ,[Installment]
            ,[InstallmentPay]
            ,[InstallmentTotal]
            ,[Principal]
            ,[PrincipalPay]

	,@CreateBy int = 1 --ผู้สร้าง

	--,@AccruedInterest decimal(20,2) --ดอกเบี้ยค้างรับ
	--,@SuspendInt decimal(20,2)--ดอกเบี้ยตั้งพักใหม่(แขวน)-คงเหลือ
	--,@DeferredInterest decimal(20,2)--ดอกเบี้ยตั้งพัก-คงเหลือ
	--,@SuspendedDefaultInterest decimal(20,2)--ดอกเบี้ยแขวนผิดนัด-คงเหลือ
	--,@PlannedInterest decimal(20,2)--ดอกเบี้ยตามแผน-คงเหลือ
	--,@DefaultInterest decimal(20,2)--ดอกเบี้ยผิดนัด-คงเหลือ
	
	,@AccruedInterestTotal decimal(20,2) --ดอกเบี้ยค้างรับ
	,@SuspendIntTotal decimal(20,2)--ดอกเบี้ยตั้งพักใหม่(แขวน)-คงเหลือ
	,@DeferredInterestTotal decimal(20,2)--ดอกเบี้ยตั้งพัก-คงเหลือ
	,@SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal decimal(20,2)--ดอกเบี้ยแขวนผิดนัด-คงเหลือ
	,@PlannedInterestTotal decimal(20,2)--ดอกเบี้ยตามแผน-คงเหลือ
	,@DefaultInterestTotal decimal(20,2)--ดอกเบี้ยผิดนัด-คงเหลือ

declare @PlannedInterest decimal(20,2) = 2000
declare @DefaultInterest decimal(20,2) = 1000

DECLARE @TypeName nvarchar(100)

 (select @TypeName = PaymentTypeName 
 , @TypeCode = PaymentTypeCode
 from SystemPaymentType 
 where PaymentTypeId = @TypeId)

newid() as [DebtorCardMovementId]

	  --+case when @SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal = 0 then [SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal] else @SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal end
	  --+case when @PlannedInterestTotal = 0 then [PlannedInterestTotal] else @PlannedInterestTotal end

	  + case when @PlannedInterest = 0 then 0 else @PlannedInterest end
	  +case when @DefaultInterest = 0 then 0 else @DefaultInterest end
	  --+case when @SuspendInt = 0 then 0 else @SuspendInt end
	  --+case when @DefaultInterest = 0 then 0 else @DefaultInterest end
	  --+case when @DeferredInterest = 0 then 0 else @DeferredInterest end

	  +PlannedInterestTotal + DefaultInterestTotal + SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal + SuspendIntTotal

      ,0 as [InstallmentPay]
      ,[InstallmentTotal] as [InstallmentTotal]

      ,PrincipalTotal as [Principal]

	  ,0

	  --+case when @DefaultInterest = 0 then 0 else @DefaultInterest end
	  --+case when @DeferredInterest = 0 then 0 else @DeferredInterest end

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_ACC_Adjust_002_9_InsertAdjust_ReduceInterest]
	-- insert ดอกเบี้ย ทุกมาตรการ
	@GetDate date = '2025-09-16'
	,@DataDebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = '00028E76-8FE1-4FBF-9218-C1E86EB69F80'
	,@TypeId int = 23	--23	ปรับปรุงรายการลดดอกเบี้ย

-- 	,@TotalPay decimal(20,2) = 300
-- 	,@PrincipalPay decimal(20,2) = 0
	,@PlannedInterestPay decimal(20,2) = 100
	,@DefaultInterestPay decimal(20,2) = 0

	,@SuspendIntPay decimal(20,2) = 0
	,@DeferredInterestPay decimal(20,2) = 0
	,@SuspendedDefaultInterestPay decimal(20,2) = 0
	,@CreateBy int = 1 --ผู้สร้าง
	,@LGNo nvarchar(150) = ''
	,@Amount decimal(20,2) = 0 --เงินคงเหลือ ของการ์ดหลัก

	
	
AS
BEGIN



DECLARE @TypeCode nvarchar(2) 
DECLARE @TypeName nvarchar(100) 
DECLARE @GetCountCard int = (select count(*)+1 from DataDebtorCard where LGNo = @LGNo and DebtorRelateTypeId = 2 ) --and CardStatusId != 1
DECLARE @PrincipalTotalMain decimal(20,2) = @Amount/@GetCountCard

 (select @TypeName = PaymentTypeName 
 , @TypeCode = PaymentTypeCode
 from SystemPaymentType 
 where PaymentTypeId = @TypeId)

 DECLARE @DefaultDate date = '1900-01-01'

declare @SeqNext int = (select SeqNext from DataDebtorCard where DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId)
--============= 1 insert ลง tmp
SELECT
top 1 
newid() as [DebtorCardMovementId]
      ,[DebtorCardId]
      ,getdate() as [DocDate]
      ,@GetDate as [PayDate]
      ,[LGNo]
      ,[DebtorId]
      ,[DebtorCode]
      ,[DebtorCardCode]
      ,[DebtorCardName]
      ,@TypeId as [TypeId]
      ,@TypeCode as [TypeCode]
      ,@TypeName as [TypeName]
      ,[FlagAutoPay]
      ,@DefaultDate as [DFDDate]
      ,@DefaultDate as [DFDStartDate]
      ,@DefaultDate as [DFDEndDate]
      ,0 as [DPD]
      ,@SuspendIntPay + @DeferredInterestPay + @SuspendedDefaultInterestPay + @PlannedInterestPay +  @DefaultInterestPay as [TotalPay]
      ,1 as [IsAdjust]
      ,0 as [AdjustRefDocNo]
      ,0 as [IsDelete]

      ,[MeasureId]
      ,[MeasureCode]
      ,[MeasureName]

      ,InterestRate as InterestRate
      ,InterestPlannedRate as InterestPlannedRate
      ,InterestDefaultRate as InterestDefaultRate

      ,PrincipalTotal  + 
	  [AccruedInterestTotal] -  (@SuspendIntPay + @DeferredInterestPay + @SuspendedDefaultInterestPay + @PlannedInterestPay +  @DefaultInterestPay)
	  as [DebtBalance] 
      ,@SuspendIntPay + @DeferredInterestPay + @SuspendedDefaultInterestPay + @PlannedInterestPay +  @DefaultInterestPay as [ReceivePayment]

      ,[InstallmentTotal] as [Installment]
      ,0 as [InstallmentPay]
      ,[InstallmentTotal] as [InstallmentTotal]

      ,PrincipalTotal as [Principal]
      ,0 as [PrincipalPay]
      ,PrincipalTotal as [PrincipalTotal]

      ,0 as [InterimInterest]
      ,0 as [AccruedInterest]
      ,@SuspendIntPay + @DeferredInterestPay + @SuspendedDefaultInterestPay + @PlannedInterestPay +  @DefaultInterestPay as [AccruedInterestPay]
      ,[AccruedInterestTotal] -  (@SuspendIntPay + @DeferredInterestPay + @SuspendedDefaultInterestPay + @PlannedInterestPay +  @DefaultInterestPay)

	-- insert ดอกเบี้ย ทุกมาตรการ
	@CurrentDate date = '2025-09-16'
	,@DataDebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = '0263F875-5E68-41A1-8C0B-E29087358308'

declare @EndDate datetime = (select InterestEndDate + 1 from DataDebtorCardMovement where DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId and SeqNo = @SeqCurrent)


DECLARE @DaysInYear INT = DATEDIFF(DAY, cast(year(getdate()) as nvarchar) + '-01-01', cast(year(getdate()) as nvarchar) + '-12-31') + 1;

--(กรณีเพิ่มรายการ) PaymentTypeId = 8 ยอดคงเหลือ
--DECLARE @TypeId int = (select PaymentTypeId from SystemPaymentType where PaymentTypeId = 19)
DECLARE @TypeCode nvarchar(2) = ''
DECLARE @TypeName nvarchar(100) = ''
(select @TypeName = PaymentTypeName
 ,@TypeCode = PaymentTypeCode
from SystemPaymentType where PaymentTypeId = @TypeId)

DECLARE @DebtBalance decimal(20,4) = 0 -- หาเพิ่ม

DECLARE @InterestRate decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @InterestPlannedRate decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @InterestDefaultRate decimal(20,4) = 0
declare @GetDate datetime = cast(getdate() as date) 
declare @GetYesterday datetime = cast(dateadd(day, -1, getdate()) as date) 
(select top 1 @InterestRate = InterestRate
,@InterestPlannedRate = InterestPlannedRate
,@InterestDefaultRate= InterestDefaultRate 
,@SeqCurrent = SeqNext

from DataDebtorCard where DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId )


DECLARE @EndDayOfMonth datetime =  EOMONTH(@CurrentDate)

DECLARE @Day int =  0

DECLARE @AccruedInterestTotal decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @PlannedInterestTotal decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @DefaultInterestTotal decimal(20,4) = 0

--select @Day

select @SeqCurrent
--IF @CurrentDate = EOMONTH(@CurrentDate)
--begin
--    PRINT 'เป็นวันสิ้นเดือน'

--end
--ELSE
--    PRINT 'ไม่ใช่วันสิ้นเดือน'
--if(@CurrentDate = @EndDayOfMonth)
--begin




--============== INSERT DataDebtorCardMovement =============================================
INSERT INTO [dbo].[DataDebtorCardMovement]
           ([DebtorCardMovementId]
           ,[DebtorCardId]
           ,[DocDate]

           ,[PayDate]
           ,[LGNo]

           ,[DebtorId]
           ,[DebtorCode]
           ,[DebtorCardCode]
           ,[DebtorCardName]

           ,[TypeId]
           ,[TypeCode]
           ,[TypeName]
           ,[FlagAutoPay]

           ,[DFDDate]
           ,[DFDStartDate]
           ,[DFDEndDate]
           ,[DPD]

           ,[TotalPay]
           ,[IsAdjust]
           ,[AdjustRefDocNo]
           ,[IsDelete]

           ,[MeasureId]
           ,[MeasureCode]
           ,[MeasureName]

           ,[InterestRate]
           ,[InterestPlannedRate]
           ,[InterestDefaultRate]

           ,[DebtBalance]
           ,[ReceivePayment]

           ,[Installment]
           ,[InstallmentPay]
           ,[InstallmentTotal]

           ,[Principal]
           ,[PrincipalPay]
           ,[PrincipalTotal]
           ,[InterimInterest]

           ,[AccruedInterest]
           ,[AccruedInterestPay]
           ,[AccruedInterestTotal]

           ,[CourtFee]
           ,[CourtFeePay]
           ,[CourtFeeTotal]

           ,[LawyerFee]
           ,[LawyerFeePay]
           ,[LawyerFeeTotal]

           ,[OtherExpense]
           ,[OtherExpensePay]
           ,[OtherExpenseTotal]

           ,[InitialMargin]
           ,[InitialMarginPay]
           ,[InitialMarginTotal]

           ,[SuspendInt]
           ,[SuspendIntPay]
           ,[SuspendIntTotal]

           ,[DeferredInterest]
           ,[DeferredInterestPay]
           ,[DeferredInterestTotal]

           ,[SuspendedDefaultInterest]
           ,[SuspendedDefaultInterestPay]
           ,[SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal]

           ,[PlannedInterest]
           ,[PlannedInterestPay]
           ,[PlannedInterestTotal]

           ,[DefaultInterest]
           ,[DefaultInterestPay]
           ,[DefaultInterestTotal]

           ,[CreateBy]
           ,[CreateDate]
           ,[UpdateBy]
           ,[UpdateDate]

           ,[ReceiptNo]
           ,[IsEstatement]
           ,[EStatementRef]
           ,[PaymentTypeId]
           ,[SeqNo]

           ,[DebtorPaymentId]
           ,[DebtorPaymentCode]
           ,[CompromiseContractGroup]
           ,[ReceiptId]

           ,[InstallmentPrincipal]
           ,[InstallmentPrincipalPay]
           ,[InstallmentPrincipalTotal]

           ,[InstallmentInterest]
           ,[InstallmentInterestPay]
           ,[InstallmentInterestTotal]

           ,[InterestStartDate]
           ,[InterestEndDate]
           ,[InterestQuantity]
		   ,IsUpdateHistory)





SELECT top 1
newid()
      ,
	  [DebtorCardId]

      ,dateadd(day, 1, @CurrentDate) as [DocDate]

      ,cast('1900-01-01' as datetime) as PayDate
      ,[LGNo]

      ,[DebtorId]
      ,[DebtorCode]
      ,[DebtorCardCode]
      ,[DebtorCardName]

      ,@TypeId as TypeId
      ,@TypeCode as TypeCode
      ,@TypeName as TypeName
      ,1 as [FlagAutoPay]

      ,cast('1900-01-01' as date) as [DFDDate]
      ,cast('1900-01-01' as date) as [DFDStartDate]
      ,cast('1900-01-01' as date)  as [DFDEndDate]
      ,0 as [DPD]

      ,@TotalPay as [TotalPay]
      ,1 as [IsAdjust]
      ,0 as [AdjustRefDocNo]
      ,0 as [IsDelete]

      ,[MeasureId]
      ,[MeasureCode]
      ,[MeasureName]

      ,InterestRate as InterestRate
      ,InterestPlannedRate as InterestPlannedRate
      ,InterestDefaultRate as InterestDefaultRate

      ,[DebtBalance] - @TotalPay as [DebtBalance] --หาเพิ่ม
      ,0 as [ReceivePayment]

      ,[PrincipalTotal] - @TotalPay as [Installment]
      ,0 as [InstallmentPay]
      ,[PrincipalTotal] - @TotalPay as [InstallmentTotal]

      ,[PrincipalTotal] - @TotalPay as [Principal]
      ,@TotalPay as [PrincipalPay]
      ,[PrincipalTotal] - @TotalPay as [PrincipalTotal]

      ,0 as [InterimInterest]

      ,0 as [AccruedInterest]
      ,0 as [AccruedInterestPay]
      ,0 as [AccruedInterestTotal]
	  
      ,[CourtFee] as [CourtFee]
      ,@CourtFeePay as [CourtFeePay]
      ,[CourtFeeTotal] as [CourtFeeTotal]

      ,[LawyerFee] as [LawyerFee]
      ,0 as [LawyerFeePay]
      ,[LawyerFeeTotal] as [LawyerFeeTotal]

      ,[OtherExpense] as [OtherExpense]
      ,0 as [OtherExpensePay]
      ,[OtherExpenseTotal]  as[OtherExpenseTotal]

      ,0 as [InitialMargin]
      ,0 as [InitialMarginPay]
      ,0 as [InitialMarginTotal]

      ,0 as[SuspendInt]
      ,0 as [SuspendIntPay]
      ,0 as[SuspendIntTotal]

      ,0 as[DeferredInterest]
      ,0 as [DeferredInterestPay]
      ,0 as [DeferredInterestTotal]

      ,0 as [SuspendedDefaultInterest]
      ,0 as [SuspendedDefaultInterestPay]
      ,0 as [SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal]

      ,0 as [PlannedInterest]
      ,0 as [PlannedInterestPay]
      ,0 as [PlannedInterestTotal]

      ,0 as [DefaultInterest]
      ,0 as [DefaultInterestPay]
      ,0 as [DefaultInterestTotal]

      ,@CreateBy as[CreateBy]
      ,getdate() as [CreateDate]
      ,@CreateBy as[UpdateBy]
      ,getdate() as [UpdateDate]

      ,0 as [ReceiptNo]
      ,0 as[IsEstatement]
      ,0 as [EStatementRef]
      ,null as [PaymentTypeId]
     ,@SeqCurrent as SeqNo

      ,null as [DebtorPaymentId]
      ,null as [DebtorPaymentCode]
      ,null as [CompromiseContractGroup]
      ,null as [ReceiptId]

      ,[PrincipalTotal] - @TotalPay as [InstallmentPrincipal]
      ,0 as [InstallmentPrincipalPay]
      ,[PrincipalTotal] - @TotalPay as [InstallmentPrincipalTotal]

      ,0 as [InstallmentInterest]
      ,0 as [InstallmentInterestPay]
      ,0 as [InstallmentInterestTotal]

      ,[InterestStartDate] as [InterestStartDate]
	  ----,cast('2024-08-27' as datetime)

      ,[InterestEndDate] as [InterestEndDate]
     -- ,[InterestQuantity]
	  ,0 as IsUpdateHistory
	  ,DATEDIFF(DAY, cm.DocDate, @CurrentDate) as CountDays 
--into #Adjust
from DataDebtorCardMovement cm
where cm.DebtorCardId= @DataDebtorCardId
and  SeqNo = 1




Update cd
set cd.PrincipalTotal= cm.PrincipalTotal
,cd.SeqCurrent = cd.SeqCurrent + 1
,cd.SeqNext = cd.SeqNext + 1
,cd.DebtBalance = cm.DebtBalance
,cd.AccruedInterestTotal = cm.AccruedInterestTotal
,cd.DefaultInterestTotal = cm.DefaultInterestTotal
,cd.PlannedInterestTotal = cm.PlannedInterestTotal
,cd.CourtFee = cm.CourtFee
,cd.CourtFeePay = cm.CourtFeePay
,cd.CourtFeeTotal = cm.CourtFeeTotal

,cd.LawyerFee = cm.LawyerFee
,cd.LawyerFeePay = cm.LawyerFeePay
,cd.LawyerFeeTotal = cm.LawyerFeeTotal

,cd.OtherExpense = cm.OtherExpense
,cd.OtherExpensePay = cm.OtherExpensePay
,cd.OtherExpenseTotal = cm.OtherExpenseTotal

,cd.InitialMargin = cm.InitialMargin
,cd.InitialMarginPay = cm.InitialMarginPay
,cd.InitialMarginTotal = cm.InitialMarginTotal

,cd.InstallmentPrincipal = cm.PrincipalTotal
,cd.InstallmentPrincipalTotal = cm.PrincipalTotal

,cd.InstallmentsAmount = cm.PrincipalTotal



from DataDebtorCard cd
left join DataDebtorCardMovement cm on cm.DebtorCardId = cd.DataDebtorCardId
where DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
and cm.SeqNo = cd.SeqNext

declare @StartCurrentDate date =  @CurrentDate
EXEC [SP_DCS_019_InsertBalance] @StartCurrentDate, @DataDebtorCardId

	declare @DFDDate date = (select DFDDate from DataDebtorCard where  DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId)
    WHILE @CurrentDate <= dateadd(day, -1, getdate())
    BEGIN
        -- รันสโตเดิม (เปลี่ยนชื่อเป็นของคุณ เช่น SP_OldProcedure)
		if(day(@CurrentDate) = 1)
		BEGIN
			EXEC [SP_DCS_019_InsertBalance] @CurrentDate, @DataDebtorCardId;

		END

		if(@CurrentDate = dateadd(day, 1, @DFDDate))
		BEGIN

		Update DataDebtorCard
		set InterestRate = 9.05
		, InterestDefaultRate = 3
		where DataDebtorCard.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId;

			EXEC [SP_DCS_019_InsertBalance] @CurrentDate, @DataDebtorCardId;

		END

			EXEC [SP_DCS_018_UpdateInterestEveryDay] @CurrentDate, @DataDebtorCardId;
        -- ขยับไปวันถัดไป
        SET @CurrentDate = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @CurrentDate);
    END





--exec [dbo].[SP_Run_Card] @CurrentDate, @GetYesterday  ,@DataDebtorCardId


END

from DataDebtorCard cd
left join DataDebtorCardMovement cm on cm.DebtorCardId = cd.DataDebtorCardId

BEGIN

declare @LGNo nvarchar(20) = (select LGNo from DataDebtorCard where DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId)

	Update DataMainCard

	where LGNo = @LGNo

	Update DataDebtorCard
	set CardStatusId = 217

	where LGNo = @LGNo

BEGIN
	Update DataMainCard
	set CardStatusId = 135

	where LGNo = @LGNo

	Update DataDebtorCard

	where LGNo = @LGNo

BEGIN
	Update DataMainCard
	set CardStatusId = 134

	where LGNo = @LGNo

	Update DataDebtorCard
	set CardStatusId = 134

	where LGNo = @LGNo
END



END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_Dashboard_GetMeasureOverview]
    @YEAR INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @ADYear INT = CASE WHEN @YEAR > 2400 THEN @YEAR - 543 ELSE @YEAR END;
    DECLARE @StartDate DATE = DATEFROMPARTS(@ADYear, 1, 1);
    DECLARE @EndDate DATE = DATEADD(YEAR, 1, @StartDate);
    DECLARE @Today DATE = CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE());
    DECLARE @LatestDate DATE =
        CASE WHEN @Today < @StartDate THEN DATEADD(DAY, -1, @StartDate)
             WHEN @Today < @EndDate THEN @Today
             ELSE DATEADD(DAY, -1, @EndDate) END;

    /* 1. Same approved TDR rules and deduplication used by other dashboards. */
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TDRBase;
    ;WITH TDRRanked AS
    (
        SELECT
            c.CompromiseContractId,
            clg.LGNo,
            clg.DebtorRelateId,
            c.MeasureId,
            c.ApproveDate,
            clg.PrincipalTotal,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER
            (
                PARTITION BY c.CompromiseContractId, clg.LGNo
                ORDER BY clg.DebtorRelateId
            ) AS rn
        FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContract c
        INNER JOIN dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractLG clg
            ON clg.CompromiseContractId = c.CompromiseContractId
        WHERE c.ApproveDate >= @StartDate
          AND c.ApproveDate < @EndDate
          AND c.CompromiseContractStatusId = 58
          AND clg.Grade = 'F1'
          AND EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractPeriodSummary ps
              WHERE ps.CompromiseContractId = c.CompromiseContractId
                AND ps.LGNo = clg.LGNo
                AND ps.[Year] = 1
          )
    )
    SELECT
        CompromiseContractId, LGNo, DebtorRelateId,
        MeasureId, ApproveDate, PrincipalTotal
    INTO #TDRBase
    FROM TDRRanked
    WHERE rn = 1;

    /* One first approval threshold per LG for BU-level receipt amounts. */
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TDRFirstApproval;
    SELECT LGNo, MIN(ApproveDate) AS FirstApproveDate
    INTO #TDRFirstApproval
    FROM #TDRBase
    WHERE LGNo IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY LGNo;
    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_TDRFirstApproval ON #TDRFirstApproval (LGNo);

    /* 2. Measures and organization ownership. */
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #MeasureBase;
    SELECT
        b.*,
        ISNULL(org.OrgStructureId, 0) AS OrgStructureId,
        ISNULL(org.OrgSectionId, 0) AS OrgSectionId,
        CASE WHEN mm.MeasureGroup IN (374,375,376,377,378,382)
             THEN mm.MeasureGroup ELSE 378 END AS MeasureGroup
    INTO #MeasureBase
    FROM #TDRBase b
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemMeasureMaster mm ON mm.MeasureId = b.MeasureId
    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT TOP (1) pi.OrgStructureId, pi.OrgSectionId
        FROM dbo.DataAssignment a
        INNER JOIN dbo.DataPersonalInfo pi
            ON pi.UserId = CASE WHEN a.TypeAssignId = 2
                                THEN a.CollectorOAUserId ELSE a.CollectorUserId END
        WHERE a.DebtorRelateId = b.DebtorRelateId
        ORDER BY a.TypeAssignId, pi.OrgStructureId, pi.OrgSectionId, pi.PersonalInfoId DESC
    ) org;

    /* 3. Receipts: select once by ReceiptId, and ONLY after TDR approval. */
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #EligibleReceipts;
    ;WITH ReceiptRanked AS
    (
        SELECT
            r.ReceiptId,
            r.LGNo,
            r.MeasureId,
            r.ReceiptDate,
            r.DebtorRelateId,
            CAST(ISNULL(r.PaymentAmount, 0) AS DECIMAL(20,2)) AS PaymentAmount,
            CAST(ISNULL(r.PrincipalPay, 0) AS DECIMAL(20,2)) AS PrincipalPay,
            r.DebtBalance,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER
            (
                PARTITION BY r.ReceiptId
                ORDER BY r.ReceiptDate DESC, r.ReceiptId DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM dbo.ACCDataReceipt r
        INNER JOIN #TDRFirstApproval t
            ON t.LGNo = r.LGNo
           AND r.ReceiptDate >= t.FirstApproveDate
        WHERE r.ReceiptDate >= @StartDate
          AND r.ReceiptDate < @EndDate
          AND r.ReceiptDate < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @LatestDate)
          AND ISNULL(r.IsCancel, 0) = 0
          AND r.ReceiptId IS NOT NULL
    )
    SELECT ReceiptId, LGNo, MeasureId, ReceiptDate, DebtorRelateId,
           PaymentAmount, PrincipalPay, DebtBalance
    INTO #EligibleReceipts
    FROM ReceiptRanked
    WHERE rn = 1;

    /* 4. By LG+Measure: only receipts after approval of THIS measure's TDR.
          #Receipt will be used by the original blue-measure result set. */
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Receipt;
    SELECT
        r.LGNo,
        r.MeasureId,
        SUM(r.PaymentAmount) AS TotalPayment,
        SUM(r.PrincipalPay) AS TotalPrincipalReduction
    INTO #Receipt
    FROM #EligibleReceipts r
    WHERE EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM #TDRBase t
        WHERE t.LGNo = r.LGNo
          AND t.MeasureId = r.MeasureId
          AND r.ReceiptDate >= t.ApproveDate
    )
    GROUP BY r.LGNo, r.MeasureId;

    /* 5. Latest eligible receipt per LG: does not include preapproval or canceled receipts. */
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #EODLatest;
    ;WITH EODRanked AS
    (
        SELECT
            e.LGNo,
            e.DebtorRelateId,
            e.PaymentAmount,
            e.DebtBalance,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER
            (
                PARTITION BY e.LGNo
                ORDER BY e.ReceiptDate DESC, e.ReceiptId DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM #EligibleReceipts e
    )
    SELECT LGNo, DebtorRelateId, PaymentAmount, DebtBalance
    INTO #EODLatest
    FROM EODRanked
    WHERE rn = 1;

    /* 6. One organizational classification per LG for EOD rollup. */
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #LGOrg;
    ;WITH TaggedLG AS
    (
        SELECT LGNo, OrgStructureId, OrgSectionId,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LGNo ORDER BY CompromiseContractId) AS rn
        FROM #MeasureBase
    )
    SELECT LGNo, OrgStructureId, OrgSectionId
    INTO #LGOrg
    FROM TaggedLG
    WHERE rn = 1;

    /* 7. Business unit summary: original output contract. */
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #ActualTarget;
    SELECT
        v.OrgStructureId,
        v.OrgSectionId,
        CASE WHEN sec.SectionNameTH IS NOT NULL AND sec.SectionNameTH <> ''
             THEN sec.SectionNameTH ELSE ISNULL(org.OrgStructureName, '') END AS BUName,
        CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS TargetPay,
        CAST(ISNULL(e.ActualPay, 0) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS ActualPay,
        ISNULL(t.ActualTDR, 0) AS ActualTDR,
        CAST(ISNULL(e.OS, 0) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS OS
    INTO #ActualTarget
    FROM
    (
        SELECT OrgStructureId, OrgSectionId FROM #MeasureBase
        UNION
        SELECT 0, 0 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #MeasureBase)
    ) v
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemOrgStructure org ON org.OrgStructureId = v.OrgStructureId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemOrgSectionMaster sec ON sec.OrgSectionId = v.OrgSectionId
    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS ActualTDR
        FROM #MeasureBase b
        WHERE b.OrgStructureId = v.OrgStructureId
          AND b.OrgSectionId = v.OrgSectionId
    ) t
    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT
            SUM(ISNULL(d.PaymentAmount, 0)) / 1000000.0 AS ActualPay,
            SUM(ISNULL(d.DebtBalance, 0)) / 1000000.0 AS OS
        FROM #EODLatest d
        INNER JOIN #LGOrg o ON o.LGNo = d.LGNo
        WHERE o.OrgStructureId = v.OrgStructureId
          AND o.OrgSectionId = v.OrgSectionId
    ) e;

    /* RESULT SET 1 — unchanged */
    SELECT
        @YEAR AS [Year],
        @LatestDate AS LatestDate,
        COUNT(*) AS TotalMeasure,
        COUNT(*) AS TotalTDR
    FROM #MeasureBase;

    /* RESULT SET 2 — six measure colors */
    ;WITH Colors AS
    (
        SELECT * FROM (VALUES
            (374,N'เหลือง'), (375,N'ฟ้า'), (376,N'ม่วง'),
            (377,N'เขียว'), (378,N'ไม่มีสี'), (382,N'น้ำเงิน')
        ) v(MeasureGroup, MeasureGroupName)
    ),
    Tally AS
    (
        SELECT MeasureGroup, COUNT(*) AS Total
        FROM #MeasureBase
        GROUP BY MeasureGroup
    )
    SELECT
        c.MeasureGroup,
        c.MeasureGroupName,
        ISNULL(t.Total, 0) AS Total,
        CAST(CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #MeasureBase) = 0 THEN 0
                  ELSE ISNULL(t.Total, 0) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #MeasureBase)
             END AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [Percent]
    FROM Colors c
    LEFT JOIN Tally t ON t.MeasureGroup = c.MeasureGroup
    ORDER BY c.MeasureGroup;

    /* RESULT SET 3 — unchanged */
    SELECT OrgStructureId, OrgSectionId, BUName,
           TargetPay, ActualPay, ActualTDR, OS
    FROM #ActualTarget
    ORDER BY OrgStructureId, OrgSectionId;

    /* RESULT SET 4 — unchanged */
    SELECT
        CAST(ISNULL(SUM(TargetPay), 0) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS TargetPay,
        CAST(ISNULL(SUM(ActualPay), 0) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS ActualPay,
        ISNULL(SUM(ActualTDR), 0) AS ActualTDR,
        CAST(ISNULL(SUM(OS), 0) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS OS
    FROM #ActualTarget;

    /* RESULT SET 5 — blue measure */
    SELECT
        N'ฟ้า' AS MeasureColor,
        COUNT(*) AS TotalDebtorCount,
        CAST(ISNULL(SUM(ISNULL(b.PrincipalTotal, 0)), 0) / 1000000.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS OutstandingAmount,
        CAST(0 AS INT) AS CompletedDebtorCount,
        CAST(ISNULL(SUM(ISNULL(p.TotalPayment, 0)), 0) / 1000000.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS TotalPaymentAmount,
        CAST(ISNULL(SUM(ISNULL(p.TotalPrincipalReduction, 0)), 0) / 1000000.0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS ReducedPrincipalAmount
    FROM #MeasureBase b
    LEFT JOIN #Receipt p
        ON p.LGNo = b.LGNo
       AND p.MeasureId = b.MeasureId
    WHERE b.MeasureGroup = 375;

    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #ActualTarget;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #LGOrg;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #EODLatest;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Receipt;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #EligibleReceipts;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #MeasureBase;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TDRFirstApproval;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TDRBase;
END;

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_001_InsertDebtorFromCBS]
	-- นำเข้าข้อมูลลูกหนี้ DataDebtor
	@GetDate date = '2025-09-04'
	
	
AS
BEGIN
---ขั้นตอน มีดังนี้
--1) Insert DataDebtor ข้อมูลลูกหนี้
--2) DataDebtorNo ข้อมูล หมายเลขบัตร
--3) DataDebtorContact ข้อมูลการติดต่อ เช่น เบอร์, เบอร์มือถือ, ไลน์, อีเมล
--4) DataDebtorAddress ที่อยู่
--5) DataLG ข้อมูลการจ่ายค่าประกันชดเชย ของ LG
--6) DataLGReduce ข้อมูลการเพิ่ม/ลด วงเงอนการจ่ายค่าประกันชดเชย
--7) DataLGFee ข้อมูลค่าธรรมเนียม
--8) DataDebtorRelate ข้อมูลความสัมพันธ์ 
--9) การ์ด
  --9.1)DataMainCard การ์ดราย LG
  --9.2)DataMainCardMovement รายการเดินการ์ดราย LG
  --9.3)DataDebtorCard การ์ดลูกหนี้ 
  --9.4)DataDebtorCardMovement รายการเดินการ์ดราย ลูกหนี้


    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @CurrentYear nvarchar(2) = substring(cast(YEAR(dateadd(year, 543, GETDATE())) as nvarchar),3,2)
DECLARE @MaxCode INT =0 ;

SELECT @MaxCode = MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING([DebtorCode], 4, 6) AS INT))
FROM [DataDebtor]
WHERE LEFT([DebtorCode], 3) = 'C' + @CurrentYear;

-- ถ้าไม่มี debtor ในปีนั้นเลย ให้เริ่มที่ 1
SET @MaxCode = ISNULL(@MaxCode, 0);

  

	-- Step 1: Group by FirstName, LastName และเลือก MAX(DebtorCBSId)
WITH CTE_Grouped AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(DebtorCBSId) AS DebtorCBSId
        --,[FirstName]
        --,[LastName]
		,TRIM(IDCard) as IDCard
    FROM [TEMPDataDebtorCBS]
    WHERE CAST(CreateDate AS DATE) = @GetDate
    GROUP BY --[FirstName], [LastName], 
	TRIM(IDCard)
),

CTE_Ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY D.[FirstName]) AS RowNum
        ,D.[DebtorTypeId]
        ,D.[TitleId]
        ,D.[FirstName]
        ,D.[LastName]
        ,D.[DebtorName]
        ,D.[CardTypeId]
        ,D.[CardNumber]
        ,D.[CompanyNameEN]
        ,D.[BirthDate]
        ,D.[IDCard]
        ,D.[ContactName]
        ,D.[BusinessType]
        ,D.[BusinessTypeName]
        ,D.[CompanyType]
        ,D.[CompanyTypeDescription]
        ,D.[BusinessDescription]
        ,D.[DebtorCodeType]
        ,D.[RegistrationType]
        ,D.[RegistrationNo]
        ,D.[CompanyEngName]
        ,D.[RegistrationDate]
        ,D.[LoanerTotal]
        ,D.[BusinessStatus]
        ,D.[BusinessStatusDate]
        ,D.[CreateBy]
        ,D.[UpdateBy]
        ,D.[Age]
        ,D.[StatusPersonId]
        ,D.[LineID]
        ,D.CreateDate
        ,D.DebtorCBSId
        ,D.ISICCode 
		,dt.IDCard as dt_IDCard

    FROM TEMPDataDebtorCBS D
    LEFT JOIN CTE_Grouped G ON D.DebtorCBSId = G.DebtorCBSId
	LEFT JOIN DataDebtor dt on dt.IDCard = D.IDCard
	WHERE CAST(D.[CreateDate] as Date) = @GetDate
	and dt.IDCard is null
	--AND D.[FirstName] + D.[LastName] NOT IN (SELECT [FirstName] + [LastName] FROM [DataDebtor] )
	--AND D.IDCard NOT IN  (SELECT [DataDebtor].IDCard FROM [DataDebtor])

)

   INSERT INTO [DataDebtor] (
        [DebtorCode]
        ,[DebtorTypeId]
        ,[TitleId]
        ,[FirstName]
        ,[LastName]
        ,[DebtorName]
        ,[CardTypeId]
        ,[CardNumber]
        ,[CompanyNameEN]
        ,[BirthDate]
        ,[DebtorId]
        ,[IDCard]
        ,[ContactName]
  --      ,[Email]
  --      ,[CntPhoneNumber]
  --      ,[CntMobileNumber]
  --      ,[CntFaxNumber]
        ,[BusinessType]
        ,[BusinessTypeName]
        ,[CompanyType]
        ,[CompanyTypeDescription]
        ,[BusinessDescription]
        ,[DebtorCodeType]
        ,[RegistrationType]
        ,[RegistrationNo]
        ,[CompanyEngName]
        ,[RegistrationDate]
        ,[LoanerTotal]
        ,[BusinessStatus]
        ,[BusinessStatusDate]
        ,[CreateBy]
        ,[CreateDate]
        ,[UpdateBy]
        ,[UpdateDate]
        ,[Age]
        ,[StatusPersonId]
        ,[LineID]
        ,[DebtorCBSId]
		,[IsActive]
		,ISICCode 
		,GenderId
		,PersonGroupId

    )

SELECT 
    'C' + @CurrentYear + RIGHT('000000' + CAST(RowNum + @MaxCode AS VARCHAR), 6) AS [DebtorCode]
    ,[DebtorTypeId]
    ,[TitleId]
    ,[FirstName]
    ,[LastName]
    ,[DebtorName]
    ,[CardTypeId]
    ,[CardNumber]
    ,[CompanyNameEN]
    ,[BirthDate]
    ,NEWID() AS [DebtorId]
    ,[IDCard]
    ,[ContactName]
    ,[BusinessType]
    ,[BusinessTypeName]
    ,[CompanyType]
    ,[CompanyTypeDescription]
    ,[BusinessDescription]
    ,[DebtorCodeType]
    ,[RegistrationType]
    ,[RegistrationNo]
    ,[CompanyEngName]
    ,[RegistrationDate]
    ,[LoanerTotal]
    ,[BusinessStatus]
    ,[BusinessStatusDate]
    ,[CreateBy]
    ,GETDATE() AS [CreateDate]
    ,[UpdateBy]
    ,GETDATE() AS [UpdateDate]
    ,[Age]
    ,[StatusPersonId]
    ,[LineID]
	,DebtorCBSId
    ,1 AS IsActive
	,ISICCode 
	,case when TitleId in (1) then 151 
	when TitleId in (2,3) then 150
	else 152 end as GenderId
	,case when TitleId in (4) then 118 else 117 end as PersonGroupId
	--,dt_IDCard


FROM CTE_Ranked



	


	--6) DataLGReduce ข้อมูลการเพิ่ม/ลด วงเงอนการจ่ายค่าประกันชดเชย

	--7) DataLGFee ข้อมูลค่าธรรมเนียม

	--8) DataDebtorRelate ข้อมูลความสัมพันธ์ 

	--9) การ์ด

	--9.1)DataMainCard การ์ดราย LG
	--9.2)DataMainCardMovement รายการเดินการ์ดราย LG
	--9.3)DataDebtorCard การ์ดลูกหนี้ 
	--9.4)DataDebtorCardMovement รายการเดินการ์ดราย ลูกหนี้

END

--4) DataDebtorAddress ที่อยู่
--5) DataLG ข้อมูลการจ่ายค่าประกันชดเชย ของ LG
--6) DataLGReduce ข้อมูลการเพิ่ม/ลด วงเงอนการจ่ายค่าประกันชดเชย

  --9.4)DataDebtorCardMovement รายการเดินการ์ดราย ลูกหนี้


    SET NOCOUNT ON;

   
	 
	--2) DataDebtorNo ข้อมูล หมายเลขบัตร
	--------------------------------------------------
    -- Step 2: Insert into DataDebtorNo โดยใช้ DebtorId ที่เพิ่งสร้าง
	--------------------------------------------------

    INSERT INTO [DataDebtorNo] (
        [DebtorNoId]
        ,[DebtorId]
        ,[DebtorNo]
        ,[IssueDate]
        ,[ExpireDate]
        ,[DebtorNoTypeId]
        ,[CreateBy]
        ,[CreateDate]
        ,[UpdateBy]
        ,[UpdateDate]
        ,[IsDefault]
        ,[DebtorNoCBSId]
    )
    SELECT
        NEWID() AS [DebtorNoId]
        ,t.[DebtorId]
        ,cbs.[DebtorNoCBSCode] AS [DebtorNo]
        ,cbs.[IssueDate]
        ,cbs.[ExpireDate]
        ,cbs.[DebtorNoTypeId]
        ,cbs.[CreateBy]
        ,GETDATE() AS [CreateDate]
        ,cbs.[UpdateBy]
        ,GETDATE() AS [UpdateDate]
        ,cbs.[IsDefault]
        ,cbs.[DebtorNoCBSId]
    FROM [DataDebtorNoCBS] cbs
    INNER JOIN [DataDebtor] t ON cbs.[DebtorIDCard] COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = t.[IDCard]
    WHERE cbs.[DebtorNoCBSId] NOT IN (
        SELECT [DebtorNoCBSId] FROM [DataDebtorNo]
    );

	

END

        ,GETDATE()
        ,c_cbs.[UpdateBy]
        ,GETDATE()
        ,c_cbs.[DebtorContactCBSId]

    INNER JOIN [DataDebtor] t ON c_cbs.[DebtorIDCard] COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = t.[IDCard] COLLATE Thai_CI_AI

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_004_InsertDataDebtorAddressFromCBS]
	-- นำเข้าข้อมูลลูกหนี้ - ที่อยู่ DataDebtorAddress
	@GetDate date = '2025-09-03'
	
	
AS
BEGIN
---ขั้นตอน มีดังนี้
--1) Insert DataDebtor ข้อมูลลูกหนี้
--2) DataDebtorNo ข้อมูล หมายเลขบัตร
--3) DataDebtorContact ข้อมูลการติดต่อ เช่น เบอร์, เบอร์มือถือ, ไลน์, อีเมล
--4) DataDebtorAddress ที่อยู่
--5) DataLG ข้อมูลการจ่ายค่าประกันชดเชย ของ LG
--6) DataLGReduce ข้อมูลการเพิ่ม/ลด วงเงอนการจ่ายค่าประกันชดเชย
--7) DataLGFee ข้อมูลค่าธรรมเนียม
--8) DataDebtorRelate ข้อมูลความสัมพันธ์ 
--9) การ์ด
  --9.1)DataMainCard การ์ดราย LG
  --9.2)DataMainCardMovement รายการเดินการ์ดราย LG
  --9.3)DataDebtorCard การ์ดลูกหนี้ 
  --9.4)DataDebtorCardMovement รายการเดินการ์ดราย ลูกหนี้


    SET NOCOUNT ON;

	--4) DataDebtorAddress ที่อยู่
	--------------------------------------------------
    -- STEP 4: Insert into [DataDebtorAddress]
    --------------------------------------------------

    INSERT INTO [DataDebtorAddress] (
         [DebtorAddressId]
        ,[DebtorId]
        ,[DebtorAddressTypeId]
        ,[AddressNumber]
        ,[PlaceName]
        ,[Moo]
        ,[Soi]
        ,[Road]
        ,[ProvinceId]
        ,[SubDistrictId]
        ,[DistrictId]
        ,[PostalCode]
        ,[DebtorContactChannelId]
        ,[IsDefault]
        ,[CreateBy]
        ,[CreateDate]
        ,[UpdateBy]
        ,[UpdateDate]
        ,[Telephone]
        ,[Fax]
        ,[Mobile]
        ,[Email]
        ,[LineID]
        ,[DebtorAddressCBSId]
    )
    SELECT
         NEWID() AS [DebtorAddressId]
        ,deb_d.[DebtorId]
        ,case when a_cbs.[DebtorAddressTypeId] = 0 then 7 else a_cbs.[DebtorAddressTypeId] end
        ,a_cbs.[AddressNumber]
        ,a_cbs.[PlaceName]
        ,a_cbs.[Moo]

        ,a_cbs.[Road]

        ,a_cbs.[CreateBy]
        ,a_cbs.CreateDate AS [CreateDate]
        ,a_cbs.[UpdateBy]
        ,GETDATE()-1 AS [UpdateDate]
		--,''
		--,''
		--,''
        ,a_cbs.[Telephone]
        ,a_cbs.[Fax]
        ,a_cbs.[Mobile]
        ,a_cbs.[Email]
        ,a_cbs.[LineID]

    LEFT JOIN [DataDebtor] deb_d ON  deb_d.[DebtorCBSId] = a_cbs.[DebtorCBSId]
    WHERE cast(a_cbs.UpdateDate as date) = @GetDate

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_008_InsertDataSubrogationLetter]
	-- สร้างหนังสือรับช่วงสิทธิ
	@GetDate date = '2025-05-26'
	
	
AS
BEGIN
-- Step 1: เตรียม Format เบื้องต้น เช่น "DCS/SUB2567/"
DECLARE @DocumenFormat NVARCHAR(50) = (
    SELECT SystemName + SystemDCS + DocumentName + CAST(YEAR(GETDATE()) + 543 AS NVARCHAR) + '/'
    FROM SystemFormatDocumentMaster
    WHERE FormatDocumentId = 1
);

-- Step 2: ตรวจสอบ Running ล่าสุดจาก SubrogationLetterNo
DECLARE @MaxRunning INT = ISNULL((
    SELECT MAX(CAST(RIGHT(SubrogationLetterNo, 5) AS INT))
    FROM DataSubrogationLetter
    WHERE SubrogationLetterNo LIKE @DocumenFormat + '%'
), 0);

-- Step 3: เตรียมรายการที่จะ Insert พร้อม Running No
WITH SourceData AS (
    SELECT 
        rel.[DebtorRelateId],
        rel.[DebtorRelateCode],
        rel.[LGNo],
        rel.[CIFNo],
        rel.[DebtorCode],
        rel.[DebtorId],
        deb.[DebtorName],
		a.CollectorUserId,
		a.CollectorOAUserId,
		a.TypeAssignId,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY rel.[DebtorRelateId]) AS RowNum
    FROM [dbo].[DataDebtorRelate] rel
    JOIN [dbo].[DataDebtor] deb ON rel.[DebtorId] = deb.[DebtorId]
	JOIN [dbo].[DataAssignment] a ON a.DebtorRelateId = rel.DebtorRelateId
)
INSERT INTO [dbo].[DataSubrogationLetter] (
     [SubrogationLetterId]
    ,[DebtorRelateId]
    ,[SubrogationLetterNo]
    ,[SubrogationLetterDate]
    ,[DebtorName]
    ,[FileName]
    ,[PathFile]
    ,[CIFNo]
    ,[LGNo]
    ,[ApproverUserId]
    ,[PositionId]
    ,[ApproverName]
    ,[CreateDate]
    ,[CreateBy]
    ,[UpdateDate]
    ,[UpdateBy]
    ,[DebtorNo]
)
SELECT
     NEWID()
    ,s.[DebtorRelateId]
    ,@DocumenFormat + RIGHT('00000' + CAST(@MaxRunning + s.RowNum AS NVARCHAR), 5) AS [SubrogationLetterNo]
    ,GETDATE()
    ,s.[DebtorName]
    ,''
    ,''
    ,s.[CIFNo]
    ,s.[LGNo]
    ,case when TypeAssignId = 1 then s.CollectorUserId else s.CollectorOAUserId end
    ,dbo.FN_DCS_25_GetPosition(case when TypeAssignId = 1 then s.CollectorUserId else s.CollectorOAUserId end)
    ,dbo.FN_DCS_10_GetOfficerUserNameTH(case when TypeAssignId = 1 then s.CollectorUserId else s.CollectorOAUserId end)
    ,GETDATE()
    ,1
    ,GETDATE()
    ,1
    ,s.[DebtorCode]
FROM SourceData s;


END

modules.name: SP_DCS_009_InsertDataMainCardFromLGCBS
modules.definition:
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_009_InsertDataMainCardFromLGCBS]
	-- นำเข้าข้อมูลการ์ดลูกหนี้ - การ์ด LG (DataMainCard)
    @GetDate DATE =  '2025-08-30'
	--,@TypeId int = 1 --1=Insert ด้วย job, 2=Insert ทีละการ์ด (Manual ทีละ Id)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @GetMeasureId INT= (SELECT TOP 1 MeasureId FROM SystemMeasureMaster WHERE IsDefault=1)
	DECLARE @GetInterestRate decimal(20,4)= (select top 1 cast(m.ConditionItemMapingValue as decimal(20,4))
									from SystemConditionItemMappingValueMaster m
									left join SystemConditionMaster c on m.ConditionId = c.ConditionId
									left join SystemCampaignConditionMaster cc on cc.ConditionId = c.ConditionId
									left join SystemMeasureCampaignMaster cm on cm.CampaignId = cc.CampaignId
									left join SystemMeasureMaster mm on mm.MeasureId = cm.MeasureId
									where mm.IsDefault=1
									and m.ConditionItemId=48)


	BEGIN TRANSACTION;

	-- ล็อกตารางแบบ Exclusive
	--SELECT 1
	--FROM [dbo].[DataMainCard] WITH (TABLOCKX);

    INSERT INTO [DataMainCard] (
        [MainCardId]
        ,[LGNo]
        ,[ClaimPayDate]
        ,[SystemBankId]
        ,[BankCode]
        ,[CardStatusId]
        ,[InterestRate]
        ,[InterestPlannedRate]
        ,[AmountDuty]
        ,[ClaimPay]
        ,[DebtBalance]
        ,[Principal]
        ,[PrincipalTotal]
        ,[CreateBy]
        ,[CreateDate]
        ,[UpdateBy]
        ,[UpdateDate]
        ,[CIFNumber]
        ,[DebtBurden]
        ,[ConditionPayment]
        ,[MainCardCode]
        ,[InstallmentsAmount]
        ,[InstallmentOutstanding]
        ,[GroupCardCode]
        ,[InstallmentPrincipal]
        ,[InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
        ,[SeqCurrent]
        ,[SeqNext]
        ,[InterestStartDate]
        ,[InterestEndDate]
        ,[CurrentPaymentDate]
        ,[MeasureId]
        ,[IsDelete]

    )
    SELECT
        NEWID() AS [MainCardId]
        ,cbs.[LGNo]
        ,cbs.[ClaimDate] AS [ClaimPayDate]
        ,sb.[BankId]
        ,cbs.[BankCode]
        ,1 AS [CardStatusId]
        ,@GetInterestRate AS [InterestRate]
        ,@GetInterestRate AS [InterestPlannedRate]
        ,cbs.[ClaimAmount] AS [AmountDuty]
        ,cbs.[ClaimPayAmount] AS [ClaimPay]
        ,cbs.[ClaimPayAmount] AS [DebtBalance]
        ,cbs.[ClaimPayAmount] AS [Principal]
        ,cbs.[ClaimPayAmount] AS [PrincipalTotal]
        ,cbs.[CreateBy]
        ,cbs.[CreateDate] AS [CreateDate]
        ,cbs.[UpdateBy]
        ,cbs.[CreateDate] AS [UpdateDate]
        ,cbs.[CIFNo] AS [CIFNumber]
        ,cbs.[ClaimAmountCurrent] AS [DebtBurden]
        ,NULL AS [ConditionPayment]
        ,cbs.[CIFNo] + '-' + cbs.[LGNo] + '-1' AS [MainCardCode]
        ,cbs.[ClaimPayAmount] AS [InstallmentsAmount]
        ,cbs.[ClaimPayAmount] AS [InstallmentOutstanding]
        ,cbs.[CIFNo] + '-' + cbs.[LGNo] AS [GroupCardCode]
        ,cbs.[ClaimPayAmount] AS [InstallmentPrincipal]
        ,cbs.[ClaimPayAmount] AS [InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
        ,2 AS [SeqCurrent]
        ,3 AS [SeqNext]
        ,cbs.[ClaimDate] AS [InterestStartDate]
        ,cbs.[ClaimDate] AS [InterestEndDate]
        ,cast('1900-01-01' as date) AS [CurrentPaymentDate]
