CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_011_InsertDataDebtorCardFromLGCBS]
	-- นำเข้าข้อมูลการ์ดลูกหนี้ - การ์ดรายคน (DataMainCard)
    @GetDate DATE =  '2025-09-04'
	
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @GetMeasureId INT= (SELECT TOP 1 MeasureId FROM SystemMeasureMaster WHERE IsDefault=1)
	DECLARE @GetInterestRate decimal(20,4)= (select top 1 cast(m.ConditionItemMapingValue as decimal(20,4))
									from SystemConditionItemMappingValueMaster m
									left join SystemConditionMaster c on m.ConditionId = c.ConditionId
									left join SystemCampaignConditionMaster cc on cc.ConditionId = c.ConditionId
									left join SystemMeasureCampaignMaster cm on cm.CampaignId = cc.CampaignId
									left join SystemMeasureMaster mm on mm.MeasureId = cm.MeasureId
									where mm.IsDefault=1
									and m.ConditionItemId=48)
	DECLARE @GetMeasureName nvarchar(200) = (SELECT TOP 1 MeasureName FROM SystemMeasureMaster WHERE MeasureId = @GetMeasureId)


	BEGIN TRANSACTION;

	-- ล็อกตารางแบบ Exclusive
	--SELECT 1
	--FROM [dbo].[DataMainCard] WITH (TABLOCKX);

    INSERT INTO [dbo].[DataDebtorCard] (
    [DataDebtorCardId]
    ,[LGNo]
    ,[DebtorCode]
    ,[DebtorCardCode]
    ,[DebtorCardName]
	,[InterestRate]
	,[InterestPlannedRate]
   -- ,[CardType]
    ,[ClaimPayDate]
    ,[SystemBankId]
    ,[BankCode]
    ,[IsAuto]
    ,[ClaimPay]
	,[DebtAmount]
    ,[DebtBalance]
    ,[Principal]
    ,[PrincipalTotal]
    ,[CreateBy]
    ,[CreateDate]
    ,[UpdateBy]
    ,[UpdateDate]
	,[MeasureId]
	,[MeasureName]
    ,[DebtorId]
    ,[DebtorRelateId]
	,[ProportionLiability]
    ,[DebtorRelateCode]
    ,[DebtorRelateTypeId]
    ,[CIFNo]
    ,[DebtBurden]
    ,[MainCardCode]
	,[DataMainCardId]
	,[SeqNo]
	,[CardStatusId]
	,[CardStatusDate]
    ,[InstallmentsAmount]
    ,[InstallmentOutstanding]
    ,[GroupCardCode]
    ,[InstallmentPrincipal]
    ,[InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
	,[AmountDuty]
	,[SeqCurrent]
	,[SeqNext]
	,[InterestStartDate]
	,[InterestEndDate]
	,[MeasureDate]
	,[RequestNoTDR]
	,[CompromiseContractId]
	,[CompromiseContracApproveDate]
	,[RequestDebtorApproveDate]
	,[FileOtherDate]
	,[Remark]
	,[IsDelete]
	,[Reference1]
	,[Reference2]

)
SELECT 
    NEWID() AS [DataDebtorCardId]
    ,r.[LGNo]
    ,r.[DebtorCode]
    ,d.[DebtorCode] +'-'+ r.[LGNo] + '-1' AS [DebtorCardCode]
    ,d.FirstName + ' ' + isnull(LastName,'') AS [DebtorCardName]
	,@GetInterestRate AS [InterestRate]
	,@GetInterestRate AS [InterestPlannedRate]
    --,CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId] = 1 THEN 'M' ELSE 'S' END AS [CardType]  -- M = Main, S = Sub
    ,mc.[ClaimPayDate] AS [ClaimPayDate]
    ,mc.[SystemBankId] AS [SystemBankId]
    ,mc.BankCode AS [BankCode]
    ,1 AS [IsAuto]
    ,mc.[ClaimPay] AS [ClaimPay]
    ,(CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId]  = 2 THEN mc.[DebtBalance] / dbo.[FN_DCS_01_ProportionLiabilit](r.[LGNo]) ELSE mc.[DebtBalance] END) AS [DebtAmount]
    ,(CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId]  = 2 THEN mc.[DebtBalance] / dbo.[FN_DCS_01_ProportionLiabilit](r.[LGNo]) ELSE mc.[DebtBalance] END) AS [DebtBalance]
    ,(CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId]  = 2 THEN mc.[DebtBalance] / dbo.[FN_DCS_01_ProportionLiabilit](r.[LGNo]) ELSE mc.[DebtBalance] END) AS [Principal]
    ,(CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId]  = 2 THEN mc.[DebtBalance] / dbo.[FN_DCS_01_ProportionLiabilit](r.[LGNo]) ELSE mc.[DebtBalance] END) AS [PrincipalTotal]
    ,1 AS [CreateBy]
    ,r.CreateDate AS [CreateDate]
    ,1 AS [UpdateBy]
    ,r.UpdateDate AS [UpdateDate]
	,@GetMeasureId AS [MeasureId]
	,@GetMeasureName AS [MeasureName]
    ,r.[DebtorId]
    ,r.[DebtorRelateId]
	,(CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId]  = 2 THEN mc.[DebtBalance] / dbo.[FN_DCS_01_ProportionLiabilit](r.[LGNo]) ELSE mc.[DebtBalance] END) AS [ProportionLiability]
    ,r.[DebtorRelateCode]
    ,r.[DebtorTypeId] AS [DebtorRelateTypeId]
    ,r.[CIFNo]
    ,mc.[DebtBurden] AS [DebtBurden]
    ,mc.[MainCardCode] AS [MainCardCode]
	,mc.[MainCardId] AS [DataMainCardId]
	,1 AS [SeqNo]
	,1 AS [CardStatusId]
	,GETDATE() AS [CardStatusDate]
    ,mc.[InstallmentsAmount] AS [InstallmentsAmount]
    ,mc.[InstallmentOutstanding] AS [InstallmentOutstanding]
    ,r.[CIFNo] + '-' + r.[LGNo] AS [GroupCardCode]
	,(CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId]  = 2 THEN mc.[DebtBalance] / dbo.[FN_DCS_01_ProportionLiabilit](r.[LGNo]) ELSE mc.[InstallmentPrincipal] END) AS [InstallmentPrincipal]
	,(CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId]  = 2 THEN mc.[DebtBalance] / dbo.[FN_DCS_01_ProportionLiabilit](r.[LGNo]) ELSE mc.[InstallmentPrincipalTotal] END) AS [InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
	,(CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId]  = 2 THEN mc.[DebtBalance] / dbo.[FN_DCS_01_ProportionLiabilit](r.[LGNo]) ELSE mc.[InstallmentPrincipalTotal] END) AS [AmountDuty]
	,2 as [SeqCurrent]
	,3 as [SeqNext]
	,mc.ClaimPayDate as [InterestStartDate]
	,mc.ClaimPayDate as [InterestEndDate]
	,mc.ClaimPayDate as [MeasureDate]
	,null as [RequestNoTDR]
	,null as [CompromiseContractId]
	,cast('1900-01-01' as date) as [CompromiseContracApproveDate]
	,cast('1900-01-01' as date) as[RequestDebtorApproveDate]
	,cast('1900-01-01' as date) as[FileOtherDate]
	,null as [Remark]
	,0 as [IsDelete]
	,null as [Reference1]
	,null as [Reference2]

FROM [dbo].[DataDebtorRelate] r
LEFT JOIN [dbo].[DataLG] lg ON r.[LGNo] = lg.[LGNo]
LEFT JOIN [dbo].[DataDebtor] d ON d.[DebtorId] = r.[DebtorId]
LEFT JOIN [dbo].[DataMainCard] mc ON r.[LGNo] = mc.[LGNo]
WHERE 
--lg.[LGNo] = '4801150'
 (r.[DebtorCode] + '-' + r.[LGNo] + '-1' not in (SELECT DebtorCardCode FROM [DataDebtorCard]))
 and lg.Grade = 'F1'
--AND CAST(r.CreateDate AS DATE) = @GetDate;
and r.DebtorRelateId not in (select DebtorRelateId from DataDebtorCard )


	--EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_012_InsertDataDebtorCardMovementFromLGCBS] @GetDate;

	--EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_015_InsertBillPayment]


	COMMIT TRANSACTION;
END

-- =============================================

-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_014_1_InsertDebtorCardPrincipal]
   

	@GetDate date = '2024-10-01'
	,@Amount decimal(20,4) = 1000
	,@DataDebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = '228362C3-4BB3-4D23-9D75-B8F73EA2C042'
	,@DataDebtorCardSubId nvarchar(150) = 'F70BC1D3-5499-425C-97E9-00192B895750'
	--,@TypeId int = 1 --1=insert ดอกเบี้ยผิดนัด ทุกมาตรการ, 2=insert ดอกเบี้ยเดิม (ปิดแผน) 
	,@LGNo nvarchar(20) = '65067431'
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

declare @CurrentDate datetime = @GetDate

declare @SeqCurrent int = (select SeqCurrent from DataDebtorCard where DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId )
declare @DebtorCode nvarchar(20) = (select DebtorCode from DataDebtorCard where DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardSubId )

declare @EndDate datetime = (select InterestEndDate + 1 from DataDebtorCardMovement where DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId and SeqNo = @SeqCurrent)


DECLARE @DaysInYear INT = DATEDIFF(DAY, cast(year(getdate()) as nvarchar) + '-01-01', cast(year(getdate()) as nvarchar) + '-12-31') + 1;
DECLARE @PaymentTypeId int = 11 --รับคืน-ผู้ค้ำ-{{DebtorCode}}
DECLARE @PaymentTypeCode nvarchar(2) =(select PaymentTypeCode from SystemPaymentType where PaymentTypeId = @PaymentTypeId)
DECLARE @PaymentTypeName nvarchar(100) = replace((select PaymentTypeName from SystemPaymentType where PaymentTypeId = @PaymentTypeId),'{{DebtorCode}}' ,@DebtorCode)

DECLARE @GetCountCard int = (select count(*)+1 from DataDebtorCard where LGNo = @LGNo and DebtorRelateTypeId = 2 ) --and CardStatusId != 1
--DECLARE @DebtBalance decimal(20,4) = @Amount/@GetCountCard
--DECLARE @GetBalance decimal(20,4) = (select InstallmentPrincipalTotal from DataDebtorCard where DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId )
DECLARE @PrincipalTotal decimal(20,4) = (select PrincipalTotal from DataDebtorCardMovement where DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId and SeqNo = @SeqCurrent)

	INSERT INTO [dbo].[DataDebtorCardMovement]
			   ([DebtorCardMovementId]
			   ,[DebtorCardId]
			   ,[DocDate]
			   ,[PayDate]
			   ,[LGNo]
			   ,[DebtorId]
			   ,[DebtorCode]
			   ,[DebtorCardCode]
			   ,[DebtorCardName]
			   ,[TypeId]
			   ,[TypeCode]
			   ,[TypeName]
			   ,[FlagAutoPay]
			   ,[DFDDate]
			   ,[DFDStartDate]
			   ,[DFDEndDate]
			   ,[DPD]
			   ,[TotalPay]
			   ,[IsAdjust]
			   ,[AdjustRefDocNo]
			   ,[IsDelete]
			   ,[MeasureId]
			   ,[MeasureCode]
			   ,[MeasureName]
			   ,[InterestRate]
			   ,[InterestPlannedRate]
			   ,[InterestDefaultRate]
			   ,[DebtBalance]
			   ,[ReceivePayment]
			   ,[Installment]
			   ,[InstallmentPay]
			   ,[InstallmentTotal]
			   ,[Principal]
			   ,[PrincipalPay]
			   ,[PrincipalTotal]
			   ,[InterimInterest]
			   ,[AccruedInterest]
			   ,[AccruedInterestPay]
			   ,[AccruedInterestTotal]
			   ,[CourtFee]
			   ,[CourtFeePay]
			   ,[CourtFeeTotal]
			   ,[LawyerFee]
			   ,[LawyerFeePay]
			   ,[LawyerFeeTotal]
			   ,[OtherExpense]
			   ,[OtherExpensePay]
			   ,[OtherExpenseTotal]
			   ,[InitialMargin]
			   ,[InitialMarginPay]
			   ,[InitialMarginTotal]
			   ,[SuspendInt]
			   ,[SuspendIntPay]
			   ,[SuspendIntTotal]
			   ,[DeferredInterest]
			   ,[DeferredInterestPay]
			   ,[DeferredInterestTotal]
			   ,[SuspendedDefaultInterest]
			   ,[SuspendedDefaultInterestPay]
			   ,[SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal]
			   ,[PlannedInterest]
			   ,[PlannedInterestPay]
			   ,[PlannedInterestTotal]
			   ,[DefaultInterest]
			   ,[DefaultInterestPay]
			   ,[DefaultInterestTotal]
			   ,[CreateBy]
			   ,[CreateDate]
			   ,[UpdateBy]
			   ,[UpdateDate]
			   ,[ReceiptNo]
			   ,[IsEstatement]
			   ,[EStatementRef]
			   ,[PaymentTypeId]
			   ,[SeqNo]
			   ,[DebtorPaymentId]
			   ,[DebtorPaymentCode]
			   ,[CompromiseContractGroup]
			   ,[ReceiptId]
			   ,[InstallmentPrincipal]
			   ,[InstallmentPrincipalPay]
			   ,[InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
			   ,[InstallmentInterest]
			   ,[InstallmentInterestPay]
			   ,[InstallmentInterestTotal]
			   ,[InterestStartDate]
			   ,[InterestEndDate]
			   ,[InterestQuantity]
			   ,[DPDAccumulate])


	SELECT top 1 newid()
		  ,[DebtorCardId]
		  ,@CurrentDate as CurrentDate
		  ,@CurrentDate as PayDate
		  ,[LGNo]
		  ,[DebtorId]
		  ,[DebtorCode]
		  ,[DebtorCardCode]
		  ,[DebtorCardName]
		  ,@PaymentTypeId as PaymentTypeId
		  ,@PaymentTypeCode as PaymentTypeCode
		  ,@PaymentTypeName as PaymentTypeName
		  ,1
		  ,cast('1900-01-01' as datetime) as [DFDDate]
		  ,@CurrentDate as [DFDStartDate]
		  ,@CurrentDate as [DFDEndDate]
		  ,[DPD]
		  ,@Amount as [TotalPay]
		  ,0 as [IsAdjust]
		  ,'' as [AdjustRefDocNo]
		  ,0
		  ,[MeasureId]
		  ,[MeasureCode]
		  ,[MeasureName]
		  ,[InterestRate]
		  ,[InterestPlannedRate]
		  ,[InterestDefaultRate]
		  ,[DebtBalance]
		  ,[ReceivePayment]
		  ,@PrincipalTotal - @Amount as [Installment]
		  ,@Amount as [InstallmentPay]
		  ,@PrincipalTotal - @Amount [InstallmentTotal]
		  ,@PrincipalTotal - @Amount as [Principal]
		  ,0 as [PrincipalPay]
		  ,@PrincipalTotal - @Amount as [PrincipalTotal]
		  ,0 as [InterimInterest]
		  ,0 as [AccruedInterest]
		  ,0 as [AccruedInterestPay]
		  ,[AccruedInterestTotal]
		  ,0 as [CourtFee]
		  ,0 as [CourtFeePay]
		  ,[CourtFeeTotal]
		  ,0 as [LawyerFee]
		  ,0 as [LawyerFeePay]
		  ,[LawyerFeeTotal]
		  ,0 as [OtherExpense]
		  ,0 as [OtherExpensePay]
		  ,[OtherExpenseTotal]
		  ,0 as [InitialMargin]
		  ,0 as [InitialMarginPay]
		  ,[InitialMarginTotal]
		  ,0 as [SuspendInt]
		  ,0 as [SuspendIntPay]
		  ,[SuspendIntTotal]
		  ,0 as [DeferredInterest]
		  ,0 as [DeferredInterestPay]
		  ,[DeferredInterestTotal]
		  ,0 as [SuspendedDefaultInterest]
		  ,0 as [SuspendedDefaultInterestPay]
		  ,[SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal]
		  ,0 as [PlannedInterest]
		  ,0 as [PlannedInterestPay]
		  ,[PlannedInterestTotal]
		  ,0 as [DefaultInterest]
		  ,0 as [DefaultInterestPay]
		  ,[DefaultInterestTotal]
		  ,1
		  ,getdate() as [CreateDate] 
		  ,1
		  ,getdate() as [UpdateDate]
		  ,[ReceiptNo]
		  ,1 as [IsEstatement]
		  ,[EStatementRef]
		  ,[PaymentTypeId]
		  ,[SeqNo]+1
		  ,[DebtorPaymentId]
		  ,[DebtorPaymentCode]
		  ,[CompromiseContractGroup]
		  ,[ReceiptId]
		  ,@PrincipalTotal - @Amount as [InstallmentPrincipal]
		  ,@Amount as [InstallmentPrincipalPay]
		  ,@PrincipalTotal - @Amount as [InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
		  ,0 as [InstallmentInterest]
		  ,0 as [InstallmentInterestPay]
		  ,[InstallmentInterestTotal]
		  ,cast('1900-01-01' as datetime) as [InterestStartDate]
		  --,cast('2024-08-27' as datetime)

		  ,cast('1900-01-01' as datetime) as [InterestEndDate]
		  ,0 as [InterestQuantity]
		  ,[DPDAccumulate]

		  
	from DataDebtorCardMovement cm
	where 
	cm.DebtorCardId= @DataDebtorCardId
	and cm.SeqNo = @SeqCurrent ;


	Update  DataDebtorCard 
	set SeqCurrent = SeqCurrent +1
	, SeqNext = SeqNext+1
	, DebtBalance = DebtBalance-@Amount
	, PrincipalTotal = @PrincipalTotal-@Amount
	, InstallmentPrincipal = InstallmentPrincipal-@Amount
	, InstallmentPrincipalTotal = InstallmentPrincipalTotal-@Amount

where DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId;
EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_022_UpdateDPD]  @GetDate, @DataDebtorCardId, @SeqCurrent

END

-- =============================================

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_014_InsertDebtorCard_backupJaO]
    -- นำเข้าข้อมูลลูกหนี้ DataDebtor
    --@Amount decimal(20,4) = 20000
    --@EStatementId nvarchar(150)  = 'd33b8016-edab-44be-971a-e1b1c0c6e22d'
	--@EStatementId nvarchar(150) = '5e256d0c-fe38-4ad5-84ee-4c3d021d39a0'
	--,@DataDebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = '228362C3-4BB3-4D23-9D75-B8F73EA2C042'
    --,@DataDebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = '228362C3-4BB3-4D23-9D75-B8F73EA2C042'
	--,@DataDebtorCardId2 nvarchar(150) = 'F70BC1D3-5499-425C-97E9-00192B895750'
    --,@DataDebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = 'F70BC1D3-5499-425C-97E9-00192B895750'

	--รอบแรก
	--@DataDebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = '228362C3-4BB3-4D23-9D75-B8F73EA2C042'
	--,@DataDebtorCardId2 nvarchar(150) = 'F70BC1D3-5499-425C-97E9-00192B895750'
	--,@EStatementId nvarchar(150)  = 'd33b8016-edab-44be-971a-e1b1c0c6e22d'

	--รอบ2
	@DataDebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = '228362C3-4BB3-4D23-9D75-B8F73EA2C042'
	--,@DataDebtorCardId2 nvarchar(150) = '228362C3-4BB3-4D23-9D75-B8F73EA2C042'
	,@EStatementId nvarchar(150)  = '791bcd90-70f3-491f-bef4-a5e827ffc541'
AS
BEGIN
    --SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @Amount DECIMAL(20,6)-- = (SELECT Amount FROM DataEStatement WHERE EStatementId = @EStatementId);
	DECLARE @GetDate datetime-- = (SELECT PaymentDate FROM DataEStatement WHERE EStatementId = @EStatementId);
	DECLARE @IDCard NVARCHAR(20) --= (SELECT Reference1 FROM DataEStatement WHERE EStatementId = @EStatementId);
    DECLARE @LGNo NVARCHAR(20)-- = (SELECT Reference2 FROM DataEStatement WHERE EStatementId = @EStatementId);
	DECLARE @SeqCurrent INT --= (SELECT SeqCurrent FROM DataDebtorCard WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId);
	DECLARE @DebtorTypeId INT-- = (SELECT DebtorRelateTypeId FROM DataDebtorCard WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId);
	DECLARE @AccruedInterestTotal DECIMAL(20,4) -- ดอกเบี้ยค้างรับทั้งหมด
	DECLARE @DebtorId nvarchar(150) 
	 DECLARE @PaymentDate DATETIME-- = (SELECT PaymentDate FROM DataEStatement WHERE EStatementId = @EStatementId);
	 DECLARE @DebtorCardId nvarchar(150)
	-- Get Data มา 
	SELECT 
	@Amount=Amount,
	@GetDate= PaymentDate,
	@IDCard=Reference1,
	@LGNo=Reference2,
	@PaymentDate=PaymentDate
	
	FROM DataEStatement WHERE EStatementId = @EStatementId;

	-- Get Data มา 
	SELECT 
	@SeqCurrent=SeqCurrent,
	@DebtorTypeId=DebtorRelateTypeId ,
	@AccruedInterestTotal= AccruedInterestTotal ,
	@DebtorId=DebtorId,
	@DataDebtorCardId=DataDebtorCardId
	FROM DataDebtorCard WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId;



/*	
select @AccruedInterestTotal= AccruedInterestTotal 
from DataDebtorCardMovement 
where DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId and SeqNo=@SeqCurrent-1
*/
	
 /* NO USED
    --IF @DebtorId IS NULL RETURN;

    DECLARE @DebtorCardMovementIdMax nvarchar(150) = (
        SELECT TOP 1 DebtorCardMovementId
        FROM DataDebtorCardMovement
        WHERE DebtorId = @DebtorId
        ORDER BY SeqNo DESC
    );


   
    DECLARE @DebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = (
        SELECT TOP 1 DataDebtorCardId
        FROM DataDebtorCard
        WHERE DebtorId = @DebtorId AND LGNo = @LGNo
    );
	*/

    DECLARE @TypeId INT = 2;
    DECLARE @TypeCode NVARCHAR(2) = (SELECT PaymentTypeCode FROM SystemPaymentType WHERE PaymentTypeId = @TypeId);
    DECLARE @TypeName NVARCHAR(50) = (SELECT PaymentTypeName FROM SystemPaymentType WHERE PaymentTypeId = @TypeId);

    DECLARE @MeasureId INT = (SELECT MeasureId FROM DataDebtorCard WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId);
    DECLARE @PaymentSeq INT = (
        SELECT TOP 1 m.ConditionItemMapingValue
        FROM SystemConditionItemMappingValueMaster m
        LEFT JOIN SystemConditionMaster c ON m.ConditionId = c.ConditionId
        LEFT JOIN SystemCampaignConditionMaster cc ON cc.ConditionId = c.ConditionId
        LEFT JOIN SystemMeasureCampaignMaster cm ON cm.CampaignId = cc.CampaignId
        LEFT JOIN SystemMeasureMaster mm ON mm.MeasureId = cm.MeasureId
        WHERE mm.IsDefault = 1 AND m.ConditionItemId = 20
    );

    -- ค่าคำนวณ
	-- อัตราดอกเบี้ย 
    DECLARE @Principal DECIMAL(20,6)-- = (SELECT PrincipalTotal FROM DataDebtorCard WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId);
    DECLARE @InterestRate DECIMAL(20,6)-- = (SELECT InterestRate / 100 FROM DataDebtorCard WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId);
   SELECT @Principal=PrincipalTotal,
   @InterestRate=(InterestRate / 100) 
   FROM DataDebtorCard WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId

   Declare @SeqNoMax int
   Select @SeqNoMax=max(seqno)
   from DataDebtorCardMovement WHERE DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
   
   DECLARE @InterestDate INT = DATEDIFF(
        DAY,
        (SELECT InterestStartDate FROM DataDebtorCardMovement WHERE SeqNo=@SeqNoMax and DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
		),
        DATEADD(DAY, -1, @PaymentDate)
    ) + 1;

	-- ทำไม hard code
	-- คำนวณ ปี ที่จะมาคำนวณ ปีปัจจุบัน 
    DECLARE @DaysInYear INT = DATEDIFF(DAY, cast( year(getdate()) as varchar(10)) + '-01-01',  cast( year(getdate()) as varchar(10))+ '-12-31') + 1; 


    DECLARE @Interest DECIMAL(20,6) = @Principal * @InterestRate * @InterestDate / @DaysInYear;

    --Update DataDebtorCardMovement 
    --Set InterestEndDate = @PaymentDate - 1
    --, PlannedInterest = @Interest --ดอกเบี้ยตามแผน-ทั้งหมด
    --, PlannedInterestTotal = PlannedInterestTotal + @Interest --ดอกเบี้ยตามแผน-คงเหลือ
    --, AccruedInterest =  @Interest --ดอกเบี้ยค้างรับ-ทั้งหมด
    --, AccruedInterestTotal =  AccruedInterestTotal + @Interest --ดอกเบี้ยค้างรับ-คงเหลือ
    --, DebtBalance = DebtBalance + @Interest
    ---- --select * from DataDebtorCardMovement
    --Where DebtorCardMovementId = @DebtorCardMovementIdMax

    --,@DebtorCardId
    --,@PaymentSeq 
    --,@InterestDate AS InterestDate
    --,@InterestRate AS InterestRate
    --,@Interest AS Interest
    --, @Amount AS PaymentAmount
    --, CASE WHEN @Amount >= (CASE WHEN sd.ConditionPaymentId = 5 THEN dbo.[FN_DCS_02_PayableAmount](@DebtorCardId, l.KeyName) * (sd.[Values]/100) 
    --						ELSE dbo.[FN_DCS_02_PayableAmount](@DebtorCardId, l.KeyName) END)
    --	   THEN @Amount - (CASE WHEN sd.ConditionPaymentId = 5 THEN dbo.[FN_DCS_02_PayableAmount](@DebtorCardId, l.KeyName) * (sd.[Values]/100) 
    --						ELSE dbo.[FN_DCS_02_PayableAmount](@DebtorCardId, l.KeyName) END)
    --	  ELSE (CASE WHEN sd.ConditionPaymentId = 5 THEN dbo.[FN_DCS_02_PayableAmount](@DebtorCardId, l.KeyName) * (sd.[Values]/100) 
    --						ELSE dbo.[FN_DCS_02_PayableAmount](@DebtorCardId, l.KeyName) END) - @Amount END AS Total
    --, sd.*

    -- เตรียม temp table
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmp') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tmp;

    SELECT 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sd.Seq) AS RowNum,
        sd.Seq,
        sd.PaymentSeqTypeId,
        l.KeyName,
        l.LookUpValue,
		CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(20,6)) AS BFAmount, --ยกมก
        isnull(CAST(
            CASE 
                WHEN sd.ConditionPaymentId = 5 
                    THEN dbo.[FN_DCS_02_PayableAmount](@DebtorCardId, l.KeyName) * (sd.[Values]/100)
                ELSE dbo.[FN_DCS_02_PayableAmount](@DebtorCardId, l.KeyName)
            END AS DECIMAL(20,6)
        ),0) AS PayableAmount, --จำนวนเงินที่จ่าย
		--dbo.[FN_DCS_02_PayableAmount](@DebtorCardId, l.KeyName) as P1, 
		--dbo.[FN_DCS_02_PayableAmount](@DebtorCardId, l.KeyName) * (sd.[Values]/100) as P2,
        
        CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(20,6)) AS UpdateAmount --คงเหลือ
    INTO #tmp
    FROM SystemPaymentSeqDetailMaster sd
    LEFT JOIN SystemPaymentSeqMaster s ON s.PaymentSeqId = sd.PaymentSeqId
    LEFT JOIN SystemLookupMaster l ON l.LookupId = sd.PaymentSeqTypeId
    WHERE s.PaymentSeqId = @PaymentSeq;

	--select  t2,d, * from #tmp
    -- วนลูปเพื่อคำนวณและอัปเดต UpdateAmount
    DECLARE @Row INT = 1, @MaxRow INT;
    SELECT @MaxRow = MAX(RowNum) FROM #tmp;

    WHILE @Row <= @MaxRow
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @Payable DECIMAL(20,6), @Update DECIMAL(20,6), @PrevUpdate DECIMAL(20,6);
        SELECT @Payable = PayableAmount FROM #tmp WHERE RowNum = @Row;

        IF @Row = 1
        BEGIN
            UPDATE #tmp SET BFAmount = @Amount WHERE RowNum = 1;
            SET @Update = CASE WHEN @Amount >= @Payable THEN @Amount - @Payable ELSE 0 END;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            SELECT @PrevUpdate = UpdateAmount FROM #tmp WHERE RowNum = @Row - 1;
            UPDATE #tmp SET BFAmount = @PrevUpdate WHERE RowNum = @Row;
            SET @Update = CASE WHEN @PrevUpdate >= @Payable THEN @PrevUpdate - @Payable ELSE 0 END;
        END

        UPDATE #tmp SET UpdateAmount = @Update WHERE RowNum = @Row;
        SET @Row += 1;
    END
	select * from #tmp
    -- แสดงผล
    SELECT *
    , PayableAmount - (CASE WHEN PayableAmount <= BFAmount THEN 0 ELSE PayableAmount - BFAmount END) AS Used
    , CASE WHEN PayableAmount <= BFAmount THEN 0 ELSE PayableAmount - BFAmount END AS Total
    INTO #tmpFinal
    FROM #tmp;

    --SELECT * FROM #tmpFinal;

	declare @PrincipalPay decimal(20,4) --= (SELECT [Used] FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'Principal')
	declare @PrincipalTotal decimal(20,4) --= (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'Principal')

	SELECT @PrincipalPay=[Used],
	@PrincipalTotal=Total 
	FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'Principal' 


	declare @DefaultInterestPay decimal(20,4)-- = (SELECT [Used] FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'DefaultInterest')
	declare @DefaultInterestTotal decimal(20,4) --= (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'DefaultInterest')

	SELECT 
	@DefaultInterestPay=[Used] ,
	@DefaultInterestTotal=Total
	FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'DefaultInterest'


	declare @PlannedInterestPay decimal(20,4) --= (SELECT [Used] FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'PlannedInterest')
	declare @PlannedInterestTotal decimal(20,4) --= (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'PlannedInterest')

	SELECT @PlannedInterestPay=[Used],
	@PlannedInterestTotal=Total
	FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'PlannedInterest'


    UPDATE DCM
    SET 
        DCM.PrincipalPay = @PrincipalPay ,
        DCM.PrincipalTotal = @PrincipalTotal ,

		--ตามแผน
        DCM.PlannedInterestPay =  @PlannedInterestPay,
        DCM.PlannedInterestTotal =  @PlannedInterestTotal,

		--ผิดนัด
		DCM.DefaultInterestPay = @DefaultInterestPay,
		DCM.DefaultInterestTotal = @DefaultInterestTotal,

		--ค้างรับ
		DCM.AccruedInterestPay = @DefaultInterestPay + @PlannedInterestPay,
		DCM.AccruedInterestTotal = @DefaultInterestTotal + @PlannedInterestTotal,

		--ค่างวด
		DCM.Installment = @PrincipalTotal ,
		DCM.InstallmentPrincipal = @PrincipalTotal ,
		DCM.InstallmentPrincipalTotal = @PrincipalTotal ,
		DCM.InstallmentInterest = @DefaultInterestTotal + @PlannedInterestTotal ,
		DCM.InstallmentInterestTotal = @DefaultInterestTotal + @PlannedInterestTotal ,

		--ค่าธรรมเนียมศาล
		DCM.CourtFee = (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'CourtFee') ,
		DCM.CourtFeePay = (SELECT [Used] FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'CourtFee') ,
        DCM.CourtFeeTotal = (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'CourtFee') ,

 

		--ค่าทนาย
		DCM.LawyerFee = (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'LawyerFee') ,
		DCM.LawyerFeePay = (SELECT [Used] FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'LawyerFee') ,
        DCM.LawyerFeeTotal = (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'LawyerFee') ,

		--ค่าใช้จ่ายอื่น
		DCM.OtherExpense = (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'OtherExpenses') ,
		DCM.OtherExpensePay = (SELECT [Used] FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'OtherExpenses') ,
        DCM.OtherExpenseTotal = (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'OtherExpenses') ,

		--เงินวางประกัน
		DCM.InitialMargin = (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'InitialMargin') ,
		DCM.InitialMarginPay = (SELECT [Used] FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'InitialMargin') ,
        DCM.InitialMarginTotal = (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'InitialMargin') ,

		----คงเหลือ
  --      DCM.DebtBalance = DCM.DebtBalance - @Amount,
        DCM.ReceivePayment = @Amount



    FROM DataDebtorCardMovement DCM
    LEFT JOIN DataDebtorCard DDC ON DDC.DataDebtorCardId = DCM.DebtorCardId
    WHERE DCM.DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId 
	AND DCM.SeqNo = @SeqCurrent;

	UPDATE DCM2
    SET DebtBalance = @PrincipalTotal + @AccruedInterestTotal
	FROM DataDebtorCardMovement DCM2
    LEFT JOIN DataDebtorCard DDC ON DDC.DataDebtorCardId = DCM2.DebtorCardId
    WHERE DCM2.DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId 
	AND DCM2.SeqNo = @SeqCurrent;

	Update DataDebtorCard
	set InterestStartDate = @GetDate
	, CourtFeeTotal = (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'CourtFee')
	, LawyerFeeTotal = (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'LawyerFee')
	, OtherExpenseTotal = (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'OtherExpenses')
	, InitialMarginTotal = (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'InitialMargin')
	
	, DebtBalance = @PrincipalTotal + @PlannedInterestTotal + @DefaultInterestTotal
	, PrincipalTotal = @PrincipalTotal
	, PlannedInterestTotal = @PlannedInterestTotal
	, DefaultInterestTotal = @DefaultInterestTotal
	, AccruedInterestTotal = @PlannedInterestTotal + @DefaultInterestTotal

	, InstallmentPrincipal = @PrincipalTotal
	, InstallmentPrincipalTotal = @PrincipalTotal

	, InstallmentInterest = @PlannedInterestTotal + @DefaultInterestTotal
	, InstallmentInterestTotal = @PlannedInterestTotal + @DefaultInterestTotal
	--, DebtBalance = @PrincipalTotal + @PlannedInterestTotal + @DefaultInterestTotal

    WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId  
	--EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_019_InsertBalance] @GetDate, @DataDebtorCardId;
	--EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_018_UpdateInterestEveryDay] @GetDate, @DataDebtorCardId;


	--AND SeqNo = @SeqCurrent

	--Update DPD 

	--EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_022_UpdateDPD]  @GetDate, @DataDebtorCardId, @SeqCurrent

	--ถ้าเป็นการ์ดย่อย และ จ่ายเงินต้น ให้นำเงินไปตัดการ์ดหลัก
	if (@PrincipalPay > 0 and @DebtorTypeId != 1)
	begin

		EXEC [SP_DCS_032_UpdateDataDebtorCardSubToMain] @GetDate, @PrincipalPay , @DataDebtorCardId, @LGNo

		--ยอดคงเหลือ
		--EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_019_InsertBalance] @GetDate, @DataDebtorCardId

		----Update ดอกเบี้ย รายวัน
		--EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_018_UpdateInterestEveryDay] @GetDate, @DataDebtorCardId


	end


	--if (@PrincipalPay > 0 and @DebtorTypeId = 2)
	--begin
	--	EXEC [SP_DCS_014_1_InsertDebtorCardPrincipal] @GetDate, @PrincipalPay , @DataDebtorCardId2, @DataDebtorCardId, @LGNo
	--end
	--if (@PrincipalPay > 0 )
	--begin
	--	EXEC [SP_DCS_019_InsertPrincipal] @GetDate, @PrincipalTotal , @DataDebtorCardId2
	--end
	select @SeqCurrent, @PrincipalPay, @PrincipalTotal, * from DataDebtorCard
WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId ;


Insert INTO CalDataDebtorCard
(UpdateDate
,DataDebtorCardId
,EStatementId
,PaymentDate
, AmountEStatement

,PrincipalPay --เงินต้นที่จ่าย
,RowNum
,Seq
,PaymentSeqTypeId
,KeyName
,LookUpValue
,BFAmount
,PayableAmount
,UpdateAmount
,Used
,Total)

SELECT
getdate() as UpdateDate
,@DataDebtorCardId as DataDebtorCardId
,@EStatementId as EStatementId
,@GetDate as PaymentDate
,@Amount as AmountEStatement

,@PrincipalPay as PrincipalPay --เงินต้นที่จ่าย
,RowNum
,Seq
,PaymentSeqTypeId
,KeyName
,LookUpValue
,BFAmount
,PayableAmount

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_014_InsertDebtorCardMainCard]
    -- นำเข้าข้อมูลลูกหนี้ DataDebtor
    --@Amount decimal(20,4) = 20000
    @EStatementId nvarchar(150)  = '8ee79f11-5eee-4014-b1fc-b74585ff1ee5'
	--@EStatementId nvarchar(150) = '5e256d0c-fe38-4ad5-84ee-4c3d021d39a0'
    ,@DataDebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = '228362C3-4BB3-4D23-9D75-B8F73EA2C042'
    --,@DataDebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = 'F70BC1D3-5499-425C-97E9-00192B895750'
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @Amount DECIMAL(20,6) = (SELECT Amount FROM DataEStatement WHERE EStatementId = @EStatementId);
    DECLARE @SeqCurrent INT = (SELECT SeqCurrent FROM DataMainCard WHERE MainCardId = @DataDebtorCardId);
    DECLARE @IDCard NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT Reference1 FROM DataEStatement WHERE EStatementId = @EStatementId);
    DECLARE @LGNo NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT Reference2 FROM DataEStatement WHERE EStatementId = @EStatementId);
	DECLARE @AccruedInterestTotal DECIMAL(20,4) = (select AccruedInterestTotal from DataMainCardMovement where MainCardId = @DataDebtorCardId and SeqNo=@SeqCurrent-1)

    DECLARE @DebtorId nvarchar(150);
    SELECT TOP 1 @DebtorId = TRY_CAST(DebtorId AS nvarchar(150))
    FROM DataDebtor
    WHERE IDCard = @IDCard;

    IF @DebtorId IS NULL RETURN;

    DECLARE @DebtorCardMovementIdMax nvarchar(150) = (
        SELECT TOP 1 MainCardId
        FROM DataMainCardMovement
        WHERE DebtorId = @DebtorId
        ORDER BY SeqNo DESC
    );

    DECLARE @PaymentDate DATETIME = (SELECT PaymentDate FROM DataEStatement WHERE EStatementId = @EStatementId);

    DECLARE @DebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = (
        SELECT TOP 1 MainCardId
        FROM DataMainCard
        WHERE MainCardId = @DebtorId AND LGNo = @LGNo
    );

    DECLARE @TypeId INT = 2;
    DECLARE @TypeCode NVARCHAR(2) = (SELECT PaymentTypeCode FROM SystemPaymentType WHERE PaymentTypeId = @TypeId);
    DECLARE @TypeName NVARCHAR(50) = (SELECT PaymentTypeName FROM SystemPaymentType WHERE PaymentTypeId = @TypeId);

    DECLARE @MeasureId INT = (SELECT MeasureId FROM DataMainCard WHERE MainCardId = @DebtorCardId);
    DECLARE @PaymentSeq INT = (
        SELECT TOP 1 m.ConditionItemMapingValue
        FROM SystemConditionItemMappingValueMaster m
        LEFT JOIN SystemConditionMaster c ON m.ConditionId = c.ConditionId
        LEFT JOIN SystemCampaignConditionMaster cc ON cc.ConditionId = c.ConditionId
        LEFT JOIN SystemMeasureCampaignMaster cm ON cm.CampaignId = cc.CampaignId
        LEFT JOIN SystemMeasureMaster mm ON mm.MeasureId = cm.MeasureId
        WHERE mm.IsDefault = 1 AND m.ConditionItemId = 20
    );

    -- ค่าคำนวณ
    DECLARE @Principal DECIMAL(20,6) = (SELECT PrincipalTotal FROM DataMainCard WHERE MainCardId = @DebtorCardId);
    DECLARE @InterestRate DECIMAL(20,6) = (SELECT InterestRate / 100 FROM DataMainCard WHERE MainCardId = @DebtorCardId);
    DECLARE @InterestDate INT = DATEDIFF(
        DAY,
        (SELECT InterestStartDate FROM DataDebtorCardMovement WHERE DebtorCardMovementId = @DebtorCardMovementIdMax),
        DATEADD(DAY, -1, @PaymentDate)
    ) + 1;
    DECLARE @DaysInYear INT = DATEDIFF(DAY, '2024-01-01', '2024-12-31') + 1;

    DECLARE @Interest DECIMAL(20,6) = @Principal * @InterestRate * @InterestDate / @DaysInYear;

    --Update DataDebtorCardMovement 
    --Set InterestEndDate = @PaymentDate - 1
    --, PlannedInterest = @Interest --ดอกเบี้ยตามแผน-ทั้งหมด
    --, PlannedInterestTotal = PlannedInterestTotal + @Interest --ดอกเบี้ยตามแผน-คงเหลือ
    --, AccruedInterest =  @Interest --ดอกเบี้ยค้างรับ-ทั้งหมด
    --, AccruedInterestTotal =  AccruedInterestTotal + @Interest --ดอกเบี้ยค้างรับ-คงเหลือ
    --, DebtBalance = DebtBalance + @Interest
    ---- --select * from DataDebtorCardMovement
    --Where DebtorCardMovementId = @DebtorCardMovementIdMax

    --,@DebtorCardId
    --,@PaymentSeq 
    --,@InterestDate AS InterestDate
    --,@InterestRate AS InterestRate
    --,@Interest AS Interest
    --, @Amount AS PaymentAmount
    --, CASE WHEN @Amount >= (CASE WHEN sd.ConditionPaymentId = 5 THEN dbo.[FN_DCS_02_PayableAmount](@DebtorCardId, l.KeyName) * (sd.[Values]/100) 
    --						ELSE dbo.[FN_DCS_02_PayableAmount](@DebtorCardId, l.KeyName) END)
    --	   THEN @Amount - (CASE WHEN sd.ConditionPaymentId = 5 THEN dbo.[FN_DCS_02_PayableAmount](@DebtorCardId, l.KeyName) * (sd.[Values]/100) 
    --						ELSE dbo.[FN_DCS_02_PayableAmount](@DebtorCardId, l.KeyName) END)
    --	  ELSE (CASE WHEN sd.ConditionPaymentId = 5 THEN dbo.[FN_DCS_02_PayableAmount](@DebtorCardId, l.KeyName) * (sd.[Values]/100) 
    --						ELSE dbo.[FN_DCS_02_PayableAmount](@DebtorCardId, l.KeyName) END) - @Amount END AS Total
    --, sd.*

    -- เตรียม temp table
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmp') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tmp;

    SELECT 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sd.Seq) AS RowNum,
        sd.Seq,
        sd.PaymentSeqTypeId,
        l.KeyName,
        l.LookUpValue,
        CAST(
            CASE 
                WHEN sd.ConditionPaymentId = 5 
                    THEN dbo.[FN_DCS_02_PayableAmount](@DebtorCardId, l.KeyName) * (sd.[Values]/100)
                ELSE dbo.[FN_DCS_02_PayableAmount](@DebtorCardId, l.KeyName)
            END AS DECIMAL(20,6)
        ) AS PayableAmount,
        CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(20,6)) AS BFAmount,
        CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(20,6)) AS UpdateAmount
    INTO #tmp
    FROM SystemPaymentSeqDetailMaster sd
    LEFT JOIN SystemPaymentSeqMaster s ON s.PaymentSeqId = sd.PaymentSeqId
    LEFT JOIN SystemLookupMaster l ON l.LookupId = sd.PaymentSeqTypeId
    WHERE s.PaymentSeqId = @PaymentSeq;

    -- วนลูปเพื่อคำนวณและอัปเดต UpdateAmount
    DECLARE @Row INT = 1, @MaxRow INT;
    SELECT @MaxRow = MAX(RowNum) FROM #tmp;

    WHILE @Row <= @MaxRow
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @Payable DECIMAL(20,6), @Update DECIMAL(20,6), @PrevUpdate DECIMAL(20,6);
        SELECT @Payable = PayableAmount FROM #tmp WHERE RowNum = @Row;

        IF @Row = 1
        BEGIN
            UPDATE #tmp SET BFAmount = @Amount WHERE RowNum = 1;
            SET @Update = CASE WHEN @Amount >= @Payable THEN @Amount - @Payable ELSE 0 END;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            SELECT @PrevUpdate = UpdateAmount FROM #tmp WHERE RowNum = @Row - 1;
            UPDATE #tmp SET BFAmount = @PrevUpdate WHERE RowNum = @Row;
            SET @Update = CASE WHEN @PrevUpdate >= @Payable THEN @PrevUpdate - @Payable ELSE 0 END;
        END

        UPDATE #tmp SET UpdateAmount = @Update WHERE RowNum = @Row;
        SET @Row += 1;
    END

    -- แสดงผล
    SELECT *
    , PayableAmount - (CASE WHEN PayableAmount <= BFAmount THEN 0 ELSE PayableAmount - BFAmount END) AS Used
    , CASE WHEN PayableAmount <= BFAmount THEN 0 ELSE PayableAmount - BFAmount END AS Total
    INTO #tmpFinal
    FROM #tmp;

    SELECT * FROM #tmpFinal;

    UPDATE DCM
    SET 
        DCM.PrincipalPay = (SELECT [Used] FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'Principal') ,
        DCM.PrincipalTotal = DCM.PrincipalTotal - (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'Principal') ,

		--ตามแผน
        DCM.PlannedInterestPay =  (SELECT [Used] FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'PlannedInterest') ,
        DCM.PlannedInterestTotal =  (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'PlannedInterest'),

		--ผิดนัด
		DCM.DefaultInterestPay = (SELECT [Used] FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'DefaultInterest'),
		DCM.DefaultInterestTotal = (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'DefaultInterest'),

		--ค้างรับ
		DCM.AccruedInterestPay = (SELECT [Used] FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'DefaultInterest') + (SELECT [Used] FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'PlannedInterest'),
		DCM.AccruedInterestTotal = @AccruedInterestTotal + (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'DefaultInterest') + (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'PlannedInterest'),

		--คงเหลือ
        DCM.DebtBalance = DCM.DebtBalance - @Amount,
        DCM.ReceivePayment = @Amount


    FROM DataMainCardMovement DCM
    LEFT JOIN DataDebtorCard DDC ON DDC.DataDebtorCardId = DCM.MainCardId
    WHERE DCM.MainCardId = @DataDebtorCardId 
	AND DCM.SeqNo = @SeqCurrent;



	declare @Principals decimal(20,4) = (SELECT Used FROM #tmpFinal where KeyName='Principal')
	if (@Principals >0)
	begin
		select 2, 'DebtorCardId',* from DataDebtor
	end

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_015_InsertBillPayment]
	-- Bill Payment
	--@GetDate date = '2025-06-09'
	

AS
BEGIN
DECLARE @TaxNoTCG NVARCHAR(13) = '010553706460901'
INSERT INTO [dbo].[DEBDataBillPayment] (
     [BillPaymentId]
    ,[Reference1]
    ,[Reference2]
    ,[CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanId]
    ,[DebtorCardId]
    ,[BillPaymentNo]
    ,[BillPaymentDate]
    ,[BarcodeNo]
    ,[TaxNoTCG]
    ,[PathFile]
    ,[PrintDate]
    ,[IsActive]
    ,[FileName]
    ,[PaymentAmount]
    ,[CollectorUserId]
    ,[CreateDate]
    ,[CreateBy]
    ,[UpdateDate]
    ,[UpdateBy]
    ,[BillPaymentType]
    ,[Years]
    ,[Months]
	,DebtorId
	,DebtorRelateId
	,HasReference1
	,HasReference2
)
SELECT 
     NEWID() AS [BillPaymentId]
    ,isnull(d.IDCard,'0000000000000') AS [Reference1]
	
    --,rel.[LGNo] AS [Reference2]
	,replace(replace(c.DebtorCardCode,'C',''),'-','') AS [Reference2]
    ,'' AS [CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanId] 
    ,c.DataDebtorCardId AS [DebtorCardId]        
    ,'BILL-' + rel.[DebtorCode] + ' ' + rel.LGNo AS [BillPaymentNo]
    ,GETDATE() AS [BillPaymentDate]
	--สรุปในที่ประชุม ใช้ ref1, ref2
	,dbo.[FN_DCS_05_GenFormatBarcode](isnull(d.[IDCard],'0000000000000'), rel.[LGNo], cast(0 as decimal(18,2))) AS [BarcodeNo]
    --,dbo.[FN_DCS_05_GenFormatBarcode](isnull(d.[IDCard],'0000000000000'), replace(replace(c.DebtorCardCode,'C',''),'-',''), cast(0 as decimal(18,2))) AS [BarcodeNo]
    ,@TaxNoTCG AS [TaxNoTCG]                
    ,'' AS [PathFile]
    ,GETDATE() AS [PrintDate]
    ,1 AS [IsActive]
    ,'' AS [FileName]
    ,isnull(c.DebtBalance, lg.ClaimPayAmount) AS [PaymentAmount]                 
    ,1 AS [CollectorUserId]
    ,GETDATE() AS [CreateDate]
    ,1 
    ,GETDATE() AS [UpdateDate]
    ,1
    ,1 AS [BillPaymentType]                
    ,YEAR(GETDATE()) AS [Years]
    ,MONTH(GETDATE()) AS [Months]
	,rel.DebtorId
	,rel.DebtorRelateId
	,substring(dbo.[FN_DCS_05_GenFormatBarcode](isnull(d.[IDCard],'0000000000000'), rel.[LGNo], cast(0 as decimal(18,2))),18,14) as HasReference1
	--,substring(dbo.[FN_DCS_05_GenFormatBarcode](isnull(d.[IDCard],'0000000000000'), replace(replace(c.DebtorCardCode,'C',''),'-',''), cast(0 as decimal(18,2))),18,14) as HasReference1
	, rel.[LGNo] as HasReference2
FROM [DataDebtorRelate] rel
left JOIN [DataDebtor] d ON rel.[DebtorId] = d.[DebtorId]
left JOIN [DataDebtorCard] c ON rel.DebtorRelateId = c.DebtorRelateId
left JOIN [DataLG] lg ON lg.LGNo = rel.LGNo
left JOIN [SystemDebtorType] dt ON dt.DebtorTypeId = rel.DebtorTypeId
where lg.Grade = 'F1'
AND dt.IsCalCard=1
AND rel.DebtorRelateId NOT IN (select DebtorRelateId from [DEBDataBillPayment])
order by d.IDCard;

Update cd
set cd.Reference1 = b.HasReference1
, cd.Reference2 = b.HasReference2
from [DataDebtorCard] cd
left join DEBDataBillPayment b on b.DebtorCardId = cd.DataDebtorCardId;





END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_016_InsertSubrogationLetter]
	-- นำเข้าข้อมูลลูกหนี้ DataDebtor
	--@GetDate date = '2025-06-09'
	
	
AS
BEGIN


-- Step 1: เตรียม Format เบื้องต้น เช่น "DCS/SUB2567/"
DECLARE @DocumenFormat NVARCHAR(50) = (
    SELECT SystemName + ' ' + SystemDCS + ' ' + DocumentName + ' ' + CAST(YEAR(GETDATE()) + 543 AS NVARCHAR) + '/'
    FROM SystemFormatDocumentMaster
    WHERE FormatDocumentId = 1
);

-- Step 2: ตรวจสอบ Running ล่าสุดจาก SubrogationLetterNo
DECLARE @MaxRunning INT = ISNULL((
    SELECT MAX(CAST(RIGHT(SubrogationLetterNo, 5) AS INT))
    FROM DataSubrogationLetter
    WHERE SubrogationLetterNo LIKE @DocumenFormat + '%'
), 0);

-- Step 3: เตรียมรายการที่จะ Insert พร้อม Running No
WITH SourceData AS (
    SELECT 
        rel.[DebtorRelateId],
        rel.[DebtorRelateCode],
        rel.[LGNo],
        rel.[CIFNo],
        rel.[DebtorCode],
        rel.[DebtorId],
        deb.FirstName + ' ' + isnull(deb.LastName,'') as DebtorName,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY rel.[DebtorRelateId]) AS RowNum
    FROM [DataDebtorRelate] rel
    left JOIN [DataDebtor] deb ON rel.[DebtorId] = deb.[DebtorId]
	left JOIN [DataLG] lg ON lg.LGNo = rel.LGNo
	left JOIN [SystemDebtorType] dt ON dt.DebtorTypeId = rel.DebtorTypeId
	where lg.Grade = 'F1'
	and dt.IsCalCard = 1
	and rel.DebtorRelateId not in (select DebtorRelateId from DataSubrogationLetter)
	--and rel.DebtorTypeId = 1
)
INSERT INTO [dbo].[DataSubrogationLetter] (
     [SubrogationLetterId]
    ,[DebtorRelateId]
    ,[SubrogationLetterNo]
    ,[SubrogationLetterDate]
    ,[DebtorName]
    ,[FileName]
    ,[PathFile]
    ,[CIFNo]
    ,[LGNo]
    ,[ApproverUserId]
    ,[PositionId]
    ,[ApproverName]
    ,[CreateDate]
    ,[CreateBy]
    ,[UpdateDate]
    ,[UpdateBy]
    ,[DebtorNo]
	,[PathFileBarcode]
	,[IsGenBarcode]
	,[BarcodeNo]

)
SELECT
     NEWID()
    ,s.[DebtorRelateId]
    ,@DocumenFormat + RIGHT('00000' + CAST(@MaxRunning + s.RowNum AS NVARCHAR), 5) AS [SubrogationLetterNo]
    ,GETDATE()
    ,s.[DebtorName]
    ,'SUB-' + s.[DebtorRelateCode] + '.pdf'
    ,'D:\SubrogationFiles\SUB-' + s.[DebtorRelateCode] + '.pdf'
    ,s.[CIFNo]
    ,s.[LGNo]
    ,0
    ,1
    ,''
    ,GETDATE()
    ,1
    ,GETDATE()
    ,1
    ,s.[DebtorCode]
	,null as [PathFileBarcode]
	,0 as [IsGenBarcode]
	,null as [BarcodeNo]
FROM SourceData s;


END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_017_InsertCardInterate]
	-- insert ดอกเบี้ย ทุกมาตรการ
	@GetDate date = '2025-05-19'
	,@TypeId int = 1 --1=insert ดอกเบี้ยผิดนัด ทุกมาตรการ, 2=insert ดอกเบี้ยเดิม (ปิดแผน) 
	
	
AS
BEGIN

SELECT [DebtorCardInterateId]
    
	--1) นำ ID [DebtorCardInterateId] ลำดับสุดท้ายมาลง tmp
	INTO #TMPInterate
	FROM [dbo].[DataDebtorCardInterate]
	WHERE [IsActive] = 1
	GROUP BY [DebtorCardInterateId]
    --=====================================================
	
	--2) นำ Update รายการดอกเบี้ยเดิม [IsDefaultInterest] = 0

	UPDATE [DataDebtorCardInterate]
	SET [IsDefaultInterest] = 0
	, [EndDate] = @GetDate
	, [UpdateDate] = GETDATE()
	, [UpdateBy] = 1
	WHERE [DebtorCardInterateId] IN (SELECT [DebtorCardInterateId] FROM #TMPInterate)

	 --3) Insert ดอกเบี้ยผิดนัด 
		  SELECT NEWID()
      ,[DebtorCardId]
      ,[MeasureId]
      ,[Seq] + 1 AS [Seq]
      ,[InterateRate]
      ,[dbo].[FN_DCS_03_DefaultInterest]([MeasureId]) AS [DefaultInterest]
      ,@GetDate + 1 AS [StartDate]
      ,CAST('3000-01-01' AS DATETIME) AS [EndDate]
      ,1 AS [IsActive]
      ,[CompromiseContractGroupId]
      ,GETDATE() AS [CreateDate]
      ,1 AS [CreateBy]
      ,GETDATE() AS [UpdateDate]
      ,1 AS [UpdateBy]
      ,1 AS [IsDefaultInterest]
  FROM [dbo].[DataDebtorCardInterate]
  WHERE [DebtorCardInterateId] IN (SELECT [DebtorCardInterateId] FROM #TMPInterate)

    SELECT [DebtorCardInterateId] FROM #TMPInterate
	DROP TABLE #TMPInterate

	 --=====================================================


END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_018_UpdateInterestEveryDayMainCare]

	-- คำอธิบาย : 1.คำนวณดอกเบี้ย รายวัน
	--			2.ถ้าวันนี้เป็นวันที่สิ้นเดือน จะปิดงวด
	--			3.ถ้าวันนี้เป็นวันที่สิ้นเดือน จะเพิ่มรายการใหม่ เป็นยอดคงเหลือ

	@CurrentDate datetime = '2024-11-07'
	,@DataDebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = 'CA78B4DB-E206-4BFA-9466-1292B6F25041'

	--,@DataDebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = 'F70BC1D3-5499-425C-97E9-00192B895750'
	
AS
BEGIN

--จำนวนบันทัดสุดท้ายของแต่ละการ์ด
declare @SeqCurrent int =  (select SeqCurrent from DataMainCard where MainCardId = @DataDebtorCardId)
--declare @CurrentDate datetime = '2025-06-06'

--หาจำนวนวันของปีที่ดำเนินการ
DECLARE @DaysInYear INT = DATEDIFF(DAY, cast(year(getdate()) as nvarchar) + '-01-01', cast(year(getdate()) as nvarchar) + '-12-31') + 1;
--(กรณีปิดงวด) PaymentTypeId = 3 ปิดงวด 
DECLARE @TypeId int = (select PaymentTypeId from SystemPaymentType where PaymentTypeId = 3)
DECLARE @TypeCode nvarchar(2) = (select PaymentTypeCode from SystemPaymentType where PaymentTypeId = @TypeId)
DECLARE @TypeName nvarchar(100) = (select PaymentTypeName from SystemPaymentType where PaymentTypeId = @TypeId)

--(กรณีเพิ่มรายการ) PaymentTypeId = 8 ยอดคงเหลือ
DECLARE @NextTypeId int = (select PaymentTypeId from SystemPaymentType where PaymentTypeId = 8)
DECLARE @NextTypeCode nvarchar(2) = (select PaymentTypeCode from SystemPaymentType where PaymentTypeId = @NextTypeId)
DECLARE @NextTypeName nvarchar(100) = (select PaymentTypeName from SystemPaymentType where PaymentTypeId = @NextTypeId)

DECLARE @PlannedInterestTotal  decimal(20,4) = (select PlannedInterestTotal from DataMainCardMovement where MainCardId = @DataDebtorCardId and SeqNo=@SeqCurrent-1)
DECLARE @DefaultInterestTotal  decimal(20,4) = (select DefaultInterestTotal from DataMainCardMovement where MainCardId = @DataDebtorCardId and SeqNo=@SeqCurrent-1)
DECLARE @AccruedInterestTotal  decimal(20,4) = (select AccruedInterestTotal from DataMainCardMovement where MainCardId = @DataDebtorCardId and SeqNo=@SeqCurrent-1)
DECLARE @DebtBalance  decimal(20,4) = (select DebtBalance from DataMainCardMovement where MainCardId = @DataDebtorCardId and SeqNo=@SeqCurrent-1)
DECLARE @InterestQuantity INT = (select DATEDIFF(DAY, InterestStartDate,  @CurrentDate ) + 1 from DataMainCardMovement where MainCardId = @DataDebtorCardId and SeqNo=@SeqCurrent)

DECLARE @EndDayOfMonth datetime =  EOMONTH(@CurrentDate)


--select @CurrentDate


--, DATEDIFF(DAY, DATEADD(DAY, 1, EOMONTH(@CurrentDate, -1)),  @CurrentDate ) + 1 as InterestQuantity

--, cast(PrincipalTotal * (InterestRate/ 100) * cast((DATEDIFF(DAY, InterestStartDate,  @CurrentDate - 1) + 1)AS DECIMAL(20,4))/ (CAST(@DaysInYear AS DECIMAL(20,4))) as decimal(20,4)) as InterimInterest

--, cast(PrincipalTotal * (InterestDefaultRate/ 100) * cast((DATEDIFF(DAY, InterestStartDate,  @CurrentDate - 1) + 1)AS DECIMAL(20,4))/ (CAST(@DaysInYear AS DECIMAL(20,4))) as decimal(20,4)) as DefaultInterest
----,  cast(PrincipalTotal * (InterestDefaultRate/ 100) * cast((DATEDIFF(DAY, InterestStartDate,  @CurrentDate - 1) + 1)AS DECIMAL(20,4))/ (CAST(@DaysInYear AS DECIMAL(20,4))) as decimal(20,4)) as DefaultInterestTotal
--,InterestDefaultRate
----รอบ 2

------ดอกเบี้ยตามแผน
----, PlannedInterest + InterimInterest  as PlannedInterest
----, PlannedInterestTotal + InterimInterest  as PlannedInterestTotal

----ค้างรับ
--, AccruedInterest + InterimInterest as AccruedInterest
--, AccruedInterestTotal   + InterimInterest as AccruedInterestTotal

----รอบ 3 
--, DebtBalance +  AccruedInterestTotal as DebtBalance 


--from DataDebtorCardMovement cm
--where cm.DebtorCardId= @DataDebtorCardId
--and cm.SeqNo = @SeqCurrent

--=====รอบ 1 Update จำนวนวันที่คิดดอกเบี้ย, ดอกเบี้ยระหว่างเดือน, ดอกเบี้ยผิดนัด, วันที่คิดดอกเบี้ยวันสุดท้าย
Update DataMainCardMovement

set InterestQuantity = @InterestQuantity
, InterimInterest = cast(PrincipalTotal * (InterestRate/ 100) * cast(@InterestQuantity AS DECIMAL(20,4))/ (CAST(@DaysInYear AS DECIMAL(20,4))) as decimal(20,4))
, DefaultInterest = cast(PrincipalTotal * (InterestDefaultRate/ 100) * cast(@InterestQuantity AS DECIMAL(20,4))/ (CAST(@DaysInYear AS DECIMAL(20,4))) as decimal(20,4))
, InterestEndDate = @CurrentDate
, PlannedInterest = cast(PrincipalTotal * (InterestPlannedRate/ 100) * cast(@InterestQuantity AS DECIMAL(20,4))/ (CAST(@DaysInYear AS DECIMAL(20,4))) as decimal(20,4))

, DFDEndDate = @CurrentDate

--ถ้า @CurrentDate เป็นวันสิ้นเดือน จะ update Type รายการนี้เป็น ปิดงวด/  แต่ถ้าไม่ใช่วันที่สิ้นเดือน Type รายการนี้จะเป็น ยอดคงเหลือ
, TypeId = (case when  @CurrentDate = @EndDayOfMonth  then @TypeId else TypeId end)
, TypeCode = (case when  @CurrentDate = @EndDayOfMonth  then @TypeCode else TypeCode end)
, TypeName = (case when  @CurrentDate = @EndDayOfMonth  then @TypeName else TypeName end)
--, DPD = DPD + 1

, DocDate = @CurrentDate
where DataMainCardMovement.MainCardId= @DataDebtorCardId
and DataMainCardMovement.SeqNo = @SeqCurrent;

--====================================================================================

--=====รอบ 2 Update ดอกเบี้ยตามแผน
Update DataMainCardMovement
set PlannedInterestTotal = @PlannedInterestTotal + PlannedInterest
, AccruedInterest = PlannedInterest + DefaultInterest
, DefaultInterestTotal = @DefaultInterestTotal+ DefaultInterest


where DataMainCardMovement.MainCardId= @DataDebtorCardId
and DataMainCardMovement.SeqNo = @SeqCurrent;
--====================================================================================
----รอบ 3 Update ดอกเบี้ยค้างรับ

Update DataMainCardMovement
set AccruedInterestTotal = PlannedInterestTotal   + DefaultInterestTotal
, DebtBalance = @DebtBalance + AccruedInterestTotal

where DataMainCardMovement.MainCardId= @DataDebtorCardId
and DataMainCardMovement.SeqNo = @SeqCurrent;

--====================================================================================

--รอบ 4 Update ยอดคงเหลือ

--Update DataDebtorCardMovement
--set DebtBalance = DebtBalance +  AccruedInterestTotal + DefaultInterest
----select * from DataDebtorCardMovement
--where DataDebtorCardMovement.DebtorCardId= @DataDebtorCardId
--and DataDebtorCardMovement.SeqNo = @SeqCurrent;

--====================================================================================
select

 DATEDIFF(DAY, InterestStartDate,  @CurrentDate ) + 1 as InterestQuantity
, cast(PrincipalTotal * (InterestRate/ 100) * cast(@InterestQuantity AS DECIMAL(20,4))/ (CAST(@DaysInYear AS DECIMAL(20,4))) as decimal(20,4)) as InterimInterest
, cast(PrincipalTotal * (InterestDefaultRate/ 100) * cast(@InterestQuantity AS DECIMAL(20,4))/ (CAST(@DaysInYear AS DECIMAL(20,4))) as decimal(20,4)) as DefaultInterest
, DefaultInterestTotal
, DFDEndDate = @CurrentDate
--ดอกเบี้ยตามแผน
, PlannedInterest
, PlannedInterestTotal

--วันที่เริ่มต้น-วิ้นสุด คิดดอกเบี้ย
, InterestStartDate
, cast(@CurrentDate as datetime) as InterestEndDate

--ดอกเบี้ยค้างรับ
, AccruedInterest 
, AccruedInterestTotal

--คงเหลือ
, DebtBalance

--ค้างรับ

into #tmp
from DataMainCardMovement
where DataMainCardMovement.MainCardId= @DataDebtorCardId
and DataMainCardMovement.SeqNo = @SeqCurrent;


--=====รอบ 4 update ที่รายการหลัก
Update DataMainCard
--==ดอกเบี้ย
set PlannedInterestTotal = (select top 1 PlannedInterestTotal from #tmp)
, DefaultInterestTotal = (select top 1 DefaultInterestTotal from #tmp)
, AccruedInterestTotal = (select top 1 AccruedInterestTotal from #tmp)
, InterestStartDate = (select top 1 InterestStartDate from #tmp)
, InterestEndDate = (select top 1 InterestEndDate from #tmp)

--==ยอดรวมทั้งหมด
, DebtBalance = (select top 1 DebtBalance from #tmp)

where MainCardId= @DataDebtorCardId

--====================================================================================
select  * from #tmp



END

modules.name: SP_DCS_022_UpdateDPD
modules.definition:
-- =============================================
-- Author:        <Author,,Name>
-- Create date:   <Create Date,,>
-- Description:   คำนวณและอัปเดต DPD ของการ์ดลูกหนี้และการ์ดหลัก
--                โดยไม่นับวันที่อยู่ในงวดพักชำระ
--                TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment.IsSuspend = 1
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_022_UpdateDPD]
    @DPDEndDate       DATE          = '2025-06-01',
    @DataDebtorCardId NVARCHAR(150) = '053143CD-8393-4ACB-9F19-60BF9288A546',
    @SeqCurrent       INT           = 5
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        /* =========================================================
           1. ข้อมูลการ์ดลูกหนี้
        ========================================================= */
        DECLARE @DebtorRelateTypeId INT;
        DECLARE @MainCardId NVARCHAR(150);
        DECLARE @SeqCurrentMainCard INT;
        DECLARE @DPDDate DATE;

        SELECT
            @DebtorRelateTypeId = c.DebtorRelateTypeId,
            @MainCardId         = c.DataMainCardId,
            @DPDDate            = CAST(c.DFDDate AS DATE)
        FROM dbo.DataDebtorCard c
        WHERE c.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId;

        IF @DPDDate IS NULL
        BEGIN
            THROW 50001, N'ไม่พบข้อมูล DataDebtorCard หรือไม่พบค่า DFDDate', 1;
        END;

        /*
            ไม่อยู่ในสถานะผิดนัด ให้จบการทำงานตามเงื่อนไขเดิม
        */
        IF @DPDDate = CAST('1900-01-01' AS DATE)
           OR @DPDEndDate < @DPDDate
        BEGIN
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            RETURN;
        END;

        SELECT
            @SeqCurrentMainCard = m.SeqCurrent
        FROM dbo.DataMainCard m
        WHERE m.MainCardId = @MainCardId;


        /* =========================================================
           2. เตรียมช่วงวันที่พักชำระ

           กรณีมีช่วงวันที่ซ้ำหรือทับซ้อนกัน
           ระบบจะรวมช่วงวันที่ก่อน เพื่อไม่ให้หักวันซ้ำ
        ========================================================= */
        CREATE TABLE #SuspendPeriods
        (
            SuspendStartDate DATE NOT NULL,
            SuspendEndDate   DATE NOT NULL
        );

        ;WITH SuspendRaw AS
        (
            SELECT
                CAST(p.StartDate AS DATE) AS SuspendStartDate,
                CAST(p.EndDate AS DATE)   AS SuspendEndDate
            FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment p
            WHERE p.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
              AND ISNULL(p.IsSuspend, 0) = 1
              AND ISNULL(p.IsActive, 1) = 1
              AND p.StartDate IS NOT NULL
              AND p.EndDate IS NOT NULL
              AND CAST(p.StartDate AS DATE) <= CAST(p.EndDate AS DATE)

              -- เอาเฉพาะงวดพักชำระที่ทับซ้อนกับช่วงผิดนัด
              AND p.StartDate < DATEADD(DAY, 1, CAST(@DPDEndDate AS DATETIME))
              AND p.EndDate >= CAST(@DPDDate AS DATETIME)
        ),
        SuspendOrdered AS
        (
            SELECT
                sr.SuspendStartDate,
                sr.SuspendEndDate,

                MAX(sr.SuspendEndDate) OVER
                (
                    ORDER BY
                        sr.SuspendStartDate,
                        sr.SuspendEndDate
                    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
                             AND 1 PRECEDING
                ) AS PreviousMaxEndDate
            FROM SuspendRaw sr
        ),
        SuspendGrouped AS
        (
            SELECT
                so.SuspendStartDate,
                so.SuspendEndDate,

                SUM
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN so.PreviousMaxEndDate IS NULL
                             OR so.SuspendStartDate > so.PreviousMaxEndDate
                            THEN 1
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ) OVER
                (
                    ORDER BY
                        so.SuspendStartDate,
                        so.SuspendEndDate
                    ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
                ) AS GroupNo
            FROM SuspendOrdered so
        )
        INSERT INTO #SuspendPeriods
        (
            SuspendStartDate,
            SuspendEndDate
        )
        SELECT
            MIN(sg.SuspendStartDate),
            MAX(sg.SuspendEndDate)
        FROM SuspendGrouped sg
        GROUP BY sg.GroupNo;


        /* =========================================================
           3. คำนวณ DPD สะสมของ DataDebtorCard

           สูตร:
           วันตั้งแต่ DFDDate ถึง DPDEndDate
           ลบจำนวนวันที่อยู่ในงวดพักชำระ
        ========================================================= */
        DECLARE @TotalDPDDays INT = 0;
        DECLARE @TotalSuspendDays INT = 0;
        DECLARE @CalculatedDPDAccumulate INT = 0;

        SET @TotalDPDDays =
            DATEDIFF
            (
                DAY,
                @DPDDate,
                @DPDEndDate
            ) + 1;

        SELECT
            @TotalSuspendDays =
                ISNULL
                (
                    SUM
                    (
                        DATEDIFF
                        (
                            DAY,

                            CASE
                                WHEN sp.SuspendStartDate < @DPDDate
                                    THEN @DPDDate
                                ELSE sp.SuspendStartDate
                            END,

                            CASE
                                WHEN sp.SuspendEndDate > @DPDEndDate
                                    THEN @DPDEndDate
                                ELSE sp.SuspendEndDate
                            END
                        ) + 1
                    ),
                    0
                )
        FROM #SuspendPeriods sp
        WHERE sp.SuspendStartDate <= @DPDEndDate
          AND sp.SuspendEndDate >= @DPDDate;

        SET @CalculatedDPDAccumulate =
            CASE
                WHEN @TotalDPDDays - @TotalSuspendDays < 0
                    THEN 0
                ELSE @TotalDPDDays - @TotalSuspendDays
            END;


        /* =========================================================
           4. คำนวณ DPD ของ DataDebtorCardMovement งวดปัจจุบัน
        ========================================================= */
        DECLARE @MovementStartDate DATE;
        DECLARE @MovementEndDate DATE;
        DECLARE @MovementCalculateStartDate DATE;
        DECLARE @MovementSuspendDays INT = 0;
        DECLARE @MovementDPD INT = 0;

        SELECT
            @MovementStartDate =
                CAST(cm.DFDStartDate AS DATE),

            @MovementEndDate =
                CASE
                    WHEN cm.DFDEndDate IS NULL
                        THEN @DPDEndDate

                    WHEN CAST(cm.DFDEndDate AS DATE) > @DPDEndDate
                        THEN @DPDEndDate

                    ELSE CAST(cm.DFDEndDate AS DATE)
                END
        FROM dbo.DataDebtorCardMovement cm
        WHERE cm.DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
          AND cm.SeqNo = @SeqCurrent;

        IF @MovementStartDate IS NULL
        BEGIN
            THROW 50002, N'ไม่พบข้อมูล DataDebtorCardMovement ตาม SeqCurrent ที่ระบุ', 1;
        END;

        /*
            ป้องกันการนับวันก่อนวันที่เริ่มผิดนัดจริง
        */
        SET @MovementCalculateStartDate =
            CASE
                WHEN @MovementStartDate < @DPDDate
                    THEN @DPDDate
                ELSE @MovementStartDate
            END;

        IF @MovementEndDate >= @MovementCalculateStartDate
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                @MovementSuspendDays =
                    ISNULL
                    (
                        SUM
                        (
                            DATEDIFF
                            (
                                DAY,

                                CASE
                                    WHEN sp.SuspendStartDate < @MovementCalculateStartDate
                                        THEN @MovementCalculateStartDate
                                    ELSE sp.SuspendStartDate
                                END,

                                CASE
                                    WHEN sp.SuspendEndDate > @MovementEndDate
                                        THEN @MovementEndDate
                                    ELSE sp.SuspendEndDate
                                END
                            ) + 1
                        ),
                        0
                    )
            FROM #SuspendPeriods sp
            WHERE sp.SuspendStartDate <= @MovementEndDate
              AND sp.SuspendEndDate >= @MovementCalculateStartDate;

            SET @MovementDPD =
                DATEDIFF
                (
                    DAY,
                    @MovementCalculateStartDate,
                    @MovementEndDate
                ) + 1 - @MovementSuspendDays;

            IF @MovementDPD < 0
            BEGIN
                SET @MovementDPD = 0;
            END;
        END;


        /* =========================================================
           5. Update DataDebtorCardMovement
        ========================================================= */
        UPDATE cm
        SET
            cm.DPD           = @MovementDPD,
            cm.DPDAccumulate = @CalculatedDPDAccumulate
        FROM dbo.DataDebtorCardMovement cm
        WHERE cm.DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
          AND cm.SeqNo = @SeqCurrent;


        /* =========================================================
           6. Update DataDebtorCard
        ========================================================= */
        UPDATE c
        SET
            c.DPD = @CalculatedDPDAccumulate
        FROM dbo.DataDebtorCard c
        WHERE c.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId;


        /* =========================================================
           7. ถ้าเป็นผู้กู้หลัก
              Update DataMainCardMovement และ DataMainCard
        ========================================================= */
--         IF @DebtorRelateTypeId = 1
--         BEGIN
--             IF @MainCardId IS NULL
--             BEGIN
--                 THROW 50003, N'ไม่พบ MainCardId ของการ์ดผู้กู้หลัก', 1;
--             END;
-- 
--             IF @SeqCurrentMainCard IS NULL
--             BEGIN
--                 THROW 50004, N'ไม่พบ SeqCurrent ของ DataMainCard', 1;
--             END;
-- 
--             DECLARE @MainMovementStartDate DATE;
--             DECLARE @MainMovementEndDate DATE;
--             DECLARE @MainMovementCalculateStartDate DATE;
--             DECLARE @MainMovementSuspendDays INT = 0;
--             DECLARE @MainMovementDPD INT = 0;
-- 
--             SELECT
--                 @MainMovementStartDate =
--                     CAST(mm.DFDStartDate AS DATE),
-- 
--                 @MainMovementEndDate =
--                     CASE
--                         WHEN mm.DFDEndDate IS NULL
--                             THEN @DPDEndDate
-- 
--                         WHEN CAST(mm.DFDEndDate AS DATE) > @DPDEndDate
--                             THEN @DPDEndDate
-- 
--                         ELSE CAST(mm.DFDEndDate AS DATE)
--                     END
--             FROM dbo.DataMainCardMovement mm
--             WHERE mm.MainCardId = @MainCardId
--               AND mm.SeqNo = @SeqCurrentMainCard;
-- 
--             IF @MainMovementStartDate IS NULL
--             BEGIN
--                 THROW 50005, N'ไม่พบข้อมูล DataMainCardMovement ตาม SeqCurrent ของการ์ดหลัก', 1;
--             END;
-- 
--             SET @MainMovementCalculateStartDate =
--                 CASE
--                     WHEN @MainMovementStartDate < @DPDDate
--                         THEN @DPDDate
--                     ELSE @MainMovementStartDate
--                 END;
-- 
--             IF @MainMovementEndDate >= @MainMovementCalculateStartDate
--             BEGIN
--                 SELECT
--                     @MainMovementSuspendDays =
--                         ISNULL
--                         (
--                             SUM
--                             (
--                                 DATEDIFF
--                                 (
--                                     DAY,
-- 
--                                     CASE
--                                         WHEN sp.SuspendStartDate < @MainMovementCalculateStartDate
--                                             THEN @MainMovementCalculateStartDate
--                                         ELSE sp.SuspendStartDate
--                                     END,
-- 
--                                     CASE
--                                         WHEN sp.SuspendEndDate > @MainMovementEndDate
--                                             THEN @MainMovementEndDate
--                                         ELSE sp.SuspendEndDate
--                                     END
--                                 ) + 1
--                             ),
--                             0
--                         )
--                 FROM #SuspendPeriods sp
--                 WHERE sp.SuspendStartDate <= @MainMovementEndDate
--                   AND sp.SuspendEndDate >= @MainMovementCalculateStartDate;
-- 
--                 SET @MainMovementDPD =
--                     DATEDIFF
--                     (
--                         DAY,
--                         @MainMovementCalculateStartDate,
--                         @MainMovementEndDate
--                     ) + 1 - @MainMovementSuspendDays;
-- 
--                 IF @MainMovementDPD < 0
--                 BEGIN
--                     SET @MainMovementDPD = 0;
--                 END;
--             END;


            /* Update DataMainCardMovement */
--             UPDATE mm
--             SET
--                 mm.DPD           = @MainMovementDPD,
--                 mm.DPDAccumulate = @CalculatedDPDAccumulate
--             FROM dbo.DataMainCardMovement mm
--             WHERE mm.MainCardId = @MainCardId
--               AND mm.SeqNo = @SeqCurrentMainCard;
-- 
-- 
--             /* Update DataMainCard */
--             UPDATE m
--             SET
--                 m.DPD = @CalculatedDPDAccumulate
--             FROM dbo.DataMainCard m
--             WHERE m.MainCardId = @MainCardId;
--         END;

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;

        /*
        -- ใช้เปิดตรวจสอบผลระหว่าง Test ได้
        SELECT
            @DataDebtorCardId        AS DataDebtorCardId,
            @DPDDate                 AS DFDDate,

            @TotalSuspendDays        AS TotalSuspendDays,

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_023_InsertConfirmClosingAccount]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE 
          @DocumentName        NVARCHAR(100)
        , @DocYear             CHAR(4)
        , @DocMonth            CHAR(2)
        , @Running             VARCHAR(10)
        , @CurrYear            CHAR(4) = FORMAT(GETDATE(), 'yyyy')
        , @CurrMonth           CHAR(2) = FORMAT(GETDATE(), 'MM')
        , @RowCount            INT
        , @RunLen              INT
        , @RunStartInt         INT
        , @RunNextInt          INT;

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 1) ดึงข้อมูลลูกหนี้มาก่อน ใส่ลง temp table
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Debtor') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Debtor;

    SELECT  
            c.[DebtorRelateId],
            d.DebtorName,
            c.[CIFNo],
            c.[LGNo],
            c.ClaimPay,
            c.ClaimPayDate,
            c.DebtorId
    INTO #Debtor
    FROM DataDebtorCard c
    LEFT JOIN DataDebtor d 
           ON d.DebtorId = c.DebtorId
    WHERE c.DebtorId IN (
            SELECT DebtorId
            FROM DataDebtorCard
            GROUP BY DebtorId
            HAVING MIN(CardStatusId) = 135 
               AND MAX(CardStatusId) = 135
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM ACCDataConfirmClosingAccount a
            WHERE a.DebtorRelateId = c.DebtorRelateId
    )
    AND c.DebtorRelateId NOT IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM ACCDataConfirmClosingAccount);

    SELECT @RowCount = COUNT(*) FROM #Debtor;

    IF @RowCount = 0
        RETURN;

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 2) จองเลข running ตามจำนวน record (สำคัญ: ทำใน transaction)
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRAN;

        SELECT 
              @DocumentName = DocumentName
            , @DocYear      = [Year]
            , @DocMonth     = [Months]
            , @Running      = Running
        FROM SystemFormatDocumentMaster WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
        WHERE DocumentId = 6;

        -- ความยาว running (เช่น 000001 => 6)
        SET @RunLen = CASE WHEN @Running IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(@Running)) = '' THEN 6 ELSE LEN(@Running) END;

        -- ถ้าเปลี่ยนเดือน/ปี => reset running เริ่ม 1
        IF @DocYear <> @CurrYear OR @DocMonth <> @CurrMonth
        BEGIN
            SET @DocYear = @CurrYear;
            SET @DocMonth = @CurrMonth;
            SET @RunStartInt = 1;                 -- เลขแรกที่จะใช้ในรอบนี้
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            -- master.Running ในระบบคุณคือ "เลขถัดไปที่จะใช้" หรือ "เลขปัจจุบัน" ?
            -- จากโค้ดเดิมคุณใช้ @Running เป็นเลขที่จะใช้งานเลย => ตรงนี้ให้ใช้ @Running เป็น start
            SET @RunStartInt = TRY_CAST(@Running AS INT);
            IF @RunStartInt IS NULL SET @RunStartInt = 1;
        END

        -- เลขถัดไปที่ต้องเก็บกลับเข้า master (ขยับไปตามจำนวนแถว)
        SET @RunNextInt = @RunStartInt + @RowCount;

        UPDATE SystemFormatDocumentMaster
        SET [Year]   = @DocYear,
            [Months] = @DocMonth,
            Running  = RIGHT(REPLICATE('0', @RunLen) + CAST(@RunNextInt AS VARCHAR(10)), @RunLen)
        WHERE DocumentId = 6;

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 3) CTE ผู้อนุมัติ
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        ;WITH Approver AS (
            SELECT TOP 1
                dpc.OwnerUserId       AS ApproverUserId,
                dpi.PositionId        AS PositionId,
                dpc.AuthorizeName     AS ApproverName
            FROM DataDocumentContact dpc
            LEFT JOIN DataPersonalInfo dpi
                   ON dpi.UserId = dpc.OwnerUserId
            WHERE dpc.DocumentId = 6
        ),
        DebtorRN AS (
            SELECT d.*,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY d.DebtorRelateId) AS rn
            FROM #Debtor d
        )
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 4) INSERT: สร้างเลขเอกสารต่อแถว (1 record = 1 running)
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[ACCDataConfirmClosingAccount]
               ([ConfirmClosingAccountId]
               ,[DebtorRelateId]
               ,[ConfirmClosingAccountNo]
               ,[ConfirmClosingAccountDate]
               ,[DebtorName]
               ,[FileName]
               ,[PathFile]
               ,[CIFNo]
               ,[LGNo]
               ,[ApproverUserId]
               ,[PositionId]
               ,[ApproverName]
               ,[CreateDate]
               ,[CreateBy]
               ,[UpdateDate]
               ,[UpdateBy]
               ,[ClaimPay]
               ,[ClaimPayDate]
               ,[DueDate]
               )
        SELECT  
            NEWID() AS [ConfirmClosingAccountId],
            d.[DebtorRelateId],

            -- ✅ เลขเอกสารไม่ซ้ำต่อ record
            ISNULL(@DocumentName, '') 
            + @DocYear
            + @DocMonth
            + '/'
            + RIGHT(REPLICATE('0', @RunLen) + CAST(@RunStartInt + d.rn - 1 AS VARCHAR(10)), @RunLen)
            AS [ConfirmClosingAccountNo],

            GETDATE() AS [ConfirmClosingAccountDate],
            d.DebtorName AS [DebtorName],
            '' AS [FileName],
            '' AS [PathFile],
            d.[CIFNo],
            d.[LGNo],
            a.ApproverUserId,
            a.PositionId,
            a.ApproverName,
            GETDATE() AS [CreateDate],
            1 AS [CreateBy],
            GETDATE() AS [UpdateDate],
            1 AS [UpdateBy],
            d.ClaimPay,
            d.ClaimPayDate,
            GETDATE() AS [DueDate]
        FROM DebtorRN d
        CROSS JOIN Approver a;

        COMMIT TRAN;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRAN;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END
