-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_026_AddDataDebtorCard]
    @TypeDataId int = 1 --1= Get ข้อมูล, 2= insert ข้อมูล
	,@DebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = 'F70BC1D3-5499-425C-97E9-00192B895750'
	--,@DebtorCardId2 nvarchar(150) = '228362C3-4BB3-4D23-9D75-B8F73EA2C042'
	,@DebtorTypeId int = 1 --ประเภทลูกหนี้
	--,@EStatementId nvarchar(150)  = '8ee79f11-5eee-4014-b1fc-b74585ff1ee5' --ลบ
	,@Amount DECIMAL(20,6) = 10000
	,@GetDate datetime = '2025-01-06 00:00:00.000'
	,@DebtorId nvarchar(150) = '409269C2-9CAD-4401-B834-A393997F9C46'
	,@LGNo NVARCHAR(20) = '65067431'
	,@MeasureId INT = 85
	,@UserId INT = 1
	,@DebtorCardMainId NVARCHAR(20) = '409269C2-9CAD-4401-B834-A393997F9C46' --รหัสการ์ดของ LG
	,@DebtorMainId NVARCHAR(20) = '228362C3-4BB3-4D23-9D75-B8F73EA2C042' --รหัสลูกหนี้ของผู้กู้หลัก
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @Proportion INT = (SELECT count(*)+1 FROM DataDebtorCard WHERE LGNo = @LGNo AND DebtorRelateTypeId = 4 AND CardStatusId != 135 )
	DECLARE @TypeId INT = 2;
    DECLARE @TypeCode NVARCHAR(2) = (SELECT PaymentTypeCode FROM SystemPaymentType WHERE PaymentTypeId = @TypeId);
    DECLARE @TypeName NVARCHAR(50) = (SELECT PaymentTypeName FROM SystemPaymentType WHERE PaymentTypeId = @TypeId);


    --DECLARE @Amount DECIMAL(20,6) = (SELECT Amount FROM DataEStatement WHERE EStatementId = @EStatementId);
	--DECLARE @GetDate datetime = (SELECT PaymentDate FROM DataEStatement WHERE EStatementId = @EStatementId);
    DECLARE @SeqCurrent INT = (SELECT SeqCurrent FROM DataDebtorCard WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId);
    --DECLARE @IDCard NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT Reference1 FROM DataEStatement WHERE EStatementId = @EStatementId);
    --DECLARE @LGNo NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT Reference2 FROM DataEStatement WHERE EStatementId = @EStatementId);
	DECLARE @AccruedInterestTotal DECIMAL(20,4) = (select AccruedInterestTotal from DataDebtorCardMovement where DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId and SeqNo=@SeqCurrent-1)
	--DECLARE @DebtorTypeId INT = (SELECT DebtorRelateTypeId FROM DataDebtorCard WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId);

    --DECLARE @DebtorId nvarchar(150);
    --SELECT TOP 1 @DebtorId = TRY_CAST(DebtorId AS nvarchar(150))
    --FROM DataDebtor
    --WHERE IDCard = @IDCard;

    IF @DebtorId IS NULL RETURN;

    DECLARE @DebtorCardMovementIdMax nvarchar(150) = (
        SELECT TOP 1 DebtorCardMovementId
        FROM DataDebtorCardMovement
        WHERE DebtorId = @DebtorId
        ORDER BY SeqNo DESC
    );

    DECLARE @PaymentDate DATETIME = @GetDate --(SELECT PaymentDate FROM DataEStatement WHERE EStatementId = @EStatementId);

    --DECLARE @DebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = (
    --    SELECT TOP 1 DataDebtorCardId
    --    FROM DataDebtorCard
    --    WHERE DebtorId = @DebtorId AND LGNo = @LGNo
    --);

    

    --DECLARE @MeasureId INT = (SELECT MeasureId FROM DataDebtorCard WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId);
    DECLARE @PaymentSeq INT = (
        SELECT TOP 1 m.ConditionItemMapingValue
        FROM SystemConditionItemMappingValueMaster m
        LEFT JOIN SystemConditionMaster c ON m.ConditionId = c.ConditionId
        LEFT JOIN SystemCampaignConditionMaster cc ON cc.ConditionId = c.ConditionId
        LEFT JOIN SystemMeasureCampaignMaster cm ON cm.CampaignId = cc.CampaignId
        LEFT JOIN SystemMeasureMaster mm ON mm.MeasureId = cm.MeasureId
        WHERE mm.IsDefault = 1 AND m.ConditionItemId = 20
    );

    -- ค่าคำนวณ
    DECLARE @Principal DECIMAL(20,6) = (SELECT PrincipalTotal FROM DataDebtorCard WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId);
    DECLARE @InterestRate DECIMAL(20,6) = (SELECT InterestRate / 100 FROM DataDebtorCard WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId);
    DECLARE @InterestDate INT = DATEDIFF(
        DAY,
        (SELECT InterestStartDate FROM DataDebtorCardMovement WHERE DebtorCardMovementId = @DebtorCardMovementIdMax),
        DATEADD(DAY, -1, @PaymentDate)
    ) + 1;
    DECLARE @DaysInYear INT = DATEDIFF(DAY, '2024-01-01', '2024-12-31') + 1;

    DECLARE @Interest DECIMAL(20,6) = @Principal * @InterestRate * @InterestDate / @DaysInYear;

    -- เตรียม temp table
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmp') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tmp;

    SELECT 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sd.Seq) AS RowNum,
        sd.Seq,
        sd.PaymentSeqTypeId,
        l.KeyName,
        l.LookUpValue,
        CAST(
            CASE 
                WHEN sd.ConditionPaymentId = 5 
                    THEN dbo.[FN_DCS_02_PayableAmount](@DebtorCardId, l.KeyName) * (sd.[Values]/100)
                ELSE dbo.[FN_DCS_02_PayableAmount](@DebtorCardId, l.KeyName)
            END AS DECIMAL(20,6)
        ) AS PayableAmount,
        CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(20,6)) AS BFAmount,
        CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(20,6)) AS UpdateAmount
    INTO #tmp
    FROM SystemPaymentSeqDetailMaster sd
    LEFT JOIN SystemPaymentSeqMaster s ON s.PaymentSeqId = sd.PaymentSeqId
    LEFT JOIN SystemLookupMaster l ON l.LookupId = sd.PaymentSeqTypeId
    WHERE s.PaymentSeqId = @PaymentSeq;

    -- วนลูปเพื่อคำนวณและอัปเดต UpdateAmount
    DECLARE @Row INT = 1, @MaxRow INT;
    SELECT @MaxRow = MAX(RowNum) FROM #tmp;

    WHILE @Row <= @MaxRow
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @Payable DECIMAL(20,6), @Update DECIMAL(20,6), @PrevUpdate DECIMAL(20,6);
        SELECT @Payable = PayableAmount FROM #tmp WHERE RowNum = @Row;

        IF @Row = 1
        BEGIN
            UPDATE #tmp SET BFAmount = @Amount WHERE RowNum = 1;
            SET @Update = CASE WHEN @Amount >= @Payable THEN @Amount - @Payable ELSE 0 END;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            SELECT @PrevUpdate = UpdateAmount FROM #tmp WHERE RowNum = @Row - 1;
            UPDATE #tmp SET BFAmount = @PrevUpdate WHERE RowNum = @Row;
            SET @Update = CASE WHEN @PrevUpdate >= @Payable THEN @PrevUpdate - @Payable ELSE 0 END;
        END

        UPDATE #tmp SET UpdateAmount = @Update WHERE RowNum = @Row;
        SET @Row += 1;
    END

    -- แสดงผล
    SELECT *
    , PayableAmount - (CASE WHEN PayableAmount <= BFAmount THEN 0 ELSE PayableAmount - BFAmount END) AS Used
    , CASE WHEN PayableAmount <= BFAmount THEN 0 ELSE PayableAmount - BFAmount END AS Total
    INTO #tmpFinal
    FROM #tmp;

    --SELECT * FROM #tmpFinal;

	declare @PrincipalPay decimal(20,4) = (SELECT [Used] FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'Principal')
	declare @PrincipalTotal decimal(20,4) = (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'Principal')

	declare @DefaultInterestPay decimal(20,4) = (SELECT [Used] FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'DefaultInterest')
	declare @DefaultInterestTotal decimal(20,4) = (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'DefaultInterest')

	declare @PlannedInterestPay decimal(20,4) = (SELECT [Used] FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'PlannedInterest')
	declare @PlannedInterestTotal decimal(20,4) = (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'PlannedInterest')


END

--select @SeqCurrent, @PrincipalPay, @PrincipalTotal, * 
--from DataDebtorCard
--WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId 

 --SELECT * FROM #tmpFinal;

 --1= Get ข้อมูล
 if (@TypeDataId =1) 
 BEGIN
	 SELECT @PrincipalPay as PrincipalPay
	 ,  @PrincipalTotal as PrincipalTotal

	 --ดอกเบี้ยตามแผน
	 , @PlannedInterestPay as PlannedInterestPay 
	 ,@PlannedInterestTotal as PlannedInterestTotal

	--ดอกเบี้ยผิดนัด
	 , @DefaultInterestPay as DefaultInterestPay
	 , @DefaultInterestTotal as DefaultInterestTotal
	 , @DefaultInterestPay + @PlannedInterestPay as AccruedInterestPay
	 , @DefaultInterestTotal + @PlannedInterestTotal as AccruedInterestTotal
	--ค่าธรรมเนียมศาล
	 , (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'CourtFee') as CourtFee
	 , (SELECT [Used] FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'CourtFee') as CourtFeePay
	 , (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'CourtFee') as CourtFeeTotal

	 --ค่าทนาย
	 , (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'CourtFee') as LawyerFee
	 , (SELECT [Used] FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'CourtFee') as LawyerFeePay
	 , (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'CourtFee') as LawyerFeeTotal

	 --ค่าใช้จ่ายอื่น
	 , (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'OtherExpenses') as OtherExpense
	 , (SELECT [Used] FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'OtherExpenses') as OtherExpensePay
	 , (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'OtherExpenses') as OtherExpenseTotal
 
	 --เงินวางประกัน
	 , (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'InitialMargin') as InitialMargin
	 , (SELECT [Used] FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'InitialMargin') as InitialMarginPay
	 , (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'InitialMargin') as InitialMarginTotal
	 , SuspendedDefaultInterestPay
	 , SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal

	 , DebtBalance - @Amount as DebtBalance
	 from DataDebtorCard
	 where DataDebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
 END
 --2= insert ข้อมูล
 else if (@TypeDataId =2 )
 BEGIN
 
   UPDATE DCM
    SET 
        DCM.PrincipalPay = @PrincipalPay ,
        DCM.PrincipalTotal = @PrincipalTotal ,

		--ตามแผน
        DCM.PlannedInterestPay =  @PlannedInterestPay,
        DCM.PlannedInterestTotal =  @PlannedInterestTotal,

		--ผิดนัด
		DCM.DefaultInterestPay = @DefaultInterestPay,
		DCM.DefaultInterestTotal = @DefaultInterestTotal,

		--ค้างรับ
		DCM.AccruedInterestPay = @DefaultInterestPay + @PlannedInterestPay,
		DCM.AccruedInterestTotal = @DefaultInterestTotal + @PlannedInterestTotal,

		--ค่างวด
		DCM.Installment = @PrincipalTotal ,
		DCM.InstallmentPrincipal = @PrincipalTotal ,
		DCM.InstallmentPrincipalTotal = @PrincipalTotal ,
		DCM.InstallmentInterest = @DefaultInterestTotal + @PlannedInterestTotal ,
		DCM.InstallmentInterestTotal = @DefaultInterestTotal + @PlannedInterestTotal ,

		--ค่าธรรมเนียมศาล
		DCM.CourtFee = (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'CourtFee') ,
		DCM.CourtFeePay = (SELECT [Used] FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'CourtFee') ,
        DCM.CourtFeeTotal = (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'CourtFee') ,

		--ค่าทนาย
		DCM.LawyerFee = (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'LawyerFee') ,
		DCM.LawyerFeePay = (SELECT [Used] FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'LawyerFee') ,
        DCM.LawyerFeeTotal = (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'LawyerFee') ,

		--ค่าใช้จ่ายอื่น
		DCM.OtherExpense = (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'OtherExpenses') ,
		DCM.OtherExpensePay = (SELECT [Used] FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'OtherExpenses') ,
        DCM.OtherExpenseTotal = (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'OtherExpenses') ,

		--เงินวางประกัน
		DCM.InitialMargin = (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'InitialMargin') ,
		DCM.InitialMarginPay = (SELECT [Used] FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'InitialMargin') ,
        DCM.InitialMarginTotal = (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'InitialMargin') ,

		--คงเหลือ
        DCM.DebtBalance = DCM.DebtBalance - @Amount,
        DCM.ReceivePayment = @Amount



    FROM DataDebtorCardMovement DCM
    LEFT JOIN DataDebtorCard DDC ON DDC.DataDebtorCardId = DCM.DebtorCardId
    WHERE DCM.DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId 
	AND DCM.SeqNo = @SeqCurrent;

	Update DataDebtorCard
	set InterestStartDate = @GetDate
	, CourtFeeTotal = (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'CourtFee')
	, LawyerFeeTotal = (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'LawyerFee')
	, OtherExpenseTotal = (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'OtherExpenses')
	, InitialMarginTotal = (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'InitialMargin')
	
	, DebtBalance = DebtBalance-@Amount
	, PrincipalTotal = @PrincipalTotal
	, PlannedInterestTotal = @PlannedInterestTotal
	, DefaultInterestTotal = @DefaultInterestTotal
	, AccruedInterestTotal = @PlannedInterestTotal + @DefaultInterestTotal

	, InstallmentPrincipal = @PrincipalTotal
	, InstallmentPrincipalTotal = @PrincipalTotal

	, InstallmentInterest = @PlannedInterestTotal + @DefaultInterestTotal
	, InstallmentInterestTotal = @PlannedInterestTotal + @DefaultInterestTotal


    WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId ;
	--AND SeqNo = @SeqCurrent

	--Update DPD 

	EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_022_UpdateDPD]  @GetDate, @DebtorCardId, @SeqCurrent

	if (@PrincipalPay > 0 and @DebtorTypeId = 2)
	begin
		EXEC [SP_DCS_014_1_InsertDebtorCardPrincipal] @GetDate, @PrincipalPay , @DebtorMainId, @DebtorCardId, @LGNo
	end

	--if (@PrincipalPay > 0 )
	--begin
	--	EXEC [SP_DCS_019_InsertPrincipal] @GetDate, @PrincipalTotal , @DataDebtorCardId2
	--end

	
	if (@PrincipalPay > 0 )
	begin
		EXEC [SP_DCS_027_AdjustSubCardToMainCard] @PrincipalPay  --เงินต้น
	,@GetDate  --วันที่จ่ายเงิน
	,@DebtorTypeId  --ประเภทลูกหนี้
	,@DebtorCardId  --รหัสการ์ดผู้กู้หลัก
	,@DebtorId  --รหัสลูกหนี้-ผู้กู้หลัก
	,@LGNo
	,@UserId  --ผู้แก้ไข
	, @DebtorId --รหัสลูกหนี้ผู้ที่จ่ายเงิน
	end

	SELECT top 1 @PrincipalPay as PrincipalPay
	 ,  @PrincipalTotal as PrincipalTotal

	 --ดอกเบี้ยตามแผน
	 , @PlannedInterestPay as PlannedInterestPay 
	 ,@PlannedInterestTotal as PlannedInterestTotal

	--ดอกเบี้ยผิดนัด
	 , @DefaultInterestPay as DefaultInterestPay
	 , @DefaultInterestTotal as DefaultInterestTotal
	 , @DefaultInterestPay + @PlannedInterestPay as AccruedInterestPay
	 , @DefaultInterestTotal + @PlannedInterestTotal as AccruedInterestTotal
	--ค่าธรรมเนียมศาล
	 , (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'CourtFee') as CourtFee
	 , (SELECT [Used] FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'CourtFee') as CourtFeePay
	 , (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'CourtFee') as CourtFeeTotal

	 --ค่าทนาย
	 , (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'CourtFee') as LawyerFee
	 , (SELECT [Used] FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'CourtFee') as LawyerFeePay
	 , (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'CourtFee') as LawyerFeeTotal

	 --ค่าใช้จ่ายอื่น
	 , (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'OtherExpenses') as OtherExpense
	 , (SELECT [Used] FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'OtherExpenses') as OtherExpensePay
	 , (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'OtherExpenses') as OtherExpenseTotal
 
	 --เงินวางประกัน
	 , (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'InitialMargin') as InitialMargin
	 , (SELECT [Used] FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'InitialMargin') as InitialMarginPay
	 , (SELECT Total FROM #tmpFinal WHERE KeyName = 'InitialMargin') as InitialMarginTotal
	 , SuspendedDefaultInterestPay
	 , SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal

	 , DebtBalance - @Amount as DebtBalance
	 from DataDebtorCard
	 where DataDebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId;

END

modules.name: SP_DCS_027_AdjustSubCardToMainCard
modules.definition:
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_027_AdjustSubCardToMainCard]
--ถ้า มีรายการรับชำระที่การ์ดย่อย ที่ตัดเงินต้น จะมารับชำระที่การ์ดผู้กู้หลักด้วย

	@PrincipalPay DECIMAL(20,4) = 0 --เงินต้น
	,@GetDate datetime = '2025-01-06 00:00:00.000' --วันที่จ่ายเงิน
	,@DebtorTypeId int = 1 --ประเภทลูกหนี้
	,@DebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = 'F70BC1D3-5499-425C-97E9-00192B895750' --รหัสการ์ดผู้กู้หลัก
	,@DebtorId nvarchar(150) = '409269C2-9CAD-4401-B834-A393997F9C46' --รหัสลูกหนี้-ผู้กู้หลัก
	,@LGNo NVARCHAR(20) = '65067431'
	,@UserId INT = 1 --ผู้แก้ไข
	,@DebtorPaymentId nvarchar(150) = 'F70BC1D3-5499-425C-97E9-00192B895750' --รหัสลูกหนี้ผู้ที่จ่ายเงิน

	

AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
	--11 = รับคืน-ผู้ค้ำ-{{DebtorCode}}, 17 = รับคืน-ผู้กู้ร่วม
	DECLARE @TypeId INT = (case when @DebtorTypeId = 2 then 17 else 11 end);
    DECLARE @TypeCode NVARCHAR(2) = (SELECT PaymentTypeCode FROM SystemPaymentType WHERE PaymentTypeId = @TypeId);
    DECLARE @TypeName NVARCHAR(50) = (SELECT PaymentTypeName FROM SystemPaymentType WHERE PaymentTypeId = @TypeId);

    DECLARE @SeqCurrent INT = (SELECT SeqCurrent FROM DataDebtorCard WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId);
	DECLARE @SeqNext INT = (SELECT SeqNext FROM DataDebtorCard WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId);
	DECLARE @AccruedInterestTotal DECIMAL(20,4) = (select AccruedInterestTotal from DataDebtorCardMovement where DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId and SeqNo=@SeqCurrent-1)
	
	DECLARE @Principal DECIMAL(20,6) = (SELECT PrincipalTotal FROM DataDebtorCard WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId);
    DECLARE @InterestRate DECIMAL(20,6) = (SELECT InterestRate / 100 FROM DataDebtorCard WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId);

	--insert [DataDebtorCardMovement] ของผู้กู้หลัก
	INSERT INTO [dbo].[DataDebtorCardMovement]
           ([DebtorCardMovementId]
           ,[DebtorCardId]
           ,[DocDate]
           ,[PayDate]
           ,[LGNo]
           ,[DebtorId]
           ,[DebtorCode]
           ,[DebtorCardCode]
           ,[DebtorCardName]
           ,[TypeId]
           ,[TypeCode]
           ,[TypeName]
           ,[FlagAutoPay]
           ,[DFDDate]
           ,[DFDStartDate]
           ,[DFDEndDate]
           ,[DPD]
           ,[TotalPay]
           ,[IsAdjust]
           ,[AdjustRefDocNo]
           ,[IsDelete]
           ,[MeasureId]
           ,[MeasureCode]
           ,[MeasureName]
           ,[InterestRate]
           ,[InterestPlannedRate]
           ,[InterestDefaultRate]
           ,[DebtBalance]
           ,[ReceivePayment]
           ,[Installment]
           ,[InstallmentPay]
           ,[InstallmentTotal]
           ,[Principal]
           ,[PrincipalPay]
           ,[PrincipalTotal]
           ,[InterimInterest]
           ,[AccruedInterest]
           ,[AccruedInterestPay]
           ,[AccruedInterestTotal]
           ,[CourtFee]
           ,[CourtFeePay]
           ,[CourtFeeTotal]
           ,[LawyerFee]
           ,[LawyerFeePay]
           ,[LawyerFeeTotal]
           ,[OtherExpense]
           ,[OtherExpensePay]
           ,[OtherExpenseTotal]
           ,[InitialMargin]
           ,[InitialMarginPay]
           ,[InitialMarginTotal]
           ,[SuspendInt]
           ,[SuspendIntPay]
           ,[SuspendIntTotal]
           ,[DeferredInterest]
           ,[DeferredInterestPay]
           ,[DeferredInterestTotal]
           ,[SuspendedDefaultInterest]
           ,[SuspendedDefaultInterestPay]
           ,[SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal]
           ,[PlannedInterest]
           ,[PlannedInterestPay]
           ,[PlannedInterestTotal]
           ,[DefaultInterest]
           ,[DefaultInterestPay]
           ,[DefaultInterestTotal]
           ,[CreateBy]
           ,[CreateDate]
           ,[UpdateBy]
           ,[UpdateDate]
           ,[ReceiptNo]
           ,[IsEstatement]
           ,[EStatementRef]
           ,[PaymentTypeId]
           ,[SeqNo]
           ,[DebtorPaymentId]
           ,[DebtorPaymentCode]
           ,[CompromiseContractGroup]
           ,[ReceiptId]
           ,[InstallmentPrincipal]
           ,[InstallmentPrincipalPay]
           ,[InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
           ,[InstallmentInterest]
           ,[InstallmentInterestPay]
           ,[InstallmentInterestTotal]
           ,[InterestStartDate]
           ,[InterestEndDate]
           ,[InterestQuantity]
           ,[DPDAccumulate]
           ,[OverdueAmount]
           ,[PrincipalOverdueAmount]
           ,[AccruedInterestOverdueAmount]
           ,[TotalOverdue]
           ,[TotalPrincipalOverdue]
           ,[TotalAccruedInterestOverdue]
           ,[CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId])
     
	 SELECT [DebtorCardMovementId]
      ,newid() as [DebtorCardId]
      ,getdate() as [DocDate]
      ,[PayDate]
      ,[LGNo]
      ,[DebtorId]
      ,[DebtorCode]
      ,[DebtorCardCode]
      ,[DebtorCardName]
      ,@TypeId as [TypeId]
      ,@TypeCode as [TypeCode]
      ,@TypeName as [TypeName]
      ,1 as [FlagAutoPay]
      ,[DFDDate]
      ,[DFDStartDate]
      ,[DFDEndDate]
      ,[DPD]
      ,@PrincipalPay as [TotalPay]
      ,0 as [IsAdjust]
      ,0 as [AdjustRefDocNo]
      ,0 as [IsDelete]
      ,[MeasureId]
      ,[MeasureCode]
      ,[MeasureName]
      ,[InterestRate]
      ,[InterestPlannedRate]
      ,[InterestDefaultRate]
      ,[DebtBalance]
      ,[ReceivePayment]
      ,[Installment]
      ,[InstallmentPay]
      ,[InstallmentTotal]
      ,@Principal as [Principal]
      ,@PrincipalPay as [PrincipalPay]
      ,@Principal - @PrincipalPay as [PrincipalTotal]
      ,[InterimInterest]
      ,[AccruedInterest]
      ,[AccruedInterestPay]
      ,[AccruedInterestTotal]
      ,[CourtFee]
      ,[CourtFeePay]
      ,[CourtFeeTotal]
      ,[LawyerFee]
      ,[LawyerFeePay]
      ,[LawyerFeeTotal]
      ,[OtherExpense]
      ,[OtherExpensePay]
      ,[OtherExpenseTotal]
      ,[InitialMargin]
      ,[InitialMarginPay]
      ,[InitialMarginTotal]
      ,[SuspendInt]
      ,[SuspendIntPay]
      ,[SuspendIntTotal]
      ,[DeferredInterest]
      ,[DeferredInterestPay]
      ,[DeferredInterestTotal]
      ,[SuspendedDefaultInterest]
      ,[SuspendedDefaultInterestPay]
      ,[SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal]
      ,[PlannedInterest]
      ,[PlannedInterestPay]
      ,[PlannedInterestTotal]
      ,[DefaultInterest]
      ,[DefaultInterestPay]
      ,[DefaultInterestTotal]
      ,@UserId as [CreateBy]
      ,getdate() as [CreateDate]
      ,@UserId as [UpdateBy]
      ,getdate() as [UpdateDate]
      ,0 as [ReceiptNo]

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>

-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_031_UpdateInterate]

	@GetDate datetime = '2025-08-20 00:00:00.000' --วันที่จ่ายเงิน
	,@InterateRate decimal(20,4) = 3
	,@TypeId int = 2 --1=ดอกเบี้ยตามประกาศ, 2=ดอกเบี้ยผิดนัด

AS
BEGIN

--select MeasureId from SystemMeasureMaster where IsDefault = 1;


select [DebtorCardInterateId], [DebtorCardId]
into #tmpDataDebtorCardInterate
from DataDebtorCardInterate
where MeasureId in (select MeasureId from SystemMeasureMaster where IsDefault = 1)
and IsActive = 1

DECLARE @EndDate datetime = @GetDate - 1

if(@TypeId = 1)
BEGIN
INSERT INTO [dbo].[DataDebtorCardInterate]
           ([DebtorCardInterateId]
           ,[DebtorCardId]
           ,[MeasureId]
           ,[Seq]
           ,[InterateRate]
           ,[DefaultInterest]
           ,[StartDate]
           ,[EndDate]
           ,[IsActive]
           ,[CompromiseContractGroupId]
           ,[CreateDate]
           ,[CreateBy]
           ,[UpdateDate]
           ,[UpdateBy]
           ,[IsDefaultInterest]
           ,[RequestNoTDR])

SELECT 
			newid() as [DebtorCardInterateId]
			
           ,[DebtorCardId]
           ,[MeasureId]
           ,[Seq] + 1 as [Seq]
           ,@InterateRate as [InterateRate]
           ,[DefaultInterest] as [DefaultInterest]
           ,@GetDate as [StartDate]
           ,cast('3000-01-01 00:00:00.000' as date) as [EndDate]
           ,1 as [IsActive]
           ,[CompromiseContractGroupId]
           ,getdate() as [CreateDate]
           ,1 as [CreateBy]
           ,getdate() as [UpdateDate]
           ,1 as [UpdateBy]
           ,[IsDefaultInterest]
           ,[RequestNoTDR]
FROM [DataDebtorCardInterate]
where [DebtorCardInterateId] in (select [DebtorCardInterateId] from #tmpDataDebtorCardInterate)

Update [DataDebtorCardInterate]
set IsActive = 0
, EndDate = @EndDate

where DebtorCardInterateId in (select [DebtorCardInterateId] from #tmpDataDebtorCardInterate);

Update DataDebtorCard
set InterestRate = @InterateRate + InterestDefaultRate
,InterestPlannedRate = @InterateRate

where DataDebtorCardId in (select [DebtorCardId] from #tmpDataDebtorCardInterate);

END
else if (@TypeId = 2)
BEGIN
INSERT INTO [dbo].[DataDebtorCardInterate]
           ([DebtorCardInterateId]
           ,[DebtorCardId]
           ,[MeasureId]
           ,[Seq]
           ,[InterateRate]
           ,[DefaultInterest]
           ,[StartDate]
           ,[EndDate]
           ,[IsActive]
           ,[CompromiseContractGroupId]
           ,[CreateDate]
           ,[CreateBy]
           ,[UpdateDate]
           ,[UpdateBy]
           ,[IsDefaultInterest]
           ,[RequestNoTDR])

SELECT 
			newid() as [DebtorCardInterateId]
		
           ,[DebtorCardId]
           ,[MeasureId]
           ,[Seq] + 1 as [Seq]
           ,[InterateRate] as [InterateRate]
           ,@InterateRate as [DefaultInterest]
           ,@GetDate as [StartDate]
           ,cast('3000-01-01 00:00:00.000' as date) as [EndDate]
           ,1 as [IsActive]
           ,[CompromiseContractGroupId]
           ,getdate() as [CreateDate]
           ,1 as [CreateBy]
           ,getdate() as [UpdateDate]
           ,1 as [UpdateBy]
           ,[IsDefaultInterest]
           ,[RequestNoTDR]
FROM [DataDebtorCardInterate]
where [DebtorCardInterateId] in (select [DebtorCardInterateId] from #tmpDataDebtorCardInterate)

Update [DataDebtorCardInterate]
set IsActive = 0
, EndDate = @EndDate

where DebtorCardInterateId in (select [DebtorCardInterateId] from #tmpDataDebtorCardInterate);

Update DataDebtorCard
set InterestRate = InterestPlannedRate + @InterateRate
--, PlannedInterest = InterestRate 
, InterestDefaultRate = @InterateRate



where DataDebtorCardId in (select [DebtorCardId] from #tmpDataDebtorCardInterate);
END

END

     RequestAdjustApproverId

    ,UpdateDate

    ,ApproverName
)

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_037_InsertACCDataReceipt]
	
	@DataDebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = '228362C3-4BB3-4D23-9D75-B8F73EA2C042'
	,@EStatementId nvarchar(150)  = '791bcd90-70f3-491f-bef4-a5e827ffc541'
	,@Amount decimal(20,4) = 0
	,@PrincipalPay decimal(20,4) = 0
	,@AccruedInterestPay decimal(20,4) = 0
	,@CourtFeePay decimal(20,4) = 0
	,@LawyerFeePay decimal(20,4) = 0
	,@OtherExpensePay decimal(20,4) = 0
	,@InitialMarginPay decimal(20,4) = 0
AS
BEGIN
--ดึงข้อมูลจากการ์ด
DECLARE @LGNo nvarchar(20)
DECLARE @DebtorId nvarchar(20)
DECLARE @DebtorCode nvarchar(20)
SELECT
	@LGNo = LGNo
	,@DebtorId = DebtorId
	,@DebtorCode = DebtorCode

FROM DataDebtorCard WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId

--ดึงข้อมูลจาก estatement
DECLARE @PaymentDate datetime

SELECT
	@PaymentDate = PaymentDate
	FROM DataEStatement WHERE EStatementId = @EStatementId

--ดึงข้อมูลที่อยู่ลูกหนี้
DECLARE @Address nvarchar(1000) = (SELECT TOP 1 
	AddressNumber + N' หมู่ที่ ' + replace(isnull(Moo,''),'','-') + N' ซอย ' + replace(isnull(Soi,''),'','-') 
	+ N'</br>' + N'ถนน ' + replace(isnull(Road,''),'','-')
	+ N'</br>' + (case when  p.Code = '10' then N'แขวง' else N'ตำบล' end) + sd.Name  
	+ (case when  p.Code = '10' then N'เขต' else N'อำเภอ' end) + d.Name
	+ N'</br>' +p.Name + N' ' + a.PostalCode

	FROM DataDebtorAddress a
	LEFT JOIN SystemProvinceMaster p on p.ProvinceId = a.ProvinceId
	LEFT JOIN SystemDistrictMaster d on d.DistrictId = a.DistrictId
	LEFT JOIN SystemSubDistrictMaster sd on sd.SubDistrictId = a.SubDistrictId
	WHERE DebtorId = @DebtorId AND IsDefault = 1)


INSERT INTO [dbo].[ACCDataReceipt]
           ([ReceiptId]
           ,[ReceiptNo]
           ,[ReceiptDate]
           ,[URL]
           ,[PeriodMonth]
           ,[PaymentAmount]
           ,[IsPrint]
           ,[AccountUserId]
           ,[PaymentTypeId]
           ,[AddressDebtor]
           ,[DueDate]
           ,[CreateDate]
           ,[CreateBy]
           ,[UpdateDate]
           ,[UpdateBy]
           ,[DataBillPaymentId]
           ,[PrincipalPay]
           ,[AccruedInterestPay]
           ,[IDCard]
           ,[LGNo]
           ,[DebtorId]
           ,[DebtorCode]
           ,[DebtorCardId]
           ,[ReceiptNoOld])

SELECT newid() as [ReceiptId]
           ,'' as [ReceiptNo]
           ,@PaymentDate as [ReceiptDate]
           ,'' as [URL]
           ,'' as [PeriodMonth]
           ,@Amount as [PaymentAmount]
           ,0 as [IsPrint]
           ,0 as [AccountUserId]
           ,'' as [PaymentTypeId]
           ,@Address as [AddressDebtor]
           ,'' as [DueDate]
           ,getdate() as [CreateDate]
           ,1 as [CreateBy]
           ,getdate() as [UpdateDate]
           ,1 as [UpdateBy]
           ,'' as [DataBillPaymentId]
           ,@PrincipalPay as [PrincipalPay]
           ,@AccruedInterestPay as [AccruedInterestPay]
           ,'' as [IDCard]
           ,@LGNo as [LGNo]
           ,@DebtorId as [DebtorId]
           ,@DebtorCode as [DebtorCode]
           ,@DataDebtorCardId as [DebtorCardId]
           ,'' as [ReceiptNoOld]
    

END

		    SELECT 
 newid()

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_042_InsertNotification]
		 @NotificationId int = 93
		,@DebtorRelateId nvarchar(150) = null
		,@SystemId int = 4
		,@UserId int =284
		,@NotificationDate datetime = '2026-07-21'
		,@RolesId nvarchar(150) = null

		,@CaesMainId nvarchar(150) = null
		,@RequestCode nvarchar(50) = '' --เลขคำขอ
		,@Count nvarchar(200) = '' --จำนวน


	
	
AS
BEGIN







declare @IsSMS bit = ''
declare @IsEmail bit = ''
declare @IsLine bit = ''
declare @IsSystem bit = ''
declare @NotificationName nvarchar(150)  = ''


declare @Descriptions nvarchar(400) = ''
declare @MenuId int = ''
declare @URLs nvarchar(400) = ''

declare @CIFNo nvarchar(400) = ''
declare @LGNo nvarchar(400) = ''
declare @CardNo nvarchar(400) = ''
declare @DebtorNo nvarchar(400) = ''
declare @DebtorName nvarchar(400) = ''

declare @DebtorTypeName nvarchar(400) = ''
declare @Grade nvarchar(400) = ''
declare @DebtBalance nvarchar(400) = ''
declare @PrincipalTotal nvarchar(400) = ''
declare @AccruedInterestTotal nvarchar(400) = ''
declare @ClaimPayDate nvarchar(400) = ''
declare @ClaimPay nvarchar(400) = ''
declare @DFD nvarchar(400) = ''
declare @DPD nvarchar(400) = ''
declare @ClaimType nvarchar(400) = ''
declare @Measure nvarchar(400) = ''
declare @BlackCaseNo nvarchar(400) = ''
declare @RedCaseNo nvarchar(400) = ''
declare @Status nvarchar(400) = ''
declare @ProjectName nvarchar(400) = ''
declare @CaseType nvarchar(400) = ''
declare @FilingDueDate nvarchar(400) = ''
declare @DueDiligenceDate nvarchar(400) = ''

select top 1
@BlackCaseNo = isnull(cm.BlackCaseNo,'')
,@RedCaseNo = isnull(cm.RedCaseNo,'')
, @ProjectName = isnull(cm.ProjectName,'')
, @CaseType = isnull(ct.CaseTypeName,'')
,@FilingDueDate = dbo.Fn_FormatDate(cm.FilingDueDate)
,@DueDiligenceDate = dbo.Fn_FormatDate(cm.DueDiligenceDate)
from LTDataCaseMain cm 
left join SystemCaseTypeMaster ct on ct.CaseTypeId = cm.CaseTypeId
where cm.CaseMainId = @CaesMainId



select top 1 
@CIFNo = r.CIFNo
,@LGNo = r.LGNo
,@DebtorNo = r.DebtorCode
,@DebtorName = t.TitleName + d.FirstName + ' ' + isnull(d.LastName,'')
,@DebtorTypeName = dt.DebtorTypeName
,@Grade = lg.Grade
,@DebtBalance = dbo.[FN_DCS_18_FormatAmount](cd.DebtBalance)
,@PrincipalTotal = dbo.[FN_DCS_18_FormatAmount](cd.PrincipalTotal)
,@AccruedInterestTotal = dbo.[FN_DCS_18_FormatAmount](cd.AccruedInterestTotal)
,@ClaimPayDate = dbo.Fn_FormatDate(lg.ClaimDate)
,@ClaimPay = dbo.[FN_DCS_18_FormatAmount](lg.ClaimAmount)
,@DPD = cd.DPD
,@Measure = cd.MeasureName
,@ClaimType = ct.ClaimTypeName
,@Status = sm.StatusName

from DataDebtorRelate r 
left join DataDebtor d on d.DebtorId = r.DebtorId
left join SystemTitleMaster t on t.TitleId = d.TitleId
left join DataDebtorCard cd on cd.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId
left join DataLG lg on lg.LGNo = r.LGNo
left join SystemDebtorType dt on dt.DebtorTypeId = r.DebtorTypeId
left join SystemClaimTypeMaster ct on ct.ClaimTypeId = lg.ClaimTypeId
left join DataDebtorStatusUpdate s on s.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId
left join SystemStatusMaster sm on sm.SystemStatusId = s.StatusDebtorId
where r.DebtorRelateId = @DebtorRelateId
--declare @DebtorStatusId = ''

    


select 
@Descriptions --n.DescriptionSystem
= replace(
replace(
replace(
replace(
replace(
replace(
replace(
replace(
replace(
replace(
replace(
replace(
replace(
replace(
replace(
replace(
replace(
replace(
replace(
replace(
replace(
replace(
replace(
replace(
replace(n.DescriptionSystem ,'[LGNo]',@LGNo)

,'[CIFNo]',@CIFNo)
,'[DebtorCode]',@DebtorNo)
,'[DebtorCardCode]',@CardNo)
,'[DebtorName]',@DebtorName)
,'[DebtorTypeName]',@DebtorTypeName)
,'[Grade]',@Grade)
,'[DebtBalance]',@DebtBalance)
,'[PrincipalTotal]',@PrincipalTotal)
,'[AccruedInterestTotal]',@AccruedInterestTotal)
,'[ClaimPayDate]',@ClaimPayDate)
,'[ClaimPay]',@ClaimPay)
,'[DFD]',@DFD)
,'[ClaimType]',@ClaimType)
,'[IDCard]','')
,'[DPD]',@DPD)
,'[BlackCaseNo]',@BlackCaseNo)
,'[RedCaseNo]',@RedCaseNo)
,'[Measure]',@Measure)
,'[Project]',@ProjectName)
,'[RequestCode]',@RequestCode)
,'[CaseType]',@CaseType)
,'[FilingDueDate]',@FilingDueDate)
,'[DueDiligenceDate]',@DueDiligenceDate)
,'[Count]',isnull(@Count,''))


,@IsSMS = n.IsSMS
,@IsEmail = n.IsEmail
,@IsLine = n.IsLine
,@IsSystem = n.IsSystem
,@MenuId = n.MunuId
,@URLs = n.[URL]
,@NotificationName = n.NotificationName
from SystemNotificationMaster n 

where n.NotificationId = @NotificationId

INSERT INTO [dbo].[DataTransactionNotification]
           ([TransactionNotificationId]
           ,[NotificationId]
           ,[SystemId]
           ,[NotificationName]
           ,[Description]
           ,[MenuId]
           ,[URL]
           ,[CreateDate]
           ,[CreateBy]
           ,[UpdateDate]
           ,[UpdateBy]
           ,[IsSMS]

           ,[IsSystem]
           ,[NotificationDate]

					 )
     select newid() as [TransactionNotificationId]

           ,@SystemId as [SystemId]

           ,@Descriptions as [Description]
           ,@MenuId as [MenuId]

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_044_GetApprover]
	
	@PersonalInfoId int = 168
	, @ApproveLevelId int = 0 --1=ปกติ, 2=อนุมัติร่วม
AS
BEGIN


 
declare 
 @OrgStructureId int = 0
, @OrgSectionId int = 0


select @OrgStructureId = OrgStructureId
, @OrgSectionId = OrgSectionId
from DataPersonalInfo where UserId = @PersonalInfoId

select dbo.[FN_DCS_40_GetSubstitute](p.PersonalInfoId, getdate()) as OfficerName
, p.PersonalInfoId
, p.UserId
, s.OrgStructureName
, st.SectionNameTH
, p.IsManager
,p.OrgSectionId
, p.OrgStructureId
from DataPersonalInfo p
left join SystemOrgStructure s on s.OrgStructureId = p.OrgStructureId
left join SystemOrgSectionMaster st on st.OrgSectionId = p.OrgSectionId

where
p.IsManager = 1 and p.OrgSectionId = @OrgSectionId
or (p.IsManager = 1 and p.OrgStructureId = @OrgStructureId and (p.OrgSectionId is null or p.OrgSectionId = 0))
and p.PersonalInfoId != @PersonalInfoId
--or (p.IsManager = 1 and p.OrgStructureId = 18 and p.OrgSectionId is null)


END

      @TypeId     INT             -- 1 = Run all, 2 = Run by MainCardId
    , @MainCardId NVARCHAR(300) = NULL
    , @BatchSize  INT = 5000      -- จำนวน MainCard ต่อ Batch สำหรับ Type 1
)
AS
BEGIN

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Validate Parameter
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    IF @TypeId NOT IN (1, 2)
    BEGIN
        THROW 50001, 'Parameter @TypeId must be 1 or 2.', 1;
    END;

    IF @TypeId = 2
       AND ISNULL(@MainCardId, N'') = N''
    BEGIN
        THROW 50002, 'Parameter @MainCardId is required when @TypeId = 2.', 1;
    END;

    IF ISNULL(@BatchSize, 0) <= 0
    BEGIN
        SET @BatchSize = 5000;
    END;


    BEGIN TRY

        /* ================================================================
           TYPE 2
           Run เฉพาะ MainCardId
           Logic เดิม:
             - UPDATE
             - INSERT
             - DELETE ถ้าต้นทางไม่มี SeqNo แล้ว
           ================================================================ */
        IF @TypeId = 2
        BEGIN

            BEGIN TRAN;

            ;WITH SRC AS
            (
                SELECT
                      DC.DataMainCardId
                    , S.SeqNo
                    , S.DocDate
                    , S.PayDate
                    , S.LGNo
                    , S.DebtorId
                    , S.DebtorCode
                    , S.DebtorCardCode
                    , S.DebtorCardName
                    , S.TypeId
                    , S.TypeCode
                    , S.TypeName
                    , S.FlagAutoPay
                    , S.DFDDate
                    , S.DFDStartDate
                    , S.DFDEndDate
                    , S.DPD
                    , S.TotalPay
                    , S.IsAdjust
                    , S.AdjustRefDocNo
                    , S.IsDelete
                    , S.MeasureId
                    , S.MeasureCode
                    , S.MeasureName
                    , S.InterestRate
                    , S.InterestPlannedRate
                    , S.InterestDefaultRate
                    , S.DebtBalance
                    , S.ReceivePayment
                    , S.Installment
                    , S.InstallmentPay
                    , S.InstallmentTotal
                    , S.Principal
                    , S.PrincipalPay
                    , S.PrincipalTotal
                    , S.InterimInterest
                    , S.AccruedInterest
                    , S.AccruedInterestPay
                    , S.AccruedInterestTotal
                    , S.CourtFee
                    , S.CourtFeePay
                    , S.CourtFeeTotal
                    , S.LawyerFee
                    , S.LawyerFeePay
                    , S.LawyerFeeTotal
                    , S.OtherExpense
                    , S.OtherExpensePay
                    , S.OtherExpenseTotal
                    , S.InitialMargin
                    , S.InitialMarginPay
                    , S.InitialMarginTotal
                    , S.SuspendInt
                    , S.SuspendIntPay
                    , S.SuspendIntTotal
                    , S.DeferredInterest
                    , S.DeferredInterestPay
                    , S.DeferredInterestTotal
                    , S.SuspendedDefaultInterest
                    , S.SuspendedDefaultInterestPay
                    , S.SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal
                    , S.PlannedInterest
                    , S.PlannedInterestPay
                    , S.PlannedInterestTotal
                    , S.DefaultInterest
                    , S.DefaultInterestPay
                    , S.DefaultInterestTotal
                    , S.CreateBy
                    , S.CreateDate
                    , S.UpdateBy
                    , S.UpdateDate
                    , S.ReceiptNo
                    , S.IsEstatement
                    , SUBSTRING(S.EStatementRef, 1, 100) AS EStatementRef
                    , S.PaymentTypeId
                    , S.DebtorPaymentId
                    , S.DebtorPaymentCode
                    , S.InstallmentPrincipal
                    , S.InstallmentPrincipalPay
                    , S.InstallmentPrincipalTotal
                    , S.InstallmentInterest
                    , S.InstallmentInterestPay
                    , S.InstallmentInterestTotal
                    , S.InterestStartDate
                    , S.InterestEndDate
                    , S.InterestQuantity
                    , S.DPDAccumulate

                FROM dbo.DataDebtorCardMovement S

                INNER JOIN dbo.DataDebtorCard DC
                    ON S.DebtorCardId = DC.DataDebtorCardId

                WHERE DC.DebtorRelateTypeId = 1
                  AND DC.DataMainCardId = @MainCardId
            )

            MERGE dbo.DataMainCardMovement AS T

            USING SRC

                ON  T.MainCardId = SRC.DataMainCardId
                AND T.SeqNo      = SRC.SeqNo


            /* ============================================================
               UPDATE
               ============================================================ */
            WHEN MATCHED AND
            (
                   ISNULL(T.DocDate, '19000101') <> ISNULL(SRC.DocDate, '19000101')
                OR ISNULL(T.PayDate, '19000101') <> ISNULL(SRC.PayDate, '19000101')
                OR ISNULL(T.LGNo, '') <> ISNULL(SRC.LGNo, '')
                OR ISNULL(T.DebtorId, '') <> ISNULL(SRC.DebtorId, '')
                OR ISNULL(T.DebtorCode, '') <> ISNULL(SRC.DebtorCode, '')
                OR ISNULL(T.DebtorCardCode, '') <> ISNULL(SRC.DebtorCardCode, '')
                OR ISNULL(T.DebtorCardName, '') <> ISNULL(SRC.DebtorCardName, '')
                OR ISNULL(T.TypeId, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.TypeId, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.TypeCode, '') <> ISNULL(SRC.TypeCode, '')
                OR ISNULL(T.TypeName, '') <> ISNULL(SRC.TypeName, '')
                OR ISNULL(T.FlagAutoPay, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.FlagAutoPay, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.DFDDate, '19000101') <> ISNULL(SRC.DFDDate, '19000101')
                OR ISNULL(T.DFDStartDate, '19000101') <> ISNULL(SRC.DFDStartDate, '19000101')
                OR ISNULL(T.DFDEndDate, '19000101') <> ISNULL(SRC.DFDEndDate, '19000101')
                OR ISNULL(T.DPD, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.DPD, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.TotalPay, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.TotalPay, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.IsAdjust, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.IsAdjust, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.AdjustRefDocNo, '') <> ISNULL(SRC.AdjustRefDocNo, '')
                OR ISNULL(T.IsDelete, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.IsDelete, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.MeasureId, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.MeasureId, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.MeasureCode, '') <> ISNULL(SRC.MeasureCode, '')
                OR ISNULL(T.MeasureName, '') <> ISNULL(SRC.MeasureName, '')
                OR ISNULL(T.InterestRate, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.InterestRate, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.InterestPlannedRate, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.InterestPlannedRate, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.InterestDefaultRate, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.InterestDefaultRate, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.DebtBalance, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.DebtBalance, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.ReceivePayment, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.ReceivePayment, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.Installment, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.Installment, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.InstallmentPay, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.InstallmentPay, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.InstallmentTotal, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.InstallmentTotal, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.Principal, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.Principal, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.PrincipalPay, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.PrincipalPay, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.PrincipalTotal, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.PrincipalTotal, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.InterimInterest, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.InterimInterest, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.AccruedInterest, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.AccruedInterest, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.AccruedInterestPay, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.AccruedInterestPay, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.AccruedInterestTotal, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.AccruedInterestTotal, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.CourtFee, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.CourtFee, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.CourtFeePay, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.CourtFeePay, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.CourtFeeTotal, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.CourtFeeTotal, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.LawyerFee, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.LawyerFee, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.LawyerFeePay, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.LawyerFeePay, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.LawyerFeeTotal, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.LawyerFeeTotal, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.OtherExpense, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.OtherExpense, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.OtherExpensePay, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.OtherExpensePay, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.OtherExpenseTotal, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.OtherExpenseTotal, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.InitialMargin, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.InitialMargin, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.InitialMarginPay, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.InitialMarginPay, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.InitialMarginTotal, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.InitialMarginTotal, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.SuspendInt, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.SuspendInt, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.SuspendIntPay, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.SuspendIntPay, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.SuspendIntTotal, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.SuspendIntTotal, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.DeferredInterest, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.DeferredInterest, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.DeferredInterestPay, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.DeferredInterestPay, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.DeferredInterestTotal, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.DeferredInterestTotal, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.SuspendedDefaultInterest, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.SuspendedDefaultInterest, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.SuspendedDefaultInterestPay, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.SuspendedDefaultInterestPay, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.PlannedInterest, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.PlannedInterest, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.PlannedInterestPay, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.PlannedInterestPay, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.PlannedInterestTotal, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.PlannedInterestTotal, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.DefaultInterest, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.DefaultInterest, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.DefaultInterestPay, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.DefaultInterestPay, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.DefaultInterestTotal, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.DefaultInterestTotal, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.CreateBy, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.CreateBy, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.CreateDate, '19000101') <> ISNULL(SRC.CreateDate, '19000101')
                OR ISNULL(T.UpdateBy, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.UpdateBy, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.UpdateDate, '19000101') <> ISNULL(SRC.UpdateDate, '19000101')
                OR ISNULL(T.ReceiptNo, '') <> ISNULL(SRC.ReceiptNo, '')
                OR ISNULL(T.IsEstatement, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.IsEstatement, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.EStatementRef, '') <> ISNULL(SRC.EStatementRef, '')
                OR ISNULL(T.PaymentTypeId, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.PaymentTypeId, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.DebtorPaymentId, '') <> ISNULL(SRC.DebtorPaymentId, '')
                OR ISNULL(T.DebtorPaymentCode, '') <> ISNULL(SRC.DebtorPaymentCode, '')
                OR ISNULL(T.InstallmentPrincipal, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.InstallmentPrincipal, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.InstallmentPrincipalPay, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.InstallmentPrincipalPay, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.InstallmentPrincipalTotal, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.InstallmentPrincipalTotal, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.InstallmentInterest, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.InstallmentInterest, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.InstallmentInterestPay, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.InstallmentInterestPay, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.InstallmentInterestTotal, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.InstallmentInterestTotal, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.InterestStartDate, '19000101') <> ISNULL(SRC.InterestStartDate, '19000101')
                OR ISNULL(T.InterestEndDate, '19000101') <> ISNULL(SRC.InterestEndDate, '19000101')
                OR ISNULL(T.InterestQuantity, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.InterestQuantity, 0)
                OR ISNULL(T.DPDAccumulate, 0) <> ISNULL(SRC.DPDAccumulate, 0)
            )

            THEN UPDATE SET

                  T.DocDate                       = SRC.DocDate
                , T.PayDate                       = SRC.PayDate
                , T.LGNo                          = SRC.LGNo
                , T.DebtorId                      = SRC.DebtorId
                , T.DebtorCode                    = SRC.DebtorCode
                , T.DebtorCardCode                = SRC.DebtorCardCode
                , T.DebtorCardName                = SRC.DebtorCardName
                , T.TypeId                        = SRC.TypeId
                , T.TypeCode                      = SRC.TypeCode
                , T.TypeName                      = SRC.TypeName
                , T.FlagAutoPay                   = SRC.FlagAutoPay
                , T.DFDDate                       = SRC.DFDDate
                , T.DFDStartDate                  = SRC.DFDStartDate
                , T.DFDEndDate                    = SRC.DFDEndDate
                , T.DPD                           = SRC.DPD
                , T.TotalPay                      = SRC.TotalPay
                , T.IsAdjust                      = SRC.IsAdjust
                , T.AdjustRefDocNo                = SRC.AdjustRefDocNo
                , T.IsDelete                      = SRC.IsDelete
                , T.MeasureId                     = SRC.MeasureId
                , T.MeasureCode                   = SRC.MeasureCode
                , T.MeasureName                   = SRC.MeasureName
                , T.InterestRate                  = SRC.InterestRate
                , T.InterestPlannedRate           = SRC.InterestPlannedRate
                , T.InterestDefaultRate           = SRC.InterestDefaultRate
                , T.DebtBalance                   = SRC.DebtBalance
                , T.ReceivePayment                = SRC.ReceivePayment
                , T.Installment                   = SRC.Installment
                , T.InstallmentPay                = SRC.InstallmentPay
                , T.InstallmentTotal              = SRC.InstallmentTotal
                , T.Principal                     = SRC.Principal
                , T.PrincipalPay                  = SRC.PrincipalPay
                , T.PrincipalTotal                = SRC.PrincipalTotal
                , T.InterimInterest               = SRC.InterimInterest
                , T.AccruedInterest               = SRC.AccruedInterest
                , T.AccruedInterestPay            = SRC.AccruedInterestPay
                , T.AccruedInterestTotal          = SRC.AccruedInterestTotal
                , T.CourtFee                      = SRC.CourtFee
                , T.CourtFeePay                   = SRC.CourtFeePay
                , T.CourtFeeTotal                 = SRC.CourtFeeTotal
                , T.LawyerFee                     = SRC.LawyerFee
                , T.LawyerFeePay                  = SRC.LawyerFeePay
                , T.LawyerFeeTotal                = SRC.LawyerFeeTotal
                , T.OtherExpense                  = SRC.OtherExpense
                , T.OtherExpensePay               = SRC.OtherExpensePay
                , T.OtherExpenseTotal             = SRC.OtherExpenseTotal
                , T.InitialMargin                  = SRC.InitialMargin
                , T.InitialMarginPay               = SRC.InitialMarginPay
                , T.InitialMarginTotal             = SRC.InitialMarginTotal
                , T.SuspendInt                     = SRC.SuspendInt
                , T.SuspendIntPay                  = SRC.SuspendIntPay
                , T.SuspendIntTotal               = SRC.SuspendIntTotal
                , T.DeferredInterest              = SRC.DeferredInterest
                , T.DeferredInterestPay           = SRC.DeferredInterestPay
                , T.DeferredInterestTotal         = SRC.DeferredInterestTotal
                , T.SuspendedDefaultInterest      = SRC.SuspendedDefaultInterest
                , T.SuspendedDefaultInterestPay   = SRC.SuspendedDefaultInterestPay
                , T.SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal = SRC.SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal
                , T.PlannedInterest               = SRC.PlannedInterest
                , T.PlannedInterestPay            = SRC.PlannedInterestPay
                , T.PlannedInterestTotal          = SRC.PlannedInterestTotal
                , T.DefaultInterest               = SRC.DefaultInterest
                , T.DefaultInterestPay            = SRC.DefaultInterestPay
                , T.DefaultInterestTotal          = SRC.DefaultInterestTotal
                , T.CreateBy                      = SRC.CreateBy
                , T.CreateDate                    = SRC.CreateDate
                , T.UpdateBy                      = SRC.UpdateBy
                , T.UpdateDate                    = SRC.UpdateDate
                , T.ReceiptNo                     = SRC.ReceiptNo
                , T.IsEstatement                  = SRC.IsEstatement
                , T.EStatementRef                 = SRC.EStatementRef
                , T.PaymentTypeId                 = SRC.PaymentTypeId
                , T.DebtorPaymentId               = SRC.DebtorPaymentId
                , T.DebtorPaymentCode             = SRC.DebtorPaymentCode
                , T.InstallmentPrincipal          = SRC.InstallmentPrincipal
                , T.InstallmentPrincipalPay       = SRC.InstallmentPrincipalPay
                , T.InstallmentPrincipalTotal     = SRC.InstallmentPrincipalTotal
                , T.InstallmentInterest           = SRC.InstallmentInterest
                , T.InstallmentInterestPay        = SRC.InstallmentInterestPay
                , T.InstallmentInterestTotal      = SRC.InstallmentInterestTotal
                , T.InterestStartDate             = SRC.InterestStartDate
                , T.InterestEndDate               = SRC.InterestEndDate
                , T.InterestQuantity              = SRC.InterestQuantity
                , T.DPDAccumulate                 = SRC.DPDAccumulate


            /* ============================================================
               INSERT
               ============================================================ */
            WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN

                INSERT
                (
                      MainCardMovementId
                    , MainCardId
                    , DocDate
                    , PayDate
                    , LGNo
                    , DebtorId
                    , DebtorCode
                    , DebtorCardCode
                    , DebtorCardName
                    , TypeId
                    , TypeCode
                    , TypeName
                    , FlagAutoPay
                    , DFDDate
                    , DFDStartDate
                    , DFDEndDate
                    , DPD
                    , TotalPay
                    , IsAdjust
                    , AdjustRefDocNo
                    , IsDelete
                    , MeasureId
                    , MeasureCode
                    , MeasureName
                    , InterestRate
                    , InterestPlannedRate
                    , InterestDefaultRate
                    , DebtBalance
                    , ReceivePayment
                    , Installment
                    , InstallmentPay
                    , InstallmentTotal
                    , Principal
                    , PrincipalPay
                    , PrincipalTotal
                    , InterimInterest
                    , AccruedInterest
                    , AccruedInterestPay
                    , AccruedInterestTotal
                    , CourtFee
                    , CourtFeePay
                    , CourtFeeTotal
                    , LawyerFee
                    , LawyerFeePay
                    , LawyerFeeTotal
                    , OtherExpense
                    , OtherExpensePay
                    , OtherExpenseTotal
                    , InitialMargin
                    , InitialMarginPay
                    , InitialMarginTotal
                    , SuspendInt
                    , SuspendIntPay
                    , SuspendIntTotal
                    , DeferredInterest
                    , DeferredInterestPay
                    , DeferredInterestTotal
                    , SuspendedDefaultInterest
                    , SuspendedDefaultInterestPay
                    , SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal
                    , PlannedInterest
                    , PlannedInterestPay
                    , PlannedInterestTotal
                    , DefaultInterest
                    , DefaultInterestPay
                    , DefaultInterestTotal
                    , CreateBy
                    , CreateDate
                    , UpdateBy
                    , UpdateDate
                    , ReceiptNo
                    , IsEstatement
                    , EStatementRef
                    , PaymentTypeId
                    , SeqNo
                    , DebtorPaymentId
                    , DebtorPaymentCode
                    , InstallmentPrincipal
                    , InstallmentPrincipalPay
                    , InstallmentPrincipalTotal
                    , InstallmentInterest
                    , InstallmentInterestPay
                    , InstallmentInterestTotal
                    , InterestStartDate
                    , InterestEndDate
                    , InterestQuantity
                    , DPDAccumulate
                )

                VALUES
                (
                      CAST(NEWID() AS NVARCHAR(150))
                    , SRC.DataMainCardId
                    , SRC.DocDate
                    , SRC.PayDate
                    , SRC.LGNo
                    , SRC.DebtorId
                    , SRC.DebtorCode
                    , SRC.DebtorCardCode
                    , SRC.DebtorCardName
                    , SRC.TypeId
                    , SRC.TypeCode
                    , SRC.TypeName
                    , SRC.FlagAutoPay
                    , SRC.DFDDate
                    , SRC.DFDStartDate
                    , SRC.DFDEndDate
                    , SRC.DPD
                    , SRC.TotalPay
                    , SRC.IsAdjust
                    , SRC.AdjustRefDocNo
                    , SRC.IsDelete
                    , SRC.MeasureId
                    , SRC.MeasureCode
                    , SRC.MeasureName
                    , SRC.InterestRate
                    , SRC.InterestPlannedRate
                    , SRC.InterestDefaultRate
                    , SRC.DebtBalance
                    , SRC.ReceivePayment
                    , SRC.Installment
                    , SRC.InstallmentPay
                    , SRC.InstallmentTotal
                    , SRC.Principal
                    , SRC.PrincipalPay
                    , SRC.PrincipalTotal
                    , SRC.InterimInterest
                    , SRC.AccruedInterest
                    , SRC.AccruedInterestPay
                    , SRC.AccruedInterestTotal
                    , SRC.CourtFee
                    , SRC.CourtFeePay
                    , SRC.CourtFeeTotal
                    , SRC.LawyerFee
                    , SRC.LawyerFeePay
                    , SRC.LawyerFeeTotal
                    , SRC.OtherExpense
                    , SRC.OtherExpensePay
                    , SRC.OtherExpenseTotal
                    , SRC.InitialMargin
                    , SRC.InitialMarginPay
                    , SRC.InitialMarginTotal
                    , SRC.SuspendInt
                    , SRC.SuspendIntPay
                    , SRC.SuspendIntTotal
                    , SRC.DeferredInterest
                    , SRC.DeferredInterestPay
                    , SRC.DeferredInterestTotal
                    , SRC.SuspendedDefaultInterest
                    , SRC.SuspendedDefaultInterestPay
                    , SRC.SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal
                    , SRC.PlannedInterest
                    , SRC.PlannedInterestPay
                    , SRC.PlannedInterestTotal
                    , SRC.DefaultInterest
                    , SRC.DefaultInterestPay
                    , SRC.DefaultInterestTotal
                    , SRC.CreateBy
                    , SRC.CreateDate
                    , SRC.UpdateBy
                    , SRC.UpdateDate
                    , SRC.ReceiptNo
                    , SRC.IsEstatement
                    , SRC.EStatementRef
                    , SRC.PaymentTypeId
                    , SRC.SeqNo
                    , SRC.DebtorPaymentId
                    , SRC.DebtorPaymentCode
                    , SRC.InstallmentPrincipal
                    , SRC.InstallmentPrincipalPay
                    , SRC.InstallmentPrincipalTotal
                    , SRC.InstallmentInterest
                    , SRC.InstallmentInterestPay
                    , SRC.InstallmentInterestTotal
                    , SRC.InterestStartDate
                    , SRC.InterestEndDate
                    , SRC.InterestQuantity
                    , SRC.DPDAccumulate
                )


            /* ============================================================
               DELETE เฉพาะ Type 2

               ถ้า SeqNo ของ MainCard นี้ไม่มีใน Source แล้ว
               ให้ลบออกจาก DataMainCardMovement
               ============================================================ */
            WHEN NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE
                 AND T.MainCardId = @MainCardId
            THEN DELETE;


            COMMIT TRAN;

            RETURN;

        END;


        /* ================================================================
           TYPE 1
           RUN ALL แบบ BATCH

           - Batch ตาม MainCardId
           - Batch ละ @BatchSize MainCard
           - Commit แยก Batch
           - ไม่ DELETE
           ================================================================ */

        CREATE TABLE #MainCardBatch
        (
              MainCardId NVARCHAR(300)
                  COLLATE THAI_CI_AI NOT NULL

            , PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (MainCardId)
        );


        DECLARE
              @LastMainCardId NVARCHAR(300) = N''
            , @RowCount       INT = 0;


        WHILE 1 = 1
        BEGIN

            TRUNCATE TABLE #MainCardBatch;


            /* ------------------------------------------------------------
               ดึง MainCard รอบถัดไป
               ใช้ Keyset Pagination
               ไม่ใช้ OFFSET เพราะข้อมูลหลักล้าน
               ------------------------------------------------------------ */
            INSERT INTO #MainCardBatch
            (
                MainCardId 
            )
            SELECT TOP (@BatchSize)
                   DC.DataMainCardId
            FROM dbo.DataDebtorCard DC
            WHERE DC.DebtorRelateTypeId = 1

              AND DC.DataMainCardId IS NOT NULL

              AND DC.DataMainCardId > @LastMainCardId

            GROUP BY
                DC.DataMainCardId

            ORDER BY
                DC.DataMainCardId;


            SET @RowCount = @@ROWCOUNT;


            IF @RowCount = 0
            BEGIN
                BREAK;
            END;


            SELECT
                @LastMainCardId = MAX(MainCardId)
            FROM #MainCardBatch;


            BEGIN TRAN;


            ;WITH SRC AS
            (
                SELECT
                      DC.DataMainCardId
                    , S.SeqNo
                    , S.DocDate
                    , S.PayDate
                    , S.LGNo
                    , S.DebtorId
                    , S.DebtorCode
                    , S.DebtorCardCode
                    , S.DebtorCardName
                    , S.TypeId
                    , S.TypeCode
                    , S.TypeName
                    , S.FlagAutoPay
                    , S.DFDDate
                    , S.DFDStartDate
                    , S.DFDEndDate
                    , S.DPD
                    , S.TotalPay
                    , S.IsAdjust
                    , S.AdjustRefDocNo
                    , S.IsDelete
                    , S.MeasureId
                    , S.MeasureCode
                    , S.MeasureName
                    , S.InterestRate
                    , S.InterestPlannedRate
                    , S.InterestDefaultRate
                    , S.DebtBalance
                    , S.ReceivePayment
                    , S.Installment
                    , S.InstallmentPay
                    , S.InstallmentTotal
                    , S.Principal
                    , S.PrincipalPay
                    , S.PrincipalTotal
                    , S.InterimInterest
                    , S.AccruedInterest
                    , S.AccruedInterestPay
                    , S.AccruedInterestTotal
                    , S.CourtFee
                    , S.CourtFeePay
                    , S.CourtFeeTotal
                    , S.LawyerFee
                    , S.LawyerFeePay
                    , S.LawyerFeeTotal
                    , S.OtherExpense
                    , S.OtherExpensePay
                    , S.OtherExpenseTotal
                    , S.InitialMargin
                    , S.InitialMarginPay
                    , S.InitialMarginTotal
                    , S.SuspendInt
                    , S.SuspendIntPay
                    , S.SuspendIntTotal
                    , S.DeferredInterest
                    , S.DeferredInterestPay
                    , S.DeferredInterestTotal
                    , S.SuspendedDefaultInterest
                    , S.SuspendedDefaultInterestPay
                    , S.SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal
                    , S.PlannedInterest
                    , S.PlannedInterestPay
                    , S.PlannedInterestTotal
                    , S.DefaultInterest
                    , S.DefaultInterestPay
                    , S.DefaultInterestTotal
                    , S.CreateBy
                    , S.CreateDate
                    , S.UpdateBy
                    , S.UpdateDate
                    , S.ReceiptNo
                    , S.IsEstatement
                    , SUBSTRING(S.EStatementRef, 1, 100) AS EStatementRef
                    , S.PaymentTypeId
                    , S.DebtorPaymentId
                    , S.DebtorPaymentCode
                    , S.InstallmentPrincipal
                    , S.InstallmentPrincipalPay
                    , S.InstallmentPrincipalTotal
                    , S.InstallmentInterest
                    , S.InstallmentInterestPay
                    , S.InstallmentInterestTotal
                    , S.InterestStartDate
                    , S.InterestEndDate
                    , S.InterestQuantity
                    , S.DPDAccumulate

                FROM #MainCardBatch B

                INNER JOIN dbo.DataDebtorCard DC
                    ON DC.DataMainCardId = B.MainCardId

                INNER JOIN dbo.DataDebtorCardMovement S
                    ON S.DebtorCardId = DC.DataDebtorCardId

            MERGE dbo.DataMainCardMovement AS T

create   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_046_UpdateDataSubrogationLetter]

AS
BEGIN



Update t
set ApproverUserId = case when a.TypeAssignId = 1 then a.CollectorUserId else a.CollectorOAUserId end
, ApproverName = dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(case when a.TypeAssignId = 1 then a.CollectorUserId else a.CollectorOAUserId end)
, PositionId = c.CorporateId

from DataSubrogationLetter t
left join DataAssignment a on a.DebtorRelateId = t.DebtorRelateId
left join SystemCorporateMaster c on c.CorporateId = (case when a.TypeAssignId = 1 then a.CollectorUserId else a.CollectorOAUserId end)

where DATEDIFF(DAY, a.CreateDate , getdate()) <=7

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_047_InsertRequestDataDebtorCard]
	-- นำเข้าข้อมูลการ์ดลูกหนี้ - การ์ดรายคน (DataMainCard)
    --@GetDate DATE =  '2025-09-04'
	@DebtorRelateId nvarchar(150) = ''
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @GetMeasureId INT= (SELECT TOP 1 MeasureId FROM SystemMeasureMaster WHERE IsDefault=1)
	DECLARE @GetInterestRate decimal(20,4)= (select top 1 IntRate from SystemInterateMaster where IsActive = 1 and InterateTypeId = 111) 
	
	--(select top 1 cast(m.ConditionItemMapingValue as decimal(20,4))
	--								from SystemConditionItemMappingValueMaster m
	--								left join SystemConditionMaster c on m.ConditionId = c.ConditionId
	--								left join SystemCampaignConditionMaster cc on cc.ConditionId = c.ConditionId
	--								left join SystemMeasureCampaignMaster cm on cm.CampaignId = cc.CampaignId
	--								left join SystemMeasureMaster mm on mm.MeasureId = cm.MeasureId
	--								where mm.IsDefault=1
	--								and m.ConditionItemId=48
	--								and mm.IsActive = 1
	--								)
	DECLARE @GetMeasureName nvarchar(200) = (SELECT TOP 1 MeasureName FROM SystemMeasureMaster WHERE MeasureId = @GetMeasureId)


	BEGIN TRANSACTION;

	-- ล็อกตารางแบบ Exclusive
	--SELECT 1
	--FROM [dbo].[DataMainCard] WITH (TABLOCKX);

    INSERT INTO [dbo].[DataDebtorCard] (
    [DataDebtorCardId]
    ,[LGNo]
    ,[DebtorCode]
    ,[DebtorCardCode]
    ,[DebtorCardName]
	,[InterestRate]
	,[InterestPlannedRate]
   -- ,[CardType]
    ,[ClaimPayDate]
    ,[SystemBankId]
    ,[BankCode]
    ,[IsAuto]
    ,[ClaimPay]
	,[DebtAmount]
    ,[DebtBalance]
    ,[Principal]
    ,[PrincipalTotal]
    ,[CreateBy]
    ,[CreateDate]
    ,[UpdateBy]
    ,[UpdateDate]
	,[MeasureId]
	,[MeasureName]
    ,[DebtorId]
    ,[DebtorRelateId]
	,[ProportionLiability]
    ,[DebtorRelateCode]
    ,[DebtorRelateTypeId]
    ,[CIFNo]
    ,[DebtBurden]
    ,[MainCardCode]
	,[DataMainCardId]
	,[SeqNo]
	,[CardStatusId]
	,[CardStatusDate]
    ,[InstallmentsAmount]
    ,[InstallmentOutstanding]
    ,[GroupCardCode]
    ,[InstallmentPrincipal]
    ,[InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
	,[AmountDuty]
	,[SeqCurrent]
	,[SeqNext]
	,[InterestStartDate]
	,[InterestEndDate]
	,[MeasureDate]
	,[RequestNoTDR]
	,[CompromiseContractId]
	,[CompromiseContracApproveDate]
	,[RequestDebtorApproveDate]
	,[FileOtherDate]
	,[Remark]
	,[IsDelete]
	,[Reference1]
	,[Reference2]

)
SELECT 
    NEWID() AS [DataDebtorCardId]
    ,r.[LGNo]
    ,r.[DebtorCode]
    ,d.[DebtorCode] +'-'+ r.[LGNo] + '-1' AS [DebtorCardCode]
    ,d.FirstName + ' ' + isnull(LastName,'') AS [DebtorCardName]
	,@GetInterestRate AS [InterestRate]
	,@GetInterestRate AS [InterestPlannedRate]
    --,CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId] = 1 THEN 'M' ELSE 'S' END AS [CardType]  -- M = Main, S = Sub
    ,mc.[ClaimPayDate] AS [ClaimPayDate]
    ,mc.[SystemBankId] AS [SystemBankId]
    ,mc.BankCode AS [BankCode]
    ,1 AS [IsAuto]
    ,mc.[ClaimPay] AS [ClaimPay]
    ,(CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId]  = 2 THEN mc.[DebtBalance] / dbo.[FN_DCS_01_ProportionLiabilit](r.[LGNo]) ELSE mc.[DebtBalance] END) AS [DebtAmount]
    ,(CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId]  = 2 THEN mc.[DebtBalance] / dbo.[FN_DCS_01_ProportionLiabilit](r.[LGNo]) ELSE mc.[DebtBalance] END) AS [DebtBalance]
    ,(CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId]  = 2 THEN mc.[DebtBalance] / dbo.[FN_DCS_01_ProportionLiabilit](r.[LGNo]) ELSE mc.[DebtBalance] END) AS [Principal]
    ,(CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId]  = 2 THEN mc.[DebtBalance] / dbo.[FN_DCS_01_ProportionLiabilit](r.[LGNo]) ELSE mc.[DebtBalance] END) AS [PrincipalTotal]
    ,1 AS [CreateBy]
    ,r.CreateDate AS [CreateDate]
    ,1 AS [UpdateBy]
    ,r.UpdateDate AS [UpdateDate]
	,@GetMeasureId AS [MeasureId]
	,@GetMeasureName AS [MeasureName]
    ,r.[DebtorId]
    ,r.[DebtorRelateId]
	,(CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId]  = 2 THEN mc.[DebtBalance] / dbo.[FN_DCS_01_ProportionLiabilit](r.[LGNo]) ELSE mc.[DebtBalance] END) AS [ProportionLiability]
    ,r.[DebtorRelateCode]
    ,r.[DebtorTypeId] AS [DebtorRelateTypeId]
    ,r.[CIFNo]
    ,mc.[DebtBurden] AS [DebtBurden]
    ,mc.[MainCardCode] AS [MainCardCode]
	,mc.[MainCardId] AS [DataMainCardId]
	,1 AS [SeqNo]
	,1 AS [CardStatusId]
	,GETDATE() AS [CardStatusDate]
    ,(CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId]  = 2 THEN mc.[DebtBalance] / dbo.[FN_DCS_01_ProportionLiabilit](r.[LGNo]) ELSE mc.[InstallmentPrincipalTotal] END) AS [InstallmentsAmount]
    ,mc.[InstallmentOutstanding] AS [InstallmentOutstanding]
    ,r.[CIFNo] + '-' + r.[LGNo] AS [GroupCardCode]
	,(CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId]  = 2 THEN mc.[DebtBalance] / dbo.[FN_DCS_01_ProportionLiabilit](r.[LGNo]) ELSE mc.[InstallmentPrincipal] END) AS [InstallmentPrincipal]
	,(CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId]  = 2 THEN mc.[DebtBalance] / dbo.[FN_DCS_01_ProportionLiabilit](r.[LGNo]) ELSE mc.[InstallmentPrincipalTotal] END) AS [InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
	,(CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId]  = 2 THEN mc.[DebtBalance] / dbo.[FN_DCS_01_ProportionLiabilit](r.[LGNo]) ELSE mc.[InstallmentPrincipalTotal] END) AS [AmountDuty]
	,2 as [SeqCurrent]
	,3 as [SeqNext]
	,mc.ClaimPayDate as [InterestStartDate]
	,mc.ClaimPayDate as [InterestEndDate]
	,mc.ClaimPayDate as [MeasureDate]
	,null as [RequestNoTDR]
	,null as [CompromiseContractId]
	,cast('1900-01-01' as date) as [CompromiseContracApproveDate]
	,cast('1900-01-01' as date) as[RequestDebtorApproveDate]
	,cast('1900-01-01' as date) as[FileOtherDate]
	,null as [Remark]
	,0 as [IsDelete]
	,null as [Reference1]
	,null as [Reference2]

FROM [dbo].[DataDebtorRelate] r
LEFT JOIN [dbo].[DataLG] lg ON r.[LGNo] = lg.[LGNo]
LEFT JOIN [dbo].[DataDebtor] d ON d.[DebtorId] = r.[DebtorId]
LEFT JOIN [dbo].[DataMainCard] mc ON r.[LGNo] = mc.[LGNo]
LEFT JOIN [dbo].[SystemDebtorType] dt ON dt.[DebtorTypeId] = r.[DebtorTypeId]
WHERE 
--lg.[LGNo] = '4801150'
 (r.[DebtorCode] + '-' + r.[LGNo] + '-1' not in (SELECT DebtorCardCode FROM [DataDebtorCard]))
 and lg.Grade = 'F1'
--AND CAST(r.CreateDate AS DATE) = @GetDate;
and r.DebtorRelateId not in (select DebtorRelateId from DataDebtorCard )
-- and dt.IsCalCard = 1
and r.DebtorRelateId = @DebtorRelateId


	EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_048_InsertRequestDataDebtorCardMovement] @DebtorRelateId;
	EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_049_InserRequestDataDebtorCardInterate] @DebtorRelateId;

	--EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_015_InsertBillPayment]


	COMMIT TRANSACTION;
END

create PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_048_InsertRequestDataDebtorCardMovement]
	@DebtorRelateId nvarchar(150) = ''
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
	--DECLARE @GetMeasureId INT= (SELECT TOP 1 MeasureId FROM SystemMeasureMaster WHERE IsDefault=1)
	DECLARE @TypeId int = (SELECT TOP 1 PaymentTypeId FROM SystemPaymentType WHERE PaymentTypeId=1)
    DECLARE @TypeCode nvarchar(2) = (SELECT TOP 1 PaymentTypeCode FROM SystemPaymentType WHERE PaymentTypeId=1)
    DECLARE @TypeName nvarchar(50) = (SELECT TOP 1 PaymentTypeName FROM SystemPaymentType WHERE PaymentTypeId=1)
	--DECLARE @GetMeasureName nvarchar(50)= (SELECT TOP 1 MeasureName FROM SystemMeasureMaster WHERE MeasureId = @GetMeasureId)
	--DECLARE @GetDebtorId INT= (SELECT TOP 1 MeasureId FROM DataDebtorRelate WHERE LGNo=)

	BEGIN TRANSACTION;

	-- ล็อกตารางแบบ Exclusive
		--SELECT 1
		--FROM [dbo].[DataDebtorCardMovement] WITH (TABLOCKX);

		INSERT INTO [dbo].[DataDebtorCardMovement] (
		[DebtorCardMovementId]
		,[DebtorCardId]
		,[DocDate]
		,[PayDate]
		,[LGNo]
		,[DebtorId]
		,[DebtorCode]
		,[DebtorCardCode]
		,[DebtorCardName]
		,[TypeId]
		,[TypeCode]
		,[TypeName]
		,[FlagAutoPay]
		,[MeasureId]
		,[MeasureName]
		,[InterestRate]
		,[InterestPlannedRate]
		,[DebtBalance]
		,[Installment]
		,[InstallmentTotal]
		,[Principal]
		,[PrincipalTotal]

		,[CreateBy]
		,[CreateDate]
		,[UpdateBy]
		,[UpdateDate]
		,[SeqNo]

		,[InstallmentPrincipal]
		,[InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
		,[InstallmentInterest]
		,[InstallmentInterestTotal]
		,[InterestStartDate]
		,[InterestEndDate]
		,[InterestQuantity]
		,[DPDAccumulate]
		,[OverdueAmount]
		,[PrincipalOverdueAmount]
		,[AccruedInterestOverdueAmount]
		,[TotalOverdue]
		,[TotalPrincipalOverdue]
		,[TotalAccruedInterestOverdue]
		,[CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId]
		,[IsUpdateHistory]


	)
	SELECT
		NEWID() AS [DebtorCardMovementId]
		,dc.[DataDebtorCardId] AS [DebtorCardId]
		,GETDATE() AS [DocDate]
		,dc.ClaimPayDate [PayDate]
		,dc.[LGNo]
		,dc.[DebtorId]
		,dc.[DebtorCode]
		,dc.[DebtorCardCode]
		,dc.[DebtorCardName]
		,@TypeId AS [TypeId]
		,@TypeCode AS [TypeCode]
		,@TypeName AS [TypeName]
		,dc.[IsAuto] AS [FlagAutoPay]
		,dc.[MeasureId]
		,dc.[MeasureName]
		,dc.[InterestRate]
		,dc.[InterestPlannedRate]
		,dc.[DebtBalance]
		,dc.[InstallmentsAmount] AS [Installment]
		,dc.[InstallmentsAmount] AS [InstallmentTotal]
		,dc.[Principal]
		,dc.[PrincipalTotal]

		,dc.[CreateBy]
		,GETDATE() AS [CreateDate]
		,dc.[UpdateBy]
		,GETDATE() AS [UpdateDate]
		,1 AS [SeqNo]

		,dc.[InstallmentPrincipal]
		,dc.[InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
		,0 AS [InstallmentInterest]
		,0 AS [InstallmentInterestTotal]
		,dc.[ClaimPayDate] AS [InterestStartDate]
		,dc.[ClaimPayDate] AS InterestEndDate
		,0 as InterestQuantity
		,0 as DPDAccumulate
		,0 as OverdueAmount
		,0 as PrincipalOverdueAmount
		,0 as AccruedInterestOverdueAmount
		,0 as TotalOverdue
		,0 as TotalPrincipalOverdue
		,0 as TotalAccruedInterestOverdue
		,0 as CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId
		,0 as IsUpdateHistory

	FROM [dbo].[DataDebtorCard] dc


	WHERE 
	--dc.LGNo = '4801150'
	dc.DebtorRelateId = @DebtorRelateId 
	union all

	SELECT
		NEWID() AS [DebtorCardMovementId]
		,dc.[DataDebtorCardId] AS [DebtorCardId]
		,GETDATE() AS [DocDate]
		, dc.ClaimPayDate as PayDate
		,dc.[LGNo]
		,dc.[DebtorId]
		,dc.[DebtorCode]
		,dc.[DebtorCardCode]
		,dc.[DebtorCardName]
		,8 AS [TypeId]
		,'08' AS [TypeCode]
		,'ยอดคงเหลือ' AS [TypeName]
		,dc.[IsAuto] AS [FlagAutoPay]
		,dc.[MeasureId]
		,dc.[MeasureName]
		,dc.[InterestRate]
		,dc.[InterestPlannedRate]
		,dc.[DebtBalance]
		,dc.[InstallmentsAmount] AS [Installment]
		,dc.[InstallmentsAmount] AS [InstallmentTotal]
		,dc.[Principal]
		,dc.[PrincipalTotal]

		,dc.[CreateBy]
		,GETDATE() AS [CreateDate]
		,dc.[UpdateBy]
		,GETDATE() AS [UpdateDate]
		,2 AS [SeqNo]

		,dc.[InstallmentPrincipal]
		,dc.[InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
		,0 AS [InstallmentInterest]
		,0 AS [InstallmentInterestTotal]
		,dc.[ClaimPayDate] AS [InterestStartDate]
		,dc.[ClaimPayDate] AS InterestEndDate
		,0 as InterestQuantity
		,0 as DPDAccumulate
		,0 as OverdueAmount
		,0 as PrincipalOverdueAmount
		,0 as AccruedInterestOverdueAmount
		,0 as TotalOverdue
		,0 as TotalPrincipalOverdue
		,0 as TotalAccruedInterestOverdue
		,0 as CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId
		,0 as IsUpdateHistory

	FROM [dbo].[DataDebtorCard] dc

	WHERE 
	--dc.LGNo = '4801150'
	dc.DebtorRelateId = @DebtorRelateId 
	----AND r.[LGNo] = '3800012'
	 --CAST(dc.CreateDate AS DATE) = @GetDate;

	COMMIT TRANSACTION;

END
