create PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_049_InserRequestDataDebtorCardInterate]
	@DebtorRelateId nvarchar(150) = ''
	
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @GetMeasureId INT= (SELECT TOP 1 MeasureId FROM SystemMeasureMaster WHERE IsDefault=1)
	DECLARE @GetInterestRate decimal(20,4)= (select top 1 cast(m.ConditionItemMapingValue as decimal(20,4))
									from SystemConditionItemMappingValueMaster m
									left join SystemConditionMaster c on m.ConditionId = c.ConditionId
									left join SystemCampaignConditionMaster cc on cc.ConditionId = c.ConditionId
									left join SystemMeasureCampaignMaster cm on cm.CampaignId = cc.CampaignId
									left join SystemMeasureMaster mm on mm.MeasureId = cm.MeasureId
									where mm.IsDefault=1
									and m.ConditionItemId=16
									and mm.IsActive = 1)
	DECLARE @EndDate DATETIME = '3000-12-01 00:00:00.000'

	--DECLARE @GetMeasureName nvarchar(200) = (SELECT TOP 1 MeasureName FROM SystemMeasureMaster WHERE MeasureId = @GetMeasureId)


	BEGIN TRANSACTION;

	-- ล็อกตารางแบบ Exclusive
	SELECT 1
	FROM [dbo].[DataMainCard] WITH (TABLOCKX);

    INSERT INTO [dbo].[DataDebtorCardInterate] (
    [DebtorCardInterateId]
    ,[DebtorCardId]
    ,[MeasureId]
    ,[Seq]
    ,[InterateRate]
    ,[DefaultInterest]
    ,[StartDate]
    ,[EndDate]
    ,[IsActive]
    ,[CompromiseContractGroupId]
    ,[CreateDate]
    ,[CreateBy]
    ,[UpdateDate]
    ,[UpdateBy]
    ,[IsDefaultInterest]
)
SELECT
    NEWID() AS [DebtorCardInterateId]
    ,dc.[DataDebtorCardId]
    ,dc.[MeasureId]
    ,1 AS [Seq]                            
    ,@GetInterestRate AS [InterateRate]
    ,dc.[InterestDefaultRate] AS [DefaultInterest]
    ,dc.[ClaimPayDate] AS [StartDate]
    ,@EndDate AS [EndDate]
    ,1 AS [IsActive]
    ,NULL AS [CompromiseContractGroupId]
    ,GETDATE() AS [CreateDate]
    ,dc.[CreateBy]
    ,GETDATE() AS [UpdateDate]
    ,dc.[UpdateBy]
    ,1 AS [IsDefaultInterest]              
FROM [dbo].[DataDebtorCard] dc
where dc.DebtorRelateId = @DebtorRelateId

	COMMIT TRANSACTION;
END

modules.name: SP_DCS_050_CalculateInterestToDocDate
modules.definition:
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_050_CalculateInterestToDocDate]
(
      @ID      NVARCHAR(150) = '39a9f1d3-1c54-4d0f-ac33-09411d36106e'
    , @DocDate DATE          = '2026-07-06'
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- กรณีไม่ส่งวันที่เข้ามา ให้ใช้วันที่ปัจจุบัน
    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    IF @DocDate IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SET @DocDate = CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE());
    END;

    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- ตารางเก็บรายการทุกบรรทัดจาก AccDataConfirmDebtBurdenLG
    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    DECLARE @CardList TABLE
    (
          RowNo                INT IDENTITY(1,1)
        , ConfirmDebtBurdenId  NVARCHAR(150)
        , DataDebtorCardId     NVARCHAR(150)
    );

    INSERT INTO @CardList
    (
          ConfirmDebtBurdenId
        , DataDebtorCardId
    )
    SELECT
          lg.ConfirmDebtBurdenId
        , lg.DataDebtorCardId
    FROM dbo.AccDataConfirmDebtBurdenLG lg
    WHERE lg.ConfirmDebtBurdenId = @ID;

    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- ไม่พบรายการตาม ConfirmDebtBurdenId
    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM @CardList
    )
    BEGIN
        THROW 50001,
              N'ไม่พบข้อมูลใน AccDataConfirmDebtBurdenLG จาก ConfirmDebtBurdenId ที่ระบุ',
              1;
    END;

    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- ตารางเก็บผลลัพธ์การคำนวณ
    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    DECLARE @Result TABLE
    (
          RowNo                    INT
        , ConfirmDebtBurdenId      NVARCHAR(150)
        , DataDebtorCardId         NVARCHAR(150)
        , PrincipalTotal           DECIMAL(20,2)
        , AccruedInterestTotal     DECIMAL(20,2)
        , InterestRate             DECIMAL(20,2)
        , InterestStartDate        DATE
        , InterestEndDate          DATE
        , InterestQuantity         INT
        , InterestAmount           DECIMAL(20,2)
    );

    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- ตัวแปรรายการ
    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    DECLARE @RowNo                 INT;
    DECLARE @ConfirmDebtBurdenId   NVARCHAR(150);
    DECLARE @DebtorCardId          NVARCHAR(150);

    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- ตัวแปร Movement ล่าสุด
    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    DECLARE @PrincipalTotal            DECIMAL(20,2);
    DECLARE @LastAccruedInterestTotal  DECIMAL(20,2);
    DECLARE @InterestRate              DECIMAL(20,2);
    DECLARE @LastInterestQuantity      INT;
    DECLARE @LastPayDate               DATE;
    DECLARE @LastInterestEndDate       DATE;

    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- ตัวแปรจาก DataDebtorCard
    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    DECLARE @CardInterestEndDate DATE;

    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- ตัวแปรคำนวณ
    --------------------------------------------------------------------
    DECLARE @InterestStartDate     DATE;
    DECLARE @InterestQuantity      INT;
    DECLARE @DaysInYear            INT;
    DECLARE @InterestAmount        DECIMAL(20,2);
    DECLARE @AccruedInterestTotal  DECIMAL(20,2);

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        -- วนคำนวณทุกบรรทัดใน AccDataConfirmDebtBurdenLG
        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        DECLARE CardCursor CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR
            SELECT
                  RowNo
                , ConfirmDebtBurdenId
                , DataDebtorCardId
            FROM @CardList
            ORDER BY RowNo;

        OPEN CardCursor;

        FETCH NEXT FROM CardCursor
        INTO
              @RowNo
            , @ConfirmDebtBurdenId
            , @DebtorCardId;

        WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
            ------------------------------------------------------------
            -- Reset ตัวแปรแต่ละรอบ
            ------------------------------------------------------------
            SET @PrincipalTotal             = NULL;
            SET @LastAccruedInterestTotal   = NULL;
            SET @InterestRate               = NULL;
            SET @LastInterestQuantity       = NULL;
            SET @LastPayDate                = NULL;
            SET @LastInterestEndDate        = NULL;
            SET @CardInterestEndDate        = NULL;
            SET @InterestStartDate          = NULL;
            SET @InterestQuantity           = 0;
            SET @DaysInYear                 = 0;
            SET @InterestAmount             = 0;
            SET @AccruedInterestTotal       = 0;

            ------------------------------------------------------------
            -- ตรวจสอบ DataDebtorCardId
            ------------------------------------------------------------
            IF NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@DebtorCardId)), '') IS NULL
            BEGIN
                THROW 50002,
                      N'พบรายการ AccDataConfirmDebtBurdenLG ที่ไม่มี DataDebtorCardId',
                      1;
            END;

            ------------------------------------------------------------
            -- ดึง InterestEndDate จาก DataDebtorCard
            ------------------------------------------------------------
            SELECT TOP 1
                @CardInterestEndDate =
                    CONVERT(DATE, dc.InterestEndDate)
            FROM dbo.DataDebtorCard dc
            WHERE dc.DataDebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId;

            ------------------------------------------------------------
            -- ดึง Movement บรรทัดล่าสุด
            --
            -- เลือก SeqNo สูงสุดจากรายการที่ DocDate <= @DocDate
            ------------------------------------------------------------
            SELECT TOP 1
                  @PrincipalTotal =
                        cm.PrincipalTotal

                , @LastAccruedInterestTotal =
                        ISNULL(cm.AccruedInterestTotal, 0)

                , @InterestRate =
                        cm.InterestRate

                , @LastInterestQuantity =
                        ISNULL(cm.InterestQuantity, 0)

                , @LastPayDate =
                        CONVERT(DATE, cm.PayDate)

                , @LastInterestEndDate =
                        CONVERT(DATE, cm.InterestEndDate)

            FROM dbo.DataDebtorCardMovement cm
            WHERE cm.DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
              AND CONVERT(DATE, cm.DocDate) <= @DocDate
            ORDER BY
                cm.SeqNo DESC;

            ------------------------------------------------------------
            -- ไม่พบ Movement
            ------------------------------------------------------------
            IF @PrincipalTotal IS NULL
            BEGIN
                THROW 50003,
                      N'ไม่พบ Movement ที่มี DocDate น้อยกว่าหรือเท่ากับ DocDate ที่ระบุ',
                      1;
            END;

            ------------------------------------------------------------
            -- ตั้งต้นจากยอด Movement ล่าสุด
            ------------------------------------------------------------
            SET @AccruedInterestTotal =
                ISNULL(@LastAccruedInterestTotal, 0);

            SET @InterestQuantity = 0;
            SET @InterestAmount = 0;

            ------------------------------------------------------------
            -- ถ้า @DocDate ไม่เท่ากับ DataDebtorCard.InterestEndDate
            -- ให้คำนวณดอกเบี้ยเพิ่ม
            ------------------------------------------------------------
            IF @CardInterestEndDate IS NOT NULL
               AND @DocDate <> @CardInterestEndDate
            BEGIN
                --------------------------------------------------------
                -- InterestQuantity = 0
                -- เริ่มจาก PayDate + 1
                --
                -- InterestQuantity <> 0
                -- เริ่มจาก InterestEndDate + 1
                --------------------------------------------------------
                SET @InterestStartDate =
                    CASE
                        WHEN ISNULL(@LastInterestQuantity, 0) = 0
                            THEN DATEADD(DAY, 1, @LastPayDate)
                        ELSE DATEADD(DAY, 1, @LastInterestEndDate)
                    END;

                --------------------------------------------------------
                -- ตรวจสอบวันที่เริ่มคำนวณ
                --------------------------------------------------------
                IF @InterestStartDate IS NULL
                BEGIN
                    THROW 50004,
                          N'ไม่สามารถหาวันที่เริ่มคิดดอกเบี้ยได้ กรุณาตรวจสอบ PayDate หรือ InterestEndDate',
                          1;
                END;

                --------------------------------------------------------
                -- จำนวนวันคิดดอกเบี้ยแบบรวม @DocDate
                --------------------------------------------------------
                SET @InterestQuantity =
                    CASE
                        WHEN @DocDate >= @InterestStartDate
                            THEN DATEDIFF
                                 (
                                     DAY,
                                     @InterestStartDate,
                                     @DocDate
                                 ) + 1
                        ELSE 0
                    END;

                --------------------------------------------------------
                -- จำนวนวันในปีของ @DocDate
                -- 365 หรือ 366 วัน
                --------------------------------------------------------
                SET @DaysInYear =
                    DATEDIFF
                    (
                        DAY,
                        DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@DocDate), 1, 1),
                        DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@DocDate) + 1, 1, 1)
                    );

                --------------------------------------------------------
                -- ถ้ามีจำนวนวันที่ต้องคิด ต้องมี InterestRate
                --------------------------------------------------------
                IF @InterestQuantity > 0
                   AND @InterestRate IS NULL
                BEGIN
                    THROW 50005,
                          N'ไม่พบ InterestRate จาก DataDebtorCardMovement บรรทัดล่าสุด',
                          1;
                END;

                --------------------------------------------------------
                -- คำนวณดอกเบี้ย
                --
                -- PrincipalTotal
                -- * InterestRate / 100
                -- * InterestQuantity
                -- / จำนวนวันในปี
                --------------------------------------------------------
                SET @InterestAmount =
                    CAST
                    (
                        ROUND
                        (
                            CAST(@PrincipalTotal AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                            * (
                                CAST(ISNULL(@InterestRate, 0) AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                                / CAST(100.00 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                              )
                            * CAST(@InterestQuantity AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                            / NULLIF
                              (
                                  CAST(@DaysInYear AS DECIMAL(38,10)),
                                  0
                              ),
                            2
                        )
                        AS DECIMAL(20,2)
                    );

                --------------------------------------------------------
                -- ดอกเบี้ยค้างรับเดิม + ดอกเบี้ยที่คำนวณเพิ่ม
                --------------------------------------------------------
                SET @AccruedInterestTotal =
                      ISNULL(@LastAccruedInterestTotal, 0)
                    + ISNULL(@InterestAmount, 0);
            END;
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                --------------------------------------------------------
                -- ถ้า @DocDate เท่ากับ DataDebtorCard.InterestEndDate
                -- ใช้ยอดจาก Movement ล่าสุดโดยไม่คำนวณเพิ่ม
                --------------------------------------------------------
                SET @InterestStartDate = NULL;
                SET @InterestQuantity = 0;
                SET @InterestAmount = 0;
                SET @AccruedInterestTotal =
                    ISNULL(@LastAccruedInterestTotal, 0);
            END;

            ------------------------------------------------------------
            -- เก็บผลลัพธ์แต่ละบรรทัด
            ------------------------------------------------------------
            INSERT INTO @Result
            (
                  RowNo
                , ConfirmDebtBurdenId
                , DataDebtorCardId
                , PrincipalTotal
                , AccruedInterestTotal
                , InterestRate
                , InterestStartDate
                , InterestEndDate
                , InterestQuantity
                , InterestAmount
            )
            VALUES
            (
                  @RowNo
                , @ConfirmDebtBurdenId
                , @DebtorCardId
                , @PrincipalTotal
                , @AccruedInterestTotal
                , @InterestRate
                , @InterestStartDate
                , @DocDate
                , @InterestQuantity
                , @InterestAmount
            );

            FETCH NEXT FROM CardCursor
            INTO
                  @RowNo
                , @ConfirmDebtBurdenId
                , @DebtorCardId;
        END;

        CLOSE CardCursor;
        DEALLOCATE CardCursor;

        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        -- อัปเดตทุกบรรทัดใน AccDataConfirmDebtBurdenLG
        --
        -- จับคู่ด้วย ConfirmDebtBurdenId และ DataDebtorCardId
        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        UPDATE lg
        SET
              lg.PrincipalTotal =
                    r.PrincipalTotal

            , lg.AccruedInterestTotal =
                    r.AccruedInterestTotal

        FROM dbo.AccDataConfirmDebtBurdenLG lg
        INNER JOIN @Result r
            ON r.ConfirmDebtBurdenId = lg.ConfirmDebtBurdenId
           AND r.DataDebtorCardId = lg.DataDebtorCardId
        WHERE lg.ConfirmDebtBurdenId = @ID;

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;

        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Return ผลลัพธ์หลังอัปเดต
        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        SELECT
              r.ConfirmDebtBurdenId
            , r.DataDebtorCardId
            , r.PrincipalTotal
            , r.AccruedInterestTotal
            , r.InterestRate
            , r.InterestStartDate
            , r.InterestEndDate
            , r.InterestQuantity
            , r.InterestAmount
        FROM @Result r
        ORDER BY r.RowNo;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        ---------------------------------------------------------------
        -- ปิด Cursor กรณีเกิด Error ระหว่างประมวลผล
        ---------------------------------------------------------------
        IF CURSOR_STATUS('local', 'CardCursor') >= 0
        BEGIN
            CLOSE CardCursor;
        END;

        IF CURSOR_STATUS('local', 'CardCursor') > -3
        BEGIN
            DEALLOCATE CardCursor;
        END;

        ---------------------------------------------------------------
        -- ย้อนกลับทั้งหมด หากมีรายการใดรายการหนึ่งผิดพลาด
        ---------------------------------------------------------------
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
        BEGIN
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        END;

        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_051_UpdateEndOfDay]

	
AS
BEGIN

UPDATE eod
set
--ค่างวด TDR 
-- select


eod.TDRInstallmentDueDate = cpp.DueDate --งวดผ่อนชำระปัจจุบัน
, eod.TDRInstallmentsAmount = cpp.Instament  --ค่างวดปัจจุบัน
, eod.TDRPayAmount = cpp.PaymentAmount --ชำระค่างวดปัจจุบัน
, eod.TDRPrincipalPay = cpp.PrincipalPay --ชำระค่างวดปัจจุบัน - เงินต้น
, eod.TDRAccruedInterestPay = cpp.AccruedInterestPay --ชำระค่างวดปัจจุบัน - ดอกเบี้ย


--จำนวนงวดค้างชำระ

--ชำระ ค่างวด ปัจจุบัน
-- from DataDebtorCard c
-- left join TDRDataCompromiseContract cc on cc.CompromiseContractId = c.CompromiseContractId
-- -- left join TDRDataCompromiseContractRelated cr on cr.CompromiseContractId = c.CompromiseContractId
-- left join TDRDataCompromiseContractDebtor cd on cd.CompromiseContractId = cc.CompromiseContractId
-- left join TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment cpp on cpp.CompromiseContractId = cc.CompromiseContractId
-- where cd.IsMain = 1
-- DataEndOfDay eod

from TDRDataCompromiseContract cc 
left join TDRDataCompromiseContractRelated cr on cr.CompromiseContractId = cc.CompromiseContractId
left join TDRDataCompromiseContractDebtor cd on cd.CompromiseContractId = cc.CompromiseContractId
left join TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment cpp on cpp.CompromiseContractId = cc.CompromiseContractId
left join DataEndOfDay eod on eod.DebtorRelateId = cr.DebtorRelateId
where cd.IsMain = 1
and getdate() between cpp.StartDate and cpp.EndDate

--========================================================
--============ หาจำนวนงวดที่ค้าง
--========================================================
-- 
;WITH Overdue AS
(
    SELECT 
        cr.DebtorRelateId,
        COUNT(cc.RequestNo) AS CountOverdueInstallments
    FROM DataDebtorCard c
    LEFT JOIN TDRDataCompromiseContract cc 
        ON cc.CompromiseContractId = c.CompromiseContractId
    LEFT JOIN TDRDataCompromiseContractRelated cr 
        ON cr.CompromiseContractId = cc.CompromiseContractId
    LEFT JOIN TDRDataCompromiseContractDebtor cd 
        ON cd.CompromiseContractId = cc.CompromiseContractId
    LEFT JOIN TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment cpp 
        ON cpp.CompromiseContractId = cc.CompromiseContractId
    WHERE cd.IsMain = 1
      AND cpp.EndDate <= GETDATE()
      AND cpp.IsPayment = 0
    GROUP BY 
        cr.DebtorRelateId
)
UPDATE eod
SET eod.CountOverdueInstallments = o.CountOverdueInstallments
FROM DataEndOfDay eod
INNER JOIN Overdue o 
    ON o.DebtorRelateId = eod.DebtorRelateId;


END

modules.definition:
-- =============================================
-- Author:      <Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description: ประมวลผลบัตรลูกหนี้ที่ครบกำหนด DPD 31 วัน
--              1. บันทึกยอดคงเหลือ
--              2. คำนวณดอกเบี้ยรายวัน
--              3. ปิดช่วงดอกเบี้ยเดิม
--              4. สร้างช่วงดอกเบี้ยผิดนัดใหม่ อัตรา 3%
-- =============================================
create PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_052_SetDFD]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    DECLARE @DPDDay INT = 30;

    /*
        ClaimPayDate นับเป็นวันที่ 1
        ดังนั้นวันที่ 31 คือ ClaimPayDate + 30 วัน
        โดยประมวลผลข้อมูลของวันพรุ่งนี้
    */
    DECLARE @CurrentDate DATE =
        CAST(DATEADD(DAY, -1, GETDATE()) AS DATE);

    DECLARE @AdjustDate DATE = '19000101';
    DECLARE @DataDebtorCardId NVARCHAR(150);

    BEGIN TRY

        /*==========================================================
          Step 1: หาบัตรลูกหนี้ที่ครบกำหนด DPD วันที่ 31
        ==========================================================*/
        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmp_DataDebtorCardDPD_DefaultMeasure;

        SELECT DISTINCT
            c.DataDebtorCardId
        INTO #tmp_DataDebtorCardDPD_DefaultMeasure
        FROM dbo.DataDebtorCard AS c
        INNER JOIN dbo.SystemMeasureMaster AS m
            ON m.MeasureId = c.MeasureId
        WHERE c.CardStatusId <> 135
          AND m.IsDefault = 1
          AND c.PrincipalTotal > 0
          AND c.ClaimPayDate IS NOT NULL
          AND CAST(
                DATEADD(DAY, @DPDDay, c.ClaimPayDate)
                AS DATE
              ) = @CurrentDate;


        /*==========================================================
          วนประมวลผลทีละ DataDebtorCardId
        ==========================================================*/
        DECLARE DataDebtorCardCursor CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD
        FOR
            SELECT DataDebtorCardId
            FROM #tmp_DataDebtorCardDPD_DefaultMeasure
            ORDER BY DataDebtorCardId;

        OPEN DataDebtorCardCursor;

        FETCH NEXT
        FROM DataDebtorCardCursor
        INTO @DataDebtorCardId;

        WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
            BEGIN TRANSACTION;


            /*======================================================
              Step 2: บันทึกยอดคงเหลือ
            ======================================================*/
            EXEC dbo.SP_DCS_Card_003_InsertBalance
                 @CurrentDate      = @CurrentDate,
                 @DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId,
                 @IsAdjust         = 0,
                 @AdjustDate       = @AdjustDate;


            /*======================================================
              Step 3: คำนวณดอกเบี้ยรายวัน
            ======================================================*/
            EXEC dbo.SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay
                 @CurrentDate      = @CurrentDate,
                 @DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId,
                 @IsAdjust         = 0,
                 @AdjustDate       = @AdjustDate;


            /*======================================================
              Step 4: ปิดช่วงดอกเบี้ยเดิมและสร้างช่วงใหม่
            ======================================================*/

            /*
                ป้องกันการสร้างข้อมูลซ้ำ
                กรณี Stored Procedure ถูกรันซ้ำในวันเดียวกัน
            */
            IF NOT EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM dbo.DataDebtorCardInterate AS chk
                WHERE chk.DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
                  AND CAST(chk.StartDate AS DATE) = @CurrentDate
                  AND chk.IsDefaultInterest = 1
            )
            BEGIN

                /*--------------------------------------------------
                  Step 4.1 ปิดรายการที่มี Seq มากที่สุด

                  EndDate            = @CurrentDate - 1 วัน
                  IsDefaultInterest  = 0
                --------------------------------------------------*/
                ;WITH LatestInterest AS
                (
                    SELECT TOP (1)
                        i.*
                    FROM dbo.DataDebtorCardInterate AS i
                        WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
                    WHERE i.DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
                    ORDER BY
                        ISNULL(i.Seq, 0) DESC
                )
                UPDATE LatestInterest
                SET
                    EndDate =
                        DATEADD(DAY, -1, @CurrentDate),
                    IsDefaultInterest = 0,
                    UpdateDate = GETDATE();


                /*--------------------------------------------------
                  Step 4.2 คัดลอกแถว Seq ล่าสุดและสร้างรายการใหม่

                  Seq                 = Seq เดิม + 1
                  StartDate           = @CurrentDate
                  EndDate             = 3000-12-31
                  DefaultInterest     = 3
                  IsDefaultInterest   = 1
                --------------------------------------------------*/
                IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
                BEGIN
                    INSERT INTO dbo.DataDebtorCardInterate
                    (
                        DebtorCardInterateId,
                        DebtorCardId,
                        MeasureId,
                        Seq,
                        InterateRate,
                        DefaultInterest,
                        StartDate,
                        EndDate,
                        IsActive,
                        CompromiseContractGroupId,
                        CreateDate,
                        CreateBy,
                        UpdateDate,
                        UpdateBy,
                        IsDefaultInterest,
                        RequestNoTDR
                    )
                    SELECT TOP (1)
                        CONVERT(NVARCHAR(150), NEWID())
                            AS DebtorCardInterateId,

                        src.DebtorCardId,
                        src.MeasureId,

                        ISNULL(src.Seq, 0) + 1
                            AS Seq,

                        src.InterateRate,

                        CAST(3 AS DECIMAL(20, 2))
                            AS DefaultInterest,

                        @CurrentDate
                            AS StartDate,

                        CONVERT(DATETIME, '30001231')
                            AS EndDate,

                        src.IsActive,
                        src.CompromiseContractGroupId,

                        GETDATE()
                            AS CreateDate,

                        src.CreateBy,

                        GETDATE()
                            AS UpdateDate,

                        src.UpdateBy,

                        CAST(1 AS BIT)
                            AS IsDefaultInterest,

                        src.RequestNoTDR
                    FROM dbo.DataDebtorCardInterate AS src
                    WHERE src.DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
                    ORDER BY
                        ISNULL(src.Seq, 0) DESC;
                END;

            END;


            COMMIT TRANSACTION;


            FETCH NEXT
            FROM DataDebtorCardCursor
            INTO @DataDebtorCardId;
        END;


        CLOSE DataDebtorCardCursor;
        DEALLOCATE DataDebtorCardCursor;

        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmp_DataDebtorCardDPD_DefaultMeasure;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH

        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
        BEGIN
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        END;


        IF CURSOR_STATUS('local', 'DataDebtorCardCursor') >= 0
        BEGIN
            CLOSE DataDebtorCardCursor;
        END;


        IF CURSOR_STATUS('local', 'DataDebtorCardCursor') > -3
        BEGIN
            DEALLOCATE DataDebtorCardCursor;
        END;


        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmp_DataDebtorCardDPD_DefaultMeasure;

        THROW;

    END CATCH;
END;

modules.name: SP_DCS_053_InsertDefaultInterest
modules.definition:
-- =============================================
-- Author:      <Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description: ปิดช่วงดอกเบี้ยเดิม และสร้างช่วงดอกเบี้ยผิดนัดใหม่
--              โดยดึงอัตราดอกเบี้ยจาก SystemInterateMaster
--              InterateTypeId = 112 และ IsActive = 1
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_053_InsertDefaultInterest]
(
    @DataDebtorCardId NVARCHAR(150),
    @CurrentDate      DATE
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    DECLARE
        @InitialTranCount INT = @@TRANCOUNT,
        @LatestInterestId NVARCHAR(150),
        @DefaultInterest DECIMAL(20, 2);

    BEGIN TRY

        /*==========================================================
          Step 1: หาอัตราดอกเบี้ยผิดนัดจาก Master
                  InterateTypeId = 112
                  IsActive = 1
        ==========================================================*/
        SELECT TOP (1)
            @DefaultInterest = im.IntRate
        FROM dbo.SystemInterateMaster AS im
        WHERE im.InterateTypeId = 112
          AND im.IsActive = 1;


        /*==========================================================
          Step 2: เริ่ม Transaction

          รองรับทั้งกรณี:
          1. เรียก Stored Procedure นี้โดยตรง
          2. เรียกจาก Stored Procedure อื่นที่มี Transaction อยู่แล้ว
        ==========================================================*/
        IF @InitialTranCount = 0
        BEGIN
            BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        END;
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            SAVE TRANSACTION SP_DCS_053_SavePoint;
        END;


        /*==========================================================
          Step 3: ป้องกันการสร้างข้อมูลซ้ำ

          ตรวจสอบว่าบัตรลูกหนี้นี้มีรายการดอกเบี้ยผิดนัด
          เริ่มต้นในวันที่ @CurrentDate แล้วหรือไม่
        ==========================================================*/
        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.DataDebtorCardInterate AS chk
                WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
            WHERE chk.DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
              AND chk.StartDate >= @CurrentDate
              AND chk.StartDate < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @CurrentDate)
              AND chk.IsDefaultInterest = 1
        )
        BEGIN

            /*======================================================
              Step 4: หารายการดอกเบี้ยล่าสุด

              ใช้ Seq มากที่สุดของ DataDebtorCardInterate
            ======================================================*/
            SELECT TOP (1)
                @LatestInterestId = i.DebtorCardInterateId
            FROM dbo.DataDebtorCardInterate AS i
                WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
            WHERE i.DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
            ORDER BY ISNULL(i.Seq, 0) DESC;


            /*======================================================
              Step 5: กรณีพบรายการดอกเบี้ยเดิม
            ======================================================*/
            IF @LatestInterestId IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN

                /*--------------------------------------------------
                  Step 5.1: ปิดช่วงดอกเบี้ยเดิม

                  EndDate           = ก่อนวันเริ่มต้นใหม่ 1 วัน
                  IsDefaultInterest = 0
                --------------------------------------------------*/
                UPDATE dbo.DataDebtorCardInterate
                SET
                    EndDate = DATEADD(DAY, -1, @CurrentDate),
                    IsDefaultInterest = 0,
                    UpdateDate = GETDATE()
                WHERE DebtorCardInterateId = @LatestInterestId;


                /*--------------------------------------------------
                  Step 5.2: สร้างช่วงดอกเบี้ยผิดนัดใหม่

                  Seq               = Seq เดิม + 1
                  DefaultInterest   = อัตราจาก SystemInterateMaster
                  StartDate         = @CurrentDate
                  EndDate           = 3000-12-31
                  IsDefaultInterest = 1
                --------------------------------------------------*/
                INSERT INTO dbo.DataDebtorCardInterate
                (
                    DebtorCardInterateId,
                    DebtorCardId,
                    MeasureId,
                    Seq,
                    InterateRate,
                    DefaultInterest,
                    StartDate,
                    EndDate,
                    IsActive,
                    CompromiseContractGroupId,
                    CreateDate,
                    CreateBy,
                    UpdateDate,
                    UpdateBy,
                    IsDefaultInterest,
                    RequestNoTDR
                )
                SELECT
                    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(150), NEWID())
                        AS DebtorCardInterateId,

                    src.DebtorCardId,

                    src.MeasureId,

                    ISNULL(src.Seq, 0) + 1
                        AS Seq,

                    src.InterateRate,

                    @DefaultInterest
                        AS DefaultInterest,

                    @CurrentDate
                        AS StartDate,

                    CONVERT(DATETIME, '30001231', 112)
                        AS EndDate,

                    src.IsActive,

                    src.CompromiseContractGroupId,

                    GETDATE()
                        AS CreateDate,

                    src.CreateBy,

                    GETDATE()
                        AS UpdateDate,

                    src.UpdateBy,

                    CAST(1 AS BIT)
                        AS IsDefaultInterest,

                    src.RequestNoTDR

                FROM dbo.DataDebtorCardInterate AS src
                WHERE src.DebtorCardInterateId = @LatestInterestId;

            END;
        END;


        /*==========================================================
          Step 6: Commit เฉพาะกรณี Stored Procedure นี้เป็นผู้เปิด
                  Transaction เอง
        ==========================================================*/
        IF @InitialTranCount = 0
        BEGIN
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
        END;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH

        IF XACT_STATE() = -1
        BEGIN
            /*
                Transaction อยู่ในสถานะใช้งานต่อไม่ได้
            */
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        END;
        ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = 1
        BEGIN
            IF @InitialTranCount = 0
            BEGIN
                ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
            END;
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                ROLLBACK TRANSACTION SP_DCS_053_SavePoint;
            END;
        END;

        THROW;

    END CATCH;
END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_Adjust_005_InsertAdjustRecalManual]

   @DebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = '87818700-102C-4A43-8810-6C24F6393A03'
  ,@SeqNo int = 41
  ,@TypeId int = 8
  ,@CreateBy int = 1
  ,@MeasureMasterId int = 1
  ,@InterestEndDate date = '2025-08-19'
  ,@IsFinal int = 1 -- 1=final Update DataDebtorCard, 0= Transaction
	,@IsFirst int = 1 -- 1=ยอดคงเหลือแถวแรก, 0= ยอดคงเหลือแถวต่อไป
	,@IsAuto int = 1 --1=Auto, 0=manual
,@PaymentTypeId int = 21

	--
	
AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON;

declare @SeqNoBefore int = @SeqNo-1
declare @PrincipalTotal decimal(20,2)
declare @AccruedInterestTotal decimal(20,2)
declare @CourtFeeTotal decimal(20,2)
declare @LawyerFeeTotal decimal(20,2)
declare @OtherExpenseTotal decimal(20,2)

declare @SuspendIntTotal decimal(20,2)
declare @DeferredInterestTotal decimal(20,2)

declare @InstallmentPrincipal decimal(20,2)

DECLARE @MeasureId int = (select top 1 MeasureId from TDRDataCompromiseContractRecalCard where SeqNo = @SeqNo-1)

select 
@MeasureCode = MeasureCode

from SystemMeasureMaster
where MeasureId = @MeasureId

--ถ้าเป็น 3, 8, 9 คำนวณดอกเบี้ย
if(@TypeId = 8 or @TypeId = 3 or @TypeId = 9)
begin
--1 ตั้งตัวแปร
	
	--if(@PaymentTypeId != 28 and @IsFirst = 0)
	--begin
	--	select 
	 
	--			@PrincipalTotal = [PrincipalTotal]

	--			,@CourtFeeTotal = [CourtFeeTotal]
	--			,@LawyerFeeTotal = [LawyerFeeTotal]
	--			,@OtherExpenseTotal = [OtherExpenseTotal]
	--			,@InitialMarginTotal = [InitialMarginTotal]

	--			,@SuspendIntTotal = [SuspendIntTotal]
	--			,@DeferredInterestTotal = [DeferredInterestTotal]
	--			,@SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal = [SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal]
	--			,@PlannedInterestTotal = [PlannedInterestTotal]
	--			,@DefaultInterestTotal = [DefaultInterestTotal]
	--			,@InterestQuantity = InterestQuantity
	--			,@EStatementsId = EStatementRef

	--			,@Installment = Installment

		  ,@SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal = [SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal]

		  ,@PlannedInterest = [PlannedInterest]
		  ,@PlannedInterestTotal = [PlannedInterestTotal]

		  ,@DefaultInterest = [DefaultInterest]
		  ,@DefaultInterestTotal = [DefaultInterestTotal]



	from TDRDataCompromiseContractRecalCard
	where DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
	and SeqNo = @SeqNoBefore;

	Update DataDebtorCard
	set PrincipalTotal = @PrincipalTotal
	, AccruedInterest = @AccruedInterest
	, AccruedInterestTotal = @AccruedInterestTotal
	, DebtBalance = @PrincipalTotal + @AccruedInterestTotal

	, CourtFee = @CourtFeeTotal

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_Adjust_007_InsertAdjustRecalTDR]

   @DebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = '7C0D3DCE-E2F1-46D3-8F04-CB43D6D3D618'
  ,@SeqNo int = 10
  ,@TypeId int = 8

declare @SeqNoBefore int = @SeqNo-1

if(@TypeId = 8 or @TypeId = 3 or @TypeId = 9)

--1 ตั้งตัวแปร
	select 
 
		  @PrincipalTotal = [PrincipalTotal]

	where DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
	and SeqNo = @SeqNo;
	
	--3 Update ดอกเบี้ย
	if(@CheckDefaultMeasureId = 1)
	  begin
		  Update c
		  set 
 			InterimInterest = (PrincipalTotal * (InterestPlannedRate/100) * [InterestQuantity] / @DaysInYear)
											+ (PrincipalTotal * (InterestDefaultRate/100) * [InterestQuantity] / @DaysInYear)
		  , PlannedInterest = (PrincipalTotal * (InterestPlannedRate/100) * [InterestQuantity] / @DaysInYear)
		  , PlannedInterestTotal = PlannedInterestTotal + (PrincipalTotal * (InterestPlannedRate/100) * [InterestQuantity] / @DaysInYear)

		  , DefaultInterest = (PrincipalTotal * (InterestDefaultRate/100) * [InterestQuantity] / @DaysInYear)
		  , DefaultInterestTotal = DefaultInterestTotal + (PrincipalTotal * (InterestDefaultRate/100) * [InterestQuantity] / @DaysInYear)

		  , AccruedInterest = (PrincipalTotal * (InterestRate/100) * [InterestQuantity] / @DaysInYear)
		  , AccruedInterestTotal = AccruedInterest + (PrincipalTotal * (InterestRate/100) * [InterestQuantity] / @DaysInYear)

		  from TDRDataCompromiseContractRecalCard c
		  where DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
		  and SeqNo = @SeqNo;

		  Update c
		  set DebtBalance = PrincipalTotal + AccruedInterestTotal
		  from TDRDataCompromiseContractRecalCard c
		  where DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
		  and SeqNo = @SeqNo;
	  end

	  if(@CheckDefaultMeasureId != 1)
	  begin
		  Update c 
		  set InterimInterest = (PrincipalTotal * (InterestPlannedRate/100) * [InterestQuantity] / @DaysInYear)
		  , SuspendInt = (PrincipalTotal * (InterestPlannedRate/100) * [InterestQuantity] / @DaysInYear)
		  , SuspendIntTotal = SuspendIntTotal + (PrincipalTotal * (InterestPlannedRate/100) * [InterestQuantity] / @DaysInYear)

		  , DefaultInterest = (InstallmentPrincipal * (InterestDefaultRate/100) * [InterestQuantity] / @DaysInYear)
		  , DefaultInterestTotal = DefaultInterestTotal + (PrincipalTotal * (InterestDefaultRate/100) * [InterestQuantity] / @DaysInYear)

	  
		  from TDRDataCompromiseContractRecalCard c
		  where DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
		  and SeqNo = @SeqNo;

		  Update c
		  set AccruedInterest = SuspendInt + DefaultInterest + DeferredInterest
		  , AccruedInterestTotal = SuspendIntTotal + DefaultInterestTotal + DeferredInterestTotal

		  from TDRDataCompromiseContractRecalCard c
		  where DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
		  and SeqNo = @SeqNo;

		  Update c
		  set DebtBalance = PrincipalTotal + AccruedInterestTotal

		  from TDRDataCompromiseContractRecalCard c
		  where DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
		  and SeqNo = @SeqNo;
	  end

end

--ถ้าเป็น 2 รับคืนออกใบเสร็จใหม่
if(@TypeId = 2)
begin

select 
 
		  @PrincipalTotal = [PrincipalTotal]

		  ,@InitialMarginTotal = [InitialMarginTotal]

		  ,@SuspendIntTotal = [SuspendIntTotal]

		  ,@SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal = [SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal]
		  ,@PlannedInterestTotal = [PlannedInterestTotal]
		  ,@DefaultInterestTotal = [DefaultInterestTotal]
		  ,@InterestQuantity = InterestQuantity
		  ,@EStatementsId = EStatementRef


	from TDRDataCompromiseContractRecalCard
	where DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
	and SeqNo = @SeqNoBefore;

	--2 Update ค่า

	Update TDRDataCompromiseContractRecalCard
	set 
-- 	PayDate = DocDate
-- 	,DocDate = getdate()

	[Principal] = @PrincipalTotal
	,[PrincipalTotal] = @PrincipalTotal

	,[CourtFee] = @CourtFeeTotal
	,[CourtFeeTotal] = @CourtFeeTotal

	,[DeferredInterest] = @DeferredInterestTotal

	where DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId

	, PlannedInterestTotal = PlannedInterest - PlannedInterestPay
	, DefaultInterestTotal = DefaultInterest - DefaultInterestPay
	, SuspendIntTotal = SuspendInt - SuspendIntPay
	, SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal = SuspendedDefaultInterest - SuspendedDefaultInterestPay
	--, DefaultInterestTotal = DefaultInterest - DefaultInterestPay
	--from TDRDataCompromiseContractRecalCard c
	where DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId

end

modules.name: SP_DCS_Adjust_007_InsertAdjustRecalTDRBatch
modules.definition:
/*
Purpose:
    Recalculate every TDRDataCompromiseContractRecalCard row for one
    DebtorCardId in a single database call.

Compatibility:
    This procedure preserves the row-by-row dependency of
    dbo.SP_DCS_Adjust_007_InsertAdjustRecalTDR:
      - rows are processed in ascending SeqNo order;
      - the current row carries balances from SeqNo - 1;
      - TypeId and InterestEndDate come from the current row.

Prerequisite:
    IX_TDRRecalCard_DebtorCardId_SeqNo on
    dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractRecalCard (DebtorCardId, SeqNo).

Deployment:
    Review and execute this script in the target database. The existing
    row-level procedure is intentionally left unchanged for rollback.
*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_Adjust_007_InsertAdjustRecalTDRBatch]
    @DebtorCardId nvarchar(150)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE
        @SeqNo int,
        @SeqNoBefore int,
        @TypeId int,
        @InterestEndDate date,
        @DaysInYear int,
        @MeasureMasterId int,
        @CheckDefaultMeasureId int,
        @PrincipalTotal decimal(20, 2),
        @AccruedInterestTotal decimal(20, 2),
        @CourtFeeTotal decimal(20, 2),
        @LawyerFeeTotal decimal(20, 2),
        @OtherExpenseTotal decimal(20, 2),
        @InitialMarginTotal decimal(20, 2),
        @DeferredInterestTotal decimal(20, 2);

    SELECT @MeasureMasterId = ddc.MeasureId
    FROM dbo.DataDebtorCard AS ddc
    WHERE ddc.DataDebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId;

    SELECT TOP (1)
        @CheckDefaultMeasureId = smm.IsDefault
    FROM dbo.SystemMeasureMaster AS smm
    WHERE smm.MeasureId = @MeasureMasterId;

    /*
    STATIC preserves the same input snapshot behavior as the current C# code,
    which loads the recalculation rows before invoking the row-level procedure.
    Only control values are materialized; balance values are read after the
    preceding SeqNo has been updated.
    */
    DECLARE recal_rows CURSOR LOCAL STATIC READ_ONLY FOR
        SELECT
            recal.SeqNo,
            recal.TypeId,
            CONVERT(date, recal.InterestEndDate)
        FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractRecalCard AS recal
        WHERE recal.DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
        ORDER BY recal.SeqNo;

    OPEN recal_rows;

    FETCH NEXT FROM recal_rows
    INTO @SeqNo, @TypeId, @InterestEndDate;

    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
        SET @SeqNoBefore = @SeqNo - 1;

        /*
        Reset values on every iteration. The row-level procedure creates fresh
        local variables for every call, so a missing SeqNo - 1 must not reuse
        values from the preceding cursor iteration.
        */
        SELECT
            @PrincipalTotal = NULL,
            @AccruedInterestTotal = NULL,
            @CourtFeeTotal = NULL,
            @LawyerFeeTotal = NULL,
            @OtherExpenseTotal = NULL,
            @InitialMarginTotal = NULL,
            @DeferredInterestTotal = NULL;

        IF @TypeId IN (3, 8, 9)
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                @PrincipalTotal = previous.PrincipalTotal,
                @AccruedInterestTotal = previous.AccruedInterestTotal,
                @CourtFeeTotal = previous.CourtFeeTotal,
                @LawyerFeeTotal = previous.LawyerFeeTotal,
                @OtherExpenseTotal = previous.OtherExpenseTotal,
                @InitialMarginTotal = previous.InitialMarginTotal,
                @DeferredInterestTotal = previous.DeferredInterestTotal
            FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractRecalCard AS previous
            WHERE previous.DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
              AND previous.SeqNo = @SeqNoBefore;

            UPDATE current_row
            SET
                PayDate = current_row.DocDate,
                DocDate = GETDATE(),
                Principal = @PrincipalTotal,
                PrincipalTotal = @PrincipalTotal,
                CourtFee = @CourtFeeTotal,
                CourtFeeTotal = @CourtFeeTotal,
                LawyerFee = @LawyerFeeTotal,
                LawyerFeeTotal = @LawyerFeeTotal,
                OtherExpense = @OtherExpenseTotal,
                OtherExpenseTotal = @OtherExpenseTotal,
                InitialMargin = @InitialMarginTotal,
                InitialMarginTotal = @InitialMarginTotal,
                DeferredInterest = @DeferredInterestTotal,
                DeferredInterestTotal = @DeferredInterestTotal
            FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractRecalCard AS current_row
            WHERE current_row.DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
              AND current_row.SeqNo = @SeqNo;

            SET @DaysInYear =
                DATEDIFF
                (
                    DAY,
                    DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@InterestEndDate), 1, 1),
                    DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@InterestEndDate), 12, 31)
                ) + 1;

            IF @CheckDefaultMeasureId = 1
            BEGIN
                UPDATE current_row
                SET
                    InterimInterest =
                        current_row.PrincipalTotal
                        * (current_row.InterestRate / 100)
                        * current_row.InterestQuantity / @DaysInYear,
                    PlannedInterest =
                        current_row.PrincipalTotal
                        * (current_row.InterestPlannedRate / 100)
                        * current_row.InterestQuantity / @DaysInYear,
                    PlannedInterestTotal =
                        current_row.PlannedInterestTotal
                        + (
                            current_row.PrincipalTotal
                            * (current_row.InterestPlannedRate / 100)
                            * current_row.InterestQuantity / @DaysInYear
                        ),
                    DefaultInterest =
                        current_row.PrincipalTotal
                        * (current_row.InterestDefaultRate / 100)
                        * current_row.InterestQuantity / @DaysInYear,
                    DefaultInterestTotal =
                        current_row.DefaultInterestTotal
                        + (
                            current_row.PrincipalTotal
                            * (current_row.InterestDefaultRate / 100)
                            * current_row.InterestQuantity / @DaysInYear
                        ),
                    AccruedInterest =
                        current_row.PrincipalTotal
                        * (current_row.InterestRate / 100)
                        * current_row.InterestQuantity / @DaysInYear,
                    AccruedInterestTotal =
                        current_row.AccruedInterest
                        + (
                            current_row.PrincipalTotal
                            * (current_row.InterestRate / 100)
                            * current_row.InterestQuantity / @DaysInYear
                        )
                FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractRecalCard AS current_row
                WHERE current_row.DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
                  AND current_row.SeqNo = @SeqNo;

                UPDATE current_row
                SET DebtBalance =
                    current_row.PrincipalTotal + current_row.AccruedInterestTotal
                FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractRecalCard AS current_row
                WHERE current_row.DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
                  AND current_row.SeqNo = @SeqNo;
            END;
            ELSE IF @CheckDefaultMeasureId <> 1
            BEGIN
                UPDATE current_row
                SET
                    InterimInterest =
                        current_row.PrincipalTotal
                        * (current_row.InterestPlannedRate / 100)
                        * current_row.InterestQuantity / @DaysInYear,
                    SuspendInt =
                        current_row.PrincipalTotal
                        * (current_row.InterestPlannedRate / 100)
                        * current_row.InterestQuantity / @DaysInYear,
                    SuspendIntTotal =
                        current_row.SuspendIntTotal
                        + (
                            current_row.PrincipalTotal
                            * (current_row.InterestPlannedRate / 100)
                            * current_row.InterestQuantity / @DaysInYear
                        ),
                    DefaultInterest =
                        current_row.InstallmentPrincipal
                        * (current_row.InterestDefaultRate / 100)
                        * current_row.InterestQuantity / @DaysInYear,
                    DefaultInterestTotal =
                        current_row.DefaultInterestTotal
                        + (
                            current_row.PrincipalTotal
                            * (current_row.InterestDefaultRate / 100)
                            * current_row.InterestQuantity / @DaysInYear
                        )
                FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractRecalCard AS current_row
                WHERE current_row.DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
                  AND current_row.SeqNo = @SeqNo;

                UPDATE current_row
                SET
                    AccruedInterest =
                        current_row.SuspendInt
                        + current_row.DefaultInterest
                        + current_row.DeferredInterest,
                    AccruedInterestTotal =
                        current_row.SuspendIntTotal
                        + current_row.DefaultInterestTotal
                        + current_row.DeferredInterestTotal
                FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractRecalCard AS current_row
                WHERE current_row.DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
                  AND current_row.SeqNo = @SeqNo;

                UPDATE current_row
                SET DebtBalance =
                    current_row.PrincipalTotal + current_row.AccruedInterestTotal
                FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractRecalCard AS current_row
                WHERE current_row.DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
                  AND current_row.SeqNo = @SeqNo;
            END;
        END;
        ELSE IF @TypeId = 2
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                @PrincipalTotal = previous.PrincipalTotal,
                @AccruedInterestTotal = previous.AccruedInterestTotal,
                @CourtFeeTotal = previous.CourtFeeTotal,
                @LawyerFeeTotal = previous.LawyerFeeTotal,
                @OtherExpenseTotal = previous.OtherExpenseTotal,
                @InitialMarginTotal = previous.InitialMarginTotal,
                @DeferredInterestTotal = previous.DeferredInterestTotal
            FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractRecalCard AS previous
            WHERE previous.DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
              AND previous.SeqNo = @SeqNoBefore;

            UPDATE current_row
            SET
                PayDate = current_row.DocDate,
                DocDate = GETDATE(),
                Principal = @PrincipalTotal,
                PrincipalTotal = @PrincipalTotal,
                CourtFee = @CourtFeeTotal,
                CourtFeeTotal = @CourtFeeTotal,
                LawyerFee = @LawyerFeeTotal,
                LawyerFeeTotal = @LawyerFeeTotal,
                OtherExpense = @OtherExpenseTotal,
                OtherExpenseTotal = @OtherExpenseTotal,
                InitialMargin = @InitialMarginTotal,
                InitialMarginTotal = @InitialMarginTotal,
                DeferredInterest = @DeferredInterestTotal,
                DeferredInterestTotal = @DeferredInterestTotal
            FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractRecalCard AS current_row
            WHERE current_row.DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
              AND current_row.SeqNo = @SeqNo;

            UPDATE current_row
            SET
                PrincipalTotal =
                    current_row.Principal - current_row.PrincipalPay,
                AccruedInterestTotal =
                    current_row.AccruedInterest - current_row.AccruedInterestPay,
                PlannedInterestTotal =
                    current_row.PlannedInterest - current_row.PlannedInterestPay,
                DefaultInterestTotal =
                    current_row.DefaultInterest - current_row.DefaultInterestPay,
                SuspendIntTotal =
                    current_row.SuspendInt - current_row.SuspendIntPay,
                SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal =
                    current_row.SuspendedDefaultInterest
                    - current_row.SuspendedDefaultInterestPay
            FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractRecalCard AS current_row
            WHERE current_row.DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
              AND current_row.SeqNo = @SeqNo;
        END;

        FETCH NEXT FROM recal_rows
        INTO @SeqNo, @TypeId, @InterestEndDate;
    END;

    CLOSE recal_rows;
    DEALLOCATE recal_rows;
END;

set e.DebtorCardId = cd.DataDebtorCardId
, e.MappingDate = getdate()
, e.IsCheck = 1
from DataEStatement e
inner join DataDebtorCard cd on cd.Reference1 = e.Reference1 and cd.Reference2 = e.Reference2

where e.DebtorCardId is null
and (StatusEStatement =1 or StatusEStatement =3)


Update e
set IsDelete = 1
from DataEStatement e
-- inner join DataDebtorCard cd on cd.Reference1 = e.Reference1 and cd.Reference2 = e.Reference2

where e.DebtorCardId is null
and (StatusEStatement =4)



END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay]

	-- คำอธิบาย : 1.คำนวณดอกเบี้ย รายวัน
	--			2.ถ้าวันนี้เป็นวันที่สิ้นเดือน จะปิดงวด
	--			3.ถ้าวันนี้เป็นวันที่สิ้นเดือน จะเพิ่มรายการใหม่ เป็นยอดคงเหลือ

	@CurrentDate datetime = '2026-08-31'
	,@DataDebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = '0B9E81B8-0867-4575-8537-4658956E8F5C'
	,@IsAdjust int = 0 --0 = รายการปกติ, 1=รายการที่ต้องปรับปรุง
	,@AdjustDate date = '2025-12-01' --วันที่ปรับปรุง
	--,@DataDebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = 'F70BC1D3-5499-425C-97E9-00192B895750'
	
AS
BEGIN

declare @Check int = 0 
declare @CheckDefaultMeasureId int = 0 
declare @MeasureId int = 0
declare @SeqCurrent int = 0
DECLARE @InterestRate decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @InterestPlannedRate decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @InterestDefaultRate decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @ClaimDate date 
DECLARE @DFD date 
DECLARE @DefaultDate date = cast('1900-01-01' as date)
DECLARE @CheckClosedStatus int
declare @IsAuto int = (select top 1 IsAuto from SystemReceivePaymentMaster)



--จำนวนบันทัดสุดท้ายของแต่ละการ์ด
select @SeqCurrent= SeqCurrent 
,@MeasureId= MeasureId
,@InterestRate = InterestRate
,@InterestPlannedRate = InterestPlannedRate
,@InterestDefaultRate = InterestDefaultRate
,@ClaimDate = ClaimPayDate
,@DFD = dateadd(day, 30, ClaimPayDate)
,@CheckClosedStatus = CardStatusId
from DataDebtorCard where DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
set @Check = (select top 1 IsReceivership from SystemMeasureMaster where MeasureId = @MeasureId)
set @CheckDefaultMeasureId = (select top 1 IsDefault from SystemMeasureMaster where MeasureId = @MeasureId)

--declare @CurrentDate datetime = '2025-06-06'


--ถ้าเป็นมาตรการทั่วไป ให้คิดดอกเบี้ย ถ้าเป็นมาตรการพิทักทรัพย์ (@Check =1) จะไม่คิดดอกเบี้ย
--ถ้าเป็นมาตรการ default (@CheckDefaultMeasureId =1) คิดดอกเบี้ย stored นี้ ถ้าไม่ใช้ ใช้อีก stored
--if(@Check = 0 and @CheckDefaultMeasureId = 1 and @CheckClosedStatus != 135 and @IsAuto = 1)
if(@Check = 0 and @CheckDefaultMeasureId = 1 )
begin

--หาจำนวนวันของปีที่ดำเนินการ
DECLARE @DFDDate date = (select dateadd(day, 1, DFDDate) from DataDebtorCard where  DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId)

DECLARE @DaysInYear INT = DATEDIFF(DAY, cast(year(getdate()) as nvarchar) + '-01-01', cast(year(getdate()) as nvarchar) + '-12-31') + 1;
--(กรณีปิดงวด) PaymentTypeId = 3 ปิดงวด 
DECLARE @CheckId int = (case when dateadd(day, -1, @DFDDate) = @CurrentDate then 9 else 3 end)
DECLARE @TypeId int = (select PaymentTypeId from SystemPaymentType where PaymentTypeId = @CheckId)
DECLARE @TypeCode nvarchar(2) = (select PaymentTypeCode from SystemPaymentType where PaymentTypeId = @TypeId)
DECLARE @TypeName nvarchar(100) = (select PaymentTypeName from SystemPaymentType where PaymentTypeId = @TypeId)

--(กรณีเพิ่มรายการ) PaymentTypeId = 8 ยอดคงเหลือ
DECLARE @NextCheckId int = (case when dateadd(day, -1, @DFDDate) = @CurrentDate then 9 else 8 end)
DECLARE @NextTypeId int = (select PaymentTypeId from SystemPaymentType where PaymentTypeId = @NextCheckId)
DECLARE @NextTypeCode nvarchar(2) = (select PaymentTypeCode from SystemPaymentType where PaymentTypeId = @NextTypeId)
DECLARE @NextTypeName nvarchar(100) = (select PaymentTypeName from SystemPaymentType where PaymentTypeId = @NextTypeId)

DECLARE @PlannedInterestTotal  decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @DefaultInterestTotal  decimal(20,4) = 0
DECLARE @AccruedInterestTotal  decimal(20,4) = 0
(select @PlannedInterestTotal = PlannedInterestTotal 
,@DefaultInterestTotal = DefaultInterestTotal
,@AccruedInterestTotal = AccruedInterestTotal
from DataDebtorCardMovement where DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId and SeqNo=@SeqCurrent-1)

DECLARE @DebtBalance  decimal(20,4) = (select DebtBalance from DataDebtorCardMovement where DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId and SeqNo=@SeqCurrent-1)
DECLARE @InterestQuantity INT = (select DATEDIFF(DAY, InterestStartDate,  @CurrentDate ) + 1 from DataDebtorCardMovement where DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId and SeqNo=@SeqCurrent)

DECLARE @EndDayOfMonth datetime =  EOMONTH(@CurrentDate)
DECLARE @DueDate date = dateadd(day,29 , @ClaimDate)






--select @CurrentDate


--, DATEDIFF(DAY, DATEADD(DAY, 1, EOMONTH(@CurrentDate, -1)),  @CurrentDate ) + 1 as InterestQuantity

--, cast(PrincipalTotal * (InterestRate/ 100) * cast((DATEDIFF(DAY, InterestStartDate,  @CurrentDate - 1) + 1)AS DECIMAL(20,4))/ (CAST(@DaysInYear AS DECIMAL(20,4))) as decimal(20,4)) as InterimInterest

--, cast(PrincipalTotal * (InterestDefaultRate/ 100) * cast((DATEDIFF(DAY, InterestStartDate,  @CurrentDate - 1) + 1)AS DECIMAL(20,4))/ (CAST(@DaysInYear AS DECIMAL(20,4))) as decimal(20,4)) as DefaultInterest
----,  cast(PrincipalTotal * (InterestDefaultRate/ 100) * cast((DATEDIFF(DAY, InterestStartDate,  @CurrentDate - 1) + 1)AS DECIMAL(20,4))/ (CAST(@DaysInYear AS DECIMAL(20,4))) as decimal(20,4)) as DefaultInterestTotal
--,InterestDefaultRate
----รอบ 2

------ดอกเบี้ยตามแผน
----, PlannedInterest + InterimInterest  as PlannedInterest
----, PlannedInterestTotal + InterimInterest  as PlannedInterestTotal

----ค้างรับ
--, AccruedInterest + InterimInterest as AccruedInterest
--, AccruedInterestTotal   + InterimInterest as AccruedInterestTotal

----รอบ 3 
--, DebtBalance +  AccruedInterestTotal as DebtBalance 


--from DataDebtorCardMovement cm
--where cm.DebtorCardId= @DataDebtorCardId
--and cm.SeqNo = @SeqCurrent

--=====รอบ 1 Update จำนวนวันที่คิดดอกเบี้ย, ดอกเบี้ยระหว่างเดือน, ดอกเบี้ยผิดนัด, วันที่คิดดอกเบี้ยวันสุดท้าย
Update DataDebtorCardMovement

set InterestQuantity = @InterestQuantity
-- , InterimInterest = cast(PrincipalTotal * (InterestRate/ 100) * cast(@InterestQuantity AS DECIMAL(20,4))/ (CAST(@DaysInYear AS DECIMAL(20,4))) as decimal(20,4))
, DefaultInterest = cast(PrincipalTotal * (InterestDefaultRate/ 100) * cast(@InterestQuantity AS DECIMAL(20,4))/ (CAST(@DaysInYear AS DECIMAL(20,4))) as decimal(20,4))
, InterestEndDate = @CurrentDate
, PlannedInterest = cast(PrincipalTotal * (InterestPlannedRate/ 100) * cast(@InterestQuantity AS DECIMAL(20,4))/ (CAST(@DaysInYear AS DECIMAL(20,4))) as decimal(20,4))

, DFDEndDate = @CurrentDate

--ถ้า @CurrentDate เป็นวันสิ้นเดือน จะ update Type รายการนี้เป็น ปิดงวด/  แต่ถ้าไม่ใช่วันที่สิ้นเดือน Type รายการนี้จะเป็น ยอดคงเหลือ
--ถ้า @CurrentDate เป็นวันสิ้นเดือน จะ update Type รายการนี้เป็น ปิดงวด/  แต่ถ้าไม่ใช่วันที่สิ้นเดือน Type รายการนี้จะเป็น ยอดคงเหลือ
, TypeId = (case when  @CurrentDate = @EndDayOfMonth  then @TypeId 
when  @CurrentDate = @DueDate  then 9 
else TypeId end)

, TypeCode = (case when  @CurrentDate = @EndDayOfMonth  then @TypeCode 
when  @CurrentDate = @DueDate  then '09'
else TypeCode end)

, TypeName = (case when  @CurrentDate = @EndDayOfMonth  then @TypeName 
when  @CurrentDate = @DueDate  then N'ครบกำหนดชำระ' 
else TypeName end)
--, DPD = DPD + 1

, DocDate = case when @IsAdjust = 1 then @AdjustDate else @CurrentDate end
, PayDate = case when @IsAdjust = 1 then @CurrentDate else @DefaultDate end
, IsUpdateHistory = 0


where DataDebtorCardMovement.DebtorCardId= @DataDebtorCardId
and DataDebtorCardMovement.SeqNo = @SeqCurrent;

--====================================================================================

--=====รอบ 2 Update ดอกเบี้ยตามแผน
Update DataDebtorCardMovement
set PlannedInterestTotal = @PlannedInterestTotal + PlannedInterest
, AccruedInterest = PlannedInterest + DefaultInterest
, DefaultInterestTotal = @DefaultInterestTotal+ DefaultInterest
, InterimInterest = DefaultInterest + PlannedInterest


where DataDebtorCardMovement.DebtorCardId= @DataDebtorCardId
and DataDebtorCardMovement.SeqNo = @SeqCurrent;
--====================================================================================
----รอบ 3 Update ดอกเบี้ยค้างรับ

Update DataDebtorCardMovement
set AccruedInterestTotal = PlannedInterestTotal   + DefaultInterestTotal


where DataDebtorCardMovement.DebtorCardId= @DataDebtorCardId
and DataDebtorCardMovement.SeqNo = @SeqCurrent;

--====================================================================================

--รอบ 4 Update ยอดคงเหลือ

Update DataDebtorCardMovement
set DebtBalance = PrincipalTotal + AccruedInterestTotal + CourtFeeTotal + LawyerFeeTotal + OtherExpenseTotal + InitialMarginTotal
--select * from DataDebtorCardMovement
where DataDebtorCardMovement.DebtorCardId= @DataDebtorCardId
and DataDebtorCardMovement.SeqNo = @SeqCurrent;

--====================================================================================
select

 DATEDIFF(DAY, InterestStartDate,  @CurrentDate ) + 1 as InterestQuantity
, cast(PrincipalTotal * (InterestRate/ 100) * cast(@InterestQuantity AS DECIMAL(20,4))/ (CAST(@DaysInYear AS DECIMAL(20,4))) as decimal(20,4)) as InterimInterest
, cast(PrincipalTotal * (InterestDefaultRate/ 100) * cast(@InterestQuantity AS DECIMAL(20,4))/ (CAST(@DaysInYear AS DECIMAL(20,4))) as decimal(20,4)) as DefaultInterest
, DefaultInterestTotal
, DFDEndDate = @CurrentDate
--ดอกเบี้ยตามแผน
, PlannedInterest
, PlannedInterestTotal

--วันที่เริ่มต้น-วิ้นสุด คิดดอกเบี้ย
, InterestStartDate
, cast(@CurrentDate as datetime) as InterestEndDate

--ดอกเบี้ยค้างรับ
, AccruedInterest 
, AccruedInterestTotal

--คงเหลือ
, DebtBalance

--ค้างรับ

into #tmp
from DataDebtorCardMovement
where DataDebtorCardMovement.DebtorCardId= @DataDebtorCardId
and DataDebtorCardMovement.SeqNo = @SeqCurrent;


--=====รอบ 4 update ที่รายการหลัก
Update DataDebtorCard
--==ดอกเบี้ย
set PlannedInterestTotal = (select top 1 PlannedInterestTotal from #tmp)
, DefaultInterestTotal = (select top 1 DefaultInterestTotal from #tmp)
, AccruedInterestTotal = (select top 1 AccruedInterestTotal from #tmp)
, InterestStartDate = (select top 1 InterestStartDate from #tmp)
, InterestEndDate = (select top 1 InterestEndDate from #tmp)


--==ยอดรวมทั้งหมด
, DebtBalance = PrincipalTotal + AccruedInterestTotal + CourtFeeTotal + LawyerFeeTotal + OtherExpenseTotal + InitialMarginTotal

where DataDebtorCardId= @DataDebtorCardId

--=====รอบ 5 update 
Update DataDebtorCard
--==ดอกเบี้ย
set DebtBalance = PrincipalTotal + AccruedInterestTotal + CourtFeeTotal + LawyerFeeTotal + OtherExpenseTotal + InitialMarginTotal

where DataDebtorCardId= @DataDebtorCardId

if(@DFDDate = @CurrentDate)
begin

	Update DataDebtorCardMovement

	set DFDDate = @DFDDate

	where DataDebtorCardMovement.DebtorCardId= @DataDebtorCardId
	and DataDebtorCardMovement.SeqNo = @SeqCurrent;


end

--====================================================================================
--select  * from #tmp

--Update DPD 
EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_022_UpdateDPD]  @CurrentDate, @DataDebtorCardId, @SeqCurrent

--insert DataDebtorCardMovementHistory
EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_036_InsertDataDebtorCardMovementHistory]
end

else if (@CheckDefaultMeasureId != 1)
begin
exec SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay_Horizontal
@CurrentDate
	,@DataDebtorCardId
	,@IsAdjust
	,@AdjustDate

end

END
