-- ============================================================
-- Description:
--   ประมวลผลดอกเบี้ยรายวันแบบ Batch
--
--   1. ถ้า @CurrentDate = NULL ใช้วันที่ปัจจุบัน
--   2. ดึงเฉพาะ Measure IsDefault = 1
--   3. ไม่ประมวลผล CardStatusId = 135
--   4. แบ่งประมวลผลตาม @BatchSize
--   5. PlannedInterest ROUND 2 ก่อนสะสม
--   6. DefaultInterest ROUND 2 ก่อนสะสม
--   7. Update DataDebtorCardMovement
--   8. Update DataDebtorCard
--   9. คำนวณ DPD โดยไม่นับช่วงพักชำระ
--  10. Insert Movement History เฉพาะ Batch
--  11. บันทึก SystemStoredProcedureLog
--
-- ROUND:
--   0.2350 -> 0.24
--   0.2340 -> 0.23
-- ============================================================

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_004_RunUpdateInterestEveryDay]
(
      @CurrentDate DATETIME = NULL
    , @BatchSize INT = 5000
)
AS
BEGIN

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;


    /* =========================================================
       0. Parameter
       ========================================================= */

    IF @CurrentDate IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SET @CurrentDate = GETDATE()-1;
    END;


    IF ISNULL(@BatchSize, 0) <= 0
    BEGIN
        SET @BatchSize = 5000;
    END;


    DECLARE @ProcessDate DATE =
        CAST(@CurrentDate AS DATE);


    DECLARE @DefaultDate DATE =
        CAST('1900-01-01' AS DATE);


    DECLARE @DaysInYear INT =
        DATEDIFF
        (
            DAY,
            DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@ProcessDate), 1, 1),
            DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@ProcessDate), 12, 31)
        ) + 1;


    DECLARE @EndDayOfMonth DATE =
        EOMONTH(@ProcessDate);


    /* =========================================================
       LOG Variable
       ========================================================= */

    DECLARE @StoredProcedureLogId BIGINT;

    DECLARE @StoredProcedureName NVARCHAR(500) =
        N'SP_DCS_Card_004_RunUpdateInterestEveryDay';

    DECLARE @SPStartDateTime DATETIME2(3) =
        SYSDATETIME();

    DECLARE @SPEndDateTime DATETIME2(3);

    DECLARE @ProcessedRows BIGINT = 0;

    DECLARE @CurrentBatchRows INT = 0;

    DECLARE @HistoryRows INT = 0;

    DECLARE @TotalHistoryRows BIGINT = 0;


    /* =========================================================
       Batch Variable
       ========================================================= */

    DECLARE @TotalRecord INT = 0;

    DECLARE @StartRow INT = 1;

    DECLARE @EndRow INT;

    DECLARE @BatchNo INT = 0;

    DECLARE @BatchStartTime DATETIME2(3);

    DECLARE @BatchEndTime DATETIME2(3);


    /* =========================================================
       Payment Type : ปิดงวด
       ========================================================= */

    DECLARE @CloseTypeId INT;

    DECLARE @CloseTypeCode NVARCHAR(2);

    DECLARE @CloseTypeName NVARCHAR(100);


    SELECT TOP 1
          @CloseTypeId = PaymentTypeId
        , @CloseTypeCode = PaymentTypeCode
        , @CloseTypeName = PaymentTypeName
    FROM dbo.SystemPaymentType
    WHERE PaymentTypeId = 3;


    /* =========================================================
       1. หา Card ทั้งหมดที่ต้องประมวลผล
       ========================================================= */

    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #AllCard;


    CREATE TABLE #AllCard
    (
          RowNo INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY
        , DataDebtorCardId NVARCHAR(150) NOT NULL
    );


    INSERT INTO #AllCard
    (
          RowNo
        , DataDebtorCardId
    )
    SELECT
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER
          (
              ORDER BY cd.DataDebtorCardId
          )
        , cd.DataDebtorCardId

    FROM dbo.DataDebtorCard cd

    INNER JOIN dbo.SystemMeasureMaster m
        ON m.MeasureId = cd.MeasureId

    WHERE ISNULL(m.IsDefault, 0) = 1
      AND ISNULL(m.IsReceivership, 0) = 0
      AND ISNULL(cd.CardStatusId, 0) <> 135;


    SELECT
        @TotalRecord = COUNT(*)
    FROM #AllCard;


    /* =========================================================
       2. INSERT LOG : RUNNING
       ========================================================= */

    INSERT INTO dbo.SystemStoredProcedureLog
    (
          StoredProcedureName
        , ProcessDate
        , StartDateTime
        , Status
        , Detail
        , TotalRows
        , ProcessedRows
        , BatchNo
        , BatchSize
        , WorkerNo
        , WorkerCount
        , HostName
        , LoginName
        , ApplicationName
    )
    VALUES
    (
          @StoredProcedureName
        , @ProcessDate
        , @SPStartDateTime
        , 'RUNNING'

        , CONCAT
          (
                N'เริ่มประมวลผลดอกเบี้ยรายวัน'
              , N' | TotalRows = ', @TotalRecord
              , N' | BatchSize = ', @BatchSize
              , N' | InterestRound = 2'
          )

        , @TotalRecord
        , 0
        , 0
        , @BatchSize
        , NULL
        , NULL
        , HOST_NAME()
        , ORIGINAL_LOGIN()
        , APP_NAME()
    );


    SET @StoredProcedureLogId =
        SCOPE_IDENTITY();


    PRINT '============================================================';
    PRINT 'SP_DCS_Card_004_RunUpdateInterestEveryDay';
    PRINT 'Process Date : ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), @ProcessDate, 120);
    PRINT 'Total Record : ' + CAST(@TotalRecord AS VARCHAR(30));
    PRINT 'Batch Size   : ' + CAST(@BatchSize AS VARCHAR(30));
    PRINT 'ROUND        : 2 Decimal';
    PRINT 'Log ID       : ' + CAST(@StoredProcedureLogId AS VARCHAR(30));
    PRINT '============================================================';


    /* =========================================================
       ไม่มีข้อมูล
       ========================================================= */

    IF @TotalRecord = 0
    BEGIN

        SET @SPEndDateTime =
            SYSDATETIME();


        UPDATE dbo.SystemStoredProcedureLog

        SET
              EndDateTime = @SPEndDateTime

            , DurationSeconds =
                CAST
                (
                    DATEDIFF_BIG
                    (
                        MILLISECOND,
                        @SPStartDateTime,
                        @SPEndDateTime
                    ) / 1000.0
                    AS DECIMAL(18,3)
                )

            , DurationMinutes =
                CAST
                (
                    DATEDIFF_BIG
                    (
                        MILLISECOND,
                        @SPStartDateTime,
                        @SPEndDateTime
                    ) / 60000.0
                    AS DECIMAL(18,2)
                )

            , Status = 'SUCCESS'

            , Detail =
                N'ไม่พบข้อมูลที่ต้องประมวลผล'

            , ProcessedRows = 0

            , BatchNo = 0

        WHERE StoredProcedureLogId =
              @StoredProcedureLogId;


        SELECT
              @ProcessDate AS ProcessDate
            , @StoredProcedureLogId AS StoredProcedureLogId
            , 0 AS TotalRecord
            , 0 AS ProcessedRows
            , 0 AS TotalBatch
            , N'SUCCESS' AS Status;


        RETURN;

    END;


    /* =========================================================
       3. Batch Loop
       ========================================================= */

    WHILE @StartRow <= @TotalRecord
    BEGIN

        SET @BatchNo =
            @BatchNo + 1;


        SET @EndRow =
            @StartRow + @BatchSize - 1;


        SET @BatchStartTime =
            SYSDATETIME();


        SET @CurrentBatchRows = 0;

        SET @HistoryRows = 0;


        PRINT '------------------------------------------------------------';
        PRINT 'Batch : ' + CAST(@BatchNo AS VARCHAR(20));

        PRINT
            'Row   : '
            + CAST(@StartRow AS VARCHAR(20))
            + ' - '
            + CAST
              (
                  CASE

                      WHEN @EndRow > @TotalRecord
                          THEN @TotalRecord

                      ELSE @EndRow

                  END
                  AS VARCHAR(20)
              );


        BEGIN TRY

            BEGIN TRANSACTION;


            /* =================================================
               4. เตรียม Card ใน Batch
               ================================================= */

            DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #BatchCard;


            CREATE TABLE #BatchCard
            (
                  DataDebtorCardId NVARCHAR(150) NOT NULL

                , SeqCurrent INT NOT NULL

                , InterestRate DECIMAL(20,4) NOT NULL

                , InterestPlannedRate DECIMAL(20,4) NOT NULL

                , InterestDefaultRate DECIMAL(20,4) NOT NULL

                , ClaimPayDate DATE NULL

                , DFDDate DATE NULL

                , DFDProcessDate DATE NULL

                , DueDate DATE NULL

                , InterestStartDate DATE NULL

                , InterestQuantity INT NOT NULL

                , PreviousPlannedInterestTotal
                    DECIMAL(20,4) NOT NULL

                , PreviousDefaultInterestTotal
                    DECIMAL(20,4) NOT NULL

                , PreviousAccruedInterestTotal
                    DECIMAL(20,4) NOT NULL

                , MovementStartDate DATE NULL

                , MovementEndDate DATE NULL

                , MovementCalculateStartDate DATE NULL

                , PRIMARY KEY
                  (
                      DataDebtorCardId,
                      SeqCurrent
                  )
            );


            INSERT INTO #BatchCard
            (
                  DataDebtorCardId
                , SeqCurrent

                , InterestRate
                , InterestPlannedRate
                , InterestDefaultRate

                , ClaimPayDate

                , DFDDate
                , DFDProcessDate

                , DueDate

                , InterestStartDate
                , InterestQuantity

                , PreviousPlannedInterestTotal
                , PreviousDefaultInterestTotal
                , PreviousAccruedInterestTotal

                , MovementStartDate
                , MovementEndDate
                , MovementCalculateStartDate
            )

            SELECT
                  cd.DataDebtorCardId

                , cd.SeqCurrent

                , ISNULL(cd.InterestRate, 0)

                , ISNULL(cd.InterestPlannedRate, 0)

                , ISNULL(cd.InterestDefaultRate, 0)

                , CAST(cd.ClaimPayDate AS DATE)

                , CAST(cd.DFDDate AS DATE)

                , DATEADD
                  (
                      DAY,
                      1,
                      CAST(cd.DFDDate AS DATE)
                  )

                , DATEADD
                  (
                      DAY,
                      29,
                      CAST(cd.ClaimPayDate AS DATE)
                  )

                , CAST(cur.InterestStartDate AS DATE)


                /* InterestQuantity */
                , CASE

                    WHEN cur.InterestStartDate IS NULL
                        THEN 0

                    WHEN CAST(cur.InterestStartDate AS DATE)
                         > @ProcessDate
                        THEN 0

                    ELSE

                        DATEDIFF
                        (
                            DAY,
                            CAST(cur.InterestStartDate AS DATE),
                            @ProcessDate
                        ) + 1

                  END


                /* Previous Total */
                , ISNULL
                  (
                      prev.PlannedInterestTotal,
                      0
                  )

                , ISNULL
                  (
                      prev.DefaultInterestTotal,
                      0
                  )

                , ISNULL
                  (
                      prev.AccruedInterestTotal,
                      0
                  )


                /* Movement Start */
                , CAST(cur.DFDStartDate AS DATE)


                /* Movement End */
                , @ProcessDate


                /* Movement Calculate Start */
                , CASE

                    WHEN CAST(cur.DFDStartDate AS DATE)
                         <
                         CAST(cd.DFDDate AS DATE)

                        THEN CAST(cd.DFDDate AS DATE)

                    ELSE
                        CAST(cur.DFDStartDate AS DATE)

                  END


            FROM #AllCard a

            INNER JOIN dbo.DataDebtorCard cd
                ON cd.DataDebtorCardId =
                   a.DataDebtorCardId

            INNER JOIN dbo.SystemMeasureMaster m
                ON m.MeasureId =
                   cd.MeasureId

               AND ISNULL(m.IsDefault, 0) = 1

               AND ISNULL(m.IsReceivership, 0) = 0

            INNER JOIN dbo.DataDebtorCardMovement cur
                ON cur.DebtorCardId =
                   cd.DataDebtorCardId

               AND cur.SeqNo =
                   cd.SeqCurrent

            LEFT JOIN dbo.DataDebtorCardMovement prev
                ON prev.DebtorCardId =
                   cd.DataDebtorCardId

               AND prev.SeqNo =
                   cd.SeqCurrent - 1

            WHERE a.RowNo
                  BETWEEN @StartRow AND @EndRow

              AND ISNULL(cd.CardStatusId, 0) <> 135;


            SELECT
                @CurrentBatchRows = COUNT(*)
            FROM #BatchCard;


            /* =================================================
               5. คำนวณดอกเบี้ย

               คำนวณ -> ROUND 2 -> บันทึก
               0.2350 -> 0.24
               ================================================= */

            UPDATE cm

            SET

                cm.InterestQuantity =
                    b.InterestQuantity,


                /* Planned Interest */
                cm.PlannedInterest =

                    CAST
                    (
                        ROUND
                        (
                            ISNULL(cm.PrincipalTotal, 0)

                            *

                            (
                                ISNULL
                                (
                                    b.InterestPlannedRate,
                                    0
                                ) / 100.0
                            )

                            *

                            CAST
                            (
                                b.InterestQuantity
                                AS DECIMAL(20,4)
                            )

                            /

                            CAST
                            (
                                @DaysInYear
                                AS DECIMAL(20,4)
                            ),

                            2
                        )

                        AS DECIMAL(20,4)
                    ),


                /* Default Interest */
                cm.DefaultInterest =

                    CAST
                    (
                        ROUND
                        (
                            ISNULL(cm.PrincipalTotal, 0)

                            *

                            (
                                ISNULL
                                (
                                    b.InterestDefaultRate,
                                    0
                                ) / 100.0
                            )

                            *

                            CAST
                            (
                                b.InterestQuantity
                                AS DECIMAL(20,4)
                            )

                            /

                            CAST
                            (
                                @DaysInYear
                                AS DECIMAL(20,4)
                            ),

                            2
                        )

                        AS DECIMAL(20,4)
                    ),


                cm.InterestEndDate =
                    @ProcessDate,


                cm.DFDEndDate =
                    @ProcessDate,


                /* Type */
                cm.TypeId =

                    CASE

                        WHEN @ProcessDate =
                             @EndDayOfMonth

                            THEN @CloseTypeId

                        WHEN @ProcessDate =
                             b.DueDate

                            THEN 9

                        ELSE cm.TypeId

                    END,


                cm.TypeCode =

                    CASE

                        WHEN @ProcessDate =
                             @EndDayOfMonth

                            THEN @CloseTypeCode

                        WHEN @ProcessDate =
                             b.DueDate

                            THEN '09'

                        ELSE cm.TypeCode

                    END,


                cm.TypeName =

                    CASE

                        WHEN @ProcessDate =
                             @EndDayOfMonth

                            THEN @CloseTypeName

                        WHEN @ProcessDate =
                             b.DueDate

                            THEN N'ครบกำหนดชำระ'

                        ELSE cm.TypeName

                    END,


                /* Job รายวัน ใช้ ProcessDate */
                cm.DocDate =
                    @ProcessDate,


                cm.PayDate =
                    @DefaultDate,


                cm.IsUpdateHistory =
                    0


            FROM dbo.DataDebtorCardMovement cm

            INNER JOIN #BatchCard b
                ON b.DataDebtorCardId =
                   cm.DebtorCardId

               AND b.SeqCurrent =
                   cm.SeqNo;


            /* =================================================
               6. ยอดสะสม

               ใช้ดอกเบี้ยที่ ROUND 2 แล้ว
               ================================================= */

            UPDATE cm

            SET

                cm.PlannedInterestTotal =

                    ISNULL
                    (
                        b.PreviousPlannedInterestTotal,
                        0
                    )

                    +

                    ISNULL
                    (
                        cm.PlannedInterest,
                        0
                    ),


                cm.DefaultInterestTotal =

                    ISNULL
                    (
                        b.PreviousDefaultInterestTotal,
                        0
                    )

                    +

                    ISNULL
                    (
                        cm.DefaultInterest,
                        0
                    ),


                cm.AccruedInterest =

                    ISNULL
                    (
                        cm.PlannedInterest,
                        0
                    )

                    +

                    ISNULL
                    (
                        cm.DefaultInterest,
                        0
                    ),


                cm.InterimInterest =

                    ISNULL
                    (
                        cm.DefaultInterest,
                        0
                    )

                    +

                    ISNULL
                    (
                        cm.PlannedInterest,
                        0
                    )


            FROM dbo.DataDebtorCardMovement cm

            INNER JOIN #BatchCard b
                ON b.DataDebtorCardId =
                   cm.DebtorCardId

               AND b.SeqCurrent =
                   cm.SeqNo;


            /* =================================================
               7. AccruedInterestTotal
               ================================================= */

            UPDATE cm

            SET

                cm.AccruedInterestTotal =

                    ISNULL
                    (
                        cm.PlannedInterestTotal,
                        0
                    )

                    +

                    ISNULL
                    (
                        cm.DefaultInterestTotal,
                        0
                    )


            FROM dbo.DataDebtorCardMovement cm

            INNER JOIN #BatchCard b
                ON b.DataDebtorCardId =
                   cm.DebtorCardId

               AND b.SeqCurrent =
                   cm.SeqNo;


            /* =================================================
               8. DebtBalance Movement
               ================================================= */

            UPDATE cm

            SET

                cm.DebtBalance =

                    ISNULL(cm.PrincipalTotal, 0)

                    +

                    ISNULL
                    (
                        cm.AccruedInterestTotal,
                        0
                    )

                    +

                    ISNULL(cm.CourtFeeTotal, 0)

                    +

                    ISNULL(cm.LawyerFeeTotal, 0)

                    +

                    ISNULL(cm.OtherExpenseTotal, 0)

                    +

                    ISNULL(cm.InitialMarginTotal, 0)


            FROM dbo.DataDebtorCardMovement cm

            INNER JOIN #BatchCard b
                ON b.DataDebtorCardId =
                   cm.DebtorCardId

               AND b.SeqCurrent =
                   cm.SeqNo;


            /* =================================================
               9. UPDATE DataDebtorCard
               ================================================= */

            UPDATE cd

            SET

                cd.PlannedInterestTotal =
                    ISNULL
                    (
                        cm.PlannedInterestTotal,
                        0
                    ),


                cd.DefaultInterestTotal =
                    ISNULL
                    (
                        cm.DefaultInterestTotal,
                        0
                    ),


                cd.AccruedInterestTotal =
                    ISNULL
                    (
                        cm.AccruedInterestTotal,
                        0
                    ),


                cd.InterestStartDate =
                    cm.InterestStartDate,


                cd.InterestEndDate =
                    cm.InterestEndDate,


                cd.DebtBalance =

                    ISNULL(cd.PrincipalTotal, 0)

                    +

                    ISNULL
                    (
                        cm.AccruedInterestTotal,
                        0
                    )

                    +

                    ISNULL(cd.CourtFeeTotal, 0)

                    +

                    ISNULL(cd.LawyerFeeTotal, 0)

                    +

                    ISNULL(cd.OtherExpenseTotal, 0)

                    +

                    ISNULL(cd.InitialMarginTotal, 0)


            FROM dbo.DataDebtorCard cd

            INNER JOIN #BatchCard b
                ON b.DataDebtorCardId =
                   cd.DataDebtorCardId

            INNER JOIN dbo.DataDebtorCardMovement cm
                ON cm.DebtorCardId =
                   cd.DataDebtorCardId

               AND cm.SeqNo =
                   b.SeqCurrent;


            /* =================================================
               10. UPDATE DFDDate
               ================================================= */

            UPDATE cm

            SET
                cm.DFDDate =
                    b.DFDProcessDate

            FROM dbo.DataDebtorCardMovement cm

            INNER JOIN #BatchCard b
                ON b.DataDebtorCardId =
                   cm.DebtorCardId

               AND b.SeqCurrent =
                   cm.SeqNo

            WHERE b.DFDProcessDate =
                  @ProcessDate;


            /* =================================================
               11. ช่วงพักชำระ
               ================================================= */

            DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #SuspendPeriods;


            CREATE TABLE #SuspendPeriods
            (
                  DataDebtorCardId NVARCHAR(150) NOT NULL
                , SuspendStartDate DATE NOT NULL
                , SuspendEndDate DATE NOT NULL
            );


            ;WITH SuspendRaw AS
            (
                SELECT
                      b.DataDebtorCardId
                    , CAST(p.StartDate AS DATE)
                        AS SuspendStartDate
                    , CAST(p.EndDate AS DATE)
                        AS SuspendEndDate

                FROM #BatchCard b

                INNER JOIN
                    dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment p

                    ON p.DataDebtorCardId =
                       b.DataDebtorCardId

                WHERE p.IsSuspend = 1
                  AND p.IsActive = 1
                  AND p.StartDate IS NOT NULL
                  AND p.EndDate IS NOT NULL

                  AND CAST(p.StartDate AS DATE)
                      <= CAST(p.EndDate AS DATE)

                  AND CAST(p.StartDate AS DATE)
                      <= @ProcessDate

                  AND CAST(p.EndDate AS DATE)
                      >= b.DFDDate
            ),

            SuspendOrdered AS
            (
                SELECT
                      sr.DataDebtorCardId
                    , sr.SuspendStartDate
                    , sr.SuspendEndDate

                    , MAX(sr.SuspendEndDate) OVER
                      (
                          PARTITION BY
                              sr.DataDebtorCardId

                          ORDER BY
                              sr.SuspendStartDate,
                              sr.SuspendEndDate

                          ROWS BETWEEN
                              UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
                              AND 1 PRECEDING
                      )
                      AS PreviousMaxEndDate

                FROM SuspendRaw sr
            ),

            SuspendGrouped AS
            (
                SELECT
                      so.DataDebtorCardId
                    , so.SuspendStartDate
                    , so.SuspendEndDate

                    , SUM
                      (
                          CASE

                              WHEN
                                  so.PreviousMaxEndDate IS NULL

                                  OR

                                  so.SuspendStartDate
                                  >
                                  so.PreviousMaxEndDate

                                  THEN 1

                              ELSE 0

                          END
                      )
                      OVER
                      (
                          PARTITION BY
                              so.DataDebtorCardId

                          ORDER BY
                              so.SuspendStartDate,
                              so.SuspendEndDate

                          ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
                      )
                      AS GroupNo

                FROM SuspendOrdered so
            )


            INSERT INTO #SuspendPeriods
            (
                  DataDebtorCardId
                , SuspendStartDate
                , SuspendEndDate
            )

            SELECT
                  DataDebtorCardId
                , MIN(SuspendStartDate)
                , MAX(SuspendEndDate)

            FROM SuspendGrouped

            GROUP BY
                  DataDebtorCardId
                , GroupNo;


            /* =================================================
               12. DPD Result
               ================================================= */

            DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #DPDResult;


            CREATE TABLE #DPDResult
            (
                  DataDebtorCardId NVARCHAR(150) NOT NULL
                , SeqCurrent INT NOT NULL
                , DPD INT NOT NULL
                , DPDAccumulate INT NOT NULL

                , PRIMARY KEY
                  (
                      DataDebtorCardId,
                      SeqCurrent
                  )
            );


            ;WITH CardSuspend AS
            (
                SELECT

                      b.DataDebtorCardId

                    , SUM
                      (
                          CASE

                              WHEN
                                  sp.SuspendStartDate
                                  <= @ProcessDate

                                  AND

                                  sp.SuspendEndDate
                                  >= b.DFDDate

                              THEN

                                  DATEDIFF
                                  (
                                      DAY,

                                      CASE

                                          WHEN
                                              sp.SuspendStartDate
                                              < b.DFDDate

                                              THEN b.DFDDate

                                          ELSE
                                              sp.SuspendStartDate

                                      END,

                                      CASE

                                          WHEN
                                              sp.SuspendEndDate
                                              > @ProcessDate

                                              THEN @ProcessDate

                                          ELSE
                                              sp.SuspendEndDate

                                      END

                                  ) + 1

                              ELSE 0

                          END
                      )
                      AS SuspendDays

                FROM #BatchCard b

                LEFT JOIN #SuspendPeriods sp
                    ON sp.DataDebtorCardId =
                       b.DataDebtorCardId

                GROUP BY
                    b.DataDebtorCardId
            ),

            MovementSuspend AS
            (
                SELECT

                      b.DataDebtorCardId
                    , b.SeqCurrent

                    , SUM
                      (
                          CASE

                              WHEN
                                  sp.SuspendStartDate
                                  <= b.MovementEndDate

                                  AND

                                  sp.SuspendEndDate
                                  >= b.MovementCalculateStartDate

                              THEN

                                  DATEDIFF
                                  (
                                      DAY,

                                      CASE

                                          WHEN
                                              sp.SuspendStartDate
                                              <
                                              b.MovementCalculateStartDate

                                              THEN
                                                  b.MovementCalculateStartDate

                                          ELSE
                                              sp.SuspendStartDate

                                      END,

                                      CASE

                                          WHEN
                                              sp.SuspendEndDate
                                              >
                                              b.MovementEndDate

                                              THEN
                                                  b.MovementEndDate

                                          ELSE
                                              sp.SuspendEndDate

                                      END

                                  ) + 1

                              ELSE 0

                          END
                      )
                      AS SuspendDays

                FROM #BatchCard b

                LEFT JOIN #SuspendPeriods sp
                    ON sp.DataDebtorCardId =
                       b.DataDebtorCardId

                GROUP BY
                      b.DataDebtorCardId
                    , b.SeqCurrent
            )


            INSERT INTO #DPDResult
            (
                  DataDebtorCardId
                , SeqCurrent
                , DPD
                , DPDAccumulate
            )

            SELECT

                  b.DataDebtorCardId
                , b.SeqCurrent


                /* Movement DPD */
                , CASE

                    WHEN
                    (
                        DATEDIFF
                        (
                            DAY,
                            b.MovementCalculateStartDate,
                            b.MovementEndDate
                        )
                        + 1
                        -
                        ISNULL(ms.SuspendDays, 0)
                    ) < 0

                        THEN 0

                    ELSE

                        DATEDIFF
                        (
                            DAY,
                            b.MovementCalculateStartDate,
                            b.MovementEndDate
                        )
                        + 1
                        -
                        ISNULL(ms.SuspendDays, 0)

                  END


                /* DPD Accumulate */
                , CASE

                    WHEN
                    (
                        DATEDIFF
                        (
                            DAY,
                            b.DFDDate,
                            @ProcessDate
                        )
                        + 1
                        -
                        ISNULL(cs.SuspendDays, 0)
                    ) < 0

                        THEN 0

                    ELSE

                        DATEDIFF
                        (
                            DAY,
                            b.DFDDate,
                            @ProcessDate
                        )
                        + 1
                        -
                        ISNULL(cs.SuspendDays, 0)

                  END


            FROM #BatchCard b

            LEFT JOIN CardSuspend cs
                ON cs.DataDebtorCardId =
                   b.DataDebtorCardId

            LEFT JOIN MovementSuspend ms
                ON ms.DataDebtorCardId =
                   b.DataDebtorCardId

               AND ms.SeqCurrent =
                   b.SeqCurrent

            WHERE b.DFDDate IS NOT NULL

              AND b.DFDDate <>
                  CAST('1900-01-01' AS DATE)

              AND @ProcessDate >=
                  b.DFDDate

              AND b.MovementCalculateStartDate
                  IS NOT NULL

              AND b.MovementEndDate >=
                  b.MovementCalculateStartDate;


            /* =================================================
               13. UPDATE Movement DPD
               ================================================= */

            UPDATE cm

            SET
                  cm.DPD =
                      d.DPD

                , cm.DPDAccumulate =
                      d.DPDAccumulate

            FROM dbo.DataDebtorCardMovement cm

            INNER JOIN #DPDResult d
                ON d.DataDebtorCardId =
                   cm.DebtorCardId

               AND d.SeqCurrent =
                   cm.SeqNo;


            /* =================================================
               14. UPDATE Card DPD
               ================================================= */

            UPDATE cd

            SET
                cd.DPD =
                    d.DPDAccumulate

            FROM dbo.DataDebtorCard cd

            INNER JOIN #DPDResult d
                ON d.DataDebtorCardId =
                   cd.DataDebtorCardId;


            /* =================================================
               15. INSERT MOVEMENT HISTORY
               ================================================= */

            INSERT INTO dbo.DataDebtorCardMovementHistory
            (
                  DebtorCardMovementHistoryId
                , DebtorCardMovementId
                , DebtorCardId
                , DocDate
                , PayDate
                , LGNo
                , DebtorId
                , DebtorCode
                , DebtorCardCode
                , DebtorCardName
                , TypeId
                , TypeCode
                , TypeName
                , FlagAutoPay
                , DFDDate
                , DFDStartDate
                , DFDEndDate
                , DPD
                , TotalPay
                , IsAdjust
                , AdjustRefDocNo
                , IsDelete
                , CampaignId
                , CampaignCode
                , CampaignName
                , InterestRate
                , InterestPlannedRate
                , InterestDefaultRate
                , DebtBalance
                , ReceivePayment
                , Installment
                , InstallmentPay
                , InstallmentTotal
                , Principal
                , PrincipalPay
                , PrincipalTotal
                , InterimInterest
                , AccruedInterest
                , AccruedInterestPay
                , AccruedInterestTotal
                , CourtFee
                , CourtFeePay
                , CourtFeeTotal
                , LawyerFee
                , LawyerFeePay
                , LawyerFeeTotal
                , OtherExpense
                , OtherExpensePay
                , OtherExpenseTotal
                , InitialMargin
                , InitialMarginPay
                , InitialMarginTotal
                , SuspendInt
                , SuspendIntPay
                , SuspendIntTotal
                , DeferredInterest
                , DeferredInterestPay
                , DeferredInterestTotal
                , SuspendedDefaultInterest
                , SuspendedDefaultInterestPay
                , SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal
                , PlannedInterest
                , PlannedInterestPay
                , PlannedInterestTotal
                , DefaultInterest
                , DefaultInterestPay
                , DefaultInterestTotal
                , CreateBy
                , CreateDate
                , UpdateBy
                , UpdateDate
                , ReceiptNo
                , IsEstatement
                , EStatementRef
                , PaymentTypeId
                , SeqNo
                , DebtorPaymentId
                , DebtorPaymentCode
                , CompromiseContractGroup
                , ReceiptId
                , InstallmentPrincipal
                , InstallmentPrincipalPay
                , InstallmentPrincipalTotal
                , InstallmentInterest
                , InstallmentInterestPay
                , InstallmentInterestTotal
                , InterestStartDate
                , InterestEndDate
                , InterestQuantity
                , DPDAccumulate
                , OverdueAmount
                , PrincipalOverdueAmount
                , AccruedInterestOverdueAmount
                , TotalOverdue
                , TotalPrincipalOverdue
                , TotalAccruedInterestOverdue
                , CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId
            )

            SELECT

                  NEWID()

                , cm.DebtorCardMovementId
                , cm.DebtorCardId
                , cm.DocDate
                , cm.PayDate
                , cm.LGNo
                , cm.DebtorId
                , cm.DebtorCode
                , cm.DebtorCardCode
                , cm.DebtorCardName
                , cm.TypeId
                , cm.TypeCode
                , cm.TypeName
                , cm.FlagAutoPay
                , cm.DFDDate
                , cm.DFDStartDate
                , cm.DFDEndDate
                , cm.DPD
                , cm.TotalPay
                , cm.IsAdjust
                , cm.AdjustRefDocNo
                , cm.IsDelete

                /* Mapping เดิมจาก SP_DCS_036 */
                , cm.MeasureId
                , cm.MeasureCode
                , cm.MeasureName

                , cm.InterestRate
                , cm.InterestPlannedRate
                , cm.InterestDefaultRate
                , cm.DebtBalance
                , cm.ReceivePayment
                , cm.Installment
                , cm.InstallmentPay
                , cm.InstallmentTotal
                , cm.Principal
                , cm.PrincipalPay
                , cm.PrincipalTotal
                , cm.InterimInterest
                , cm.AccruedInterest
                , cm.AccruedInterestPay
                , cm.AccruedInterestTotal
                , cm.CourtFee
                , cm.CourtFeePay
                , cm.CourtFeeTotal
                , cm.LawyerFee
                , cm.LawyerFeePay
                , cm.LawyerFeeTotal
                , cm.OtherExpense
                , cm.OtherExpensePay
                , cm.OtherExpenseTotal
                , cm.InitialMargin
                , cm.InitialMarginPay
                , cm.InitialMarginTotal
                , cm.SuspendInt
                , cm.SuspendIntPay
                , cm.SuspendIntTotal
                , cm.DeferredInterest
                , cm.DeferredInterestPay
                , cm.DeferredInterestTotal
                , cm.SuspendedDefaultInterest
                , cm.SuspendedDefaultInterestPay
                , cm.SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal
                , cm.PlannedInterest
                , cm.PlannedInterestPay
                , cm.PlannedInterestTotal
                , cm.DefaultInterest
                , cm.DefaultInterestPay
                , cm.DefaultInterestTotal
                , cm.CreateBy
                , GETDATE()
                , cm.UpdateBy
                , GETDATE()
                , cm.ReceiptNo
                , cm.IsEstatement
                , cm.EStatementRef
                , cm.PaymentTypeId
                , cm.SeqNo
                , cm.DebtorPaymentId
                , cm.DebtorPaymentCode
                , cm.CompromiseContractGroup
                , cm.ReceiptId
                , cm.InstallmentPrincipal
                , cm.InstallmentPrincipalPay
                , cm.InstallmentPrincipalTotal
                , cm.InstallmentInterest
                , cm.InstallmentInterestPay
                , cm.InstallmentInterestTotal
                , cm.InterestStartDate
                , cm.InterestEndDate
                , cm.InterestQuantity
                , cm.DPDAccumulate
                , cm.OverdueAmount
                , cm.PrincipalOverdueAmount
                , cm.AccruedInterestOverdueAmount
                , cm.TotalOverdue
                , cm.TotalPrincipalOverdue
                , cm.TotalAccruedInterestOverdue
                , cm.CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId

            FROM dbo.DataDebtorCardMovement cm

            INNER JOIN #BatchCard b
                ON b.DataDebtorCardId =
                   cm.DebtorCardId

               AND b.SeqCurrent =
                   cm.SeqNo

            WHERE ISNULL(cm.IsUpdateHistory, 0) = 0;


            SET @HistoryRows =
                @@ROWCOUNT;


            /* =================================================
               16. UPDATE HISTORY FLAG
               ================================================= */

            UPDATE cm

            SET
                cm.IsUpdateHistory = 1

            FROM dbo.DataDebtorCardMovement cm

            INNER JOIN #BatchCard b
                ON b.DataDebtorCardId =
                   cm.DebtorCardId

               AND b.SeqCurrent =
                   cm.SeqNo

            WHERE ISNULL(cm.IsUpdateHistory, 0) = 0;


            /* =================================================
               17. COMMIT BATCH
               ================================================= */

            COMMIT TRANSACTION;


            /* =================================================
               18. Update Progress
               ================================================= */

            SET @ProcessedRows =
                @ProcessedRows
                + ISNULL(@CurrentBatchRows, 0);


            SET @TotalHistoryRows =
                @TotalHistoryRows
                + ISNULL(@HistoryRows, 0);


            SET @BatchEndTime =
                SYSDATETIME();


            UPDATE dbo.SystemStoredProcedureLog

            SET
                  ProcessedRows =
                      @ProcessedRows

                , BatchNo =
                      @BatchNo

                , Detail =
                    CONCAT
                    (
                          N'กำลังประมวลผลดอกเบี้ยรายวัน'

                        , N' | Batch = ',
                          @BatchNo

                        , N' | BatchRows = ',
                          @CurrentBatchRows

                        , N' | ProcessedRows = ',
                          @ProcessedRows

                        , N' / ',
                          @TotalRecord

                        , N' | HistoryRows = ',
                          @HistoryRows

                        , N' | TotalHistoryRows = ',
                          @TotalHistoryRows

                        , N' | InterestRound = 2'

                        , N' | BatchTime = ',

                          CAST
                          (
                              DATEDIFF_BIG
                              (
                                  MILLISECOND,
                                  @BatchStartTime,
                                  @BatchEndTime
                              ) / 1000.0

                              AS DECIMAL(18,3)
                          )

                        , N' sec'
                    )

            WHERE StoredProcedureLogId =
                  @StoredProcedureLogId;


            PRINT
                'Batch '
                + CAST(@BatchNo AS VARCHAR(20))
                + ' Success'
                + ' | BatchRows = '
                + CAST(@CurrentBatchRows AS VARCHAR(20))
                + ' | Processed = '
                + CAST(@ProcessedRows AS VARCHAR(30))
                + '/'
                + CAST(@TotalRecord AS VARCHAR(30))
                + ' | History = '
                + CAST(@HistoryRows AS VARCHAR(20));


        END TRY


        BEGIN CATCH

            /* =================================================
               ERROR
               ================================================= */

            IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
                ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;


            DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX) =
                ERROR_MESSAGE();

            DECLARE @ErrorNumber INT =
                ERROR_NUMBER();

            DECLARE @ErrorSeverity INT =
                ERROR_SEVERITY();

            DECLARE @ErrorState INT =
                ERROR_STATE();

            DECLARE @ErrorLine INT =
                ERROR_LINE();

            DECLARE @ErrorProcedure NVARCHAR(500) =
                ERROR_PROCEDURE();


            SET @SPEndDateTime =
                SYSDATETIME();


            UPDATE dbo.SystemStoredProcedureLog

            SET
                  EndDateTime =
                      @SPEndDateTime

                , DurationSeconds =
                    CAST
                    (
                        DATEDIFF_BIG
                        (
                            MILLISECOND,
                            @SPStartDateTime,
                            @SPEndDateTime
                        ) / 1000.0

                        AS DECIMAL(18,3)
                    )

                , DurationMinutes =
                    CAST
                    (
                        DATEDIFF_BIG
                        (
                            MILLISECOND,
                            @SPStartDateTime,
                            @SPEndDateTime
                        ) / 60000.0

                        AS DECIMAL(18,2)
                    )

                , Status =
                    'ERROR'

                , Detail =
                    CONCAT
                    (
                          N'ประมวลผลดอกเบี้ยรายวันไม่สำเร็จ'

                        , N' | Batch = ',
                          @BatchNo

                        , N' | BatchRows = ',
                          @CurrentBatchRows

                        , N' | ProcessedRows = ',
                          @ProcessedRows

                        , N' / ',
                          @TotalRecord

                        , N' | TotalHistoryRows = ',
                          @TotalHistoryRows
                    )

                , ErrorNumber =
                    @ErrorNumber

                , ErrorSeverity =
                    @ErrorSeverity

                , ErrorState =
                    @ErrorState

                , ErrorLine =
                    @ErrorLine

                , ErrorProcedure =
                    @ErrorProcedure

                , ErrorMessage =
                    @ErrorMessage

                , ProcessedRows =
                    @ProcessedRows

                , BatchNo =
                    @BatchNo

            WHERE StoredProcedureLogId =
                  @StoredProcedureLogId;


            PRINT '============================================================';
            PRINT 'ERROR';
            PRINT 'Log ID         : ' + CAST(@StoredProcedureLogId AS VARCHAR(30));
            PRINT 'Batch          : ' + CAST(@BatchNo AS VARCHAR(20));
            PRINT 'Processed Rows : ' + CAST(@ProcessedRows AS VARCHAR(30));
            PRINT 'Total Rows     : ' + CAST(@TotalRecord AS VARCHAR(30));
            PRINT 'Error Number   : ' + CAST(@ErrorNumber AS VARCHAR(20));
            PRINT 'Error Severity : ' + CAST(@ErrorSeverity AS VARCHAR(20));
            PRINT 'Error State    : ' + CAST(@ErrorState AS VARCHAR(20));
            PRINT 'Error Line     : ' + CAST(@ErrorLine AS VARCHAR(20));
            PRINT 'Procedure      : ' + ISNULL(@ErrorProcedure, '');
            PRINT 'Message        : ' + ISNULL(@ErrorMessage, '');
            PRINT '============================================================';


            THROW;

        END CATCH;


        SET @StartRow =
            @EndRow + 1;

    END;


    /* =========================================================
       19. SUCCESS
       ========================================================= */

    SET @SPEndDateTime =
        SYSDATETIME();


    UPDATE dbo.SystemStoredProcedureLog

    SET
          EndDateTime =
              @SPEndDateTime

        , DurationSeconds =
            CAST
            (
                DATEDIFF_BIG
                (
                    MILLISECOND,
                    @SPStartDateTime,
                    @SPEndDateTime
                ) / 1000.0

                AS DECIMAL(18,3)
            )

        , DurationMinutes =
            CAST
            (
                DATEDIFF_BIG
                (
                    MILLISECOND,
                    @SPStartDateTime,
                    @SPEndDateTime
                ) / 60000.0

                AS DECIMAL(18,2)
            )

        , Status =
            'SUCCESS'

        , Detail =
            CONCAT
            (
                  N'ประมวลผลดอกเบี้ยรายวันสำเร็จ'

                , N' | TotalRows = ',
                  @TotalRecord

                , N' | ProcessedRows = ',
                  @ProcessedRows

                , N' | TotalBatch = ',
                  @BatchNo

                , N' | BatchSize = ',
                  @BatchSize

                , N' | InterestRound = 2'

                , N' | TotalHistoryRows = ',
                  @TotalHistoryRows
            )

        , ProcessedRows =
            @ProcessedRows

        , BatchNo =
            @BatchNo

    WHERE StoredProcedureLogId =
          @StoredProcedureLogId;


    PRINT '============================================================';
    PRINT 'PROCESS COMPLETE';
    PRINT 'Log ID        : ' + CAST(@StoredProcedureLogId AS VARCHAR(30));
    PRINT 'Process Date  : ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), @ProcessDate, 120);
    PRINT 'Total Record  : ' + CAST(@TotalRecord AS VARCHAR(30));
    PRINT 'Processed     : ' + CAST(@ProcessedRows AS VARCHAR(30));
    PRINT 'Total Batch   : ' + CAST(@BatchNo AS VARCHAR(20));
    PRINT 'History Rows  : ' + CAST(@TotalHistoryRows AS VARCHAR(30));
    PRINT 'ROUND         : 2 Decimal';
    PRINT '============================================================';


    /* =========================================================
       Result
       ========================================================= */

    SELECT

          @StoredProcedureLogId
              AS StoredProcedureLogId

        , @ProcessDate
              AS ProcessDate

        , @TotalRecord
              AS TotalRecord

        , @ProcessedRows
              AS ProcessedRows

        , @BatchSize
              AS BatchSize

        , @BatchNo
              AS TotalBatch

        , @TotalHistoryRows
              AS TotalHistoryRows

        , @SPStartDateTime
              AS StartDateTime

        , @SPEndDateTime
              AS EndDateTime

        , CAST
          (
              DATEDIFF_BIG
              (
                  MILLISECOND,
                  @SPStartDateTime,
                  @SPEndDateTime
              ) / 1000.0

              AS DECIMAL(18,3)
          )
              AS DurationSeconds

        , CAST
          (
              DATEDIFF_BIG
              (
                  MILLISECOND,
                  @SPStartDateTime,
                  @SPEndDateTime
              ) / 60000.0

              AS DECIMAL(18,2)
          )
              AS DurationMinutes

        , 'SUCCESS'
              AS Status;

END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_005_eStatement]
	-- insert ดอกเบี้ย ทุกมาตรการ
	@GetDate date = '2026-05-20'
	--,@TypeId int = 1 --1=insert ดอกเบี้ยผิดนัด ทุกมาตรการ, 2=insert ดอกเบี้ยเดิม (ปิดแผน) 
	,@DataDebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = '053143CD-8393-4ACB-9F19-60BF9288A546'
	-- ,@EStatementId nvarchar(150) = 'B11E471D-BB41-4CD8-B7DF-0F3DFE34B3AE'
	,@EStatementId nvarchar(150) = '76889609-2b41-4fb1-b9dc-17fc96271727'
	,@UserId int = 1
	--,@IsAdjust int = 0 --0 = รายการปกติ, 1=รายการที่ต้องปรับปรุง
	--,@AdjustDate date = '1900-01-01' --วันที่ปรับปรุง
	
	
AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON;
SET @UserId = ISNULL(@UserId, 1);
declare @CurrentDate datetime = @GetDate

--declare @DataDebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = '228362C3-4BB3-4D23-9D75-B8F73EA2C042'
--declare @EStatementId nvarchar(150) = 'd33b8016-edab-44be-971a-e1b1c0c6e22d'
--รอบ 2


--declare @EStatementId nvarchar(150) = '5e256d0c-fe38-4ad5-84ee-4c3d021d39a0'
declare @Amount decimal(20,4) = (select top 1 Amount from DataEStatement where EStatementId = @EStatementId)
--declare @DataDebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = 'F70BC1D3-5499-425C-97E9-00192B895750'
declare @SeqCurrent int = (select top 1 SeqCurrent from DataDebtorCard where DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId )

declare @EndDate datetime = (select top 1 InterestEndDate + 1 from DataDebtorCardMovement where DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId and SeqNo = @SeqCurrent)


DECLARE @DaysInYear INT = DATEDIFF(DAY, cast(year(getdate()) as nvarchar) + '-01-01', cast(year(getdate()) as nvarchar) + '-12-31') + 1;
DECLARE @PaymentTypeId int = 2 --รับคืน
DECLARE @PaymentTypeCode nvarchar(2) =(select PaymentTypeCode from SystemPaymentType where PaymentTypeId = @PaymentTypeId)
DECLARE @PaymentTypeName nvarchar(100) =(select PaymentTypeName from SystemPaymentType where PaymentTypeId = @PaymentTypeId)


select @SeqCurrent
--IF @CurrentDate = EOMONTH(@CurrentDate)
--begin
--    PRINT 'เป็นวันสิ้นเดือน'

--end
--ELSE
--    PRINT 'ไม่ใช่วันสิ้นเดือน'
INSERT INTO [dbo].[DataDebtorCardMovement]
           ([DebtorCardMovementId]
           ,[DebtorCardId]
           ,[DocDate]
           ,[PayDate]
           ,[LGNo]
           ,[DebtorId]
           ,[DebtorCode]
           ,[DebtorCardCode]
           ,[DebtorCardName]
           ,[TypeId]
           ,[TypeCode]
           ,[TypeName]
           ,[FlagAutoPay]
           ,[DFDDate]
           ,[DFDStartDate]
           ,[DFDEndDate]
           ,[DPD]
           ,[TotalPay]
           ,[IsAdjust]
           ,[AdjustRefDocNo]
           ,[IsDelete]
           ,[MeasureId]
           ,[MeasureCode]
           ,[MeasureName]
           ,[InterestRate]
           ,[InterestPlannedRate]
           ,[InterestDefaultRate]
           ,[DebtBalance]
           ,[ReceivePayment]
           ,[Installment]
           ,[InstallmentPay]
           ,[InstallmentTotal]
           ,[Principal]
           ,[PrincipalPay]
           ,[PrincipalTotal]
           ,[InterimInterest]
           ,[AccruedInterest]
           ,[AccruedInterestPay]
           ,[AccruedInterestTotal]
           ,[CourtFee]
           ,[CourtFeePay]
           ,[CourtFeeTotal]
           ,[LawyerFee]
           ,[LawyerFeePay]
           ,[LawyerFeeTotal]
           ,[OtherExpense]
           ,[OtherExpensePay]
           ,[OtherExpenseTotal]
           ,[InitialMargin]
           ,[InitialMarginPay]
           ,[InitialMarginTotal]
           ,[SuspendInt]
           ,[SuspendIntPay]
           ,[SuspendIntTotal]
           ,[DeferredInterest]
           ,[DeferredInterestPay]
           ,[DeferredInterestTotal]
           ,[SuspendedDefaultInterest]
           ,[SuspendedDefaultInterestPay]
           ,[SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal]
           ,[PlannedInterest]
           ,[PlannedInterestPay]
           ,[PlannedInterestTotal]
           ,[DefaultInterest]
           ,[DefaultInterestPay]
           ,[DefaultInterestTotal]
           ,[CreateBy]
           ,[CreateDate]
           ,[UpdateBy]
           ,[UpdateDate]
           ,[ReceiptNo]
           ,[IsEstatement]
           ,[EStatementRef]
           ,[PaymentTypeId]
           ,[SeqNo]
           ,[DebtorPaymentId]
           ,[DebtorPaymentCode]
           ,[CompromiseContractGroup]
           ,[ReceiptId]
           ,[InstallmentPrincipal]
           ,[InstallmentPrincipalPay]
           ,[InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
           ,[InstallmentInterest]
           ,[InstallmentInterestPay]
           ,[InstallmentInterestTotal]
           ,[InterestStartDate]
           ,[InterestEndDate]
           ,[InterestQuantity]
		   ,[DPDAccumulate]
		   ,IsUpdateHistory)


SELECT top 1 newid()
      ,[DebtorCardId]
      ,getdate()
      ,@CurrentDate as PayDate
      ,cm.[LGNo]
      ,cm.[DebtorId]
      ,cm.[DebtorCode]
      ,cm.[DebtorCardCode]
      ,cm.[DebtorCardName]
      ,@PaymentTypeId
      ,@PaymentTypeCode
      ,@PaymentTypeName
      ,1
      ,cast('1900-01-01' as datetime) as [DFDDate]
      ,@CurrentDate as [DFDStartDate]
      ,@CurrentDate as [DFDEndDate]
      ,0 as [DPD]
      ,@Amount as [TotalPay]
      ,[IsAdjust]
      ,[AdjustRefDocNo]
      ,0
      ,cm.[MeasureId]
      ,cm.[MeasureCode]
      ,cm.[MeasureName]
      ,cm.[InterestRate]
      ,cm.[InterestPlannedRate]
      ,cm.[InterestDefaultRate]
      ,cm.[DebtBalance]
      ,0 as [ReceivePayment]
      ,[InstallmentTotal] as [Installment]
      ,[InstallmentPay]
      ,[InstallmentTotal]
      ,cm.[PrincipalTotal] as [Principal]
      ,0 as [PrincipalPay]
      ,cm.[PrincipalTotal]
      ,0 as [InterimInterest]
      ,0 as [AccruedInterest]
      ,0 as [AccruedInterestPay]
      ,cm.[AccruedInterestTotal]
      ,0 as [CourtFee]
      ,0 as [CourtFeePay]
      ,cm.[CourtFeeTotal]
      ,0 as [LawyerFee]
      ,0 as [LawyerFeePay]
      ,cm.[LawyerFeeTotal]
      ,0 as [OtherExpense]
      ,0 as [OtherExpensePay]
      ,cm.[OtherExpenseTotal]
      ,0 as [InitialMargin]
      ,0 as [InitialMarginPay]
      ,cm.[InitialMarginTotal]
      ,0 as [SuspendInt]
      ,0 as [SuspendIntPay]
      ,cm.[SuspendIntTotal]
      ,0 as [DeferredInterest]
      ,0 as [DeferredInterestPay]
      ,cm.[DeferredInterestTotal]
      ,0 as [SuspendedDefaultInterest]
      ,0 as [SuspendedDefaultInterestPay]
      ,cm.[SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal]
      ,0 as [PlannedInterest]
      ,0 as [PlannedInterestPay]
      ,cm.[PlannedInterestTotal]
      ,0 as [DefaultInterest]
      ,0 as [DefaultInterestPay]
      ,cm.[DefaultInterestTotal]
      ,@UserId as CreateBy
      ,getdate() as [CreateDate] 
      ,@UserId as UpdateBy
      ,getdate() as [UpdateDate]
      ,[ReceiptNo]
      ,1 as [IsEstatement]
      ,@EStatementId as EStatementRef
      ,[PaymentTypeId]
      ,cm.[SeqNo]+1
      ,[DebtorPaymentId]
      ,[DebtorPaymentCode]
      ,[CompromiseContractGroup]
      ,[ReceiptId]
      ,cm.[InstallmentPrincipal]
      ,cm.[InstallmentPrincipalPay]
      ,cm.[InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
      ,cm.[InstallmentInterest]
      ,cm.[InstallmentInterestPay]
      ,cm.[InstallmentInterestTotal]
      ,cast('1900-01-01' as datetime) as [InterestStartDate]
	  --,cast('2024-08-27' as datetime)

      ,cast('1900-01-01' as datetime) as [InterestEndDate]
      ,0 as [InterestQuantity]
	  ,[DPDAccumulate]  as [DPDAccumulate]
	  ,0 as IsUpdateHistory

from DataDebtorCardMovement cm
left join DataDebtorCard c on c.DataDebtorCardId = cm.DebtorCardId
where 
cm.DebtorCardId= @DataDebtorCardId
and cm.SeqNo = @SeqCurrent 
and CardStatusId !=135;

Update  DataDebtorCard 
set SeqCurrent = SeqCurrent +1
, SeqNext = SeqNext+1
, CurrentPaymentDate = @CurrentDate

where DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
and CardStatusId !=135;


--EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_014_InsertDebtorCard] @DataDebtorCardId, @EStatementId

--, DATEDIFF(DAY, InterestStartDate,  @CurrentDate - 1) + 1 as InterestQuantity

--, cast(PrincipalTotal * (InterestRate/ 100) * cast((DATEDIFF(DAY, InterestStartDate,  @CurrentDate - 1) + 1)AS DECIMAL(20,4))/ (CAST(@DaysInYear AS DECIMAL(20,4))) as decimal(20,4)) as InterimInterest

--, DefaultInterestTotal + cast(PrincipalTotal * (InterestDefaultRate/ 100) * cast((DATEDIFF(DAY, InterestStartDate,  @CurrentDate - 1) + 1)AS DECIMAL(20,4))/ (CAST(@DaysInYear AS DECIMAL(20,4))) as decimal(20,4)) as DefaultInterestTotal

----รอบ 2

----ตั้งพักใหม่
--, SuspendInt + InterimInterest  as SuspendInt
--, SuspendIntTotal + InterimInterest  as SuspendIntTotal

----ค้างรับ
--, AccruedInterest + InterimInterest as AccruedInterest
--, AccruedInterestTotal   + InterimInterest as AccruedInterestTotal

----รอบ 3

--, * 
--from DataDebtorCardMovement cm


--where cm.DebtorCardId= '05C71BE6-FC84-475E-B29A-ED0D7D66EEF0'

END
