CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_006_InsertDebtorCard_Horizontal]
    @DataDebtorCardId NVARCHAR(150) = '053143CD-8393-4ACB-9F19-60BF9288A546'
    ,@EStatementId     NVARCHAR(150) = '76889609-2b41-4fb1-b9dc-17fc96271727'
    ,@IsUpfront        BIT = 0 -- 0 = มาตรการทั่วไป, 1 = Upfront (ใช้ PaymentSeq พิเศษ)
	,@IsAdjust int = 0 --0 = รายการปกติ, 1=รายการที่ต้องปรับปรุง
	,@AdjustDate date = '1900-01-01' --วันที่ปรับปรุง
	,@OnPlan int = 1 --1= อยู่ในแผน, 0=เกินแผน
	,@TypeUpdateId int =0 --0=รายการปกติ, 1=Update
	,@DataDebtorCardMovementId NVARCHAR(150) = '' -- กรณี รับชำระงวดค้าง ส่ง MovementId เพื่อ Update รายการเดิม
	,@AmounteStatement DECIMAL(20,2) = 0
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

	-- ==========================
	-- Transaction Wrapper (รองรับ nested tran)
	-- ==========================
	DECLARE @__StartedTran bit = 0;
	DECLARE @__SavePoint nvarchar(128) = N'SP_DCS_Card_006_SavePoint';

    BEGIN TRY
		IF @@TRANCOUNT = 0
		BEGIN
			SET @__StartedTran = 1;
			BEGIN TRAN;
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SAVE TRAN @__SavePoint;
		END

        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 1) ตัวแปรหลัก
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        DECLARE 
              @Amount                    DECIMAL(20,6)
            , @PaymentDate               DATETIME
            , @IDCard                    NVARCHAR(20)
            , @LGNo                      NVARCHAR(20)
            , @DebtorPaymentName         NVARCHAR(200)
            , @SeqCurrent                INT
            , @DebtorTypeId              INT
            , @DebtorId                  NVARCHAR(150)
            , @MeasureId                 INT
            , @CompromiseContractId      NVARCHAR(150)
            , @CompromiseContractLGId    NVARCHAR(150)  -- ใช้ตอนอ่านจาก TDR เท่านั้น
            , @InterestRate              DECIMAL(20,6)
            , @InterimInterest           DECIMAL(20,6)
            , @SystemId                  INT = 4
            , @DocumentId                INT = 9
            , @CreateBy                  INT = 1
            , @AccountUserId             INT = 1         
            , @InstallmentShow           DECIMAL(20,4);  

        -- Totals จากการ์ด (ก่อนรับชำระ)
        DECLARE
              @CardPrincipalTotal                    DECIMAL(20,4)
            , @CardSuspendIntTotal                   DECIMAL(20,4)
            , @CardDeferredInterestTotal             DECIMAL(20,4)
            , @CardSuspendedDefaultInterestTotal     DECIMAL(20,4)
            , @CardPlannedInterestTotal              DECIMAL(20,4)
            , @CardDefaultInterestTotal              DECIMAL(20,4)
            , @CardAccruedInterestTotal              DECIMAL(20,4)
            , @CardCourtFeeTotal                     DECIMAL(20,4)
            , @CardLawyerFeeTotal                    DECIMAL(20,4)
            , @CardOtherExpenseTotal                 DECIMAL(20,4)
            , @CardInitialMarginTotal                DECIMAL(20,4)
            , @CardDebtBalance                       DECIMAL(20,4);

        -- Working copy สำหรับใช้ตัดชำระทีละลำดับ
        DECLARE
              @WorkPrincipalTotal         DECIMAL(20,4)
            , @WorkSuspendIntTotal        DECIMAL(20,4)
            , @WorkAccruedInterestTotal   DECIMAL(20,4)
            , @WorkCourtFeeTotal          DECIMAL(20,4)
            , @WorkLawyerFeeTotal         DECIMAL(20,4)
            , @WorkOtherExpenseTotal      DECIMAL(20,4)
            , @WorkInitialMarginTotal     DECIMAL(20,4)
            , @BaseLimit                  DECIMAL(20,6)
            , @Old_PrincipalTotal         DECIMAL(20,4)
            , @Old_SuspendIntTotal        DECIMAL(20,4)
            , @Old_CourtFeeTotal          DECIMAL(20,4)
            , @Old_LawyerFeeTotal         DECIMAL(20,4)
            , @Old_OtherExpenseTotal      DECIMAL(20,4)
            , @Old_InitialMarginTotal     DECIMAL(20,4)
            , @OldValueForKey             DECIMAL(20,6);

        -- ยอดที่ “จ่ายจริง” ตาม KeyName แต่ละประเภท (ระดับการ์ด)
        DECLARE
              @TotalPrincipalPay          DECIMAL(20,4) = 0
            , @TotalSuspendIntPay         DECIMAL(20,4) = 0
            , @TotalCourtFeePay           DECIMAL(20,4) = 0
            , @TotalLawyerFeePay          DECIMAL(20,4) = 0
            , @TotalOtherExpensePay       DECIMAL(20,4) = 0
            , @TotalInitialMarginPay      DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;

        -- สำหรับ Sequence แนวนอน
        DECLARE
              @PaymentSeq                 INT
            , @PaymentSeqType             INT  -- PaymentMethodId (1=Vertical, 15=Horizontal)
            , @Row                        INT
            , @MaxRow                     INT
            , @Remain                     DECIMAL(20,6)
            , @KeyName                    NVARCHAR(100)
            , @UnitValuesId               INT
            , @SeqValues                  DECIMAL(20,6)
            , @Available                  DECIMAL(20,6)
            , @ConfigAmount               DECIMAL(20,6)
            , @CanPay                     DECIMAL(20,6)
            , @Used                       DECIMAL(20,6)
            , @Installment                DECIMAL(20,6)
            , @DueDate                    DATE;

        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2) อ่าน DataEStatement
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
	
        SELECT
              @Amount            = Amount
            , @PaymentDate       = PaymentDate
            , @IDCard            = Reference1
            , @LGNo              = Reference2
            , @DebtorPaymentName = CustomerName
        FROM DataEStatement 
        WHERE EStatementId = @EStatementId;

        --IF @Amount IS NULL
        --BEGIN
        --    RAISERROR(N'ไม่พบข้อมูล E-Statement ตาม EStatementId ที่ระบุ',16,1);
        --    ROLLBACK TRAN;
        --    RETURN;
        --END;
		IF @Amount IS NULL
			THROW 50001, N'ไม่พบข้อมูล E-Statement ตาม EStatementId ที่ระบุ', 1;

        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2.1 หาค่างวดแรกที่ยังไม่จ่าย
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        SELECT TOP 1 
              @Installment = Instament
            , @DueDate     = DueDate 
        FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment pp
        WHERE pp.IsPayment = 0
          AND pp.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
        ORDER BY Seq;

        SET @InstallmentShow =
            CASE 
                WHEN @DueDate IS NULL THEN @Installment
                WHEN @DueDate > @PaymentDate THEN 0
                ELSE @Installment
            END;

        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 3) อ่าน DataDebtorCard (สถานะล่าสุดของการ์ด)
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
	
        SELECT
              @SeqCurrent                        = SeqCurrent
            , @DebtorTypeId                      = DebtorRelateTypeId
            , @DebtorId                          = DebtorId
            , @MeasureId                         = MeasureId
            , @CompromiseContractId              = CompromiseContractId
            , @CardPrincipalTotal                = ISNULL(PrincipalTotal,0)
--            , @CardSuspendIntTotal               = ISNULL(SuspendIntTotal,0)
            , @CardSuspendIntTotal               = [dbo].[FN_DCS_Card_02_GetSuspendIntTotal](@DataDebtorCardId, @PaymentDate)            
            , @CardDeferredInterestTotal         = ISNULL(DeferredInterestTotal,0)
            , @CardSuspendedDefaultInterestTotal = ISNULL(SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal,0)
            , @CardPlannedInterestTotal          = ISNULL(PlannedInterestTotal,0)
            , @CardDefaultInterestTotal          = ISNULL(DefaultInterestTotal,0)
            , @CardAccruedInterestTotal          = ISNULL(AccruedInterestTotal,0)
            , @CardCourtFeeTotal                 = ISNULL(CourtFeeTotal,0)
            , @CardLawyerFeeTotal                = ISNULL(LawyerFeeTotal,0)
            , @CardOtherExpenseTotal             = ISNULL(OtherExpenseTotal,0)
            , @CardInitialMarginTotal            = ISNULL(InitialMarginTotal,0)
            , @CardDebtBalance                   = ISNULL(DebtBalance,0)
            , @InterestRate                      = ISNULL(InterestRate,0) / 100
        FROM DataDebtorCard
        WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId;

--        SET @InterimInterest = (
--            SELECT TOP 1 InterimInterest
--            FROM DataDebtorCardMovement
--            WHERE DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
--              AND SeqNo = (@SeqCurrent - 1)
--        );
        
        DECLARE @InterestStartDate date = (select top 1 (case when cast(CurrentPaymentDate as date) != '1900-01-01' and MeasureDate <= CurrentPaymentDate then MeasureDate
			else MeasureDate end) as InterestStartDate
			from DataDebtorCard where DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId);
        
        DECLARE @InterestEndDate date = dateadd(day, -1, @PaymentDate)
        
        SET @InterimInterest = [dbo].[FN_DCS_Card_01_CalInterimInterest](@DataDebtorCardId, @InterestStartDate, @InterestEndDate)

        IF @SeqCurrent IS NULL
        BEGIN
            RAISERROR(N'ไม่พบข้อมูล DataDebtorCard หรือ SeqCurrent',16,1);
            --ROLLBACK TRAN;
            --RETURN;
            THROW 50002, N'ไม่พบข้อมูล DataDebtorCard หรือ SeqCurrent', 1;
        END;

        -- ถ้า CompromiseContractId ยังว่าง -> หาแผนจาก TDR (พร้อมดึง LGId ไว้ใช้ต่อ)
        IF (@CompromiseContractId IS NULL OR @CompromiseContractId = '')
        BEGIN
            SELECT TOP 1
                  @CompromiseContractId   = CompromiseContractId
                , @CompromiseContractLGId = CompromiseContractLGId
            FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
            WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
            ORDER BY ISNULL(IsActive,0) DESC, InstallmentSeq;
        END;

        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 4) เตรียม Working copy
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        SET @WorkPrincipalTotal        = @CardPrincipalTotal;
        SET @WorkSuspendIntTotal       = @CardSuspendIntTotal;
        SET @WorkAccruedInterestTotal  = @CardAccruedInterestTotal;
        SET @WorkCourtFeeTotal         = @CardCourtFeeTotal;
        SET @WorkLawyerFeeTotal        = @CardLawyerFeeTotal;
        SET @WorkOtherExpenseTotal     = @CardOtherExpenseTotal;
        SET @WorkInitialMarginTotal    = @CardInitialMarginTotal;

        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 5) เลือกลำดับการตัดชำระ (PaymentSeq)
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        IF (@IsUpfront = 1 or @OnPlan = 0)
        BEGIN
            SET @PaymentSeq = 737; -- Upfront
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            SELECT TOP 1
                @PaymentSeq = m.ConditionItemMapingValue
            FROM SystemConditionItemMappingValueMaster m
            LEFT JOIN SystemConditionMaster c          ON m.ConditionId = c.ConditionId
            LEFT JOIN SystemCampaignConditionMaster cc ON cc.ConditionId = c.ConditionId
            LEFT JOIN SystemMeasureCampaignMaster cm   ON cm.CampaignId = cc.CampaignId
            LEFT JOIN SystemMeasureMaster mm           ON mm.MeasureId = cm.MeasureId
            WHERE m.ConditionItemId = 20
              AND mm.MeasureId      = @MeasureId;
        END;

        IF @PaymentSeq IS NULL
        BEGIN
            RAISERROR(N'ไม่พบ PaymentSeq',16,1);
            --ROLLBACK TRAN;
            --RETURN;
            THROW 50003, N'ไม่พบ PaymentSeq', 1;
        END;

        SELECT 
              @PaymentSeqType = case when @PaymentSeq = 737 then 15 else PaymentMethodId end
        FROM SystemPaymentSeqMaster
        WHERE PaymentSeqId = @PaymentSeq;

        IF @PaymentSeqType IS NULL
        BEGIN
            RAISERROR(N'ไม่พบ PaymentSeqType (PaymentMethodId)',16,1);
            --ROLLBACK TRAN;
            --RETURN;
            THROW 50004, N'ไม่พบ PaymentSeqType (PaymentMethodId)', 1;
        END;

        -- ต้องเป็นแนวนอน (PaymentMethodId = 15)
        IF @PaymentSeqType <> 15
        BEGIN
            RAISERROR(N'PaymentSeq นี้ไม่ได้เป็นแนวนอน (PaymentMethodId <> 15)',16,1);
            --ROLLBACK TRAN;
            --RETURN;
            THROW 50005, N'PaymentSeq นี้ไม่ได้เป็นแนวนอน (PaymentMethodId <> 15)', 1;
        END;

        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 6) temp table สำหรับลำดับตัดชำระ
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#SeqDetail') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #SeqDetail;

        SELECT 
              RowNum        = ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sd.Seq)
            , sd.Seq
            , sd.PaymentSeqTypeId
            , l.KeyName
            , l.LookUpValue
            , sd.UnitValuesId        -- 94 = %, 95 = ยอดเต็ม
            , sd.[Values]
            , BFAmount       = CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(20,6))
            , PayableAmount  = CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(20,6))
            , UsedThisLevel  = CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(20,6))
            , Remaining      = CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(20,6))
            , s.PaymentSeqId
            , OldValue       = CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(20,6))
        INTO #SeqDetail
        FROM SystemPaymentSeqDetailMaster sd
        LEFT JOIN SystemPaymentSeqMaster s ON s.PaymentSeqId = sd.PaymentSeqId
        LEFT JOIN SystemLookupMaster     l ON l.LookupId     = sd.PaymentSeqTypeId
        WHERE s.PaymentSeqId = @PaymentSeq;

        SELECT @MaxRow = MAX(RowNum) FROM #SeqDetail;
        SET @Row    = 1;
        SET @Remain = @Amount;

        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 7) วนลูปตัดชำระแนวนอน (ระดับการ์ด)
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
		--------Start @TypeUpdateId = 0---------------------------------------
		
			SELECT top 1
				  @Old_PrincipalTotal     = PrincipalTotal
				, @Old_SuspendIntTotal    = SuspendIntTotal
				, @Old_CourtFeeTotal      = CourtFeeTotal
				, @Old_LawyerFeeTotal     = LawyerFeeTotal
				, @Old_OtherExpenseTotal  = OtherExpenseTotal
				, @Old_InitialMarginTotal = InitialMarginTotal
			FROM DataDebtorCardMovement
			WHERE DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
			and SeqNo = @SeqCurrent;

			WHILE @Row <= @MaxRow AND @Remain > 0
			BEGIN
				SELECT 
					  @KeyName      = KeyName
					, @UnitValuesId = UnitValuesId
					, @SeqValues    = [Values]
				FROM #SeqDetail
				WHERE RowNum = @Row;

				SET @OldValueForKey =
					CASE 
						WHEN @KeyName = 'Principal'     THEN @Old_PrincipalTotal
						WHEN @KeyName = 'SuspendInt'    THEN @Old_SuspendIntTotal
						WHEN @KeyName = 'CourtFee'      THEN @Old_CourtFeeTotal
						WHEN @KeyName = 'LawyerFee'     THEN @Old_LawyerFeeTotal
						WHEN @KeyName = 'OtherExpenses' THEN @Old_OtherExpenseTotal
						WHEN @KeyName = 'InitialMargin' THEN @Old_InitialMarginTotal
						ELSE 0
					END;

				SET @Available = 0;

				IF @KeyName = 'Principal'
					SET @Available = @WorkPrincipalTotal;
				ELSE IF @KeyName = 'SuspendInt'
					SET @Available = @WorkSuspendIntTotal;
				ELSE IF @KeyName = 'CourtFee'
					SET @Available = @WorkCourtFeeTotal;
				ELSE IF @KeyName = 'LawyerFee'
					SET @Available = @WorkLawyerFeeTotal;
				ELSE IF @KeyName = 'OtherExpenses'
					SET @Available = @WorkOtherExpenseTotal;
				ELSE IF @KeyName = 'InitialMargin'
					SET @Available = @WorkInitialMarginTotal;
				ELSE
					SET @Available = 0;

				IF (@Available <= 0 OR @Remain <= 0)
				BEGIN
					UPDATE #SeqDetail
					SET BFAmount      = @Remain,
						PayableAmount = 0,
						UsedThisLevel = 0,
						Remaining     = @Remain,
						OldValue      = @OldValueForKey
					WHERE RowNum = @Row;

					SET @Row = @Row + 1;
					CONTINUE;
				END;

				-- ===== คำนวณ ConfigAmount ตาม UnitValuesId =====
				IF @UnitValuesId = 94
				BEGIN
					-- 94 = เปอร์เซ็นต์ (%)
					IF @KeyName = 'Principal'
					BEGIN
						-- เงินต้น: ใช้เปอร์เซ็นต์จากยอดคงเหลือ
						SET @ConfigAmount = @Available * (@SeqValues / 100.0);
					END
					ELSE IF @KeyName = 'SuspendInt'
					BEGIN
						-- ดอกเบี้ย: จำกัดจากค่างวด + เปอร์เซ็นต์ + เพดาน InterimInterest
						SET @BaseLimit = ISNULL(@InstallmentShow, 0) * (@SeqValues / 100.0);
						IF @InterimInterest IS NOT NULL AND @InterimInterest < @BaseLimit
							SET @ConfigAmount = @InterimInterest;
						ELSE
							SET @ConfigAmount = @BaseLimit;
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						-- ค่าอื่นๆ: จำกัดสูงสุดไม่เกินค่างวด * เปอร์เซ็นต์
						SET @BaseLimit = ISNULL(@InstallmentShow, 0) * (@SeqValues / 100.0);
						SET @ConfigAmount = @BaseLimit;
					END
				END
				ELSE IF @UnitValuesId = 95
				BEGIN
					-- 95 = หน่วยเป็นบาท + เทียบกับ InterimInterest
					SET @BaseLimit =
						CASE 
							WHEN @InterimInterest IS NULL THEN @SeqValues
							WHEN @InterimInterest <= @SeqValues THEN @InterimInterest
							ELSE @SeqValues
						END;

					SET @ConfigAmount = @BaseLimit;
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					-- หน่วยอื่นๆ: ใช้ยอดคงเหลือทั้งก้อนตามเดิม
					SET @ConfigAmount = @Available;
				END;

				IF @ConfigAmount > @Available
					SET @CanPay = @Available;
				ELSE
					SET @CanPay = @ConfigAmount;

				IF @Remain < @CanPay
					SET @Used = @Remain;
				ELSE
					SET @Used = @CanPay;

				UPDATE #SeqDetail
				SET BFAmount      = @Remain,
					PayableAmount = @ConfigAmount,
					UsedThisLevel = @Used,
					Remaining     = @Remain - @Used,
					OldValue      = @OldValueForKey
				WHERE RowNum = @Row;

				-- ปรับยอดค้างในการ์ด และสะสมยอดที่จ่ายจริง
				IF @KeyName = 'Principal'
				BEGIN
					SET @WorkPrincipalTotal = @WorkPrincipalTotal - @Used;
					SET @TotalPrincipalPay  = @TotalPrincipalPay  + CAST(@Used AS DECIMAL(20,4));
				END
				ELSE IF @KeyName = 'SuspendInt'
				BEGIN
					SET @WorkSuspendIntTotal      = @WorkSuspendIntTotal      - @Used;
					SET @WorkAccruedInterestTotal = @WorkAccruedInterestTotal - @Used;
					SET @TotalSuspendIntPay       = @TotalSuspendIntPay       + CAST(@Used AS DECIMAL(20,4));
				END
				ELSE IF @KeyName = 'CourtFee'
				BEGIN
					SET @WorkCourtFeeTotal    = @WorkCourtFeeTotal    - @Used;
					SET @TotalCourtFeePay     = @TotalCourtFeePay     + CAST(@Used AS DECIMAL(20,4));
				END
				ELSE IF @KeyName = 'LawyerFee'
				BEGIN
					SET @WorkLawyerFeeTotal   = @WorkLawyerFeeTotal   - @Used;
					SET @TotalLawyerFeePay    = @TotalLawyerFeePay    + CAST(@Used AS DECIMAL(20,4));
				END
				ELSE IF @KeyName = 'OtherExpenses'
				BEGIN
					SET @WorkOtherExpenseTotal = @WorkOtherExpenseTotal - @Used;
					SET @TotalOtherExpensePay  = @TotalOtherExpensePay  + CAST(@Used AS DECIMAL(20,4));
				END
				ELSE IF @KeyName = 'InitialMargin'
				BEGIN
					SET @WorkInitialMarginTotal = @WorkInitialMarginTotal - @Used;
					SET @TotalInitialMarginPay  = @TotalInitialMarginPay  + CAST(@Used AS DECIMAL(20,4));
				END;

				SET @Remain = @Remain - @Used;
				SET @Row    = @Row + 1;
			END;
--เช็ค
			SELECT 
      RowNum
    , Seq
    , KeyName
    , CASE 
          WHEN KeyName = 'Principal' THEN N'เงินต้น'
          WHEN KeyName = 'SuspendInt' THEN N'ดอกเบี้ย'
          WHEN KeyName = 'CourtFee' THEN N'ค่าศาล'
          WHEN KeyName = 'LawyerFee' THEN N'ค่าทนาย'
          WHEN KeyName = 'OtherExpenses' THEN N'ค่าใช้จ่ายอื่น'
          WHEN KeyName = 'InitialMargin' THEN N'เงินประกัน'
          ELSE N'อื่นๆ'
      END AS CutTypeName

    , Remaining AS AfterAmount
	,@PaymentSeq
FROM #SeqDetail

			-- 13) UPDATE TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment แนวนอน
			---------------------------------------------------------------------
			DECLARE 
				  @PrincipalBudget DECIMAL(20,6) = @TotalPrincipalPay
				, @InterestBudget  DECIMAL(20,6) = @TotalSuspendIntPay;

			DECLARE @CurrentInstallmentSeq INT;
			DECLARE @OverdueCount INT = 0;

			-- นับ "งวดค้างทั้งหมด"
			-- งวดค้าง = DueDate < PaymentDate 
			--        หรือ เดือน/ปีเดียวกับ PaymentDate
			SELECT @OverdueCount = COUNT(*)
			FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
			WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
			  AND (@CompromiseContractId IS NULL OR CompromiseContractId = @CompromiseContractId)
			  AND IsActive = 1
			  AND ISNULL(IsPayment,0) = 0
			  AND (
					DueDate < @PaymentDate
					OR (MONTH(DueDate) = MONTH(@PaymentDate) 
						AND YEAR(DueDate)  = YEAR(@PaymentDate))
				  );

			IF ISNULL(@OverdueCount,0) = 0
			BEGIN
				-----------------------------------------------------------------
				-- 1) ถ้าไม่เจองวดค้างเลย -> เอาเงินดอกทั้งหมดไปรวมตัดเข้าต้น
				-----------------------------------------------------------------
				SET @PrincipalBudget = @PrincipalBudget + @InterestBudget;
				SET @InterestBudget  = 0;

				-- เลือกงวดแรกที่ยังไม่จ่ายมาเป็นงวดอ้างอิง
				SELECT TOP 1
					@CurrentInstallmentSeq = InstallmentSeq
				FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
				WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
				  AND (@CompromiseContractId IS NULL OR CompromiseContractId = @CompromiseContractId)
				  AND IsActive = 1
				  AND ISNULL(IsPayment,0) = 0
				ORDER BY InstallmentSeq;
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				-----------------------------------------------------------------
				-- 2–3) ถ้ามีงวดค้าง (>= 1 บรรทัด)
				-- เลือก seq สูงสุดของ "งวดค้าง" เป็นขอบบน
				-- แล้ว cursor ข้างล่างจะวน InstallmentSeq <= @CurrentInstallmentSeq
				-----------------------------------------------------------------
				SELECT @CurrentInstallmentSeq = MAX(InstallmentSeq)
				FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
				WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
				  AND (@CompromiseContractId IS NULL OR CompromiseContractId = @CompromiseContractId)
				  AND IsActive = 1
				  AND ISNULL(IsPayment,0) = 0
				  AND (
						DueDate < @PaymentDate
						OR (MONTH(DueDate) = MONTH(@PaymentDate) 
							AND YEAR(DueDate)  = YEAR(@PaymentDate))
					  );
			END;

			IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TDRDebug') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #TDRDebug;

			CREATE TABLE #TDRDebug
			(
				  CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId NVARCHAR(150)
				, InstallmentSeq           INT
				, PaymentDate              DATETIME
				, Instament                DECIMAL(20,4)
				, Principal                DECIMAL(20,4)
				, Interest                 DECIMAL(20,4)
				, Old_PrincipalPay         DECIMAL(20,4)
				, Old_InterestPay          DECIMAL(20,4)
				, Old_PaymentAmount        DECIMAL(20,4)
				, Old_OverPayment          DECIMAL(20,4)
				, Old_Overdue              DECIMAL(20,4)
				, Old_PrincipalOverdue     DECIMAL(20,4)
				, Old_InterestOverdue      DECIMAL(20,4)
				, New_PrincipalPay         DECIMAL(20,4)
				, New_InterestPay          DECIMAL(20,4)
				, New_PaymentAmount        DECIMAL(20,4)
				, New_OverPayment          DECIMAL(20,4)
				, New_PrincipalOverPayment DECIMAL(20,4)
				, New_InterestOverPayment  DECIMAL(20,4)
				, New_Overdue              DECIMAL(20,4)
				, New_PrincipalOverdue     DECIMAL(20,4)
				, New_InterestOverdue      DECIMAL(20,4)
				, New_IsPayment            BIT
			);

			IF @CurrentInstallmentSeq IS NOT NULL
			BEGIN
				DECLARE @InstallmentId NVARCHAR(150);

				DECLARE InstallCursor CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR
					SELECT CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId
					FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
					WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
					  AND (@CompromiseContractId IS NULL OR CompromiseContractId = @CompromiseContractId)
					  AND IsActive = 1
					  AND ISNULL(IsPayment,0) = 0
					  AND InstallmentSeq <= @CurrentInstallmentSeq
					ORDER BY InstallmentSeq;

				OPEN InstallCursor;
				FETCH NEXT FROM InstallCursor INTO @InstallmentId;

				WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 AND (@PrincipalBudget > 0 OR @InterestBudget > 0)
				BEGIN
					-- ตัวแปรของงวดใน TDR
					DECLARE
						  @RowPrincipal            DECIMAL(20,4)
						, @RowInterest             DECIMAL(20,4)
						, @RowPrincipalPayOld      DECIMAL(20,4)
						, @RowInterestPayOld       DECIMAL(20,4)
						, @RowInstament            DECIMAL(20,4)
						, @RowPayAmountOld         DECIMAL(20,4)
						, @RowOverPaymentOld       DECIMAL(20,4)
						, @RowOverdueOld           DECIMAL(20,4)
						, @RowPrinOverdueOld       DECIMAL(20,4)
						, @RowIntOverdueOld        DECIMAL(20,4)
						, @RowRemPrincipal         DECIMAL(20,4)
						, @RowRemInterest          DECIMAL(20,4)
						, @StepInterest            DECIMAL(20,4)
						, @StepPrincipal           DECIMAL(20,4)
						, @RowPrincipalPayNew      DECIMAL(20,4)
						, @RowInterestPayNew       DECIMAL(20,4)
						, @RowTotalPaidNew         DECIMAL(20,4)
						, @RowPaymentAmountNew     DECIMAL(20,4)
						, @RowOverPaymentNew       DECIMAL(20,4)
						, @RowPrinOverPayment      DECIMAL(20,4)
						, @RowIntOverPayment       DECIMAL(20,4)
						, @RowOverdue              DECIMAL(20,4)
						, @RowPrinOverdue          DECIMAL(20,4)
						, @RowIntOverdue           DECIMAL(20,4)
						, @RowIsPayment            BIT
						, @RowInstallmentSeq       INT
						, @RowAllowedStep          DECIMAL(20,4)
						, @RowTotalStep            DECIMAL(20,4)
						, @Excess                  DECIMAL(20,4);

					SELECT
						  @RowInstallmentSeq   = InstallmentSeq
						, @RowPrincipal        = ISNULL(Principal,0)
						, @RowInterest         = ISNULL(Interest,0)
						, @RowPrincipalPayOld  = ISNULL(PrincipalPay,0)
						, @RowInterestPayOld   = ISNULL(AccruedInterestPay,0)
						, @RowInstament        = ISNULL(Instament,0)
						, @RowPayAmountOld     = ISNULL(PaymentAmount,0)
						, @RowOverPaymentOld   = ISNULL(OverPayment,0)
						, @RowOverdueOld       = ISNULL(OverdueAmount,0)
						, @RowPrinOverdueOld   = ISNULL(PrincipalOverdueAmount,0)
						, @RowIntOverdueOld    = ISNULL(AccruedInterestOverdueAmount,0)
					FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
					WHERE CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @InstallmentId;

					SET @RowRemPrincipal = @RowPrincipal - @RowPrincipalPayOld;
					SET @RowRemInterest  = @RowInterest  - @RowInterestPayOld;
					SET @StepInterest    = 0;
					SET @StepPrincipal   = 0;

					-- ตัดดอกเบี้ยก่อน
					IF @RowRemInterest > 0 AND @InterestBudget > 0
					BEGIN
						SET @StepInterest = CAST(
							CASE WHEN @InterestBudget >= @RowRemInterest
								 THEN @RowRemInterest
								 ELSE @InterestBudget END
							AS DECIMAL(20,4));
						SET @InterestBudget = @InterestBudget - @StepInterest;
					END;

					-- แล้วตัดเงินต้น
					IF @RowRemPrincipal > 0 AND @PrincipalBudget > 0
					BEGIN
						SET @StepPrincipal = CAST(
							CASE WHEN @PrincipalBudget >= @RowRemPrincipal
								 THEN @RowRemPrincipal
								 ELSE @PrincipalBudget END
							AS DECIMAL(20,4));
						SET @PrincipalBudget = @PrincipalBudget - @StepPrincipal;
					END;

					-----------------------------------------------------------------
					-- เพดานจ่ายของงวดนี้ = Instament - PaymentAmount เดิม
					-----------------------------------------------------------------
					SET @RowAllowedStep = @RowInstament - @RowPayAmountOld;
					IF @RowAllowedStep < 0 SET @RowAllowedStep = 0;

					SET @RowTotalStep = @StepInterest + @StepPrincipal;

					IF @RowTotalStep > @RowAllowedStep
					BEGIN
						SET @Excess = @RowTotalStep - @RowAllowedStep;

						-- ลดส่วนเกินจาก เงินต้น ก่อน (ให้ดอกเบี้ยมี priority)
						IF @StepPrincipal >= @Excess
						BEGIN
							SET @StepPrincipal = @StepPrincipal - @Excess;
						END
						ELSE
						BEGIN
							SET @Excess        = @Excess - @StepPrincipal;
							SET @StepPrincipal = 0;

							IF @StepInterest >= @Excess
								SET @StepInterest = @StepInterest - @Excess;
							ELSE
								SET @StepInterest = 0;
						END;
					END;
					-----------------------------------------------------------------

					SET @RowPrincipalPayNew   = @RowPrincipalPayOld + @StepPrincipal;
					SET @RowInterestPayNew    = @RowInterestPayOld  + @StepInterest;
					SET @RowTotalPaidNew      = @RowPrincipalPayNew + @RowInterestPayNew;
					SET @RowPaymentAmountNew  = @RowPayAmountOld + @StepPrincipal + @StepInterest;

					SET @RowOverPaymentNew    = 0;
					SET @RowPrinOverPayment   = 0;
					SET @RowIntOverPayment    = 0;
					SET @RowOverdue           = 0;
					SET @RowPrinOverdue       = 0;
					SET @RowIntOverdue        = 0;
					SET @RowIsPayment         = 0;

					-----------------------------------------------------------------
					-- เงื่อนไข IsPayment = 1 ถ้า PaymentAmount ถึง / เกินค่างวด
					-----------------------------------------------------------------
					IF @RowPaymentAmountNew >= @RowInstament AND @RowInstament > 0
					BEGIN
						SET @RowIsPayment      = 1;
						SET @RowOverPaymentNew = @RowPaymentAmountNew - @RowInstament;

						SET @RowPrinOverPayment = @RowOverPaymentNew;
						SET @RowIntOverPayment  = @RowOverPaymentNew;
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						SET @RowOverdue     = @RowInstament - @RowPaymentAmountNew;
						SET @RowPrinOverdue = @RowPrincipal - @RowPrincipalPayNew;
						SET @RowIntOverdue  = @RowInterest  - @RowInterestPayNew;
					END;

					-- เก็บ Debug
					INSERT INTO #TDRDebug
					(
						  CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId
						, InstallmentSeq
						, PaymentDate
						, Instament
						, Principal
						, Interest
						, Old_PrincipalPay
						, Old_InterestPay
						, Old_PaymentAmount
						, Old_OverPayment
						, Old_Overdue
						, Old_PrincipalOverdue
						, Old_InterestOverdue
						, New_PrincipalPay
						, New_InterestPay
						, New_PaymentAmount
						, New_OverPayment
						, New_PrincipalOverPayment
						, New_InterestOverPayment
						, New_Overdue
						, New_PrincipalOverdue
						, New_InterestOverdue
						, New_IsPayment
					)
					SELECT 
						  @InstallmentId
						, @RowInstallmentSeq
						, @PaymentDate
						, @RowInstament
						, @RowPrincipal
						, @RowInterest
						, @RowPrincipalPayOld
						, @RowInterestPayOld
						, @RowPayAmountOld
						, @RowOverPaymentOld
						, @RowOverdueOld
						, @RowPrinOverdueOld
						, @RowIntOverdueOld
						, @RowPrincipalPayNew
						, @RowInterestPayNew
						, @RowPaymentAmountNew
						, @RowOverPaymentNew
						, @RowPrinOverPayment
						, @RowIntOverPayment
						, @RowOverdue
						, @RowPrinOverdue
						, @RowIntOverdue
						, @RowIsPayment;

					-----------------------------------------------------------------
					--  UPDATE TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment 
					-----------------------------------------------------------------
					--UPDATE TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
					--SET
					--	  PaymentDate                  = @PaymentDate
					--	, PaymentAmount                = @RowPaymentAmountNew
					--	, PrincipalPay                 = @RowPrincipalPayNew
					--	, AccruedInterestPay           = @RowInterestPayNew
					--	, OverPayment                  = @RowOverPaymentNew
					--	, PrincipalOverPayment         = CAST(@RowPrinOverPayment AS DECIMAL(20,0))
					--	, AccruedInterestOverPayment   = CAST(@RowIntOverPayment  AS DECIMAL(20,0))
					--	, OverdueAmount                = @RowOverdue
					--	, PrincipalOverdueAmount       = @RowPrinOverdue
					--	, AccruedInterestOverdueAmount = @RowIntOverdue
					--	, IsPayment                    = @RowIsPayment
					--	, UpdateDate                   = GETDATE()
					--	, UpdateBy                     = @CreateBy
					--WHERE CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @InstallmentId;

					FETCH NEXT FROM InstallCursor INTO @InstallmentId;
				END

				CLOSE InstallCursor;
				DEALLOCATE InstallCursor;

				-- Debug: ดูผลที่จะ update TDR รายงวด
				--ถ้าไม่ใช้ comment
				--SELECT 'TDR_RowUpdate' AS DebugType, * FROM #TDRDebug;

				-----------------------------------------------------------------
				--  UPDATE TotalOverdue / TotalPrincipalOverdue / TotalAccruedInterestOverdue
				-----------------------------------------------------------------
				--ถ้าไม่ใช้ comment
				--SELECT 
				--	  'TDR_TotalOverdueCalc'          AS DebugType
				--	, ip.CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId
				--	, ip.DataDebtorCardId
				--	, ip.InstallmentSeq
				--	, x.SumOverdue            AS New_TotalOverdue
				--	, x.SumPrin               AS New_TotalPrincipalOverdue
				--	, x.SumInt                AS New_TotalAccruedInterestOverdue
				--FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment ip
				--CROSS APPLY (
				--	SELECT
				--		  SUM(ISNULL(OverdueAmount,0))                AS SumOverdue
				--		, SUM(ISNULL(PrincipalOverdueAmount,0))       AS SumPrin
				--		, SUM(ISNULL(AccruedInterestOverdueAmount,0)) AS SumInt
				--	FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment z
				--	WHERE z.DataDebtorCardId = ip.DataDebtorCardId
				--	  AND (@CompromiseContractId IS NULL OR z.CompromiseContractId = @CompromiseContractId)
				--	  AND z.InstallmentSeq <= ip.InstallmentSeq
				--) x
				--WHERE ip.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
				--  AND (@CompromiseContractId IS NULL OR ip.CompromiseContractId = @CompromiseContractId);

				--UPDATE ip
				--SET 
				--	  TotalOverdue                = x.SumOverdue
				--	, TotalPrincipalOverdue       = x.SumPrin
				--	, TotalAccruedInterestOverdue = x.SumInt
				--FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment ip
				--CROSS APPLY (
				--	SELECT
				--		  SUM(ISNULL(OverdueAmount,0))                AS SumOverdue
				--		, SUM(ISNULL(PrincipalOverdueAmount,0))       AS SumPrin
				--		, SUM(ISNULL(AccruedInterestOverdueAmount,0)) AS SumInt
				--	FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment z
				--	WHERE z.DataDebtorCardId = ip.DataDebtorCardId
				--	  AND (@CompromiseContractId IS NULL OR z.CompromiseContractId = @CompromiseContractId)
				--	  AND z.InstallmentSeq <= ip.InstallmentSeq
				--) x
				--WHERE ip.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
				--  AND (@CompromiseContractId IS NULL OR ip.CompromiseContractId = @CompromiseContractId);
			END;



			exec [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_003_InsertBalance]@PaymentDate, @DataDebtorCardId, @IsAdjust, @AdjustDate
			exec [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay_Horizontal]@PaymentDate, @DataDebtorCardId

			---------------------------------------------------------------------
			-- 14) Commit และ debug result หลักจาก #SeqDetail
			---------------------------------------------------------------------
			--COMMIT TRAN; -- ✅ กัน COMMIT ซ้ำ (ไป commit จุดเดียวท้าย TRY)

			--ถ้าไม่ใช้ comment
			--SELECT 
			--	  'SeqDetail_AfterCal' AS DebugType
			--	, @DataDebtorCardId    AS DataDebtorCardId
			--	, @EStatementId        AS EStatementId
			--	, @PaymentDate         AS PaymentDate
			--	, @Amount              AS AmountEStatement
			--	, @TotalPrincipalPay   AS PrincipalPayTotal
			--	, @InterimInterest     AS InterimInterest
			--	, OldValue
			--	, CASE 
			--		  WHEN @DueDate IS NULL THEN NULL
			--		  WHEN @DueDate > @PaymentDate 
			--			  THEN CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(20,4))
			--		  ELSE @Installment
			--	  END AS InstallmentShow
			--	, *
			--FROM #SeqDetail;

			UPDATE DataDebtorCardMovement
			SET 
				  ReceivePayment       = @Amount
				, PrincipalPay         = ISNULL(@TotalPrincipalPay,0)
				, PrincipalTotal       = @CardPrincipalTotal
				, SuspendIntPay        = ISNULL(@TotalSuspendIntPay,0)
				, SuspendIntTotal      = @CardSuspendIntTotal
				, AccruedInterestPay   = ISNULL(@TotalSuspendIntPay,0)
				, AccruedInterestTotal = @CardAccruedInterestTotal
				, CourtFeePay          = ISNULL(@TotalCourtFeePay,0)
				, CourtFeeTotal        = @CardCourtFeeTotal
				, LawyerFeePay         = ISNULL(@TotalLawyerFeePay,0)
				, LawyerFeeTotal       = @CardLawyerFeeTotal
				, OtherExpensePay      = ISNULL(@TotalOtherExpensePay,0)
				, OtherExpenseTotal    = @CardOtherExpenseTotal
				, InitialMarginPay     = ISNULL(@TotalInitialMarginPay,0)
				, InitialMarginTotal   = @CardInitialMarginTotal
				, DebtBalance          = @CardDebtBalance
				, UpdateDate           = GETDATE()
			WHERE DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
			  AND SeqNo        = @SeqCurrent;


			select top 1 DebtorCardMovementId
			, @Amount as PaymentAmount
			, ISNULL(@TotalPrincipalPay,0) as PrincipalPay
			, ISNULL(@TotalSuspendIntPay,0) as AccruedInterestPay
			from DataDebtorCardMovement 
			where DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId and TypeId = 2 order by SeqNo desc
	END
	----------------------End @TypeUpdateId = 0 ----------------------------
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------
	ELSE IF (@TypeUpdateId = 1)
	BEGIN
		--UPDATE DataDebtorCardMovement
		--	SET 
		--		  PrincipalTotal                = @CardPrincipalTotal
		--		, SuspendIntTotal               = @CardSuspendIntTotal
		--		, DeferredInterestTotal         = @CardDeferredInterestTotal
		--		, SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal = @CardSuspendedDefaultInterestTotal
		--		, PlannedInterestTotal          = @CardPlannedInterestTotal
		--		, DefaultInterestTotal          = @CardDefaultInterestTotal
		--		, AccruedInterestTotal          = @CardAccruedInterestTotal
		--		, CourtFeeTotal                 = @CardCourtFeeTotal
		--		, LawyerFeeTotal                = @CardLawyerFeeTotal
		--		, OtherExpenseTotal             = @CardOtherExpenseTotal
		--		, InitialMarginTotal            = @CardInitialMarginTotal
		--		, DebtBalance                   = @CardDebtBalance
		--		, InterestStartDate             = @PaymentDate
		--		, UpdateDate                    = GETDATE()
		--		, UpdateBy                      = @CreateBy
		
			--WHERE DebtorCardMovementId = @DataDebtorCardMovementId;
			DECLARE @UseReceiptId nvarchar(150)
			select @UseReceiptId = ReceiptId 
			from DataDebtorCardMovement where DebtorCardMovementId =  @DataDebtorCardMovementId

			--UPDATE DataDebtorCardMovement
			--SET 
			--	  ReceivePayment       = ReceivePayment + @Amount
			--	, PrincipalPay         = PrincipalPay + ISNULL(@TotalPrincipalPay,0)
			--	, PrincipalTotal       = PrincipalTotal - ISNULL(@TotalPrincipalPay,0)
			--	, SuspendIntPay        = SuspendIntPay + ISNULL(@TotalSuspendIntPay,0)
			--	, SuspendIntTotal      = SuspendIntTotal - ISNULL(@TotalSuspendIntPay,0)
			--	, AccruedInterestPay   = AccruedInterestPay + ISNULL(@TotalSuspendIntPay,0)
			--	, AccruedInterestTotal = AccruedInterestTotal - ISNULL(@TotalSuspendIntPay,0)
			--	, CourtFeePay          = CourtFeePay + ISNULL(@TotalCourtFeePay,0)
			--	, CourtFeeTotal        = CourtFeeTotal - ISNULL(@TotalCourtFeePay,0)
			--	, LawyerFeePay         = LawyerFeePay + ISNULL(@TotalLawyerFeePay,0)
			--	, LawyerFeeTotal       = LawyerFeeTotal - ISNULL(@TotalLawyerFeePay,0)
			--	, OtherExpensePay      = OtherExpensePay + ISNULL(@TotalOtherExpensePay,0)
			--	, OtherExpenseTotal    = OtherExpenseTotal - ISNULL(@TotalOtherExpensePay,0)
			--	, InitialMarginPay     = InitialMarginPay + ISNULL(@TotalInitialMarginPay,0)
			--	, InitialMarginTotal   = InitialMarginTotal - ISNULL(@TotalInitialMarginPay,0)
			--	, DebtBalance          = @CardDebtBalance
			--	, UpdateDate           = GETDATE()
			--WHERE DebtorCardMovementId = @DataDebtorCardMovementId

			UPDATE DataDebtorCardMovement
			SET 
				  ReceivePayment       = @Amount
				, PrincipalPay         = ISNULL(@TotalPrincipalPay,0)
				, PrincipalTotal       = ISNULL(@TotalPrincipalPay,0)
				, SuspendIntPay        = ISNULL(@TotalSuspendIntPay,0)
				, SuspendIntTotal      = ISNULL(@TotalSuspendIntPay,0)
				, AccruedInterestPay   = ISNULL(@TotalSuspendIntPay,0)
				, AccruedInterestTotal = ISNULL(@TotalSuspendIntPay,0)
				, CourtFeePay          = ISNULL(@TotalCourtFeePay,0)
				, CourtFeeTotal        = ISNULL(@TotalCourtFeePay,0)
				, LawyerFeePay         = ISNULL(@TotalLawyerFeePay,0)
				, LawyerFeeTotal       = ISNULL(@TotalLawyerFeePay,0)
				, OtherExpensePay      = ISNULL(@TotalOtherExpensePay,0)
				, OtherExpenseTotal    = ISNULL(@TotalOtherExpensePay,0)
				, InitialMarginPay     = ISNULL(@TotalInitialMarginPay,0)
				, InitialMarginTotal   = ISNULL(@TotalInitialMarginPay,0)
				, DebtBalance          = @CardDebtBalance
				, UpdateDate           = GETDATE()
			WHERE DebtorCardMovementId = @DataDebtorCardMovementId

			--Update ACCDataReceipt
			--Set 
			--PaymentAmount		   = PaymentAmount + @Amount
			--, PrincipalPay		   = PrincipalPay + ISNULL(@TotalPrincipalPay,0)
			--, PrincipalTotal	   = PrincipalTotal - ISNULL(@TotalPrincipalPay,0)
			--, SuspendIntTotal      = SuspendIntTotal - ISNULL(@TotalSuspendIntPay,0)
			--, AccruedInterestPay   = AccruedInterestPay + ISNULL(@TotalSuspendIntPay,0)
			--, AccruedInterestTotal = AccruedInterestTotal - ISNULL(@TotalSuspendIntPay,0)
			--, CourtFeePay          = CourtFeePay + ISNULL(@TotalCourtFeePay,0)
			--, CourtFeeTotal        = CourtFeeTotal - ISNULL(@TotalCourtFeePay,0)
			--, LawyerFeePay         = LawyerFeePay + ISNULL(@TotalLawyerFeePay,0)
			--, LawyerFeeTotal       = LawyerFeeTotal - ISNULL(@TotalLawyerFeePay,0)
			--, OtherExpensePay      = OtherExpensePay + ISNULL(@TotalOtherExpensePay,0)
			--, OtherExpenseTotal    = OtherExpenseTotal - ISNULL(@TotalOtherExpensePay,0)
			--, InitialMarginPay     = InitialMarginPay + ISNULL(@TotalInitialMarginPay,0)
			--, InitialMarginTotal   = InitialMarginTotal - ISNULL(@TotalInitialMarginPay,0)
			--, DebtBalance          = @CardDebtBalance
			--where ReceiptId = @UseReceiptId

			-- ถ้ามี Receipt เดิม ให้ Update เดิม
			-- ถ้า Movement ไม่มี ReceiptId ให้สร้าง Receipt ใหม่ผ่าน SP_DCS_039_InsertReceipt
			IF NULLIF(@UseReceiptId, '') IS NOT NULL
			BEGIN
				UPDATE ACCDataReceipt
				SET 
					  PaymentAmount         = @Amount
					, PrincipalPay          = ISNULL(@TotalPrincipalPay,0)
					, PrincipalTotal        = ISNULL(@TotalPrincipalPay,0)
					, SuspendIntTotal       = ISNULL(@TotalSuspendIntPay,0)
					, AccruedInterestPay    = ISNULL(@TotalSuspendIntPay,0)
					, AccruedInterestTotal  = ISNULL(@TotalSuspendIntPay,0)
					, CourtFeePay           = ISNULL(@TotalCourtFeePay,0)
					, CourtFeeTotal         = ISNULL(@TotalCourtFeePay,0)
					, LawyerFeePay          = ISNULL(@TotalLawyerFeePay,0)
					, LawyerFeeTotal        = ISNULL(@TotalLawyerFeePay,0)
					, OtherExpensePay       = ISNULL(@TotalOtherExpensePay,0)
					, OtherExpenseTotal     = ISNULL(@TotalOtherExpensePay,0)
					, InitialMarginPay      = ISNULL(@TotalInitialMarginPay,0)
					, InitialMarginTotal    = ISNULL(@TotalInitialMarginPay,0)
					, DebtBalance           = @CardDebtBalance
				WHERE ReceiptId = @UseReceiptId;
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				EXEC dbo.SP_DCS_039_InsertReceipt
					 @SystemId                      = @SystemId,
					 @DocumentId                    = @DocumentId,
					 @DebtorCardId                  = @DataDebtorCardId,
					 @ReceiptDate                   = @PaymentDate,
					 @CreateBy                      = @CreateBy,
					 @AccountUserId                 = @AccountUserId,
					 @DebtorPaymentName             = @DebtorPaymentName,
					 @PaymentAmount                 = @Amount,
					 @PrincipalPay                  = @TotalPrincipalPay,
					 @AccruedInterestPay            = @TotalSuspendIntPay,
					 @CourtFeePay                   = @TotalCourtFeePay,
					 @LawyerFeePay                  = @TotalLawyerFeePay,
					 @OtherExpensePay               = @TotalOtherExpensePay,
					 @InitialMarginPay              = @TotalInitialMarginPay,
					 @CourtFeeTotal                 = @CardCourtFeeTotal,
					 @LawyerFeeTotal                = @CardLawyerFeeTotal,
					 @OtherExpenseTotal             = @CardOtherExpenseTotal,
					 @InitialMarginTotal            = @CardInitialMarginTotal,
					 @SuspendIntTotal               = @CardSuspendIntTotal,
					 @DeferredInterestTotal         = @CardDeferredInterestTotal,
					 @SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal = @CardSuspendedDefaultInterestTotal,
					 @PlannedInterestTotal          = @CardPlannedInterestTotal,
					 @DefaultInterestTotal          = @CardDefaultInterestTotal,
					 @EStatementId                  = @EStatementId,
					 @AccruedInterestTotal          = @CardAccruedInterestTotal,
					 @CallerHandlesTxn              = 1;
			END

			select top 1 DebtorCardMovementId
			, @Amount as PaymentAmount
			, ISNULL(@TotalPrincipalPay,0) as PrincipalPay
			, ISNULL(@TotalSuspendIntPay,0) as AccruedInterestPay
			from DataDebtorCardMovement 
			where DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId and TypeId = 2 order by SeqNo desc


	END

	-- ✅ COMMIT จุดเดียว และ commit เฉพาะตอน SP นี้เป็นคน BEGIN เอง
	IF @__StartedTran = 1
		COMMIT TRAN;

    END TRY
   BEGIN CATCH
    IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
    BEGIN
        IF @__StartedTran = 1
            ROLLBACK TRAN;
        ELSE
            ROLLBACK TRAN @__SavePoint;
    END;

    SELECT 
        ERROR_NUMBER() AS ErrorNumber,
        ERROR_MESSAGE() AS ErrorMessage,
        ERROR_PROCEDURE() AS ErrorProcedure,
        ERROR_LINE() AS ErrorLine;

    THROW;
END CATCH
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_007_RunAllPaymentDebtorCard]
--รับชำระ มาตรการ default ได้ข้อมูลการชำระตรงวัน และ ได้ข้อมูลการชำระ "ไม่ตรงวัน"
AS
BEGIN
    BEGIN TRY
        
        DECLARE @IsAuto bit = (SELECT IsAuto FROM SystemSettingPaymentMaster);
		DECLARE @GetDate date = GETDATE(); -- วันที่จ่ายเงิน
		DECLARE @IsAdjust int = 0 --0 = รายการปกติ, 1=รายการที่ต้องปรับปรุง

        -- ✅ รันเฉพาะเมื่อเปิดโหมด Auto  ได้ข้อมูลการชำระตรงวัน
--        IF (@IsAuto = 1)
--        BEGIN
--            
            DECLARE @CounteStatement int = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DataEStatement WHERE CAST(PaymentDate AS date) = @GetDate AND IsConfirm = 0 AND IsCheck = 1) 

            DECLARE @i INT = 1;

            SELECT 
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY e.EStatementId) AS RowId,
                e.EStatementId,
                e.DebtorCardId
            INTO #TempDataEStatement
            FROM DataEStatement e
            WHERE CAST(e.PaymentDate AS date) = @GetDate
              AND IsConfirm = 0
			  AND IsCheck = 1; -- รายการที่ยังไม่ได้เอามาคำนวณ

            WHILE (@i <= @CounteStatement)
            BEGIN
                DECLARE @DataDebtorCardId NVARCHAR(150) = (SELECT DebtorCardId FROM #TempDataEStatement WHERE RowId = @i);
                DECLARE @EStatementId NVARCHAR(150) = (SELECT EStatementId FROM #TempDataEStatement WHERE RowId = @i);
                DECLARE @SeqCurrent INT = (SELECT SeqCurrent FROM DataDebtorCard WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId);
				

                -- Insert รายการจาก eStatement
                EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_005_eStatement] @GetDate, @DataDebtorCardId, @EStatementId;

                -- ตัดชำระ
                EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_006_InsertDebtorCard] @DataDebtorCardId, @EStatementId, 0, 0, @GetDate;

                -- อัปเดตสถานะ
                UPDATE DataEStatement
                SET IsConfirm = 1 
                WHERE EStatementId = @EStatementId;

                SET @i = @i + 1;
            END
--        END

		----------------------------------------------------------------------
		-------------------- ได้ข้อมูลการชำระ "ไม่ตรงวัน"----------------------------
		----------------------------------------------------------------------
--		IF (@IsAuto = 1)
--        BEGIN

            DECLARE @CounteStatement2 int = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DataEStatement WHERE CAST(PaymentDate AS date) < @GetDate and isConfirm = 0 and isCheck = 1);
            select @CounteStatement2;
			DECLARE @Yesterday date = dateadd(day, -1, getdate())
            DECLARE @i2 INT = 1;
            DECLARE @Today  date = getdate();

            SELECT 
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY e.EStatementId) AS RowId,
                e.EStatementId,
                e.DebtorCardId
            INTO #TempDataEStatement2
            FROM DataEStatement e
            WHERE CAST(e.PaymentDate AS date) < @GetDate
              AND IsConfirm = 0
              AND IsCheck = 1; -- รายการที่ยังไม่ได้เอามาคำนวณ
			
            WHILE (@i2 <= @CounteStatement2)
            BEGIN
                SELECT @i2;
	            DECLARE @DataDebtorCardId2 NVARCHAR(150) = (SELECT DebtorCardId FROM #TempDataEStatement2 WHERE RowId = @i2);
                DECLARE @EStatementId2 NVARCHAR(150) = (SELECT EStatementId FROM #TempDataEStatement2 WHERE RowId = @i2);
                DECLARE @SeqCurrent2 INT = (SELECT SeqCurrent FROM DataDebtorCard WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId2);
                DECLARE @InterestEndDate2 date = (SELECT InterestEndDate FROM DataDebtorCard WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId2);
				DECLARE @PaymentDate date = (SELECT PaymentDate FROM DataEStatement WHERE EStatementId = @EStatementId2);
				DECLARE @FirstDate date = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@PaymentDate), MONTH(@PaymentDate), 1) ;

            
				IF (MONTH(@PaymentDate) = MONTH(@InterestEndDate2)
					AND YEAR(@PaymentDate) = YEAR(@InterestEndDate2))
				--เดือน ปี เท่ากัน กับวันปัจจุบัน 
				BEGIN
					-- EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_033_InsertAdjustRecalInterest] @PaymentDate, @DataDebtorCardId2 -- น่าจะไม่ได้ใช้แล้วหล่ะนะ
	            	DECLARE @PaymentBefore date = dateadd(day, -1, @PaymentDate)
	            	-- update ดอกเบี้ยย้อนหลัง paymentDate -1
	            	EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay] @PaymentBefore, @DataDebtorCardId2, 1, @Today;
	            
	                -- Insert รายการจาก eStatement
	                EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_005_eStatement] @PaymentDate, @DataDebtorCardId2, @EStatementId2;
	
	                -- ตัดชำระ
	                EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_006_InsertDebtorCard] @DataDebtorCardId2, @EStatementId2, 0;
	
					-- ดอกเบี้ยรายวัน
	                EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay] @Yesterday, @DataDebtorCardId2;

				END

				ELSE IF (MONTH(@PaymentDate) < MONTH(@InterestEndDate2)
					AND YEAR(@PaymentDate) = YEAR(@InterestEndDate2))
				BEGIN
					DECLARE @EOEnd date = (SELECT EOMONTH(@PaymentDate) AS LastDayOfCurrentMonth);
					DECLARE @FirstDateOfMonth date = dateadd(day, +1, @EOEnd)
					DELETE from DataDebtorCardMovement where DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId2 and SeqNo = @SeqCurrent2;
				
					declare @SeqNoLast int = 0
					
					select top 1
					@SeqNoLast =  cm.SeqNo 
					from DataDebtorCardMovement cm
					left join DataDebtorCard cd on cd.DataDebtorCardId = cm.DebtorCardId
					where cd.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId2
					order by cm.SeqNo desc
					
					Update cd
					set cd.PrincipalTotal = cm.PrincipalTotal 
					, cd.PlannedInterestTotal = cm.PlannedInterestTotal
					, cd.DefaultInterestTotal = cm.DefaultInterestTotal
					, cd.AccruedInterestTotal = cm.AccruedInterestTotal
					, cd.DebtBalance = cm.DebtBalance
					, cd.SeqCurrent = cm.SeqNo
					, cd.SeqNext = cm.SeqNo +1
					, cd.InterestStartDate = cm.InterestStartDate
					, cd.InterestEndDate = cm.InterestEndDate
					, cd.InterestRate = cm.InterestRate
					, cd.InterestPlannedRate = cm.InterestPlannedRate
					, cd.InterestDefaultRate = cm.InterestDefaultRate
				
					
					from DataDebtorCardMovement cm
					left join DataDebtorCard cd on cd.DataDebtorCardId = cm.DebtorCardId
					where cm.DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId2
					and cm.SeqNo = @SeqNoLast
					
					update cm
					set cm.TypeId = 8
					,cm.TypeCode = '08'
					,cm.TypeName= 'ยอดคงเหลือ'
					from DataDebtorCardMovement cm
					join DataDebtorCard cd on cd.DataDebtorCardId = cm.DebtorCardId
					where cm.DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId2 and cm.SeqNo = cd.SeqCurrent
					
					DECLARE @PaymentBefore2 date = dateadd(day, -1, @PaymentDate)
	            	-- update ดอกเบี้ยย้อนหลัง paymentDate -1
	            	EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay] @PaymentBefore2, @DataDebtorCardId2, 1, @Today;
	            
	                -- Insert รายการจาก eStatement
	                EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_005_eStatement] @PaymentDate, @DataDebtorCardId2, @EStatementId2;
	
	                -- ตัดชำระ
	                EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_006_InsertDebtorCard] @DataDebtorCardId2, @EStatementId2, 0;
	
					-- ดอกเบี้ยรายวัน
	                EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay] @EOEnd, @DataDebtorCardId2;
					
					EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_003_InsertBalance] @FirstDateOfMonth, @DataDebtorCardId2, 1, @GetDate;
					
					EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay] @FirstDateOfMonth, @DataDebtorCardId2;
					
					EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay] @Yesterday, @DataDebtorCardId2;
					
				END

--         --        อัปเดตสถานะ
                UPDATE DataEStatement
                SET IsConfirm = 1 
                WHERE EStatementId = @EStatementId2;

                SET @i2 = @i2 + 1;
            END
--        END
    

	
	-------------------------------------------------------------------
	END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        PRINT 'ERROR: ' + ERROR_MESSAGE();
    END CATCH
END;
