CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_007_RunAllPaymentDebtorCard_Horizontal]
--รับชำระ มาตรการ default ได้ข้อมูลการชำระตรงวัน และ ได้ข้อมูลการชำระ "ไม่ตรงวัน"
AS
BEGIN
    BEGIN TRY
        
        DECLARE @IsAuto bit = (SELECT IsAuto FROM SystemSettingPaymentMaster);
--		DECLARE @GetDate date = GETDATE(); -- วันที่จ่ายเงิน
        DECLARE @GetDate date = '2026-06-30'; -- วันที่จ่ายเงิน
		DECLARE @IsAdjust int = 0 --0 = รายการปกติ, 1=รายการที่ต้องปรับปรุง
-- 		DECLARE @Yesterday date = dateadd(day, -1, getdate())
		DECLARE @Yesterday date = dateadd(day, -1, @GetDate)

        -- ✅ รันเฉพาะเมื่อเปิดโหมด Auto  ได้ข้อมูลการชำระตรงวัน
--        IF (@IsAuto = 1)
--        BEGIN
--            
            DECLARE @CounteStatement int = (SELECT COUNT(*)
				FROM DataEStatement ds
				join DataDebtorCard ddc on ddc.DataDebtorCardId = ds.DebtorCardId 
				join SystemMeasureMaster smm on smm.MeasureId = ddc.MeasureId
				WHERE CAST(ds.PaymentDate AS date) = @GetDate
				AND ds.IsConfirm = 0 AND ds.IsCheck = 1
				AND smm.IsDefault = 0)
            

            DECLARE @i INT = 1;

			--===================================รับชำระตรงวัน
			--==============================================ตรงงวด
            SELECT 
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ds.EStatementId) AS RowId,
                ds.EStatementId,
                ds.DebtorCardId,
                ds.PaymentDate,
                ds.Amount
            INTO #TempDataEStatement
            FROM DataEStatement ds
            join DataDebtorCard ddc on ddc.DataDebtorCardId = ds.DebtorCardId 
			join SystemMeasureMaster smm on smm.MeasureId = ddc.MeasureId
            WHERE CAST(ds.PaymentDate AS date) = @GetDate
              AND ds.IsConfirm = 0
			  AND ds.IsCheck = 1
			  AND smm.IsDefault = 0; -- รายการที่ยังไม่ได้เอามาคำนวณ

            WHILE (@i <= @CounteStatement)
            BEGIN
                DECLARE @DataDebtorCardId NVARCHAR(150) = (SELECT DebtorCardId FROM #TempDataEStatement WHERE RowId = @i);
                DECLARE @EStatementId NVARCHAR(150) = (SELECT EStatementId FROM #TempDataEStatement WHERE RowId = @i);
            	DECLARE @PaymentDate NVARCHAR(150) = (SELECT PaymentDate FROM #TempDataEStatement WHERE RowId = @i);
            	DECLARE @Amount decimal(20, 2) = (SELECT Amount FROM #TempDataEStatement WHERE RowId = @i);
            	DECLARE @PaymentAmount decimal(20, 2) = (SELECT Amount FROM #TempDataEStatement WHERE RowId = @i);
                DECLARE @SeqCurrent INT = (SELECT SeqCurrent FROM DataDebtorCard WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId);
            	DECLARE @DPD INT = (SELECT DPD FROM DataDebtorCard WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId);
            	DECLARE @InterestEndDate date = (SELECT InterestEndDate FROM DataDebtorCard WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId);
				
				SELECT 
					ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a.Seq ASC) as RowId,
					a.*
				INTO #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
				from TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment a
				where a.isPayment = 0 
				and a.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
				and a.StartDate <= @PaymentDate
				and a.IsUpfront = 0
				order by a.Seq ASC
				
				DECLARE @CountDPD int = (SELECT count(*) from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment)
				
				SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a.Seq ASC) as RowId, a.*, b.UpfrontAmount
				INTO #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentUpfront
				FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment AS a
				join TDRDataCompromiseContract b on b.CompromiseContractId = a.CompromiseContractId
				WHERE a.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
				and a.IsPayment = 0
				and a.IsUpfront  = 1
				ORDER BY a.Seq ASC
				
				DECLARE @CountUpfront int = (SELECT count(*) from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentUpfront)
				
				IF (MONTH(@PaymentDate) = MONTH(@InterestEndDate)
					AND YEAR(@PaymentDate) = YEAR(@InterestEndDate)
					AND DAY(@PaymentDate) <= DAY(@InterestEndDate))
				BEGIN
					DECLARE @PaymentBefore date = dateadd(day, -1, @PaymentDate)
					EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay_Horizontal] @PaymentBefore, @DataDebtorCardId, 1, @GetDate;
					EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_005_eStatement] @PaymentDate, @DataDebtorCardId, @EStatementId;
					EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_006_InsertDebtorCard_Horizontal] @DataDebtorCardId, @EStatementId, 0, 0, @GetDate, 1, 0;
					EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay_Horizontal] @Yesterday, @DataDebtorCardId;
				END
				ELSE IF (MONTH(@PaymentDate) = MONTH(@InterestEndDate)
					AND YEAR(@PaymentDate) = YEAR(@InterestEndDate)
					AND DAY(@PaymentDate) = DAY(@InterestEndDate))
				BEGIN
					EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_005_eStatement] @GetDate, @DataDebtorCardId, @EStatementId;
					EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_006_InsertDebtorCard_Horizontal] @DataDebtorCardId, @EStatementId, 0, 0, @GetDate, 1, 0;
					EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay_Horizontal] @Yesterday, @DataDebtorCardId;
				END
				ELSE IF (MONTH(@PaymentDate) < MONTH(@InterestEndDate)
					AND YEAR(@PaymentDate) = YEAR(@InterestEndDate))
				BEGIN
					DECLARE @EOEnd date = (SELECT EOMONTH(@PaymentDate) AS LastDayOfCurrentMonth);
					DECLARE @FirstDateOfMonth date = dateadd(day, +1, @EOEnd)
					DELETE ddcm from DataDebtorCardMovement ddcm
					join DataDebtorCard ddc on ddc.DataDebtorCardId = ddcm.DebtorCardId where ddcm.DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId and ddcm.SeqNo = ddc.SeqCurrent;
				
					declare @SeqNoLast int = 0
					
					select top 1
					@SeqNoLast =  cm.SeqNo 
					from DataDebtorCardMovement cm
					left join DataDebtorCard cd on cd.DataDebtorCardId = cm.DebtorCardId
					where cd.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
					order by cm.SeqNo desc
					
					Update cd
					set cd.PrincipalTotal = cm.PrincipalTotal 
					, cd.PlannedInterestTotal = cm.PlannedInterestTotal
					, cd.DefaultInterestTotal = cm.DefaultInterestTotal
					, cd.AccruedInterestTotal = cm.AccruedInterestTotal
					, cd.DebtBalance = cm.DebtBalance
					, cd.SeqCurrent = cm.SeqNo
					, cd.SeqNext = cm.SeqNo +1
					, cd.InterestStartDate = cm.InterestStartDate
					, cd.InterestEndDate = cm.InterestEndDate
					, cd.InterestRate = cm.InterestRate
					, cd.InterestPlannedRate = cm.InterestPlannedRate
					, cd.InterestDefaultRate = cm.InterestDefaultRate
				
					
					from DataDebtorCardMovement cm
					left join DataDebtorCard cd on cd.DataDebtorCardId = cm.DebtorCardId
					where cm.DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
					and cm.SeqNo = @SeqNoLast
					
					update cm
					set cm.TypeId = 8
					,cm.TypeCode = '08'
					,cm.TypeName= 'ยอดคงเหลือ'
					from DataDebtorCardMovement cm
					join DataDebtorCard cd on cd.DataDebtorCardId = cm.DebtorCardId
					where cm.DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId and cm.SeqNo = cd.SeqCurrent
					
					DECLARE @PaymentBefore2 date = dateadd(day, -1, @PaymentDate)
	            	-- update ดอกเบี้ยย้อนหลัง paymentDate -1
	            	EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay_Horizontal] @PaymentBefore2, @DataDebtorCardId, 1, @GetDate;
	            
	                -- Insert รายการจาก eStatement
	                EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_005_eStatement] @PaymentDate, @DataDebtorCardId, @EStatementId;
	
	                -- ตัดชำระ
	                EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_006_InsertDebtorCard_Horizontal] @DataDebtorCardId, @EStatementId, 0;
	
					-- ดอกเบี้ยรายวัน
	                EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay_Horizontal] @EOEnd, @DataDebtorCardId;
					
					EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_003_InsertBalance] @FirstDateOfMonth, @DataDebtorCardId, 1, @GetDate;
					
					EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay_Horizontal] @FirstDateOfMonth, @DataDebtorCardId;
					
					EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay_Horizontal] @Yesterday, @DataDebtorCardId;
					
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					
					-- Insert รายการจาก eStatement
	                EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_005_eStatement] @GetDate, @DataDebtorCardId, @EStatementId;
	                -- ตัดชำระ
					IF (@CountUpfront > 0)
					BEGIN
						EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_006_InsertDebtorCard_Horizontal] @DataDebtorCardId, @EStatementId, 1, 0, @GetDate, 1, 0;
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_006_InsertDebtorCard_Horizontal] @DataDebtorCardId, @EStatementId, 0, 0, @GetDate, 1, 0;
					END
				
				END
				
				--
                --EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_039_UpdateInstallmentPlanPayment] @DataDebtorCardId, @EStatementId;
                
--				DECLARE @DefaultRate int = (SELECT top 1 sim.DefaultRate FROM SystemInterateMaster AS sim WHERE InterateTypeId = 112 and IsActive = 1 ORDER BY sim.UpdateDate DESC)
				
                DECLARE @PrincipalPay decimal(20, 2)
            	DECLARE @AccruedInterestPay decimal(20, 2)
            	select top 1 @PrincipalPay = PrincipalPay, @AccruedInterestPay = AccruedInterestPay 
						from DataDebtorCardMovement
						where 
						DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
						and TypeId = 2
						and IsAdjust = 0
						order by SeqNo desc
						
                DECLARE @j INT = 1;
                DECLARE @k INT = 1;
                
				IF (@CountDPD > 0)
				BEGIN
					WHILE (@j <= @CountDPD)
					BEGIN
						DECLARE @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId NVARCHAR(150) = (SELECT CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment where RowId = @j);
						DECLARE @OverdueAmount decimal(20, 2) = (SELECT OverdueAmount from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment where RowId = @j);
						DECLARE @Total decimal(20, 2) = (SELECT Total from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment where RowId = @j);
						DECLARE @Found0 NVARCHAR(150) = (SELECT CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
						where 
						--RowId = @j and
						(CAST(StartDate AS date) <= CAST(@PaymentDate AS date)
						and CAST(EndDate AS date) >= CAST(@PaymentDate AS date)));
--						and (StartDate <= @PaymentDate
--						and EndDate >= @PaymentDate));
				
						DECLARE @IsClearDPD bit = 0
						
						IF (@Found0 is not null)
						BEGIN
							update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
							set PrincipalPay = @PrincipalPay
							,AccruedInterestPay = @AccruedInterestPay
							,PaymentAmount = @PaymentAmount
							,PaymentDate = @PaymentDate
							where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @Found0

							--select @Found0
						END
				
						IF (@OverdueAmount > 0)
						BEGIN
							IF (@Amount >= @OverdueAmount)
							BEGIN
								update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
								set isPayment = 1
								,OverdueAmount = 0
								where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId
								SET @Amount = @Amount - @OverdueAmount
								SET @IsClearDPD = 1
							END
							ELSE
							BEGIN
								SET @OverdueAmount = @OverdueAmount - @Amount
								update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
								set isPayment = 0
								,OverdueAmount = @OverdueAmount
								where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId
								SET @Amount = 0
							END
						END
						ELSE
						BEGIN
							IF (@Amount >= @Total)
							BEGIN
								update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
								set isPayment = 1
								,OverdueAmount = 0
								where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId
								SET @Amount = @Amount - @Total
								SET @IsClearDPD = 1
							END
							ELSE
							BEGIN
								update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
								set isPayment = 0
								,OverdueAmount = @Total - @Amount
								where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId
								SET @Amount = 0
							END
						END
						
						IF (@j = @CountDPD)
						BEGIN
							SELECT 'AAAAA'
							DECLARE @MinEndDate date = (SELECT TOP 1 EndDate from TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
							where IsPayment = 0
							AND DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
							AND CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId != @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId
							ORDER BY Seq ASC);
						
							SELECT @MinEndDate;
							
							IF (@MinEndDate is not null)
							BEGIN
								
								SELECT 'BBBBBB';
								
								update DataDebtorCard 
								set DPD = 1
								, DFDDate = dateadd(day, +1, @MinEndDate)
								WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
								
								SELECT 'CCCCCCC';
							END
						END
						
						
						IF (@j = @CountDPD AND @IsClearDPD = 1)
						BEGIN
							update DataDebtorCard 
							set DPD = 0 
							, DFDDate = '1900-01-01'
							WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId	
						END
						SET @j = @j + 1;
					END
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					IF (@CountUpfront > 0)
					BEGIN
						
						WHILE (@k <= @CountUpfront)
						BEGIN
							DECLARE @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId3 NVARCHAR(150) = (SELECT CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentUpfront where RowId = @k);
							DECLARE @Found NVARCHAR(150) = (SELECT CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentUpfront
							where RowId = @k
							and (CAST(StartDate AS date) <= CAST(@PaymentDate AS date)
							and CAST(EndDate AS date) >= CAST(@PaymentDate AS date)));

							DECLARE @UpfrontAmount decimal(20, 2) = (SELECT UpfrontAmount from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentUpfront where RowId = @k);
							DECLARE @TotalUpfrontAmount decimal(20, 2) = (SELECT Total from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentUpfront where RowId = @k);
						
							IF (@Found is not null)
							BEGIN
								IF (@PaymentAmount >= @UpfrontAmount)
								BEGIN
									update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
									set isPayment = 1
									,PaymentAmount = PaymentAmount + @PaymentAmount
									,PrincipalPay = PrincipalPay + @PaymentAmount
									,PaymentDate = @PaymentDate
									where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId3
								END
								ELSE
								BEGIN
									update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
									set isPayment = 0
									,PaymentAmount = PaymentAmount + @PaymentAmount
									,PrincipalPay = PrincipalPay + @PaymentAmount
									,PaymentDate = @PaymentDate
									where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId3
								END
							END
							
							DECLARE @SumPaymentAmount decimal(20, 2) = (SELECT SUM(PaymentAmount) as SumPaymentAmount from TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment where DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId and IsUpfront = 1);
							
							IF (@k = @CountUpfront)
							BEGIN
								SELECT @SumPaymentAmount;
								SELECT @UpfrontAmount;
								IF (@SumPaymentAmount >= @UpfrontAmount)
								BEGIN
									SELECT 'SumPaymentAmount gather than UpfrontAmount'
									
									DECLARE @l INT = 1;
									WHILE (@l <= @k)
									BEGIN
										DECLARE @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId4 NVARCHAR(150) = (SELECT CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentUpfront where RowId = @l);
										
										update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
										set isPayment = 1
										where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId4
										
										SET @l = @l + 1;
									END
								END
							END
							SET @k = @k + 1;
						END
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						DECLARE @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2 NVARCHAR(150) = (select top 1 a.CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId
						from TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment a
						where a.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
						and a.IsPayment = 0
						order by a.Seq ASC)
						
						update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
						set isPayment = 1
						,PaymentAmount = @PaymentAmount
						,PrincipalPay = @PrincipalPay
						,AccruedInterestPay= @AccruedInterestPay
						where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2
					END
				END
				

                -- อัปเดตสถานะ
                UPDATE DataEStatement
                SET IsConfirm = 1 
                WHERE EStatementId = @EStatementId;

                SET @i = @i + 1;
            END
--        END
            
            
            

		----------------------------------------------------------------------
		-------------------- ได้ข้อมูลการชำระ "ไม่ตรงวัน"----------------------------
		----------------------------------------------------------------------
--		IF (@IsAuto = 1)
--        BEGIN
--
            DECLARE @CounteStatement2 int = (SELECT COUNT(*)
				FROM DataEStatement ds
				join DataDebtorCard ddc on ddc.DataDebtorCardId = ds.DebtorCardId
				join SystemMeasureMaster smm on smm.MeasureId = ddc.MeasureId
				WHERE CAST(ds.PaymentDate AS date) < @GetDate
				AND ds.IsConfirm = 0 AND ds.IsCheck = 1
				AND smm.IsDefault = 0);
            select @CounteStatement2;
            DECLARE @i2 INT = 1;
            DECLARE @Today  date = getdate();
            DECLARE @j2 INT = 1;
            DECLARE @k2 INT = 1;
            DECLARE @l2 INT = 1;
            DECLARE @DataDebtorCardId2 NVARCHAR(150);
            DECLARE @EStatementId2 NVARCHAR(150);
            DECLARE @PaymentDate2 date;
            DECLARE @Amount2 decimal(20, 2);
            DECLARE @PaymentAmount2 decimal(20, 2);
            DECLARE @SeqCurrent2 INT;
            DECLARE @InterestEndDate2 date;
            DECLARE @CountDPD2 int;
            DECLARE @CountUpfront2 int;
            DECLARE @PaymentBefore3 date;
            DECLARE @EOEnd2 date;
            DECLARE @FirstDateOfMonth2 date;
            DECLARE @SeqNoLast2 int;
            DECLARE @PaymentBefore4 date;
            DECLARE @PrincipalPay2 decimal(20, 2);
            DECLARE @AccruedInterestPay2 decimal(20, 2);
            DECLARE @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2a NVARCHAR(150);
            DECLARE @OverdueAmount2 decimal(20, 2);
            DECLARE @Total2 decimal(20, 2);
            DECLARE @Found0_2 NVARCHAR(150);
            DECLARE @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2b NVARCHAR(150);
            DECLARE @Found2 NVARCHAR(150);
            DECLARE @UpfrontAmount2 decimal(20, 2);
            DECLARE @SumPaymentAmount2 decimal(20, 2);
            DECLARE @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2c NVARCHAR(150);
            DECLARE @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2d NVARCHAR(150);

            SELECT 
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ds.EStatementId) AS RowId,
                ds.EStatementId,
                ds.DebtorCardId,
                ds.PaymentDate,
                ds.Amount
            INTO #TempDataEStatement2
            FROM DataEStatement ds
            join DataDebtorCard ddc on ddc.DataDebtorCardId = ds.DebtorCardId
			join SystemMeasureMaster smm on smm.MeasureId = ddc.MeasureId
            WHERE CAST(ds.PaymentDate AS date) < @GetDate
              AND ds.IsConfirm = 0
              AND ds.IsCheck = 1
			  AND smm.IsDefault = 0; -- รายการที่ยังไม่ได้เอามาคำนวณ
			
            WHILE (@i2 <= @CounteStatement2)
            BEGIN
                SELECT @i2;
	            SET @DataDebtorCardId2 = (SELECT DebtorCardId FROM #TempDataEStatement2 WHERE RowId = @i2);
                SET @EStatementId2 = (SELECT EStatementId FROM #TempDataEStatement2 WHERE RowId = @i2);
                SET @PaymentDate2 = (SELECT PaymentDate FROM #TempDataEStatement2 WHERE RowId = @i2);
            	SET @Amount2 = (SELECT Amount FROM #TempDataEStatement2 WHERE RowId = @i2);
            	SET @PaymentAmount2 = (SELECT Amount FROM #TempDataEStatement2 WHERE RowId = @i2);
                SET @SeqCurrent2 = (SELECT SeqCurrent FROM DataDebtorCard WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId2);
                SET @InterestEndDate2 = (SELECT InterestEndDate FROM DataDebtorCard WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId2);

				SELECT 
					ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a.Seq ASC) as RowId,
					a.*
				INTO #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment2
				from TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment a
				where a.isPayment = 0 
				and a.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId2
				and a.StartDate <= @PaymentDate2
				and a.IsUpfront = 0
				order by a.Seq ASC
				
				SET @CountDPD2 = (SELECT count(*) from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment2)

				SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a.Seq ASC) as RowId, a.*, b.UpfrontAmount
				INTO #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentUpfront2
				FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment AS a
				join TDRDataCompromiseContract b on b.CompromiseContractId = a.CompromiseContractId
				WHERE a.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId2
				and a.IsPayment = 0
				and a.IsUpfront  = 1
				ORDER BY a.Seq ASC
				
				SET @CountUpfront2 = (SELECT count(*) from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentUpfront2)

				IF (MONTH(@PaymentDate2) = MONTH(@InterestEndDate2)
					AND YEAR(@PaymentDate2) = YEAR(@InterestEndDate2)
					AND DAY(@PaymentDate2) <= DAY(@InterestEndDate2))
				BEGIN
	            	SET @PaymentBefore3 = dateadd(day, -1, @PaymentDate2)
	            	EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay_Horizontal] @PaymentBefore3, @DataDebtorCardId2, 1, @Today;
	                EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_005_eStatement] @PaymentDate2, @DataDebtorCardId2, @EStatementId2;
	                EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_006_InsertDebtorCard_Horizontal] @DataDebtorCardId2, @EStatementId2, 0, 0, @GetDate, 1, 0;
	                EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay_Horizontal] @Yesterday, @DataDebtorCardId2;
				END
				ELSE IF (MONTH(@PaymentDate2) = MONTH(@InterestEndDate2)
					AND YEAR(@PaymentDate2) = YEAR(@InterestEndDate2)
					AND DAY(@PaymentDate2) = DAY(@InterestEndDate2))
				BEGIN
					EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_005_eStatement] @GetDate, @DataDebtorCardId2, @EStatementId2;
					EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_006_InsertDebtorCard_Horizontal] @DataDebtorCardId2, @EStatementId2, 0, 0, @GetDate, 1, 0;
					EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay_Horizontal] @Yesterday, @DataDebtorCardId2;
				END
				ELSE IF (MONTH(@PaymentDate2) < MONTH(@InterestEndDate2)
					AND YEAR(@PaymentDate2) = YEAR(@InterestEndDate2))
				BEGIN
					SET @EOEnd2 = (SELECT EOMONTH(@PaymentDate2) AS LastDayOfCurrentMonth);
					SET @FirstDateOfMonth2 = dateadd(day, +1, @EOEnd2)
					DELETE ddcm from DataDebtorCardMovement ddcm
					join DataDebtorCard ddc on ddc.DataDebtorCardId = ddcm.DebtorCardId where ddcm.DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId2 and ddcm.SeqNo = ddc.SeqCurrent;
				
					SET @SeqNoLast2 = 0
					
					select top 1
					@SeqNoLast2 =  cm.SeqNo 
					from DataDebtorCardMovement cm
					left join DataDebtorCard cd on cd.DataDebtorCardId = cm.DebtorCardId
					where cd.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId2
					order by cm.SeqNo desc
					
					Update cd
					set cd.PrincipalTotal = cm.PrincipalTotal 
					, cd.PlannedInterestTotal = cm.PlannedInterestTotal
					, cd.DefaultInterestTotal = cm.DefaultInterestTotal
					, cd.AccruedInterestTotal = cm.AccruedInterestTotal
					, cd.DebtBalance = cm.DebtBalance
					, cd.SeqCurrent = cm.SeqNo
					, cd.SeqNext = cm.SeqNo +1
					, cd.InterestStartDate = cm.InterestStartDate
					, cd.InterestEndDate = cm.InterestEndDate
					, cd.InterestRate = cm.InterestRate
					, cd.InterestPlannedRate = cm.InterestPlannedRate
					, cd.InterestDefaultRate = cm.InterestDefaultRate
					from DataDebtorCardMovement cm
					left join DataDebtorCard cd on cd.DataDebtorCardId = cm.DebtorCardId
					where cm.DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId2
					and cm.SeqNo = @SeqNoLast2
					
					update cm
					set cm.TypeId = 8
					,cm.TypeCode = '08'
					,cm.TypeName= 'ยอดคงเหลือ'
					from DataDebtorCardMovement cm
					join DataDebtorCard cd on cd.DataDebtorCardId = cm.DebtorCardId
					where cm.DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId2 and cm.SeqNo = cd.SeqCurrent
					
					SET @PaymentBefore4 = dateadd(day, -1, @PaymentDate2)
	            	EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay_Horizontal] @PaymentBefore4, @DataDebtorCardId2, 1, @Today;
	                EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_005_eStatement] @PaymentDate2, @DataDebtorCardId2, @EStatementId2;
	                EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_006_InsertDebtorCard_Horizontal] @DataDebtorCardId2, @EStatementId2, 0;
	                EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay_Horizontal] @EOEnd2, @DataDebtorCardId2;
					EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_003_InsertBalance] @FirstDateOfMonth2, @DataDebtorCardId2, 1, @GetDate;
					EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay_Horizontal] @FirstDateOfMonth2, @DataDebtorCardId2;
					EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay_Horizontal] @Yesterday, @DataDebtorCardId2;
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
	                EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_005_eStatement] @GetDate, @DataDebtorCardId2, @EStatementId2;
					IF (@CountUpfront2 > 0)
					BEGIN
						EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_006_InsertDebtorCard_Horizontal] @DataDebtorCardId2, @EStatementId2, 1, 0, @GetDate, 1, 0;
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_006_InsertDebtorCard_Horizontal] @DataDebtorCardId2, @EStatementId2, 0, 0, @GetDate, 1, 0;
					END
				END

            	select top 1 @PrincipalPay2 = PrincipalPay, @AccruedInterestPay2 = AccruedInterestPay 
						from DataDebtorCardMovement
						where 
						DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId2
						and TypeId = 2
						and IsAdjust = 0
						order by SeqNo desc

                SET @j2 = 1;
                SET @k2 = 1;
                
				IF (@CountDPD2 > 0)
				BEGIN
					WHILE (@j2 <= @CountDPD2)
					BEGIN
						SET @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2a = (SELECT CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment2 where RowId = @j2);
						SET @OverdueAmount2 = (SELECT OverdueAmount from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment2 where RowId = @j2);
						SET @Total2 = (SELECT Total from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment2 where RowId = @j2);
						SET @Found0_2 = (SELECT CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment2
						where 
						(CAST(StartDate AS date) <= CAST(@PaymentDate2 AS date)
						and CAST(EndDate AS date) >= CAST(@PaymentDate2 AS date)));
				
						IF (@Found0_2 is not null)
						BEGIN
							update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
							set PrincipalPay = @PrincipalPay2
							,AccruedInterestPay = @AccruedInterestPay2
							,PaymentAmount = @PaymentAmount2
							,PaymentDate = @PaymentDate2
							where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @Found0_2
						END
						
						DECLARE @IsClearDPD2 bit = 0
				
						IF (@OverdueAmount2 > 0)
						BEGIN
							IF (@Amount2 >= @OverdueAmount2)
							BEGIN
								update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
								set isPayment = 1
								,OverdueAmount = 0
								where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2a
								SET @Amount2 = @Amount2 - @OverdueAmount2
								SET @IsClearDPD2 = 1
							END
							ELSE
							BEGIN
								SET @OverdueAmount2 = @OverdueAmount2 - @Amount2
								update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
								set isPayment = 0
								,OverdueAmount = @OverdueAmount2
								where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2a
								SET @Amount2 = 0
							END
						END
						ELSE
						BEGIN
							IF (@Amount2 >= @Total2)
							BEGIN
								update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
								set isPayment = 1
								,OverdueAmount = 0
								where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2a
								SET @Amount2 = @Amount2 - @Total2
								SET @IsClearDPD2 = 1
							END
							ELSE
							BEGIN
								update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
								set isPayment = 0
								,OverdueAmount = @Total2 - @Amount2
								where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2a
								SET @Amount2 = 0
							END
						END
						
						IF (@j2 = @CountDPD2)
						BEGIN
							SELECT 'AAAAAAA2'
							DECLARE @MinEndDate2 date = (SELECT TOP 1 EndDate from TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
							where IsPayment = 0
							AND DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId2
							AND CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId != @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2a
							ORDER BY Seq ASC);
							
							SELECT @MinEndDate2;
							
							IF (@MinEndDate2 is not null)
							BEGIN
								
								SELECT 'BBBBBBBB2';
							
								update DataDebtorCard 
								set DPD = 1
								, DFDDate = dateadd(day, +1, @MinEndDate2)
								WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId2
								
								SELECT 'CCCCCCC2';
							END
						END
						
						IF (@j2 = @CountDPD2 AND @IsClearDPD2 = 1)
						BEGIN
							update DataDebtorCard 
							set DPD = 0 
							, DFDDate = '1900-01-01'
							WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId2	
						END
						SET @j2 = @j2 + 1;
					END
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					IF (@CountUpfront2 > 0)
					BEGIN
						SELECT 'Upfront not in Date'
						WHILE (@k2 <= @CountUpfront2)
						BEGIN
							SET @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2b = (SELECT CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentUpfront2 where RowId = @k2);
							SET @Found2 = (SELECT CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentUpfront2
							where RowId = @k2
							and (CAST(StartDate AS date) <= CAST(@PaymentDate2 AS date)
							and CAST(EndDate AS date) >= CAST(@PaymentDate2 AS date)));
							SET @UpfrontAmount2 = (SELECT UpfrontAmount from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentUpfront2 where RowId = @k2);
							DECLARE @TotalUpfrontAmount2 decimal(20, 2) = (SELECT Total from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentUpfront2 where RowId = @k2);
						
							IF (@Found2 is not null)
							BEGIN
								IF (@PaymentAmount2 >= @UpfrontAmount2)
								BEGIN
									update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
									set isPayment = 1
									,PaymentAmount = PaymentAmount + @PaymentAmount2
									,PrincipalPay = PrincipalPay + @PaymentAmount2
									,PaymentDate = @PaymentDate2
									where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2b
								END
								ELSE
								BEGIN
									update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
									set isPayment = 0
									,PaymentAmount = PaymentAmount + @PaymentAmount2
									,PrincipalPay = PrincipalPay + @PaymentAmount2
									,PaymentDate = @PaymentDate2
									where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2b
								END
							END
							
							SET @SumPaymentAmount2 = (SELECT SUM(PaymentAmount) as SumPaymentAmount from TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment where DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId2 and IsUpfront = 1);
							
							IF (@k2 = @CountUpfront2)
							BEGIN
								SELECT @SumPaymentAmount2;
								SELECT @UpfrontAmount2;
								IF (@SumPaymentAmount2 >= @UpfrontAmount2)
								BEGIN
									SELECT 'SumPaymentAmount gather than UpfrontAmount not in date'
									
									SET @l2 = 1;
									WHILE (@l2 <= @k2)
									BEGIN
										SET @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2c = (SELECT CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentUpfront2 where RowId = @l2);
										
										update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
										set isPayment = 1
										where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2c
										
										SET @l2 = @l2 + 1;
									END
								END
							END
							SET @k2 = @k2 + 1;
						END
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						SET @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2d = (select top 1 a.CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId
						from TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment a
						where a.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId2
						and a.IsPayment = 0
						order by a.Seq ASC)
						
						update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
						set isPayment = 1
						,PaymentAmount = @PaymentAmount2
						,PrincipalPay = @PrincipalPay2
						,AccruedInterestPay= @AccruedInterestPay2
						where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2d
					END
				END

                UPDATE DataEStatement
                SET IsConfirm = 1 
                WHERE EStatementId = @EStatementId2;

                SET @i2 = @i2 + 1;
            END
--        END
    

	
	-------------------------------------------------------------------
	END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        PRINT 'ERROR: ' + ERROR_MESSAGE();
    END CATCH
END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_007_RunAllPaymentDebtorCard_Horizontal_Style_Safe]
--รับชำระ มาตรการ default ได้ข้อมูลการชำระตรงวัน และ ได้ข้อมูลการชำระ "ไม่ตรงวัน"
AS
BEGIN
    BEGIN TRY
        
        DECLARE @IsAuto bit = (SELECT IsAuto FROM SystemSettingPaymentMaster);
--		DECLARE @GetDate date = GETDATE(); -- วันที่จ่ายเงิน
        DECLARE @GetDate date = '2026-05-02'; -- วันที่จ่ายเงิน
		DECLARE @IsAdjust int = 0 --0 = รายการปกติ, 1=รายการที่ต้องปรับปรุง
		DECLARE @Yesterday date = dateadd(day, -1, getdate())

        -- ✅ รันเฉพาะเมื่อเปิดโหมด Auto  ได้ข้อมูลการชำระตรงวัน
--        IF (@IsAuto = 1)
--        BEGIN
--            
            DECLARE @CounteStatement int = (SELECT COUNT(*)
				FROM DataEStatement ds
				join DataDebtorCard ddc on ddc.DataDebtorCardId = ds.DebtorCardId 
				join SystemMeasureMaster smm on smm.MeasureId = ddc.MeasureId
				WHERE CAST(ds.PaymentDate AS date) = @GetDate
				AND ds.IsConfirm = 0 AND ds.IsCheck = 1
				AND smm.IsDefault = 0)
            

            DECLARE @i INT = 1;
            DECLARE @j INT = 1;
            DECLARE @k INT = 1;
            DECLARE @l INT = 1;
            DECLARE @DataDebtorCardId NVARCHAR(150);
            DECLARE @EStatementId NVARCHAR(150);
            DECLARE @PaymentDate NVARCHAR(150);
            DECLARE @Amount decimal(20, 2);
            DECLARE @PaymentAmount decimal(20, 2);
            DECLARE @SeqCurrent INT;
            DECLARE @DPD INT;
            DECLARE @InterestEndDate date;
            DECLARE @CountDPD int;
            DECLARE @CountUpfront int;
            DECLARE @PaymentBefore date;
            DECLARE @PaymentBefore2 date;
            DECLARE @EOEnd date;
            DECLARE @FirstDateOfMonth date;
            DECLARE @SeqNoLast int;
            DECLARE @PrincipalPay decimal(20, 2);
            DECLARE @AccruedInterestPay decimal(20, 2);
            DECLARE @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId NVARCHAR(150);
            DECLARE @OverdueAmount decimal(20, 2);
            DECLARE @Total decimal(20, 2);
            DECLARE @Found0 NVARCHAR(150);
            DECLARE @IsClearDPD bit;
            DECLARE @MinEndDate date;
            DECLARE @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2 NVARCHAR(150);
            DECLARE @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId3 NVARCHAR(150);
            DECLARE @Found NVARCHAR(150);
            DECLARE @UpfrontAmount decimal(20, 2);
            DECLARE @TotalUpfrontAmount decimal(20, 2);
            DECLARE @SumPaymentAmount decimal(20, 2);
            DECLARE @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId4 NVARCHAR(150);

			--===================================รับชำระตรงวัน
			--==============================================ตรงงวด
            SELECT 
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ds.EStatementId) AS RowId,
                ds.EStatementId,
                ds.DebtorCardId,
                ds.PaymentDate,
                ds.Amount
            INTO #TempDataEStatement
            FROM DataEStatement ds
            join DataDebtorCard ddc on ddc.DataDebtorCardId = ds.DebtorCardId 
			join SystemMeasureMaster smm on smm.MeasureId = ddc.MeasureId
            WHERE CAST(ds.PaymentDate AS date) = @GetDate
              AND ds.IsConfirm = 0
			  AND ds.IsCheck = 1
			  AND smm.IsDefault = 0; -- รายการที่ยังไม่ได้เอามาคำนวณ

            WHILE (@i <= @CounteStatement)
            BEGIN
                SET @DataDebtorCardId = (SELECT DebtorCardId FROM #TempDataEStatement WHERE RowId = @i);
                SET @EStatementId = (SELECT EStatementId FROM #TempDataEStatement WHERE RowId = @i);
            	SET @PaymentDate = (SELECT PaymentDate FROM #TempDataEStatement WHERE RowId = @i);
            	SET @Amount = (SELECT Amount FROM #TempDataEStatement WHERE RowId = @i);
            	SET @PaymentAmount = (SELECT Amount FROM #TempDataEStatement WHERE RowId = @i);
                SET @SeqCurrent = (SELECT SeqCurrent FROM DataDebtorCard WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId);
            	SET @DPD = (SELECT DPD FROM DataDebtorCard WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId);
            	SET @InterestEndDate = (SELECT InterestEndDate FROM DataDebtorCard WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId);

				IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment;

				SELECT 
					ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a.Seq ASC) as RowId,
					a.*
				INTO #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
				from TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment a
				where a.isPayment = 0 
				and a.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
				and a.StartDate <= @PaymentDate
				and a.IsUpfront = 0
				order by a.Seq ASC
				
				SET @CountDPD = (SELECT count(*) from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment)

				IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentUpfront') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentUpfront;

				SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a.Seq ASC) as RowId, a.*, b.UpfrontAmount
				INTO #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentUpfront
				FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment AS a
				join TDRDataCompromiseContract b on b.CompromiseContractId = a.CompromiseContractId
				WHERE a.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
				and a.IsPayment = 0
				and a.IsUpfront  = 1
				ORDER BY a.Seq ASC
				
				SET @CountUpfront = (SELECT count(*) from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentUpfront)
				
				IF (MONTH(@PaymentDate) = MONTH(@InterestEndDate)
					AND YEAR(@PaymentDate) = YEAR(@InterestEndDate)
					AND DAY(@PaymentDate) <= DAY(@InterestEndDate))
				BEGIN
					SET @PaymentBefore = dateadd(day, -1, @PaymentDate)
					EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay_Horizontal] @PaymentBefore, @DataDebtorCardId, 1, @GetDate;
					EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_005_eStatement] @PaymentDate, @DataDebtorCardId, @EStatementId;
					EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_006_InsertDebtorCard_Horizontal] @DataDebtorCardId, @EStatementId, 0, 0, @GetDate, 1, 0;
					EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay_Horizontal] @Yesterday, @DataDebtorCardId;
				END
				ELSE IF (MONTH(@PaymentDate) = MONTH(@InterestEndDate)
					AND YEAR(@PaymentDate) = YEAR(@InterestEndDate)
					AND DAY(@PaymentDate) = DAY(@InterestEndDate))
				BEGIN
					EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_005_eStatement] @GetDate, @DataDebtorCardId, @EStatementId;
					EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_006_InsertDebtorCard_Horizontal] @DataDebtorCardId, @EStatementId, 0, 0, @GetDate, 1, 0;
					EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay_Horizontal] @Yesterday, @DataDebtorCardId;
				END
				ELSE IF (MONTH(@PaymentDate) < MONTH(@InterestEndDate)
					AND YEAR(@PaymentDate) = YEAR(@InterestEndDate))
				BEGIN
					SET @EOEnd = (SELECT EOMONTH(@PaymentDate) AS LastDayOfCurrentMonth);
					SET @FirstDateOfMonth = dateadd(day, +1, @EOEnd)
					DELETE ddcm from DataDebtorCardMovement ddcm
					join DataDebtorCard ddc on ddc.DataDebtorCardId = ddcm.DebtorCardId where ddcm.DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId and ddcm.SeqNo = ddc.SeqCurrent;
				
					SET @SeqNoLast = 0
					
					select top 1
					@SeqNoLast =  cm.SeqNo 
					from DataDebtorCardMovement cm
					left join DataDebtorCard cd on cd.DataDebtorCardId = cm.DebtorCardId
					where cd.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
					order by cm.SeqNo desc
					
					Update cd
					set cd.PrincipalTotal = cm.PrincipalTotal 
					, cd.PlannedInterestTotal = cm.PlannedInterestTotal
					, cd.DefaultInterestTotal = cm.DefaultInterestTotal
					, cd.AccruedInterestTotal = cm.AccruedInterestTotal
					, cd.DebtBalance = cm.DebtBalance
					, cd.SeqCurrent = cm.SeqNo
					, cd.SeqNext = cm.SeqNo +1
					, cd.InterestStartDate = cm.InterestStartDate
					, cd.InterestEndDate = cm.InterestEndDate
					, cd.InterestRate = cm.InterestRate
					, cd.InterestPlannedRate = cm.InterestPlannedRate
					, cd.InterestDefaultRate = cm.InterestDefaultRate
				
					
					from DataDebtorCardMovement cm
					left join DataDebtorCard cd on cd.DataDebtorCardId = cm.DebtorCardId
					where cm.DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
					and cm.SeqNo = @SeqNoLast
					
					update cm
					set cm.TypeId = 8
					,cm.TypeCode = '08'
					,cm.TypeName= 'ยอดคงเหลือ'
					from DataDebtorCardMovement cm
					join DataDebtorCard cd on cd.DataDebtorCardId = cm.DebtorCardId
					where cm.DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId and cm.SeqNo = cd.SeqCurrent
					
					SET @PaymentBefore2 = dateadd(day, -1, @PaymentDate)
	            	-- update ดอกเบี้ยย้อนหลัง paymentDate -1
	            	EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay_Horizontal] @PaymentBefore2, @DataDebtorCardId, 1, @GetDate;
	            
	                -- Insert รายการจาก eStatement
	                EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_005_eStatement] @PaymentDate, @DataDebtorCardId, @EStatementId;
	
	                -- ตัดชำระ
	                EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_006_InsertDebtorCard_Horizontal] @DataDebtorCardId, @EStatementId, 0;
	
					-- ดอกเบี้ยรายวัน
	                EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay_Horizontal] @EOEnd, @DataDebtorCardId;
					
					EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_003_InsertBalance] @FirstDateOfMonth, @DataDebtorCardId, 1, @GetDate;
					
					EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay_Horizontal] @FirstDateOfMonth, @DataDebtorCardId;
					
					EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay_Horizontal] @Yesterday, @DataDebtorCardId;
					
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					
					-- Insert รายการจาก eStatement
	                EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_005_eStatement] @GetDate, @DataDebtorCardId, @EStatementId;
	                -- ตัดชำระ
					IF (@CountUpfront > 0)
					BEGIN
						EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_006_InsertDebtorCard_Horizontal] @DataDebtorCardId, @EStatementId, 1, 0, @GetDate, 1, 0;
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_006_InsertDebtorCard_Horizontal] @DataDebtorCardId, @EStatementId, 0, 0, @GetDate, 1, 0;
					END
				
				END
				
				--
                --EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_039_UpdateInstallmentPlanPayment] @DataDebtorCardId, @EStatementId;
                
--				DECLARE @DefaultRate int = (SELECT top 1 sim.DefaultRate FROM SystemInterateMaster AS sim WHERE InterateTypeId = 112 and IsActive = 1 ORDER BY sim.UpdateDate DESC)
				

            	select top 1 @PrincipalPay = PrincipalPay, @AccruedInterestPay = AccruedInterestPay 
						from DataDebtorCardMovement
						where 
						DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
						and TypeId = 2
						and IsAdjust = 0
						order by SeqNo desc
						
                SET @j = 1;
                SET @k = 1;
                
				IF (@CountDPD > 0)
				BEGIN
					WHILE (@j <= @CountDPD)
					BEGIN
						SET @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = (SELECT CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment where RowId = @j);
						SET @OverdueAmount = (SELECT OverdueAmount from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment where RowId = @j);
						SET @Total = (SELECT Total from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment where RowId = @j);
						SET @Found0 = (SELECT CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
						where 
						--RowId = @j and
						(CAST(StartDate AS date) <= CAST(@PaymentDate AS date)
						and CAST(EndDate AS date) >= CAST(@PaymentDate AS date)));
--						and (StartDate <= @PaymentDate
--						and EndDate >= @PaymentDate));
				
						SET @IsClearDPD = 0
						
						IF (@Found0 is not null)
						BEGIN
							update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
							set PrincipalPay = @PrincipalPay
							,AccruedInterestPay = @AccruedInterestPay
							,PaymentAmount = @PaymentAmount
							,PaymentDate = @PaymentDate
							where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @Found0
						END
				
						IF (@OverdueAmount > 0)
						BEGIN
							IF (@Amount >= @OverdueAmount)
							BEGIN
								update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
								set isPayment = 1
								,OverdueAmount = 0
								where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId
								SET @Amount = @Amount - @OverdueAmount
								SET @IsClearDPD = 1
							END
							ELSE
							BEGIN
								SET @OverdueAmount = @OverdueAmount - @Amount
								update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
								set isPayment = 0
								,OverdueAmount = @OverdueAmount
								where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId
								SET @Amount = 0
							END
						END
						ELSE
						BEGIN
							IF (@Amount >= @Total)
							BEGIN
								update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
								set isPayment = 1
								,OverdueAmount = 0
								where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId
								SET @Amount = @Amount - @Total
								SET @IsClearDPD = 1
							END
							ELSE
							BEGIN
								update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
								set isPayment = 0
								,OverdueAmount = @Total - @Amount
								where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId
								SET @Amount = 0
							END
						END
						
						IF (@j = @CountDPD)
						BEGIN
							SET @MinEndDate = (SELECT TOP 1 EndDate from TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
							where IsPayment = 0
							AND DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
							AND CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId != @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId
							ORDER BY Seq ASC);
							
							IF (@MinEndDate is not null)
							BEGIN
								update DataDebtorCard 
								set DPD = 1
								, DFDDate = dateadd(day, +1, @MinEndDate)
								WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
							END
						END
						
						
						IF (@j = @CountDPD AND @IsClearDPD = 1)
						BEGIN
							update DataDebtorCard 
							set DPD = 0 
							, DFDDate = '1900-01-01'
							WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId	
						END
						SET @j = @j + 1;
					END
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					IF (@CountUpfront > 0)
					BEGIN
						
						WHILE (@k <= @CountUpfront)
						BEGIN
							SET @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId3 = (SELECT CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentUpfront where RowId = @k);
							SET @Found = (SELECT CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentUpfront
							where RowId = @k
							and (CAST(StartDate AS date) <= CAST(@PaymentDate AS date)
							and CAST(EndDate AS date) >= CAST(@PaymentDate AS date)));

							SET @UpfrontAmount = (SELECT UpfrontAmount from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentUpfront where RowId = @k);
							SET @TotalUpfrontAmount = (SELECT Total from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentUpfront where RowId = @k);
						
							IF (@Found is not null)
							BEGIN
								IF (@PaymentAmount >= @UpfrontAmount)
								BEGIN
									update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
									set isPayment = 1
									,PaymentAmount = PaymentAmount + @PaymentAmount
									,PrincipalPay = PrincipalPay + @PaymentAmount
									,PaymentDate = @PaymentDate
									where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId3
								END
								ELSE
								BEGIN
									update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
									set isPayment = 0
									,PaymentAmount = PaymentAmount + @PaymentAmount
									,PrincipalPay = PrincipalPay + @PaymentAmount
									,PaymentDate = @PaymentDate
									where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId3
								END
							END
							
							SET @SumPaymentAmount = (SELECT SUM(PaymentAmount) as SumPaymentAmount from TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment where DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId and IsUpfront = 1);
							
							IF (@k = @CountUpfront)
							BEGIN
								IF (@SumPaymentAmount >= @UpfrontAmount)
								BEGIN
									SET @l = 1;
									WHILE (@l <= @k)
									BEGIN
										SET @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId4 = (SELECT CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentUpfront where RowId = @l);
										
										update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
										set isPayment = 1
										where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId4
										
										SET @l = @l + 1;
									END
								END
							END
							SET @k = @k + 1;
						END
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						SET @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2 = (select top 1 a.CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId
						from TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment a
						where a.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
						and a.IsPayment = 0
						order by a.Seq ASC)
						
						update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
						set isPayment = 1
						,PaymentAmount = @PaymentAmount
						,PrincipalPay = @PrincipalPay
						,AccruedInterestPay= @AccruedInterestPay
						where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2
					END
				END
				

                -- อัปเดตสถานะ
                UPDATE DataEStatement
                SET IsConfirm = 1 
                WHERE EStatementId = @EStatementId;

                SET @i = @i + 1;
            END
--        END
            
            
            

		----------------------------------------------------------------------
		-------------------- ได้ข้อมูลการชำระ "ไม่ตรงวัน"----------------------------
		----------------------------------------------------------------------
--		IF (@IsAuto = 1)
--        BEGIN
--
            DECLARE @CounteStatement2 int = (SELECT COUNT(*)
				FROM DataEStatement ds
				join DataDebtorCard ddc on ddc.DataDebtorCardId = ds.DebtorCardId
				join SystemMeasureMaster smm on smm.MeasureId = ddc.MeasureId
				WHERE CAST(ds.PaymentDate AS date) < @GetDate
				AND ds.IsConfirm = 0 AND ds.IsCheck = 1
				AND smm.IsDefault = 0);
            DECLARE @i2 INT = 1;
            DECLARE @Today  date = getdate();
            DECLARE @j2 INT = 1;
            DECLARE @k2 INT = 1;
            DECLARE @l2 INT = 1;
            DECLARE @DataDebtorCardId2 NVARCHAR(150);
            DECLARE @EStatementId2 NVARCHAR(150);
            DECLARE @PaymentDate2 date;
            DECLARE @Amount2 decimal(20, 2);
            DECLARE @PaymentAmount2 decimal(20, 2);
            DECLARE @SeqCurrent2 INT;
            DECLARE @InterestEndDate2 date;
            DECLARE @CountDPD2 int;
            DECLARE @CountUpfront2 int;
            DECLARE @PaymentBefore3 date;
            DECLARE @EOEnd2 date;
            DECLARE @FirstDateOfMonth2 date;
            DECLARE @SeqNoLast2 int;
            DECLARE @PaymentBefore4 date;
            DECLARE @PrincipalPay2 decimal(20, 2);
            DECLARE @AccruedInterestPay2 decimal(20, 2);
            DECLARE @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2a NVARCHAR(150);
            DECLARE @OverdueAmount2 decimal(20, 2);
            DECLARE @Total2 decimal(20, 2);
            DECLARE @Found0_2 NVARCHAR(150);
            DECLARE @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2b NVARCHAR(150);
            DECLARE @Found2 NVARCHAR(150);
            DECLARE @UpfrontAmount2 decimal(20, 2);
            DECLARE @SumPaymentAmount2 decimal(20, 2);
            DECLARE @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2c NVARCHAR(150);
            DECLARE @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2d NVARCHAR(150);
            DECLARE @IsClearDPD2 bit;
            DECLARE @MinEndDate2 date;
            DECLARE @TotalUpfrontAmount2 decimal(20, 2);

            SELECT 
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ds.EStatementId) AS RowId,
                ds.EStatementId,
                ds.DebtorCardId,
                ds.PaymentDate,
                ds.Amount
            INTO #TempDataEStatement2
            FROM DataEStatement ds
            join DataDebtorCard ddc on ddc.DataDebtorCardId = ds.DebtorCardId
			join SystemMeasureMaster smm on smm.MeasureId = ddc.MeasureId
            WHERE CAST(ds.PaymentDate AS date) < @GetDate
              AND ds.IsConfirm = 0
              AND ds.IsCheck = 1
			  AND smm.IsDefault = 0; -- รายการที่ยังไม่ได้เอามาคำนวณ
			
            WHILE (@i2 <= @CounteStatement2)
            BEGIN
	            SET @DataDebtorCardId2 = (SELECT DebtorCardId FROM #TempDataEStatement2 WHERE RowId = @i2);
                SET @EStatementId2 = (SELECT EStatementId FROM #TempDataEStatement2 WHERE RowId = @i2);
                SET @PaymentDate2 = (SELECT PaymentDate FROM #TempDataEStatement2 WHERE RowId = @i2);
            	SET @Amount2 = (SELECT Amount FROM #TempDataEStatement2 WHERE RowId = @i2);
            	SET @PaymentAmount2 = (SELECT Amount FROM #TempDataEStatement2 WHERE RowId = @i2);
                SET @SeqCurrent2 = (SELECT SeqCurrent FROM DataDebtorCard WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId2);
                SET @InterestEndDate2 = (SELECT InterestEndDate FROM DataDebtorCard WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId2);

				IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment2') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment2;

				SELECT 
					ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a.Seq ASC) as RowId,
					a.*
				INTO #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment2
				from TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment a
				where a.isPayment = 0 
				and a.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId2
				and a.StartDate <= @PaymentDate2
				and a.IsUpfront = 0
				order by a.Seq ASC
				
				SET @CountDPD2 = (SELECT count(*) from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment2)

				IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentUpfront2') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentUpfront2;

				SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a.Seq ASC) as RowId, a.*, b.UpfrontAmount
				INTO #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentUpfront2
				FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment AS a
				join TDRDataCompromiseContract b on b.CompromiseContractId = a.CompromiseContractId
				WHERE a.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId2
				and a.IsPayment = 0
				and a.IsUpfront  = 1
				ORDER BY a.Seq ASC
				
				SET @CountUpfront2 = (SELECT count(*) from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentUpfront2)

				IF (MONTH(@PaymentDate2) = MONTH(@InterestEndDate2)
					AND YEAR(@PaymentDate2) = YEAR(@InterestEndDate2)
					AND DAY(@PaymentDate2) <= DAY(@InterestEndDate2))
				BEGIN
	            	SET @PaymentBefore3 = dateadd(day, -1, @PaymentDate2)
	            	EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay_Horizontal] @PaymentBefore3, @DataDebtorCardId2, 1, @Today;
	                EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_005_eStatement] @PaymentDate2, @DataDebtorCardId2, @EStatementId2;
	                EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_006_InsertDebtorCard_Horizontal] @DataDebtorCardId2, @EStatementId2, 0, 0, @GetDate, 1, 0;
	                EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay_Horizontal] @Yesterday, @DataDebtorCardId2;
				END
				ELSE IF (MONTH(@PaymentDate2) = MONTH(@InterestEndDate2)
					AND YEAR(@PaymentDate2) = YEAR(@InterestEndDate2)
					AND DAY(@PaymentDate2) = DAY(@InterestEndDate2))
				BEGIN
					EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_005_eStatement] @GetDate, @DataDebtorCardId2, @EStatementId2;
					EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_006_InsertDebtorCard_Horizontal] @DataDebtorCardId2, @EStatementId2, 0, 0, @GetDate, 1, 0;
					EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay_Horizontal] @Yesterday, @DataDebtorCardId2;
				END
				ELSE IF (MONTH(@PaymentDate2) < MONTH(@InterestEndDate2)
					AND YEAR(@PaymentDate2) = YEAR(@InterestEndDate2))
				BEGIN
					SET @EOEnd2 = (SELECT EOMONTH(@PaymentDate2) AS LastDayOfCurrentMonth);
					SET @FirstDateOfMonth2 = dateadd(day, +1, @EOEnd2)
					DELETE ddcm from DataDebtorCardMovement ddcm
					join DataDebtorCard ddc on ddc.DataDebtorCardId = ddcm.DebtorCardId where ddcm.DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId2 and ddcm.SeqNo = ddc.SeqCurrent;
				
					SET @SeqNoLast2 = 0
					
					select top 1
					@SeqNoLast2 =  cm.SeqNo 
					from DataDebtorCardMovement cm
					left join DataDebtorCard cd on cd.DataDebtorCardId = cm.DebtorCardId
					where cd.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId2
					order by cm.SeqNo desc
					
					Update cd
					set cd.PrincipalTotal = cm.PrincipalTotal 
					, cd.PlannedInterestTotal = cm.PlannedInterestTotal
					, cd.DefaultInterestTotal = cm.DefaultInterestTotal
					, cd.AccruedInterestTotal = cm.AccruedInterestTotal
					, cd.DebtBalance = cm.DebtBalance
					, cd.SeqCurrent = cm.SeqNo
					, cd.SeqNext = cm.SeqNo +1
					, cd.InterestStartDate = cm.InterestStartDate
					, cd.InterestEndDate = cm.InterestEndDate
					, cd.InterestRate = cm.InterestRate
					, cd.InterestPlannedRate = cm.InterestPlannedRate
					, cd.InterestDefaultRate = cm.InterestDefaultRate
					from DataDebtorCardMovement cm
					left join DataDebtorCard cd on cd.DataDebtorCardId = cm.DebtorCardId
					where cm.DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId2
					and cm.SeqNo = @SeqNoLast2
					
					update cm
					set cm.TypeId = 8
					,cm.TypeCode = '08'
					,cm.TypeName= 'ยอดคงเหลือ'
					from DataDebtorCardMovement cm
					join DataDebtorCard cd on cd.DataDebtorCardId = cm.DebtorCardId
					where cm.DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId2 and cm.SeqNo = cd.SeqCurrent
					
					SET @PaymentBefore4 = dateadd(day, -1, @PaymentDate2)
	            	EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay_Horizontal] @PaymentBefore4, @DataDebtorCardId2, 1, @Today;
	                EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_005_eStatement] @PaymentDate2, @DataDebtorCardId2, @EStatementId2;
	                EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_006_InsertDebtorCard_Horizontal] @DataDebtorCardId2, @EStatementId2, 0;
	                EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay_Horizontal] @EOEnd2, @DataDebtorCardId2;
					EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_003_InsertBalance] @FirstDateOfMonth2, @DataDebtorCardId2, 1, @GetDate;
					EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay_Horizontal] @FirstDateOfMonth2, @DataDebtorCardId2;
					EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay_Horizontal] @Yesterday, @DataDebtorCardId2;
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
	                EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_005_eStatement] @GetDate, @DataDebtorCardId2, @EStatementId2;
					IF (@CountUpfront2 > 0)
					BEGIN
						EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_006_InsertDebtorCard_Horizontal] @DataDebtorCardId2, @EStatementId2, 1, 0, @GetDate, 1, 0;
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_006_InsertDebtorCard_Horizontal] @DataDebtorCardId2, @EStatementId2, 0, 0, @GetDate, 1, 0;
					END
				END

            	select top 1 @PrincipalPay2 = PrincipalPay, @AccruedInterestPay2 = AccruedInterestPay 
						from DataDebtorCardMovement
						where 
						DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId2
						and TypeId = 2
						and IsAdjust = 0
						order by SeqNo desc

                SET @j2 = 1;
                SET @k2 = 1;
                
				IF (@CountDPD2 > 0)
				BEGIN
					WHILE (@j2 <= @CountDPD2)
					BEGIN
						SET @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2a = (SELECT CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment2 where RowId = @j2);
						SET @OverdueAmount2 = (SELECT OverdueAmount from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment2 where RowId = @j2);
						SET @Total2 = (SELECT Total from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment2 where RowId = @j2);
						SET @Found0_2 = (SELECT CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment2
						where 
						(CAST(StartDate AS date) <= CAST(@PaymentDate2 AS date)
						and CAST(EndDate AS date) >= CAST(@PaymentDate2 AS date)));
				
						IF (@Found0_2 is not null)
						BEGIN
							update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
							set PrincipalPay = @PrincipalPay2
							,AccruedInterestPay = @AccruedInterestPay2
							,PaymentAmount = @PaymentAmount2
							,PaymentDate = @PaymentDate2
							where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @Found0_2
						END
						
						SET @IsClearDPD2 = 0
				
						IF (@OverdueAmount2 > 0)
						BEGIN
							IF (@Amount2 >= @OverdueAmount2)
							BEGIN
								update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
								set isPayment = 1
								,OverdueAmount = 0
								where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2a
								SET @Amount2 = @Amount2 - @OverdueAmount2
								SET @IsClearDPD2 = 1
							END
							ELSE
							BEGIN
								SET @OverdueAmount2 = @OverdueAmount2 - @Amount2
								update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
								set isPayment = 0
								,OverdueAmount = @OverdueAmount2
								where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2a
								SET @Amount2 = 0
							END
						END
						ELSE
						BEGIN
							IF (@Amount2 >= @Total2)
							BEGIN
								update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
								set isPayment = 1
								,OverdueAmount = 0
								where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2a
								SET @Amount2 = @Amount2 - @Total2
								SET @IsClearDPD2 = 1
							END
							ELSE
							BEGIN
								update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
								set isPayment = 0
								,OverdueAmount = @Total2 - @Amount2
								where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2a
								SET @Amount2 = 0
							END
						END
						
						IF (@j2 = @CountDPD2)
						BEGIN
							SET @MinEndDate2 = (SELECT TOP 1 EndDate from TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
							where IsPayment = 0
							AND DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId2
							AND CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId != @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2a
							ORDER BY Seq ASC);
							
							IF (@MinEndDate2 is not null)
							BEGIN
								update DataDebtorCard 
								set DPD = 1
								, DFDDate = dateadd(day, +1, @MinEndDate2)
								WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId2
							END
						END
						
						IF (@j2 = @CountDPD2 AND @IsClearDPD2 = 1)
						BEGIN
							update DataDebtorCard 
							set DPD = 0 
							, DFDDate = '1900-01-01'
							WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId2	
						END
						SET @j2 = @j2 + 1;
					END
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					IF (@CountUpfront2 > 0)
					BEGIN
						WHILE (@k2 <= @CountUpfront2)
						BEGIN
							SET @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2b = (SELECT CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentUpfront2 where RowId = @k2);
							SET @Found2 = (SELECT CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentUpfront2
							where RowId = @k2
							and (CAST(StartDate AS date) <= CAST(@PaymentDate2 AS date)
							and CAST(EndDate AS date) >= CAST(@PaymentDate2 AS date)));
							SET @UpfrontAmount2 = (SELECT UpfrontAmount from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentUpfront2 where RowId = @k2);
							SET @TotalUpfrontAmount2 = (SELECT Total from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentUpfront2 where RowId = @k2);
						
							IF (@Found2 is not null)
							BEGIN
								IF (@PaymentAmount2 >= @UpfrontAmount2)
								BEGIN
									update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
									set isPayment = 1
									,PaymentAmount = PaymentAmount + @PaymentAmount2
									,PrincipalPay = PrincipalPay + @PaymentAmount2
									,PaymentDate = @PaymentDate2
									where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2b
								END
								ELSE
								BEGIN
									update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
									set isPayment = 0
									,PaymentAmount = PaymentAmount + @PaymentAmount2
									,PrincipalPay = PrincipalPay + @PaymentAmount2
									,PaymentDate = @PaymentDate2
									where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2b
								END
							END
							
							SET @SumPaymentAmount2 = (SELECT SUM(PaymentAmount) as SumPaymentAmount from TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment where DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId2 and IsUpfront = 1);
							
							IF (@k2 = @CountUpfront2)
							BEGIN
								IF (@SumPaymentAmount2 >= @UpfrontAmount2)
								BEGIN
									SET @l2 = 1;
									WHILE (@l2 <= @k2)
									BEGIN
										SET @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2c = (SELECT CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentUpfront2 where RowId = @l2);
										
										update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
										set isPayment = 1
										where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2c
										
										SET @l2 = @l2 + 1;
									END
								END
							END
							SET @k2 = @k2 + 1;
						END
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						SET @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2d = (select top 1 a.CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId
						from TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment a
						where a.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId2
						and a.IsPayment = 0
						order by a.Seq ASC)
						
						update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
						set isPayment = 1
						,PaymentAmount = @PaymentAmount2
						,PrincipalPay = @PrincipalPay2
						,AccruedInterestPay= @AccruedInterestPay2
						where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2d
					END
				END

                UPDATE DataEStatement
                SET IsConfirm = 1 
                WHERE EStatementId = @EStatementId2;

                SET @i2 = @i2 + 1;
            END
--        END
    

	
	-------------------------------------------------------------------
	END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        PRINT 'ERROR: ' + ERROR_MESSAGE();
    END CATCH
END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_007_RunAllPaymentDebtorCard_Upfront_Horizontal]
AS
BEGIN
    BEGIN TRY
        
        DECLARE @IsAuto bit = (SELECT IsAuto FROM SystemSettingPaymentMaster);
--		DECLARE @GetDate date = GETDATE(); -- วันที่จ่ายเงิน
        DECLARE @GetDate date = '2026-05-29'; -- วันที่จ่ายเงิน
        DECLARE @IsAdjust int = 0 --0 = รายการปกติ, 1=รายการที่ต้องปรับปรุง


        -- ✅ รันเฉพาะเมื่อเปิดโหมด Auto  ได้ข้อมูลการชำระตรงวัน
--        IF (@IsAuto = 1)
--        BEGIN
--            
        DECLARE @CounteStatement int = 
				(SELECT COUNT(*)
				FROM DataEStatement ds
				join DataDebtorCard ddc on ddc.DataDebtorCardId = ds.DebtorCardId 
				join SystemMeasureMaster smm on smm.MeasureId = ddc.MeasureId
				WHERE CAST(ds.PaymentDate AS date) = @GetDate
				AND ds.IsConfirm = 0 AND ds.IsCheck = 1
				AND smm.IsDefault = 0)
            

            DECLARE @i INT = 1;

            SELECT 
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY e.EStatementId) AS RowId,
                e.EStatementId,
                e.DebtorCardId,
                e.PaymentDate,
                e.Amount
            INTO #TempDataEStatement
            FROM DataEStatement e
            WHERE CAST(e.PaymentDate AS date) = @GetDate
              AND IsConfirm = 0
			  AND IsCheck = 1; -- รายการที่ยังไม่ได้เอามาคำนวณ

            WHILE (@i <= @CounteStatement)
            BEGIN
                DECLARE @DataDebtorCardId NVARCHAR(150) 
								DECLARE @CompromiseContractId NVARCHAR(150)
                DECLARE @EStatementId NVARCHAR(150)
            	DECLARE @PaymentDate NVARCHAR(150) 
            	DECLARE @Amount NVARCHAR(150) 
            	DECLARE @PaymentAmount NVARCHAR(150) 
                DECLARE @SeqCurrent INT 
            	DECLARE @DPD INT 
            
						
						--ใส่ค่า จาก TempDataEStatement
						SELECT @DataDebtorCardId = DebtorCardId 
						, @EStatementId = EStatementId
						, @PaymentDate = PaymentDate
						, @Amount = Amount
						, @PaymentAmount = Amount
						 
						FROM #TempDataEStatement 
						WHERE RowId = @i
						
						
						--ใส่ค่า จาก DataDebtorCard
						SELECT @SeqCurrent = SeqCurrent 
						, @CompromiseContractId = CompromiseContractId
						, @DPD = DPD
						FROM DataDebtorCard WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
					
						
						
						
            	DECLARE @PrincipalPay decimal(20, 2)
            	DECLARE @AccruedInterestPay decimal(20, 2)
            	select top 1 @PrincipalPay = PrincipalPay, @AccruedInterestPay = AccruedInterestPay 
						from DataDebtorCardMovement
						where 
						DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
						and TypeId = 2
						and IsAdjust = 0
						order by SeqNo desc
				
				SELECT 
					ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a.Seq ASC) as RowId,
					a.*
				INTO #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
				from TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment a
				where a.isPayment = 0 
				and a.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
				and a.StartDate <= @PaymentDate
				and a.CompromiseContractId = @CompromiseContractId
				order by a.Seq ASC
				
				DECLARE @CountDPD int = (SELECT count(*) #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment)
				
				
				-- Insert รายการจาก eStatement
                EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_005_eStatement] @GetDate, @DataDebtorCardId, @EStatementId;
                -- ตัดชำระ
                EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_006_InsertDebtorCard_Horizontal] @DataDebtorCardId, @EStatementId, 0, 0, @GetDate, 1, 0;
                
                EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_039_UpdateInstallmentPlanPayment] @DataDebtorCardId, @EStatementId;
                
--				DECLARE @DefaultRate int = (SELECT top 1 sim.DefaultRate FROM SystemInterateMaster AS sim WHERE InterateTypeId = 112 and IsActive = 1 ORDER BY sim.UpdateDate DESC)
				
                DECLARE @j INT = 1;
                
				IF (@CountDPD > 0)
				BEGIN
					WHILE (@j <= @CountDPD)
					BEGIN
						DECLARE @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId NVARCHAR(150) = (SELECT CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment where RowId = @j);
						DECLARE @OverdueAmount decimal(20, 2) = (SELECT OverdueAmount from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment where RowId = @j);
						DECLARE @Total decimal(20, 2) = (SELECT Total from #TempTDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment where RowId = @j);
				
						
				
						IF (@OverdueAmount > 0)
						BEGIN
							IF (@Amount >= @OverdueAmount)
							BEGIN
								SET @Amount = @Amount - @OverdueAmount
								update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
								set isPayment = 1
								,OverdueAmount = 0
								,PaymentAmount = @PaymentAmount
								,PrincipalPay = @PrincipalPay
								,AccruedInterestPay = @AccruedInterestPay
								where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId
							END
							ELSE
							BEGIN
								SET @OverdueAmount = @OverdueAmount - @Amount
								update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
								set isPayment = 0
								,OverdueAmount = @OverdueAmount
								,PaymentAmount = @PaymentAmount
								,PrincipalPay = @PrincipalPay
								,AccruedInterestPay = @AccruedInterestPay
								where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId
							END
						END
						ELSE
						BEGIN
							IF (@Amount >= @Total)
							BEGIN
								update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
								set isPayment = 1
								,PaymentAmount = @PaymentAmount
								,PrincipalPay = @PrincipalPay
								,AccruedInterestPay= @AccruedInterestPay
								where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId
							END
							ELSE
							BEGIN
								update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
								set isPayment = 0
								,OverdueAmount = @Total - @Amount
								,PaymentAmount = @PaymentAmount
								,PrincipalPay = @PrincipalPay
								,AccruedInterestPay = @AccruedInterestPay
								where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId
							END
						END
						
					-- 1 05-31 05, 1 06-31 06
	                -- overdue, ispayment
	                -- ตัดงวดต่ำสุด แล้วตัด OverdueAmount
						IF (@j = @CountDPD)
						BEGIN
							update DataDebtorCard set DPD = 0 WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId	
						END
					END
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					DECLARE @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2 NVARCHAR(150) = (select top 1 a.CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId
					from TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment a
					where a.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
					and a.IsPayment = 0
					order by a.Seq ASC)
					
					update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
					set isPayment = 1
					,PaymentAmount = @PaymentAmount
					,PrincipalPay = @PrincipalPay
					,AccruedInterestPay= @AccruedInterestPay
					where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = @CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId2
				END
				

                -- อัปเดตสถานะ
                UPDATE DataEStatement
                SET IsConfirm = 1 
                WHERE EStatementId = @EStatementId;

                SET @i = @i + 1;
            END
--        END
            
	END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        PRINT 'ERROR: ' + ERROR_MESSAGE();
    END CATCH
END;
