CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_008_UpdateDataDebtorCardSubToMain]

	@CurrentDate date = '2025-10-05 00:00:00.000' --วันที่จ่ายเงิน
	,@Amount decimal(20,4) = 10000
	,@DataDebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = 'F70BC1D3-5499-425C-97E9-00192B895750'
	--,@TypeId int = 1 --1=insert ดอกเบี้ยผิดนัด ทุกมาตรการ, 2=insert ดอกเบี้ยเดิม (ปิดแผน) 
	,@LGNo nvarchar(20) = '65067431'

AS
BEGIN
declare @DataDebtorCardMainId nvarchar(150) = (select top 1 DataDebtorCardId from DataDebtorCard where LGNo = @LGNo and DebtorRelateTypeId = 1)
declare @SeqCurrent int = (select SeqCurrent from DataDebtorCard where DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardMainId )
declare @InterestRate decimal(20,4) 
declare @InterestPlannedRate decimal(20,4)  
declare @InterestDefaultRate decimal(20,4)  

declare @EndDate datetime = (select InterestEndDate + 1 from DataDebtorCardMovement where DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardMainId and SeqNo = @SeqCurrent)


DECLARE @DaysInYear INT = DATEDIFF(DAY, cast(year(getdate()) as nvarchar) + '-01-01', cast(year(getdate()) as nvarchar) + '-12-31') + 1;
DECLARE @PaymentTypeId int = 18 --ปรับปรุงรายการเงินต้นจากการ์ดผู้ค้ำ
DECLARE @PaymentTypeCode nvarchar(2) =(select PaymentTypeCode from SystemPaymentType where PaymentTypeId = @PaymentTypeId)
DECLARE @PaymentTypeName nvarchar(100) =(select PaymentTypeName from SystemPaymentType where PaymentTypeId = @PaymentTypeId)

DECLARE @GetCountCard int = (select count(*)+1 from DataDebtorCard where LGNo = @LGNo and DebtorRelateTypeId = 2 ) --and CardStatusId != 1
DECLARE @DebtBalance decimal(20,4) = isnull((select top 1 DebtBalance from DataDebtorCard where DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardMainId) - @Amount,0)
select @InterestRate = InterestRate
, @InterestPlannedRate = InterestPlannedRate
, @InterestDefaultRate = InterestDefaultRate
from DataDebtorCard where DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardMainId 
select @SeqCurrent

Declare @Id nvarchar(150) = newid()
--IF @CurrentDate = EOMONTH(@CurrentDate)
--begin
--    PRINT 'เป็นวันสิ้นเดือน'

--end
--ELSE
--    PRINT 'ไม่ใช่วันสิ้นเดือน'
INSERT INTO [dbo].[DataDebtorCardMovement]
           ([DebtorCardMovementId]
           ,[DebtorCardId]
           ,[DocDate]
           ,[PayDate]
           ,[LGNo]
           ,[DebtorId]
           ,[DebtorCode]
           ,[DebtorCardCode]
           ,[DebtorCardName]
           ,[TypeId]
           ,[TypeCode]
           ,[TypeName]
           ,[FlagAutoPay]
           ,[DFDDate]
           ,[DFDStartDate]
           ,[DFDEndDate]
           ,[DPD]
           ,[TotalPay]
           ,[IsAdjust]
           ,[AdjustRefDocNo]
           ,[IsDelete]
           ,[MeasureId]
           ,[MeasureCode]
           ,[MeasureName]
           ,[InterestRate]
           ,[InterestPlannedRate]
           ,[InterestDefaultRate]
           ,[DebtBalance]
           ,[ReceivePayment]
           ,[Installment]
           ,[InstallmentPay]
           ,[InstallmentTotal]
           ,[Principal]
           ,[PrincipalPay]
           ,[PrincipalTotal]
           ,[InterimInterest]
           ,[AccruedInterest]
           ,[AccruedInterestPay]
           ,[AccruedInterestTotal]
           ,[CourtFee]
           ,[CourtFeePay]
           ,[CourtFeeTotal]
           ,[LawyerFee]
           ,[LawyerFeePay]
           ,[LawyerFeeTotal]
           ,[OtherExpense]
           ,[OtherExpensePay]
           ,[OtherExpenseTotal]
           ,[InitialMargin]
           ,[InitialMarginPay]
           ,[InitialMarginTotal]
           ,[SuspendInt]
           ,[SuspendIntPay]
           ,[SuspendIntTotal]
           ,[DeferredInterest]
           ,[DeferredInterestPay]
           ,[DeferredInterestTotal]
           ,[SuspendedDefaultInterest]
           ,[SuspendedDefaultInterestPay]
           ,[SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal]
           ,[PlannedInterest]
           ,[PlannedInterestPay]
           ,[PlannedInterestTotal]
           ,[DefaultInterest]
           ,[DefaultInterestPay]
           ,[DefaultInterestTotal]
           ,[CreateBy]
           ,[CreateDate]
           ,[UpdateBy]
           ,[UpdateDate]
           ,[ReceiptNo]
           ,[IsEstatement]
           ,[EStatementRef]
           ,[PaymentTypeId]
           ,[SeqNo]
           ,[DebtorPaymentId]
           ,[DebtorPaymentCode]
           ,[CompromiseContractGroup]
           ,[ReceiptId]
           ,[InstallmentPrincipal]
           ,[InstallmentPrincipalPay]
           ,[InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
           ,[InstallmentInterest]
           ,[InstallmentInterestPay]
           ,[InstallmentInterestTotal]
           ,[InterestStartDate]
           ,[InterestEndDate]
           ,[InterestQuantity]
		   ,[DPDAccumulate])
		 


SELECT @Id
      ,[DebtorCardId]
      ,getdate() as [DocDate]
      ,@CurrentDate as PayDate
      ,[LGNo]
      ,[DebtorId]
      ,[DebtorCode]
      ,[DebtorCardCode]
      ,[DebtorCardName]
      ,@PaymentTypeId
      ,@PaymentTypeCode
      ,@PaymentTypeName
      ,1
      ,cast('1900-01-01' as datetime) as [DFDDate]
      ,@CurrentDate as [DFDStartDate]
      ,@CurrentDate as [DFDEndDate]
      ,0 as [DPD]
      ,@Amount as [TotalPay]
      ,0 as [IsAdjust]
      ,'' as [AdjustRefDocNo]
      ,0
      ,[MeasureId]
      ,[MeasureCode]
      ,[MeasureName]
      ,@InterestRate as [InterestRate]
      ,@InterestPlannedRate as [InterestPlannedRate]
      ,@InterestDefaultRate as [InterestDefaultRate]
      ,([PrincipalTotal] - @Amount) + [AccruedInterestTotal] as [DebtBalance]
      ,0 as [ReceivePayment]
      ,[Installment]- @Amount as [Installment]
      ,0 as [InstallmentPay]
      ,[InstallmentTotal] - @Amount as [InstallmentTotal]
      ,[Principal] - @Amount as [Principal]
      ,@Amount as [PrincipalPay]
      ,[PrincipalTotal] - @Amount as [PrincipalTotal]
      ,0 as [InterimInterest]
      ,0 as [AccruedInterest]
      ,0 as [AccruedInterestPay]
      ,[AccruedInterestTotal]
      ,[CourtFeeTotal] as [CourtFee]
      ,0 as [CourtFeePay]
      ,[CourtFeeTotal]
      ,[LawyerFeeTotal] as [LawyerFee]
      ,0 as [LawyerFeePay]
      ,[LawyerFeeTotal]
      ,[OtherExpenseTotal] as [OtherExpense]
      ,0 as [OtherExpensePay]
      ,[OtherExpenseTotal]
      ,[InitialMarginTotal] as [InitialMargin]
      ,0 as [InitialMarginPay]
      ,[InitialMarginTotal]
      ,[SuspendIntTotal] as [SuspendInt]
      ,0 as [SuspendIntPay]
      ,[SuspendIntTotal]
      ,0 as [DeferredInterest]
      ,0 as [DeferredInterestPay]
      ,[DeferredInterestTotal]
      ,0 as [SuspendedDefaultInterest]
      ,0 as [SuspendedDefaultInterestPay]
      ,[SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal]
      ,0 as [PlannedInterest]
      ,0 as [PlannedInterestPay]
      ,[PlannedInterestTotal]
      ,0 as [DefaultInterest]
      ,0 as [DefaultInterestPay]
      ,[DefaultInterestTotal]
      ,1
      ,getdate() as [CreateDate] 
      ,1
      ,getdate() as [UpdateDate]
      ,[ReceiptNo]
      ,0 as [IsEstatement]
      ,'' as [EStatementRef]
      ,[PaymentTypeId]
      ,[SeqNo]+1
      ,[DebtorPaymentId]
      ,[DebtorPaymentCode]
      ,[CompromiseContractGroup]
      ,[ReceiptId]
      ,[InstallmentPrincipalTotal] - @Amount as [InstallmentPrincipal]
      ,0 as [InstallmentPrincipalPay]
      ,[InstallmentPrincipalTotal] - @Amount as [InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
      ,[InstallmentInterestTotal] as [InstallmentInterest]
      ,0 as [InstallmentInterestPay]
      ,[InstallmentInterestTotal]
      ,cast('1900-01-01' as datetime) as [InterestStartDate]
	  --,cast('2024-08-27' as datetime)

      ,cast('1900-01-01' as datetime) as [InterestEndDate]
      ,0 as [InterestQuantity]
	  ,[DPDAccumulate]

from DataDebtorCardMovement cm
where 
cm.DebtorCardId= @DataDebtorCardMainId
and cm.SeqNo = @SeqCurrent ;

declare @SeqNext int = @SeqCurrent+1 

--EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_022_UpdateDPD]  @CurrentDate, @DataDebtorCardMainId, @SeqNext ;


--Update  DataDebtorCardMovement 
--set 
--DebtBalance = ([PrincipalTotal] - @Amount) + AccruedInterestTotal
--, [InstallmentPrincipal] = [InstallmentPrincipal] - @Amount
--, [InstallmentPrincipalPay] = 0
--, [InstallmentPrincipalTotal] = [InstallmentPrincipalTotal] - @Amount
--, [InstallmentInterestPay] = 0 

--where DebtorCardMovementId = @Id;



Update  DataDebtorCard 
set SeqCurrent = SeqCurrent +1
, SeqNext = SeqNext+1
, [PrincipalTotal] = [PrincipalTotal] - @Amount
, DebtBalance = ([PrincipalTotal] - @Amount) + AccruedInterestTotal
, [InstallmentPrincipal] = [InstallmentPrincipal] - @Amount
, [InstallmentPrincipalPay] = 0
, [InstallmentPrincipalTotal] = [InstallmentPrincipalTotal] - @Amount
, [InstallmentInterestPay] = 0 

where DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardMainId;

select @DebtBalance, @GetCountCard

--ยอดคงเหลือ
EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_003_InsertBalance] @CurrentDate, @DataDebtorCardMainId;

EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay] @CurrentDate,@DataDebtorCardMainId;




END

	,@Amount decimal(20,4) = 11248215.6900

      ,[SeqNo]+1
      ,[DebtorPaymentId]
      ,[DebtorPaymentCode]
      ,[CompromiseContractGroup]
      ,[ReceiptId]
      ,@PrincipalTotalMain as [InstallmentPrincipal]
      ,0 as [InstallmentPrincipalPay]
      ,@PrincipalTotalMain as [InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
      ,[InstallmentInterest]
      ,0 as [InstallmentInterestPay]
      ,[InstallmentInterestTotal]
      ,cast('1900-01-01' as datetime) as [InterestStartDate]
	  --,cast('2024-08-27' as datetime)

      ,cast('1900-01-01' as datetime) as [InterestEndDate]
      ,0 as [InterestQuantity]
	  ,[DPDAccumulate]

from DataDebtorCardMovement cm
where 
cm.DebtorCardId= @DataDebtorCardId
and cm.SeqNo = @SeqCurrent ;

declare @SeqNext int = @SeqCurrent+1 
--ยอดคงเหลือ
Update  DataDebtorCard 
set 
SeqCurrent = SeqCurrent +1
, SeqNext = SeqNext+1
, [PrincipalTotal] = @PrincipalTotalMain
, DebtBalance = @PrincipalTotalMain + AccruedInterestTotal
, [InstallmentPrincipal] = @PrincipalTotalMain
, [InstallmentPrincipalPay] = 0
, [InstallmentPrincipalTotal] = @PrincipalTotalMain
, [InstallmentInterestPay] = 0 

where DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId;

EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_003_InsertBalance] @CurrentDate, @DataDebtorCardId;
EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay] @CurrentDate, @DataDebtorCardId;

--EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_022_UpdateDPD]  @CurrentDate, @DataDebtorCardMainId, @SeqNext ;



--select @DebtBalanceMain, @GetCountCard

END

declare @SeqInterestRate int = (select max(Seq) from DataDebtorCardInterate where DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId)

Update DataDebtorCardInterate
set EndDate = dateadd(day, -1, @ApproveTDRDate)
, IsDefaultInterest = 0
where DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
and Seq = @SeqInterestRate

           ,[MeasureId]
           ,[Seq]
           ,[InterateRate]
           ,[DefaultInterest]

           ,[EndDate]
           ,[IsActive]

           ,getdate() [UpdateDate]

DECLARE @TypeCode nvarchar(2) = (select PaymentTypeCode from SystemPaymentType where PaymentTypeId = @TypeId)
DECLARE @TypeName nvarchar(100) = (select PaymentTypeName from SystemPaymentType where PaymentTypeId = @TypeId)

DECLARE @InterestRate decimal(20,4) = (select InterestRate from DataDebtorCard where DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId )
DECLARE @InterestPlannedRate decimal(20,4) = (select InterestPlannedRate from DataDebtorCard where DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId )
DECLARE @InterestDefaultRate decimal(20,4) = (select InterestDefaultRate from DataDebtorCard where DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId )


DECLARE @EndDayOfMonth datetime =  EOMONTH(@CurrentDate)

select @SeqCurrent
IF @CurrentDate = EOMONTH(@CurrentDate)
begin
    PRINT 'เป็นวันสิ้นเดือน'

end

    PRINT 'ไม่ใช่วันสิ้นเดือน'
--if(@CurrentDate = @EndDayOfMonth)
--begin


SELECT
--newid()

	  [DebtorCardId]

      ,@CurrentDate as [DocDate]

      ,cast('1900-01-01' as datetime) as PayDate
      ,[LGNo]

      ,[DebtorId]
      ,[DebtorCode]
      ,[DebtorCardCode]
      ,[DebtorCardName]

      ,@TypeId as TypeId
      ,@TypeCode as TypeCode
      ,@TypeName as TypeName
      ,1 as [FlagAutoPay]

      ,cast('1900-01-01' as date) as [DFDDate]
      ,@CurrentDate as [DFDStartDate]
      ,cast('1900-01-01' as date)  as [DFDEndDate]
      ,0 as [DPD]

      ,-sum([TotalPay]) as [TotalPay]
      ,0 as [IsAdjust]
      ,0 as [AdjustRefDocNo]
      ,0 as [IsDelete]

      ,[MeasureId]
      ,[MeasureCode]
      ,[MeasureName]

      ,@InterestRate as InterestRate
      ,@InterestPlannedRate as InterestPlannedRate
      ,@InterestDefaultRate as InterestDefaultRate

      ,-sum([DebtBalance]) as [DebtBalance]--หาเพิ่ม

      ,0 as [InstallmentTotal]

      ,0 as [DeferredInterestTotal]

      ,0 as[SuspendedDefaultInterest]

      ,0 as [SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal]

      ,0 as [PlannedInterestTotal]

      ,0 as[DefaultInterest]
      ,-sum([DefaultInterestPay]) as [DefaultInterestPay]
      ,0 as [DefaultInterestTotal]

      ,1 as[CreateBy]
      ,getdate() as [CreateDate]
      ,1 as[UpdateBy]
      ,getdate() as [UpdateDate]

      ,0 as [ReceiptNo]
      ,0 as[IsEstatement]
      ,0 as [EStatementRef]
      ,[PaymentTypeId]
     -- ,[SeqNo]+1

      ,[DebtorPaymentId]
      ,[DebtorPaymentCode]
      ,[CompromiseContractGroup]
      ,[ReceiptId]

      ,0 as [InstallmentPrincipal]
      ,-sum([InstallmentPrincipalPay]) as [InstallmentPrincipalPay]
      ,0 as[InstallmentPrincipalTotal]

      ,0 as [InstallmentInterest]
      ,-sum([InstallmentInterestPay]) as [InstallmentInterestPay]
      ,0 as [InstallmentInterestTotal]

      ,cast('1900-01-01' as date) as [InterestStartDate]
	  ----,cast('2024-08-27' as datetime)

     -- ,[InterestQuantity]

from DataDebtorCardMovement cm
where cm.DebtorCardId= @DataDebtorCardId
and DocDate >= @CurrentDate

    [DebtorCardId],
    [LGNo],
    [DebtorId],
    [DebtorCode],
    [DebtorCardCode],

    [MeasureId],
    [MeasureCode],

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_020_InsertAdjust]
	-- insert ดอกเบี้ย ทุกมาตรการ
	@CurrentDate date = '2025-08-31'
	,@TypeCalId int = 0 --1=back date, 0=recal
	--,@DataDebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = 'F70BC1D3-5499-425C-97E9-00192B895750'
	 --,@DataDebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = '228362C3-4BB3-4D23-9D75-B8F73EA2C042'
	
	
AS
BEGIN

--declare @CurrentDate date = cast(getdate()-1 as date)
declare @PaymentDate date = '2025-08-23'
declare @DataDebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = '228362C3-4BB3-4D23-9D75-B8F73EA2C042'
declare @Seq int = 
(select top 1 cm.seqNo from DataDebtorCardMovement cm
where cm.DebtorCardId= @DataDebtorCardId and DocDate >= @PaymentDate and TypeId = 2
order by cm.seqNo)

if(@TypeCalId = 1)
begin
	--ลบบันทัดทิ้ง
	delete from DataDebtorCardMovement 
	where DebtorCardId= @DataDebtorCardId
	and seqNo >=@Seq;

	--==Update Seq
	Update DataDebtorCard
	set SeqCurrent = @Seq-1
	,SeqNext = @Seq
	where DataDebtorCardId= @DataDebtorCardId;
end

select ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY PayDate asc) AS RowNum
,* 
,0 as IsCheck
into #tmp_CalDebtorCard
from DataDebtorCardReceive
where PayDate >=@PaymentDate
order by PayDate

select * from #tmp_CalDebtorCard


--หาวันที่สุดท้าย ที่ต้องคิดดอกเบี้ย
declare @GetDate date = (select top 1 cast(PayDate-1 as date) from #tmp_CalDebtorCard)
select @GetDate
--EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_018_UpdateInterestEveryDay] @GetDate, @DataDebtorCardId;
DECLARE @CounteCalDebtorCard int = (select count(*) from #tmp_CalDebtorCard)
DECLARE @i INT 
SET @i = 1
WHILE (@i <= @CounteCalDebtorCard)
	BEGIN
		--declare @DataDebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = (select DebtorCardId from #TempDataEStatement where RowId = @i);
		declare @EStatementId  nvarchar(150) = (select EStatementId from #tmp_CalDebtorCard where RowNum = @i);
		declare @SeqCurrent int =  (select SeqCurrent from DataDebtorCard where DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId); 
		declare @DateAfter datetime =  (select dateadd(day, -1, PayDate) from #tmp_CalDebtorCard where RowNum = @i);
		declare @PayDate datetime =  (select PayDate from #tmp_CalDebtorCard where RowNum = @i); 

		--EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_018_UpdateInterestEveryDay] @DateAfter, @DataDebtorCardId;
		EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_019_estatement] @PayDate, @DataDebtorCardId, @EStatementId
		EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_014_InsertDebtorCard] @DataDebtorCardId, @EStatementId, 1
		EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_019_InsertBalance] @PayDate, @DataDebtorCardId;
		EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_018_UpdateInterestEveryDay] @PayDate, @DataDebtorCardId;

		SET @i = @i + 1
	END

delete from #tmp_CalDebtorCard

DECLARE @GetCurrentDate DATETIME = DATEADD(day, -1, GETDATE());

EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_018_UpdateInterestEveryDay]  @GetCurrentDate , @DataDebtorCardId;

END

           ,0 as [TotalPrincipalOverdue]
           ,0 as [TotalAccruedInterestOverdue]
           ,null as [CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId]
           ,0 as [IsUpdateHistory]
from DataDebtorCard c
where c.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId

Update c
set DebtBalance = @P_DebtBalance
,PrincipalTotal = @P_PrincipalTotal
,AccruedInterestTotal = @P_AccruedInterestTotal
,PlannedInterestTotal = @P_PlannedInterestTotal
,DefaultInterestTotal = @P_DefaultInterestTotal
,CourtFeeTotal = @P_CourtFeeTotal

,InterestEndDate = dateadd(day, -1, @P_InterestEndDate)

from DataDebtorCard c
where c.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId


--EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_020_InsertAdjust] @CurrentDate

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_024_InsertInterestRate]

  ,@CurrentDate date = '2025-08-31'
  ,@InterestDefaultRate decimal(20,4) = 0


	
AS
BEGIN

declare @DebtorCardInterateId nvarchar(150) = (select top 1 DebtorCardInterateId from [DataDebtorCardInterate] where DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId order by Seq desc)

Update [DataDebtorCardInterate]
set EndDate = dateadd(day, -1, @CurrentDate)
, IsDefaultInterest = 0
, UpdateDate = getdate()
, UpdateBy = 1
where DebtorCardInterateId = @DebtorCardInterateId

INSERT INTO [dbo].[DataDebtorCardInterate]
           ([DebtorCardInterateId]
           ,[DebtorCardId]
           ,[MeasureId]

           ,[DefaultInterest]
           ,[StartDate]
           ,[EndDate]
           ,[IsActive]
           ,[CompromiseContractGroupId]
           ,[CreateDate]
           ,[CreateBy]
           ,[UpdateDate]
           ,[UpdateBy]
           ,[IsDefaultInterest]
           ,[RequestNoTDR])
			
select newid() as [DebtorCardInterateId]
           ,@DebtorCardId as [DebtorCardId]
           ,[MeasureId] as [MeasureId]
           ,[Seq] +1 as [Seq]
           ,[InterateRate] as [InterateRate]
           ,@InterestDefaultRate as [DefaultInterest]
           ,@CurrentDate as [StartDate]
           ,'3000-12-31' as [EndDate]
           ,1 [IsActive]
           ,null [CompromiseContractGroupId]
           ,getdate() as [CreateDate]
           ,1 as [CreateBy]
           ,getdate() as [UpdateDate]
           ,1 as [UpdateBy]
           ,1 [IsDefaultInterest]
           ,null[RequestNoTDR]

		   from [DataDebtorCardInterate]
		   where DebtorCardInterateId = @DebtorCardInterateId

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_030_InsertAdjustRecal_RequestRefund]

   @DebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = '8AAD3095-DEBE-4790-83E0-651F3B49788C'
  ,@PayDate date = '2025-05-10'
  ,@EstatementId nvarchar(150)  = ''

	--อธิบาย : เลือกวันที่ต้องการปรับปรุง เช่น  @PayDate = 2025-08-30 แปลว่า จะไปหาบันทัดในการ์ด ที่วันที่ น้อยกว่า หรือ เท่ากับ วันที่เลือก เพื่อเอารายการล่าสุด มาตั้งต้นก่อน
	--และถ้าจะรับชำระใหม่ หรือปรับปรุงรายการใหม่ จะใช้ stored อื่น
	
AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON;

declare @SeqNext int = (select SeqNext from DataDebtorCard where DataDebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId)
declare @TypeId int = 7
declare @TypeCode nvarchar(20) 
declare @TypeName nvarchar(200) 

declare @TotalPay decimal(20,2)
declare @ReceivePayment decimal(20,2)
declare @PrincipalPay decimal(20,2)
declare @AccruedInterestPay decimal(20,2)
declare @CourtFeePay decimal(20,2)
declare @LawyerFeePay decimal(20,2)
declare @OtherExpensePay decimal(20,2)
declare @InitialMarginPay decimal(20,2)
declare @SuspendIntPay decimal(20,2)
declare @DeferredInterestPay decimal(20,2)
declare @SuspendedDefaultInterestPay decimal(20,2)
declare @PlannedInterestPay decimal(20,2)
declare @DefaultInterestPay decimal(20,2)

select 
@TypeCode = PaymentTypeCode
, @TypeName = PaymentTypeName
from SystemPaymentType
where PaymentTypeId = @TypeId

select 
@PrincipalPay = case when PrincipalPay = 0 then 0 else - PrincipalPay end
, @AccruedInterestPay = case when AccruedInterestPay = 0 then 0 else - AccruedInterestPay end
, @CourtFeePay = case when CourtFeePay = 0 then 0 else - CourtFeePay end
, @LawyerFeePay = case when LawyerFeePay = 0 then 0 else - LawyerFeePay end
, @OtherExpensePay = case when OtherExpensePay = 0 then 0 else - OtherExpensePay end
, @InitialMarginPay = case when InitialMarginPay = 0 then 0 else - InitialMarginPay end
, @SuspendIntPay = case when SuspendIntPay = 0 then 0 else - SuspendIntPay end
, @DeferredInterestPay = case when DeferredInterestPay = 0 then 0 else - DeferredInterestPay end
, @SuspendedDefaultInterestPay = case when SuspendedDefaultInterestPay = 0 then 0 else - SuspendedDefaultInterestPay end
, @PlannedInterestPay = case when PlannedInterestPay = 0 then 0 else - PlannedInterestPay end
, @DefaultInterestPay = case when DefaultInterestPay = 0 then 0 else - DefaultInterestPay end
, @TotalPay = - TotalPay
, @ReceivePayment = - @ReceivePayment

from DataDebtorCardMovement
where DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
and EStatementRef = @EstatementId

SELECT top 1 [DebtorCardMovementId]
      ,[DebtorCardId]
      ,getdate() as [DocDate]

      ,[LGNo]
      ,[DebtorId]
      ,[DebtorCode]

      ,[DebtorCardName]

      ,[MeasureName]
      ,[InterestRate]

      ,[InterestDefaultRate]
      ,[DebtBalance]
      ,[ReceivePayment]
      ,[Installment]
      ,[InstallmentPay]
      ,[InstallmentTotal]
      ,[Principal]
      ,@PrincipalPay as [PrincipalPay]
      ,[PrincipalTotal]
      ,[InterimInterest]
      ,[AccruedInterest]
      ,@AccruedInterestPay as [AccruedInterestPay]
      ,[AccruedInterestTotal]
      ,[CourtFee]
      ,@CourtFeePay as [CourtFeePay]
      ,[CourtFeeTotal]
      ,[LawyerFee]

      ,getdate() as [UpdateDate]
      ,null as [ReceiptNo]
      ,0 as [IsEstatement]
      ,null as [EStatementRef]
      ,[PaymentTypeId]
      ,@SeqNext as SeqNo
	  --,[SeqNo] --ถัาไม่ใช้ ให้ comment
      ,[DebtorPaymentId]

      ,[TotalAccruedInterestOverdue]

      ,0 as [IsUpdateHistory]

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_032_1_InsertDataDebtorCardMovementFromTDRRecal]

   @DebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = '7C0D3DCE-E2F1-46D3-8F04-CB43D6D3D618'
   ,@CompromiseContractId nvarchar(150) = '722fd91c-ae06-4954-a530-c70b9b9f9dc4'
   ,@PayDate date = '2024-08-29'
   ,@TypeId int = 28

--การ์ดที่มีแผน และ DPD = 90 วัน จะปิดแผน และกลับไปใช้มาตรการตั้งต้น
	
AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON;
declare @TotalPay decimal(20,2)
declare @PrincipalPay decimal(20,2)
declare @ReceivePayment decimal(20,2)
declare @DefaultInterestPay decimal(20,2)
declare @PlannedInterestPay decimal(20,2)
declare @AccruedInterestPay decimal(20,2)
declare @CourtFeePay decimal(20,2)
declare @InitialMarginPay decimal(20,2)
declare @LawyerFeePay decimal(20,2)
declare @OtherExpensePay decimal(20,2)
declare @SuspendIntPay decimal(20,2)
declare @DeferredInterestPay decimal(20,2)
declare @SuspendedDefaultInterestPay decimal(20,2)
declare @GetDate date = getdate()
declare @SeqNo int = 1

select 
--r.ReceiptNo
--,
 @TotalPay  = -sum(cdm.TotalPay) 
, @PrincipalPay = -sum(cdm.PrincipalPay)
, @ReceivePayment = -sum(cdm.ReceivePayment)
, @DefaultInterestPay = -sum(cdm.DefaultInterestPay)
, @PlannedInterestPay = -sum(cdm.PlannedInterestPay)
, @AccruedInterestPay = -sum(cdm.AccruedInterestPay) 

-----
, @CourtFeePay = -sum(cdm.CourtFeePay)
, @InitialMarginPay = -sum(cdm.InitialMarginPay)
, @LawyerFeePay = -sum(cdm.LawyerFeePay)
, @OtherExpensePay = -sum(OtherExpensePay)
, @SuspendIntPay = -sum(cdm.SuspendIntPay)
, @DeferredInterestPay = -sum(cdm.DeferredInterestPay)
, @SuspendedDefaultInterestPay = -sum(cdm.SuspendedDefaultInterestPay)
, @SeqNo = min(cdm.SeqNo)
--, cdm.TotalPay, cdm.PrincipalPay, cdm.ReceivePayment, cdm.DefaultInterestPay, cdm.PlannedInterestPay, cdm.AccruedInterestPay
--, cdm.CourtFeePay, cdm.InitialMarginPay, cdm.LawyerFeePay, OtherExpensePay
--, cdm.SuspendIntPay , cdm.DeferredInterestPay
--, cdm.*
from TDRDataCompromiseContractReceipt r
left join DataDebtorCardMovement cdm on cdm.ReceiptId = r.ReceiptId
where CompromiseContractId = @CompromiseContractId
and cdm.DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
-- and TypeId = 28

--group by r.ReceiptNo
--select
--@TotalPay as TotalPay
--, @PrincipalPay as PrincipalPay
--, @ReceivePayment as ReceivePayment
--, @DefaultInterestPay as DefaultInterestPay
--, @PlannedInterestPay as PlannedInterestPay
--, @AccruedInterestPay as AccruedInterestPay

-------
--, @CourtFeePay as CourtFeePay
--, @InitialMarginPay as InitialMarginPay
--, @LawyerFeePay as LawyerFeePay
--, @OtherExpensePay as OtherExpensePay
--, @SuspendIntPay as SuspendIntPay
--, @DeferredInterestPay as DeferredInterestPay
declare @TypeCode nvarchar(10)
declare @TypeName nvarchar(100)

select @TypeCode = PaymentTypeCode
, @TypeName = PaymentTypeName
from SystemPaymentType where PaymentTypeId = 28


declare @SeqNext int = (select SeqNext from DataDebtorCard where DataDebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId)
SELECT top 1 cdm.[DebtorCardMovementId]
      ,[DebtorCardId]
      ,getdate() as [DocDate]
      ,[DocDate] as [PayDate]
      ,[LGNo]
      ,[DebtorId]
      ,[DebtorCode]
      ,[DebtorCardCode]
      ,[DebtorCardName]
      ,@TypeId as [TypeId]
      ,@TypeCode as [TypeCode]
      ,@TypeName as [TypeName]

-- =============================================

create PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_033_InsertAdjustRecalInterest]
	-- 
	@CurrentDate date = '2025-05-01'
	,@DataDebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = 'F70BC1D3-5499-425C-97E9-00192B895750'


AS
BEGIN

declare @SeqCurrent int = (select SeqCurrent from DataDebtorCard where DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId )

declare @EndDate datetime = (select InterestEndDate + 1 from DataDebtorCardMovement where DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId and SeqNo = @SeqCurrent)
DECLARE @DaysInYear INT = DATEDIFF(DAY, cast(year(@CurrentDate) as nvarchar) + '-01-01', cast(year(@CurrentDate) as nvarchar) + '-12-31') + 1;

--(กรณีเพิ่มรายการ) PaymentTypeId = 8 ยอดคงเหลือ
DECLARE @TypeId int = (select PaymentTypeId from SystemPaymentType where PaymentTypeId = 30)
DECLARE @TypeCode nvarchar(2) = (select PaymentTypeCode from SystemPaymentType where PaymentTypeId = @TypeId)
DECLARE @TypeName nvarchar(100) = (select PaymentTypeName from SystemPaymentType where PaymentTypeId = @TypeId)



DECLARE @EndDayOfMonth datetime =  EOMONTH(@CurrentDate)

select @SeqCurrent



SELECT top 1
--newid()
      --,
	  [DebtorCardId]

      ,@CurrentDate as [DocDate]

      ,dateadd(day, -1, @CurrentDate) as PayDate
      ,[LGNo]

      ,[DebtorId]
      ,[DebtorCode]
      ,[DebtorCardCode]
      ,[DebtorCardName]

      ,@TypeId as TypeId
      ,@TypeCode as TypeCode
      ,@TypeName as TypeName
      ,1 as [FlagAutoPay]

      ,[DFDDate] as [DFDDate]
      ,[DFDStartDate] as [DFDStartDate]
      ,[DFDEndDate]  as [DFDEndDate]
      ,[DPD] as [DPD]

      ,0 as [TotalPay]
      ,0 as [IsAdjust]
      ,0 as [AdjustRefDocNo]
      ,0 as [IsDelete]

      ,[MeasureId]
      ,[MeasureCode]
      ,[MeasureName]

      ,InterestRate as InterestRate
      ,InterestPlannedRate as InterestPlannedRate
      ,InterestDefaultRate as InterestDefaultRate

      ,[DebtBalance] as [DebtBalance]--หาเพิ่ม
      ,0 as [ReceivePayment]

      ,[Installment] as [Installment]
      ,0 as [InstallmentPay]
      ,[InstallmentTotal] as [InstallmentTotal]

      ,[Principal] as [Principal]
      ,0 as [PrincipalPay]
      ,[PrincipalTotal] as [PrincipalTotal]

      ,[InterimInterest] as [InterimInterest]

      ,[AccruedInterest] as [AccruedInterest]
      ,0 as [AccruedInterestPay]
      ,[AccruedInterestTotal] as [AccruedInterestTotal]

      ,[CourtFee] as [CourtFee]
      ,0 as [CourtFeePay]
      ,[CourtFeeTotal] as [CourtFeeTotal]

      ,[LawyerFee] as [LawyerFee]
      ,0 as [LawyerFeePay]
      ,[LawyerFeeTotal] as [LawyerFeeTotal]

      ,[OtherExpense] as [OtherExpense]
      ,0 as [OtherExpensePay]
      ,[OtherExpenseTotal] as [OtherExpenseTotal]

      ,[InitialMargin] as [InitialMargin]
      ,0 as [InitialMarginPay]
      ,[InitialMarginTotal] as[InitialMarginTotal]

      ,[SuspendInt] as[SuspendInt]
      ,0 as [SuspendIntPay]
      ,[SuspendIntTotal] as[SuspendIntTotal]

      ,[DeferredInterest] as [DeferredInterest]
      ,0 as [DeferredInterestPay]
      ,[DeferredInterestTotal] as [DeferredInterestTotal]

      ,[SuspendedDefaultInterest] as[SuspendedDefaultInterest]
      ,0 as [SuspendedDefaultInterestPay]
      ,[SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal] as [SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal]

      ,[PlannedInterest] as[PlannedInterest]
      ,0 as [PlannedInterestPay]
      ,[PlannedInterestTotal] as [PlannedInterestTotal]

      ,[DefaultInterest] as [DefaultInterest]
      ,0 as [DefaultInterestPay]
      ,[DefaultInterestTotal] as [DefaultInterestTotal]

      ,1 as[CreateBy]
      ,getdate() as [CreateDate]
      ,1 as[UpdateBy]
      ,getdate() as [UpdateDate]

      ,0 as [ReceiptNo]
      ,0 as [IsEstatement]
      ,0 as [EStatementRef]
      ,[PaymentTypeId]
     -- ,[SeqNo]+1

      ,[DebtorPaymentId]
      ,[DebtorPaymentCode]
      ,[CompromiseContractGroup]
      ,[ReceiptId]

      ,[InstallmentPrincipal] as [InstallmentPrincipal]
      ,0 as [InstallmentPrincipalPay]
      ,[InstallmentPrincipalTotal] as[InstallmentPrincipalTotal]

      ,[InstallmentInterest] as [InstallmentInterest]
      ,0 as [InstallmentInterestPay]
      ,[InstallmentInterestTotal] as [InstallmentInterestTotal]

      ,[InterestStartDate] as [InterestStartDate]
	  ----,cast('2024-08-27' as datetime)

      ,@CurrentDate as [InterestEndDate]
      ,[InterestQuantity] as [InterestQuantity]
	  ,0 as IsUpdateHistory
	  , DPDAccumulate
into #Adjust
from DataDebtorCardMovement cm
where cm.DebtorCardId= @DataDebtorCardId
and year(DocDate) = year(@CurrentDate)
and month(DocDate) = month(@CurrentDate)
order by DocDate desc




declare @InterestQuantity decimal(20,4) = 0
declare @InstallmentPay decimal(20,4) = 0

declare @PrincipalPay decimal(20,4) = 0
declare @InterimInterest decimal(20,4) = 0
declare @AccruedInterestTotal decimal(20,4) = 0
declare @CourtFeePay decimal(20,4) = 0
declare @LawyerFeePay decimal(20,4) = 0
declare @OtherExpensePay decimal(20,4) = 0
declare @InitialMarginPay decimal(20,4) = 0
declare @SuspendIntPay decimal(20,4) = 0
declare @PlannedInterestTotal decimal(20,4) = 0
declare @DefaultInterestTotal decimal(20,4) = 0
declare @InstallmentPrincipalPay decimal(20,4) = 0
declare @DPDAccumulate decimal(20,4) = 0

    
select @InterestQuantity = datediff(day, a.InterestStartDate, @CurrentDate)
, @PlannedInterestTotal = PlannedInterestTotal - PlannedInterest
, @DefaultInterestTotal = DefaultInterestTotal - DefaultInterest
, @AccruedInterestTotal = AccruedInterestTotal - AccruedInterest
, @DPDAccumulate = DPDAccumulate - DPD
from #Adjust a


Update #Adjust
set InterimInterest = PrincipalTotal * (InterestRate/100) * @InterestQuantity / @DaysInYear
, PlannedInterest = PrincipalTotal * (InterestPlannedRate/100) * @InterestQuantity / @DaysInYear
, DefaultInterest = PrincipalTotal * (InterestDefaultRate/100) * @InterestQuantity / @DaysInYear
, AccruedInterest = PrincipalTotal * (InterestRate/100) * @InterestQuantity / @DaysInYear
, InterestQuantity = @InterestQuantity

Update #Adjust
set PlannedInterestTotal = @PlannedInterestTotal + PlannedInterest
, DefaultInterestTotal = @DefaultInterestTotal + DefaultInterest
, AccruedInterestTotal = @AccruedInterestTotal + AccruedInterest
, InstallmentInterestTotal = @AccruedInterestTotal + AccruedInterest
, DPDAccumulate = @DPDAccumulate + @InterestQuantity

Update #Adjust
set DebtBalance = PrincipalTotal + AccruedInterestTotal + CourtFeeTotal + LawyerFeeTotal + OtherExpenseTotal + InitialMarginTotal 

--==============DataDebtorCard=============================================


--end

           ,[DefaultInterestTotal]

           ,[CreateBy]

           ,[InterestStartDate]

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_034_InsertAdjust_Cancel]

   @DebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = '8AAD3095-DEBE-4790-83E0-651F3B49788C'
  ,@PayDate date = '2025-05-10'
  ,@EstatementId nvarchar(150)  = ''

	--อธิบาย : เลือกวันที่ต้องการปรับปรุง เช่น  @PayDate = 2025-08-30 แปลว่า จะไปหาบันทัดในการ์ด ที่วันที่ น้อยกว่า หรือ เท่ากับ วันที่เลือก เพื่อเอารายการล่าสุด มาตั้งต้นก่อน
	--และถ้าจะรับชำระใหม่ หรือปรับปรุงรายการใหม่ จะใช้ stored อื่น
	
AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON;

declare @SeqNext int = (select SeqNext from DataDebtorCard where DataDebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId)
declare @TypeId int = 31
declare @TypeCode nvarchar(20) 
declare @TypeName nvarchar(200) 

declare @TotalPay decimal(20,2)
declare @ReceivePayment decimal(20,2)
declare @PrincipalPay decimal(20,2)
declare @AccruedInterestPay decimal(20,2)
declare @CourtFeePay decimal(20,2)
declare @LawyerFeePay decimal(20,2)
declare @OtherExpensePay decimal(20,2)
declare @InitialMarginPay decimal(20,2)
declare @SuspendIntPay decimal(20,2)
declare @DeferredInterestPay decimal(20,2)
declare @SuspendedDefaultInterestPay decimal(20,2)
declare @PlannedInterestPay decimal(20,2)
declare @DefaultInterestPay decimal(20,2)

select 
@TypeCode = PaymentTypeCode
, @TypeName = PaymentTypeName
from SystemPaymentType
where PaymentTypeId = @TypeId

select 
@PrincipalPay = case when PrincipalPay = 0 then 0 else - PrincipalPay end
, @AccruedInterestPay = case when AccruedInterestPay = 0 then 0 else - AccruedInterestPay end
, @CourtFeePay = case when CourtFeePay = 0 then 0 else - CourtFeePay end
, @LawyerFeePay = case when LawyerFeePay = 0 then 0 else - LawyerFeePay end
, @OtherExpensePay = case when OtherExpensePay = 0 then 0 else - OtherExpensePay end
, @InitialMarginPay = case when InitialMarginPay = 0 then 0 else - InitialMarginPay end
, @SuspendIntPay = case when SuspendIntPay = 0 then 0 else - SuspendIntPay end

  ,@PayDate date = '2025-05-10'
  ,@CourtFee decimal(20,2) = 0
  ,@LawyerFee decimal(20,2) = 0

SET NOCOUNT ON;

declare @SeqNext int = (select SeqNext from DataDebtorCard where DataDebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId)
declare @TypeId int = 31

@TypeCode = PaymentTypeCode

from SystemPaymentType
where PaymentTypeId = @TypeId

      ,[InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
      ,[InstallmentInterest]

      ,[InstallmentInterestTotal]

      ,[TotalOverdue]

      ,[TotalAccruedInterestOverdue]
      ,[CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId]
      ,0 as [IsUpdateHistory]
	  ,[SeqNo] as SeqNoOld
	  into #tmp_DataDebtorCard
  FROM [DataDebtorCardMovement]
  
  where DebtorCardId = @DebtorCardId
  and SeqNo = (@SeqNext - 1)
  order by [DataDebtorCardMovement].SeqNo desc



  Update c

  --, c.SuspendIntTotal = tc.SuspendIntTotal --ดอกเบี้ยตั้งพักใหม่(แขวน)-คงเหลือ
  --, c.DeferredInterestTotal = tc.DeferredInterestTotal

  --, c.DefaultInterestTotal = tc.DefaultInterestTotal

  from DataDebtorCard c

  --select

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_039_UpdateInstallmentPlanPayment]
	@DataDebtorCardId NVARCHAR(150) = '053143CD-8393-4ACB-9F19-60BF9288A546',
	@EStatementId NVARCHAR(150) = '76889609-2b41-4fb1-b9dc-17fc96271727'
AS 
BEGIN
	DECLARE @PaymentDate date = (select ds.PaymentDate from DataEStatement ds where ds.EStatementId = @EStatementId)
	
	DECLARE @TotalPay decimal(20, 2)
	DECLARE @PrincipalPay decimal(20, 2)
	DECLARE @AccruedInterestPay decimal(20 ,2)
	(select top 1 @TotalPay = cm.TotalPay
		, @PrincipalPay = cm.PrincipalPay
		, @AccruedInterestPay = cm.AccruedInterestPay
		from DataDebtorCardMovement cm
		left join DataDebtorCard c on c.DataDebtorCardId = cm.DebtorCardId
		where  cm.DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
		and cm.IsAdjust = 0
		and cm.TypeId = 2
		and cast(cm.PayDate as date) = @PaymentDate
--		order by cm.PayDate DESC
		)
		
	Update TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment set 
	PaymentDate = @PaymentDate,
	PaymentAmount = @TotalPay, 
	PrincipalPay = @PrincipalPay, 
	AccruedInterestPay = @AccruedInterestPay,
	OverdueAmount = case when @TotalPay < Total then Total - @TotalPay else 0 end
	where CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId = (
		select top 1 CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId from TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment
		where isPayment = 0 
		and DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
		order by Seq ASC)
END

-- Start of adjustment range: immediately AFTER the last real receipt.
declare @SeqNo int = (select top (1) TRY_CONVERT(int,SeqNo)+1
                      from dbo.DataDebtorCardMovement
                      where DebtorCardId=@DataDebtorCardId and TypeId=2
                      order by TRY_CONVERT(int,SeqNo) desc);
-- New staged movement must be appended AFTER the last existing ledger row.
declare @InsertSeqNo int = (select ISNULL(MAX(TRY_CONVERT(int,SeqNo)),0)+1
                            from dbo.DataDebtorCardMovement
                            where DebtorCardId=@DataDebtorCardId);

declare @TypeId int = 7

declare @TypeName nvarchar(200)

select @TypeCode = PaymentTypeCode
, @TypeName = PaymentTypeName
from SystemPaymentType
where PaymentTypeId = @TypeId





SELECT 

@DPD = -SUM(DPD)
, @DPDAccumulate = -SUM(DPDAccumulate)
, @InterimInterest = -SUM(InterimInterest)
, @AccruedInterest = -SUM(AccruedInterest)
, @CourtFee = -SUM(CourtFee)

, @SuspendedDefaultInterest = -SUM(SuspendedDefaultInterest)
, @PlannedInterest = -SUM(PlannedInterest)
, @DefaultInterest = -SUM(DefaultInterest)
, @InterestQuantity = -SUM(InterestQuantity)

  FROM DataDebtorCardMovement cm 
  where DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
  and SeqNo >= @SeqNo

  SELECT top 1


@DPDAccumulate = -DPDAccumulate

, @AccruedInterestTotal = -AccruedInterestTotal
, @CourtFeeTotal = -CourtFeeTotal
, @LawyerFeeTotal = -LawyerFeeTotal
, @OtherExpenseTotal = -OtherExpenseTotal
, @InitialMarginTotal = -InitialMarginTotal
, @SuspendIntTotal = -SuspendIntTotal
, @DeferredInterestTotal = -DeferredInterestTotal

, @PlannedInterestTotal = -PlannedInterestTotal
, @DefaultInterestTotal = -DefaultInterestTotal

  FROM DataDebtorCardMovement cm 
  where DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
  and SeqNo >= @SeqNo
  order by cast(SeqNo as int) desc
