CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_Card_042_AdjustInterestBeforePayment]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TempMovement') IS NULL
        THROW 51001, 'Create #TempMovement in the caller session before running this SP.', 1;

/* ============================================================
   TEST CALCULATE INTEREST + DEFAULT INTEREST
   ============================================================ */

DECLARE @CurrentDate DATE = '2025-08-31'
      , @DataDebtorCardId NVARCHAR(150) = '8BABC2FD-3163-44B9-A51C-F9B085A96843';
DECLARE @PaymentDate DATE = '2026-06-18';       -- วันที่จ่ายเงินรอบนี้

/* ============================================================
   VARIABLE เดิม
   ============================================================ */

DECLARE @SeqNo INT =
(
    SELECT TOP 1 SeqNo
    FROM DataDebtorCardMovement
    WHERE DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
      AND TypeId = 2
    ORDER BY SeqNo DESC
);

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #TempMovement WHERE DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId AND TypeId = 7)
    THROW 51002, 'Run SP_DCS_Card_041_AdjustBeforePayment first in this session.', 1;

IF (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #TempMovement WHERE DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId) <> 1
    THROW 51003, 'Expected exactly one staged movement row before step 2.', 1;

DECLARE @NextSeqNo INT =
(
    SELECT ISNULL(MAX(TRY_CONVERT(INT, SeqNo)), @SeqNo) + 1
    FROM #TempMovement WHERE DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
);

DECLARE @DPD INT = 0;
DECLARE @DPDAccumulate INT = 0;

DECLARE @InterimInterest DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;

DECLARE @AccruedInterest DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;
DECLARE @AccruedInterestTotal DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;

DECLARE @CourtFee DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;
DECLARE @CourtFeeTotal DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;

DECLARE @LawyerFee DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;
DECLARE @LawyerFeeTotal DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;

DECLARE @OtherExpense DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;
DECLARE @OtherExpenseTotal DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;

DECLARE @InitialMargin DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;
DECLARE @InitialMarginTotal DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;

DECLARE @SuspendInt DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;
DECLARE @SuspendIntTotal DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;

DECLARE @DeferredInterest DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;
DECLARE @DeferredInterestTotal DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;

DECLARE @SuspendedDefaultInterest DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;
DECLARE @SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;

DECLARE @PlannedInterest DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;
DECLARE @PlannedInterestTotal DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;

DECLARE @DefaultInterest DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;
DECLARE @DefaultInterestTotal DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;

DECLARE @InterestQuantity INT = 0;


DECLARE @InterestStartDate DATE =
(
    SELECT TOP 1 PayDate
    FROM DataDebtorCardMovement
    WHERE DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
      AND SeqNo = @SeqNo
);

DECLARE @InterestEndDate DATE =
(
    SELECT TOP 1 InterestEndDate
    FROM DataDebtorCard
    WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
);


DECLARE @DayInYear INT =
(
    SELECT DATEDIFF
    (
        DAY,
        DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@InterestStartDate), 1, 1),
        DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@InterestStartDate) + 1, 1, 1)
    )
);


DECLARE @TypeId INT = 7;
DECLARE @TypeCode NVARCHAR(200);
DECLARE @TypeName NVARCHAR(200);


SELECT
      @TypeCode = PaymentTypeCode
    , @TypeName = PaymentTypeName
FROM SystemPaymentType
WHERE PaymentTypeId = @TypeId;


/* ============================================================
   ดึงยอด Movement เดิม
   ============================================================ */

SELECT
      @DPD = ISNULL(SUM(DPD), 0)
    , @DPDAccumulate = ISNULL(SUM(DPDAccumulate), 0)
    , @AccruedInterest = -ISNULL(SUM(AccruedInterest), 0)
    , @CourtFee = -ISNULL(SUM(CourtFee), 0)
    , @LawyerFee = -ISNULL(SUM(LawyerFee), 0)
    , @OtherExpense = -ISNULL(SUM(OtherExpense), 0)
    , @InitialMargin = -ISNULL(SUM(InitialMargin), 0)
    , @SuspendInt = -ISNULL(SUM(SuspendInt), 0)
    , @DeferredInterest = -ISNULL(SUM(DeferredInterest), 0)
    , @SuspendedDefaultInterest = -ISNULL(SUM(SuspendedDefaultInterest), 0)
    , @PlannedInterest = -ISNULL(SUM(PlannedInterest), 0)

    -- DefaultInterest จะคำนวณใหม่ด้านล่าง
    --, @DefaultInterest = -ISNULL(SUM(DefaultInterest), 0)

    , @InterestQuantity =
        DATEDIFF(DAY, @InterestStartDate, @InterestEndDate) + 1

FROM DataDebtorCardMovement cm
WHERE DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
  AND SeqNo >= @SeqNo;


/* ============================================================
   ยอด Total ตั้งต้นจาก Movement TypeId = 2 ที่ SeqNo = @SeqNo
   ============================================================ */

SELECT TOP 1
      @DPDAccumulate = ISNULL(cm.DPDAccumulate, 0)
    , @AccruedInterestTotal = ISNULL(cm.AccruedInterestTotal, 0)
    , @CourtFeeTotal = ISNULL(cm.CourtFeeTotal, 0)
    , @LawyerFeeTotal = ISNULL(cm.LawyerFeeTotal, 0)
    , @OtherExpenseTotal = ISNULL(cm.OtherExpenseTotal, 0)
    , @InitialMarginTotal = ISNULL(cm.InitialMarginTotal, 0)
    , @SuspendIntTotal = ISNULL(cm.SuspendIntTotal, 0)
    , @DeferredInterestTotal = ISNULL(cm.DeferredInterestTotal, 0)
    , @SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal = ISNULL(cm.SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal, 0)
    , @PlannedInterestTotal = ISNULL(cm.PlannedInterestTotal, 0)
    , @DefaultInterestTotal = ISNULL(cm.DefaultInterestTotal, 0)
FROM DataDebtorCardMovement cm
WHERE cm.DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
  AND cm.SeqNo = @SeqNo
  AND cm.TypeId = 2;


/* ============================================================
   CALCULATE DEFAULT INTEREST
   ============================================================ */

DECLARE @DFDDate DATE;
DECLARE @InterestPlannedRate DECIMAL(20,6);
DECLARE @InterestDefaultRate DECIMAL(20,6);
DECLARE @PrincipalTotal DECIMAL(20,4);

DECLARE @LastPaymentDate DATE;
DECLARE @CurrentPaymentAmount DECIMAL(20,4) = 1600;

DECLARE @FirstOverdueDueDate DATE;
DECLARE @PaymentEndDate DATE;

-- เคสปัจจุบัน ตัดดอก 20%
DECLARE @InterestCutPercent DECIMAL(20,6) = 20.00;


/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   ข้อมูลจาก Card
   ------------------------------------------------------------ */

SELECT
      @DFDDate = CAST(c.DFDDate AS DATE)
    , @InterestPlannedRate = ISNULL(c.InterestPlannedRate, 0)
    , @InterestDefaultRate = ISNULL(c.InterestDefaultRate, 0)

FROM DataDebtorCard c
WHERE c.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId;


/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   PrincipalTotal
   ใช้ยอดเดียวสำหรับคิดดอกเบี้ยระหว่างเดือน
   ------------------------------------------------------------ */

SELECT TOP 1
    @PrincipalTotal = ISNULL(m.PrincipalTotal, 0)
FROM DataDebtorCardMovement m
WHERE m.DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
  AND m.SeqNo = @SeqNo;


/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   วันที่จ่ายเงินจริงครั้งล่าสุด

   ใช้ Movement ก่อนรอบปัจจุบัน
   ------------------------------------------------------------ */

SELECT TOP 1
    @LastPaymentDate = CAST(m.PayDate AS DATE)
FROM DataDebtorCardMovement m
WHERE m.DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
  AND ISNULL(m.TotalPay, 0) > 0
  AND CAST(m.PayDate AS DATE) < @PaymentDate
ORDER BY
      CAST(m.PayDate AS DATE) DESC
    , CAST(m.SeqNo AS INT) DESC;





/* วันที่ก่อนวันที่จ่าย */
SET @PaymentEndDate = DATEADD(DAY, -1, @PaymentDate);



/* ============================================================
   TEMP : ใช้ตรวจสอบการคำนวณ Default Interest
   ============================================================ */

IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TempDefaultInterest') IS NOT NULL
    DROP TABLE #TempDefaultInterest;


CREATE TABLE #TempDefaultInterest
(
      RowNo INT
    , InstallmentSeq INT

    , DueDate DATE
    , IsSuspend BIT

    , PrincipalTotal DECIMAL(20,4)
    , Instament DECIMAL(20,4)

    -- กรณีงวดแรกเคยถูกชำระบางส่วน
    , PaymentAmountBefore DECIMAL(20,4)
    , PrincipalPayBefore DECIMAL(20,4)
    , AccruedInterestPayBefore DECIMAL(20,4)

    -- ค่างวดที่ยังเหลือ
    , RemainingInstallment DECIMAL(20,4)

    -- ช่วงผิดนัด
    , DefaultStartDate DATE
    , DefaultEndDate DATE
    , DPDDay INT

    -- ช่วงคิดดอกเบี้ยระหว่างเดือน
    , InterimStartDate DATE
    , InterimEndDate DATE
    , InterimDay INT

    -- ดอกเบี้ยระหว่างเดือน
    , InterimInterest DECIMAL(20,4)

    -- ดอกที่สามารถตัดได้ตามเงื่อนไข 20%
    , InterestCutLimit DECIMAL(20,4)
    , InterestToPay DECIMAL(20,4)

    -- เงินต้นจริงของค่างวด
    , ActualPrincipal DECIMAL(20,4)

    -- จำลองเงินที่จ่ายรอบนี้
    , PaymentBefore DECIMAL(20,4)
    , PaymentUsed DECIMAL(20,4)
    , PaymentAfter DECIMAL(20,4)

    -- เงินรอบนี้แตะงวดนี้หรือไม่
    , IsPaymentReached BIT

    -- ดอกเบี้ยผิดนัด
    , DefaultInterest DECIMAL(20,4)
);



/* ============================================================
   ถ้ามี DFD จึงคำนวณ Default Interest
   ============================================================ */

IF ISNULL(@DFDDate, '1900-01-01') <> '1900-01-01'
   AND ISNULL(@InterestDefaultRate, 0) > 0
BEGIN

    /* --------------------------------------------------------
       หางวดค้างต่ำสุด
       -------------------------------------------------------- */

    SELECT TOP 1
        @FirstOverdueDueDate = CAST(p.DueDate AS DATE)
    FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment p
    WHERE p.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
      AND ISNULL(p.IsPayment, 0) = 0
      AND ISNULL(p.IsActive, 1) = 1
    ORDER BY
          p.DueDate ASC
        , p.InstallmentSeq ASC;


    /* --------------------------------------------------------
       สร้างแถวตั้งแต่งวดค้างแรก
       จนถึงเดือนที่รับชำระ

       เช่น
       31/03
       30/04
       31/05
       30/06
       -------------------------------------------------------- */

    ;WITH InstallmentData AS
    (
        SELECT
              ROW_NUMBER() OVER
              (
                  ORDER BY
                        p.DueDate
                      , p.InstallmentSeq
              ) AS RowNo

            , p.InstallmentSeq
            , CAST(p.DueDate AS DATE) AS DueDate

            , ISNULL(p.IsSuspend, 0) AS IsSuspend

            , @PrincipalTotal AS PrincipalTotal

            , ISNULL(p.Instament, 0) AS Instament

            , ISNULL(p.PaymentAmount, 0) AS PaymentAmountBefore
            , ISNULL(p.PrincipalPay, 0) AS PrincipalPayBefore
            , ISNULL(p.AccruedInterestPay, 0) AS AccruedInterestPayBefore

        FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment p

        WHERE p.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId

          AND CAST(p.DueDate AS DATE) >= @FirstOverdueDueDate

          -- สร้างถึงงวดของเดือนที่จ่าย
          AND CAST(p.DueDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(@PaymentDate)

          AND ISNULL(p.IsActive, 1) = 1
    )

    INSERT INTO #TempDefaultInterest
    (
          RowNo
        , InstallmentSeq
        , DueDate
        , IsSuspend

        , PrincipalTotal
        , Instament

        , PaymentAmountBefore
        , PrincipalPayBefore
        , AccruedInterestPayBefore

        , RemainingInstallment

        , DefaultStartDate
        , DefaultEndDate
        , DPDDay

        , InterimStartDate
        , InterimEndDate
        , InterimDay

        , InterimInterest

        , InterestCutLimit
        , InterestToPay

        , ActualPrincipal

        , PaymentBefore
        , PaymentUsed
        , PaymentAfter

        , IsPaymentReached

        , DefaultInterest
    )

    SELECT
          x.RowNo
        , x.InstallmentSeq
        , x.DueDate
        , x.IsSuspend

        , x.PrincipalTotal
        , x.Instament

        , x.PaymentAmountBefore
        , x.PrincipalPayBefore
        , x.AccruedInterestPayBefore


        /* ----------------------------------------------------
           ค่างวดคงเหลือ

           เช่น
           ค่างวด 800
           เคยจ่าย 200
           เหลือ 600
           ---------------------------------------------------- */

        , CASE
            WHEN x.Instament - x.PaymentAmountBefore < 0
                THEN 0

            ELSE
                x.Instament - x.PaymentAmountBefore
          END AS RemainingInstallment


        /* ----------------------------------------------------
           วันที่เริ่มผิดนัด

           เดือน 3 = 01/04
           เดือน 4 = 01/05
           เดือน 5 = 01/06
           ---------------------------------------------------- */

        , DATEADD(DAY, 1, x.DueDate)
            AS DefaultStartDate


        /* วันก่อนวันที่จ่าย */

        , @PaymentEndDate
            AS DefaultEndDate


        /* ----------------------------------------------------
           DPD

           ถ้า DueDate ยังไม่ถึงรอบผิดนัด
           เช่น เดือนปัจจุบัน ให้เป็น 0
           ---------------------------------------------------- */

        , CASE

            WHEN DATEADD(DAY, 1, x.DueDate) > @PaymentEndDate
                THEN 0

            ELSE
                DATEDIFF
                (
                    DAY,
                    DATEADD(DAY, 1, x.DueDate),
                    @PaymentEndDate
                ) + 1

          END AS DPDDay


        /* ----------------------------------------------------
           วันที่เริ่มคิดดอกเบี้ยระหว่างเดือน

           แถวแรก:
           ใช้วันที่จ่ายครั้งล่าสุด

           แถวอื่น:
           วันแรกของเดือน DueDate
           ---------------------------------------------------- */

        , CASE

            WHEN x.RowNo = 1
                THEN @LastPaymentDate

            ELSE
                DATEFROMPARTS
                (
                    YEAR(x.DueDate),
                    MONTH(x.DueDate),
                    1
                )

          END AS InterimStartDate


        /* สิ้นเดือนของงวด */

        , x.DueDate AS InterimEndDate


        /* ----------------------------------------------------
           จำนวนวันคิดดอกเบี้ยระหว่างเดือน

           แถวแรก:
           LastPaymentDate ถึง DueDate
           นับรวมวันแรกและวันสุดท้าย

           ตัวอย่าง
           27/02 - 31/03 = 33 วัน
           ---------------------------------------------------- */

        , CASE

            WHEN x.RowNo = 1
            THEN
                DATEDIFF
                (
                    DAY,
                    @LastPaymentDate,
                    x.DueDate
                ) + 1

            ELSE
                DAY(x.DueDate)

          END AS InterimDay


        /* ค่าอื่นคำนวณ UPDATE ด้านล่าง */

        , 0 AS InterimInterest
        , 0 AS InterestCutLimit
        , 0 AS InterestToPay
        , 0 AS ActualPrincipal

        , 0 AS PaymentBefore
        , 0 AS PaymentUsed
        , 0 AS PaymentAfter

        , 0 AS IsPaymentReached

        , 0 AS DefaultInterest

    FROM InstallmentData x;





    /* ========================================================
       STEP 1 : คำนวณดอกเบี้ยระหว่างเดือน
       ======================================================== */

    UPDATE t
    SET t.InterimInterest =
        ROUND
        (
              t.PrincipalTotal
            * @InterestPlannedRate / 100.0
            * t.InterimDay
            /
            CASE
                WHEN
                    (
                        YEAR(t.InterimStartDate) % 400 = 0
                        OR
                        (
                            YEAR(t.InterimStartDate) % 4 = 0
                            AND YEAR(t.InterimStartDate) % 100 <> 0
                        )
                    )
                THEN 366
                ELSE 365
            END
        , 2
        )
    FROM #TempDefaultInterest t;



    /* ========================================================
       STEP 2 : เพดานดอก = 20% ของค่างวดคงเหลือ
       ======================================================== */

    UPDATE t
    SET t.InterestCutLimit =
        ROUND
        (
            t.RemainingInstallment
            * @InterestCutPercent / 100.0
        , 2
        )
    FROM #TempDefaultInterest t;



    /* ========================================================
       STEP 3 :
       ถ้าดอกเบี้ยจริง < 20% ค่างวด
           ใช้ดอกเบี้ยจริง

       ถ้าดอกเบี้ยจริง > 20% ค่างวด
           ใช้ 20% ของค่างวด
       ======================================================== */

    UPDATE t
    SET t.InterestToPay =
        CASE

            WHEN t.InterimInterest < t.InterestCutLimit
                THEN t.InterimInterest

            ELSE t.InterestCutLimit

        END
    FROM #TempDefaultInterest t;



    /* ========================================================
       STEP 4 : หาเงินต้นจริงของงวด

       RemainingInstallment - InterestToPay
       ======================================================== */

    UPDATE t
    SET t.ActualPrincipal =
        CASE

            WHEN t.RemainingInstallment - t.InterestToPay < 0
                THEN 0

            ELSE
                t.RemainingInstallment - t.InterestToPay

        END
    FROM #TempDefaultInterest t;



    /* ========================================================
       STEP 5 :
       จำลองเงินที่จ่ายรอบนี้ว่าไล่ไปถึงงวดไหน

       ใช้ Cursor เฉพาะ Temp ขนาดเล็ก
       เพื่อ Debug Logic ได้ง่าย
       ======================================================== */

    DECLARE @PaymentRemaining DECIMAL(20,4)
        = ISNULL(@CurrentPaymentAmount, 0);

    DECLARE @TempRowNo INT;
    DECLARE @TempRemainingInstallment DECIMAL(20,4);
    DECLARE @TempIsSuspend BIT;

    DECLARE @PaymentBefore DECIMAL(20,4);
    DECLARE @PaymentUsed DECIMAL(20,4);
    DECLARE @PaymentAfter DECIMAL(20,4);
    DECLARE @IsPaymentReached BIT;


    DECLARE DefaultInterestCursor CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD
    FOR
    SELECT
          RowNo
        , RemainingInstallment
        , IsSuspend
    FROM #TempDefaultInterest
    ORDER BY RowNo;


    OPEN DefaultInterestCursor;


    FETCH NEXT FROM DefaultInterestCursor
    INTO
          @TempRowNo
        , @TempRemainingInstallment
        , @TempIsSuspend;


    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN

        SET @PaymentBefore = @PaymentRemaining;

        SET @PaymentUsed = 0;
        SET @PaymentAfter = @PaymentRemaining;
        SET @IsPaymentReached = 0;


        /* ----------------------------------------------------
           ถ้ามีเงินเหลือ แปลว่าเงินรอบนี้แตะงวดนี้แล้ว
           ---------------------------------------------------- */

        IF @PaymentRemaining > 0
        BEGIN

            SET @IsPaymentReached = 1;


            /* จำนวนเงินที่ใช้กับงวดนี้ */

            SET @PaymentUsed =
                CASE

                    WHEN @PaymentRemaining >= @TempRemainingInstallment
                        THEN @TempRemainingInstallment

                    ELSE @PaymentRemaining

                END;


            SET @PaymentRemaining =
                @PaymentRemaining - @PaymentUsed;


            SET @PaymentAfter = @PaymentRemaining;

        END;


        UPDATE #TempDefaultInterest
        SET
              PaymentBefore = @PaymentBefore
            , PaymentUsed = @PaymentUsed
            , PaymentAfter = @PaymentAfter
            , IsPaymentReached = @IsPaymentReached
        WHERE RowNo = @TempRowNo;


        FETCH NEXT FROM DefaultInterestCursor
        INTO
              @TempRowNo
            , @TempRemainingInstallment
            , @TempIsSuspend;

    END;


    CLOSE DefaultInterestCursor;
    DEALLOCATE DefaultInterestCursor;



    /* ========================================================
       STEP 6 : คำนวณ Default Interest

       เงื่อนไข
       - เงินรอบนี้ต้องไปถึงงวดนั้น
       - ไม่ใช่งวดพักชำระ
       - ต้องมี DPD > 0
       ======================================================== */

    UPDATE t
    SET t.DefaultInterest =
        CASE

            WHEN t.IsPaymentReached = 1
             AND ISNULL(t.IsSuspend, 0) = 0
             AND t.DPDDay > 0

            THEN
                ROUND
                (
                      t.ActualPrincipal
                    * @InterestDefaultRate / 100.0
                    * t.DPDDay
                    /
                    CASE
                        WHEN
                            (
                                YEAR(t.DefaultStartDate) % 400 = 0
                                OR
                                (
                                    YEAR(t.DefaultStartDate) % 4 = 0
                                    AND YEAR(t.DefaultStartDate) % 100 <> 0
                                )
                            )
                        THEN 366
                        ELSE 365
                    END
                , 2
                )

            ELSE 0

        END
    FROM #TempDefaultInterest t;



    /* ========================================================
       STEP 7 : รวม DefaultInterest

       ตัวอย่างเคสที่สอน
       4.42 + 2.76 = 7.18
       ======================================================== */

    SELECT
        @DefaultInterest =
            ISNULL(SUM(DefaultInterest), 0)
    FROM #TempDefaultInterest;

END;



/* ============================================================
   FINAL INTEREST CALCULATION
   คำนวณ AccruedInterest หลังจากคำนวณดอกเบี้ยทุกประเภทเสร็จแล้ว
   Total ตั้งต้นอ่านจาก Movement TypeId=2 / @SeqNo ด้านบน
   ============================================================ */

-- SuspendInt รอบนี้: ใช้สูตรเดียวกับ SELECT Movement เดิม
SET @SuspendInt = ISNULL(CAST(
      @PrincipalTotal * @InterestPlannedRate / 100.0
    * @InterestQuantity / NULLIF(@DayInYear, 0)
    AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 0);

-- ใน SELECT Movement เดิม DeferredInterest รอบนี้เป็น 0
SET @DeferredInterest = 0;

-- ต้องทำหลังจาก @DefaultInterest และดอกเบี้ยประเภทอื่นคำนวณเสร็จแล้ว
SET @AccruedInterest =
      ISNULL(@SuspendInt, 0)
    + ISNULL(@DeferredInterest, 0)
    + ISNULL(@SuspendedDefaultInterest, 0)
    + ISNULL(@PlannedInterest, 0)
    + ISNULL(@DefaultInterest, 0);

-- เพิ่มยอดสะสมเพียงครั้งเดียว ไม่บวกซ้ำใน SELECT ผลลัพธ์
SET @AccruedInterestTotal =
      ISNULL(@AccruedInterestTotal, 0)
    + ISNULL(@AccruedInterest, 0);


/* ============================================================
   DEBUG

   ตรงนี้เอาไว้ตรวจแต่ละเคส
   ถ้าไม่ต้องการดู สามารถ Comment SELECT นี้ได้
   ไม่กระทบ @DefaultInterest
   ============================================================ */

SELECT
      RowNo
    , InstallmentSeq
    , DueDate

    , IsSuspend

    , PrincipalTotal

    , Instament
    , PaymentAmountBefore
    , RemainingInstallment

    , DefaultStartDate
    , DefaultEndDate
    , DPDDay

    , InterimStartDate
    , InterimEndDate
    , InterimDay

    , InterimInterest

    , InterestCutLimit
    , InterestToPay

    , ActualPrincipal

    , PaymentBefore
    , PaymentUsed
    , PaymentAfter

    , IsPaymentReached

    , DefaultInterest

FROM #TempDefaultInterest
ORDER BY RowNo;



/* ============================================================
   DEBUG RESULT

   ดูยอดรวม Default Interest
   ============================================================ */

SELECT
      @DFDDate AS DFDDate
    , @LastPaymentDate AS LastPaymentDate
    , @PaymentDate AS PaymentDate

    , @CurrentPaymentAmount AS CurrentPaymentAmount

    , @PrincipalTotal AS PrincipalTotal

    , @InterestPlannedRate AS InterestPlannedRate
    , @InterestDefaultRate AS InterestDefaultRate

    , @DefaultInterest AS DefaultInterest;



/* ============================================================
   RESULT เดิม
   ============================================================ */

SELECT
      @DPD AS DPD
    , @DPDAccumulate AS DPDAccumulate

    , @InterimInterest AS InterimInterest

    , @AccruedInterest AS AccruedInterest
    , @AccruedInterestTotal AS AccruedInterestTotal

    , @CourtFee AS CourtFee
    , @CourtFeeTotal AS CourtFeeTotal

    , @LawyerFee AS LawyerFee
    , @LawyerFeeTotal AS LawyerFeeTotal

    , @OtherExpense AS OtherExpense
    , @OtherExpenseTotal AS OtherExpenseTotal

    , @InitialMargin AS InitialMargin
    , @InitialMarginTotal AS InitialMarginTotal

    , @SuspendInt AS SuspendInt
    , @SuspendIntTotal AS SuspendIntTotal

    , @DeferredInterest AS DeferredInterest
    , @DeferredInterestTotal AS DeferredInterestTotal

    , @SuspendedDefaultInterest AS SuspendedDefaultInterest
    , @SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal AS SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal

    , @PlannedInterest AS PlannedInterest
    , @PlannedInterestTotal AS PlannedInterestTotal

    , @DefaultInterest AS DefaultInterest
    , @DefaultInterestTotal AS DefaultInterestTotal;



/* ============================================================
   ตารางเดิมของเธอ
   ============================================================ */

INSERT INTO #TempMovement
(

     [DebtorCardMovementId]
    ,[DebtorCardId]
    ,[DocDate]
    ,[PayDate]
    ,[LGNo]
    ,[DebtorId]
    ,[DebtorCode]
    ,[DebtorCardCode]
    ,[DebtorCardName]
    ,[TypeId]
    ,[TypeCode]
    ,[TypeName]
    ,[FlagAutoPay]
    ,[DFDDate]
    ,[DFDStartDate]
    ,[DFDEndDate]
    ,[DPD]
    ,[TotalPay]
    ,[IsAdjust]
    ,[AdjustRefDocNo]
    ,[IsDelete]
    ,[MeasureId]
    ,[MeasureCode]
    ,[MeasureName]
    ,[InterestRate]
    ,[InterestPlannedRate]
    ,[InterestDefaultRate]
    ,[DebtBalance]
    ,[ReceivePayment]
    ,[Installment]
    ,[InstallmentPay]
    ,[InstallmentTotal]
    ,[Principal]
    ,[PrincipalPay]
    ,[PrincipalTotal]
    ,[InterimInterest]
    ,[AccruedInterest]
    ,[AccruedInterestPay]
    ,[AccruedInterestTotal]
    ,[CourtFee]
    ,[CourtFeePay]
    ,[CourtFeeTotal]
    ,[LawyerFee]
    ,[LawyerFeePay]
    ,[LawyerFeeTotal]
    ,[OtherExpense]
    ,[OtherExpensePay]
    ,[OtherExpenseTotal]
    ,[InitialMargin]
    ,[InitialMarginPay]
    ,[InitialMarginTotal]
    ,[SuspendInt]
    ,[SuspendIntPay]
    ,[SuspendIntTotal]
    ,[DeferredInterest]
    ,[DeferredInterestPay]
    ,[DeferredInterestTotal]
    ,[SuspendedDefaultInterest]
    ,[SuspendedDefaultInterestPay]
    ,[SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal]
    ,[PlannedInterest]
    ,[PlannedInterestPay]
    ,[PlannedInterestTotal]
    ,[DefaultInterest]
    ,[DefaultInterestPay]
    ,[DefaultInterestTotal]
    ,[CreateBy]
    ,[CreateDate]
    ,[UpdateBy]
    ,[UpdateDate]
    ,[ReceiptNo]
    ,[IsEstatement]
    ,[EStatementRef]
    ,[PaymentTypeId]
    ,[SeqNo]
    ,[DebtorPaymentId]
    ,[DebtorPaymentCode]
    ,[CompromiseContractGroup]
    ,[ReceiptId]
    ,[InstallmentPrincipal]
    ,[InstallmentPrincipalPay]
    ,[InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
    ,[InstallmentInterest]
    ,[InstallmentInterestPay]
    ,[InstallmentInterestTotal]
    ,[InterestStartDate]
    ,[InterestEndDate]
    ,[InterestQuantity]
    ,[DPDAccumulate]
    ,[OverdueAmount]
    ,[PrincipalOverdueAmount]
    ,[AccruedInterestOverdueAmount]
    ,[TotalOverdue]
    ,[TotalPrincipalOverdue]
    ,[TotalAccruedInterestOverdue]
    ,[CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId]
    ,[IsUpdateHistory]

)
SELECT
       NEWID() AS [DebtorCardMovementId]
      ,@DataDebtorCardId AS [DebtorCardId]
      ,@CurrentDate AS [DocDate]
      ,@CurrentDate AS [PayDate]

      ,m.[LGNo]
      ,m.[DebtorId]
      ,m.[DebtorCode]
      ,m.[DebtorCardCode]
      ,m.[DebtorCardName]

      ,@TypeId AS [TypeId]
      ,@TypeCode AS [TypeCode]
      ,@TypeName AS [TypeName]

      ,0 AS [FlagAutoPay]

      ,CAST('1900-01-01' AS DATE) AS [DFDDate]
      ,CAST('1900-01-01' AS DATE) AS [DFDStartDate]
      ,CAST('1900-01-01' AS DATE) AS [DFDEndDate]

      ,@DPD AS [DPD]

      ,0 AS [TotalPay]
      ,1 AS [IsAdjust]
      ,NULL AS [AdjustRefDocNo]
      ,0 AS [IsDelete]

      ,m.[MeasureId]
      ,m.[MeasureCode]
      ,m.[MeasureName]

      ,c.[InterestRate]
      ,c.[InterestPlannedRate]
      ,c.[InterestDefaultRate]

      ,m.PrincipalTotal AS [DebtBalance]

      ,0 AS [ReceivePayment]

      ,0 AS [Installment]
      ,0 AS [InstallmentPay]
      ,0 AS [InstallmentTotal]

      ,0 AS [Principal]
      ,0 AS [PrincipalPay]

      ,m.[PrincipalTotal]


      /* ดอกเบี้ยระหว่างเดือน */

      ,CAST
       (
            m.[PrincipalTotal]
            * c.InterestPlannedRate / 100.0
            * @InterestQuantity
            / @DayInYear
        AS DECIMAL(18,2)
       ) AS [InterimInterest]


      ,@AccruedInterest AS [AccruedInterest]
      ,0 AS [AccruedInterestPay]
      ,@AccruedInterestTotal AS [AccruedInterestTotal]

      ,@CourtFee AS [CourtFee]
      ,0 AS [CourtFeePay]
      ,(@CourtFeeTotal + @CourtFee) AS [CourtFeeTotal]

      ,@LawyerFee AS [LawyerFee]
      ,0 AS [LawyerFeePay]
      ,(@LawyerFeeTotal + @LawyerFee) AS [LawyerFeeTotal]

      ,@OtherExpense AS [OtherExpense]
      ,0 AS [OtherExpensePay]
      ,(@OtherExpenseTotal + @OtherExpense) AS [OtherExpenseTotal]

      ,@InitialMargin AS [InitialMargin]
      ,0 AS [InitialMarginPay]
      ,(@InitialMarginTotal + @InitialMargin) AS [InitialMarginTotal]


      ,@SuspendInt AS [SuspendInt]
      ,0 AS [SuspendIntPay]
      ,(@SuspendIntTotal + @SuspendInt) AS [SuspendIntTotal]

      ,0 AS [DeferredInterest]
      ,0 AS [DeferredInterestPay]
      ,(@DeferredInterestTotal + 0) AS [DeferredInterestTotal]

      ,@SuspendedDefaultInterest AS [SuspendedDefaultInterest]
      ,0 AS [SuspendedDefaultInterestPay]
      ,(@SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal + @SuspendedDefaultInterest) AS [SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal]

      ,@PlannedInterest AS [PlannedInterest]
      ,0 AS [PlannedInterestPay]
      ,(@PlannedInterestTotal + @PlannedInterest) AS [PlannedInterestTotal]


      /* ======================================================
         ดอกเบี้ยผิดนัดที่คำนวณจาก Temp
         ตัวอย่างเคสนี้ควรได้ 7.18
         ====================================================== */

      ,@DefaultInterest AS [DefaultInterest]

      ,0 AS [DefaultInterestPay]

      /* ยอดสะสม */
      ,@DefaultInterestTotal + @DefaultInterest
            AS [DefaultInterestTotal]


      ,1 AS [CreateBy]
      ,GETDATE() AS [CreateDate]

      ,1 AS [UpdateBy]
      ,GETDATE() AS [UpdateDate]

      ,NULL AS [ReceiptNo]

      ,0 AS [IsEstatement]
      ,NULL AS [EStatementRef]

      ,NULL AS [PaymentTypeId]

      ,@NextSeqNo AS [SeqNo]

      ,NULL AS [DebtorPaymentId]
      ,NULL AS [DebtorPaymentCode]

      ,NULL AS [CompromiseContractGroup]
      ,NULL AS [ReceiptId]

      ,c.[InstallmentPrincipal]
      ,c.[InstallmentPrincipalPay]
      ,c.[InstallmentPrincipalTotal]

      ,c.[InstallmentInterest]
      ,c.[InstallmentInterestPay]
      ,c.[InstallmentInterestTotal]

      ,@InterestStartDate AS [InterestStartDate]
      ,@InterestEndDate AS [InterestEndDate]
      ,@InterestQuantity AS [InterestQuantity]

      ,@DPDAccumulate AS [DPDAccumulate]

      ,0 AS [OverdueAmount]
      ,0 AS [PrincipalOverdueAmount]
      ,0 AS [AccruedInterestOverdueAmount]

      ,0 AS [TotalOverdue]
      ,0 AS [TotalPrincipalOverdue]
      ,0 AS [TotalAccruedInterestOverdue]

      ,NULL AS [CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId]

      ,0 AS [IsUpdateHistory]
FROM #TempMovement m

LEFT JOIN DataDebtorCard c
       ON c.DataDebtorCardId = m.DebtorCardId

WHERE m.DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
  AND TRY_CONVERT(INT, m.SeqNo) = @NextSeqNo - 1;
END;

modules.name: SP_DCS_Card_042_AdjustInterestBeforePayment_Stage
modules.definition:
CREATE   PROCEDURE dbo.SP_DCS_Card_042_AdjustInterestBeforePayment_Stage
 @DataDebtorCardId NVARCHAR(150), @CurrentDate DATE, @PaymentDate DATE, @CurrentPaymentAmount DECIMAL(20,4)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TempMovement') IS NULL
        THROW 51001, 'Create #TempMovement in the caller session before running this SP.', 1;

/* ============================================================
   TEST CALCULATE INTEREST + DEFAULT INTEREST
   ============================================================ */

-- parameters supplied by caller

/* ============================================================
   VARIABLE เดิม
   ============================================================ */

DECLARE @SeqNo INT =
(
    SELECT TOP 1 SeqNo
    FROM DataDebtorCardMovement
    WHERE DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
      AND TypeId = 2
    ORDER BY TRY_CONVERT(INT,SeqNo) DESC
);

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #TempMovement WHERE DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId AND TypeId = 7)
    THROW 51002, 'Run SP_DCS_Card_041_AdjustBeforePayment first in this session.', 1;

IF (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #TempMovement WHERE DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId) <> 1
    THROW 51003, 'Expected exactly one staged movement row before step 2.', 1;

DECLARE @NextSeqNo INT =
(
    SELECT ISNULL(MAX(TRY_CONVERT(INT, SeqNo)), @SeqNo) + 1
    FROM #TempMovement WHERE DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
);

DECLARE @DPD INT = 0;
DECLARE @DPDAccumulate INT = 0;

DECLARE @InterimInterest DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;

DECLARE @AccruedInterest DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;
DECLARE @AccruedInterestTotal DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;

DECLARE @CourtFee DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;
DECLARE @CourtFeeTotal DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;

DECLARE @LawyerFee DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;
DECLARE @LawyerFeeTotal DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;

DECLARE @OtherExpense DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;
DECLARE @OtherExpenseTotal DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;

DECLARE @InitialMargin DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;
DECLARE @InitialMarginTotal DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;

DECLARE @SuspendInt DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;
DECLARE @SuspendIntTotal DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;

DECLARE @DeferredInterest DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;
DECLARE @DeferredInterestTotal DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;

DECLARE @SuspendedDefaultInterest DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;
DECLARE @SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;

DECLARE @PlannedInterest DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;
DECLARE @PlannedInterestTotal DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;

DECLARE @DefaultInterest DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;
DECLARE @DefaultInterestTotal DECIMAL(20,4) = 0;

DECLARE @InterestQuantity INT = 0;


DECLARE @InterestStartDate DATE =
(
    SELECT TOP 1 PayDate
    FROM DataDebtorCardMovement
    WHERE DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
      AND SeqNo = @SeqNo
);

DECLARE @InterestEndDate DATE =
(
    SELECT TOP 1 InterestEndDate
    FROM DataDebtorCard
    WHERE DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
);


DECLARE @DayInYear INT =
(
    SELECT DATEDIFF
    (
        DAY,
        DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@InterestStartDate), 1, 1),
        DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@InterestStartDate) + 1, 1, 1)
    )
);


DECLARE @TypeId INT = 7;
DECLARE @TypeCode NVARCHAR(200);
DECLARE @TypeName NVARCHAR(200);


SELECT
      @TypeCode = PaymentTypeCode
    , @TypeName = PaymentTypeName
FROM SystemPaymentType
WHERE PaymentTypeId = @TypeId;


/* ============================================================
   ดึงยอด Movement เดิม
   ============================================================ */

SELECT
      @DPD = ISNULL(SUM(DPD), 0)
    , @DPDAccumulate = ISNULL(SUM(DPDAccumulate), 0)
    , @AccruedInterest = -ISNULL(SUM(AccruedInterest), 0)
    , @CourtFee = -ISNULL(SUM(CourtFee), 0)
    , @LawyerFee = -ISNULL(SUM(LawyerFee), 0)
    , @OtherExpense = -ISNULL(SUM(OtherExpense), 0)
    , @InitialMargin = -ISNULL(SUM(InitialMargin), 0)
    , @SuspendInt = -ISNULL(SUM(SuspendInt), 0)
    , @DeferredInterest = -ISNULL(SUM(DeferredInterest), 0)
    , @SuspendedDefaultInterest = -ISNULL(SUM(SuspendedDefaultInterest), 0)
    , @PlannedInterest = -ISNULL(SUM(PlannedInterest), 0)

    -- DefaultInterest จะคำนวณใหม่ด้านล่าง
    --, @DefaultInterest = -ISNULL(SUM(DefaultInterest), 0)

    , @InterestQuantity =
        DATEDIFF(DAY, @InterestStartDate, @InterestEndDate) + 1

FROM DataDebtorCardMovement cm
WHERE DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
  AND SeqNo >= @SeqNo;


/* ============================================================
   ยอด Total ตั้งต้นจาก Movement TypeId = 2 ที่ SeqNo = @SeqNo
   ============================================================ */

SELECT TOP 1
      @DPDAccumulate = ISNULL(cm.DPDAccumulate, 0)
    , @AccruedInterestTotal = ISNULL(cm.AccruedInterestTotal, 0)
    , @CourtFeeTotal = ISNULL(cm.CourtFeeTotal, 0)
    , @LawyerFeeTotal = ISNULL(cm.LawyerFeeTotal, 0)
    , @OtherExpenseTotal = ISNULL(cm.OtherExpenseTotal, 0)
    , @InitialMarginTotal = ISNULL(cm.InitialMarginTotal, 0)
    , @SuspendIntTotal = ISNULL(cm.SuspendIntTotal, 0)
    , @DeferredInterestTotal = ISNULL(cm.DeferredInterestTotal, 0)
    , @SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal = ISNULL(cm.SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal, 0)
    , @PlannedInterestTotal = ISNULL(cm.PlannedInterestTotal, 0)
    , @DefaultInterestTotal = ISNULL(cm.DefaultInterestTotal, 0)
FROM DataDebtorCardMovement cm
WHERE cm.DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
  AND cm.SeqNo = @SeqNo
  AND cm.TypeId = 2;


/* ============================================================
   CALCULATE DEFAULT INTEREST
   ============================================================ */

DECLARE @DFDDate DATE;
DECLARE @InterestPlannedRate DECIMAL(20,6);
DECLARE @InterestDefaultRate DECIMAL(20,6);
DECLARE @PrincipalTotal DECIMAL(20,4);

DECLARE @LastPaymentDate DATE;
-- @CurrentPaymentAmount is caller supplied

DECLARE @FirstOverdueDueDate DATE;
DECLARE @PaymentEndDate DATE;

-- เคสปัจจุบัน ตัดดอก 20%
DECLARE @InterestCutPercent DECIMAL(20,6);
DECLARE @InterestPaymentSeqId INT;
SELECT @InterestPaymentSeqId = MIN(TRY_CONVERT(INT, map.ConditionItemMapingValue))
FROM dbo.SystemConditionItemMappingValueMaster map
JOIN dbo.SystemConditionMaster cond ON cond.ConditionId=map.ConditionId
JOIN dbo.SystemCampaignConditionMaster camp ON camp.ConditionId=cond.ConditionId
JOIN dbo.SystemMeasureCampaignMaster measureCamp ON measureCamp.CampaignId=camp.CampaignId
JOIN dbo.DataDebtorCard card ON card.MeasureId=measureCamp.MeasureId
WHERE map.ConditionItemId=20 AND card.DataDebtorCardId=@DataDebtorCardId;
SELECT TOP (1) @InterestCutPercent = 100.0 - ISNULL(sd.[Values],0)
FROM dbo.SystemPaymentSeqDetailMaster sd
WHERE sd.PaymentSeqId=@InterestPaymentSeqId
  AND sd.ParameterValuesId=102 AND sd.UnitValuesId=94
ORDER BY sd.Seq;
IF @InterestCutPercent IS NULL OR @InterestCutPercent<0 OR @InterestCutPercent>100
  THROW 54201,N'042: Unsupported or missing interest split in payment master',1;


/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   ข้อมูลจาก Card
   ------------------------------------------------------------ */

SELECT
      @DFDDate = CAST(c.DFDDate AS DATE)
    , @InterestPlannedRate = ISNULL(c.InterestPlannedRate, 0)
    , @InterestDefaultRate = ISNULL(c.InterestDefaultRate, 0)

FROM DataDebtorCard c
WHERE c.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId;


/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   PrincipalTotal
   ใช้ยอดเดียวสำหรับคิดดอกเบี้ยระหว่างเดือน
   ------------------------------------------------------------ */

SELECT TOP 1
    @PrincipalTotal = ISNULL(m.PrincipalTotal, 0)
FROM DataDebtorCardMovement m
WHERE m.DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
  AND m.SeqNo = @SeqNo;


/* ------------------------------------------------------------
   วันที่จ่ายเงินจริงครั้งล่าสุด

   ใช้ Movement ก่อนรอบปัจจุบัน
   ------------------------------------------------------------ */

SELECT TOP 1
    @LastPaymentDate = CAST(m.PayDate AS DATE)
FROM DataDebtorCardMovement m
WHERE m.DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
  AND ISNULL(m.TotalPay, 0) > 0
  AND CAST(m.PayDate AS DATE) < @PaymentDate
ORDER BY
      CAST(m.PayDate AS DATE) DESC
    , CAST(m.SeqNo AS INT) DESC;





/* วันที่ก่อนวันที่จ่าย */
SET @PaymentEndDate = DATEADD(DAY, -1, @PaymentDate);



/* ============================================================
   TEMP : ใช้ตรวจสอบการคำนวณ Default Interest
   ============================================================ */

IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TempDefaultInterest') IS NOT NULL
    DROP TABLE #TempDefaultInterest;


CREATE TABLE #TempDefaultInterest
(
      RowNo INT
    , InstallmentSeq INT

    , DueDate DATE
    , IsSuspend BIT

    , PrincipalTotal DECIMAL(20,4)
    , Instament DECIMAL(20,4)

    -- กรณีงวดแรกเคยถูกชำระบางส่วน
    , PaymentAmountBefore DECIMAL(20,4)
    , PrincipalPayBefore DECIMAL(20,4)
    , AccruedInterestPayBefore DECIMAL(20,4)

    -- ค่างวดที่ยังเหลือ
    , RemainingInstallment DECIMAL(20,4)

    -- ช่วงผิดนัด
    , DefaultStartDate DATE
    , DefaultEndDate DATE
    , DPDDay INT

    -- ช่วงคิดดอกเบี้ยระหว่างเดือน
    , InterimStartDate DATE
    , InterimEndDate DATE
    , InterimDay INT

    -- ดอกเบี้ยระหว่างเดือน
    , InterimInterest DECIMAL(20,4)

    -- ดอกที่สามารถตัดได้ตามเงื่อนไข 20%
    , InterestCutLimit DECIMAL(20,4)
    , InterestToPay DECIMAL(20,4)

    -- เงินต้นจริงของค่างวด
    , ActualPrincipal DECIMAL(20,4)

    -- จำลองเงินที่จ่ายรอบนี้
    , PaymentBefore DECIMAL(20,4)
    , PaymentUsed DECIMAL(20,4)
    , PaymentAfter DECIMAL(20,4)

    -- เงินรอบนี้แตะงวดนี้หรือไม่
    , IsPaymentReached BIT

    -- ดอกเบี้ยผิดนัด
    , DefaultInterest DECIMAL(20,4)
);



/* ============================================================
   ถ้ามี DFD จึงคำนวณ Default Interest
   ============================================================ */

IF ISNULL(@DFDDate, '1900-01-01') <> '1900-01-01'
   AND ISNULL(@InterestDefaultRate, 0) > 0
BEGIN

    /* --------------------------------------------------------
       หางวดค้างต่ำสุด
       -------------------------------------------------------- */

    SELECT TOP 1
        @FirstOverdueDueDate = CAST(p.DueDate AS DATE)
    FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment p
    WHERE p.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
      AND ISNULL(p.IsPayment, 0) = 0
      AND ISNULL(p.IsActive, 1) = 1
    ORDER BY
          p.DueDate ASC
        , p.InstallmentSeq ASC;


    /* --------------------------------------------------------
       สร้างแถวตั้งแต่งวดค้างแรก
       จนถึงเดือนที่รับชำระ

       เช่น
       31/03
       30/04
       31/05
       30/06
       -------------------------------------------------------- */

    ;WITH InstallmentData AS
    (
        SELECT
              ROW_NUMBER() OVER
              (
                  ORDER BY
                        p.DueDate
                      , p.InstallmentSeq
              ) AS RowNo

            , p.InstallmentSeq
            , CAST(p.DueDate AS DATE) AS DueDate

            , ISNULL(p.IsSuspend, 0) AS IsSuspend

            , @PrincipalTotal AS PrincipalTotal

            , ISNULL(p.Instament, 0) AS Instament

            , ISNULL(p.PaymentAmount, 0) AS PaymentAmountBefore
            , ISNULL(p.PrincipalPay, 0) AS PrincipalPayBefore
            , ISNULL(p.AccruedInterestPay, 0) AS AccruedInterestPayBefore

        FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment p

        WHERE p.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId

          AND CAST(p.DueDate AS DATE) >= @FirstOverdueDueDate

          -- สร้างถึงงวดของเดือนที่จ่าย
          AND CAST(p.DueDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(@PaymentDate)

          AND ISNULL(p.IsActive, 1) = 1
    )

    INSERT INTO #TempDefaultInterest
    (
          RowNo
        , InstallmentSeq
        , DueDate
        , IsSuspend

        , PrincipalTotal
        , Instament

        , PaymentAmountBefore
        , PrincipalPayBefore
        , AccruedInterestPayBefore

        , RemainingInstallment

        , DefaultStartDate
        , DefaultEndDate
        , DPDDay

        , InterimStartDate
        , InterimEndDate
        , InterimDay

        , InterimInterest

        , InterestCutLimit
        , InterestToPay

        , ActualPrincipal

        , PaymentBefore
        , PaymentUsed
        , PaymentAfter

        , IsPaymentReached

        , DefaultInterest
    )

    SELECT
          x.RowNo
        , x.InstallmentSeq
        , x.DueDate
        , x.IsSuspend

        , x.PrincipalTotal
        , x.Instament

        , x.PaymentAmountBefore
        , x.PrincipalPayBefore
        , x.AccruedInterestPayBefore


        /* ----------------------------------------------------
           ค่างวดคงเหลือ

           เช่น
           ค่างวด 800
           เคยจ่าย 200
           เหลือ 600
           ---------------------------------------------------- */

        , CASE
            WHEN x.Instament - x.PaymentAmountBefore < 0
                THEN 0

            ELSE
                x.Instament - x.PaymentAmountBefore
          END AS RemainingInstallment


        /* ----------------------------------------------------
           วันที่เริ่มผิดนัด

           เดือน 3 = 01/04
           เดือน 4 = 01/05
           เดือน 5 = 01/06
           ---------------------------------------------------- */

        , DATEADD(DAY, 1, x.DueDate)
            AS DefaultStartDate


        /* วันก่อนวันที่จ่าย */

        , @PaymentEndDate
            AS DefaultEndDate


        /* ----------------------------------------------------
           DPD

           ถ้า DueDate ยังไม่ถึงรอบผิดนัด
           เช่น เดือนปัจจุบัน ให้เป็น 0
           ---------------------------------------------------- */

        , CASE

            WHEN DATEADD(DAY, 1, x.DueDate) > @PaymentEndDate
                THEN 0

            ELSE
                DATEDIFF
                (
                    DAY,
                    DATEADD(DAY, 1, x.DueDate),
                    @PaymentEndDate
                ) + 1

          END AS DPDDay


        /* ----------------------------------------------------
           วันที่เริ่มคิดดอกเบี้ยระหว่างเดือน

           แถวแรก:
           ใช้วันที่จ่ายครั้งล่าสุด

           แถวอื่น:
           วันแรกของเดือน DueDate
           ---------------------------------------------------- */

        , CASE

            WHEN x.RowNo = 1
                THEN @LastPaymentDate

            ELSE
                DATEFROMPARTS
                (
                    YEAR(x.DueDate),
                    MONTH(x.DueDate),
                    1
                )

          END AS InterimStartDate


        /* สิ้นเดือนของงวด */

        , x.DueDate AS InterimEndDate


        /* ----------------------------------------------------
           จำนวนวันคิดดอกเบี้ยระหว่างเดือน

           แถวแรก:
           LastPaymentDate ถึง DueDate
           นับรวมวันแรกและวันสุดท้าย

           ตัวอย่าง
           27/02 - 31/03 = 33 วัน
           ---------------------------------------------------- */

        , CASE

            WHEN x.RowNo = 1
            THEN
                DATEDIFF
                (
                    DAY,
                    @LastPaymentDate,
                    x.DueDate
                ) + 1

            ELSE
                DAY(x.DueDate)

          END AS InterimDay


        /* ค่าอื่นคำนวณ UPDATE ด้านล่าง */

        , 0 AS InterimInterest
        , 0 AS InterestCutLimit
        , 0 AS InterestToPay
        , 0 AS ActualPrincipal

        , 0 AS PaymentBefore
        , 0 AS PaymentUsed
        , 0 AS PaymentAfter

        , 0 AS IsPaymentReached

        , 0 AS DefaultInterest

    FROM InstallmentData x;





    /* ========================================================
       STEP 1 : คำนวณดอกเบี้ยระหว่างเดือน
       ======================================================== */

    UPDATE t
    SET t.InterimInterest =
        ROUND
        (
              t.PrincipalTotal
            * @InterestPlannedRate / 100.0
            * t.InterimDay
            /
            CASE
                WHEN
                    (
                        YEAR(t.InterimStartDate) % 400 = 0
                        OR
                        (
                            YEAR(t.InterimStartDate) % 4 = 0
                            AND YEAR(t.InterimStartDate) % 100 <> 0
                        )
                    )
                THEN 366
                ELSE 365
            END
        , 2
        )
    FROM #TempDefaultInterest t;



    /* ========================================================
       STEP 2 : เพดานดอก = 20% ของค่างวดคงเหลือ
       ======================================================== */

    UPDATE t
    SET t.InterestCutLimit =
        ROUND
        (
            t.RemainingInstallment
            * @InterestCutPercent / 100.0
        , 2
        )
    FROM #TempDefaultInterest t;



    /* ========================================================
       STEP 3 :
       ถ้าดอกเบี้ยจริง < 20% ค่างวด
           ใช้ดอกเบี้ยจริง

       ถ้าดอกเบี้ยจริง > 20% ค่างวด
           ใช้ 20% ของค่างวด
       ======================================================== */

    UPDATE t
    SET t.InterestToPay =
        CASE

            WHEN t.InterimInterest < t.InterestCutLimit
                THEN t.InterimInterest

            ELSE t.InterestCutLimit

        END
    FROM #TempDefaultInterest t;



    /* ========================================================
       STEP 4 : หาเงินต้นจริงของงวด

       RemainingInstallment - InterestToPay
       ======================================================== */

    UPDATE t
    SET t.ActualPrincipal =
        CASE

            WHEN t.RemainingInstallment - t.InterestToPay < 0
                THEN 0

            ELSE
                t.RemainingInstallment - t.InterestToPay

        END
    FROM #TempDefaultInterest t;



    /* ========================================================
       STEP 5 :
       จำลองเงินที่จ่ายรอบนี้ว่าไล่ไปถึงงวดไหน

       ใช้ Cursor เฉพาะ Temp ขนาดเล็ก
       เพื่อ Debug Logic ได้ง่าย
       ======================================================== */

    DECLARE @PaymentRemaining DECIMAL(20,4)
        = ISNULL(@CurrentPaymentAmount, 0);

    DECLARE @TempRowNo INT;
    DECLARE @TempRemainingInstallment DECIMAL(20,4);
    DECLARE @TempIsSuspend BIT;

    DECLARE @PaymentBefore DECIMAL(20,4);
    DECLARE @PaymentUsed DECIMAL(20,4);
    DECLARE @PaymentAfter DECIMAL(20,4);
    DECLARE @IsPaymentReached BIT;


    DECLARE DefaultInterestCursor CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD
    FOR
    SELECT
          RowNo
        , RemainingInstallment
        , IsSuspend
    FROM #TempDefaultInterest
    ORDER BY RowNo;


    OPEN DefaultInterestCursor;


    FETCH NEXT FROM DefaultInterestCursor
    INTO
          @TempRowNo
        , @TempRemainingInstallment
        , @TempIsSuspend;


    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN

        SET @PaymentBefore = @PaymentRemaining;

        SET @PaymentUsed = 0;
        SET @PaymentAfter = @PaymentRemaining;
        SET @IsPaymentReached = 0;


        /* ----------------------------------------------------
           ถ้ามีเงินเหลือ แปลว่าเงินรอบนี้แตะงวดนี้แล้ว
           ---------------------------------------------------- */

        IF @PaymentRemaining > 0
        BEGIN

            SET @IsPaymentReached = 1;


            /* จำนวนเงินที่ใช้กับงวดนี้ */

            SET @PaymentUsed =
                CASE

                    WHEN @PaymentRemaining >= @TempRemainingInstallment
                        THEN @TempRemainingInstallment

                    ELSE @PaymentRemaining

                END;


            SET @PaymentRemaining =
                @PaymentRemaining - @PaymentUsed;


            SET @PaymentAfter = @PaymentRemaining;

        END;


        UPDATE #TempDefaultInterest
        SET
              PaymentBefore = @PaymentBefore
            , PaymentUsed = @PaymentUsed
            , PaymentAfter = @PaymentAfter
            , IsPaymentReached = @IsPaymentReached
        WHERE RowNo = @TempRowNo;


        FETCH NEXT FROM DefaultInterestCursor
        INTO
              @TempRowNo
            , @TempRemainingInstallment
            , @TempIsSuspend;

    END;


    CLOSE DefaultInterestCursor;
    DEALLOCATE DefaultInterestCursor;



    /* ========================================================
       STEP 6 : คำนวณ Default Interest

       เงื่อนไข
       - เงินรอบนี้ต้องไปถึงงวดนั้น
       - ไม่ใช่งวดพักชำระ
       - ต้องมี DPD > 0
       ======================================================== */

    UPDATE t
    SET t.DefaultInterest =
        CASE

            WHEN t.IsPaymentReached = 1
             AND ISNULL(t.IsSuspend, 0) = 0
             AND t.DPDDay > 0

            THEN
                ROUND
                (
                      t.ActualPrincipal
                    * @InterestDefaultRate / 100.0
                    * t.DPDDay
                    /
                    CASE
                        WHEN
                            (
                                YEAR(t.DefaultStartDate) % 400 = 0
                                OR
                                (
                                    YEAR(t.DefaultStartDate) % 4 = 0
                                    AND YEAR(t.DefaultStartDate) % 100 <> 0
                                )
                            )
                        THEN 366
                        ELSE 365
                    END
                , 2
                )

            ELSE 0

        END
    FROM #TempDefaultInterest t;



    /* ========================================================
       STEP 7 : รวม DefaultInterest

       ตัวอย่างเคสที่สอน
       4.42 + 2.76 = 7.18
       ======================================================== */

    SELECT
        @DefaultInterest =
            ISNULL(SUM(DefaultInterest), 0)
    FROM #TempDefaultInterest;

END;



/* ============================================================
   FINAL INTEREST CALCULATION
   คำนวณ AccruedInterest หลังจากคำนวณดอกเบี้ยทุกประเภทเสร็จแล้ว
   Total ตั้งต้นอ่านจาก Movement TypeId=2 / @SeqNo ด้านบน
   ============================================================ */

-- SuspendInt รอบนี้: ใช้สูตรเดียวกับ SELECT Movement เดิม
SET @SuspendInt = ISNULL(CAST(
      @PrincipalTotal * @InterestPlannedRate / 100.0
    * @InterestQuantity / NULLIF(@DayInYear, 0)
    AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 0);

-- ใน SELECT Movement เดิม DeferredInterest รอบนี้เป็น 0
SET @DeferredInterest = 0;

-- ต้องทำหลังจาก @DefaultInterest และดอกเบี้ยประเภทอื่นคำนวณเสร็จแล้ว
SET @AccruedInterest =
      ISNULL(@SuspendInt, 0)
    + ISNULL(@DeferredInterest, 0)
    + ISNULL(@SuspendedDefaultInterest, 0)
    + ISNULL(@PlannedInterest, 0)
    + ISNULL(@DefaultInterest, 0);

-- เพิ่มยอดสะสมเพียงครั้งเดียว ไม่บวกซ้ำใน SELECT ผลลัพธ์
SET @AccruedInterestTotal =
      ISNULL(@AccruedInterestTotal, 0)
    + ISNULL(@AccruedInterest, 0);


/* ============================================================
   DEBUG

   ตรงนี้เอาไว้ตรวจแต่ละเคส
   ถ้าไม่ต้องการดู สามารถ Comment SELECT นี้ได้
   ไม่กระทบ @DefaultInterest
   ============================================================ */

SELECT
      RowNo
    , InstallmentSeq
    , DueDate

    , IsSuspend

    , PrincipalTotal

    , Instament
    , PaymentAmountBefore
    , RemainingInstallment

    , DefaultStartDate
    , DefaultEndDate
    , DPDDay

    , InterimStartDate
    , InterimEndDate
    , InterimDay

    , InterimInterest

    , InterestCutLimit
    , InterestToPay

    , ActualPrincipal

    , PaymentBefore
    , PaymentUsed
    , PaymentAfter

    , IsPaymentReached

    , DefaultInterest

FROM #TempDefaultInterest
ORDER BY RowNo;



/* ============================================================
   DEBUG RESULT

   ดูยอดรวม Default Interest
   ============================================================ */

SELECT
      @DFDDate AS DFDDate
    , @LastPaymentDate AS LastPaymentDate
    , @PaymentDate AS PaymentDate

    , @CurrentPaymentAmount AS CurrentPaymentAmount

    , @PrincipalTotal AS PrincipalTotal

    , @InterestPlannedRate AS InterestPlannedRate
    , @InterestDefaultRate AS InterestDefaultRate

    , @DefaultInterest AS DefaultInterest;



/* ============================================================
   RESULT เดิม
   ============================================================ */

SELECT
      @DPD AS DPD
    , @DPDAccumulate AS DPDAccumulate

    , @InterimInterest AS InterimInterest

    , @AccruedInterest AS AccruedInterest
    , @AccruedInterestTotal AS AccruedInterestTotal

    , @CourtFee AS CourtFee
    , @CourtFeeTotal AS CourtFeeTotal

    , @LawyerFee AS LawyerFee
    , @LawyerFeeTotal AS LawyerFeeTotal

    , @OtherExpense AS OtherExpense
    , @OtherExpenseTotal AS OtherExpenseTotal

    , @InitialMargin AS InitialMargin
    , @InitialMarginTotal AS InitialMarginTotal

    , @SuspendInt AS SuspendInt
    , @SuspendIntTotal AS SuspendIntTotal

    , @DeferredInterest AS DeferredInterest
    , @DeferredInterestTotal AS DeferredInterestTotal

    , @SuspendedDefaultInterest AS SuspendedDefaultInterest
    , @SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal AS SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal

    , @PlannedInterest AS PlannedInterest
    , @PlannedInterestTotal AS PlannedInterestTotal

    , @DefaultInterest AS DefaultInterest
    , @DefaultInterestTotal AS DefaultInterestTotal;



/* ============================================================
   ตารางเดิมของเธอ
   ============================================================ */

INSERT INTO #TempMovement
(

     [DebtorCardMovementId]
    ,[DebtorCardId]
    ,[DocDate]
    ,[PayDate]
    ,[LGNo]
    ,[DebtorId]
    ,[DebtorCode]
    ,[DebtorCardCode]
    ,[DebtorCardName]
    ,[TypeId]
    ,[TypeCode]
    ,[TypeName]
    ,[FlagAutoPay]
    ,[DFDDate]
    ,[DFDStartDate]
    ,[DFDEndDate]
    ,[DPD]
    ,[TotalPay]
    ,[IsAdjust]
    ,[AdjustRefDocNo]
    ,[IsDelete]
    ,[MeasureId]
    ,[MeasureCode]
    ,[MeasureName]
    ,[InterestRate]
    ,[InterestPlannedRate]
    ,[InterestDefaultRate]
    ,[DebtBalance]
    ,[ReceivePayment]
    ,[Installment]
    ,[InstallmentPay]
    ,[InstallmentTotal]
    ,[Principal]
    ,[PrincipalPay]
    ,[PrincipalTotal]
    ,[InterimInterest]
    ,[AccruedInterest]
    ,[AccruedInterestPay]
    ,[AccruedInterestTotal]
    ,[CourtFee]
    ,[CourtFeePay]
    ,[CourtFeeTotal]
    ,[LawyerFee]
    ,[LawyerFeePay]
    ,[LawyerFeeTotal]
    ,[OtherExpense]
    ,[OtherExpensePay]
    ,[OtherExpenseTotal]
    ,[InitialMargin]
    ,[InitialMarginPay]
    ,[InitialMarginTotal]
    ,[SuspendInt]
    ,[SuspendIntPay]
    ,[SuspendIntTotal]
    ,[DeferredInterest]
    ,[DeferredInterestPay]
    ,[DeferredInterestTotal]
    ,[SuspendedDefaultInterest]
    ,[SuspendedDefaultInterestPay]
    ,[SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal]
    ,[PlannedInterest]
    ,[PlannedInterestPay]
    ,[PlannedInterestTotal]
    ,[DefaultInterest]
    ,[DefaultInterestPay]
    ,[DefaultInterestTotal]
    ,[CreateBy]
    ,[CreateDate]
    ,[UpdateBy]
    ,[UpdateDate]
    ,[ReceiptNo]
    ,[IsEstatement]
    ,[EStatementRef]
    ,[PaymentTypeId]
    ,[SeqNo]
    ,[DebtorPaymentId]
    ,[DebtorPaymentCode]
    ,[CompromiseContractGroup]
    ,[ReceiptId]
    ,[InstallmentPrincipal]
    ,[InstallmentPrincipalPay]
    ,[InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
    ,[InstallmentInterest]
    ,[InstallmentInterestPay]
    ,[InstallmentInterestTotal]
    ,[InterestStartDate]
    ,[InterestEndDate]
    ,[InterestQuantity]
    ,[DPDAccumulate]
    ,[OverdueAmount]
    ,[PrincipalOverdueAmount]
    ,[AccruedInterestOverdueAmount]
    ,[TotalOverdue]
    ,[TotalPrincipalOverdue]
    ,[TotalAccruedInterestOverdue]
    ,[CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId]
    ,[IsUpdateHistory]

)
SELECT
       NEWID() AS [DebtorCardMovementId]
      ,@DataDebtorCardId AS [DebtorCardId]
      ,@CurrentDate AS [DocDate]
      ,@CurrentDate AS [PayDate]

      ,m.[LGNo]
      ,m.[DebtorId]
      ,m.[DebtorCode]
      ,m.[DebtorCardCode]
      ,m.[DebtorCardName]

      ,@TypeId AS [TypeId]
      ,@TypeCode AS [TypeCode]
      ,@TypeName AS [TypeName]

      ,0 AS [FlagAutoPay]

      ,CAST('1900-01-01' AS DATE) AS [DFDDate]
      ,CAST('1900-01-01' AS DATE) AS [DFDStartDate]
      ,CAST('1900-01-01' AS DATE) AS [DFDEndDate]

      ,@DPD AS [DPD]

      ,0 AS [TotalPay]
      ,1 AS [IsAdjust]
      ,NULL AS [AdjustRefDocNo]
      ,0 AS [IsDelete]

      ,m.[MeasureId]
      ,m.[MeasureCode]
      ,m.[MeasureName]

      ,c.[InterestRate]
      ,c.[InterestPlannedRate]
      ,c.[InterestDefaultRate]

      ,m.PrincipalTotal AS [DebtBalance]

      ,0 AS [ReceivePayment]

      ,0 AS [Installment]
      ,0 AS [InstallmentPay]
      ,0 AS [InstallmentTotal]

      ,0 AS [Principal]
      ,0 AS [PrincipalPay]

      ,m.[PrincipalTotal]


      /* ดอกเบี้ยระหว่างเดือน */

      ,CAST
       (
            m.[PrincipalTotal]
            * c.InterestPlannedRate / 100.0
            * @InterestQuantity
            / @DayInYear
        AS DECIMAL(18,2)
       ) AS [InterimInterest]


      ,@AccruedInterest AS [AccruedInterest]
      ,0 AS [AccruedInterestPay]
      ,@AccruedInterestTotal AS [AccruedInterestTotal]

      ,@CourtFee AS [CourtFee]
      ,0 AS [CourtFeePay]
      ,(@CourtFeeTotal + @CourtFee) AS [CourtFeeTotal]

      ,@LawyerFee AS [LawyerFee]
      ,0 AS [LawyerFeePay]
      ,(@LawyerFeeTotal + @LawyerFee) AS [LawyerFeeTotal]

      ,@OtherExpense AS [OtherExpense]
      ,0 AS [OtherExpensePay]
      ,(@OtherExpenseTotal + @OtherExpense) AS [OtherExpenseTotal]

      ,@InitialMargin AS [InitialMargin]
      ,0 AS [InitialMarginPay]
      ,(@InitialMarginTotal + @InitialMargin) AS [InitialMarginTotal]


      ,@SuspendInt AS [SuspendInt]
      ,0 AS [SuspendIntPay]
      ,(@SuspendIntTotal + @SuspendInt) AS [SuspendIntTotal]

      ,0 AS [DeferredInterest]
      ,0 AS [DeferredInterestPay]
      ,(@DeferredInterestTotal + 0) AS [DeferredInterestTotal]

      ,@SuspendedDefaultInterest AS [SuspendedDefaultInterest]
      ,0 AS [SuspendedDefaultInterestPay]
      ,(@SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal + @SuspendedDefaultInterest) AS [SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal]

      ,@PlannedInterest AS [PlannedInterest]
      ,0 AS [PlannedInterestPay]
      ,(@PlannedInterestTotal + @PlannedInterest) AS [PlannedInterestTotal]


      /* ======================================================
         ดอกเบี้ยผิดนัดที่คำนวณจาก Temp
         ตัวอย่างเคสนี้ควรได้ 7.18
         ====================================================== */

      ,@DefaultInterest AS [DefaultInterest]

      ,0 AS [DefaultInterestPay]

      /* ยอดสะสม */
      ,@DefaultInterestTotal + @DefaultInterest
            AS [DefaultInterestTotal]


      ,1 AS [CreateBy]
      ,GETDATE() AS [CreateDate]

      ,1 AS [UpdateBy]
      ,GETDATE() AS [UpdateDate]

      ,NULL AS [ReceiptNo]

      ,0 AS [IsEstatement]
      ,NULL AS [EStatementRef]

      ,NULL AS [PaymentTypeId]

      ,@NextSeqNo AS [SeqNo]

      ,NULL AS [DebtorPaymentId]
      ,NULL AS [DebtorPaymentCode]

      ,NULL AS [CompromiseContractGroup]
      ,NULL AS [ReceiptId]

      ,c.[InstallmentPrincipal]
      ,c.[InstallmentPrincipalPay]
      ,c.[InstallmentPrincipalTotal]

      ,c.[InstallmentInterest]
      ,c.[InstallmentInterestPay]
      ,c.[InstallmentInterestTotal]

      ,@InterestStartDate AS [InterestStartDate]
      ,@InterestEndDate AS [InterestEndDate]
      ,@InterestQuantity AS [InterestQuantity]

      ,@DPDAccumulate AS [DPDAccumulate]

      ,0 AS [OverdueAmount]
      ,0 AS [PrincipalOverdueAmount]
      ,0 AS [AccruedInterestOverdueAmount]

      ,0 AS [TotalOverdue]
      ,0 AS [TotalPrincipalOverdue]
      ,0 AS [TotalAccruedInterestOverdue]

      ,NULL AS [CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId]

      ,0 AS [IsUpdateHistory]
FROM #TempMovement m

LEFT JOIN DataDebtorCard c
       ON c.DataDebtorCardId = m.DebtorCardId

WHERE m.DebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId
  AND TRY_CONVERT(INT, m.SeqNo) = @NextSeqNo - 1;
END;
