CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_Datawarehouse]
    -- ========================================================================
    -- Frontend Parameters
    -- ========================================================================
    @CIFNo NVARCHAR(20) = NULL,                 -- รหัส CIF
    @LGNo NVARCHAR(20) = NULL,                  -- เลข LG
    @CardNumber NVARCHAR(20) = NULL,            -- รหัสการ์ด
    @DebtorCode NVARCHAR(20) = NULL,            -- รหัสลูกหนี้
    @DebtorName NVARCHAR(500) = NULL,           -- ชื่อ–นามสกุล
    @DebtorTypeId INT = NULL,                   -- ประเภทความสัมพันธ์ลูกหนี้ (default NULL = ผู้กู้หลัก)
    @ClaimTypeId INT = NULL,                    -- ประเภทการค้ำประกัน
    @ClaimPayAmountMin DECIMAL(18,4) = NULL,    -- จำนวนเงินจ่ายประกันชดเชยขั้นต่ำ
    @ClaimPayAmountMax DECIMAL(18,4) = NULL,    -- จำนวนเงินจ่ายประกันชดเชยสูงสุด
    @Grade NVARCHAR(10) = NULL,                 -- เกรด
    @DebtBalanceMin DECIMAL(18,4) = NULL,       -- ภาระหนี้ขั้นต่ำ
    @DebtBalanceMax DECIMAL(18,4) = NULL,       -- ภาระหนี้สูงสุด
    @PhoneNumber NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,           -- เบอร์โทร
    @CaseNo NVARCHAR(20) = NULL,                -- คดีดำ/คดีแดง
    @GuaranteeAmountMin DECIMAL(18,4) = NULL,   -- วงเงินขั้นต่ำ
    @GuaranteeAmountMax DECIMAL(18,4) = NULL,   -- วงเงินสูงสุด
    @ClaimPayDateFrom DATETIME = NULL,          -- วันที่จ่ายประกันชดเชย (จาก)
    @ClaimPayDateTo DATETIME = NULL,            -- วันที่จ่ายประกันชดเชย (ถึง)
    @StatusCollectorId INT = NULL,              -- สถานะลูกหนี้
    @StatusTrackingId INT = NULL,               -- สถานะระบบติดตามหนี้
    @AsofDate DATETIME = NULL,                  -- Report date (default to current date)
    @PageIndex INT = 1,                         -- หน้าที่ (1-based)
    @PageSize INT = 100                         -- จำนวนรายการต่อหน้า
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Set default Asof date if not provided — ใช้ MAX(AsOfDate) จาก DataEndOfDay แทน GETDATE()
    DECLARE @ReportDate DATETIME = ISNULL(@AsofDate, (SELECT MAX(AsOfDate) FROM DataEndOfDay));

    -- Pre-computed date boundaries — avoids non-sargable YEAR()/MONTH()/CAST() on indexed columns
    DECLARE @ReportDateOnly DATE = CAST(@ReportDate AS DATE);
    DECLARE @ReportDateNext DATE = DATEADD(DAY, 1, CAST(@ReportDate AS DATE));
    DECLARE @MonthStart     DATE = CAST(DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, @ReportDate),     0) AS DATE);
    DECLARE @MonthEnd       DATE = CAST(DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, @ReportDate) + 1, 0) AS DATE);
    DECLARE @YearStart      DATE = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@ReportDate),     1, 1);
    DECLARE @YearEnd        DATE = DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@ReportDate) + 1, 1, 1);

    -- ========================================================================
    -- Step 1: Collect the DebtorRelateIds that will actually be needed.
    -- This lets the TDR and payment temp tables scan only relevant rows
    -- instead of the entire table on every call.
    -- ========================================================================
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#FilteredIds') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #FilteredIds;

    SELECT DR.DebtorRelateId
    INTO #FilteredIds
    FROM DataDebtorRelate DR
    WHERE DR.IsActive = 1
      AND DR.IsDelete = 0
      AND (@CIFNo      IS NULL OR DR.CIFNo      = @CIFNo)
      AND (@LGNo       IS NULL OR DR.LGNo       = @LGNo)
      AND (@DebtorCode IS NULL OR DR.DebtorCode = @DebtorCode)
      AND (
          (@DebtorTypeId IS NULL AND DR.DebtorTypeId = 1)
          OR (@DebtorTypeId IS NOT NULL AND DR.DebtorTypeId = @DebtorTypeId)
      );

    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_FilteredIds ON #FilteredIds (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ========================================================================
    -- Step 2: Materialize TDR data filtered to relevant DebtorRelateIds only
    -- ========================================================================
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TDR_Consolidated') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #TDR_Consolidated;

    SELECT
        TDR_D.DebtorRelateId,
        TDR_D.DebtorName,
        TDR_D.IsMain,
        TDR_D.CreateDate,
        TDR_C.CompromiseContractId,
        TDR_C.ContractNo,
        TDR_C.TDRDate,
        TDR_C.RequestDate,
        TDR_C.ApproveDate,
        TDR_C.InterestRate,
        TDR_C.Installments,
        TDR_C.InstallmentsAmount,
        TDR_C.UpfrontInstallments,
        TDR_C.UpfrontAmount,
        TDR_C.MeasureId,
        TDR_C.CompromiseContractStatusId,
        -- RN_Latest: latest contract per DebtorRelateId (used by TDR_Contract)
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TDR_D.DebtorRelateId                ORDER BY TDR_C.TDRDate DESC                   ) AS RN_Latest,
        -- RN_Main:   latest per DebtorRelateId+IsMain sorted by TDRDate (used by TDR_DebtorMain/Sub)
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TDR_D.DebtorRelateId, TDR_D.IsMain  ORDER BY TDR_C.TDRDate DESC                   ) AS RN_Main,
        -- RN_Sub:    same partition but secondary sort by CreateDate (used by TDR_DebtorSub)
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TDR_D.DebtorRelateId, TDR_D.IsMain  ORDER BY TDR_C.TDRDate DESC, TDR_D.CreateDate ) AS RN_Sub,
        -- TDRCount: pre-aggregated via subquery (COUNT DISTINCT not allowed in OVER clause)
        TDR_Cnt.TDRCount
    INTO #TDR_Consolidated
    FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractDebtor TDR_D
    INNER JOIN #FilteredIds F ON TDR_D.DebtorRelateId = F.DebtorRelateId
    INNER JOIN TDRDataCompromiseContract TDR_C ON TDR_D.CompromiseContractId = TDR_C.CompromiseContractId
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT TDR_D2.DebtorRelateId, COUNT(DISTINCT TDR_D2.CompromiseContractId) AS TDRCount
        FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractDebtor TDR_D2
        INNER JOIN #FilteredIds F2 ON TDR_D2.DebtorRelateId = F2.DebtorRelateId
        GROUP BY TDR_D2.DebtorRelateId
    ) TDR_Cnt ON TDR_D.DebtorRelateId = TDR_Cnt.DebtorRelateId;

    CREATE INDEX IX_TDRConsolidated_Lookup ON #TDR_Consolidated (DebtorRelateId, RN_Latest, IsMain);

    -- ========================================================================
    -- CTE: Pre-filter DataDebtorRelate ก่อน join (ลด rows ที่ต้อง process)
    -- ========================================================================
    ;WITH FilteredDR AS (
        SELECT
            DR.DebtorRelateId, DR.CIFNo, DR.LGNo, DR.DebtorCode,
            DR.DebtorId, DR.DebtorTypeId, DR.IsActive, DR.IsDelete
        FROM DataDebtorRelate DR
        WHERE DR.IsActive = 1
          AND DR.IsDelete = 0
          AND (@CIFNo       IS NULL OR DR.CIFNo       = @CIFNo)
          AND (@LGNo        IS NULL OR DR.LGNo        = @LGNo)
          AND (@DebtorCode  IS NULL OR DR.DebtorCode  = @DebtorCode)
          AND (
              (@DebtorTypeId IS NULL AND DR.DebtorTypeId = 1)
              OR (@DebtorTypeId IS NOT NULL AND DR.DebtorTypeId = @DebtorTypeId)
          )
    )

    -- ========================================================================
    -- Main Query with Complete CSV Coverage
    -- ========================================================================
    SELECT
            -- ================================================================
            -- 1: Asof
            -- ================================================================
            FORMAT(DATEADD(YEAR, 543, @ReportDate), 'ddMMyyyy') AS [AsOfDate],

            -- ================================================================
            -- 2-4: Core Identifiers
            -- ================================================================
            DR.CIFNo AS [CIFNo],                        -- รหัสผู้กู้
            DR.DebtorCode AS [DebtorCode],               -- cif
            DR.LGNo AS [LGNo],                           -- เลขที่ LG

            -- ================================================================
            -- 5-10: Status Groupings
            -- ================================================================
            CASE
                WHEN SM_Collector.StatusName IN ('อยู่ระหว่าง UpFront')
                THEN '0. อยู่ระหว่าง Up Front'
                WHEN SM_Collector.StatusName IN ('TDR อยู่ระหว่างผ่อนชำระ')
                THEN '7. TDR อยู่ระหว่างผ่อนชำระ'
                WHEN SM_Collector.StatusName IN ('ดำเนินคดี (คดีแดง)') AND CASE_D.RedCaseNo IS NOT NULL
                THEN '6. ดำเนินคดี (คดีแดง)'
                WHEN SM_Collector.StatusName IN ('ดำเนินคดี (คดีดำ)') AND CASE_D.BlackCaseNo IS NOT NULL
                THEN '5. ดำเนินคดี (คดีดำ)'
                WHEN SM_Collector.StatusName IN ('เตรียมส่งดำเนินคดี')
                THEN '4. เตรียมส่งดำเนินคดี'
                WHEN SM_Collector.StatusName IN ('ติดต่อไม่ได้')
                THEN '3. ติดต่อไม่ได้'
                WHEN SM_Collector.StatusName IN ('ติดต่อได้')
                THEN '2. ติดต่อได้อยู่ระหว่างเจรจา'
                WHEN DATEDIFF(MONTH, LG.ClaimDate, @ReportDate) <= 12
                THEN '1. อยู่ระหว่างติดตามหนี้'
                ELSE SM_Collector.StatusName
            END AS [StatusDCSValue],                     -- กลุ่มรายงาน122566_Check
            CASE MAX(
                CASE SM_Collector.StatusName
                    WHEN 'ดำเนินคดี (คดีแดง)'       THEN 8
                    WHEN 'ดำเนินคดี (คดีดำ)'         THEN 7
                    WHEN 'เตรียมส่งดำเนินคดี'         THEN 6
                    WHEN 'ติดต่อไม่ได้'               THEN 5
                    WHEN 'ติดต่อได้'                   THEN 4
                    WHEN 'TDR อยู่ระหว่างผ่อนชำระ'   THEN 3
                    WHEN 'อยู่ระหว่าง UpFront'        THEN 2
                    WHEN 'อยู่ระหว่างติดตามหนี้'       THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) OVER (PARTITION BY DR.CIFNo)
                WHEN 8 THEN 'ดำเนินคดี (คดีแดง)'
                WHEN 7 THEN 'ดำเนินคดี (คดีดำ)'
                WHEN 6 THEN 'เตรียมส่งดำเนินคดี'
                WHEN 5 THEN 'ติดต่อไม่ได้'
                WHEN 4 THEN 'ติดต่อได้'
                WHEN 3 THEN 'TDR อยู่ระหว่างผ่อนชำระ'
                WHEN 2 THEN 'อยู่ระหว่าง UpFront'
                WHEN 1 THEN 'อยู่ระหว่างติดตามหนี้'
                ELSE SM_Collector.StatusName
            END AS [StatusDCSLGNew],                     -- สถานะ By CIF (Max priority per CIF)
            '' AS [StatusLevelNew],                      -- กลุ่มรายงาน122566 MC
            CASE
                WHEN DATEDIFF(MONTH, LG.ClaimDate, @ReportDate) < 12
                     AND SM_Collector.StatusName IN (
                         'TDR อยู่ระหว่างผ่อนชำระ',
                         'ดำเนินคดี (คดีแดง)',
                         'อยู่ระหว่าง UpFront'
                     )
                THEN 'อยู่ระหว่างติดตาม'
                ELSE SM_Collector.StatusName
            END AS [StatusLevelPP],                      -- ปป_กลุ่มรายงาน122566 MC
            SUM(CASE WHEN SM_Card.StatusName NOT IN ('ปิดบัญชี', 'หนี้สูญ') THEN DC.PrincipalTotal ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY DR.CIFNo) AS [StatusLevelPPOS],  -- ปป_กลุ่มรายงาน122566 MC_OS

            -- ================================================================
            -- 11-14: Account Close/WriteOff Dates
            -- ================================================================
            ISNULL(CASE WHEN SM_Card.StatusName = 'ปิดบัญชี' THEN DC.CloseDate END, '1900-01-01') AS [CloseDate],    -- วันที่ปิดบัญชี
            ISNULL(CASE WHEN SM_Card.StatusName = 'หนี้สูญ' THEN DC.CloseDate END, '1900-01-01') AS [BadDebtDate],  -- วันที่หนี้สูญ
            CASE WHEN SM_Card.StatusName = 'ปิดบัญชี'    THEN YEAR(DC.CloseDate)  ELSE NULL END AS [YCloseDate],  -- Y_วันที่ปิดบัญชี
            CASE WHEN SM_Card.StatusName = 'ปิดบัญชี'    THEN MONTH(DC.CloseDate) ELSE NULL END AS [MCloseDate],  -- M_วันที่ปิดบัญชี

            -- ================================================================
            -- 15-16: Card Status
            -- ================================================================
            SM_Card.StatusCode AS [CardStatus],         -- OS.CardStatus
            SM_Card.StatusName AS [CardStatusName],      -- OS.CardStatusName

            -- ================================================================
            -- 17-26: Debtor Information
            -- ================================================================
            SDT.DebtorTypeName AS [DebtorCodeTypeName],          -- ประเภทผู้กู้
            SM_Title.TitleShortName AS [TitleName],              -- คำนำหน้าชื่อผู้กู้
            D.FirstName AS [FirstName],                          -- ชื่อผู้กู้
            D.LastName AS [LastName],                            -- นามสกุลผู้กู้
            D.IDCard AS [IDCard],                                -- เลขที่บัตรประชาชน
            D.RegistrationNo AS [RegistrationNo],                -- เลขที่นิติบุคคล
            ISNULL(D.BirthDate, '1900-01-01') AS [BirthOfDate],                          -- วัน/เดือน/ปี เกิด
            ISNULL(D.RegistrationDate, '1900-01-01') AS [RegistrationDate],            -- วันที่จดทะเบียนนิติบุคคล

            -- ================================================================
            -- 27-30: Guarantor & Co-Borrower
            -- ================================================================
            GRT.DebtorName AS [GuarantorName],            -- ชื่อผู้ค้ำประกัน
            GRT.CntPhoneNumber AS [GuarantorContactNumber], -- เบอร์ติดต่อผู้ค้ำประกัน
            COB.DebtorName AS [CoBorrowerName],              -- ชื่อผู้กู้ร่วม
            COB.CntPhoneNumber AS [CoBorrowerContactNumber], -- เบอร์ติดต่อผู้กู้ร่วม

            -- ================================================================
            -- 31-34: Bank Information
            -- ================================================================
            BK.BankCode AS [BankCode],                   -- รหัสธนาคาร
            BK.BankName AS [BankName],                   -- ชื่อธนาคาร
            BB.BankBranchCode AS [BankBranchCode],       -- รหัสสาขาธนาคาร
            BB.BankBranchName AS [BankBranchName],       -- ชื่อสาขาธนาคาร

            -- ================================================================
            -- 35-42: LG & Branch Info
            -- ================================================================
            ISNULL(LG.LGDate, '1900-01-01') AS [LGDate],                               -- วันที่ LG
            SProv.Name AS [BusinessAddrBranchOfficeName],      -- สำนักงานสาขา (จังหวัดที่อยู่ติดต่อ)
            ORG_Section.SectionNameTH AS [DivisionNew],          -- สำนักงานสาขา New
            ORG_Struct.OrgStructureName AS [DivisionGroup],     -- Group_สนง
            CAST(LG.ClaimTypeId AS INT) AS [AccountType],        -- ประเภทการค้ำหลัก
            SM_ClaimType.ClaimTypeGroup AS [ProjectTypeGroup],   -- กลุ่มโครงการ
            LG.ClaimAmountCurrent AS [CreditLimit],              -- ภาระค้ำ
            LG.Grade AS [BankGradeName],                         -- เกรด

            -- ================================================================
            -- 43-47: Business Type
            -- ================================================================
            D.BusinessType AS [BusinessType],                    -- รหัสธุรกิจ
            D.BusinessTypeName AS [IndustryGroupName],           -- ประเภทธุรกิจ
            D.CompanyTypeDescription AS [SubIndustryTypeName],  -- ประเภทกิจการ
            D.BusinessDescription AS [ProjectCharacter],         -- ลักษณะกิจการ
            '' AS [BOTBizGroupName],                             -- จัดกลุ่มตามประเภทธุรกิจ BOT

            -- ================================================================
            -- 48-61: Address (Registered + Contact)
            -- ================================================================
            DDA.AddressNumber AS [ContactAddr],               -- บ้านเลขที่ (ทะเบียนบ้าน)
            DDA.Road AS [ContactAddrRoad],                    -- ถนน
            SSub.Name AS [ContactAddrSubDistrict],            -- ตำบล
            SDist.Name AS [ContactAddrDistrict],              -- อำเภอ
            SProv.Name AS [ContactAddrProvince],              -- จังหวัด
            DDA.PostalCode AS [ContactAddrZipCode],           -- รหัสไปรษณีย์
            SZone.Name AS [ContactAddrRegion],                -- ภูมิภาค
            DDA2.AddressNumber AS [BusinessAddr],             -- บ้านเลขที่ (ติดต่อ)
            DDA2.Road AS [BusinessAddrRoad],                  -- ถนน
            SSub2.Name AS [BusinessAddrSubDistrict],          -- ตำบล
            SDist2.Name AS [BusinessAddrDistrict],            -- อำเภอ
            SProv2.Name AS [BusinessAddrProvince],            -- จังหวัด
            DDA2.PostalCode AS [BusinessAddrZipCode],         -- รหัสไปรษณีย์
            SZone2.Name AS [BusinessAddrRegion],              -- ภูมิภาค

            -- ================================================================
            -- 62-70: Claim Payment & Balance
            -- ================================================================
            ISNULL(NULLIF(LG.ClaimDate, '1900-01-01'), '1900-01-01') AS [ClaimPayDate],               -- วันที่จ่าย
            CASE WHEN LG.ClaimDate > '1900-01-02' THEN YEAR(LG.ClaimDate)  ELSE NULL END AS [YClaimPayDate],
            CASE WHEN LG.ClaimDate > '1900-01-02' THEN MONTH(LG.ClaimDate) ELSE NULL END AS [MClaimPayDate],
            CASE WHEN LG.ClaimDate > '1900-01-02'
                 THEN DATEDIFF(MONTH, LG.ClaimDate, @ReportDate) / 12
                 ELSE NULL END AS [AgeOfClaim],                               -- คำนวณอายุ Loan Y (ปี)
            CASE WHEN LG.ClaimDate > '1900-01-02'
                THEN CASE
                    WHEN DATEDIFF(MONTH, LG.ClaimDate, @ReportDate) < 12  THEN 'น้อยกว่า 1 ปี'
                    WHEN DATEDIFF(MONTH, LG.ClaimDate, @ReportDate) < 48  THEN '1 - 3 ปี'
                    WHEN DATEDIFF(MONTH, LG.ClaimDate, @ReportDate) < 72  THEN '4 - 5 ปี'
                    WHEN DATEDIFF(MONTH, LG.ClaimDate, @ReportDate) < 120 THEN '6 - 9 ปี'
                    WHEN DATEDIFF(MONTH, LG.ClaimDate, @ReportDate) < 132 THEN '10 ปี'
                    ELSE 'มากกว่า 10 ปี'
                END
                ELSE NULL
            END AS [GroupOfClaim],
            CASE MAX(CASE WHEN LG.ClaimDate > '1900-01-02' THEN DATEDIFF(MONTH, LG.ClaimDate, @ReportDate) ELSE NULL END)
                OVER (PARTITION BY DR.CIFNo)
                WHEN NULL THEN NULL
                ELSE CASE
                    WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN LG.ClaimDate > '1900-01-02' THEN DATEDIFF(MONTH, LG.ClaimDate, @ReportDate) ELSE NULL END) OVER (PARTITION BY DR.CIFNo) < 12  THEN 'น้อยกว่า 1 ปี'
                    WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN LG.ClaimDate > '1900-01-02' THEN DATEDIFF(MONTH, LG.ClaimDate, @ReportDate) ELSE NULL END) OVER (PARTITION BY DR.CIFNo) < 48  THEN '1 - 3 ปี'
                    WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN LG.ClaimDate > '1900-01-02' THEN DATEDIFF(MONTH, LG.ClaimDate, @ReportDate) ELSE NULL END) OVER (PARTITION BY DR.CIFNo) < 72  THEN '4 - 5 ปี'
                    WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN LG.ClaimDate > '1900-01-02' THEN DATEDIFF(MONTH, LG.ClaimDate, @ReportDate) ELSE NULL END) OVER (PARTITION BY DR.CIFNo) < 120 THEN '6 - 9 ปี'
                    WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN LG.ClaimDate > '1900-01-02' THEN DATEDIFF(MONTH, LG.ClaimDate, @ReportDate) ELSE NULL END) OVER (PARTITION BY DR.CIFNo) < 132 THEN '10 ปี'
                    ELSE 'มากกว่า 10 ปี'
                END
            END AS [MaxGroupOfClaim],
            SUM(LG.ClaimPayAmount) OVER (PARTITION BY DR.CIFNo) AS [SumOfClaimByCIF],
            LG.ClaimPayAmount AS [ClaimPay],                     -- ยอดจ่าย Claim

            -- ================================================================
            -- 70-79: OS Financial Fields
            -- ================================================================
            SUM(CASE WHEN SM_Card.StatusName NOT IN ('ปิดบัญชี', 'หนี้สูญ') THEN DC.PrincipalTotal ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY DR.CIFNo) AS [SumOutstandingBalanceByCIF],
            CASE WHEN SM_Card.StatusName NOT IN ('ปิดบัญชี', 'หนี้สูญ') THEN DC.PrincipalTotal ELSE 0 END AS [OutstandingCapitalExcludeBadDebt],  -- OS.เงินต้นคงเหลือ
            BDLG.PrincipalTotal AS [OutstandingCapitalPay],      -- OS.เงินต้นคงเหลือ ก่อนหนี้สูญ
            DC.InterestRate AS [Rate],                   -- OS.อัตราดอกเบี้ย
            DC.AccruedInterestTotal AS [AccruedInt],             -- OS.ดอกเบี้ยค้างรับ
            CAST(DC.SuspendInt AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS [SuspendIntPay],        -- OS.ดอกเบี้ยตั้งพัก/ดอกเบี้ยแขวน
            CAST(DC.SuspendIntTotal AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS [SuspendIntBalance], -- OS.ดอกเบี้ยตั้งพัก/ดอกเบี้ยแขวนคงเหลือ
            CAST(DC.DeferredInterest AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS [HangingInt],    -- OS.HangingInt
            CAST(DC.DeferredInterestPay AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS [HangingIntPay],  -- OS.HangingIntPay
            CAST(DC.DeferredInterestTotal AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS [HangingIntBalance],  -- OS.HangingIntBalance

            -- ================================================================
            -- 80-84: SME / Business Info
            -- ================================================================
            D.FixedAssetValue AS [Asset],                   -- ทรัพย์สินถาวรสุทธิ
            D.EmploymentQty AS [StaffAmount],                    -- การจ้างงาน
            D.IncEmploymentQty AS [StaffAmtInc],                 -- การจ้างงานที่เพิ่มขึ้น
            LG.BusinessSize AS [SMETypeSSV],                     -- ขนาดธุรกิจ SME สสว

            -- ================================================================
            -- 85-93: Payment Receipt Fields
            -- ================================================================
            PAY_YTD.TotalPaymentYTD AS [TotalReceiveAmount],     -- รับชำระสะสม_YTD
            SM_PaymentType.PaymentTypeName AS [PaymentChannel],  -- ช่องทางการรับชำระ (เดือนที่เรียก report)
            PAY_Month.PrincipalPay AS [CapitalPay],              -- ชำระเงินต้น (เดือนที่เรียก report)
            PAY_Month.AccruedInterestPay AS [IntPay],            -- ชำระดอกเบี้ย (เดือนที่เรียก report)
            PAY_Month.CourtFeePay AS [CourtFeePay],              -- ชำระค่าศาล (เดือนที่เรียก report)
            DC.DefaultInterestPay AS [DefaultIntPay],            -- ชำระเบี้ยปรับ
            PAY_Month.LawyerFeePay AS [LawyerFeePay],            -- ชำระค่าทนาย (เดือนที่เรียก report)
            PAY_Month.OtherExpensePay AS [OtherExpensePay],      -- อื่น (เดือนที่เรียก report)
            CASE
                WHEN DC.IsTDR = 1 AND DC.DPD > 0
                THEN CEILING(CAST(DC.DPD AS FLOAT) / 30.0)
                WHEN DC.IsTDR = 0 OR DC.IsTDR IS NULL
                THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END AS [NoOfPastDueDays],                           -- งวดค้าง

            -- ================================================================
            -- 94-97: BU & Staff
            -- ================================================================
            ORG_Struct.OrgStructureName AS [BU],                 -- BU
            ORG_Section.SectionNameTH AS [BUII],                -- BU_II
            USR_Collector.UserName AS [CollectorUserOfficerName], -- ชื่อเจ้าหน้าที่
            ISNULL(DSU.StatusTrackingDate, '1900-01-01') AS [FollowDate],              -- วันที่ติดตามล่าสุด

            -- ================================================================
            -- 98-102: Status 1-3
            -- ================================================================
            SM_Debtor.StatusName AS [StatusDebtByLG],            -- สถานะ 1 สถานะลูกหนี้ By LG
            ISNULL(DSU.StatusDebtorDate, '1900-01-01') AS [StatusDebtUpdateByLG],      -- วันที่บันทึก_สถานะ 1
            SM_Collector.StatusName AS [FollowStatusKey],        -- สถานะ 2 สถานะติดตามหนี้ By LG
            SM_Compromise.StatusName AS [StatusCompoundByLG],    -- สถานะ 3 สถานะประนอมหนี้ By LG
            ISNULL(DSU.StatusCompromiseDate, '1900-01-01') AS [StatusCompoundUpdateByLG],  -- วันที่บันทึกสถานะ 3

            -- ================================================================
            -- 103-109: TDR Contract Info
            -- ================================================================
            TDR_Contract.ContractNo AS [ContractNo],             -- เลขที่ประนอมหนี้
            ISNULL(TDR_Contract.RequestDate, '1900-01-01') AS [ContractDate],           -- วันที่หนังสือสภาพหนี้
            ISNULL(TDR_Contract.ApproveDate, '1900-01-01') AS [ContractApproveDate],   -- วันที่อนุมัติปรับปรุงโครงสร้างหนี้
            CAST(SM_Measure.MeasureId AS NVARCHAR(20)) AS [ContractCampaignCode],  -- รหัสแคมเปญ
            SM_Measure.MeasureName AS [ContractCampaignName],    -- ชื่อแคมเปญ
            TDR_DebtorMain.DebtorName AS [DebtorContractName],   -- ชื่อโครงการ (ชื่อผู้กู้หลัก IsMain=1)
            TDR_DebtorSub.DebtorName AS [ContractDebtorName],   -- ชื่อลูกหนี้โครงการ (ผู้กู้อื่น IsMain=0)

            -- ================================================================
            -- 110-111: Status 4 (Case Port)
            -- ================================================================
            SM_Legal.StatusName AS [StatusPortKey],              -- สถานะ 4 สถานะคดี By LG
            ISNULL(DSU.StatusLegalDate, '1900-01-01') AS [UpdateLaw],                  -- วันที่บันทึกสถานะ 4

            -- ================================================================
            -- 112-170: Case Fields
            -- ================================================================
            USR_Legal.UserName AS [LegalUserName],               -- คดี.เจ้าหน้าที่ดำเนินคดี
            SM_CaseType.CaseTypeName AS [LegalTypeName],         -- คดี.ประเภทการดำเนินคดี
            SM_CasePort.StatusName AS [StatusLawPortName],       -- คดี.สถานะ Port
            '' AS [StatusLawName],                               -- คดี.สถานะหนังสือค้ำประกัน
            ISNULL(CASE_D.ApproveDate, '1900-01-01') AS [LegalApproveDate],            -- คดี.วันอนุมัติดำเนินคดี
            ISNULL(CASE_D.EnforcemetApproveDate, '1900-01-01') AS [EnforcementApproveDate],  -- คดี.วันที่อนุมัติสวมสิทธิ
            ISNULL(CASE_D.EnforcemetApplyDate, '1900-01-01') AS [EnforcementApplyDate],      -- คดี.วันที่ยื่นคำร้องสวมสิทธิ
            ISNULL(CASE_D.PetitionDate, '1900-01-01') AS [PetitionDate],               -- คดี.วันที่ศาลมีคำสั่งให้สวมสิทธิ
            SM_Prosecution.StatusName AS [StatusOrderName],      -- คดี.สถานะขั้นตอนการดำเนินคดี(ธปท.)
            ISNULL(CASE_D.SendLawyerDate, '1900-01-01') AS [SendLawyerDate],           -- คดี.วันที่ส่งเอกสารให้ทนาย
            ISNULL(CASE_D.FilingDate, '1900-01-01') AS [FileDate],                   -- คดี.วันที่ยื่นฟ้อง
            ISNULL(CASE_D.FirstTrialDate, '1900-01-01') AS [FirstTrialDate],           -- คดี.วันที่สืบพยานครั้งแรก
            ISNULL(CASE_D.FrozenAssetDate, '1900-01-01') AS [FrozenAssetDate],         -- คดี.วันที่พิทักษ์ทรัพย์(บสย.)
            ISNULL(CASE_D.JmTrialDate, '1900-01-01') AS [JmTrialDate],                 -- คดี.วันที่พิพากษาชั้นต้น
            ISNULL(CASE_D.WarrantDate, '1900-01-01') AS [WarrantDate],                 -- คดี.วันที่ออกหมาย
            ISNULL(CASE_D.AppealDueDate, '1900-01-01') AS [AppealDueDate],             -- คดี.วันที่ครบกำหนดอุทธรณ์
            ISNULL(CASE_D.AppealDate, '1900-01-01') AS [AppealDate],                   -- คดี.วันที่ยื่นอุทธรณ์
            ISNULL(CASE_D.JmAppealDate, '1900-01-01') AS [JmAppealDate],               -- คดี.วันที่พิพากษาศาลอุทธรณ์
            ISNULL(CASE_D.SupremeDueDate, '1900-01-01') AS [SupremeDueDate],           -- คดี.วันที่ครบกำหนดฎีกา
            ISNULL(CASE_D.SupremeDate, '1900-01-01') AS [SupremeDate],                 -- คดี.วันที่ยื่นฎีกา
            ISNULL(CASE_D.JmSupremeDate, '1900-01-01') AS [JmSupremeDate],             -- คดี.วันที่พิพากษาฎีกา
            ISNULL(CASE_D.NoticeAssetDate, '1900-01-01') AS [NoticeAssetDate],         -- คดี.วันที่แจ้งสืบทรัพย์
            ISNULL(CASE_D.InvestigationDate, '1900-01-01') AS [InvestigationDate],     -- คดี.วันที่สืบทรัพย์
            ISNULL(CASE_D.NoticeSeizePropertyDate, '1900-01-01') AS [NoticeSeizePropertyDate],  -- คดี.วันที่แจ้งยึดทรัพย์
            ISNULL(CASE_D.SeizePropertyDate, '1900-01-01') AS [SeizePropertyDate],     -- คดี.วันที่ยึดทรัพย์
            ISNULL(CASE_D.OtherFrozenAssDate, '1900-01-01') AS [OtherFrozenAssetDate], -- คดี.วันที่พิทักษ์ทรัพย์(อื่น)
            ISNULL(CASE_D.ReqRepayDate, '1900-01-01') AS [ReqRepayDate],       -- คดี.วันที่ยื่นขอรับชำระหนี้
            CASE_D.BlackCaseNo AS [BlackCaseNo],                 -- คดี.เลขที่คดีดำ
            CASE_D.RedCaseNo AS [RedCaseNo],                     -- คดี.เลขที่คดีแดง
            CASE_D.JudgementNote AS [LawDescription],             -- คดี.หมายเหตุ
            ISNULL(CASE_D.RoyalDecreeDate, '1900-01-01') AS [RoyalDecreeDate],         -- คดี.วันที่ประกาศราชกิจจาฯ
            ISNULL(CASE_D.SuspendDate, '1900-01-01') AS [SuspendDate],                 -- คดี.วันที่ชะลอดำเนินคดี
            CASE WHEN CASE_D.DebtorRelateId IS NOT NULL
                      AND CASE_D.AcknowDebtDate >= CASE_D.RedCaseDate
                 THEN CASE_D.AcknowDebtDate ELSE '1900-01-01' END AS [AcknowledgeDebtDate],  -- คดี.วันที่รับสภาพหนี้ (เฉพาะ >= วันที่คดีแดง)
            ISNULL(CASE_D.WithdrawDate, '1900-01-01') AS [WithdrawDate],               -- คดี.วันที่ บสย.ถอนฟ้อง
            ISNULL(CASE WHEN CASE_D.DebtorRelateId IS NOT NULL THEN DC.CloseDate END, '1900-01-01') AS [PayOffDate],  -- คดี.วันที่ชำระผ่อนหมด (ใช้วันที่ปิดบัญชี เฉพาะมีสถานะคดี)
            ISNULL(CASE_D.BadDebtDate, '1900-01-01') AS [CaseBadDebtDate],             -- คดี.วันที่หนี้สูญ
            CASE_D.ClaimAmount AS [SClaimAmount],            -- คดี.ต้นเงินยื่นฟ้อง
            CASE_D.IntToFileAmount AS [IntToFileAmount],         -- คดี.ดอกเบี้ยถึงวันที่ฟ้อง
            CASE_D.CapitalFile AS [CapitalFile],                 -- คดี.ทุนทรัพย์ฟ้อง
            CASE_D.CapitalAppeal AS [CapitalAppeal],             -- คดี.ทุนทรัพย์อุทธรณ์
            CASE_D.CapitalSupreme AS [CapitalSupreme],           -- คดี.ทุนทรัพย์ฎีกา
            CASE_D.RedCaseNoBank AS [RedCaseNoBank],             -- คดี.หมายเลขคดีแดงที่สวมสิทธิ
            CASE_D.AccuserBank AS [AccuserBank],                 -- คดี.โจทก์ธนาคาร
            D.BusinessStatus AS [BusinessStatus],             -- คดี.สถานภาพกิจการ
            ISNULL(D.BusinessStatusDate, '1900-01-01') AS [BusinessStatusDate],         -- คดี.วันที่สถานภาพกิจการ
            ISNULL(CASE_D.BankruptcyDate, '1900-01-01') AS [BankruptcyDate],               -- คดี.วันที่ปลดล้มละลาย
            ISNULL(CASE_D.JudgmentBankruptcyDate, '1900-01-01') AS [JudgmentBankruptcyDate],   -- คดี.วันที่พิพากษาล้มละลาย

            -- ================================================================
            -- 159-175: NCB / Bucket / Classification
            -- ================================================================
            ISNULL(DC.PrincipalTotal, 0) + ISNULL(DC.AccruedInterestTotal, 0) AS [OutstandingBalance],  -- Owned_Amount
            DC.CodeOfRestructuring AS [RestructuredCase],         -- Restructured_Case
            ISNULL(TDR_Contract.ApproveDate, '1900-01-01') AS [DateOfRestructured],    -- Restructured_Date
            TDR_Contract.InstallmentsAmount AS [InstallmentAmount],  -- Installment_Amount
            CAST(TDR_Contract.Installments AS INT) AS [NumberOfInstallments],  -- Number_Of_Installments
            ISNULL(PAY_Month.PrincipalPay, 0)
            + ISNULL(PAY_Month.AccruedInterestPay, 0)
            + ISNULL(PAY_Month.CourtFeePay, 0)
            + ISNULL(PAY_Month.LawyerFeePay, 0)
            + ISNULL(PAY_Month.OtherExpensePay, 0) AS [PaymentAmount],  -- Payment_Amount (total เดือนที่เรียก report)
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS [AmountPastDue],      -- Past_Due_Amount (รอ SA clarify)
            CAST(DC.DPD AS NVARCHAR(20)) AS [PastDueDays],         -- Past_Due_Days
            ISNULL(DC.DFDDate, '1900-01-01') AS [DefaultDate],                         -- Defaultdate (DFD)
            CAST(DC.DPD AS INT) AS [DPD],                        -- DPD
            CASE
                WHEN DC.DPD IS NULL THEN NULL
                WHEN DC.DPD = 0    THEN 'B0'
                WHEN DC.DPD <= 30  THEN 'B1'
                WHEN DC.DPD <= 60  THEN 'B2'
                WHEN DC.DPD <= 90  THEN 'B3'
                WHEN DC.DPD <= 120 THEN 'B4'
                WHEN DC.DPD <= 150 THEN 'B5'
                ELSE 'B6'
            END AS [Bucket],
            MAX(CASE
                WHEN DC.DPD IS NULL THEN NULL
                WHEN DC.DPD = 0    THEN 'B0'
                WHEN DC.DPD <= 30  THEN 'B1'
                WHEN DC.DPD <= 60  THEN 'B2'
                WHEN DC.DPD <= 90  THEN 'B3'
                WHEN DC.DPD <= 120 THEN 'B4'
                WHEN DC.DPD <= 150 THEN 'B5'
                ELSE 'B6'
            END) OVER (PARTITION BY DR.CIFNo) AS [BucketByCIF],
            CASE
                WHEN DC.DPD IS NULL  THEN NULL
                WHEN DC.DPD = 0      THEN 'ปกติ'
                WHEN DC.DPD <= 90    THEN 'กล่าวถึงพิเศษ'
                WHEN DC.DPD <= 180   THEN 'ต่ำกว่ามาตรฐาน'
                WHEN DC.DPD <= 360   THEN 'สงสัย'
                ELSE 'สูญ'
            END AS [Class],
            CASE MAX(CASE
                WHEN DC.DPD IS NULL THEN 0
                WHEN DC.DPD = 0     THEN 1
                WHEN DC.DPD <= 90   THEN 2
                WHEN DC.DPD <= 180  THEN 3
                WHEN DC.DPD <= 360  THEN 4
                ELSE 5
            END) OVER (PARTITION BY DR.CIFNo)
                WHEN 0 THEN NULL
                WHEN 1 THEN 'ปกติ'
                WHEN 2 THEN 'กล่าวถึงพิเศษ'
                WHEN 3 THEN 'ต่ำกว่ามาตรฐาน'
                WHEN 4 THEN 'สงสัย'
                WHEN 5 THEN 'สูญ'
            END AS [ClassByCIF],
            ISNULL(PAY_Latest.ReceiptDate, '1900-01-01') AS [LastPaymentDate],         -- Date Of Last Payment
            DC.ConditionPayment AS [PaymentTerms],               -- Payment Term
            CAST(DC.DPD AS NVARCHAR(20)) AS [TermOfPastDue],     -- Past_Due_Term

            -- ================================================================
            -- 176-181: Ongoing TDR
            -- ================================================================
            TDR_Contract.TDRCount AS [NumberOfContract],         -- Ongoing.จำนวนครั้งที่ทำ TDR
            ISNULL(TDR_Contract.ApproveDate, '1900-01-01') AS [ContractUpdateDateClose],   -- Ongoing.วันที่ปิดแผน TDR
            CAST(TDR_Contract.Installments - ISNULL(TDR_Contract.UpfrontInstallments, 0) AS INT) AS [NumberOfInstallmentsNotUpFront],  -- Ongoing.numberofinstallments (ไม่รวม UpFront)
            TDR_Contract.UpfrontAmount AS [FullUpfrontAmount],   -- Ongoing.จำนวนเงินที่ Upfront
            -- ================================================================
            -- ค่างวด TDR รายเดือน (12 เดือนถัดไปจากวันที่รายงาน)
            -- ================================================================
            CASE WHEN TDR_Contract.TDRDate IS NOT NULL AND DATEADD(MONTH,  1, @ReportDate) <= DATEADD(MONTH, ISNULL(TDR_Contract.Installments, 0), TDR_Contract.TDRDate) THEN TDR_Contract.InstallmentsAmount ELSE 0 END AS [TDRMonth01],
            CASE WHEN TDR_Contract.TDRDate IS NOT NULL AND DATEADD(MONTH,  2, @ReportDate) <= DATEADD(MONTH, ISNULL(TDR_Contract.Installments, 0), TDR_Contract.TDRDate) THEN TDR_Contract.InstallmentsAmount ELSE 0 END AS [TDRMonth02],
            CASE WHEN TDR_Contract.TDRDate IS NOT NULL AND DATEADD(MONTH,  3, @ReportDate) <= DATEADD(MONTH, ISNULL(TDR_Contract.Installments, 0), TDR_Contract.TDRDate) THEN TDR_Contract.InstallmentsAmount ELSE 0 END AS [TDRMonth03],
            CASE WHEN TDR_Contract.TDRDate IS NOT NULL AND DATEADD(MONTH,  4, @ReportDate) <= DATEADD(MONTH, ISNULL(TDR_Contract.Installments, 0), TDR_Contract.TDRDate) THEN TDR_Contract.InstallmentsAmount ELSE 0 END AS [TDRMonth04],
            CASE WHEN TDR_Contract.TDRDate IS NOT NULL AND DATEADD(MONTH,  5, @ReportDate) <= DATEADD(MONTH, ISNULL(TDR_Contract.Installments, 0), TDR_Contract.TDRDate) THEN TDR_Contract.InstallmentsAmount ELSE 0 END AS [TDRMonth05],
            CASE WHEN TDR_Contract.TDRDate IS NOT NULL AND DATEADD(MONTH,  6, @ReportDate) <= DATEADD(MONTH, ISNULL(TDR_Contract.Installments, 0), TDR_Contract.TDRDate) THEN TDR_Contract.InstallmentsAmount ELSE 0 END AS [TDRMonth06],
            CASE WHEN TDR_Contract.TDRDate IS NOT NULL AND DATEADD(MONTH,  7, @ReportDate) <= DATEADD(MONTH, ISNULL(TDR_Contract.Installments, 0), TDR_Contract.TDRDate) THEN TDR_Contract.InstallmentsAmount ELSE 0 END AS [TDRMonth07],
            CASE WHEN TDR_Contract.TDRDate IS NOT NULL AND DATEADD(MONTH,  8, @ReportDate) <= DATEADD(MONTH, ISNULL(TDR_Contract.Installments, 0), TDR_Contract.TDRDate) THEN TDR_Contract.InstallmentsAmount ELSE 0 END AS [TDRMonth08],
            CASE WHEN TDR_Contract.TDRDate IS NOT NULL AND DATEADD(MONTH,  9, @ReportDate) <= DATEADD(MONTH, ISNULL(TDR_Contract.Installments, 0), TDR_Contract.TDRDate) THEN TDR_Contract.InstallmentsAmount ELSE 0 END AS [TDRMonth09],
            CASE WHEN TDR_Contract.TDRDate IS NOT NULL AND DATEADD(MONTH, 10, @ReportDate) <= DATEADD(MONTH, ISNULL(TDR_Contract.Installments, 0), TDR_Contract.TDRDate) THEN TDR_Contract.InstallmentsAmount ELSE 0 END AS [TDRMonth10],
            CASE WHEN TDR_Contract.TDRDate IS NOT NULL AND DATEADD(MONTH, 11, @ReportDate) <= DATEADD(MONTH, ISNULL(TDR_Contract.Installments, 0), TDR_Contract.TDRDate) THEN TDR_Contract.InstallmentsAmount ELSE 0 END AS [TDRMonth11],
            CASE WHEN TDR_Contract.TDRDate IS NOT NULL AND DATEADD(MONTH, 12, @ReportDate) <= DATEADD(MONTH, ISNULL(TDR_Contract.Installments, 0), TDR_Contract.TDRDate) THEN TDR_Contract.InstallmentsAmount ELSE 0 END AS [TDRMonth12],

            -- ================================================================
            -- 182-185: Measure / Generation / Business Age
            -- ================================================================
            SM_Measure.MeasureName AS [CampaignTypeGroup],       -- มาตรการสี
            BK.BankAbbrName AS [BankShortName],                  -- ชื่อย่อ
            CASE
                WHEN D.PersonGroupId = 117 AND D.BirthDate > '1900-01-01' THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN YEAR(@ReportDate) - YEAR(D.BirthDate) < 25 THEN 'Gen Z'
                        WHEN YEAR(@ReportDate) - YEAR(D.BirthDate) BETWEEN 25 AND 40 THEN 'Gen Y (Millennial)'
                        WHEN YEAR(@ReportDate) - YEAR(D.BirthDate) BETWEEN 41 AND 56 THEN 'Gen X'
                        WHEN YEAR(@ReportDate) - YEAR(D.BirthDate) > 56 THEN 'Baby Boomer'
                        ELSE 'Unknown'
                    END
                ELSE NULL
            END AS [AgeOfBirthDate],                             -- Generation
            CASE
                WHEN D.PersonGroupId = 118 AND D.RegistrationDate > '1900-01-01' THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, D.RegistrationDate, @ReportDate) < 3 THEN 'น้อยกว่า 3 ปี'
                        WHEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, D.RegistrationDate, @ReportDate) BETWEEN 3 AND 5 THEN '3-5 ปี'
                        WHEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, D.RegistrationDate, @ReportDate) BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN '6-10 ปี'
                        ELSE 'มากกว่า 10 ปี'
                    END
                ELSE NULL
            END AS [AgeOfRegistrationDate],                      -- ช่วงอายุกิจการ
            DC.InterestPlannedRate AS [InterestPlannedRate],     -- ดอกเบี้ยตามแผน
            DC.InterestDefaultRate AS [InterestDefaultRate],     -- ดอกเบี้ยผิดนัด
            -- ================================================================
            -- ชำระเงินรวม รายเดือน (Row 183)
            -- ================================================================
            CASE MONTH(@ReportDate)
                WHEN 1  THEN ISNULL(PAY_YTD.M01Payment, 0)
                WHEN 2  THEN ISNULL(PAY_YTD.M02Payment, 0)
                WHEN 3  THEN ISNULL(PAY_YTD.M03Payment, 0)
                WHEN 4  THEN ISNULL(PAY_YTD.M04Payment, 0)
                WHEN 5  THEN ISNULL(PAY_YTD.M05Payment, 0)
                WHEN 6  THEN ISNULL(PAY_YTD.M06Payment, 0)
                WHEN 7  THEN ISNULL(PAY_YTD.M07Payment, 0)
                WHEN 8  THEN ISNULL(PAY_YTD.M08Payment, 0)
                WHEN 9  THEN ISNULL(PAY_YTD.M09Payment, 0)
                WHEN 10 THEN ISNULL(PAY_YTD.M10Payment, 0)
                WHEN 11 THEN ISNULL(PAY_YTD.M11Payment, 0)
                WHEN 12 THEN ISNULL(PAY_YTD.M12Payment, 0)
            END AS [MonthlyPayment]

    FROM FilteredDR DR

        -- ====================================================================
        -- Joins
        -- ====================================================================
        LEFT JOIN DataDebtor D
            ON DR.DebtorCode = D.DebtorCode

        LEFT JOIN DataLG LG
            ON DR.LGNo = LG.LGNo

        -- Sargable range replaces CAST(DC.AsOfDate AS DATE) = CAST(@ReportDate AS DATE)
        LEFT JOIN DataEndOfDay DC
            ON DR.DebtorRelateId = DC.DebtorRelateId
            AND DC.AsOfDate >= @ReportDateOnly
            AND DC.AsOfDate <  @ReportDateNext

        LEFT JOIN SystemBankMaster BK
            ON LG.BankId = BK.BankId

        LEFT JOIN SystemBankBranchMaster BB
            ON LG.BankBranchId = BB.BankBranchId

        LEFT JOIN SystemTitleMaster SM_Title
            ON D.TitleId = SM_Title.TitleId

        LEFT JOIN SystemDebtorType SDT
            ON DR.DebtorTypeId = SDT.DebtorTypeId

        -- Guarantor (ผู้ค้ำประกัน: DebtorTypeId IN (2,6)) — comma-separated with ID
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT DR2.LGNo,
                STRING_AGG(D2.DebtorName + ' (' + ISNULL(D2.IDCard, ISNULL(D2.RegistrationNo, '')) + ')', ', ') AS DebtorName,
                STRING_AGG(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(D2.CntPhoneNumber)), ''), ', ') AS CntPhoneNumber
            FROM DataDebtorRelate DR2
            INNER JOIN DataDebtor D2 ON DR2.DebtorCode = D2.DebtorCode
            WHERE DR2.DebtorTypeId IN (2, 6) AND DR2.IsActive = 1 AND DR2.IsDelete = 0
            GROUP BY DR2.LGNo
        ) GRT ON GRT.LGNo = DR.LGNo

        -- Co-Borrower (ผู้กู้ร่วม: DebtorTypeId = 4) — comma-separated with ID
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT DR2.LGNo,
                STRING_AGG(D2.DebtorName + ' (' + ISNULL(D2.IDCard, ISNULL(D2.RegistrationNo, '')) + ')', ', ') AS DebtorName,
                STRING_AGG(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(D2.CntPhoneNumber)), ''), ', ') AS CntPhoneNumber
            FROM DataDebtorRelate DR2
            INNER JOIN DataDebtor D2 ON DR2.DebtorCode = D2.DebtorCode
            WHERE DR2.DebtorTypeId = 4 AND DR2.IsActive = 1 AND DR2.IsDelete = 0
            GROUP BY DR2.LGNo
        ) COB ON COB.LGNo = DR.LGNo

        -- Address 1: ที่อยู่ที่ติดต่อได้ (TOP 1 per DebtorId, DebtorContactChannelId = 4)
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DebtorId ORDER BY CreateDate DESC) AS RN
            FROM DataDebtorAddress WHERE IsDefault = 1 AND DebtorContactChannelId = 4
        ) DDA ON DR.DebtorId = DDA.DebtorId AND DDA.RN = 1

        LEFT JOIN SystemSubDistrictMaster SSub
            ON DDA.SubDistrictId = SSub.SubDistrictId

        LEFT JOIN SystemDistrictMaster SDist
            ON DDA.DistrictId = SDist.DistrictId

        LEFT JOIN SystemProvinceMaster SProv
            ON DDA.ProvinceId = SProv.ProvinceId

        LEFT JOIN SystemZoneMaster SZone
            ON SProv.ZoneId = SZone.ZoneId

        -- Address 2: ที่อยู่ที่ตั้งกิจการ (TOP 1 per DebtorId, DebtorContactChannelId = 4)
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DebtorId ORDER BY CreateDate DESC) AS RN
            FROM DataDebtorAddress WHERE DebtorAddressTypeId = 2 AND DebtorContactChannelId = 4
        ) DDA2 ON DR.DebtorId = DDA2.DebtorId AND DDA2.RN = 1

        LEFT JOIN SystemSubDistrictMaster SSub2
            ON DDA2.SubDistrictId = SSub2.SubDistrictId

        LEFT JOIN SystemDistrictMaster SDist2
            ON DDA2.DistrictId = SDist2.DistrictId

        LEFT JOIN SystemProvinceMaster SProv2
            ON DDA2.ProvinceId = SProv2.ProvinceId

        LEFT JOIN SystemZoneMaster SZone2
            ON SProv2.ZoneId = SZone2.ZoneId

        LEFT JOIN DataDebtorStatusUpdate DSU
            ON DR.DebtorRelateId = DSU.DebtorRelateId

        LEFT JOIN SystemStatusMaster SM_Collector
            ON DSU.StatusCollectorId = SM_Collector.SystemStatusId

        LEFT JOIN SystemStatusMaster SM_Compromise
            ON DSU.StatusCompromiseId = SM_Compromise.SystemStatusId

        LEFT JOIN SystemStatusMaster SM_Legal
            ON DSU.StatusLegalId = SM_Legal.SystemStatusId

        LEFT JOIN SystemStatusMaster SM_Card
            ON DC.CardStatusId = SM_Card.SystemStatusId

        LEFT JOIN ACCDataBadDebtLG BDLG
            ON DR.DebtorRelateId = BDLG.DebtorRelateId

        LEFT JOIN SystemStatusMaster SM_Debtor
            ON DSU.StatusDebtorId = SM_Debtor.SystemStatusId

        LEFT JOIN SystemClaimTypeMaster SM_ClaimType
            ON LG.ClaimTypeId = SM_ClaimType.ClaimTypeId

        -- Extended Case Information
        LEFT JOIN LTDataCaseMainDebtor CASE_D
            ON DR.DebtorRelateId = CASE_D.DebtorRelateId
            AND CASE_D.IsCancel = 0

        LEFT JOIN SystemStatusMaster SM_CasePort
            ON CASE_D.StatusPortId = SM_CasePort.SystemStatusId

        LEFT JOIN SystemCaseTypeMaster SM_CaseType
            ON CASE_D.CaseTypeId = SM_CaseType.CaseTypeId

        LEFT JOIN SystemStatusMaster SM_Prosecution
            ON CASE_D.StatusProsecutionId = SM_Prosecution.SystemStatusId

        -- TDR Contract (latest per DebtorRelateId — from pre-materialized temp table)
        LEFT JOIN #TDR_Consolidated TDR_Contract
            ON DR.DebtorRelateId = TDR_Contract.DebtorRelateId AND TDR_Contract.RN_Latest = 1

        -- TDR Main Debtor name (IsMain=1, latest TDRDate)
        LEFT JOIN #TDR_Consolidated TDR_DebtorMain
            ON DR.DebtorRelateId = TDR_DebtorMain.DebtorRelateId
            AND TDR_DebtorMain.IsMain = 1
            AND TDR_DebtorMain.RN_Main = 1

        -- TDR Sub Debtor name (IsMain=0, latest TDRDate then oldest CreateDate)
        LEFT JOIN #TDR_Consolidated TDR_DebtorSub
            ON DR.DebtorRelateId = TDR_DebtorSub.DebtorRelateId
            AND TDR_DebtorSub.IsMain = 0
            AND TDR_DebtorSub.RN_Sub = 1

        LEFT JOIN SystemMeasureMaster SM_Measure
            ON TDR_Contract.MeasureId = SM_Measure.MeasureId

        -- Payment Information (Latest Receipt)
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT
                DebtorRelateId,
                ReceiptDate,
                PrincipalPay,
                AccruedInterestPay,
                CourtFeePay,
                LawyerFeePay,
                OtherExpensePay,
                PaymentTypeId,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DebtorRelateId ORDER BY ReceiptDate DESC) AS RowNum
            FROM ACCDataReceipt
            WHERE IsCancel = 0
        ) PAY_Latest ON DR.DebtorRelateId = PAY_Latest.DebtorRelateId AND PAY_Latest.RowNum = 1

        -- Payment Information (Current Report Month) — sargable range replaces YEAR()/MONTH() wraps
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT
                DebtorRelateId,
                MAX(ReceiptDate)          AS ReceiptDate,
                SUM(PrincipalPay)         AS PrincipalPay,
                SUM(AccruedInterestPay)   AS AccruedInterestPay,
                SUM(CourtFeePay)          AS CourtFeePay,
                SUM(LawyerFeePay)         AS LawyerFeePay,
                SUM(OtherExpensePay)      AS OtherExpensePay,
                MAX(PaymentTypeId)        AS PaymentTypeId
            FROM ACCDataReceipt
            WHERE IsCancel = 0
                AND ReceiptDate >= @MonthStart
                AND ReceiptDate <  @MonthEnd
            GROUP BY DebtorRelateId
        ) PAY_Month ON DR.DebtorRelateId = PAY_Month.DebtorRelateId

        LEFT JOIN SystemPaymentType SM_PaymentType
            ON PAY_Month.PaymentTypeId = SM_PaymentType.PaymentTypeId

        -- Payment YTD Summary + Monthly Breakdown — sargable range replaces YEAR() wrap
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT
                DebtorRelateId,
                SUM(PrincipalPay + AccruedInterestPay + CourtFeePay + LawyerFeePay + OtherExpensePay) AS TotalPaymentYTD,
                SUM(PrincipalPay) AS PrincipalPayYTD,
                SUM(AccruedInterestPay) AS InterestPayYTD,
                SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 1  THEN PrincipalPay + AccruedInterestPay + CourtFeePay + LawyerFeePay + OtherExpensePay ELSE 0 END) AS M01Payment,
                SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 2  THEN PrincipalPay + AccruedInterestPay + CourtFeePay + LawyerFeePay + OtherExpensePay ELSE 0 END) AS M02Payment,
                SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 3  THEN PrincipalPay + AccruedInterestPay + CourtFeePay + LawyerFeePay + OtherExpensePay ELSE 0 END) AS M03Payment,
                SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 4  THEN PrincipalPay + AccruedInterestPay + CourtFeePay + LawyerFeePay + OtherExpensePay ELSE 0 END) AS M04Payment,
                SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 5  THEN PrincipalPay + AccruedInterestPay + CourtFeePay + LawyerFeePay + OtherExpensePay ELSE 0 END) AS M05Payment,
                SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 6  THEN PrincipalPay + AccruedInterestPay + CourtFeePay + LawyerFeePay + OtherExpensePay ELSE 0 END) AS M06Payment,
                SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 7  THEN PrincipalPay + AccruedInterestPay + CourtFeePay + LawyerFeePay + OtherExpensePay ELSE 0 END) AS M07Payment,
                SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 8  THEN PrincipalPay + AccruedInterestPay + CourtFeePay + LawyerFeePay + OtherExpensePay ELSE 0 END) AS M08Payment,
                SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 9  THEN PrincipalPay + AccruedInterestPay + CourtFeePay + LawyerFeePay + OtherExpensePay ELSE 0 END) AS M09Payment,
                SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 10 THEN PrincipalPay + AccruedInterestPay + CourtFeePay + LawyerFeePay + OtherExpensePay ELSE 0 END) AS M10Payment,
                SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 11 THEN PrincipalPay + AccruedInterestPay + CourtFeePay + LawyerFeePay + OtherExpensePay ELSE 0 END) AS M11Payment,
                SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 12 THEN PrincipalPay + AccruedInterestPay + CourtFeePay + LawyerFeePay + OtherExpensePay ELSE 0 END) AS M12Payment
            FROM ACCDataReceipt
            WHERE IsCancel = 0
                AND ReceiptDate >= @YearStart
                AND ReceiptDate <  @YearEnd
            GROUP BY DebtorRelateId
        ) PAY_YTD ON DR.DebtorRelateId = PAY_YTD.DebtorRelateId

        LEFT JOIN DataUsers USR_Collector
            ON DSU.CollectorUserId = USR_Collector.UserId

        LEFT JOIN DataUsers USR_Legal
            ON CASE_D.LegalUserId = USR_Legal.UserId

        -- #34, #35, #90, #91: Org structure ของเจ้าหน้าที่ผู้ดูแล
        LEFT JOIN DataPersonalInfo PI_Collector
            ON USR_Collector.UserId = PI_Collector.UserId

        LEFT JOIN SystemOrgStructure ORG_Struct
            ON PI_Collector.OrgStructureId = ORG_Struct.OrgStructureId

        LEFT JOIN SystemOrgSectionMaster ORG_Section
            ON PI_Collector.OrgSectionId = ORG_Section.OrgSectionId

        -- ====================================================================
        -- WHERE Clause with Frontend Parameters
        -- ====================================================================
    WHERE
        1 = 1
        -- CIF, LGNo, DebtorCode, DebtorTypeId กรองใน FilteredDR CTE แล้ว

        -- รหัสการ์ด
        AND (@CardNumber IS NULL OR D.CardNumber LIKE '%' + @CardNumber + '%')

        -- ชื่อ–นามสกุล
        AND (@DebtorName IS NULL OR D.DebtorName LIKE '%' + @DebtorName + '%')

        -- ประเภทการค้ำประกัน
        AND (@ClaimTypeId IS NULL OR LG.ClaimTypeId = @ClaimTypeId)

        -- จำนวนเงินจ่ายประกันชดเชย (Range)
        AND (@ClaimPayAmountMin IS NULL OR LG.ClaimPayAmount >= @ClaimPayAmountMin)
        AND (@ClaimPayAmountMax IS NULL OR LG.ClaimPayAmount <= @ClaimPayAmountMax)

        -- เกรด
        AND (@Grade IS NULL OR LG.Grade = @Grade)

        -- ภาระหนี้ (Range)
        AND (@DebtBalanceMin IS NULL OR DC.PrincipalTotal >= @DebtBalanceMin)
        AND (@DebtBalanceMax IS NULL OR DC.PrincipalTotal <= @DebtBalanceMax)

        -- เบอร์โทร (search in contact fields)
        AND (
            @PhoneNumber IS NULL
            OR D.CntPhoneNumber LIKE '%' + @PhoneNumber + '%'
            OR D.CntMobileNumber LIKE '%' + @PhoneNumber + '%'
        )

        -- คดีดำ/คดีแดง
        AND (
            @CaseNo IS NULL
            OR CASE_D.BlackCaseNo LIKE '%' + @CaseNo + '%'
            OR CASE_D.RedCaseNo LIKE '%' + @CaseNo + '%'
        )

        -- วงเงิน (Guarantee Amount Range)
        AND (@GuaranteeAmountMin IS NULL OR LG.ClaimAmount >= @GuaranteeAmountMin)
        AND (@GuaranteeAmountMax IS NULL OR LG.ClaimAmount <= @GuaranteeAmountMax)

        -- วันที่จ่ายประกันชดเชย (Date Range)
        AND (@ClaimPayDateFrom IS NULL OR LG.ClaimDate >= @ClaimPayDateFrom)
        AND (@ClaimPayDateTo IS NULL OR LG.ClaimDate <= @ClaimPayDateTo)

        -- สถานะลูกหนี้
        AND (@StatusCollectorId IS NULL OR DSU.StatusCollectorId = @StatusCollectorId)

        -- สถานะระบบติดตามหนี้
        AND (@StatusTrackingId IS NULL OR DSU.StatusTrackingId = @StatusTrackingId)

    ORDER BY DR.CIFNo, DR.LGNo
    OFFSET (@PageIndex - 1) * @PageSize ROWS FETCH NEXT @PageSize ROWS ONLY
    OPTION (RECOMPILE)

END

            CASE_D.SupremeDate AS [SupremeDate],  -- คดี.วันที่ยื่นฎีกา
            CASE_D.JmSupremeDate AS [JmSupremeDate],  -- คดี.วันที่พิพากษาฎีกา
            CASE_D.NoticeAssetDate AS [NoticeAssetDate],  -- คดี.วันที่แจ้งสืบทรัพย์

            CASE_D.ReqRepayDate AS [RequestRepaymentDate],  -- คดี.วันที่ยื่นขอรับชำระหนี้
            CASE_D.BlackCaseDate AS [BlackCaseDate],  -- วันที่คดีดำ
            CASE_D.JudgementNoteBlack AS [BlackCaseNote],  -- หมายเหตุคดีดำ
            CASE_D.RedCaseDate AS [RedCaseDate],  -- วันที่คดีแดง
            CASE_D.JudgementNoteRed AS [RedCaseNote],  -- หมายเหตุคดีแดง
            CASE_D.JudgementNote AS [JudgementNote],  -- คดี.หมายเหตุ
            CASE_D.Description AS [LegalDescription],  -- คดี.รายละเอียด
            CASE_D.RoyalDecreeDate AS [RoyalDecreeDate],  -- คดี.วันที่ประกาศราชกิจจาฯ
            CASE_D.AcknowDebtDate AS [AcknowDebtDate],  -- คดี.วันที่รับสภาพหนี้
            CASE_D.WithdrawDate AS [WithdrawDate],  -- คดี.วันที่ บสย.ถอนฟ้อง
            CASE_D.PayOffDate AS [PayOffDate],
            CASE_D.BadDebtDate AS [BadDebtDate],  -- วันที่ตัดหนี้สูญ
            CASE_D.IntToFileAmount AS [IntToFileAmount],  -- คดี.ดอกเบี้ยถึงวันที่ฟ้อง
            CASE_D.CapitalFile AS [CapitalFile],  -- คดี.ทุนทรัพย์ฟ้อง
            CASE_D.CapitalAppeal AS [CapitalAppeal],  -- คดี.ทุนทรัพย์อุทธรณ์
            CASE_D.CapitalSupreme AS [CapitalSupreme],  -- คดี.ทุนทรัพย์ฎีกา
            CASE_D.RedCaseNoBank AS [RedCaseNoBank],  -- คดี.หมายเลขคดีแดงที่สวมสิทธิ
            CASE_D.AccuserBank AS [AccuserBank],  -- คดี.โจทก์ธนาคาร
            '' AS [StatusLawName],  -- คดี.สถานะหนังสือค้ำประกัน
            CASE_D.SuspendDate AS [SuspendDate],  -- คดี.วันที่ชะลอดำเนินคดี
            CASE_D.EnforcemetApproveDate AS [EnforcementApproveDate],  -- คดี.วันที่อนุมัติสวมสิทธิ
            CASE_D.EnforcemetApplyDate AS [EnforcementApplyDate],  -- คดี.วันที่ยื่นคำร้องสวมสิทธิ
            CASE_D.PetitionDate AS [PetitionDate],  -- คดี.วันที่ศาลมีคำสั่งให้สวมสิทธิ
            SM_Prosecution.StatusName AS [StatusOrderName],  -- คดี.สถานะขั้นตอนการดำเนินคดี(ธปท.)

            -- ================================================================
            -- TDR/Compromise Information - EXTENDED
            -- ================================================================
            TDR_Latest.DebtDate AS [TDRDebtDate],  -- วันที่หนี้ TDR
            TDR_Latest.ClaimPay AS [TDRClaimPay],  -- ยอด Claim TDR
            TDR_Latest.LGNo AS [TDRLGNo],  -- เลขที่ LG TDR
            TDR_Latest.Grade AS [TDRGrade],  -- เกรด TDR

            -- TDR Contract Details
            TDR_Contract.CompromiseContractId AS [CompromiseContractId],  -- รหัสสัญญาประนอมหนี้
            TDR_Contract.ContractNo AS [ContractNo],  -- เลขที่ประนอมหนี้
