            TDR_Contract.ApproveDate AS [ContractApproveDate],  -- วันที่อนุมัติปรับปรุงโครงสร้างหนี้
            TDR_Contract.InterestRate AS [TDRInterestRate],  -- อัตราดอกเ บี้ย TDR
            CAST(TDR_Contract.Installments AS INT) AS [NumberOfInstallmentsNotUpFront],  -- จำนวนงวดที่ต้องชำระ (ไม่รวม Upfront)
            TDR_Contract.InstallmentsAmount AS [InstallmentAmount],  -- ค่างวด TDR
            TDR_Contract.UpfrontInstallments AS [NumberOfUpfront],  -- จำนวนงวดที่ Upfront
            TDR_Contract.UpfrontAmount AS [FullUpfrontAmount],  -- จำนวนเงินที่ Upfront
            SM_Measure.MeasureName AS [ContractCampaignName],  -- ชื่อแคมเปญ
            TDR_Contract.Remark AS [TDRRemark],  -- หมายเหตุ TDR
            SM_TDRStatus.StatusName AS [TDRStatus],  -- สถานะ TDR

            -- TDR Count (aggregate)
            TDR_Count.TDRCount AS [NumberOfContract],  -- จำนวนครั้งที่ทำ TDR
            TDR_Count.LatestTDRDate AS [LatestTDRDate],  -- วันที่ปรับปรุงโครงสร้างหนี้ (TDR) ครั้งล่าสุด
            SM_Measure.MeasureName AS [LatestTDRMeasureName],  -- ชื่อมาตรการที่ปรับปรุงโครงสร้างหนี้
            TDR_Contract.RequestDate AS [CompromiseDate],  -- Ongoing.วันที่ประนอมหนี้
            TDR_Contract.ApproveDate AS [CompromiseApproveDate],  -- Ongoing.วันที่อนุมัติประนอมหนี้
            -- '' AS [ContractUpdateDateClose],  -- Ongoing.วันที่ปิดแผน TDR
            CAST(NULL AS DATETIME) AS [ContractUpdateDateClose],

            -- ================================================================
            -- Payment Information (from ACCDataReceipt)
            -- ================================================================
            PAY_Latest.ReceiptDate AS [LastReceiptDate],  -- วันที่รับชำระครั้งล่าสุด
            YEAR(PAY_Latest.ReceiptDate) AS [YearLastPayment],  -- Y_วันที่รับชำระครั้งล่าสุด
            MONTH(PAY_Latest.ReceiptDate) AS [MonthLastPayment],  -- M_วันที่รับชำระครั้งล่าสุด
            PAY_Latest.PrincipalPay AS [CapitalPay],  -- ชำระเงินต้น
            PAY_Latest.AccruedInterestPay AS [IntPay],  -- ชำระดอกเบี้ย
            (PAY_Latest.CourtFeePay + PAY_Latest.LawyerFeePay + PAY_Latest.OtherExpensePay) AS [OtherPayment],  -- อื่น (ค่าศาล/ทนาย/อื่นๆ)
            SM_PaymentType.PaymentTypeName AS [PaymentChannel],  -- ช่องทางการรับชำระ

            -- Payment YTD Summary
            PAY_YTD.TotalPaymentYTD AS [TotalReceiveAmount],  -- รับชำระสะสม_YTD
            PAY_YTD.PrincipalPayYTD AS [TotalPrincipalPayYTD],  -- เงินต้นรับชำระสะสม
            PAY_YTD.InterestPayYTD AS [TotalInterestPayYTD],  -- ดอกเบี้ยรับชำระสะสม

            -- Monthly Payments (M01-M12) - requires Year parameter for accurate calculation
            -- For simplicity, showing last 12 months from report date
            PAY_M01.Amount AS [M01Payment],  -- M01-2566
            PAY_M02.Amount AS [M02Payment],  -- M02-2566
            PAY_M03.Amount AS [M03Payment],  -- M03-2566
            PAY_M04.Amount AS [M04Payment],  -- M04-2566
            PAY_M05.Amount AS [M05Payment],  -- M05-2566
            PAY_M06.Amount AS [M06Payment],  -- M06-2566
            PAY_M07.Amount AS [M07Payment],  -- M07-2566
            PAY_M08.Amount AS [M08Payment],  -- M08-2566
            PAY_M09.Amount AS [M09Payment],  -- M09-2566
            PAY_M10.Amount AS [M10Payment],  -- M10-2566
            PAY_M11.Amount AS [M11Payment],  -- M11-2566
            PAY_M12.Amount AS [M12Payment],  -- M12-2566

            -- ================================================================
            -- Classification/Bucketing (External: Classification System)
            -- ================================================================
            --'' AS [OutstandingBalance],  -- Owned_Amount
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS [OutstandingBalance],
            '' AS [RestructuredCase],  -- Restructured_Case
            --'' AS [DateOfRestructured],  -- Restructured_Date
            CAST(NULL AS DATETIME) AS [DateOfRestructured],
            -- '' AS [InstallmentAmount],  -- ค่างวด TDR
            '' AS [NumberOfInstallments],  -- Number_Of_Installments
            --'' AS [PaymentAmount],  -- Payment_Amount
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS [PaymentAmount],
            --'' AS [AmountPastDue],  -- Past_Due_Amount
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS [AmountPastDue],
            '' AS [PastDueDays],  -- Past_Due_Days
            -- '' AS [DefaultDate],  -- Defaultdate
            CAST(NULL AS DATETIME) AS [DefaultDate],
            CAST(DC.DPD AS INT) AS [DPDAvailable],  -- DPD
            '' AS [Bucket],  -- Bucket
            '' AS [BucketByCIF],  -- Bucket by CIF
            '' AS [Class],  -- Class
            '' AS [ClassByCIF],  -- Class By CIF
            '' AS [CollectorName],  -- Collectorname
            '' AS [PaymentTerms],  -- Payment Term
            '' AS [TermOfPastDue],  -- Past_Due_Term
            '' AS [PastDueInstallments],  -- งวดที่ค้างชำระ

            -- ================================================================
            -- Additional Card Fields (External Data Needed)
            -- ================================================================
            '' AS [OutstandingCapitalPay],  -- OS.เงินต้นคงเหลือ ก่อนตัดหนี้สูญ
            '' AS [SuspendIntPay],  -- OS.ดอกเบี้ยตั้งพัก/ดอกเบี้ยแขวน
            '' AS [SuspendIntBalance],  -- OS.ดอกเบี้ยตั้งพัก/ดอกเบี้ยแขวนคงเหลือ
            '' AS [HangingInt],  -- OS.HangingInt
            '' AS [HangingIntPay],  -- OS.HangingIntPay
            '' AS [HangingIntBalance],  -- OS.HangingIntBalance
            -- '' AS [TitleCode],  -- คำนำหน้าชื่อผู้กู้

            -- ================================================================
            -- Project Information (External: Magic System)
            -- ================================================================
            '' AS [DebtorContractName],  -- ชื่อโครงการ
            '' AS [ProjectType],  -- ประเภทโครงการ
            '' AS [PaymentConditionCode],  -- รหัส เงื่อนไขการจ่าย
            '' AS [PaymentCondition],  -- เงื่อนไขการจ่าย
            -- '' AS [GradeRecognitionDate],  -- วันที่รับรู้เกรด
            -- '' AS [GradeRecordDate],  -- วันที่บันทึกเกรด
            '' AS [PrimaryGuaranteeType],  -- ประเภทการค้ำหลัก

            -- ================================================================
            -- Calculated Fields
            -- ================================================================
            DATEDIFF(MONTH, LG.ClaimDate, @ReportDate) AS [AgeOfClaim],  -- คำนวณอายุ Loan Y
            YEAR(LG.ClaimDate) AS [YearClaimPayDate],  -- Y_วันที่จ่าย
            MONTH(LG.ClaimDate) AS [MonthClaimPayDate],  -- M_วันที่จ่าย
            YEAR(DC.CloseDate) AS [YearCloseDate],  -- Y_วันที่ปิดบัญชี
            MONTH(DC.CloseDate) AS [MonthCloseDate],  -- M_วันที่ปิดบัญชี

            -- Loan Age Grouping (example grouping logic - adjust as needed)
            CASE
                WHEN DATEDIFF(MONTH, LG.ClaimDate, @ReportDate) <= 12 THEN '0-1 ปี'
                WHEN DATEDIFF(MONTH, LG.ClaimDate, @ReportDate) <= 24 THEN '1-2 ปี'
                WHEN DATEDIFF(MONTH, LG.ClaimDate, @ReportDate) <= 36 THEN '2-3 ปี'
                WHEN DATEDIFF(MONTH, LG.ClaimDate, @ReportDate) <= 60 THEN '3-5 ปี'
                ELSE 'มากกว่า 5 ปี'
            END AS [GroupOfClaim],  -- กลุ่มอายุ Loan_MC

            -- Generation (for individuals only)
            CASE
                WHEN DR.DebtorTypeId = 1 THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN YEAR(@ReportDate) - YEAR(D.BirthDate) < 25 THEN 'Gen Z'
                        WHEN YEAR(@ReportDate) - YEAR(D.BirthDate) BETWEEN 25 AND 40 THEN 'Gen Y (Millennial)'
                        WHEN YEAR(@ReportDate) - YEAR(D.BirthDate) BETWEEN 41 AND 56 THEN 'Gen X'
                        WHEN YEAR(@ReportDate) - YEAR(D.BirthDate) > 56 THEN 'Baby Boomer'
                        ELSE 'Unknown'
                    END
                ELSE NULL
            END AS [AgeOfBirthDate],  -- Generation

            -- Business Age (for legal entities only)
            CASE
                WHEN DR.DebtorTypeId = 2 THEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, D.RegistrationDate, @ReportDate)
                ELSE NULL
            END AS [BusinessAge],  -- อายุกิจการ

            CASE
                WHEN DR.DebtorTypeId = 2 THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, D.RegistrationDate, @ReportDate) < 3 THEN 'น้อยกว่า 3 ปี'
                        WHEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, D.RegistrationDate, @ReportDate) BETWEEN 3 AND 5 THEN '3-5 ปี'
                        WHEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, D.RegistrationDate, @ReportDate) BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN '6-10 ปี'
                        ELSE 'มากกว่า 10 ปี'
                    END
                ELSE NULL
            END AS [AgeOfRegistrationDate],  -- ช่วงอายุกิจการ

            -- OS Grouping (20 MB threshold)
            CASE
                WHEN DC.PrincipalTotal > 20000000 THEN 'มากกว่า 20 ล้าน'
                ELSE 'น้อยกว่าหรือเท่ากับ 20 ล้าน'
            END AS [OSGrouping20MB],  -- จัดกลุ่ม 20 MB

            -- Tracking calculation date
            COALESCE(DTT.UpdateDate, DTT.TransactionTrackingDate, DSU.CollectorUpdateDate) AS [TrackingCalculationDate],  -- วันที่นำมาคำนวณ TK

            -- Days since last tracking
            DATEDIFF(DAY, COALESCE(DTT.UpdateDate, DTT.TransactionTrackingDate, DSU.CollectorUpdateDate), @ReportDate) AS [DaysSinceLastTracking],  -- จำนวนวันตั้งแต่ติดตามล่าสุด

            -- Tracking age grouping
            CASE
                WHEN DATEDIFF(DAY, COALESCE(DTT.UpdateDate, DTT.TransactionTrackingDate, DSU.CollectorUpdateDate), @ReportDate) > 31
                    THEN 'มากกว่า 1 เดือน'
                ELSE 'ภายใน 1 เดือน'
            END AS [OverMonthGroup],  -- กลุ่มการเกินเดือน

            -- ================================================================
            -- Additional Aggregations (External: Need CIF-level aggregation)
            -- ================================================================
            '' AS [SumOfClaimByCIF],  -- ยอดจ่าย Claim by CIF
            '' AS [SumOutstandingBalanceByCIF],  -- CIF by OS.เงินต้นคงเหลือ
            '' AS [MaxGroupOfClaim],  -- อายุ Loan MC by CIF
            '' AS [OnbookLoanAgeGroupMC],  -- กลุ่มอายุ Loan_MC
            '' AS [OnbookLoanAgeGroup],  -- กลุ่มอายุ Loan_Onbook
            '' AS [CaseOSGroup],  -- กลุ่ม OS By CIF_คดี
            '' AS [BOTOSByCIF],  -- CIF by OS_ BOT
            CAST(1 AS INT) AS [RowCount],  -- Row counter for aggregation purposes
            '' AS [CampaignTypeGroup]  -- มาตรการสี

    FROM DataDebtorRelate DR

        -- ====================================================================
        -- Joins
        -- ====================================================================
        LEFT JOIN DataDebtor D
            ON DR.DebtorCode = D.DebtorCode

        LEFT JOIN DataLG LG
            ON DR.LGNo = LG.LGNo

        LEFT JOIN DataDebtorCard DC
            ON DR.DebtorRelateId = DC.DebtorRelateId

        LEFT JOIN SystemBankMaster BK
            ON LG.BankId = BK.BankId

        LEFT JOIN SystemBankBranchMaster BB
            ON LG.BankBranchId = BB.BankBranchId

        LEFT JOIN DataDebtorAddress DDA
            ON DR.DebtorId = DDA.DebtorId
            AND DDA.IsDefault = 1

        LEFT JOIN SystemSubDistrictMaster SSub
            ON DDA.SubDistrictId = SSub.SubDistrictId

        LEFT JOIN SystemDistrictMaster SDist
            ON DDA.DistrictId = SDist.DistrictId

        LEFT JOIN SystemProvinceMaster SProv
            ON DDA.ProvinceId = SProv.ProvinceId

        LEFT JOIN SystemZoneMaster SZone
            ON SProv.ZoneId = SZone.ZoneId

        LEFT JOIN DataDebtorStatusUpdate DSU
            ON DR.DebtorRelateId = DSU.DebtorRelateId

        LEFT JOIN SystemStatusMaster SM_LG
            ON LG.StatusId = SM_LG.SystemStatusId

        LEFT JOIN SystemStatusMaster SM_Port
            ON DSU.StatusPortId = SM_Port.SystemStatusId

        LEFT JOIN SystemStatusMaster SM_Collector
            ON DSU.StatusCollectorId = SM_Collector.SystemStatusId

        LEFT JOIN SystemStatusMaster SM_Tracking
            ON DSU.StatusTrackingId = SM_Tracking.SystemStatusId

        LEFT JOIN SystemStatusMaster SM_Compromise
            ON DSU.StatusCompromiseId = SM_Compromise.SystemStatusId

        LEFT JOIN SystemStatusMaster SM_Legal
            ON DSU.StatusLegalId = SM_Legal.SystemStatusId

        LEFT JOIN SystemStatusMaster SM_Card
            ON DSU.StatusCardId = SM_Card.SystemStatusId

        LEFT JOIN SystemStatusMaster SM_ClaimType
            ON LG.ClaimTypeId = SM_ClaimType.SystemStatusId

        LEFT JOIN SystemStatusMaster SM_ClaimSubType
            ON LG.ClaimSubTypeId = SM_ClaimSubType.SystemStatusId

        -- Extended Case Information
        LEFT JOIN LTDataCaseMainDebtor CASE_D
            ON DR.DebtorRelateId = CASE_D.DebtorRelateId
            AND CASE_D.IsCancel = 0

        LEFT JOIN SystemStatusMaster SM_CasePort
            ON CASE_D.StatusPortId = SM_CasePort.SystemStatusId

        LEFT JOIN SystemCaseTypeMaster SM_CaseType
            ON CASE_D.CaseTypeId = SM_CaseType.CaseTypeId

        LEFT JOIN SystemStatusMaster SM_Prosecution
            ON CASE_D.StatusProsecutionId = SM_Prosecution.SystemStatusId

        -- Tracking Information (Latest)
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT
                DebtorId,
                TransactionTrackingDate,
                TransactionTrackingDetail,
                UpdateDate,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DebtorId ORDER BY TransactionTrackingDate DESC) AS RowNum
            FROM DEBDataTransactionTracking
        ) DTT ON DR.DebtorId = DTT.DebtorId AND DTT.RowNum = 1

        -- TDR Information (Latest by LG)
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT
                LGNo,
                DebtDate,
                ClaimPay,
                Grade,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LGNo ORDER BY DebtDate DESC) AS RowNum
            FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractLG
        ) TDR_Latest ON DR.LGNo = TDR_Latest.LGNo AND TDR_Latest.RowNum = 1

        -- TDR Contract Information (Latest)
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT
                TDR_D.DebtorRelateId,
                TDR_C.CompromiseContractId,
                TDR_C.ContractNo,
                TDR_C.TDRDate,
                TDR_C.RequestDate,
                TDR_C.ApproveDate,
                TDR_C.InterestRate,
                TDR_C.Installments,
                TDR_C.InstallmentsAmount,
                TDR_C.UpfrontInstallments,
                TDR_C.UpfrontAmount,
                TDR_C.MeasureId,
                TDR_C.CompromiseContractStatusId,
                TDR_C.Remark,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TDR_D.DebtorRelateId ORDER BY TDR_C.TDRDate DESC) AS RowNum
            FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractDebtor TDR_D
            INNER JOIN TDRDataCompromiseContract TDR_C ON TDR_D.CompromiseContractId = TDR_C.CompromiseContractId
        ) TDR_Contract ON DR.DebtorRelateId = TDR_Contract.DebtorRelateId AND TDR_Contract.RowNum = 1

        LEFT JOIN SystemMeasureMaster SM_Measure
            ON TDR_Contract.MeasureId = SM_Measure.MeasureId

        LEFT JOIN SystemStatusMaster SM_TDRStatus
            ON TDR_Contract.CompromiseContractStatusId = SM_TDRStatus.SystemStatusId

        -- TDR Count (aggregate count of TDR times)
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT
                TDR_D.DebtorRelateId,
                COUNT(DISTINCT TDR_C.CompromiseContractId) AS TDRCount,
                MAX(TDR_C.TDRDate) AS LatestTDRDate
            FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractDebtor TDR_D
            INNER JOIN TDRDataCompromiseContract TDR_C ON TDR_D.CompromiseContractId = TDR_C.CompromiseContractId
            GROUP BY TDR_D.DebtorRelateId
        ) TDR_Count ON DR.DebtorRelateId = TDR_Count.DebtorRelateId

        -- Payment Information (Latest Receipt)
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT
                DebtorRelateId,
                ReceiptDate,
                PrincipalPay,
                AccruedInterestPay,
                CourtFeePay,
                LawyerFeePay,
                OtherExpensePay,
                PaymentTypeId,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DebtorRelateId ORDER BY ReceiptDate DESC) AS RowNum
            FROM ACCDataReceipt
            WHERE IsCancel = 0
        ) PAY_Latest ON DR.DebtorRelateId = PAY_Latest.DebtorRelateId AND PAY_Latest.RowNum = 1

        LEFT JOIN SystemPaymentType SM_PaymentType
            ON PAY_Latest.PaymentTypeId = SM_PaymentType.PaymentTypeId

        -- Payment YTD Summary
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT
                DebtorRelateId,
                SUM(PrincipalPay + AccruedInterestPay + CourtFeePay + LawyerFeePay + OtherExpensePay) AS TotalPaymentYTD,
                SUM(PrincipalPay) AS PrincipalPayYTD,
                SUM(AccruedInterestPay) AS InterestPayYTD
            FROM ACCDataReceipt
            WHERE IsCancel = 0
                AND YEAR(ReceiptDate) = YEAR(@ReportDate)
            GROUP BY DebtorRelateId
        ) PAY_YTD ON DR.DebtorRelateId = PAY_YTD.DebtorRelateId

        -- Monthly Payment Summaries (M01-M12)
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT DebtorRelateId, SUM(PrincipalPay + AccruedInterestPay + CourtFeePay + LawyerFeePay + OtherExpensePay) AS Amount
            FROM ACCDataReceipt
            WHERE IsCancel = 0 AND MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 1 AND YEAR(ReceiptDate) = YEAR(@ReportDate)
            GROUP BY DebtorRelateId
        ) PAY_M01 ON DR.DebtorRelateId = PAY_M01.DebtorRelateId

        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT DebtorRelateId, SUM(PrincipalPay + AccruedInterestPay + CourtFeePay + LawyerFeePay + OtherExpensePay) AS Amount
            FROM ACCDataReceipt
            WHERE IsCancel = 0 AND MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 2 AND YEAR(ReceiptDate) = YEAR(@ReportDate)
            GROUP BY DebtorRelateId
        ) PAY_M02 ON DR.DebtorRelateId = PAY_M02.DebtorRelateId

        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT DebtorRelateId, SUM(PrincipalPay + AccruedInterestPay + CourtFeePay + LawyerFeePay + OtherExpensePay) AS Amount
            FROM ACCDataReceipt
            WHERE IsCancel = 0 AND MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 3 AND YEAR(ReceiptDate) = YEAR(@ReportDate)
            GROUP BY DebtorRelateId
        ) PAY_M03 ON DR.DebtorRelateId = PAY_M03.DebtorRelateId

        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT DebtorRelateId, SUM(PrincipalPay + AccruedInterestPay + CourtFeePay + LawyerFeePay + OtherExpensePay) AS Amount
            FROM ACCDataReceipt
            WHERE IsCancel = 0 AND MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 4 AND YEAR(ReceiptDate) = YEAR(@ReportDate)
            GROUP BY DebtorRelateId
        ) PAY_M04 ON DR.DebtorRelateId = PAY_M04.DebtorRelateId

        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT DebtorRelateId, SUM(PrincipalPay + AccruedInterestPay + CourtFeePay + LawyerFeePay + OtherExpensePay) AS Amount
            FROM ACCDataReceipt
            WHERE IsCancel = 0 AND MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 5 AND YEAR(ReceiptDate) = YEAR(@ReportDate)
            GROUP BY DebtorRelateId
        ) PAY_M05 ON DR.DebtorRelateId = PAY_M05.DebtorRelateId

        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT DebtorRelateId, SUM(PrincipalPay + AccruedInterestPay + CourtFeePay + LawyerFeePay + OtherExpensePay) AS Amount
            FROM ACCDataReceipt
            WHERE IsCancel = 0 AND MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 6 AND YEAR(ReceiptDate) = YEAR(@ReportDate)
            GROUP BY DebtorRelateId
        ) PAY_M06 ON DR.DebtorRelateId = PAY_M06.DebtorRelateId

        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT DebtorRelateId, SUM(PrincipalPay + AccruedInterestPay + CourtFeePay + LawyerFeePay + OtherExpensePay) AS Amount
            FROM ACCDataReceipt
            WHERE IsCancel = 0 AND MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 7 AND YEAR(ReceiptDate) = YEAR(@ReportDate)
            GROUP BY DebtorRelateId
        ) PAY_M07 ON DR.DebtorRelateId = PAY_M07.DebtorRelateId

        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT DebtorRelateId, SUM(PrincipalPay + AccruedInterestPay + CourtFeePay + LawyerFeePay + OtherExpensePay) AS Amount
            FROM ACCDataReceipt
            WHERE IsCancel = 0 AND MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 8 AND YEAR(ReceiptDate) = YEAR(@ReportDate)
            GROUP BY DebtorRelateId
        ) PAY_M08 ON DR.DebtorRelateId = PAY_M08.DebtorRelateId

        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT DebtorRelateId, SUM(PrincipalPay + AccruedInterestPay + CourtFeePay + LawyerFeePay + OtherExpensePay) AS Amount
            FROM ACCDataReceipt
            WHERE IsCancel = 0 AND MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 9 AND YEAR(ReceiptDate) = YEAR(@ReportDate)
            GROUP BY DebtorRelateId
        ) PAY_M09 ON DR.DebtorRelateId = PAY_M09.DebtorRelateId

        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT DebtorRelateId, SUM(PrincipalPay + AccruedInterestPay + CourtFeePay + LawyerFeePay + OtherExpensePay) AS Amount
            FROM ACCDataReceipt
            WHERE IsCancel = 0 AND MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 10 AND YEAR(ReceiptDate) = YEAR(@ReportDate)
            GROUP BY DebtorRelateId
        ) PAY_M10 ON DR.DebtorRelateId = PAY_M10.DebtorRelateId

        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT DebtorRelateId, SUM(PrincipalPay + AccruedInterestPay + CourtFeePay + LawyerFeePay + OtherExpensePay) AS Amount
            FROM ACCDataReceipt
            WHERE IsCancel = 0 AND MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 11 AND YEAR(ReceiptDate) = YEAR(@ReportDate)
            GROUP BY DebtorRelateId
        ) PAY_M11 ON DR.DebtorRelateId = PAY_M11.DebtorRelateId

        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT DebtorRelateId, SUM(PrincipalPay + AccruedInterestPay + CourtFeePay + LawyerFeePay + OtherExpensePay) AS Amount
            FROM ACCDataReceipt
            WHERE IsCancel = 0 AND MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 12 AND YEAR(ReceiptDate) = YEAR(@ReportDate)
            GROUP BY DebtorRelateId
        ) PAY_M12 ON DR.DebtorRelateId = PAY_M12.DebtorRelateId

        LEFT JOIN DataUsers USR_Collector
            ON DSU.CollectorUserId = USR_Collector.UserId

        LEFT JOIN DataUsers USR_CollectorDEB
            ON DSU.CollectorOAUserId = USR_CollectorDEB.UserId

        LEFT JOIN DataUsers USR_Legal
            ON CASE_D.LegalUserId = USR_Legal.UserId

        -- ====================================================================
        -- WHERE Clause with Frontend Parameters
        -- ====================================================================
    WHERE
        DR.IsActive = 1
        AND DR.IsDelete = 0

        -- รหัส CIF
        AND (@CIFNo IS NULL OR DR.CIFNo LIKE '%' + @CIFNo + '%')

        -- เลข LG
        AND (@LGNo IS NULL OR DR.LGNo LIKE '%' + @LGNo + '%')

        -- รหัสการ์ด
        AND (@CardNumber IS NULL OR D.CardNumber LIKE '%' + @CardNumber + '%')

        -- รหัสลูกหนี้
        AND (@DebtorCode IS NULL OR DR.DebtorCode LIKE '%' + @DebtorCode + '%')

        -- ชื่อ–นามสกุล
        AND (@DebtorName IS NULL OR D.DebtorName LIKE '%' + @DebtorName + '%')

        -- ประเภทลูกหนี้
        AND (@DebtorTypeId IS NULL OR DR.DebtorTypeId = @DebtorTypeId)

        -- ประเภทการค้ำประกัน
        AND (@ClaimTypeId IS NULL OR LG.ClaimTypeId = @ClaimTypeId)

        -- จำนวนเงินจ่ายประกันชดเชย (Range)
        AND (@ClaimPayAmountMin IS NULL OR LG.ClaimPayAmount >= @ClaimPayAmountMin)
        AND (@ClaimPayAmountMax IS NULL OR LG.ClaimPayAmount <= @ClaimPayAmountMax)

        -- เกรด
        AND (@Grade IS NULL OR LG.Grade = @Grade)

        -- ภาระหนี้ (Range)
        AND (@DebtBalanceMin IS NULL OR DC.PrincipalTotal >= @DebtBalanceMin)
        AND (@DebtBalanceMax IS NULL OR DC.PrincipalTotal <= @DebtBalanceMax)

        -- เบอร์โทร (search in contact fields)
        AND (
            @PhoneNumber IS NULL
            OR D.CntPhoneNumber LIKE '%' + @PhoneNumber + '%'
            OR D.CntMobileNumber LIKE '%' + @PhoneNumber + '%'
        )

        -- คดีดำ/คดีแดง
        AND (
            @CaseNo IS NULL
            OR CASE_D.BlackCaseNo LIKE '%' + @CaseNo + '%'
            OR CASE_D.RedCaseNo LIKE '%' + @CaseNo + '%'
        )

        -- วงเงิน (Guarantee Amount Range)
        AND (@GuaranteeAmountMin IS NULL OR LG.ClaimAmount >= @GuaranteeAmountMin)
        AND (@GuaranteeAmountMax IS NULL OR LG.ClaimAmount <= @GuaranteeAmountMax)

        -- วันที่จ่ายประกันชดเชย (Date Range)
        AND (@ClaimPayDateFrom IS NULL OR LG.ClaimDate >= @ClaimPayDateFrom)
        AND (@ClaimPayDateTo IS NULL OR LG.ClaimDate <= @ClaimPayDateTo)

        -- สถานะลูกหนี้
        AND (@StatusCollectorId IS NULL OR DSU.StatusCollectorId = @StatusCollectorId)

        -- สถานะระบบติดตามหนี้
        AND (@StatusTrackingId IS NULL OR DSU.StatusTrackingId = @StatusTrackingId)

    ORDER BY DR.CIFNo, DR.LGNo;

END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_GetTracking]
    @DebtorId NVARCHAR(100)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT
        t.TransactionTrackingId,
        t.TransactionTrackingDate,
        ISNULL(t.DebtorContactName,      '')  AS DebtorContactName,
        ISNULL(t.DebtorContactTel,       '')  AS DebtorContactTel,
        t.AppointmentPaymentDate,
        t.AppointmentDate,
        t.StatusTransactionTrackingId,
        ISNULL(s.StatusName,             '')  AS StatusTransactionTrackingName,
        ISNULL(t.TransactionTrackingDetail,'') AS TransactionTrackingDetail,
        ISNULL(title.TitleName,          '')  AS TitleName,
        ISNULL(p.FirstName,              '')  AS FirstName,
        ISNULL(p.LastName,               '')  AS LastName
    FROM  [dbo].[DEBDataTransactionTracking]  t  WITH (NOLOCK)
    LEFT JOIN [dbo].[SystemStatusMaster]       s  WITH (NOLOCK)
        ON  s.SystemStatusId = t.StatusTransactionTrackingId
    LEFT JOIN [dbo].[DataPersonalInfo]         p  WITH (NOLOCK)
        ON  p.UserId = t.CreateBy
    LEFT JOIN [dbo].[SystemTitleMaster]        title WITH (NOLOCK)
        ON  title.TitleId = p.TitleId
    WHERE t.DebtorId = @DebtorId
    ORDER BY t.TransactionTrackingDate DESC;
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DCS_UpdateStatus]


	@RelateId nvarchar(150) = 'b045f135-2bf4-4a41-a6cf-b368bdc98062'
	,@StatusId int = 1
	,@GroupId int = 9
	
AS
BEGIN
Declare @RelateTypeId int = (select top 1 DebtorTypeId from DataDebtorRelate where DebtorRelateId = @RelateId)
Declare @CIFNo nvarchar = (select top 1 CIFNo from DataDebtorRelate where DebtorRelateId = @RelateId)



Declare @StatusCompromiseId int= 0;
Set @StatusCompromiseId=case 
when @StatusId=54 then 55
when @StatusId=55 then 56
when @StatusId=56 then 57
when @StatusId=57 then 58
when @StatusId=58 then 59
when @StatusId=59 then 60
when @StatusId=60 then 61
when @StatusId=61 then 62
when @StatusId=62 then 114
end ;

--Update Status Port
Update s
set StatusPortId = 
case 
when @StatusId=106 then 3
when @StatusId=107 then 2
when @StatusId=108 then 2
when @StatusId=201 then 3
when @StatusId=202 then 1
when @StatusId=203 then 4
when @StatusId=204 then 5
when @StatusId=205 then 7
else s.StatusPortId end,

s.StatusLegalId=
case when @StatusId=205 then 74
else StatusLegalId end,

-- Update Status StatusCollectorId ระบบติดตามหนี้
s.StatusCollectorId=
Case
when @StatusId=106 then 39
when @StatusId=107 then 38
when @StatusId=108 then 40
when @StatusId=201 then 41
when @StatusId=202 then 43
when @StatusId=203 then 48
when @StatusId=204 then 49
when @StatusId=205 then 43 else StatusCollectorId end,

-- Update Status LG
StatusLGId=
Case
when @StatusId=106 then 27
when @StatusId=107 then 27
when @StatusId=108 then 27
when @StatusId=201 then 27
when @StatusId=202 then 27
when @StatusId=203 then 29
when @StatusId=204 then 30
when @StatusId=205 then 27 else StatusLGId end,

-- Update Satus 
s.StatusSubTrackingId=case when @StatusId in (106,107,108,201,202,203,204,205) then 212 else StatusSubTrackingId end,

-- Update Debtor Status
 s.StatusDebtorId = 
case 
when @StatusId=106 then 14
when @StatusId=107 then 14
when @StatusId=108 then 14
when @StatusId=201 then 14
when @StatusId=202 then 14
when @StatusId=203 then 16
when @StatusId=204 then 17
when @StatusId=205 then 20
else StatusDebtorId end,

s.UpdateDate=getdate()
from DataDebtorStatusUpdate s
left join DataLG lg on lg.LGNo = s.LGNo
where (s.DebtorRelateId = @RelateId
or s.CIFNo = (case when @RelateTypeId in (1, 2) then @CIFNo else '0' end))
and lg.Grade = 'F1'
;






if @StatusCompromiseId<>0
begin

	Update s
	set 
	 s.StatusCompromiseId = @StatusCompromiseId,
	 s.StatusDebtorId = 
	case 
	when @StatusCompromiseId in (55,56,57,58,59) then 15
	when @StatusCompromiseId in (60,61) then 14
	when @StatusCompromiseId=62 then 18
	when @StatusCompromiseId=114 then 17
	else StatusDebtorId end,
	 s.StatusPortId = 
	case 
	when @StatusCompromiseId in (55,56,57,58,59,60,61,62,114) then 3
	else StatusDebtorId end,
	  s.StatusCollectorId = 
	case 
	when @StatusCompromiseId in (55,56,57,58,59,60,61,62,114) then 106
	else s.StatusCollectorId end,

	UpdateDate=getdate()
	from DataDebtorStatusUpdate s
	left join DataLG lg on lg.LGNo = s.LGNo
	where DebtorRelateId = @RelateId




end

-- กรณีที่สถานะเป็นดำเนินคดี ต้องแก้สถานะ LG ให้ตรงสถานะ
Update DataDebtorStatusUpdate
set StatusLGId=27
where StatusLegalId=74 and DebtorRelateId = @RelateId;
		
END

  SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @DebtorId nvarchar(100);
  DECLARE @CollectorUserId INT;
  
  --หยิบข้อมูล Debtor ที่เป็นผู้กู้หลัก
    SELECT @DebtorId = DebtorId 
    FROM DataDebtorRelate
    WHERE DebtorTypeId = 1 AND LGNo = @LGNo
    
    
   --หยิบข้อมูลผู้ดูแลที่เป็น บสย. / สาขา
    SELECT @CollectorUserId = a.CollectorUserId
    FROM DataAssignment a
    JOIN DataDebtorRelate b on a.DebtorRelateId = b.DebtorRelateId 
    Where b.DebtorId = @DebtorId AND a.LGNo <> @LGNo AND a.CollectorUserId <> 0
    
    IF @CollectorUserId IS NULL
    RETURN 0;
    
    
    Update a Set a.CollectorUserId = @CollectorUserId
	, a.IsOriginal =1 
	, a.IsShow = (case when r.DebtorTypeId=1 then 1 else 0 end)
	, a.TypeAssignId = 1
    from DataAssignment a
    left join DataDebtorRelate r on r.DebtorRelateId = a.DebtorRelateId
    where a.LGNo=@LGNo

	
-- 		
-- 		---- ✅ อัปเดตสถานะ DataDebtorTransactionStatus
--         UPDATE DataDebtorTransactionStatus
--         SET SystemStatusId = 132
--         WHERE DebtorRelateId in (select DebtorRelateId from DataDebtorRelate where LGNo = @LGNo)
-- 		and GroupStatusId = 15;
    
    
    Update DataDebtorStatusUpdate 
    Set StatusAssignId = 132,
--         StatusTrackingId = 217,
        StatusSubTrackingId = 211,
        StatusAssignDate = GETDATE(),
        StatusSubTrackingDate = GETDATE(),
--         StatusTrackingDate = GETDATE(),
        CollectorUserId= @CollectorUserId, 
        CollectorUpdateDate = GETDATE() 
     Where LGNo = @LGNo
    

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DEB_002_UpdateAssignmentBranch]
	-- นำเข้าข้อมูลลูกหนี้ - ที่อยู่ DataDebtorAddress
	@LGNo nvarchar(20) = '64807936'
	
	
AS
BEGIN
  SET NOCOUNT ON;
  DECLARE @DebtorId NVARCHAR(100);
  DECLARE @ProvinceId INT;
  DECLARE @ManagerUserId INT = 0; -- default ถ้าไม่เจอ
  DECLARE @DebtorRelateId nvarchar(100);


    -- 1) หาค่า DebtorId ของผู้กู้หลัก
    SELECT TOP 1 @DebtorId = b.DebtorId, @DebtorRelateId = a.DebtorRelateId
    FROM DataAssignment a
    JOIN DataDebtorRelate b ON a.DebtorRelateId = b.DebtorRelateId
    WHERE a.LGNo = @LGNo
      AND b.DebtorTypeId = 1;

    IF @DebtorId IS NULL
    BEGIN
        RETURN 0; -- ไม่เจอ Debtor
    END
    
    
        -- 2) หา ProvinceId จาก Address
    ;WITH Address AS
    (
        SELECT d.ProvinceId, d.DebtorAddressTypeId, d.UpdateDate,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY CASE WHEN d.DebtorAddressTypeId = 7 THEN 7 ELSE 0 END
                   ORDER BY d.UpdateDate DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM DataDebtorAddress d
        WHERE d.DebtorId = @DebtorId
    )
    
    SELECT TOP 1 @ProvinceId = ProvinceId
    FROM Address
    WHERE (DebtorAddressTypeId = 7 AND rn = 1) OR (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Address WHERE DebtorAddressTypeId = 7) AND rn = 1);

    IF @ProvinceId IS NULL
    BEGIN
        RETURN 0; -- ไม่มีที่อยู่
    END
    
        -- 3) หา ManagerUserId
    SELECT TOP 1 @ManagerUserId = a.UserId
    FROM DataUsers a
    JOIN DataPersonalInfo b ON a.UserId = b.UserId
    JOIN SystemOrgStructure e ON b.OrgStructureId = e.OrgStructureId
    JOIN SystemOrgSectionMaster c ON b.OrgStructureId = c.OrgStructureId
    JOIN SystemResponsibleAreaMaster d ON b.OrgSectionId = d.OrgSectionId
    WHERE d.ProvinceId = @ProvinceId
      AND b.IsManager = 1
      AND a.IsActive = 1
      AND e.OrgStructureId <> 6
	  AND e.OrgStructureId in (5, 18)
	  AND (b.OrgSectionId is not null OR b.OrgSectionId != 0)
      AND a.IsDelete = 0;

    -- 4) คืนค่า
    IF @ManagerUserId IS NULL
    BEGIN
        RETURN 0; -- ไม่มีที่อยู่
    END
    
 
	Update a Set CollectorUserId = @ManagerUserId ,IsShow = (case when r.DebtorTypeId=1 then 1 else 0 end),TypeAssignId=1, UpdateDate = GETDATE()
	from DataAssignment a
	left join DataDebtorRelate r on r.DebtorRelateId = a.DebtorRelateId
	where a.LGNo=@LGNo
  
  
  
  Update DataDebtorStatusUpdate 
  Set StatusAssignId = 131,
        StatusAssignDate = GETDATE(),
        CollectorUserId= @ManagerUserId, 
        CollectorUpdateDate = GETDATE() 
  Where LGNo = @LGNo
  
  
  
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DEB_003_UpdateAssignmentOA]
     @LGNo           NVARCHAR(50),
     @CIFNo          NVARCHAR(50),
     @DebtorCode     NVARCHAR(50),
     @DebtorRelateId NVARCHAR(150),
     @OAGroupId      INT

BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    -- 0) ถ้าเคย Assign แล้ว ให้จบเลย (ยังไม่เปิด TX)
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM DEBDataAssignOA
        WHERE LGNo = @LGNo 
          AND DebtorRelateId = @DebtorRelateId
    )
    BEGIN
        RETURN 0;
    END;

    DECLARE @DebtorId        NVARCHAR(255),
            @DebtorName      NVARCHAR(255),
            @ClaimPay        DECIMAL(18,2),
            @ClaimPayDate    DATE,
            @SelectedOAUserId INT,
--             @CurrentRound    INT,
--             @NextRound       INT,
            @RoundAssign     NVARCHAR(50)
--             @PeriodId        INT

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        -- 1) ดึงข้อมูลลูกหนี้
        SELECT 
            @DebtorId      = dr.DebtorId,
            @DebtorName    = d.DebtorName,
            @ClaimPay      = ISNULL(lg.ClaimPayAmount, 0),
            @ClaimPayDate  = mc.ClaimPayDate
        FROM DataDebtorRelate dr WITH (NOLOCK)
        JOIN DataDebtor      d  WITH (NOLOCK) ON d.DebtorId = dr.DebtorId
        JOIN DataLG          lg WITH (NOLOCK) ON dr.LGNo = lg.LGNo
        JOIN DataMainCard    mc WITH (NOLOCK) ON dr.LGNo = mc.LGNo
        WHERE lg.LGNo = @LGNo
          AND dr.DebtorRelateId = @DebtorRelateId;

        IF @DebtorId IS NULL
            THROW 50000, N'ไม่พบข้อมูลลูกหนี้ตาม LG/Relate ที่ระบุ', 1;

        -- 2) หา OA ที่มียอด ClaimPay สะสมน้อยสุดในกลุ่ม
        SELECT TOP (1) @SelectedOAUserId = u.UserId
        FROM DataUsers u WITH (NOLOCK)
        JOIN DataPersonalInfo p WITH (NOLOCK) ON u.UserId = p.UserId
        LEFT JOIN DEBDataAssignOA assign 
               ON assign.CollectorOAUserId = u.UserId
              AND assign.OAGroupId        = @OAGroupId
        WHERE p.OrgStructureId = 47
          AND p.IsManager      = 1
          AND p.IsActive       = 1
          AND p.IsDelete       = 0
        GROUP BY u.UserId
        ORDER BY SUM(ISNULL(assign.ClaimPay, 0)) ASC;

        IF @SelectedOAUserId IS NULL
            THROW 50001, N'ไม่พบเจ้าหน้าที่ OA ที่มีสิทธิ์จ่ายงาน', 1;

        -- 2.1) หา Seq ปัจจุบัน และสร้าง RoundAssign = ปีพ.ศ._เดือน_(@CurrentRound + 1)
        SELECT @RoundAssign = RoundCurrent
        FROM SystemAssignOAPeriodMaster
        WHERE IsActive = 1;
-- 
--         SET @NextRound = ISNULL(@CurrentRound, 0) + 1;
-- 
--         SET @RoundAssign = CONCAT(
--                 CAST(YEAR(GETDATE()) + 543 AS VARCHAR(4)),       -- ปี พ.ศ.
--                 '_',
--                 RIGHT('0' + CAST(MONTH(GETDATE()) AS VARCHAR(2)), 2), -- เดือน 2 หลัก
--                 '_',
--                 CAST(@NextRound AS VARCHAR(10))                  -- (@CurrentRound + 1)
--             );

        -- 3) Insert จ่ายงาน
        INSERT INTO DEBDataAssignOA (
            AssignOAId,
            DebtorRelateId,
            CollectorOAUserId,
            DebtorName,
            DebtorTypeId,
            ClaimPay,
            ClaimPayDate,
            RoudAssign,
            Seq,
            IsAssign,
            CreateDate,
            CreateBy,
            UpdateDate,
            UpdateBy,
            DebtorId,
            CIFNo,
            LGNo,
            OAGroupId
        )
        VALUES (
            NEWID(),
            @DebtorRelateId,
            @SelectedOAUserId,
            @DebtorName,
            1,
            @ClaimPay,
            @ClaimPayDate,
            @RoundAssign,    -- ✅ ใช้ค่าที่ format แล้ว
            1,
            0,
            GETDATE(),
            1,
            GETDATE(),
            1,
            @DebtorId,
            @CIFNo,
            @LGNo,
            @OAGroupId
        );
        
--         Update SystemAssignOAPeriodMaster Set Seq = @NextRound, RoundCurrent = @RoundAssign
--         where AssignOAPeriodId = @PeriodId

        -- 4) อัปเดตสถานะ Assignment
        UPDATE DataAssignment
        SET TypeAssignId = 2,
            IsShow       = 1
        WHERE LGNo = @LGNo;

        -- 5) ถ้าจะอัปเดต DataDebtorTransactionStatus ค่อยเปิดส่วนนี้ทีหลัง
        -- UPDATE DataDebtorTransactionStatus
        -- SET SystemStatusId = 132
        -- WHERE DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM DataDebtorRelate WHERE LGNo = @LGNo)
        --   AND GroupStatusId = 15;

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
        RETURN 0;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_DEB_008_InsertDEBDataRequestPaymentDebt]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    DECLARE 
        @DocumentId     int = 12,
        @DocumentName   nvarchar(100),
        @CurYY          char(2),
        @CurMM          char(2),
        @MasterYY       char(2),
        @MasterMM       char(2),
        @RunningStr     char(6),
        @RunningInt     int,
        @TotalRow       int;

    /* =========================
       Current Year / Month (พ.ศ.)
       ========================= */
    SET @CurYY = RIGHT(CONVERT(varchar(4), YEAR(GETDATE()) + 543), 2);
    SET @CurMM = RIGHT('00' + CONVERT(varchar(2), MONTH(GETDATE())), 2);

    BEGIN TRAN;

    /* =========================
       1) Lock + Read Master
       ========================= */
    SELECT 
        @DocumentName = DocumentName,
        @MasterYY     = [Year],
        @MasterMM     = [Months],
        @RunningStr   = ISNULL(UpdateRunning, '000000')
    FROM SystemFormatDocumentMaster WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
    WHERE DocumentId = @DocumentId;

    /* =========================
       2) Reset running เมื่อเปลี่ยนปี / เดือน
       ========================= */
    IF (@MasterYY <> @CurYY OR @MasterMM <> @CurMM)
    BEGIN
        UPDATE SystemFormatDocumentMaster
        SET [Year] = @CurYY,
            [Months] = @CurMM,
            UpdateRunning = '000000'
        WHERE DocumentId = @DocumentId;

        SET @RunningStr = '000000';
    END

    /* แปลง running เป็น int */
    SET @RunningInt = CAST(@RunningStr AS int);

    /* =========================
       3) Prepare Source → Temp Table
       ========================= */
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Src') IS NOT NULL
        DROP TABLE #Src;

    SELECT
        c.DebtorRelateId,
        c.DebtorId,
        c.CIFNo,
        c.LGNo,
        c.ClaimPay,
        c.ClaimPayDate,
        c.CompromiseContracApproveDate,
        clg.PrincipalTotal,
        c.DPD,
        c.CompromiseContractId,
       
        ct.DebtRequestDate,
				max(p.DueDate) as InstallmentsDate,
				count(*) as Installments,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c.DebtorRelateId, c.LGNo) AS rn
    INTO #Src
    FROM DataDebtorCard c
    LEFT JOIN TDRDataCompromiseContract ct ON ct.CompromiseContractId = c.CompromiseContractId
    LEFT JOIN TDRDataCompromiseContractLG clg ON clg.CompromiseContractId = ct.CompromiseContractId
		LEFT JOIN TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment p on p.CompromiseContractId = c.CompromiseContractId
		
		--where c.IsTDR = 1 
		--and  c.DPD > 6 
		--and p.IsPayment = 0
		--and p.IsUpfront = 0
		--and p.DueDate <= getdate()
		--and (c.DebtorRelateId not in (select DebtorRelateId  from DEBDataRequestPaymentDebt)
		--		and p.DueDate not in (select InstallmentsDate from DEBDataRequestPaymentDebt))
		 WHERE c.DataDebtorCardId IN
     (
       '8F526A52-D542-4CA0-8FC0-D25E0C35816F'
,'1D38E538-6AE5-4484-8C32-959455411FFB'
         
     )

		group by  c.DebtorRelateId,
        c.DebtorId,
        c.CIFNo,
        c.LGNo,
        c.ClaimPay,
        c.ClaimPayDate,
        c.CompromiseContracApproveDate,
        clg.PrincipalTotal,
        c.DPD,
        c.CompromiseContractId,
        clg.Installments,
        ct.DebtRequestDate
-- 				p.DueDate
-- 		where 
    

    /* =========================
       4) Count rows
       ========================= */
    SELECT @TotalRow = COUNT(*) FROM #Src;

    IF @TotalRow = 0
    BEGIN
        COMMIT TRAN;
        RETURN;
    END

    /* =========================
       5) Insert with running 000001
       ========================= */
    INSERT INTO DEBDataRequestPaymentDebt
    (
        RequestPaymentDebtId,
        DebtorRelateId,
        RequestPaymentDebtNo,
        RequestPaymentDebtDate,
        DebtorName,
        CIFNo,
        LGNo,
        ClaimPay,
        ClaimPayDate,
        CreateDate,
        CreateBy,
        UpdateDate,
        UpdateBy,
        ApproveTRRDate,
        TRRDebtBalance,
        Installments,
        AmountInstallments,
        InstallmentsDate,
        InstallmentAmount,
        DebtRequestDate,
        IsGenBarcode
    )
    SELECT
        NEWID() as RequestPaymentDebtId,
        s.DebtorRelateId as DebtorRelateId,
        @DocumentName 
        + @CurYY
        + @CurMM
        + RIGHT('000000' + CAST(@RunningInt + s.rn AS varchar(6)), 6) as RequestPaymentDebtNo,
        GETDATE() as RequestPaymentDebtDate,
        s.DebtorId as DebtorName,
        s.CIFNo as CIFNo,
        s.LGNo as LGNo,
        s.ClaimPay as ClaimPay,
        s.ClaimPayDate as ClaimPayDate,
        GETDATE() as CreateDate,
        1 as CreateBy,
        GETDATE() as UpdateDate,
        1 as UpdateBy,
        s.CompromiseContracApproveDate as ApproveTRRDate,
        s.PrincipalTotal as TRRDebtBalance,
        s.Installments as Installments,
        dbo.FN_TDR_05_GetOverdueInstallments(s.CompromiseContractId, s.LGNo, '') as AmountInstallments,
        GETDATE() as InstallmentsDate,
        s.Installments as InstallmentAmount,
        s.DebtRequestDate as DebtRequestDate,
        0 as IsGenBarcode
    FROM #Src s;

    /* =========================
       6) UpdateRunning (เก็บเป็น char(6))
       ========================= */
    UPDATE SystemFormatDocumentMaster
    SET UpdateRunning =
        RIGHT(
            '000000' + CAST(@RunningInt + @TotalRow AS varchar(6)),
            6
        )
    WHERE DocumentId = @DocumentId;

    COMMIT TRAN;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_GetAssignTasks]
    @CurrentPage      INT             = 1,
    @PageSize         INT             = 50,
    @Keyword          NVARCHAR(500)   = NULL,
    @SearchTypes      NVARCHAR(MAX)   = NULL,
    @AmountKeyword    NVARCHAR(100)   = NULL,
    @ProvinceIds      NVARCHAR(MAX)   = NULL,
    @DistrictId       INT             = 0,
    @LGNos            NVARCHAR(MAX)   = NULL,
    @StatusCode       NVARCHAR(10)    = NULL,
    @OrgStructureId   INT             = 0,
    @IsManager        TINYINT         = 0,
    @UserId           INT             = 0,
    @OrgSectionId     INT             = 0,
    @IsAdmin          BIT             = 0,
    @TotalCount       INT             = 0 OUTPUT,
    @CountNew         INT             = 0 OUTPUT,
    @CountAssigned    INT             = 0 OUTPUT,
    @CountNotAssigned INT             = 0 OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF @CurrentPage <= 0 SET @CurrentPage = 1;
    IF @PageSize <= 0 SET @PageSize = 50;

    DECLARE @Offset INT = (@CurrentPage - 1) * @PageSize;

    DECLARE @TypeAssignId TINYINT = CASE 
        WHEN @OrgStructureId = 47 THEN 2 
        ELSE 1 
    END;

    DECLARE @AssignStatusId INT = CASE @StatusCode
        WHEN N'01' THEN 131
        WHEN N'02' THEN 132
        WHEN N'03' THEN 133
        ELSE 0
    END;

    DECLARE @Like NVARCHAR(600) = N'%' + ISNULL(@Keyword, N'') + N'%';
    DECLARE @AmountLike NVARCHAR(200) = N'%' + ISNULL(@AmountKeyword, N'') + N'%';

    DECLARE 
        @SrchLGNo       BIT = 0,
        @SrchCIFNo      BIT = 0,
        @SrchDebtorName BIT = 0,
        @SrchIDCard     BIT = 0,
        @SrchDebtorType BIT = 0,
        @SrchDebtorCode BIT = 0,
        @SrchProvince   BIT = 0,
        @SrchDistrict   BIT = 0;

    IF LEN(ISNULL(@Keyword, N'')) > 0
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @ST NVARCHAR(MAX) = LOWER(ISNULL(@SearchTypes, N''));

        SET @SrchLGNo       = CASE WHEN LEN(@ST) = 0 OR CHARINDEX(N'lgno', @ST) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
        SET @SrchCIFNo      = CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(N'cifno', @ST) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
        SET @SrchDebtorName = CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(N'debtorname', @ST) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
        SET @SrchIDCard     = CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(N'idcard', @ST) > 0 OR CHARINDEX(N'debtorcardcode', @ST) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
        SET @SrchDebtorType = CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(N'debtortypename', @ST) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
        SET @SrchDebtorCode = CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(N'debtorcode', @ST) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
        SET @SrchProvince   = CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(N'provincename', @ST) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
        SET @SrchDistrict   = CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(N'districtname', @ST) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
    END;

    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #BaseData;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #WorkData;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #FilteredNoStatus;

    -- ============================================================
    -- Step 1: Base data
    -- ยังไม่ทำ ROW_NUMBER ในชั้นนี้
    -- ============================================================
    ;WITH LatestStatus AS (
    SELECT
        s.DebtorRelateId,
        s.StatusPortId,
        s.StatusTrackingId,
        s.StatusCollectorId,
        s.StatusTrackingDate,
        s.StatusSubTrackingId,
        s.StatusAssignId,
        s.DebtorStatusUpdateId,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY s.DebtorRelateId
            ORDER BY
                s.StatusTrackingDate DESC,
                s.DebtorStatusUpdateId DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM dbo.DataDebtorStatusUpdate s WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE s.DebtorTypeId = 1
)
    SELECT
        dr.DebtorRelateId,
        lg.LGNo,
        a.UpdateDate,

        ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), a.AssignmentId), N'') AS AssignmentId,
        ISNULL(d.DebtorId, N'') AS DebtorId,
        ISNULL(dr.CIFNo, N'') AS CIFNo,
        ISNULL(d.DebtorCode, N'') AS DebtorCode,
        ISNULL(dc.DebtorCardCode, N'') AS IDCard,

        sdu.StatusAssignId,
        ISNULL(sm_assign.StatusCode, N'') AS SystemStatusCode,
        ISNULL(sm_assign.StatusName, N'') AS SystemStatusName,

        ISNULL(td.TitleShortName, N'') AS DebtorTitleName,
        ISNULL(d.FirstName, N'') AS DebtorFirstName,
        ISNULL(d.LastName, N'') AS DebtorLastName,

        CASE
            WHEN d.PersonGroupId = 118
                THEN ISNULL(d.DebtorName, N'')
            ELSE LTRIM(RTRIM(
                    ISNULL(td.TitleShortName, N'') + N' ' +
                    ISNULL(d.FirstName, N'') + N' ' +
                    ISNULL(d.LastName, N'')
                 ))
        END AS DebtorName,

        ISNULL(dty.DebtorTypeName, N'') AS DebtorTypeName,
        dr.DebtorTypeId,

        CASE 
            WHEN @OrgStructureId = 47 THEN a.CollectorOAUserId
            ELSE a.CollectorUserId
        END AS CollectorUserId,

        ISNULL(p.OrgSectionId, 0) AS CollectorOrgSectionId,
        ISNULL(p.OrgStructureId, 0) AS CollectorOrgStructureId,

        ISNULL(tc.TitleShortName, N'') AS CollectorTitle,
        ISNULL(p.FirstName, N'') AS CollectorFirst,
        ISNULL(p.LastName, N'') AS CollectorLast,

        RTRIM(LTRIM(
            ISNULL(tc.TitleShortName, N'') + N' ' +
            ISNULL(p.FirstName, N'') + N' ' +
            ISNULL(p.LastName, N'')
        )) AS CollectorName,

        ISNULL(addr.ProvinceId, 0) AS ProvinceId,
        ISNULL(prov.[Name], N'') AS ProvinceName,
        ISNULL(addr.DistrictId, 0) AS DistrictId,
        ISNULL(dist.[Name], N'') AS DistrictName,

        ISNULL(dc.ClaimPay, 0) AS ClaimPay,
        dc.ClaimPayDate,

        ISNULL(lg.Grade, N'') AS DebtorGrade,
        a.Remark,

        sdu.StatusPortId AS PortId,
        ISNULL(sm_port.StatusCode, N'') AS PortCode,
        ISNULL(sm_port.StatusName, N'') AS PortName

    INTO #BaseData
    FROM dbo.DataAssignment a WITH (NOLOCK)

    INNER JOIN dbo.DataDebtorRelate dr WITH (NOLOCK)
        ON a.DebtorRelateId = dr.DebtorRelateId
       AND dr.DebtorTypeId = 1

    INNER JOIN dbo.DataLG lg WITH (NOLOCK)
        ON dr.LGNo = lg.LGNo
       AND lg.Grade = 'F1'

    INNER JOIN dbo.DataDebtor d WITH (NOLOCK)
        ON dr.DebtorId = d.DebtorId

    INNER JOIN dbo.DataDebtorAddress addr WITH (NOLOCK)
        ON d.DebtorId = addr.DebtorId
       AND addr.DebtorAddressTypeId = 7

   INNER JOIN LatestStatus sdu
    ON dr.DebtorRelateId = sdu.DebtorRelateId
   AND sdu.rn = 1

    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemStatusMaster sm_port WITH (NOLOCK)
        ON sdu.StatusPortId = sm_port.SystemStatusId

    INNER JOIN dbo.DataPersonalInfo p WITH (NOLOCK)
        ON p.UserId = CASE 
            WHEN @OrgStructureId = 47 THEN a.CollectorOAUserId
            ELSE a.CollectorUserId
        END

    INNER JOIN dbo.SystemTitleMaster tc WITH (NOLOCK)
        ON p.TitleId = tc.TitleId

    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemTitleMaster td WITH (NOLOCK)
        ON d.TitleId = td.TitleId

    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemLookupMaster lm WITH (NOLOCK)
        ON d.StatusPersonId = lm.LookupId

    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemDebtorType dty WITH (NOLOCK)
        ON dr.DebtorTypeId = dty.DebtorTypeId

    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1
            c.DebtorCardCode,
            c.ClaimPay,
            c.ClaimPayDate
        FROM dbo.DataDebtorCard c WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE c.DebtorRelateId = dr.DebtorRelateId
        ORDER BY
            c.ClaimPayDate DESC,
            c.DataDebtorCardId DESC
    ) dc

    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemProvinceMaster prov WITH (NOLOCK)
        ON addr.ProvinceId = prov.ProvinceId

    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemDistrictMaster dist WITH (NOLOCK)
        ON addr.DistrictId = dist.DistrictId

    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemStatusMaster sm_assign WITH (NOLOCK)
        ON sdu.StatusAssignId = sm_assign.SystemStatusId

    WHERE lg.Grade = 'F1'
      AND dr.DebtorTypeId = 1
      AND a.TypeAssignId = @TypeAssignId
      AND CASE 
            WHEN @OrgStructureId = 47 THEN ISNULL(a.CollectorOAUserId, 0)
            ELSE ISNULL(a.CollectorUserId, 0)
          END > 0
      AND (
            @IsAdmin = 1
         OR @IsManager = 2
         OR (
                @IsManager = 1
            AND ISNULL(p.OrgSectionId, 0) = @OrgSectionId
         )
         OR (
                @IsManager = 0
            AND CASE 
                    WHEN @OrgStructureId = 47 THEN a.CollectorOAUserId
                    ELSE a.CollectorUserId
                END = @UserId
         )
      )
    OPTION (RECOMPILE);

    CREATE INDEX IX_BD_LGNo ON #BaseData(LGNo);
    CREATE INDEX IX_BD_Status ON #BaseData(StatusAssignId);
    CREATE INDEX IX_BD_ClaimPayDate ON #BaseData(ClaimPayDate);
    CREATE INDEX IX_BD_Province ON #BaseData(ProvinceId, DistrictId);

    -- ============================================================
    -- Step 1.5: WorkData = 1 LGNo = 1 งาน
    -- จุดนี้เป็นจุดเดียวที่ dedup ด้วย ROW_NUMBER
    -- ============================================================
    SELECT *
    INTO #WorkData
    FROM (
        SELECT
            b.*,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY b.LGNo
                ORDER BY
                    ISNULL(b.ClaimPayDate, '19000101') DESC,
                    ISNULL(b.UpdateDate, '19000101') DESC,
                    b.AssignmentId DESC,
                    b.DebtorRelateId ASC
            ) AS rn_lg
        FROM #BaseData b
    ) x
    WHERE x.rn_lg = 1;

    CREATE INDEX IX_WD_Status ON #WorkData(StatusAssignId);
    CREATE INDEX IX_WD_ClaimPayDate ON #WorkData(ClaimPayDate);
    CREATE INDEX IX_WD_Province ON #WorkData(ProvinceId, DistrictId);
    CREATE INDEX IX_WD_LGNo ON #WorkData(LGNo);

    -- ============================================================
    -- Step 1.6: Filter กลาง ยกเว้น StatusCode
    -- CountNew / Assigned / NotAssigned นับจากตัวนี้
    -- ============================================================
    SELECT *
    INTO #FilteredNoStatus
    FROM #WorkData b
    WHERE  (
              @ProvinceIds IS NULL
             OR LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(@ProvinceIds))) = 0

             -- ถ้ามีหลายจังหวัด เช่น '10,73,12,13,11,74'
             -- ให้ไม่กรองจังหวัด
             OR CHARINDEX(',', @ProvinceIds) > 0

             -- กรองเฉพาะกรณีส่งมาเป็นเลขจังหวัดเดียว เช่น '10'
             OR b.ProvinceId = TRY_CAST(@ProvinceIds AS INT)
        )
      AND (
            ISNULL(@DistrictId, 0) = 0
         OR b.DistrictId = @DistrictId
      )
      AND (
            @LGNos IS NULL
         OR LEN(@LGNos) = 0
         OR b.LGNo IN (
                SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(value))
                FROM STRING_SPLIT(@LGNos, ',')
                WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(value)) <> ''
            )
      )
      AND (
            LEN(ISNULL(@AmountKeyword, N'')) = 0
         OR CONVERT(NVARCHAR(100), b.ClaimPay) LIKE @AmountLike
      )
      AND (
            LEN(ISNULL(@Keyword, N'')) = 0
         OR (@SrchLGNo = 1 AND b.LGNo LIKE @Like)
         OR (@SrchCIFNo = 1 AND b.CIFNo LIKE @Like)
         OR (@SrchDebtorName = 1 AND (
                b.DebtorName LIKE @Like
             OR LTRIM(RTRIM(b.DebtorFirstName + N' ' + b.DebtorLastName)) LIKE @Like
             OR LTRIM(RTRIM(b.DebtorTitleName + b.DebtorFirstName + N' ' + b.DebtorLastName)) LIKE @Like
            ))
         OR (@SrchIDCard = 1 AND b.IDCard LIKE @Like)
         OR (@SrchDebtorType = 1 AND b.DebtorTypeName LIKE @Like)
         OR (@SrchDebtorCode = 1 AND b.DebtorCode LIKE @Like)
         OR (@SrchProvince = 1 AND b.ProvinceName LIKE @Like)
         OR (@SrchDistrict = 1 AND b.DistrictName LIKE @Like)
      );

    CREATE INDEX IX_FNS_Status ON #FilteredNoStatus(StatusAssignId);
    CREATE INDEX IX_FNS_Date ON #FilteredNoStatus(ClaimPayDate);
    CREATE INDEX IX_FNS_LGNo ON #FilteredNoStatus(LGNo);

    -- ============================================================
    -- Step 2: Count ตาม status จากฐานเดียวกับหน้ารายการ
    -- ============================================================
    SELECT
        @CountNew = SUM(CASE WHEN StatusAssignId = 131 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
        @CountAssigned = SUM(CASE WHEN StatusAssignId = 132 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
        @CountNotAssigned = SUM(CASE WHEN StatusAssignId = 133 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    FROM #WorkData;

    SET @CountNew = ISNULL(@CountNew, 0);
    SET @CountAssigned = ISNULL(@CountAssigned, 0);
    SET @CountNotAssigned = ISNULL(@CountNotAssigned, 0);

    -- ============================================================
    -- Step 3: TotalCount ตาม StatusCode ที่เลือก
    -- ============================================================
    SELECT @TotalCount = COUNT(1)
    FROM #FilteredNoStatus b
    WHERE (@AssignStatusId = 0 OR b.StatusAssignId = @AssignStatusId);

    SET @TotalCount = ISNULL(@TotalCount, 0);

    -- ============================================================
    -- Step 4: Page result
    -- ============================================================
    SELECT
        b.DebtorRelateId,
        b.LGNo,
        b.UpdateDate,

        b.AssignmentId,
        b.DebtorId,
        b.CIFNo,
        b.DebtorCode,
        b.IDCard,

        b.StatusAssignId,
        b.SystemStatusCode,
        b.SystemStatusName,

        b.DebtorTitleName,
        b.DebtorFirstName,
        b.DebtorLastName,
        b.DebtorTypeName,
        b.DebtorTypeId,

        b.CollectorUserId,
        b.CollectorOrgSectionId,
        b.CollectorTitle,
        b.CollectorFirst,
        b.CollectorLast,

        b.ProvinceId,
        b.ProvinceName,
        b.DistrictId,
        b.DistrictName,

        b.ClaimPay,
        b.ClaimPayDate,

        b.DebtorGrade,
        b.Remark
    FROM #FilteredNoStatus b
    WHERE (@AssignStatusId = 0 OR b.StatusAssignId = @AssignStatusId)
    ORDER BY
        ISNULL(b.ClaimPayDate, '19000101') DESC,
        ISNULL(b.UpdateDate, '19000101') DESC,
        b.LGNo
    OFFSET @Offset ROWS FETCH NEXT @PageSize ROWS ONLY;

    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #FilteredNoStatus;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #WorkData;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #BaseData;
END;

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.SP_GetCommissionByReceiptIds
(
    @ReceiptIds NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL
)
AS
BEGIN

    SET NOCOUNT ON;


    /* ============================================================
       Receipt Filter
       ============================================================ */

    DECLARE @HasReceiptFilter BIT =
        CASE
            WHEN @ReceiptIds IS NULL
              OR LTRIM(RTRIM(@ReceiptIds)) = ''
              OR LTRIM(RTRIM(@ReceiptIds)) = '[]'
            THEN 0
            ELSE 1
        END;


    ;WITH ReceiptFilter AS
    (
        SELECT
            LTRIM(RTRIM([value])) AS ReceiptId

        FROM OPENJSON
        (
            CASE
                WHEN @HasReceiptFilter = 1
                    THEN @ReceiptIds
                ELSE N'[]'
            END
        )
    ),


    /* ============================================================
       Commission Configuration
       ============================================================ */

    CommissionConfig AS
    (
        SELECT
            map.CommissionOAMappingId,
            map.CommissionOAId,
            map.OAGroupId,

            com.CommissionOAName AS OAGroupName,

            TRY_CAST
            (
                condition.ParameterValue
                AS DECIMAL(18,2)
            ) AS ParameterValue,

            lookup.LookupValue,

            com_d.StartAmount,
            com_d.EndAmount,
            com_d.[Percent]

        FROM dbo.SystemCommissionOAMappingMaster map

        INNER JOIN dbo.SystemCommissionOAMaster com
            ON map.CommissionOAId = com.CommissionOAId

        INNER JOIN dbo.SystemCommissionOADetailMaster com_d
            ON com.CommissionOAId = com_d.CommissionOAId

        INNER JOIN dbo.SystemOAGroupMaster oa
            ON map.OAGroupId = oa.OAGroupId

        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemConditionCommissionOAMaster condition
            ON map.CommissionOAId = condition.ConditionCommissionOAId

        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemLookupMaster lookup
            ON condition.OperatorsId = lookup.LookupId

        WHERE
            com.IsActive = 1
    ),


    /* ============================================================
       Commission Percent แรกของแต่ละกลุ่ม

       ตัวอย่าง
       StartAmount   EndAmount    Percent
       0             10000        10
       10000         30000        15
       30000         NULL         20

       จะเลือก 10
       ============================================================ */

    CommissionPercentSource AS
    (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            CommissionOAId,
            OAGroupId,
            StartAmount,
            EndAmount,
            [Percent]

        FROM CommissionConfig
    ),


    CommissionPercentRank AS
    (
        SELECT
            CommissionOAId,
            OAGroupId,

            StartAmount,
            EndAmount,
            [Percent],

            ROW_NUMBER() OVER
            (
                PARTITION BY
                    CommissionOAId,
                    OAGroupId

                ORDER BY
                    ISNULL(StartAmount, 0),
                    CASE
                        WHEN EndAmount IS NULL THEN 1
                        ELSE 0
                    END,
                    EndAmount
            ) AS RowNo

        FROM CommissionPercentSource
    ),


    FirstCommissionPercent AS
    (
        SELECT
            CommissionOAId,
            OAGroupId,

            CAST(
                ISNULL([Percent], 0)
                AS DECIMAL(18,4)
            ) AS CommissionPercent

        FROM CommissionPercentRank

        WHERE RowNo = 1
    ),


    /* ============================================================
       Base Receipt
       ============================================================ */

    BaseData AS
    (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            a.ReceiptId,
            a.ReceiptNo,
            a.ReceiptNoOld,

            a.CreateDate AS ACCReceiptDate,
            a.ReceiptDate,

            a.PaymentAmount,

            a.DebtorRelateId,

            b.CIFNo,
            b.LGNo,

            c.PrincipalTotal,
            c.DebtorCardName,

            d.UserId AS CollectorOAUserId,
            d.OrgStructureId,
            d.OrgSectionId,

            f.SectionNameTH,


            /* Inform Payment */
            es.Reference1,
            es.Reference2,

            channel.LookupValue AS Channel,


            /* Collector OA */
            LTRIM
            (
                RTRIM
                (
                    ISNULL(t.TitleShortName, N'')
                    + N' '
                    + ISNULL(d.FirstName, N'')
                    + N' '
                    + ISNULL(d.LastName, N'')
                )
            ) AS CollectorOAName


        FROM dbo.ACCDataReceipt a


        INNER JOIN dbo.DEBDataAssignOA b
            ON a.DebtorRelateId = b.DebtorRelateId


        INNER JOIN dbo.DataDebtorCard c
            ON a.DebtorRelateId = c.DebtorRelateId


        INNER JOIN dbo.DataPersonalInfo d
            ON b.CollectorOAUserId = d.UserId


        INNER JOIN dbo.SystemOrgSectionMaster f
            ON d.OrgSectionId = f.OrgSectionId


        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemTitleMaster t
            ON d.TitleId = t.TitleId


        /* Reference1 / Reference2 */
        LEFT JOIN dbo.ACCDataInformPayment ip
            ON a.DebtorRelateId = ip.DebtorRelateId


        LEFT JOIN dbo.DataEStatement es
            ON a.ReceiptId = es.ReceiptId


        /* Channel */
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemLookupMaster channel
            ON ip.ChannelPaymentId = channel.LookupId


        WHERE
            @HasReceiptFilter = 0

            OR EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1

                FROM ReceiptFilter rf

                WHERE
                    CAST(
                        a.ReceiptId
                        AS NVARCHAR(100)
                    ) = rf.ReceiptId
            )
    ),


    /* ============================================================
       LG Summary
       ============================================================ */

    LGSummary AS
    (
        SELECT
            SectionNameTH,
            LGNo,

            MAX(
                ISNULL(PrincipalTotal, 0)
            ) AS PrincipalTotal,

            SUM(
                ISNULL(PaymentAmount, 0)
            ) AS PaymentAmount

        FROM BaseData

        GROUP BY
            SectionNameTH,
            LGNo
    ),


    /* ============================================================
       LG Commission Group
       ============================================================ */

    LGCommissionGroup AS
    (
        SELECT
            l.SectionNameTH,
            l.LGNo,
            l.PrincipalTotal,
            l.PaymentAmount,

            c.CommissionOAId,
            c.OAGroupId,
            c.OAGroupName,

            c.ParameterValue,
            c.LookupValue

        FROM LGSummary l

        INNER JOIN
        (
            SELECT DISTINCT
                CommissionOAId,
                OAGroupId,
                OAGroupName,
                ParameterValue,
                LookupValue

            FROM CommissionConfig
        ) c
            ON
            (
                   (
                        c.LookupValue = '<='
                        AND l.PrincipalTotal <= c.ParameterValue
                   )

                OR (
                        c.LookupValue = '<'
                        AND l.PrincipalTotal < c.ParameterValue
                   )

                OR (
                        c.LookupValue = '>='
                        AND l.PrincipalTotal >= c.ParameterValue
                   )

                OR (
                        c.LookupValue = '>'
                        AND l.PrincipalTotal > c.ParameterValue
                   )

                OR (
                        c.LookupValue = '='
                        AND l.PrincipalTotal = c.ParameterValue
                   )
            )
    ),


    /* ============================================================
       Section Summary
       ============================================================ */

    SectionSummary AS
    (
        SELECT
            SectionNameTH,

            CommissionOAId,
            OAGroupId,
            OAGroupName,

            ParameterValue,
            LookupValue,

            SUM(PaymentAmount) AS PaymentAmount

        FROM LGCommissionGroup

        GROUP BY
            SectionNameTH,
            CommissionOAId,
            OAGroupId,
            OAGroupName,
            ParameterValue,
            LookupValue
    ),


    /* ============================================================
       Progressive Commission
       ============================================================ */

    CommissionCalculate AS
    (
        SELECT
            s.SectionNameTH,

            s.CommissionOAId,
            s.OAGroupId,
            s.OAGroupName,

            s.ParameterValue,
            s.LookupValue,

            s.PaymentAmount,

            config.StartAmount,
            config.EndAmount,
            config.[Percent],

            CASE
                WHEN s.PaymentAmount <= ISNULL(config.StartAmount, 0)
                    THEN 0

                WHEN config.EndAmount IS NULL
                    THEN
                        s.PaymentAmount
                        - ISNULL(config.StartAmount, 0)

                WHEN s.PaymentAmount > config.EndAmount
                    THEN
                        config.EndAmount
                        - ISNULL(config.StartAmount, 0)

                ELSE
                    s.PaymentAmount
                    - ISNULL(config.StartAmount, 0)

            END AS AmountInRange

        FROM SectionSummary s

        INNER JOIN CommissionConfig config
            ON s.CommissionOAId = config.CommissionOAId
           AND s.OAGroupId = config.OAGroupId
    ),


    /* ============================================================
       Commission Result

       CommissionAmount
       = ยังคำนวณ Progressive ตามเดิม

       CommissionPercent
       = เอา Percent Tier แรกตรง ๆ
       ============================================================ */

    CommissionResult AS
    (
        SELECT
            cc.SectionNameTH,

            cc.CommissionOAId,
            cc.OAGroupId,
            cc.OAGroupName,

            MAX(cc.PaymentAmount) AS GroupPaymentAmount,


            /* Progressive Commission Amount */
            SUM
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN cc.AmountInRange > 0
                        THEN
                            cc.AmountInRange
                            * (cc.[Percent] / 100.0)

                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) AS CommissionAmount,


            /* Percent แรกตรง ๆ */
            MAX(
                ISNULL(fp.CommissionPercent, 0)
            ) AS CommissionPercent


        FROM CommissionCalculate cc


        LEFT JOIN FirstCommissionPercent fp
            ON cc.CommissionOAId = fp.CommissionOAId
           AND cc.OAGroupId = fp.OAGroupId


        GROUP BY
            cc.SectionNameTH,
            cc.CommissionOAId,
            cc.OAGroupId,
            cc.OAGroupName
    ),


    /* ============================================================
       Receipt Group
       ============================================================ */

    ReceiptGroup AS
    (
        SELECT
            b.ReceiptId,
            b.ReceiptNo,
            b.ReceiptNoOld,

            b.ACCReceiptDate,
            b.ReceiptDate,

            b.CIFNo,
            b.LGNo,

            b.DebtorCardName,

            b.PaymentAmount,

            b.Reference1,
            b.Reference2,
            b.Channel,

            b.SectionNameTH,
            b.CollectorOAUserId,
            b.CollectorOAName,

            lg.CommissionOAId,
            lg.OAGroupId,
            lg.OAGroupName

        FROM BaseData b

        INNER JOIN LGCommissionGroup lg
            ON b.SectionNameTH = lg.SectionNameTH
           AND b.LGNo = lg.LGNo
    ),


    /* ============================================================
       Receipt Commission
       ============================================================ */

    ReceiptCommission AS
    (
        SELECT
            r.*,

            cr.GroupPaymentAmount,

            cr.CommissionAmount
                AS GroupCommissionAmount,


            /* ====================================================
               Commission ของ Receipt

               ยังคงเฉลี่ยตามสัดส่วนยอด Receipt เหมือนเดิม
               ==================================================== */

            CAST
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN ISNULL(cr.GroupPaymentAmount, 0) > 0
                    THEN
                        (
                            ISNULL(r.PaymentAmount, 0)
                            / cr.GroupPaymentAmount
                        )
                        * cr.CommissionAmount

                    ELSE 0
                END

                AS DECIMAL(18,2)

            ) AS ReceiptCommissionAmount,


            /* ====================================================
               ไม่คำนวณ Average Percent แล้ว

               เอา Percent Tier แรกตรง ๆ
               ==================================================== */

            CAST
            (
                ISNULL(cr.CommissionPercent, 0)
                AS DECIMAL(18,4)

            ) AS CommissionPercent


        FROM ReceiptGroup r


        INNER JOIN CommissionResult cr
            ON r.SectionNameTH = cr.SectionNameTH
           AND r.CommissionOAId = cr.CommissionOAId
           AND r.OAGroupId = cr.OAGroupId
    )


    /* ============================================================
       FINAL RESULT
       ============================================================ */

    SELECT
        ReceiptId,


        CONVERT(
            VARCHAR(10),
            ACCReceiptDate,
            103
        ) AS ACCReceiptDate,


        ISNULL(
            ReceiptNo,
            N''
        ) AS ReceiptNo,


        ReceiptNoOld AS ReceiptNoOld,


        ISNULL(
            CIFNo,
            N''
        ) AS CIFNo,


        ISNULL(
            LGNo,
            N''
        ) AS LGNo,


        ISNULL(
            DebtorCardName,
            N''
        ) AS DebtorCardName,


        CONVERT(
            VARCHAR(10),
            ReceiptDate,
            103
        ) AS ReceiptDate,


        CAST(
            ISNULL(PaymentAmount, 0)
            AS DECIMAL(18,2)
        ) AS PaymentAmount,


        ISNULL(
            Reference1,
            N''
        ) AS Reference1,


        ISNULL(
            Reference2,
            N''
        ) AS Reference2,


        ISNULL(
            CollectorOAName,
            N''
        ) AS CollectorOAName,


        ISNULL(
            Channel,
            N''
        ) AS Channel,


        ISNULL(
            OAGroupName,
            N''
        ) AS OAGroupName,


        /* % ค่าคอม Tier แรก */
        CAST(
            ISNULL(CommissionPercent, 0)
            AS DECIMAL(18,4)
        ) AS CommissionPercent,


        /* จำนวนเงินค่าคอม */
        CAST(
            ISNULL(ReceiptCommissionAmount, 0)
            AS DECIMAL(18,2)
        ) AS CommissionAmount,


        N'' AS Remark


    FROM ReceiptCommission


    ORDER BY
        ReceiptDate,
        ReceiptNo;

END;
