CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_GetTrackingStatusCollectorPage]
    @CurrentPage      INT,
    @PageSize         INT,
    @SearchTypesCsv   NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,
    @Keyword          NVARCHAR(200) = NULL,
    @StartDate        DATETIME      = NULL,
    @EndDate          DATETIME      = NULL,
    @IsManager        INT           = NULL,   -- NULL=admin, 0=staff, 1=manager
    @UserId           INT           = NULL,
    @OrgSectionId     INT           = NULL,   -- ไม่ใช้แล้ว เก็บไว้กัน API เดิมพัง
    @OrgStructureId   INT           = NULL,
    @UserIdListCsv    NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,
    @Port             INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @Skip INT = CASE 
                            WHEN @CurrentPage > 1 
                            THEN (@CurrentPage - 1) * @PageSize 
                            ELSE 0 
                        END;

    DECLARE @Take INT = CASE 
                            WHEN @PageSize > 0 
                            THEN @PageSize 
                            ELSE 10 
                        END;

    DECLARE @kw NVARCHAR(400) = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Keyword)), '');

    IF @kw IS NOT NULL 
        SET @kw = N'%' + @kw + N'%';

    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #ranked;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #rankedNoPort;

    /* ─── SearchType flags ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
    DECLARE @has_dataDebtorRelateId BIT = CASE 
        WHEN @SearchTypesCsv IS NULL THEN 0 
        ELSE CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM STRING_SPLIT(@SearchTypesCsv, ',') 
            WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(value)) = 'dataDebtorRelateId'
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END 
    END;

    DECLARE @has_cifNo BIT = CASE 
        WHEN @SearchTypesCsv IS NULL THEN 0 
        ELSE CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM STRING_SPLIT(@SearchTypesCsv, ',') 
            WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(value)) = 'cifNo'
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END 
    END;

    DECLARE @has_lgNo BIT = CASE 
        WHEN @SearchTypesCsv IS NULL THEN 0 
        ELSE CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM STRING_SPLIT(@SearchTypesCsv, ',') 
            WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(value)) = 'lgNo'
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END 
    END;

    DECLARE @has_debtorCardCode BIT = CASE 
        WHEN @SearchTypesCsv IS NULL THEN 0 
        ELSE CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM STRING_SPLIT(@SearchTypesCsv, ',') 
            WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(value)) = 'debtorCardCode'
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END 
    END;

    DECLARE @has_debtorCode BIT = CASE 
        WHEN @SearchTypesCsv IS NULL THEN 0 
        ELSE CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM STRING_SPLIT(@SearchTypesCsv, ',') 
            WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(value)) = 'debtorCode'
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END 
    END;

    DECLARE @has_debtorName BIT = CASE 
        WHEN @SearchTypesCsv IS NULL THEN 0 
        ELSE CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM STRING_SPLIT(@SearchTypesCsv, ',') 
            WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(value)) = 'debtorName'
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END 
    END;

    DECLARE @has_ClaimPay BIT = CASE 
        WHEN @SearchTypesCsv IS NULL THEN 0 
        ELSE CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM STRING_SPLIT(@SearchTypesCsv, ',') 
            WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(value)) = 'ClaimPay'
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END 
    END;

    DECLARE @has_collectorName BIT = CASE 
        WHEN @SearchTypesCsv IS NULL THEN 0 
        ELSE CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM STRING_SPLIT(@SearchTypesCsv, ',') 
            WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(value)) = 'collectorName'
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END 
    END;

    DECLARE @has_provinceName BIT = CASE 
        WHEN @SearchTypesCsv IS NULL THEN 0 
        ELSE CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM STRING_SPLIT(@SearchTypesCsv, ',') 
            WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(value)) = 'provinceName'
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END 
    END;

    DECLARE @has_personGroupValue BIT = CASE 
        WHEN @SearchTypesCsv IS NULL THEN 0 
        ELSE CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM STRING_SPLIT(@SearchTypesCsv, ',') 
            WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(value)) = 'personGroupValueLookup'
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END 
    END;

    DECLARE @has_systemStatusName BIT = CASE 
        WHEN @SearchTypesCsv IS NULL THEN 0 
        ELSE CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM STRING_SPLIT(@SearchTypesCsv, ',') 
            WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(value)) = 'systemStatusName'
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END 
    END;

    DECLARE @has_otherSearch BIT = CASE
        WHEN (
                @has_dataDebtorRelateId = 1
             OR @has_cifNo = 1
             OR @has_lgNo = 1
             OR @has_debtorCardCode = 1
             OR @has_debtorCode = 1
             OR @has_debtorName = 1
             OR @has_ClaimPay = 1
             OR @has_provinceName = 1
             OR @has_personGroupValue = 1
             OR @has_systemStatusName = 1
        )
        THEN 1 
        ELSE 0 
    END;

    ;WITH
    latest_status AS (
        SELECT
            s.DebtorRelateId,
            s.StatusPortId,
            s.StatusTrackingId,
            s.StatusCollectorId,
            s.StatusTrackingDate,
            s.StatusSubTrackingId,
            s.StatusAssignId,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY s.DebtorRelateId
                ORDER BY s.StatusTrackingDate DESC, s.DebtorStatusUpdateId DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM dbo.DataDebtorStatusUpdate s
        WHERE s.DebtorTypeId = 1
    ),
    latest_card AS (
        SELECT
            c.DebtorRelateId,
            c.DebtorCardCode,
            c.ClaimPay,
            c.ClaimPayDate,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY c.DebtorRelateId
                ORDER BY c.ClaimPayDate DESC, c.DataDebtorCardId DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM dbo.DataDebtorCard c
    ),
    eligible AS (
        SELECT
            r.DebtorRelateId,
            r.LGNo,
            r.CIFNo,

            a.AssignmentId,

            -- คนดูแลลูกหนี้ ยึดจาก DataAssignment
            a.CollectorOAUserId,

            d.DebtorId,
            d.DebtorCode,
            d.TitleId,
            d.FirstName,
            d.LastName,
            d.StatusPersonId,

            r.DebtorTypeId,

            addr.ProvinceId,
            addr.DistrictId,

            -- ตัด SystemResponsibleAreaMaster ออกแล้ว
            CAST(NULL AS INT) AS OrgSectionId,

            t.SystemStatusId
        FROM dbo.DataDebtorTransactionStatus t

        INNER JOIN dbo.DataDebtorRelate r
            ON t.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId

        INNER JOIN dbo.DataLG lg
            ON r.LGNo = lg.LGNo

        INNER JOIN dbo.DataDebtor d
            ON r.DebtorId = d.DebtorId

        INNER JOIN dbo.DataAssignment a
            ON r.DebtorRelateId = a.DebtorRelateId

        INNER JOIN dbo.DataDebtorAddress addr
            ON addr.DebtorId = d.DebtorId
           AND addr.DebtorAddressTypeId = 7

        WHERE t.IsDefault = 1
          AND t.GroupStatusId = 15
          AND t.SystemStatusId <> 184
          AND lg.Grade = 'F1'
          AND r.DebtorTypeId = 1
          AND a.TypeAssignId = 2
          AND a.CollectorOAUserId > 0
          AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM dbo.DataDebtorStatusUpdate su
                WHERE su.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId
                  AND su.DebtorTypeId = 1
          )
          AND (
                -- Admin เห็นทั้งหมด
                @IsManager IS NULL

                -- Staff เห็นเฉพาะลูกหนี้ที่ตัวเองดูแลใน DataAssignment
             OR (
                    @IsManager = 0 
                AND a.CollectorOAUserId = @UserId
                )

                -- Manager เห็นของตัวเอง + ลูกทีมใน @UserIdListCsv
             OR (
                    @IsManager = 1 
                AND (
                        a.CollectorOAUserId = @UserId
                     OR (
                            @UserIdListCsv IS NOT NULL
                        AND a.CollectorOAUserId IN (
                                SELECT TRY_CAST(value AS INT)
                                FROM STRING_SPLIT(@UserIdListCsv, ',')
                                WHERE TRY_CAST(value AS INT) IS NOT NULL
                            )
                        )
                    )
                )
          )
    ),
    w AS (
        SELECT
            e.*,
            lc.DebtorCardCode,
            lc.ClaimPay,
            lc.ClaimPayDate,
            ls.StatusPortId,
            ls.StatusTrackingId,
            ls.StatusCollectorId,
            ls.StatusTrackingDate,
            ls.StatusAssignId 
        FROM eligible e

        LEFT JOIN latest_card lc
            ON lc.DebtorRelateId = e.DebtorRelateId
           AND lc.rn = 1

        INNER JOIN latest_status ls
            ON ls.DebtorRelateId = e.DebtorRelateId
           AND ls.rn = 1
    ),
    wj AS (
        SELECT
            w.*,

            port.StatusCode AS PortCode,
            port.StatusName AS PortName,
            port.SystemId AS PortId,

            sys.StatusName AS SystemStatusName,
            sys.StatusCode AS SystemStatusCode,

            prov.Name AS ProvinceName,

            dt.DebtorTypeName AS DebtorTypeName,

            tDeb.TitleName AS DebtorTitle,

            LTRIM(RTRIM(CONCAT(
                ISNULL(tCol.TitleName, N''),
                N' ',
                ISNULL(p.FirstName, N''),
                N' ',
                ISNULL(p.LastName, N'')
            ))) AS CollectorName,

            p.OrgStructureId
        FROM w

        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemStatusMaster port
            ON port.SystemStatusId = w.StatusPortId

        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemStatusMaster sys
            ON sys.SystemStatusId = w.StatusAssignId

        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemProvinceMaster prov
            ON prov.ProvinceId = w.ProvinceId

        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemDebtorType dt
            ON dt.DebtorTypeId = w.DebtorTypeId

        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemTitleMaster tDeb
            ON tDeb.TitleId = w.TitleId

        LEFT JOIN dbo.DataPersonalInfo p
            ON p.UserId = w.CollectorOAUserId

        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemTitleMaster tCol
            ON tCol.TitleId = p.TitleId

        WHERE 1 = 1
          AND (
                @StartDate IS NULL 
             OR @EndDate IS NULL 
             OR w.ClaimPayDate BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
          )
    )
    SELECT
        wj.DebtorRelateId,
        wj.CIFNo,
        wj.LGNo,

        wj.DebtorCardCode,
        wj.DebtorCode,
        wj.DebtorId,

        wj.DebtorTitle,
        wj.FirstName AS DebtorFirstName,
        wj.LastName AS DebtorLastName,

        wj.StatusPersonId AS PersonGroupId,
        wj.DebtorTypeName AS PersonGroupValueLookup,

        wj.ClaimPay,
        wj.ClaimPayDate,

        -- คนดูแลจาก DataAssignment
        wj.CollectorOAUserId AS CollectorId,

        -- ไม่มี SystemResponsibleAreaMaster แล้ว
        wj.OrgSectionId,

        wj.OrgStructureId,
        wj.CollectorName,

        wj.ProvinceId,
        wj.ProvinceName,

        wj.SystemStatusId,
        wj.SystemStatusCode,
        wj.SystemStatusName,

        wj.PortCode,
        wj.PortName,
        wj.PortId,
        wj.StatusPortId,
        wj.AssignmentId,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY wj.LGNo
            ORDER BY wj.ClaimPayDate DESC, wj.DebtorRelateId
        ) AS rn_lg
    INTO #rankedNoPort
    FROM wj
    OPTION (RECOMPILE);

    CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_rankedNoPort_order    
        ON #rankedNoPort (rn_lg, ClaimPayDate DESC, DebtorRelateId);

    CREATE INDEX IX_rankedNoPort_port      
        ON #rankedNoPort (StatusPortId, PortCode, PortName);

    CREATE INDEX IX_rankedNoPort_collector 
        ON #rankedNoPort (CollectorId);

    ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- สร้าง #ranked สำหรับ RS1 Page items เท่านั้น
    -- จุดนี้กรอง:
    -- 1) Port
    -- 2) Keyword / SearchType
    -- 3) collectorName
    ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT *
    INTO #ranked
    FROM #rankedNoPort r
    WHERE
        (
               @Port = 0
            OR r.StatusPortId = @Port
        )
        AND (
               @kw IS NULL
            OR @has_otherSearch = 0
            OR (
                   (@has_dataDebtorRelateId = 1 AND CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), r.DebtorRelateId) LIKE @kw)
                OR (@has_cifNo = 1 AND r.CIFNo LIKE @kw)
                OR (@has_lgNo = 1 AND r.LGNo LIKE @kw)
                OR (@has_debtorCardCode = 1 AND r.DebtorCardCode LIKE @kw)
                OR (@has_debtorCode = 1 AND r.DebtorCode LIKE @kw)
                OR (
                        @has_debtorName = 1
                    AND (
                           ISNULL(r.DebtorTitle, N'') LIKE @kw
                        OR ISNULL(r.DebtorFirstName, N'') LIKE @kw
                        OR ISNULL(r.DebtorLastName, N'') LIKE @kw
                    )
                )
                OR (@has_ClaimPay = 1 AND CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), r.ClaimPay) LIKE @kw)
                OR (@has_provinceName = 1 AND r.ProvinceName LIKE @kw)
                OR (@has_personGroupValue = 1 AND r.PersonGroupValueLookup LIKE @kw)
                OR (@has_systemStatusName = 1 AND r.SystemStatusName LIKE @kw)
            )
        )
        AND (
               @has_collectorName = 0
            OR @kw IS NULL
            OR r.CollectorName LIKE @kw
        );

    CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_ranked_order    
        ON #ranked (rn_lg, ClaimPayDate DESC, DebtorRelateId);

    CREATE INDEX IX_ranked_port      
        ON #ranked (StatusPortId, PortCode, PortName);

    CREATE INDEX IX_ranked_collector 
        ON #ranked (CollectorId);

    /* =========================
       RS1) Page items
       โดนกรอง:
       - Port
       - Keyword / SearchType
       - collectorName
       - Date
       - Permission
    ========================= */
    SELECT
        r.DebtorRelateId,
        r.CIFNo,
        r.LGNo,

        r.DebtorCardCode,
        r.DebtorCode,
        r.DebtorId,

        r.DebtorTitle,
        r.DebtorFirstName,
        r.DebtorLastName,

        r.PersonGroupId,
        r.PersonGroupValueLookup,

        r.ClaimPay,
        r.ClaimPayDate,

        r.CollectorId,

        r.OrgSectionId,

        r.OrgStructureId,
        r.CollectorName,

        r.ProvinceId,
        r.ProvinceName,

        r.SystemStatusId,
        r.SystemStatusCode,
        r.SystemStatusName,

        r.StatusPortId AS PortId,
        r.PortCode,
        r.PortName,
        COUNT(*) OVER () AS TotalFiltered
    FROM #ranked r
    WHERE r.rn_lg = 1
    ORDER BY 
        r.ClaimPayDate DESC,
        r.DebtorRelateId
    OFFSET @Skip ROWS 
    FETCH NEXT @Take ROWS ONLY;

    /* =========================
       RS2) AllWork
       ไม่โดน:
       - Port
       - Keyword / SearchType
       - collectorName

       ยังโดน:
       - Date
       - Permission
    ========================= */
    SELECT 
        COUNT(1) AS AllWork
    FROM #rankedNoPort r
    WHERE rn_lg = 1;

    /* =========================
       RS3) Port counts
       ไม่โดน:
       - Port
       - Keyword / SearchType
       - collectorName

       ยังโดน:
       - Date
       - Permission
    ========================= */
    SELECT
        PortCode,
        StatusPortId AS PortId,
        PortName,
        COUNT(*) AS Cnt
    FROM #rankedNoPort r
    WHERE rn_lg = 1
    AND (
               @has_collectorName = 0
            OR @kw IS NULL
            OR r.CollectorName LIKE @kw
        )
    GROUP BY
        PortCode,
        StatusPortId,
        PortName
    ORDER BY
        PortCode;

    /* =========================
       RS4) Assignment per collector / ListWork
       ไม่โดน:
       - Port
       - Keyword / SearchType
       - collectorName

       ยังโดน:
       - Date
       - Permission
    ========================= */
    SELECT
        r.CollectorId,
        MAX(r.CollectorName) AS UserCollectorName,
        COUNT(DISTINCT r.AssignmentId) AS AssignmentCount
    FROM #rankedNoPort r
    WHERE r.rn_lg = 1
    GROUP BY
        r.CollectorId
    ORDER BY
        MAX(r.CollectorName);

    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #ranked;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #rankedNoPort;
END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_GetTrackingStatusCollectorPage_Backup]
    @CurrentPage     int,
    @PageSize        int,
    @SearchTypesCsv  nvarchar(max) = NULL,
    @Keyword         nvarchar(200) = NULL,
    @StartDate       datetime     = NULL,
    @EndDate         datetime     = NULL,
    @IsManager       int          = NULL,   -- NULL/0/1
    @UserId          int          = NULL,
    @OrgSectionId    int          = NULL,
    @OrgStructureId    int          = NULL,
    @UserIdListCsv   nvarchar(max)= NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @Skip int = CASE WHEN @CurrentPage > 1 THEN (@CurrentPage - 1) * @PageSize ELSE 0 END;
    DECLARE @Take int = CASE WHEN @PageSize > 0 THEN @PageSize ELSE 10 END;

    DECLARE @kw nvarchar(400) = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Keyword)), '');
    IF @kw IS NOT NULL SET @kw = N'%' + @kw + N'%';

    -- flags ของ SearchType
    DECLARE @has_dataDebtorRelateId bit = CASE WHEN @SearchTypesCsv IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM STRING_SPLIT(@SearchTypesCsv, ',') WHERE value='dataDebtorRelateId') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END;
    DECLARE @has_cifNo               bit = CASE WHEN @SearchTypesCsv IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM STRING_SPLIT(@SearchTypesCsv, ',') WHERE value='cifNo') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END;
    DECLARE @has_lgNo                bit = CASE WHEN @SearchTypesCsv IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM STRING_SPLIT(@SearchTypesCsv, ',') WHERE value='lgNo') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END;
    DECLARE @has_debtorCardCode      bit = CASE WHEN @SearchTypesCsv IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM STRING_SPLIT(@SearchTypesCsv, ',') WHERE value='debtorCardCode') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END;
    DECLARE @has_debtorCode          bit = CASE WHEN @SearchTypesCsv IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM STRING_SPLIT(@SearchTypesCsv, ',') WHERE value='debtorCode') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END;
    DECLARE @has_debtorName          bit = CASE WHEN @SearchTypesCsv IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM STRING_SPLIT(@SearchTypesCsv, ',') WHERE value='debtorName') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END;
    DECLARE @has_ClaimPay            bit = CASE WHEN @SearchTypesCsv IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM STRING_SPLIT(@SearchTypesCsv, ',') WHERE value='ClaimPay') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END;
    DECLARE @has_collectorName       bit = CASE WHEN @SearchTypesCsv IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM STRING_SPLIT(@SearchTypesCsv, ',') WHERE value='collectorName') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END;
    DECLARE @has_provinceName        bit = CASE WHEN @SearchTypesCsv IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM STRING_SPLIT(@SearchTypesCsv, ',') WHERE value='provinceName') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END;
    DECLARE @has_personGroupValue    bit = CASE WHEN @SearchTypesCsv IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM STRING_SPLIT(@SearchTypesCsv, ',') WHERE value='personGroupValueLookup') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END;
    DECLARE @has_systemStatusName    bit = CASE WHEN @SearchTypesCsv IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM STRING_SPLIT(@SearchTypesCsv, ',') WHERE value='systemStatusName') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END;

    -- ✅ มี search อย่างอื่น (ยกเว้น collectorName) ไหม? (ใช้สำหรับ filter ชุดหลัก)
    DECLARE @has_otherSearch bit = CASE
        WHEN (@has_dataDebtorRelateId=1 OR @has_cifNo=1 OR @has_lgNo=1 OR @has_debtorCardCode=1 OR @has_debtorCode=1 OR
              @has_debtorName=1 OR @has_ClaimPay=1 OR @has_provinceName=1 OR @has_personGroupValue=1 OR @has_systemStatusName=1)
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

    ;WITH
    latest_status AS (
        SELECT
            s.DebtorRelateId,
            s.StatusPortId,
            s.StatusTrackingId,
            s.StatusCollectorId,
            s.StatusTrackingDate,
            s.StatusSubTrackingId,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY s.DebtorRelateId
                ORDER BY s.StatusTrackingDate DESC, s.DebtorStatusUpdateId DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM dbo.DataDebtorStatusUpdate s
        WHERE s.DebtorTypeId = 1
          --AND ISNULL(s.StatusSubTrackingId, 0) <> 0
    ),
    latest_card AS (
        SELECT
            c.DebtorRelateId, c.DebtorCardCode, c.ClaimPay, c.ClaimPayDate,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER(
                PARTITION BY c.DebtorRelateId
                ORDER BY c.ClaimPayDate DESC, c.DataDebtorCardId DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM dbo.DataDebtorCard c
    ),
    eligible AS (
        SELECT
            r.DebtorRelateId,
            r.LGNo,
            r.CIFNo,
            a.AssignmentId,
            a.CollectorOAUserId,
            d.DebtorId,
            d.DebtorCode,
            d.TitleId,
            d.FirstName,
            d.LastName,
            d.StatusPersonId,
            r.DebtorTypeId,
            addr.ProvinceId,
            addr.DistrictId,
            area.OrgSectionId,
            t.SystemStatusId
        FROM dbo.DataDebtorTransactionStatus t
        JOIN dbo.DataDebtorRelate r ON t.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId
        JOIN dbo.DataLG lg          ON r.LGNo = lg.LGNo
        JOIN dbo.DataDebtor d       ON r.DebtorId = d.DebtorId
        JOIN dbo.DataAssignment a   ON r.DebtorRelateId = a.DebtorRelateId
        JOIN dbo.DataDebtorAddress addr
            ON addr.DebtorId = d.DebtorId AND addr.DebtorAddressTypeId = 7
        JOIN dbo.SystemResponsibleAreaMaster area
            ON area.ProvinceId = addr.ProvinceId
        WHERE t.IsDefault = 1
          AND t.GroupStatusId = 15
          AND t.SystemStatusId <> 184
          AND lg.Grade = 'F1'
          AND r.DebtorTypeId = 1
          AND a.TypeAssignId = 2
          AND a.CollectorOAUserId > 0
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.DataDebtorStatusUpdate su
              WHERE su.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId
                AND su.DebtorTypeId = 1
                --AND ISNULL(su.StatusSubTrackingId, 0) <> 0
          )
          AND (
                @IsManager IS NULL
             OR (@IsManager = 0 AND a.CollectorOAUserId = @UserId)
             OR (@IsManager = 1 AND (
                      a.CollectorOAUserId = @UserId
                   OR (@UserIdListCsv IS NOT NULL
                       AND area.OrgSectionId = @OrgSectionId
                       AND a.CollectorOAUserId IN (
                            SELECT TRY_CAST(value AS int)
                            FROM STRING_SPLIT(@UserIdListCsv, ',')
                       ))
                ))
          )
    ),
    w AS (
        SELECT
            e.*,
            lc.DebtorCardCode, lc.ClaimPay, lc.ClaimPayDate,
            ls.StatusPortId, ls.StatusTrackingId, ls.StatusCollectorId, ls.StatusTrackingDate
        FROM eligible e
        LEFT JOIN latest_card lc ON lc.DebtorRelateId = e.DebtorRelateId AND lc.rn = 1
        JOIN latest_status ls ON ls.DebtorRelateId = e.DebtorRelateId AND ls.rn = 1
    ),
    wj AS (
        SELECT
            w.*,
            port.StatusCode  AS PortCode,
            sys.StatusName   AS SystemStatusName,
            sys.StatusCode   AS SystemStatusCode,
            prov.Name        AS ProvinceName,
            dt.DebtorTypeName AS DebtorTypeName,
            tDeb.TitleName   AS DebtorTitle,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(CONCAT(
                ISNULL(tCol.TitleName, N''),
                N' ',
                ISNULL(p.FirstName, N''),
                N' ',
                ISNULL(p.LastName, N'')
            ))) AS CollectorName,p.OrgStructureId
        FROM w
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemStatusMaster port ON port.SystemStatusId = w.StatusPortId
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemStatusMaster sys  ON sys.SystemStatusId  = w.SystemStatusId
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemProvinceMaster prov ON prov.ProvinceId   = w.ProvinceId
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemDebtorType dt ON dt.DebtorTypeId         = w.DebtorTypeId
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemTitleMaster tDeb ON tDeb.TitleId         = w.TitleId
        LEFT JOIN dbo.DataPersonalInfo p ON p.UserId                 = w.CollectorOAUserId
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemTitleMaster tCol ON tCol.TitleId         = p.TitleId
        WHERE 1=1
          AND (@StartDate IS NULL OR @EndDate IS NULL OR (w.ClaimPayDate BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate))

          -- ✅ IMPORTANT: keyword filter ชุดหลัก "ไม่รวม collectorName"
          AND (
                @kw IS NULL
                OR @has_otherSearch = 0
                OR (
                    (@has_dataDebtorRelateId = 1 AND w.DebtorRelateId LIKE @kw) OR
                    (@has_cifNo               = 1 AND w.CIFNo LIKE @kw) OR
                    (@has_lgNo                = 1 AND w.LGNo  LIKE @kw) OR
                    (@has_debtorCardCode      = 1 AND w.DebtorCardCode LIKE @kw) OR
                    (@has_debtorCode          = 1 AND w.DebtorCode LIKE @kw) OR
                    (@has_debtorName          = 1 AND (ISNULL(tDeb.TitleName,N'') LIKE @kw OR ISNULL(w.FirstName,N'') LIKE @kw OR ISNULL(w.LastName,N'') LIKE @kw)) OR
                    (@has_ClaimPay            = 1 AND CONVERT(nvarchar(50), w.ClaimPay) LIKE @kw) OR
                    (@has_provinceName        = 1 AND prov.Name LIKE @kw) OR
                    (@has_personGroupValue    = 1 AND dt.DebtorTypeName LIKE @kw) OR
                    (@has_systemStatusName    = 1 AND sys.StatusName LIKE @kw)
                )
          )
    )
    SELECT
        wj.DebtorRelateId, wj.CIFNo, wj.LGNo,
        wj.DebtorCardCode, wj.DebtorCode, wj.DebtorId,
        wj.DebtorTitle, wj.FirstName AS DebtorFirstName, wj.LastName AS DebtorLastName,
        wj.StatusPersonId AS PersonGroupId,
        wj.DebtorTypeName AS PersonGroupValueLookup,
        wj.ClaimPay, wj.ClaimPayDate,
        wj.CollectorOAUserId AS CollectorId, wj.OrgSectionId,wj.OrgStructureId, wj.CollectorName,
        wj.ProvinceId, wj.ProvinceName,
        wj.SystemStatusId, wj.SystemStatusCode, wj.SystemStatusName,
        wj.PortCode, wj.StatusPortId, wj.AssignmentId,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wj.LGNo ORDER BY wj.ClaimPayDate DESC, wj.DebtorRelateId) AS rn_lg
    INTO #ranked
    FROM wj
    OPTION (RECOMPILE);

    CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_ranked_order    ON #ranked (rn_lg, ClaimPayDate DESC, DebtorRelateId);
    CREATE INDEX          IX_ranked_port      ON #ranked (StatusPortId, PortCode);
    CREATE INDEX          IX_ranked_collector ON #ranked (CollectorId);

    -- =========================
    -- RS1) Page items
    -- ✅ filter collectorName "หลังการนับ allwork" -> เลยกรองเฉพาะ RS1
    -- =========================
    SELECT
        r.DebtorRelateId, r.CIFNo, r.LGNo,
        r.DebtorCardCode, r.DebtorCode, r.DebtorId,
        r.DebtorTitle, r.DebtorFirstName, r.DebtorLastName,
        r.PersonGroupId, r.PersonGroupValueLookup,
        r.ClaimPay, r.ClaimPayDate,
        r.CollectorId, r.OrgSectionId,r.OrgStructureId, r.CollectorName,
        r.ProvinceId, r.ProvinceName,
        r.SystemStatusId, r.SystemStatusCode, r.SystemStatusName
    FROM #ranked r
    WHERE r.rn_lg = 1
      AND (
            @has_collectorName = 0
         OR @kw IS NULL
         OR r.CollectorName LIKE @kw
      ) 
      AND (
                @IsManager IS NULL
             OR (@IsManager = 0 AND r.CollectorId = @UserId)
             OR (@IsManager = 1 AND (
                      r.CollectorId = @UserId
                   OR (@UserIdListCsv IS NOT NULL
                       AND OrgSectionId = @OrgSectionId
                       AND r.CollectorId IN (
                            SELECT TRY_CAST(value AS int)
                            FROM STRING_SPLIT(@UserIdListCsv, ',')
                       ))
                ))
          )
    ORDER BY r.ClaimPayDate DESC, r.DebtorRelateId
    OFFSET @Skip ROWS FETCH NEXT @Take ROWS ONLY;

    -- =========================
    -- RS2) AllWork (ไม่โดน collectorName)
    -- =========================
    SELECT COUNT(1) AS AllWork
    FROM #ranked
    WHERE rn_lg = 1
    AND (
                @IsManager IS NULL
             OR (@IsManager = 0 AND CollectorId = @UserId)
             OR (@IsManager = 1 AND (
                      CollectorId = @UserId
                   OR (@UserIdListCsv IS NOT NULL
                       AND OrgSectionId = @OrgSectionId
                       AND CollectorId IN (
                            SELECT TRY_CAST(value AS int)
                            FROM STRING_SPLIT(@UserIdListCsv, ',')
                       ))
                ))
          )

    -- =========================
    -- RS3) Port counts (ไม่โดน collectorName)
    -- =========================
    SELECT PortCode, StatusPortId AS PortId, COUNT(*) AS Cnt
    FROM #ranked
    WHERE rn_lg = 1
    AND (
                @IsManager IS NULL
             OR (@IsManager = 0 AND CollectorId = @UserId)
             OR (@IsManager = 1 AND (
                      CollectorId = @UserId
                   OR (@UserIdListCsv IS NOT NULL
                       AND OrgSectionId = @OrgSectionId
                       AND CollectorId IN (
                            SELECT TRY_CAST(value AS int)
                            FROM STRING_SPLIT(@UserIdListCsv, ',')
                       ))
                ))
          )
    GROUP BY PortCode, StatusPortId;

    -- =========================
    -- RS4) Assignment per collector (ListWork) (ไม่โดน collectorName)
    -- =========================
    SELECT
        r.CollectorId,
        MAX(r.CollectorName) AS UserCollectorName,
        COUNT(DISTINCT r.AssignmentId) AS AssignmentCount
    FROM #ranked r
    WHERE r.rn_lg = 1
    AND (
                @IsManager IS NULL
             OR (@IsManager = 0 AND CollectorId = @UserId)
             OR (@IsManager = 1 AND (
                      CollectorId = @UserId
                   OR (@UserIdListCsv IS NOT NULL
                       AND OrgSectionId = @OrgSectionId
                       AND CollectorId IN (
                            SELECT TRY_CAST(value AS int)
                            FROM STRING_SPLIT(@UserIdListCsv, ',')
                       ))
                ))
          )
    GROUP BY r.CollectorId;

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_GetTrackingStatusCollectorPageNonOA]
    @CurrentPage    INT            = 1,
    @PageSize       INT            = 50,
    @SearchTypesCsv NVARCHAR(500)  = NULL,
    @Keyword        NVARCHAR(200)  = NULL,
    @StartDate      DATETIME       = NULL,
    @EndDate        DATETIME       = NULL,
    @IsManager      INT            = NULL,   -- NULL=admin, 0=staff, 1=section-mgr, 2=org-mgr
    @UserId         INT            = NULL,
    @OrgSectionId   INT            = NULL,   -- ใช้กรอง section ของ Collector ตอน IsManager = 1
    @OrgStructureId INT            = NULL,
    @UserIdListCsv  NVARCHAR(MAX)  = NULL,
    @Port          INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @SafeCurrentPage INT = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@CurrentPage, 0) <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE @CurrentPage END;
    DECLARE @SafePageSize    INT = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@PageSize, 0) <= 0 THEN 50 ELSE @PageSize END;

    DECLARE @EffectiveOrgSectionId INT = @OrgSectionId;

    IF (
            @IsManager = 1
        AND (@EffectiveOrgSectionId IS NULL OR @EffectiveOrgSectionId = 0)
        AND @UserId IS NOT NULL
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1
            @EffectiveOrgSectionId = p.OrgSectionId
        FROM dbo.DataPersonalInfo p
        WHERE p.UserId = @UserId;
    END;

    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #UidList;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #BaseData;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Filtered;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #FilteredNoPort;

    CREATE TABLE #UidList 
    (
        UserId INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY
    );

    IF ISNULL(LEN(@UserIdListCsv), 0) > 0
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO #UidList (UserId)
        SELECT DISTINCT TRY_CAST(TRIM([value]) AS INT)
        FROM STRING_SPLIT(@UserIdListCsv, ',')
        WHERE ISNULL(TRIM([value]), '') <> ''
          AND TRY_CAST(TRIM([value]) AS INT) IS NOT NULL;
    END;

    DECLARE 
        @srchRelateId BIT = 0,
        @srchCIF      BIT = 0,
        @srchLG       BIT = 0,
        @srchCardCode BIT = 0,
        @srchCode     BIT = 0,
        @srchName     BIT = 0,
        @srchClaim    BIT = 0,
        @srchCollect  BIT = 0,
        @srchProv     BIT = 0,
        @srchGroup    BIT = 0,
        @srchStatus   BIT = 0;

    IF ISNULL(@SearchTypesCsv, '') <> '' 
       AND ISNULL(@Keyword, '') <> ''
    BEGIN
        IF CHARINDEX('dataDebtorRelateId',     @SearchTypesCsv) > 0 SET @srchRelateId = 1;
        IF CHARINDEX('cifNo',                  @SearchTypesCsv) > 0 SET @srchCIF      = 1;
        IF CHARINDEX('lgNo',                   @SearchTypesCsv) > 0 SET @srchLG       = 1;
        IF CHARINDEX('debtorCardCode',         @SearchTypesCsv) > 0 SET @srchCardCode = 1;
        IF CHARINDEX('debtorCode',             @SearchTypesCsv) > 0 SET @srchCode     = 1;
        IF CHARINDEX('debtorName',             @SearchTypesCsv) > 0 SET @srchName     = 1;
        IF CHARINDEX('ClaimPay',               @SearchTypesCsv) > 0 SET @srchClaim    = 1;
        IF CHARINDEX('collectorName',          @SearchTypesCsv) > 0 SET @srchCollect  = 1;
        IF CHARINDEX('provinceName',           @SearchTypesCsv) > 0 SET @srchProv     = 1;
        IF CHARINDEX('personGroupValueLookup', @SearchTypesCsv) > 0 SET @srchGroup    = 1;
        IF CHARINDEX('systemStatusName',       @SearchTypesCsv) > 0 SET @srchStatus   = 1;
    END;

    SELECT
        a.AssignmentId,
        a.CollectorUserId AS CollectorId,

        lg.LGNo,

        dr.DebtorRelateId,
        dr.CIFNo,

        d.DebtorId,
        d.DebtorCode,
        d.PersonGroupId,
        d.DebtorName AS DebtorNameGroup,

        ISNULL(td.TitleShortName, '') AS DebtorTitle,
        ISNULL(d.FirstName, '')       AS DebtorFirstName,
        ISNULL(d.LastName, '')        AS DebtorLastName,

        lm.LookupId AS PersonGroupLookupId,
        ISNULL(dty.DebtorTypeName, '') AS PersonGroupValueLookup,

        ISNULL(dc.DebtorCardCode, '') AS DebtorCardCode,
        ISNULL(dc.ClaimPay, 0)        AS ClaimPay,
        dc.ClaimPayDate,

        ISNULL(prov.ProvinceId, 0) AS ProvinceId,
        ISNULL(prov.Name, '')      AS ProvinceName,

        p.OrgStructureId AS CollectorOrgStructureId,

        -- OrgSection ของ Collector/User เอง
        p.OrgSectionId AS AreaOrgSectionId,

        RTRIM(LTRIM(
            ISNULL(tc.TitleShortName, '') + ' ' +
            ISNULL(p.FirstName, '') + ' ' +
            ISNULL(p.LastName, '')
        )) AS CollectorName,

        sdu.StatusPortId AS PortId,
        sm_port.StatusCode AS PortCode,
        ISNULL(sm_port.StatusName, '') AS PortName,

        ISNULL(sm_assign.SystemId, 0)    AS AssignStatusSystemId,
        ISNULL(sm_assign.StatusCode, '') AS AssignStatusCode,
        ISNULL(sm_assign.StatusName, '') AS AssignStatusName,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY lg.LGNo
            ORDER BY 
                dc.ClaimPayDate DESC,
                dr.DebtorRelateId ASC
        ) AS RowNum

    INTO #BaseData
    FROM dbo.DataAssignment a

    INNER JOIN dbo.DataDebtorRelate dr
        ON a.DebtorRelateId = dr.DebtorRelateId
       AND dr.DebtorTypeId = 1

    INNER JOIN dbo.DataLG lg
        ON dr.LGNo = lg.LGNo
       AND lg.Grade = 'F1'

    INNER JOIN dbo.DataDebtor d
        ON dr.DebtorId = d.DebtorId

    INNER JOIN dbo.DataDebtorAddress addr
        ON d.DebtorId = addr.DebtorId
       AND addr.DebtorAddressTypeId = 7

    INNER JOIN dbo.DataDebtorStatusUpdate sdu
        ON dr.DebtorRelateId = sdu.DebtorRelateId
       AND sdu.DebtorTypeId = 1
       AND ISNULL(sdu.StatusSubTrackingId, 0) <> 0

    INNER JOIN dbo.SystemStatusMaster sm_port
        ON sdu.StatusPortId = sm_port.SystemStatusId

    INNER JOIN dbo.DataPersonalInfo p
        ON a.CollectorUserId = p.UserId

    INNER JOIN dbo.SystemTitleMaster tc
        ON p.TitleId = tc.TitleId

    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemTitleMaster td
        ON d.TitleId = td.TitleId

    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemLookupMaster lm
        ON d.StatusPersonId = lm.LookupId

    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemDebtorType dty
        ON dr.DebtorTypeId = dty.DebtorTypeId

    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1
            c.DebtorCardCode,
            c.ClaimPay,
            c.ClaimPayDate
        FROM dbo.DataDebtorCard c
        WHERE c.DebtorRelateId = dr.DebtorRelateId
        ORDER BY 
            c.ClaimPayDate DESC,
            c.DataDebtorCardId DESC
    ) dc

    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemProvinceMaster prov
        ON addr.ProvinceId = prov.ProvinceId

    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemStatusMaster sm_assign
        ON sdu.StatusAssignId = sm_assign.SystemStatusId

    WHERE a.TypeAssignId = 1
      AND (
            -- Admin เห็นทั้งหมด
            @IsManager IS NULL

            -- Org manager เห็นเฉพาะ CollectorUserId ที่อยู่ใน list
            OR (
                @IsManager = 2
                AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM #UidList ul
                    WHERE ul.UserId = a.CollectorUserId
                )
            )

            -- Section manager เห็นทุกงานของ Collector ที่อยู่ OrgSection เดียวกับตัวเอง
            OR (
                @IsManager = 1
                AND @EffectiveOrgSectionId IS NOT NULL
                AND @EffectiveOrgSectionId > 0
                AND p.OrgSectionId = @EffectiveOrgSectionId
            )

            -- Staff เห็นเฉพาะงานของตัวเอง
            OR (
                @IsManager = 0
                AND a.CollectorUserId = @UserId
            )
          );

    CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_BD_RowNum
        ON #BaseData (RowNum);

    CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_BD_LGNo
        ON #BaseData (LGNo)
        INCLUDE (
            PortId,
            PortCode,
            PortName,
            AssignmentId,
            CollectorId,
            CollectorName,
            ClaimPayDate
        );

;WITH SearchNoPort AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM #BaseData
    WHERE
        (
            ISNULL(@Keyword, '') = ''

            OR (
                   @srchRelateId = 1 
               AND CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), DebtorRelateId) LIKE '%' + @Keyword + '%'
            )

            OR (
                   @srchCIF = 1 
               AND CIFNo LIKE '%' + @Keyword + '%'
            )

            OR (
                   @srchLG = 1 
               AND LGNo LIKE '%' + @Keyword + '%'
            )

            OR (
                   @srchCardCode = 1 
               AND DebtorCardCode LIKE '%' + @Keyword + '%'
            )

            OR (
                   @srchCode = 1 
               AND DebtorCode LIKE '%' + @Keyword + '%'
            )

            OR (
                   @srchName = 1 
               AND (
                    CASE 
                        WHEN PersonGroupId = 118
                            THEN ISNULL(DebtorNameGroup, '')
                        ELSE 
                            ISNULL(DebtorTitle, '') + 
                            ISNULL(DebtorFirstName, '') + ' ' + 
                            ISNULL(DebtorLastName, '')
                    END
               ) LIKE '%' + @Keyword + '%'
            )

            OR (
                   @srchClaim = 1 
               AND CAST(ClaimPay AS NVARCHAR(50)) LIKE '%' + @Keyword + '%'
            )

            OR (
                   @srchCollect = 1 
               AND CollectorName LIKE '%' + @Keyword + '%'
            )

            OR (
                   @srchProv = 1 
               AND ProvinceName LIKE '%' + @Keyword + '%'
            )

            OR (
                   @srchGroup = 1 
               AND PersonGroupValueLookup LIKE '%' + @Keyword + '%'
            )

            OR (
                   @srchStatus = 1 
               AND AssignStatusName LIKE '%' + @Keyword + '%'
            )
        )

        AND (
               @StartDate IS NULL 
            OR ClaimPayDate >= @StartDate
        )

        AND (
               @EndDate IS NULL 
            OR ClaimPayDate <= @EndDate
        )
),
FilteredNoPortDedup AS (
    SELECT *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY 
                CASE 
                    WHEN @srchCollect = 1 THEN CollectorId
                    ELSE 0
                END,
                LGNo
            ORDER BY 
                ClaimPayDate DESC,
                DebtorRelateId ASC
        ) AS FinalRowNum
    FROM SearchNoPort
    WHERE 
        @srchCollect = 1
        OR RowNum = 1
)
SELECT
    AssignmentId,
    CollectorId,
    LGNo,

    DebtorRelateId,
    CIFNo,

    DebtorId,
    DebtorCode,
    PersonGroupId,
    DebtorNameGroup,
    DebtorTitle,
    DebtorFirstName,
    DebtorLastName,

    PersonGroupLookupId,
    PersonGroupValueLookup,

    DebtorCardCode,
    ClaimPay,
    ClaimPayDate,

    ProvinceId,
    ProvinceName,

    CollectorOrgStructureId,
    AreaOrgSectionId,
    CollectorName,

    PortId,
    PortCode,
    PortName,

    AssignStatusSystemId,
    AssignStatusCode,
    AssignStatusName,

    RowNum
INTO #FilteredNoPort
FROM FilteredNoPortDedup
WHERE FinalRowNum = 1;

 SELECT *
    INTO #Filtered
    FROM #FilteredNoPort
    WHERE
           @Port =0
        OR PortId = @Port 

    CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_F_Page
        ON #Filtered (ClaimPayDate DESC, DebtorRelateId ASC);

    SELECT
        DebtorRelateId,
        CIFNo,
        LGNo,

        DebtorCardCode,
        DebtorCode,
        DebtorId,

        DebtorTitle,
        DebtorFirstName,
        DebtorLastName,

        PersonGroupLookupId AS PersonGroupId,
        PersonGroupValueLookup,

        ClaimPay,
        ClaimPayDate,

        CollectorId,

        AreaOrgSectionId AS OrgSectionId,
        CollectorOrgStructureId AS OrgStructureId,
        CollectorName,

        ProvinceId,
        ProvinceName,

        AssignStatusSystemId AS SystemStatusId,
        AssignStatusCode AS SystemStatusCode,
        AssignStatusName AS SystemStatusName,

        PortId,
        PortCode,
        PortName,

        COUNT(*) OVER () AS TotalFiltered
    FROM #Filtered
    ORDER BY 
        PortCode DESC,
        DebtorRelateId ASC
    OFFSET ((@SafeCurrentPage - 1) * @SafePageSize) ROWS
    FETCH NEXT @SafePageSize ROWS ONLY;

    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT LGNo) AS AllWork
    FROM #BaseData;

    SELECT
        PortCode,
        PortId,
        PortName,
        COUNT(*) AS Cnt
    FROM #FilteredNoPort
    WHERE RowNum = 1
    GROUP BY
        PortCode,
        PortId,
        PortName
    ORDER BY
        PortCode;
        
    SELECT
        CollectorId,
        CollectorName AS UserCollectorName,
        ' ' AS UserOAName,
        COUNT(DISTINCT LGNo) AS AssignmentCount
    FROM #BaseData
    GROUP BY
        CollectorId,
        CollectorName
    ORDER BY
        CollectorName;

    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Filtered;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #FilteredNoPort;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #BaseData;
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #UidList;
END;

--         IF CHARINDEX('dataDebtorRelateId',     @SearchTypesCsv) > 0 SET @srchRelateId = 1;

--         IF CHARINDEX('lgNo',                   @SearchTypesCsv) > 0 SET @srchLG       = 1;
--         IF CHARINDEX('debtorCardCode',         @SearchTypesCsv) > 0 SET @srchCardCode = 1;
--         IF CHARINDEX('debtorCode',             @SearchTypesCsv) > 0 SET @srchCode     = 1;
--         IF CHARINDEX('debtorName',             @SearchTypesCsv) > 0 SET @srchName     = 1;
--         IF CHARINDEX('ClaimPay',               @SearchTypesCsv) > 0 SET @srchClaim    = 1;
--         IF CHARINDEX('collectorName',          @SearchTypesCsv) > 0 SET @srchCollect  = 1;
--         IF CHARINDEX('provinceName',           @SearchTypesCsv) > 0 SET @srchProv     = 1;
--         IF CHARINDEX('personGroupValueLookup', @SearchTypesCsv) > 0 SET @srchGroup    = 1;
--         IF CHARINDEX('systemStatusName',       @SearchTypesCsv) > 0 SET @srchStatus   = 1;
--         IF CHARINDEX('port',                   @SearchTypesCsv) > 0 SET @srchPort     = 1;

--

--     SELECT
--         a.AssignmentId,

--         ISNULL(d.LastName, '')        AS DebtorLastName,
-- 
--         lm.LookupId AS PersonGroupLookupId,
--         ISNULL(dty.DebtorTypeName, '') AS PersonGroupValueLookup,
-- 
--         ISNULL(dc.DebtorCardCode, '') AS DebtorCardCode,
--         ISNULL(dc.ClaimPay, 0)        AS ClaimPay,
--         dc.ClaimPayDate,
-- 
--         ISNULL(prov.ProvinceId, 0) AS ProvinceId,
--         ISNULL(prov.Name, '')      AS ProvinceName,
-- 
--         p.OrgStructureId AS CollectorOrgStructureId,
-- 
--         -- ตัด SystemResponsibleAreaMaster ออกแล้ว
--         -- คืนค่า NULL ไว้เพื่อไม่ให้ response structure เดิมพัง
--         CAST(NULL AS INT) AS AreaOrgSectionId,
-- 
--         RTRIM(LTRIM(
--             ISNULL(tc.TitleShortName, '') + ' ' +
--             ISNULL(p.FirstName, '') + ' ' +
--             ISNULL(p.LastName, '')
--         )) AS CollectorName,
-- 
--         sdu.StatusPortId AS PortId,
--         sm_port.StatusCode AS PortCode,
--         ISNULL(sm_port.StatusName, '') AS PortName,
-- 
--         ISNULL(sm_assign.SystemId, 0)    AS AssignStatusSystemId,
--         ISNULL(sm_assign.StatusCode, '') AS AssignStatusCode,
--         ISNULL(sm_assign.StatusName, '') AS AssignStatusName,
-- 
--         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
--             PARTITION BY lg.LGNo
--             ORDER BY 
--                 dc.ClaimPayDate DESC,
--                 dr.DebtorRelateId ASC
--         ) AS RowNum
-- 
--     INTO #BaseData
--     FROM dbo.DataAssignment a
-- 
--     INNER JOIN dbo.DataDebtorRelate dr
--         ON a.DebtorRelateId = dr.DebtorRelateId
--        AND dr.DebtorTypeId = 1
-- 
--     INNER JOIN dbo.DataLG lg
--         ON dr.LGNo = lg.LGNo
--        AND lg.Grade = 'F1'
-- 
--     INNER JOIN dbo.DataDebtor d
--         ON dr.DebtorId = d.DebtorId
-- 
--     INNER JOIN dbo.DataDebtorAddress addr
--         ON d.DebtorId = addr.DebtorId
--        AND addr.DebtorAddressTypeId = 7
-- 
--     INNER JOIN dbo.DataDebtorStatusUpdate sdu
--         ON dr.DebtorRelateId = sdu.DebtorRelateId
--        AND sdu.DebtorTypeId = 1
--        AND ISNULL(sdu.StatusSubTrackingId, 0) <> 0
-- 
--     INNER JOIN dbo.SystemStatusMaster sm_port
--         ON sdu.StatusPortId = sm_port.SystemStatusId
-- 
--     INNER JOIN dbo.DataPersonalInfo p
--         ON a.CollectorUserId = p.UserId
-- 
--     INNER JOIN dbo.SystemTitleMaster tc
--         ON p.TitleId = tc.TitleId
-- 
--     LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemTitleMaster td
--         ON d.TitleId = td.TitleId
-- 
--     LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemLookupMaster lm
--         ON d.StatusPersonId = lm.LookupId
-- 
--     LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemDebtorType dty
--         ON dr.DebtorTypeId = dty.DebtorTypeId
-- 
--     OUTER APPLY (
--         SELECT TOP 1
--             c.DebtorCardCode,
--             c.ClaimPay,
--             c.ClaimPayDate
--         FROM dbo.DataDebtorCard c
--         WHERE c.DebtorRelateId = dr.DebtorRelateId
--         ORDER BY 
--             c.ClaimPayDate DESC,
--             c.DataDebtorCardId DESC
--     ) dc
-- 
--     LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemProvinceMaster prov
--         ON addr.ProvinceId = prov.ProvinceId
-- 
--     LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemStatusMaster sm_assign
--         ON sdu.StatusAssignId = sm_assign.SystemStatusId
-- 
--     WHERE a.TypeAssignId = 1
--       AND (
--             -- Admin เห็นทั้งหมด
--             @IsManager IS NULL
-- 
--             -- Org manager เห็นเฉพาะ CollectorUserId ที่อยู่ใน list
--             OR (
--                 @IsManager = 2
--                 AND EXISTS (
--                     SELECT 1
--                     FROM #UidList ul
--                     WHERE ul.UserId = a.CollectorUserId
--                 )
--             )
-- 
--             -- Section manager เห็นของตัวเอง + ลูกทีมใน list
--             -- ไม่กรอง area.OrgSectionId แล้ว
--             OR (
--                 @IsManager = 1
--                 AND (
--                         a.CollectorUserId = @UserId
--                      OR EXISTS (
--                             SELECT 1
--                             FROM #UidList ul
--                             WHERE ul.UserId = a.CollectorUserId
--                         )
--                     )
--             )
-- 
--             -- Staff เห็นเฉพาะของตัวเอง
--             OR (
--                 @IsManager = 0
--                 AND a.CollectorUserId = @UserId
--             )
--           );
-- 
--     CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_BD_RowNum
--         ON #BaseData (RowNum);
-- 
--     CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_BD_LGNo
--         ON #BaseData (LGNo)
--         INCLUDE (
--             PortId,
--             PortCode,
--             PortName,
--             AssignmentId,
--             CollectorId,
--             CollectorName,
--             ClaimPayDate
--         );
-- 
--     /* ─── Filter กลาง: ยังไม่แบ่งหน้า ─────────────────────────────── */
--     ;WITH SearchFirst AS (
--         SELECT *
--         FROM #BaseData
--         WHERE (
--                 ISNULL(@Keyword, '') = ''
-- 
--              OR (
--                     @srchRelateId = 1 
--                 AND CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), DebtorRelateId) LIKE '%' + @Keyword + '%'
--                 )
-- 
--              OR (
--                     @srchCIF = 1 
--                 AND CIFNo LIKE '%' + @Keyword + '%'
--                 )
-- 
--              OR (
--                     @srchLG = 1 
--                 AND LGNo LIKE '%' + @Keyword + '%'
--                 )
-- 
--              OR (
--                     @srchCardCode = 1 
--                 AND DebtorCardCode LIKE '%' + @Keyword + '%'
--                 )
-- 
--              OR (
--                     @srchCode = 1 
--                 AND DebtorCode LIKE '%' + @Keyword + '%'
--                 )
-- 
--              OR (
--                     @srchName = 1 
--                 AND (
--                         CASE 
--                             WHEN PersonGroupId = 118
--                                 THEN ISNULL(DebtorNameGroup, '')
--                             ELSE 
--                                 ISNULL(DebtorTitle, '') + 
--                                 ISNULL(DebtorFirstName, '') + ' ' + 
--                                 ISNULL(DebtorLastName, '')
--                         END
--                     ) LIKE '%' + @Keyword + '%'
--                 )
-- 
--              OR (
--                     @srchClaim = 1 
--                 AND CAST(ClaimPay AS NVARCHAR(50)) LIKE '%' + @Keyword + '%'
--                 )
-- 
--              OR (
--                     @srchCollect = 1 
--                 AND CollectorName LIKE '%' + @Keyword + '%'
--                 )
-- 
--              OR (
--                     @srchProv = 1 
--                 AND ProvinceName LIKE '%' + @Keyword + '%'
--                 )
-- 
--              OR (
--                     @srchGroup = 1 
--                 AND PersonGroupValueLookup LIKE '%' + @Keyword + '%'
--                 )
-- 
--              OR (
--                     @srchStatus = 1 
--                 AND AssignStatusName LIKE '%' + @Keyword + '%'
--                 )
-- 
--              OR (
--                     @srchPort = 1 
--                 AND PortName LIKE '%' + @Keyword + '%'
--                 )
--         )
--         AND (
--                 @StartDate IS NULL 
--              OR ClaimPayDate >= @StartDate
--         )
--         AND (
--                 @EndDate IS NULL 
--              OR ClaimPayDate <= @EndDate
--         )
--     ),
--     FilteredDedup AS (
--         SELECT *,
--             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
--                 PARTITION BY 
--                     CASE 
--                         WHEN @srchCollect = 1 THEN CollectorId
--                         ELSE 0
--                     END,
--                     LGNo
--                 ORDER BY 
--                     ClaimPayDate DESC,
--                     DebtorRelateId ASC
--             ) AS FinalRowNum
--         FROM SearchFirst
--         WHERE 
--             @srchCollect = 1
--             OR RowNum = 1
--     )
--     SELECT
--         AssignmentId,
--         CollectorId,
--         LGNo,
-- 
--         DebtorRelateId,
--         CIFNo,
-- 
--         DebtorId,
--         DebtorCode,
--         PersonGroupId,
--         DebtorNameGroup,
--         DebtorTitle,
--         DebtorFirstName,
--         DebtorLastName,
-- 
--         PersonGroupLookupId,
--         PersonGroupValueLookup,
-- 
--         DebtorCardCode,
--         ClaimPay,
--         ClaimPayDate,
-- 
--         ProvinceId,
--         ProvinceName,
-- 
--         CollectorOrgStructureId,
--         AreaOrgSectionId,
--         CollectorName,
-- 
--         PortId,
--         PortCode,
--         PortName,
-- 
--         AssignStatusSystemId,
--         AssignStatusCode,
--         AssignStatusName,
-- 
--         RowNum
--     INTO #Filtered
--     FROM FilteredDedup
--     WHERE FinalRowNum = 1;
-- 
--     /* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
--        RS1: Page items
--     ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
--     SELECT
--         DebtorRelateId,
--         CIFNo,
--         LGNo,
-- 
--         DebtorCardCode,
--         DebtorCode,
--         DebtorId,
-- 
--         DebtorTitle,
--         DebtorFirstName,
--         DebtorLastName,
-- 
--         PersonGroupLookupId AS PersonGroupId,
--         PersonGroupValueLookup,
-- 
--         ClaimPay,
--         ClaimPayDate,
-- 
--         CollectorId,
-- 
--         -- ไม่มี SystemResponsibleAreaMaster แล้ว
--         AreaOrgSectionId AS OrgSectionId,
-- 
--         CollectorOrgStructureId AS OrgStructureId,
--         CollectorName,
-- 
--         ProvinceId,
--         ProvinceName,
-- 
--         AssignStatusSystemId AS SystemStatusId,
--         AssignStatusCode AS SystemStatusCode,
--         AssignStatusName AS SystemStatusName,
-- 
--         COUNT(*) OVER () AS TotalFiltered
--     FROM #Filtered
--     ORDER BY 
--         ClaimPayDate DESC,
--         DebtorRelateId ASC
--     OFFSET ((@SafeCurrentPage - 1) * @SafePageSize) ROWS
--     FETCH NEXT @SafePageSize ROWS ONLY;
-- 
--     /* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
--        RS2: AllWork
--     ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
--     SELECT 
--         COUNT(DISTINCT LGNo) AS AllWork
--     FROM #BaseData;
-- 
--     /* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
--        RS3: Port summary
--     ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
--     SELECT
--         PortCode,
--         PortId,
--         COUNT(*) AS Cnt
--     FROM #Filtered
--     WHERE RowNum = 1
--     GROUP BY
--         PortCode,
--         PortId;
-- 
--     /* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
--        RS4: Collector summary
--        สรุปว่า Collector แต่ละคนดูแล LGNo กี่รายการจาก DataAssignment
--     ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
--     SELECT
--         CollectorId,
--         CollectorName AS UserCollectorName,
--         ' ' AS UserOAName,
--         COUNT(DISTINCT LGNo) AS AssignmentCount
--     FROM #BaseData
--     GROUP BY
--         CollectorId,
--         CollectorName
--     ORDER BY
--         CollectorName;
-- 
--     DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Filtered;
--     DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #BaseData;

-- END;

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_helpdiagrams
	(
		@diagramname sysname = NULL,
		@owner_id int = NULL
	)
	WITH EXECUTE AS N'dbo'
	AS
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @user sysname
		DECLARE @dboLogin bit
		EXECUTE AS CALLER;
			SET @user = USER_NAME();
			SET @dboLogin = CONVERT(bit,IS_MEMBER('db_owner'));
		REVERT;
		SELECT
			[Database] = DB_NAME(),
			[Name] = name,
			[ID] = diagram_id,
			[Owner] = USER_NAME(principal_id),
			[OwnerID] = principal_id
		FROM
			sysdiagrams
		WHERE
			(@dboLogin = 1 OR USER_NAME(principal_id) = @user) AND
			(@diagramname IS NULL OR name = @diagramname) AND
			(@owner_id IS NULL OR principal_id = @owner_id)
		ORDER BY
			4, 5, 1
	END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_001_InsertAmphurCBS]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRAN;

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 1) เตรียมข้อมูลจาก TEMPAmphurCBS: ตัดช่องว่าง/จำกัดความยาว/คัดแยกแถวว่าง
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#src') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #src;

        SELECT
            Id,
            AmphurCode   = LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(AmphurCode )), 10),
            AmphurName   = LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(AmphurName )),100),
            ProvinceCode = LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(ProvinceCode)), 10)
        INTO #src
        FROM dbo.TEMPAmphurCBS
        WHERE AmphurName IS NOT NULL
          AND LTRIM(RTRIM(AmphurName)) <> N'';

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2) กันข้อมูลซ้ำใน TEMP (ตาม AmphurName) - เอาแถวล่าสุด (ตาม Id; ปรับได้)
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dedup') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dedup;

        ;WITH s AS
        (
            SELECT *,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                       PARTITION BY AmphurName
                       ORDER BY Id DESC
                   ) AS rn
            FROM #src
        )
        SELECT *
        INTO #dedup
        FROM s
        WHERE rn = 1;

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 3) INSERT ลง SystemDistrictMaster เฉพาะ AmphurName ที่ยังไม่มี
        --    จับคู่: AmphurCode -> Code, AmphurName -> Name, ProvinceCode -> ProvinceCode
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        INSERT INTO dbo.SystemDistrictMaster
        (
            Code, Name, ProvinceId, ZoneID, NameEN, Latitude, Longitude,
            CreateBy, CreateDate, UpdateBy, UpdateDate, ProvinceCode
        )
        SELECT
            d.AmphurCode,
            d.AmphurName,
            NULL AS ProvinceId,     -- ถ้าต้อง map จาก ProvinceCode -> ProvinceId แจ้งมาได้
            NULL AS ZoneID,
            NULL AS NameEN,
            NULL AS Latitude,
            NULL AS Longitude,
            N'1' AS CreateBy,
            GETDATE() AS CreateDate,
            N'1' AS UpdateBy,
            GETDATE() AS UpdateDate,
            d.ProvinceCode
        FROM #dedup d
        WHERE NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.SystemDistrictMaster m
            WHERE (LTRIM(RTRIM(m.Name)) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
                  = (d.AmphurName COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
        );

        DECLARE @InsertedCount INT = @@ROWCOUNT;

        COMMIT TRAN;

        SELECT @InsertedCount AS InsertedCount,
               N'สำเร็จ: เพิ่มเขตอำเภอใหม่จาก TEMPAmphurCBS ตาม AmphurName (ไม่แทรกซ้ำชื่อเดิม)' AS Note;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0 ROLLBACK TRAN;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_002_InsertBankBranchCBS]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRAN;

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 1) เตรียมข้อมูลจาก TEMPBankBranchCBS: clean/trim/limit length
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#src_BRANCH') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #src_BRANCH;

        SELECT
            Id,
            BankCode        = LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(BankCode       )), 20),  -- ปลายทางยาว 20
            BankBranchCode  = LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(BankBranchCode )), 20),  -- ปลายทางยาว 20
            BankBranchName  = LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(BankBranchName )),200)   -- ปลายทางยาว 200
        INTO #src_BRANCH
        FROM dbo.TEMPBankBranchCBS
        WHERE BankBranchName IS NOT NULL
          AND LTRIM(RTRIM(BankBranchName)) <> N'';

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2) กันข้อมูลซ้ำใน TEMP เอง (ตาม BankBranchName) - เลือกแถวล่าสุด (ตาม Id)
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dedup_BRANCH') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dedup_BRANCH;

        ;WITH S AS
        (
            SELECT *,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                       PARTITION BY BankBranchName
                       ORDER BY Id DESC
                   ) AS rn
            FROM #src_BRANCH
        )
        SELECT *
        INTO #dedup_BRANCH
        FROM S
        WHERE rn = 1;

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 3) INSERT ลง SystemBankBranchMaster
        --    เฉพาะชื่อสาขาที่ยังไม่มี และ BankCode ต้องมีใน SystemBankMaster
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        INSERT INTO dbo.SystemBankBranchMaster
        (
            BankId,
            BankBranchCode,
            BankBranchName,
            CreateDate,
            CreateBy,
            UpdateDate,
            UpdateBy,
            BranchCode,
            BankCode,
            IsActive
        )
        SELECT
            bm.BankId,
            d.BankBranchCode,
            d.BankBranchName,
            GETDATE(),
            N'SYSTEM',
            GETDATE(),
            N'SYSTEM',
            d.BankBranchCode,       -- เก็บซ้ำตาม schema
            bm.BankCode,            -- ใช้ BankCode จาก master ที่ผ่านการ match แล้ว
            1
        FROM #dedup_BRANCH d
        INNER JOIN dbo.SystemBankMaster bm
            ON (LTRIM(RTRIM(bm.BankCode)) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
             = (d.BankCode COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
        WHERE NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.SystemBankBranchMaster b
            WHERE (LTRIM(RTRIM(b.BankBranchName)) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
                  = (d.BankBranchName COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
        );

        DECLARE @InsertedCount INT = @@ROWCOUNT;

        COMMIT TRAN;

        SELECT @InsertedCount AS InsertedCount,
               N'สำเร็จ: เพิ่มสาขาธนาคารจาก TEMPBankBranchCBS โดยเช็คชื่อสาขา และ BankCode ต้องมีใน SystemBankMaster' AS Note;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0 ROLLBACK TRAN;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_003_InsertBankCBS]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRAN;

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 1) เตรียมข้อมูลจาก TEMPBankCBS: ตัดช่องว่าง/จำกัดความยาว/คัดแยกแถวว่าง
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#src_BANK') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #src_BANK;

        SELECT
            Id,
            BankCode     = LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(BankCode    )), 20),
            MappingCode  = LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(MappingCode )), 50),  -- เผื่ออนาคตใช้
            BankName     = LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(BankName    )), 500),
            BankAbbrName = LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(BankAbbrName)), 20),
            GroupBank    = LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(GroupBank   )), 20)
        INTO #src_BANK
        FROM dbo.TEMPBankCBS
        WHERE BankName IS NOT NULL
          AND LTRIM(RTRIM(BankName)) <> N'';

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2) กันข้อมูลซ้ำใน TEMP (ตาม BankName) - เลือกแถวล่าสุด (ตาม Id)
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dedup_BANK') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dedup_BANK;

        ;WITH S AS
        (
            SELECT *,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                       PARTITION BY BankName
                       ORDER BY Id DESC
                   ) AS rn
            FROM #src_BANK
        )
        SELECT *
        INTO #dedup_BANK
        FROM S
        WHERE rn = 1;

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 3) INSERT ลง SystemBankMaster เฉพาะ BankName ที่ยังไม่มี
        --    จับคู่ฟิลด์: BankCode, BankName, GroupBank, BankAbbrName
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        INSERT INTO dbo.SystemBankMaster
        (
            BankCode,
            BankName,
            CreateDate, CreateBy,
            UpdateDate, UpdateBy,
            GroupBank,
            BankAbbrName,
            IsActive
        )
        SELECT
            d.BankCode,
            d.BankName,
            GETDATE(), 1,
            GETDATE(), 1,
            d.GroupBank,
            d.BankAbbrName,
            1
        FROM #dedup_BANK d
        WHERE NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.SystemBankMaster m
            WHERE (LTRIM(RTRIM(m.BankName)) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
                  = (d.BankName COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
        );

        DECLARE @InsertedCount INT = @@ROWCOUNT;

        COMMIT TRAN;

        SELECT @InsertedCount AS InsertedCount,
               N'สำเร็จ: เพิ่มรายการธนาคารใหม่จาก TEMPBankCBS ตาม BankName (ไม่แทรกซ้ำชื่อเดิม)' AS Note;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0 ROLLBACK TRAN;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_004_InsertBankruptcy]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRAN;

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 1) เตรียมข้อมูล + trim + map cus_type
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Stage') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Stage;

        SELECT
            t.TEMPId,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(t.card_id))  AS card_id,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(t.cus_name)) AS cus_name,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(t.cus_title)) AS cus_title,
            t.CIF,
            t.LGNO,
            t.CreateDate,
            t.UpdateDate,
            CASE
                WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT, t.cus_type) = 1 THEN 1
                WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT, t.cus_type) IN (4, 5) THEN 2
                WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT, t.cus_type) = 3 THEN 6
                WHEN TRY_CONVERT(INT, t.cus_type) = 2 THEN 4
                ELSE 2
            END AS DebtorTypeId
        INTO #Stage
        FROM dbo.TEMPBankruptcy t
        WHERE t.card_id IS NOT NULL
          AND LTRIM(RTRIM(t.card_id)) <> '';

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2) แยกชื่อจาก cus_name
        --    คำแรก = FirstName, ที่เหลือ = LastName
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#StageName') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #StageName;

        SELECT
            s.*,
            CASE
                WHEN CHARINDEX(' ', s.cus_name) > 0
                    THEN LEFT(s.cus_name, CHARINDEX(' ', s.cus_name) - 1)
                ELSE s.cus_name
            END AS FirstName,
            CASE
                WHEN CHARINDEX(' ', s.cus_name) > 0
                    THEN LTRIM(SUBSTRING(s.cus_name, CHARINDEX(' ', s.cus_name) + 1, 255))
                ELSE NULL
            END AS LastName
        INTO #StageName
        FROM #Stage s;

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 3) คัดเฉพาะรายการที่ยังไม่มีใน DataDebtor
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#NewDebtor') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #NewDebtor;

        SELECT
            s.*
        INTO #NewDebtor
        FROM #StageName s
        WHERE NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.DataDebtor d
            WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(d.IDCard, ''))) = s.card_id
               OR LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(d.CardNumber, ''))) = s.card_id
        );

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 4) เตรียม running DebtorCode แบบตัวอย่าง
        --    C + ปี พ.ศ. 2 หลัก + running 6 หลัก
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        DECLARE @BEYear   INT      = YEAR(GETDATE()) + 543;
        DECLARE @YY       CHAR(2)  = RIGHT(CONVERT(VARCHAR(4), @BEYear), 2);
        DECLARE @Prefix   NCHAR(3) = N'C' + @YY;
        DECLARE @N        INT;
        DECLARE @Current  INT;
        DECLARE @StartRun INT;
        DECLARE @EndRun   INT;

        SELECT @N = COUNT(*) FROM #NewDebtor;

        IF @N > 0
        BEGIN
            SELECT @Current = LastRun
            FROM dbo.SystemRunningDebtorCode WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
            WHERE YearPrefix = @Prefix;

            IF @Current IS NULL
            BEGIN
                THROW 50001, 'ไม่พบข้อมูล YearPrefix ในตาราง SystemRunningDebtorCode สำหรับปีปัจจุบัน', 1;
            END;

            SET @StartRun = @Current + 1;
            SET @EndRun   = @Current + @N;

            IF @EndRun > 999999
            BEGIN
                THROW 50002, 'DebtorCode running number for current BE year would exceed 999999.', 1;
            END;

            UPDATE dbo.SystemRunningDebtorCode
            SET LastRun = @EndRun
            WHERE YearPrefix = @Prefix;
        END;

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 5) ใส่ลำดับ running ให้รายการใหม่
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#NewDebtorRun') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #NewDebtorRun;

        SELECT
            n.*,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY n.card_id) AS rn
        INTO #NewDebtorRun
        FROM #NewDebtor n;

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 6) INSERT DataDebtor
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        INSERT INTO dbo.DataDebtor
        (
            DebtorCode,
            DebtorTypeId,
            TitleId,
            FirstName,
            LastName,
            DebtorName,
            CardNumber,
            IDCard,
            RefCode,
            DebtorId,
            ImportDate,
            CreateDate,
            CreateBy,
            UpdateDate,
            UpdateBy,
            IsActive,
            ImportType,
            DebtorCBSId
        )
        SELECT
            CONCAT(@Prefix, RIGHT(CONCAT('000000', @StartRun + n.rn - 1), 6)) AS DebtorCode,
            n.DebtorTypeId,
            st.TitleId,
            LEFT(n.FirstName, 100),
            LEFT(n.LastName, 100),
            LEFT(n.cus_name, 500),
            LEFT(n.card_id, 20),
            LEFT(n.card_id, 20),
            LEFT(n.CIF, 30),
            CONVERT(NVARCHAR(150), NEWID()),
            COALESCE(n.UpdateDate, n.CreateDate, GETDATE()),
            GETDATE(),
            1,
            GETDATE(),
            1,
            1,
            1,
            CONVERT(NVARCHAR(150), n.TEMPId)
        FROM #NewDebtorRun n
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemTitleMaster st
            ON st.TitleCode = n.cus_title;

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 7) INSERT TEMPMapLGCBS
        --    ต้องลงทั้งกรณี debtor ใหม่ และ debtor เดิม
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        INSERT INTO dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS
        (
            TEMPMapLGId,
            CIFNo,
            LGNo,
            DebtorCode,
            DebtorTypeId,
            ImportDate
        )
        SELECT
            CONVERT(NVARCHAR(150), NEWID()),
            LEFT(s.CIF, 20),
            LEFT(s.LGNO, 20),
            LEFT(d.DebtorCode, 20),
            s.DebtorTypeId,
            GETDATE()
        FROM #StageName s
        INNER JOIN dbo.DataDebtor d
            ON LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(d.IDCard, ''))) = s.card_id
            OR LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(d.CardNumber, ''))) = s.card_id
        WHERE s.LGNO IS NOT NULL
          AND LTRIM(RTRIM(s.LGNO)) <> ''
          AND NOT EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS m
              WHERE m.DebtorCode = LEFT(d.DebtorCode, 20)
                AND m.LGNo = LEFT(s.LGNO, 20)
          );

        COMMIT TRAN;

        SELECT
            'SUCCESS' AS [Status],
            'Insert TEMPBankruptcy -> DataDebtor / TEMPMapLGCBS completed' AS [Message];

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK TRAN;

        THROW;
    END CATCH
END
