CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_004_InsertBankruptcy_Customer]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRAN;

        -- 0) clear temp
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Src') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Src;
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Latest') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Latest;
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#MapType') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #MapType;
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ToCreate') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ToCreate;
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ToUpdate') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ToUpdate;
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Numbered') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Numbered;
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Assign') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Assign;

        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 1) source rows (only grade = F1, latest per card_id)
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        SELECT *
        INTO #Src
        FROM dbo.TEMPBankruptcy WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE card_id IS NOT NULL
          AND LTRIM(RTRIM(card_id)) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT <> N''
          AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(grade, N'')))) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT = N'F1';

        SELECT
            x.TEMPId AS TEMPId,
            x.Id AS Id,
            x.CIF AS CIF,
            x.cus_title AS cus_title,
            x.cus_name AS cus_name,
            x.idcode AS idcode,
            x.card_id AS card_id,
            x.diffnid AS diffnid,
            x.tproject_name AS tproject_name,
            x.LGNO AS LGNO,
            x.bank_grade AS bank_grade,
            x.cus_type AS cus_type,
            x.cus_type_name AS cus_type_name,
            x.project_type AS project_type,
            x.caseno AS caseno,
            x.pname AS pname,
            x.action AS action,
            x.pipaksa AS pipaksa,
            x.pipaksa_e AS pipaksa_e,
            x.prakas AS prakas,
            x.kosana AS kosana,
            x.cus_add1 AS cus_add1,
            x.cus_add2 AS cus_add2,
            x.debt_money AS debt_money,
            x.debt_date AS debt_date,
            x.debt_Remark AS debt_Remark,
            x.claim_date AS claim_date,
            x.claim_amount AS claim_amount,
            x.abs_prot_dd AS abs_prot_dd,
            x.restore_dd AS restore_dd,
            x.abs_gaz_dd AS abs_gaz_dd,
            x.restore_prot_dd AS restore_prot_dd,
            x.abs_due_dd AS abs_due_dd,
            x.b_restore_dd AS b_restore_dd,
            x.b_cou_set_dd AS b_cou_set_dd,
            x.r_restore_dd AS r_restore_dd,
            x.bkr_prot_dd AS bkr_prot_dd,
            x.c_bkr_dd AS c_bkr_dd,
            x.r_bkr_dd AS r_bkr_dd,
            x.close_dd AS close_dd,
            x.share_asset_dd AS share_asset_dd,
            x.r_bkrprot_amount AS r_bkrprot_amount,
            x.approve_dd AS approve_dd,
            x.aporove_amount AS aporove_amount,
            x.r_bkrprot_dd AS r_bkrprot_dd,
            x.grade AS grade,
            x.bkr_amount AS bkr_amount,
            x.abs_bkr_dd AS abs_bkr_dd,
            x.r_abs_bkr_dd AS r_abs_bkr_dd,
            x.c_abs_bkr_dd AS c_abs_bkr_dd,
            x.a_abs_bkr_dd AS a_abs_bkr_dd,
            x.e_abs_bkr_dd AS e_abs_bkr_dd,
            x.CreateDate AS CreateDate,
            x.UpdateDate AS UpdateDate,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER(
                PARTITION BY x.card_id
                ORDER BY
                    CASE WHEN x.UpdateDate IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END DESC,
                    x.UpdateDate DESC,
                    CASE WHEN x.CreateDate IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END DESC,
                    x.CreateDate DESC,
                    x.TEMPId DESC
            ) AS rn
        INTO #Latest
        FROM #Src x;

        DELETE FROM #Latest WHERE rn <> 1;

        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2) map debtor type + keep fields for LTDataAssignCaseBankrupcy
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        SELECT
            l.TEMPId AS TEMPId,
            l.card_id AS card_id,
            l.cus_name AS cus_name,
            l.CIF AS CIF,
            l.CreateDate AS CreateDate,
            l.UpdateDate AS UpdateDate,

            l.bkr_prot_dd AS bkr_prot_dd,
            l.c_bkr_dd AS c_bkr_dd,
            l.r_bkr_dd AS r_bkr_dd,
            l.abs_bkr_dd AS abs_bkr_dd,
            l.r_abs_bkr_dd AS r_abs_bkr_dd,
            l.c_abs_bkr_dd AS c_abs_bkr_dd,
            l.a_abs_bkr_dd AS a_abs_bkr_dd,
            l.e_abs_bkr_dd AS e_abs_bkr_dd,
            l.close_dd AS close_dd,

            l.cus_type_name AS cus_type_name,
            sdt.DebtorTypeId AS DebtorTypeId,

            -- fields for LTDataAssignCaseBankrupcy
            l.caseno AS caseno,
            l.pname AS pname,
            l.claim_date AS claim_date,
            l.claim_amount AS claim_amount,
            l.debt_money AS debt_money
        INTO #MapType
        FROM #Latest l
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemDebtorType sdt
          ON (sdt.DebtorTypeName COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (l.cus_type_name COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT);

        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 3) split create / update
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        SELECT m.*
        INTO #ToCreate
        FROM #MapType m
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.DataDebtor d
            WHERE (d.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (m.card_id COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
        );

        SELECT m.*
        INTO #ToUpdate
        FROM #MapType m
        WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.DataDebtor d
            WHERE (d.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (m.card_id COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
        );

        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 4) running debtor code
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        DECLARE @BEYear INT = YEAR(GETDATE()) + 543;
        DECLARE @YY CHAR(2) = RIGHT(CONVERT(VARCHAR(4), @BEYear), 2);
        DECLARE @Prefix NVARCHAR(3) = CONCAT(N'C', @YY);

        DECLARE @MaxRun INT;
        SELECT @MaxRun = MAX(TRY_CONVERT(INT, RIGHT(DebtorCode, 5)))
        FROM dbo.DataDebtor WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
        WHERE (DebtorCode COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) LIKE CONCAT(@Prefix, N'[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]');

        IF @MaxRun IS NULL SET @MaxRun = 0;
        IF @MaxRun >= 99999
        BEGIN
            THROW 50001, 'DebtorCode running number for current BE year has reached 99999.', 1;
        END;

        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 5) numbering for create
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        SELECT
            tc.TEMPId AS TEMPId,
            tc.card_id AS card_id,
            tc.cus_name AS cus_name,
            tc.CIF AS CIF,
            tc.CreateDate AS CreateDate,
            tc.DebtorTypeId AS DebtorTypeId,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY tc.card_id) AS rn_order,
            @MaxRun + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY tc.card_id) AS NextRun
        INTO #Numbered
        FROM #ToCreate tc;

        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 6) insert DataDebtor
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        DECLARE @InsertedCount INT = 0;

        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #Numbered)
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO dbo.DataDebtor
            (
                DebtorCode, DebtorTypeId, TitleId, FirstName, LastName, DebtorName,
                CardTypeId, CardNumber, CompanyNameEN, BirthDate, FixedAssetValue, DebtorId,
                OldSection, IDCard, RefCode, ContactName, Email, CntPhoneNumber, CntMobileNumber, CntFaxNumber,
                DefaultAddressId, Note, BusinessType, BusinessTypeName, CompanyType, CompanyTypeDescription, BusinessDescription,
                EmploymentQty, IncEmploymentQty, ISICCode, Totalclaim, DebtorCodeType, DivisionCode, ProvinceCode,
                RegistrationType, RegistrationNo, CompanyEngName, RegistrationDate, LoanerTotal, ImportDate,
                BusinessStatus, BusinessStatusDate, CreateDate, CreateBy, UpdateDate, UpdateBy, NotSendSMS, RefMigrateId,
                IsActive, Age, StatusPersonId, LineID, DebtorCBSId, GenderId, PersonGroupId, BusinessStatusId, BusinessTypeId,
                CompanyTypeId, BusinessDescriptionId, FilingDueDate, BankFilingDate, LawOfficeSectionId, ImportType
            )
            SELECT
                CONCAT(@Prefix, RIGHT(CONCAT(N'00000', CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), n.NextRun)), 5)) AS DebtorCode,
                n.DebtorTypeId AS DebtorTypeId,
                NULL AS TitleId,
                NULL AS FirstName,
                NULL AS LastName,
                LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(n.cus_name)), 500) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS DebtorName,
                NULL AS CardTypeId,
                LEFT(n.card_id, 20) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS CardNumber,
                NULL AS CompanyNameEN,
                NULL AS BirthDate,
                NULL AS FixedAssetValue,
                CONVERT(NVARCHAR(150), NEWID()) AS DebtorId,
                NULL AS OldSection,
                LEFT(n.card_id, 20) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS IDCard,
                LEFT(ISNULL(n.CIF, N''), 30) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS RefCode,
                NULL AS ContactName,
                NULL AS Email,
                NULL AS CntPhoneNumber,
                NULL AS CntMobileNumber,
                NULL AS CntFaxNumber,
                NULL AS DefaultAddressId,
                NULL AS Note,
                NULL AS BusinessType,
                NULL AS BusinessTypeName,
                NULL AS CompanyType,
                NULL AS CompanyTypeDescription,
                NULL AS BusinessDescription,
                NULL AS EmploymentQty,
                NULL AS IncEmploymentQty,
                NULL AS ISICCode,
                NULL AS Totalclaim,
                NULL AS DebtorCodeType,
                NULL AS DivisionCode,
                NULL AS ProvinceCode,
                NULL AS RegistrationType,
                NULL AS RegistrationNo,
                NULL AS CompanyEngName,
                NULL AS RegistrationDate,
                NULL AS LoanerTotal,
                ISNULL(n.CreateDate, GETDATE()) AS ImportDate,
                NULL AS BusinessStatus,
                NULL AS BusinessStatusDate,
                GETDATE() AS CreateDate,
                1 AS CreateBy,
                GETDATE() AS UpdateDate,
                1 AS UpdateBy,
                0 AS NotSendSMS,
                NULL AS RefMigrateId,
                1 AS IsActive,
                NULL AS Age,
                NULL AS StatusPersonId,
                NULL AS LineID,
                NULL AS DebtorCBSId,
                NULL AS GenderId,
                NULL AS PersonGroupId,
                NULL AS BusinessStatusId,
                NULL AS BusinessTypeId,
                NULL AS CompanyTypeId,
                NULL AS BusinessDescriptionId,
                NULL AS FilingDueDate,
                NULL AS BankFilingDate,
                NULL AS LawOfficeSectionId,
                1 AS ImportType
            FROM #Numbered n;

            SET @InsertedCount = @@ROWCOUNT;
        END

        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 7) update status (no CTE)
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        DECLARE @UpdatedCount INT = 0;

        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #ToUpdate)
        BEGIN
            UPDATE d
            SET d.BusinessStatus = N'Bankruptcy',
                d.BusinessStatusDate = u.StatusDate,
                d.UpdateBy = 1,
                d.UpdateDate = GETDATE(),
                d.DebtorTypeId = COALESCE(u.DebtorTypeId, d.DebtorTypeId)
            FROM dbo.DataDebtor d
            JOIN (
                SELECT
                    tu.card_id AS card_id,
                    tu.DebtorTypeId AS DebtorTypeId,
                    COALESCE(
                        NULLIF(tu.bkr_prot_dd, '1900-01-01'),
                        NULLIF(tu.c_bkr_dd, '1900-01-01'),
                        NULLIF(tu.r_bkr_dd, '1900-01-01'),
                        NULLIF(tu.abs_bkr_dd, '1900-01-01'),
                        NULLIF(tu.r_abs_bkr_dd, '1900-01-01'),
                        NULLIF(tu.c_abs_bkr_dd, '1900-01-01'),
                        NULLIF(tu.a_abs_bkr_dd, '1900-01-01'),
                        NULLIF(tu.e_abs_bkr_dd, '1900-01-01'),
                        NULLIF(tu.close_dd, '1900-01-01'),
                        GETDATE()
                    ) AS StatusDate
                FROM #ToUpdate tu
            ) u
              ON (d.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (u.card_id COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT);

            SET @UpdatedCount = @@ROWCOUNT;
        END

        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 8) insert LTDataAssignCaseBankrupcy (skip duplicates)
        --    Duplicate rule: same DebtorRelateId + RedCaseNo -> skip
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        DECLARE @InsertedAssignCount INT = 0;

        SELECT DISTINCT
            d.DebtorId AS DebtorRelateId,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(m.caseno)) AS RedCaseNo,
            LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(m.pname)), 200) AS PName,
            m.CreateDate AS ImportDate,
            TRY_CONVERT(INT, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(m.CIF)), N'')) AS CIFNo,
            m.claim_date AS ClaimPayDate,
            TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(20, 2), COALESCE(m.claim_amount, m.debt_money)) AS DebtBalance,
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(m.bkr_prot_dd, '1900-01-01'),
                NULLIF(m.c_bkr_dd,   '1900-01-01'),
                NULLIF(m.r_bkr_dd,   '1900-01-01'),
                NULLIF(m.abs_bkr_dd, '1900-01-01'),
                NULLIF(m.r_abs_bkr_dd,'1900-01-01'),
                NULLIF(m.c_abs_bkr_dd,'1900-01-01'),
                NULLIF(m.a_abs_bkr_dd,'1900-01-01'),
                NULLIF(m.e_abs_bkr_dd,'1900-01-01'),
                NULLIF(m.close_dd,   '1900-01-01'),
                GETDATE()
            ) AS EffectiveDate
        INTO #Assign
        FROM #MapType m
        JOIN dbo.DataDebtor d
          ON (d.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (m.card_id COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
        WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(m.caseno, N''))), N'') IS NOT NULL;

        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #Assign)
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO dbo.LTDataAssignCaseBankrupcy
            (
                AssignCaseBankrupcyId,
                DebtorRelateId,
                ClaimPayDate,
                DebtBalance,
                LegalUserId,
                LawOfficeUserId,
                CIFNo,
                EffectiveDate,
                AssignCaseTypeId,
                CreateDate,
                UpdateDate,
                CreateBy,
                UpdateBy,
                RedCaseNo,
                PName,
                ImportDate,
                IsAssignLegal,
                IsAssignLawOffice,
                CaseTypeId,
                BankFilingDate,
                OtherFrozenAssDate,
                ExpirationDate,
                IsCreateCase
            )
            SELECT
                CONVERT(NVARCHAR(150), NEWID()) AS AssignCaseBankrupcyId,
                a.DebtorRelateId,
                a.ClaimPayDate,
                a.DebtBalance,
                NULL AS LegalUserId,
                NULL AS LawOfficeUserId,
                a.CIFNo,
                a.EffectiveDate,
                0 AS AssignCaseTypeId,
                GETDATE() AS CreateDate,
                GETDATE() AS UpdateDate,
                1 AS CreateBy,
                1 AS UpdateBy,
                LEFT(a.RedCaseNo, 20) AS RedCaseNo,
                a.PName,
                ISNULL(a.ImportDate, GETDATE()) AS ImportDate,
                0 AS IsAssignLegal,
                0 AS IsAssignLawOffice,
                NULL AS CaseTypeId,
                NULL AS BankFilingDate,
                NULL AS OtherFrozenAssDate,
                NULL AS ExpirationDate,
                0 AS IsCreateCase
            FROM #Assign a
            WHERE NOT EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM dbo.LTDataAssignCaseBankrupcy t
                WHERE (t.DebtorRelateId COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (a.DebtorRelateId COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
                  AND (t.RedCaseNo      COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (a.RedCaseNo      COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
            );

            SET @InsertedAssignCount = @@ROWCOUNT;
        END

        COMMIT TRAN;

        SELECT
            @InsertedCount       AS InsertedDebtorCount,
            @UpdatedCount        AS UpdatedDebtorCount,
            @InsertedAssignCount AS InsertedAssignCaseBankruptcyCount,
            N'Import Bankruptcy (grade=F1): created missing Debtors, updated status to Bankruptcy, and inserted LTDataAssignCaseBankrupcy (skip duplicates by DebtorRelateId+RedCaseNo)' AS Note;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0 ROLLBACK TRAN;

        DECLARE
            @ErrMsg NVARCHAR(4000) = ERROR_MESSAGE(),
            @ErrNo  INT = ERROR_NUMBER(),
            @ErrSev INT = ERROR_SEVERITY(),
            @ErrSta INT = ERROR_STATE(),
            @ErrLin INT = ERROR_LINE();

        RAISERROR(N'[SP_INTERFACE_004_InsertBankruptcy_Customer] %s (Error %d, Severity %d, State %d, Line %d)',
                  @ErrSev, 1, @ErrMsg, @ErrNo, @ErrSev, @ErrSta, @ErrLin);
    END CATCH
END

            x.c_abs_bkr_dd AS c_abs_bkr_dd,
            x.a_abs_bkr_dd AS a_abs_bkr_dd,
            x.e_abs_bkr_dd AS e_abs_bkr_dd,
            x.CreateDate AS CreateDate,
            x.UpdateDate AS UpdateDate,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER(
                PARTITION BY x.card_id
                ORDER BY
                    CASE WHEN x.UpdateDate IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END DESC,
                    x.UpdateDate DESC,
                    CASE WHEN x.CreateDate IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END DESC,
                    x.CreateDate DESC,
                    x.TEMPId DESC
            ) AS rn
        INTO #Latest
        FROM #Src x;

        DELETE FROM #Latest WHERE rn <> 1;

        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2) map debtor type (keep needed fields for AssignCase)
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        SELECT
            l.TEMPId AS TEMPId,
            l.card_id AS card_id,
            l.cus_name AS cus_name,
            l.CIF AS CIF,
            l.CreateDate AS CreateDate,
            l.UpdateDate AS UpdateDate,

            l.bkr_prot_dd AS bkr_prot_dd,
            l.c_bkr_dd AS c_bkr_dd,
            l.r_bkr_dd AS r_bkr_dd,
            l.abs_bkr_dd AS abs_bkr_dd,
            l.r_abs_bkr_dd AS r_abs_bkr_dd,
            l.c_abs_bkr_dd AS c_abs_bkr_dd,
            l.a_abs_bkr_dd AS a_abs_bkr_dd,
            l.e_abs_bkr_dd AS e_abs_bkr_dd,
            l.close_dd AS close_dd,

            l.cus_type_name AS cus_type_name,
            sdt.DebtorTypeId AS DebtorTypeId,

            -- fields for LTDataAssignCaseBankrupcy
            l.caseno AS caseno,
            l.pname AS pname,
            l.claim_date AS claim_date,
            l.claim_amount AS claim_amount,
            l.debt_money AS debt_money
        INTO #MapType
        FROM #Latest l
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemDebtorType sdt
          ON (sdt.DebtorTypeName COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (l.cus_type_name COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT);

        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 3) split create / update
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        SELECT m.*
        INTO #ToCreate
        FROM #MapType m
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.DataDebtor d
            WHERE (d.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (m.card_id COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
        );

        SELECT m.*
        INTO #ToUpdate
        FROM #MapType m
        WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.DataDebtor d
            WHERE (d.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (m.card_id COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
        );

        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 4) running debtor code
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        DECLARE @BEYear INT = YEAR(GETDATE()) + 543;
        DECLARE @YY CHAR(2) = RIGHT(CONVERT(VARCHAR(4), @BEYear), 2);
        DECLARE @Prefix NVARCHAR(3) = CONCAT(N'C', @YY);

        DECLARE @MaxRun INT;
        SELECT @MaxRun = MAX(TRY_CONVERT(INT, RIGHT(DebtorCode, 5)))
        FROM dbo.DataDebtor WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
        WHERE (DebtorCode COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) LIKE CONCAT(@Prefix, N'[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]');

        IF @MaxRun IS NULL SET @MaxRun = 0;
        IF @MaxRun >= 99999
        BEGIN
            THROW 50001, 'DebtorCode running number for current BE year has reached 99999.', 1;
        END;

        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 5) numbering for create
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        SELECT
            tc.TEMPId AS TEMPId,
            tc.card_id AS card_id,
            tc.cus_name AS cus_name,
            tc.CIF AS CIF,
            tc.CreateDate AS CreateDate,
            tc.DebtorTypeId AS DebtorTypeId,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY tc.card_id) AS rn_order,
            @MaxRun + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY tc.card_id) AS NextRun
        INTO #Numbered
        FROM #ToCreate tc;

        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 6) insert DataDebtor
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        DECLARE @InsertedCount INT = 0;

        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #Numbered)
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO dbo.DataDebtor
            (
                DebtorCode, DebtorTypeId, TitleId, FirstName, LastName, DebtorName,
                CardTypeId, CardNumber, CompanyNameEN, BirthDate, FixedAssetValue, DebtorId,
                OldSection, IDCard, RefCode, ContactName, Email, CntPhoneNumber, CntMobileNumber, CntFaxNumber,
                DefaultAddressId, Note, BusinessType, BusinessTypeName, CompanyType, CompanyTypeDescription, BusinessDescription,
                EmploymentQty, IncEmploymentQty, ISICCode, Totalclaim, DebtorCodeType, DivisionCode, ProvinceCode,
                RegistrationType, RegistrationNo, CompanyEngName, RegistrationDate, LoanerTotal, ImportDate,
                BusinessStatus, BusinessStatusDate, CreateDate, CreateBy, UpdateDate, UpdateBy, NotSendSMS, RefMigrateId,
                IsActive, Age, StatusPersonId, LineID, DebtorCBSId, GenderId, PersonGroupId, BusinessStatusId, BusinessTypeId,
                CompanyTypeId, BusinessDescriptionId, FilingDueDate, BankFilingDate, LawOfficeSectionId, ImportType
            )
            SELECT
                CONCAT(@Prefix, RIGHT(CONCAT(N'00000', CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), n.NextRun)), 5)) AS DebtorCode,
                n.DebtorTypeId AS DebtorTypeId,
                NULL AS TitleId,
                NULL AS FirstName,
                NULL AS LastName,
                LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(n.cus_name)), 500) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS DebtorName,
                NULL AS CardTypeId,
                LEFT(n.card_id, 20) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS CardNumber,
                NULL AS CompanyNameEN,
                NULL AS BirthDate,
                NULL AS FixedAssetValue,
                CONVERT(NVARCHAR(150), NEWID()) AS DebtorId,
                NULL AS OldSection,
                LEFT(n.card_id, 20) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS IDCard,
                LEFT(ISNULL(n.CIF, N''), 30) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS RefCode,
                NULL AS ContactName,
                NULL AS Email,
                NULL AS CntPhoneNumber,
                NULL AS CntMobileNumber,
                NULL AS CntFaxNumber,
                NULL AS DefaultAddressId,
                NULL AS Note,
                NULL AS BusinessType,
                NULL AS BusinessTypeName,
                NULL AS CompanyType,
                NULL AS CompanyTypeDescription,
                NULL AS BusinessDescription,
                NULL AS EmploymentQty,
                NULL AS IncEmploymentQty,
                NULL AS ISICCode,
                NULL AS Totalclaim,
                NULL AS DebtorCodeType,
                NULL AS DivisionCode,
                NULL AS ProvinceCode,
                NULL AS RegistrationType,
                NULL AS RegistrationNo,
                NULL AS CompanyEngName,
                NULL AS RegistrationDate,
                NULL AS LoanerTotal,
                ISNULL(n.CreateDate, GETDATE()) AS ImportDate,
                NULL AS BusinessStatus,
                NULL AS BusinessStatusDate,
                GETDATE() AS CreateDate,
                1 AS CreateBy,
                GETDATE() AS UpdateDate,
                1 AS UpdateBy,
                0 AS NotSendSMS,
                NULL AS RefMigrateId,
                1 AS IsActive,
                NULL AS Age,
                NULL AS StatusPersonId,
                NULL AS LineID,
                NULL AS DebtorCBSId,
                NULL AS GenderId,
                NULL AS PersonGroupId,
                NULL AS BusinessStatusId,
                NULL AS BusinessTypeId,
                NULL AS CompanyTypeId,
                NULL AS BusinessDescriptionId,
                NULL AS FilingDueDate,
                NULL AS BankFilingDate,
                NULL AS LawOfficeSectionId,
                1 AS ImportType
            FROM #Numbered n;

            SET @InsertedCount = @@ROWCOUNT;
        END

        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 7) update status (no CTE)
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        DECLARE @UpdatedCount INT = 0;

        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #ToUpdate)
        BEGIN
            UPDATE d
            SET d.BusinessStatus = N'Bankruptcy',
                d.BusinessStatusDate = u.StatusDate,
                d.UpdateBy = 1,
                d.UpdateDate = GETDATE(),
                d.DebtorTypeId = COALESCE(u.DebtorTypeId, d.DebtorTypeId)
            FROM dbo.DataDebtor d
            JOIN (
                SELECT
                    tu.card_id AS card_id,
                    tu.DebtorTypeId AS DebtorTypeId,
                    COALESCE(
                        NULLIF(tu.bkr_prot_dd, '1900-01-01'),
                        NULLIF(tu.c_bkr_dd, '1900-01-01'),
                        NULLIF(tu.r_bkr_dd, '1900-01-01'),
                        NULLIF(tu.abs_bkr_dd, '1900-01-01'),
                        NULLIF(tu.r_abs_bkr_dd, '1900-01-01'),
                        NULLIF(tu.c_abs_bkr_dd, '1900-01-01'),
                        NULLIF(tu.a_abs_bkr_dd, '1900-01-01'),
                        NULLIF(tu.e_abs_bkr_dd, '1900-01-01'),
                        NULLIF(tu.close_dd, '1900-01-01'),
                        GETDATE()
                    ) AS StatusDate
                FROM #ToUpdate tu
            ) u
              ON (d.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (u.card_id COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT);

            SET @UpdatedCount = @@ROWCOUNT;
        END

        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 8) insert LTDataAssignCaseBankrupcy (skip duplicates)
        --    Duplicate rule: same DebtorRelateId + RedCaseNo -> skip
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        DECLARE @InsertedAssignCount INT = 0;

        SELECT DISTINCT
            d.DebtorId AS DebtorRelateId,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(m.caseno)) AS RedCaseNo,
            LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(m.pname)), 200) AS PName,
            m.CreateDate AS ImportDate,
            TRY_CONVERT(INT, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(m.CIF)), N'')) AS CIFNo,
            m.claim_date AS ClaimPayDate,
            TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(20, 2), COALESCE(m.claim_amount, m.debt_money)) AS DebtBalance,
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(m.bkr_prot_dd, '1900-01-01'),
                NULLIF(m.c_bkr_dd,   '1900-01-01'),
                NULLIF(m.r_bkr_dd,   '1900-01-01'),
                NULLIF(m.abs_bkr_dd, '1900-01-01'),
                NULLIF(m.r_abs_bkr_dd,'1900-01-01'),
                NULLIF(m.c_abs_bkr_dd,'1900-01-01'),
                NULLIF(m.a_abs_bkr_dd,'1900-01-01'),
                NULLIF(m.e_abs_bkr_dd,'1900-01-01'),
                NULLIF(m.close_dd,   '1900-01-01'),
                GETDATE()
            ) AS EffectiveDate
        INTO #Assign
        FROM #MapType m
        JOIN dbo.DataDebtor d
          ON (d.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (m.card_id COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
        WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(m.caseno, N''))), N'') IS NOT NULL;

        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #Assign)
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO dbo.LTDataAssignCaseBankrupcy
            (
                AssignCaseBankrupcyId,
                DebtorRelateId,
                ClaimPayDate,
                DebtBalance,
                LegalUserId,
                LawOfficeUserId,
                CIFNo,
                EffectiveDate,
                AssignCaseTypeId,
                CreateDate,
                UpdateDate,
                CreateBy,
                UpdateBy,
                RedCaseNo,
                PName,
                ImportDate,
                IsAssignLegal,
                IsAssignLawOffice,
                CaseTypeId,
                BankFilingDate,
                OtherFrozenAssDate,
                ExpirationDate,
                IsCreateCase
            )
            SELECT
                CONVERT(NVARCHAR(150), NEWID()) AS AssignCaseBankrupcyId,
                a.DebtorRelateId,
                a.ClaimPayDate,
                a.DebtBalance,
                NULL AS LegalUserId,
                NULL AS LawOfficeUserId,
                a.CIFNo,
                a.EffectiveDate,
                0 AS AssignCaseTypeId,
                GETDATE() AS CreateDate,
                GETDATE() AS UpdateDate,
                1 AS CreateBy,
                1 AS UpdateBy,
                LEFT(a.RedCaseNo, 20) AS RedCaseNo,
                a.PName,
                ISNULL(a.ImportDate, GETDATE()) AS ImportDate,
                0 AS IsAssignLegal,
                0 AS IsAssignLawOffice,
                NULL AS CaseTypeId,
                NULL AS BankFilingDate,
                NULL AS OtherFrozenAssDate,
                NULL AS ExpirationDate,
                0 AS IsCreateCase
            FROM #Assign a
            WHERE NOT EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM dbo.LTDataAssignCaseBankrupcy t
                WHERE (t.DebtorRelateId COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (a.DebtorRelateId COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
                  AND (t.RedCaseNo      COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (a.RedCaseNo      COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
            );

            SET @InsertedAssignCount = @@ROWCOUNT;
        END

        COMMIT TRAN;

        SELECT
            @InsertedCount       AS InsertedDebtorCount,
            @UpdatedCount        AS UpdatedDebtorCount,
            @InsertedAssignCount AS InsertedAssignCaseBankruptcyCount,
            N'Import Bankruptcy (grade=F1): created missing Debtors, updated status to Bankruptcy, and inserted LTDataAssignCaseBankrupcy (skip duplicates by DebtorRelateId+RedCaseNo)' AS Note;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0 ROLLBACK TRAN;

        DECLARE
            @ErrMsg NVARCHAR(4000) = ERROR_MESSAGE(),
            @ErrNo  INT = ERROR_NUMBER(),
            @ErrSev INT = ERROR_SEVERITY(),
            @ErrSta INT = ERROR_STATE(),
            @ErrLin INT = ERROR_LINE();

        RAISERROR(N'[SP_INTERFACE_004_InsertBankruptcy_Debtor] %s (Error %d, Severity %d, State %d, Line %d)',
                  @ErrSev, 1, @ErrMsg, @ErrNo, @ErrSev, @ErrSta, @ErrLin);
    END CATCH
END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_005_InsertBorrowerAddressClaim]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    -- Ensure ImportType exists on DataDebtorContact
    IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.DataDebtorContact', 'ImportType') IS NULL
    BEGIN
        ALTER TABLE dbo.DataDebtorContact
        ADD ImportType INT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT DF_DataDebtorContact_ImportType DEFAULT (1) WITH VALUES;
    END;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRAN;

        ;WITH Raw AS
        (
            SELECT
                T.TEMPId,
                T.LGNO,
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(T.BorrowerAddressNum)), '')           AS AddrNo,
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(T.BorrowerAddressBuilding)), '')      AS PlaceName,
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(T.BorrowerAddressMoo)), '')           AS Moo,
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(T.BorrowerAddressSoi)), '')           AS Soi,
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(T.BorrowerAddressRoad)), '')          AS Road,
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(T.BorrowerAddressProvince)), '')      AS ProvinceCodeSrc,    -- SystemProvinceMaster.Code
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(T.BorrowerAddressBoundary)), '')      AS DistrictCodeSrc,    -- SystemDistrictMaster.Code
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(T.BorrowerAddressDistrict)), '')      AS SubDistrictCodeSrc, -- SystemSubDistrictMaster.Code
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(T.BorrowerAddressZipcode)), '')       AS ZipRaw,
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(T.BorrowerAddressPhoneNumber)), '')   AS Phone,
                T.SystemCreate,
                T.ImportDate,
                -- ใช้ DebtorCode จาก TEMPMapLGCBS ไปหา DebtorId ที่ DataDebtor
                DD.DebtorId
            FROM dbo.TEMPBorrowerAddressClaim T
            INNER JOIN dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS M
                ON M.LGNo = T.LGNO
            INNER JOIN dbo.DataDebtor DD
                ON DD.DebtorCode = M.DebtorCode
        ),
        Mapped AS
        (
            SELECT
                R.*,
                P.ProvinceId      AS P_ProvinceId,
                D.DistrictId      AS D_DistrictId,
                D.ProvinceId      AS D_ProvinceId,
                SDM.SubDistrictId AS SDM_SubDistrictId,
                SDM.DistrictId    AS SDM_DistrictId,
                SDM.ProvinceId    AS SDM_ProvinceId,
                SDM.PostCode      AS SDM_PostCode
            FROM Raw R
            LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemProvinceMaster      P   ON P.Code = R.ProvinceCodeSrc
            LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemDistrictMaster      D   ON D.Code = R.DistrictCodeSrc
            LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemSubDistrictMaster   SDM ON SDM.Code = R.SubDistrictCodeSrc
        ),
        Resolved AS
        (
            SELECT
                M.*,
                COALESCE(M.P_ProvinceId, M.SDM_ProvinceId, M.D_ProvinceId) AS ProvinceId_Resolved,
                COALESCE(M.D_DistrictId, M.SDM_DistrictId)                 AS DistrictId_Resolved,
                M.SDM_SubDistrictId                                        AS SubDistrictId_Resolved,
                CASE WHEN M.ZipRaw IS NOT NULL THEN LEFT(M.ZipRaw, 5)
                     WHEN M.SDM_PostCode IS NOT NULL THEN LEFT(M.SDM_PostCode, 5)
                     ELSE NULL END AS PostalCode_Resolved
            FROM Mapped M
        )

        -- 1) Insert Address (DebtorAddressTypeId = 1) กันซ้ำ
        INSERT INTO dbo.DataDebtorAddress
        (
            DebtorCode,
            DebtorAddressTypeId,
            AddressNumber,
            PlaceName,
            Moo,
            Soi,
            Road,
            ProvinceId,
            SubDistrictId,
            DistrictId,
            PostalCode,
            DebtorContactChannelId,
            IsDefault,
            CreateBy,
            CreateDate,
            UpdateBy,
            UpdateDate,
            DebtorAddressId,
            DebtorId,
            Telephone,
            Fax,
            Mobile,
            Email,
            LineID,
            DebtorAddressCBSId,
            ContactName,
            ImportType
        )
        SELECT
            NULL AS DebtorCode,                 -- ถ้าต้องใช้จริง สามารถ JOIN DataDebtor เพิ่มมาได้
            1   AS DebtorAddressTypeId,         -- ตามเงื่อนไข
            R.AddrNo,
            R.PlaceName,
            R.Moo,
            R.Soi,
            R.Road,
            R.ProvinceId_Resolved,
            R.SubDistrictId_Resolved,
            R.DistrictId_Resolved,
            R.PostalCode_Resolved,
            NULL,                               -- ไม่บังคับในโจทย์
            CAST(0 AS bit) AS IsDefault,
            TRY_CAST(R.SystemCreate AS INT),
            ISNULL(R.ImportDate, GETDATE()),
            NULL,
            NULL,
            CONVERT(nvarchar(150), NEWID()) AS DebtorAddressId,
            R.DebtorId,
            NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
            R.TEMPId,
            NULL,
            1
        FROM Resolved R
        WHERE NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.DataDebtorAddress D
            WHERE D.DebtorId = R.DebtorId
              AND D.DebtorAddressTypeId = 1
              AND ISNULL(D.AddressNumber, '')   = ISNULL(R.AddrNo, '')
              AND ISNULL(D.PlaceName,   '')     = ISNULL(R.PlaceName, '')
              AND ISNULL(D.Moo,         '')     = ISNULL(R.Moo, '')
              AND ISNULL(D.Soi,         '')     = ISNULL(R.Soi, '')
              AND ISNULL(D.Road,        '')     = ISNULL(R.Road, '')
              AND ISNULL(D.PostalCode,  '')     = ISNULL(R.PostalCode_Resolved, '')
              AND ISNULL(D.ProvinceId,  0)      = ISNULL(R.ProvinceId_Resolved, 0)
              AND ISNULL(D.DistrictId,  0)      = ISNULL(R.DistrictId_Resolved, 0)
              AND ISNULL(D.SubDistrictId, 0)    = ISNULL(R.SubDistrictId_Resolved, 0)
        );

        -- 2) Insert Contact (มีเบอร์เท่านั้น) กันซ้ำต่อ Debtor + Type/Channel + เบอร์
        INSERT INTO dbo.DataDebtorContact
        (
            DebtorId,
            ContactType,
            DebtorContactChannelId,
            [ContactValue],          -- ถ้าสคีมาจริงใช้ชื่อคอลัมน์อื่น (เช่น PhoneNumber) ให้เปลี่ยนตรงนี้และใน EXISTS
            ImportType,
            CreateDate
        )
        SELECT
            R.DebtorId,
            1 AS ContactType,
            2 AS DebtorContactChannelId,
            R.Phone AS [ContactValue],
            1 AS ImportType,
            ISNULL(R.ImportDate, GETDATE())
        FROM Resolved R
        WHERE R.Phone IS NOT NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.DataDebtorContact C
              WHERE C.DebtorId = R.DebtorId
                AND C.ContactType = 1
                AND C.DebtorContactChannelId = 2
                AND C.[ContactValue] = R.Phone
          );

        COMMIT TRAN;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0 ROLLBACK TRAN;

        DECLARE @ErrMsg nvarchar(4000) = ERROR_MESSAGE(),
                @ErrNo  int = ERROR_NUMBER(),
                @ErrSev int = ERROR_SEVERITY(),
                @ErrSt  int = ERROR_STATE(),
                @ErrLine int = ERROR_LINE();
        RAISERROR(N'[SP_INTERFACE_005_InsertBorrowerAddressClaim] failed (%d, Sev %d, State %d, Line %d): %s',
                  @ErrSev, 1, @ErrNo, @ErrSev, @ErrSt, @ErrLine, @ErrMsg);
        RETURN;
    END CATCH
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_006_InsertDataClaimCBS]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRAN;

        ;WITH Src AS
        (
            SELECT
                t.*,
                SeqNorm = LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(t.T45Seq_Pay_LG_Claim, N''))) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
                rn = ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                        PARTITION BY LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(t.T45Seq_Pay_LG_Claim, N''))) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
                        ORDER BY ISNULL(t.T45Date_Update, t.T45Date_Create) DESC,
                                 ISNULL(t.ImportDate, SYSDATETIME()) DESC,
                                 t.TEMPId
                )
            FROM dbo.TEMPDataClaimCBS t
            WHERE t.TypeName COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT = N'จ่ายค่าประกันชดเชย'
        )
        INSERT INTO dbo.DataClaimCBS
        (
            DataClaimCBSId,
            LGNo,
            CIF,
            DebtorCardCode,
            SeqNo,
            DocDate,
            PayDate,
            CampaiqnCode,
            RefDocNo,
            TypeCode,
            TypeName,
            CourtFee,
            CourtFeePay,
            LawyerFee,
            LawyerFeePay,
            BFCapital,
            Capital,
            CapitalPay,
            BalanceCapital,
            StCalIntDate,
            EndCalIntDate,
            PeriodDateCall,
            CalIntDay,
            IntRate,
            BFAccruedInt,
            IntPayable,
            IntPay,
            AccruedInt,
            OtherExpense,
            OtherExpensePay,
            T45Date_Create,
            T45User_Create,
            T45Date_Update,
            T45User_Update,
            PaySeq,
            ProjectSeq,
            T45Seq_Pay_LG_Claim,
            SystemCreate,
            ImportDate
        )
        SELECT
            CONVERT(NVARCHAR(36), NEWID()),
            s.LGNo,
            s.CIF,
            s.DebtorCardCode,
            s.SeqNo,
            s.DocDate,
            s.PayDate,
            s.CampaiqnCode,
            s.RefDocNo,
            s.TypeCode,
            s.TypeName,
            s.CourtFee,
            s.CourtFeePay,
            s.LawyerFee,
            s.LawyerFeePay,
            s.BFCapital,
            s.Capital,
            s.CapitalPay,
            s.BalanceCapital,
            s.StCalIntDate,
            s.EndCalIntDate,
            s.PeriodDateCall,
            s.CalIntDay,
            s.IntRate,
            s.BFAccruedInt,
            s.IntPayable,
            s.IntPay,
            s.AccruedInt,
            s.OtherExpense,
            s.OtherExpensePay,
            s.T45Date_Create,
            s.T45User_Create,
            s.T45Date_Update,
            s.T45User_Update,
            s.PaySeq,
            s.ProjectSeq,
            s.T45Seq_Pay_LG_Claim,
            s.SystemCreate,
            s.ImportDate
        FROM Src s
        WHERE s.rn = 1
          AND NOT EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.DataClaimCBS d
              WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(d.T45Seq_Pay_LG_Claim, N''))) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT = s.SeqNorm
          );

        DECLARE @InsertedCount INT = @@ROWCOUNT;

        COMMIT;

        SELECT
            1 AS IsSuccess,
            @InsertedCount AS InsertedCount,
            N'Insert from TEMPDataClaimCBS → DataClaimCBS (TypeName=จ่ายค่าประกันชดเชย, de-dup by T45Seq_Pay_LG_Claim)' AS Message;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK;

        SELECT
            0 AS IsSuccess,
            ERROR_NUMBER()  AS ErrorNumber,
            ERROR_SEVERITY() AS ErrorSeverity,
            ERROR_STATE()   AS ErrorState,
            ERROR_LINE()    AS ErrorLine,
            ERROR_MESSAGE() AS ErrorMessage;
    END CATCH
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_007_InsertDataFeeBeforeCBS]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    /*
        เงื่อนไขหลัก:
        - ใช้ T.LGNO join กับ DataLG เพื่อได้ L.LGId
        - ใส่ AS ทุกฟิลด์ในฝั่ง SELECT
        - กันซ้ำพื้นฐานด้วย NOT EXISTS (เทียบ LGId + FeeAmount + ImportDate)
        - ไม่แก้ schema ของ TEMPDataFeeBeforeCBS
    */

    INSERT INTO dbo.DataLGFee
    (
          LGId
        , FeeAmount
        , PayDate
        , ImportDate
        , CreateBy
        , CreateDate
        , UpdateBy
        , UpdateDate
        , CIFNumber
        , IsFinish
        , LGFeeCBSId
    )
    SELECT
          L.LGId                                               AS LGId
        , CAST(T.Fee_Amount AS DECIMAL(20, 2))                AS FeeAmount
        , NULL                                                AS PayDate
        , T.ImportDate                                        AS ImportDate
        , NULL                                                AS CreateBy          -- ปรับเป็นค่าที่องค์กรต้องการได้
        , GETDATE()                                           AS CreateDate
        , NULL                                                AS UpdateBy
        , NULL                                                AS UpdateDate
        , NULL                                                AS CIFNumber
        , CAST(0 AS BIT)                                      AS IsFinish
        , NULL                                                AS LGFeeCBSId
    FROM dbo.TEMPDataFeeBeforeCBS AS T
    INNER JOIN dbo.DataLG AS L
        ON L.LGNo = T.LGNO
    WHERE NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.DataLGFee AS F
        WHERE F.LGId = L.LGId
          AND F.FeeAmount = CAST(T.Fee_Amount AS DECIMAL(20, 2))
          AND (
                 (F.ImportDate IS NULL AND T.ImportDate IS NULL)
                 OR F.ImportDate = T.ImportDate
              )
    );
END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_008_InsertDataLG]
AS
BEGIN
   SET NOCOUNT ON;
SET XACT_ABORT ON;

BEGIN TRY
    BEGIN TRAN;

    -- สำหรับนับผลลัพธ์
    DECLARE @Inserted TABLE (LGNo NVARCHAR(50));
    DECLARE @Updated  TABLE (LGNo NVARCHAR(50));
    DECLARE @SkippedNoBank INT = 0;

    ;WITH Dedup AS
    (
        SELECT
            t.TEMPId,
            t.LGNo,
            t.CIF,
            t.BankCode,
            t.LGDate,
            t.AmountDuty,
            t.AmountDutyCompare,
            t.ClaimPayDate,
            t.ClaimPay,
            t.JudicalProcessCode,
            t.BankGrade,
            t.Grade,
            t.GradeKnowDate,
            t.GradeRecDate,
            t.GradeCompare,
            t.GradeKnowDateCompare,
            t.GradeRecDateCompare,
            t.StatusLG,
            t.StatusDate,
            t.StatusLGCompare,
            t.StatusDateCompare,
            ct.ClaimTypeId as ProjectType,
            cst.ClaimSubTypeId as SubProjectType,
            t.PayCoditionCode,
            t.PayCoditionDetail,
            t.BankBranchCode,
            t.DivisionCode,
            t.ProvinceCode,
            t.UpdateDate,
            t.SystemCreate,
            t.ImportDate,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY t.LGNo
                ORDER BY 
                    CASE WHEN t.UpdateDate IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END DESC,
                    t.UpdateDate DESC,
                    CASE WHEN t.ImportDate IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END DESC,
                    t.ImportDate DESC,
                    t.TEMPId DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM dbo.TEMPDataLGCBSCSV t
		left join SystemClaimTypeMaster ct on ct.ClaimTypeCode = t.ProjectType collate thai_ci_ai
		left join SystemClaimSubTypeMaster cst on cst.ClaimTypeId = ct.ClaimTypeId and cst.ClaimSubTypeCode = t.SubProjectType
    ),
    MapBank AS
    (
        SELECT
            s.*,
            b.BankId AS MapBankId
        FROM Dedup s
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemBankMaster b
          ON RIGHT('000' + ISNULL(s.BankCode,''), 3) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
           = RIGHT('000' + ISNULL(b.BankCode,''), 3) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
    )
    -- ❗ Materialize CTE เป็น temp table เพื่อใช้ซ้ำหลายคำสั่ง
    SELECT
        m.TEMPId                                        AS LGCBSId,
        m.CIF                                           AS CIFNo,
        m.LGNo      COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT            AS LGNo,
        m.Grade                                         AS Grade,
        TRY_CONVERT(decimal(18,2), m.AmountDuty)        AS ClaimAmount,
        TRY_CONVERT(decimal(18,2), m.AmountDutyCompare) AS ClaimAmountCurrent,
        m.LGDate                                        AS LGDate,
        m.ClaimPayDate                                  AS ClaimDate,
        TRY_CONVERT(decimal(18,2), m.ClaimPay)          AS ClaimPayAmount,
        TRY_CONVERT(int, m.StatusLG)                    AS StatusId,
        m.StatusDate                                    AS StatusDate,
        TRY_CONVERT(int, m.ProjectType)                 AS ClaimTypeId,
        TRY_CONVERT(int, m.SubProjectType)              AS ClaimSubTypeId,
        m.MapBankId                                     AS BankId,
        TRY_CONVERT(int, m.BankBranchCode)              AS BankBranchId,
        m.ImportDate                                    AS ImportDate,
        m.UpdateDate                                    AS UpdateDate,
		m.GradeKnowDate,
		m.GradeRecDate
    INTO #Src
    FROM MapBank m
    WHERE m.rn = 1;

    -- แนะนำ index ช่วย join
    CREATE INDEX IX_Src_LGNo ON #Src(LGNo);
    CREATE INDEX IX_Src_BankId ON #Src(BankId);

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 1) UPDATE (ยกเว้น Grade = 'F1')
    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    UPDATE d
        SET 
            d.Grade              = s.Grade,
            d.ClaimAmount        = s.ClaimAmount,
            d.LGDate             = s.LGDate,
            d.ClaimAmountCurrent = s.ClaimAmountCurrent,
            d.ClaimDate          = s.ClaimDate,
            d.ClaimPayAmount     = s.ClaimPayAmount,
            d.StatusId           = s.StatusId,
            d.StatusDate         = s.StatusDate,
            d.ClaimTypeId        = s.ClaimTypeId,
            d.ClaimSubTypeId     = s.ClaimSubTypeId,
            d.BankId             = s.BankId,
            d.BankBranchId       = s.BankBranchId,
            d.ImportDate         = s.ImportDate,
            d.LGCBSId            = s.LGCBSId,
            d.ImportType         = 1,
            d.UpdateBy           = 1,
            d.UpdateDate         = COALESCE(s.UpdateDate, GETDATE()),
			d.GradeKnowDate =		s.GradeKnowDate,
			d.GradeRecDate = s.GradeRecDate
    OUTPUT inserted.LGNo INTO @Updated(LGNo)
    FROM dbo.DATALG d
    INNER JOIN #Src s
        ON d.LGNo COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT = s.LGNo COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
    WHERE s.BankId IS NOT NULL
      AND ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.Grade)),'') <> 'F1'
      --AND ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.Grade)),'') <> 'F1'

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 2) INSERT (หากยังไม่มี LGNo & แมป Bank สำเร็จ)
    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    INSERT INTO dbo.DATALG
    (
        CIFNo, LGNo, Grade, ClaimAmount,
        CreateBy, CreateDate, UpdateBy, UpdateDate,
        LGDate, ClaimAmountCurrent, ClaimDate, ClaimPayAmount,
        StatusId, StatusDate, ClaimTypeId, ClaimSubTypeId,
        BankId, BankBranchId, ImportDate,
        ISICCode, EmploymentQty, IncEmploymentQty, CompanyTypeDescription,
        FixedAssetValue, Income, BusinessSize, LGCBSId, ImportType, GradeKnowDate, GradeRecDate
    )
    OUTPUT inserted.LGNo INTO @Inserted(LGNo)
    SELECT
        s.CIFNo,
        s.LGNo,
        s.Grade,
        s.ClaimAmount,
        1,
        GETDATE(),
        1,
        COALESCE(s.UpdateDate, GETDATE()),
        s.LGDate,
        s.ClaimAmountCurrent,
        s.ClaimDate,
        s.ClaimPayAmount,
        s.StatusId,
        s.StatusDate,
        s.ClaimTypeId,
        s.ClaimSubTypeId,
        s.BankId,
        s.BankBranchId,
        s.ImportDate,
        NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
        s.LGCBSId,
        1,
		s.GradeKnowDate,
		s.GradeRecDate
    FROM #Src s
    WHERE s.BankId IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS
          (SELECT 1
           FROM dbo.DATALG d
           WHERE d.LGNo COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT = s.LGNo COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT);

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 3) นับรายการที่แมป Bank ไม่เจอ (เฉพาะแถวล่าสุดต่อ LGNo)
    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT @SkippedNoBank = COUNT(*)
    FROM (
        SELECT d.LGNo, d.BankCode
        FROM (
            SELECT
                t.LGNo,
                t.BankCode,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.LGNo ORDER BY 
                    CASE WHEN t.UpdateDate IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END DESC,
                    t.UpdateDate DESC,
                    CASE WHEN t.ImportDate IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END DESC,
                    t.ImportDate DESC,
                    t.TEMPId DESC
                ) AS rn
            FROM dbo.TEMPDataLGCBSCSV t
        ) d
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemBankMaster b
          ON RIGHT('000' + ISNULL(d.BankCode,''), 3) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
           = RIGHT('000' + ISNULL(b.BankCode,''), 3) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
        WHERE d.rn = 1
          AND b.BankId IS NULL
    ) AS Unmatched;

    COMMIT TRAN;

    SELECT 
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @Inserted) AS InsertedCount,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @Updated)  AS UpdatedCount,
        @SkippedNoBank                   AS Skipped_NoBank_Match,
        N'Upsert สำเร็จ: INSERT ถ้า LGNo ใหม่, UPDATE ถ้า LGNo ซ้ำ (ยกเว้น Grade = ''F1'') และทำเฉพาะเคสที่แมป Bank สำเร็จ' AS Note;
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
    IF XACT_STATE() <> 0 ROLLBACK TRAN;
    THROW;
END CATCH

END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_008_InsertDataLG_Backup]
AS
BEGIN

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRAN;

        -- เก็บ LGNo ที่ insert สำเร็จ
        DECLARE @Inserted TABLE (LGNo NVARCHAR(50));

        ;WITH Dedup AS
        (
            SELECT
                t.TEMPId,
                t.LGNo,
                t.CIF,
                t.BankCode,
                t.LGDate,
                t.AmountDuty,
                t.AmountDutyCompare,
                t.ClaimPayDate,
                t.ClaimPay,
                t.JudicalProcessCode,
                t.BankGrade,
                t.Grade,
                t.GradeKnowDate,

                t.GradeCompare,

                t.StatusLGCompare,

                t.ProjectType,

                    PARTITION BY t.LGNo

                        CASE WHEN t.UpdateDate IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END DESC,
                        t.UpdateDate DESC,
                        CASE WHEN t.ImportDate IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END DESC,
                        t.ImportDate DESC,
                        t.TEMPId DESC
                ) AS rn
            FROM dbo.TEMPDataLGCBSCSV t
        ),
        -- แมป BankId โดยเทียบ BankCode (zero-pad 3 หลัก) กับ Master
        MapBank AS

            LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemBankMaster b
              ON RIGHT('000' + ISNULL(s.BankCode,''), 3) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
               = RIGHT('000' + ISNULL(b.BankCode,''), 3) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
        )
        INSERT INTO dbo.DATALG
        (

            LGNo,
            Grade,
            ClaimAmount,
            CreateBy,
            CreateDate,
            UpdateBy,
            UpdateDate,
            LGDate,
            ClaimAmountCurrent,
            ClaimDate,
            ClaimPayAmount,
            StatusId,
            StatusDate,
            ClaimTypeId,
            ClaimSubTypeId,
            BankId,
            BankBranchId,
            ImportDate,
            ISICCode,
            EmploymentQty,
            IncEmploymentQty,
            CompanyTypeDescription,
            FixedAssetValue,
            Income,
            BusinessSize,
            LGCBSId,
            ImportType
        )
        OUTPUT inserted.LGNo INTO @Inserted(LGNo)
        SELECT
            m.CIF                                         AS CIFNo,
            m.LGNo COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
            m.Grade,
            TRY_CONVERT(decimal(18,2), m.AmountDuty)         AS ClaimAmount,
            1                                                 AS CreateBy,
            GETDATE()                                         AS CreateDate,
            1                                                 AS UpdateBy,
            m.UpdateDate                                      AS UpdateDate,
            m.LGDate                                          AS LGDate,
            TRY_CONVERT(decimal(18,2), m.AmountDutyCompare)   AS ClaimAmountCurrent,
            m.ClaimPayDate                                    AS ClaimDate,
            TRY_CONVERT(decimal(18,2), m.ClaimPay)            AS ClaimPayAmount,
            TRY_CONVERT(int, m.StatusLG)                      AS StatusId,
            m.StatusDate                                      AS StatusDate,
            TRY_CONVERT(int, m.ProjectType)                   AS ClaimTypeId,
            TRY_CONVERT(int, m.SubProjectType)                AS ClaimSubTypeId,
            m.MapBankId                                       AS BankId,              -- ใช้ BankId จาก Master
            TRY_CONVERT(int, m.BankBranchCode)                AS BankBranchId,        -- ถ้ามี FK จริง ไว้ค่อยเพิ่ม JOIN
            m.ImportDate                                      AS ImportDate,
            NULL                                              AS ISICCode,
            NULL                                              AS EmploymentQty,
            NULL                                              AS IncEmploymentQty,
            NULL                                              AS CompanyTypeDescription,
            NULL                                              AS FixedAssetValue,
            NULL                                              AS Income,
            NULL                                              AS BusinessSize,
            m.TEMPId                                          AS LGCBSId,
            1                                                 AS ImportType
        FROM MapBank m
        WHERE m.rn = 1
          AND m.MapBankId IS NOT NULL            -- แทรกเฉพาะเคสที่หา BankId ได้จริง (กัน FK ล้ม)
          AND NOT EXISTS
              (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM dbo.DATALG d
                  WHERE d.LGNo COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT = m.LGNo COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
              );

        DECLARE @InsertedCount INT = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @Inserted);

        -- รายงานรายการที่ข้ามเพราะหา Bank ไม่เจอ (เพื่อ debug/ตามเก็บ)
        ;WITH Dedup AS
        (
            SELECT
                t.TEMPId,
                t.LGNo,
                t.BankCode,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.LGNo ORDER BY 
                    CASE WHEN t.UpdateDate IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END DESC,
                    t.UpdateDate DESC,
                    CASE WHEN t.ImportDate IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END DESC,
                    t.ImportDate DESC,
                    t.TEMPId DESC
                ) AS rn
            FROM dbo.TEMPDataLGCBSCSV t
        ),
        Unmatched AS
        (
            SELECT d.LGNo, d.BankCode
            FROM Dedup d
            LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemBankMaster b
              ON RIGHT('000' + ISNULL(d.BankCode,''), 3) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
               = RIGHT('000' + ISNULL(b.BankCode,''), 3) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
            WHERE d.rn = 1
              AND b.BankId IS NULL
        )
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS Skipped_NoBank_Match
        FROM Unmatched;

        COMMIT TRAN;

        SELECT @InsertedCount AS InsertedCount, N'ย้ายข้อมูลสำเร็จ (เฉพาะ LGNo ใหม่ และ Bank แมปสำเร็จ)' AS Note;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK TRAN;

        THROW;
    END CATCH
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_009_InsertReduceCBS]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
SET XACT_ABORT ON;

BEGIN TRY
    BEGIN TRAN;

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 1) เลือกแถวล่าสุดต่อ LGNo จาก TEMP (กันซ้ำ) + บังคับคอลลิชัน
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#LatestReduce') IS NOT NULL
        DROP TABLE #LatestReduce;

    SELECT
        S.LGNo COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT      AS LGNo,
        S.Reduce_Amount
    INTO #LatestReduce
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            T.*,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY T.LGNo
                ORDER BY T.TEMPId DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM dbo.TEMPDataReduceCBS AS T
        WHERE T.LGNo IS NOT NULL
    ) AS S
    WHERE S.rn = 1;

    -- ช่วยเรื่องประสิทธิภาพเวลา join/merge
    CREATE INDEX IX_LatestReduce_LGNo ON #LatestReduce(LGNo);

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 2) MERGE: อัปเดตถ้ามี LGNo แล้ว / แทรกถ้ายังไม่มี
    --    บังคับคอลลิชันที่เงื่อนไขเทียบ LGNo
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    ;WITH Src AS
    (
        SELECT L.LGNo, L.Reduce_Amount
        FROM #LatestReduce AS L
    )
    MERGE dbo.DataReduceCBS AS D
    USING Src AS S
        ON D.LGNo COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT = S.LGNo COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
        UPDATE SET
            D.Reduce_Amount = S.Reduce_Amount
    WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN
        INSERT (DataReduceCBSId, LGNo, Reduce_Amount)
        VALUES (CONVERT(nvarchar(100), NEWID()),
                S.LGNo, S.Reduce_Amount);

    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 3) ลบรายการที่ประมวลผลแล้วออกจาก TEMP (บังคับคอลลิชันตอนเทียบ)
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    DELETE T
    FROM dbo.TEMPDataReduceCBS AS T
    INNER JOIN #LatestReduce AS L
        ON T.LGNo COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT = L.LGNo COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT;

    COMMIT TRAN;
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
    IF XACT_STATE() <> 0 ROLLBACK TRAN;
    THROW;
END CATCH

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_010_InsertDebtorBusinessAddressCBS]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRAN;

        -----------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 1) Prepare Business Address temp
        -----------------------------------------------------------------------
        SELECT DISTINCT
            m.DebtorCode AS DebtorCode,
            7 AS DebtorAddressTypeId,
            t.BusinessAddrNum AS AddressNumber,
            t.BusinessAddrBuilding AS PlaceName,
            t.BusinessMoo AS Moo,
            t.BusinessAddrSoi AS Soi,
            t.BusinessAddrRoad AS Road,
            p.ProvinceId AS ProvinceId,
            s.SubDistrictId AS SubDistrictId,
            d.DistrictId AS DistrictId,
            LEFT(ISNULL(t.BusinessAddrZipcode, ''), 5) AS PostalCode,
            2 AS DebtorContactChannelId,
            CAST(1 AS bit) AS IsDefault,
            1 AS CreateBy,
            GETDATE() AS CreateDate,
            1 AS UpdateBy,
            GETDATE() AS UpdateDate,
            ddeb.DebtorId AS DebtorId,
            t.BusinessPhoneNumber AS Telephone,
            t.BusinessFaxNumber AS Fax,
            t.BusinessMobileNumber AS Mobile,
            t.BusinessEmail AS Email,
            NULL AS LineID,
            NULL AS DebtorAddressCBSId,
            NULL AS ContactName,
            1 AS ImportType
        INTO #tmp_DataDebtorAddress
        FROM [dbo].[TEMPDebtorBusinessAddressCBS] t
        LEFT JOIN [dbo].[SystemProvinceMaster] p
            ON p.TCGProvinceCode = t.BusinessAddrProvince
        LEFT JOIN [dbo].[SystemDistrictMaster] d
            ON d.Name COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
             = t.BusinessAddrBoundary COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
           AND d.ProvinceId = p.ProvinceId
        LEFT JOIN [dbo].[SystemSubDistrictMaster] s
            ON s.Name COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
             = t.BusinessAddrDistrict COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
           AND s.DistrictId = d.DistrictId
           AND s.DistrictId = d.DistrictId
        LEFT JOIN [dbo].[TEMPMapLGCBS] m
            ON m.CIFNo = t.CIF COLLATE thai_ci_ai
           AND m.DebtorTypeId = 1
        LEFT JOIN [dbo].[DataDebtor] ddeb
            ON ddeb.DebtorCode = m.DebtorCode COLLATE thai_ci_ai;

        -----------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2) Insert Address with duplicate check
        --    - Dedup in current batch
        --    - Skip if already exists in DataDebtorAddress
        --      only when existing record is DebtorAddressTypeId = 7
        -----------------------------------------------------------------------
        ;WITH CTE_ADDR AS
        (
            SELECT
                t.*,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER
                (
                    PARTITION BY
                        t.DebtorId,
                        t.DebtorAddressTypeId,
                        ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(t.AddressNumber)), ''),
                        ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(t.PlaceName)), ''),
                        ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(t.Moo)), ''),
                        ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(t.Soi)), ''),
                        ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(t.Road)), ''),
                        ISNULL(t.ProvinceId, 0),
                        ISNULL(t.DistrictId, 0),
                        ISNULL(t.SubDistrictId, 0),
                        ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(t.PostalCode)), '')
                    ORDER BY t.DebtorCode
                ) AS RN
            FROM #tmp_DataDebtorAddress t
            WHERE t.DebtorId IS NOT NULL
        )
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[DataDebtorAddress]
        (
            [DebtorCode],
            [DebtorAddressTypeId],
            [AddressNumber],
            [PlaceName],
            [Moo],
            [Soi],
            [Road],
            [ProvinceId],
            [SubDistrictId],
            [DistrictId],
            [PostalCode],
            [DebtorContactChannelId],
            [IsDefault],
            [CreateBy],
            [CreateDate],
            [UpdateBy],
            [UpdateDate],
            [DebtorAddressId],
            [DebtorId],
            [Telephone],
            [Fax],
            [Mobile],
            [Email],
            [LineID],
            [DebtorAddressCBSId],
            [ContactName],
            [ImportType]
        )
        SELECT
            a.DebtorCode,
            a.DebtorAddressTypeId,
            a.AddressNumber,
            a.PlaceName,
            a.Moo,
            a.Soi,
            a.Road,
            a.ProvinceId,
            a.SubDistrictId,
            a.DistrictId,
            a.PostalCode,
            a.DebtorContactChannelId,
            a.IsDefault,
            a.CreateBy,
            a.CreateDate,
            a.UpdateBy,
            a.UpdateDate,
            CONVERT(NVARCHAR(150), NEWID()) AS DebtorAddressId,
            a.DebtorId,
            a.Telephone,
            a.Fax,
            a.Mobile,
            a.Email,
            a.LineID,
            a.DebtorAddressCBSId,
            a.ContactName,
            a.ImportType
        FROM CTE_ADDR a
        WHERE a.RN = 1
          AND NOT EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM [dbo].[DataDebtorAddress] x
              WHERE x.DebtorId = a.DebtorId
                AND x.DebtorAddressTypeId = 7
                AND ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(x.AddressNumber)), '') COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
                    = ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.AddressNumber)), '') COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
                AND ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(x.PlaceName)), '') COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
                    = ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.PlaceName)), '') COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
                AND ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(x.Moo)), '') COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
                    = ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.Moo)), '') COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
                AND ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(x.Soi)), '') COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
                    = ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.Soi)), '') COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
                AND ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(x.Road)), '') COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
                    = ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.Road)), '') COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
                AND ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(x.PostalCode)), '') COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
                    = ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.PostalCode)), '') COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
          );

        DROP TABLE #tmp_DataDebtorAddress;

        -----------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 3) Insert Contact : BusinessPhoneNumber / Mobile / Fax / Email
        -----------------------------------------------------------------------
        ;WITH CTE_CONTACT AS
        (
            -------------------------------------------------------------------
            -- TELEPHONE
            -------------------------------------------------------------------
            SELECT
                D.DebtorId,
                1 AS DebtorContactTypeId,
                LTRIM(RTRIM(S.value)) AS DebtorContactValue,
                NULL AS DebtorContactExtension,
                2 AS DebtorContactChannelId,
                1 AS IsDefault,
                0 AS CreateBy,
                GETDATE() AS CreateDate,
                0 AS UpdateBy,
                GETDATE() AS UpdateDate,
                A.TEMPId AS DebtorContactCBSId,
                1 AS ImportType
            FROM [dbo].[TEMPDebtorBusinessAddressCBS] A
            INNER JOIN [dbo].[TEMPMapLGCBS] B
                ON A.CIF = B.CIFNo
               AND B.DebtorTypeId = 1
            INNER JOIN [dbo].[DataDebtor] D
                ON B.DebtorCode = D.DebtorCode
            CROSS APPLY
            (
                SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(value)) AS value
                FROM STRING_SPLIT(REPLACE(REPLACE(A.BusinessPhoneNumber, ';', ','), '/', ','), ',')
            ) S
            WHERE A.BusinessPhoneNumber IS NOT NULL
              AND LTRIM(RTRIM(A.BusinessPhoneNumber)) <> ''
              AND LTRIM(RTRIM(S.value)) <> ''

            UNION ALL

            -------------------------------------------------------------------
            -- MOBILE
            -------------------------------------------------------------------
            SELECT
                D.DebtorId,
                2 AS DebtorContactTypeId,
                LTRIM(RTRIM(S.value)) AS DebtorContactValue,
                NULL AS DebtorContactExtension,
                2 AS DebtorContactChannelId,
                0 AS IsDefault,
                0 AS CreateBy,
                GETDATE() AS CreateDate,
                0 AS UpdateBy,
                GETDATE() AS UpdateDate,
                A.TEMPId AS DebtorContactCBSId,
                1 AS ImportType
            FROM [dbo].[TEMPDebtorBusinessAddressCBS] A
            INNER JOIN [dbo].[TEMPMapLGCBS] B
                ON A.CIF = B.CIFNo
               AND B.DebtorTypeId = 1
            INNER JOIN [dbo].[DataDebtor] D
                ON B.DebtorCode = D.DebtorCode
            CROSS APPLY
            (
                SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(value)) AS value
                FROM STRING_SPLIT(REPLACE(REPLACE(A.BusinessMobileNumber, ';', ','), '/', ','), ',')
            ) S
            WHERE A.BusinessMobileNumber IS NOT NULL
              AND LTRIM(RTRIM(A.BusinessMobileNumber)) <> ''
              AND LTRIM(RTRIM(S.value)) <> ''

            UNION ALL

            -------------------------------------------------------------------
            -- FAX
            -------------------------------------------------------------------
            SELECT
                D.DebtorId,
                3 AS DebtorContactTypeId,
                LTRIM(RTRIM(S.value)) AS DebtorContactValue,
                NULL AS DebtorContactExtension,
                2 AS DebtorContactChannelId,
                0 AS IsDefault,
                0 AS CreateBy,
                GETDATE() AS CreateDate,
                0 AS UpdateBy,
                GETDATE() AS UpdateDate,
                A.TEMPId AS DebtorContactCBSId,
                1 AS ImportType
            FROM [dbo].[TEMPDebtorBusinessAddressCBS] A
            INNER JOIN [dbo].[TEMPMapLGCBS] B
                ON A.CIF = B.CIFNo
               AND B.DebtorTypeId = 1
            INNER JOIN [dbo].[DataDebtor] D
                ON B.DebtorCode = D.DebtorCode
            CROSS APPLY
            (
                SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(value)) AS value
                FROM STRING_SPLIT(REPLACE(REPLACE(A.BusinessFaxNumber, ';', ','), '/', ','), ',')
            ) S
            WHERE A.BusinessFaxNumber IS NOT NULL
              AND LTRIM(RTRIM(A.BusinessFaxNumber)) <> ''
              AND LTRIM(RTRIM(S.value)) <> ''

            UNION ALL

            -------------------------------------------------------------------
            -- EMAIL
            -------------------------------------------------------------------
            SELECT
                D.DebtorId,
                4 AS DebtorContactTypeId,
                LTRIM(RTRIM(A.BusinessEmail)) AS DebtorContactValue,
                NULL AS DebtorContactExtension,
                2 AS DebtorContactChannelId,
                0 AS IsDefault,
                0 AS CreateBy,
                GETDATE() AS CreateDate,
                0 AS UpdateBy,
                GETDATE() AS UpdateDate,
                A.TEMPId AS DebtorContactCBSId,
                1 AS ImportType
            FROM [dbo].[TEMPDebtorBusinessAddressCBS] A
            INNER JOIN [dbo].[TEMPMapLGCBS] B
                ON A.CIF = B.CIFNo
               AND B.DebtorTypeId = 1
            INNER JOIN [dbo].[DataDebtor] D
                ON B.DebtorCode = D.DebtorCode
            WHERE A.BusinessEmail IS NOT NULL
              AND LTRIM(RTRIM(A.BusinessEmail)) <> ''
        ),
        CTE_DEDUP AS
        (
            SELECT
                DebtorId,
                DebtorContactTypeId,
                DebtorContactValue,
                DebtorContactExtension,
                DebtorContactChannelId,
                IsDefault,
                CreateBy,
                CreateDate,
                UpdateBy,
                UpdateDate,
                DebtorContactCBSId,
                ImportType,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER
                (
                    PARTITION BY DebtorId, DebtorContactTypeId, DebtorContactValue
                    ORDER BY DebtorContactCBSId
                ) AS RN
            FROM CTE_CONTACT
        )
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[DataDebtorContact]
        (
            DebtorContactId,
            DebtorId,
            DebtorContactTypeId,
            DebtorContactValue,
            DebtorContactExtension,
            DebtorContactChannelId,
            IsDefault,
            CreateBy,
            CreateDate,
            UpdateBy,
            UpdateDate,
            DebtorContactCBSId,
            ImportType
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID() AS DebtorContactId,
            C.DebtorId,
            C.DebtorContactTypeId,
            C.DebtorContactValue,
            C.DebtorContactExtension,
            C.DebtorContactChannelId,
            C.IsDefault,
            C.CreateBy,
            C.CreateDate,
            C.UpdateBy,
            C.UpdateDate,
            C.DebtorContactCBSId,
            C.ImportType
        FROM CTE_DEDUP C
        WHERE C.RN = 1
          AND NOT EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM [dbo].[DataDebtorContact] X
              WHERE X.DebtorId = C.DebtorId
                AND X.DebtorContactTypeId = C.DebtorContactTypeId
                AND X.DebtorContactValue = C.DebtorContactValue
          );

        COMMIT TRAN;

        -----------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- Optional cleanup (left from old logic)
        -----------------------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb.#Resolved') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Resolved;
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb.#Mapped')   IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Mapped;
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb.#Raw')      IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Raw;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK TRAN;

        DECLARE
            @ErrMsg  NVARCHAR(4000) = ERROR_MESSAGE(),
            @ErrNo   INT = ERROR_NUMBER(),
            @ErrSev  INT = ERROR_SEVERITY(),
            @ErrSt   INT = ERROR_STATE(),
            @ErrLine INT = ERROR_LINE();

        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb.#tmp_DataDebtorAddress') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tmp_DataDebtorAddress;
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb.#Resolved') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Resolved;
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb.#Mapped')   IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Mapped;
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb.#Raw')      IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Raw;

        RAISERROR
        (
            N'[SP_INTERFACE_010_InsertDebtorBusinessAddressCBS] failed (%d, Sev %d, State %d, Line %d): %s',
            @ErrSev,
            1,
            @ErrNo, @ErrSev, @ErrSt, @ErrLine, @ErrMsg
        );

        RETURN;
    END CATCH
END
