CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_011_InsertDebtor]
AS
BEGIN
     SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;  -- ให้ error ใด ๆ rollback อัตโนมัติ

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Pre-check (ไม่ใช้ GO): สร้างตารางเลขรัน/เพิ่ม ImportType/สร้าง TEMPMapLGCBS ถ้ายังไม่มี
    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.SystemRunningDebtorCode','U') IS NULL
    BEGIN
        CREATE TABLE dbo.SystemRunningDebtorCode
        (
            YearPrefix NCHAR(3) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, -- เช่น 'C68'
            LastRun    INT      NOT NULL
        );
    END;

    IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.DataDebtorContact','ImportType') IS NULL
    BEGIN
        ALTER TABLE dbo.DataDebtorContact
        ADD ImportType INT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT DF_DataDebtorContact_ImportType DEFAULT (1) WITH VALUES;
    END;

    -- ตารางแม็ป LG (ตามที่ผู้ใช้ระบุ)
    

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRAN;

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 1) เลือกแถวล่าสุดต่อ IDCard จาก TEMPDebtorCBS (กันซ้ำ)
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Latest') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Latest;

        SELECT *
        INTO #Latest
        FROM
        (
            SELECT  t.*,
                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                        PARTITION BY t.IDCard
                        ORDER BY 
                            CASE WHEN t.ImportDate IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END DESC,
                            t.ImportDate DESC,
                            t.TempId DESC
                    ) AS rn
            FROM dbo.TEMPDebtorCBS t
        ) s
        WHERE s.rn = 1
          AND s.IDCard IS NOT NULL
          AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(s.IDCard)) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) <> (N'' COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT);

		 

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2) คงไว้เฉพาะ IDCard ที่ยังไม่อยู่ใน DataDebtor
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ToInsert') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ToInsert;

        SELECT l.*
        INTO #ToInsert
        FROM #Latest l
        WHERE NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.DataDebtor d
            WHERE (d.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (l.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
        );
		--JAO
		select* from #ToInsert
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 3) Map TitleId จาก SystemTitleMaster โดย TitleCode
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#MapTitle') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #MapTitle;

        SELECT  ti.*,
                case when st.TitleId = 171 then 168 else st.TitleId end TitleId
        INTO #MapTitle
        FROM #ToInsert ti
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemTitleMaster st
               ON (st.TitleCode COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (ti.TitleCode COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT);

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 3.1) ดึง LGNo ล่าสุดต่อ CIF จาก DATALG (NEW)
        ------------------------------------------------------------
       IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#LGAll') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #LGAll;

SELECT DISTINCT
    d.CIFNo COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS CIFNo,
    d.LGNo  COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS LGNo
INTO #LGAll
FROM dbo.DATALG d
WHERE d.CIFNo IS NOT NULL
  AND LTRIM(RTRIM(d.CIFNo)) <> ''
  AND d.LGNo IS NOT NULL
  AND LTRIM(RTRIM(d.LGNo)) <> '';

CREATE INDEX IX_LGAll_CIFNo ON #LGAll(CIFNo);

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 4) จอง "บล็อกเลขรัน" ต่อปี พ.ศ. (กันชน)
        --    DebtorCode: 'C' + YY(พ.ศ.) + 6 หลัก  (รองรับถึง 999999)
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        DECLARE @BEYear  INT  = YEAR(GETDATE()) + 541;                     -- ปี พ.ศ.
        DECLARE @YY      CHAR(2) = RIGHT(CONVERT(VARCHAR(4), @BEYear), 2); -- 2 หลักท้าย
        DECLARE @Prefix  NCHAR(3) = N'C' + @YY;                             -- 'C68' ฯลฯ

        DECLARE @N INT = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #MapTitle);
        DECLARE @Current INT, @StartRun INT, @EndRun INT;

        IF @N > 0
        BEGIN
            -- ล็อกแถวของปีนี้ (สร้างถ้าไม่มี) ด้วย UPDLOCK+HOLDLOCK กัน race
            IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.SystemRunningDebtorCode WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) WHERE YearPrefix = @Prefix)
            BEGIN
                INSERT dbo.SystemRunningDebtorCode (YearPrefix, LastRun)
                VALUES (@Prefix, 0);
            END;

            -- อ่านค่า LastRun ปัจจุบัน (ถือ lock จนจบ tran)
            SELECT @Current = LastRun
            FROM dbo.SystemRunningDebtorCode WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
            WHERE YearPrefix = @Prefix;

            SET @StartRun = @Current + 1;
            SET @EndRun   = @Current + @N;

            IF @EndRun > 999999
            BEGIN
                THROW 50001, 'DebtorCode running number for current BE year would exceed 999999. Please roll over year/prefix or widen the sequence.', 1;
            END;

            -- อัปเดต LastRun = @EndRun (กันชน)
            UPDATE dbo.SystemRunningDebtorCode
            SET LastRun = @EndRun
            WHERE YearPrefix = @Prefix;
        END;

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 5) ผูกเลขรันต่อแถวที่จะ insert  (เพิ่ม LGNo จาก #LGLatest)
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Numbered') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Numbered;

SELECT  
    mt.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY mt.IDCard) AS rn_order,
    CASE WHEN @N > 0 THEN @StartRun + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY mt.IDCard) - 1 ELSE NULL END AS NextRun
INTO #Numbered
FROM #MapTitle mt;


select * from #MapTitle;

CREATE INDEX IX_Numbered_IDCard ON #Numbered(IDCard);

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 6) INSERT ลง DataDebtor (63 คอลัมน์) + เก็บ DebtorId/IDCard/DebtorCode ที่แทรกได้
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        DECLARE @InsertedDebtor TABLE
        (
            DebtorId   NVARCHAR(150) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
            IDCard     NVARCHAR(20)  COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
            DebtorCode NVARCHAR(20)  COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
        );

      INSERT INTO dbo.DataDebtor
(
    DebtorCode, DebtorTypeId,
    TitleId, FirstName,
    LastName, DebtorName,
    CardTypeId, CardNumber,
    CompanyNameEN,
	BirthDate,
    FixedAssetValue, DebtorId,
    OldSection, IDCard,
    RefCode, ContactName,
    Email, CntPhoneNumber,
    CntMobileNumber, CntFaxNumber,
    DefaultAddressId, Note,
    BusinessType, BusinessTypeName,
    CompanyType, CompanyTypeDescription,
    BusinessDescription,
    EmploymentQty, IncEmploymentQty,
    ISICCode, Totalclaim,
    DebtorCodeType, DivisionCode,
    ProvinceCode, RegistrationType,
    RegistrationNo, CompanyEngName,
    RegistrationDate, 
	LoanerTotal, ImportDate,
    BusinessStatus, 
	--BusinessStatusDate,
    CreateDate, CreateBy, UpdateDate, UpdateBy,
    NotSendSMS, RefMigrateId,
    IsActive,
	--Age,
    StatusPersonId, LineID,
    DebtorCBSId, GenderId,
    PersonGroupId, BusinessStatusId,
    BusinessTypeId, CompanyTypeId,
    BusinessDescriptionId, FilingDueDate,
    BankFilingDate, LawOfficeSectionId,
    ImportType
)
OUTPUT inserted.DebtorId, inserted.IDCard, inserted.DebtorCode
INTO @InsertedDebtor(DebtorId, IDCard, DebtorCode)
SELECT
    -- 01 DebtorCode: C + ปีพ.ศ.2หลัก + running 6 หลัก
    CONCAT(@Prefix, RIGHT(CONCAT(N'000000', CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), n.NextRun)), 6)) AS DebtorCode,

    -- 02..07
    NULL AS DebtorTypeId,                               -- DebtorTypeId
    n.TitleId AS TitleId,                               -- TitleId
    (LEFT(n.FirstName , 100) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) AS FirstName, 
    (LEFT(n.LastName  , 100) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) AS LastName,
    LEFT(
        CASE 
            WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(n.NamePrint)) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, N'' COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) IS NOT NULL
                 THEN (n.NamePrint COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
            ELSE LTRIM(RTRIM(CONCAT(
                         COALESCE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(100), n.FirstName) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, N'' COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT),
                         CASE 
                           WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(n.LastName)) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, N'' COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) IS NULL
                           THEN (N'' COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
                           ELSE (N' ' COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
                         END,
                         COALESCE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(100), n.LastName) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, N'' COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
                     ))) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
        END, 500) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS DebtorName,
    NULL AS CardTypeId,                                 -- CardTypeId

    -- 08 CardNumber
    (LEFT(n.IDCard, 20) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) AS CardNumber,

    -- 09..12
    NULL AS CompanyNameEN,                              -- CompanyNameEN
    CAST(ISNULL(n.BirthDate, '1900-01-01') AS DATE) AS BirthDate, -- แก้ไขตรงนี้ให้เป็น DATE
    TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(20,0), n.FixedAssetValue) AS FixedAssetValue,
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(150), NEWID()) AS DebtorId,        -- DebtorId (nvarchar)

    -- 13..20
    NULL AS OldSection,                                 -- OldSection
    (LEFT(n.IDCard, 20) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) AS IDCard,
    (LEFT(n.CIF , 30) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) AS RefCode,
    (LEFT(n.ContactName, 100) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) AS ContactName,
    (LEFT(n.ContactEmail, 70) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) AS Email,
    (LEFT(n.ContactPhoneNumber, 50) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) AS CntPhoneNumber,
    (LEFT(n.ContactMobileNumber, 50) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) AS CntMobileNumber,
    (LEFT(n.ContactFaxNumber, 50) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) AS CntFaxNumber,

    -- 21..27
    NULL AS DefaultAddressId,                           -- DefaultAddressId
    NULL AS Note,                                       -- Note
    (LEFT(n.BusinessType, 10) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) AS BusinessType,
    (LEFT(n.BusinessTypeName, 1000) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) AS BusinessTypeName,
    (LEFT(n.CompanyType, 200) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) AS CompanyType,
    (LEFT(n.CompanyType1, 1000) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) AS CompanyTypeDescription,
    (LEFT(n.BusinessDescription, 1000) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) AS BusinessDescription,

    -- 28..31
    NULL AS EmploymentQty,                              -- EmploymentQty
    NULL AS IncEmploymentQty,                           -- IncEmploymentQty
    (LEFT(n.ISICCode, 10) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) AS ISICCode,
    TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,0), n.TotalClaim) AS Totalclaim,

    -- 32..40
    NULL AS DebtorCodeType,                            -- DebtorCodeType
    NULL AS DivisionCode ,                             -- DivisionCode
    (LEFT(n.ProvinceCode, 10) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) AS ProvinceCode,
    NULL AS RegistrationType,                          -- RegistrationType
    (LEFT(n.RegistrationNo, 30) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) AS RegistrationNo,
    NULL AS CompanyEngName,                            -- CompanyEngName
    ISNULL(n.RegistrationDate, CAST('1900-01-01' AS DATE)) AS RegistrationDate,
    TRY_CONVERT(INT, n.LoanerTotal) AS LoanerTotal,
    CAST(n.ImportDate AS DATE) AS ImportDate,          -- CAST เป็น DATE ให้แน่ใจว่าไม่มีปัญหา

    ---- 41..47
    NULL AS BusinessStatus,                            -- BusinessStatus
    --CAST('1900-01-01' AS DATE) AS BusinessStatusDate,   -- BusinessStatusDate
    GETDATE() AS CreateDate,                            -- CreateDate
    1 AS CreateBy,                                     -- CreateBy
    GETDATE() AS UpdateDate,                            -- UpdateDate
    1 AS UpdateBy ,                                    -- UpdateBy
    0 AS NotSendSMS,                                   -- NotSendSMS

    ---- 48..53
    NULL AS RefMigrateId,                              -- RefMigrateId (INT)
    1 AS IsActive,                                     -- IsActive
    --CASE WHEN n.BirthDate IS NOT NULL AND n.BirthDate >= '1753-01-01' 
    --     THEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, n.BirthDate, GETDATE()) ELSE CAST('1900-01-01' AS DATE) END AS Age,
    153 AS StatusPersonId,                            -- StatusPersonId
    NULL AS LineID,                                    -- LineID
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(150), n.TempId) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS DebtorCBSId,

    -- 54..62 (สำรอง)
    CASE WHEN TitleId IN (1) THEN 151 
         WHEN TitleId IN (2, 3) THEN 150
         ELSE 152 END AS GenderId,
    CASE WHEN TitleId IN (4) THEN 118 ELSE 117 END AS PersonGroupId,
	 
    NULL AS BusinessStatusId    ,                -- BusinessStatusId
	NULL AS BusinessTypeId ,NULL AS  CompanyTypeId,
	NULL AS BusinessDescriptionId,
    CAST('1900-01-01' AS DATE) AS FilingDueDate,       -- FilingDueDate
    NULL AS BankFilingDate,                            -- BankFilingDate
    NULL AS LawOfficeSectionId,                        -- LawOfficeSectionId

    ---- 63
    1 AS ImportType                                    -- ImportType
FROM #Numbered n;


        DECLARE @InsertedDebtorCount INT = @@ROWCOUNT;

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 7) เตรียมข้อมูลติดต่อ (Phone=1, Mobile=2, Fax=6) ลง temp
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ContactStage') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ContactStage;

        SELECT 
            CAST(i.DebtorId AS NVARCHAR(150)) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS DebtorId,
            CAST(i.IDCard   AS NVARCHAR(20))  COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS IDCard,
            CAST(1 AS INT) AS DebtorContactTypeId,
            (LTRIM(RTRIM(n.ContactPhoneNumber)) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) AS DebtorContactValue
        INTO #ContactStage
        FROM @InsertedDebtor i
        JOIN #Numbered      n 
          ON (n.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (i.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)

        UNION ALL
        SELECT 
            CAST(i.DebtorId AS NVARCHAR(150)) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
            CAST(i.IDCard   AS NVARCHAR(20))  COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
            CAST(2 AS INT),
            (LTRIM(RTRIM(n.ContactMobileNumber)) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
        FROM @InsertedDebtor i
        JOIN #Numbered      n 
          ON (n.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (i.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)

        UNION ALL
        SELECT 
            CAST(i.DebtorId AS NVARCHAR(150)) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
            CAST(i.IDCard   AS NVARCHAR(20))  COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
            CAST(6 AS INT),
            (LTRIM(RTRIM(n.ContactFaxNumber)) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
        FROM @InsertedDebtor i
        JOIN #Numbered      n 
          ON (n.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (i.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT);
	 

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 8) INSERT DataDebtorContact (ข้าม null/ว่าง/เฉพาะขีด/ขีด+ช่องว่าง) + ImportType=1
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        INSERT INTO dbo.DataDebtorContact
        (
            DebtorContactId,
            DebtorId,
            DebtorContactTypeId,
            DebtorContactValue,
            DebtorContactExtension,
            DebtorContactChannelId,
            IsDefault,
            CreateBy,
            CreateDate,
            UpdateBy,
            UpdateDate,
            DebtorContactCBSId,
            ImportType
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID(),
            c.DebtorId,
            c.DebtorContactTypeId,
            c.DebtorContactValue,
            NULL as DebtorContactExtension,
            2 as DebtorContactChannelId,
            1,
            1,              -- CreateBy
            GETDATE(),
            1,              -- UpdateBy
            GETDATE(),
            NULL,
            1               -- Fixed = 1
        FROM #ContactStage c
        WHERE c.DebtorContactValue IS NOT NULL
          AND REPLACE(REPLACE(c.DebtorContactValue COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, N'-', N''), N' ', N'') 
                <> (N'' COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
          AND NOT EXISTS
              (
                SELECT 1
                FROM dbo.DataDebtorContact dc
                WHERE (dc.DebtorId          COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (c.DebtorId          COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
                  AND dc.DebtorContactTypeId = c.DebtorContactTypeId
                  AND (dc.DebtorContactValue COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (c.DebtorContactValue COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
              );

        DECLARE @InsertedContactCount INT = @@ROWCOUNT;

		--JAO
		--BEGIN

		Declare @count int 
		set @count =(select count(*) from @InsertedDebtor)

 

		if (@count =0)
		begin
	      insert into @InsertedDebtor(DebtorId,IDCard,DebtorCode)
		  select 
		  d.DebtorId,d.IDCard,d.DebtorCode
		  from DataDebtor d 
		  inner join TEMPDebtorCBS b on b.IDCard=d.IDCard 
		  
		  select * from #Numbered
		--  select * from @InsertedDebtor
		end 
			--END

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 9) INSERT TEMPMapLGCBS: จากข้อมูลที่เพิ่งแทรก + LGNo ล่าสุดต่อ CIF
        ------------------------------------------------------------
--  INSERT INTO dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS (TEMPMapLGId, CIFNo, LGNo, DebtorCode, ImportDate, DebtorTypeId)
--SELECT
--    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(150), NEWID())                     AS TEMPMapLGId,
--    LEFT(c.CIF, 20) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT           AS CIFNo,
--    LEFT(lg.LGNo, 20) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT         AS LGNo,
--    LEFT(d.DebtorCode, 20) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT    AS DebtorCode,
--    GETDATE()                                          AS ImportDate,
--    1 AS DebtorTypeId
--FROM DataLG lg
--left join TEMPDebtorCBS c on c.CIF = lg.CIFNo
--left join DataDebtor d on d.IDCard = c.IDCard


Update d
set BirthDate = case when t.PersonTypeId = 117 then BirthDate else '1900-01-01' end
, RegistrationDate = case when t.PersonTypeId = 117 then  '1900-01-01' else RegistrationDate end
, PersonGroupId = t.PersonTypeId

from DataDebtor d
left join SystemTitleMaster t on t.TitleId = d.TitleId

        DECLARE @InsertedMapCount INT = @@ROWCOUNT;

        COMMIT TRAN;

        SELECT  @InsertedDebtorCount  AS InsertedDebtorCount,
                @InsertedContactCount AS InsertedContactCount,
                @InsertedMapCount     AS InsertedTEMPMapLGCBSCount,
                N'Insert Debtor + Contact + TEMPMapLGCBS สำเร็จ (DebtorCode = C + พ.ศ.2หลัก + running 6 หลัก; รีเซ็ตทุกปีอัตโนมัติ; Contact.ImportType=1; TEMPMapLGCBS.ImportDate=GETDATE())' AS Note;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0 ROLLBACK TRAN;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_011_InsertDebtor_copy1]
AS
BEGIN
     SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;  -- ให้ error ใด ๆ rollback อัตโนมัติ

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Pre-check (ไม่ใช้ GO): สร้างตารางเลขรัน/เพิ่ม ImportType/สร้าง TEMPMapLGCBS ถ้ายังไม่มี
    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.SystemRunningDebtorCode','U') IS NULL
    BEGIN
        CREATE TABLE dbo.SystemRunningDebtorCode
        (
            YearPrefix NCHAR(3) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, -- เช่น 'C68'
            LastRun    INT      NOT NULL
        );
    END;

    IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.DataDebtorContact','ImportType') IS NULL
    BEGIN
        ALTER TABLE dbo.DataDebtorContact
        ADD ImportType INT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT DF_DataDebtorContact_ImportType DEFAULT (1) WITH VALUES;
    END;

    -- ตารางแม็ป LG (ตามที่ผู้ใช้ระบุ)
    IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS','U') IS NULL
    BEGIN
        CREATE TABLE dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS
        (
            TEMPMapLGId NVARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
            CIFNo       NVARCHAR(20)  NULL,
            LGNo        NVARCHAR(20)  NULL,
            DebtorCode  NVARCHAR(20)  NULL,
            ImportDate  DATETIME      NOT NULL
			
                CONSTRAINT DF_TEMPMapLGCBS_ImportDate DEFAULT (GETDATE()),
				DebtorTypeId INT NULL
        );
        CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_TEMPMapLGCBS_LG_Debtor
            ON dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS (LGNo, DebtorCode);
    END;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRAN;

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 1) เลือกแถวล่าสุดต่อ IDCard จาก TEMPDebtorCBS (กันซ้ำ)
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Latest') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Latest;

        SELECT *
        INTO #Latest
        FROM
        (
            SELECT  t.*,
                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                        PARTITION BY t.IDCard
                        ORDER BY 
                            CASE WHEN t.ImportDate IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END DESC,
                            t.ImportDate DESC,
                            t.TempId DESC
                    ) AS rn
            FROM dbo.TEMPDebtorCBS t
        ) s
        WHERE s.rn = 1
          AND s.IDCard IS NOT NULL
          AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(s.IDCard)) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) <> (N'' COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT);

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2) คงไว้เฉพาะ IDCard ที่ยังไม่อยู่ใน DataDebtor
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ToInsert') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ToInsert;

        SELECT l.*
        INTO #ToInsert
        FROM #Latest l
        WHERE NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.DataDebtor d
            WHERE (d.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (l.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
        );

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 3) Map TitleId จาก SystemTitleMaster โดย TitleCode
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#MapTitle') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #MapTitle;

        SELECT  ti.*,
                st.TitleId
        INTO #MapTitle
        FROM #ToInsert ti
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemTitleMaster st
               ON (st.TitleCode COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (ti.TitleCode COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT);

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 3.1) ดึง LGNo ล่าสุดต่อ CIF จาก DATALG (NEW)
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#LGLatest') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #LGLatest;

        ;WITH LgRank AS (
            SELECT 
                d.CIFNo,
                d.LGNo,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY d.CIFNo
                    ORDER BY 
                        CASE WHEN d.UpdateDate IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END DESC,
                        d.UpdateDate DESC,
                        CASE WHEN d.ImportDate IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END DESC,
                        d.ImportDate DESC,
                        d.LGNo DESC
                ) AS rn
            FROM dbo.DATALG d
        )
        SELECT 
            CIFNo COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS CIFNo,
            LGNo  COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS LGNo
        INTO #LGLatest
        FROM LgRank
        WHERE rn = 1;

        CREATE INDEX IX_LGLatest_CIFNo ON #LGLatest(CIFNo);

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 4) จอง "บล็อกเลขรัน" ต่อปี พ.ศ. (กันชน)
        --    DebtorCode: 'C' + YY(พ.ศ.) + 6 หลัก  (รองรับถึง 999999)
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        DECLARE @BEYear  INT  = YEAR(GETDATE()) + 543;                     -- ปี พ.ศ.
        DECLARE @YY      CHAR(2) = RIGHT(CONVERT(VARCHAR(4), @BEYear), 2); -- 2 หลักท้าย
        DECLARE @Prefix  NCHAR(3) = N'C' + @YY;                             -- 'C68' ฯลฯ

        DECLARE @N INT = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #MapTitle);
        DECLARE @Current INT, @StartRun INT, @EndRun INT;

        IF @N > 0
        BEGIN
            -- ล็อกแถวของปีนี้ (สร้างถ้าไม่มี) ด้วย UPDLOCK+HOLDLOCK กัน race
            IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.SystemRunningDebtorCode WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) WHERE YearPrefix = @Prefix)
            BEGIN
                INSERT dbo.SystemRunningDebtorCode (YearPrefix, LastRun)
                VALUES (@Prefix, 0);
            END;

            -- อ่านค่า LastRun ปัจจุบัน (ถือ lock จนจบ tran)
            SELECT @Current = LastRun
            FROM dbo.SystemRunningDebtorCode WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
            WHERE YearPrefix = @Prefix;

            SET @StartRun = @Current + 1;
            SET @EndRun   = @Current + @N;

            IF @EndRun > 999999
            BEGIN
                THROW 50001, 'DebtorCode running number for current BE year would exceed 999999. Please roll over year/prefix or widen the sequence.', 1;
            END;

            -- อัปเดต LastRun = @EndRun (กันชน)
            UPDATE dbo.SystemRunningDebtorCode
            SET LastRun = @EndRun
            WHERE YearPrefix = @Prefix;
        END;

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 5) ผูกเลขรันต่อแถวที่จะ insert  (เพิ่ม LGNo จาก #LGLatest)
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Numbered') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Numbered;

        SELECT  
            mt.*,
            lg.LGNo,  -- NEW: ติด LGNo เข้ามาที่ #Numbered
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY mt.IDCard) AS rn_order,
            CASE WHEN @N > 0 THEN @StartRun + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY mt.IDCard) - 1 ELSE NULL END AS NextRun
        INTO #Numbered
        FROM #MapTitle mt
        LEFT JOIN #LGLatest lg
          ON (lg.CIFNo COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (mt.CIF COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT);  -- *ถ้า field ชื่อ CIFNo ให้ปรับฝั่ง mt.*

        CREATE INDEX IX_Numbered_IDCard ON #Numbered(IDCard);
        CREATE INDEX IX_Numbered_LGNo   ON #Numbered(LGNo);

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 6) INSERT ลง DataDebtor (63 คอลัมน์) + เก็บ DebtorId/IDCard/DebtorCode ที่แทรกได้
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        DECLARE @InsertedDebtor TABLE
        (
            DebtorId   NVARCHAR(150) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
            IDCard     NVARCHAR(20)  COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
            DebtorCode NVARCHAR(20)  COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
        );

        INSERT INTO dbo.DataDebtor
        (
            DebtorCode, DebtorTypeId, TitleId, FirstName, LastName, DebtorName,
            CardTypeId, CardNumber, CompanyNameEN, BirthDate, FixedAssetValue, DebtorId,
            OldSection, IDCard, RefCode, ContactName, Email, CntPhoneNumber, CntMobileNumber, CntFaxNumber,
            DefaultAddressId, Note, BusinessType, BusinessTypeName, CompanyType, CompanyTypeDescription, BusinessDescription,
            EmploymentQty, IncEmploymentQty, ISICCode, Totalclaim, DebtorCodeType, DivisionCode, ProvinceCode,
            RegistrationType, RegistrationNo, CompanyEngName, RegistrationDate, LoanerTotal, ImportDate,
            BusinessStatus, BusinessStatusDate, CreateDate, CreateBy, UpdateDate, UpdateBy, NotSendSMS, RefMigrateId,
            IsActive, Age, StatusPersonId, LineID, DebtorCBSId, GenderId, PersonGroupId, BusinessStatusId, BusinessTypeId,
            CompanyTypeId, BusinessDescriptionId, FilingDueDate, BankFilingDate, LawOfficeSectionId, ImportType
        )
        OUTPUT inserted.DebtorId, inserted.IDCard, inserted.DebtorCode
        INTO @InsertedDebtor(DebtorId, IDCard, DebtorCode)
        SELECT
            -- 01 DebtorCode: C + ปีพ.ศ.2หลัก + running 6 หลัก
            CONCAT(@Prefix, RIGHT(CONCAT(N'000000', CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), n.NextRun)), 6)),

            -- 02..07
            NULL,                               -- DebtorTypeId
            n.TitleId,                          -- TitleId
            (LEFT(n.FirstName , 100) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT),
            (LEFT(n.LastName  , 100) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT),
            LEFT(
                CASE 
                    WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(n.NamePrint)) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, N'' COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) IS NOT NULL
                         THEN (n.NamePrint COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
                    ELSE LTRIM(RTRIM(CONCAT(
                             COALESCE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(100), n.FirstName) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, N'' COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT),
                             CASE 
                               WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(n.LastName)) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, N'' COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) IS NULL
                               THEN (N'' COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
                               ELSE (N' ' COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
                             END,
                             COALESCE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(100), n.LastName) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, N'' COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
                         ))) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
                END, 500) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
            NULL,                               -- CardTypeId

            -- 08 CardNumber
            (LEFT(n.IDCard, 20) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT),

            -- 09..12
            NULL,                               -- CompanyNameEN
            n.BirthDate,
            TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(20,0), n.FixedAssetValue),
            CONVERT(NVARCHAR(150), NEWID()),    -- DebtorId (nvarchar)

            -- 13..20
            NULL,                               -- OldSection
            (LEFT(n.IDCard, 20) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT),     -- IDCard
            (LEFT(n.CIF  , 30) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT),      -- RefCode
            (LEFT(n.ContactName,        100) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT),
            (LEFT(n.ContactEmail,         70) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT),
            (LEFT(n.ContactPhoneNumber,   50) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT),
            (LEFT(n.ContactMobileNumber,  50) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT),
            (LEFT(n.ContactFaxNumber,     50) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT),

            -- 21..27
            NULL,                               -- DefaultAddressId
            NULL,                               -- Note
            (LEFT(n.BusinessType,      10) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT),
            (LEFT(n.BusinessTypeName,1000) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT),
            (LEFT(n.CompanyType,      200) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT),
            (LEFT(n.CompanyType1,    1000) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT),
            (LEFT(n.BusinessDescription,1000) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT),

            -- 28..31
            NULL,                               -- EmploymentQty
            NULL,                               -- IncEmploymentQty
            (LEFT(n.ISICCode, 10) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT),
            TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,0), n.TotalClaim),

            -- 32..40
            NULL,                               -- DebtorCodeType
            NULL,                               -- DivisionCode
            (LEFT(n.ProvinceCode, 10) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT),
            NULL,                               -- RegistrationType
            (LEFT(n.RegistrationNo, 30) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT),
            NULL,                               -- CompanyEngName
            n.RegistrationDate,
            TRY_CONVERT(INT, n.LoanerTotal),
            n.ImportDate,

            -- 41..47
            NULL,                               -- BusinessStatus
            NULL,                               -- BusinessStatusDate
            GETDATE(),                          -- CreateDate
            1,                                  -- CreateBy
            GETDATE(),                          -- UpdateDate
            1,                                  -- UpdateBy
            0,                                  -- NotSendSMS

            -- 48..53
            NULL,                               -- RefMigrateId (INT)
            1,                                  -- IsActive
            CASE WHEN n.BirthDate IS NOT NULL AND n.BirthDate >= '1753-01-01' 
                 THEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, n.BirthDate, GETDATE()) ELSE NULL END, -- Age
            NULL,                               -- StatusPersonId
            NULL,                               -- LineID
            CONVERT(NVARCHAR(150), n.TempId) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,  -- DebtorCBSId

            -- 54..62 (สำรอง)
            case when TitleId in (1) then 151 
			when TitleId in (2,3) then 150
			else 152 end, --GenderId
			case when TitleId in (4) then 118 else 117 end, --PersonGroupId
			NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,  -- ..BusinessDescriptionId
            NULL, NULL, NULL,                    -- FilingDueDate..LawOfficeSectionId

            -- 63
            1                                    -- ImportType
        FROM #Numbered n;

        DECLARE @InsertedDebtorCount INT = @@ROWCOUNT;

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 7) เตรียมข้อมูลติดต่อ (Phone=1, Mobile=2, Fax=6) ลง temp
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ContactStage') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ContactStage;

        SELECT 
            CAST(i.DebtorId AS NVARCHAR(150)) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS DebtorId,
            CAST(i.IDCard   AS NVARCHAR(20))  COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS IDCard,
            CAST(1 AS INT) AS DebtorContactTypeId,
            (LTRIM(RTRIM(n.ContactPhoneNumber)) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) AS DebtorContactValue
        INTO #ContactStage
        FROM @InsertedDebtor i
        JOIN #Numbered      n 
          ON (n.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (i.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)

        UNION ALL
        SELECT 
            CAST(i.DebtorId AS NVARCHAR(150)) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
            CAST(i.IDCard   AS NVARCHAR(20))  COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
            CAST(2 AS INT),
            (LTRIM(RTRIM(n.ContactMobileNumber)) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
        FROM @InsertedDebtor i
        JOIN #Numbered      n 
          ON (n.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (i.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)

        UNION ALL
        SELECT 
            CAST(i.DebtorId AS NVARCHAR(150)) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
            CAST(i.IDCard   AS NVARCHAR(20))  COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
            CAST(6 AS INT),
            (LTRIM(RTRIM(n.ContactFaxNumber)) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
        FROM @InsertedDebtor i
        JOIN #Numbered      n 
          ON (n.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (i.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT);

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 8) INSERT DataDebtorContact (ข้าม null/ว่าง/เฉพาะขีด/ขีด+ช่องว่าง) + ImportType=1
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        INSERT INTO dbo.DataDebtorContact
        (
            DebtorContactId,
            DebtorId,
            DebtorContactTypeId,
            DebtorContactValue,
            DebtorContactExtension,
            DebtorContactChannelId,
            IsDefault,
            CreateBy,
            CreateDate,
            UpdateBy,
            UpdateDate,
            DebtorContactCBSId,
            ImportType
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID(),
            c.DebtorId,
            c.DebtorContactTypeId,
            c.DebtorContactValue,
            NULL,
            NULL,
            1,
            1,              -- CreateBy
            GETDATE(),
            1,              -- UpdateBy
            GETDATE(),
            NULL,
            1               -- Fixed = 1
        FROM #ContactStage c
        WHERE c.DebtorContactValue IS NOT NULL
          AND REPLACE(REPLACE(c.DebtorContactValue COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, N'-', N''), N' ', N'') 
                <> (N'' COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
          AND NOT EXISTS
              (
                SELECT 1
                FROM dbo.DataDebtorContact dc
                WHERE (dc.DebtorId          COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (c.DebtorId          COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
                  AND dc.DebtorContactTypeId = c.DebtorContactTypeId
                  AND (dc.DebtorContactValue COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (c.DebtorContactValue COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
              );

        DECLARE @InsertedContactCount INT = @@ROWCOUNT;

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 9) INSERT TEMPMapLGCBS: จากข้อมูลที่เพิ่งแทรก + LGNo ล่าสุดต่อ CIF
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        INSERT INTO dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS (TEMPMapLGId, CIFNo, LGNo, DebtorCode, ImportDate, DebtorTypeId)
        SELECT
            CONVERT(NVARCHAR(150), NEWID())                                      AS TEMPMapLGId,
            LEFT(n.CIF   , 20) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT                           AS CIFNo,
            LEFT(n.LGNo  , 20) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT                           AS LGNo,
            LEFT(i.DebtorCode, 20) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT                       AS DebtorCode,
            GETDATE()                                                             AS ImportDate,
			1 as DebtorTypeId
        FROM @InsertedDebtor i
        JOIN #Numbered      n
          ON (n.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (i.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
        WHERE n.LGNo IS NOT NULL
          AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(n.LGNo)) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) <> (N'' COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
          AND NOT EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS m
              WHERE (m.DebtorCode COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (i.DebtorCode COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
                AND (m.LGNo       COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (LEFT(n.LGNo,20) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
          );

        DECLARE @InsertedMapCount INT = @@ROWCOUNT;

        COMMIT TRAN;

        SELECT  @InsertedDebtorCount  AS InsertedDebtorCount,
                @InsertedContactCount AS InsertedContactCount,
                @InsertedMapCount     AS InsertedTEMPMapLGCBSCount,
                N'Insert Debtor + Contact + TEMPMapLGCBS สำเร็จ (DebtorCode = C + พ.ศ.2หลัก + running 6 หลัก; รีเซ็ตทุกปีอัตโนมัติ; Contact.ImportType=1; TEMPMapLGCBS.ImportDate=GETDATE())' AS Note;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0 ROLLBACK TRAN;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_012_InsertDebtorContactAddressCBS]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    -- Ensure ImportType exists on DataDebtorContact
    IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.DataDebtorContact', 'ImportType') IS NULL
    BEGIN
        ALTER TABLE dbo.DataDebtorContact
        ADD ImportType INT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT DF_DataDebtorContact_ImportType DEFAULT (1) WITH VALUES;
    END;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRAN;

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- #Raw : ดึงข้อมูลต้นทาง + map DebtorId
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Raw') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Raw;

        SELECT
            T.TEMPId,
            T.CIF,
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(T.ContactNum)), '')            AS AddrNo,
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(T.ContactBuilding)), '')       AS PlaceName,
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(T.ContactMoo)), '')            AS Moo,
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(T.ContactSoi)), '')            AS Soi,
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(T.ContactRoad)), '')           AS Road,
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(T.ContactProvince)), '')       AS ProvinceCodeSrc,
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(T.ContactBoundary)), '')       AS DistrictCodeSrc,
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(T.ContactDistrict)), '')       AS SubDistrictCodeSrc,
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(T.ContactZipcode)), '')        AS ZipRaw,
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(T.ContactPhoneNumber)), '')    AS PhoneRaw,
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(T.ContactMobileNumber)), '')   AS MobileRaw,
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(T.ContactFaxNumber)), '')      AS FaxRaw,
            T.SystemCreate,
            T.ImportDate,
            DD.DebtorId
        INTO #Raw
        FROM dbo.TEMPDebtorContactAddressCBS T
        INNER JOIN dbo.DataDebtorRelate M
            ON M.CIFNo COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT = T.CIF COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
           AND M.DebtorTypeId = 1
        INNER JOIN dbo.DataDebtor DD
            ON DD.DebtorId COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT = M.DebtorId COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT;

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- #Mapped : map จังหวัด / อำเภอ / ตำบล
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Mapped') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Mapped;

        SELECT
            R.*,
            P.ProvinceId      AS P_ProvinceId,
            D.DistrictId      AS D_DistrictId,
            D.ProvinceId      AS D_ProvinceId,
            SDM.SubDistrictId AS SDM_SubDistrictId,
            SDM.DistrictId    AS SDM_DistrictId,
            SDM.ProvinceId    AS SDM_ProvinceId,
            SDM.PostCode      AS SDM_PostCode
        INTO #Mapped
        FROM #Raw R
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemProvinceMaster P ON P.TCGProvinceCode COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT = R.ProvinceCodeSrc COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemDistrictMaster D ON P.ProvinceId = D.ProvinceId and D.Name COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT = R.DistrictCodeSrc COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemSubDistrictMaster SDM ON P.ProvinceId = D.ProvinceId and D.DistrictId = SDM.DistrictId and SDM.Name COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT = R.SubDistrictCodeSrc COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT;

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- #Resolved : resolve ProvinceId / DistrictId / SubDistrictId / PostalCode
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Resolved') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Resolved;

        SELECT
            M.*,
            COALESCE(M.P_ProvinceId, M.SDM_ProvinceId, M.D_ProvinceId) AS ProvinceId_Resolved,
            COALESCE(M.D_DistrictId, M.SDM_DistrictId)                 AS DistrictId_Resolved,
            M.SDM_SubDistrictId                                        AS SubDistrictId_Resolved,
            CASE
                WHEN M.ZipRaw IS NOT NULL THEN LEFT(M.ZipRaw, 5)
                WHEN M.SDM_PostCode IS NOT NULL THEN LEFT(M.SDM_PostCode, 5)
                ELSE NULL
            END AS PostalCode_Resolved
        INTO #Resolved
        FROM #Mapped M;

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 1) Insert Address (กันซ้ำใน source และกันซ้ำกับปลายทาง)
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        ;WITH CTE_Address AS
        (
            SELECT
                R.*,
                rn = ROW_NUMBER() OVER
                (
                    PARTITION BY
                        R.DebtorId,
                        ISNULL(R.AddrNo, ''),
                        ISNULL(R.PlaceName, ''),
                        ISNULL(R.Moo, ''),
                        ISNULL(R.Soi, ''),
                        ISNULL(R.Road, ''),
                        ISNULL(R.PostalCode_Resolved, ''),
                        ISNULL(R.ProvinceId_Resolved, 0),
                        ISNULL(R.DistrictId_Resolved, 0),
                        ISNULL(R.SubDistrictId_Resolved, 0)
                    ORDER BY R.TEMPId
                )
            FROM #Resolved R
        )
        INSERT INTO dbo.DataDebtorAddress
        (
            DebtorCode,
            DebtorAddressTypeId,
            AddressNumber,
            PlaceName,
            Moo,
            Soi,
            Road,
            ProvinceId,
            SubDistrictId,
            DistrictId,
            PostalCode,
            DebtorContactChannelId,
            IsDefault,
            CreateBy,
            CreateDate,
            UpdateBy,
            UpdateDate,
            DebtorAddressId,
            DebtorId,
            Telephone,
            Fax,
            Mobile,
            Email,
            LineID,
            DebtorAddressCBSId,
            ContactName,
            ImportType
        )
        SELECT
            NULL AS DebtorCode,
            1 AS DebtorAddressTypeId,
            R.AddrNo,
            R.PlaceName,
            R.Moo,
            R.Soi,
            R.Road,
            R.ProvinceId_Resolved,
            R.SubDistrictId_Resolved,
            R.DistrictId_Resolved,
            R.PostalCode_Resolved,
            NULL AS DebtorContactChannelId,
            CAST(0 AS bit) AS IsDefault,
            TRY_CAST(R.SystemCreate AS INT) AS CreateBy,
            ISNULL(R.ImportDate, GETDATE()) AS CreateDate,
            TRY_CAST(R.SystemCreate AS INT) AS UpdateBy,
            ISNULL(R.ImportDate, GETDATE()) AS UpdateDate,
            CONVERT(nvarchar(150), NEWID()) AS DebtorAddressId,
            R.DebtorId,
            NULL AS Telephone,
            NULL AS Fax,
            NULL AS Mobile,
            NULL AS Email,
            NULL AS LineID,
            R.TEMPId,
            NULL AS ContactName,
            1 AS ImportType
        FROM CTE_Address R
        WHERE R.rn = 1
          AND NOT EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.DataDebtorAddress D
              WHERE D.DebtorId = R.DebtorId
                AND D.DebtorAddressTypeId = 1
                AND ISNULL(D.AddressNumber COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, '') = ISNULL(R.AddrNo COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, '')
                AND ISNULL(D.PlaceName COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, '') = ISNULL(R.PlaceName COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, '')
                AND ISNULL(D.Moo COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, '') = ISNULL(R.Moo COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, '')
                AND ISNULL(D.Soi COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, '') = ISNULL(R.Soi COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, '')
                AND ISNULL(D.Road COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, '') = ISNULL(R.Road COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, '')
                AND ISNULL(D.PostalCode COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, '') = ISNULL(R.PostalCode_Resolved COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, '')
                AND ISNULL(D.ProvinceId, 0) = ISNULL(R.ProvinceId_Resolved, 0)
                AND ISNULL(D.DistrictId, 0) = ISNULL(R.DistrictId_Resolved, 0)
                AND ISNULL(D.SubDistrictId, 0) = ISNULL(R.SubDistrictId_Resolved, 0)
          );

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2) Insert Contact : Phone
        -- split ; , ， ； และกันซ้ำใน source + ปลายทาง
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        ;WITH CTE_Phone AS
        (
            SELECT
                R.DebtorId,
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(S.value)), '') AS Phone,
                R.ImportDate,
                rn = ROW_NUMBER() OVER
                (
                    PARTITION BY
                        R.DebtorId,
                        NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(S.value)), '')
                    ORDER BY R.TEMPId
                )
            FROM #Resolved R
            CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT
            (
                REPLACE(
                    REPLACE(
                        REPLACE(ISNULL(R.PhoneRaw, ''), N'；', N';'),
                        N'，', N';'
                    ),
                    N',', N';'
                ),
                ';'
            ) S
        )
        INSERT INTO dbo.DataDebtorContact
        (
            DebtorContactId,
            DebtorId,
            DebtorContactTypeId,
            DebtorContactChannelId,
            DebtorContactValue,
            ImportType,
            CreateDate
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID() AS DebtorContactId,
            P.DebtorId,
            1 AS DebtorContactTypeId,
            2 AS DebtorContactChannelId,
            P.Phone AS DebtorContactValue,
            1 AS ImportType,
            ISNULL(P.ImportDate, GETDATE()) AS CreateDate
        FROM CTE_Phone P
        WHERE P.Phone IS NOT NULL
          AND P.rn = 1
          AND NOT EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.DataDebtorContact C
              WHERE C.DebtorId = P.DebtorId
                AND C.DebtorContactTypeId = 1
                AND C.DebtorContactChannelId = 2
                AND C.DebtorContactValue COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT = P.Phone COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
          );

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 3) Insert Contact : Mobile
        -- กันซ้ำใน source + ปลายทาง
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        ;WITH CTE_Mobile AS
        (
            SELECT
                R.DebtorId,
                R.MobileRaw,
                R.ImportDate,
                rn = ROW_NUMBER() OVER
                (
                    PARTITION BY
                        R.DebtorId,
                        ISNULL(R.MobileRaw, '')
                    ORDER BY R.TEMPId
                )
            FROM #Resolved R
            WHERE R.MobileRaw IS NOT NULL
        )
        INSERT INTO dbo.DataDebtorContact
        (
            DebtorContactId,
            DebtorId,
            DebtorContactTypeId,
            DebtorContactChannelId,
            DebtorContactValue,
            ImportType,
            CreateDate

        SELECT
            NEWID() AS DebtorContactId,
            M.DebtorId,
            2 AS DebtorContactTypeId,
            2 AS DebtorContactChannelId,
            M.MobileRaw AS DebtorContactValue,
            1 AS ImportType,
            ISNULL(M.ImportDate, GETDATE()) AS CreateDate
        FROM CTE_Mobile M
        WHERE M.rn = 1
          AND NOT EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.DataDebtorContact C
              WHERE C.DebtorId = M.DebtorId
                AND C.DebtorContactTypeId = 2
                AND C.DebtorContactChannelId = 2
                AND C.DebtorContactValue COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT = M.MobileRaw COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
          );

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 4) Insert Contact : Fax
        -- กันซ้ำใน source + ปลายทาง
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        ;WITH CTE_Fax AS
        (
            SELECT
                R.DebtorId,
                R.FaxRaw,
                R.ImportDate,

                        R.DebtorId,
                        ISNULL(R.FaxRaw, '')

                )

        )
        INSERT INTO dbo.DataDebtorContact
        (
            DebtorContactId,
            DebtorId,
            DebtorContactTypeId,
            DebtorContactChannelId,
            DebtorContactValue,
            ImportType,
            CreateDate
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID() AS DebtorContactId,
            F.DebtorId,
            6 AS DebtorContactTypeId,
            2 AS DebtorContactChannelId,
            F.FaxRaw AS DebtorContactValue,
            1 AS ImportType,
            ISNULL(F.ImportDate, GETDATE()) AS CreateDate
        FROM CTE_Fax F
        WHERE F.rn = 1
          AND NOT EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.DataDebtorContact C
              WHERE C.DebtorId = F.DebtorId
                AND C.DebtorContactTypeId = 6
                AND C.DebtorContactChannelId = 2
                AND C.DebtorContactValue COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT = F.FaxRaw COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
          );

        COMMIT TRAN;

        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Resolved') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Resolved;
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Mapped') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Mapped;
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Raw') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Raw;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK TRAN;

        DECLARE
            @ErrMsg  NVARCHAR(4000) = ERROR_MESSAGE(),
            @ErrNo   INT = ERROR_NUMBER(),
            @ErrSev  INT = ERROR_SEVERITY(),
            @ErrSt   INT = ERROR_STATE(),
            @ErrLine INT = ERROR_LINE();

        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Resolved') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Resolved;
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Mapped') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Mapped;
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Raw') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Raw;

        RAISERROR(
            N'[SP_INTERFACE_012_InsertDebtorContactAddressCBS] failed (%d, Sev %d, State %d, Line %d): %s',
            @ErrSev,
            1,
            @ErrNo,
            @ErrSev,
            @ErrSt,
            @ErrLine,
            @ErrMsg
        );

        RETURN;
    END CATCH
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_013_InsertDebtorHomeAddressCBS]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    -- Ensure ImportType exists on DataDebtorContact
    IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.DataDebtorContact', 'ImportType') IS NULL
    BEGIN
        ALTER TABLE dbo.DataDebtorContact
        ADD ImportType INT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT DF_DataDebtorContact_ImportType DEFAULT (1) WITH VALUES;
    END;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRAN;

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- #Raw : TEMPDebtorHomeAddressCBS + CIF -> DebtorCode -> DebtorId
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Raw') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Raw;

        SELECT
            T.TEMPId,
            T.CIF,
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(T.HouseAddrNum)),       '') COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS AddrNo,
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(T.HouseAddrBuilding)),  '') COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS PlaceName,
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(T.HouseMoo)),           '') COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS Moo,
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(T.HouseAddrSoi)),       '') COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS Soi,
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(T.HouseAddrRoad)),      '') COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS Road,
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(T.HouseAddrProvince)),  '') COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS ProvinceCodeSrc,
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(T.HouseAddrBoundary)),  '') COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS DistrictCodeSrc,
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(T.HouseAddrDistrict)),  '') COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS SubDistrictCodeSrc,
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(T.HouseAddrZipcode)),   '') COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS ZipRaw,
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(T.HousePhoneNumber)),   '') COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS PhoneRaw,
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(T.HouseMobileNumber)),  '') COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS MobileRaw,
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(T.HouseFaxNumber)),     '') COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS FaxRaw,
            T.SystemCreate,
            T.ImportDate,
            DD.DebtorId
        INTO #Raw
        FROM dbo.TEMPDebtorHomeAddressCBS T
        INNER JOIN dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS M
            ON M.CIFNo COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT = T.CIF COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
           AND M.DebtorTypeId = 1
        INNER JOIN dbo.DataDebtor DD
            ON DD.DebtorCode COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT = M.DebtorCode COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT;

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- #Mapped : join master จังหวัด/อำเภอ/ตำบล
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Mapped') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Mapped;

        SELECT
            R.*,
            P.ProvinceId      AS P_ProvinceId,
            D.DistrictId      AS D_DistrictId,
            D.ProvinceId      AS D_ProvinceId,
            SDM.SubDistrictId AS SDM_SubDistrictId,
            SDM.DistrictId    AS SDM_DistrictId,
            SDM.ProvinceId    AS SDM_ProvinceId,
            SDM.PostCode      AS SDM_PostCode
        INTO #Mapped
        FROM #Raw R
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemProvinceMaster P
            ON P.TCGProvinceCode COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT = R.ProvinceCodeSrc COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemDistrictMaster D
            ON P.ProvinceId = D.ProvinceId
           AND D.Name COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT = R.DistrictCodeSrc COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemSubDistrictMaster SDM
            ON P.ProvinceId = SDM.ProvinceId
           AND D.DistrictId = SDM.DistrictId
           AND SDM.Name COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT = R.SubDistrictCodeSrc COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT;

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- #Resolved : คำนวณ ProvinceId/DistrictId/SubDistrictId/PostalCode
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Resolved') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Resolved;

        SELECT
            M.*,
            COALESCE(M.P_ProvinceId, M.SDM_ProvinceId, M.D_ProvinceId) AS ProvinceId_Resolved,
            COALESCE(M.D_DistrictId, M.SDM_DistrictId)                 AS DistrictId_Resolved,
            M.SDM_SubDistrictId                                        AS SubDistrictId_Resolved,
            CASE
                WHEN M.ZipRaw IS NOT NULL THEN LEFT(M.ZipRaw, 5)
                WHEN M.SDM_PostCode IS NOT NULL THEN LEFT(M.SDM_PostCode, 5)
                ELSE NULL
            END COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS PostalCode_Resolved
        INTO #Resolved
        FROM #Mapped M;

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 1) Insert Address (DebtorAddressTypeId = 15)
        -- กันซ้ำใน source และกันซ้ำกับปลายทาง
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        ;WITH CTE_Address AS
        (
            SELECT
                R.*,
                rn = ROW_NUMBER() OVER
                (
                    PARTITION BY
                        R.DebtorId,
                        ISNULL(R.AddrNo, ''),
                        ISNULL(R.PlaceName, ''),
                        ISNULL(R.Moo, ''),
                        ISNULL(R.Soi, ''),
                        ISNULL(R.Road, ''),
                        ISNULL(R.PostalCode_Resolved, ''),
                        ISNULL(R.ProvinceId_Resolved, 0),
                        ISNULL(R.DistrictId_Resolved, 0),
                        ISNULL(R.SubDistrictId_Resolved, 0)
                    ORDER BY R.TEMPId
                )
            FROM #Resolved R
        )
        INSERT INTO dbo.DataDebtorAddress
        (
            DebtorCode,
            DebtorAddressTypeId,
            AddressNumber,
            PlaceName,
            Moo,
            Soi,
            Road,
            ProvinceId,
            SubDistrictId,
            DistrictId,
            PostalCode,
            DebtorContactChannelId,
            IsDefault,
            CreateBy,
            CreateDate,
            UpdateBy,
            UpdateDate,
            DebtorAddressId,
            DebtorId,
            Telephone,
            Fax,
            Mobile,
            Email,
            LineID,
            DebtorAddressCBSId,
            ContactName,
            ImportType
        )
        SELECT
            NULL AS DebtorCode,
            15   AS DebtorAddressTypeId,
            R.AddrNo,
            R.PlaceName,
            R.Moo,
            R.Soi,
            R.Road,
            R.ProvinceId_Resolved,
            R.SubDistrictId_Resolved,
            R.DistrictId_Resolved,
            R.PostalCode_Resolved,
            NULL AS DebtorContactChannelId,
            CAST(0 AS bit) AS IsDefault,
            TRY_CAST(R.SystemCreate AS INT) AS CreateBy,
            ISNULL(R.ImportDate, GETDATE()) AS CreateDate,
            TRY_CAST(R.SystemCreate AS INT) AS UpdateBy,
            ISNULL(R.ImportDate, GETDATE()) AS UpdateDate,
            CONVERT(nvarchar(150), NEWID()) AS DebtorAddressId,
            R.DebtorId,
            NULL AS Telephone,
            NULL AS Fax,
            NULL AS Mobile,
            NULL AS Email,
            NULL AS LineID,
            R.TEMPId,
            NULL AS ContactName,
            1 AS ImportType
        FROM CTE_Address R
        WHERE R.rn = 1
          AND NOT EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.DataDebtorAddress D
              WHERE D.DebtorId = R.DebtorId
                AND D.DebtorAddressTypeId = 15
                AND ISNULL(D.AddressNumber COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, '') = ISNULL(R.AddrNo COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, '')
                AND ISNULL(D.PlaceName COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, '') = ISNULL(R.PlaceName COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, '')
                AND ISNULL(D.Moo COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, '') = ISNULL(R.Moo COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, '')
                AND ISNULL(D.Soi COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, '') = ISNULL(R.Soi COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, '')
                AND ISNULL(D.Road COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, '') = ISNULL(R.Road COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, '')
                AND ISNULL(D.PostalCode COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, '') = ISNULL(R.PostalCode_Resolved COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT, '')
                AND ISNULL(D.ProvinceId, 0) = ISNULL(R.ProvinceId_Resolved, 0)
                AND ISNULL(D.DistrictId, 0) = ISNULL(R.DistrictId_Resolved, 0)
                AND ISNULL(D.SubDistrictId, 0) = ISNULL(R.SubDistrictId_Resolved, 0)
          );

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2) Insert Contact : HousePhoneNumber
        -- split ; , ， ； และกันซ้ำใน source + ปลายทาง
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        ;WITH CTE_Phone AS
        (
            SELECT
                R.DebtorId,
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(S.value)), '') COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS Phone,
                R.ImportDate,
                R.TEMPId,
                rn = ROW_NUMBER() OVER
                (
                    PARTITION BY
                        R.DebtorId,
                        NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(S.value)), '') COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
                    ORDER BY R.TEMPId
                )
            FROM #Resolved R
            CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT
            (
                REPLACE(
                    REPLACE(
                        REPLACE(ISNULL(R.PhoneRaw, ''), N'；', N';'),
                        N'，', N';'
                    ),
                    N',', N';'
                ),
                ';'
            ) S
        )
        INSERT INTO dbo.DataDebtorContact
        (
            DebtorContactId,
            DebtorId,
            DebtorContactTypeId,
            DebtorContactChannelId,
            DebtorContactValue,
            ImportType,
            CreateDate
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID() AS DebtorContactId,
            P.DebtorId,
            1 AS DebtorContactTypeId,
            2 AS DebtorContactChannelId,
            P.Phone AS DebtorContactValue,
            1 AS ImportType,
            ISNULL(P.ImportDate, GETDATE()) AS CreateDate
        FROM CTE_Phone P
        WHERE P.Phone IS NOT NULL
          AND P.rn = 1
          AND NOT EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.DataDebtorContact C
              WHERE C.DebtorId = P.DebtorId
                AND C.DebtorContactTypeId = 1
                AND C.DebtorContactChannelId = 2
                AND C.DebtorContactValue COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT = P.Phone COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
          );

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 3) Insert Contact : HouseMobileNumber
        -- กันซ้ำใน source + ปลายทาง
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        ;WITH CTE_Mobile AS
        (
            SELECT
                R.DebtorId,
                R.MobileRaw,
                R.ImportDate,
                R.TEMPId,
                rn = ROW_NUMBER() OVER
                (
                    PARTITION BY
                        R.DebtorId,
                        ISNULL(R.MobileRaw, '')
                    ORDER BY R.TEMPId
                )
            FROM #Resolved R
            WHERE R.MobileRaw IS NOT NULL
        )
        INSERT INTO dbo.DataDebtorContact
        (
            DebtorContactId,
            DebtorId,
            DebtorContactTypeId,
            DebtorContactChannelId,
            DebtorContactValue,
            ImportType,
            CreateDate
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID() AS DebtorContactId,
            M.DebtorId,
            2 AS DebtorContactTypeId,
            2 AS DebtorContactChannelId,
            M.MobileRaw AS DebtorContactValue,
            1 AS ImportType,
            ISNULL(M.ImportDate, GETDATE()) AS CreateDate
        FROM CTE_Mobile M
        WHERE M.rn = 1
          AND NOT EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.DataDebtorContact C
              WHERE C.DebtorId = M.DebtorId
                AND C.DebtorContactTypeId = 2
                AND C.DebtorContactChannelId = 2
                AND C.DebtorContactValue COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT = M.MobileRaw COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
          );

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 4) Insert Contact : HouseFaxNumber
        -- กันซ้ำใน source + ปลายทาง
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        ;WITH CTE_Fax AS
        (
            SELECT
                R.DebtorId,
                R.FaxRaw,
                R.ImportDate,
                R.TEMPId,
                rn = ROW_NUMBER() OVER
                (
                    PARTITION BY
                        R.DebtorId,
                        ISNULL(R.FaxRaw, '')
                    ORDER BY R.TEMPId
                )
            FROM #Resolved R
            WHERE R.FaxRaw IS NOT NULL
        )
        INSERT INTO dbo.DataDebtorContact
        (
            DebtorContactId,
            DebtorId,
            DebtorContactTypeId,
            DebtorContactChannelId,
            DebtorContactValue,
            ImportType,
            CreateDate
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID() AS DebtorContactId,
            F.DebtorId,
            6 AS DebtorContactTypeId,
            2 AS DebtorContactChannelId,
            F.FaxRaw AS DebtorContactValue,
            1 AS ImportType,
            ISNULL(F.ImportDate, GETDATE()) AS CreateDate
        FROM CTE_Fax F
        WHERE F.rn = 1
          AND NOT EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.DataDebtorContact C
              WHERE C.DebtorId = F.DebtorId
                AND C.DebtorContactTypeId = 6
                AND C.DebtorContactChannelId = 2
                AND C.DebtorContactValue COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT = F.FaxRaw COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
          );

        COMMIT TRAN;

        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Resolved') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Resolved;
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Mapped')   IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Mapped;
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Raw')      IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Raw;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK TRAN;

        DECLARE
            @ErrMsg  NVARCHAR(4000) = ERROR_MESSAGE(),
            @ErrNo   INT = ERROR_NUMBER(),
            @ErrSev  INT = ERROR_SEVERITY(),
            @ErrSt   INT = ERROR_STATE(),
            @ErrLine INT = ERROR_LINE();

        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Resolved') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Resolved;
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Mapped')   IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Mapped;
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Raw')      IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Raw;

        RAISERROR(
            N'[SP_INTERFACE_013_InsertTEMPDebtorHomeAddressCBS] failed (%d, Sev %d, State %d, Line %d): %s',
            @ErrSev,
            1,
            @ErrNo, @ErrSev, @ErrSt, @ErrLine, @ErrMsg
        );
        RETURN;
    END CATCH
END
