    --    CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_TEMPMapLGCBS_LG_Debtor ON dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS (LGNo, DebtorCode);
    --END
    --ELSE
    --BEGIN
    --    IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS','DebtorTypeId') IS NULL
    --        ALTER TABLE dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS ADD DebtorTypeId INT NULL;
    --END;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRAN;

        /* ---------- 1) เลือกแถวล่าสุดต่อ IDCard ---------- */
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Latest') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Latest;

        SELECT *
        INTO #Latest
        FROM
        (
            SELECT t.*,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.IDCard ORDER BY t.ImportDate DESC, t.TempId DESC) AS rn
            FROM dbo.TEMPDebtorJoinCBS AS t
        ) s
        WHERE s.rn = 1
          AND ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(IDCard)),'') <> '';

        /* ---------- 2) เฉพาะที่ยังไม่อยู่ใน DataDebtor + เติมคอลัมน์ที่หายไป ---------- */
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ToInsert') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ToInsert;

        SELECT
            l.*,

            -- คอลัมน์ข้อมูลบุคคล/ธุรกิจ (กัน invalid column)
            CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(200))  AS NamePrint,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(20,0))  AS FixedAssetValue,
            CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(50))   AS ContactPhoneNumber,
            CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(50))   AS ContactMobileNumber,
            CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(50))   AS ContactFaxNumber,
            CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(100))  AS BusinessType,
            CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(200))  AS BusinessTypeName,
            CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(200))  AS BusinessTypeGroupName,
            CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(300))  AS CompanyNameTH,
            CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(100))  AS CompanyType,
            CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(200))  AS CompanyType1,           -- Description
            CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(500))  AS BusinessDescription,
            CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(50))   AS ISICCode,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,0))  AS TotalClaim,
            CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(50))   AS ProvinceCode,
            CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(50))   AS RegistrationNo,
            CAST(NULL AS INT)            AS LoanerTotal,

            -- คอลัมน์ที่อยู่ (กัน invalid column)
            CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(100))  AS AddressNumber,
            CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(200))  AS PlaceName,
            CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(50))   AS Moo,
            CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(100))  AS Soi,
            CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(200))  AS Road,
            CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(20))   AS PostalCode,
            CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(100))  AS LineID,
            CAST(NULL AS INT)            AS ProvinceId,
            CAST(NULL AS INT)            AS SubDistrictId,
            CAST(NULL AS INT)            AS DistrictId,

            -- สำหรับ JOIN ไป DataLG (รองรับกรณี staging มีเฉพาะ 'CIF')
            CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(50))   AS CIFNo
        INTO #ToInsert
        FROM #Latest AS l
        WHERE NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.DataDebtor AS d
            WHERE d.IDCard = l.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
        );

        /* ---------- 3) Map TitleId ---------- */
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#MapTitle') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #MapTitle;

        SELECT ti.*, st.TitleId
        INTO #MapTitle
        FROM #ToInsert AS ti
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemTitleMaster AS st
               ON st.TitleCode = ti.TitleCode;

        /* ---------- 4) Running Number (พ.ศ.) ---------- */
        DECLARE @BEYear INT = YEAR(GETDATE()) + 542;
        DECLARE @YY CHAR(2) = RIGHT(CONVERT(VARCHAR(4), @BEYear), 2);
        DECLARE @Prefix NCHAR(3) = N'C' + @YY;

        DECLARE @N INT = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #MapTitle);
        DECLARE @Current INT, @StartRun INT, @EndRun INT;

        IF @N > 0
        BEGIN
            IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.SystemRunningDebtorCode WHERE YearPrefix = @Prefix)
                INSERT dbo.SystemRunningDebtorCode(YearPrefix, LastRun) VALUES(@Prefix, 0);

            SELECT @Current = LastRun FROM dbo.SystemRunningDebtorCode WHERE YearPrefix = @Prefix;

            SET @StartRun = @Current + 1;
            SET @EndRun   = @Current + @N;

            UPDATE dbo.SystemRunningDebtorCode SET LastRun = @EndRun WHERE YearPrefix = @Prefix;
        END;

        /* ---------- 5) ใส่เลขรันต่อแถว ---------- */
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Numbered') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Numbered;

        SELECT
            mt.*,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY mt.IDCard) AS rn_order,
            CASE WHEN @N > 0 THEN @StartRun + ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY mt.IDCard) - 1 END AS NextRun
        INTO #Numbered
        FROM #MapTitle AS mt;

        /* ---------- 6) INSERT DataDebtor ---------- */
        DECLARE @InsertedDebtor TABLE
        (
            DebtorId   NVARCHAR(150),
            IDCard     NVARCHAR(20),
            DebtorCode NVARCHAR(20)
        );

        INSERT INTO dbo.DataDebtor
        (
            DebtorCode, DebtorTypeId, TitleId, FirstName, LastName, DebtorName,
            CardTypeId, CardNumber, CompanyNameEN, BirthDate, FixedAssetValue, DebtorId,
            OldSection, IDCard, RefCode, ContactName, Email, CntPhoneNumber, CntMobileNumber, CntFaxNumber,
            DefaultAddressId, Note, BusinessType, BusinessTypeName, CompanyType, CompanyTypeDescription, BusinessDescription,
            EmploymentQty, IncEmploymentQty, ISICCode, TotalClaim, DebtorCodeType, DivisionCode, ProvinceCode,
            RegistrationType, RegistrationNo, CompanyEngName, RegistrationDate, LoanerTotal, ImportDate,
            BusinessStatus, BusinessStatusDate, CreateDate, CreateBy, UpdateDate, UpdateBy, NotSendSMS, RefMigrateId,
            IsActive, Age, StatusPersonId, LineID, DebtorCBSId, GenderId, PersonGroupId, BusinessStatusId, BusinessTypeId,
            CompanyTypeId, BusinessDescriptionId, FilingDueDate, BankFilingDate, LawOfficeSectionId, ImportType
        )
        OUTPUT inserted.DebtorId, inserted.IDCard, inserted.DebtorCode
          INTO @InsertedDebtor(DebtorId, IDCard, DebtorCode)
        SELECT
            CONCAT(@Prefix, RIGHT(CONCAT(N'000000', CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), n.NextRun)), 6)) AS DebtorCode,
            NULL                                        AS DebtorTypeId,
            n.TitleId                                   AS TitleId,
            n.FirstName                                 AS FirstName,
            n.LastName                                  AS LastName,
            ISNULL(NULLIF(n.NamePrint, ''), LTRIM(RTRIM(CONCAT(n.FirstName, ' ', n.LastName)))) AS DebtorName,
            NULL                                        AS CardTypeId,
            n.IDCard                                    AS CardNumber,
            NULL                                        AS CompanyNameEN,
            n.BirthDate                                 AS BirthDate,
            TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(20,0), n.FixedAssetValue) AS FixedAssetValue,
            NEWID()                                     AS DebtorId,
            NULL                                        AS OldSection,
            n.IDCard                                    AS IDCard,
            n.CIF                                       AS RefCode,
            n.ContactName                               AS ContactName,
            n.Email                                     AS Email,
            n.ContactPhoneNumber                        AS CntPhoneNumber,
            n.ContactMobileNumber                       AS CntMobileNumber,
            n.ContactFaxNumber                          AS CntFaxNumber,
            NULL                                        AS DefaultAddressId,
            NULL                                        AS Note,
            n.BusinessType                              AS BusinessType,
            n.BusinessTypeName                          AS BusinessTypeName,
            n.CompanyType                               AS CompanyType,
            n.CompanyType1                              AS CompanyTypeDescription,
            n.BusinessDescription                       AS BusinessDescription,
            NULL                                        AS EmploymentQty,
            NULL                                        AS IncEmploymentQty,
            n.ISICCode                                  AS ISICCode,
            TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(18,0), n.TotalClaim)    AS TotalClaim,
            NULL                                        AS DebtorCodeType,
            NULL                                        AS DivisionCode,
            n.ProvinceCode                              AS ProvinceCode,
            NULL                                        AS RegistrationType,
            n.RegistrationNo                            AS RegistrationNo,
            NULL                                        AS CompanyEngName,
            n.RegistrationDate                          AS RegistrationDate,
            TRY_CONVERT(INT, n.LoanerTotal)             AS LoanerTotal,
            n.ImportDate                                AS ImportDate,
            NULL                                        AS BusinessStatus,
            NULL                                        AS BusinessStatusDate,
            GETDATE()                                   AS CreateDate,
            1                                           AS CreateBy,
            GETDATE()                                   AS UpdateDate,
            1                                           AS UpdateBy,
            0                                           AS NotSendSMS,
            NULL                                        AS RefMigrateId,
            1                                           AS IsActive,
            DATEDIFF(YEAR, n.BirthDate, GETDATE())      AS Age,
            NULL                                        AS StatusPersonId,
            NULL                                        AS LineID,
            n.TempId                                    AS DebtorCBSId,
            NULL                                        AS GenderId,
            NULL                                        AS PersonGroupId,
            NULL                                        AS BusinessStatusId,
            NULL                                        AS BusinessTypeId,
            NULL                                        AS CompanyTypeId,
            NULL                                        AS BusinessDescriptionId,
            NULL                                        AS FilingDueDate,
            NULL                                        AS BankFilingDate,
            NULL                                        AS LawOfficeSectionId,
            1                                           AS ImportType
        FROM #Numbered AS n;

        /* ---------- 7) INSERT DataDebtorContact (Collation-safe JOIN & WHERE) ---------- */
        INSERT INTO dbo.DataDebtorContact
        (
            DebtorContactId, DebtorId, DebtorContactTypeId, DebtorContactValue,
            DebtorContactExtension, DebtorContactChannelId, IsDefault,
            CreateBy, CreateDate, UpdateBy, UpdateDate, DebtorContactCBSId, ImportType
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID()                 AS DebtorContactId,
            i.DebtorId              AS DebtorId,
            t.ContactType           AS DebtorContactTypeId,
            t.ContactValue          AS DebtorContactValue,
            NULL                    AS DebtorContactExtension,
            NULL                    AS DebtorContactChannelId,
            1                       AS IsDefault,
            1                       AS CreateBy,
            GETDATE()               AS CreateDate,
            1                       AS UpdateBy,
            GETDATE()               AS UpdateDate,
            NULL                    AS DebtorContactCBSId,
            1                       AS ImportType
        FROM @InsertedDebtor AS i
        JOIN #Numbered AS n
          ON n.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT = i.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
        CROSS APPLY (VALUES
            (1, n.ContactPhoneNumber),
            (2, n.ContactMobileNumber),
            (6, n.ContactFaxNumber)
        ) AS t(ContactType, ContactValue)
        WHERE ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(t.ContactValue COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)),'') <> '';

        /* ---------- 8) INSERT DataDebtorAddress (Collation-safe JOIN & WHERE) ---------- */
       exec dbo.SP_INTERFACE_034_InsertDataDebtorAddressJoin

        /* ---------- 9) Insert TEMPMapLGCBS (เอา CIFNo จาก staging ไป JOIN DataLG เพื่อดึง LGNo) ---------- */
        --INSERT INTO dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS
        --(
        --    TEMPMapLGId, CIFNo, LGNo, DebtorCode, ImportDate, DebtorTypeId
        --)
        --SELECT
        --    NEWID()                                        AS TEMPMapLGId,
        --    lg.CIFNo                                       AS CIFNo,        -- จาก DataLG
        --    lg.LGNo                                        AS LGNo,         -- จาก DataLG
        --    i.DebtorCode                                   AS DebtorCode,
        --    GETDATE()                                      AS ImportDate,
        --    4                                              AS DebtorTypeId
        --FROM @InsertedDebtor AS i
        --JOIN #Numbered AS n
        --  ON n.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT = i.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
        --JOIN dbo.DataLG AS lg
        --  ON lg.CIFNo COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT =
        --     (CASE WHEN n.CIFNo IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(n.CIFNo)) <> ''
        --           THEN n.CIFNo ELSE n.CIF END) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
        --WHERE ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(lg.LGNo COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)),'') <> ''
        --  AND NOT EXISTS
        --  (
        --      SELECT 1
        --      FROM dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS m
        --      WHERE m.DebtorCode = i.DebtorCode COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
        --        AND m.LGNo       = lg.LGNo COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
        --  );

        COMMIT TRAN;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0 ROLLBACK TRAN;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_015_InsertEStatement]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    BEGIN TRAN;

    INSERT INTO dbo.DataEStatement
    (
        EStatementId,
        Reference1,
        Reference2,
        BankId,
        BankBranchId,
        BankCode,
        BankAccountNo,
        Amount,
        IsCheck,
        ReceiptId,
        ReceiptNo,
        StatementDate,
        PaymentDate,
        Remark,
        CreateDate,
        CreateBy,
        UpdateDate,
        UpdateBy,
        CustomerName,
        LGNo,
        BankName,
        StatementNo,
        BankReference1,
        BankReference2,
        BillPaymentId,
        DebtorCardId,
        BankBranchName,
        IsConfirm,
        BankBranchCode,
        MappingDate,
        StatusEStatement,
        TellerNo,
        BillType,
        PayType,
        CreateDateEStatement
    )
    SELECT
        CONVERT(nvarchar(150), NEWID())                       AS EStatementId,
        LEFT(t.Reference1, 30)                                 AS Reference1,
        LEFT(t.Reference2, 30)                                 AS Reference2,
        sb.BankId                                              AS BankId,
        NULL                                                   AS BankBranchId,
        LEFT(t.BankCode, 30)                                   AS BankCode,
        LEFT(t.AccountNo, 30)                                  AS BankAccountNo,
        CAST(t.PayAmount AS decimal(20, 2))                    AS Amount,
        CAST(0 AS bit)                                         AS IsCheck,
        t.MappingReceiptId                                     AS ReceiptId,
        NULL                                                   AS ReceiptNo,
        t.UpdateDateES                                         AS StatementDate,
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(datetime, t.PayTime), t.PayDate)  AS PaymentDate,
        NULL                                                   AS Remark,
        GETDATE()                                              AS CreateDate,
        0                                                      AS CreateBy,      -- ปรับเป็น 0 เผื่อคอลัมน์เป็น NOT NULL
        GETDATE()                                              AS UpdateDate,    -- แก้จุดที่ error: ต้องไม่เป็น NULL
        0                                                      AS UpdateBy,      -- ปรับเป็น 0 เผื่อคอลัมน์เป็น NOT NULL
        LEFT(t.CustomerName, 200)                              AS CustomerName,
        LEFT(t.Reference2, 30)                                 AS LGNo,
        sb.BankName                                            AS BankName,
        LEFT(t.BillPaymentNo, 30)                              AS StatementNo,
        NULL                                                   AS BankReference1,
        NULL                                                   AS BankReference2,
        NULL                                                   AS BillPaymentId,
        NULL                                                   AS DebtorCardId,
        LEFT(t.BranchName, 30)                                 AS BankBranchName,
        CAST(0 AS bit)                                         AS IsConfirm,
        LEFT(t.Status, 30)                                     AS BankBranchCode,
        GETDATE()                                              AS MappingDate,
        TRY_CONVERT(int, t.Status)                             AS StatusEStatement,
        LEFT(t.TellerNo, 20)                                   AS TellerNo,
        TRY_CONVERT(int, t.BillType)                           AS BillType,
        TRY_CONVERT(int, t.PayType)                            AS PayType,
        t.CreateDate                                           AS CreateDateEStatement
    FROM dbo.TEMPEStatement AS t
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemBankMaster AS sb
        ON sb.BankCode = t.BankCode
    WHERE NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.DataEStatement AS d
        WHERE d.StatementNo = LEFT(t.BillPaymentNo, 30)
          AND d.StatusEStatement = TRY_CONVERT(int, t.Status)
    )
	and t.Reference1 != '----------';

    COMMIT;

    /*
        Daily outbound preparation
        --------------------------
        ProcessEStatementInbound already calls this procedure.  After the
        inbound import is committed, reconcile receipt/transfer source rows
        into the two E-Statement output tables before RunEStatementBatch
        exports the CSV files.

        Only rows with a real receipt/payment source are selected.  The
        downstream SPs keep their own idempotency guards, so this block is
        safe to run every day and also repairs incomplete output rows.
    */

    -- Receipt: ACCDataReceipt + DataEStatement -> SP_ACC_003
    DECLARE
        @ReceiptEStatementId       nvarchar(150),
        @ReceiptMappingReceiptId   nvarchar(150),
        @ReceiptNo                 nvarchar(150),
        @ReceiptLGNo               nvarchar(150),
        @ReceiptAmount             decimal(18,2),
        @ReceiptDate               datetime,
        @ReceiptCreateUser         nvarchar(150);

    DECLARE ReceiptSyncCursor CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR
        SELECT
            d.EStatementId,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.ReceiptId)), ''), r.ReceiptId),
            r.ReceiptNo,
            r.LGNo,
            CONVERT(decimal(18,2), r.PaymentAmount),
            r.ReceiptDate,
            CONVERT(nvarchar(150), ISNULL(r.CreateBy, 0))
        FROM dbo.ACCDataReceipt r
        CROSS APPLY
        (
            SELECT TOP (1)
                d0.EStatementId,
                d0.ReceiptId,
                d0.StatementNo,
                d0.LGNo,
                d0.Amount,
                d0.PaymentDate,
                d0.BankCode,
                d0.UpdateDate,
                d0.CreateDate
            FROM dbo.DataEStatement d0
            WHERE
              (
                  (NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(r.eStatementId)), '') IS NOT NULL
                   AND d0.EStatementId = r.eStatementId)
               OR (NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(r.eStatementId)), '') IS NULL
                   AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(r.ReceiptId)), '') IS NOT NULL
                   AND d0.ReceiptId = r.ReceiptId)
              )
              AND ISNULL(d0.IsDelete, 0) = 0
            ORDER BY
                CASE WHEN d0.EStatementId = r.eStatementId THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                d0.UpdateDate DESC,
                d0.CreateDate DESC
        ) d
        WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(r.ReceiptNo)), '') IS NOT NULL
          AND ISNULL(r.IsCancel, 0) = 0
          AND NOT EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.Output_eStatementReceipt o
              WHERE (o.EStatementId = d.EStatementId OR o.ReceiptNo = r.ReceiptNo)
                AND ISNULL(o.[Status], '1') <> '2'
                AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(o.EStatementId)), '') IS NOT NULL
                AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(o.MappingReceiptId)), '') IS NOT NULL
                AND (NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.StatementNo)), '') IS NULL
                     OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(o.BillPaymentNo)), '') IS NOT NULL)
                AND (NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.LGNo)), '') IS NULL
                     OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(o.LGNo)), '') IS NOT NULL)
                AND ISNULL(o.StatusReceipt, '') = '1'
                AND ISNULL(o.StatusES, '') = '1'
                AND ISNULL(o.TransStatus, '') = '01'
          );

    OPEN ReceiptSyncCursor;
    FETCH NEXT FROM ReceiptSyncCursor INTO
        @ReceiptEStatementId,
        @ReceiptMappingReceiptId,
        @ReceiptNo,
        @ReceiptLGNo,
        @ReceiptAmount,
        @ReceiptDate,
        @ReceiptCreateUser;

    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
        EXEC dbo.SP_ACC_003_eStatementReceipt
             @MappingReceiptId    = @ReceiptMappingReceiptId,
             @BillPaymentNo       = N'',
             @ReceiptNo           = @ReceiptNo,
             @RequestNo           = N'',
             @LGNo                = @ReceiptLGNo,
             @ReceiptAmount       = @ReceiptAmount,
             @ReceiptDate         = @ReceiptDate,
             @ReceiptType         = N'',
             @StatusReceipt       = N'1',
             @PaymentDes2         = N'',
             @CreateUser          = @ReceiptCreateUser,
             @BankCode            = N'',
             @TanReceiptNo        = N'',
             @StatusES            = N'1',
             @TransStatus         = N'01',
             @CreateDate          = NULL,
             @UpdateDate          = NULL,
             @InputEStatementId   = @ReceiptEStatementId;

        FETCH NEXT FROM ReceiptSyncCursor INTO
            @ReceiptEStatementId,
            @ReceiptMappingReceiptId,
            @ReceiptNo,
            @ReceiptLGNo,
            @ReceiptAmount,
            @ReceiptDate,
            @ReceiptCreateUser;
    END;

    CLOSE ReceiptSyncCursor;
    DEALLOCATE ReceiptSyncCursor;

    -- Transfer: ACCDataInformPaymentEStatement -> SP_ACC_002
    DECLARE @TransferInformPaymentId nvarchar(150);

    DECLARE TransferSyncCursor CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR
        SELECT DISTINCT
            p.InformPaymentId
        FROM dbo.ACCDataInformPaymentEStatement ed
        INNER JOIN dbo.ACCDataInformPayment p
            ON p.InformPaymentId = ed.InformPaymentId
        INNER JOIN dbo.DataEStatement d
            ON d.EStatementId = ed.EStatementId
        WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(p.InformPaymentNo)), '') IS NOT NULL
          AND ISNULL(d.IsDelete, 0) = 0
          AND NOT EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.Output_eStatementTransfer o
              WHERE o.DocNo = p.InformPaymentNo
                AND ISNULL(o.BillPaymentNo, '') = ISNULL(d.StatementNo, '')
                AND ISNULL(o.[Status], '') = '1'
                AND ISNULL(o.TransactionStatus, '') = '01'
          );

    OPEN TransferSyncCursor;
    FETCH NEXT FROM TransferSyncCursor INTO @TransferInformPaymentId;

    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
        EXEC dbo.SP_ACC_002_eStatementTransactionTransfer
             @InformPaymentId = @TransferInformPaymentId;

        FETCH NEXT FROM TransferSyncCursor INTO @TransferInformPaymentId;
    END;

    CLOSE TransferSyncCursor;
    DEALLOCATE TransferSyncCursor;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_017_InsertGuarantorAddressClaim]
    @GetDate DATE = '2025-09-03'
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRAN;

        /* =========================================================
           STEP 1: ดึงข้อมูลจาก TEMP และหา DebtorId ของผู้ค้ำประกัน
           DebtorTypeId = 2
           ========================================================= */
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Raw') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #Raw;

        SELECT
            c.TEMPId,
            c.LGNO,

            r.DebtorId,

            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.GuarantorAddressNum)), '') AS AddressNumber,
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.GuarantorAddressBuilding)), '') AS PlaceName,
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.GuarantorAddressMoo)), '') AS Moo,
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.GuarantorAddressSoi)), '') AS Soi,
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.GuarantorAddressRoad)), '') AS Road,

            NULLIF(
                LTRIM(RTRIM(c.GuarantorAddressProvince)),
                ''
            ) AS ProvinceCodeSource,

            NULLIF(
                LTRIM(RTRIM(c.GuarantorAddressBoundary)),
                ''
            ) AS DistrictIdSource,

            NULLIF(
                LTRIM(RTRIM(c.GuarantorAddressDistrict)),
                ''
            ) AS SubDistrictIdSource,

            NULLIF(
                LTRIM(RTRIM(c.GuarantorAddressZipcode)),
                ''
            ) AS PostalCodeSource,

            NULLIF(
                LTRIM(RTRIM(c.GuarantorAddressPhoneNumber)),
                ''
            ) AS Telephone,

            c.SystemCreate,
            c.ImportDate
        INTO #Raw
        FROM dbo.TEMPGuarantorAddressClaim c
        INNER JOIN dbo.DataDebtorRelate r
            ON r.LGNo COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
                = c.LGNo COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
           AND r.DebtorTypeId = 2
        WHERE 
		--c.ImportDate >= @GetDate
  --        AND c.ImportDate < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @GetDate)
           NULLIF(
                LTRIM(RTRIM(c.GuarantorAddressProvince)),
                ''
              ) IS NOT NULL;


        /* =========================================================
           STEP 2: Map จังหวัด / อำเภอ / ตำบล
           ========================================================= */
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Resolved') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #Resolved;

        SELECT
            R.TEMPId,
            R.LGNO,
            R.DebtorId,

            R.AddressNumber,
            R.PlaceName,
            R.Moo,
            R.Soi,
            R.Road,

            P.ProvinceId,
            D.DistrictId,
            SD.SubDistrictId,

            CASE
                WHEN R.PostalCodeSource IS NOT NULL
                    THEN LEFT(R.PostalCodeSource, 5)

                WHEN SD.PostCode IS NOT NULL
                    THEN LEFT(SD.PostCode, 5)

                ELSE NULL
            END AS PostalCode,

            R.Telephone,
            R.SystemCreate,
            R.ImportDate
        INTO #Resolved
        FROM #Raw R
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemProvinceMaster P
            ON P.TCGProvinceCode COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
                = R.ProvinceCodeSource COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT

        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemDistrictMaster D
            ON D.DistrictId = TRY_CONVERT(
                                    INT,
                                    R.DistrictIdSource
                              )
           AND D.ProvinceId = P.ProvinceId

        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemSubDistrictMaster SD
            ON SD.SubDistrictId = TRY_CONVERT(
                                       INT,
                                       R.SubDistrictIdSource
                                   )
           AND SD.DistrictId = D.DistrictId
           AND SD.ProvinceId = P.ProvinceId;


        /* =========================================================
           STEP 3: Insert DataDebtorAddress

           กันซ้ำ 2 ระดับ
           1. ข้อมูลซ้ำภายใน TEMP
           2. ข้อมูลซ้ำกับ DataDebtorAddress
           ========================================================= */
        ;WITH CTE_Address AS
        (
            SELECT
                R.*,

                ROW_NUMBER() OVER
                (
                    PARTITION BY
                        R.DebtorId,
                        ISNULL(R.AddressNumber, ''),
                        ISNULL(R.PlaceName, ''),
                        ISNULL(R.Moo, ''),
                        ISNULL(R.Soi, ''),
                        ISNULL(R.Road, ''),
                        ISNULL(R.ProvinceId, 0),
                        ISNULL(R.DistrictId, 0),
                        ISNULL(R.SubDistrictId, 0),
                        ISNULL(R.PostalCode, '')
                    ORDER BY
                        R.TEMPId
                ) AS RowNo
            FROM #Resolved R
        )
        INSERT INTO dbo.DataDebtorAddress
        (
            DebtorAddressId,
            DebtorId,
            DebtorAddressTypeId,
            AddressNumber,
            PlaceName,
            Moo,
            Soi,
            Road,
            ProvinceId,
            SubDistrictId,
            DistrictId,
            PostalCode,
            DebtorContactChannelId,
            IsDefault,
            CreateBy,
            CreateDate,
            UpdateBy,
            UpdateDate,
            Telephone,
            Fax,
            Mobile,
            Email,
            LineID,
            DebtorAddressCBSId
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID() AS DebtorAddressId,
            R.DebtorId,

            1 AS DebtorAddressTypeId,

            R.AddressNumber,
            R.PlaceName,
            R.Moo,
            R.Soi,
            R.Road,
            R.ProvinceId,
            R.SubDistrictId,
            R.DistrictId,
            R.PostalCode,

            4 AS DebtorContactChannelId,
            CAST(0 AS BIT) AS IsDefault,

            1 AS CreateBy,
            ISNULL(R.ImportDate, GETDATE()) AS CreateDate,

            1 AS UpdateBy,
            ISNULL(R.ImportDate, GETDATE()) AS UpdateDate,

            '',
            NULL AS Fax,
            NULL AS Mobile,
            NULL AS Email,
            NULL AS LineID,

            R.TEMPId AS DebtorAddressCBSId
        FROM CTE_Address R
        WHERE R.RowNo = 1

          /* ต้องมี DebtorId */
          AND R.DebtorId IS NOT NULL

          /* ป้องกันการ Insert ที่อยู่ว่างทั้งหมด */
          AND
          (
                 R.AddressNumber IS NOT NULL
              OR R.PlaceName IS NOT NULL
              OR R.Moo IS NOT NULL
              OR R.Soi IS NOT NULL
              OR R.Road IS NOT NULL
              OR R.ProvinceId IS NOT NULL
              OR R.DistrictId IS NOT NULL
              OR R.SubDistrictId IS NOT NULL
              OR R.PostalCode IS NOT NULL
          )

          /* ตรวจสอบข้อมูลซ้ำในตารางปลายทาง */
          AND NOT EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.DataDebtorAddress DA
              WHERE DA.DebtorId = R.DebtorId
                AND DA.DebtorAddressTypeId = 1

                AND ISNULL(
                        DA.AddressNumber COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
                        ''
                    )
                    =
                    ISNULL(
                        R.AddressNumber COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
                        ''
                    )

                AND ISNULL(
                        DA.PlaceName COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
                        ''
                    )
                    =
                    ISNULL(
                        R.PlaceName COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
                        ''
                    )

                AND ISNULL(
                        DA.Moo COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
                        ''
                    )
                    =
                    ISNULL(
                        R.Moo COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
                        ''
                    )

                AND ISNULL(
                        DA.Soi COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
                        ''
                    )
                    =
                    ISNULL(
                        R.Soi COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
                        ''
                    )

                AND ISNULL(
                        DA.Road COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
                        ''
                    )
                    =
                    ISNULL(
                        R.Road COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
                        ''
                    )

                AND ISNULL(DA.ProvinceId, 0)
                    = ISNULL(R.ProvinceId, 0)

                AND ISNULL(DA.DistrictId, 0)
                    = ISNULL(R.DistrictId, 0)

                AND ISNULL(DA.SubDistrictId, 0)
                    = ISNULL(R.SubDistrictId, 0)

                AND ISNULL(
                        DA.PostalCode COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
                        ''
                    )
                    =
                    ISNULL(
                        R.PostalCode COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
                        ''
                    )
          );

        DECLARE @InsertedAddressCount INT = @@ROWCOUNT;

        COMMIT TRAN;

        /* =========================================================
           แสดงผลจำนวนรายการที่ Insert
           ========================================================= */
        SELECT
            @GetDate AS ImportDate,
            @InsertedAddressCount AS InsertedAddressCount;


        /* =========================================================
           ลบ Temporary Table
           ========================================================= */
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Resolved') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #Resolved;

        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Raw') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #Raw;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH

        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK TRAN;

        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Resolved') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #Resolved;

        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Raw') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #Raw;

        DECLARE
            @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(4000) = ERROR_MESSAGE(),
            @ErrorNumber INT = ERROR_NUMBER(),
            @ErrorLine INT = ERROR_LINE();

        RAISERROR
        (
            N'[SP_INTERFACE_017_InsertGuarantorAddressClaim] Error %d at line %d: %s',
            16,
            1,
            @ErrorNumber,
            @ErrorLine,
            @ErrorMessage
        );

        RETURN;
    END CATCH
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_018_InsertGuarantorClaim]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Pre-check: ตารางเลขรัน / TEMPMapLGCBS (เพิ่ม DebtorTypeId ถ้ายังไม่มี)
    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.SystemRunningDebtorCode','U') IS NULL
    BEGIN
        CREATE TABLE dbo.SystemRunningDebtorCode
        (
            YearPrefix NCHAR(3) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, -- เช่น 'C68'
            LastRun    INT      NOT NULL
        );
    END;

    IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS','U') IS NULL
    BEGIN
        CREATE TABLE dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS
        (
            TEMPMapLGId NVARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
            CIFNo       NVARCHAR(20)  NULL,
            LGNo        NVARCHAR(20)  NULL,
            DebtorCode  NVARCHAR(20)  NULL,
            DebtorTypeId INT          NULL,
            ImportDate  DATETIME      NOT NULL
                CONSTRAINT DF_TEMPMapLGCBS_ImportDate DEFAULT (GETDATE())
        );
        CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_TEMPMapLGCBS_LG_Debtor
            ON dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS (LGNo, DebtorCode);
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS','DebtorTypeId') IS NULL
            ALTER TABLE dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS ADD DebtorTypeId INT NULL;
    END;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRAN;

        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 1) เลือกข้อมูลจาก TEMPGuarantorClaim เฉพาะ IDCard ที่ถูกต้องและไม่ซ้ำ DataDebtor
        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Stage') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Stage;

        ;WITH LATEST AS
        (
            SELECT  t.*,
                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                        PARTITION BY t.IDCard
                        ORDER BY 
                            CASE WHEN t.ImportDate IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END DESC,
                            t.ImportDate DESC,
                            t.TempId DESC
                    ) AS rn
            FROM dbo.TEMPGuarantorClaim t
            WHERE 
                t.IDCard IS NOT NULL
                AND LTRIM(RTRIM(t.IDCard)) <> N''
                AND t.IDCard NOT LIKE '%[^0-9]%'   -- เฉพาะตัวเลขล้วน
        )
        SELECT *
        INTO #Stage
        FROM LATEST s
        WHERE s.rn = 1
          AND NOT EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.DataDebtor d
              WHERE d.IDCard = s.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
          );

        -- Map TitleId จาก TitleCode
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#StageTitle') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #StageTitle;
        SELECT  s.*, st.TitleId
        INTO #StageTitle
        FROM #Stage s
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemTitleMaster st
               ON st.TitleCode = s.TitleCode;

        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2) กันชนเลขรัน DebtorCode: C + YY(พ.ศ.) + 6 หลัก
        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        DECLARE @BEYear  INT  = YEAR(GETDATE()) + 543;
        DECLARE @YY      CHAR(2) = RIGHT(CONVERT(VARCHAR(4), @BEYear), 2);
        DECLARE @Prefix  NCHAR(3) = N'C' + @YY;

        DECLARE @N INT = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #StageTitle);
        DECLARE @Current INT, @StartRun INT, @EndRun INT;

        IF @N > 0
        BEGIN
            IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.SystemRunningDebtorCode WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) WHERE YearPrefix = @Prefix)
            BEGIN
                INSERT dbo.SystemRunningDebtorCode (YearPrefix, LastRun)
                VALUES (@Prefix, 0);
            END;

            SELECT @Current = LastRun
            FROM dbo.SystemRunningDebtorCode WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
            WHERE YearPrefix = @Prefix;

            SET @StartRun = @Current + 1;
            SET @EndRun   = @Current + @N;

            IF @EndRun > 999999
            BEGIN
                THROW 50001, 'DebtorCode running number for current BE year would exceed 999999.', 1;
            END;

            UPDATE dbo.SystemRunningDebtorCode
            SET LastRun = @EndRun
            WHERE YearPrefix = @Prefix;
        END;

        -- แก้ duplicate 'rn' โดยรีเนม rn เดิมเป็น rn_latest แล้วสร้าง rn_order ใหม่
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Numbered') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Numbered;
        SELECT  t2.*,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.IDCard) AS rn_order,
                CASE WHEN @N > 0 THEN @StartRun + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.IDCard) - 1 END AS NextRun
        INTO #Numbered
        FROM (
            SELECT t.*, t.rn AS rn_latest
            FROM #StageTitle t
        ) AS t2;

        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 3) INSERT DataDebtor (DebtorTypeId = 6 ตายตัว)
        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        DECLARE @InsertedDebtor TABLE
        (
            DebtorId   NVARCHAR(150),
            DebtorCode NVARCHAR(20),
            IDCard     NVARCHAR(20)
        );

        INSERT INTO dbo.DataDebtor
        (
            DebtorCode, DebtorTypeId, TitleId, FirstName, LastName, DebtorName,
            CardTypeId, CardNumber, CompanyNameEN, BirthDate, FixedAssetValue, DebtorId,
            OldSection, IDCard, RefCode, ContactName, Email, CntPhoneNumber, CntMobileNumber, CntFaxNumber,
            DefaultAddressId, Note, BusinessType, BusinessTypeName, CompanyType, CompanyTypeDescription, BusinessDescription,
            EmploymentQty, IncEmploymentQty, ISICCode, Totalclaim, DebtorCodeType, DivisionCode, ProvinceCode,
            RegistrationType, RegistrationNo, CompanyEngName, RegistrationDate, LoanerTotal, ImportDate,
            BusinessStatus, BusinessStatusDate, CreateDate, CreateBy, UpdateDate, UpdateBy, NotSendSMS, RefMigrateId,
            IsActive, Age, StatusPersonId, LineID, DebtorCBSId, GenderId, PersonGroupId, BusinessStatusId, BusinessTypeId,
            CompanyTypeId, BusinessDescriptionId, FilingDueDate, BankFilingDate, LawOfficeSectionId, ImportType
        )
        OUTPUT inserted.DebtorId, inserted.DebtorCode, inserted.IDCard
        INTO @InsertedDebtor(DebtorId, DebtorCode, IDCard)
        SELECT
            CONCAT(@Prefix, RIGHT(CONCAT(N'000000', CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), n.NextRun)), 6))          AS DebtorCode,
            6                                                                                       AS DebtorTypeId,  -- FIXED
            n.TitleId                                                                               AS TitleId,
            LEFT(n.FirstName , 100)                                                                 AS FirstName,
            LEFT(n.LastName  , 100)                                                                 AS LastName,
            LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONCAT(COALESCE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(100), n.FirstName), N''),
                                     CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(n.LastName)), N'') IS NULL THEN N'' ELSE N' ' END,
                                     COALESCE(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(100), n.LastName),  N'')))), 500)   AS DebtorName,
            NULL AS CardTypeId,
            LEFT(n.IDCard, 20) AS CardNumber,
            NULL AS CompanyNameEN,
            NULL AS BirthDate,
            NULL AS FixedAssetValue,
            CONVERT(NVARCHAR(150), NEWID()) AS DebtorId,
            NULL AS OldSection,
            LEFT(n.IDCard, 20) AS IDCard,
            LEFT(n.CIF, 30)    AS RefCode,               -- เก็บ CIF เป็นอ้างอิง
            NULL AS ContactName,
            NULL AS Email,
            NULL AS CntPhoneNumber,
            NULL AS CntMobileNumber,
            NULL AS CntFaxNumber,
            NULL AS DefaultAddressId,
            NULL AS Note,
            NULL AS BusinessType,
            NULL AS BusinessTypeName,
            NULL AS CompanyType,
            NULL AS CompanyTypeDescription,
            NULL AS BusinessDescription,
            NULL AS EmploymentQty,
            NULL AS IncEmploymentQty,
            NULL AS ISICCode,
            NULL AS Totalclaim,
            NULL AS DebtorCodeType,
            NULL AS DivisionCode,
            NULL AS ProvinceCode,
            NULL AS RegistrationType,
            NULL AS RegistrationNo,
            NULL AS CompanyEngName,
            NULL AS RegistrationDate,
            NULL AS LoanerTotal,
            n.ImportDate,
            NULL AS BusinessStatus,
            NULL AS BusinessStatusDate,
            GETDATE() AS CreateDate,
            1 AS CreateBy,
            GETDATE() AS UpdateDate,
            1 AS UpdateBy,
            0 AS NotSendSMS,
            NULL AS RefMigrateId,
            1 AS IsActive,
            NULL AS Age,
            NULL AS StatusPersonId,
            NULL AS LineID,
            CONVERT(NVARCHAR(150), n.TempId) AS DebtorCBSId,
            NULL AS GenderId,
            NULL AS PersonGroupId,
            NULL AS BusinessStatusId,
            NULL AS BusinessTypeId,
            NULL AS CompanyTypeId,
            NULL AS BusinessDescriptionId,
            NULL AS FilingDueDate,
            NULL AS BankFilingDate,
            NULL AS LawOfficeSectionId,
            1 AS ImportType
        FROM #Numbered n;

        DECLARE @InsertedDebtorCount INT = @@ROWCOUNT;

        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 4) TEMPMapLGCBS (CIF, LGNo, DebtorCode, DebtorTypeId=6)
        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        INSERT INTO dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS (TEMPMapLGId, CIFNo, LGNo, DebtorCode, DebtorTypeId, ImportDate)
        SELECT
            CONVERT(NVARCHAR(150), NEWID()),
            LEFT(n.CIF , 20),
            LEFT(n.LGNo, 20),
            LEFT(i.DebtorCode, 20),
            6,
            GETDATE()
        FROM @InsertedDebtor i
        JOIN #Numbered n 
          ON n.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT = i.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
        WHERE n.LGNo IS NOT NULL
          AND LTRIM(RTRIM(n.LGNo COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)) <> N''
          AND NOT EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS m
              WHERE m.DebtorCode = i.DebtorCode COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
                AND m.LGNo       = LEFT(n.LGNo,20) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
          );

        DECLARE @InsertedMapCount INT = @@ROWCOUNT;

        COMMIT TRAN;

        SELECT  @InsertedDebtorCount AS InsertedDataDebtor,
                @InsertedMapCount    AS InsertedTEMPMapLGCBS,
                N'Insert TEMPGuarantorClaim → DataDebtor + TEMPMapLGCBS (DebtorTypeId=6) สำเร็จ' AS Note;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0 ROLLBACK TRAN;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END
