CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_019_InsertGuarantorLoanCBS]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    /* =========================================================
       0) PREPARE OBJECTS
    ========================================================= */
    IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.SystemRunningDebtorCode', N'U') IS NULL
    BEGIN
        CREATE TABLE dbo.SystemRunningDebtorCode
        (
            YearPrefix NCHAR(3) NOT NULL,
            LastRun INT NOT NULL,
            CONSTRAINT PK_SystemRunningDebtorCode PRIMARY KEY (YearPrefix)
        );

        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM sys.extended_properties ep
            INNER JOIN sys.tables t
                ON ep.major_id = t.object_id
            WHERE t.name = N'SystemRunningDebtorCode'
              AND ep.minor_id = 0
              AND ep.name = N'MS_Description'
        )
        BEGIN
            EXEC sys.sp_addextendedproperty
                @name = N'MS_Description',
                @value = N'เก็บเลข Running ล่าสุดของ DebtorCode แยกตามปี พ.ศ.',
                @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'dbo',
                @level1type = N'TABLE',  @level1name = N'SystemRunningDebtorCode';
        END;

        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM sys.extended_properties ep
            INNER JOIN sys.tables t
                ON ep.major_id = t.object_id
            INNER JOIN sys.columns c
                ON c.object_id = t.object_id
               AND c.column_id = ep.minor_id
            WHERE t.name = N'SystemRunningDebtorCode'
              AND c.name = N'YearPrefix'
              AND ep.name = N'MS_Description'
        )
        BEGIN
            EXEC sys.sp_addextendedproperty
                @name = N'MS_Description',
                @value = N'Prefix ของ DebtorCode เช่น C69',
                @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'dbo',
                @level1type = N'TABLE',  @level1name = N'SystemRunningDebtorCode',
                @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'YearPrefix';
        END;

        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM sys.extended_properties ep
            INNER JOIN sys.tables t
                ON ep.major_id = t.object_id
            INNER JOIN sys.columns c
                ON c.object_id = t.object_id
               AND c.column_id = ep.minor_id
            WHERE t.name = N'SystemRunningDebtorCode'
              AND c.name = N'LastRun'
              AND ep.name = N'MS_Description'
        )
        BEGIN
            EXEC sys.sp_addextendedproperty
                @name = N'MS_Description',
                @value = N'เลข Running ล่าสุดของปีนั้น',
                @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'dbo',
                @level1type = N'TABLE',  @level1name = N'SystemRunningDebtorCode',
                @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'LastRun';
        END;
    END;

    IF COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.DataDebtorContact', N'ImportType') IS NULL
    BEGIN
        ALTER TABLE dbo.DataDebtorContact
        ADD ImportType INT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT DF_DataDebtorContact_ImportType DEFAULT (1) WITH VALUES;
    END;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM sys.extended_properties ep
        INNER JOIN sys.tables t
            ON ep.major_id = t.object_id
        INNER JOIN sys.columns c
            ON c.object_id = t.object_id
           AND c.column_id = ep.minor_id
        WHERE t.name = N'DataDebtorContact'
          AND c.name = N'ImportType'
          AND ep.name = N'MS_Description'
    )
    BEGIN
        EXEC sys.sp_addextendedproperty
            @name = N'MS_Description',
            @value = N'ประเภทการนำเข้าข้อมูล เช่น 1 = CBS',
            @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'dbo',
            @level1type = N'TABLE',  @level1name = N'DataDebtorContact',
            @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'ImportType';
    END;

    IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS', N'U') IS NULL
    BEGIN
        CREATE TABLE dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS
        (
            TEMPMapLGId NVARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
            CIFNo NVARCHAR(20) NULL,
            LGNo NVARCHAR(20) NULL,
            DebtorCode NVARCHAR(20) NULL,
            DebtorTypeId INT NULL,
            ImportDate DATETIME NOT NULL
                CONSTRAINT DF_TEMPMapLGCBS_ImportDate DEFAULT (GETDATE())
        );

        CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_TEMPMapLGCBS_LG_Debtor
            ON dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS (LGNo, DebtorCode);

        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM sys.extended_properties ep
            INNER JOIN sys.tables t
                ON ep.major_id = t.object_id
            WHERE t.name = N'TEMPMapLGCBS'
              AND ep.minor_id = 0
              AND ep.name = N'MS_Description'
        )
        BEGIN
            EXEC sys.sp_addextendedproperty
                @name = N'MS_Description',
                @value = N'ตารางเก็บความสัมพันธ์ระหว่าง LGNo และ DebtorCode จากข้อมูลนำเข้า CBS',
                @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'dbo',
                @level1type = N'TABLE',  @level1name = N'TEMPMapLGCBS';
        END;

        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM sys.extended_properties ep
            INNER JOIN sys.tables t
                ON ep.major_id = t.object_id
            INNER JOIN sys.columns c
                ON c.object_id = t.object_id
               AND c.column_id = ep.minor_id
            WHERE t.name = N'TEMPMapLGCBS'
              AND c.name = N'TEMPMapLGId'
              AND ep.name = N'MS_Description'
        )
        BEGIN
            EXEC sys.sp_addextendedproperty
                @name = N'MS_Description',
                @value = N'รหัสรายการ map ชั่วคราว',
                @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'dbo',
                @level1type = N'TABLE',  @level1name = N'TEMPMapLGCBS',
                @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'TEMPMapLGId';
        END;

        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM sys.extended_properties ep
            INNER JOIN sys.tables t
                ON ep.major_id = t.object_id
            INNER JOIN sys.columns c
                ON c.object_id = t.object_id
               AND c.column_id = ep.minor_id
            WHERE t.name = N'TEMPMapLGCBS'
              AND c.name = N'CIFNo'
              AND ep.name = N'MS_Description'
        )
        BEGIN
            EXEC sys.sp_addextendedproperty
                @name = N'MS_Description',
                @value = N'CIF จากข้อมูลต้นทาง',
                @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'dbo',
                @level1type = N'TABLE',  @level1name = N'TEMPMapLGCBS',
                @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'CIFNo';
        END;

        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM sys.extended_properties ep
            INNER JOIN sys.tables t
                ON ep.major_id = t.object_id
            INNER JOIN sys.columns c
                ON c.object_id = t.object_id
               AND c.column_id = ep.minor_id
            WHERE t.name = N'TEMPMapLGCBS'
              AND c.name = N'LGNo'
              AND ep.name = N'MS_Description'
        )
        BEGIN
            EXEC sys.sp_addextendedproperty
                @name = N'MS_Description',
                @value = N'เลข LG จากข้อมูลต้นทาง',
                @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'dbo',
                @level1type = N'TABLE',  @level1name = N'TEMPMapLGCBS',
                @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'LGNo';
        END;

        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM sys.extended_properties ep
            INNER JOIN sys.tables t
                ON ep.major_id = t.object_id
            INNER JOIN sys.columns c
                ON c.object_id = t.object_id
               AND c.column_id = ep.minor_id
            WHERE t.name = N'TEMPMapLGCBS'
              AND c.name = N'DebtorCode'
              AND ep.name = N'MS_Description'
        )
        BEGIN
            EXEC sys.sp_addextendedproperty
                @name = N'MS_Description',
                @value = N'รหัสลูกหนี้ใน DataDebtor',
                @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'dbo',
                @level1type = N'TABLE',  @level1name = N'TEMPMapLGCBS',
                @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'DebtorCode';
        END;

        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM sys.extended_properties ep
            INNER JOIN sys.tables t
                ON ep.major_id = t.object_id
            INNER JOIN sys.columns c
                ON c.object_id = t.object_id
               AND c.column_id = ep.minor_id
            WHERE t.name = N'TEMPMapLGCBS'
              AND c.name = N'DebtorTypeId'
              AND ep.name = N'MS_Description'
        )
        BEGIN
            EXEC sys.sp_addextendedproperty
                @name = N'MS_Description',
                @value = N'ประเภทลูกหนี้ที่ map จาก CustType',
                @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'dbo',
                @level1type = N'TABLE',  @level1name = N'TEMPMapLGCBS',
                @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'DebtorTypeId';
        END;

        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM sys.extended_properties ep
            INNER JOIN sys.tables t
                ON ep.major_id = t.object_id
            INNER JOIN sys.columns c
                ON c.object_id = t.object_id
               AND c.column_id = ep.minor_id
            WHERE t.name = N'TEMPMapLGCBS'
              AND c.name = N'ImportDate'
              AND ep.name = N'MS_Description'
        )
        BEGIN
            EXEC sys.sp_addextendedproperty
                @name = N'MS_Description',
                @value = N'วันที่นำเข้าข้อมูล',
                @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'dbo',
                @level1type = N'TABLE',  @level1name = N'TEMPMapLGCBS',
                @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'ImportDate';
        END;
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        IF COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS', N'DebtorTypeId') IS NULL
        BEGIN
            ALTER TABLE dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS
            ADD DebtorTypeId INT NULL;
        END;

        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM sys.extended_properties ep
            INNER JOIN sys.tables t
                ON ep.major_id = t.object_id
            INNER JOIN sys.columns c
                ON c.object_id = t.object_id
               AND c.column_id = ep.minor_id
            WHERE t.name = N'TEMPMapLGCBS'
              AND c.name = N'DebtorTypeId'
              AND ep.name = N'MS_Description'
        )
        BEGIN
            EXEC sys.sp_addextendedproperty
                @name = N'MS_Description',
                @value = N'ประเภทลูกหนี้ที่ map จาก CustType',
                @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'dbo',
                @level1type = N'TABLE',  @level1name = N'TEMPMapLGCBS',
                @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'DebtorTypeId';
        END;

        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM sys.indexes
            WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS')
              AND name = N'IX_TEMPMapLGCBS_LG_Debtor'
        )
        BEGIN
            CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_TEMPMapLGCBS_LG_Debtor
                ON dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS (LGNo, DebtorCode);
        END;
    END;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRAN;

        /* =========================================================
           1) DECLARE RESULT COUNTERS
        ========================================================= */
        DECLARE @InsertedDebtorCount INT = 0;
        DECLARE @InsertedContactCount INT = 0;
        DECLARE @InsertedAddr15 INT = 0;
        DECLARE @InsertedAddr01 INT = 0;
        DECLARE @InsertedMapCount INT = 0;

        /* =========================================================
           2) PREPARE SOURCE
              - clean IDCard
              - check duplicate IDCard
              - check duplicate record
              - keep latest row by IDCard
              - exclude existing DataDebtor
        ========================================================= */
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#Source') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Source;
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#DuplicateIDCard') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #DuplicateIDCard;
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#DuplicateRecord') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #DuplicateRecord;
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#Latest') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Latest;
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#Stage') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Stage;
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#StageMap') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #StageMap;
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#Numbered') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Numbered;
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#DistrictMaster') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #DistrictMaster;
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#SubDistrictMaster') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #SubDistrictMaster;
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#ContactStage') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ContactStage;
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#Addr15') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Addr15;
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#Addr01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Addr01;

        SELECT
            t.TempId AS TempId,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(t.IDCard)) AS IDCard,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(t.FirstName)) AS FirstName,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(t.LastName)) AS LastName,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(t.TitleCode)) AS TitleCode,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(t.CustType)) AS CustType,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(t.CIF)) AS CIF,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(t.LGNo)) AS LGNo,
            t.BirthDate AS BirthDate,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(t.ContactName)) AS ContactName,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(t.Email)) AS Email,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(t.ContactPhoneNumber)) AS ContactPhoneNumber,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(t.ContactMobileNumber)) AS ContactMobileNumber,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(t.ContactFaxNumber)) AS ContactFaxNumber,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(t.HouseAddrNum)) AS HouseAddrNum,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(t.AddrBuilding)) AS AddrBuilding,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(t.HouseAddrSoi)) AS HouseAddrSoi,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(t.HouseAddrRoad)) AS HouseAddrRoad,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(t.HouseAddrProvince)) AS HouseAddrProvince,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(t.HouseAddrDistrict)) AS HouseAddrDistrict,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(t.HouseAddrBoundary)) AS HouseAddrBoundary,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(t.HouseAddrZipcode)) AS HouseAddrZipcode,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(t.ContactAddrNum)) AS ContactAddrNum,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(t.ContactAddrBuilding)) AS ContactAddrBuilding,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(t.ContactAddrSoi)) AS ContactAddrSoi,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(t.ContactAddrRoad)) AS ContactAddrRoad,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(t.ContactAddrProvince)) AS ContactAddrProvince,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(t.ContactAddrDistrict)) AS ContactAddrDistrict,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(t.ContactAddrBoundary)) AS ContactAddrBoundary,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(t.ContactAddrZipcode)) AS ContactAddrZipcode,
            t.ImportDate AS ImportDate
        INTO #Source
        FROM dbo.TEMPGuarantorLoanCBS t
        WHERE t.IDCard IS NOT NULL
          AND LTRIM(RTRIM(t.IDCard)) <> N''
          AND LTRIM(RTRIM(t.IDCard)) NOT LIKE N'%[^0-9]%';

        SELECT
            s.IDCard AS IDCard,
            COUNT(*) AS DuplicateCount
        INTO #DuplicateIDCard
        FROM #Source s
        GROUP BY s.IDCard
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

        SELECT
            s.IDCard AS IDCard,
            ISNULL(s.CIF, N'') AS CIF,
            ISNULL(s.LGNo, N'') AS LGNo,
            COUNT(*) AS DuplicateCount
        INTO #DuplicateRecord
        FROM #Source s
        GROUP BY
            s.IDCard,
            ISNULL(s.CIF, N''),
            ISNULL(s.LGNo, N'')
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

        ;WITH CTE_Latest AS
        (
            SELECT
                s.TempId AS TempId,
                s.IDCard AS IDCard,
                s.FirstName AS FirstName,
                s.LastName AS LastName,
                s.TitleCode AS TitleCode,
                s.CustType AS CustType,
                s.CIF AS CIF,
                s.LGNo AS LGNo,
                s.BirthDate AS BirthDate,
                s.ContactName AS ContactName,
                s.Email AS Email,
                s.ContactPhoneNumber AS ContactPhoneNumber,
                s.ContactMobileNumber AS ContactMobileNumber,
                s.ContactFaxNumber AS ContactFaxNumber,
                s.HouseAddrNum AS HouseAddrNum,
                s.AddrBuilding AS AddrBuilding,
                s.HouseAddrSoi AS HouseAddrSoi,
                s.HouseAddrRoad AS HouseAddrRoad,
                s.HouseAddrProvince AS HouseAddrProvince,
                s.HouseAddrDistrict AS HouseAddrDistrict,
                s.HouseAddrBoundary AS HouseAddrBoundary,
                s.HouseAddrZipcode AS HouseAddrZipcode,
                s.ContactAddrNum AS ContactAddrNum,
                s.ContactAddrBuilding AS ContactAddrBuilding,
                s.ContactAddrSoi AS ContactAddrSoi,
                s.ContactAddrRoad AS ContactAddrRoad,
                s.ContactAddrProvince AS ContactAddrProvince,
                s.ContactAddrDistrict AS ContactAddrDistrict,
                s.ContactAddrBoundary AS ContactAddrBoundary,
                s.ContactAddrZipcode AS ContactAddrZipcode,
                s.ImportDate AS ImportDate,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER
                (
                    PARTITION BY s.IDCard
                    ORDER BY
                        CASE WHEN s.ImportDate IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END DESC,
                        s.ImportDate DESC,
                        s.TempId DESC
                ) AS RowNo
            FROM #Source s
        )
        SELECT
            c.TempId AS TempId,
            c.IDCard AS IDCard,
            c.FirstName AS FirstName,
            c.LastName AS LastName,
            c.TitleCode AS TitleCode,
            c.CustType AS CustType,
            c.CIF AS CIF,
            c.LGNo AS LGNo,
            c.BirthDate AS BirthDate,
            c.ContactName AS ContactName,
            c.Email AS Email,
            c.ContactPhoneNumber AS ContactPhoneNumber,
            c.ContactMobileNumber AS ContactMobileNumber,
            c.ContactFaxNumber AS ContactFaxNumber,
            c.HouseAddrNum AS HouseAddrNum,
            c.AddrBuilding AS AddrBuilding,
            c.HouseAddrSoi AS HouseAddrSoi,
            c.HouseAddrRoad AS HouseAddrRoad,
            c.HouseAddrProvince AS HouseAddrProvince,
            c.HouseAddrDistrict AS HouseAddrDistrict,
            c.HouseAddrBoundary AS HouseAddrBoundary,
            c.HouseAddrZipcode AS HouseAddrZipcode,
            c.ContactAddrNum AS ContactAddrNum,
            c.ContactAddrBuilding AS ContactAddrBuilding,
            c.ContactAddrSoi AS ContactAddrSoi,
            c.ContactAddrRoad AS ContactAddrRoad,
            c.ContactAddrProvince AS ContactAddrProvince,
            c.ContactAddrDistrict AS ContactAddrDistrict,
            c.ContactAddrBoundary AS ContactAddrBoundary,
            c.ContactAddrZipcode AS ContactAddrZipcode,
            c.ImportDate AS ImportDate
        INTO #Latest
        FROM CTE_Latest c
        WHERE c.RowNo = 1;

        SELECT
            l.TempId AS TempId,
            l.IDCard AS IDCard,
            l.FirstName AS FirstName,
            l.LastName AS LastName,
            l.TitleCode AS TitleCode,
            l.CustType AS CustType,
            l.CIF AS CIF,
            l.LGNo AS LGNo,
            l.BirthDate AS BirthDate,
            l.ContactName AS ContactName,
            l.Email AS Email,
            l.ContactPhoneNumber AS ContactPhoneNumber,
            l.ContactMobileNumber AS ContactMobileNumber,
            l.ContactFaxNumber AS ContactFaxNumber,
            l.HouseAddrNum AS HouseAddrNum,
            l.AddrBuilding AS AddrBuilding,
            l.HouseAddrSoi AS HouseAddrSoi,
            l.HouseAddrRoad AS HouseAddrRoad,
            l.HouseAddrProvince AS HouseAddrProvince,
            l.HouseAddrDistrict AS HouseAddrDistrict,
            l.HouseAddrBoundary AS HouseAddrBoundary,
            l.HouseAddrZipcode AS HouseAddrZipcode,
            l.ContactAddrNum AS ContactAddrNum,
            l.ContactAddrBuilding AS ContactAddrBuilding,
            l.ContactAddrSoi AS ContactAddrSoi,
            l.ContactAddrRoad AS ContactAddrRoad,
            l.ContactAddrProvince AS ContactAddrProvince,
            l.ContactAddrDistrict AS ContactAddrDistrict,
            l.ContactAddrBoundary AS ContactAddrBoundary,
            l.ContactAddrZipcode AS ContactAddrZipcode,
            l.ImportDate AS ImportDate
        INTO #Stage
        FROM #Latest l
        WHERE NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.DataDebtor d
            WHERE d.IDCard COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = l.IDCard COLLATE Thai_CI_AI
        );

        SELECT
            s.TempId AS TempId,
            s.IDCard AS IDCard,
            s.FirstName AS FirstName,
            s.LastName AS LastName,
            s.TitleCode AS TitleCode,
            s.CustType AS CustType,
            s.CIF AS CIF,
            s.LGNo AS LGNo,
            s.BirthDate AS BirthDate,
            s.ContactName AS ContactName,
            s.Email AS Email,
            s.ContactPhoneNumber AS ContactPhoneNumber,
            s.ContactMobileNumber AS ContactMobileNumber,
            s.ContactFaxNumber AS ContactFaxNumber,
            s.HouseAddrNum AS HouseAddrNum,
            s.AddrBuilding AS AddrBuilding,
            s.HouseAddrSoi AS HouseAddrSoi,
            s.HouseAddrRoad AS HouseAddrRoad,
            s.HouseAddrProvince AS HouseAddrProvince,
            s.HouseAddrDistrict AS HouseAddrDistrict,
            s.HouseAddrBoundary AS HouseAddrBoundary,
            s.HouseAddrZipcode AS HouseAddrZipcode,
            s.ContactAddrNum AS ContactAddrNum,
            s.ContactAddrBuilding AS ContactAddrBuilding,
            s.ContactAddrSoi AS ContactAddrSoi,
            s.ContactAddrRoad AS ContactAddrRoad,
            s.ContactAddrProvince AS ContactAddrProvince,
            s.ContactAddrDistrict AS ContactAddrDistrict,
            s.ContactAddrBoundary AS ContactAddrBoundary,
            s.ContactAddrZipcode AS ContactAddrZipcode,
            s.ImportDate AS ImportDate,
            st.TitleId AS TitleId,
            ISNULL(dt.DebtorTypeId, 5) AS DebtorTypeId_Mapped
        INTO #StageMap
        FROM #Stage s
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemTitleMaster st
            ON st.TitleCode COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = s.TitleCode COLLATE Thai_CI_AI
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemDebtorType dt
            ON dt.DebtorTypeCode COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = s.CustType COLLATE Thai_CI_AI
            OR dt.DebtorTypeName COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = s.CustType COLLATE Thai_CI_AI;

        /* =========================================================
           3) PREPARE RUNNING NUMBER
        ========================================================= */
        DECLARE @BEYear INT = YEAR(GETDATE()) + 543;
        DECLARE @YY CHAR(2) = RIGHT(CONVERT(VARCHAR(4), @BEYear), 2);
        DECLARE @Prefix NCHAR(3) = N'C' + @YY;
        DECLARE @N INT = 0;
        DECLARE @Current INT = 0;
        DECLARE @StartRun INT = 0;
        DECLARE @EndRun INT = 0;

        SELECT @N = COUNT(*)
        FROM #StageMap;

        IF @N > 0
        BEGIN
            IF NOT EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM dbo.SystemRunningDebtorCode WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
                WHERE YearPrefix = @Prefix
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO dbo.SystemRunningDebtorCode
                (
                    YearPrefix,
                    LastRun
                )
                SELECT
                    @Prefix AS YearPrefix,
                    0 AS LastRun;
            END;

            SELECT
                @Current = r.LastRun
            FROM dbo.SystemRunningDebtorCode r WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
            WHERE r.YearPrefix = @Prefix;

            SET @StartRun = @Current + 1;
            SET @EndRun = @Current + @N;

            IF @EndRun > 999999
            BEGIN
                THROW 50001, 'DebtorCode running number for current BE year would exceed 999999.', 1;
            END;

            UPDATE dbo.SystemRunningDebtorCode
            SET LastRun = @EndRun
            WHERE YearPrefix = @Prefix;
        END;

        SELECT
            s.TempId AS TempId,
            s.IDCard AS IDCard,
            s.FirstName AS FirstName,
            s.LastName AS LastName,
            s.TitleCode AS TitleCode,
            s.CustType AS CustType,
            s.CIF AS CIF,
            s.LGNo AS LGNo,
            s.BirthDate AS BirthDate,
            s.ContactName AS ContactName,
            s.Email AS Email,
            s.ContactPhoneNumber AS ContactPhoneNumber,
            s.ContactMobileNumber AS ContactMobileNumber,
            s.ContactFaxNumber AS ContactFaxNumber,
            s.HouseAddrNum AS HouseAddrNum,
            s.AddrBuilding AS AddrBuilding,
            s.HouseAddrSoi AS HouseAddrSoi,
            s.HouseAddrRoad AS HouseAddrRoad,
            s.HouseAddrProvince AS HouseAddrProvince,
            s.HouseAddrDistrict AS HouseAddrDistrict,
            s.HouseAddrBoundary AS HouseAddrBoundary,
            s.HouseAddrZipcode AS HouseAddrZipcode,
            s.ContactAddrNum AS ContactAddrNum,
            s.ContactAddrBuilding AS ContactAddrBuilding,
            s.ContactAddrSoi AS ContactAddrSoi,
            s.ContactAddrRoad AS ContactAddrRoad,
            s.ContactAddrProvince AS ContactAddrProvince,
            s.ContactAddrDistrict AS ContactAddrDistrict,
            s.ContactAddrBoundary AS ContactAddrBoundary,
            s.ContactAddrZipcode AS ContactAddrZipcode,
            s.ImportDate AS ImportDate,
            s.TitleId AS TitleId,
            s.DebtorTypeId_Mapped AS DebtorTypeId_Mapped,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.IDCard, s.TempId) AS RowNo,
            @StartRun + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.IDCard, s.TempId) - 1 AS NextRun
        INTO #Numbered
        FROM #StageMap s;

        /* =========================================================
           4) INSERT DataDebtor
        ========================================================= */
        DECLARE @InsertedDebtor TABLE
        (
            DebtorId NVARCHAR(150),
            DebtorCode NVARCHAR(20),
            IDCard NVARCHAR(20)
        );

        INSERT INTO dbo.DataDebtor
        (
            DebtorCode,
            DebtorTypeId,
            TitleId,
            FirstName,
            LastName,
            DebtorName,
            CardTypeId,
            CardNumber,
            CompanyNameEN,
            BirthDate,
            FixedAssetValue,
            DebtorId,
            OldSection,
            IDCard,
            RefCode,
            ContactName,
            Email,
            CntPhoneNumber,
            CntMobileNumber,
            CntFaxNumber,
            DefaultAddressId,
            Note,
            BusinessType,
            BusinessTypeName,
            CompanyType,
            CompanyTypeDescription,
            BusinessDescription,
            EmploymentQty,
            IncEmploymentQty,
            ISICCode,
            Totalclaim,
            DebtorCodeType,
            DivisionCode,
            ProvinceCode,
            RegistrationType,
            RegistrationNo,
            CompanyEngName,
            RegistrationDate,
            LoanerTotal,
            ImportDate,
            BusinessStatus,
            BusinessStatusDate,
            CreateDate,
            CreateBy,
            UpdateDate,
            UpdateBy,
            NotSendSMS,
            RefMigrateId,
            IsActive,
            Age,
            StatusPersonId,
            LineID,
            DebtorCBSId,
            GenderId,
            PersonGroupId,
            BusinessStatusId,
            BusinessTypeId,
            CompanyTypeId,
            BusinessDescriptionId,
            FilingDueDate,
            BankFilingDate,
            LawOfficeSectionId,
            ImportType
        )
        OUTPUT
            inserted.DebtorId,
            inserted.DebtorCode,
            inserted.IDCard
        INTO @InsertedDebtor
        (
            DebtorId,
            DebtorCode,
            IDCard
        )
        SELECT
            CONCAT(@Prefix, RIGHT(CONCAT(N'000000', CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), n.NextRun)), 6)) AS DebtorCode,
            n.DebtorTypeId_Mapped AS DebtorTypeId,
            n.TitleId AS TitleId,
            LEFT(n.FirstName, 100) AS FirstName,
            LEFT(n.LastName, 100) AS LastName,
            LEFT
            (
                LTRIM(RTRIM
                (
                    ISNULL(n.FirstName, N'')
                    + CASE
                        WHEN ISNULL(n.FirstName, N'') <> N''
                         AND ISNULL(n.LastName, N'') <> N''
                        THEN N' '
                        ELSE N''
                      END
                    + ISNULL(n.LastName, N'')
                )),
                500
            ) AS DebtorName,
            NULL AS CardTypeId,
            LEFT(n.IDCard, 20) AS CardNumber,
            NULL AS CompanyNameEN,
            n.BirthDate AS BirthDate,
            NULL AS FixedAssetValue,
            CONVERT(NVARCHAR(150), NEWID()) AS DebtorId,
            NULL AS OldSection,
            LEFT(n.IDCard, 20) AS IDCard,
            LEFT(n.CIF, 30) AS RefCode,
            LEFT(n.ContactName, 100) AS ContactName,
            LEFT(n.Email, 70) AS Email,
            LEFT(n.ContactPhoneNumber, 50) AS CntPhoneNumber,
            LEFT(n.ContactMobileNumber, 50) AS CntMobileNumber,
            LEFT(n.ContactFaxNumber, 50) AS CntFaxNumber,
            NULL AS DefaultAddressId,
            NULL AS Note,
            NULL AS BusinessType,
            NULL AS BusinessTypeName,
            NULL AS CompanyType,
            NULL AS CompanyTypeDescription,
            NULL AS BusinessDescription,
            NULL AS EmploymentQty,
            NULL AS IncEmploymentQty,
            NULL AS ISICCode,
            NULL AS Totalclaim,
            NULL AS DebtorCodeType,
            NULL AS DivisionCode,
            NULL AS ProvinceCode,
            NULL AS RegistrationType,
            NULL AS RegistrationNo,
            NULL AS CompanyEngName,
            NULL AS RegistrationDate,
            NULL AS LoanerTotal,
            n.ImportDate AS ImportDate,
            NULL AS BusinessStatus,
            NULL AS BusinessStatusDate,
            GETDATE() AS CreateDate,
            1 AS CreateBy,
            GETDATE() AS UpdateDate,
            1 AS UpdateBy,
            CAST(0 AS BIT) AS NotSendSMS,
            NULL AS RefMigrateId,
            CAST(1 AS BIT) AS IsActive,
            CASE
                WHEN n.BirthDate IS NOT NULL
                 AND n.BirthDate >= '1753-01-01'
                THEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, n.BirthDate, GETDATE())
                ELSE NULL
            END AS Age,
            NULL AS StatusPersonId,
            NULL AS LineID,
            CONVERT(NVARCHAR(150), n.TempId) AS DebtorCBSId,
            NULL AS GenderId,
            NULL AS PersonGroupId,
            NULL AS BusinessStatusId,
            NULL AS BusinessTypeId,
            NULL AS CompanyTypeId,
            NULL AS BusinessDescriptionId,
            NULL AS FilingDueDate,
            NULL AS BankFilingDate,
            NULL AS LawOfficeSectionId,
            1 AS ImportType
        FROM #Numbered n;

        SET @InsertedDebtorCount = @@ROWCOUNT;

        /* =========================================================
           5) LOAD DISTRICT / SUBDISTRICT MASTER
        ========================================================= */
        CREATE TABLE #DistrictMaster
        (
            DistrictId INT PRIMARY KEY,
            ProvinceId INT NULL,
            DistrictNameNorm NVARCHAR(200) NULL
        );

        DECLARE @DistrictNameCol SYSNAME;
        DECLARE @DistrictProvCol SYSNAME;
        DECLARE @Sql NVARCHAR(MAX);
        DECLARE @NameExpr NVARCHAR(MAX);

        SELECT TOP 1
            @DistrictNameCol = c.name
        FROM sys.columns c
        WHERE c.object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.SystemDistrictMaster')
          AND c.name IN (N'DistrictName', N'Name', N'NameTH', N'AmphurName', N'AmphoeName', N'DistrictThaiName')
        ORDER BY CASE c.name
                    WHEN N'DistrictName' THEN 1
                    WHEN N'Name' THEN 2
                    WHEN N'NameTH' THEN 3
                    WHEN N'AmphurName' THEN 4
                    WHEN N'AmphoeName' THEN 5
                    WHEN N'DistrictThaiName' THEN 6
                 END;

        SELECT TOP 1
            @DistrictProvCol = c.name
        FROM sys.columns c
        WHERE c.object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.SystemDistrictMaster')
          AND c.name IN (N'ProvinceId', N'ProvId', N'ProvinceCode')
        ORDER BY CASE c.name
                    WHEN N'ProvinceId' THEN 1
                    WHEN N'ProvId' THEN 2
                    WHEN N'ProvinceCode' THEN 3
                 END;

        SET @NameExpr =
            CASE
                WHEN @DistrictNameCol IS NOT NULL
                THEN N'UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(200),' + QUOTENAME(@DistrictNameCol) + N'))))'
                ELSE N'NULL'
            END;

        SET @Sql = N'
            INSERT INTO #DistrictMaster
            (
                DistrictId,
                ProvinceId,
                DistrictNameNorm
            )
            SELECT
                DistrictId AS DistrictId,
                ' + ISNULL(QUOTENAME(@DistrictProvCol), N'NULL') + N' AS ProvinceId,
                ' + @NameExpr + N' AS DistrictNameNorm
            FROM dbo.SystemDistrictMaster;
        ';
        EXEC sys.sp_executesql @Sql;

        CREATE TABLE #SubDistrictMaster
        (
            SubDistrictId INT PRIMARY KEY,
            DistrictId INT NULL,
            ProvinceId INT NULL,
            SubDistrictNameNorm NVARCHAR(200) NULL
        );

        IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.SystemSubDistrictMaster', N'U') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DECLARE @SubDistrictNameCol SYSNAME;
            DECLARE @SubDistrictDistrictCol SYSNAME;
            DECLARE @SubDistrictProvinceCol SYSNAME;
            DECLARE @NameExpr2 NVARCHAR(MAX);

            SELECT TOP 1
                @SubDistrictNameCol = c.name
            FROM sys.columns c
            WHERE c.object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.SystemSubDistrictMaster')
              AND c.name IN (N'SubDistrictName', N'Name', N'NameTH', N'TambonName', N'TumbolName', N'SubDistrictThaiName', N'TambonThaiName')
            ORDER BY CASE c.name
                        WHEN N'SubDistrictName' THEN 1
                        WHEN N'Name' THEN 2
                        WHEN N'NameTH' THEN 3
                        WHEN N'TambonName' THEN 4
                        WHEN N'TumbolName' THEN 5
                        WHEN N'SubDistrictThaiName' THEN 6
                        WHEN N'TambonThaiName' THEN 7
                     END;

            SELECT TOP 1
                @SubDistrictDistrictCol = c.name
            FROM sys.columns c
            WHERE c.object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.SystemSubDistrictMaster')
              AND c.name IN (N'DistrictId', N'AmphurId', N'AmphoeId', N'AmphurCode', N'DistrictCode')
            ORDER BY CASE c.name
                        WHEN N'DistrictId' THEN 1
                        WHEN N'AmphurId' THEN 2
                        WHEN N'AmphoeId' THEN 3
                        WHEN N'AmphurCode' THEN 4
                        WHEN N'DistrictCode' THEN 5
                     END;

            SELECT TOP 1
                @SubDistrictProvinceCol = c.name
            FROM sys.columns c
            WHERE c.object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.SystemSubDistrictMaster')
              AND c.name IN (N'ProvinceId', N'ProvId', N'ProvinceCode')
            ORDER BY CASE c.name
                        WHEN N'ProvinceId' THEN 1
                        WHEN N'ProvId' THEN 2
                        WHEN N'ProvinceCode' THEN 3
                     END;

            SET @NameExpr2 =
                CASE
                    WHEN @SubDistrictNameCol IS NOT NULL
                    THEN N'UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(200),' + QUOTENAME(@SubDistrictNameCol) + N'))))'
                    ELSE N'NULL'
                END;

            SET @Sql = N'
                INSERT INTO #SubDistrictMaster
                (
                    SubDistrictId,
                    DistrictId,
                    ProvinceId,
                    SubDistrictNameNorm
                )
                SELECT
                    SubDistrictId AS SubDistrictId,
                    ' + ISNULL(QUOTENAME(@SubDistrictDistrictCol), N'NULL') + N' AS DistrictId,
                    ' + ISNULL(QUOTENAME(@SubDistrictProvinceCol), N'NULL') + N' AS ProvinceId,
                    ' + @NameExpr2 + N' AS SubDistrictNameNorm
                FROM dbo.SystemSubDistrictMaster;
            ';
            EXEC sys.sp_executesql @Sql;
        END;

        /* =========================================================
           6) INSERT DataDebtorContact
        ========================================================= */
        SELECT
            i.DebtorId AS DebtorId,
            i.IDCard AS IDCard,
            1 AS DebtorContactTypeId,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(n.ContactPhoneNumber)) AS DebtorContactValue
        INTO #ContactStage
        FROM @InsertedDebtor i
        INNER JOIN #Numbered n
            ON n.IDCard COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = i.IDCard COLLATE Thai_CI_AI

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            i.DebtorId AS DebtorId,
            i.IDCard AS IDCard,
            2 AS DebtorContactTypeId,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(n.ContactMobileNumber)) AS DebtorContactValue
        FROM @InsertedDebtor i
        INNER JOIN #Numbered n
            ON n.IDCard COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = i.IDCard COLLATE Thai_CI_AI

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            i.DebtorId AS DebtorId,
            i.IDCard AS IDCard,
            6 AS DebtorContactTypeId,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(n.ContactFaxNumber)) AS DebtorContactValue
        FROM @InsertedDebtor i
        INNER JOIN #Numbered n
            ON n.IDCard COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = i.IDCard COLLATE Thai_CI_AI

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            i.DebtorId AS DebtorId,
            i.IDCard AS IDCard,
            4 AS DebtorContactTypeId,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(n.Email)) AS DebtorContactValue
        FROM @InsertedDebtor i
        INNER JOIN #Numbered n
            ON n.IDCard COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = i.IDCard COLLATE Thai_CI_AI;

        INSERT INTO dbo.DataDebtorContact
        (
            DebtorContactId,
            DebtorId,
            DebtorContactTypeId,
            DebtorContactValue,
            DebtorContactExtension,
            DebtorContactChannelId,
            IsDefault,
            CreateBy,
            CreateDate,
            UpdateBy,
            UpdateDate,
            DebtorContactCBSId,
            ImportType
        )
        SELECT
            NEWID() AS DebtorContactId,
            c.DebtorId AS DebtorId,
            c.DebtorContactTypeId AS DebtorContactTypeId,
            c.DebtorContactValue AS DebtorContactValue,
            NULL AS DebtorContactExtension,
            NULL AS DebtorContactChannelId,
            1 AS IsDefault,
            1 AS CreateBy,
            GETDATE() AS CreateDate,
            1 AS UpdateBy,
            GETDATE() AS UpdateDate,
            NULL AS DebtorContactCBSId,
            1 AS ImportType
        FROM #ContactStage c
        WHERE c.DebtorContactValue IS NOT NULL
          AND REPLACE(REPLACE(c.DebtorContactValue, N'-', N''), N' ', N'') <> N''
          AND NOT EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.DataDebtorContact dc
              WHERE dc.DebtorId COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = c.DebtorId COLLATE Thai_CI_AI
                AND dc.DebtorContactTypeId = c.DebtorContactTypeId
                AND dc.DebtorContactValue COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = c.DebtorContactValue COLLATE Thai_CI_AI
          );

        SET @InsertedContactCount = @@ROWCOUNT;

        /* =========================================================
           7) INSERT DataDebtorAddress TYPE 15
        ========================================================= */
        SELECT
            i.DebtorCode AS DebtorCode,
            i.DebtorId AS DebtorId,
            LEFT(n.HouseAddrNum, 100) COLLATE Thai_CI_AI AS AddressNumber,
            LEFT(n.AddrBuilding, 100) COLLATE Thai_CI_AI AS PlaceName,
            NULL AS Moo,
            LEFT(n.HouseAddrSoi, 50) COLLATE Thai_CI_AI AS Soi,
            LEFT(n.HouseAddrRoad, 100) COLLATE Thai_CI_AI AS Road,
            vp.ProvinceId AS ProvinceId,
            vs.SubDistrictId AS SubDistrictId,
            vd.DistrictId AS DistrictId,
            LEFT(n.HouseAddrZipcode, 5) COLLATE Thai_CI_AI AS PostalCode,
            LEFT(n.ContactPhoneNumber, 50) COLLATE Thai_CI_AI AS Telephone,
            LEFT(n.ContactFaxNumber, 20) COLLATE Thai_CI_AI AS Fax,
            LEFT(n.ContactMobileNumber, 50) COLLATE Thai_CI_AI AS Mobile,
            LEFT(n.Email, 100) COLLATE Thai_CI_AI AS Email,
            NULL AS LineID,
            LEFT(n.ContactName, 400) COLLATE Thai_CI_AI AS ContactName,
            CONVERT(NVARCHAR(150), n.TempId) AS DebtorAddressCBSId
        INTO #Addr15
        FROM @InsertedDebtor i
        INNER JOIN #Numbered n
            ON n.IDCard COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = i.IDCard COLLATE Thai_CI_AI
        OUTER APPLY
        (
            SELECT TOP 1
                p.ProvinceId AS ProvinceId
            FROM dbo.SystemProvinceMaster p
            WHERE p.ProvinceId = TRY_CONVERT(INT, n.HouseAddrProvince)
               OR p.[Name] COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(200), n.HouseAddrProvince))) COLLATE Thai_CI_AI
        ) vp
        OUTER APPLY
        (
            SELECT TOP 1
                d.DistrictId AS DistrictId
            FROM #DistrictMaster d
            WHERE
                (
                    d.DistrictId = TRY_CONVERT(INT, n.HouseAddrDistrict)
                    OR
                    (
                        d.DistrictNameNorm IS NOT NULL
                        AND d.DistrictNameNorm COLLATE Thai_CI_AI =
                            UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(200), n.HouseAddrDistrict)))) COLLATE Thai_CI_AI
                    )
                )
                AND (vp.ProvinceId IS NULL OR d.ProvinceId IS NULL OR d.ProvinceId = vp.ProvinceId)
        ) vd
        OUTER APPLY
        (
            SELECT TOP 1
                s.SubDistrictId AS SubDistrictId
            FROM #SubDistrictMaster s
            WHERE
                (
                    s.SubDistrictId = TRY_CONVERT(INT, n.HouseAddrBoundary)
                    OR
                    (
                        s.SubDistrictNameNorm IS NOT NULL
                        AND s.SubDistrictNameNorm COLLATE Thai_CI_AI =
                            UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(200), n.HouseAddrBoundary)))) COLLATE Thai_CI_AI
                    )
                )
                AND (vd.DistrictId IS NULL OR s.DistrictId IS NULL OR s.DistrictId = vd.DistrictId)
                AND (vp.ProvinceId IS NULL OR s.ProvinceId IS NULL OR s.ProvinceId = vp.ProvinceId)
        ) vs;

        ;WITH A AS
        (
            SELECT
                a.DebtorCode AS DebtorCode,
                a.DebtorId AS DebtorId,
                a.AddressNumber AS AddressNumber,
                a.PlaceName AS PlaceName,
                a.Moo AS Moo,
                a.Soi AS Soi,
                a.Road AS Road,
                a.ProvinceId AS ProvinceId,
                a.SubDistrictId AS SubDistrictId,
                a.DistrictId AS DistrictId,
                a.PostalCode AS PostalCode,
                a.Telephone AS Telephone,
                a.Fax AS Fax,
                a.Mobile AS Mobile,
                a.Email AS Email,
                a.LineID AS LineID,
                a.ContactName AS ContactName,
                a.DebtorAddressCBSId AS DebtorAddressCBSId
            FROM #Addr15 a
            WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(a.AddressNumber, N''), NULLIF(a.PlaceName, N''), NULLIF(a.Soi, N''), NULLIF(a.Road, N'')) IS NOT NULL
               OR a.ProvinceId IS NOT NULL
               OR a.SubDistrictId IS NOT NULL
               OR a.DistrictId IS NOT NULL
               OR NULLIF(a.PostalCode, N'') IS NOT NULL
               OR COALESCE(NULLIF(a.Telephone, N''), NULLIF(a.Mobile, N''), NULLIF(a.Fax, N''), NULLIF(a.Email, N''), NULLIF(a.ContactName, N'')) IS NOT NULL
        )
        INSERT INTO dbo.DataDebtorAddress
        (
            DebtorCode,
            DebtorAddressTypeId,
            AddressNumber,
            PlaceName,
            Moo,
            Soi,
            Road,
            ProvinceId,
            SubDistrictId,
            DistrictId,
            PostalCode,
            DebtorContactChannelId,
            IsDefault,
            CreateBy,
            CreateDate,
            UpdateBy,
            UpdateDate,
            DebtorAddressId,
            DebtorId,
            Telephone,
            Fax,
            Mobile,
            Email,
            LineID,
            DebtorAddressCBSId,
            ContactName,
            ImportType
        )
        SELECT
            a.DebtorCode AS DebtorCode,
            15 AS DebtorAddressTypeId,
            a.AddressNumber AS AddressNumber,
            a.PlaceName AS PlaceName,
            a.Moo AS Moo,
            a.Soi AS Soi,
            a.Road AS Road,
            a.ProvinceId AS ProvinceId,
            a.SubDistrictId AS SubDistrictId,
            a.DistrictId AS DistrictId,
            a.PostalCode AS PostalCode,
            NULL AS DebtorContactChannelId,
            1 AS IsDefault,
            1 AS CreateBy,
            GETDATE() AS CreateDate,
            1 AS UpdateBy,
            GETDATE() AS UpdateDate,
            NEWID() AS DebtorAddressId,
            a.DebtorId AS DebtorId,
            a.Telephone AS Telephone,
            a.Fax AS Fax,
            a.Mobile AS Mobile,
            a.Email AS Email,
            a.LineID AS LineID,
            a.DebtorAddressCBSId AS DebtorAddressCBSId,
            a.ContactName AS ContactName,
            1 AS ImportType
        FROM A a
        WHERE NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.DataDebtorAddress da
            WHERE da.DebtorId COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = a.DebtorId COLLATE Thai_CI_AI
              AND da.DebtorAddressTypeId = 15
              AND ISNULL(da.AddressNumber, N'') COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = ISNULL(a.AddressNumber, N'') COLLATE Thai_CI_AI
              AND ISNULL(da.PlaceName, N'') COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = ISNULL(a.PlaceName, N'') COLLATE Thai_CI_AI
              AND ISNULL(da.Soi, N'') COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = ISNULL(a.Soi, N'') COLLATE Thai_CI_AI
              AND ISNULL(da.Road, N'') COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = ISNULL(a.Road, N'') COLLATE Thai_CI_AI
              AND ISNULL(da.ProvinceId, 0) = ISNULL(a.ProvinceId, 0)
              AND ISNULL(da.SubDistrictId, 0) = ISNULL(a.SubDistrictId, 0)
              AND ISNULL(da.DistrictId, 0) = ISNULL(a.DistrictId, 0)
              AND ISNULL(da.PostalCode, N'') COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = ISNULL(a.PostalCode, N'') COLLATE Thai_CI_AI
        );

        SET @InsertedAddr15 = @@ROWCOUNT;

        /* =========================================================
           8) INSERT DataDebtorAddress TYPE 1
        ========================================================= */
        SELECT
            i.DebtorCode AS DebtorCode,
            i.DebtorId AS DebtorId,
            LEFT(n.ContactAddrNum, 100) COLLATE Thai_CI_AI AS AddressNumber,
            LEFT(n.ContactAddrBuilding, 100) COLLATE Thai_CI_AI AS PlaceName,
            NULL AS Moo,
            LEFT(n.ContactAddrSoi, 50) COLLATE Thai_CI_AI AS Soi,
            LEFT(n.ContactAddrRoad, 100) COLLATE Thai_CI_AI AS Road,
            vp.ProvinceId AS ProvinceId,
            vs.SubDistrictId AS SubDistrictId,
            vd.DistrictId AS DistrictId,
            LEFT(n.ContactAddrZipcode, 5) COLLATE Thai_CI_AI AS PostalCode,
            NULL AS Telephone,
            NULL AS Fax,
            NULL AS Mobile,
            NULL AS Email,
            NULL AS LineID,
            NULL AS ContactName,
            CONVERT(NVARCHAR(150), n.TempId) AS DebtorAddressCBSId
        INTO #Addr01
        FROM @InsertedDebtor i
        INNER JOIN #Numbered n
            ON n.IDCard COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = i.IDCard COLLATE Thai_CI_AI
        OUTER APPLY
        (
            SELECT TOP 1
                p.ProvinceId AS ProvinceId
            FROM dbo.SystemProvinceMaster p
            WHERE p.ProvinceId = TRY_CONVERT(INT, n.ContactAddrProvince)
               OR p.[Name] COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(200), n.ContactAddrProvince))) COLLATE Thai_CI_AI
        ) vp
        OUTER APPLY
        (
            SELECT TOP 1
                d.DistrictId AS DistrictId
            FROM #DistrictMaster d
            WHERE
                (
                    d.DistrictId = TRY_CONVERT(INT, n.ContactAddrDistrict)
                    OR
                    (
                        d.DistrictNameNorm IS NOT NULL
                        AND d.DistrictNameNorm COLLATE Thai_CI_AI =
                            UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(200), n.ContactAddrDistrict)))) COLLATE Thai_CI_AI
                    )
                )
                AND (vp.ProvinceId IS NULL OR d.ProvinceId IS NULL OR d.ProvinceId = vp.ProvinceId)
        ) vd
        OUTER APPLY
        (
            SELECT TOP 1
                s.SubDistrictId AS SubDistrictId
            FROM #SubDistrictMaster s
            WHERE
                (
                    s.SubDistrictId = TRY_CONVERT(INT, n.ContactAddrBoundary)
                    OR
                    (
                        s.SubDistrictNameNorm IS NOT NULL
                        AND s.SubDistrictNameNorm COLLATE Thai_CI_AI =
                            UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(200), n.ContactAddrBoundary)))) COLLATE Thai_CI_AI
                    )
                )
                AND (vd.DistrictId IS NULL OR s.DistrictId IS NULL OR s.DistrictId = vd.DistrictId)
                AND (vp.ProvinceId IS NULL OR s.ProvinceId IS NULL OR s.ProvinceId = vp.ProvinceId)
        ) vs;

        ;WITH B AS
        (
            SELECT
                b.DebtorCode AS DebtorCode,
                b.DebtorId AS DebtorId,
                b.AddressNumber AS AddressNumber,
                b.PlaceName AS PlaceName,
                b.Moo AS Moo,
                b.Soi AS Soi,
                b.Road AS Road,
                b.ProvinceId AS ProvinceId,
                b.SubDistrictId AS SubDistrictId,
                b.DistrictId AS DistrictId,
                b.PostalCode AS PostalCode,
                b.Telephone AS Telephone,
                b.Fax AS Fax,
                b.Mobile AS Mobile,
                b.Email AS Email,
                b.LineID AS LineID,
                b.ContactName AS ContactName,
                b.DebtorAddressCBSId AS DebtorAddressCBSId
            FROM #Addr01 b
            WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(b.AddressNumber, N''), NULLIF(b.PlaceName, N''), NULLIF(b.Soi, N''), NULLIF(b.Road, N'')) IS NOT NULL
               OR b.ProvinceId IS NOT NULL
               OR b.SubDistrictId IS NOT NULL
               OR b.DistrictId IS NOT NULL
               OR NULLIF(b.PostalCode, N'') IS NOT NULL
        )
        INSERT INTO dbo.DataDebtorAddress
        (
            DebtorCode,
            DebtorAddressTypeId,
            AddressNumber,
            PlaceName,
            Moo,
            Soi,
            Road,
            ProvinceId,
            SubDistrictId,
            DistrictId,
            PostalCode,
            DebtorContactChannelId,
            IsDefault,
            CreateBy,
            CreateDate,
            UpdateBy,
            UpdateDate,
            DebtorAddressId,
            DebtorId,
            Telephone,
            Fax,
            Mobile,
            Email,
            LineID,
            DebtorAddressCBSId,
            ContactName,
            ImportType
        )
        SELECT
            b.DebtorCode AS DebtorCode,
            1 AS DebtorAddressTypeId,
            b.AddressNumber AS AddressNumber,
            b.PlaceName AS PlaceName,
            b.Moo AS Moo,
            b.Soi AS Soi,
            b.Road AS Road,
            b.ProvinceId AS ProvinceId,
            b.SubDistrictId AS SubDistrictId,
            b.DistrictId AS DistrictId,
            b.PostalCode AS PostalCode,
            NULL AS DebtorContactChannelId,
            0 AS IsDefault,
            1 AS CreateBy,
            GETDATE() AS CreateDate,
            1 AS UpdateBy,
            GETDATE() AS UpdateDate,
            NEWID() AS DebtorAddressId,
            b.DebtorId AS DebtorId,
            b.Telephone AS Telephone,
            b.Fax AS Fax,
            b.Mobile AS Mobile,
            b.Email AS Email,
            b.LineID AS LineID,
            b.DebtorAddressCBSId AS DebtorAddressCBSId,
            b.ContactName AS ContactName,
            1 AS ImportType
        FROM B b
        WHERE NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.DataDebtorAddress da
            WHERE da.DebtorId COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = b.DebtorId COLLATE Thai_CI_AI
              AND da.DebtorAddressTypeId = 1
              AND ISNULL(da.AddressNumber, N'') COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = ISNULL(b.AddressNumber, N'') COLLATE Thai_CI_AI
              AND ISNULL(da.PlaceName, N'') COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = ISNULL(b.PlaceName, N'') COLLATE Thai_CI_AI
              AND ISNULL(da.Soi, N'') COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = ISNULL(b.Soi, N'') COLLATE Thai_CI_AI
              AND ISNULL(da.Road, N'') COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = ISNULL(b.Road, N'') COLLATE Thai_CI_AI
              AND ISNULL(da.ProvinceId, 0) = ISNULL(b.ProvinceId, 0)
              AND ISNULL(da.SubDistrictId, 0) = ISNULL(b.SubDistrictId, 0)
              AND ISNULL(da.DistrictId, 0) = ISNULL(b.DistrictId, 0)
              AND ISNULL(da.PostalCode, N'') COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = ISNULL(b.PostalCode, N'') COLLATE Thai_CI_AI
        );

        SET @InsertedAddr01 = @@ROWCOUNT;

        /* =========================================================
           9) INSERT TEMPMapLGCBS
        ========================================================= */
        INSERT INTO dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS
        (
            TEMPMapLGId,
            CIFNo,
            LGNo,
            DebtorCode,
            DebtorTypeId,
            ImportDate
        )
        SELECT
            CONVERT(NVARCHAR(150), NEWID()) AS TEMPMapLGId,
            LEFT(n.CIF, 20) AS CIFNo,
            LEFT(n.LGNo, 20) AS LGNo,
            LEFT(i.DebtorCode, 20) AS DebtorCode,
            2 AS DebtorTypeId,
            GETDATE() AS ImportDate
        FROM @InsertedDebtor i
        INNER JOIN #Numbered n
            ON n.IDCard COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = i.IDCard COLLATE Thai_CI_AI
        WHERE n.LGNo IS NOT NULL
          AND LTRIM(RTRIM(n.LGNo)) <> N''
          AND NOT EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS m
              WHERE m.DebtorCode COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = LEFT(i.DebtorCode, 20) COLLATE Thai_CI_AI
                AND m.LGNo COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = LEFT(n.LGNo, 20) COLLATE Thai_CI_AI
          );

        SET @InsertedMapCount = @@ROWCOUNT;

        COMMIT;

        /* =========================================================
           10) RESULT SUMMARY
        ========================================================= */
        SELECT
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #DuplicateIDCard) AS DuplicateIDCardGroupCount,
            (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(DuplicateCount), 0) FROM #DuplicateIDCard) AS DuplicateIDCardRowCount,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #DuplicateRecord) AS DuplicateRecordGroupCount,
            (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(DuplicateCount), 0) FROM #DuplicateRecord) AS DuplicateRecordRowCount,
            @InsertedDebtorCount AS InsertedDataDebtor,
            @InsertedContactCount AS InsertedDataDebtorContact,
            @InsertedAddr15 AS InsertedAddressType15,
            @InsertedAddr01 AS InsertedAddressType1,
            @InsertedMapCount AS InsertedTEMPMapLGCBS,
            N'Insert TEMPGuarantorLoanCBS -> DataDebtor / Contact / Address / TEMPMapLGCBS สำเร็จ' AS Note;

        SELECT
            d.IDCard AS IDCard,
            d.DuplicateCount AS DuplicateCount
        FROM #DuplicateIDCard d
        ORDER BY d.IDCard;

        SELECT
            d.IDCard AS IDCard,
            d.CIF AS CIF,
            d.LGNo AS LGNo,
            d.DuplicateCount AS DuplicateCount
        FROM #DuplicateRecord d
        ORDER BY d.IDCard, d.CIF, d.LGNo;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK;

        THROW;
    END CATCH
END
