CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_020_InsertGuarantorOtherCBS]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 0) Prepare required tables
    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.SystemRunningDebtorCode', N'U') IS NULL
    BEGIN
        CREATE TABLE dbo.SystemRunningDebtorCode
        (
            YearPrefix NCHAR(3) NOT NULL,
            LastRun INT NOT NULL,
            CONSTRAINT PK_SystemRunningDebtorCode PRIMARY KEY (YearPrefix)
        );

        EXEC sys.sp_addextendedproperty
            @name = N'MS_Description',
            @value = N'เก็บเลขรันล่าสุดของ DebtorCode แยกตามปี พ.ศ.',
            @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'dbo',
            @level1type = N'TABLE',  @level1name = N'SystemRunningDebtorCode';

        EXEC sys.sp_addextendedproperty
            @name = N'MS_Description',
            @value = N'Prefix ของ DebtorCode เช่น C69',
            @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'dbo',
            @level1type = N'TABLE',  @level1name = N'SystemRunningDebtorCode',
            @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'YearPrefix';

        EXEC sys.sp_addextendedproperty
            @name = N'MS_Description',
            @value = N'เลขรันล่าสุดของปีนั้น',
            @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'dbo',
            @level1type = N'TABLE',  @level1name = N'SystemRunningDebtorCode',
            @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'LastRun';
    END;

    IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS', N'U') IS NULL
    BEGIN
        CREATE TABLE dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS
        (
            TEMPMapLGId NVARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
            CIFNo NVARCHAR(20) NULL,
            LGNo NVARCHAR(20) NULL,
            DebtorCode NVARCHAR(20) NULL,
            DebtorTypeId INT NULL,
            ImportDate DATETIME NOT NULL
                CONSTRAINT DF_TEMPMapLGCBS_ImportDate DEFAULT (GETDATE())
        );

        CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_TEMPMapLGCBS_LGNo_DebtorCode
            ON dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS (LGNo, DebtorCode);

        EXEC sys.sp_addextendedproperty
            @name = N'MS_Description',
            @value = N'ตารางเก็บความสัมพันธ์ระหว่าง LGNo กับ DebtorCode ที่นำเข้าจาก CBS',
            @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'dbo',
            @level1type = N'TABLE',  @level1name = N'TEMPMapLGCBS';

        EXEC sys.sp_addextendedproperty
            @name = N'MS_Description',
            @value = N'Primary key เชิงธุรกิจของรายการ map ชั่วคราว',
            @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'dbo',
            @level1type = N'TABLE',  @level1name = N'TEMPMapLGCBS',
            @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'TEMPMapLGId';

        EXEC sys.sp_addextendedproperty
            @name = N'MS_Description',
            @value = N'CIF จากข้อมูลต้นทาง',
            @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'dbo',
            @level1type = N'TABLE',  @level1name = N'TEMPMapLGCBS',
            @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'CIFNo';

        EXEC sys.sp_addextendedproperty
            @name = N'MS_Description',
            @value = N'เลข LG จากข้อมูลต้นทาง',
            @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'dbo',
            @level1type = N'TABLE',  @level1name = N'TEMPMapLGCBS',
            @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'LGNo';

        EXEC sys.sp_addextendedproperty
            @name = N'MS_Description',
            @value = N'รหัสลูกหนี้ใน DataDebtor',
            @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'dbo',
            @level1type = N'TABLE',  @level1name = N'TEMPMapLGCBS',
            @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'DebtorCode';

        EXEC sys.sp_addextendedproperty
            @name = N'MS_Description',
            @value = N'ประเภทลูกหนี้ที่ใช้สำหรับ map ข้อมูล LG',
            @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'dbo',
            @level1type = N'TABLE',  @level1name = N'TEMPMapLGCBS',
            @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'DebtorTypeId';

        EXEC sys.sp_addextendedproperty
            @name = N'MS_Description',
            @value = N'วันที่นำเข้าข้อมูล',
            @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'dbo',
            @level1type = N'TABLE',  @level1name = N'TEMPMapLGCBS',
            @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'ImportDate';
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        IF COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS', N'DebtorTypeId') IS NULL
        BEGIN
            ALTER TABLE dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS
            ADD DebtorTypeId INT NULL;

            IF NOT EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM sys.extended_properties ep
                INNER JOIN sys.tables t
                    ON ep.major_id = t.object_id
                INNER JOIN sys.columns c
                    ON c.object_id = t.object_id
                   AND c.column_id = ep.minor_id
                WHERE t.name = N'TEMPMapLGCBS'
                  AND c.name = N'DebtorTypeId'
                  AND ep.name = N'MS_Description'
            )
            BEGIN
                EXEC sys.sp_addextendedproperty
                    @name = N'MS_Description',
                    @value = N'ประเภทลูกหนี้ที่ใช้สำหรับ map ข้อมูล LG',
                    @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'dbo',
                    @level1type = N'TABLE',  @level1name = N'TEMPMapLGCBS',
                    @level2type = N'COLUMN', @level2name = N'DebtorTypeId';
            END
        END;

        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM sys.indexes
            WHERE name = N'IX_TEMPMapLGCBS_LGNo_DebtorCode'
              AND object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS')
        )
        BEGIN
            CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_TEMPMapLGCBS_LGNo_DebtorCode
                ON dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS (LGNo, DebtorCode);
        END
    END;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRAN;

        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 1) Prepare source
        --    - only valid numeric IDCard
        --    - if duplicate IDCard in TEMPGuarantorOtherCBS, keep only 1 row
        --    - choose latest row by ImportDate, TempId
        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Source') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Source;
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#DuplicateIDCard') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #DuplicateIDCard;
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#DuplicateRecord') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #DuplicateRecord;
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Latest') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Latest;
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Stage') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Stage;
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#InsertDebtor') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #InsertDebtor;
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#InsertMap') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #InsertMap;

        SELECT
            t.TempId,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(t.IDCard))      AS IDCard,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(t.FirstName))   AS FirstName,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(t.LastName))    AS LastName,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(t.TitleCode))   AS TitleCode,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(t.CustType))    AS CustType,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(t.CIF))         AS CIF,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(t.LGNo))        AS LGNo,
            t.ImportDate
        INTO #Source
        FROM dbo.TEMPGuarantorOtherCBS t
        WHERE t.IDCard IS NOT NULL
          AND LTRIM(RTRIM(t.IDCard)) <> N''
          AND LTRIM(RTRIM(t.IDCard)) NOT LIKE N'%[^0-9]%';

        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        -- duplicate IDCard summary
        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        SELECT
            s.IDCard,
            COUNT(*) AS DuplicateCount
        INTO #DuplicateIDCard
        FROM #Source s
        GROUP BY s.IDCard
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        -- duplicate record summary by IDCard + CIF + LGNo
        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        SELECT
            s.IDCard,
            ISNULL(s.CIF, N'')  AS CIF,
            ISNULL(s.LGNo, N'') AS LGNo,
            COUNT(*) AS DuplicateCount
        INTO #DuplicateRecord
        FROM #Source s
        GROUP BY
            s.IDCard,
            ISNULL(s.CIF, N''),
            ISNULL(s.LGNo, N'')
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        -- keep only 1 row per IDCard
        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        ;WITH CTE_Latest AS
        (
            SELECT
                s.TempId,
                s.IDCard,
                s.FirstName,
                s.LastName,
                s.TitleCode,
                s.CustType,
                s.CIF,
                s.LGNo,
                s.ImportDate,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER
                (
                    PARTITION BY s.IDCard
                    ORDER BY
                        CASE WHEN s.ImportDate IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END DESC,
                        s.ImportDate DESC,
                        s.TempId DESC
                ) AS RowNo
            FROM #Source s
        )
        SELECT
            c.TempId,
            c.IDCard,
            c.FirstName,
            c.LastName,
            c.TitleCode,
            c.CustType,
            c.CIF,
            c.LGNo,
            c.ImportDate
        INTO #Latest
        FROM CTE_Latest c
        WHERE c.RowNo = 1;

        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        -- map TitleId / DebtorTypeId
        -- exclude IDCard already existing in DataDebtor
        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        SELECT
            l.TempId,
            l.IDCard,
            l.FirstName,
            l.LastName,
            l.TitleCode,
            l.CustType,
            l.CIF,
            l.LGNo,
            l.ImportDate,
            st.TitleId,
            ISNULL(dt.DebtorTypeId, 5) AS DebtorTypeId_Mapped
        INTO #Stage
        FROM #Latest l
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemTitleMaster st
            ON st.TitleCode COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = l.TitleCode COLLATE Thai_CI_AI
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemDebtorType dt
            ON dt.DebtorTypeCode COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = l.CustType COLLATE Thai_CI_AI
            OR dt.DebtorTypeName COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = l.CustType COLLATE Thai_CI_AI
        WHERE NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.DataDebtor d
            WHERE d.IDCard COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = l.IDCard COLLATE Thai_CI_AI
        );

        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2) Generate DebtorCode
        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        DECLARE @BEYear INT = YEAR(GETDATE()) + 543;
        DECLARE @YY CHAR(2) = RIGHT(CONVERT(VARCHAR(4), @BEYear), 2);
        DECLARE @Prefix NCHAR(3) = N'C' + @YY;

        DECLARE @TotalInsert INT;
        DECLARE @CurrentRun INT;
        DECLARE @StartRun INT;
        DECLARE @EndRun INT;

        SELECT @TotalInsert = COUNT(*)
        FROM #Stage;

        IF @TotalInsert > 0
        BEGIN
            IF NOT EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM dbo.SystemRunningDebtorCode WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
                WHERE YearPrefix = @Prefix
            )
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO dbo.SystemRunningDebtorCode
                (
                    YearPrefix,
                    LastRun
                )
                VALUES
                (
                    @Prefix,
                    0
                );
            END;

            SELECT @CurrentRun = r.LastRun
            FROM dbo.SystemRunningDebtorCode r WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
            WHERE r.YearPrefix = @Prefix;

            SET @StartRun = @CurrentRun + 1;
            SET @EndRun   = @CurrentRun + @TotalInsert;

            IF @EndRun > 999999
            BEGIN
                THROW 50001, 'DebtorCode running number for current BE year would exceed 999999.', 1;
            END;

            UPDATE dbo.SystemRunningDebtorCode
            SET LastRun = @EndRun
            WHERE YearPrefix = @Prefix;
        END;

        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 3) Prepare insert DataDebtor
        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        ;WITH CTE_Numbered AS
        (
            SELECT
                s.TempId,
                s.IDCard,
                s.FirstName,
                s.LastName,
                s.TitleId,
                s.CIF,
                s.LGNo,
                s.ImportDate,
                s.DebtorTypeId_Mapped,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.IDCard, s.TempId) AS RowNo
            FROM #Stage s
        )
        SELECT
            CONVERT(NVARCHAR(150), NEWID()) AS DebtorId,
            c.TempId,
            c.IDCard,
            c.FirstName,
            c.LastName,
            c.TitleId,
            c.CIF,
            c.LGNo,
            c.ImportDate,
            c.DebtorTypeId_Mapped,
            @Prefix + RIGHT('000000' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), @StartRun + c.RowNo - 1), 6) AS DebtorCode
        INTO #InsertDebtor
        FROM CTE_Numbered c;

        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 4) Insert DataDebtor
        --    check duplicate IDCard again before insert
        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        INSERT INTO dbo.DataDebtor
        (
            DebtorCode,
            DebtorTypeId,
            TitleId,
            FirstName,
            LastName,
            DebtorName,
            CardTypeId,
            CardNumber,
            CompanyNameEN,
            BirthDate,
            FixedAssetValue,
            DebtorId,
            OldSection,
            IDCard,
            RefCode,
            ContactName,
            Email,
            CntPhoneNumber,
            CntMobileNumber,
            CntFaxNumber,
            DefaultAddressId,
            Note,
            BusinessType,
            BusinessTypeName,
            CompanyType,
            CompanyTypeDescription,
            BusinessDescription,
            EmploymentQty,
            IncEmploymentQty,
            ISICCode,
            Totalclaim,
            DebtorCodeType,
            DivisionCode,
            ProvinceCode,
            RegistrationType,
            RegistrationNo,
            CompanyEngName,
            RegistrationDate,
            LoanerTotal,
            ImportDate,
            BusinessStatus,
            BusinessStatusDate,
            CreateDate,
            CreateBy,
            UpdateDate,
            UpdateBy,
            NotSendSMS,
            RefMigrateId,
            IsActive,
            Age,
            StatusPersonId,
            LineID,
            DebtorCBSId,
            GenderId,
            PersonGroupId,
            BusinessStatusId,
            BusinessTypeId,
            CompanyTypeId,
            BusinessDescriptionId,
            FilingDueDate,
            BankFilingDate,
            LawOfficeSectionId,
            ImportType
        )
        SELECT
            i.DebtorCode,
            i.DebtorTypeId_Mapped,
            i.TitleId,
            LEFT(i.FirstName, 100),
            LEFT(i.LastName, 100),
            LEFT
            (
                LTRIM(RTRIM
                (
                    ISNULL(NULLIF(i.FirstName, N''), N'')
                    + CASE
                        WHEN ISNULL(NULLIF(i.FirstName, N''), N'') <> N''
                         AND ISNULL(NULLIF(i.LastName, N''), N'') <> N''
                        THEN N' '
                        ELSE N''
                      END
                    + ISNULL(NULLIF(i.LastName, N''), N'')
                )),
                500
            ),
            NULL,
            LEFT(i.IDCard, 20),
            NULL,
            NULL,
            NULL,
            i.DebtorId,
            NULL,
            LEFT(i.IDCard, 20),
            LEFT(i.CIF, 30),
            NULL,
            NULL,
            NULL,
            NULL,
            NULL,
            NULL,
            NULL,
            NULL,
            NULL,
            NULL,
            NULL,
            NULL,
            NULL,
            NULL,
            NULL,
            NULL,
            NULL,
            NULL,
            NULL,
            NULL,
            NULL,
            NULL,
            NULL,
            NULL,
            i.ImportDate,
            NULL,
            NULL,
            GETDATE(),
            1,
            GETDATE(),
            1,
            0,
            NULL,
            1,
            NULL,
            NULL,
            NULL,
            CONVERT(NVARCHAR(150), i.TempId),
            NULL,
            NULL,
            NULL,
            NULL,
            NULL,
            NULL,
            NULL,
            NULL,
            NULL,
            1
        FROM #InsertDebtor i
        WHERE NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.DataDebtor d WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
            WHERE d.IDCard COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = LEFT(i.IDCard, 20) COLLATE Thai_CI_AI
        );

        DECLARE @InsertedDebtorCount INT = @@ROWCOUNT;

        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 5) Prepare insert TEMPMapLGCBS
        --    duplicate check by DebtorCode, CIFNo, LGNo, DebtorTypeId
        --    DebtorTypeId used in EXISTS must equal inserted value
        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        SELECT
            CONVERT(NVARCHAR(150), NEWID()) AS TEMPMapLGId,
            LEFT(i.CIF, 20) AS CIFNo,
            LEFT(i.LGNo, 20) AS LGNo,
            LEFT(i.DebtorCode, 20) AS DebtorCode,
            CASE
                WHEN i.DebtorTypeId_Mapped NOT IN (1, 2, 4) THEN 2
                ELSE i.DebtorTypeId_Mapped
            END AS DebtorTypeId,
            GETDATE() AS ImportDate
        INTO #InsertMap
        FROM #InsertDebtor i
        WHERE i.LGNo IS NOT NULL
          AND LTRIM(RTRIM(i.LGNo)) <> N''
          AND NOT EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS m
              WHERE ISNULL(m.DebtorCode, N'') COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = ISNULL(LEFT(i.DebtorCode, 20), N'') COLLATE Thai_CI_AI
                AND ISNULL(m.CIFNo, N'')      COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = ISNULL(LEFT(i.CIF, 20), N'') COLLATE Thai_CI_AI
                AND ISNULL(m.LGNo, N'')       COLLATE Thai_CI_AI = ISNULL(LEFT(i.LGNo, 20), N'') COLLATE Thai_CI_AI
                AND ISNULL(m.DebtorTypeId, 0) = ISNULL
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN i.DebtorTypeId_Mapped NOT IN (1, 2, 4) THEN 2
                        ELSE i.DebtorTypeId_Mapped
                    END,
                    0
                )
          );

        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 6) Insert TEMPMapLGCBS
        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        INSERT INTO dbo.TEMPMapLGCBS
        (
            TEMPMapLGId,
            CIFNo,
            LGNo,
            DebtorCode,
            DebtorTypeId,
            ImportDate
        )
        SELECT
            m.TEMPMapLGId,
            m.CIFNo,
            m.LGNo,
            m.DebtorCode,
            m.DebtorTypeId,
            m.ImportDate
        FROM #InsertMap m;

        DECLARE @InsertedMapCount INT = @@ROWCOUNT;

        COMMIT;

        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 7) Summary
        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        SELECT
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #DuplicateIDCard) AS DuplicateIDCardGroupCount,
            (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(DuplicateCount), 0) FROM #DuplicateIDCard) AS DuplicateIDCardRowCount,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #DuplicateRecord) AS DuplicateRecordGroupCount,
            (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(DuplicateCount), 0) FROM #DuplicateRecord) AS DuplicateRecordRowCount,
            @InsertedDebtorCount AS InsertedDebtorCount,
            @InsertedMapCount AS InsertedTEMPMapLGCBSCount,
            N'Insert TEMPGuarantorOtherCBS -> DataDebtor และ TEMPMapLGCBS สำเร็จ' AS Note;

        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 8) Duplicate IDCard detail
        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        SELECT
            d.IDCard,
            d.DuplicateCount
        FROM #DuplicateIDCard d
        ORDER BY d.IDCard;

        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 9) Duplicate record detail
        ----------------------------------------------------------------
        SELECT
            d.IDCard,
            d.CIF,
            d.LGNo,
            d.DuplicateCount
        FROM #DuplicateRecord d
        ORDER BY d.IDCard, d.CIF, d.LGNo;


		Update d
set d.PersonGroupId = t.PersonTypeId

from TEMPDebtorCBS c
left join DataDebtor d on d.IDCard = c.IDCard
left join SystemTitleMaster t on t.TitleCode = c.TitleCode

Update d
set d.PersonGroupId = t.PersonTypeId

from TEMPGuarantorOtherCBS c
left join DataDebtor d on d.IDCard = c.IDCard
left join SystemTitleMaster t on t.TitleCode = c.TitleCode

Update d
set d.PersonGroupId = t.PersonTypeId

from TEMPDebtorJoinCBS c
left join DataDebtor d on d.IDCard = c.IDCard
left join SystemTitleMaster t on t.TitleCode = c.TitleCode

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK;

        THROW;
    END CATCH
END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_024_InsertSystemTitleMaster]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRAN;

        -- เก็บรายการที่ insert สำเร็จ
        DECLARE @Inserted TABLE (TitleCode NVARCHAR(50));

        -- Insert ข้อมูลที่ยังไม่ถูก Migrate
        INSERT INTO SystemTitleMaster 
            (TitleCode, TitleName, TitleNameEn, CreateDate, UpdateDate, CreateBy, UpdateBy)
        OUTPUT inserted.TitleCode INTO @Inserted(TitleCode)
        SELECT  
            t.TitleCode,           
            t.TitleName,           
            t.TitleNameEn,         
            GETDATE(), 
            GETDATE(), 
            1, 
            1
        FROM TEMPTitleCBS t
        WHERE t.IsMigrated = 0
          AND NOT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM SystemTitleMaster s
              WHERE s.TitleName = t.TitleName
          );

        -- Update IsMigrated = 1 เฉพาะรายการที่ถูก insert
        UPDATE t
        SET t.IsMigrated = 1
        FROM TEMPTitleCBS t
        INNER JOIN @Inserted i 
            ON t.TitleCode COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT = i.TitleCode COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT;

        COMMIT TRAN;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        ROLLBACK TRAN;

        THROW; -- ส่ง error ออกไปให้เห็น
    END CATCH
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_026_InsertDebtorRelate]
	-- นำเข้าข้อมูลลูกหนี้ - ข้อมูลความสัมพันธ์ DataDebtorRelate
	@GetDate date = '2025-09-04'
	
	
AS
BEGIN


    SET NOCOUNT ON;

;WITH G AS (
    SELECT 
        lg_cbs.LGNo,
        lg_cbs.DebtorCode,
        lg_cbs.CIFNo,
        lg_cbs.DebtorTypeId,
        MIN(lg_cbs.LGNoSeq) AS LGNoSeq,  -- เลือกค่าตัวแทน
        MIN(lg_cbs.Seq)    AS Seq        -- เลือกค่าตัวแทน
    FROM TEMPMapLGCBS lg_cbs
    LEFT JOIN DataDebtor d
        ON d.DebtorCode = lg_cbs.DebtorCode
    WHERE 
        -- กันไม่ให้ชนกับของที่มีอยู่แล้วใน DataDebtorRelate
        lg_cbs.DebtorCode 
        + CAST(lg_cbs.DebtorTypeId AS NVARCHAR(10)) 
        + CAST(lg_cbs.LGNo AS NVARCHAR(10))
            NOT IN (
                SELECT DebtorCode 
                       + CAST(LGNo AS NVARCHAR(10))
                FROM DataDebtorRelate
            )
        AND d.DebtorId IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        lg_cbs.LGNo,
        lg_cbs.DebtorCode,
        lg_cbs.CIFNo,
        lg_cbs.DebtorTypeId
)
INSERT INTO [DataDebtorRelate] (
    [DebtorRelateId],
    [DebtorRelateCode],
    [LGNo],
    [DebtorCode],
    [CIFNo],
    [DebtorTypeId],
    [ProportionLiabilityTypeId],
    [CreateBy],
    [CreateDate],
    [UpdateBy],
    [UpdateDate],
    [RefCode],
    [DebtorId],
    [IsActive],
    [IsDelete],
    [ImportType],
    [LGNoSeq],
    [Seq],
	IsFirstCall
)
SELECT
    NEWID() AS DebtorRelateId,                    -- ใส่ NEWID ตรงนี้ (หลัง group แล้ว)
    'R' + g.CIFNo AS DebtorRelateCode,
    g.LGNo,
    g.DebtorCode,
    g.CIFNo,
    case when g.DebtorTypeId not in (1, 2, 4, 5, 6) then 2 else  g.DebtorTypeId end,
    dbo.FN_DCS_17_GetProportionLiabilityType(g.DebtorTypeId),
    1 AS CreateBy,
    GETDATE() AS CreateDate,
    1 AS UpdateBy,
    GETDATE() AS UpdateDate,
    NULL AS RefCode,
    d.DebtorId,
    1 AS IsActive,
    0 AS IsDelete,
    1 AS ImportType,
    g.LGNoSeq,
    g.Seq,
	1 as IsFirstCall
FROM DataLG lg
inner join G g on g.LGNo = lg.LGNo
inner JOIN DataDebtor d ON d.DebtorCode = g.DebtorCode
where d.DebtorCode + '|' + g.LGNo  not in (select DebtorCode + '|' + LGNo from DataDebtorRelate)


END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_027_InsertDataMainCard]
	-- นำเข้าข้อมูลการ์ดลูกหนี้ - การ์ด LG (DataMainCard)
    --@GetDate DATE =  '2025-08-30'
	--,@TypeId int = 1 --1=Insert ด้วย job, 2=Insert ทีละการ์ด (Manual ทีละ Id)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @GetMeasureId INT= (SELECT TOP 1 MeasureId FROM SystemMeasureMaster WHERE IsDefault=1)
	DECLARE @GetInterestRate decimal(20,4)= (select top 1 IntRate from SystemInterateMaster where IsActive = 1 and InterateTypeId = 111)
	
									--(select top 1 cast(m.ConditionItemMapingValue as decimal(20,4))
									--from SystemConditionItemMappingValueMaster m
									--left join SystemConditionMaster c on m.ConditionId = c.ConditionId
									--left join SystemCampaignConditionMaster cc on cc.ConditionId = c.ConditionId
									--left join SystemMeasureCampaignMaster cm on cm.CampaignId = cc.CampaignId
									--left join SystemMeasureMaster mm on mm.MeasureId = cm.MeasureId
									--where mm.IsDefault=1
									--and m.ConditionItemId=48)

									


	BEGIN TRANSACTION;

	-- ล็อกตารางแบบ Exclusive
	--SELECT 1
	--FROM [dbo].[DataMainCard] WITH (TABLOCKX);

    INSERT INTO [DataMainCard] (
        [MainCardId]
        ,[LGNo]
        ,[ClaimPayDate]
        ,[SystemBankId]
        ,[BankCode]
        ,[CardStatusId]
        ,[InterestRate]
        ,[InterestPlannedRate]
        ,[AmountDuty]
        ,[ClaimPay]
        ,[DebtBalance]
        ,[Principal]
        ,[PrincipalTotal]
        ,[CreateBy]
        ,[CreateDate]
        ,[UpdateBy]
        ,[UpdateDate]
        ,[CIFNumber]
        ,[DebtBurden]
        ,[ConditionPayment]
        ,[MainCardCode]
        ,[InstallmentsAmount]
        ,[InstallmentOutstanding]
        ,[GroupCardCode]
        ,[InstallmentPrincipal]
        ,[InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
        ,[SeqCurrent]
        ,[SeqNext]
        ,[InterestStartDate]
        ,[InterestEndDate]
        ,[CurrentPaymentDate]
        ,[MeasureId]
        ,[IsDelete]

    )
    SELECT
        NEWID() AS [MainCardId]
        ,cbs.[LGNo]
        ,cbs.[ClaimDate] AS [ClaimPayDate]
        ,sb.[BankId]
        ,sb.[BankCode]
        ,1 AS [CardStatusId]
        ,@GetInterestRate AS [InterestRate]
        ,@GetInterestRate AS [InterestPlannedRate]
        ,cbs.[ClaimAmount] AS [AmountDuty]
        ,cbs.[ClaimPayAmount] AS [ClaimPay]
        ,cbs.[ClaimPayAmount] AS [DebtBalance]
        ,cbs.[ClaimPayAmount] AS [Principal]
        ,cbs.[ClaimPayAmount] AS [PrincipalTotal]
        ,cbs.[CreateBy]
        ,cbs.[CreateDate] AS [CreateDate]
        ,cbs.[UpdateBy]
        ,cbs.[CreateDate] AS [UpdateDate]
        ,cbs.[CIFNo] AS [CIFNumber]
        ,cbs.[ClaimAmountCurrent] AS [DebtBurden]
        ,NULL AS [ConditionPayment]
        ,cbs.[CIFNo] + '-' + cbs.[LGNo] + '-1' AS [MainCardCode]
        ,cbs.[ClaimPayAmount] AS [InstallmentsAmount]
        ,cbs.[ClaimPayAmount] AS [InstallmentOutstanding]
        ,cbs.[CIFNo] + '-' + cbs.[LGNo] AS [GroupCardCode]
        ,cbs.[ClaimPayAmount] AS [InstallmentPrincipal]
        ,cbs.[ClaimPayAmount] AS [InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
        ,2 AS [SeqCurrent]
        ,3 AS [SeqNext]
        ,cbs.[ClaimDate] AS [InterestStartDate]
        ,cbs.[ClaimDate] AS [InterestEndDate]
        ,cast('1900-01-01' as date) AS [CurrentPaymentDate]
        ,0 AS [MeasureId]
        ,0 AS [IsDelete]
    FROM [DataLG] cbs
    LEFT JOIN [SystemBankMaster] sb ON sb.BankId= cbs.BankId
    WHERE 
	--CAST(cbs.[CreateDate] AS DATE) = @GetDate
	--AND 
	(cbs.[CIFNo] + '-' + cbs.[LGNo] + '-1')  NOT IN (SELECT [CIFNo] + '-' + [LGNo] + '-1' FROM [DataMainCard])
	--and cbs.[LGNo]  = '64104760'
	and cbs.Grade = 'F1'

	--EXEC [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_028_InsertDataMainCardMovement];

	EXEC [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_029_InsertDataDebtorCard];

	COMMIT TRANSACTION;
END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_028_InsertDataMainCardMovement]
		-- นำเข้าข้อมูลการ์ดลูกหนี้ - ประวัติการเดินการ์ด LG (DataMainCardMovement)
    --@GetDate DATE =  '2025-09-04'
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @GetMeasureId INT= (SELECT TOP 1 MeasureId FROM SystemMeasureMaster WHERE IsDefault=1)
	DECLARE @TypeId int = (SELECT TOP 1 PaymentTypeId FROM SystemPaymentType WHERE PaymentTypeId=1)
    DECLARE @TypeCode nvarchar(2) = (SELECT TOP 1 PaymentTypeCode FROM SystemPaymentType WHERE PaymentTypeId=1)
    DECLARE @TypeName nvarchar(50) = (SELECT TOP 1 PaymentTypeName FROM SystemPaymentType WHERE PaymentTypeId=1)
	DECLARE @GetMeasureName nvarchar(50)= (SELECT TOP 1 MeasureName FROM SystemMeasureMaster WHERE MeasureId = @GetMeasureId)
	--DECLARE @GetDebtorId INT= (SELECT TOP 1 MeasureId FROM DataDebtorRelate WHERE LGNo=)

	--BEGIN TRANSACTION;

	---- ล็อกตารางแบบ Exclusive
	--SELECT 1
	--FROM [dbo].[DataMainCardMovement] WITH (TABLOCKX);

	INSERT INTO [DataMainCardMovement] (
		 [MainCardMovementId]
		,[MainCardId]
		,[DocDate]
		,[LGNo]
		,[TypeId]
		,[TypeCode]
		,[TypeName]
		,[FlagAutoPay]
		,[DebtBalance]
		,[Principal]
		,[PrincipalTotal]
		,[Installment]
		,[InstallmentTotal]
		,[InstallmentPrincipal]
		,[InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
		,[MeasureId]
		,[MeasureName]
		,[InterestRate]
		,[InterestPlannedRate]
		,[InterestStartDate]
		,[CreateBy]
		,[CreateDate]
		,[UpdateBy]
		,[UpdateDate]
		,[SeqNo]
		,[DebtorPaymentId]
		,[DebtorPaymentCode]

		--,[InstallmentPrincipal]
		,[InstallmentPrincipalPay]
		--,[InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
		,[InstallmentInterest]
		,[InstallmentInterestPay]
		,[InstallmentInterestTotal]
		--,[InterestStartDate]
		,[InterestEndDate]
		,[InterestQuantity]
		,[DPDAccumulate]
		

	)
	SELECT
		 NEWID() AS [MainCardMovementId]
		,mc.[MainCardId]
		,mc.[ClaimPayDate] AS [DocDate]
		,mc.[LGNo]
		,@TypeId AS [TypeId]
		,@TypeCode AS [TypeCode]
		,@TypeName AS [TypeName]
		,1
		,mc.[DebtBalance]
		,mc.[Principal]
		,mc.[PrincipalTotal]
		,mc.[InstallmentsAmount]
		,mc.[InstallmentsAmount]
		,mc.[InstallmentPrincipal]
		,mc.[InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
		,@GetMeasureId
		,@GetMeasureName
		,mc.[InterestRate]
		,mc.[InterestPlannedRate] 
		,mc.[ClaimPayDate] AS [InterestStartDate]
		,mc.[CreateBy]
		,GETDATE() AS [CreateDate]
		,mc.[UpdateBy]
		,GETDATE() AS [UpdateDate]
		,1 AS [SeqNo]
		,null AS [DebtorPaymentId]
		,null AS [DebtorPaymentCode]

		--,mc.[PrincipalTotal] AS [InstallmentPrincipal]
		,0 AS [InstallmentPrincipalPay]
		--,mc.[PrincipalTotal] AS [InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
		,0 AS [InstallmentInterest]
		,0 AS [InstallmentInterestPay]
		,0 AS [InstallmentInterestTotal]
		--,mc.[ClaimPayDate] AS [InterestStartDate]
		,mc.[ClaimPayDate] AS [InterestEndDate]
		,0 AS [InterestQuantity]
		,0 AS [DPDAccumulate]
		
	FROM [dbo].[DataMainCard] mc
	WHERE 
	--CAST(mc.[CreateDate] AS DATE) = @GetDate
	--and 
	mc.[MainCardId] not in (select cm.MainCardId from DataMainCardMovement cm)

	union all
	SELECT
		 NEWID() AS [MainCardMovementId]
		,mc.[MainCardId]
		,mc.[ClaimPayDate] AS [DocDate]
		,mc.[LGNo]
		,8 AS [TypeId]
		,'08' AS [TypeCode]
		,N'ยอดคงเหลือ' AS [TypeName]
		,1
		,mc.[DebtBalance]
		,mc.[Principal]
		,mc.[PrincipalTotal]
		,mc.[InstallmentsAmount]
		,mc.[InstallmentsAmount]
		,mc.[InstallmentPrincipal]
		,mc.[InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
		,@GetMeasureId
		,@GetMeasureName
		,mc.[InterestRate]
		,mc.[InterestPlannedRate]
		,mc.[ClaimPayDate] AS [InterestStartDate]
		,mc.[CreateBy]
		,GETDATE() AS [CreateDate]
		,mc.[UpdateBy]
		,GETDATE() AS [UpdateDate]
		,2 AS [SeqNo]
		,null AS [DebtorPaymentId]
		,null AS [DebtorPaymentCode]

		--,mc.[PrincipalTotal] AS [InstallmentPrincipal]
		,0 AS [InstallmentPrincipalPay]
		--,mc.[PrincipalTotal] AS [InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
		,0 AS [InstallmentInterest]
		,0 AS [InstallmentInterestPay]
		,0 AS [InstallmentInterestTotal]
		--,mc.[ClaimPayDate] AS [InterestStartDate]
		,mc.[ClaimPayDate] AS [InterestEndDate]
		,0 AS [InterestQuantity]
		,0 AS [DPDAccumulate]

	FROM [dbo].[DataMainCard] mc
	WHERE 
	--CAST(mc.[CreateDate] AS DATE) = @GetDate
	--and 
	mc.[MainCardId] not in (select cm.MainCardId from DataMainCardMovement cm)

	--and 
	--mc.[LGNo]  = '4801150';

	--UPDATE m
	--SET 
	--	m.DebtorId = r.DebtorId
	--	,m.DebtorCode = d.DebtorCode
	--	,m.DebtorCardName = d.DebtorName
		
	--FROM [DataMainCardMovement] m
	--INNER JOIN [DataDebtorRelate] r ON m.LGNo = r.LGNo AND r.DebtorTypeId = 1
	--INNER JOIN [DataDebtor] d ON r.DebtorId = d.DebtorId
	--WHERE CAST(m.[CreateDate] AS DATE) = @GetDate;

	--COMMIT TRANSACTION;

END

-- =============================================

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_029_InsertDataDebtorCard]
	-- นำเข้าข้อมูลการ์ดลูกหนี้ - การ์ดรายคน (DataMainCard)
    --@GetDate DATE =  '2025-09-04'
	
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @GetMeasureId INT= (SELECT TOP 1 MeasureId FROM SystemMeasureMaster WHERE IsDefault=1)
	DECLARE @GetInterestRate decimal(20,4)= (select top 1 IntRate from SystemInterateMaster where IsActive = 1 and InterateTypeId = 111) 
	
	--(select top 1 cast(m.ConditionItemMapingValue as decimal(20,4))
	--								from SystemConditionItemMappingValueMaster m
	--								left join SystemConditionMaster c on m.ConditionId = c.ConditionId
	--								left join SystemCampaignConditionMaster cc on cc.ConditionId = c.ConditionId
	--								left join SystemMeasureCampaignMaster cm on cm.CampaignId = cc.CampaignId
	--								left join SystemMeasureMaster mm on mm.MeasureId = cm.MeasureId
	--								where mm.IsDefault=1
	--								and m.ConditionItemId=48
	--								and mm.IsActive = 1
	--								)
	DECLARE @GetMeasureName nvarchar(200) = (SELECT TOP 1 MeasureName FROM SystemMeasureMaster WHERE MeasureId = @GetMeasureId)


	BEGIN TRANSACTION;

	-- ล็อกตารางแบบ Exclusive
	--SELECT 1
	--FROM [dbo].[DataMainCard] WITH (TABLOCKX);

    INSERT INTO [dbo].[DataDebtorCard] (
    [DataDebtorCardId]
    ,[LGNo]
    ,[DebtorCode]
    ,[DebtorCardCode]
    ,[DebtorCardName]
	,[InterestRate]
	,[InterestPlannedRate]
   -- ,[CardType]
    ,[ClaimPayDate]
    ,[SystemBankId]
    ,[BankCode]
    ,[IsAuto]
    ,[ClaimPay]
	,[DebtAmount]
    ,[DebtBalance]
    ,[Principal]
    ,[PrincipalTotal]
    ,[CreateBy]
    ,[CreateDate]
    ,[UpdateBy]
    ,[UpdateDate]
	,[MeasureId]
	,[MeasureName]
    ,[DebtorId]
    ,[DebtorRelateId]
	,[ProportionLiability]
    ,[DebtorRelateCode]
    ,[DebtorRelateTypeId]
    ,[CIFNo]
    ,[DebtBurden]
    ,[MainCardCode]
	,[DataMainCardId]
	,[SeqNo]
	,[CardStatusId]
	,[CardStatusDate]
    ,[InstallmentsAmount]
    ,[InstallmentOutstanding]
    ,[GroupCardCode]
    ,[InstallmentPrincipal]
    ,[InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
	,[AmountDuty]
	,[SeqCurrent]
	,[SeqNext]
	,[InterestStartDate]
	,[InterestEndDate]
	,[MeasureDate]
	,[RequestNoTDR]
	,[CompromiseContractId]
	,[CompromiseContracApproveDate]
	,[RequestDebtorApproveDate]
	,[FileOtherDate]
	,[Remark]
	,[IsDelete]
	,[Reference1]
	,[Reference2]

)
SELECT 
    NEWID() AS [DataDebtorCardId]
    ,r.[LGNo]
    ,r.[DebtorCode]
    ,d.[DebtorCode] +'-'+ r.[LGNo] + '-1' AS [DebtorCardCode]
    ,d.FirstName + ' ' + isnull(LastName,'') AS [DebtorCardName]
	,@GetInterestRate AS [InterestRate]
	,@GetInterestRate AS [InterestPlannedRate]
    --,CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId] = 1 THEN 'M' ELSE 'S' END AS [CardType]  -- M = Main, S = Sub
    ,mc.[ClaimPayDate] AS [ClaimPayDate]
    ,mc.[SystemBankId] AS [SystemBankId]
    ,mc.BankCode AS [BankCode]
    ,1 AS [IsAuto]
    ,mc.[ClaimPay] AS [ClaimPay]
    ,(CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId]  = 2 THEN mc.[DebtBalance] / dbo.[FN_DCS_01_ProportionLiabilit](r.[LGNo]) ELSE mc.[DebtBalance] END) AS [DebtAmount]
    ,(CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId]  = 2 THEN mc.[DebtBalance] / dbo.[FN_DCS_01_ProportionLiabilit](r.[LGNo]) ELSE mc.[DebtBalance] END) AS [DebtBalance]
    ,(CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId]  = 2 THEN mc.[DebtBalance] / dbo.[FN_DCS_01_ProportionLiabilit](r.[LGNo]) ELSE mc.[DebtBalance] END) AS [Principal]
    ,(CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId]  = 2 THEN mc.[DebtBalance] / dbo.[FN_DCS_01_ProportionLiabilit](r.[LGNo]) ELSE mc.[DebtBalance] END) AS [PrincipalTotal]
    ,1 AS [CreateBy]
    ,r.CreateDate AS [CreateDate]
    ,1 AS [UpdateBy]
    ,r.UpdateDate AS [UpdateDate]
	,@GetMeasureId AS [MeasureId]
	,@GetMeasureName AS [MeasureName]
    ,r.[DebtorId]
    ,r.[DebtorRelateId]
	,(CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId]  = 2 THEN mc.[DebtBalance] / dbo.[FN_DCS_01_ProportionLiabilit](r.[LGNo]) ELSE mc.[DebtBalance] END) AS [ProportionLiability]
    ,r.[DebtorRelateCode]
    ,r.[DebtorTypeId] AS [DebtorRelateTypeId]
    ,r.[CIFNo]
    ,mc.[DebtBurden] AS [DebtBurden]
    ,mc.[MainCardCode] AS [MainCardCode]
	,mc.[MainCardId] AS [DataMainCardId]
	,1 AS [SeqNo]
	,1 AS [CardStatusId]
	,GETDATE() AS [CardStatusDate]
    ,(CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId]  = 2 THEN mc.[DebtBalance] / dbo.[FN_DCS_01_ProportionLiabilit](r.[LGNo]) ELSE mc.[InstallmentPrincipalTotal] END) AS [InstallmentsAmount]
    ,mc.[InstallmentOutstanding] AS [InstallmentOutstanding]
    ,r.[CIFNo] + '-' + r.[LGNo] AS [GroupCardCode]
	,(CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId]  = 2 THEN mc.[DebtBalance] / dbo.[FN_DCS_01_ProportionLiabilit](r.[LGNo]) ELSE mc.[InstallmentPrincipal] END) AS [InstallmentPrincipal]
	,(CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId]  = 2 THEN mc.[DebtBalance] / dbo.[FN_DCS_01_ProportionLiabilit](r.[LGNo]) ELSE mc.[InstallmentPrincipalTotal] END) AS [InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
	,(CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId]  = 2 THEN mc.[DebtBalance] / dbo.[FN_DCS_01_ProportionLiabilit](r.[LGNo]) ELSE mc.[InstallmentPrincipalTotal] END) AS [AmountDuty]
	,2 as [SeqCurrent]
	,3 as [SeqNext]
	,mc.ClaimPayDate as [InterestStartDate]
	,mc.ClaimPayDate as [InterestEndDate]
	,mc.ClaimPayDate as [MeasureDate]
	,null as [RequestNoTDR]
	,null as [CompromiseContractId]
	,cast('1900-01-01' as date) as [CompromiseContracApproveDate]
	,cast('1900-01-01' as date) as[RequestDebtorApproveDate]
	,cast('1900-01-01' as date) as[FileOtherDate]
	,null as [Remark]
	,0 as [IsDelete]
	,null as [Reference1]
	,null as [Reference2]

FROM [dbo].[DataDebtorRelate] r
LEFT JOIN [dbo].[DataLG] lg ON r.[LGNo] = lg.[LGNo]
LEFT JOIN [dbo].[DataDebtor] d ON d.[DebtorId] = r.[DebtorId]
LEFT JOIN [dbo].[DataMainCard] mc ON r.[LGNo] = mc.[LGNo]
LEFT JOIN [dbo].[SystemDebtorType] dt ON dt.[DebtorTypeId] = r.[DebtorTypeId]
WHERE 
--lg.[LGNo] = '4801150'
 (r.[DebtorCode] + '-' + r.[LGNo] + '-1' not in (SELECT DebtorCardCode FROM [DataDebtorCard]))
 and lg.Grade = 'F1'
--AND CAST(r.CreateDate AS DATE) = @GetDate;
and r.DebtorRelateId not in (select DebtorRelateId from DataDebtorCard )
and dt.IsCalCard = 1


	EXEC [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_030_InsertDataDebtorCardMovement];
	EXEC [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_031_InserDataDebtorCardInterate];

	--EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_015_InsertBillPayment]


	COMMIT TRANSACTION;
END

-- =============================================

-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_030_InsertDataDebtorCardMovement]
	-- นำเข้าข้อมูลการ์ดลูกหนี้ - ประวัติรายการเดินการ์ดรายคน (DataDebtorCardMovement)
    --@GetDate DATE =  '2025-09-02'
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
	--DECLARE @GetMeasureId INT= (SELECT TOP 1 MeasureId FROM SystemMeasureMaster WHERE IsDefault=1)
	DECLARE @TypeId int = (SELECT TOP 1 PaymentTypeId FROM SystemPaymentType WHERE PaymentTypeId=1)
    DECLARE @TypeCode nvarchar(2) = (SELECT TOP 1 PaymentTypeCode FROM SystemPaymentType WHERE PaymentTypeId=1)
    DECLARE @TypeName nvarchar(50) = (SELECT TOP 1 PaymentTypeName FROM SystemPaymentType WHERE PaymentTypeId=1)
	--DECLARE @GetMeasureName nvarchar(50)= (SELECT TOP 1 MeasureName FROM SystemMeasureMaster WHERE MeasureId = @GetMeasureId)
	--DECLARE @GetDebtorId INT= (SELECT TOP 1 MeasureId FROM DataDebtorRelate WHERE LGNo=)

	BEGIN TRANSACTION;

	-- ล็อกตารางแบบ Exclusive
		--SELECT 1
		--FROM [dbo].[DataDebtorCardMovement] WITH (TABLOCKX);

		INSERT INTO [dbo].[DataDebtorCardMovement] (
		[DebtorCardMovementId]
		,[DebtorCardId]
		,[DocDate]
		,[PayDate]
		,[LGNo]
		,[DebtorId]
		,[DebtorCode]
		,[DebtorCardCode]
		,[DebtorCardName]
		,[TypeId]
		,[TypeCode]
		,[TypeName]
		,[FlagAutoPay]
		,[MeasureId]
		,[MeasureName]
		,[InterestRate]
		,[InterestPlannedRate]
		,[DebtBalance]
		,[Installment]
		,[InstallmentTotal]
		,[Principal]
		,[PrincipalTotal]

		,[CreateBy]
		,[CreateDate]
		,[UpdateBy]
		,[UpdateDate]
		,[SeqNo]

		,[InstallmentPrincipal]
		,[InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
		,[InstallmentInterest]
		,[InstallmentInterestTotal]
		,[InterestStartDate]
		,[InterestEndDate]
		,[InterestQuantity]
		,[DPDAccumulate]
		,[OverdueAmount]
		,[PrincipalOverdueAmount]
		,[AccruedInterestOverdueAmount]
		,[TotalOverdue]
		,[TotalPrincipalOverdue]
		,[TotalAccruedInterestOverdue]
		,[CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId]
		,[IsUpdateHistory]


	)
	SELECT
		NEWID() AS [DebtorCardMovementId]
		,dc.[DataDebtorCardId] AS [DebtorCardId]
		,GETDATE() AS [DocDate]
		,dc.ClaimPayDate [PayDate]
		,dc.[LGNo]
		,dc.[DebtorId]
		,dc.[DebtorCode]
		,dc.[DebtorCardCode]
		,dc.[DebtorCardName]
		,@TypeId AS [TypeId]
		,@TypeCode AS [TypeCode]
		,@TypeName AS [TypeName]
		,dc.[IsAuto] AS [FlagAutoPay]
		,dc.[MeasureId]
		,dc.[MeasureName]
		,dc.[InterestRate]
		,dc.[InterestPlannedRate]
		,dc.[DebtBalance]
		,dc.[InstallmentsAmount] AS [Installment]
		,dc.[InstallmentsAmount] AS [InstallmentTotal]
		,dc.[Principal]
		,dc.[PrincipalTotal]

		,dc.[CreateBy]
		,GETDATE() AS [CreateDate]
		,dc.[UpdateBy]
		,GETDATE() AS [UpdateDate]
		,1 AS [SeqNo]

		,dc.[InstallmentPrincipal]
		,dc.[InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
		,0 AS [InstallmentInterest]
		,0 AS [InstallmentInterestTotal]
		,dc.[ClaimPayDate] AS [InterestStartDate]
		,dc.[ClaimPayDate] AS InterestEndDate
		,0 as InterestQuantity
		,0 as DPDAccumulate
		,0 as OverdueAmount
		,0 as PrincipalOverdueAmount
		,0 as AccruedInterestOverdueAmount
		,0 as TotalOverdue
		,0 as TotalPrincipalOverdue
		,0 as TotalAccruedInterestOverdue
		,0 as CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId
		,0 as IsUpdateHistory

	FROM [dbo].[DataDebtorCard] dc

	WHERE 
	--dc.LGNo = '4801150'
	dc.DataDebtorCardId not in (SELECT DebtorCardId FROM [DataDebtorCardMovement])
	union all

	SELECT
		NEWID() AS [DebtorCardMovementId]
		,dc.[DataDebtorCardId] AS [DebtorCardId]
		,GETDATE() AS [DocDate]
		, dc.ClaimPayDate as PayDate
		,dc.[LGNo]
		,dc.[DebtorId]
		,dc.[DebtorCode]
		,dc.[DebtorCardCode]
		,dc.[DebtorCardName]
		,8 AS [TypeId]
		,'08' AS [TypeCode]
		,'ยอดคงเหลือ' AS [TypeName]
		,dc.[IsAuto] AS [FlagAutoPay]
		,dc.[MeasureId]
		,dc.[MeasureName]
		,dc.[InterestRate]
		,dc.[InterestPlannedRate]
		,dc.[DebtBalance]
		,dc.[InstallmentsAmount] AS [Installment]
		,dc.[InstallmentsAmount] AS [InstallmentTotal]
		,dc.[Principal]
		,dc.[PrincipalTotal]

		,dc.[CreateBy]
		,GETDATE() AS [CreateDate]
		,dc.[UpdateBy]
		,GETDATE() AS [UpdateDate]
		,2 AS [SeqNo]

		,dc.[InstallmentPrincipal]
		,dc.[InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
		,0 AS [InstallmentInterest]
		,0 AS [InstallmentInterestTotal]
		,dc.[ClaimPayDate] AS [InterestStartDate]
		,dc.[ClaimPayDate] AS InterestEndDate
		,0 as InterestQuantity
		,0 as DPDAccumulate
		,0 as OverdueAmount
		,0 as PrincipalOverdueAmount
		,0 as AccruedInterestOverdueAmount
		,0 as TotalOverdue
		,0 as TotalPrincipalOverdue
		,0 as TotalAccruedInterestOverdue
		,0 as CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId
		,0 as IsUpdateHistory

	FROM [dbo].[DataDebtorCard] dc

	WHERE 
	--dc.LGNo = '4801150'
	dc.DataDebtorCardId not in (SELECT DebtorCardId FROM [DataDebtorCardMovement])
	----AND r.[LGNo] = '3800012'
	 --CAST(dc.CreateDate AS DATE) = @GetDate;

	COMMIT TRANSACTION;

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_031_InserDataDebtorCardInterate]
	-- นำเข้าข้อมูลการ์ดลูกหนี้ - การ์ดรายคน (DataMainCard)
    --@GetDate DATE =  '2025-06-03'
	
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @GetMeasureId INT= (SELECT TOP 1 MeasureId FROM SystemMeasureMaster WHERE IsDefault=1)
	DECLARE @GetInterestRate decimal(20,4)= (select top 1 IntRate from SystemInterateMaster where IsActive = 1 and InterateTypeId = 111) 
	DECLARE @EndDate DATETIME = '3000-12-01 00:00:00.000'

	--DECLARE @GetMeasureName nvarchar(200) = (SELECT TOP 1 MeasureName FROM SystemMeasureMaster WHERE MeasureId = @GetMeasureId)


	BEGIN TRANSACTION;

	-- ล็อกตารางแบบ Exclusive
	SELECT 1
	FROM [dbo].[DataMainCard] WITH (TABLOCKX);

    INSERT INTO [dbo].[DataDebtorCardInterate] (
    [DebtorCardInterateId]
    ,[DebtorCardId]
    ,[MeasureId]
    ,[Seq]
    ,[InterateRate]
    ,[DefaultInterest]
    ,[StartDate]
    ,[EndDate]
    ,[IsActive]
    ,[CompromiseContractGroupId]
    ,[CreateDate]
    ,[CreateBy]
    ,[UpdateDate]
    ,[UpdateBy]
    ,[IsDefaultInterest]
)
SELECT
    NEWID() AS [DebtorCardInterateId]
    ,dc.[DataDebtorCardId]
    ,dc.[MeasureId]
    ,1 AS [Seq]                            
    ,@GetInterestRate AS [InterateRate]
    ,dc.[InterestDefaultRate] AS [DefaultInterest]
    ,dc.[ClaimPayDate] AS [StartDate]
    ,@EndDate AS [EndDate]
    ,1 AS [IsActive]
    ,NULL AS [CompromiseContractGroupId]
    ,GETDATE() AS [CreateDate]
    ,dc.[CreateBy]
    ,GETDATE() AS [UpdateDate]
    ,dc.[UpdateBy]
    ,1 AS [IsDefaultInterest]              
FROM [dbo].[DataDebtorCard] dc
where dc.[DataDebtorCardId] not in (select DataDebtorCardId from DataDebtorCardInterate)

	COMMIT TRANSACTION;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_032_InsertDataDebtorHistory]
	
	--@GetDate date = '2025-08-30'
AS
BEGIN
INSERT INTO [dbo].[DataDebtorHistory]
           ([DebtorHistoryId]
           ,[CIFNo]
           ,[LGNo]
           ,[DebtorCode]
           ,[DebtorId]
           ,[CreateDate]
           ,[CreateBy]
           ,[UpdateDate]
           ,[UpdateBy]
           ,[Detail]
           ,[SystemId])
 
           SELECT
		   NEWID() as [DebtorHistoryId]
           ,r.CIFNo as [CIFNo]
           ,r.LGNo as [LGNo]
           ,d.DebtorCode as [DebtorCode]
           ,d.DebtorId as [DebtorId]
           ,getdate() as [CreateDate]
           ,1 as [CreateBy]
           ,getdate() as [UpdateDate]
           ,1 as [UpdateBy]
           ,N'บันทึกข้อมูลลูกหนี้เข้าสู่ระบบ' as [Detail]
           ,1 as [SystemId]

		   FROM DataDebtorRelate r
		   LEFT JOIN DataDebtor d ON d.DebtorId = r.DebtorId
		   where d.DebtorCode + r.CIFNo + r.LGNo not in (select DebtorCode + CIFNo + LGNo from [DataDebtorHistory])

    

END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_033_InsertDataMainCardMovementFee]
		-- นำเข้าข้อมูลการ์ดลูกหนี้ - ประวัติการเดินการ์ด LG (DataMainCardMovement)
    --@GetDate DATE =  '2025-09-04'
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @GetMeasureId INT= (SELECT TOP 1 MeasureId FROM SystemMeasureMaster WHERE IsDefault=1)
	DECLARE @TypeId int = (SELECT TOP 1 PaymentTypeId FROM SystemPaymentType WHERE PaymentTypeId=1)
    DECLARE @TypeCode nvarchar(2) = (SELECT TOP 1 PaymentTypeCode FROM SystemPaymentType WHERE PaymentTypeId=1)
    DECLARE @TypeName nvarchar(50) = (SELECT TOP 1 PaymentTypeName FROM SystemPaymentType WHERE PaymentTypeId=1)
	DECLARE @GetMeasureName nvarchar(50)= (SELECT TOP 1 MeasureName FROM SystemMeasureMaster WHERE MeasureId = @GetMeasureId)
	--DECLARE @GetDebtorId INT= (SELECT TOP 1 MeasureId FROM DataDebtorRelate WHERE LGNo=)

	--BEGIN TRANSACTION;

	---- ล็อกตารางแบบ Exclusive
	--SELECT 1
	--FROM [dbo].[DataMainCardMovement] WITH (TABLOCKX);

	INSERT INTO [DataMainCardMovement] (
		 [MainCardMovementId]
		,[MainCardId]
		,[DocDate]
		,[LGNo]
		,[TypeId]
		,[TypeCode]
		,[TypeName]
		,[FlagAutoPay]
		,[DebtBalance]
		,[Principal]
		,[PrincipalTotal]
		,[Installment]
		,[InstallmentTotal]
		,[InstallmentPrincipal]
		,[InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
		,[MeasureId]
		,[MeasureName]
		,[InterestRate]
		,[InterestPlannedRate]
		,[InterestStartDate]
		,[CreateBy]
		,[CreateDate]
		,[UpdateBy]
		,[UpdateDate]
		,[SeqNo]
		,[DebtorPaymentId]
		,[DebtorPaymentCode]

		--,[InstallmentPrincipal]
		,[InstallmentPrincipalPay]
		--,[InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
		,[InstallmentInterest]
		,[InstallmentInterestPay]
		,[InstallmentInterestTotal]
		--,[InterestStartDate]
		,[InterestEndDate]
		,[InterestQuantity]
		,[DPDAccumulate]
		

	)
		-- ค่าธรรมเนียมล่างหน้า
	SELECT
		 NEWID() AS [MainCardMovementId]
		,mc.[MainCardId]
		,mc.[ClaimPayDate] AS [DocDate]
		,mc.[LGNo]
		,20 AS [TypeId]
		,'20' AS [TypeCode]
		,N'ปรับปรุงเงินต้นโครงการรับชำระค่าธรรมเนียมล่วงหน้า' AS [TypeName]
		,1
		,mc.[DebtBalance] - f.Fee_Amount
		,mc.[Principal] - f.Fee_Amount
		,mc.[PrincipalTotal] - f.Fee_Amount
		,mc.[InstallmentsAmount] - f.Fee_Amount
		,mc.[InstallmentsAmount] - f.Fee_Amount
		,mc.[InstallmentPrincipal] - f.Fee_Amount
		,mc.[InstallmentPrincipalTotal] - f.Fee_Amount
		,@GetMeasureId
		,@GetMeasureName
		,mc.[InterestRate]
		,mc.[InterestPlannedRate]
		,mc.[ClaimPayDate] AS [InterestStartDate]
		,mc.[CreateBy]
		,GETDATE() AS [CreateDate]
		,mc.[UpdateBy]
		,GETDATE() AS [UpdateDate]
		,3 AS [SeqNo]
		,null AS [DebtorPaymentId]
		,null AS [DebtorPaymentCode]

		--,mc.[PrincipalTotal] AS [InstallmentPrincipal]
		,0 AS [InstallmentPrincipalPay]
		--,mc.[PrincipalTotal] AS [InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
		,0 AS [InstallmentInterest]
		,0 AS [InstallmentInterestPay]
		,0 AS [InstallmentInterestTotal]
		--,mc.[ClaimPayDate] AS [InterestStartDate]
		,mc.[ClaimPayDate] AS [InterestEndDate]
		,0 AS [InterestQuantity]
		,0 AS [DPDAccumulate]

	FROM [dbo].[DataMainCard] mc
	LEFT JOIN TEMPDataFeeBeforeCBS f on f.LGNO = mc.LGNo
	WHERE mc.[MainCardId] not in (select cm.MainCardId from DataMainCardMovement cm)
	AND mc.LGNo in (select LGNO from TEMPDataFeeBeforeCBS)

	union all

	SELECT
		 NEWID() AS [MainCardMovementId]
		,mc.[MainCardId]
		,mc.[ClaimPayDate] AS [DocDate]
		,mc.[LGNo]
		,8 AS [TypeId]
		,'08' AS [TypeCode]
		,N'ยอดคงเหลือ' AS [TypeName]
		,1
		,mc.[DebtBalance] - f.Fee_Amount
		,mc.[Principal] - f.Fee_Amount
		,mc.[PrincipalTotal] - f.Fee_Amount
		,mc.[InstallmentsAmount] - f.Fee_Amount
		,mc.[InstallmentsAmount] - f.Fee_Amount
		,mc.[InstallmentPrincipal] - f.Fee_Amount
		,mc.[InstallmentPrincipalTotal] - f.Fee_Amount
		,@GetMeasureId
		,@GetMeasureName
		,mc.[InterestRate]
		,mc.[InterestPlannedRate]
		,mc.[ClaimPayDate] AS [InterestStartDate]
		,mc.[CreateBy]
		,GETDATE() AS [CreateDate]
		,mc.[UpdateBy]
		,GETDATE() AS [UpdateDate]
		,4 AS [SeqNo]
		,null AS [DebtorPaymentId]
		,null AS [DebtorPaymentCode]

		--,mc.[PrincipalTotal] AS [InstallmentPrincipal]
		,0 AS [InstallmentPrincipalPay]
		--,mc.[PrincipalTotal] AS [InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
		,0 AS [InstallmentInterest]
		,0 AS [InstallmentInterestPay]
		,0 AS [InstallmentInterestTotal]
		--,mc.[ClaimPayDate] AS [InterestStartDate]
		,mc.[ClaimPayDate] AS [InterestEndDate]
		,0 AS [InterestQuantity]
		,0 AS [DPDAccumulate]

	FROM [dbo].[DataMainCard] mc
	LEFT JOIN TEMPDataFeeBeforeCBS f on f.LGNO = mc.LGNo
	WHERE mc.[MainCardId] not in (select cm.MainCardId from DataMainCardMovement cm)
	AND mc.LGNo in (select LGNO from TEMPDataFeeBeforeCBS)

	Update [dbo].[DataMainCard]
	set SeqCurrent = 4
	, SeqNext =5
	where [DataMainCard].LGNo in (select LGNO from TEMPDataFeeBeforeCBS)
	

END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_034_InsertDataDebtorAddressJoin]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    ;WITH SourceData AS
    (
        -- Contact Address
        SELECT
             DD.DebtorCode                           AS DebtorCode
            ,1                                       AS DebtorAddressTypeId
            ,T.ContactNum                            AS AddressNumber
            ,T.ContactBuilding                       AS PlaceName
            ,NULL                                    AS Moo
            ,T.ContactSoi                            AS Soi
            ,T.ContactRoad                           AS Road
            ,P.ProvinceId                            AS ProvinceId
            ,SDM.SubDistrictId                       AS SubDistrictId
            ,D.DistrictId                            AS DistrictId
            ,SDM.PostCode                       AS PostalCode
            ,2                                       AS DebtorContactChannelId
            ,1                                       AS IsDefault
            ,1                                       AS CreateBy
            ,GETDATE()                               AS CreateDate
            ,1                                       AS UpdateBy
            ,GETDATE()                               AS UpdateDate
            ,DD.DebtorId                             AS DebtorId
            ,NULL                                    AS Telephone
            ,NULL                                    AS Fax
            ,NULL                                    AS Mobile
            ,NULL                                    AS Email
            ,NULL                                    AS LineID
            ,NULL                                    AS ContactName
            ,1                                       AS ImportType
            ,T.SystemCreate                          AS SystemCreate
            ,T.ImportDate                            AS ImportDate
            ,1                                       AS SourcePriority
        FROM dbo.TEMPDebtorJoinCBS T
        INNER JOIN dbo.DataDebtor DD ON DD.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT = T.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemProvinceMaster P ON P.TCGProvinceCode COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT = T.ContactProvince COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemDistrictMaster D ON P.ProvinceId = D.ProvinceId
           AND D.Name COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT = T.ContactBoundary COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemSubDistrictMaster SDM
            ON D.ProvinceId = SDM.ProvinceId
           AND D.DistrictId = SDM.DistrictId
           AND SDM.Name COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT = T.ContactDistrict COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT

        UNION ALL

        -- House Address
        SELECT
             DD.DebtorCode                           AS DebtorCode
            ,15                                       AS DebtorAddressTypeId
            ,T.ContactNum                            AS AddressNumber
            ,T.ContactBuilding                       AS PlaceName
            ,NULL                                    AS Moo
            ,T.ContactSoi                            AS Soi
            ,T.ContactRoad                           AS Road
            ,P.ProvinceId                            AS ProvinceId
            ,SDM.SubDistrictId                       AS SubDistrictId
            ,D.DistrictId                            AS DistrictId
            ,SDM.PostCode                     AS PostalCode
            ,2                                       AS DebtorContactChannelId
            ,1                                       AS IsDefault
            ,1                                       AS CreateBy
            ,GETDATE()                               AS CreateDate
            ,1                                       AS UpdateBy
            ,GETDATE()                               AS UpdateDate
            ,DD.DebtorId                             AS DebtorId
            ,NULL                                    AS Telephone
            ,NULL                                    AS Fax
            ,NULL                                    AS Mobile
            ,NULL                                    AS Email
            ,NULL                                    AS LineID
            ,NULL                                    AS ContactName
            ,1                                       AS ImportType
            ,T.SystemCreate                          AS SystemCreate
            ,T.ImportDate                            AS ImportDate
            ,2                                       AS SourcePriority
        FROM dbo.TEMPDebtorJoinCBS T
        INNER JOIN dbo.DataDebtor DD
            ON DD.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT = T.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemProvinceMaster P
            ON P.TCGProvinceCode COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT = T.HouseProvince COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemDistrictMaster D
            ON P.ProvinceId = D.ProvinceId
           AND D.Name COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT = T.HouseBoundary COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemSubDistrictMaster SDM
            ON D.ProvinceId = SDM.ProvinceId
           AND D.DistrictId = SDM.DistrictId
           AND SDM.Name COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT = T.HouseDistrict COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
    ),
    Dedup AS
    (
        SELECT
             S.*
            ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER
             (
                PARTITION BY S.DebtorId, S.DebtorAddressTypeId
                ORDER BY 
                     S.ImportDate DESC
                    ,S.SystemCreate DESC
                    ,S.SourcePriority ASC
             ) AS RN
        FROM SourceData S
    )
    INSERT INTO dbo.DataDebtorAddress
    (
         DebtorCode
        ,DebtorAddressTypeId
        ,AddressNumber
        ,PlaceName
        ,Moo
        ,Soi
        ,Road
        ,ProvinceId
        ,SubDistrictId
        ,DistrictId
        ,PostalCode
        ,DebtorContactChannelId
        ,IsDefault
        ,CreateBy
        ,CreateDate
        ,UpdateBy
        ,UpdateDate
        ,DebtorAddressId
        ,DebtorId
        ,Telephone
        ,Fax
        ,Mobile
        ,Email
        ,LineID
        ,DebtorAddressCBSId
        ,ContactName
        ,ImportType

    )
    SELECT
         D.DebtorCode
        ,D.DebtorAddressTypeId
        ,D.AddressNumber
        ,D.PlaceName
        ,D.Moo
        ,D.Soi
        ,D.Road
        ,D.ProvinceId
        ,D.SubDistrictId
        ,D.DistrictId
        ,D.PostalCode
        ,D.DebtorContactChannelId
        ,D.IsDefault
        ,D.CreateBy
        ,D.CreateDate
        ,D.UpdateBy
        ,D.UpdateDate
        ,NEWID()                AS DebtorAddressId
        ,D.DebtorId
        ,D.Telephone
        ,D.Fax
        ,D.Mobile
        ,D.Email
        ,D.LineID
        ,NEWID()                AS DebtorAddressCBSId
        ,D.ContactName
        ,D.ImportType

    FROM Dedup D
    WHERE D.RN = 1
      AND NOT EXISTS
      (
          SELECT 1
          FROM dbo.DataDebtorAddress A
          WHERE A.DebtorId = D.DebtorId
            AND A.DebtorAddressTypeId = D.DebtorAddressTypeId
      );

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_035_InsertAssignCase]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRAN;

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- STEP 1: Seed (LG + Debtor ตั้งต้นจาก Bankruptcy)
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Seed') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Seed;

        SELECT DISTINCT
            dr.DebtorId,
            dr.LGNo
        INTO #Seed
        FROM dbo.TEMPBankruptcy tb
        INNER JOIN dbo.DataDebtorRelate dr
            ON dr.LGNo = tb.LGNo
        INNER JOIN dbo.DataDebtor d
            ON d.DebtorId = dr.DebtorId
           AND tb.card_id = d.IDCard
        WHERE tb.action = N'พิพากษาล้มละลาย';

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- STEP 2: หา LG อื่นของ Debtor เดิม
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Step2') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Step2;

        SELECT DISTINCT
            dr.DebtorId,
            dr.LGNo
        INTO #Step2
        FROM dbo.DataDebtorRelate dr
        INNER JOIN #Seed s
            ON s.DebtorId = dr.DebtorId;

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- STEP 3: หา Debtor อื่นใน LG เหล่านั้น
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Final') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Final;

        SELECT DISTINCT
            dr.DebtorRelateId,
            dr.DebtorId,
            dr.LGNo,
            dr.DebtorCode,
            dr.CIFNo
        INTO #Final
        FROM dbo.DataDebtorRelate dr
        INNER JOIN #Step2 s
            ON s.LGNo = dr.LGNo;

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- INSERT LTDataAssignCase
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        INSERT INTO dbo.LTDataAssignCase
        (
            AssignCaseId,
            DebtorRelateId,
            ClaimPayDate,
            DebtBalance,
            LegalUserId,
            LawOfficeUserId,
            CIFNo,
            EffectiveDate,
            AssignCaseTypeId,
            CreateDate,
            UpdateDate,
            CreateBy,
            UpdateBy,
            CollectorUserId,
            ExpirationDate,
            IsAssignLegal,
            IsAssignLawOffice,
            CaseTypeId,
            IsCancel,
            LGNo,
            IsCreateCase,
            DebtorCode,
            Remark,
            StatusId
        )
        SELECT
            CONVERT(NVARCHAR(150), NEWID()) AS AssignCaseId,
            f.DebtorRelateId,
            ISNULL(lg.ClaimDate, '1900-01-01') AS ClaimPayDate,
            0 AS DebtBalance, -- TODO: join การ์ด
            NULL AS LegalUserId,
            NULL AS LawOfficeUserId,
            f.CIFNo,
            GETDATE() AS EffectiveDate,
            0 AS AssignCaseTypeId,
            GETDATE() AS CreateDate,
            GETDATE() AS UpdateDate,
            1 AS CreateBy,
            1 AS UpdateBy,
            NULL AS CollectorUserId,
            DATEADD(DAY, 90, GETDATE()) AS ExpirationDate,
            0 AS IsAssignLegal,
            0 AS IsAssignLawOffice,
            6 AS CaseTypeId,
            0 AS IsCancel,
            f.LGNo,
            0 AS IsCreateCase,
            f.DebtorCode,
            tb_remark.debt_Remark AS Remark,
            215 AS StatusId
        FROM #Final f
        LEFT JOIN dbo.DataLG lg
            ON lg.LGNo = f.LGNo
        OUTER APPLY
        (
            SELECT TOP 1 tb.debt_Remark
            FROM dbo.TEMPBankruptcy tb
            WHERE tb.LGNo = f.LGNo
              AND tb.action = N'พิพากษาล้มละลาย'
        ) tb_remark
        WHERE NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.LTDataAssignCase c
            WHERE c.DebtorRelateId = f.DebtorRelateId
              AND c.LGNo = f.LGNo
              AND c.CaseTypeId = 6
              AND c.IsCreateCase = 0
        );

        COMMIT TRAN;

		Update DataDebtorStatusUpdate
		set StatusDebtorId = 22
		, StatusDebtorDate = getdate()
		where CIFNo in 
		(select CIFNo from LTDataAssignCase 
		where CaseTypeId = 6 and cast(UpdateDate as date) = cast(getdate() as date) )

        SELECT 'SUCCESS' AS Status;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK TRAN;

        THROW;
    END CATCH
END
