CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_004_InsertBankruptcy_Customer]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRAN;

        -- 0) clear temp
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Src') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Src;
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Latest') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Latest;
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#MapType') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #MapType;
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ToCreate') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ToCreate;
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ToUpdate') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ToUpdate;
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Numbered') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Numbered;
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Assign') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Assign;

        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 1) source rows (only grade = F1, latest per card_id)
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        SELECT *
        INTO #Src
        FROM dbo.TEMPBankruptcy WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE card_id IS NOT NULL
          AND LTRIM(RTRIM(card_id)) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT <> N''
          AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(grade, N'')))) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT = N'F1';

        SELECT
            x.TEMPId AS TEMPId,
            x.Id AS Id,
            x.CIF AS CIF,
            x.cus_title AS cus_title,
            x.cus_name AS cus_name,
            x.idcode AS idcode,
            x.card_id AS card_id,
            x.diffnid AS diffnid,
            x.tproject_name AS tproject_name,
            x.LGNO AS LGNO,
            x.bank_grade AS bank_grade,
            x.cus_type AS cus_type,
            x.cus_type_name AS cus_type_name,
            x.project_type AS project_type,
            x.caseno AS caseno,
            x.pname AS pname,
            x.action AS action,
            x.pipaksa AS pipaksa,
            x.pipaksa_e AS pipaksa_e,
            x.prakas AS prakas,
            x.kosana AS kosana,
            x.cus_add1 AS cus_add1,
            x.cus_add2 AS cus_add2,
            x.debt_money AS debt_money,
            x.debt_date AS debt_date,
            x.debt_Remark AS debt_Remark,
            x.claim_date AS claim_date,
            x.claim_amount AS claim_amount,
            x.abs_prot_dd AS abs_prot_dd,
            x.restore_dd AS restore_dd,
            x.abs_gaz_dd AS abs_gaz_dd,
            x.restore_prot_dd AS restore_prot_dd,
            x.abs_due_dd AS abs_due_dd,
            x.b_restore_dd AS b_restore_dd,
            x.b_cou_set_dd AS b_cou_set_dd,
            x.r_restore_dd AS r_restore_dd,
            x.bkr_prot_dd AS bkr_prot_dd,
            x.c_bkr_dd AS c_bkr_dd,
            x.r_bkr_dd AS r_bkr_dd,
            x.close_dd AS close_dd,
            x.share_asset_dd AS share_asset_dd,
            x.r_bkrprot_amount AS r_bkrprot_amount,
            x.approve_dd AS approve_dd,
            x.aporove_amount AS aporove_amount,
            x.r_bkrprot_dd AS r_bkrprot_dd,
            x.grade AS grade,
            x.bkr_amount AS bkr_amount,
            x.abs_bkr_dd AS abs_bkr_dd,
            x.r_abs_bkr_dd AS r_abs_bkr_dd,
            x.c_abs_bkr_dd AS c_abs_bkr_dd,
            x.a_abs_bkr_dd AS a_abs_bkr_dd,
            x.e_abs_bkr_dd AS e_abs_bkr_dd,
            x.CreateDate AS CreateDate,
            x.UpdateDate AS UpdateDate,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER(
                PARTITION BY x.card_id
                ORDER BY
                    CASE WHEN x.UpdateDate IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END DESC,
                    x.UpdateDate DESC,
                    CASE WHEN x.CreateDate IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END DESC,
                    x.CreateDate DESC,
                    x.TEMPId DESC
            ) AS rn
        INTO #Latest
        FROM #Src x;

        DELETE FROM #Latest WHERE rn <> 1;

        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 2) map debtor type + keep fields for LTDataAssignCaseBankrupcy
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        SELECT
            l.TEMPId AS TEMPId,
            l.card_id AS card_id,
            l.cus_name AS cus_name,
            l.CIF AS CIF,
            l.CreateDate AS CreateDate,
            l.UpdateDate AS UpdateDate,

            l.bkr_prot_dd AS bkr_prot_dd,
            l.c_bkr_dd AS c_bkr_dd,
            l.r_bkr_dd AS r_bkr_dd,
            l.abs_bkr_dd AS abs_bkr_dd,
            l.r_abs_bkr_dd AS r_abs_bkr_dd,
            l.c_abs_bkr_dd AS c_abs_bkr_dd,
            l.a_abs_bkr_dd AS a_abs_bkr_dd,
            l.e_abs_bkr_dd AS e_abs_bkr_dd,
            l.close_dd AS close_dd,

            l.cus_type_name AS cus_type_name,
            sdt.DebtorTypeId AS DebtorTypeId,

            -- fields for LTDataAssignCaseBankrupcy
            l.caseno AS caseno,
            l.pname AS pname,
            l.claim_date AS claim_date,
            l.claim_amount AS claim_amount,
            l.debt_money AS debt_money
        INTO #MapType
        FROM #Latest l
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemDebtorType sdt
          ON (sdt.DebtorTypeName COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (l.cus_type_name COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT);

        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 3) split create / update
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        SELECT m.*
        INTO #ToCreate
        FROM #MapType m
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.DataDebtor d
            WHERE (d.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (m.card_id COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
        );

        SELECT m.*
        INTO #ToUpdate
        FROM #MapType m
        WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.DataDebtor d
            WHERE (d.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (m.card_id COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
        );

        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 4) running debtor code
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        DECLARE @BEYear INT = YEAR(GETDATE()) + 543;
        DECLARE @YY CHAR(2) = RIGHT(CONVERT(VARCHAR(4), @BEYear), 2);
        DECLARE @Prefix NVARCHAR(3) = CONCAT(N'C', @YY);

        DECLARE @MaxRun INT;
        SELECT @MaxRun = MAX(TRY_CONVERT(INT, RIGHT(DebtorCode, 5)))
        FROM dbo.DataDebtor WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
        WHERE (DebtorCode COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) LIKE CONCAT(@Prefix, N'[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]');

        IF @MaxRun IS NULL SET @MaxRun = 0;
        IF @MaxRun >= 99999
        BEGIN
            THROW 50001, 'DebtorCode running number for current BE year has reached 99999.', 1;
        END;

        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 5) numbering for create
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        SELECT
            tc.TEMPId AS TEMPId,
            tc.card_id AS card_id,
            tc.cus_name AS cus_name,
            tc.CIF AS CIF,
            tc.CreateDate AS CreateDate,
            tc.DebtorTypeId AS DebtorTypeId,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY tc.card_id) AS rn_order,
            @MaxRun + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY tc.card_id) AS NextRun
        INTO #Numbered
        FROM #ToCreate tc;

        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 6) insert DataDebtor
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        DECLARE @InsertedCount INT = 0;

        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #Numbered)
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO dbo.DataDebtor
            (
                DebtorCode, DebtorTypeId, TitleId, FirstName, LastName, DebtorName,
                CardTypeId, CardNumber, CompanyNameEN, BirthDate, FixedAssetValue, DebtorId,
                OldSection, IDCard, RefCode, ContactName, Email, CntPhoneNumber, CntMobileNumber, CntFaxNumber,
                DefaultAddressId, Note, BusinessType, BusinessTypeName, CompanyType, CompanyTypeDescription, BusinessDescription,
                EmploymentQty, IncEmploymentQty, ISICCode, Totalclaim, DebtorCodeType, DivisionCode, ProvinceCode,
                RegistrationType, RegistrationNo, CompanyEngName, RegistrationDate, LoanerTotal, ImportDate,
                BusinessStatus, BusinessStatusDate, CreateDate, CreateBy, UpdateDate, UpdateBy, NotSendSMS, RefMigrateId,
                IsActive, Age, StatusPersonId, LineID, DebtorCBSId, GenderId, PersonGroupId, BusinessStatusId, BusinessTypeId,
                CompanyTypeId, BusinessDescriptionId, FilingDueDate, BankFilingDate, LawOfficeSectionId, ImportType
            )
            SELECT
                CONCAT(@Prefix, RIGHT(CONCAT(N'00000', CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), n.NextRun)), 5)) AS DebtorCode,
                n.DebtorTypeId AS DebtorTypeId,
                NULL AS TitleId,
                NULL AS FirstName,
                NULL AS LastName,
                LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(n.cus_name)), 500) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS DebtorName,
                NULL AS CardTypeId,
                LEFT(n.card_id, 20) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS CardNumber,
                NULL AS CompanyNameEN,
                NULL AS BirthDate,
                NULL AS FixedAssetValue,
                CONVERT(NVARCHAR(150), NEWID()) AS DebtorId,
                NULL AS OldSection,
                LEFT(n.card_id, 20) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS IDCard,
                LEFT(ISNULL(n.CIF, N''), 30) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS RefCode,
                NULL AS ContactName,
                NULL AS Email,
                NULL AS CntPhoneNumber,
                NULL AS CntMobileNumber,
                NULL AS CntFaxNumber,
                NULL AS DefaultAddressId,
                NULL AS Note,
                NULL AS BusinessType,
                NULL AS BusinessTypeName,
                NULL AS CompanyType,
                NULL AS CompanyTypeDescription,
                NULL AS BusinessDescription,
                NULL AS EmploymentQty,
                NULL AS IncEmploymentQty,
                NULL AS ISICCode,
                NULL AS Totalclaim,
                NULL AS DebtorCodeType,
                NULL AS DivisionCode,
                NULL AS ProvinceCode,
                NULL AS RegistrationType,
                NULL AS RegistrationNo,
                NULL AS CompanyEngName,
                NULL AS RegistrationDate,
                NULL AS LoanerTotal,
                ISNULL(n.CreateDate, GETDATE()) AS ImportDate,
                NULL AS BusinessStatus,
                NULL AS BusinessStatusDate,
                GETDATE() AS CreateDate,
                1 AS CreateBy,
                GETDATE() AS UpdateDate,
                1 AS UpdateBy,
                0 AS NotSendSMS,
                NULL AS RefMigrateId,
                1 AS IsActive,
                NULL AS Age,
                NULL AS StatusPersonId,
                NULL AS LineID,
                NULL AS DebtorCBSId,
                NULL AS GenderId,
                NULL AS PersonGroupId,
                NULL AS BusinessStatusId,
                NULL AS BusinessTypeId,
                NULL AS CompanyTypeId,
                NULL AS BusinessDescriptionId,
                NULL AS FilingDueDate,
                NULL AS BankFilingDate,
                NULL AS LawOfficeSectionId,
                1 AS ImportType
            FROM #Numbered n;

            SET @InsertedCount = @@ROWCOUNT;
        END

        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 7) update status (no CTE)
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        DECLARE @UpdatedCount INT = 0;

        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #ToUpdate)
        BEGIN
            UPDATE d
            SET d.BusinessStatus = N'Bankruptcy',
                d.BusinessStatusDate = u.StatusDate,
                d.UpdateBy = 1,
                d.UpdateDate = GETDATE(),
                d.DebtorTypeId = COALESCE(u.DebtorTypeId, d.DebtorTypeId)
            FROM dbo.DataDebtor d
            JOIN (
                SELECT
                    tu.card_id AS card_id,
                    tu.DebtorTypeId AS DebtorTypeId,
                    COALESCE(
                        NULLIF(tu.bkr_prot_dd, '1900-01-01'),
                        NULLIF(tu.c_bkr_dd, '1900-01-01'),
                        NULLIF(tu.r_bkr_dd, '1900-01-01'),
                        NULLIF(tu.abs_bkr_dd, '1900-01-01'),
                        NULLIF(tu.r_abs_bkr_dd, '1900-01-01'),
                        NULLIF(tu.c_abs_bkr_dd, '1900-01-01'),
                        NULLIF(tu.a_abs_bkr_dd, '1900-01-01'),
                        NULLIF(tu.e_abs_bkr_dd, '1900-01-01'),
                        NULLIF(tu.close_dd, '1900-01-01'),
                        GETDATE()
                    ) AS StatusDate
                FROM #ToUpdate tu
            ) u
              ON (d.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (u.card_id COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT);

            SET @UpdatedCount = @@ROWCOUNT;
        END

        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        -- 8) insert LTDataAssignCaseBankrupcy (skip duplicates)
        --    Duplicate rule: same DebtorRelateId + RedCaseNo -> skip
        ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        DECLARE @InsertedAssignCount INT = 0;

        SELECT DISTINCT
            d.DebtorId AS DebtorRelateId,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(m.caseno)) AS RedCaseNo,
            LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(m.pname)), 200) AS PName,
            m.CreateDate AS ImportDate,
            TRY_CONVERT(INT, NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(m.CIF)), N'')) AS CIFNo,
            m.claim_date AS ClaimPayDate,
            TRY_CONVERT(DECIMAL(20, 2), COALESCE(m.claim_amount, m.debt_money)) AS DebtBalance,
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(m.bkr_prot_dd, '1900-01-01'),
                NULLIF(m.c_bkr_dd,   '1900-01-01'),
                NULLIF(m.r_bkr_dd,   '1900-01-01'),
                NULLIF(m.abs_bkr_dd, '1900-01-01'),
                NULLIF(m.r_abs_bkr_dd,'1900-01-01'),
                NULLIF(m.c_abs_bkr_dd,'1900-01-01'),
                NULLIF(m.a_abs_bkr_dd,'1900-01-01'),
                NULLIF(m.e_abs_bkr_dd,'1900-01-01'),
                NULLIF(m.close_dd,   '1900-01-01'),
                GETDATE()
            ) AS EffectiveDate
        INTO #Assign
        FROM #MapType m
        JOIN dbo.DataDebtor d
          ON (d.IDCard COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (m.card_id COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
        WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(m.caseno, N''))), N'') IS NOT NULL;

        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #Assign)
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO dbo.LTDataAssignCaseBankrupcy
            (
                AssignCaseBankrupcyId,
                DebtorRelateId,
                ClaimPayDate,
                DebtBalance,
                LegalUserId,
                LawOfficeUserId,
                CIFNo,
                EffectiveDate,
                AssignCaseTypeId,
                CreateDate,
                UpdateDate,
                CreateBy,
                UpdateBy,
                RedCaseNo,
                PName,
                ImportDate,
                IsAssignLegal,
                IsAssignLawOffice,
                CaseTypeId,
                BankFilingDate,
                OtherFrozenAssDate,
                ExpirationDate,
                IsCreateCase
            )
            SELECT
                CONVERT(NVARCHAR(150), NEWID()) AS AssignCaseBankrupcyId,
                a.DebtorRelateId,
                a.ClaimPayDate,
                a.DebtBalance,
                NULL AS LegalUserId,
                NULL AS LawOfficeUserId,
                a.CIFNo,
                a.EffectiveDate,
                0 AS AssignCaseTypeId,
                GETDATE() AS CreateDate,
                GETDATE() AS UpdateDate,
                1 AS CreateBy,
                1 AS UpdateBy,
                LEFT(a.RedCaseNo, 20) AS RedCaseNo,
                a.PName,
                ISNULL(a.ImportDate, GETDATE()) AS ImportDate,
                0 AS IsAssignLegal,
                0 AS IsAssignLawOffice,
                NULL AS CaseTypeId,
                NULL AS BankFilingDate,
                NULL AS OtherFrozenAssDate,
                NULL AS ExpirationDate,
                0 AS IsCreateCase
            FROM #Assign a
            WHERE NOT EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM dbo.LTDataAssignCaseBankrupcy t
                WHERE (t.DebtorRelateId COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (a.DebtorRelateId COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
                  AND (t.RedCaseNo      COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT) = (a.RedCaseNo      COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT)
            );

            SET @InsertedAssignCount = @@ROWCOUNT;
        END

        COMMIT TRAN;

        SELECT
            @InsertedCount       AS InsertedDebtorCount,
            @UpdatedCount        AS UpdatedDebtorCount,
            @InsertedAssignCount AS InsertedAssignCaseBankruptcyCount,
            N'Import Bankruptcy (grade=F1): created missing Debtors, updated status to Bankruptcy, and inserted LTDataAssignCaseBankrupcy (skip duplicates by DebtorRelateId+RedCaseNo)' AS Note;

    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0 ROLLBACK TRAN;

        DECLARE
            @ErrMsg NVARCHAR(4000) = ERROR_MESSAGE(),
            @ErrNo  INT = ERROR_NUMBER(),
            @ErrSev INT = ERROR_SEVERITY(),
            @ErrSta INT = ERROR_STATE(),
            @ErrLin INT = ERROR_LINE();

        RAISERROR(N'[SP_INTERFACE_004_InsertBankruptcy_Customer] %s (Error %d, Severity %d, State %d, Line %d)',
                  @ErrSev, 1, @ErrMsg, @ErrNo, @ErrSev, @ErrSta, @ErrLin);
    END CATCH
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_036_InsertBankruptcy_Debtor]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRAN;

declare @MeasureId int = ( select top 1 MeasureId from SystemMeasureMaster where IsActive = 1 and IsReceivership = 1)
declare @MeasureCode nvarchar(10) = ( select top 1 MeasureCode from SystemMeasureMaster where MeasureId = @MeasureId)
declare @MeasureName nvarchar(400) = ( select top 1 MeasureName from SystemMeasureMaster where MeasureId = @MeasureId)

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- STEP 1: Seed (LG + Debtor ตั้งต้นจาก Bankruptcy)
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Seed') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Seed;

        SELECT DISTINCT
            dr.DebtorId,
            dr.LGNo,
			
			CAST(
    DATEFROMPARTS(
        CAST(LEFT(tb.pipaksa_e, 4) AS int) - 543,
        CAST(SUBSTRING(tb.pipaksa_e, 5, 2) AS int),
        CAST(RIGHT(tb.pipaksa_e, 2) AS int)
    ) AS datetime
	) as Pipaksa,

	caseno,
		CAST(
		DATEFROMPARTS(
			CAST(RIGHT(tb.prakas, 4) AS int) - 543, -- ปี ค.ศ.
			CAST(SUBSTRING(tb.prakas, 4, 2) AS int), -- เดือน
			CAST(LEFT(tb.prakas, 2) AS int) -- วัน
		) AS datetime 
	)as Prakas,

	CASE 
        WHEN NULLIF(REPLACE(LTRIM(RTRIM(tb.kosana)), '/', ''), '') IS NULL 
            THEN NULL

        WHEN TRY_CONVERT(int, LEFT(tb.kosana, 2)) IS NULL
          OR TRY_CONVERT(int, SUBSTRING(tb.kosana, 4, 2)) IS NULL
          OR TRY_CONVERT(int, RIGHT(tb.kosana, 4)) IS NULL
            THEN NULL

        ELSE CAST(
            TRY_CONVERT(
                date,
                CONCAT(
                    TRY_CONVERT(int, RIGHT(tb.kosana, 4)) - 543,
                    '-',
                    RIGHT('00' + CAST(TRY_CONVERT(int, SUBSTRING(tb.kosana, 4, 2)) AS varchar(2)), 2),
                    '-',
                    RIGHT('00' + CAST(TRY_CONVERT(int, LEFT(tb.kosana, 2)) AS varchar(2)), 2)
                ),
                23
            ) AS datetime
        )
    END AS Kosana


	


        INTO #Seed
        FROM dbo.TEMPBankruptcy tb
        INNER JOIN dbo.DataDebtorRelate dr
            ON dr.LGNo = tb.LGNo
        INNER JOIN dbo.DataDebtor d
            ON d.DebtorId = dr.DebtorId
           AND tb.card_id = d.IDCard
        WHERE tb.action = N'พิพากษาล้มละลาย'
		and pname != N'บรรษัทประกันสินเชื่ออุตสาหกรรมขนาดย่อม';

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- STEP 2: หา LG อื่นของ Debtor เดิม
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Step2') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Step2;

        SELECT DISTINCT
            dr.DebtorId,
            dr.LGNo,
			Pipaksa,
			caseno,
			Prakas,
			Kosana

        INTO #Step2
        FROM dbo.DataDebtorRelate dr
        INNER JOIN #Seed s
            ON s.DebtorId = dr.DebtorId;

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- STEP 3: หา Debtor อื่นใน LG เหล่านั้น
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Final') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Final;

        SELECT DISTINCT
            dr.DebtorRelateId,
            dr.DebtorId,
            dr.LGNo,
            dr.DebtorCode,
            dr.CIFNo,
			Pipaksa,
			caseno,
			Prakas,
			Kosana

        INTO #Final
        FROM dbo.DataDebtorRelate dr
        INNER JOIN #Step2 s
            ON s.LGNo = dr.LGNo;

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- เตรียมข้อมูล Bankruptcy ล่าสุดต่อ LG
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TB') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #TB;

        ;WITH CTE AS
        (
            SELECT
                tb.LGNo,
                tb.debt_Remark,
                tb.claim_date,
                tb.UpdateDate,
                tb.CreateDate,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER
                (
                    PARTITION BY tb.LGNo
                    ORDER BY
                        CASE WHEN tb.UpdateDate IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END DESC,
                        tb.UpdateDate DESC,
                        CASE WHEN tb.CreateDate IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END DESC,
                        tb.CreateDate DESC,
                        tb.TEMPId DESC
                ) AS rn
            FROM dbo.TEMPBankruptcy tb
            WHERE tb.action = N'พิพากษาล้มละลาย'
			and pname != N'บรรษัทประกันสินเชื่ออุตสาหกรรมขนาดย่อม'
        )
        SELECT
            LGNo,
            debt_Remark,
            claim_date
        INTO #TB
        FROM CTE
        WHERE rn = 1;

        ------------------------------------------------------------
        -- UPDATE LTDataAssignCase
        ------------------------------------------------------------
        UPDATE c
        SET
            c.CaseTypeId     = 6,
            c.ClaimPayDate   = ISNULL(lg.ClaimDate, '1900-01-01'),
            c.EffectiveDate  = GETDATE(),
            c.ExpirationDate = DATEADD(DAY, 90, GETDATE()),
            c.Remark         = tb.debt_Remark,
            c.StatusId       = 215,
            c.UpdateDate     = GETDATE(),
            c.UpdateBy       = 1,
			c.OtherFrozenAssDate = Pipaksa,
			c.RedCaseNo = caseno,
			c.JudgmentDate = Pipaksa,
			c.AnnouncementDate = Prakas,
			c.PublicNoticeDate = Kosana



        FROM dbo.LTDataAssignCase c
        INNER JOIN #Final f
            ON f.DebtorRelateId = c.DebtorRelateId
        LEFT JOIN dbo.DataLG lg
            ON lg.LGNo = c.LGNo
        LEFT JOIN #TB tb
            ON tb.LGNo = c.LGNo
        WHERE c.IsCreateCase = 0
          AND ISNULL(c.CaseTypeId, 0) <> 6;


		Update DataDebtorStatusUpdate
		set StatusDebtorId = 22
		, StatusDebtorDate = getdate()
		where DebtorId in (select DebtorId from LTDataAssignCase where CaseTypeId = 6 and cast(UpdateDate as date) = cast(getdate() as date) )

		Update c
		set c.MeasureId = @MeasureId
		, c.MeasureCode = @MeasureCode
		, c.MeasureName = @MeasureName
		, c.InterestRate = 0
		, c.InterestPlannedRate = 0
		, c.InterestDefaultRate = 0
		, c.MeasureDate = lt.JudgmentDate

		from DataDebtorCard c
		left join LTDataAssignCase lt on lt.DebtorRelateId = c.DebtorRelateId
		where c.DebtorId in (select DebtorId from LTDataAssignCase where CaseTypeId = 6 and cast(UpdateDate as date) = cast(getdate() as date) )

        COMMIT TRAN;

        SELECT
            @@ROWCOUNT AS UpdatedRow,
            'SUCCESS' AS Status;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK TRAN;

        THROW;
    END CATCH
END

create PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_037_InsertDataMainCard_Bankrupcy]
	-- นำเข้าข้อมูลการ์ดลูกหนี้ - การ์ด LG (DataMainCard)
    --@GetDate DATE =  '2025-08-30'
	--,@TypeId int = 1 --1=Insert ด้วย job, 2=Insert ทีละการ์ด (Manual ทีละ Id)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @GetMeasureId INT= (SELECT TOP 1 MeasureId FROM SystemMeasureMaster WHERE IsActive = 1 and IsReceivership = 1)
	DECLARE @GetInterestRate decimal(20,4)= 0
	
									--(select top 1 cast(m.ConditionItemMapingValue as decimal(20,4))
									--from SystemConditionItemMappingValueMaster m
									--left join SystemConditionMaster c on m.ConditionId = c.ConditionId
									--left join SystemCampaignConditionMaster cc on cc.ConditionId = c.ConditionId
									--left join SystemMeasureCampaignMaster cm on cm.CampaignId = cc.CampaignId
									--left join SystemMeasureMaster mm on mm.MeasureId = cm.MeasureId
									--where mm.IsDefault=1
									--and m.ConditionItemId=48)

									


	BEGIN TRANSACTION;

	-- ล็อกตารางแบบ Exclusive
	--SELECT 1
	--FROM [dbo].[DataMainCard] WITH (TABLOCKX);

    INSERT INTO [DataMainCard] (
        [MainCardId]
        ,[LGNo]
        ,[ClaimPayDate]
        ,[SystemBankId]
        ,[BankCode]
        ,[CardStatusId]
        ,[InterestRate]
        ,[InterestPlannedRate]
        ,[AmountDuty]
        ,[ClaimPay]
        ,[DebtBalance]
        ,[Principal]
        ,[PrincipalTotal]
        ,[CreateBy]
        ,[CreateDate]
        ,[UpdateBy]
        ,[UpdateDate]
        ,[CIFNumber]
        ,[DebtBurden]
        ,[ConditionPayment]
        ,[MainCardCode]
        ,[InstallmentsAmount]
        ,[InstallmentOutstanding]
        ,[GroupCardCode]
        ,[InstallmentPrincipal]
        ,[InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
        ,[SeqCurrent]
        ,[SeqNext]
        ,[InterestStartDate]
        ,[InterestEndDate]
        ,[CurrentPaymentDate]
        ,[MeasureId]
        ,[IsDelete]

    )
    SELECT
        NEWID() AS [MainCardId]
        ,cbs.[LGNo]
        ,cbs.[ClaimDate] AS [ClaimPayDate]
        ,sb.[BankId]
        ,sb.[BankCode]
        ,1 AS [CardStatusId]
        ,@GetInterestRate AS [InterestRate]
        ,@GetInterestRate AS [InterestPlannedRate]
        ,cbs.[ClaimAmount] AS [AmountDuty]
        ,cbs.[ClaimPayAmount] AS [ClaimPay]
        ,cbs.[ClaimPayAmount] AS [DebtBalance]
        ,cbs.[ClaimPayAmount] AS [Principal]
        ,cbs.[ClaimPayAmount] AS [PrincipalTotal]
        ,cbs.[CreateBy]
        ,cbs.[CreateDate] AS [CreateDate]
        ,cbs.[UpdateBy]
        ,cbs.[CreateDate] AS [UpdateDate]
        ,cbs.[CIFNo] AS [CIFNumber]
        ,cbs.[ClaimAmountCurrent] AS [DebtBurden]
        ,NULL AS [ConditionPayment]
        ,cbs.[CIFNo] + '-' + cbs.[LGNo] + '-1' AS [MainCardCode]
        ,cbs.[ClaimPayAmount] AS [InstallmentsAmount]
        ,cbs.[ClaimPayAmount] AS [InstallmentOutstanding]
        ,cbs.[CIFNo] + '-' + cbs.[LGNo] AS [GroupCardCode]
        ,cbs.[ClaimPayAmount] AS [InstallmentPrincipal]
        ,cbs.[ClaimPayAmount] AS [InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
        ,2 AS [SeqCurrent]
        ,3 AS [SeqNext]
        ,cbs.[ClaimDate] AS [InterestStartDate]
        ,cbs.[ClaimDate] AS [InterestEndDate]
        ,cast('1900-01-01' as date) AS [CurrentPaymentDate]
        ,0 AS [MeasureId]
        ,0 AS [IsDelete]
    FROM [DataLG] cbs
    LEFT JOIN [SystemBankMaster] sb ON sb.BankId= cbs.BankId
    WHERE 
	--CAST(cbs.[CreateDate] AS DATE) = @GetDate
	--AND 
	(cbs.[CIFNo] + '-' + cbs.[LGNo] + '-1')  NOT IN (SELECT [MainCardCode] FROM [DataMainCard])
	--and cbs.[LGNo]  = '64104760'
	and cbs.Grade != 'F1'
	and cbs.LGNo in (select LGNo from LTDataAssignCase where CaseTypeId = 6 and cast(UpdateDate as date) = cast(getdate() as date) )

	--EXEC [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_028_InsertDataMainCardMovement];

	EXEC [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_038_InsertDataDebtorCard_Bankrupcy];

	COMMIT TRANSACTION;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_038_InsertDataDebtorCard_Bankrupcy]
	-- นำเข้าข้อมูลการ์ดลูกหนี้ - การ์ดรายคน (DataMainCard)
    --@GetDate DATE =  '2025-09-04'
	
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @GetMeasureId INT= (SELECT TOP 1 MeasureId FROM SystemMeasureMaster WHERE IsActive = 1 and IsReceivership = 1)
	DECLARE @GetInterestRate decimal(20,4)= 0
	

	DECLARE @GetMeasureName nvarchar(200) = (SELECT TOP 1 MeasureName FROM SystemMeasureMaster WHERE MeasureId = @GetMeasureId)


	BEGIN TRANSACTION;

	-- ล็อกตารางแบบ Exclusive
	--SELECT 1
	--FROM [dbo].[DataMainCard] WITH (TABLOCKX);

    INSERT INTO [dbo].[DataDebtorCard] (
    [DataDebtorCardId]
    ,[LGNo]
    ,[DebtorCode]
    ,[DebtorCardCode]
    ,[DebtorCardName]
	,[InterestRate]
	,[InterestPlannedRate]
   -- ,[CardType]
    ,[ClaimPayDate]
    ,[SystemBankId]
    ,[BankCode]
    ,[IsAuto]
    ,[ClaimPay]
	,[DebtAmount]
    ,[DebtBalance]
    ,[Principal]
    ,[PrincipalTotal]
    ,[CreateBy]
    ,[CreateDate]
    ,[UpdateBy]
    ,[UpdateDate]
	,[MeasureId]
	,[MeasureName]
    ,[DebtorId]
    ,[DebtorRelateId]
	,[ProportionLiability]
    ,[DebtorRelateCode]
    ,[DebtorRelateTypeId]
    ,[CIFNo]
    ,[DebtBurden]
    ,[MainCardCode]
	,[DataMainCardId]
	,[SeqNo]
	,[CardStatusId]
	,[CardStatusDate]
    ,[InstallmentsAmount]
    ,[InstallmentOutstanding]
    ,[GroupCardCode]
    ,[InstallmentPrincipal]
    ,[InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
	,[AmountDuty]
	,[SeqCurrent]
	,[SeqNext]
	,[InterestStartDate]
	,[InterestEndDate]
	,[MeasureDate]
	,[RequestNoTDR]
	,[CompromiseContractId]
	,[CompromiseContracApproveDate]
	,[RequestDebtorApproveDate]
	,[FileOtherDate]
	,[Remark]
	,[IsDelete]
	,[Reference1]
	,[Reference2]

)
SELECT 
    NEWID() AS [DataDebtorCardId]
    ,r.[LGNo]
    ,r.[DebtorCode]
    ,d.[DebtorCode] +'-'+ r.[LGNo] + '-1' AS [DebtorCardCode]
    ,d.FirstName + ' ' + isnull(LastName,'') AS [DebtorCardName]
	,@GetInterestRate AS [InterestRate]
	,@GetInterestRate AS [InterestPlannedRate]
    --,CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId] = 1 THEN 'M' ELSE 'S' END AS [CardType]  -- M = Main, S = Sub
    ,mc.[ClaimPayDate] AS [ClaimPayDate]
    ,mc.[SystemBankId] AS [SystemBankId]
    ,mc.BankCode AS [BankCode]
    ,1 AS [IsAuto]
    ,mc.[ClaimPay] AS [ClaimPay]
    ,(CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId]  = 2 THEN mc.[DebtBalance] / dbo.[FN_DCS_01_ProportionLiabilit](r.[LGNo]) ELSE mc.[DebtBalance] END) AS [DebtAmount]
    ,(CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId]  = 2 THEN mc.[DebtBalance] / dbo.[FN_DCS_01_ProportionLiabilit](r.[LGNo]) ELSE mc.[DebtBalance] END) AS [DebtBalance]
    ,(CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId]  = 2 THEN mc.[DebtBalance] / dbo.[FN_DCS_01_ProportionLiabilit](r.[LGNo]) ELSE mc.[DebtBalance] END) AS [Principal]
    ,(CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId]  = 2 THEN mc.[DebtBalance] / dbo.[FN_DCS_01_ProportionLiabilit](r.[LGNo]) ELSE mc.[DebtBalance] END) AS [PrincipalTotal]
    ,1 AS [CreateBy]
    ,r.CreateDate AS [CreateDate]
    ,1 AS [UpdateBy]
    ,r.UpdateDate AS [UpdateDate]
	,@GetMeasureId AS [MeasureId]
	,@GetMeasureName AS [MeasureName]
    ,r.[DebtorId]
    ,r.[DebtorRelateId]
	,(CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId]  = 2 THEN mc.[DebtBalance] / dbo.[FN_DCS_01_ProportionLiabilit](r.[LGNo]) ELSE mc.[DebtBalance] END) AS [ProportionLiability]
    ,r.[DebtorRelateCode]
    ,r.[DebtorTypeId] AS [DebtorRelateTypeId]
    ,r.[CIFNo]
    ,mc.[DebtBurden] AS [DebtBurden]
    ,mc.[MainCardCode] AS [MainCardCode]
	,mc.[MainCardId] AS [DataMainCardId]
	,1 AS [SeqNo]
	,1 AS [CardStatusId]
	,GETDATE() AS [CardStatusDate]
    ,(CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId]  = 2 THEN mc.[DebtBalance] / dbo.[FN_DCS_01_ProportionLiabilit](r.[LGNo]) ELSE mc.[InstallmentPrincipalTotal] END) AS [InstallmentsAmount]
    ,mc.[InstallmentOutstanding] AS [InstallmentOutstanding]
    ,r.[CIFNo] + '-' + r.[LGNo] AS [GroupCardCode]
	,(CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId]  = 2 THEN mc.[DebtBalance] / dbo.[FN_DCS_01_ProportionLiabilit](r.[LGNo]) ELSE mc.[InstallmentPrincipal] END) AS [InstallmentPrincipal]
	,(CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId]  = 2 THEN mc.[DebtBalance] / dbo.[FN_DCS_01_ProportionLiabilit](r.[LGNo]) ELSE mc.[InstallmentPrincipalTotal] END) AS [InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
	,(CASE WHEN r.[DebtorTypeId]  = 2 THEN mc.[DebtBalance] / dbo.[FN_DCS_01_ProportionLiabilit](r.[LGNo]) ELSE mc.[InstallmentPrincipalTotal] END) AS [AmountDuty]
	,2 as [SeqCurrent]
	,3 as [SeqNext]
	,cast('1900-01-01' as date) as [InterestStartDate]
	,cast('1900-01-01' as date) as [InterestEndDate]
	,mc.ClaimPayDate as [MeasureDate]
	,null as [RequestNoTDR]
	,null as [CompromiseContractId]
	,cast('1900-01-01' as date) as [CompromiseContracApproveDate]
	,cast('1900-01-01' as date) as[RequestDebtorApproveDate]
	,cast('1900-01-01' as date) as[FileOtherDate]
	,null as [Remark]
	,0 as [IsDelete]
	,null as [Reference1]
	,null as [Reference2]

FROM [dbo].[DataDebtorRelate] r
LEFT JOIN [dbo].[DataLG] lg ON r.[LGNo] = lg.[LGNo]
LEFT JOIN [dbo].[DataDebtor] d ON d.[DebtorId] = r.[DebtorId]
LEFT JOIN [dbo].[DataMainCard] mc ON r.[LGNo] = mc.[LGNo]
LEFT JOIN [dbo].[SystemDebtorType] dt ON dt.[DebtorTypeId] = r.[DebtorTypeId]
WHERE 
--lg.[LGNo] = '4801150'
 (r.[DebtorCode] + '-' + r.[LGNo] + '-1' not in (SELECT DebtorCardCode FROM [DataDebtorCard]))
 and lg.Grade != 'F1'
 and lg.LGNo in (select LGNo from LTDataAssignCase where CaseTypeId = 6 and cast(UpdateDate as date) = cast(getdate() as date) and IsCreateCard = 0)
--AND CAST(r.CreateDate AS DATE) = @GetDate;
and r.DebtorRelateId not in (select DebtorRelateId from DataDebtorCard )
and dt.IsCalCard = 1


	EXEC [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_039_InsertDataDebtorCardMovement_Bankrupcy];
	EXEC [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_040_InserDataDebtorCardInterate_Bankrupcy];


	Update c
	set IsCreateCard = 1
	
	from LTDataAssignCase c 
	left join DataLG lg on lg.LGNo = c.LGNo
	where c.CaseTypeId = 6 
	and lg.Grade != 'F1'
	and IsCreateCard = 0
	and cast(c.UpdateDate as date) = cast(getdate() as date);



	--EXEC [dbo].[SP_DCS_015_InsertBillPayment]


	COMMIT TRANSACTION;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_039_InsertDataDebtorCardMovement_Bankrupcy]

	BEGIN TRANSACTION;

	-- ล็อกตารางแบบ Exclusive
		--SELECT 1
		--FROM [dbo].[DataDebtorCardMovement] WITH (TABLOCKX);

		INSERT INTO [dbo].[DataDebtorCardMovement] (

		,[CreateBy]
		,[CreateDate]
		,[UpdateBy]
		,[UpdateDate]
		,[SeqNo]

		,[InstallmentPrincipal]
		,[InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
		,[InstallmentInterest]
		,[InstallmentInterestTotal]
		,[InterestStartDate]
		,[InterestEndDate]
		,[InterestQuantity]
		,[DPDAccumulate]
		,[OverdueAmount]
		,[PrincipalOverdueAmount]
		,[AccruedInterestOverdueAmount]
		,[TotalOverdue]
		,[TotalPrincipalOverdue]
		,[TotalAccruedInterestOverdue]
		,[CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId]
		,[IsUpdateHistory]


	)
	SELECT
		NEWID() AS [DebtorCardMovementId]
		,dc.[DataDebtorCardId] AS [DebtorCardId]
		,GETDATE() AS [DocDate]
		,dc.ClaimPayDate [PayDate]
		,dc.[LGNo]
		,dc.[DebtorId]
		,dc.[DebtorCode]
		,dc.[DebtorCardCode]
		,dc.[DebtorCardName]
		,@TypeId AS [TypeId]
		,@TypeCode AS [TypeCode]
		,@TypeName AS [TypeName]
		,dc.[IsAuto] AS [FlagAutoPay]
		,dc.[MeasureId]
		,dc.[MeasureName]
		,dc.[InterestRate]
		,dc.[InterestPlannedRate]
		,dc.[DebtBalance]
		,dc.[InstallmentsAmount] AS [Installment]
		,dc.[InstallmentsAmount] AS [InstallmentTotal]
		,dc.[Principal]
		,dc.[PrincipalTotal]

		,dc.[CreateBy]
		,GETDATE() AS [CreateDate]
		,dc.[UpdateBy]
		,GETDATE() AS [UpdateDate]
		,1 AS [SeqNo]

		,dc.[InstallmentPrincipal]
		,dc.[InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
		,0 AS [InstallmentInterest]
		,0 AS [InstallmentInterestTotal]
		,dc.[ClaimPayDate] AS [InterestStartDate]
		,dc.[ClaimPayDate] AS InterestEndDate
		,0 as InterestQuantity
		,0 as DPDAccumulate
		,0 as OverdueAmount
		,0 as PrincipalOverdueAmount
		,0 as AccruedInterestOverdueAmount
		,0 as TotalOverdue
		,0 as TotalPrincipalOverdue
		,0 as TotalAccruedInterestOverdue
		,0 as CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId
		,0 as IsUpdateHistory

	FROM [dbo].[DataDebtorCard] dc

	WHERE 
	--dc.LGNo = '4801150'
	dc.DataDebtorCardId not in (SELECT DebtorCardId FROM [DataDebtorCardMovement])
	union all

	SELECT
		NEWID() AS [DebtorCardMovementId]
		,dc.[DataDebtorCardId] AS [DebtorCardId]
		,GETDATE() AS [DocDate]
		, dc.ClaimPayDate as PayDate
		,dc.[LGNo]
		,dc.[DebtorId]
		,dc.[DebtorCode]
		,dc.[DebtorCardCode]
		,dc.[DebtorCardName]
		,8 AS [TypeId]
		,'08' AS [TypeCode]
		,'ยอดคงเหลือ' AS [TypeName]
		,dc.[IsAuto] AS [FlagAutoPay]
		,dc.[MeasureId]
		,dc.[MeasureName]
		,dc.[InterestRate]
		,dc.[InterestPlannedRate]
		,dc.[DebtBalance]
		,dc.[InstallmentsAmount] AS [Installment]
		,dc.[InstallmentsAmount] AS [InstallmentTotal]
		,dc.[Principal]
		,dc.[PrincipalTotal]

		,dc.[CreateBy]
		,GETDATE() AS [CreateDate]
		,dc.[UpdateBy]
		,GETDATE() AS [UpdateDate]
		,2 AS [SeqNo]

		,dc.[InstallmentPrincipal]
		,dc.[InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
		,0 AS [InstallmentInterest]
		,0 AS [InstallmentInterestTotal]
		,dc.[ClaimPayDate] AS [InterestStartDate]
		,dc.[ClaimPayDate] AS InterestEndDate
		,0 as InterestQuantity
		,0 as DPDAccumulate
		,0 as OverdueAmount
		,0 as PrincipalOverdueAmount
		,0 as AccruedInterestOverdueAmount
		,0 as TotalOverdue
		,0 as TotalPrincipalOverdue
		,0 as TotalAccruedInterestOverdue
		,0 as CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId
		,0 as IsUpdateHistory

	FROM [dbo].[DataDebtorCard] dc

	WHERE 
	--dc.LGNo = '4801150'
	dc.DataDebtorCardId not in (SELECT DebtorCardId FROM [DataDebtorCardMovement])
	----AND r.[LGNo] = '3800012'
	 --CAST(dc.CreateDate AS DATE) = @GetDate;

	COMMIT TRANSACTION;

END

create PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_040_InserDataDebtorCardInterate_Bankrupcy]

    --@GetDate DATE =  '2025-06-03'
	
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @GetMeasureId INT= (SELECT TOP 1 MeasureId FROM SystemMeasureMaster WHERE IsActive = 1 and IsReceivership = 1)
	DECLARE @GetInterestRate decimal(20,4)= 0
	

	DECLARE @GetMeasureName nvarchar(200) = (SELECT TOP 1 MeasureName FROM SystemMeasureMaster WHERE MeasureId = @GetMeasureId)
	DECLARE @EndDate DATETIME = '3000-12-01 00:00:00.000'

	--DECLARE @GetMeasureName nvarchar(200) = (SELECT TOP 1 MeasureName FROM SystemMeasureMaster WHERE MeasureId = @GetMeasureId)


	BEGIN TRANSACTION;

	-- ล็อกตารางแบบ Exclusive
	SELECT 1
	FROM [dbo].[DataMainCard] WITH (TABLOCKX);

    INSERT INTO [dbo].[DataDebtorCardInterate] (
    [DebtorCardInterateId]
    ,[DebtorCardId]
    ,[MeasureId]
    ,[Seq]
    ,[InterateRate]
    ,[DefaultInterest]
    ,[StartDate]
    ,[EndDate]
    ,[IsActive]
    ,[CompromiseContractGroupId]
    ,[CreateDate]
    ,[CreateBy]
    ,[UpdateDate]
    ,[UpdateBy]
    ,[IsDefaultInterest]
)
SELECT
    NEWID() AS [DebtorCardInterateId]
    ,dc.[DataDebtorCardId]
    ,dc.[MeasureId]
    ,1 AS [Seq]                            
    ,@GetInterestRate AS [InterateRate]
    ,dc.[InterestDefaultRate] AS [DefaultInterest]
    ,dc.[ClaimPayDate] AS [StartDate]
    ,@EndDate AS [EndDate]
    ,1 AS [IsActive]
    ,NULL AS [CompromiseContractGroupId]
    ,GETDATE() AS [CreateDate]
    ,dc.[CreateBy]
    ,GETDATE() AS [UpdateDate]
    ,dc.[UpdateBy]
    ,1 AS [IsDefaultInterest]              
FROM [dbo].[DataDebtorCard] dc
where dc.[DataDebtorCardId] not in (select DataDebtorCardId from DataDebtorCardInterate)

	COMMIT TRANSACTION;
END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_042_InsertDataDebtorCardMovementFee]
	
   
AS
BEGIN

DECLARE @TypeId nvarchar(2) = 20

DECLARE @TypeName nvarchar(100) 

 (select @TypeName = PaymentTypeName 
 , @TypeCode = PaymentTypeCode
 from SystemPaymentType 
 where PaymentTypeId = @TypeId)

 DECLARE @DefaultDate date = '1900-01-01'

--declare @SeqNext int = (select SeqNext from DataDebtorCard where DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId)

           (

           ,[DebtorCardCode]
           ,[DebtorCardName]
           ,[TypeId]

           ,[TypeName]
           ,[FlagAutoPay]

           ,[DeferredInterest]
           ,[DeferredInterestPay]
           ,[DeferredInterestTotal]
           ,[SuspendedDefaultInterest]

           ,[SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal]

           ,[PaymentTypeId]
           ,[SeqNo]
           ,[DebtorPaymentId]
           ,[DebtorPaymentCode]
           ,[CompromiseContractGroup]
           ,[ReceiptId]
           ,[InstallmentPrincipal]
           ,[InstallmentPrincipalPay]
           ,[InstallmentPrincipalTotal]
           ,[InstallmentInterest]

           ,[InstallmentInterestTotal]
           ,[InterestStartDate]
           ,[InterestEndDate]
           ,[InterestQuantity]
           ,[DPDAccumulate]
           ,[OverdueAmount]
           ,[PrincipalOverdueAmount]
           ,[AccruedInterestOverdueAmount]
           ,[TotalOverdue]
           ,[TotalPrincipalOverdue]
           ,[TotalAccruedInterestOverdue]
           ,[CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId]
           ,[IsUpdateHistory]
           ,[IsCancel])
 select
 newid() as [DebtorCardMovementId]
      ,[DebtorCardId]
      ,[DocDate] as [DocDate]
      ,c.ClaimPayDate as [PayDate]
      ,cm.[LGNo]
      ,cm.[DebtorId]
      ,cm.[DebtorCode]
      ,cm.[DebtorCardCode]
      ,cm.[DebtorCardName]

      ,cm.[PrincipalTotal] - f.Fee_Amount as [Installment]
      ,0 as [InstallmentPay]
      ,cm.[PrincipalTotal] - f.Fee_Amount as [InstallmentTotal]

      ,cm.[PrincipalTotal] as [Principal]
      ,f.Fee_Amount as [PrincipalPay]
      ,cm.[PrincipalTotal] - f.Fee_Amount as [PrincipalTotal]

      ,0 as [InterimInterest]
      ,0 as [AccruedInterest]
      ,0 as [AccruedInterestPay]
      ,0 as [AccruedInterestTotal]

      ,cm.[CourtFeeTotal] as [CourtFee]
      ,0 as [CourtFeePay]
      ,cm.[CourtFeeTotal]

      ,cm.[LawyerFeeTotal] as [LawyerFee]
      ,0 as [LawyerFeePay]
      ,cm.[LawyerFeeTotal]

      ,cm.[OtherExpenseTotal] as [OtherExpense]
      ,0 as [OtherExpensePay]
      ,cm.[OtherExpenseTotal]

      ,cm.[InitialMarginTotal] as [InitialMargin]
      ,0 as [InitialMarginPay]
      ,cm.[InitialMarginTotal]

      ,0 as [SuspendInt]
      ,0 as [SuspendIntPay]
      ,0 as [SuspendIntTotal]

      ,0 as [DeferredInterest]
      ,0 as [DeferredInterestPay]
      ,0 as [DeferredInterestTotal]

      ,0 as [SuspendedDefaultInterest]
      ,0 as [SuspendedDefaultInterestPay]
      ,0 as [SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal]

      ,0 as [PlannedInterest]
      ,0 as [PlannedInterestPay]
      ,0 as [PlannedInterestTotal]

      ,0 as [DefaultInterest]
      ,0 as [DefaultInterestPay]
      ,0 as [DefaultInterestTotal]

      ,1 as [CreateBy]
      ,getdate() as [CreateDate]
      ,1 as [UpdateBy]
      ,getdate() as [UpdateDate]

      ,null as [ReceiptNo]
      ,0 as [IsEstatement]
      ,null as [EStatementRef]
      ,[PaymentTypeId]
      ,3 as SeqNo
	  --,[SeqNo] --ถัาไม่ใช้ ให้ comment
      ,[DebtorPaymentId]
      ,[DebtorPaymentCode]
      ,[CompromiseContractGroup]
      ,null as [ReceiptId]

      ,cm.[InstallmentPrincipalTotal] - f.Fee_Amount as [InstallmentPrincipal]
      ,0 as [InstallmentPrincipalPay]
      ,cm.[InstallmentPrincipalTotal] - f.Fee_Amount as [InstallmentPrincipalTotal]

      ,cm.[InstallmentInterestTotal] as [InstallmentInterest]
      ,0 as [InstallmentInterestPay]
      ,cm.[InstallmentInterestTotal]

      ,@DefaultDate as [InterestStartDate]
      ,@DefaultDate as [InterestEndDate]
      ,0 as [InterestQuantity]
      ,[DPDAccumulate]
      ,0 as [OverdueAmount]
      ,0 as [PrincipalOverdueAmount]
      ,0 as [AccruedInterestOverdueAmount]
      ,0 as [TotalOverdue]
      ,0 as [TotalPrincipalOverdue]
      ,0 as [TotalAccruedInterestOverdue]
      ,[CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId]
      ,0 as [IsUpdateHistory]
		   ,0 as [IsCancel]
		   --,SeqNoOld
		   from DataDebtorCardMovement cm
		   left join DataDebtorCard c on c.DataDebtorCardId = cm.DebtorCardId
		   left join TEMPDataFeeBeforeCBS f on f.LGNO = cm.LGNo
		   where cm.SeqNo = 1
		   and f.LGNO is not null
		   and ClaimPayDate >= '2026-03-01'
		   and c.SeqCurrent = 2

	union all

	select
 newid() as [DebtorCardMovementId]
      ,[DebtorCardId]
      ,[DocDate] as [DocDate]
      ,c.ClaimPayDate as [PayDate]
      ,cm.[LGNo]
      ,cm.[DebtorId]
      ,cm.[DebtorCode]
      ,cm.[DebtorCardCode]
      ,cm.[DebtorCardName]
      ,8 as [TypeId]
      ,'08' as [TypeCode]
      ,N'ยอดคงเหลือ' as [TypeName]
      ,[FlagAutoPay]
      ,@DefaultDate as [DFDDate]
      ,@DefaultDate as [DFDStartDate]
      ,@DefaultDate as [DFDEndDate]
      ,0 as [DPD]
      ,f.Fee_Amount as [TotalPay]
      ,1 as [IsAdjust]
      ,0 as [AdjustRefDocNo]
      ,0 as [IsDelete]

      ,cm.[MeasureId]
      ,cm.[MeasureCode]
      ,cm.[MeasureName]

      ,cm.InterestRate as InterestRate
      ,cm.InterestPlannedRate as InterestPlannedRate
      ,cm.InterestDefaultRate as InterestDefaultRate

      ,cm.[DebtBalance] - f.Fee_Amount as [DebtBalance] --หาเพิ่ม
      ,0 as [ReceivePayment]

      ,cm.[PrincipalTotal] - f.Fee_Amount as [Installment]
      ,0 as [InstallmentPay]
      ,cm.[PrincipalTotal] - f.Fee_Amount as [InstallmentTotal]

      ,cm.[PrincipalTotal] as [Principal]
      ,f.Fee_Amount as [PrincipalPay]
      ,cm.[PrincipalTotal] - f.Fee_Amount as [PrincipalTotal]

      ,0 as [InterimInterest]
      ,0 as [AccruedInterest]
      ,0 as [AccruedInterestPay]
      ,0 as [AccruedInterestTotal]

      ,cm.[CourtFeeTotal] as [CourtFee]
      ,0 as [CourtFeePay]
      ,cm.[CourtFeeTotal]

      ,cm.[LawyerFeeTotal] as [LawyerFee]
      ,0 as [LawyerFeePay]
      ,cm.[LawyerFeeTotal]

      ,cm.[OtherExpenseTotal] as [OtherExpense]
      ,0 as [OtherExpensePay]
      ,cm.[OtherExpenseTotal]

      ,cm.[InitialMarginTotal] as [InitialMargin]
      ,0 as [InitialMarginPay]
      ,cm.[InitialMarginTotal]

      ,0 as [SuspendInt]
      ,0 as [SuspendIntPay]
      ,0 as [SuspendIntTotal]

      ,0 as [DeferredInterest]
      ,0 as [DeferredInterestPay]
      ,0 as [DeferredInterestTotal]

      ,0 as [SuspendedDefaultInterest]
      ,0 as [SuspendedDefaultInterestPay]
      ,0 as [SuspendedDefaultInterestTotal]

      ,0 as [PlannedInterest]
      ,0 as [PlannedInterestPay]
      ,0 as [PlannedInterestTotal]

      ,0 as [DefaultInterest]
      ,0 as [DefaultInterestPay]
      ,0 as [DefaultInterestTotal]

      ,1 as [CreateBy]
      ,getdate() as [CreateDate]
      ,1 as [UpdateBy]
      ,getdate() as [UpdateDate]

      ,null as [ReceiptNo]
      ,0 as [IsEstatement]
      ,null as [EStatementRef]
      ,[PaymentTypeId]
      ,4 as SeqNo
	  --,[SeqNo] --ถัาไม่ใช้ ให้ comment
      ,[DebtorPaymentId]
      ,[DebtorPaymentCode]
      ,[CompromiseContractGroup]
      ,null as [ReceiptId]

      ,cm.[InstallmentPrincipalTotal] - f.Fee_Amount as [InstallmentPrincipal]
      ,0 as [InstallmentPrincipalPay]
      ,cm.[InstallmentPrincipalTotal] - f.Fee_Amount as [InstallmentPrincipalTotal]

      ,cm.[InstallmentInterestTotal] as [InstallmentInterest]
      ,0 as [InstallmentInterestPay]
      ,cm.[InstallmentInterestTotal]

      ,@DefaultDate as [InterestStartDate]
      ,@DefaultDate as [InterestEndDate]
      ,0 as [InterestQuantity]
      ,[DPDAccumulate]
      ,0 as [OverdueAmount]
      ,0 as [PrincipalOverdueAmount]
      ,0 as [AccruedInterestOverdueAmount]
      ,0 as [TotalOverdue]
      ,0 as [TotalPrincipalOverdue]
      ,0 as [TotalAccruedInterestOverdue]
      ,[CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId]
      ,0 as [IsUpdateHistory]
		   ,0 as [IsCancel]
		   --,SeqNoOld
		   from DataDebtorCardMovement cm
		   left join DataDebtorCard c on c.DataDebtorCardId = cm.DebtorCardId
		   left join TEMPDataFeeBeforeCBS f on f.LGNO = cm.LGNo
		   where cm.SeqNo = 1
		   and f.LGNO is not null
		   and ClaimPayDate >= '2026-03-01'
		   and c.SeqCurrent = 2

		   Update c
		   set SeqCurrent = 2
		   , SeqNext = 3
		   from DataDebtorCardMovement cm
		   left join DataDebtorCard c on c.DataDebtorCardId = cm.DebtorCardId
		   left join TEMPDataFeeBeforeCBS f on f.LGNO = cm.LGNo
		   where cm.SeqNo = 1
		   and f.LGNO is not null
		   and ClaimPayDate >= '2026-03-01'
		   and c.SeqCurrent = 2


	

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_INTERFACE_043_InsertDataDebtorRelate]
AS
BEGIN
  --กู้หลัก

  SELECT distinct
--newid() as [DebtorRelateId]
           'R' + [CIFNo] as [DebtorRelateCode]
           ,lg.[LGNo] as [LGNo]
           ,d.[DebtorCode] as [DebtorCode]
           ,lg.[CIFNo] as [CIFNo]
           ,1 as [DebtorTypeId]
           ,1 as [ProportionLiabilityTypeId]
           ,1 as [CreateBy]
           ,getdate() as [CreateDate]
           ,1 as[UpdateBy]
           ,getdate() as [UpdateDate]
           ,[RefCode]
           ,d.[DebtorId] as [DebtorId]
           ,1 as [IsActive]
           ,0 as [IsDelete]
           ,1 as [ImportType]
           ,lg.[LGNo] as [LGNoSeq]
           ,1 as [Seq]
           ,1 as [IsFirstCall]
           ,0 as [IsManualCall]
           ,'1900-01-01' as [ManualCallDate]
		   ,N'ผู้กู้หลัก' as DebtorTypeCBS
		   into #tmpDataDebtorRelateDebtor
		   FROM DataLG lg
	left join TEMPDebtorCBS c on c.CIF = lg.CIFNo
	left join DataDebtor d on d.IDCard = c.IDCard
	where lg.[LGNo] + '-' + d.[DebtorId]  not in (select [LGNo] + '-' + [DebtorId]  from DataDebtorRelate);

--	กู้ร่วม
	SELECT 
--newid() as [DebtorRelateId]
distinct
           'R' + [DebtorCode] as [DebtorRelateCode]
           ,lg.[LGNo] as [LGNo]
           ,d.[DebtorCode] as [DebtorCode]
           ,lg.[CIFNo] as [CIFNo]
           ,4 as [DebtorTypeId]
           ,1 as [ProportionLiabilityTypeId]
           ,1 as [CreateBy]
           ,getdate() as [CreateDate]
           ,1 as[UpdateBy]
           ,getdate() as [UpdateDate]
           ,[RefCode]
           ,d.[DebtorId] as [DebtorId]
           ,1 as [IsActive]
           ,0 as [IsDelete]
           ,1 as [ImportType]
           ,lg.[LGNo] as [LGNoSeq]
           ,1 as [Seq]
           ,1 as [IsFirstCall]
           ,0 as [IsManualCall]
           ,'1900-01-01' as [ManualCallDate]
		   ,N'ผู้กู้ร่วม' as DebtorTypeCBS
		   into #tmpDataDebtorRelateJoin
		   FROM DataLG lg
	left join TEMPDebtorJoinCBS c on c.CIF = lg.CIFNo
	left join DataDebtor d on d.IDCard = c.IDCard
	where lg.[LGNo] + '-' + d.[DebtorId]  not in (select [LGNo] + '-' + [DebtorId]  from DataDebtorRelate);

	--ค้ำธนาคาร GuarantorClaim
	SELECT 
--newid() as [DebtorRelateId]
distinct
           'R' + [DebtorCode] as [DebtorRelateCode]
           ,lg.[LGNo] as [LGNo]
           ,d.[DebtorCode] as [DebtorCode]
           ,lg.[CIFNo] as [CIFNo]
           ,2 as [DebtorTypeId]
           ,1 as [ProportionLiabilityTypeId]
           ,1 as [CreateBy]
           ,getdate() as [CreateDate]
           ,1 as[UpdateBy]
           ,getdate() as [UpdateDate]
           ,[RefCode]
           ,d.[DebtorId] as [DebtorId]
           ,1 as [IsActive]
           ,0 as [IsDelete]
           ,1 as [ImportType]
           ,lg.[LGNo] as [LGNoSeq]
           ,1 as [Seq]
           ,1 as [IsFirstCall]
           ,0 as [IsManualCall]
           ,'1900-01-01' as [ManualCallDate]
		   ,c.CustType as DebtorTypeCBS
		   into #tmpDataDebtorRelateGuarantorClaim
		   FROM DataLG lg
	left join TEMPGuarantorClaim c on c.LGNo = lg.LGNo
	left join DataDebtor d on d.IDCard = c.IDCard
	where lg.[LGNo] + '-' + d.[DebtorId]  not in (select [LGNo] + '-' + [DebtorId]  from DataDebtorRelate);

	--ค้ำธนาคาร TEMPGuarantorLoanCBS
	SELECT 
--newid() as [DebtorRelateId]
distinct
           'R' + [DebtorCode] as [DebtorRelateCode]
           ,lg.[LGNo] as [LGNo]
           ,d.[DebtorCode] as [DebtorCode]
           ,lg.[CIFNo] as [CIFNo]
           ,2 as [DebtorTypeId]
           ,1 as [ProportionLiabilityTypeId]
           ,1 as [CreateBy]
           ,getdate() as [CreateDate]
           ,1 as[UpdateBy]
           ,getdate() as [UpdateDate]
           ,[RefCode]
           ,d.[DebtorId] as [DebtorId]
           ,1 as [IsActive]
           ,0 as [IsDelete]
           ,1 as [ImportType]
           ,lg.[LGNo] as [LGNoSeq]
           ,1 as [Seq]
           ,1 as [IsFirstCall]
           ,0 as [IsManualCall]
           ,'1900-01-01' as [ManualCallDate]
		   ,c.CustType as DebtorTypeCBS
		   into #tmpDataDebtorRelateGuarantorLoan
		   FROM DataLG lg
	left join TEMPGuarantorLoanCBS c on c.LGNo = lg.LGNo
	left join DataDebtor d on d.IDCard = c.IDCard
	where lg.[LGNo] + '-' + d.[DebtorId]  not in (select [LGNo] + '-' + [DebtorId]  from DataDebtorRelate);

	--ค้ำธนาคาร TEMPGuarantorOtherCBS
	SELECT 
--newid() as [DebtorRelateId]
distinct
           'R' + [DebtorCode] as [DebtorRelateCode]
           ,lg.[LGNo] as [LGNo]
           ,d.[DebtorCode] as [DebtorCode]
           ,lg.[CIFNo] as [CIFNo]
           ,2 as [DebtorTypeId]
           ,1 as [ProportionLiabilityTypeId]
           ,1 as [CreateBy]
           ,getdate() as [CreateDate]
           ,1 as[UpdateBy]
           ,getdate() as [UpdateDate]
           ,[RefCode]
           ,d.[DebtorId] as [DebtorId]
           ,1 as [IsActive]
           ,0 as [IsDelete]
           ,1 as [ImportType]
           ,lg.[LGNo] as [LGNoSeq]
           ,1 as [Seq]
           ,1 as [IsFirstCall]
           ,0 as [IsManualCall]
           ,'1900-01-01' as [ManualCallDate]
		   ,c.CustType as DebtorTypeCBS
		   into #tmpDataDebtorRelateGuarantorOther
		   FROM DataLG lg
	left join TEMPGuarantorOtherCBS c on c.LGNo = lg.LGNo
	left join DataDebtor d on d.IDCard = c.IDCard
	where lg.[LGNo] + '-' + d.[DebtorId]  not in (select [LGNo] + '-' + [DebtorId]  from DataDebtorRelate);

--======== กู้หลัก กู้ร่วม

modules.name: SP_JOB_ProcessSpecialTDRInstallmentPlan
modules.definition:
CREATE   PROCEDURE dbo.SP_JOB_ProcessSpecialTDRInstallmentPlan
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    DECLARE @ProcessDate date = CONVERT(date, GETDATE());
    DECLARE @PlanSet nvarchar(max);
    DECLARE @PaymentSet nvarchar(max);
    DECLARE @Sql nvarchar(max);
    DECLARE @PlansUpdated int = 0;
    DECLARE @PaymentsUpdated int = 0;
    DECLARE @PlansSuspended int = 0;
    DECLARE @PaymentsSuspended int = 0;
    DECLARE @OldContractsStatusUpdated int = 0;
    DECLARE @CurrentContractsStatusUpdated int = 0;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        CREATE TABLE #SpecialContracts
        (
            SpecialCompromiseContractId nvarchar(450)
                COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
            ReferencedCompromiseContractId nvarchar(450)
                COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT NOT NULL,
            InstallmentsStartDate date NULL,
            InstallmentsEndDate date NOT NULL
        );

        /*
         * Select special contracts that have an installment-plan DueDate today.
         * InstallmentsStartDate/InstallmentsEndDate are retained for the
         * IsSuspend update range; they are not the job trigger date.
         */
        INSERT INTO #SpecialContracts
        (
            SpecialCompromiseContractId,
            ReferencedCompromiseContractId,
            InstallmentsStartDate,
            InstallmentsEndDate
        )
        SELECT
            contract.CompromiseContractId,
            contract.RefId,
            CONVERT(date, contract.InstallmentsStartDate),
            CONVERT(date, contract.InstallmentsEndDate)
        FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContract AS contract
        WHERE contract.IsSpecial = 1
          AND contract.RefId IS NOT NULL
          AND LTRIM(RTRIM(contract.RefId)) <> ''
          AND contract.InstallmentsEndDate IS NOT NULL
          AND EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlan AS duePlan
              WHERE duePlan.CompromiseContractId = contract.CompromiseContractId
                AND duePlan.DueDate >= @ProcessDate
                AND duePlan.DueDate < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @ProcessDate)
          );

        /*
         * Generate the SET clauses from the current table metadata. This copies
         * every business column while preserving IDs/FKs. IsSuspend is handled
         * separately using the special contract's installment date range.
         */
        SELECT @PlanSet = STRING_AGG(
            CONVERT(nvarchar(max),
                'target.' + QUOTENAME(columnInfo.name)
                + ' = source.' + QUOTENAME(columnInfo.name)),
            ', ')
        FROM sys.columns AS columnInfo
        WHERE columnInfo.object_id =
              OBJECT_ID('dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlan')
          AND columnInfo.name NOT IN
          (
              'CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId',
              'CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanId',
              'CompromiseContractId',
              'CompromiseContractLGId',
              'IsSuspend'
          )
          AND columnInfo.is_identity = 0
          AND columnInfo.is_computed = 0
          AND columnInfo.system_type_id <> 189;

        SELECT @PaymentSet = STRING_AGG(
            CONVERT(nvarchar(max),
                'target.' + QUOTENAME(columnInfo.name)
                + ' = source.' + QUOTENAME(columnInfo.name)),
            ', ')
        FROM sys.columns AS columnInfo
        WHERE columnInfo.object_id =
              OBJECT_ID('dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment')
          AND columnInfo.name NOT IN
          (
              'CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId',
              'CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanId',
              'CompromiseContractId',
              'CompromiseContractLGId',
              'IsSuspend'
          )
          AND columnInfo.is_identity = 0
          AND columnInfo.is_computed = 0
          AND columnInfo.system_type_id <> 189;

        IF NULLIF(@PlanSet, '') IS NULL OR NULLIF(@PaymentSet, '') IS NULL
            THROW 50001, 'Cannot determine installment plan columns.', 1;

        /*
         * Match by Seq. ROW_NUMBER makes the result deterministic when the same
         * contract has multiple rows with an identical Seq.
         */
        SET @Sql = N'
            ;WITH SourceRows AS
            (
                SELECT
                    source.*,
                    candidate.ReferencedCompromiseContractId,
                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER
                    (
                        PARTITION BY source.CompromiseContractId, source.Seq
                        ORDER BY source.CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanId
                    ) AS MatchRow
                FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlan AS source
                INNER JOIN #SpecialContracts AS candidate
                    ON candidate.SpecialCompromiseContractId =
                       source.CompromiseContractId
            ),
            TargetRows AS
            (
                SELECT
                    target.CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanId,
                    target.CompromiseContractId,
                    target.Seq,
                    candidate.SpecialCompromiseContractId,
                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER
                    (
                        PARTITION BY target.CompromiseContractId, target.Seq
                        ORDER BY target.CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanId
                    ) AS MatchRow
                FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlan AS target
                INNER JOIN #SpecialContracts AS candidate
                    ON candidate.ReferencedCompromiseContractId =
                       target.CompromiseContractId
            )
            UPDATE target
            SET ' + @PlanSet + N'
            FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlan AS target
            INNER JOIN TargetRows AS targetRow
                ON targetRow.CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanId =
                   target.CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanId
            INNER JOIN SourceRows AS source
                ON source.CompromiseContractId =
                   targetRow.SpecialCompromiseContractId
               AND source.ReferencedCompromiseContractId =
                   targetRow.CompromiseContractId
               AND source.Seq = targetRow.Seq
               AND source.MatchRow = targetRow.MatchRow;

            SET @Affected = @@ROWCOUNT;';

        EXEC sys.sp_executesql
            @Sql,
            N'@Affected int OUTPUT',
            @Affected = @PlansUpdated OUTPUT;

        SET @Sql = N'
            ;WITH SourceRows AS
            (
                SELECT
                    source.*,
                    candidate.ReferencedCompromiseContractId,
                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER
                    (
                        PARTITION BY source.CompromiseContractId, source.Seq
                        ORDER BY source.CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId
                    ) AS MatchRow
                FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment AS source
                INNER JOIN #SpecialContracts AS candidate
                    ON candidate.SpecialCompromiseContractId =
                       source.CompromiseContractId
            ),
            TargetRows AS
            (
                SELECT
                    target.CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId,
                    target.CompromiseContractId,
                    target.Seq,
                    candidate.SpecialCompromiseContractId,
                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER
                    (
                        PARTITION BY target.CompromiseContractId, target.Seq
                        ORDER BY target.CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId
                    ) AS MatchRow
                FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment AS target
                INNER JOIN #SpecialContracts AS candidate
                    ON candidate.ReferencedCompromiseContractId =
                       target.CompromiseContractId
            )
            UPDATE target
            SET ' + @PaymentSet + N'
            FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment AS target
            INNER JOIN TargetRows AS targetRow
                ON targetRow.CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId =
                   target.CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId
            INNER JOIN SourceRows AS source
                ON source.CompromiseContractId =
                   targetRow.SpecialCompromiseContractId
               AND source.ReferencedCompromiseContractId =
                   targetRow.CompromiseContractId
               AND source.Seq = targetRow.Seq
               AND source.MatchRow = targetRow.MatchRow;

            SET @Affected = @@ROWCOUNT;';

        EXEC sys.sp_executesql
            @Sql,
            N'@Affected int OUTPUT',
            @Affected = @PaymentsUpdated OUTPUT;

        /*
         * Suspend the referenced (old) plan for the special-contract period.
         * A NULL start date means there is no lower date boundary.
         */
        UPDATE planData
        SET planData.IsSuspend = 1
        FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlan AS planData
        INNER JOIN #SpecialContracts AS candidate
            ON candidate.ReferencedCompromiseContractId =
               planData.CompromiseContractId
        WHERE (candidate.InstallmentsStartDate IS NULL
               OR planData.DueDate >= candidate.InstallmentsStartDate)
          AND planData.DueDate < DATEADD(DAY, 1, candidate.InstallmentsEndDate)
          AND ISNULL(planData.IsSuspend, 0) <> 1;

        SET @PlansSuspended = @@ROWCOUNT;

        UPDATE paymentData
        SET paymentData.IsSuspend = 1
        FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment AS paymentData
        INNER JOIN #SpecialContracts AS candidate
            ON candidate.ReferencedCompromiseContractId =
               paymentData.CompromiseContractId
        WHERE (candidate.InstallmentsStartDate IS NULL
               OR paymentData.DueDate >= candidate.InstallmentsStartDate)
          AND paymentData.DueDate < DATEADD(DAY, 1, candidate.InstallmentsEndDate)
          AND ISNULL(paymentData.IsSuspend, 0) <> 1;

        SET @PaymentsSuspended = @@ROWCOUNT;

        /*
         * Close the referenced (old) contract and set the current special
         * contract to its post-processing status.
         */
        UPDATE oldContract
        SET oldContract.CompromiseContractStatusId = 58
        FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContract AS oldContract
        INNER JOIN #SpecialContracts AS candidate
            ON candidate.ReferencedCompromiseContractId =
               oldContract.CompromiseContractId
        WHERE ISNULL(oldContract.CompromiseContractStatusId, -1) <> 58;

        SET @OldContractsStatusUpdated = @@ROWCOUNT;

        UPDATE currentContract
        SET currentContract.CompromiseContractStatusId = 62
        FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContract AS currentContract
        INNER JOIN #SpecialContracts AS candidate
            ON candidate.SpecialCompromiseContractId =
               currentContract.CompromiseContractId
        WHERE ISNULL(currentContract.CompromiseContractStatusId, -1) <> 62;

        SET @CurrentContractsStatusUpdated = @@ROWCOUNT;

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;

        SELECT
            @ProcessDate AS ProcessDate,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #SpecialContracts) AS ContractCount,
            @PlansUpdated AS PlansUpdated,
            @PaymentsUpdated AS PaymentsUpdated,
            @PlansSuspended AS PlansSuspended,
            @PaymentsSuspended AS PaymentsSuspended,
            @OldContractsStatusUpdated AS OldContractsStatusUpdated,
            @CurrentContractsStatusUpdated AS CurrentContractsStatusUpdated;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

        THROW;
    END CATCH
END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_LineOA_GetNotification]
    @DayStart DATETIME,
    @DayEnd   DATETIME
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY n.NotificationDate) AS No,
        n.CIFNo,
        n.LGNo,
        CONVERT(VARCHAR(13), d.IDCard) As IDCard,
        t.TitleCode,
				t.TitleShortName As TitleShortName,
        d.FirstName,
        d.LastName,
        n.NotificationName,
        n.Description,
        CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), n.NotificationDate, 112) AS NotificationDate,
        REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), n.NotificationDate, 108), ':', '') AS NotificationTime,
        d.UID
    FROM DataTransactionNotification n
    LEFT JOIN SystemNotificationMaster m
           ON m.NotificationId = n.NotificationId
    LEFT JOIN DataDebtorRelate r
           ON n.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId
          AND r.IsActive = 1
          AND (r.IsDelete IS NULL OR r.IsDelete = 0)
    LEFT JOIN DataDebtor d
           ON r.DebtorId = d.DebtorId
    LEFT JOIN SystemTitleMaster t
           ON d.TitleId = t.TitleId
    WHERE (ISNULL(n.IsLine, 0) = 1 OR ISNULL(m.IsLine, 0) = 1) AND d.UID IS NOT NULL
      AND n.NotificationDate >= @DayStart
      AND n.NotificationDate <  @DayEnd
    ORDER BY n.NotificationDate;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_LT_001_GetDebtBalance_Backup]
	-- insert ดอกเบี้ย ทุกมาตรการ
	@LGNo nvarchar(20) = '65067431'
	,@DebtorId nvarchar(150) = '409269C2-9CAD-4401-B834-A393997F9C46'
	,@DebtorRelateId nvarchar(150) = 'd3a7adf8-d5da-466d-a778-5f3c898a7333'
	,@CaseTypeId int = 1 --ประเภทคดี
	,@FilingDueDate datetime = '2025-01-01 00:00:00.000'
	
	
	
AS
BEGIN

 ;WITH CTE AS (
        SELECT top 1
            cm.InterestRate,
            cm.PrincipalTotal,
            cm.AccruedInterestTotal,
            cm.PayDate,
            cm.DocDate,
            cm.SeqNo,
            EffectiveDate = CASE 
                                WHEN cm.PayDate = '1900-01-01' THEN cm.DocDate 
                                ELSE cm.PayDate 
                            END
        FROM DataDebtorCard c
        LEFT JOIN DataDebtorCardMovement cm 
            ON cm.DebtorCardId = c.DataDebtorCardId
        WHERE c.DebtorRelateId = @DebtorRelateId
          AND CAST(cm.PayDate AS DATE) < @FilingDueDate
          AND CAST(cm.DocDate AS DATE) < @FilingDueDate
		  order by cm.SeqNo desc
    )
    SELECT 
        InterestRate,
        PrincipalTotal,
--         Final_DebtBalance = PrincipalTotal,
        --AccruedInterest,
        PayDate,
        DocDate,
        EffectiveDate,
        DayInterate = DATEDIFF(DAY, EffectiveDate, @FilingDueDate),
        DaysInCurrentYear = DATEDIFF(
                                DAY, 
                                DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), 1, 1),
                                DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()) + 1, 1, 1)
                             ),
        SeqNo, 
        -- ถ้าจะใช้สูตรดอกเบี้ยรวม ก็ทำแบบนี้ได้เลย ไม่ต้องใช้ @DayInterate
        -- ,Final_AccruedInterestTotal =
        --      AccruedInterestTotal 
        --      + (PrincipalTotal * (InterestRate/100) 
        --         * DATEDIFF(DAY, EffectiveDate, @Date) / 365.0)

cast(PrincipalTotal +	AccruedInterestTotal  +	(PrincipalTotal * (InterestRate/100) * (DATEDIFF(DAY, EffectiveDate, @FilingDueDate)) / 365) as decimal(20,2)) Final_DebtBalance
    FROM CTE
    ORDER BY SeqNo DESC;


END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_LT_004_GetCaseMainCapitalFile]
	-- insert ดอกเบี้ย ทุกมาตรการ
	@LGNo nvarchar(1000) = '65067431,65067431'
	--@DebtorId nvarchar(150) = '409269C2-9CAD-4401-B834-A393997F9C46'
	,@DebtorRelateId nvarchar(1500) = 'd3a7adf8-d5da-466d-a778-5f3c898a7333,d3a7adf8-d5da-466d-a778-5f3c898a7333'

Select sum(c.DebtBalance) as CapitalFile

from DataDebtorCard c
where LGNo in (SELECT value as LGNoValue FROM STRING_SPLIT(@LGNo, ','))
and c.DebtorRelateTypeId = 1
--and c.DebtorRelateId in (SELECT value as DebtorRelateIdValue FROM STRING_SPLIT(@DebtorRelateId, ','))




END
