CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_LT_005_GetCaseMainFilingDueDate]
	--หาวันที่ ครบกำหนดวันที่ยื่นฟ้อง
	@CaseTypeId int = 1 --ประเภทคดี

AS
BEGIN

declare @GetDay int = (select top 1 DueDate from SystemCaseTypeMaster c where c.CaseTypeId = @CaseTypeId)

DECLARE @Days INT = @GetDay

    SELECT CAST(DATEADD(DAY, @Days - 1, GETDATE()) AS DATE) AS FilingDueDate

END

modules.name: SP_LT_006_AssignLegalRoundRobin
modules.definition:
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_LT_006_AssignLegalRoundRobin]
(
    @DryRun BIT = 0  -- 0 = อัปเดตจริง, 1 = ทดลอง (ไม่ UPDATE)
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    DECLARE @lockResult INT;

    BEGIN TRY
        /* 0) กันชนการรันซ้อน */
        BEGIN TRAN;

        EXEC @lockResult = sys.sp_getapplock
             @Resource    = N'LT_Legal_RR'
           , @LockMode    = N'Exclusive'
           , @LockOwner   = N'Transaction'
           , @LockTimeout = 30000
           , @DbPrincipal = N'public';

        IF (@lockResult < 0)
        BEGIN
            RAISERROR(
                N'Could not acquire application lock (LT_Legal_RR).',
                16,
                1
            );

            ROLLBACK;
            RETURN;
        END

        /* 1) พูลผู้รับงาน: เอาเฉพาะ OrgStructureId = 41 และไม่ใช่ผู้จัดการ */
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#UserPool') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #UserPool;

        ;WITH Eligible AS
        (
            SELECT DISTINCT
                u.UserId
            FROM dbo.DataPersonalInfo u WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)
            WHERE u.UserId IS NOT NULL
              AND u.UserId <> 0
              AND u.OrgStructureId = 41
              AND ISNULL(u.OrgSectionId, 0) NOT IN (36, 43)
              AND u.IsActive = 1
              AND NOT
              (
                    ISNULL(u.OrgSectionId, 0) = 0
                AND ISNULL(u.IsManager, 0) = 1
              )
        )
        SELECT
            e.UserId,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY e.UserId) AS UserPos
        INTO #UserPool
        FROM Eligible e;

        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM #UserPool
        )
        BEGIN
            RAISERROR(
                N'No eligible users found for round-robin pool (OrgStructureId=41 & IsManager<>1).',
                16,
                1
            );

            ROLLBACK;
            RETURN;
        END

        DECLARE @UserCount INT =
        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM #UserPool
        );

        /* 2) คิวงานที่ยังไม่ถูกมอบหมาย */
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Pending') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #Pending;

        SELECT
            a.AssignCaseId,
            a.CIFNo,
            a.CreateDate
        INTO #Pending
        FROM dbo.LTDataAssignCase a WITH (READPAST)
        LEFT JOIN dbo.DataDebtorCard cd
            ON cd.DebtorRelateId = a.DebtorRelateId
        WHERE
            (
                a.LegalUserId IS NULL
                OR a.LegalUserId = 0
            )
            AND ISNULL(a.IsAssignLegal, 0) = 0
            AND cd.PrincipalTotal > 50000
        ORDER BY
            ISNULL(a.CreateDate, '1900-01-01'),
            a.AssignCaseId;

        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM #Pending
        )
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                CAST(0 AS INT) AS TotalQueued,
                CAST(0 AS INT) AS StickyAssigned,
                CAST(0 AS INT) AS RRAssigned,
                @DryRun AS IsDryRun;

            COMMIT;
            RETURN;
        END

        /* 3) Sticky ตาม CIFNo: ใช้ผู้รับเดิมก่อน */
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#StickyPlan') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #StickyPlan;

        SELECT
            p.AssignCaseId,
            s.LegalUserId AS StickyUserId
        INTO #StickyPlan
        FROM #Pending p
        CROSS APPLY
        (
            SELECT TOP (1)
                a2.LegalUserId
            FROM dbo.LTDataAssignCase a2 WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)
            WHERE a2.CIFNo = p.CIFNo
              AND a2.LegalUserId IS NOT NULL
              AND a2.LegalUserId <> 0
            ORDER BY
                ISNULL(a2.UpdateDate, a2.CreateDate) DESC,
                a2.AssignCaseId DESC
        ) s;

        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#StickyAssigned') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #StickyAssigned;

        SELECT TOP (0)
            p.AssignCaseId,
            CAST(0 AS INT) AS UserId
        INTO #StickyAssigned
        FROM #Pending p;

        IF (@DryRun = 0)
        BEGIN
            UPDATE a
               SET a.LegalUserId   = sp.StickyUserId,
                   a.IsAssignLegal = 1,
                   a.UpdateDate    = GETDATE()
            OUTPUT
                inserted.AssignCaseId,
                inserted.LegalUserId
            INTO #StickyAssigned
            (
                AssignCaseId,
                UserId
            )
            FROM dbo.LTDataAssignCase a
            INNER JOIN #StickyPlan sp
                ON sp.AssignCaseId = a.AssignCaseId
            WHERE
                (
                    a.LegalUserId IS NULL
                    OR a.LegalUserId = 0
                )
                AND ISNULL(a.IsAssignLegal, 0) = 0;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO #StickyAssigned
            (
                AssignCaseId,
                UserId
            )
            SELECT
                AssignCaseId,
                StickyUserId
            FROM #StickyPlan;
        END

        /* 4) ส่วนที่เหลือ แจกแบบรอบ-โรบิน */
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#QueueRR') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #QueueRR;

        SELECT
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER
            (
                ORDER BY
                    p.CreateDate,
                    p.AssignCaseId
            ) AS RN,
            p.AssignCaseId
        INTO #QueueRR
        FROM #Pending p
        LEFT JOIN #StickyAssigned sa
            ON sa.AssignCaseId = p.AssignCaseId
        WHERE sa.AssignCaseId IS NULL;

        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#PlanRR') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #PlanRR;

        SELECT
            q.RN,
            u.UserId
        INTO #PlanRR
        FROM #QueueRR q
        INNER JOIN #UserPool u
            ON u.UserPos = ((q.RN - 1) % @UserCount) + 1;

        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#RRAssigned') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #RRAssigned;

        SELECT TOP (0)
            p.AssignCaseId,
            CAST(0 AS INT) AS UserId
        INTO #RRAssigned
        FROM #Pending p;

        IF (@DryRun = 0)
        BEGIN
            UPDATE a
               SET a.LegalUserId   = pr.UserId,
                   a.IsAssignLegal = 1,
                   a.UpdateDate    = GETDATE()
            OUTPUT
                inserted.AssignCaseId,
                inserted.LegalUserId
            INTO #RRAssigned
            (
                AssignCaseId,
                UserId
            )
            FROM dbo.LTDataAssignCase a
            INNER JOIN #QueueRR q
                ON q.AssignCaseId = a.AssignCaseId
            INNER JOIN #PlanRR pr
                ON pr.RN = q.RN
            WHERE
                (
                    a.LegalUserId IS NULL
                    OR a.LegalUserId = 0
                )
                AND ISNULL(a.IsAssignLegal, 0) = 0;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO #RRAssigned
            (
                AssignCaseId,
                UserId
            )
            SELECT
                q.AssignCaseId,
                pr.UserId
            FROM #QueueRR q
            INNER JOIN #PlanRR pr
                ON pr.RN = q.RN;
        END

        /* 4.1) อัปเดต LegalUserId กลับไปที่ DataAssignment
                 โดยใช้ DebtorRelateId เดียวกัน */
        IF (@DryRun = 0)
        BEGIN
            ;WITH AssignedResult AS
            (
                SELECT
                    AssignCaseId,
                    UserId
                FROM #StickyAssigned

                UNION ALL

                SELECT
                    AssignCaseId,
                    UserId
                FROM #RRAssigned
            )
            UPDATE da
               SET da.LegalUserId = ar.UserId
            FROM dbo.DataAssignment da
            INNER JOIN dbo.LTDataAssignCase ac
                ON ac.DebtorRelateId = da.DebtorRelateId
            INNER JOIN AssignedResult ar
                ON ar.AssignCaseId = ac.AssignCaseId
            WHERE ISNULL(da.LegalUserId, 0) <> ar.UserId;
        END

        /* 5) สรุปผล */
        SELECT
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #Pending) AS TotalQueued,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #StickyAssigned) AS StickyAssigned,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #RRAssigned) AS RRAssigned,
            @DryRun AS IsDryRun;

        SELECT
            UserId,
            COUNT(*) AS AssignedCount
        FROM
        (
            SELECT UserId
            FROM #StickyAssigned

            UNION ALL

            SELECT UserId
            FROM #RRAssigned
        ) x
        GROUP BY UserId
        ORDER BY UserId;

        SELECT
            p.AssignCaseId,
            p.CIFNo,
            'STICKY' AS Source,
            s.UserId
        FROM #StickyAssigned s
        INNER JOIN #Pending p
            ON p.AssignCaseId = s.AssignCaseId

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            p.AssignCaseId,
            p.CIFNo,
            'ROUND_ROBIN' AS Source,
            r.UserId
        FROM #RRAssigned r
        INNER JOIN #Pending p
            ON p.AssignCaseId = r.AssignCaseId

        ORDER BY AssignCaseId;

        COMMIT;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK;

        DECLARE @msg NVARCHAR(4000) = ERROR_MESSAGE();

        RAISERROR(
            N'SP_LT_006_AssignLegalRoundRobin failed: %s',
            16,
            1,
            @msg
        );
    END CATCH
END

modules.name: SP_LT_006_GetGroupAssignCasePaging
modules.definition:
-- =============================================================================
-- SP_LT_006_GetGroupAssignCasePaging
-- ใช้กับ endpoint: api/assign-case/group-assign-paging
-- เรียกจาก: Services/LTDataAssignCaseService.GetGroupAssignCase
--
-- Result Set 1: ข้อมูลหน้า (paged) ตาม column ที่ service reader อ่าน
-- Result Set 2: ListWork (Legal nvarchar, Counts int, DashboardStatus int)
-- OUTPUT: @TotalRows = จำนวน row ทั้งหมดหลัง dedup AssignCaseId
--
-- แนวทาง performance:
--   1. Phase 1 ดึงเฉพาะ column ที่ใช้ filter/dedup/aggregate/sort ลง #slim
--   2. Dedup + aggregate + sort + page ใน temp table (ไม่ดึง detail ทั้งหมด)
--   3. Phase 2 join detail เฉพาะ row ของหน้าที่ขอ (@PageSize row)
--   4. OPTION (RECOMPILE) ให้ optimizer ตัด branch ของ filter ที่เป็น NULL ทิ้ง
--   ** ต้อง run Scripts/IX_GroupAssignCasePaging_Indexes.sql คู่กันด้วย **
-- =============================================================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_LT_006_GetGroupAssignCasePaging]
    @LoginUserId         INT,
    @IsManager           INT,
    @OrgSectionId        INT           = NULL,
    @OrgStructureId      INT           = NULL,
    @FilterLegalUserId   INT           = NULL,
    @DebtorId            NVARCHAR(150) = NULL,
    @FromDate            DATE          = NULL,
    @EndDate             DATE          = NULL,
    @DebtorStatusCardId  INT           = NULL,
    @DebtorStatusId      INT           = NULL,
    @LegalStatusId       INT           = NULL,
    @StatusProsecutionId INT           = NULL,
    @DebtorRelateIds     NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,  -- CSV ของ DebtorRelateId
    @LgNo                NVARCHAR(20)  = NULL,
    @IsCreateCase        BIT           = NULL,
    @Keyword             NVARCHAR(500) = NULL,
    @SearchFields        NVARCHAR(500) = NULL,  -- CSV: debtor_code, red_case_no, debtor_name, ...
    @DashboardStatusId   INT           = NULL,
    @DashboardStatusCode INT           = 1,
    @PageNumber          INT           = 1,
    @PageSize            INT           = 50,
    @TotalRows           INT OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF @PageNumber < 1 SET @PageNumber = 1;
    IF @PageSize   < 1 SET @PageSize   = 50;

    DECLARE @EndDateExclusive DATETIME = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @EndDate);

    -- แตก CSV search fields เป็น flag ล่วงหน้า (กัน STRING_SPLIT ใน predicate)
    DECLARE @fDebtorCode BIT = 0, @fRedCaseNo BIT = 0, @fDebtorName BIT = 0,
            @fDebtorTypeName BIT = 0, @fCaseTypeName BIT = 0, @fLgNo BIT = 0,
            @fCifNo BIT = 0, @fLegalUserName BIT = 0, @fFullName BIT = 0;

    IF @Keyword IS NOT NULL AND @Keyword <> '' AND @SearchFields IS NOT NULL AND @SearchFields <> ''
    BEGIN
        SELECT
            @fDebtorCode     = MAX(CASE WHEN f = 'debtor_code'      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
            @fRedCaseNo      = MAX(CASE WHEN f = 'red_case_no'      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
            @fDebtorName     = MAX(CASE WHEN f = 'debtor_name'      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
            @fDebtorTypeName = MAX(CASE WHEN f = 'debtor_type_name' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
            @fCaseTypeName   = MAX(CASE WHEN f = 'case_type_name'   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
            @fLgNo           = MAX(CASE WHEN f = 'lg_no'            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
            @fCifNo          = MAX(CASE WHEN f = 'cif_no'           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
            @fLegalUserName  = MAX(CASE WHEN f = 'legal_user_name'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
            @fFullName       = MAX(CASE WHEN f = 'full_name'        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        FROM (SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(value)) AS f FROM STRING_SPLIT(@SearchFields, ',')) s;
    END
    ELSE
        SET @Keyword = NULL; -- keyword ใช้ก็ต่อเมื่อมี search fields เท่านั้น (ตาม logic เดิม)

    -- CSV DebtorRelateIds → temp table
    -- COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT: temp table ใช้ collation ของ tempdb (server) ซึ่งไม่ตรงกับ DB → ชน error 468
    CREATE TABLE #relateIds (DebtorRelateId NVARCHAR(150) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY);
    IF @DebtorRelateIds IS NOT NULL AND @DebtorRelateIds <> ''
        INSERT INTO #relateIds (DebtorRelateId)
        SELECT DISTINCT LTRIM(RTRIM(value)) FROM STRING_SPLIT(@DebtorRelateIds, ',')
        WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(value)) <> '';
    DECLARE @HasRelateIds BIT = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #relateIds) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- PHASE 1: slim rows (filter + column ขั้นต่ำสำหรับ dedup/aggregate/sort)
    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    CREATE TABLE #slim (
        RowId          INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
        AssignCaseId   NVARCHAR(150) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT NOT NULL,
        DebtorRelateId NVARCHAR(150) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT NULL,
        DebtorId       NVARCHAR(150) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT NULL,
        LGNo           NVARCHAR(20)  COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT NULL,
        ClaimPayAmount DECIMAL(20,4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        ExpirationDate DATETIME      NULL,
        LegalUserName  NVARCHAR(200) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT NULL
    );

    INSERT INTO #slim (AssignCaseId, DebtorRelateId, DebtorId, LGNo, ClaimPayAmount, ExpirationDate, LegalUserName)
    SELECT
        a.AssignCaseId,
        a.DebtorRelateId,
        r.DebtorId,
        r.LGNo,
        ISNULL(lg.ClaimPayAmount, 0),
        a.ExpirationDate,
        CASE WHEN lu.PersonalInfoId IS NULL THEN NULL
             ELSE CONCAT(lt.TitleName, lu.FirstName, ' ', lu.LastName) END
    FROM dbo.LTDataAssignCase a
    INNER JOIN dbo.DataDebtorRelate r ON a.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataDebtor d          ON r.DebtorId   = d.DebtorId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemDebtorType dt   ON r.DebtorTypeId = dt.DebtorTypeId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemCaseTypeMaster ct ON a.CaseTypeId = ct.CaseTypeId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataPersonalInfo lu   ON a.LegalUserId = lu.UserId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemTitleMaster lt  ON lu.TitleId    = lt.TitleId
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) x.ClaimPayAmount
        FROM dbo.DataLG x
        WHERE x.LGNo = r.LGNo
    ) lg
    WHERE a.AssignCaseId IS NOT NULL AND a.AssignCaseId <> ''
      -- สิทธิ์ตาม role (ตรงกับ LINQ เดิม)
      AND (
            @IsManager = 2
         OR (@IsManager = 1 AND ISNULL(@OrgSectionId, 0) <> 0
             AND lu.OrgSectionId = @OrgSectionId AND r.DebtorId IS NOT NULL)
         OR (@IsManager = 1 AND ISNULL(@OrgSectionId, 0) = 0
             AND (lu.OrgStructureId = @OrgStructureId
                  OR (lu.OrgStructureId IS NULL AND @OrgStructureId IS NULL))
             AND r.DebtorId IS NOT NULL)
         OR (@IsManager = 0 AND a.LegalUserId = @LoginUserId AND r.DebtorId IS NOT NULL)
      )
      -- filter ทั่วไป
      AND (@FilterLegalUserId  IS NULL OR a.LegalUserId = @FilterLegalUserId)
      AND (@DebtorId           IS NULL OR r.DebtorId    = @DebtorId)
      AND (@FromDate           IS NULL OR a.ExpirationDate >= @FromDate)
      AND (@EndDate            IS NULL OR a.ExpirationDate <  @EndDateExclusive)
      AND (@DebtorStatusCardId IS NULL OR a.StatusId = @DebtorStatusCardId)
      AND (@DashboardStatusId  IS NULL OR a.StatusId = @DashboardStatusId)
      AND (@LgNo               IS NULL OR r.LGNo = @LgNo)
      AND (@IsCreateCase       IS NULL OR ISNULL(a.IsCreateCase, 0) = @IsCreateCase)
      AND (@HasRelateIds = 0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #relateIds ri WHERE ri.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId))
      -- keyword search
      AND (@Keyword IS NULL OR (
            (@fDebtorCode     = 1 AND d.DebtorCode  LIKE '%' + @Keyword + '%')
         OR (@fRedCaseNo      = 1 AND a.RedCaseNo   LIKE '%' + @Keyword + '%')
         OR (@fDebtorName     = 1 AND d.DebtorName  LIKE '%' + @Keyword + '%')
         OR (@fDebtorTypeName = 1 AND dt.DebtorTypeName LIKE '%' + @Keyword + '%')
         OR (@fCaseTypeName   = 1 AND ct.CaseTypeName   LIKE '%' + @Keyword + '%')
         OR (@fLgNo           = 1 AND r.LGNo  = @Keyword)
         OR (@fCifNo          = 1 AND r.CIFNo = @Keyword)
         OR (@fLegalUserName  = 1 AND lu.PersonalInfoId IS NOT NULL
             AND CONCAT(lt.TitleName, lu.FirstName, ' ', lu.LastName) LIKE '%' + @Keyword + '%')
         OR (@fFullName       = 1 AND d.DebtorName LIKE '%' + @Keyword + '%')
      ))
    OPTION (RECOMPILE);

    -- filter สถานะล่าสุด (รันเฉพาะเมื่อส่ง filter มา — หลัง #slim เล็กลงแล้ว)
    IF @DebtorStatusId IS NOT NULL
        DELETE s FROM #slim s
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM (
                SELECT TOP (1) u.StatusDebtorId
                FROM dbo.DataDebtorStatusUpdate u
                WHERE u.DebtorRelateId = s.DebtorRelateId
                ORDER BY u.UpdateDate DESC
            ) t WHERE t.StatusDebtorId = @DebtorStatusId);

    IF @LegalStatusId IS NOT NULL
        DELETE s FROM #slim s
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM (
                SELECT TOP (1) u.StatusLegalId
                FROM dbo.DataDebtorStatusUpdate u
                WHERE u.DebtorRelateId = s.DebtorRelateId
                ORDER BY u.UpdateDate DESC
            ) t WHERE t.StatusLegalId = @LegalStatusId);

    IF @StatusProsecutionId IS NOT NULL
        DELETE s FROM #slim s
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM (
                SELECT TOP (1) m.StatusProsecutionId
                FROM dbo.LTDataCaseMainDebtor m
                WHERE m.DebtorRelateId = s.DebtorRelateId
                ORDER BY m.CaseMainDebtorId DESC
            ) t WHERE t.StatusProsecutionId = @StatusProsecutionId);

    -- dedup AssignCaseId (เก็บ row แรก)
    DELETE s
    FROM (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY AssignCaseId ORDER BY RowId) AS rn
          FROM #slim) s
    WHERE s.rn > 1;

    SET @TotalRows = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #slim);

    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Aggregate ต่อ DebtorId: SUM(ClaimPayAmount) นับ LGNo ซ้ำครั้งเดียว + MIN(ExpirationDate)
    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    CREATE TABLE #agg (
        DebtorId NVARCHAR(150) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
        Total    DECIMAL(20,4) NOT NULL,
        MinExp   DATETIME      NULL
    );

    INSERT INTO #agg (DebtorId, Total, MinExp)
    SELECT DebtorId,
           SUM(CASE WHEN lgRn = 1 THEN ClaimPayAmount ELSE 0 END),
           MIN(ExpirationDate)
    FROM (
        SELECT DebtorId, ClaimPayAmount, ExpirationDate,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DebtorId, ISNULL(LGNo, '') ORDER BY RowId) AS lgRn
        FROM #slim
        WHERE DebtorId IS NOT NULL AND DebtorId <> ''
    ) x
    GROUP BY DebtorId;

    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Sort + page: sortKey = MinExp ของ debtor (ถ้ามี) ไม่งั้นใช้ ExpirationDate ตัวเอง
    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    CREATE TABLE #page (
        PageOrder    INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
        AssignCaseId NVARCHAR(150) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT NOT NULL
    );

    INSERT INTO #page (AssignCaseId)
    SELECT s.AssignCaseId
    FROM #slim s
    LEFT JOIN #agg ag ON s.DebtorId = ag.DebtorId
    ORDER BY CASE WHEN ag.DebtorId IS NOT NULL THEN ag.MinExp ELSE s.ExpirationDate END ASC,
             s.RowId ASC
    OFFSET (@PageNumber - 1) * @PageSize ROWS
    FETCH NEXT @PageSize ROWS ONLY;

    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- PHASE 2 / Result Set 1: detail เฉพาะ row ของหน้า
    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
        a.AssignCaseId,
        a.CaseMainId,
        ISNULL(a.DebtorRelateId, '')                          AS DebtorRelateId,
        ISNULL(r.DebtorId, '')                                AS DebtorId,
        d.DebtorCode,
        d.DebtorName,
        LTRIM(RTRIM(CONCAT(dtt.TitleName, d.FirstName, ' ', d.LastName))) AS FullName,
        ISNULL(dtt.TitleName, '')                             AS TitleName,
        d.TitleId,
        COALESCE(r.DebtorTypeId, d.DebtorTypeId)              AS PersonGroupId,
        dt.DebtorTypeName                                     AS PersonGroupName,
        r.DebtorTypeId,
        dt.DebtorTypeName,
        COALESCE(r.LGNo, a.LGNo)                              AS LGNo,
        r.CIFNo,
        a.ExpirationDate,
        su.StatusDebtorId                                     AS DebtorStatusId,
        stD.StatusName                                        AS DebtorStatusName,
        su.StatusLegalId                                      AS LegalStatusId,
        stL.StatusName                                        AS LegalStatusName,
        ISNULL(lg.ClaimAmountCurrent, 0)                      AS ClaimAmountCurrent,
        ISNULL(lg.ClaimAmount, 0)                             AS ClaimAmount,
        CASE WHEN r.DebtorId IS NOT NULL AND r.DebtorId <> '' AND ag.DebtorId IS NOT NULL
             THEN ag.Total
             ELSE ISNULL(lg.ClaimPayAmount, 0) END            AS ClaimPayAmount,
        a.CaseTypeId,
        ct.CaseTypeName,
        lo.FirstName                                          AS LawOfficeUserName,
        a.LawOfficeUserId,
        CASE WHEN lu.PersonalInfoId IS NULL THEN NULL
             ELSE LTRIM(RTRIM(CONCAT(lt.TitleName, lu.FirstName, ' ', lu.LastName))) END AS LegalUserName,
        a.LegalUserId,
        lg.ClaimDate,
        lg.Grade,
        clt.ClaimTypeName,
        card.PrincipalTotal                                   AS DebtBalance,
        card.ProportionLiability,
        a.IsCreateCase,
        cmd.StatusProsecutionId,
        stP.StatusName                                        AS StatusProsecutionName,
        a.StatusId,
        stC.StatusName                                        AS StatusName,
        lu.OrgStructureId,
        lu.OrgSectionId,
        a.BankFilingDate,
        a.OtherFrozenAssDate,
        a.RedCaseNo,
        cm.BlackCaseNo
    FROM #page p
    INNER JOIN dbo.LTDataAssignCase a  ON a.AssignCaseId = p.AssignCaseId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataDebtorRelate r   ON a.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataDebtor d         ON r.DebtorId = d.DebtorId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemTitleMaster dtt ON d.TitleId = dtt.TitleId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemDebtorType dt  ON COALESCE(r.DebtorTypeId, d.DebtorTypeId) = dt.DebtorTypeId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemCaseTypeMaster ct ON a.CaseTypeId = ct.CaseTypeId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.LTDataCaseMain cm    ON a.CaseMainId = cm.CaseMainId
    LEFT JOIN #agg ag                  ON r.DebtorId = ag.DebtorId
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) x.PersonalInfoId, x.TitleId, x.FirstName, x.LastName, x.OrgStructureId, x.OrgSectionId
        FROM dbo.DataPersonalInfo x
        WHERE x.UserId = a.LegalUserId
        ORDER BY x.PersonalInfoId
    ) lu
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemTitleMaster lt ON lu.TitleId = lt.TitleId
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) x.FirstName
        FROM dbo.DataPersonalInfo x
        WHERE x.UserId = a.LawOfficeUserId
        ORDER BY x.PersonalInfoId
    ) lo
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) x.ClaimPayAmount, x.ClaimAmountCurrent, x.ClaimAmount, x.ClaimDate, x.Grade, x.ClaimTypeId
        FROM dbo.DataLG x
        WHERE x.LGNo = COALESCE(r.LGNo, a.LGNo)
    ) lg
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemClaimTypeMaster clt ON lg.ClaimTypeId = clt.ClaimTypeId
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) x.PrincipalTotal, x.ProportionLiability
        FROM dbo.DataDebtorCard x
        WHERE x.DebtorRelateId = a.DebtorRelateId
    ) card
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) x.StatusDebtorId, x.StatusLegalId
        FROM dbo.DataDebtorStatusUpdate x
        WHERE x.DebtorRelateId = a.DebtorRelateId
        ORDER BY x.UpdateDate DESC
    ) su
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemStatusMaster stD ON su.StatusDebtorId = stD.SystemStatusId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemStatusMaster stL ON su.StatusLegalId = stL.SystemStatusId
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) x.StatusProsecutionId
        FROM dbo.LTDataCaseMainDebtor x
        WHERE x.DebtorRelateId = a.DebtorRelateId
        ORDER BY x.CaseMainDebtorId DESC
    ) cmd
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemStatusMaster stP ON cmd.StatusProsecutionId = stP.SystemStatusId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemStatusMaster stC ON a.StatusId = stC.SystemStatusId
    ORDER BY p.PageOrder
    OPTION (RECOMPILE);

    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Result Set 2: ListWork — group ตามชื่อเจ้าหน้าที่คดี
    ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
        ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(LegalUserName)), ''), N'รอมอบหมายงาน') AS Legal,
        COUNT(*)             AS Counts,
        @DashboardStatusCode AS DashboardStatus
    FROM #slim
    GROUP BY ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(LegalUserName)), ''), N'รอมอบหมายงาน')
    ORDER BY Legal;

END

modules.name: SP_LT_007_AssignLawOfficeRoundRobin_Project
modules.definition:
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_LT_007_AssignLawOfficeRoundRobin_Project]
(
    @DryRun BIT = 0 -- 0 = อัปเดตจริง, 1 = ทดลองโดยไม่บันทึก
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    DECLARE
        @LockResult               INT,
        @ConditionAssignLawyerId INT,
        @LawOfficeYearId         INT,
        @CursorRowCount          INT,
        @StoredCursorLastSeq     INT,
        @EffectiveCursorLastSeq  INT,
        @CursorAfter             INT,
        @UnitCount               INT,
        @RRAssignedCount         INT,
        @RRGroupAssignedCount    INT,
        @MaxTally                INT;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        /* =========================================================
           0. ป้องกัน Stored Procedure รันซ้อน
           ========================================================= */
        EXEC @LockResult = sys.sp_getapplock
             @Resource    = N'LAW_OFFICE_RR_PROJECT',
             @LockMode    = N'Exclusive',
             @LockOwner   = N'Transaction',
             @LockTimeout = 30000,
             @DbPrincipal = N'public';

        IF @LockResult < 0
        BEGIN
            THROW 50001,
                  N'ไม่สามารถล็อกการประมวลผล LAW_OFFICE_RR_PROJECT ได้',
                  1;
        END;

        /* =========================================================
           1. หาเงื่อนไขจัดสรรล่าสุด
           ========================================================= */
        SELECT TOP (1)
            @ConditionAssignLawyerId = m.ConditionAssignLawyerId
        FROM dbo.SystemConditionAssignLawyerMaster m
        WHERE m.IsActive = 1
        ORDER BY
            m.UpdateDate DESC,
            m.ConditionAssignLawyerId DESC;

        IF @ConditionAssignLawyerId IS NULL
        BEGIN
            THROW 50002,
                  N'ไม่พบ SystemConditionAssignLawyerMaster ที่เปิดใช้งาน',
                  1;
        END;

        /* =========================================================
           2. หาปีสำนักงานทนายล่าสุด
           ========================================================= */
        SELECT TOP (1)
            @LawOfficeYearId = y.LawOfficeYearId
        FROM dbo.SystemLawOfficeYearMaster y
        WHERE y.IsActive = 1
        ORDER BY
            y.UpdateDate DESC,
            y.LawOfficeYearId DESC;

        IF @LawOfficeYearId IS NULL
        BEGIN
            THROW 50003,
                  N'ไม่พบ SystemLawOfficeYearMaster ที่เปิดใช้งาน',
                  1;
        END;

        /* =========================================================
           3. อ่าน CursorLastSeq

           ในแต่ละ LawOfficeYearId ต้องมี IsCursorRow = 1
           เพียง 1 รายการ
           ========================================================= */
        SELECT
            @CursorRowCount = COUNT(*),
            @StoredCursorLastSeq = MAX(ISNULL(s.CursorLastSeq, 0))
        FROM dbo.SystemLawOfficeScoreMaster s WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
        WHERE s.LawOfficeYearId = @LawOfficeYearId
          AND ISNULL(s.IsCursorRow, 0) = 1;

        IF ISNULL(@CursorRowCount, 0) = 0
        BEGIN
            THROW 50004,
                  N'ไม่พบ Cursor Row กรุณากำหนด IsCursorRow = 1 จำนวน 1 รายการในปีที่ใช้งาน',
                  1;
        END;

        IF @CursorRowCount > 1
        BEGIN
            THROW 50005,
                  N'พบ Cursor Row มากกว่า 1 รายการ กรุณากำหนด IsCursorRow = 1 เพียงรายการเดียวต่อปี',
                  1;
        END;

        SET @StoredCursorLastSeq = ISNULL(@StoredCursorLastSeq, 0);

        IF @StoredCursorLastSeq < 0
        BEGIN
            SET @StoredCursorLastSeq = 0;
        END;

        /* =========================================================
           4. โหลดเงื่อนไขช่วงคะแนน รอบ และจำนวนต่อรอบ
           ========================================================= */
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Detail') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #Detail;

        SELECT
            d.ConditionAssignLawyerDetailId AS DetailId,
            d.StartScore,
            d.EndScore,
            ISNULL(d.[Round], 0) AS RoundCnt,
            ISNULL(d.Quantity, 0) AS QtyPerRound,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER
            (
                ORDER BY
                    d.StartScore DESC,
                    d.EndScore DESC,
                    d.ConditionAssignLawyerDetailId ASC
            ) AS Priority
        INTO #Detail
        FROM dbo.SystemConditionAssignLawyerDetailMaster d
        WHERE d.ConditionAssignLawyerId = @ConditionAssignLawyerId;

        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM #Detail
        )
        BEGIN
            THROW 50006,
                  N'ไม่พบรายละเอียดเงื่อนไขการจัดสรรสำนักงานทนาย',
                  1;
        END;

        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM #Detail
            WHERE RoundCnt <= 0
               OR QtyPerRound <= 0
        )
        BEGIN
            THROW 50007,
                  N'ค่า Round และ Quantity ต้องมากกว่า 0',
                  1;
        END;

        /* =========================================================
           5. โหลดคะแนนสำนักงานทนาย

           ไม่นำรายการ IsCursorRow = 1 มาเข้า Round Robin
           ========================================================= */
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#OfficeScore') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #OfficeScore;

        ;WITH RankedOfficeScore AS
        (
            SELECT
                s.LawOfficeId,
                s.Score,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER
                (
                    PARTITION BY s.LawOfficeId
                    ORDER BY
                        s.UpdateDate DESC,
                        s.LawOfficeScoreId DESC
                ) AS RN
            FROM dbo.SystemLawOfficeScoreMaster s
            WHERE s.LawOfficeYearId = @LawOfficeYearId
              AND ISNULL(s.IsCursorRow, 0) = 0
              AND s.LawOfficeId IS NOT NULL
        )
        SELECT
            LawOfficeId,
            Score
        INTO #OfficeScore
        FROM RankedOfficeScore
        WHERE RN = 1;

        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM #OfficeScore
        )
        BEGIN
            THROW 50008,
                  N'ไม่พบคะแนนสำนักงานทนายของปีที่เลือก',
                  1;
        END;

        /* =========================================================
           6. Map สำนักงานทนายกับ OrgSectionId
           ========================================================= */
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#OfficeMap') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #OfficeMap;

        SELECT DISTINCT
            lom.LawOfficeId,
            lom.OrgSectionId
        INTO #OfficeMap
        FROM dbo.SystemLawOfficeMaster lom
        INNER JOIN #OfficeScore os
            ON os.LawOfficeId = lom.LawOfficeId;

        /* =========================================================
           7. จัดสำนักงานทนายเข้าช่วงคะแนน
           ========================================================= */
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#BucketOffice') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #BucketOffice;

        SELECT
            d.DetailId,
            os.LawOfficeId,
            os.Score
        INTO #BucketOffice
        FROM #Detail d
        INNER JOIN #OfficeScore os
            ON os.Score BETWEEN d.StartScore AND d.EndScore;

        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM #BucketOffice
        )
        BEGIN
            THROW 50009,
                  N'ไม่มีสำนักงานทนายที่อยู่ในช่วงคะแนนตามเงื่อนไข',
                  1;
        END;

        /* =========================================================
           8. หาผู้จัดการของสำนักงานทนาย
           ========================================================= */
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#OfficeUser') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #OfficeUser;

        SELECT
            b.LawOfficeId,
            om.OrgSectionId,
            mgr.UserId
        INTO #OfficeUser
        FROM
        (
            SELECT DISTINCT
                LawOfficeId
            FROM #BucketOffice
        ) b
        LEFT JOIN #OfficeMap om
            ON om.LawOfficeId = b.LawOfficeId
        OUTER APPLY
        (
            SELECT TOP (1)
                dpi.UserId
            FROM dbo.DataPersonalInfo dpi
            WHERE dpi.OrgSectionId = om.OrgSectionId
              AND ISNULL(dpi.IsManager, 0) = 1
            ORDER BY
                dpi.UpdateDate DESC,
                dpi.UserId DESC
        ) mgr;

        /* =========================================================
           9. Map UserId กับ OrgSectionId
           ========================================================= */
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#UserSection') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #UserSection;

        SELECT DISTINCT
            UserId,
            OrgSectionId
        INTO #UserSection
        FROM #OfficeUser
        WHERE UserId IS NOT NULL;

        /* =========================================================
           10. จัดลำดับสำนักงานในแต่ละช่วงคะแนน
           ========================================================= */
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#OfficePos') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #OfficePos;

        SELECT
            b.DetailId,
            b.LawOfficeId,
            ou.UserId,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER
            (
                PARTITION BY b.DetailId
                ORDER BY b.LawOfficeId ASC
            ) AS OfficePos
        INTO #OfficePos
        FROM #BucketOffice b
        LEFT JOIN #OfficeUser ou
            ON ou.LawOfficeId = b.LawOfficeId;

        /* =========================================================
           11. โหลดคดีที่ยังไม่ได้มอบหมายสำนักงานทนาย
           ========================================================= */
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Projects') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #Projects;

        SELECT
            cm.CaseMainId,
            cm.CreateDate
        INTO #Projects
        FROM dbo.LTDataCaseMain cm WITH (UPDLOCK, READPAST, ROWLOCK)
        WHERE cm.LawOfficeUserId IS NULL
          AND cm.StatusProsecutionId = 147;

        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM #Projects
        )
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                @ConditionAssignLawyerId AS ConditionAssignLawyerId,
                @LawOfficeYearId AS LawOfficeYearId,
                0 AS TotalQueued,
                0 AS StickyAssigned,
                0 AS RRAssigned,
                0 AS RRGroupAssigned,
                @StoredCursorLastSeq AS CursorLastSeqBefore,
                @StoredCursorLastSeq AS CursorLastSeqAfter,
                @DryRun AS IsDryRun;

            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            RETURN;
        END;

        /* =========================================================
           12. เตรียม CIF ของแต่ละคดี และหาทนายเดิมของ CIF

           หลักการ
           - CIF มาจาก DataDebtorRelate.CIFNo
             โดยเชื่อมผ่าน LTDataCaseMainDebtor.DebtorRelateId
           - ถ้า CIF เคยมีทนายแล้ว ให้ยึดทนายล่าสุดของ CIF นั้น
           - ถ้าไม่มี CIF ให้ fallback เป็น DebtorId ตามสูตรเดิม
           - ถ้าไม่มีทั้ง CIF และ DebtorId ให้แยกเป็นราย CaseMainId
           ========================================================= */
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#IdentityCandidate') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #IdentityCandidate;

        SELECT
            p.CaseMainId,
            p.CreateDate,
            d.CaseMainDebtorId,
            d.DebtorId,
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(dr.CIFNo)), N'') AS CIFNo,
            d.Seq
        INTO #IdentityCandidate
        FROM #Projects p
        LEFT JOIN dbo.LTDataCaseMainDebtor d
            ON d.CaseMainId = p.CaseMainId
        LEFT JOIN dbo.DataDebtorRelate dr
            ON dr.DebtorRelateId = d.DebtorRelateId;

        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#LatestCIFAssignment') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #LatestCIFAssignment;

        ;WITH CIFHistorySource AS
        (
            SELECT DISTINCT
                NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(dr.CIFNo)), N'') AS CIFNo,
                cm.CaseMainId,
                cm.LawOfficeUserId,
                cm.CreateDate
            FROM dbo.LTDataCaseMain cm
            INNER JOIN dbo.LTDataCaseMainDebtor d
                ON d.CaseMainId = cm.CaseMainId
            INNER JOIN dbo.DataDebtorRelate dr
                ON dr.DebtorRelateId = d.DebtorRelateId
            WHERE cm.LawOfficeUserId IS NOT NULL
              AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(dr.CIFNo)), N'') IS NOT NULL
        ),
        RankedCIFHistory AS
        (
            SELECT
                h.CIFNo,
                h.LawOfficeUserId,
                h.CreateDate,
                h.CaseMainId,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER
                (
                    PARTITION BY h.CIFNo
                    ORDER BY
                        ISNULL(h.CreateDate, '19000101') DESC,
                        h.CaseMainId DESC
                ) AS RN
            FROM CIFHistorySource h
        )
        SELECT
            CIFNo,
            LawOfficeUserId AS UserId,
            CreateDate AS PreviousCreateDate,
            CaseMainId AS PreviousCaseMainId
        INTO #LatestCIFAssignment
        FROM RankedCIFHistory
        WHERE RN = 1;

        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_LatestCIFAssignment_CIFNo
            ON #LatestCIFAssignment (CIFNo);

        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#LatestDebtorAssignment') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #LatestDebtorAssignment;

        ;WITH DebtorHistorySource AS
        (
            SELECT DISTINCT
                d.DebtorId,
                cm.CaseMainId,
                cm.LawOfficeUserId,
                cm.CreateDate
            FROM dbo.LTDataCaseMain cm
            INNER JOIN dbo.LTDataCaseMainDebtor d
                ON d.CaseMainId = cm.CaseMainId
            WHERE cm.LawOfficeUserId IS NOT NULL
              AND d.DebtorId IS NOT NULL
        ),
        RankedDebtorHistory AS
        (
            SELECT
                h.DebtorId,
                h.LawOfficeUserId,
                h.CreateDate,
                h.CaseMainId,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER
                (
                    PARTITION BY h.DebtorId
                    ORDER BY
                        ISNULL(h.CreateDate, '19000101') DESC,
                        h.CaseMainId DESC
                ) AS RN
            FROM DebtorHistorySource h
        )
        SELECT
            DebtorId,
            LawOfficeUserId AS UserId,
            CreateDate AS PreviousCreateDate,
            CaseMainId AS PreviousCaseMainId
        INTO #LatestDebtorAssignment
        FROM RankedDebtorHistory
        WHERE RN = 1;

        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_LatestDebtorAssignment_DebtorId
            ON #LatestDebtorAssignment (DebtorId);

        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ProjectIdentity') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #ProjectIdentity;

        ;WITH RankedIdentity AS
        (
            SELECT
                c.CaseMainId,
                c.CreateDate,
                c.CaseMainDebtorId,
                c.DebtorId,
                c.CIFNo,
                CASE
                    WHEN c.CIFNo IS NOT NULL THEN cifHistory.UserId
                    ELSE debtorHistory.UserId
                END AS StickyUserId,
                CASE
                    WHEN c.CIFNo IS NOT NULL THEN cifHistory.PreviousCreateDate
                    ELSE debtorHistory.PreviousCreateDate
                END AS PreviousCreateDate,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER
                (
                    PARTITION BY c.CaseMainId
                    ORDER BY
                        CASE
                            WHEN c.CIFNo IS NOT NULL
                                 AND cifHistory.UserId IS NOT NULL THEN 1
                            WHEN c.CIFNo IS NOT NULL THEN 2
                            WHEN c.CIFNo IS NULL
                                 AND debtorHistory.UserId IS NOT NULL THEN 3
                            WHEN c.DebtorId IS NOT NULL THEN 4
                            ELSE 5
                        END ASC,
                        CASE
                            WHEN c.CIFNo IS NOT NULL
                                THEN ISNULL(cifHistory.PreviousCreateDate, '19000101')
                            ELSE ISNULL(debtorHistory.PreviousCreateDate, '19000101')
                        END DESC,
                        ISNULL(c.Seq, 2147483647) ASC,
                        ISNULL(c.CaseMainDebtorId, N'') ASC
                ) AS RN
            FROM #IdentityCandidate c
            LEFT JOIN #LatestCIFAssignment cifHistory
                ON cifHistory.CIFNo = c.CIFNo
            LEFT JOIN #LatestDebtorAssignment debtorHistory
                ON debtorHistory.DebtorId = c.DebtorId
        )
        SELECT
            r.CaseMainId,
            r.CreateDate,
            r.CIFNo,
            r.DebtorId,
            CAST
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN r.CIFNo IS NOT NULL
                        THEN CONCAT(N'CIF|', r.CIFNo)
                    WHEN r.DebtorId IS NOT NULL
                        THEN CONCAT(N'DEBTOR|', r.DebtorId)
                    ELSE CONCAT(N'CASE|', r.CaseMainId)
                END
                AS NVARCHAR(400)
            ) AS AssignmentKey,
            r.StickyUserId
        INTO #ProjectIdentity
        FROM RankedIdentity r
        WHERE r.RN = 1;

        CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_ProjectIdentity_CaseMainId
            ON #ProjectIdentity (CaseMainId);

        CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_ProjectIdentity_AssignmentKey
            ON #ProjectIdentity (AssignmentKey);

        /* =========================================================
           13. Sticky Assignment ตาม CIF

           ถ้า CIF เดียวกันเคยมีทนายแล้ว
           ทุกคดีของ CIF นั้นต้องได้ทนายคนเดิม
           ========================================================= */
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#StickyPlan') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #StickyPlan;

        SELECT
            i.CaseMainId,
            i.CIFNo,
            i.AssignmentKey,
            i.StickyUserId,
            stickySection.OrgSectionId AS StickySectionId
        INTO #StickyPlan
        FROM #ProjectIdentity i
        OUTER APPLY
        (
            SELECT TOP (1)
                dpi.OrgSectionId
            FROM dbo.DataPersonalInfo dpi
            WHERE dpi.UserId = i.StickyUserId
            ORDER BY
                dpi.UpdateDate DESC,
                dpi.UserId DESC
        ) stickySection
        WHERE i.StickyUserId IS NOT NULL;

        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#StickyAssigned') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #StickyAssigned;

        SELECT TOP (0)
            p.CaseMainId,
            CAST(0 AS INT) AS UserId,
            CAST(NULL AS INT) AS OrgSectionId
        INTO #StickyAssigned
        FROM #Projects p;

        IF @DryRun = 0
        BEGIN
            /* อัปเดตคดีหลักแบบ Sticky */
            UPDATE cm
            SET
                cm.LawOfficeUserId = sp.StickyUserId,
                cm.LawOfficeSectionId = sp.StickySectionId
            OUTPUT
                inserted.CaseMainId,
                inserted.LawOfficeUserId,
                inserted.LawOfficeSectionId
            INTO #StickyAssigned
            (
                CaseMainId,
                UserId,
                OrgSectionId
            )
            FROM dbo.LTDataCaseMain cm
            INNER JOIN #StickyPlan sp
                ON sp.CaseMainId = cm.CaseMainId
            WHERE cm.LawOfficeUserId IS NULL;

            /* อัปเดต Section ในลูกหนี้ */
            UPDATE debtor
            SET
                debtor.LawOfficeSectionId = assigned.OrgSectionId
            FROM dbo.LTDataCaseMainDebtor debtor
            INNER JOIN #StickyAssigned assigned
                ON assigned.CaseMainId = debtor.CaseMainId;

            /* อัปเดต AssignCase */
            UPDATE assignCase
            SET
                assignCase.LawOfficeUserId = assigned.UserId,
                assignCase.IsAssignLawOffice = 1
            FROM dbo.LTDataAssignCase assignCase
            INNER JOIN #StickyAssigned assigned
                ON assigned.CaseMainId = assignCase.CaseMainId
            WHERE assigned.UserId IS NOT NULL;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO #StickyAssigned
            (
                CaseMainId,
                UserId,
                OrgSectionId
            )
            SELECT
                CaseMainId,
                StickyUserId,
                StickySectionId
            FROM #StickyPlan;
        END;

        /* =========================================================
           14. จัดกลุ่มคดีที่ต้องเข้า Round Robin ตาม CIF

           1 CIF = 1 คิว Round Robin
           ดังนั้นทุก CaseMainId ที่ CIF เดียวกันจะได้ทนายคนเดียวกัน
           ========================================================= */
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#RRGroups') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #RRGroups;

        ;WITH PendingGroups AS
        (
            SELECT
                i.AssignmentKey,
                MIN(ISNULL(i.CreateDate, '19000101')) AS FirstCreateDate,
                MIN(i.CaseMainId) AS FirstCaseMainId
            FROM #ProjectIdentity i
            WHERE i.StickyUserId IS NULL
            GROUP BY i.AssignmentKey
        )
        SELECT
            CAST
            (
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER
                (
                    ORDER BY
                        g.FirstCreateDate,
                        g.FirstCaseMainId,
                        g.AssignmentKey
                )
                AS INT
            ) AS RN,
            g.AssignmentKey
        INTO #RRGroups
        FROM PendingGroups g;

        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ProjectsRR') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #ProjectsRR;

        SELECT
            g.RN,
            i.CaseMainId,
            i.CIFNo,
            i.AssignmentKey
        INTO #ProjectsRR
        FROM #ProjectIdentity i
        INNER JOIN #RRGroups g
            ON g.AssignmentKey = i.AssignmentKey
        WHERE i.StickyUserId IS NULL;

        /* ถ้าทุกคดีเป็น Sticky ไม่ต้องขยับ Cursor */
        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM #RRGroups
        )
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                @ConditionAssignLawyerId AS ConditionAssignLawyerId,
                @LawOfficeYearId AS LawOfficeYearId,
                (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #Projects) AS TotalQueued,
                (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #StickyAssigned) AS StickyAssigned,
                0 AS RRAssigned,
                0 AS RRGroupAssigned,
                @StoredCursorLastSeq AS CursorLastSeqBefore,
                @StoredCursorLastSeq AS CursorLastSeqAfter,
                @DryRun AS IsDryRun;

            SELECT
                UserId,
                COUNT(*) AS AssignedCount
            FROM #StickyAssigned
            WHERE UserId IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY UserId
            ORDER BY UserId;

            SELECT
                sticky.CaseMainId,
                projectIdentity.CIFNo,
                projectIdentity.AssignmentKey,
                N'STICKY_CIF' AS AssignmentSource,
                sticky.UserId,
                sticky.OrgSectionId
            FROM #StickyAssigned sticky
            INNER JOIN #ProjectIdentity projectIdentity
                ON projectIdentity.CaseMainId = sticky.CaseMainId
            ORDER BY
                projectIdentity.AssignmentKey,
                sticky.CaseMainId;

            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            RETURN;
        END;

        /* =========================================================
           15. สร้างลำดับ Round Robin ตาม Round และ Quantity
           ========================================================= */
        SELECT
            @MaxTally =
                MAX
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN RoundCnt > QtyPerRound
                            THEN RoundCnt
                        ELSE QtyPerRound
                    END
                )
        FROM #Detail;

        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#UnitsOrdered') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #UnitsOrdered;

        ;WITH Tally AS
        (
            SELECT 1 AS NumberValue

            UNION ALL

            SELECT NumberValue + 1
            FROM Tally
            WHERE NumberValue < @MaxTally
        ),
        DetailRounds AS
        (
            SELECT
                d.DetailId,
                d.Priority,
                t.NumberValue AS RoundIndex
            FROM #Detail d
            INNER JOIN Tally t
                ON t.NumberValue <= d.RoundCnt
        ),
        Units AS
        (
            SELECT
                dr.RoundIndex,
                dr.Priority,
                op.DetailId,
                op.LawOfficeId,
                op.UserId,
                op.OfficePos,
                qty.NumberValue AS QtyIndex
            FROM DetailRounds dr
            INNER JOIN #OfficePos op
                ON op.DetailId = dr.DetailId
            INNER JOIN #Detail d
                ON d.DetailId = dr.DetailId
            INNER JOIN Tally qty
                ON qty.NumberValue <= d.QtyPerRound
            WHERE op.UserId IS NOT NULL
        )
        SELECT
            u.RoundIndex,
            u.Priority,
            u.DetailId,
            u.LawOfficeId,
            u.UserId,
            u.OfficePos,
            u.QtyIndex,
            CAST
            (
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER
                (
                    ORDER BY
                        u.RoundIndex ASC,
                        u.Priority ASC,
                        u.OfficePos ASC,
                        u.QtyIndex ASC,
                        u.LawOfficeId ASC
                )
                AS INT
            ) AS SeqNo
        INTO #UnitsOrdered
        FROM Units u
        OPTION (MAXRECURSION 0);

        SELECT
            @UnitCount = COUNT(*)
        FROM #UnitsOrdered;

        IF ISNULL(@UnitCount, 0) = 0
        BEGIN
            THROW 50010,
                  N'ไม่พบสำนักงานทนายที่มีผู้จัดการสำหรับทำ Round Robin',
                  1;
        END;

        /* =========================================================
           16. ปรับ Cursor กรณีจำนวนลำดับเปลี่ยน
           ========================================================= */
        SET @EffectiveCursorLastSeq = @StoredCursorLastSeq;

        IF @EffectiveCursorLastSeq > @UnitCount
        BEGIN
            SET @EffectiveCursorLastSeq =
                @EffectiveCursorLastSeq % @UnitCount;
        END;

        /* =========================================================
           17. จับคู่กลุ่ม CIF กับ Round Robin

           CursorLastSeq เก็บลำดับล่าสุดที่เคยแจก
           กลุ่ม CIF ถัดไปจึงเริ่มจากลำดับถัดไป
           ========================================================= */
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#PlanRR') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #PlanRR;

        SELECT
            rrGroup.RN,
            rrGroup.AssignmentKey,
            rrPosition.TargetSeq AS SeqNo,
            unit.UserId,
            unit.LawOfficeId,
            unit.DetailId
        INTO #PlanRR
        FROM #RRGroups rrGroup
        CROSS APPLY
        (
            SELECT
                CAST
                (
                    (
                        (
                            @EffectiveCursorLastSeq
                            + rrGroup.RN
                            - 1
                        ) % @UnitCount
                    ) + 1
                    AS INT
                ) AS TargetSeq
        ) rrPosition
        INNER JOIN #UnitsOrdered unit
            ON unit.SeqNo = rrPosition.TargetSeq;

        /* =========================================================
           18. อัปเดต Round Robin
           ========================================================= */
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#RRAssigned') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #RRAssigned;

        SELECT TOP (0)
            p.CaseMainId,
            CAST(0 AS INT) AS UserId,
            CAST(NULL AS INT) AS OrgSectionId
        INTO #RRAssigned
        FROM #Projects p;

        IF @DryRun = 0
        BEGIN
            /* อัปเดตคดีหลัก */
            UPDATE caseMain
            SET
                caseMain.LawOfficeUserId = rrPlan.UserId,
                caseMain.LawOfficeSectionId = userSection.OrgSectionId
            OUTPUT
                inserted.CaseMainId,
                inserted.LawOfficeUserId,
                inserted.LawOfficeSectionId
            INTO #RRAssigned
            (
                CaseMainId,
                UserId,
                OrgSectionId
            )
            FROM dbo.LTDataCaseMain caseMain
            INNER JOIN #ProjectsRR project
                ON project.CaseMainId = caseMain.CaseMainId
            INNER JOIN #PlanRR rrPlan
                ON rrPlan.RN = project.RN
            LEFT JOIN #UserSection userSection
                ON userSection.UserId = rrPlan.UserId
            WHERE caseMain.LawOfficeUserId IS NULL;

            /* อัปเดต Section ในลูกหนี้ */
            UPDATE debtor
            SET
                debtor.LawOfficeSectionId = assigned.OrgSectionId
            FROM dbo.LTDataCaseMainDebtor debtor
            INNER JOIN #RRAssigned assigned
                ON assigned.CaseMainId = debtor.CaseMainId;

            /* อัปเดต AssignCase */
            UPDATE assignCase
            SET
                assignCase.LawOfficeUserId = assigned.UserId,
                assignCase.IsAssignLawOffice = 1
            FROM dbo.LTDataAssignCase assignCase
            INNER JOIN #RRAssigned assigned
                ON assigned.CaseMainId = assignCase.CaseMainId
            WHERE assigned.UserId IS NOT NULL;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO #RRAssigned
            (
                CaseMainId,
                UserId,
                OrgSectionId
            )
            SELECT
                project.CaseMainId,
                rrPlan.UserId,
                userSection.OrgSectionId
            FROM #ProjectsRR project
            INNER JOIN #PlanRR rrPlan
                ON rrPlan.RN = project.RN
            LEFT JOIN #UserSection userSection
                ON userSection.UserId = rrPlan.UserId;
        END;

        /* =========================================================
           19. คำนวณ Cursor หลังประมวลผล

           Cursor ขยับตามจำนวนกลุ่ม CIF ที่แจกจริง
           ไม่ใช่จำนวน CaseMainId
           ========================================================= */
        SELECT
            @RRAssignedCount = COUNT(*)
        FROM #RRAssigned;

        SELECT
            @RRGroupAssignedCount = COUNT(*)
        FROM
        (
            SELECT DISTINCT
                project.RN
            FROM #RRAssigned assigned
            INNER JOIN #ProjectsRR project
                ON project.CaseMainId = assigned.CaseMainId
        ) assignedGroup;

        SET @CursorAfter = @EffectiveCursorLastSeq;

        IF @RRGroupAssignedCount > 0
        BEGIN
            SET @CursorAfter =
                (
                    (
                        @EffectiveCursorLastSeq
                        + @RRGroupAssignedCount
                        - 1
                    ) % @UnitCount
                ) + 1;
        END;

        /* =========================================================
           20. บันทึก CursorLastSeq

           DryRun จะไม่บันทึก Cursor
           ========================================================= */
        IF @DryRun = 0
           AND @RRGroupAssignedCount > 0
        BEGIN
            UPDATE dbo.SystemLawOfficeScoreMaster
            SET
                CursorLastSeq = @CursorAfter,
                UpdateDate = GETDATE()
            WHERE LawOfficeYearId = @LawOfficeYearId
              AND ISNULL(IsCursorRow, 0) = 1;
        END;

        /* =========================================================
           21. สรุปผล
           ========================================================= */
        SELECT
            @ConditionAssignLawyerId AS ConditionAssignLawyerId,
            @LawOfficeYearId AS LawOfficeYearId,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #Projects) AS TotalQueued,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #StickyAssigned) AS StickyAssigned,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #RRAssigned) AS RRAssigned,
            @RRGroupAssignedCount AS RRGroupAssigned,
            @UnitCount AS TotalRoundRobinUnits,
            @StoredCursorLastSeq AS CursorLastSeqBefore,
            @EffectiveCursorLastSeq AS EffectiveCursorBefore,
            @CursorAfter AS CursorLastSeqAfter,
            @DryRun AS IsDryRun;

        /* จำนวนคดีที่ทนายแต่ละคนได้รับ */
        SELECT
            result.UserId,
            COUNT(*) AS AssignedCount
        FROM
        (
            SELECT
                UserId
            FROM #StickyAssigned

            UNION ALL

            SELECT
                UserId
            FROM #RRAssigned
        ) result
        WHERE result.UserId IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY result.UserId
        ORDER BY result.UserId;

        /* รายละเอียดการจัดสรร */
        SELECT
            sticky.CaseMainId,
            projectIdentity.CIFNo,
            projectIdentity.AssignmentKey,
            N'STICKY_CIF' AS AssignmentSource,
            sticky.UserId,
            sticky.OrgSectionId,
            CAST(NULL AS INT) AS QueueRN,
            CAST(NULL AS INT) AS RoundRobinSeq
        FROM #StickyAssigned sticky
        INNER JOIN #ProjectIdentity projectIdentity
            ON projectIdentity.CaseMainId = sticky.CaseMainId

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            assigned.CaseMainId,
            project.CIFNo,
            project.AssignmentKey,
            N'ROUND_ROBIN_CIF' AS AssignmentSource,
            assigned.UserId,
            assigned.OrgSectionId,
            project.RN AS QueueRN,
            rrPlan.SeqNo AS RoundRobinSeq
        FROM #RRAssigned assigned
        INNER JOIN #ProjectsRR project
            ON project.CaseMainId = assigned.CaseMainId
        INNER JOIN #PlanRR rrPlan
            ON rrPlan.RN = project.RN

        ORDER BY
            AssignmentKey,
            AssignmentSource,
            QueueRN,
            CaseMainId;

        /* สำนักงานที่ไม่มีผู้จัดการ */
        SELECT
            officePosition.DetailId,
            officePosition.LawOfficeId,
            officeUser.OrgSectionId
        FROM #OfficePos officePosition
        LEFT JOIN #OfficeUser officeUser
            ON officeUser.LawOfficeId = officePosition.LawOfficeId
        WHERE officePosition.UserId IS NULL
        ORDER BY
            officePosition.DetailId,
            officePosition.LawOfficeId;

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
        BEGIN
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        END;

        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_LT_008_AssignLegalExpensesRoundRobin]
(
    @DryRun BIT = 0   -- 0 = Update จริง, 1 = ทดลอง
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    DECLARE @LockResult INT;
    DECLARE @NextPos INT;
    DECLARE @UserCount INT;
    DECLARE @AssignedCount INT = 0;
    DECLARE @NextPosAfter INT;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRAN;

        /* =========================================================
           A) กันการรันซ้อน
           ========================================================= */
        EXEC @LockResult = sys.sp_getapplock
             @Resource    = N'LT_Legal_Expense_RR'
           , @LockMode    = N'Exclusive'
           , @LockOwner   = N'Transaction'
           , @LockTimeout = 30000
           , @DbPrincipal = N'public';

        IF (@LockResult < 0)
        BEGIN
            RAISERROR(N'Could not acquire application lock (LT_Legal_Expense_RR).', 16, 1);
            ROLLBACK;
            RETURN;
        END

        /* =========================================================
           B) Sync Pool จาก DataPersonalInfo
              เงื่อนไขที่ถือว่าใช้งานได้:
              - OrgSectionId = 43
              - IsActive = 1
           ========================================================= */

        /* B.1) เพิ่ม user ใหม่ที่ยังไม่มีใน LT_LegalExpenseRRUser */
        ;WITH EligibleUser AS
        (
            SELECT DISTINCT dpi.UserId
            FROM dbo.DataPersonalInfo dpi WITH (READCOMMITTED)
            WHERE dpi.UserId IS NOT NULL
              AND dpi.UserId <> 0
              AND dpi.OrgSectionId = 43
              AND dpi.IsActive = 1
							AND dpi.IsManager = 0
        ),
        MissingUser AS
        (
            SELECT eu.UserId
            FROM EligibleUser eu
            LEFT JOIN dbo.LT_LegalExpenseRRUser rr WITH (READCOMMITTED)
                   ON rr.UserId = eu.UserId
            WHERE rr.UserId IS NULL
        ),
        NewUserSeq AS
        (
            SELECT
                mu.UserId,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY mu.UserId) AS RN
            FROM MissingUser mu
        )
        INSERT INTO dbo.LT_LegalExpenseRRUser
        (
            UserId,
            UserPos,
            IsActive,
            UpdateDate
        )
        SELECT
            nus.UserId,
            ISNULL(
                (
                    SELECT MAX(x.UserPos)
                    FROM dbo.LT_LegalExpenseRRUser x WITH (READCOMMITTED)
                ), 0
            ) + nus.RN AS UserPos,
            1 AS IsActive,
            GETDATE() AS UpdateDate
        FROM NewUserSeq nus;

        /* B.2) ปิด user ที่ไม่เข้าเงื่อนไขแล้ว
                 - OrgSectionId <> 43
                 - หรือ IsActive = 0
                 - หรือไม่มีใน DataPersonalInfo
        */
        ;WITH EligibleUser AS
        (
            SELECT DISTINCT dpi.UserId
            FROM dbo.DataPersonalInfo dpi WITH (READCOMMITTED)
            WHERE dpi.UserId IS NOT NULL
              AND dpi.UserId <> 0
              AND dpi.OrgSectionId = 43
              AND dpi.IsActive = 1
							AND dpi.IsManager = 0
        )
        UPDATE rr
           SET rr.IsActive   = 0,
               rr.UpdateDate = GETDATE()
        FROM dbo.LT_LegalExpenseRRUser rr
        LEFT JOIN EligibleUser eu
               ON eu.UserId = rr.UserId
        WHERE rr.IsActive = 1
          AND eu.UserId IS NULL;

        /* B.3) เปิดกลับ ถ้า user เดิมกลับมาเข้าเงื่อนไขอีกครั้ง */
        ;WITH EligibleUser AS
(
    SELECT DISTINCT dpi.UserId
    FROM dbo.DataPersonalInfo dpi WITH (READCOMMITTED)
    WHERE dpi.UserId IS NOT NULL
      AND dpi.UserId <> 0
      AND dpi.OrgSectionId = 43
      AND dpi.IsActive = 1
      AND ISNULL(dpi.IsManager, 0) = 0
)
UPDATE rr
   SET rr.IsActive   = 1,
       rr.UpdateDate = GETDATE()
FROM dbo.LT_LegalExpenseRRUser rr
INNER JOIN EligibleUser eu
        ON eu.UserId = rr.UserId
WHERE rr.IsActive = 0;

        /* =========================================================
           C) ตรวจว่ามี state row หรือยัง
           ========================================================= */
        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.LT_LegalExpenseRRState WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
            WHERE StateKey = 'LEGAL_EXPENSE'
        )
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO dbo.LT_LegalExpenseRRState
            (
                StateKey,
                NextUserPos,
                UpdateDate
            )
            VALUES
            (
                'LEGAL_EXPENSE',
                1,
                GETDATE()
            );
        END

        /* =========================================================
           D) สร้าง active pool แบบ dynamic sequence
              ใช้ ROW_NUMBER ใหม่ทุกครั้ง เพื่อกันปัญหา UserPos ขาดช่วง
           ========================================================= */
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ActiveUser','U') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #ActiveUser;

        SELECT
    rr.UserId,
    rr.UserPos,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY rr.UserPos, rr.UserId) AS ActiveSeq
INTO #ActiveUser
FROM dbo.LT_LegalExpenseRRUser rr WITH (READCOMMITTED)
INNER JOIN dbo.DataPersonalInfo dpi WITH (READCOMMITTED)
        ON dpi.UserId = rr.UserId
WHERE rr.IsActive = 1
  AND dpi.OrgSectionId = 43
  AND dpi.IsActive = 1
  AND ISNULL(dpi.IsManager, 0) = 0;

        SELECT @UserCount = COUNT(*)
        FROM #ActiveUser;

        IF (@UserCount IS NULL OR @UserCount = 0)
        BEGIN
            RAISERROR(N'No active users found in dbo.LT_LegalExpenseRRUser.', 16, 1);
            ROLLBACK;
            RETURN;
        END

        /* =========================================================
           E) อ่าน pointer
           ========================================================= */
        SELECT @NextPos = NextUserPos
        FROM dbo.LT_LegalExpenseRRState WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
        WHERE StateKey = 'LEGAL_EXPENSE';

        IF (@NextPos IS NULL OR @NextPos < 1)
            SET @NextPos = 1;

        /* ปรับให้ pointer อยู่ในช่วง 1..@UserCount เสมอ */
        SET @NextPos = ((@NextPos - 1) % @UserCount) + 1;

        /* =========================================================
           F) ดึงงาน 1 รายการเท่านั้น
           ========================================================= */
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Pending','U') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #Pending;

        SELECT TOP (1)
               e.CaseExpenseId,
               e.CreateDate
        INTO #Pending
        FROM dbo.LTDataCaseExpense e WITH (READPAST)
        WHERE (e.LegalUserId IS NULL OR e.LegalUserId = 0)
          AND e.StatusCaseExpenseId = 188
        ORDER BY ISNULL(e.CreateDate, '1900-01-01'),
                 e.CaseExpenseId;

        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #Pending)
        BEGIN
            SELECT
                CAST(0 AS INT) AS TotalQueued,
                CAST(0 AS INT) AS Assigned,
                @DryRun         AS IsDryRun,
                @NextPos        AS NextUserPos_Before,
                @NextPos        AS NextUserPos_After;

            COMMIT;
            RETURN;
        END

        /* =========================================================
           G) วางแผน assign ตามลำดับ pointer ปัจจุบัน
           ========================================================= */
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Plan','U') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #Plan;

        SELECT
            p.CaseExpenseId,
            au.UserId,
            au.ActiveSeq
        INTO #Plan
        FROM #Pending p
        INNER JOIN #ActiveUser au
                ON au.ActiveSeq = @NextPos;

        /* =========================================================
           H) เก็บผลลัพธ์
           ========================================================= */
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Assigned','U') IS NOT NULL
            DROP TABLE #Assigned;

        CREATE TABLE #Assigned
        (
            CaseExpenseId NVARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
            UserId INT NOT NULL
        );

        /* =========================================================
           I) Update จริง / DryRun
           ========================================================= */
        IF (@DryRun = 0)
        BEGIN
            UPDATE e
               SET e.LegalUserId = p.UserId,
                   e.UpdateDate  = GETDATE()
            OUTPUT inserted.CaseExpenseId, inserted.LegalUserId
              INTO #Assigned (CaseExpenseId, UserId)
            FROM dbo.LTDataCaseExpense e
            INNER JOIN #Plan p
                    ON p.CaseExpenseId = e.CaseExpenseId
            WHERE (e.LegalUserId IS NULL OR e.LegalUserId = 0)
              AND e.StatusCaseExpenseId = 188;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO #Assigned (CaseExpenseId, UserId)
            SELECT
                p.CaseExpenseId,
                p.UserId
            FROM #Plan p;
        END

        SELECT @AssignedCount = COUNT(*)
        FROM #Assigned;

        /* =========================================================
           J) ขยับ pointer
              ถ้า assign ได้ 1 รายการ:
              1->2, 2->3, ... , N->1
           ========================================================= */
        SET @NextPosAfter = ((@NextPos - 1 + @AssignedCount) % @UserCount) + 1;

        IF (@DryRun = 0)
        BEGIN
            UPDATE dbo.LT_LegalExpenseRRState
               SET NextUserPos = @NextPosAfter,
                   UpdateDate  = GETDATE()
            WHERE StateKey = 'LEGAL_EXPENSE';
        END

        /* =========================================================
           K) Result
           ========================================================= */
        SELECT
            CAST(1 AS INT)     AS TotalQueued,
            @AssignedCount     AS Assigned,
            @DryRun            AS IsDryRun,
            @NextPos           AS NextUserPos_Before,
            @NextPosAfter      AS NextUserPos_After;

        SELECT
            a.UserId,
            COUNT(*) AS AssignedCount
        FROM #Assigned a
        GROUP BY a.UserId
        ORDER BY a.UserId;

        SELECT
            a.CaseExpenseId,
            a.UserId
        FROM #Assigned a
        ORDER BY a.CaseExpenseId;

        COMMIT;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
            ROLLBACK;

        DECLARE @ErrMsg NVARCHAR(4000) = ERROR_MESSAGE();
        RAISERROR(N'SP_LT_008_AssignLegalExpensesRoundRobin failed: %s', 16, 1, @ErrMsg);
    END CATCH
END

create PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_LT_009_UpdateExpirationDate]

AS
BEGIN
    --select * from ACCDataConfirmClosingAccount
--order by CIFNo


declare @StartDate date 
select 
@StartDate = case when isnull(c.CurrentPaymentDate,'1900-01-01') = '1900-01-01' then c.ClaimPayDate else c.CurrentPaymentDate end



from LTDataAssignCase ac
left join DataDebtorCard c on c.DebtorRelateId = ac.DebtorRelateId
left join DataDebtorRelate r on r.DebtorRelateId = c.DebtorRelateId

Update LTDataAssignCase
set ExpirationDate = dateadd(year, 10, @StartDate)

where StatusId in (215, 218)
END
