CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_ACC_08_SummaryClaimPay_Backup]
	    -- บังคับ
 @StartDate date = '2025-09-01'
,@EndDate date = '2025-09-30'
,@ClaimPayTypeId int  =0

--https://119.59.117.171:44398/ReportViewer?report=RP_ACC_08_SummaryClaimPay&StartDate=2024-09-18&EndDate=2025-09-19&ClaimPayTypeId=1	
	
AS
BEGIN
set @StartDate = case when year(@StartDate) > 2400 then dateadd(year, -543, @StartDate) else @StartDate end
set @EndDate =  case when year(@EndDate) > 2400 then dateadd(year, -543, @EndDate) else @EndDate end


 SELECT 
     
     r.CIFNo AS DebtorCode                                               --รหัสลูกหนี้
     ,r.LGNo AS GuaranteeLetterNo                                        --เลขที่หนังสือค้ำประกัน
     ,t.TitleShortName AS DebtorNameShort                                     --คำนำหน้า
     ,d.FirstName + ' ' + isnull(LastName,'') AS DebtorFullName          --รายชื่อลูกหนี้
     ,b.BankAbbrName AS Lender    --,b.BankName AS Lender                -- ผู้ให้กู้
     ,dbo.[Fn_FormatDate](lg.ClaimDate) AS PaymentDate                      --วันที่จ่าย
	 ,lg.ClaimDate as ClaimDateSoryOrder
     ,lg.ClaimAmountCurrent AS GuaranteeLiability                   --ภาระค้ำประกัน
     ,m.CFPrincipalTotal AS Principal                                --เงินต้น (1)
     ,m.CFAccruedInterestTotal AS Interest                            --ดอกเบี้ย (2)
     ,m.CFDebtBalance AS TotalAmount                              --รวม (1)+(2)
     ,c.ClaimTypeName AS GuaranteeType                                   --ประเภทการค้ำประกัน
     ,sc.ClaimSubTypeName AS GuaranteeSubType                            --ประเภทการค้ำย่อย
 	,dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(@StartDate) + ' - ' +  dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(@EndDate) AS MonthSelect  --MonthSelect
 	, N'วันที่พิมพ์ : ' + dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(getdate()) as PrintDate
 	, N'ผู้สั่งพิมพ์ : '+ null as PrintName
 	From ACCDataMonthlyReport m 
	left join DataDebtorRelate r on r.DebtorId = m.DebtorId and m.LGNo = r.LGNo and r.DebtorTypeId = 1
 	left join DataDebtor d on r.DebtorId = d.DebtorId
 	left join SystemTitleMaster t on t.TitleId = d.TitleId
 	left join DataLG lg on lg.LGNo = r.LGNo
 	left join SystemBankMaster b on b.BankId = lg.BankId
 	left join SystemClaimTypeMaster c on c.ClaimTypeId = lg.ClaimTypeId
 	left join SystemClaimSubTypeMaster sc on sc.ClaimSubTypeId = lg.ClaimSubTypeId
 	where cast(m.AsOfDate as date) = cast(@EndDate as date)
  --         --and cast(lg.ClaimDate as date) between @StartDate and @EndDate

modules.definition:
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_ACC_08_SummaryClaimPay_before_upgate]
    -- บังคับ
    @StartDate       DATE,
    @EndDate         DATE,
    -- ไม่บังคับ
    @DebtorCode      NVARCHAR(20)  = 'null',
    @LGNo            NVARCHAR(20)  = 'null',
    @ClaimPayTypeId  INT           = 0,
    @PrintUserId     INT           = 1
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- ISNULL safety
    SET @DebtorCode     = ISNULL(@DebtorCode, 'null');
    SET @LGNo           = ISNULL(@LGNo, 'null');
    SET @ClaimPayTypeId = ISNULL(@ClaimPayTypeId, 0);
    SET @PrintUserId    = ISNULL(@PrintUserId, 1);

    -- BE → CE
    SET @StartDate = CASE WHEN YEAR(@StartDate) > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @StartDate) ELSE @StartDate END;
    SET @EndDate   = CASE WHEN YEAR(@EndDate)   > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @EndDate)   ELSE @EndDate   END;

    -- ข้อมูล ณ วันพิมพ์ (พ.ศ.)
    DECLARE @DataAsOf NVARCHAR(20) = CAST(YEAR(GETDATE()) + 543 AS NVARCHAR(4))
                                  + RIGHT('0' + CAST(MONTH(GETDATE()) AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2)
                                  + RIGHT('0' + CAST(DAY(GETDATE()) AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2);

    SELECT
        -- (1) ข้อมูล ณ วัน
        @DataAsOf AS DataAsOf,
        -- (2) รหัส CIF
        r.CIFNo AS CIFCode,
        -- (3) รหัส LG
        r.LGNo AS LGNumber,
        -- (4) ชื่อลูกหนี้
        dbo.FN_DCS_16_GetDebtorName(r.DebtorId) AS DebtorName,
        -- (5) วันที่จ่ายค่าประกันชดเชย
        dbo.Fn_FormatDate(lg.ClaimDate) AS ClaimPayDate,
        -- (6) ยอดจ่ายค่าประกันชดเชย
        ISNULL(lg.ClaimPayAmount, 0) AS ClaimPayAmount,
        -- (7) ภาระหนี้คงเหลือ (เงินต้น + ดอกเบี้ย)
        ISNULL(dc.PrincipalTotal, 0) + ISNULL(dc.AccruedInterestTotal, 0) AS OutstandingDebt,
        -- (8) เงินต้นคงเหลือ
        ISNULL(dc.PrincipalTotal, 0) AS PrincipalBalance,
        -- (9) ดอกเบี้ยคงเหลือ
        ISNULL(dc.AccruedInterestTotal, 0) AS InterestBalance,
        -- (10) เจ้าหน้าที่ผู้ดูแล
        CASE
            WHEN a.TypeAssignId = 1 THEN dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(a.CollectorUserId)
            WHEN a.TypeAssignId = 2 AND a.CollectorOAUserId != 0 THEN dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(a.CollectorOAUserId)
            WHEN a.TypeAssignId = 2 AND a.CollectorOAUserId = 0 THEN N'รอจ่ายงาน OA'
        END AS OfficerName,
        -- (11) ฝ่ายติดตามหนี้
        CASE
            WHEN a.TypeAssignId = 1 THEN dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG(a.CollectorUserId, 2)
            WHEN a.TypeAssignId = 2 AND a.CollectorOAUserId != 0 THEN dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG(a.CollectorOAUserId, 2)
            WHEN a.TypeAssignId = 2 AND a.CollectorOAUserId = 0 THEN N'OA'
        END AS Department,
        -- (12) ทีมติดตามหนี้
        CASE
            WHEN a.TypeAssignId = 1 THEN dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG(a.CollectorUserId, 3)
            WHEN a.TypeAssignId = 2 AND a.CollectorOAUserId != 0 THEN dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG(a.CollectorOAUserId, 3)
            WHEN a.TypeAssignId = 2 AND a.CollectorOAUserId = 0 THEN N'OA'
        END AS Team,
        -- (13) สัดส่วน% = เงินต้นคงเหลือ / ยอดจ่ายเคลม * 100
        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(lg.ClaimPayAmount, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(ISNULL(dc.PrincipalTotal, 0) / lg.ClaimPayAmount * 100, 2)
        END AS PrincipalRatio,
        -- (14) สัดส่วนเงินต้น+ดอกเบี้ย / ยอดจ่ายเคลม * 100
        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(lg.ClaimPayAmount, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND((ISNULL(dc.PrincipalTotal, 0) + ISNULL(dc.AccruedInterestTotal, 0)) / lg.ClaimPayAmount * 100, 2)
        END AS PrincipalInterestRatio,
        -- footer
        N'วันที่พิมพ์ : ' + dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(GETDATE()) AS PrintDate,
        N'ผู้สั่งพิมพ์ : ' + ISNULL(dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(@PrintUserId), N'') AS PrintName
    FROM DataDebtorRelate r
    LEFT JOIN DataLG lg ON lg.LGNo = r.LGNo
    LEFT JOIN DataDebtorCard dc ON dc.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN DataAssignment a ON a.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId
    WHERE r.DebtorTypeId = 1
      AND lg.ClaimDate IS NOT NULL
      AND CAST(lg.ClaimDate AS DATE) >= @StartDate
      AND CAST(lg.ClaimDate AS DATE) <= @EndDate
      AND (@DebtorCode = 'null' OR r.CIFNo = @DebtorCode OR r.DebtorCode = @DebtorCode)
      AND (@LGNo = 'null' OR r.LGNo = @LGNo)
      AND (@ClaimPayTypeId = 0 OR lg.ClaimTypeId = @ClaimPayTypeId)
    ORDER BY lg.ClaimDate, r.CIFNo, r.LGNo;
END

modules.name: SP_RP_ACC_09_DebtorCardAdjustment
modules.definition:
-- =============================================
-- Author:      <Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description: รายงานการปรับปรุงข้อมูลการ์ดลูกหนี้
--              - TypeId 3,8 เลือก SeqNo สูงสุด
--              - Group ผลลัพธ์ตาม LG
--              - SUM ช่องจำนวนเงิน
--              - PrincipalBalanceCarriedForward
--                1. เลือก PayDate ต่ำสุด
--                2. ถ้าวันเดียวกันมีหลายรายการ เลือกยอดต่ำสุด
--                3. ไม่เอา TypeId 3,8 มาพิจารณา
--              - AdjustmentStartDate ใช้ PayDate ต่ำสุดของ LG
--              - AdjustmentStartDateSort เก็บ Date จริงสำหรับ Sort Report
-- =============================================

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_ACC_09_DebtorCardAdjustment]

     @StartDate       DATE = '2569-08-01'
    ,@EndDate         DATE = '2569-08-31'
    ,@ClaimPayTypeId  INT  = 0

AS
BEGIN

    SET NOCOUNT ON;


    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Convert พ.ศ. -> ค.ศ.
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    SET @StartDate =
        CASE
            WHEN YEAR(@StartDate) > 2400
                THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @StartDate)
            ELSE @StartDate
        END;


    SET @EndDate =
        CASE
            WHEN YEAR(@EndDate) > 2400
                THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @EndDate)
            ELSE @EndDate
        END;


    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- ผู้พิมพ์รายงาน
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    DECLARE @PrintBy INT = 284;


    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- ลบ Temp เดิม
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TempAdjustment') IS NOT NULL
        DROP TABLE #TempAdjustment;


    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- TypeId 3,8
    -- เลือก SeqNo สูงสุดของแต่ละ DebtorCard
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    ;WITH CTE_Type38 AS
    (
        SELECT
             m.SeqNo
            ,m.DebtorCardId
            ,m.TypeId
            ,m.DocDate
            ,m.PayDate
            ,m.PrincipalTotal

            ,r.CIFNo
            ,r.LGNo
            ,r.DebtorId

            ,cd.MeasureDate
            ,cd.ClaimPayDate
            ,'' AS MeasureName

            ,c.ClaimTypeId
            ,c.ClaimTypeName

            ,sc.ClaimSubTypeName

            ,ISNULL(sc.ERPCode, c.ERPCode)
                AS ERPProductCode


            ----------------------------------------------------
            -- SeqNo สูงสุดต่อ DebtorCard
            ----------------------------------------------------
            ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER
            (
                PARTITION BY m.DebtorCardId
                ORDER BY m.SeqNo DESC
            ) AS RN


        FROM DataDebtorCardMovement m

        LEFT JOIN DataDebtorCard cd
            ON cd.DataDebtorCardId = m.DebtorCardId

        LEFT JOIN DataDebtorRelate r
            ON r.DebtorRelateId = cd.DebtorRelateId

        LEFT JOIN DataLG lg
            ON lg.LGNo = r.LGNo

        LEFT JOIN SystemClaimTypeMaster c
            ON c.ClaimTypeId = lg.ClaimTypeId

        LEFT JOIN SystemClaimSubTypeMaster sc
            ON sc.ClaimSubTypeId = lg.ClaimSubTypeId


        WHERE CAST(m.DocDate AS DATE)
              BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate

          AND
          (
                c.ClaimTypeId = @ClaimPayTypeId
                OR @ClaimPayTypeId = 0
          )

          AND r.DebtorTypeId = 1

          AND m.TypeId IN (3,8)

          AND m.IsAdjust = 1
    )


    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- เอาข้อมูลทั้งหมดลง Temp
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT

         X.TypeId
        ,X.UpdateDate
        ,X.DebtorCode
        ,X.GuaranteeLetterNo
        ,X.DebtorId

        ,X.PrincipalTotal
        ,X.PrincipalPay
        ,X.PrincipalBalanceCarriedForward
        ,X.InterestBalanceCarriedForward
        ,X.AdjustedInterestBalanceCarriedForward

        ,X.AdjustmentAmount
        ,X.PrincipalAdjustment
        ,X.InterestAdjustment
        ,X.AdjustedInterestAdjustment

        ,X.OtherExpensesAdjustment
        ,X.CourtFeeAdjustment
        ,X.LawyerFeeAdjustment
        ,X.DepositAdjustment

        ,X.PrincipalBalanceCarriedForwardOut
        ,X.Difference
        ,X.InterestBalanceCarriedForwardOut
        ,X.AdjustedInterestBalanceCarriedForwardOut
        ,X.InterestAccruedToMonthEnd

        ,X.CampaignDate
        ,X.Campaign
        ,X.GuaranteeType
        ,X.GuaranteeSubType
        ,X.ERPProductCode

        ,X.AdjustmentStartDate


    INTO #TempAdjustment

    FROM
    (

        --------------------------------------------------------
        -- Type อื่น ๆ
        --------------------------------------------------------
        SELECT

             m.TypeId

            ,m.DocDate
                AS UpdateDate

            ,r.CIFNo
                AS DebtorCode

            ,r.LGNo
                AS GuaranteeLetterNo

            ,r.DebtorId


            ----------------------------------------------------
            -- จำนวนเงิน
            ----------------------------------------------------
            ,ISNULL(m.PrincipalTotal,0)
                AS PrincipalTotal


            ,ISNULL(m.PrincipalPay,0)
                AS PrincipalPay


            ----------------------------------------------------
            -- ยอดยกมาเงินต้น
            ----------------------------------------------------
            ,ISNULL(m.PrincipalTotal,0)
                + ISNULL(m.PrincipalPay,0)
                AS PrincipalBalanceCarriedForward


            ,ISNULL(m.AccruedInterestTotal,0)
                AS InterestBalanceCarriedForward


            ,ISNULL(m.DefaultInterestTotal,0)
                - ISNULL(m.DefaultInterestPay,0)
                AS AdjustedInterestBalanceCarriedForward


            ,ISNULL(m.AccruedInterestPay,0)
                + ISNULL(m.PrincipalPay,0)
                AS AdjustmentAmount


            ,ISNULL(m.PrincipalPay,0)
                AS PrincipalAdjustment


            ,ISNULL(m.PlannedInterestPay,0)+ ISNULL(m.DeferredInterestPay,0)+ ISNULL(m.SuspendIntPay,0)
                AS InterestAdjustment


            ,ISNULL(m.DefaultInterestPay,0)
                AS AdjustedInterestAdjustment


            ,CASE
                WHEN m.TypeId = 33
                    THEN m.OtherExpense
                ELSE ISNULL(m.OtherExpensePay,0)
             END
                AS OtherExpensesAdjustment


            ,CASE
                WHEN m.TypeId = 33
                    THEN m.CourtFee
                ELSE ISNULL(m.CourtFeePay,0)
             END
                AS CourtFeeAdjustment


            ,CASE
                WHEN m.TypeId = 33
                    THEN m.LawyerFee
                ELSE ISNULL(m.LawyerFeePay,0)
             END
                AS LawyerFeeAdjustment


            ,CASE
                WHEN m.TypeId = 33
                    THEN m.InitialMargin
                ELSE ISNULL(m.InitialMarginPay,0)
             END
                AS DepositAdjustment


            ----------------------------------------------------
            -- ยอดยกไป
            ----------------------------------------------------
            ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                AS PrincipalBalanceCarriedForwardOut


            ,ISNULL(m.PrincipalTotal,0)
             -
             (
                  ISNULL(m.PrincipalTotal,0)
                + ISNULL(m.PrincipalPay,0)
             )
                AS Difference


            ,ISNULL(m.AccruedInterestTotal,0)
                AS InterestBalanceCarriedForwardOut


            ,ISNULL(m.DefaultInterestTotal,0)
                AS AdjustedInterestBalanceCarriedForwardOut


            ----------------------------------------------------
            -- InterestAccruedToMonthEnd
            -- คำนวณจริงด้าน FINAL RESULT
            ----------------------------------------------------
            ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                AS InterestAccruedToMonthEnd


            ----------------------------------------------------
            -- Campaign
            ----------------------------------------------------
            ,CASE
                WHEN CAST(cd.MeasureDate AS DATE) = '1900-01-01'
                    THEN cd.ClaimPayDate
                ELSE cd.MeasureDate
             END
                AS CampaignDate


            ,CASE
                WHEN m.TypeId = 25
                    THEN N'ปรับปรุงรายการ (ส่วนลดจากการHaircut)'

                WHEN m.TypeId = 20
                    THEN N'ปรับปรุงเงินต้นโครงการรับชำระค่าธรรมเนียมล่วงหน้า'

                ELSE cd.MeasureName
             END
                AS Campaign


            ,c.ClaimTypeName
                AS GuaranteeType


            ,sc.ClaimSubTypeName
                AS GuaranteeSubType


            ,ISNULL(sc.ERPCode, c.ERPCode)
                AS ERPProductCode


            ----------------------------------------------------
            -- PayDate จริง
            ----------------------------------------------------
            ,m.PayDate
                AS AdjustmentStartDate


        FROM DataDebtorCardMovement m

        LEFT JOIN DataDebtorCard cd
            ON cd.DataDebtorCardId = m.DebtorCardId

        LEFT JOIN DataDebtorRelate r
            ON r.DebtorRelateId = cd.DebtorRelateId

        LEFT JOIN DataLG lg
            ON lg.LGNo = r.LGNo

        LEFT JOIN SystemClaimTypeMaster c
            ON c.ClaimTypeId = lg.ClaimTypeId

        LEFT JOIN SystemClaimSubTypeMaster sc
            ON sc.ClaimSubTypeId = lg.ClaimSubTypeId


        WHERE CAST(m.DocDate AS DATE)
              BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate

          AND
          (
                c.ClaimTypeId = @ClaimPayTypeId
                OR @ClaimPayTypeId = 0
          )

          AND r.DebtorTypeId = 1

          AND m.TypeId IN
          (
               4
              ,5
              --,6
              ,7
              ,16
              ,18
              ,20
              ,21
              ,22
              ,23
              --,24
              ,25
              ,27
              --,29
              --,30
              ,31
              ,32
              --,33
          )

          AND m.IsAdjust = 1


        --------------------------------------------------------
        -- TypeId 3,8
        --------------------------------------------------------
        UNION ALL


        SELECT

             m.TypeId

            ,m.DocDate
                AS UpdateDate

            ,m.CIFNo
                AS DebtorCode

            ,m.LGNo
                AS GuaranteeLetterNo

            ,m.DebtorId


            ----------------------------------------------------
            -- ช่องปรับปรุงเป็น 0
            ----------------------------------------------------
            ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                AS PrincipalTotal


            ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                AS PrincipalPay


            ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                AS PrincipalBalanceCarriedForward


            ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                AS InterestBalanceCarriedForward


            ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                AS AdjustedInterestBalanceCarriedForward


            ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                AS AdjustmentAmount


            ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                AS PrincipalAdjustment


            ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                AS InterestAdjustment


            ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                AS AdjustedInterestAdjustment


            ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                AS OtherExpensesAdjustment


            ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                AS CourtFeeAdjustment


            ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                AS LawyerFeeAdjustment


            ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                AS DepositAdjustment


            ----------------------------------------------------
            -- Principal จาก SeqNo ล่าสุด
            ----------------------------------------------------
            ,ISNULL(m.PrincipalTotal,0)
                AS PrincipalBalanceCarriedForwardOut


            ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                AS Difference


            ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                AS InterestBalanceCarriedForwardOut


            ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                AS AdjustedInterestBalanceCarriedForwardOut


            ----------------------------------------------------
            -- InterestAccruedToMonthEnd
            -- คำนวณจริงด้าน FINAL RESULT
            ----------------------------------------------------
            ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                AS InterestAccruedToMonthEnd


            ----------------------------------------------------
            -- Campaign
            ----------------------------------------------------
            ,CASE
                WHEN CAST(m.MeasureDate AS DATE) = '1900-01-01'
                    THEN m.ClaimPayDate
                ELSE m.MeasureDate
             END
                AS CampaignDate


            ,m.MeasureName
                AS Campaign


            ,m.ClaimTypeName
                AS GuaranteeType


            ,m.ClaimSubTypeName
                AS GuaranteeSubType


            ,m.ERPProductCode
                AS ERPProductCode


            ----------------------------------------------------
            -- PayDate จริง
            ----------------------------------------------------
            ,m.PayDate
                AS AdjustmentStartDate


        FROM CTE_Type38 m

        WHERE m.RN = 1

    ) X;


    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- FINAL RESULT
    -- 1 LG = 1 Record
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT

         ROW_NUMBER() OVER
         (
             ORDER BY T.GuaranteeLetterNo
         )
            AS SeqNo


        --------------------------------------------------------
        -- วันที่ปรับปรุง
        --------------------------------------------------------
        ,dbo.Fn_FormatDate(MAX(T.UpdateDate))
            AS UpdateDate


        --------------------------------------------------------
        -- ลูกหนี้
        --------------------------------------------------------
        ,MAX(T.DebtorCode)
            AS DebtorCode


        ,T.GuaranteeLetterNo


        ,dbo.FN_DCS_16_GetDebtorName(MAX(T.DebtorId))
            AS DebtorName


        --------------------------------------------------------
        -- SUM ช่องจำนวนเงิน
        --------------------------------------------------------
        ,SUM(ISNULL(T.PrincipalTotal,0))
            AS PrincipalTotal


        ,SUM(ISNULL(T.PrincipalPay,0))
            AS PrincipalPay


        --------------------------------------------------------
        -- PrincipalBalanceCarriedForward
        -- 1. ไม่เอา TypeId 3,8
        -- 2. เลือก PayDate ต่ำสุดก่อน
        -- 3. ถ้า PayDate เดียวกันมีหลายรายการ
        --    เลือก PrincipalBalanceCarriedForward ต่ำสุด
        --------------------------------------------------------
        ,ISNULL
        (
            (
                SELECT TOP 1

                    ISNULL
                    (
                        T2.PrincipalBalanceCarriedForward,
                        0
                    )

                FROM #TempAdjustment T2

                WHERE T2.GuaranteeLetterNo
                      = T.GuaranteeLetterNo

                  AND T2.TypeId NOT IN (3,8)

                ORDER BY
                     T2.AdjustmentStartDate ASC
                    ,T2.PrincipalBalanceCarriedForward ASC
                    ,T2.UpdateDate ASC
            ),
            0
        )
            AS PrincipalBalanceCarriedForward


        ,SUM(ISNULL(T.InterestBalanceCarriedForward,0))
            AS InterestBalanceCarriedForward


        ,SUM(ISNULL(T.AdjustedInterestBalanceCarriedForward,0))
            AS AdjustedInterestBalanceCarriedForward


        ,SUM(ISNULL(T.AdjustmentAmount,0))
            AS AdjustmentAmount


        ,SUM(ISNULL(T.PrincipalAdjustment,0))
            AS PrincipalAdjustment


        ,SUM(ISNULL(T.InterestAdjustment,0))
            AS InterestAdjustment


        ,SUM(ISNULL(T.AdjustedInterestAdjustment,0))
            AS AdjustedInterestAdjustment


        ,SUM(ISNULL(T.OtherExpensesAdjustment,0))
            AS OtherExpensesAdjustment


        ,SUM(ISNULL(T.CourtFeeAdjustment,0))
            AS CourtFeeAdjustment


        ,SUM(ISNULL(T.LawyerFeeAdjustment,0))
            AS LawyerFeeAdjustment


        ,SUM(ISNULL(T.DepositAdjustment,0))
            AS DepositAdjustment


        ,SUM(ISNULL(T.PrincipalBalanceCarriedForwardOut,0))
            AS PrincipalBalanceCarriedForwardOut


        ,SUM(ISNULL(T.Difference,0))
            AS Difference


        ,SUM(ISNULL(T.InterestBalanceCarriedForwardOut,0))
            AS InterestBalanceCarriedForwardOut


        ,SUM(ISNULL(T.AdjustedInterestBalanceCarriedForwardOut,0))
            AS AdjustedInterestBalanceCarriedForwardOut


        --------------------------------------------------------
        -- InterestAccruedToMonthEnd
        --
        -- 1. เลือกข้อมูลตาม LG
        -- 2. จับกลุ่มตาม DebtorCardId + InterestStartDate
        -- 3. ถ้า InterestStartDate ซ้ำกัน
        --    เลือก SeqNo มากที่สุด
        -- 4. เอา InterimInterest ของ SeqNo นั้น
        -- 5. SUM ทุกช่วงเป็นดอกเบี้ยทั้งเดือน
        --------------------------------------------------------
        ,ISNULL
        (
            (
                SELECT
                    SUM(X.InterimInterest)

                FROM
                (
                    SELECT
                         Y.DebtorCardId
                        ,Y.InterestStartDate
                        ,Y.InterestEndDate
                        ,Y.InterimInterest

                    FROM
                    (
                        SELECT
                             mi.DebtorCardId
                            ,mi.SeqNo

                            ,CAST(mi.InterestStartDate AS DATE)
                                AS InterestStartDate

                            ,CAST(mi.InterestEndDate AS DATE)
                                AS InterestEndDate

                            ,ISNULL(mi.InterimInterest,0)
                                AS InterimInterest


                            ------------------------------------------------
                            -- ถ้า InterestStartDate ซ้ำกัน
                            -- เลือก SeqNo มากที่สุด
                            ------------------------------------------------
                            ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER
                            (
                                PARTITION BY
                                     mi.DebtorCardId
                                    ,CAST(mi.InterestStartDate AS DATE)

                                ORDER BY
                                    mi.SeqNo DESC

                            ) AS RN


                        FROM DataDebtorCardMovement mi

                        INNER JOIN DataDebtorCard dc
                            ON dc.DataDebtorCardId = mi.DebtorCardId

                        INNER JOIN DataDebtorRelate dr
                            ON dr.DebtorRelateId = dc.DebtorRelateId


                        WHERE dr.LGNo = T.GuaranteeLetterNo

                          AND dr.DebtorTypeId = 1

                          AND CAST(mi.InterestStartDate AS DATE)
                              >= @StartDate

                          AND CAST(mi.InterestEndDate AS DATE)
                              <= @EndDate

                    ) Y

                    WHERE Y.RN = 1

                ) X
            ),
            0
        )
            AS InterestAccruedToMonthEnd


        --------------------------------------------------------
        -- Campaign
        --------------------------------------------------------
        ,dbo.Fn_FormatDate(MAX(T.CampaignDate))
            AS CampaignDate


        ,MAX(T.Campaign)
            AS Campaign


        ,MAX(T.GuaranteeType)
            AS GuaranteeType


        ,MAX(T.GuaranteeSubType)
            AS GuaranteeSubType


        ,MAX(T.ERPProductCode)
            AS ERPProductCode


        --------------------------------------------------------
        -- วันที่เริ่มปรับปรุง
        -- ใช้ PayDate ต่ำสุดของ LG
        --------------------------------------------------------
        ,dbo.Fn_FormatDate
        (
            MIN(T.AdjustmentStartDate)
        )
            AS AdjustmentStartDate


        --------------------------------------------------------
        -- PayDate จริง
        -- สำหรับ Sort ใน Report
        --------------------------------------------------------
        ,MIN(T.AdjustmentStartDate)
            AS AdjustmentStartDateSort


        --------------------------------------------------------
        -- ช่วงเดือน
        --------------------------------------------------------
        ,dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@StartDate)
            + ' - '
            + dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@EndDate)
            AS MonthSelect


        --------------------------------------------------------
        -- วันที่พิมพ์
        --------------------------------------------------------
        ,dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(GETDATE())
            AS PrintDate


        --------------------------------------------------------
        -- ผู้พิมพ์
        --------------------------------------------------------
        ,dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(@PrintBy)
            AS PrintBy


    FROM #TempAdjustment T


    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Group ตาม LG
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    GROUP BY
        T.GuaranteeLetterNo


    ORDER BY
        T.GuaranteeLetterNo;


    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Drop Temp
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    DROP TABLE #TempAdjustment;

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_ACC_09_DebtorCardAdjustment_backup]
	    -- บังคับ
 @StartDate date 
,@EndDate date
,@ClaimPayTypeId int  
	
	
AS
BEGIN
set @StartDate = dateadd(year, -543, @StartDate)
set @EndDate = dateadd(year, -543, @EndDate)

SELECT
    1 AS SeqNo, -- ลำดับ
    CONVERT(DATE, '2024-11-29', 111) AS UpdateDate, -- วันที่ปรับปรุง (29/11/2567)
    '5305602' AS DebtorCode, -- รหัสลูกหนี้
    '64080870' AS GuaranteeLetterNo, -- เลขที่หนังสือค้ำประกัน
    N'บริษัท 35 ลายน์ อินโนเวชั่น จำกัด' AS DebtorName, -- รายชื่อลูกหนี้
    2765873.38 AS PrincipalBalanceCarriedForward, -- เงินต้นคงเหลือยกมา
    0.00 AS InterestBalanceCarriedForward, -- ดอกเบี้ยคงเหลือยกมา
    0.00 AS AdjustedInterestBalanceCarriedForward, -- ดอกเบี้ยปรับคงเหลือยกมา
    -113600.24 AS AdjustmentAmount, -- ยอดเงินที่ปรับปรุง
    -74927.32 AS PrincipalAdjustment, -- ปรับปรุงเงินต้น
    -38672.92 AS InterestAdjustment, -- ปรับปรุงดอกเบี้ย
    0.00 AS AdjustedInterestAdjustment, -- ปรับปรุงดอกเบี้ยปรับ
    0.00 AS OtherExpensesAdjustment, -- ปรับปรุงค่าใช้จ่ายอื่นๆ
    0.00 AS CourtFeeAdjustment, -- ปรับปรุงค่าธรรมเนียมศาล
    0.00 AS LawyerFeeAdjustment, -- ปรับปรุงค่าทนายความ
    0.00 AS DepositAdjustment, -- ปรับปรุงเงินวางประกัน
    2727200.46 AS PrincipalBalanceCarriedForwardOut, -- เงินต้นคงเหลือยกไป
    -38672.92 AS Difference, -- ผลต่าง
    38672.92 AS InterestBalanceCarriedForwardOut, -- ดอกเบี้ยคงเหลือยกไป
    0.00 AS AdjustedInterestBalanceCarriedForwardOut, -- ดอกเบี้ยปรับคงเหลือยกไป
    17533.07 AS InterestAccruedToMonthEnd, -- คิดดอกเบี้ยคงเหลือถึง ณ สิ้นเดือน
    CONVERT(DATE, '2024-11-25', 111) AS CampaignDate, -- วันที่ Campaign
    N'มาตรการ 3 ลูกหนี้ดีมีวินัย 2567' AS Campaign, -- Campaign
    N'พ.ร.ก. สินเชื่อฟื้นฟู ระยะที่ 1 กลุ่ม Micro & SMEs' AS GuaranteeType, -- ประเภทการค้ำประกัน
    N'รอบ 1 พ.ร.ก.สินเชื่อฟื้นฟู ระยะที่ 1' AS GuaranteeSubType, -- ประเภทการค้ำย่อย
    '3210412' AS ERPProductCode, -- ERP-Product Code
    CONVERT(DATE, '2024-10-30', 111) AS AdjustmentStartDate, -- วันที่รายการที่เริ่มปรับปรุง
     'พฤศจิกายน 2567' MonthSelect,
     'รัชดา พิจารโชติ' AS	PrintBy
;


		
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_ACC_10_DebtorCardAdjustmentAfter]

     @StartDate       DATE = '2569-08-01'
    ,@EndDate         DATE = '2569-08-31'
    ,@ClaimPayTypeId  INT  = 0

AS
BEGIN

    SET NOCOUNT ON;


    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Convert พ.ศ. -> ค.ศ.
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    SET @StartDate =
        CASE
            WHEN YEAR(@StartDate) > 2400
                THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @StartDate)
            ELSE @StartDate
        END;


    SET @EndDate =
        CASE
            WHEN YEAR(@EndDate) > 2400
                THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @EndDate)
            ELSE @EndDate
        END;


    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- ผู้พิมพ์รายงาน
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    DECLARE @PrintBy INT = 284;


    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- ลบ Temp เดิม
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TempAdjustment') IS NOT NULL
        DROP TABLE #TempAdjustment;



    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- TypeId 3,8
    -- เลือก SeqNo สูงสุดของแต่ละ DebtorCard
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    ;WITH CTE_Type38 AS
    (
        SELECT
             m.SeqNo
            ,m.DebtorCardId
            ,m.TypeId
            ,m.DocDate
            ,m.PayDate

            ,m.PrincipalPay
            ,m.PrincipalTotal

            ,r.CIFNo
            ,r.LGNo
            ,r.DebtorId

            ,cd.MeasureDate
            ,cd.ClaimPayDate
            ,'' AS MeasureName

            ,c.ClaimTypeId
            ,c.ClaimTypeName

            ,sc.ClaimSubTypeName

            ,ISNULL
            (
                sc.ERPCode,
                c.ERPCode
            ) AS ERPProductCode


            ----------------------------------------------------
            -- เอา SeqNo สูงสุด
            ----------------------------------------------------
            ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER
            (
                PARTITION BY m.DebtorCardId
                ORDER BY m.SeqNo DESC
            ) AS RN


        FROM DataDebtorCardMovement m


        LEFT JOIN DataDebtorCard cd
            ON cd.DataDebtorCardId = m.DebtorCardId


        LEFT JOIN DataDebtorRelate r
            ON r.DebtorRelateId = cd.DebtorRelateId


        LEFT JOIN DataLG lg
            ON lg.LGNo = r.LGNo


        LEFT JOIN SystemClaimTypeMaster c
            ON c.ClaimTypeId = lg.ClaimTypeId


        LEFT JOIN SystemClaimSubTypeMaster sc
            ON sc.ClaimSubTypeId = lg.ClaimSubTypeId


        WHERE CAST(m.DocDate AS DATE)
              BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate


          AND
          (
                c.ClaimTypeId = @ClaimPayTypeId
                OR @ClaimPayTypeId = 0
          )


          AND r.DebtorTypeId = 1


          AND m.TypeId IN (3,8)


          AND m.IsAdjust = 1
    )



    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- เอาข้อมูลทั้งหมดลง Temp
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT

         X.TypeId
        ,X.UpdateDate
        ,X.DebtorCode
        ,X.GuaranteeLetterNo
        ,X.DebtorId

        ,X.PrincipalTotal
        ,X.PrincipalPay

        ,X.PrincipalBalanceCarriedForward
        ,X.InterestBalanceCarriedForward
        ,X.AdjustedInterestBalanceCarriedForward

        ,X.AdjustmentAmount
        ,X.PrincipalAdjustment
        ,X.InterestAdjustment
        ,X.AdjustedInterestAdjustment

        ,X.OtherExpensesAdjustment
        ,X.CourtFeeAdjustment
        ,X.LawyerFeeAdjustment
        ,X.DepositAdjustment

        ,X.PrincipalBalanceCarriedForwardOut
        ,X.Difference
        ,X.InterestBalanceCarriedForwardOut
        ,X.AdjustedInterestBalanceCarriedForwardOut
        ,X.InterestAccruedToMonthEnd

        ,X.CampaignDate
        ,X.Campaign
        ,X.GuaranteeType
        ,X.GuaranteeSubType
        ,X.ERPProductCode

        --------------------------------------------------------
        -- PayDate จริง
        --------------------------------------------------------
        ,X.AdjustmentStartDate


    INTO #TempAdjustment


    FROM
    (

        --------------------------------------------------------
        -- Type อื่น ๆ + TypeId = 2
        --------------------------------------------------------
        SELECT

             m.TypeId

            ,m.DocDate
                AS UpdateDate


            ,r.CIFNo
                AS DebtorCode


            ,r.LGNo
                AS GuaranteeLetterNo


            ,r.DebtorId



            ----------------------------------------------------
            -- PrincipalTotal
            ----------------------------------------------------
            ,CASE
                WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                    THEN 0

                ELSE ISNULL(m.PrincipalTotal,0)
             END
             AS PrincipalTotal



            ----------------------------------------------------
            -- PrincipalPay
            -- After: TypeId 2 เท่านั้น
            ----------------------------------------------------
            ,CASE
                WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                    THEN ISNULL(m.PrincipalPay,0)

                ELSE 0
             END
             AS PrincipalPay



            ----------------------------------------------------
            -- Principal Balance ยกมา
            ----------------------------------------------------
            ,CASE
                WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                    THEN 0

                ELSE
                    ISNULL(m.PrincipalTotal,0)
                    + ISNULL(m.PrincipalPay,0)
             END
             AS PrincipalBalanceCarriedForward



            ----------------------------------------------------
            -- Interest Balance ยกมา
            ----------------------------------------------------
            ,CASE
                WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                    THEN 0

                ELSE
                    ISNULL(m.AccruedInterestTotal,0)
             END
             AS InterestBalanceCarriedForward



            ----------------------------------------------------
            -- Default Interest Balance ยกมา
            ----------------------------------------------------
            ,CASE
                WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                    THEN 0

                ELSE
                    ISNULL(m.DefaultInterestTotal,0)
                    - ISNULL(m.DefaultInterestPay,0)
             END
             AS AdjustedInterestBalanceCarriedForward



            ----------------------------------------------------
            -- Adjustment Amount
            ----------------------------------------------------
            ,CASE
                WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                    THEN
                        ISNULL(m.AccruedInterestPay,0)
                        + ISNULL(m.PrincipalPay,0)

                ELSE 0
             END
             AS AdjustmentAmount



            ----------------------------------------------------
            -- Principal Adjustment
            ----------------------------------------------------
            ,CASE
                WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                    THEN ISNULL(m.PrincipalPay,0)

                ELSE 0
             END
             AS PrincipalAdjustment



            ----------------------------------------------------
            -- Interest Adjustment
            ----------------------------------------------------
            ,CASE
                WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                    THEN
                          ISNULL(m.PlannedInterestPay,0)
                        + ISNULL(m.DefaultInterestPay,0)
                        + ISNULL(m.DeferredInterestPay,0)
                        + ISNULL(m.SuspendIntPay,0)

                ELSE 0
             END
             AS InterestAdjustment



            ----------------------------------------------------
            -- Default Interest Adjustment
            ----------------------------------------------------
            ,CASE
                WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                    THEN ISNULL(m.DefaultInterestPay,0)

                ELSE 0
             END
             AS AdjustedInterestAdjustment



            ----------------------------------------------------
            -- Other Expense
            ----------------------------------------------------
            ,CASE
                WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                    THEN ISNULL(m.OtherExpensePay,0)

                WHEN m.TypeId = 33
                    THEN ISNULL(m.OtherExpense,0)

                ELSE 0
             END
             AS OtherExpensesAdjustment



            ----------------------------------------------------
            -- Court Fee
            ----------------------------------------------------
            ,CASE
                WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                    THEN ISNULL(m.CourtFeePay,0)

                WHEN m.TypeId = 33
                    THEN ISNULL(m.CourtFee,0)

                ELSE 0
             END
             AS CourtFeeAdjustment



            ----------------------------------------------------
            -- Lawyer Fee
            ----------------------------------------------------
            ,CASE
                WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                    THEN ISNULL(m.LawyerFeePay,0)

                WHEN m.TypeId = 33
                    THEN ISNULL(m.LawyerFee,0)

                ELSE 0
             END
             AS LawyerFeeAdjustment



            ----------------------------------------------------
            -- Deposit
            ----------------------------------------------------
            ,CASE
                WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                    THEN ISNULL(m.InitialMarginPay,0)

                WHEN m.TypeId = 33
                    THEN ISNULL(m.InitialMargin,0)

                ELSE 0
             END
             AS DepositAdjustment



            ----------------------------------------------------
            -- Principal Balance ยกไป
            ----------------------------------------------------
            ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                AS PrincipalBalanceCarriedForwardOut



            ----------------------------------------------------
            -- Difference
            ----------------------------------------------------
            ,CASE
                WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                    THEN
                        ISNULL(m.PrincipalTotal,0)
                        -
                        (
                            ISNULL(m.PrincipalTotal,0)
                            + ISNULL(m.PrincipalPay,0)
                        )

                ELSE 0
             END
             AS Difference



            ----------------------------------------------------
            -- Interest Balance ยกไป
            ----------------------------------------------------
            ,CASE
                WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                    THEN 0

                ELSE ISNULL(m.AccruedInterestTotal,0)
             END
             AS InterestBalanceCarriedForwardOut



            ----------------------------------------------------
            -- Default Interest Balance ยกไป
            ----------------------------------------------------
            ,CASE
                WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                    THEN 0

                ELSE ISNULL(m.DefaultInterestTotal,0)
             END
             AS AdjustedInterestBalanceCarriedForwardOut


            ----------------------------------------------------
            -- ดอกเบี้ยค้างรับสิ้นเดือน
            ----------------------------------------------------            
						,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
              AS InterestAccruedToMonthEnd


            ----------------------------------------------------
            -- Campaign Date
            ----------------------------------------------------
            ,CASE
                WHEN CAST(cd.MeasureDate AS DATE)
                     = CAST('1900-01-01' AS DATE)

                    THEN cd.ClaimPayDate

                ELSE cd.MeasureDate
             END
             AS CampaignDate



            ,CASE
                WHEN m.TypeId = 25
                    THEN N'ปรับปรุงรายการ (ส่วนลดจากการHaircut)'

                WHEN m.TypeId = 20
                    THEN N'ปรับปรุงเงินต้นโครงการรับชำระค่าธรรมเนียมล่วงหน้า'

                ELSE cd.MeasureName
             END
             AS Campaign


            ,c.ClaimTypeName
                AS GuaranteeType


            ,sc.ClaimSubTypeName
                AS GuaranteeSubType


            ,ISNULL
            (
                sc.ERPCode,
                c.ERPCode
            )
            AS ERPProductCode



            ----------------------------------------------------
            -- วันที่จริง ไม่ Format
            ----------------------------------------------------
            ,m.PayDate
                AS AdjustmentStartDate



        FROM DataDebtorCardMovement m


        LEFT JOIN DataDebtorCard cd
            ON cd.DataDebtorCardId = m.DebtorCardId


        LEFT JOIN DataDebtorRelate r
            ON r.DebtorRelateId = cd.DebtorRelateId


        LEFT JOIN DataLG lg
            ON lg.LGNo = r.LGNo


        LEFT JOIN SystemClaimTypeMaster c
            ON c.ClaimTypeId = lg.ClaimTypeId


        LEFT JOIN SystemClaimSubTypeMaster sc
            ON sc.ClaimSubTypeId = lg.ClaimSubTypeId


        WHERE CAST(m.DocDate AS DATE)
              BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate


          AND
          (
                c.ClaimTypeId = @ClaimPayTypeId
                OR @ClaimPayTypeId = 0
          )


          AND r.DebtorTypeId = 1


          ------------------------------------------------------
          -- คง Type เดิมของ SP After
          ------------------------------------------------------
          AND m.TypeId IN
          (
               4
              ,5
              --,6
              ,7
              ,16
              ,18
              ,20
              ,21
              ,22
              ,23
              --,24
              ,25
              ,27
              --,29
              --,30
              ,31
              ,32
--               ,33
              ,2
          )


          AND m.IsAdjust = 1



        --------------------------------------------------------
        -- TypeId 3,8
        -- เอาเฉพาะ SeqNo สูงสุด
        --------------------------------------------------------
        UNION ALL


        SELECT

             m.TypeId

            ,m.DocDate
                AS UpdateDate


            ,m.CIFNo
                AS DebtorCode


            ,m.LGNo
                AS GuaranteeLetterNo


            ,m.DebtorId



            ----------------------------------------------------
            -- ช่องเงินส่วนนี้เป็น 0
            ----------------------------------------------------
            ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                AS PrincipalTotal


            ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                AS PrincipalPay


            ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                AS PrincipalBalanceCarriedForward


            ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                AS InterestBalanceCarriedForward


            ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                AS AdjustedInterestBalanceCarriedForward


            ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                AS AdjustmentAmount


            ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                AS PrincipalAdjustment


            ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                AS InterestAdjustment


            ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                AS AdjustedInterestAdjustment


            ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                AS OtherExpensesAdjustment


            ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                AS CourtFeeAdjustment


            ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                AS LawyerFeeAdjustment


            ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                AS DepositAdjustment



            ----------------------------------------------------
            -- เงินต้นคงเหลือ
            -- Principal จาก SeqNo ล่าสุดของ Type 3,8
            ----------------------------------------------------
            ,ISNULL(m.PrincipalTotal,0)
                AS PrincipalBalanceCarriedForwardOut


            ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                AS Difference


            ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                AS InterestBalanceCarriedForwardOut


            ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                AS AdjustedInterestBalanceCarriedForwardOut


            ,CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,10))
                AS InterestAccruedToMonthEnd



            ----------------------------------------------------
            -- Campaign Date
            ----------------------------------------------------
            ,CASE
                WHEN CAST(m.MeasureDate AS DATE)
                     = CAST('1900-01-01' AS DATE)

                    THEN m.ClaimPayDate

                ELSE m.MeasureDate
             END
             AS CampaignDate



            ,m.MeasureName
                AS Campaign


            ,m.ClaimTypeName
                AS GuaranteeType


            ,m.ClaimSubTypeName
                AS GuaranteeSubType


            ,m.ERPProductCode
                AS ERPProductCode



            ----------------------------------------------------
            -- วันที่จริง ไม่ Format
            ----------------------------------------------------
            ,m.PayDate
                AS AdjustmentStartDate


        FROM CTE_Type38 m


        WHERE m.RN = 1

    ) X;



    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- FINAL RESULT
    -- 1 LG = 1 Record
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT

         ROW_NUMBER() OVER
         (
             ORDER BY T.GuaranteeLetterNo
         )
         AS SeqNo



        --------------------------------------------------------
        -- Update Date
        --------------------------------------------------------
        ,dbo.Fn_FormatDate
        (
            MAX(T.UpdateDate)
        )
        AS UpdateDate



        --------------------------------------------------------
        -- ข้อมูลลูกหนี้
        --------------------------------------------------------
        ,MAX(T.DebtorCode)
            AS DebtorCode


        ,T.GuaranteeLetterNo


        ,dbo.FN_DCS_16_GetDebtorName
        (
            MAX(T.DebtorId)
        )
        AS DebtorName



        --------------------------------------------------------
        -- SUM ช่องเงิน
        --------------------------------------------------------
        ,SUM
        (
            ISNULL(T.PrincipalTotal,0)
        )
        AS PrincipalTotal


        ,SUM
        (
            ISNULL(T.PrincipalPay,0)
        )
        AS PrincipalPay



        --------------------------------------------------------
        -- PrincipalBalanceCarriedForward
        -- เหมือน SP 09
        --
        -- 1. ไม่เอา TypeId 2,3,8
        -- 2. เลือก PayDate ต่ำสุด
        -- 3. ถ้าวันเดียวกันมีหลายรายการ
        --    เลือกยอดต่ำสุด
        --------------------------------------------------------
        ,ISNULL
        (
            (
                SELECT TOP 1

                    ISNULL
                    (
                        T2.PrincipalBalanceCarriedForward,
                        0
                    )

                FROM #TempAdjustment T2

                WHERE T2.GuaranteeLetterNo
                      = T.GuaranteeLetterNo

                  AND T2.TypeId NOT IN (2,3,8)

                ORDER BY

                     T2.AdjustmentStartDate ASC

                    ,T2.PrincipalBalanceCarriedForward ASC

                    ,T2.UpdateDate ASC
            ),
            0
        )
        AS PrincipalBalanceCarriedForward



        ,SUM
        (
            ISNULL(T.InterestBalanceCarriedForward,0)
        )
        AS InterestBalanceCarriedForward


        ,SUM
        (
            ISNULL(T.AdjustedInterestBalanceCarriedForward,0)
        )
        AS AdjustedInterestBalanceCarriedForward


        ,SUM
        (
            ISNULL(T.AdjustmentAmount,0)
        )
        AS AdjustmentAmount


        ,SUM
        (
            ISNULL(T.PrincipalAdjustment,0)
        )
        AS PrincipalAdjustment


        ,SUM
        (
            ISNULL(T.InterestAdjustment,0)
        )
        AS InterestAdjustment


        ,SUM
        (
            ISNULL(T.AdjustedInterestAdjustment,0)
        )
        AS AdjustedInterestAdjustment


        ,SUM
        (
            ISNULL(T.OtherExpensesAdjustment,0)
        )
        AS OtherExpensesAdjustment


        ,SUM
        (
            ISNULL(T.CourtFeeAdjustment,0)
        )
        AS CourtFeeAdjustment


        ,SUM
        (
            ISNULL(T.LawyerFeeAdjustment,0)
        )
        AS LawyerFeeAdjustment


        ,SUM
        (
            ISNULL(T.DepositAdjustment,0)
        )
        AS DepositAdjustment



        --------------------------------------------------------
        -- PrincipalBalanceCarriedForwardOut
        -- เงินต้นคงเหลือหลังปรับปรุง
        --
        -- 1. ใช้เฉพาะ TypeId 3,8
        -- 2. เลือก PayDate ล่าสุด
        -- 3. ถ้าวันเดียวกันมีหลายรายการ
        --    เลือกยอดต่ำสุด
        --------------------------------------------------------
        ,ISNULL
        (
            (
                SELECT TOP 1

                    ISNULL
                    (
                        T2.PrincipalBalanceCarriedForwardOut,
                        0
                    )

                FROM #TempAdjustment T2

                WHERE T2.GuaranteeLetterNo
                      = T.GuaranteeLetterNo

                  AND T2.TypeId IN (3,8)

                ORDER BY

                     T2.AdjustmentStartDate DESC

                    ,T2.PrincipalBalanceCarriedForwardOut ASC

                    ,T2.UpdateDate DESC
            ),
            0
        )
        AS PrincipalBalanceCarriedForwardOut



        ,SUM
        (
            ISNULL(T.Difference,0)
        )
        AS Difference


        ,SUM
        (
            ISNULL(T.InterestBalanceCarriedForwardOut,0)
        )
        AS InterestBalanceCarriedForwardOut


        ,SUM
        (
            ISNULL(T.AdjustedInterestBalanceCarriedForwardOut,0)
        )
        AS AdjustedInterestBalanceCarriedForwardOut


        ,ISNULL
        (
            (
                SELECT SUM(X.InterimInterest)
                FROM
                (
                    SELECT
                         Y.DebtorCardId
                        ,Y.InterestStartDate
                        ,Y.InterestEndDate
                        ,Y.InterimInterest
                    FROM
                    (
                        SELECT
                             mi.DebtorCardId
                            ,mi.SeqNo
                            ,CAST(mi.InterestStartDate AS DATE) AS InterestStartDate
                            ,CAST(mi.InterestEndDate AS DATE)   AS InterestEndDate
                            ,ISNULL(mi.InterimInterest,0)       AS InterimInterest
                            ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER
                            (
                                PARTITION BY
                                     mi.DebtorCardId
                                    ,CAST(mi.InterestStartDate AS DATE)
                                ORDER BY mi.SeqNo DESC
                            ) AS RN

                        FROM DataDebtorCardMovement mi

                        INNER JOIN DataDebtorCard dc
                            ON dc.DataDebtorCardId = mi.DebtorCardId

                        INNER JOIN DataDebtorRelate dr
                            ON dr.DebtorRelateId = dc.DebtorRelateId

                        WHERE dr.LGNo = T.GuaranteeLetterNo
                          AND dr.DebtorTypeId = 1
                          AND CAST(mi.InterestStartDate AS DATE) >= @StartDate
                          AND CAST(mi.InterestEndDate AS DATE) <= @EndDate
                    ) Y

                    WHERE Y.RN = 1
                ) X
            ),
            0
        )
        AS InterestAccruedToMonthEnd



        --------------------------------------------------------
        -- Campaign
        --------------------------------------------------------
        ,dbo.Fn_FormatDate
        (
            MAX(T.CampaignDate)
        )
        AS CampaignDate


        ,MAX(T.Campaign)
            AS Campaign


        ,MAX(T.GuaranteeType)
            AS GuaranteeType


        ,MAX(T.GuaranteeSubType)
            AS GuaranteeSubType


        ,MAX(T.ERPProductCode)
            AS ERPProductCode



        --------------------------------------------------------
        -- วันที่สำหรับแสดงผล
        -- ใช้ PayDate ต่ำสุดของ LG
        --------------------------------------------------------
        ,dbo.Fn_FormatDate
        (
            MIN(T.AdjustmentStartDate)
        )
        AS AdjustmentStartDate



        --------------------------------------------------------
        -- วันที่จริง
        -- สำหรับเอาไป Sort ใน Report
        --------------------------------------------------------
        ,MIN(T.UpdateDate)
            AS AdjustmentStartDateSort



        --------------------------------------------------------
        -- ช่วงเดือนที่เลือก
        --------------------------------------------------------
        ,dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@StartDate)
            + ' - '
            + dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@EndDate)
            AS MonthSelect



        --------------------------------------------------------
        -- วันที่พิมพ์
        --------------------------------------------------------
        ,dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(GETDATE())
            AS PrintDate



        --------------------------------------------------------
        -- ผู้พิมพ์
        --------------------------------------------------------
        ,dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(@PrintBy)
            AS PrintBy



    FROM #TempAdjustment T


    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Group ตาม LG
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    GROUP BY
        T.GuaranteeLetterNo


    ORDER BY
        T.GuaranteeLetterNo;



    ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Drop Temp
    ------------------------------------------------------------
    DROP TABLE #TempAdjustment;


END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_ACC_11_BadDebtWriteOff]
	  -- 🟥 บังคับ
      @StartDate DATE = '2024-08-14'
    ,@EndDate   DATE = '2026-08-14'
	
	
AS
BEGIN

set @StartDate = case when year(@StartDate) > 2400 then dateadd(year, -543, @StartDate) else @StartDate end
set @EndDate =  case when year(@EndDate) > 2400 then dateadd(year, -543, @EndDate) else @EndDate end
SELECT distinct
     lg.CIFNo AS BorrowerID -- รหัสผู้กู้
    ,blg.LGNo AS LGCode -- LG
    ,b.DebtorName AS ProjectName -- โครงการ (ชื่อผู้กู้ / โครงการ)
    ,lg.ClaimDate AS CompensationPaymentDate -- วันที่จ่ายค่าประกันชดเชย (25/11/2559)
    ,lg.ClaimPayAmount AS Amount -- จำนวนเงิน
    ,blg.InitialMarginTotal AS DepositMoney -- งทร.เงินวางประกัน (ค่าประกันชดเชยคงเหลือ)
    ,blg.OtherExpenseTotal AS OtherExpenses -- คชจ. อื่น ๆ
    ,blg.CourtFeeTotal AS CourtFees -- ค่าธรรมเนียมศาล
    ,blg.LawyerFeeTotal AS LawyerFees -- ค่าทนายความ
    ,c.ClaimTypeName AS MainGuaranteeType -- ประเภทการค้ำหลัก
    ,st.ClaimSubTypeName AS SubGuaranteeType -- ประเภทการค้ำย่อย
    ,b.Remark AS Notes -- หมายเหตุ (คดีเป็นคนระบุมา)
    ,dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(b.LegalSendApproveDate) AS RequestWriteOffDate -- วันที่ บค.ส่งขอตัดหนี้สูญ
    ,dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(b.ApproveDate) AS ApprovalWriteOffDate -- วันที่อนุมัติตัดหนี้สูญ (ยังไม่มีข้อมูล)
    ,dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(@StartDate) + ' - ' + dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(@EndDate) AS YearSelect -- ปี พ.ศ. ที่เลือก
	,st.ERPCode
	, N'วันที่พิมพ์ : ' + dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(getdate()) as PrintDate
	, N'ผู้สั่งพิมพ์ : '+ null as PrintName

FROM ACCDataBadDebtLG blg 
LEFT JOIN ACCDataBadDebt b ON b.BadDebtId = blg.BadDebtId
LEFT JOIN LTDataCaseMain cm ON cm.CaseMainId = b.CaseMainId
LEFT JOIN DataLG lg ON lg.LGNo = blg.LGNo
LEFT JOIN SystemClaimSubTypeMaster st on st.ClaimSubTypeId = lg.ClaimSubTypeId
LEFT JOIN SystemClaimTypeMaster c on c.ClaimTypeId = lg.ClaimTypeId

WHERE B.ApproveDate between @StartDate and @EndDate

		
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_ACC_12_CloseAccount]
    -- 🟥 บังคับ
     @StartDate date = '2568-01-01'
    ,@EndDate date= '2569-12-31'
	,@PrintUserId int = 2
	,@PMOrgStructureId int = 0
	,@PMOrgSectionId int = 0
	,@TypeId int = 0 --0=admin, 1=เฉพาะชื่อตัวเอง, 2=ทุกคนใน bu, 3=ทุกคนใน ทีม
	
AS
BEGIN
set @StartDate = case when year(@StartDate) > 2400 then dateadd(year, -543, @StartDate) else @StartDate end
set @EndDate =  case when year(@EndDate) > 2400 then dateadd(year, -543, @EndDate) else @EndDate end
declare @UsedPMOrgStructureId int = case when @TypeId = 0 then 0 else @PMOrgStructureId end
declare @UsedPMOrgSectionId int = case when @TypeId = 0 or @TypeId = 2 then 0 else @PMOrgSectionId end
declare @UsedUserId int = case when @TypeId = 0 or @TypeId = 2 or @TypeId = 3 then 0 else @PrintUserId end

SELECT distinct
     dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(c.CreateDate) AS RecordDate -- วันที่บันทึกรายการ (4/12/2567)
    ,c.LGNo AS LGCode -- รหัส LG
    ,c.DebtorName AS DebtorName -- ชื่อลูกหนี้
    ,dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(c.ConfirmClosingAccountDate) AS AccountClosedDate -- วันที่ปิดบัญชี (4/12/2567)
    ,c.ClaimPay AS CompensationPaidAmount -- ยอดจ่ายประกันชดเชย
    ,dbo.[FN_DCS_45_GetPaymentCard](cd.DataDebtorCardId, 1) AS PrincipalReceived -- เงินต้น (ยังไม่ระบุ)
    ,dbo.[FN_DCS_45_GetPaymentCard](cd.DataDebtorCardId, 2) AS InterestReceived -- ดอกเบี้ย (ยังไม่ระบุ)
    ,'ปิดบัญชี' AS Status -- สถานะ
	,c.ConfirmClosingAccountDate
	,cd.DataDebtorCardId
    ,dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(@StartDate) + ' - ' + dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(@EndDate) AS PeriodMonth -- ประจำเดือน
	, N'วันที่พิมพ์ : ' + dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(getdate()) as PrintDate
	, N'ผู้สั่งพิมพ์ : '+ dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(@PrintUserId) as PrintName


	FROM ACCDataConfirmClosingAccount c
	LEFT JOIN DataDebtorCard cd on cd.DebtorRelateId = c.DebtorRelateId
	left join DataAssignment a on a.DebtorRelateId = c.DebtorRelateId
	left join DataPersonalInfo p on p.UserId = a.CollectorUserId

	WHERE cast(c.ConfirmClosingAccountDate as date) between @StartDate and @EndDate

  --and (p.OrgStructureId = @UsedPMOrgStructureId or 0 = @UsedPMOrgStructureId)
  --and (p.OrgSectionId = @UsedPMOrgSectionId or 0 = @UsedPMOrgSectionId)
  --and (a.CreateBy = @UsedUserId or 0 = @UsedUserId)

		
END

-- =============================================

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_ACC_13_DebtInstallmentDue49]
        -- 🟥 บังคับ
        @StartDate date = '2024-01-01'
       ,@EndDate date= '2040-06-01'
       ,@PrintUserId INT = 1
	   ,@MeasureId int = 0

	
	
AS
BEGIN
set @StartDate = (case when year(@StartDate) > 2400 then dateadd(year, -543, @StartDate) else @StartDate end)
set @EndDate = (case when year(@EndDate) > 2400 then dateadd(year, -543, @EndDate) else @EndDate end)

SELECT distinct
    1 AS Seq,                                        -- ลำดับ
    a.CIFNo AS DebtorCode,                         -- รหัสลูกหนี้
    a.LGNo AS GuaranteeLetterNo,                  -- เลขที่หนังสือค้ำประกัน
    dbo.FN_DCS_16_GetDebtorName(cr.DebtorId) AS DebtorName, -- ชื่อลูกหนี้
    lg.ClaimAmountCurrent AS GuaranteeLiability, -- ภาระค้ำประกัน
	c.MeasureId ,
    dbo.Fn_FormatDate(cp.DueDate) AS DueDate49,   -- วันที่ครบกำหนดชำระ (งวดที่ 49)
		cp.DueDate,
    dbo.Fn_FormatDate(c.ApproveDate) AS DebtRestructureApprovalDate, -- วันที่อนุมัติประนอมหนี้
    m.MeasureName AS CampaignName, -- ชื่อแคมเปญ
    case when a.TypeAssignId = 1 and a.CollectorUserId !=0 then dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(a.CollectorUserId) 
		when a.TypeAssignId = 2 and a.CollectorOAUserId !=0 then dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(a.CollectorOAUserId)
		end AS FollowUpStaff,         -- เจ้าหน้าที่ติดตาม
    case when a.TypeAssignId = 1 and a.CollectorUserId !=0 then dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG(a.CollectorUserId,2) 
		when a.TypeAssignId = 2 and a.CollectorOAUserId !=0 then dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG(a.CollectorOAUserId,2) 
		end  AS Manager  ,               -- ผู้ดูแล
    dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(@StartDate) as StartDate,
    dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(@EndDate) AS	EndDate,
    case when @MeasureId = 0 then N'ทั้งหมด' else m.MeasureName end as  Campaign
    ,N'วันที่พิมพ์ : ' + dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(GETDATE()) AS PrintDate,
     N'ผู้สั่งพิมพ์ : ' + dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(@PrintUserId) AS PrintName
	 ,m.MeasureCode
	 --,cp.*
		 
		 from TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlan cp
		 left join TDRDataCompromiseContractRelated cr on cr.CompromiseContractId = cp.CompromiseContractId
		 left join TDRDataCompromiseContract c on c.CompromiseContractId = cp.CompromiseContractId
		 left join DataAssignment a on a.DebtorRelateId = cr.DebtorRelateId
		 left join DataLG lg on lg.LGNo = a.LGNo
		 left join SystemMeasureMaster m on m.MeasureId = c.MeasureId
		 left join DataDebtorRelate r on r.DebtorRelateId = cr.DebtorRelateId
		 where
		 cast(cp.DueDate as date) between @StartDate and @EndDate
		 and 
		 c.CompromiseContractStatusId = 58
		 --and cp.Seq = 49
		 and cp.PeriodYear = 5
		 and cp.PeriodMonth = 1
		 and DebtorTypeId = 1
		 and c.MeasureId is not null
		 and (c.MeasureId = @MeasureId or 0 = @MeasureId)
		 and m.MeasureCode in ('00037', '00038', '00042', '00043', '00044')

		
END
