modules.definition:
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_ACC_23_ERPAdjust]
    @StartDate DATE = '2025-01-01',
    @EndDate   DATE = '2025-01-01'
AS
BEGIN

    SET NOCOUNT ON;


    /* =========================================================
       แปลง พ.ศ. -> ค.ศ.
       ========================================================= */
    SET @StartDate =
        CASE
            WHEN YEAR(@StartDate) > 2400
                THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @StartDate)
            ELSE @StartDate
        END;

    SET @EndDate =
        CASE
            WHEN YEAR(@EndDate) > 2400
                THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @EndDate)
            ELSE @EndDate
        END;



    /* =========================================================
       1. Raw Data
       ========================================================= */
    ;WITH RawData AS
    (
        SELECT

            /* =================================================
               ERPCode

               Account 920044
               รวมทุก ERP Product เป็น 0000000

               Account อื่น
               ใช้ ERPCode ตาม SubType ก่อน
               fallback ClaimType
               ================================================= */
            CASE
                WHEN LTRIM(RTRIM(acc.AccountCode)) = '920044'
                    THEN '0000000'

                ELSE COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(sc.ERPCode)), ''),
                    NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.ERPCode)), '')
                )
            END AS ERPCode,


            /* =================================================
               Seq เดิม

               1  เงินต้น 1 Debit
               2  เงินต้น 1 Credit
               3  เงินต้น 2 Debit
               4  เงินต้น 2 Credit

               5  ดอกเบี้ย 1 Debit
               6  ดอกเบี้ย 1 Credit
               7  ดอกเบี้ย 2 Debit
               8  ดอกเบี้ย 2 Credit

               9  ศาล Debit
               10 ศาล Credit

               11 ทนาย Debit
               12 ทนาย Credit

               13 อื่น Debit
               14 อื่น Credit

               15 เงินวางประกัน Debit
               16 เงินวางประกัน Credit
               ================================================= */
            acc.Seq,


            /* =================================================
               CategoryGroup

               ใช้สำหรับลำดับประเภท
               ================================================= */
            CASE
                WHEN acc.Seq BETWEEN 1 AND 4
                    THEN 1              -- เงินต้น

                WHEN acc.Seq BETWEEN 5 AND 8
                    THEN 2              -- ดอกเบี้ย

                WHEN acc.Seq BETWEEN 9 AND 10
                    THEN 3              -- ค่าธรรมเนียมศาล

                WHEN acc.Seq BETWEEN 11 AND 12
                    THEN 4              -- ค่าทนาย

                WHEN acc.Seq BETWEEN 13 AND 14
                    THEN 5              -- ค่าใช้จ่ายอื่น

                WHEN acc.Seq BETWEEN 15 AND 16
                    THEN 6              -- เงินวางประกัน

                ELSE 99
            END AS CategoryGroup,


            /* =================================================
               SignOrder

               1 = บวก
               2 = ลบ

               ทำให้เรียง:
               เงินต้นบวกทั้งหมดก่อน
               แล้วเงินต้นลบ

               ดอกเบี้ยบวก
               แล้วดอกเบี้ยลบ
               ================================================= */
            CASE
                WHEN acc.Amount > 0
                    THEN 1

                WHEN acc.Amount < 0
                    THEN 2

                ELSE 3
            END AS SignOrder,


            acc.AccountCode,

            acc.Amount,

            acc.DebitCredit,


            /* =================================================
               Debug
               ================================================= */
            m.DebtorCardMovementId,

            m.DebtorCardId,

            m.TypeId,

            m.DocDate,

            m.PayDate,

            r.CIFNo,

            r.LGNo,

            lg.ClaimTypeId,

            lg.ClaimSubTypeId


        FROM dbo.DataDebtorCardMovement m


        /* =====================================================
           Debtor Card
           ===================================================== */
        LEFT JOIN dbo.DataDebtorCard cd
            ON cd.DataDebtorCardId = m.DebtorCardId


        /* =====================================================
           Debtor Relate
           ===================================================== */
        LEFT JOIN dbo.DataDebtorRelate r
            ON r.DebtorRelateId = cd.DebtorRelateId


        /* =====================================================
           Data LG

           ใช้ r.LGNo
           ตาม Query ต้นทาง
           ===================================================== */
        LEFT JOIN dbo.DataLG lg
            ON lg.LGNo = r.LGNo


        /* =====================================================
           Claim Type
           ===================================================== */
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemClaimTypeMaster c
            ON c.ClaimTypeId = lg.ClaimTypeId



        /* =====================================================
           Claim SubType

           ถ้ามี ClaimSubTypeId
           ให้ใช้ ClaimSubType ตรงก่อน

           ถ้าไม่มี
           fallback ด้วย ClaimTypeId

           รองรับ:
           ERP 3100602 / PrincipalPay = 10000
           ===================================================== */
        OUTER APPLY
        (
            SELECT TOP 1
                s.*

            FROM dbo.SystemClaimSubTypeMaster s

            WHERE
                (
                    lg.ClaimSubTypeId IS NOT NULL
                    AND s.ClaimSubTypeId = lg.ClaimSubTypeId
                )

                OR

                (
                    s.ClaimTypeId = lg.ClaimTypeId
                )

            ORDER BY

                CASE
                    WHEN s.ClaimSubTypeId = lg.ClaimSubTypeId
                        THEN 0
                    ELSE 1
                END,

                s.ClaimSubTypeId

        ) sc



        /* =====================================================
           Debit / Credit Mapping

           สำคัญมาก:

           ยอดบวก
               ใช้ Debit / Credit ตาม Master ปกติ

           ยอดลบ
               สลับ Account Debit <-> Credit

           แต่ Seq ไม่เปลี่ยน
           ===================================================== */
        CROSS APPLY
        (
            VALUES


            /* =================================================
               เงินต้น 1
               ================================================= */

            /* Seq 1
               เงินต้น 1 เดบิต

               บวก = PrincipalDebit_1
               ลบ  = PrincipalCredit_1
            */
            (
                1,

                CASE
                    WHEN ISNULL(m.PrincipalPay, 0) >= 0
                        THEN sc.PrincipalDebit_1
                    ELSE sc.PrincipalCredit_1
                END,

                ISNULL(m.PrincipalPay, 0),

                'D'
            ),


            /* Seq 2
               เงินต้น 1 เครดิต

               บวก = PrincipalCredit_1
               ลบ  = PrincipalDebit_1
            */
            (
                2,

                CASE
                    WHEN ISNULL(m.PrincipalPay, 0) >= 0
                        THEN sc.PrincipalCredit_1
                    ELSE sc.PrincipalDebit_1
                END,

                ISNULL(m.PrincipalPay, 0),

                'C'
            ),



            /* =================================================
               เงินต้น 2
               ================================================= */

            /* Seq 3 */
            (
                3,

                CASE
                    WHEN ISNULL(m.PrincipalPay, 0) >= 0
                        THEN sc.PrincipalDebit_2
                    ELSE sc.PrincipalCredit_2
                END,

                ISNULL(m.PrincipalPay, 0),

                'D'
            ),


            /* Seq 4 */
            (
                4,

                CASE
                    WHEN ISNULL(m.PrincipalPay, 0) >= 0
                        THEN sc.PrincipalCredit_2
                    ELSE sc.PrincipalDebit_2
                END,

                ISNULL(m.PrincipalPay, 0),

                'C'
            ),



            /* =================================================
               ดอกเบี้ย 1

               PlannedInterestPay
               + DeferredInterestPay
               + SuspendIntPay
               ================================================= */

            /* Seq 5 */
            (
                5,

                CASE
                    WHEN
                    (
                          ISNULL(m.PlannedInterestPay, 0)
                        + ISNULL(m.DeferredInterestPay, 0)
                        + ISNULL(m.SuspendIntPay, 0)
                    ) >= 0
                        THEN sc.InterestDebit_1
                    ELSE sc.InterestCredit_1
                END,

                (
                      ISNULL(m.PlannedInterestPay, 0)
                    + ISNULL(m.DeferredInterestPay, 0)
                    + ISNULL(m.SuspendIntPay, 0)
                ),

                'D'
            ),


            /* Seq 6 */
            (
                6,

                CASE
                    WHEN
                    (
                          ISNULL(m.PlannedInterestPay, 0)
                        + ISNULL(m.DeferredInterestPay, 0)
                        + ISNULL(m.SuspendIntPay, 0)
                    ) >= 0
                        THEN sc.InterestCredit_1
                    ELSE sc.InterestDebit_1
                END,

                (
                      ISNULL(m.PlannedInterestPay, 0)
                    + ISNULL(m.DeferredInterestPay, 0)
                    + ISNULL(m.SuspendIntPay, 0)
                ),

                'C'
            ),



            /* =================================================
               ดอกเบี้ย 2
               DefaultInterestPay
               ================================================= */

            /* Seq 7 */
            (
                7,

                CASE
                    WHEN ISNULL(m.DefaultInterestPay, 0) >= 0
                        THEN sc.InterestDebit_2
                    ELSE sc.InterestCredit_2
                END,

                ISNULL(m.DefaultInterestPay, 0),

                'D'
            ),


            /* Seq 8 */
           (
    8,

    CASE
        WHEN ISNULL(m.DefaultInterestPay, 0) > 0
            THEN '441000'

        WHEN ISNULL(m.DefaultInterestPay, 0) < 0
            THEN '920044'

        ELSE NULL
    END,

    ISNULL(m.DefaultInterestPay, 0),

    'C'
),


            /* =================================================
               ค่าธรรมเนียมศาล
               ================================================= */

            /* Seq 9 : Debit */
            (
                9,

                CASE
                    WHEN
                    (
                        CASE
                            WHEN m.TypeId = 33
                                THEN ISNULL(m.CourtFee, 0)
                            ELSE ISNULL(m.CourtFeePay, 0)
                        END
                    ) >= 0
                        THEN sc.CourtFeeDebit
                    ELSE sc.CourtFeeCredit
                END,

                CASE
                    WHEN m.TypeId = 33
                        THEN ISNULL(m.CourtFee, 0)
                    ELSE ISNULL(m.CourtFeePay, 0)
                END,

                'D'
            ),


            /* Seq 10 : Credit */
            (
                10,

                CASE
                    WHEN
                    (
                        CASE
                            WHEN m.TypeId = 33
                                THEN ISNULL(m.CourtFee, 0)
                            ELSE ISNULL(m.CourtFeePay, 0)
                        END
                    ) >= 0
                        THEN sc.CourtFeeCredit
                    ELSE sc.CourtFeeDebit
                END,

                CASE
                    WHEN m.TypeId = 33
                        THEN ISNULL(m.CourtFee, 0)
                    ELSE ISNULL(m.CourtFeePay, 0)
                END,

                'C'
            ),



            /* =================================================
               ค่าทนาย
               ================================================= */

            /* Seq 11 */
            (
                11,

                CASE
                    WHEN
                    (
                        CASE
                            WHEN m.TypeId = 33
                                THEN ISNULL(m.LawyerFee, 0)
                            ELSE ISNULL(m.LawyerFeePay, 0)
                        END
                    ) >= 0
                        THEN sc.LawyerDebit
                    ELSE sc.LawyerCredit
                END,

                CASE
                    WHEN m.TypeId = 33
                        THEN ISNULL(m.LawyerFee, 0)
                    ELSE ISNULL(m.LawyerFeePay, 0)
                END,

                'D'
            ),


            /* Seq 12 */
            (
                12,

                CASE
                    WHEN
                    (
                        CASE
                            WHEN m.TypeId = 33
                                THEN ISNULL(m.LawyerFee, 0)
                            ELSE ISNULL(m.LawyerFeePay, 0)
                        END
                    ) >= 0
                        THEN sc.LawyerCredit
                    ELSE sc.LawyerDebit
                END,

                CASE
                    WHEN m.TypeId = 33
                        THEN ISNULL(m.LawyerFee, 0)
                    ELSE ISNULL(m.LawyerFeePay, 0)
                END,

                'C'
            ),



            /* =================================================
               ค่าใช้จ่ายอื่น
               ================================================= */

            /* Seq 13 */
            (
                13,

                CASE
                    WHEN
                    (
                        CASE
                            WHEN m.TypeId = 33
                                THEN ISNULL(m.OtherExpense, 0)
                            ELSE ISNULL(m.OtherExpensePay, 0)
                        END
                    ) >= 0
                        THEN sc.OtherExpenseDebit
                    ELSE sc.OtherExpenseCredit
                END,

                CASE
                    WHEN m.TypeId = 33
                        THEN ISNULL(m.OtherExpense, 0)
                    ELSE ISNULL(m.OtherExpensePay, 0)
                END,

                'D'
            ),


            /* Seq 14 */
            (
                14,

                CASE
                    WHEN
                    (
                        CASE
                            WHEN m.TypeId = 33
                                THEN ISNULL(m.OtherExpense, 0)
                            ELSE ISNULL(m.OtherExpensePay, 0)
                        END
                    ) >= 0
                        THEN sc.OtherExpenseCredit
                    ELSE sc.OtherExpenseDebit
                END,

                CASE
                    WHEN m.TypeId = 33
                        THEN ISNULL(m.OtherExpense, 0)
                    ELSE ISNULL(m.OtherExpensePay, 0)
                END,

                'C'
            ),



            /* =================================================
               เงินวางประกัน

               Account ตาม ERP Master
               ยอดลบสลับ Debit/Credit เหมือนกัน
               ================================================= */

            /* Seq 15 */
            (
                15,

                CASE
                    WHEN
                    (
                        CASE
                            WHEN m.TypeId = 33
                                THEN ISNULL(m.InitialMargin, 0)
                            ELSE ISNULL(m.InitialMarginPay, 0)
                        END
                    ) >= 0
                        THEN sc.InitialMarginDebit
                    ELSE sc.InitialMarginCredit
                END,

                CASE
                    WHEN m.TypeId = 33
                        THEN ISNULL(m.InitialMargin, 0)
                    ELSE ISNULL(m.InitialMarginPay, 0)
                END,

                'D'
            ),


            /* Seq 16 */
            (
                16,

                CASE
                    WHEN
                    (
                        CASE
                            WHEN m.TypeId = 33
                                THEN ISNULL(m.InitialMargin, 0)
                            ELSE ISNULL(m.InitialMarginPay, 0)
                        END
                    ) >= 0
                        THEN sc.InitialMarginCredit
                    ELSE sc.InitialMarginDebit
                END,

                CASE
                    WHEN m.TypeId = 33
                        THEN ISNULL(m.InitialMargin, 0)
                    ELSE ISNULL(m.InitialMarginPay, 0)
                END,

                'C'
            )

        ) acc
        (
             Seq
            ,AccountCode
            ,Amount
            ,DebitCredit
        )



        /* =====================================================
           Filter

           ใช้เงื่อนไขเดียวกับ Query ต้นทาง
           ===================================================== */
        WHERE CAST(m.DocDate AS DATE)
              BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate


          /* เฉพาะลูกหนี้หลัก */
          AND r.DebtorTypeId = 1


          /* ===================================================
             TypeId
             =================================================== */
          AND m.TypeId IN
          (
               4
              ,5
              ,7
              ,16
              ,18
--               ,20
              ,21
              ,22
              ,23
--               ,25
              ,27
              ,31
              ,32
          )


          /* เฉพาะ Adjust */
          AND m.IsAdjust = 1


          /* Account ต้องมี */
          AND NULLIF(
                LTRIM(RTRIM(acc.AccountCode)),
                ''
              ) IS NOT NULL


          /* Amount ต้องไม่เป็น 0 */
          AND ISNULL(acc.Amount, 0) <> 0
    ),



    /* =========================================================
       2. Summary

       SUM ตาม

       CategoryGroup
       SignOrder
       Seq
       AccountCode
       ERPCode

       สำคัญ:

       920044
       ERPCode = 0000000 ตั้งแต่ RawData
       จึงรวมยอดตลอด

       Account อื่น
       ยังคงแยกตาม ERPCode
       ========================================================= */
    SummaryData AS
    (
        SELECT

            CategoryGroup,

            SignOrder,

            Seq,

            ERPCode,

            AccountCode,

            DebitCredit,


            SUM(
                ISNULL(Amount, 0)
            ) AS Amount


        FROM RawData


        GROUP BY

            CategoryGroup,

            SignOrder,

            Seq,

            ERPCode,

            AccountCode,

            DebitCredit
    ),



    /* =========================================================
       3. Final Data

       แยก Debit / Credit
       ========================================================= */
    FinalData AS
    (
        SELECT

            CategoryGroup,

            SignOrder,

            Seq,

            ERPCode,

            AccountCode,


            CASE
                WHEN DebitCredit = 'D'
                    THEN Amount
                ELSE 0
            END AS DebitAmount,


            CASE
                WHEN DebitCredit = 'C'
                    THEN Amount
                ELSE 0
            END AS CreditAmount


        FROM SummaryData


        WHERE ISNULL(Amount, 0) <> 0
    )



    /* =========================================================
       4. Output ERP
       ========================================================= */
    SELECT


        /* =====================================================
           Header
           ===================================================== */

        'CGS 67110024'
            AS ReportCode,


        'บสย.'
            AS Ledger,


        'CGS'
            AS Category,


        'Manual'
            AS Source,


        'THB'
            AS Currency,



        /* =====================================================
           Accounting Date
           ===================================================== */
        dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@EndDate)
            AS Accounting_Date,



        /* =====================================================
           Journal Description
           ===================================================== */
        N'ปรับปรุงรายการ Revers การ์ดลูกหนี้'
        + N' วันที่ '
        + dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@StartDate)
        + N' ถึง '
        + dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@EndDate)
            AS Journal_Description,



        /* =====================================================
           Batch Name
           ===================================================== */
        N'ปรับปรุงรายการ Revers การ์ดลูกหนี้'
        + N' วันที่ '
        + dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@StartDate)
        + N' ถึง '
        + dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@EndDate)
             AS Batch_Name,



        /* =====================================================
           Journal Name
           ===================================================== */
        N'ปรับปรุงรายการ Revers การ์ดลูกหนี้'
        + N' วันที่ '
        + dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@StartDate)
        + N' ถึง '
        + dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@EndDate)
             AS Journal_Name,



        55 AS CodeNumber,


        '' AS Monthly,


        '' AS Daily,



        /* =====================================================
           A : Row Number

           ลำดับ:

           เงินต้น +
               Seq 1
               Seq 2
               Seq 3
               Seq 4

           เงินต้น -
               Seq 1
               Seq 2
               Seq 3
               Seq 4

           ดอกเบี้ย +
               Seq 5
               Seq 6
               Seq 7
               Seq 8

           ดอกเบี้ย -
               Seq 5
               Seq 6
               Seq 7
               Seq 8

           แล้วไปประเภทถัดไป
           ===================================================== */
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER
        (
            ORDER BY

                CategoryGroup,

                SignOrder,

                Seq,

                TRY_CAST(AccountCode AS BIGINT),

                TRY_CAST(ERPCode AS BIGINT)

        ) AS A,



        /* =====================================================
           ERP Columns
           ===================================================== */

        1 AS B,


        '000000' AS C,


        '000' AS D,


        AccountCode AS E,


        '000' AS F,


        CASE
    WHEN LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(AccountCode)), 1) = '6'
        THEN '20'
    ELSE '00'
END AS G,


        '0000000' AS H,


        ERPCode AS I,


        '000000' AS J,


        '00' AS K,



        /* =====================================================
           L2 : Debit Numeric
           ===================================================== */
        DebitAmount AS L2,



        /* =====================================================
           M2 : Credit Numeric
           ===================================================== */
        CreditAmount AS M2,



        /* =====================================================
           L : Debit Export

           คงรูปแบบเดิม:
           × 100
           ===================================================== */
        CASE
    WHEN ISNULL(DebitAmount, 0) <> 0
        THEN FORMAT(
            DebitAmount,
            '0.##'
        )
    ELSE ''
END AS L,



        /* =====================================================
           M : Credit Export
           ===================================================== */
        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(CreditAmount, 0) <> 0
                THEN FORMAT(
                    CreditAmount,
                    '0.##'
                )

            ELSE ''
        END AS M,



        /* =====================================================
           N
           ===================================================== */
        N'ปรับปรุงรายการ Revers การ์ดลูกหนี้'
        + N' วันที่ '
        + dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@StartDate)
        + N' ถึง '
        + dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@EndDate)
             AS N,



        NULL AS O,


        NULL AS P,



        /* =====================================================
           Q : ประเภทรายการ

           Q ใช้ Seq เดิมเสมอ

           ถึงยอดลบ Account จะสลับ
           ชื่อ Debit/Credit ไม่สลับ
           ===================================================== */
        CASE

            WHEN Seq = 1
                THEN N'เงินต้น 1 เดบิต'

            WHEN Seq = 2
                THEN N'เงินต้น 1 เครดิต'

            WHEN Seq = 3
                THEN N'เงินต้น 2 เดบิต'

            WHEN Seq = 4
                THEN N'เงินต้น 2 เครดิต'


            WHEN Seq = 5
                THEN N'ดอกเบี้ย 1 เดบิต'

            WHEN Seq = 6
                THEN N'ดอกเบี้ย 1 เครดิต'

            WHEN Seq = 7
                THEN N'ดอกเบี้ย 2 เดบิต'

            WHEN Seq = 8
                THEN N'ดอกเบี้ย 2 เครดิต'


            WHEN Seq = 9
                THEN N'ค่าธรรมเนียมศาล เดบิต'

            WHEN Seq = 10
                THEN N'ค่าธรรมเนียมศาล เครดิต'


            WHEN Seq = 11
                THEN N'ค่าทนาย เดบิต'

            WHEN Seq = 12
                THEN N'ค่าทนาย เครดิต'


            WHEN Seq = 13
                THEN N'ค่าใช้จ่ายอื่น เดบิต'

            WHEN Seq = 14
                THEN N'ค่าใช้จ่ายอื่น เครดิต'


            WHEN Seq = 15
                THEN N'เงินวางประกัน เดบิต'

            WHEN Seq = 16
                THEN N'เงินวางประกัน เครดิต'


            ELSE N'ไม่ทราบประเภท'

        END AS Q


    FROM FinalData



    /* =========================================================
       ORDER BY

       สำคัญมาก:
       ไม่เรียง Account ก่อน Seq

       เพราะต้องการลำดับตามประเภท Debit/Credit
       ========================================================= */
    ORDER BY

        CategoryGroup,

        SignOrder,

        Seq,

        TRY_CAST(AccountCode AS BIGINT),

        TRY_CAST(ERPCode AS BIGINT);

END;

    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataDebtorRelate r ON r.DebtorRelateId = cd.DebtorRelateId

    AND m.IsAdjust = 1
    AND r.DebtorTypeId = 1
    AND CAST (m.DocDate AS DATE) BETWEEN @StartDate
    AND @EndDate
  GROUP BY
    isnull(cst.ERPCode, ct.ERPCode)
END

BEGIN

    ELSE
      @StartDate
  END
  SET @EndDate =

      dateadd(YEAR, - 543, @EndDate)
    ELSE

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_ACC_26_ERPPostAdjust]
     @StartDate      DATE = '2025-01-01'
    ,@EndDate        DATE = '2025-01-01'
    ,@ClaimPayTypeId INT  = 0
AS
BEGIN

    SET NOCOUNT ON;


    /* =========================================================
       1. แปลง พ.ศ. -> ค.ศ.
       ========================================================= */

    SET @StartDate =
        CASE
            WHEN YEAR(@StartDate) > 2400
                THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @StartDate)
            ELSE @StartDate
        END;


    SET @EndDate =
        CASE
            WHEN YEAR(@EndDate) > 2400
                THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @EndDate)
            ELSE @EndDate
        END;



    /* =========================================================
       2. Raw Data
       ========================================================= */

    ;WITH RawData AS
    (
        SELECT

            /* =================================================
               ERPCode

               AccountCode = 920044
               ให้รวมทุก Product เป็น 0000000

               AccountCode อื่น
               ใช้ ERPCode จาก ClaimSubType ก่อน
               ถ้าไม่มี fallback ไป ClaimType
               ================================================= */

            CASE
                WHEN LTRIM(RTRIM(acc.AccountCode)) = '920044'
                    THEN '0000000'

                ELSE COALESCE
                (
                    NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(sc.ERPCode)), ''),
                    NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.ERPCode)), '')
                )
            END AS ERPCode,


            /* =================================================
               Seq

               1  เงินต้น 1 เดบิต
               2  เงินต้น 1 เครดิต
               3  เงินต้น 2 เดบิต
               4  เงินต้น 2 เครดิต

               5  ดอกเบี้ย 1 เดบิต
               6  ดอกเบี้ย 1 เครดิต
               7  ดอกเบี้ย 2 เดบิต
               8  ดอกเบี้ย 2 เครดิต

               9  รายได้ค่าใช้จ่าย เดบิต
               10 รายได้ค่าใช้จ่าย เครดิต

               11 ค่าธรรมเนียม เดบิต
               12 ค่าธรรมเนียม เครดิต

               13 ค่าทนาย เดบิต
               14 ค่าทนาย เครดิต
               ================================================= */

            acc.Seq,


            /* =================================================
               CategoryGroup
               ใช้จัดลำดับใน Report
               ================================================= */

            CASE
                WHEN acc.Seq BETWEEN 1 AND 4
                    THEN 1      -- เงินต้น

                WHEN acc.Seq BETWEEN 5 AND 8
                    THEN 2      -- ดอกเบี้ย

                WHEN acc.Seq BETWEEN 9 AND 10
                    THEN 3      -- รายได้ค่าใช้จ่าย

                WHEN acc.Seq BETWEEN 11 AND 12
                    THEN 4      -- ค่าธรรมเนียม

                WHEN acc.Seq BETWEEN 13 AND 14
                    THEN 5      -- ค่าทนาย

                ELSE 99
            END AS CategoryGroup,


            /* =================================================
               SignOrder

               1 = ยอดบวก
               2 = ยอดลบ
               ================================================= */

            CASE
                WHEN acc.Amount > 0
                    THEN 1

                WHEN acc.Amount < 0
                    THEN 2

                ELSE 3
            END AS SignOrder,


            acc.AccountCode,
            acc.Amount,
            acc.DebitCredit,


            /* =================================================
               Debug / ข้อมูลต้นทาง
               ================================================= */

            m.DebtorCardMovementId,
            m.DebtorCardId,
            m.TypeId,
            m.DocDate,
            m.PayDate,

            r.CIFNo,
            r.LGNo,

            lg.ClaimTypeId,
            lg.ClaimSubTypeId


        FROM dbo.DataDebtorCardMovement m


        /* =====================================================
           Debtor Card
           ===================================================== */

        LEFT JOIN dbo.DataDebtorCard cd
            ON cd.DataDebtorCardId = m.DebtorCardId


        /* =====================================================
           Debtor Relate
           ===================================================== */

        LEFT JOIN dbo.DataDebtorRelate r
            ON r.DebtorRelateId = cd.DebtorRelateId


        /* =====================================================
           LG
           ===================================================== */

        LEFT JOIN dbo.DataLG lg
            ON lg.LGNo = r.LGNo


        /* =====================================================
           Claim Type
           ===================================================== */

        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemClaimTypeMaster c
            ON c.ClaimTypeId = lg.ClaimTypeId



        /* =====================================================
           Claim SubType

           1. ถ้ามี ClaimSubTypeId ให้ใช้ตรงก่อน
           2. ถ้าไม่มี ให้ fallback ด้วย ClaimTypeId
           ===================================================== */

        OUTER APPLY
        (
            SELECT TOP 1

                s.*

            FROM dbo.SystemClaimSubTypeMaster s

            WHERE
            (
                lg.ClaimSubTypeId IS NOT NULL
                AND s.ClaimSubTypeId = lg.ClaimSubTypeId
            )

            OR
            (
                s.ClaimTypeId = lg.ClaimTypeId
            )

            ORDER BY

                CASE
                    WHEN s.ClaimSubTypeId = lg.ClaimSubTypeId
                        THEN 0
                    ELSE 1
                END,

                s.ClaimSubTypeId

        ) sc



        /* =====================================================
           3. Account Mapping

           IMPORTANT

           PrincipalPay 1 ยอด
           ต้องแตกเป็น 4 รายการ

           ตัวอย่าง PrincipalPay = 50,000

           Debit   920044 = 50,000
           Credit  151100 = 50,000

           Debit   151200 = 50,000
           Credit  621110 = 50,000

           ===================================================== */

 /* =====================================================
   Account Mapping
   ใช้ยอด Adjustment ตาม SP_RP_ACC_10_DebtorCardAdjustmentAfter
   ===================================================== */

CROSS APPLY
(
    VALUES

    /* =================================================
       เงินต้น 1
       
       SP10:
       PrincipalAdjustment =
           TypeId = 2 ? PrincipalPay : 0

       Debit  = 920044
       Credit = 151100
       ================================================= */

    (
        1,

        CASE
            WHEN
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                        THEN ISNULL(m.PrincipalPay, 0)
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) >= 0
                THEN '920044'
            ELSE '151100'
        END,

        ABS
        (
            CASE
                WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                    THEN ISNULL(m.PrincipalPay, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ),

        'D'
    ),


    (
        2,

        CASE
            WHEN
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                        THEN ISNULL(m.PrincipalPay, 0)
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) >= 0
                THEN '151100'
            ELSE '920044'
        END,

        ABS
        (
            CASE
                WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                    THEN ISNULL(m.PrincipalPay, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ),

        'C'
    ),



    /* =================================================
       เงินต้น 2

       Debit  = 151200
       Credit = 621110
       ================================================= */

    (
        3,

        CASE
            WHEN
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                        THEN ISNULL(m.PrincipalPay, 0)
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) >= 0
                THEN '151200'
            ELSE '621110'
        END,

        ABS
        (
            CASE
                WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                    THEN ISNULL(m.PrincipalPay, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ),

        'D'
    ),


    (
        4,

        CASE
            WHEN
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                        THEN ISNULL(m.PrincipalPay, 0)
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) >= 0
                THEN '621110'
            ELSE '151200'
        END,

        ABS
        (
            CASE
                WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                    THEN ISNULL(m.PrincipalPay, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ),

        'C'
    ),



    /* =================================================
       ดอกเบี้ย 1

       SP10:
       InterestAdjustment =
           PlannedInterestPay
         + DefaultInterestPay
         + DeferredInterestPay
         + SuspendIntPay

       แต่จาก Mapping ERP
       แยก DefaultInterest เป็นดอกเบี้ย 2

       ดังนั้นดอกเบี้ย 1 =
           PlannedInterestPay
         + DeferredInterestPay
         + SuspendIntPay

       เฉพาะ TypeId = 2

       Debit  = 920044
       Credit = 441000
       ================================================= */

    (
        5,

        CASE
            WHEN
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                        THEN
                              ISNULL(m.PlannedInterestPay, 0)
                            + ISNULL(m.DeferredInterestPay, 0)
                            + ISNULL(m.SuspendIntPay, 0)
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) >= 0
                THEN '920044'
            ELSE '441000'
        END,

        ABS
        (
            CASE
                WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                    THEN
                          ISNULL(m.PlannedInterestPay, 0)
                        + ISNULL(m.DeferredInterestPay, 0)
                        + ISNULL(m.SuspendIntPay, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ),

        'D'
    ),


    (
        6,

        CASE
            WHEN
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                        THEN
                              ISNULL(m.PlannedInterestPay, 0)
                            + ISNULL(m.DeferredInterestPay, 0)
                            + ISNULL(m.SuspendIntPay, 0)
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) >= 0
                THEN '441000'
            ELSE '920044'
        END,

        ABS
        (
            CASE
                WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                    THEN
                          ISNULL(m.PlannedInterestPay, 0)
                        + ISNULL(m.DeferredInterestPay, 0)
                        + ISNULL(m.SuspendIntPay, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ),

        'C'
    ),



    /* =================================================
       ดอกเบี้ย 2

       SP10:
       AdjustedInterestAdjustment = DefaultInterestPay

       เฉพาะ TypeId = 2

       Debit  = 920044
       Credit = 441000
       ================================================= */

    (
        7,

        CASE
            WHEN
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                        THEN ISNULL(m.DefaultInterestPay, 0)
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) >= 0
                THEN '920044'
            ELSE '441000'
        END,

        ABS
        (
            CASE
                WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                    THEN ISNULL(m.DefaultInterestPay, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ),

        'D'
    ),


    (
        8,

        CASE
            WHEN
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                        THEN ISNULL(m.DefaultInterestPay, 0)
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) >= 0
                THEN '441000'
            ELSE '920044'
        END,

        ABS
        (
            CASE
                WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                    THEN ISNULL(m.DefaultInterestPay, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ),

        'C'
    ),



    /* =================================================
       ค่าใช้จ่ายอื่น

       SP10:
       TypeId = 2  => OtherExpensePay
       TypeId = 33 => OtherExpense

       แต่ Type 33 ยังถูกปิดอยู่ใน Filter ปัจจุบัน

       Debit  = 920044
       Credit = 920045
       ================================================= */

    (
        9,

        CASE
            WHEN
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                        THEN ISNULL(m.OtherExpensePay, 0)

                    WHEN m.TypeId = 33
                        THEN ISNULL(m.OtherExpense, 0)

                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) >= 0
                THEN '920044'
            ELSE '920045'
        END,

        ABS
        (
            CASE
                WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                    THEN ISNULL(m.OtherExpensePay, 0)

                WHEN m.TypeId = 33
                    THEN ISNULL(m.OtherExpense, 0)

                ELSE 0
            END
        ),

        'D'
    ),


    (
        10,

        CASE
            WHEN
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                        THEN ISNULL(m.OtherExpensePay, 0)

                    WHEN m.TypeId = 33
                        THEN ISNULL(m.OtherExpense, 0)

                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) >= 0
                THEN '920045'
            ELSE '920044'
        END,

        ABS
        (
            CASE
                WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                    THEN ISNULL(m.OtherExpensePay, 0)

                WHEN m.TypeId = 33
                    THEN ISNULL(m.OtherExpense, 0)

                ELSE 0
            END
        ),

        'C'
    ),



    /* =================================================
       ค่าธรรมเนียม

       ใช้ CourtFee ตาม SP10

       TypeId = 2  => CourtFeePay
       TypeId = 33 => CourtFee

       Debit  = 920044
       Credit = 920045
       ================================================= */

    (
        11,

        CASE
            WHEN
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                        THEN ISNULL(m.CourtFeePay, 0)

                    WHEN m.TypeId = 33
                        THEN ISNULL(m.CourtFee, 0)

                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) >= 0
                THEN '920044'
            ELSE '920045'
        END,

        ABS
        (
            CASE
                WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                    THEN ISNULL(m.CourtFeePay, 0)

                WHEN m.TypeId = 33
                    THEN ISNULL(m.CourtFee, 0)

                ELSE 0
            END
        ),

        'D'
    ),


    (
        12,

        CASE
            WHEN
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                        THEN ISNULL(m.CourtFeePay, 0)

                    WHEN m.TypeId = 33
                        THEN ISNULL(m.CourtFee, 0)

                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) >= 0
                THEN '920045'
            ELSE '920044'
        END,

        ABS
        (
            CASE
                WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                    THEN ISNULL(m.CourtFeePay, 0)

                WHEN m.TypeId = 33
                    THEN ISNULL(m.CourtFee, 0)

                ELSE 0
            END
        ),

        'C'
    ),



    /* =================================================
       ค่าทนาย

       TypeId = 2  => LawyerFeePay
       TypeId = 33 => LawyerFee

       Debit  = 920044
       Credit = 473600
       ================================================= */

    (
        13,

        CASE
            WHEN
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                        THEN ISNULL(m.LawyerFeePay, 0)

                    WHEN m.TypeId = 33
                        THEN ISNULL(m.LawyerFee, 0)

                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) >= 0
                THEN '920044'
            ELSE '473600'
        END,

        ABS
        (
            CASE
                WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                    THEN ISNULL(m.LawyerFeePay, 0)

                WHEN m.TypeId = 33
                    THEN ISNULL(m.LawyerFee, 0)

                ELSE 0
            END
        ),

        'D'
    ),


    (
        14,

        CASE
            WHEN
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                        THEN ISNULL(m.LawyerFeePay, 0)

                    WHEN m.TypeId = 33
                        THEN ISNULL(m.LawyerFee, 0)

                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) >= 0
                THEN '473600'
            ELSE '920044'
        END,

        ABS
        (
            CASE
                WHEN m.TypeId = 2
                    THEN ISNULL(m.LawyerFeePay, 0)

                WHEN m.TypeId = 33
                    THEN ISNULL(m.LawyerFee, 0)

                ELSE 0
            END
        ),

        'C'
    )

) acc
(
     Seq
    ,AccountCode
    ,Amount
    ,DebitCredit
)

        /* =====================================================
           4. Filter

           ใช้เงื่อนไขแบบเดียวกับ
           SP_RP_ACC_10_DebtorCardAdjustmentAfter
           ===================================================== */

        WHERE CAST(m.DocDate AS DATE)
              BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate


          /* ===================================================
             Claim Type

             @ClaimPayTypeId = 0
             หมายถึงเอาทั้งหมด
             =================================================== */

          AND
          (
                c.ClaimTypeId = @ClaimPayTypeId
                OR @ClaimPayTypeId = 0
          )


          /* ===================================================
             เฉพาะลูกหนี้หลัก
             =================================================== */

          AND r.DebtorTypeId = 1


          /* ===================================================
             TypeId เหมือน SP_RP_ACC_10
             =================================================== */

          AND m.TypeId IN
          (
               4
              ,5
              --,6
              ,7
              ,16
              ,18
              ,20
              ,21
              ,22
              ,23
              --,24
              ,25
              ,27
              --,29
              --,30
              ,31
              ,32
              --,33
              ,2
          )


          /* ===================================================
             เฉพาะรายการ Adjust
             =================================================== */

          AND m.IsAdjust = 1


          /* ===================================================
             AccountCode ต้องมี
             =================================================== */

          AND NULLIF
          (
              LTRIM(RTRIM(acc.AccountCode)),
              ''
          ) IS NOT NULL


          /* ===================================================
             Amount ต้องไม่เป็น 0
             =================================================== */

          AND ISNULL(acc.Amount, 0) <> 0
    ),



    /* =========================================================
       5. Summary Data

       ตัวอย่าง

       LG A
       920044 / ERP 3100810 = 50,000

       LG B
       920044 / ERP 3100852 = 50,000

       เนื่องจาก 920044 ถูกเปลี่ยน ERPCode = 0000000
       ก่อนถึง GROUP BY

       จึงได้

       920044 / 0000000 = 100,000

       ส่วน Account อื่นยังแยก ERPCode
       ========================================================= */

    SummaryData AS
    (
        SELECT

             CategoryGroup
            ,SignOrder
            ,Seq
            ,ERPCode
            ,AccountCode
            ,DebitCredit


            ,SUM
            (
                ISNULL(Amount, 0)
            ) AS Amount


        FROM RawData


        GROUP BY

             CategoryGroup
            ,SignOrder
            ,Seq
            ,ERPCode
            ,AccountCode
            ,DebitCredit
    ),



    /* =========================================================
       6. Final Data

       แยก Debit / Credit
       ========================================================= */

    FinalData AS
    (
        SELECT

             CategoryGroup
            ,SignOrder
            ,Seq
            ,ERPCode
            ,AccountCode


            /* Debit */
            ,CASE
                WHEN DebitCredit = 'D'
                    THEN Amount
                ELSE 0
             END AS DebitAmount


            /* Credit */
            ,CASE
                WHEN DebitCredit = 'C'
                    THEN Amount
                ELSE 0
             END AS CreditAmount


        FROM SummaryData


        WHERE ISNULL(Amount, 0) <> 0
    )



    /* =========================================================
       7. ERP Output
       ========================================================= */

    SELECT


        /* =====================================================
           Header
           ===================================================== */

        'CGS 67110024'
            AS ReportCode,


        'บสย.'
            AS Ledger,


        'CGS'
            AS Category,


        'Manual'
            AS Source,


        'THB'
            AS Currency,



        /* =====================================================
           Accounting Date
           ===================================================== */

        dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@EndDate)
            AS Accounting_Date,



        /* =====================================================
           Journal Description
           ===================================================== */

        N'ปรับปรุงรายการหลังการปรับปรุงการ์ดลูกหนี้'
        + N' วันที่ '
        + dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@StartDate)
        + N' ถึง '
        + dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@EndDate)
            AS Journal_Description,



        /* =====================================================
           Batch Name
           ===================================================== */

        N'ปรับปรุงรายการหลังการปรับปรุงการ์ดลูกหนี้'
        + N' วันที่ '
        + dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@StartDate)
        + N' ถึง '
        + dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@EndDate)
            AS Batch_Name,



        /* =====================================================
           Journal Name
           ===================================================== */

        N'ปรับปรุงรายการหลังการปรับปรุงการ์ดลูกหนี้'
        + N' วันที่ '
        + dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@StartDate)
        + N' ถึง '
        + dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@EndDate)
            AS Journal_Name,



        55 AS CodeNumber,


        '' AS Monthly,


        '' AS Daily,



        /* =====================================================
           A : Row Number

           ลำดับ

           เงินต้น +
           เงินต้น -

           ดอกเบี้ย +
           ดอกเบี้ย -

           รายได้ค่าใช้จ่าย
           ค่าธรรมเนียม
           ค่าทนาย
           ===================================================== */

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER
        (
            ORDER BY

                 CategoryGroup
                ,SignOrder
                ,Seq
                ,TRY_CAST(AccountCode AS BIGINT)
                ,TRY_CAST(ERPCode AS BIGINT)

        ) AS A,



        /* =====================================================
           ERP Column B
           ===================================================== */

        1 AS B,



        /* =====================================================
           ERP Column C
           ===================================================== */

        '000000' AS C,



        /* =====================================================
           ERP Column D
           ===================================================== */

        '000' AS D,



        /* =====================================================
           ERP Column E : AccountCode
           ===================================================== */

        AccountCode AS E,



        /* =====================================================
           ERP Column F
           ===================================================== */

        '000' AS F,



        /* =====================================================
           ERP Column G
           ===================================================== */

         CASE
    WHEN LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(AccountCode)), 1) = '6'
        THEN '20'
    ELSE '00'
END AS G,



        /* =====================================================
           ERP Column H
           ===================================================== */

        '0000000' AS H,



        /* =====================================================
           ERP Column I : ERP Product Code
           ===================================================== */

        ERPCode AS I,



        /* =====================================================
           ERP Column J
           ===================================================== */

        '000000' AS J,



        /* =====================================================
           ERP Column K
           ===================================================== */

        '00' AS K,



        /* =====================================================
           L2 : Debit Numeric
           ===================================================== */

        DebitAmount AS L2,



        /* =====================================================
           M2 : Credit Numeric
           ===================================================== */

        CreditAmount AS M2,



        /* =====================================================
           L : Debit

           100000   -> 100000
           3655.25  -> 3655.25
           0        -> blank
           ===================================================== */

        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(DebitAmount, 0) <> 0
                THEN FORMAT
                (
                    DebitAmount,
                    '0.##'
                )

            ELSE ''
        END AS L,



        /* =====================================================
           M : Credit
           ===================================================== */

        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(CreditAmount, 0) <> 0
                THEN FORMAT
                (
                    CreditAmount,
                    '0.##'
                )

            ELSE ''
        END AS M,



        /* =====================================================
           N : Description
           ===================================================== */

        N'ปรับปรุงรายการหลังการปรับปรุงการ์ดลูกหนี้'
        + N' วันที่ '
        + dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@StartDate)
        + N' ถึง '
        + dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@EndDate)
            AS N,



        /* =====================================================
           O / P
           ===================================================== */

        NULL AS O,


        NULL AS P,



        /* =====================================================
           Q : Remark / ประเภทรายการ

           ถึง Amount ติดลบแล้ว Account ถูกสลับ
           ชื่อรายการยังยึด Seq เดิม
           ===================================================== */

        CASE

            /* เงินต้น */
            WHEN Seq = 1
                THEN N'เงินต้น 1 เดบิต'

            WHEN Seq = 2
                THEN N'เงินต้น 1 เครดิต'

            WHEN Seq = 3
                THEN N'เงินต้น 2 เดบิต'

            WHEN Seq = 4
                THEN N'เงินต้น 2 เครดิต'


            /* ดอกเบี้ย */
            WHEN Seq = 5
                THEN N'ดอกเบี้ย 1 เดบิต'

            WHEN Seq = 6
                THEN N'ดอกเบี้ย 1 เครดิต'

            WHEN Seq = 7
                THEN N'ดอกเบี้ย 2 เดบิต'

            WHEN Seq = 8
                THEN N'ดอกเบี้ย 2 เครดิต'


            /* รายได้ค่าใช้จ่าย */
            WHEN Seq = 9
                THEN N'รายได้ค่าใช้จ่าย เดบิต'

            WHEN Seq = 10
                THEN N'รายได้ค่าใช้จ่าย เครดิต'


            /* ค่าธรรมเนียม */
            WHEN Seq = 11
                THEN N'ค่าธรรมเนียม เดบิต'

            WHEN Seq = 12
                THEN N'ค่าธรรมเนียม เครดิต'


            /* ค่าทนาย */
            WHEN Seq = 13
                THEN N'ค่าทนาย เดบิต'

            WHEN Seq = 14
                THEN N'ค่าทนาย เครดิต'


            ELSE N'ไม่ทราบประเภท'

        END AS Q


    FROM FinalData



    /* =========================================================
       8. ORDER BY

       เรียงตามประเภทก่อน
       ไม่เอา AccountCode ขึ้นก่อน Seq
       ========================================================= */

    ORDER BY

         CategoryGroup
        ,SignOrder
        ,Seq
        ,TRY_CAST(AccountCode AS BIGINT)
        ,TRY_CAST(ERPCode AS BIGINT);

END;

        @StartDate date

AS

set @StartDate = dateadd(year, -543, @StartDate)
set @EndDate = dateadd(year, -543, @EndDate)
Select 
'GS 67' AS ReportCode
,'บสย.' AS Ledger	
,'CGS' AS Category	
,'Manual' AS Source	
,'THB' AS Currency	
,'29/11/2024' AS Accounting_Date

,'ปรับปรุงรายการหลังการปรับปรุงการ์ดลูกหนี้ เดือน พฤศจิกายน 2567' AS Batch_Name

--Table--------------------------

    NULL     AS O,
    NULL    AS P    -- จำนวนเงินรวม
    ;


		
END

-- ALTER PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_ACC_27_BadDebt]
-- ALTER PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_ACC_27_BadDebt]
--     @StartDate DATE = '2025-01-01',
--        @EndDate   DATE = '2025-01-01'
-- AS
-- BEGIN
--     SET NOCOUNT ON;
-- 
--     /* =========================================================
--        แปลง พ.ศ. -> ค.ศ.
--        ========================================================= */
--     SET @StartDate =
--         CASE
--             WHEN YEAR(@StartDate) > 2400
--                 THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @StartDate)
--             ELSE @StartDate
--         END;
-- 
--     SET @EndDate =
--         CASE
--             WHEN YEAR(@EndDate) > 2400
--                 THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @EndDate)
--             ELSE @EndDate
--         END;
-- 
-- 
--     /* =========================================================
--        1) จัดอันดับข้อมูลภายใน ReceiptId เดียวกัน
--           เพื่อให้เหลือ 1 ReceiptId = 1 แถว
--        ========================================================= */
--     ;WITH DataRanked AS
--     (
--         SELECT
--             r.ReceiptId,
--             r.ReceiptNo,
--             r.ReceiptDate,
--             r.PaymentAmount,
-- 
--             sbbm.GLNo,
--             sctm.ERPCode,
-- 
--             ROW_NUMBER() OVER
--             (
--                 PARTITION BY r.ReceiptId
--                 ORDER BY
--                     TRY_CAST(sbbm.GLNo AS BIGINT) ASC,
--                     TRY_CAST(sctm.ERPCode AS INT) ASC,
--                     r.ReceiptDate ASC,
--                     r.ReceiptNo ASC
--             ) AS rn
-- 
--         FROM dbo.ACCDataReceipt r
-- 
--         LEFT JOIN dbo.DataLG lg
--             ON lg.LGNo = r.LGNo
--        
--         LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemClaimSubTypeMaster sctm
--             ON sctm.ClaimSubTypeId = lg.ClaimSubTypeId
-- 
--         INNER JOIN dbo.DataEStatement dem
--             ON dem.eStatementId = r.eStatementId
--             AND r.ReceiptId = dem.ReceiptId
-- 
--         INNER JOIN dbo.SystemBankTCGMaster sbbm
--             ON sbbm.BankId = dem.BankId
--             
--             
--         LEFT JOIN dbo.DataDebtorStatusUpdate d  ON r.DebtorCode = d.DebtorCode
--         
--         WHERE
-- --             r.CreateDate >= @StartDate
-- -- 
-- --             AND r.CreateDate < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @EndDate)
--  CAST(r.CreateDate AS DATE) BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
-- 
--             AND ISNULL(r.PaymentAmount, 0) <> 0
-- 
--             AND ISNULL(r.IsCancel, 0) <> 1
-- 
--             AND ISNULL(dem.BankId, 0) <> 0
--             
--             AND  d.StatusLGId = 32 AND d.StatusDebtorId = 23
--     ),
-- 
-- 
--     /* =========================================================
--        2) รวมยอด PaymentAmount ตาม GLNo
--           1 GLNo = 1 แถว
--        ========================================================= */
--     DataGrouped AS
--     (
--         SELECT
--             GLNo,
-- 
--             SUM(
--                 ISNULL(PaymentAmount, 0)
--             ) AS PaymentAmount,
-- 
--             MIN(
--                 TRY_CAST(ERPCode AS INT)
--             ) AS ERPCode
-- 
--         FROM DataRanked
-- 
--         WHERE rn = 1
-- 
--         GROUP BY
--             GLNo
--     )
-- 
-- 
--     /* =========================================================
--        3) Result
--        ========================================================= */
--     SELECT
-- 
--         /* =========================================================
--            Header
--            ========================================================= */
-- 
--         'CGS 67110024' AS ReportCode,
-- 
--         'บสย.' AS Ledger,
-- 
--         'CGS' AS Category,
-- 
--         'Manual' AS Source,
-- 
--         'THB' AS Currency,
-- 
-- 
--         /* =========================================================
--            Accounting Date
--            ========================================================= */
-- 
--         dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@EndDate) AS Accounting_Date,
-- 
-- 
--         /* =========================================================
--            Journal Description
--            ========================================================= */
-- 
--         N'บันทึกรับชำระรายการลูกหนี้ที่ตัดจำหน่ายหนี้สูญ'
--             + N' วันที่  '
--             + dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@StartDate)
--             + N' ถึง '
--             + dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@EndDate)
--         AS Journal_Description,
-- 
-- 
--         /* =========================================================
--            Batch Name
--            ========================================================= */
-- 
--         N'บันทึกรับชำระรายการลูกหนี้ที่ตัดจำหน่ายหนี้สูญ'
--             + N' วันที่  '
--             + dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@StartDate)
--             + N' ถึง '
--             + dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@EndDate)
--         AS Batch_Name,
-- 
-- 
--         /* =========================================================
--            Journal Name
--            ========================================================= */
-- 
--         N'บันทึกรับชำระรายการลูกหนี้ที่ตัดจำหน่ายหนี้สูญ'
--             + N' วันที่  '
--             + dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@StartDate)
--             + N' ถึง '
--             + dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@EndDate)
--         AS Journal_Name,
-- 
-- 
--         88 AS CodeNumber,
-- 
--         '' AS Monthly,
-- 
--         '' AS Daily,
-- 
-- 
--         /* =========================================================
--            A : Row Number ของรายงาน
--            เรียง GLNo จากน้อยไปมาก
--            ========================================================= */
-- 
-- 
--         ROW_NUMBER() OVER
--         (
--             ORDER BY
--                 TRY_CAST(GLNo AS BIGINT) ASC
--         ) AS A,
-- 
-- 
--         /* =========================================================
--            ERP Columns
--            ========================================================= */
-- 
--         1 AS B,
-- 
--         '000000' AS C,
-- 
--         '000' AS D,
-- 
-- 
--         /* =========================================================
--            E2
--            ========================================================= */
-- 
--         '' AS E2,
-- 
-- 
--         /* =========================================================
--            E : GL Number
--            ========================================================= */
-- 
--         GLNo AS E,
-- 
-- 
--         '000' AS F,
-- 
--          CASE
--     WHEN LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(GLNo)), 1) = '6'
--         THEN '20'
--     ELSE '00'
-- END AS G,
-- 
--         '0000000' AS H,
-- 
-- 
--         /* =========================================================
--            I : ERP Code
--            ปัจจุบันกำหนดเป็น 0000000
--            ========================================================= */
-- 
--         '0000000' AS I,
-- 
-- 
--         '000000' AS J,
-- 
--         '00' AS K,
-- 
-- 
--         /* =========================================================
--            L : รวม PaymentAmount ตาม GLNo
-- 
--            ตัวอย่าง
--            PaymentAmount รวม = 600.00
--            L = 60000
-- 
--            PaymentAmount รวม = 458.25
--            L = 45825
--            ========================================================= */
-- 
--         CASE
--     WHEN ISNULL(PaymentAmount, 0) <> 0
--         THEN FORMAT(
--             PaymentAmount,
--             '0.##'
--         )
--     ELSE ''
-- END AS L,
-- 
-- 
--         /* =========================================================
--            M : ไม่ใช้
--            ========================================================= */
-- 
--         '' AS M,
-- 
-- 
--         /* =========================================================
--            Numeric สำหรับตรวจสอบยอดใน Report
--            ========================================================= */
-- 
--         ISNULL(PaymentAmount, 0) AS L2,
-- 
--         CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS M2,
-- 
-- 
--         /* =========================================================
--            N
--            ========================================================= */
-- 
--         N'บันทึกรับชำระรายการลูกหนี้ที่ตัดจำหน่ายหนี้สูญ'
--             + N' วันที่  '
--             + dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@StartDate)
--             + N' ถึง '
--             + dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@EndDate)
--         AS N,
-- 
-- 
--         NULL AS O,
-- 
--         NULL AS P,
-- 
-- 
--         /* =========================================================
--            Q ไม่ใช้
--            ========================================================= */
-- 
--         '' AS Q,
-- 
-- 
--         /* =========================================================
--            R
--            เมื่อ Group ตาม GLNo แล้ว
--            ไม่สามารถใช้ ReceiptId เดี่ยวได้
--            ========================================================= */
-- 
--         NULL AS R
-- 
-- 
--     FROM DataGrouped
-- 
-- 
--     /* =============================================================
--        เรียง GLNo จากน้อยไปมาก
--        ============================================================= */
-- 
--     ORDER BY
--         TRY_CAST(GLNo AS BIGINT) ASC;
-- 
-- END;





CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_ACC_27_BadDebt]
    @StartDate DATE = '2025-01-01',
    @EndDate   DATE = '2025-01-01'
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    /* =========================================================
       0. แปลง พ.ศ. -> ค.ศ.
       ========================================================= */

    SET @StartDate =
        CASE
            WHEN YEAR(@StartDate) > 2400
                THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @StartDate)
            ELSE @StartDate
        END;

    SET @EndDate =
        CASE
            WHEN YEAR(@EndDate) > 2400
                THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @EndDate)
            ELSE @EndDate
        END;


    /* =========================================================
       1. RECEIPT BASE

       เงื่อนไข:
       - CreateDate อยู่ในช่วงวันที่
       - ไม่ใช่ใบเสร็จยกเลิก
       - PaymentAmount ไม่เท่ากับ 0
       - มี EStatement และ BankId
       - StatusLGId = 32
       - StatusDebtorId = 23

       ใช้ EXISTS ป้องกัน JOIN แล้วข้อมูลซ้ำ
       ========================================================= */

    ;WITH ReceiptBase AS
    (
        SELECT
            r.ReceiptId,
            r.ReceiptNo,
            r.ReceiptDate,

            ISNULL(r.PaymentAmount, 0)
                AS PaymentAmount,

            ISNULL(r.PrincipalPay, 0)
                AS PrincipalPay,

            ISNULL(r.AccruedInterestPay, 0)
                AS AccruedInterestPay,

            ISNULL(r.CourtFeePay, 0)
                AS CourtFeePay,

            ISNULL(r.LawyerFeePay, 0)
                AS LawyerFeePay,

            ISNULL(r.OtherExpensePay, 0)
                AS OtherExpensePay,

            ISNULL(r.InitialMarginPay, 0)
                AS InitialMarginPay

        FROM dbo.ACCDataReceipt r

        WHERE
            r.CreateDate >= @StartDate

            AND r.CreateDate <
                DATEADD(DAY, 1, @EndDate)

            AND ISNULL(r.PaymentAmount, 0) <> 0

            AND ISNULL(r.IsCancel, 0) <> 1

            /* มี EStatement ที่ผูกกับใบเสร็จ */
            AND EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM dbo.DataEStatement dem

                INNER JOIN dbo.SystemBankTCGMaster sbbm
                    ON sbbm.BankId = dem.BankId

                WHERE
                    dem.EStatementId = r.EStatementId

                    AND dem.ReceiptId = r.ReceiptId

                    AND ISNULL(dem.BankId, 0) <> 0
            )

            /* สถานะลูกหนี้หนี้สูญ */
            AND EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM dbo.DataDebtorStatusUpdate d

                WHERE
                    d.DebtorCode = r.DebtorCode

                    AND d.StatusLGId = 32

                    AND d.StatusDebtorId = 23
            )
    ),


    /* =========================================================
       2. รวม DeferredInterestPay ต่อ ReceiptId

       ป้องกัน Movement หลายรายการ
       ทำให้ยอดเงินประเภทอื่นถูกคูณ
       ========================================================= */

    ReceiptAmount AS
    (
        SELECT
            r.ReceiptId,

            r.PrincipalPay,
            r.AccruedInterestPay,

            ISNULL
            (
                (
                    SELECT
                        SUM(
                            ISNULL(m.DeferredInterestPay, 0)
                        )

                    FROM dbo.DataDebtorCardMovement m

                    WHERE m.ReceiptId = r.ReceiptId
                ),
                0
            ) AS DeferredInterestPay,

            r.CourtFeePay,
            r.LawyerFeePay,
            r.OtherExpensePay,
            r.InitialMarginPay

        FROM ReceiptBase r
    ),


    /* =========================================================
       3. แยกประเภทการชำระเป็น GLNo

       463310 = เงินต้น + เงินวางประกัน

       443000 = ดอกเบี้ยค้างรับ + ดอกเบี้ยพักรับ

       463410 = ค่าธรรมเนียมศาล
              + ค่าทนาย
              + ค่าใช้จ่ายอื่น ๆ
       ========================================================= */

    RawData AS
    (
        SELECT
            acc.GLNo,
            acc.Amount

        FROM ReceiptAmount r

        CROSS APPLY
        (
            VALUES

            /* เงินต้น */
            (
                '463310',
                CAST(r.PrincipalPay AS DECIMAL(28,2))
            ),

            /* ดอกเบี้ยค้างรับ */
            (
                '443000',
                CAST(r.AccruedInterestPay AS DECIMAL(28,2))
            ),

            /* ดอกเบี้ยพักรับ */
            (
                '443000',
                CAST(r.DeferredInterestPay AS DECIMAL(28,2))
            ),

            /* ค่าธรรมเนียมศาล */
            (
                '463410',
                CAST(r.CourtFeePay AS DECIMAL(28,2))
            ),

            /* ค่าทนาย */
            (
                '463410',
                CAST(r.LawyerFeePay AS DECIMAL(28,2))
            ),

            /* ค่าใช้จ่ายอื่น ๆ */
            (
                '463410',
                CAST(r.OtherExpensePay AS DECIMAL(28,2))
            ),

            /* เงินวางประกัน */
            (
                '463310',
                CAST(r.InitialMarginPay AS DECIMAL(28,2))
            )

        ) acc (GLNo, Amount)

        WHERE ISNULL(acc.Amount, 0) <> 0
    ),


    /* =========================================================
       4. GROUP BY GLNo

       1 GLNo = 1 แถว
       ========================================================= */

    DataGrouped AS
    (
        SELECT
            GLNo,

            SUM(
                ISNULL(Amount, 0)
            ) AS PaymentAmount

        FROM RawData

        GROUP BY GLNo

        HAVING
            SUM(ISNULL(Amount, 0)) <> 0
    )


    /* =========================================================
       5. RESULT ERP
       คงโครงสร้างคอลัมน์เดิม
       ========================================================= */

    SELECT

        /* HEADER */
        'CGS 67110024' AS ReportCode,

        N'บสย.' AS Ledger,

        'CGS' AS Category,

        'Manual' AS Source,

        'THB' AS Currency,


        /* Accounting Date */
        dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@EndDate)
            AS Accounting_Date,


        /* Journal Description */
        N'บันทึกรับชำระรายการลูกหนี้ที่ตัดจำหน่ายหนี้สูญ'
            + N' วันที่ '
            + dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@StartDate)
            + N' ถึง '
            + dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@EndDate)
            AS Journal_Description,


        /* Batch Name */
        N'บันทึกรับชำระรายการลูกหนี้ที่ตัดจำหน่ายหนี้สูญ'
            + N' วันที่ '
            + dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@StartDate)
            + N' ถึง '
            + dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@EndDate)
            AS Batch_Name,


        /* Journal Name */
        N'บันทึกรับชำระรายการลูกหนี้ที่ตัดจำหน่ายหนี้สูญ'
            + N' วันที่ '
            + dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@StartDate)
            + N' ถึง '
            + dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@EndDate)
            AS Journal_Name,


        88 AS CodeNumber,

        '' AS Monthly,

        '' AS Daily,


        /* A : Row Number */
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER
        (
            ORDER BY
                TRY_CAST(GLNo AS BIGINT) ASC
        ) AS A,


        /* B - D */
        1 AS B,

        '000000' AS C,

        '000' AS D,


        /* E2 */
        '' AS E2,


        /* E : GLNo */
        GLNo AS E,


        /* F - H */
        '000' AS F,

        CASE
            WHEN LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(GLNo)), 1) = '6'
                THEN '20'
            ELSE '00'
        END AS G,

        '0000000' AS H,


        /* I : ERP Code */
        '0000000' AS I,


        /* J - K */
        '000000' AS J,

        '00' AS K,


        /* L : Debit Export */
      CASE
    WHEN ISNULL(PaymentAmount, 0) <> 0
        THEN FORMAT(
            PaymentAmount,
            '0.##',
            'en-US'
        )
    ELSE ''
END AS L,


        /* M : Credit Export */
        '' AS M,


        /* L2 : Numeric */
        ISNULL(PaymentAmount, 0) AS L2,


        /* M2 : Numeric */
        CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS M2,


        /* N : Description */
        N'บันทึกรับชำระรายการลูกหนี้ที่ตัดจำหน่ายหนี้สูญ'
            + N' วันที่ '
            + dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@StartDate)
            + N' ถึง '
            + dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@EndDate)
            AS N,


        SUM(ISNULL(PaymentAmount, 0)) OVER () AS O,

        NULL AS P,


        /* Q : คงค่าตามรายงานเดิม */
CASE
    WHEN SUM(ISNULL(PaymentAmount, 0)) OVER () <> 0
        THEN FORMAT(
            SUM(ISNULL(PaymentAmount, 0)) OVER (),
            '0.##',
            'en-US'
        )
    ELSE ''
END AS Q,


        /* R */
        NULL AS R

    FROM DataGrouped

    ORDER BY
        TRY_CAST(GLNo AS BIGINT) ASC;

END;
