        ISNULL(ra.Y2566, 0) AS Y2566,                                           -- Y2566 (143)
        ISNULL(ra.Y2567, 0) AS Y2567,                                           -- Y2567 (144)
        ISNULL(ra.M01_2567, 0) AS M01_2567,                                     -- M01-2567 (145)
        ISNULL(ra.M02_2567, 0) AS M02_2567,                                     -- M02-2567 (146)
        ISNULL(ra.M03_2567, 0) AS M03_2567,                                     -- M03-2567 (147)
        ISNULL(ra.M04_2567, 0) AS M04_2567,                                     -- M04-2567 (148)
        ISNULL(ra.M05_2567, 0) AS M05_2567,                                     -- M05-2567 (149)
        ISNULL(ra.M06_2567, 0) AS M06_2567,                                     -- M06-2567 (150)
        ISNULL(ra.M07_2567, 0) AS M07_2567,                                     -- M07-2567 (151)
        ISNULL(ra.M08_2567, 0) AS M08_2567,                                     -- M08-2567 (152)
        ISNULL(ra.PrincipalPaid, 0) AS PrincipalPaid,                           -- ชำระเงินต้น (153)
        ISNULL(ra.InterestPaid, 0) AS InterestPaid,                             -- ชำระดอกเบี้ย (154)
        ISNULL(ra.OtherPaid, 0) AS OtherPaid,                                   -- อื่นๆ (155)
        COALESCE(
            dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(eod.CollectorUserId),
            dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(eod.CollectorOAUserId)
        ) AS OfficerName,                                                       -- ชื่อเจ้าหน้าที่ ### ไม่มี TypeAssignId ใน EOD
        dbo.Fn_FormatDate(COALESCE(eod.StatusTrackingDate, eod.CollectorUpdateDate, eod.CollectorOAUpdateDate)) AS LastFollowUpDate, -- วันที่ติดตามล่าสุด (157)
        dbo.FN_DCS_26_GetStatusName(eod.StatusDebtorId) AS Status1_Debtor,      -- สถานะ 1 สถานะลูกหนี้ (158)
        dbo.Fn_FormatDate(eod.StatusDebtorDate) AS Status1Date,                 -- วันที่บันทึก_สถานะ 1 สถานะลูกหนี้ (159)
        dbo.FN_DCS_26_GetStatusName(eod.StatusTrackingId) AS Status2_Collection, -- สถานะ 2 สถานะติดตามหนี้ (160)
        dbo.Fn_FormatDate(eod.StatusTrackingDate) AS Status2Date,               -- วันที่บันทึก_สถานะ 2 สถานะติดตามหนี้ (161)
        dbo.FN_DCS_26_GetStatusName(eod.StatusCompromiseId) AS Status3_RestructuringByLG, -- สถานะ 3 สถานะประนอมหนี้ By LG (162)
        dbo.Fn_FormatDate(eod.StatusCompromiseDate) AS Status3DateByLG,         -- วันที่บันทึกสถานะ 3 สถานะประนอมหนี้ By LG (163)
        dbo.FN_DCS_26_GetStatusName(eod.StatusLegalId) AS Status4_Case,         -- สถานะ 4 สถานะคดี (164)
        dbo.Fn_FormatDate(eod.StatusLegalDate) AS Status4Date,                  -- วันที่บันทึกสถานะ 4 สถานะคดี (165)
        eod.RequestNoTDR AS RestructureContractNumber,                          -- เลขที่ประนอมหนี้ (166)
        dbo.Fn_FormatDate(eod.[DebtRequestDate ]) AS DebtAcknowledgementLetterDate, -- วันที่หนังสือสภาพหนี้ (167)
        dbo.Fn_FormatDate(eod.CompromiseContracApproveDate) AS RestructureApprovalDate, -- วันที่อนุมัติปรับปรุงโครงสร้างหนี้ (168)
        eod.MeasureCode AS CampaignCode,                                        -- รหัสแคมเปญ (169)
        eod.MeasureName AS CampaignName,                                        -- ชื่อแคมเปญ (170)
        NULL AS MeasureColor,                                             -- มาตรการสี ### ไม่มี source ชัดใน EOD
        ct.ClaimTypeName AS ProjectName,                                        -- ชื่อโครงการ (172)
        eod.DebtorName AS DebtorName1,                                          -- ชื่อลูกหนี้ (173)
        dbo.FN_DCS_26_GetStatusName(eod.StatusCompromiseId) AS Status3_ByCIF,   -- สถานะ 3 สถานะประนอมหนี้ By รหัส CIF ### ไม่มั่นใจ ใช้สถานะประนอมหนี้ By LG

        N'วันที่พิมพ์ : ' + dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(GETDATE()) AS PrintDate,
        N'ผู้สั่งพิมพ์ : ' + ISNULL(dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(@PrintUserId), N'') AS PrintName
    FROM dbo.DataEndOfDay eod
    INNER JOIN #EODKey ek
        ON ek.EndOfDayId = eod.EndOfDayId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataLG lg
        ON lg.LGNo = eod.LGNo
    LEFT JOIN #CIFAgg cif
        ON cif.CIFNo = eod.CIFNo
    LEFT JOIN #ReceiptAgg ra
        ON ra.DebtorRelateId = eod.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #Address addr
        ON addr.DebtorCode = eod.DebtorCode
    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataLGCBS lgcbs
        ON lgcbs.LGNo = eod.LGNo
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemBankMaster bank
        ON bank.BankId = eod.SystemBankId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemBankBranchMaster bb
        ON bb.BankBranchId = lg.BankBranchId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemClaimTypeMaster ct
        ON ct.ClaimTypeId = lg.ClaimTypeId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemTitleMaster tm
        ON tm.TitleId = eod.TitleId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemProvinceMaster pv
        ON pv.ProvinceId = addr.ProvinceId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemZoneMaster zn
        ON zn.ZoneId = pv.ZoneId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemCaseTypeMaster ctm
        ON ctm.CaseTypeId = eod.CaseTypeId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemLawOfficeMaster law
        ON law.LawOfficeId = eod.LawOfficeUserId
    ORDER BY
        eod.AsOfDate,
        eod.CIFNo,
        eod.LGNo;
END

    NULL AS LawyerOffice,                           -- สำนักงานทนาย (140)
    NULL AS BankruptcyJudgementDate,                -- วันที่พิพากษาล้มละลาย (141)
    NULL AS BankruptcyDischargeDate,                -- วันที่ปลดล้มละลาย (142)
    0 AS Y2566,                                     -- Y2566 (143)
    0 AS Y2567,                                     -- Y2567 (144)
    0 AS M01_2567,                                  -- M01-2567 (145)
    0 AS M02_2567,                                  -- M02-2567 (146)
    0 AS M03_2567,                                  -- M03-2567 (147)
    0 AS M04_2567,                                  -- M04-2567 (148)
    0 AS M05_2567,                                  -- M05-2567 (149)
    0 AS M06_2567,                                  -- M06-2567 (150)
    0 AS M07_2567,                                  -- M07-2567 (151)
    0 AS M08_2567,                                  -- M08-2567 (152)
    0.00 AS PrincipalPaid,                          -- ชำระเงินต้น (153)
    0.00 AS InterestPaid,                           -- ชำระดอกเบี้ย (154)
    0.00 AS OtherPaid,                              -- อื่นๆ (155)
    N'จารุวรรณ์ จันทวงษ์' AS OfficerName,         -- ชื่อเจ้าหน้าที่ (156)
    CONVERT(DATE, '2024-09-04', 111) AS LastFollowUpDate, -- วันที่ติดตามล่าสุด (157)
    N'หนี้สูญ' AS Status1_Debtor,                  -- สถานะ 1 สถานะลูกหนี้ (158)
    CONVERT(DATE, '2019-09-17', 111) AS Status1Date,-- วันที่บันทึก_สถานะ 1 สถานะลูกหนี้ (159)
    N'ส่งเรื่องให้ตคดำเนินคดี' AS Status2_Collection,-- สถานะ 2 สถานะติดตามหนี้ (160)
    CONVERT(DATE, '2019-01-01', 111) AS Status2Date,-- วันที่บันทึก_สถานะ 2 สถานะติดตามหนี้ (161)
    NULL AS Status3_RestructuringByLG,              -- สถานะ 3 สถานะประนอมหนี้ By LG (162)
    NULL AS Status3DateByLG,                        -- วันที่บันทึกสถานะ 3 สถานะประนอมหนี้ By LG (163)
    N'โครงการที่จำหน่ายหนี้สูญ (ยังมีสิทธิทางกฏหมาย)' AS Status4_Case,-- สถานะ 4 สถานะคดี (164)
    CONVERT(DATE, '2019-01-01', 111) AS Status4Date,-- วันที่บันทึกสถานะ 4 สถานะคดี (165)
    NULL AS RestructureContractNumber,              -- เลขที่ประนอมหนี้ (166)
    NULL AS DebtAcknowledgementLetterDate,          -- วันที่หนังสือสภาพหนี้ (167)
    NULL AS RestructureApprovalDate,                -- วันที่อนุมัติปรับปรุงโครงสร้างหนี้ (168)
    NULL AS CampaignCode,                           -- รหัสแคมเปญ (169)
    NULL AS CampaignName,                           -- ชื่อแคมเปญ (170)
    NULL AS MeasureColor,                           -- มาตรการสี (171)
    N'โครงการที่จำหน่ายหนี้สูญ (ยังมีสิทธิทางกฎหมาย)' AS ProjectName, -- ชื่อโครงการ (172)
    NULL AS DebtorName1,                             -- ชื่อลูกหนี้ (173)
    NULL AS Status3_ByCIF                           -- สถานะ 3 สถานะประนอมหนี้ By รหัส CIF (174)

;



		
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_DEB_07_Status_before_upgate]
    -- บังคับ
    @StartDate      DATE         = NULL,
    @EndDate        DATE         = NULL,
    -- ไม่บังคับ
    @DebtorCode     NVARCHAR(20) = 'null',
    @LGNo           NVARCHAR(20) = 'null',
    @ClaimPayTypeId INT          = 0,
    @StatusPortId   INT          = 0,
    @PrintUserId INT  
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- NULL safety
    SET @DebtorCode     = ISNULL(@DebtorCode, 'null');
    SET @LGNo           = ISNULL(@LGNo, 'null');
    SET @ClaimPayTypeId = ISNULL(@ClaimPayTypeId, 0);
    SET @StatusPortId   = ISNULL(@StatusPortId, 0);

    -- BE → CE
    SET @StartDate = CASE WHEN YEAR(@StartDate) > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR,-543,@StartDate) ELSE @StartDate END;
    SET @EndDate   = CASE WHEN YEAR(@EndDate)   > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR,-543,@EndDate)   ELSE @EndDate   END;

    ;WITH
    -- Count ผู้กู้หลักต่อ CIF
    CIFCount AS (
        SELECT CIFNo, COUNT(DISTINCT DebtorRelateId) AS CntByCIF
        FROM   DataDebtorRelate
        WHERE  DebtorTypeId = 1
        GROUP BY CIFNo
    ),
    -- เก็บผู้ค้ำ 1 คนแรกต่อ LG
    GuarantorInfo AS (
        SELECT r2.LGNo,
               ISNULL(t2.TitleName+N' ',N'') + ISNULL(d2.DebtorName,N'') AS GuarantorName,
               ISNULL(d2.CntMobileNumber, d2.CntPhoneNumber)              AS GuarantorPhone,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r2.LGNo ORDER BY r2.DebtorRelateId) AS rn
        FROM   DataDebtorRelate r2
        JOIN   DataDebtor       d2 ON d2.DebtorId = r2.DebtorId
        LEFT JOIN SystemTitleMaster t2 ON t2.TitleId = d2.TitleId
        WHERE  r2.DebtorTypeId = 3
    ),
    -- เก็บผู้กู้ร่วม 1 คนแรกต่อ LG
    CoDebtorInfo AS (
        SELECT r3.LGNo,
               ISNULL(t3.TitleName+N' ',N'') + ISNULL(d3.DebtorName,N'') AS CoDebtorName,
               ISNULL(d3.CntMobileNumber, d3.CntPhoneNumber)              AS CoDebtorPhone,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r3.LGNo ORDER BY r3.DebtorRelateId) AS rn
        FROM   DataDebtorRelate r3
        JOIN   DataDebtor       d3 ON d3.DebtorId = r3.DebtorId
        LEFT JOIN SystemTitleMaster t3 ON t3.TitleId = d3.TitleId
        WHERE  r3.DebtorTypeId = 2
    ),
    -- รวมยอดรับชำระต่อ DebtorRelateId
    ReceiptAgg AS (
        SELECT
            DebtorRelateId,
            SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ReceiptDate) = 2023 AND IsCancel = 0 THEN PaymentAmount ELSE 0 END) AS Y2566,
            SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ReceiptDate) = 2024 AND IsCancel = 0 THEN PaymentAmount ELSE 0 END) AS Y2567,
            SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ReceiptDate) = 2024 AND MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 1  AND IsCancel = 0 THEN PaymentAmount ELSE 0 END) AS M01_2567,
            SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ReceiptDate) = 2024 AND MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 2  AND IsCancel = 0 THEN PaymentAmount ELSE 0 END) AS M02_2567,
            SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ReceiptDate) = 2024 AND MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 3  AND IsCancel = 0 THEN PaymentAmount ELSE 0 END) AS M03_2567,
            SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ReceiptDate) = 2024 AND MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 4  AND IsCancel = 0 THEN PaymentAmount ELSE 0 END) AS M04_2567,
            SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ReceiptDate) = 2024 AND MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 5  AND IsCancel = 0 THEN PaymentAmount ELSE 0 END) AS M05_2567,
            SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ReceiptDate) = 2024 AND MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 6  AND IsCancel = 0 THEN PaymentAmount ELSE 0 END) AS M06_2567,
            SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ReceiptDate) = 2024 AND MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 7  AND IsCancel = 0 THEN PaymentAmount ELSE 0 END) AS M07_2567,
            SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ReceiptDate) = 2024 AND MONTH(ReceiptDate) = 8  AND IsCancel = 0 THEN PaymentAmount ELSE 0 END) AS M08_2567,
            SUM(CASE WHEN IsCancel = 0 THEN ISNULL(PrincipalPay,0) ELSE 0 END)       AS TotalPrincipalPay,
            SUM(CASE WHEN IsCancel = 0 THEN ISNULL(AccruedInterestPay,0) ELSE 0 END) AS TotalInterestPay,
            SUM(CASE WHEN IsCancel = 0 THEN ISNULL(CourtFeePay,0)+ISNULL(LawyerFeePay,0)+ISNULL(OtherExpensePay,0) ELSE 0 END) AS TotalOtherPay,
             N'วันที่พิมพ์ : ' + dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(GETDATE()) AS PrintDate,
             N'ผู้สั่งพิมพ์ : ' + dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(@PrintUserId) AS PrintName
        FROM ACCDataReceipt
        GROUP BY DebtorRelateId
    ),
    -- สถานะล่าสุดต่อ DebtorRelateId
    LatestStatus AS (
        SELECT *,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY DebtorRelateId
                   ORDER BY ISNULL(UpdateDate, CreateDate) DESC, DebtorStatusUpdateId DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM DataDebtorStatusUpdate
    ),
    -- ผู้ติดตามล่าสุดต่อ DebtorRelateId
    LatestAssign AS (
        SELECT DebtorRelateId, CollectorOAUserId, UpdateDate,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY DebtorRelateId
                   ORDER BY ISNULL(UpdateDate, CreateDate) DESC, AssignmentId DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM DataAssignment
    ),
    -- ที่อยู่ทะเบียนบ้าน default 1 แถวต่อ DebtorCode
    LatestAddress AS (
        SELECT DebtorCode,
               AddressNumber,
               Soi,
               Road,
               SubDistrictId,
               DistrictId,
               ProvinceId,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY DebtorCode
                   ORDER BY ISNULL(UpdateDate, CreateDate) DESC, DebtorAddressId DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM DataDebtorAddress
        WHERE DebtorAddressTypeId = 7
          AND IsDefault = 1
    ),
    -- ข้อมูลบุคลากร 1 แถวต่อ UserId
    -- prefer: not deleted -> active -> latest row
    LatestPersonalInfo AS (
        SELECT UserId,
               FirstName,
               LastName,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY UserId
                   ORDER BY
                       CASE WHEN ISNULL(IsDelete, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                       CASE WHEN ISNULL(IsActive, 0) = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                       ISNULL(UpdateDate, CreateDate) DESC,
                       PersonalInfoId DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM DataPersonalInfo
    ),
    -- ข้อมูลคดีล่าสุดต่อ DebtorRelateId
    LatestAssignCase AS (
        SELECT DebtorRelateId,
               CaseMainId,
               LegalUserId,
               LawOfficeUserId,
               CaseTypeId,
               EffectiveDate,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY DebtorRelateId
                   ORDER BY ISNULL(UpdateDate, CreateDate) DESC, AssignCaseId DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM LTDataAssignCase
        WHERE ISNULL(IsCancel, 0) = 0
    ),
    -- สัญญา TDR ล่าสุดต่อ DebtorRelateId
    LatestTDR AS (
        SELECT
            t.DebtorRelateId,
            t.CompromiseContractId,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY t.DebtorRelateId
                ORDER BY
                    ISNULL(
                        NULLIF(c.ApproveDate, '1900-01-01'),
                        ISNULL(NULLIF(c.TDRDate, '1900-01-01'), ISNULL(t.UpdateDate, t.CreateDate))
                    ) DESC,
                    t.CompromiseContractLGId DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractLG t
        LEFT JOIN TDRDataCompromiseContract c
            ON c.CompromiseContractId = t.CompromiseContractId
        WHERE t.DebtorRelateId IS NOT NULL
          AND t.DebtorRelateId <> ''
    ),
    -- อายุหนี้ระดับ CIF
    LoanAgeCIF AS (
        SELECT r4.CIFNo,
               DATEDIFF(YEAR, MIN(dc4.ClaimPayDate), @EndDate) AS LoanAgYearsByCIF
        FROM   DataDebtorRelate r4
        JOIN   DataDebtorCard   dc4 ON dc4.DebtorRelateId = r4.DebtorRelateId
        WHERE  r4.DebtorTypeId = 1
        GROUP BY r4.CIFNo
    ),
    -- เงินต้นคงเหลือรวมระดับ CIF
    PrincipalByCIF AS (
        SELECT r5.CIFNo, SUM(ISNULL(dc5.PrincipalTotal,0)) AS PrincipalTotalByCIF
        FROM   DataDebtorRelate r5
        JOIN   DataDebtorCard   dc5 ON dc5.DebtorRelateId = r5.DebtorRelateId
        WHERE  r5.DebtorTypeId = 1
        GROUP BY r5.CIFNo
    ),
    -- ยอดจ่ายชดเชยรวมระดับ CIF
    ClaimPayByCIF AS (
        SELECT r6.CIFNo, SUM(ISNULL(dc6.ClaimPay,0)) AS ClaimPayByCIF
        FROM   DataDebtorRelate r6
        JOIN   DataDebtorCard   dc6 ON dc6.DebtorRelateId = r6.DebtorRelateId
        WHERE  r6.DebtorTypeId = 1
        GROUP BY r6.CIFNo
    )

    SELECT
        -- (1)
        RIGHT('0'+CAST(DAY(@EndDate) AS NVARCHAR(2)),2)
          + RIGHT('0'+CAST(MONTH(@EndDate) AS NVARCHAR(2)),2)
          + CAST(YEAR(@EndDate)+543 AS NVARCHAR(4))                          AS DataAsOf,
        -- (2)
        d.DebtorCode                                                          AS DebtorCode,
        -- (3)
        d.DebtorCode                                                          AS DupCode,
        -- (4)
        r.CIFNo                                                               AS CIFCode,
        -- (5)
        cc.CntByCIF                                                           AS DebtorCount,
        -- (6)
        r.LGNo                                                                AS LGCode,
        -- (7)
        spm.StatusPortName                                                    AS ReportGroup072567_MC_I,
        -- (8)
        spm.StatusPortName                                                    AS PP_ReportGroup072567_MC_I,
        -- (9)
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(200))                                           AS Group072567_ByLG_I,
        -- (10)
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(200))                                           AS Group072567_ByCIF_I,
        -- (11)
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(200))                                           AS ReportGroup072567_TRIS_I,
        -- (12)
        spm.StatusPortName                                                    AS Group082567_ByLG_I,
        -- (13)
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(200))                                           AS Group082567_ByCIF_I,
        -- (14)
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(200))                                           AS ReportGroup082567_TRIS_I,
        -- (15)
        spm.StatusPortName                                                    AS ReportGroup082567_MC_I,
        -- (16)
        spm.StatusPortName                                                    AS PP_ReportGroup082567_MC_I,
        -- (17)
        NULLIF(CAST(dc.CloseDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')                      AS AccountClosedDate,
        -- (18)
        CASE WHEN dc.CloseDate IS NULL OR YEAR(dc.CloseDate) = 1900 THEN NULL
             ELSE YEAR(dc.CloseDate) END                                      AS ClosedYear,
        -- (19)
        CASE WHEN dc.CloseDate IS NULL OR YEAR(dc.CloseDate) = 1900 THEN NULL
             ELSE MONTH(dc.CloseDate) END                                     AS ClosedMonth,
        -- (20)
        NULLIF(CAST(dc.BadDebtDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')                    AS WriteOffClosedDate,
        -- (21)
        dc.CardType                                                           AS CardStatus,
        -- (22)
        CASE WHEN NULLIF(d.CompanyType,'') IS NOT NULL THEN N'นิติบุคคล'
             ELSE N'บุคคลธรรมดา' END                                         AS DebtorType,
        -- (23)
        tm.TitleName                                                          AS DebtorPrefix,
        -- (24)
        d.DebtorName                                                          AS DebtorName_Main,
        -- (25)
        d.IDCard                                                              AS DebtorCitizenID,
        -- (26)
        NULLIF(CAST(d.BirthDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')                      AS DebtorBirthDate,
        -- (27)
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(50))                                            AS T06CardID,
        -- (28)
        gi.GuarantorName                                                      AS GuarantorName,
        -- (29)
        ISNULL(d.CntMobileNumber, d.CntPhoneNumber)                           AS DebtorContact,
        -- (30)
        cdi.CoDebtorName                                                      AS CoDebtorName,
        -- (31)
        cdi.CoDebtorPhone                                                     AS CoDebtorContact,
        -- (32)
        b.BankName                                                            AS BankList,
        -- (33)
        b.GroupBank                                                           AS BankType,
        -- (34)
        b.BankAbbrName                                                        AS BankAbbr,
        -- (35)
        bb.BankBranchName                                                     AS BranchOffice,
        -- (36)
        bb.BankBranchName                                                     AS BranchOfficeNew,
        -- (37)
        bb.BankBranchId                                                       AS BranchGroup,
        -- (38)
        ct.ClaimTypeGroup                                                     AS MainProjectType,
        -- (39)
        ct.ClaimTypeName                                                      AS Project,
        -- (40)
        ct.ClaimTypeGroup                                                     AS ProjectType,
        -- (41)
        ct.ClaimTypeName                                                      AS GuaranteeType,
        -- (42)
        ct.ClaimTypeNameShort                                                 AS GuaranteeType_I,
        -- (43)
        bb.BankBranchName                                                     AS BankBranch,
        -- (44)
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(50))                                            AS BankBranchPhone,
        -- (45)
        r.LGNo                                                                AS LGCode_Result,
        -- (46)
        NULLIF(CAST(lg.LGDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')                        AS LGDate,
        -- (47)
        lgcbs.PayCoditionCode                                                 AS PaymentConditionCode,
        -- (48)
        lgcbs.PayCoditionDetail                                               AS PaymentConditionDesc,
        -- (49)
        lg.ClaimAmount                                                        AS GuaranteeLiability,
        -- (50)
        NULLIF(CAST(dc.ClaimPayDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')                  AS CompensationPaymentDate,
        -- (51)
        MONTH(dc.ClaimPayDate)                                                AS MonthNo,
        -- (52)
        YEAR(dc.ClaimPayDate) + 543                                           AS YearBE,
        -- (53)
        DATEDIFF(YEAR, dc.ClaimPayDate, @EndDate)                             AS LoanAgeCalcY,
        -- (54)
        CASE
            WHEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, dc.ClaimPayDate, @EndDate) > 10 THEN N'มากกว่า 10 ปี'
            WHEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, dc.ClaimPayDate, @EndDate) >= 7  THEN N'7-10 ปี'
            WHEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, dc.ClaimPayDate, @EndDate) >= 4  THEN N'4-6 ปี'
            WHEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, dc.ClaimPayDate, @EndDate) >= 1  THEN N'1-3 ปี'
            ELSE N'น้อยกว่า 1 ปี'
        END                                                                   AS LoanAgeCalcYText,
        -- (55)
        CASE
            WHEN lac.LoanAgYearsByCIF > 10 THEN N'มากกว่า 10 ปี'
            WHEN lac.LoanAgYearsByCIF >= 7  THEN N'7-10 ปี'
            WHEN lac.LoanAgYearsByCIF >= 4  THEN N'4-6 ปี'
            WHEN lac.LoanAgYearsByCIF >= 1  THEN N'1-3 ปี'
            ELSE N'น้อยกว่า 1 ปี'
        END                                                                   AS LoanAgeMC_ByCIF,
        -- (56)
        pcif.ClaimPayByCIF                                                    AS ClaimPaid_ByCIF,
        -- (57)
        dc.ClaimPay                                                           AS CompensationPaid,
        -- (58)
        pp.PrincipalTotalByCIF                                                AS OS_Principal_ByCIF,
        -- (59)
        dc.PrincipalTotal                                                     AS OS_Principal,
        -- (60)
        dc.InterestRate                                                       AS InterestRate,
        -- (61)
        dc.AccruedInterest                                                    AS AccruedInterest,
        -- (62)
        dc.SuspendInt                                                         AS SuspendedOrDeferredInterest,
        -- (63)
        ISNULL(dc.SuspendInt,0) - ISNULL(dc.SuspendIntPay,0)                 AS SuspendedOrDeferredInterestBalance,
        -- (64)
        dc.DeferredInterest                                                   AS HangingInt,
        -- (65)
        dc.DeferredInterestPay                                                AS HangingIntPay,
        -- (66)
        ISNULL(dc.DeferredInterest,0) - ISNULL(dc.DeferredInterestPay,0)     AS HangingIntBalance,
        -- (67)
        lgcbs.GradeCompare                                                    AS Result_GradeCompare,
        -- (68)
        lgcbs.GradeKnowDateCompare                                            AS Result_GradeRecognizedDateSerial,
        -- (69)
        lgcbs.GradeRecDateCompare                                             AS Result_GradeRecordedDateSerial,
        -- (70)
        lgcbs.StatusLGCompare                                                 AS Result_LGStatusCompare,
        -- (71)
        lgcbs.StatusDateCompare                                               AS Result_LGStatusDateSerial,
        -- (72)
        d.BusinessType                                                        AS Result_BusinessCode,
        -- (73)
        d.BusinessTypeName                                                    AS Result_BusinessType,
        -- (74)
        d.CompanyType                                                         AS Result_BusinessCategory,
        -- (75)
        d.CompanyTypeDescription                                              AS Result_BusinessNature,
        -- (76)
        da.AddressNumber                                                      AS Result_AddressNo,
        -- (77)
        da.Soi                                                                AS Result_Soi,
        -- (78)
        da.Road                                                               AS Result_Street,
        -- (79)
        dbo.FN_GetSubDistrictName(da.SubDistrictId)                           AS Result_SubDistrict,
        -- (80)
        dbo.FN_GetDistrictName(da.DistrictId)                                 AS Result_District,
        -- (81)
        pv.Name                                                               AS Result_Province,
        -- (82)
        zn.Name                                                               AS Region,
        -- (83)
        cm.StatusProsecutionId                                                AS Result_LitigationStepCode,
        -- (84)
        N'unknown'                                                           AS Result_LitigationStep,
        -- (85)
        d.FixedAssetValue                                                     AS Result_NetFixedAssets,
        -- (86)
        lg.EmploymentQty                                                      AS Result_Employment,
        -- (87)
        lg.IncEmploymentQty                                                   AS Result_EmploymentIncrease,
        -- (88)
        d.ISICCode                                                            AS Result_ISICCode,
        -- (89)
        N'unknown'                                                           AS Result_BusinessType1,
        -- (90)
        lg.Income                                                             AS Result_Revenue,
        -- (91)
        N'unknown'                                                           AS Result_SMESize,
        -- (92)
        N'unknown'                                                           AS Result_DataGroup,
        -- (93)
        ISNULL(pi_legal.FirstName+N' ',N'') + ISNULL(pi_legal.LastName,N'')  AS LegalOfficer,
        -- (94)
        N'unknown'                                                           AS CaseType,
        -- (95)
        N'unknown'                                                           AS GroupByCIF,
        -- (96)
        N'unknown'                                                           AS ReportTRIS,
        -- (97)
        N'unknown'                                                           AS ReportMC,
        -- (98)
        N'unknown'                                                           AS ReportMC_New,
        -- (99)
        N'unknown'                                                           AS PortStatus,
        -- (100)
        N'unknown'                                                           AS GuaranteeLetterStatus,
        -- (101)
        NULLIF(CAST(ac.EffectiveDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')                 AS CaseApprovalDate,
        -- (102)
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.EnforcemetApproveDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')         AS SubrogationApprovalDate,
        -- (103)
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.EnforcemetApplyDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')           AS SubrogationFilingDate,
        -- (104)
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.PetitionDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')                  AS SubrogationCourtOrderDate,
        -- (105)
        N'unknown'                                                           AS LitigationStepStatusBOT,
        -- (106)
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.SendLawyerDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')                AS DocumentSentToLawyerDate,
        -- (107)
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.FilingDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')                    AS LawsuitFilingDate,
        -- (108)
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.FirstTrialDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')                AS FirstWitnessDate,
        -- (109)
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.FrozenAssetDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')               AS BsmeAssetManagementDate,
        -- (110)
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.JmTrialDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')                   AS FirstCourtJudgementDate,
        -- (111)
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.WarrantDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')                   AS WarrantIssueDate,
        -- (112)
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.AppealDueDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')                 AS AppealDueDate,
        -- (113)
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.AppealDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')                    AS AppealFilingDate,
        -- (114)
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.JmAppealDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')                  AS AppealCourtJudgementDate,
        -- (115)
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.SupremeDueDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')                AS SupremeDueDate,
        -- (116)
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.SupremeDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')                   AS SupremeFilingDate,
        -- (117)
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.JmSupremeDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')                 AS SupremeCourtJudgementDate,
        -- (118)
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.NoticeAssetDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')               AS AssetInvestigationNoticeDate,
        -- (119)
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.InvestigationDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')             AS AssetInvestigationDate,
        -- (120)
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.NoticeSeizePropertyDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')       AS AssetSeizureNoticeDate,
        -- (121)
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.SeizePropertyDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')             AS AssetSeizureDate,
        -- (122)
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.OtherFrozenAssDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')            AS OtherAssetManagementDate,
        -- (123)
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.ReqRepayDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')                  AS DebtPaymentClaimFilingDate,
        -- (124)
        cm.BlackCaseNo                                                        AS CaseNumberBlack,
        -- (125)
        cm.RedCaseNo                                                          AS CaseNumberRed,
        -- (126)
        cm.JudgementNote                                                      AS Remark,
        -- (127)
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.RoyalDecreeDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')               AS PublicAnnouncementDate,
        -- (128)
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.AlertDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')                     AS CaseSuspensionDate,
        -- (129)
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.AcknowDebtDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')                AS DebtAcknowledgementDate,
        -- (130)
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.WithdrawDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')                  AS BsmeWithdrawLawsuitDate,
        -- (131)
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.PayOffDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')                    AS FullInstallmentPaidDate,
        -- (132)
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.BadDebtDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')                   AS WriteOffDate,
        -- (133)
        cm.CapitalFile                                                        AS PrincipalFiled,
        -- (134)
        cm.IntToFileAmount                                                    AS InterestUntilFilingDate,
        -- (135)
        ISNULL(cm.CapitalFile,0) + ISNULL(cm.IntToFileAmount,0)              AS LawsuitAmount,
        -- (136)
        cm.CapitalAppeal                                                      AS AppealAmount,
        -- (137)
        cm.CapitalSupreme                                                     AS SupremeAmount,
        -- (138)
        cm.RedCaseNoBank                                                      AS SubrogatedCaseNumberRed,
        -- (139)
        N'unknown'                                                           AS PlaintiffBank,
        -- (140)
        pi_law.FirstName + N' ' + ISNULL(pi_law.LastName,N'')               AS LawyerOffice,
        -- (141)
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.JudgmentBankruptcyDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')        AS BankruptcyJudgementDate,
        -- (142)
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.BankruptcyDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')                AS BankruptcyDischargeDate,
        -- (143)
        ISNULL(ra.Y2566,   0)                                                 AS Y2566,
        -- (144)
        ISNULL(ra.Y2567,   0)                                                 AS Y2567,
        -- (145)
        ISNULL(ra.M01_2567,0)                                                 AS M01_2567,
        -- (146)
        ISNULL(ra.M02_2567,0)                                                 AS M02_2567,
        -- (147)
        ISNULL(ra.M03_2567,0)                                                 AS M03_2567,
        -- (148)
        ISNULL(ra.M04_2567,0)                                                 AS M04_2567,
        -- (149)
        ISNULL(ra.M05_2567,0)                                                 AS M05_2567,
        -- (150)
        ISNULL(ra.M06_2567,0)                                                 AS M06_2567,
        -- (151)
        ISNULL(ra.M07_2567,0)                                                 AS M07_2567,
        -- (152)
        ISNULL(ra.M08_2567,0)                                                 AS M08_2567,
        -- (153)
        ISNULL(ra.TotalPrincipalPay,0)                                        AS PrincipalPaid,
        -- (154)
        ISNULL(ra.TotalInterestPay,0)                                         AS InterestPaid,
        -- (155)
        ISNULL(ra.TotalOtherPay,0)                                            AS OtherPaid,
        -- (156)
        ISNULL(pi_coll.FirstName+N' ',N'') + ISNULL(pi_coll.LastName,N'')    AS OfficerName,
        -- (157)
        NULLIF(CAST(la.UpdateDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')                    AS LastFollowUpDate,
        -- (158)
        ssm_d.StatusName                                                      AS Status1_Debtor,
        -- (159)
        NULLIF(CAST(su.StatusDebtorDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')              AS Status1Date,
        -- (160)
        scm.StatusCollectorName                                               AS Status2_Collection,
        -- (161)
        NULLIF(CAST(su.StatusCollectorDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')           AS Status2Date,
        -- (162)
        ssm_c.StatusName                                                      AS Status3_RestructuringByLG,
        -- (163)
        NULLIF(CAST(su.StatusCompromiseDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')          AS Status3DateByLG,
        -- (164)
        ssl.StatusLegalName                                                   AS Status4_Case,
        -- (165)
        NULLIF(CAST(su.StatusLegalDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')               AS Status4Date,
        -- (166)
        tcc.ContractNo                                                        AS RestructureContractNumber,
        -- (167)
        NULLIF(CAST(cm.AcknowDebtDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')                AS DebtAcknowledgementLetterDate,
        -- (168)
        NULLIF(CAST(tcc.ApproveDate AS DATE), '1900-01-01')                  AS RestructureApprovalDate,
        -- (169)
        CAST(scam.CampaignId AS NVARCHAR(20))                                 AS CampaignCode,
        -- (170)
        scam.CampaignName                                                     AS CampaignName,
        -- (171)
        smeas.MeasureName                                                     AS MeasureColor,
        -- (172)
        ct.ClaimTypeName                                                      AS ProjectName,
        -- (173)
        d.DebtorName                                                          AS DebtorName1,
        -- (174)
        N'unknown'                                                           AS Status3_ByCIF,

        -- report footer
        N'วันที่พิมพ์ : ' + dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(GETDATE())                AS PrintDate,
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(200))                                            AS PrintName

    FROM DataDebtorRelate r
    JOIN DataDebtor d         ON d.DebtorId       = r.DebtorId
    JOIN DataLG lg            ON lg.LGNo          = r.LGNo
    JOIN DataDebtorCard dc    ON dc.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId
    JOIN CIFCount cc          ON cc.CIFNo         = r.CIFNo

    -- Status update (ล่าสุดต่อ DebtorRelateId)
    LEFT JOIN LatestStatus su ON su.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId AND su.rn = 1

    -- CBS data
    LEFT JOIN DataLGCBS lgcbs ON lgcbs.LGNo = r.LGNo

    -- Bank / Branch / ClaimType
    LEFT JOIN SystemBankMaster       b   ON b.BankId         = lg.BankId
    LEFT JOIN SystemBankBranchMaster bb  ON bb.BankBranchId  = lg.BankBranchId
    LEFT JOIN SystemClaimTypeMaster  ct  ON ct.ClaimTypeId   = lg.ClaimTypeId

    -- Title
    LEFT JOIN SystemTitleMaster      tm  ON tm.TitleId        = d.TitleId

    -- Address (type 7 = ที่อยู่ตามทะเบียนบ้าน)
    LEFT JOIN LatestAddress          da  ON da.DebtorCode = d.DebtorCode
                                        AND da.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN SystemProvinceMaster   pv  ON pv.ProvinceId = da.ProvinceId
    LEFT JOIN SystemZoneMaster       zn  ON zn.ZoneId     = pv.ZoneId

    -- Port status
    LEFT JOIN SystemStatusPortMaster spm ON spm.StatusPortId = su.StatusPortId

    -- Collector status
    LEFT JOIN SystemStatusCollectorMaster scm ON scm.StatusCollectorId = su.StatusCollectorId

    -- Legal status (for cols 96, 105, 164)
    LEFT JOIN SystemStatusLegalMaster ssl ON ssl.StatusLegalId = su.StatusLegalId

    -- LG status (col 100)
    LEFT JOIN SystemStatusMaster ssm_lg  ON ssm_lg.SystemStatusId = su.StatusLGId

    -- Debtor status (col 158)
    LEFT JOIN SystemStatusMaster ssm_d   ON ssm_d.SystemStatusId  = su.StatusDebtorId

    -- Compromise status (col 162/174)
    LEFT JOIN SystemStatusMaster ssm_c   ON ssm_c.SystemStatusId  = su.StatusCompromiseId

    -- Legal case
    LEFT JOIN LatestAssignCase    ac  ON ac.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId AND ac.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN LTDataCaseMain      cm  ON cm.CaseMainId     = ac.CaseMainId

    -- Legal officer (from case)
    LEFT JOIN LatestPersonalInfo  pi_legal ON pi_legal.UserId = ac.LegalUserId AND pi_legal.rn = 1

    -- Law office (from case)
    LEFT JOIN LatestPersonalInfo  pi_law   ON pi_law.UserId   = ac.LawOfficeUserId AND pi_law.rn = 1

    -- Legal status for litigation step
    LEFT JOIN SystemStatusLegalMaster slt ON slt.StatusLegalId = cm.StatusProsecutionId

    -- Latest assignment
    LEFT JOIN LatestAssign la ON la.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId AND la.rn = 1

    -- Collector officer
    LEFT JOIN LatestPersonalInfo  pi_coll ON pi_coll.UserId   = la.CollectorOAUserId AND pi_coll.rn = 1

    -- Receipt aggregation
    LEFT JOIN ReceiptAgg ra ON ra.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId

    -- TDR: CompromiseContractLG → CompromiseContract
    LEFT JOIN LatestTDR                   tclg ON tclg.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId AND tclg.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN TDRDataCompromiseContract   tcc  ON tcc.CompromiseContractId = tclg.CompromiseContractId

    -- Campaign / Measure from TDR
    LEFT JOIN SystemCampaignMaster scam ON scam.CampaignId = tcc.DebtRequestId
    LEFT JOIN SystemMeasureMaster  smeas ON smeas.MeasureId = tcc.MeasureId

    -- Guarantor (first one)
    LEFT JOIN GuarantorInfo gi  ON gi.LGNo = r.LGNo AND gi.rn = 1

    -- Co-debtor (first one)
    LEFT JOIN CoDebtorInfo  cdi ON cdi.LGNo = r.LGNo AND cdi.rn = 1

    -- CIF loan age
    LEFT JOIN LoanAgeCIF    lac ON lac.CIFNo = r.CIFNo

    -- Principal by CIF
    LEFT JOIN PrincipalByCIF pp  ON pp.CIFNo = r.CIFNo

    -- ClaimPay by CIF
    LEFT JOIN ClaimPayByCIF  pcif ON pcif.CIFNo = r.CIFNo

    WHERE r.DebtorTypeId = 1
          AND CAST(dc.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
          AND (@DebtorCode     = 'null' OR d.DebtorCode    = @DebtorCode)
          AND (@LGNo           = 'null' OR r.LGNo          = @LGNo)
          AND (@ClaimPayTypeId = 0      OR lg.ClaimTypeId  = @ClaimPayTypeId)
          AND (@StatusPortId   = 0      OR su.StatusPortId = @StatusPortId)

    ORDER BY r.LGNo, d.DebtorCode;

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_DEB_10_TotalPortfolio]
    -- บังคับ
    @StartDate DATE = '2568-01-31',
    @EndDate DATE = '2568-08-31',
    @OrgStructureId INT = 0,
    @OrgSectionId INT = 0,
    @CollectorUserId INT = 0,
    @PrintUserId INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SET @OrgStructureId = ISNULL(@OrgStructureId, 0);
    SET @OrgSectionId = ISNULL(@OrgSectionId, 0);
    SET @CollectorUserId = ISNULL(@CollectorUserId, 0);
    SET @PrintUserId = ISNULL(@PrintUserId, 0);

    SET @StartDate = CASE
        WHEN YEAR(@StartDate) > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @StartDate)
        ELSE @StartDate
    END;

    SET @EndDate = CASE
        WHEN YEAR(@EndDate) > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @EndDate)
        ELSE @EndDate
    END;

    SELECT
        N'F1' AS Category, -- F1
        eod.MeasureId AS MeasureId,
        eod.MeasureName AS Status, -- Status
        COUNT(DISTINCT eod.CIFNo) AS CIFCode, -- รหัส CIF
        COUNT(DISTINCT eod.LGNo) AS LGCode, -- LG
        SUM(eod.ClaimPayAmount) AS NetClaim, -- Net Claim
--         SUM(eod.ClaimPay) AS OS, -- OS
--         SUM(eod.PrincipalTotal) AS OutstandingDebt, -- OS
SUM(eod.PrincipalTotal) AS OS,
       CONCAT(
    dbo.Fn_formatDate(@StartDate),
    ' - ',
    dbo.Fn_FormatDate(@EndDate)
) AS MonthName, -- วันที่เริ่มต้น
--        dbo.Fn_FormatDateMonth(@EndDate) AS MonthName,
--         dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG(p.UserId, 2) AS OrgStructureName,
--         dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG(p.UserId, 3) AS OrgSectionName,
--         CASE
--             WHEN p.OrgStructureId IN (5, 18) THEN N'ฝ่ายกิจการสาขา'
--             WHEN p.OrgStructureId = 47 THEN N'OA'
--             ELSE dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG(p.UserId, 2)
--         END AS MISOrgStructureName,
--         CASE
--             WHEN p.OrgStructureId = 47 THEN N'OA'
--             WHEN p.OrgStructureId = 5 THEN N'ฝ่ายกิจการสาขา 1'
--             WHEN p.OrgStructureId = 18 THEN N'ฝ่ายกิจการสาขา 2'
--             ELSE dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG(p.UserId, 3)
--         END AS MISOrgSectionName,
        CASE
            WHEN p.OrgStructureId IN (5, 18) THEN N'ฝ่ายกิจการสาขา'
            WHEN p.OrgStructureId = 47 THEN N'OA'
            ELSE dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG(p.UserId, 2)
        END AS OrgStructureName,
        CASE
            WHEN p.OrgStructureId = 47 THEN N'OA'
            WHEN p.OrgStructureId = 5 THEN N'ฝ่ายกิจการสาขา 1'
            ELSE dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG(p.UserId, 3)
        END AS OrgSectionName,
        N'วันที่พิมพ์ : ' + dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(GETDATE()) AS PrintDate,
        N'ผู้สั่งพิมพ์ : ' + dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(@PrintUserId) AS PrintName
    FROM eod.DataEndOfDay eod
    LEFT JOIN dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContract ct ON ct.CompromiseContractId = eod.CompromiseContractId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataDebtorRelate r ON r.DebtorRelateId = eod.DebtorRelateId
-- 		LEFT JOIN dbo.DataLG lg ON r.LGNo = lg.LGNo
    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataPersonalInfo p ON p.UserId = ct.CompoundUserId AND p.UserId <> 0
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemOrgSectionMaster s ON s.OrgSectionId = p.OrgSectionId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataLG lg ON lg.LGNo = eod.LGNo
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemMeasureMaster m ON m.MeasureId = ct.MeasureId
    WHERE CAST(eod.CompromiseContracApproveDate AS DATE) BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
      
      AND (p.OrgStructureId = @OrgStructureId OR @OrgStructureId = 0)
      AND (p.OrgSectionId = @OrgSectionId   OR @OrgSectionId = 0)
      AND (ct.CompoundUserId = @CollectorUserId OR @CollectorUserId = 0)
      AND lg.Grade = N'F1'
      AND eod.MeasureId IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
    eod.MeasureId,
        eod.MeasureName,
        p.UserId,
        p.OrgStructureId;
END

--         CASE
--             WHEN p.OrgStructureId = 47 THEN N'OA'
--             WHEN p.OrgStructureId = 5 THEN N'ฝ่ายกิจการสาขา 1'
--             WHEN p.OrgStructureId = 18 THEN N'ฝ่ายกิจการสาขา 2'
--             ELSE dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG(p.UserId, 3)
--         END AS MISOrgSectionName,
        CASE
            WHEN p.OrgStructureId IN (5, 18) THEN N'ฝ่ายกิจการสาขา'
            WHEN p.OrgStructureId = 47 THEN N'OA'
            ELSE dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG(p.UserId, 2)
        END AS OrgStructureName,
        CASE
            WHEN p.OrgStructureId = 47 THEN N'OA'
            WHEN p.OrgStructureId = 5 THEN N'ฝ่ายกิจการสาขา 1'
            WHEN p.OrgStructureId = 18 THEN N'ฝ่ายกิจการสาขา 2'
            ELSE dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG(p.UserId, 3)
        END AS OrgSectionName,
        N'วันที่พิมพ์ : ' + dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(GETDATE()) AS PrintDate,
        N'ผู้สั่งพิมพ์ : ' + dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(@PrintUserId) AS PrintName
    FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractLG clg
    LEFT JOIN dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContract ct ON ct.CompromiseContractId = clg.CompromiseContractId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataDebtorRelate r ON r.DebtorRelateId = clg.DebtorRelateId
-- 		LEFT JOIN dbo.DataLG lg ON r.LGNo = lg.LGNo
    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataPersonalInfo p ON p.UserId = ct.CompoundUserId AND p.UserId <> 0
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemOrgSectionMaster s ON s.OrgSectionId = p.OrgSectionId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataLG lg ON lg.LGNo = clg.LGNo
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemMeasureMaster m ON m.MeasureId = ct.MeasureId
    WHERE CAST(ct.ApproveDate AS DATE) BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
      AND ct.CompromiseContractStatusId = 58
      AND (p.OrgStructureId = @OrgStructureId OR @OrgStructureId = 0)
      AND (p.OrgSectionId = @OrgSectionId OR @OrgSectionId = 0)
      AND (ct.CompoundUserId = @CollectorUserId OR @CollectorUserId = 0)
      AND lg.Grade = N'F1'
    GROUP BY
        m.MeasureName,
        p.UserId,
        p.OrgStructureId;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_DEB_11_DebtPaymentAndRestructureSummaryReport_T1]
    -- บังคับ
    @StartDate       DATE          = '2569-07-01',
    @EndDate         DATE          = '2569-07-31',

    -- ไม่บังคับ
    @DebtorCode      NVARCHAR(20)  = N'null',
    @LGNo            NVARCHAR(20)  = N'null',
    @DebtorName      NVARCHAR(200) = N'null',
    @DebtorStatusId  INT           = 0,
    @OrgStructureId  INT           = 0,
    @PrintUserId     INT           = 0
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    /* =====================================================
       แปลงวันที่ พ.ศ. เป็น ค.ศ.
       ===================================================== */
    SET @StartDate =
        CASE
            WHEN YEAR(@StartDate) > 2400
                THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @StartDate)
            ELSE @StartDate
        END;

    SET @EndDate =
        CASE
            WHEN YEAR(@EndDate) > 2400
                THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @EndDate)
            ELSE @EndDate
        END;

    /* =====================================================
       รวม Period Summary ให้เหลือ 1 แถว
       ต่อ CompromiseContractId + LGNo + Year
       ===================================================== */
    ;WITH PeriodSummaryYear1 AS
    (
        SELECT
            ps.CompromiseContractId,
            ps.LGNo,
            MAX(ps.PaymentAmount) AS PaymentAmount
        FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractPeriodSummary ps
        WHERE ps.[Year] = 1
        GROUP BY
            ps.CompromiseContractId,
            ps.LGNo
    )
    SELECT
        dbo.Fn_FormatDateAD(c.ApproveDate) AS MonthlyPayment,
        dbo.Fn_FormatDateAD(c.DebtRequestDate) AS DebtRequestDate,

        lg.CIFNo,
        c.CompromiseContractId,
        c.RequestNo as ContractNo,
        lg.LGNo,

        dbo.Fn_FormatDate(cd.FirstPaymentDate) AS FirstPaymentDate,
        dbo.Fn_FormatDateAD(cd.CurrentPaymentDate) AS LastPaymentDate,

        '' AS AmountPastDue,

        a.TypeAssignId,

        CASE
            WHEN a.TypeAssignId = 1 THEN p1.EmployeeCode
            WHEN a.TypeAssignId = 2 THEN p2.EmployeeCode
            ELSE ''
        END AS CollectorCode,

        CASE
            WHEN a.TypeAssignId = 1
                THEN dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(p1.UserId)
            WHEN a.TypeAssignId = 2
                THEN dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(p2.UserId)
            ELSE N'รอจ่ายงาน OA'
        END AS CollectorName,

        g.GroupApproverName AS ApprovalAuthority,

        dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(ca.ApproverUserId) AS Approver1,

        l.LookUpValue AS Approver2,

        clg.PrincipalTotal AS OSTDR,
		a.TypeAssignId,
		a.DebtorRelateId,
		a.CollectorUserId,
        dbo.FN_DCS_47_GetOrgStructureMIS(
            a.DebtorRelateId
        ) AS Department,

        dbo.FN_DCS_48_GetOrgSectionMIS(
            a.DebtorRelateId
        ) AS TeamName,

        ct.ClaimTypeName AS GuaranteeType,

        r.ProjectName AS ProjectName,

        CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS PrincipalDiscount,

        p.PaymentAmount AS TermAmount,

        ISNULL(
            m.MeasureCode,
            CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), m.MeasureId)
        ) AS CampaignCode,

        dbo.FN_DCS_26_GetStatusName(
            u.StatusDebtorId
        ) AS Status,

        c.SeqNo AS SeqNo,
        c.InterestRate AS IntRate,
        clg.PeriodYear AS PlanYear,
        cast(c.UpfrontInstallments as int) AS InstallmentUpfront,
        clg.PeriodMonth AS InstallmentTerm,
        clg.PeriodMonth AS PeriodTerm,

        N'วันที่พิมพ์ : '
            + dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(GETDATE()) AS PrintDate,

        N'ผู้สั่งพิมพ์ : '
            + dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(@PrintUserId) AS PrintName

    FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractLG clg

    INNER JOIN dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContract c
        ON c.CompromiseContractId = clg.CompromiseContractId

    /* PeriodSummaryYear1 เหลือเพียง 1 แถวต่อสัญญาและ LG */
    INNER JOIN PeriodSummaryYear1 p
        ON p.CompromiseContractId = clg.CompromiseContractId
        AND p.LGNo = clg.LGNo

    LEFT JOIN dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractApprover ca
        ON ca.CompromiseContractId = c.CompromiseContractId
        AND ca.ApproverTypeId IN (271, 282, 283)

    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemGroupApproverMaster g
        ON g.GroupApproverId = c.ApproverLevelId

    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemMeasureMaster m
        ON m.MeasureId = c.MeasureId

    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataDebtorRelate r
        ON r.DebtorRelateId = clg.DebtorRelateId

    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataDebtorStatusUpdate u
        ON u.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId

    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataAssignment a
        ON a.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId

    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataDebtorCard cd
        ON cd.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId

    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataPersonalInfo p1
        ON p1.UserId = a.CollectorUserId

    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataPersonalInfo p2
        ON p2.UserId = a.CollectorOAUserId

    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemLookupMaster l
        ON l.LookupId = ca.ApproverTypeId

    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataLG lg
        ON lg.LGNo = clg.LGNo

    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemClaimTypeMaster ct
        ON ct.ClaimTypeId = lg.ClaimTypeId

    WHERE c.ApproveDate >= @StartDate
      AND c.ApproveDate < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @EndDate)
      AND c.CompromiseContractStatusId = 58
      AND clg.Grade = 'F1'

      AND (
            @LGNo = N'null'
            OR clg.LGNo = @LGNo
          )

      AND (
            @DebtorCode = N'null'
            OR clg.CIFNo = @DebtorCode
          )

      AND (
            @DebtorName = N'null'
            OR r.ProjectName LIKE N'%' + @DebtorName + N'%'
          )

      AND (
            @DebtorStatusId = 0
            OR u.StatusDebtorId = @DebtorStatusId
          );

END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_DEB_11_DebtPaymentAndRestructureSummaryReport_T2]
  -- 🟥 บังคับ
    @StartDate DATE = '2569-06-01' ,       -- วันที่เริ่มต้น
    @EndDate   DATE = '2569-06-30'  ,     -- วันที่สิ้นสุด
	@DebtorCode     nvarchar(20)  = N'null',
    @LGNo           nvarchar(20)  = N'null',
    @DebtorName     nvarchar(200) = N'null',
	@OrgStructureId INT = 0

	
AS


    SET @StartDate = CASE
        WHEN YEAR(@StartDate) > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @StartDate)
        ELSE @StartDate
    END;
    SET @EndDate = CASE
        WHEN YEAR(@EndDate) > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @EndDate)
        ELSE @EndDate
    END;
BEGIN



SELECT
     --1               AS No,                  -- No (1)
    dbo.Fn_FormatDateAD(rc.CreateDate)    AS DocDate,             -- DocDate (2)
    rc.ReceiptNo     AS PayNo,               -- PayNo (3)
    NULL             AS ReferenceNo,         -- ReferenceNo (4)
    rc.LGNo       AS LGNo,                -- LGNo (5)
    r.ProjectName AS DebtorName, -- DebtorName (6)
    N'รับคืนค่าประกันชดเชยบางส่วน' AS Refund,    -- refund (7)
    e.BankCode         AS BankCode,            -- BankCode (8)
    N'เงินโอน'      AS PaymentType,         -- Payment_type (9)
    e.BankName AS BankName,   -- BankName (10)
    e.BankBranchName AS BankBranchName, -- BankBranchName (11)
    dbo.Fn_FormatDateAD(rc.ReceiptDate)     AS PayDate,             -- PayDate (12)
    rc.PaymentAmount          AS TotalPay,            -- TotalPay (13)
    ct.ClaimTypeName AS ProjectTypeName, -- ProjectTypeName (14)
    cst.ClaimSubTypeName AS SubProjectTypeName, -- SubProjectTypeName (15)
    dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(rc.CollectorUserId)  AS UserName,     -- UserName (16)
    rc.SectionName AS DivisionCode, -- DivisionCode (17)
    r.CIFNo       AS DebtorCode,          -- DebtorCode (18)
	ct.ERPCode,
	ct.ClaimTypeId,
    case when cst.ClaimSubTypeId is null then ct.ERPCode else cst.ERPCode end       AS ERPProductCode,      -- ERPProductCode (19)
    rc.PrincipalPay          AS CapitalPay,          -- CapitalPay (20)
    rc.PrincipalTotal        AS BalanceCapital,      -- BalanceCapital (21)
    rc.AccruedInterestPay                AS IntPay,              -- IntPay (22)
    isnull(rc.DefaultInterestPay,0)              AS DefaultIntPay,       -- DefaultIntPay (23)
    rc.CourtFeePay                AS CourtFeePay,         -- CourtFeePay (24)
    rc.LawyerFeePay               AS LawyerFeePay,        -- LawyerFeePay (25)
    rc.OtherExpensePay                AS OtherPay,            -- OtherPay (26)
    dbo.Fn_FormatDateAD(rc.ReceiptDate)      AS DatePay,             -- DatePay (27)
    dbo.Fn_FormatDateAD(@EndDate)     AS EndMonthDate,        -- EndMonthDate (28)
    0              AS DiffDate,            -- DiffDate (29)
    rc.PlannedInterestTotal         AS AccruedInt,          -- AccruedInt (30)
    rc.DefaultInterestTotal                AS AccruedDefaultInt,   -- AccruedDefaultInt (31)
    0                AS RemainIn,            -- RemainIn (32)
    case when p.OrgStructureId = 47 then dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(p.UserId) else '' end AS Outsource,           -- Outsource (33)
    e.Reference1 AS Reference1,          -- Reference1 (34)
    e.Reference2       AS Reference2,          -- Reference2 (35)
    --'15760000000000' AS Text17,              -- Text17 (36)
    --'60045699'       AS Text18,              -- Text18 (37)
    dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(rc.CollectorUserId) AS CollectorName, -- CollectorName (38)
    ct.ClaimTypeId               AS ProjectTypeId,       -- ProjectTypeId (39)
    cst.ClaimSubTypeId                AS SubProjectTypeId,    -- SubProjectTypeId (40)
    dbo.Fn_FormatDateAD(rc.CreateDate)            AS SendDate,            -- SendDate (41)
    --'6/11/2566'      AS Text21,              -- Text21 (42)
    --N'มาตรการ 3 ลูกหนี้ดีมีวินัย 2566' AS Text23, -- Text23 (43)
    rc.OverdueAmount                AS OverTransfer,        -- ยอดเงินโอนเกิน (44)
    rc.PeriodYear                AS PlanYear,            -- ปีที่ชำระตามแพลน (45)
    rc.InstallmentAmount       AS Installment,         -- ค่างวด (46)
    case when p.OrgStructureId IN (5, 18) THEN N'ฝ่ายกิจการสาขา'
	when p.OrgStructureId IN (34) THEN s.OrgStructureName
	else 'OA' end             AS Department,          -- ฝ่าย (47)
    case when p.OrgStructureId = 5 THEN N'ฝ่ายกิจการสาขา 1'
    when p.OrgStructureId = 18 THEN N'ฝ่ายกิจการสาขา 2'
    when p.OrgStructureId =34 THEN sc.SectionNameTH
	else 'OA' end AS TeamName,            -- ทีม (48)
    ct.ClaimTypeName             AS GuaranteeType,       -- ประเภทการค้ำหลัก (49)
    r.ProjectName             AS ProjectName,         -- โครงการ (50)
    --case when s.OrgStructureId = 47 then goa.OAGroupName    else '' end         AS GroupPay             -- กลุ่มจ่ายงาน (51)
	'' AS GroupPay 
	from ACCDataReceipt rc
	left join DataEStatement e on e.EStatementId = rc.eStatementId
	left join DataDebtorRelate r on r.DebtorRelateId = rc.DebtorRelateId
	left join DataLG lg on lg.LGNo = rc.LGNo
	left join SystemClaimTypeMaster ct on ct.ClaimTypeId = lg.ClaimTypeId
	left join SystemClaimSubTypeMaster cst on cst.ClaimSubTypeId = lg.ClaimSubTypeId
	left join DataPersonalInfo p on p.UserId = rc.CollectorUserId
	left join SystemOrgStructure s on s.OrgStructureId = p.OrgStructureId
	left join SystemOrgSectionMaster sc on sc.OrgSectionId = p.OrgSectionId
	--left join TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlan pl on pl.LGNo = rc.LGNo and rc.PeriodMonth = pl.InstallmentSeq
	--left join ACCDataMonthlyReport m on m.DebtorRelateId = rc.DebtorRelateId and cast(m.AsOfDate as date) = @EndDate
	--left join DataEndOfDay eod on eod.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId and cast(eod.AsOfDate as date) = @EndDate and eod.CompromiseContractId is not null
	--left join DEBDataAssignOA oa on oa.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId
	--left join SystemOAGroupMaster goa on goa.OAGroupId = oa.OAGroupId
	where cast(rc.ReceiptDate as date) between @StartDate and @EndDate
	AND (@LGNo = N'null' OR r.LGNo = @LGNo)
    AND (@DebtorCode = N'null' OR r.CIFNo = @DebtorCode)
    AND (@DebtorName = N'null' OR r.ProjectName LIKE N'%' + @DebtorName + N'%')
	AND (@OrgStructureId = 0 OR s.OrgStructureId = @OrgStructureId)
	and e.BankCode is not null





		
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_DEB_12_MonthlyDebtPayment]
    -- บังคับ
    @StartDate DATE = '2569-01-01',
    @EndDate   DATE = '2569-05-30',

    -- ไม่บังคับ
    @DebtorCode     NVARCHAR(20)  = N'null',
    @LGNo           NVARCHAR(20)  = N'null',
    @DebtorName     NVARCHAR(200) = N'null',
    @DebtorStatusId INT           = 0,
    @ProvinceId     INT           = 0,
    @PrintUserId    INT           = 1
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    /* =========================================================
       1. กำหนดค่าเริ่มต้น
       ========================================================= */
    SET @DebtorCode     = ISNULL(@DebtorCode, N'null');
    SET @LGNo           = ISNULL(@LGNo, N'null');
    SET @DebtorName     = ISNULL(@DebtorName, N'null');
    SET @DebtorStatusId = ISNULL(@DebtorStatusId, 0);
    SET @ProvinceId     = ISNULL(@ProvinceId, 0);
    SET @PrintUserId    = ISNULL(@PrintUserId, 1);

    /* แปลงปี พ.ศ. เป็น ค.ศ. */
    SET @EndDate =
        CASE
            WHEN YEAR(@EndDate) > 2400
                THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @EndDate)
            ELSE @EndDate
        END;

    /* รายงานนี้ใช้ข้อมูลตั้งแต่วันที่ 1 ของเดือน @EndDate */
    SET @StartDate =
        DATEFROMPARTS
        (
            YEAR(@EndDate),
            MONTH(@EndDate),
            1
        );

    DECLARE @EndDateNext DATE = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @EndDate);

    /* =========================================================
       2. เตรียมข้อมูลที่ต้องลดให้เหลือ 1 Record
       ========================================================= */
    ;WITH FirstAddress AS
    (
        /* เลือกที่อยู่ประเภท 1 เพียง 1 รายการต่อลูกหนี้ */
        SELECT
            da.DebtorId,
            MIN(da.DebtorAddressId) AS DebtorAddressId
        FROM dbo.DataDebtorAddress da
        WHERE da.DebtorAddressTypeId = 1
        GROUP BY
            da.DebtorId
    ),
    AddressData AS
    (
        SELECT
            fa.DebtorId,
            da.ProvinceId
        FROM FirstAddress fa
        LEFT JOIN dbo.DataDebtorAddress da
            ON da.DebtorAddressId = fa.DebtorAddressId
    ),
    AssignmentRanked AS
    (
        /*
            ป้องกัน DataAssignment มีหลายรายการต่อ DebtorRelateId

            ลำดับการเลือก:
            1. เลือกรายการที่มีผู้รับผิดชอบแล้วก่อน
            2. เลือก TypeAssignId 1 หรือ 2 ก่อน
            3. เลือกค่าผู้รับผิดชอบที่มากที่สุดเพื่อให้ผลลัพธ์คงที่
        */
        SELECT
            da.DebtorRelateId,
            da.TypeAssignId,
            da.CollectorUserId,
            da.CollectorOAUserId,

            ROW_NUMBER() OVER
            (
                PARTITION BY da.DebtorRelateId
                ORDER BY
                    CASE
                        WHEN da.TypeAssignId = 1
                         AND NULLIF(da.CollectorUserId, 0) IS NOT NULL
                            THEN 0

                        WHEN da.TypeAssignId = 2
                         AND NULLIF(da.CollectorOAUserId, 0) IS NOT NULL
                            THEN 0

                        ELSE 1
                    END,

                    CASE
                        WHEN da.TypeAssignId IN (1, 2)
                            THEN 0
                        ELSE 1
                    END,

                    da.TypeAssignId DESC,
                    da.CollectorUserId DESC,
                    da.CollectorOAUserId DESC
            ) AS RowNo
        FROM dbo.DataAssignment da
    ),
    AssignmentOne AS
    (
        SELECT
            ar.DebtorRelateId,
            ar.TypeAssignId,
            ar.CollectorUserId,
            ar.CollectorOAUserId
        FROM AssignmentRanked ar
        WHERE ar.RowNo = 1
    ),
    DebtorStatusOne AS
    (
        /*
            DataDebtorStatusUpdate ควรมี 1 รายการต่อ DebtorRelateId
            GROUP BY ไว้เพื่อป้องกันข้อมูลซ้ำแล้วทำให้ใบเสร็จถูกคูณ
        */
        SELECT
            su.DebtorRelateId,
            MAX(su.StatusDebtorId) AS StatusDebtorId
        FROM dbo.DataDebtorStatusUpdate su
        GROUP BY
            su.DebtorRelateId
    )

    /* =========================================================
       3. ข้อมูลรายงาน
       ========================================================= */
    SELECT
        dbo.Fn_FormatDateAD(@EndDate) AS Datamonth,

        r.CIFNo AS DebtorCode,
        rc.LGNo AS LGCode,
        r.ProjectName AS Fullname,
        d.BusinessTypeName AS BusinessType,
        pvm.Name AS Province,

        dbo.Fn_FormatDateAD(tdr.ApproveDate)
            AS DebtAckonwloedgementDate,

        CASE
            WHEN tdr.ApproveDate IS NULL
              OR YEAR(tdr.ApproveDate) = 1900
                THEN N''
            ELSE CONVERT
                 (
                     NVARCHAR(10),
                     MONTH(cd.RequestDebtorApproveDate)
                 )
        END AS AcknowledgementMon,

        CASE
            WHEN tdr.ApproveDate IS NULL
              OR YEAR(tdr.ApproveDate) = 1900
                THEN N''
            ELSE CONVERT
                 (
                     NVARCHAR(10),
                     YEAR(cd.RequestDebtorApproveDate)
                 )
        END AS AcknowledgementYear,

        dbo.FN_DCS_26_GetStatusName(su.StatusDebtorId)
            AS DebtorStatus,

        cd.CompromiseContractId,

        CASE
            WHEN cd.CompromiseContractId IS NOT NULL
                THEN ISNULL
                     (
                         tdrlg.PrincipalTotal,
                         cd.PrincipalTotal
                     )
            ELSE 0
        END AS DebtRestructureAmount,

        CASE
            WHEN cd.CompromiseContractId IS NOT NULL
                THEN ISNULL(tdr.Installments, 84)
            ELSE 0
        END AS Totallstallments,

        rc.ReceiptNo,

        rc.PeriodMonth AS CurrentInstallment,
        rc.PeriodYear AS CurrentInstallmentYear,

        rc.OverdueAmount AS OverdueInstallmentAM,
        rc.OverdueAmount AS OverdueInstallmentCount,

        dbo.Fn_FormatDateAD(cd.DFDDate) AS OverdueDate,

        cd.MeasureName AS Campaign,
        cd.InterestRate AS InterestRate,



        
        rc.PrincipalPay AS CapitalPayment,
        rc.AccruedInterestPay AS InterestPayment,
        ISNULL(rc.DefaultInterestPay, 0)
            AS DefaultInterestPayment,
        rc.CourtFeePay AS CourtFeePayment,
        rc.LawyerFeePay AS LawyerFeePayment,
        rc.OtherExpensePay AS OtherPayment,
		rc.PaymentAmount AS AmountPaid,
		ISNULL(rc.InstallmentAmount, ISNULL(pr.PaymentAmount, 0)) AS InstallmentAmount,
		rc.PaymentAmount - 
		ISNULL(rc.InstallmentAmount, ISNULL(pr.PaymentAmount, 0)) AS PaymentVsInstallment,
    --    CASE
    --        WHEN rc.PeriodYear IS NULL
    --            THEN 0
    --        ELSE
    --            ISNULL(rc.PaymentAmount, 0)
				---ISNULL
    --            (rc.InstallmentAmount,ISNULL(pr.PaymentAmount, 0))

    --    END AS PaymentVsInstallment,
			
			case when ISNULL(rc.InstallmentAmount, ISNULL(pr.PaymentAmount, 0)) = 0 then 0
			else 
			rc.PaymentAmount * 100.0 / 
			ISNULL(rc.InstallmentAmount, ISNULL(pr.PaymentAmount, 0)) end
			AS InstallmentToPaymentRatioPercent,

        a.TypeAssignId,

        CASE
            WHEN a.TypeAssignId = 2
                THEN N'OA'
            ELSE ISNULL(sec.SectionNameTH, N'')
        END AS BranchOffice,

        CASE
            WHEN a.TypeAssignId = 2
             AND ISNULL(a.CollectorOAUserId, 0) = 0
                THEN N'OA'

            WHEN pi.OrgStructureId IN (5, 18)
                THEN N'ฝ่ายกิจการสาขา'

            WHEN pi.OrgStructureId = 47
                THEN N'OA'

            ELSE ISNULL(st.OrgStructureName, N'')
        END AS Department,

        CASE
            WHEN a.TypeAssignId = 2
             AND ISNULL(a.CollectorOAUserId, 0) = 0
                THEN N'OA'

            WHEN pi.OrgStructureId = 47
                THEN N'OA'

            WHEN pi.OrgStructureId = 5
                THEN N'ฝ่ายกิจการสาขา 1'

            WHEN pi.OrgStructureId = 18
                THEN N'ฝ่ายกิจการสาขา 2'

            ELSE ISNULL(sec.SectionNameTH, N'')
        END AS Team,

        CASE
            WHEN a.TypeAssignId = 1
                THEN dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName
                     (
                         a.CollectorUserId
                     )

            WHEN a.TypeAssignId = 2
             AND ISNULL(a.CollectorOAUserId, 0) > 0
                THEN dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName
                     (
                         a.CollectorOAUserId
                     )

            WHEN a.TypeAssignId = 3
                THEN N'รอเปลี่ยนผู้ดูแล'

            ELSE N'รอจ่ายงาน OA'
        END AS CollectorUser,

        ct.ClaimTypeName AS GuaranteeType,
        ct.ClaimTypeGroup AS Project,

        N'' AS WorkGroup,

        N'วันที่พิมพ์ : '
            + dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(GETDATE())
            AS PrintDate,

        N'ผู้สั่งพิมพ์ : '
            + ISNULL
              (
                  pt.TitleName
                  + pp.FirstName
                  + N' '
                  + ISNULL(pp.LastName, N''),
                  N''
              ) AS PrintName

    FROM dbo.ACCDataReceipt rc

    LEFT JOIN AssignmentOne a
        ON a.DebtorRelateId = rc.DebtorRelateId

    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataDebtorRelate r
        ON r.DebtorRelateId = rc.DebtorRelateId

    /*
        เลือก DataDebtorCard เพียง 1 รายการต่อ DebtorRelateId + LGNo
        และไม่เอา CardStatusId = 135
    */
    CROSS APPLY
    (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            cd1.CompromiseContractId,
            cd1.PrincipalTotal,
            cd1.RequestDebtorApproveDate,
            cd1.DFDDate,
            cd1.MeasureName,
            cd1.InterestRate,
            cd1.CardStatusId
        FROM dbo.DataDebtorCard cd1
        WHERE cd1.DebtorRelateId = rc.DebtorRelateId
          AND cd1.LGNo = rc.LGNo
          AND ISNULL(cd1.CardStatusId, 0) <> 135
        ORDER BY
            CASE
                WHEN cd1.CompromiseContractId IS NOT NULL
                    THEN 0
                ELSE 1
            END,

            ISNULL
            (
                cd1.RequestDebtorApproveDate,
                CONVERT(DATETIME, '19000101', 112)
            ) DESC,

            ISNULL(cd1.PrincipalTotal, 0) DESC
    ) cd

    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataDebtor d
        ON d.DebtorId = r.DebtorId

    LEFT JOIN AddressData addr
        ON addr.DebtorId = r.DebtorId

    LEFT JOIN dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContract tdr
        ON tdr.CompromiseContractId = cd.CompromiseContractId
       AND tdr.CompromiseContractStatusId = 58

    /*
        เลือก LG ในสัญญาประนอมหนี้เพียง 1 รายการ
        ป้องกัน Contract + LG + Grade มีข้อมูลซ้ำ
    */
    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            tdrlg1.LGNo,
            tdrlg1.PrincipalTotal
        FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractLG tdrlg1
        WHERE tdrlg1.CompromiseContractId =
              cd.CompromiseContractId

          AND tdrlg1.LGNo = rc.LGNo
          AND tdrlg1.Grade = N'F1'

        ORDER BY
            ISNULL(tdrlg1.PrincipalTotal, 0) DESC
    ) tdrlg

    /*
        PeriodSummary มีหลายปีต่อ Contract + LG
        เลือกปีที่ตรงกับ PeriodYear ของใบเสร็จก่อน
        ถ้าไม่พบ ให้เลือกปีล่าสุด
    */
    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            pr1.PaymentAmount
        FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractPeriodSummary pr1
        WHERE pr1.CompromiseContractId =
              tdr.CompromiseContractId

          AND pr1.LGNo = rc.LGNo

        ORDER BY
            CASE
                WHEN pr1.[Year] = rc.PeriodYear
                    THEN 0
                ELSE 1
            END,

            pr1.[Year] DESC,
            ISNULL(pr1.PaymentAmount, 0) DESC
    ) pr

    LEFT JOIN DebtorStatusOne su
        ON su.DebtorRelateId = rc.DebtorRelateId

    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemProvinceMaster pvm
        ON pvm.ProvinceId = addr.ProvinceId

    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataPersonalInfo pi
        ON pi.UserId =
           CASE
               WHEN a.TypeAssignId = 1
                   THEN NULLIF(a.CollectorUserId, 0)

               WHEN a.TypeAssignId = 2
                AND ISNULL(a.CollectorOAUserId, 0) <> 0
                   THEN a.CollectorOAUserId
           END

    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemOrgStructure st
        ON st.OrgStructureId = pi.OrgStructureId

    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemOrgSectionMaster sec
        ON sec.OrgSectionId = pi.OrgSectionId

    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataLG lg
        ON lg.LGNo = rc.LGNo

    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemClaimTypeMaster ct
        ON ct.ClaimTypeId = lg.ClaimTypeId

    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataPersonalInfo pp
        ON pp.UserId = @PrintUserId

    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemTitleMaster pt
        ON pt.TitleId = pp.TitleId

    WHERE rc.ReceiptDate >= @StartDate
      AND rc.ReceiptDate < @EndDateNext

      AND r.DebtorTypeId = 1

      AND
      (
          @LGNo = N'null'
          OR rc.LGNo = @LGNo
      )

      AND
      (
          @DebtorCode = N'null'
          OR r.CIFNo = @DebtorCode
      )

      AND
      (
          @DebtorName = N'null'
          OR r.ProjectName LIKE N'%' + @DebtorName + N'%'
      )

      AND
      (
          @DebtorStatusId = 0
          OR su.StatusDebtorId = @DebtorStatusId
      )

      AND
      (
          @ProvinceId = 0
          OR addr.ProvinceId = @ProvinceId
      )

    ORDER BY
        rc.ReceiptDate,
        rc.ReceiptNo,
        rc.LGNo

    OPTION (RECOMPILE);
END
