CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_DEB_19_DebtorCallVolume]
    -- บังคับ
    @AsOfDate DATE = '2569-06-30',

    -- ไม่บังคับ
    @DebtorCode     NVARCHAR(20)  = N'null',
    @LGNo           NVARCHAR(20)  = N'null',
    @DebtorName     NVARCHAR(200) = N'null',
    @DebtorStatusId INT           = 0,
    @PrintUserId    INT           = 1
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    /* =========================================================
       1. จัดรูปแบบ Parameter
       ========================================================= */
    SET @DebtorCode = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@DebtorCode)), N'');
    SET @LGNo       = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@LGNo)), N'');
    SET @DebtorName = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@DebtorName)), N'');

    IF LOWER(ISNULL(@DebtorCode, N'')) = N'null'
        SET @DebtorCode = NULL;

    IF LOWER(ISNULL(@LGNo, N'')) = N'null'
        SET @LGNo = NULL;

    IF LOWER(ISNULL(@DebtorName, N'')) = N'null'
        SET @DebtorName = NULL;

    SET @DebtorStatusId = ISNULL(@DebtorStatusId, 0);
    SET @PrintUserId    = ISNULL(@PrintUserId, 1);

    /* รับวันที่ พ.ศ. จาก Report แล้วแปลงเป็น ค.ศ. */
    SET @AsOfDate =
        CASE
            WHEN YEAR(@AsOfDate) > 2400
                THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @AsOfDate)
            ELSE @AsOfDate
        END;

    DECLARE @MonthStartDate DATE =
        DATEFROMPARTS
        (
            YEAR(@AsOfDate),
            MONTH(@AsOfDate),
            1
        );

    DECLARE @AsOfDateExclusive DATE =
        DATEADD(DAY, 1, @AsOfDate);

    DECLARE @AsOfDateText NVARCHAR(100) =
        dbo.Fn_FormatDateAD(@AsOfDate);

    DECLARE @PrintDateText NVARCHAR(100) =
        N'วันที่พิมพ์ : '
        + dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(GETDATE());

    DECLARE @PrintNameText NVARCHAR(400) =
        N'ผู้สั่งพิมพ์ : '
        + ISNULL
        (
            dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(@PrintUserId),
            N''
        );

    DECLARE @DebtorStatusName NVARCHAR(100);
    DECLARE @DebtorStatusGroupId NVARCHAR(10);

    SELECT
        @DebtorStatusName = sm.StatusName,
        @DebtorStatusGroupId = sm.GroupStatusId
    FROM dbo.SystemStatusMaster sm
    WHERE sm.SystemStatusId = @DebtorStatusId;

    /* =========================================================
       2. กรอง DataEndOfDay และตัดข้อมูลซ้ำ

       ให้เหลือ 1 Record ต่อ:
       - DebtorId
       - CIFNo
       - LGNo
       ========================================================= */
    SELECT
        src.CIFNo,
        src.LGNo,
        src.DebtorId,
        src.DebtorRelateId,
        src.DebtorName,
        src.ClaimPay,
        src.ClaimPayDate,
        src.DebtBalance,
        src.PrincipalTotal,
        src.TypeAssignId,
        src.CollectorUserId,
        src.CollectorOAUserId,
        src.StatusCollectorId,
        src.StatusCompromiseId,
        src.StatusCardId,
        src.StatusLegalId,
        src.CurrentPaymentDate,
        src.StatusPortId
    INTO #EOD
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            e.CIFNo,
            e.LGNo,
            e.DebtorId,
            e.DebtorRelateId,
            e.DebtorName,
            e.ClaimPay,
            e.ClaimPayDate,
            e.DebtBalance,
            e.PrincipalTotal,
            e.TypeAssignId,
            e.CollectorUserId,
            e.CollectorOAUserId,
            e.StatusCollectorId,
            e.StatusCompromiseId,
            e.StatusCardId,
            e.StatusLegalId,
            e.CurrentPaymentDate,
            e.StatusPortId,

            ROW_NUMBER() OVER
            (
                PARTITION BY
                    e.DebtorId,
                    e.CIFNo,
                    e.LGNo

                ORDER BY
                    /* เลือกแถวที่มีข้อมูลสถานะครบมากที่สุด */
                    (
                        CASE
                            WHEN NULLIF(e.StatusCollectorId, 0)
                                 IS NOT NULL
                                THEN 1
                            ELSE 0
                        END
                        +
                        CASE
                            WHEN NULLIF(e.StatusCompromiseId, 0)
                                 IS NOT NULL
                                THEN 1
                            ELSE 0
                        END
                        +
                        CASE
                            WHEN NULLIF(e.StatusCardId, 0)
                                 IS NOT NULL
                                THEN 1
                            ELSE 0
                        END
                        +
                        CASE
                            WHEN NULLIF(e.StatusLegalId, 0)
                                 IS NOT NULL
                                THEN 1
                            ELSE 0
                        END
                        +
                        CASE
                            WHEN NULLIF(e.StatusPortId, 0)
                                 IS NOT NULL
                                THEN 1
                            ELSE 0
                        END
                    ) DESC,

                    /* เลือกแถวที่มีผู้รับผิดชอบก่อน */
                    CASE
                        WHEN NULLIF(e.CollectorUserId, 0) IS NOT NULL
                          OR NULLIF(e.CollectorOAUserId, 0) IS NOT NULL
                            THEN 0
                        ELSE 1
                    END,

                    e.ClaimPayDate DESC,
                    e.DebtorRelateId DESC
            ) AS RowNo

        FROM dbo.DataEndOfDay e
        WHERE e.DebtorTypeId = 1

          AND e.AsOfDate >= @AsOfDate
          AND e.AsOfDate < @AsOfDateExclusive

          AND
          (
                @DebtorCode IS NULL
             OR e.DebtorCode = @DebtorCode
             OR e.CIFNo = @DebtorCode
          )

          AND
          (
                @LGNo IS NULL
             OR e.LGNo = @LGNo
          )
    ) src
    WHERE src.RowNo = 1
    OPTION (RECOMPILE);

    CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_TMP_EOD_Debtor
        ON #EOD
        (
            DebtorId,
            LGNo,
            CIFNo
        );

    CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_TMP_EOD_DebtorRelate
        ON #EOD
        (
            DebtorRelateId
        );

    /* =========================================================
       3. รายการ DebtorId ที่เกี่ยวข้อง
       ========================================================= */
    SELECT DISTINCT
        e.DebtorId
    INTO #DebtorList
    FROM #EOD e
    WHERE e.DebtorId IS NOT NULL;

    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_TMP_DebtorList
        ON #DebtorList
        (
            DebtorId
        );

    /* =========================================================
       4. รายการ DebtorRelateId ที่เกี่ยวข้อง
       ========================================================= */
    SELECT DISTINCT
        e.DebtorRelateId
    INTO #DebtorRelateList
    FROM #EOD e
    WHERE e.DebtorRelateId IS NOT NULL;

    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_TMP_DebtorRelateList
        ON #DebtorRelateList
        (
            DebtorRelateId
        );

    /* =========================================================
       5. เลือก Assignment เพียง 1 Record ต่อ DebtorRelateId
       ========================================================= */
    SELECT
        src.DebtorRelateId,
        src.TypeAssignId,
        src.CollectorUserId,
        src.CollectorOAUserId
    INTO #Assignment
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            da.DebtorRelateId,
            da.TypeAssignId,
            da.CollectorUserId,
            da.CollectorOAUserId,

            ROW_NUMBER() OVER
            (
                PARTITION BY da.DebtorRelateId

                ORDER BY
                    CASE
                        WHEN da.TypeAssignId = 1
                         AND NULLIF(da.CollectorUserId, 0) IS NOT NULL
                            THEN 0

                        WHEN da.TypeAssignId = 2
                         AND NULLIF(da.CollectorOAUserId, 0) IS NOT NULL
                            THEN 0

                        ELSE 1
                    END,

                    CASE
                        WHEN da.TypeAssignId IN (1, 2)
                            THEN 0
                        ELSE 1
                    END,

                    da.TypeAssignId DESC,
                    da.CollectorUserId DESC,
                    da.CollectorOAUserId DESC
            ) AS RowNo

        FROM dbo.DataAssignment da
        INNER JOIN #DebtorRelateList dr
            ON dr.DebtorRelateId = da.DebtorRelateId
    ) src
    WHERE src.RowNo = 1;

    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_TMP_Assignment
        ON #Assignment
        (
            DebtorRelateId
        );

    /* =========================================================
       6. รวม EOD กับ Assignment และหาผู้รับผิดชอบ
       ========================================================= */
    SELECT
        e.CIFNo,
        e.LGNo,
        e.DebtorId,
        e.DebtorRelateId,
        e.DebtorName,
        e.ClaimPay,
        e.ClaimPayDate,
        e.DebtBalance,
        e.PrincipalTotal,
        e.StatusCollectorId,
        e.StatusCompromiseId,
        e.StatusCardId,
        e.StatusLegalId,
        e.CurrentPaymentDate,
        e.StatusPortId,

        assignSource.TypeAssignId,
        assignSource.CollectorUserId,
        assignSource.CollectorOAUserId,

        ResponsibleUserId =
            CASE
                WHEN assignSource.TypeAssignId = 1
                    THEN assignSource.CollectorUserId

                WHEN assignSource.TypeAssignId = 2
                    THEN assignSource.CollectorOAUserId
            END,

        IsWaitingOA =
            CASE
                WHEN assignSource.TypeAssignId = 2
                 AND assignSource.CollectorOAUserId IS NULL
                    THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
    INTO #Base
    FROM #EOD e

    LEFT JOIN #Assignment a
        ON a.DebtorRelateId = e.DebtorRelateId

    CROSS APPLY
    (
        SELECT
            TypeAssignId =
                COALESCE
                (
                    NULLIF(a.TypeAssignId, 0),
                    NULLIF(e.TypeAssignId, 0),
                    0
                ),

            CollectorUserId =
                COALESCE
                (
                    NULLIF(a.CollectorUserId, 0),
                    NULLIF(e.CollectorUserId, 0)
                ),

            CollectorOAUserId =
                COALESCE
                (
                    NULLIF(a.CollectorOAUserId, 0),
                    NULLIF(e.CollectorOAUserId, 0)
                )
    ) assignSource;

    CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_TMP_Base_Debtor
        ON #Base
        (
            DebtorId,
            LGNo,
            CIFNo
        );

    CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_TMP_Base_DebtorRelate
        ON #Base
        (
            DebtorRelateId
        );

    /* =========================================================
       7. หารายการติดตามล่าสุด

       ค้นหาเพียง 1 ครั้งต่อ DebtorId
       ไม่ค้นหาซ้ำทุก LG
       ========================================================= */
    SELECT
        dl.DebtorId,
        lastTrack.TransactionTrackingId,
        lastTrack.StatusTransactionTrackingId,
        lastTrack.TransactionTrackingDate
    INTO #LastTrack
    FROM #DebtorList dl

    CROSS APPLY
    (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            t.TransactionTrackingId,
            t.StatusTransactionTrackingId,
            t.TransactionTrackingDate
        FROM dbo.DEBDataTransactionTracking t
        WHERE t.DebtorId = dl.DebtorId
          AND t.TransactionTrackingDate >= CONVERT(DATE, '19000102')
          AND t.TransactionTrackingDate < @AsOfDateExclusive

        ORDER BY
            t.TransactionTrackingDate DESC,
            t.UpdateDate DESC,
            t.CreateDate DESC,
            t.TransactionTrackingId DESC
    ) lastTrack;

    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_TMP_LastTrack
        ON #LastTrack
        (
            DebtorId
        );

    /* =========================================================
       8. นับจำนวนการโทรภายในเดือน

       ใช้ GROUP BY ครั้งเดียว
       แทนการ COUNT ผ่าน OUTER APPLY ทีละ Record
       ========================================================= */
    SELECT
        t.DebtorId,
        COUNT(*) AS CountTrack
    INTO #TrackCount
    FROM dbo.DEBDataTransactionTracking t

    INNER JOIN #DebtorList dl
        ON dl.DebtorId = t.DebtorId

    WHERE t.TransactionTrackingDate >= @MonthStartDate
      AND t.TransactionTrackingDate < @AsOfDateExclusive

    GROUP BY
        t.DebtorId;

    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_TMP_TrackCount
        ON #TrackCount
        (
            DebtorId
        );

    /* =========================================================
       9. หาสถานะลูกหนี้ล่าสุด

       ค้นหาเพียง 1 ครั้งต่อ DebtorRelateId
       ========================================================= */
    SELECT
        dr.DebtorRelateId,
        lastStatus.StatusDebtorId
    INTO #StatusLatest
    FROM #DebtorRelateList dr

    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            st.StatusDebtorId
        FROM dbo.DataDebtorStatusUpdate st
        WHERE st.DebtorRelateId = dr.DebtorRelateId
          AND st.CreateDate < @AsOfDateExclusive

        ORDER BY
            COALESCE(st.UpdateDate, st.CreateDate) DESC,
            st.CreateDate DESC,
            st.DebtorStatusUpdateId DESC
    ) lastStatus;

    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_TMP_StatusLatest
        ON #StatusLatest
        (
            DebtorRelateId
        );

    /* =========================================================
       10. ชื่อผู้กู้จาก DataDebtor

       GROUP BY เพื่อป้องกัน DataDebtor ทำข้อมูลซ้ำ
       ========================================================= */
    SELECT
        dd.DebtorId,

        MAX
        (
            NULLIF
            (
                LTRIM(RTRIM(dd.DebtorName)),
                N''
            )
        ) AS DebtorName
    INTO #DebtorMasterName
    FROM dbo.DataDebtor dd

    INNER JOIN #DebtorList dl
        ON dl.DebtorId = dd.DebtorId

    GROUP BY
        dd.DebtorId;

    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_TMP_DebtorMasterName
        ON #DebtorMasterName
        (
            DebtorId
        );

    /* เรียกฟังก์ชันชื่อผู้กู้ครั้งเดียวต่อ DebtorId */
    SELECT
        dl.DebtorId,

        COALESCE
        (
            NULLIF
            (
                LTRIM
                (
                    RTRIM
                    (
                        dbo.FN_DCS_16_GetDebtorName(dl.DebtorId)
                    )
                ),
                N''
            ),
            dm.DebtorName
        ) AS DebtorName
    INTO #DebtorName
    FROM #DebtorList dl

    LEFT JOIN #DebtorMasterName dm
        ON dm.DebtorId = dl.DebtorId;

    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_TMP_DebtorName
        ON #DebtorName
        (
            DebtorId
        );

    /* =========================================================
       11. หารายชื่อผู้รับผิดชอบไม่ซ้ำ
       ========================================================= */
    SELECT DISTINCT
        b.ResponsibleUserId
    INTO #ResponsibleUserList
    FROM #Base b
    WHERE b.ResponsibleUserId IS NOT NULL;

    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_TMP_ResponsibleUserList
        ON #ResponsibleUserList
        (
            ResponsibleUserId
        );

    /*
        เรียกฟังก์ชันชื่อและหน่วยงาน
        เพียง 1 ครั้งต่อเจ้าหน้าที่หนึ่งคน
    */
    SELECT
        ru.ResponsibleUserId,

        dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName
        (
            ru.ResponsibleUserId
        ) AS ResponsibleOfficer,

        dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG
        (
            ru.ResponsibleUserId,
            2
        ) AS CollectionDepartment,

        dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG
        (
            ru.ResponsibleUserId,
            3
        ) AS CollectionTeam,

        CASE
            WHEN p.OrgStructureId IN (5, 18)
                THEN N'ฝ่ายกิจการสาขา'

            WHEN p.OrgStructureId = 47
                THEN N'OA'

            ELSE dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG
                 (
                     ru.ResponsibleUserId,
                     2
                 )
        END AS OrgStructureName,

        CASE
            WHEN p.OrgStructureId = 47
                THEN N'OA'

            WHEN p.OrgStructureId = 5
                THEN N'ฝ่ายกิจการสาขา 1'

            WHEN p.OrgStructureId = 18
                THEN N'ฝ่ายกิจการสาขา 2'

            ELSE dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG
                 (
                     ru.ResponsibleUserId,
                     3
                 )
        END AS OrgSectionName

    INTO #ResponsibleUser
    FROM #ResponsibleUserList ru

    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataPersonalInfo p
        ON p.UserId = ru.ResponsibleUserId
       AND p.UserId <> 0;

    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_TMP_ResponsibleUser
        ON #ResponsibleUser
        (
            ResponsibleUserId
        );

    /* =========================================================
       12. แสดงผล
       ========================================================= */
    SELECT
        @AsOfDateText AS AsOfDate,

        b.CIFNo AS CIFCode,
        b.LGNo,
        b.DebtorId,

        COALESCE
        (
            dn.DebtorName,
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(b.DebtorName)), N'')
        ) AS DebtorName,

        b.ClaimPay AS CompensationPaid,

        dbo.Fn_FormatDateAD
        (
            b.ClaimPayDate
        ) AS CompensationPaidDate,

        b.PrincipalTotal AS OutstandingDebt,

        CASE
            WHEN b.ResponsibleUserId IS NOT NULL
                THEN ISNULL
                (
                    ru.ResponsibleOfficer,
                    N'unknown'
                )

            WHEN b.IsWaitingOA = 1
                THEN N'รอจ่ายงาน OA'

            ELSE N'unknown'
        END AS ResponsibleOfficer,

        CASE
            WHEN b.ResponsibleUserId IS NOT NULL
                THEN ISNULL
                (
                    ru.OrgStructureName,
                    N'unknown'
                )

            WHEN b.IsWaitingOA = 1
                THEN N'OA'

            ELSE N'unknown'
        END AS CollectionDepartment,

        CASE
            WHEN b.ResponsibleUserId IS NOT NULL
                THEN ISNULL
                (
                    ru.OrgSectionName,
                    N'unknown'
                )

            WHEN b.IsWaitingOA = 1
                THEN N'OA'

            ELSE N'unknown'
        END AS CollectionTeam,

        CASE
            WHEN b.ResponsibleUserId IS NOT NULL
                THEN ISNULL
                (
                    ru.CollectionDepartment,
                    N'unknown'
                )

            WHEN b.IsWaitingOA = 1
                THEN N'OA'

            ELSE N'unknown'
        END AS CollectionDepartment2,

        CASE
            WHEN b.ResponsibleUserId IS NOT NULL
                THEN ISNULL
                (
                    ru.CollectionTeam,
                    N'unknown'
                )

            WHEN b.IsWaitingOA = 1
                THEN N'OA'

            ELSE N'unknown'
        END AS CollectionTeam2,

        CASE
            WHEN b.TypeAssignId = 2
                THEN N'OA'

            WHEN b.ResponsibleUserId IS NOT NULL
                THEN ISNULL
                (
                    ru.CollectionTeam,
                    N''
                )

            ELSE N''
        END AS BranchOffice,                                      -- สำนักงานเขต = ชื่อส่วนงานดิบ dbo.SystemOrgSectionMaster.SectionNameTH ผ่าน FN_DCS_30_GetORG(UserId, 3) เช่น "สำนักงานสาขาเชียงใหม่ (สำนักงานเขตภาคเหนือตอนบน)"; งาน OA → 'OA'

        smCollector.StatusName AS DebtStatus,
        smCompromise.StatusName AS RestructureStatus,
        smCard.StatusName AS CardStatus,
        smLegal.StatusName AS CaseStatus,

        dbo.Fn_FormatDateAD
        (
            b.CurrentPaymentDate
        ) AS LastPaymentDate,

        smPort.StatusName AS PortStatus,

        dbo.Fn_FormatDateAD
        (
            lt.TransactionTrackingDate
        ) AS LastFollowUpDate,

        smContact.StatusName AS ContactStatus,

        ISNULL
        (
            tc.CountTrack,
            0
        ) AS CallCount,

        /* ใช้สูตรเดิม */
        DATEDIFF
        (
            DAY,
            lt.TransactionTrackingDate,
            @AsOfDate
        ) AS DaysSinceLastContact,

        /* ใช้สูตรเดิม */
        DATEDIFF
        (
            MONTH,
            lt.TransactionTrackingDate,
            @AsOfDate
        ) AS MonthsSinceLastContact,

        @AsOfDateText AS DataAsOf,
        @PrintDateText AS PrintDate,
        @PrintNameText AS PrintName

    FROM #Base b

    /* INNER JOIN เพราะรายงานเดิมแสดงเฉพาะผู้ที่มี Tracking */
    INNER JOIN #LastTrack lt
        ON lt.DebtorId = b.DebtorId

    LEFT JOIN #TrackCount tc
        ON tc.DebtorId = b.DebtorId

    LEFT JOIN #StatusLatest sl
        ON sl.DebtorRelateId = b.DebtorRelateId

    LEFT JOIN #DebtorName dn
        ON dn.DebtorId = b.DebtorId

    LEFT JOIN #ResponsibleUser ru
        ON ru.ResponsibleUserId = b.ResponsibleUserId

    /* ใช้ JOIN แทน Scalar Function FN_DCS_26_GetStatusName */
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemStatusMaster smCollector
        ON smCollector.SystemStatusId = b.StatusCollectorId

    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemStatusMaster smCompromise
        ON smCompromise.SystemStatusId = b.StatusCompromiseId

    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemStatusMaster smCard
        ON smCard.SystemStatusId = b.StatusCardId

    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemStatusMaster smLegal
        ON smLegal.SystemStatusId = b.StatusLegalId

    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemStatusMaster smPort
        ON smPort.SystemStatusId = b.StatusPortId

    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemStatusMaster smContact
        ON smContact.SystemStatusId =
           lt.StatusTransactionTrackingId

    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemStatusMaster smDebtor
        ON smDebtor.SystemStatusId = sl.StatusDebtorId

    WHERE
	ru.ResponsibleOfficer is not null and
	ru.ResponsibleUserId !=1 and 
        (
            @DebtorName IS NULL

            OR COALESCE
               (
                   dn.DebtorName,
                   NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(b.DebtorName)), N'')
               )
               LIKE N'%' + @DebtorName + N'%'
        )

        AND
        (
               @DebtorStatusId = 0
            OR sl.StatusDebtorId = @DebtorStatusId
            OR
            (
                    @DebtorStatusGroupId = N'7'
                AND smDebtor.StatusName = @DebtorStatusName
            )
        )

    ORDER BY
        b.CIFNo,
        b.LGNo

    OPTION (RECOMPILE);
END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_DEB_20_DebtorContactResult]

  -- 🟥 บังคับ
    @StartDate DATE = '2568-01-01',
    @EndDate   DATE = '2569-10-01',

    -- 🟩 ไม่บังคับ
    @LGNo           NVARCHAR(20)   = 'null',
    @DebtorName     NVARCHAR(400)  = 'null',
    @DebtorStatusId INT            = 0,
    @PrintUserId INT  =1
	
	
AS

set @StartDate = case when year(@StartDate) > 2400 then dateadd(year, -543, @StartDate) else @StartDate end
set @EndDate = case when year(@EndDate) > 2400 then dateadd(year, -543, @EndDate) else @EndDate end
BEGIN

-- SELECT 
--     '3100088' AS DebtorCode,
--     '5918927' AS LGNO,
--     CONVERT(DATE, '2024-11-30') AS FollowDate,
--     NULL AS AppointmentDate,
--     NULL AS PaymentDate,
--     N'อยู่ระหว่างการผ่อนชำระหลังจากประนอมหนี้' AS FollowType,
--     N'คุณสุลาลักษณ์ 081-5441150 / แจ้งเตือนงวดเดือน ก.ย. 67 LG 5918927 ค่างวดปีแรก จำนวน 10,000 บาท, LG 5943333 ค่างวดปีแรก จำนวน 10,000 บาท และ LG 62030757 Upfront งวดที่ 5 จำนวน 113,000 บาท ภายในวันที่ 30 พ.ย. 67 / ทางไลน์' AS Description,
--     'C62033' AS CollectorCode,
--     N'กัณณ์พัชร ไกรศรีวรรธนะ' AS CollectorName,
--     CONVERT(DATE, '2024-11-30') AS CreateDate,
--     CONVERT(DATE, '2024-11-30') AS UpdateDate;


SELECT
dtr.CIFNo as DebtorCode
, dl.LGNO as LGNO
, dbo.Fn_FormatDateShort(t.TransactionTrackingDate) as FollowDate
, dbo.Fn_FormatDateShort(t.AppointmentDate) as AppointmentDate
, dbo.Fn_FormatDateShort(t.AppointmentPaymentDate) as PaymentDate
, dbo.FN_DCS_26_GetStatusName(t.StatusTransactionTrackingId) as FollowType
, t.TransactionTrackingDetail as Description
, dbo.FN_DCS_29_GetOfficerCode(t.CollectorUserId) as CollectorCode
, dbo.FN_DCS_16_GetDebtorName(t.DebtorId) as CollectorName
, dbo.Fn_FormatDateShort(t.CreateDate) as CreateDate
, dbo.Fn_FormatDateShort(t.UpdateDate) as UpdateDate
, t.CreateDate as CreateDateSort
    , N'วันที่พิมพ์ : ' + dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(GETDATE()) AS PrintDate
    , N'ผู้สั่งพิมพ์ : ' + dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(@PrintUserId) AS PrintName

from DEBDataTransactionTracking t

left join DataDebtorRelate dtr on dtr.DebtorId = t.DebtorId
left join DataDebtor d on d.DebtorId = t.DebtorId
left join DataLG dl on dl.LGNo = dtr.LGNo


--left join DEBDataBillPayment dbp on dbp.DebtorId = ddr.DebtorId
--left join SystemStatusCollectorMaster scm on scm.seq = dtr.Seq

where cast(t.CreateDate as date) between @StartDate and @EndDate
and (dtr.LGNo = @LGNo or 'null' = @LGNo)
and (d.FirstName like '%' + @DebtorName + '%' or d.LastName like '%' + @DebtorName + '%' or d.DebtorName like '%' + @DebtorName + '%' or 'null' = @DebtorName)
and (t.StatusTransactionTrackingId = @DebtorStatusId or 0 = @DebtorStatusId)
and dtr.DebtorTypeId = 1
		
END

-- =============================================
-- Version: v5 (2026-07-29) ปรับโครงเป็น basic join + OUTER APPLY ทั้งหมด (ยุบ CTE 8 ก้อนเหลือ 0 — ผลเท่าเดิมทุกแถว)
--          LastPayDate+LastPayment 2 ก้อนยุบเหลือ APPLY เดียว (TOP 1 เรียงวันชำระล่าสุด ได้ทั้งวันที่+ยอด)
-- Version: v4 (2026-07-29) เติมชื่อผู้กู้ร่วม (CoBorrowerName) จาก DataDebtorRelate.DebtorTypeId=2 บน LG เดียวกัน (เดิม NULL ยังไม่พบ source)
-- Version: v3 (2026-07-22) Asof เป็น DD/MM/YYYY ค.ศ. (Fn_FormatDateAD) + เพิ่มคอลัมน์ AsofSort ท้ายสุดไว้เรียงเวลา
--          (v2 = *_backup_v2_20260722.sql) | พิสูจน์ full query v3 บน UAT: 36 แถวเท่า v2 เรียงถูก
-- Version: v2 (2026-07-22) แก้ UAT Defect 21/07/2026 ข้อ 3 (วันที่ TDR ไม่แสดง — source ใหม่จากสัญญา TDR)
--          defect ข้อ 4 (ค่างวดค้าง=0) ไม่แก้ — พิสูจน์แล้วเป็นข้อมูล (มีค่า 17/38 แถว แถว 0 = ไม่มีการ์ด/ค่าจริง 0)
-- Author:        TCG DCS
-- Create date:   2026-07-20
-- Description:   5.8.1.22 รายงานแจ้งเตือนให้ติดตามลูกหนี้กรณีนัดชำระ
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_DEB_22_DebtorPaymentReminder]
    @StartDate DATE = '2569-05-31',
    @EndDate DATE= '2569-05-31',
    @LGNo NVARCHAR(20) = N'null',
    @DebtorName NVARCHAR(400) = N'null',
    @DebtorStatusId INT = 0,
    @PrintUserId INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SET @LGNo = ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@LGNo)), N''), N'null');
    SET @DebtorName = ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@DebtorName)), N''), N'null');
    SET @DebtorStatusId = ISNULL(@DebtorStatusId, 0);
    SET @PrintUserId = ISNULL(@PrintUserId, 0);

    SET @StartDate = CASE WHEN YEAR(@StartDate) > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @StartDate) ELSE @StartDate END;
    SET @EndDate = CASE WHEN YEAR(@EndDate) > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @EndDate) ELSE @EndDate END;

    SELECT DISTINCT
        dbo.Fn_FormatDateAD(t.AppointmentPaymentDate) AS Asof,                     -- วันที่นัดชำระ DD/MM/YYYY ค.ศ. dbo.DEBDataTransactionTracking.AppointmentPaymentDate
        r.CIFNo AS BorrowerID,                                                     -- รหัสผู้กู้
        r.LGNo AS LGNo,                                                            -- เลขที่หนังสือค้ำประกัน
        dbo.FN_DCS_16_GetDebtorName(d.DebtorId) AS BorrowerName,                   -- ชื่อผู้กู้
        dbo.FN_DCS_26_GetStatusName(COALESCE(t.StatusTransactionTrackingId, su.StatusCollectorId, su.StatusDebtorId)) AS StatusDCS, -- status DCS: สถานะติดตาม/สถานะลูกหนี้ล่าสุด
        COALESCE(NULLIF(t.DebtorContactTel, N''), tac.BorrowerAddressPhoneNumber, NULLIF(d.CntMobileNumber, N''), NULLIF(d.CntPhoneNumber, N'')) AS BorrowerPhone, -- เบอร์ติดต่อผู้กู้
        cob.CoBorrowerName AS CoBorrowerName,                                      -- ชื่อผู้กู้ร่วม (v4): dbo.DataDebtorRelate.DebtorTypeId = 2 บน LG เดียวกัน รวมชื่อด้วย comma
        dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG(p.UserId, 2) AS Branch,                               -- สำนักงานสาขา: org ของเจ้าหน้าที่ผู้ดูแล
        CASE
            WHEN s.OrgStructureId IN (5, 18) THEN N'ฝ่ายกิจการสาขา'
            WHEN s.OrgStructureId = 47 THEN N'OA'
            ELSE dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG(p.UserId, 2)
        END AS MISOrgStructureName,                                                -- BU ตาม mapping MIS
        CASE
            WHEN s.OrgStructureId = 47 THEN N'OA'
            WHEN s.OrgStructureId = 5 THEN N'ฝ่ายกิจการสาขา 1'
            WHEN s.OrgStructureId = 18 THEN N'ฝ่ายกิจการสาขา 2'
            ELSE dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG(p.UserId, 3)
        END AS MISOrgSectionName,                                                  -- Team ตาม mapping MIS
        ct.ClaimTypeName AS GuaranteeType,                                         -- ประเภทการค้ำหลัก: DataLG.ClaimTypeId
        claim.ClaimByCIF AS ClaimByCIF,                                            -- Claim by รหัส CIF: SUM(DataLG.ClaimPayAmount) ตาม CIF
        lg.ClaimPayAmount AS ClaimAmount,                                          -- ยอดจ่าย Claim: DataLG.ClaimPayAmount
        NULLIF(dc.MeasureName, N'') AS CampaignName,                               -- Campaign Name: DataDebtorCard.MeasureName
        dc.InterestRate AS InterestRate,                                           -- อัตราดอกเบี้ย: DataDebtorCard.InterestRate
        dc.SeqCurrent AS OverdueInstallments,                                      -- จำนวนงวดค้าง: DataDebtorCard.SeqCurrent
        dc.InstallmentOutstanding AS OverdueAmount,                                -- ค่างวดที่ค้าง: DataDebtorCard.InstallmentOutstanding
        dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(p.UserId) AS Officer,                         -- เจ้าหน้าที่ดูแล
        dbo.Fn_FormatDateAD(COALESCE(ltdr.LastTDRDate, NULLIF(dc.MeasureDate, '19000101'))) AS TDRDate, -- (v2) วันที่อนุมัติ TDR จากสัญญาจริง dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContract.TDRDate (สถานะ 58,62) fallback MeasureDate
        COALESCE(dbo.FN_DCS_26_GetStatusName(dc.CardStatusId), dc.CardType) AS CardStatus, -- Card Status: DataDebtorCard.CardStatusId/CardType
        dbo.Fn_FormatDateAD(COALESCE(NULLIF(dc.CurrentPaymentDate, '19000101'), m.PayDate)) AS LastPaymentDate, -- วันที่ชำระล่าสุด ค.ศ.
        COALESCE(NULLIF(m.TotalPay, 0), NULLIF(m.ReceivePayment, 0), ISNULL(m.PrincipalPay, 0) + ISNULL(m.AccruedInterestPay, 0)) AS LastPaymentAmount, -- ยอดเงินที่ชำระล่าสุด
        N'วันที่พิมพ์ : ' + dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(GETDATE()) AS PrintDate,
        N'ผู้สั่งพิมพ์ : ' + ISNULL(dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(@PrintUserId), N'') AS PrintName,
        t.AppointmentPaymentDate AS AsofSort                                       -- datetime ดิบไว้เรียงเวลาภายใต้ DISTINCT — RDL ไม่ต้องผูก/ไม่ต้องแสดง
    FROM dbo.DEBDataTransactionTracking t
    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataDebtor d ON d.DebtorId = t.DebtorId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataDebtorRelate r ON r.DebtorId = t.DebtorId AND r.DebtorTypeId = 1
    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataLG lg ON lg.LGNo = r.LGNo
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemClaimTypeMaster ct ON ct.ClaimTypeId = lg.ClaimTypeId
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT SUM(ISNULL(lg2.ClaimPayAmount, 0)) AS ClaimByCIF                    -- ยอดเคลมรวมทุก LG ของ CIF
        FROM dbo.DataLG lg2
        WHERE lg2.CIFNo = r.CIFNo
    ) claim
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT STRING_AGG(x.CoName, N', ') AS CoBorrowerName                       -- (v4) ชื่อผู้กู้ร่วมทุกคนบน LG เดียวกัน
        FROM (
            SELECT DISTINCT dbo.FN_DCS_16_GetDebtorName(r2.DebtorId) AS CoName
            FROM dbo.DataDebtorRelate r2
            WHERE r2.LGNo = r.LGNo AND r2.DebtorTypeId = 2                         -- 4 = ผู้กู้ร่วม (SystemDebtorType)
        ) x
    ) cob
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 su1.StatusCollectorId, su1.StatusDebtorId                     -- สถานะลูกหนี้ล่าสุด
        FROM dbo.DataDebtorStatusUpdate su1
        WHERE su1.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId
        ORDER BY su1.DebtorStatusUpdateId DESC
    ) su
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 dc1.*                                                          -- การ์ดลูกหนี้ล่าสุด
        FROM dbo.DataDebtorCard dc1
        WHERE dc1.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId
          AND ISNULL(dc1.IsDelete, 0) = 0
        ORDER BY dc1.DataDebtorCardId DESC
    ) dc
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 a1.TypeAssignId, a1.CollectorUserId, a1.CollectorOAUserId     -- การมอบหมายล่าสุด
        FROM dbo.DataAssignment a1
        WHERE a1.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId
          AND ISNULL(a1.IsShow, 1) = 1
        ORDER BY a1.AssignmentId DESC
    ) a
    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataPersonalInfo p ON p.UserId = COALESCE(NULLIF(t.CollectorUserId, 0), CASE WHEN a.TypeAssignId = 1 THEN NULLIF(a.CollectorUserId, 0) WHEN a.TypeAssignId = 2 THEN NULLIF(a.CollectorOAUserId, 0) ELSE NULLIF(a.CollectorUserId, 0) END)
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemOrgSectionMaster s ON s.OrgSectionId = p.OrgSectionId
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT MAX(c.TDRDate) AS LastTDRDate                                       -- (v2) วันที่อนุมัติ TDR ล่าสุดจากสัญญาสถานะอนุมัติ/ปิดแผน (58,62)
        FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractLG clg
        JOIN dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContract c ON c.CompromiseContractId = clg.CompromiseContractId
        WHERE clg.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId
          AND clg.LGNo = r.LGNo
          AND c.CompromiseContractStatusId IN (58, 62)
          AND c.TDRDate IS NOT NULL AND CAST(c.TDRDate AS DATE) > '1901-01-01'
    ) ltdr
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 tac1.BorrowerAddressPhoneNumber                                -- เบอร์ติดต่อจากข้อมูลเคลมล่าสุดของ LG
        FROM dbo.TEMPBorrowerAddressClaim tac1
        WHERE tac1.LGNO = r.LGNo
          AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(tac1.BorrowerAddressPhoneNumber)), N'') IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY tac1.TEMPId DESC
    ) tac
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 m1.PayDate, m1.TotalPay, m1.ReceivePayment, m1.PrincipalPay, m1.AccruedInterestPay -- รายการรับชำระล่าสุดของการ์ด (ยุบ LastPayDate+LastPayment เดิม)
        FROM dbo.DataDebtorCardMovement m1
        WHERE m1.DebtorCardId = dc.DataDebtorCardId
          AND ISNULL(m1.IsDelete, 0) = 0
          AND NULLIF(m1.PayDate, '19000101') IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY m1.PayDate DESC, m1.DebtorCardMovementId DESC
    ) m
    WHERE t.AppointmentPaymentDate >= @StartDate
      AND t.AppointmentPaymentDate < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @EndDate)
      AND t.AppointmentPaymentDate >= '1901-01-01'
      AND (@DebtorStatusId = 0 OR t.StatusTransactionTrackingId = @DebtorStatusId)
      AND (@LGNo = N'null' OR r.LGNo = @LGNo)
      AND (
          @DebtorName = N'null'
          OR d.FirstName LIKE N'%' + @DebtorName + N'%'
          OR d.LastName LIKE N'%' + @DebtorName + N'%'
          OR d.DebtorName LIKE N'%' + @DebtorName + N'%'
          OR dbo.FN_DCS_16_GetDebtorName(d.DebtorId) LIKE N'%' + @DebtorName + N'%'
      )
      AND ISNULL(dc.CardStatusId, 0) != 135
    ORDER BY
        t.AppointmentPaymentDate,
        r.CIFNo;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_DEB_23_OverdueDebtorReminder]
    @StartDate      DATE,
    @EndDate        DATE,
    @LGNo           NVARCHAR(20)  = N'null',
    @DebtorName     NVARCHAR(400) = N'null',
    @DebtorStatusId INT           = 0,
    @PrintUserId    INT           = 0
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;


    /* =============================================================
       1. Parameter
       ============================================================= */

    SET @LGNo =
        ISNULL(
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@LGNo)), N''),
            N'null'
        );


    SET @DebtorName =
        ISNULL(
            NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@DebtorName)), N''),
            N'null'
        );


    SET @DebtorStatusId = ISNULL(@DebtorStatusId, 0);

    SET @PrintUserId = ISNULL(@PrintUserId, 0);



    /* =============================================================
       2. รองรับวันที่ พ.ศ. -> ค.ศ.
       ============================================================= */

    SET @StartDate =
        CASE
            WHEN YEAR(@StartDate) > 2400
                THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @StartDate)

            ELSE @StartDate
        END;


    SET @EndDate =
        CASE
            WHEN YEAR(@EndDate) > 2400
                THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @EndDate)

            ELSE @EndDate
        END;



    /* =============================================================
       3. Main Query

       Base Table
       DEBDataRequestPaymentDebt
       ============================================================= */

    SELECT DISTINCT


        /* =========================================================
           Contract
           ========================================================= */

        c.CompromiseContractId,

        r.DebtorRelateId,



        /* =========================================================
           ลูกหนี้
           ========================================================= */

        COALESCE(
            r.CIFNo,
            dr.CIFNo
        ) AS DebtorCode,


        r.LGNo AS LGCode,


        dbo.FN_DCS_16_GetDebtorName(
            dr.DebtorId
        ) AS FullName,



        /* =========================================================
           วันที่ / วงเงิน
           ========================================================= */

        r.RequestPaymentDebtNo
            AS RequestPaymentDebtNo,


        dbo.Fn_FormatDateAD(
            CAST(
                NULLIF(
                    r.RequestPaymentDebtDate,
                    '19000101'
                )
                AS DATE
            )
        ) AS BookReceivedDate,


        dbo.Fn_FormatDateAD(
            CAST(
                NULLIF(
                    c.ApproveDate,
                    '19000101'
                )
                AS DATE
            )
        ) AS ApprovalDate,


        r.ClaimPay
            AS DebtAmount,


        r.TRRDebtBalance
            AS OutstandingDebt,



        /* =========================================================
           แผนผ่อนชำระ
           ========================================================= */

        plan_.TotalInstallments,


        r.AmountInstallments
            AS InstallmentAmount,


        r.InstallmentAmount
            AS AmountPerInstallment,


        dbo.Fn_FormatDateAD(
            CAST(
                COALESCE(

                    NULLIF(
                        clg.StartInstallmentPeriod,
                        '19000101'
                    ),

                    plan_.FirstDueDate

                )
                AS DATE
            )
        ) AS FirstPaymentDate,


        dbo.Fn_FormatDateAD(
            CAST(
                COALESCE(

                    NULLIF(
                        clg.EndInstallmentPeriod,
                        '19000101'
                    ),

                    plan_.LastDueDate

                )
                AS DATE
            )
        ) AS LastPaymentDate,



        /* =========================================================
           ค้างชำระ
           ========================================================= */

        cur.InstallmentSeq
            AS OverdueInstallment,


        cur.Instament
            AS OverdueInstallmentAmount,


        r.Installments
            AS OverdueInstallments,


        dbo.Fn_FormatDateAD(
            CAST(
                NULLIF(
                    cur.DueDate,
                    '19000101'
                )
                AS DATE
            )
        ) AS OverdueSince,


        dbo.Fn_FormatDateAD(
            CAST(
                DATEADD(
                    DAY,
                    1,
                    NULLIF(
                        cur.DueDate,
                        '19000101'
                    )
                )
                AS DATE
            )
        ) AS OverdueDate,



        /* =========================================================
           ผู้ดูแล
           ========================================================= */

        CASE

            WHEN a.TypeAssignId = 1
                THEN
                    dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(
                        a.CollectorUserId
                    )


            WHEN a.TypeAssignId = 2
                 AND ISNULL(
                        a.CollectorOAUserId,
                        0
                     ) <> 0
                THEN
                    dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(
                        a.CollectorOAUserId
                    )


            WHEN a.TypeAssignId = 2
                 AND ISNULL(
                        a.CollectorOAUserId,
                        0
                     ) = 0
                THEN N'รอจ่ายงาน OA'


            ELSE N''

        END AS Officer,



        ISNULL(
            sec.SectionNameTH,
            N''
        ) AS Branch,



        CASE

            WHEN pi.OrgStructureId IN (5, 18)
                THEN N'ฝ่ายกิจการสาขา'


            WHEN pi.OrgStructureId = 47
                THEN N'OA'


            ELSE
                ISNULL(
                    org.OrgStructureName,
                    N''
                )

        END AS MISOrgStructureName,



        CASE

            WHEN pi.OrgStructureId = 47
                THEN N'OA'


            WHEN pi.OrgStructureId = 5
                THEN N'ฝ่ายกิจการสาขา 1'


            WHEN pi.OrgStructureId = 18
                THEN N'ฝ่ายกิจการสาขา 2'


            ELSE
                ISNULL(
                    sec.SectionNameTH,
                    N''
                )

        END AS MISOrgSectionName,



        /* =========================================================
           ที่อยู่
           ========================================================= */

        dbo.FN_DCS_39_GetDebtorAddressComponent(
            dr.DebtorId,
            1,
            1
        ) AS Address,


        dbo.FN_DCS_39_GetDebtorAddressComponent(
            dr.DebtorId,
            1,
            5
        ) AS Soi,


        dbo.FN_DCS_39_GetDebtorAddressComponent(
            dr.DebtorId,
            1,
            4
        ) AS Road,


        dbo.FN_DCS_39_GetDebtorAddressComponent(
            dr.DebtorId,
            1,
            8
        ) AS SubDistrict,


        dbo.FN_DCS_39_GetDebtorAddressComponent(
            dr.DebtorId,
            1,
            7
        ) AS District,


        dbo.FN_DCS_39_GetDebtorAddressComponent(
            dr.DebtorId,
            1,
            6
        ) AS Province,


        dbo.FN_DCS_39_GetDebtorAddressComponent(
            dr.DebtorId,
            1,
            9
        ) AS PostalCode,



        /* =========================================================
           เงื่อนไขสัญญา
           ========================================================= */

        NULLIF(
            m.MeasureName,
            N''
        ) AS Campaign,


        c.InterestRate
            AS InterestRate,



        /* =========================================================
           EndOfDay

           Column 27 = ค่างวด1
           Column 28 = ชำระ
           Column 29 = ส่วนต่างค่างวด

           Installment1
               = TDRInstallmentsAmount

           PaidAmount
               = TotalPayMonth

           PaymentToInstallmentGap
               = ค่างวด - ชำระ

           ถ้าชำระเกินค่างวด
               ส่วนต่าง = 0
           ========================================================= */


        /* =========================================================
           27. ค่างวด1
           ========================================================= */

        ISNULL(
            eod.TDRInstallmentsAmount,
            0
        ) AS Installment1,



        /* =========================================================
           28. ชำระ
           ========================================================= */

        ISNULL(
            eod.TotalPayMonth,
            0
        ) AS PaidAmount,



        /* =========================================================
           29. ชำระเทียบกับค่างวด1 ส่วนต่าง

           เช่น
           ค่างวด 15,000
           ชำระ       0
           ส่วนต่าง 15,000

           ค่างวด 15,000
           ชำระ  15,000
           ส่วนต่าง     0
           ========================================================= */

        CASE

            WHEN
                ISNULL(
                    eod.TDRInstallmentsAmount,
                    0
                )
                <=
                ISNULL(
                    eod.TotalPayMonth,
                    0
                )

                THEN 0


            ELSE

                ISNULL(
                    eod.TDRInstallmentsAmount,
                    0
                )
                -
                ISNULL(
                    eod.TotalPayMonth,
                    0
                )

        END AS PaymentToInstallmentGap,



        /* =========================================================
           % สัดส่วนยอดรับชำระต่อค่างวด

           Payment / Installment * 100

           เช่น

           ค่างวด 1000
           ชำระ   1000
           = 100 %

           ค่างวด 15000
           ชำระ       0
           = 0 %

           ถ้าชำระเกินค่างวด
           จำกัดไว้ที่ 100 %
           ========================================================= */

        CASE

            WHEN
                ISNULL(
                    eod.TDRInstallmentsAmount,
                    0
                ) = 0

                THEN NULL


            WHEN
                ISNULL(
                    eod.TotalPayMonth,
                    0
                )
                >=
                ISNULL(
                    eod.TDRInstallmentsAmount,
                    0
                )

                THEN
                    CAST(
                        100
                        AS DECIMAL(18,2)
                    )


            ELSE

                CAST(
                    (
                        ISNULL(
                            eod.TotalPayMonth,
                            0
                        )
                        * 100.0
                    )
                    /
                    NULLIF(
                        eod.TDRInstallmentsAmount,
                        0
                    )

                    AS DECIMAL(18,2)
                )

        END AS PaymentRatio,



        /* =========================================================
           ท้ายรายงาน
           ========================================================= */

        N'วันที่พิมพ์ : '
        +
        dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(
            GETDATE()
        )
        AS PrintDate,



        N'ผู้สั่งพิมพ์ : '
        +
        ISNULL(
            dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(
                @PrintUserId
            ),
            N''
        )
        AS PrintName



    /* =============================================================
       4. Base Table

       หนังสือขอให้ชำระหนี้
       ============================================================= */

    FROM dbo.DEBDataRequestPaymentDebt r



    /* =============================================================
       5. DataEndOfDay

       เดิมใช้ LEFT JOIN ตรง ๆ

       LEFT JOIN DataEndOfDay eod
           ON eod.LGNo = r.LGNo
          AND eod.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId

       ปัญหา:
       DataEndOfDay เป็น Snapshot
       LG เดียวมีได้หลาย AsOfDate

       ดังนั้นถ้า JOIN ตรง ๆ
       อาจทำให้รายการซ้ำ

       วิธีใหม่:
       เอา Snapshot ล่าสุด
       ที่ AsOfDate <= @EndDate
       ============================================================= */

    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT TOP 1

            x.EndOfDayId,

            x.AsOfDate,

            x.LGNo,

            x.DebtorRelateId,


            /* -------------------------
               ค่างวด
               ------------------------- */

            x.TDRInstallmentsAmount,


            /* -------------------------
               ชำระประจำเดือน
               ------------------------- */

            x.TotalPayMonth,


            /* -------------------------
               ข้อมูลประกอบ TDR
               ------------------------- */

            x.TDRPayAmount,

            x.TDRPrincipalPay,

            x.TDRAccruedInterestPay,

            x.TDROutstandingDebt,

            x.CountOverdueInstallments,

            x.OverdueInstallment


        FROM dbo.DataEndOfDay x


        WHERE

            x.LGNo = r.LGNo


            AND x.DebtorRelateId =
                r.DebtorRelateId


            /* Snapshot ล่าสุด
               ไม่เกินวันที่ออกรายงาน */

            AND x.AsOfDate
                <
                DATEADD(
                    DAY,
                    1,
                    CAST(
                        @EndDate
                        AS DATETIME
                    )
                )


            AND ISNULL(
                    x.IsActive,
                    1
                ) = 1


            AND ISNULL(
                    x.IsDelete,
                    0
                ) = 0


        ORDER BY

            x.AsOfDate DESC,

            x.EndOfDayId DESC

    ) eod



    /* =============================================================
       6. ลูกหนี้
       ============================================================= */

    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataDebtorRelate dr

        ON dr.DebtorRelateId =
           r.DebtorRelateId

       AND dr.LGNo =
           r.LGNo



    /* =============================================================
       7. หา TDR LG

       ใช้
       DebtorRelateId
       + LGNo
       + CIFNo
       ============================================================= */

    LEFT JOIN dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractLG clg

        ON clg.DebtorRelateId =
           r.DebtorRelateId

       AND clg.LGNo =
           r.LGNo

       AND clg.CIFNo =
           r.CIFNo



    /* =============================================================
       8. Contract

       เอาเฉพาะ TDR ที่อนุมัติแล้ว

       CompromiseContractStatusId = 58
       ============================================================= */

    LEFT JOIN dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContract c

        ON c.CompromiseContractId =
           clg.CompromiseContractId

       AND c.CompromiseContractStatusId = 58



    /* =============================================================
       9. มาตรการ
       ============================================================= */

    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemMeasureMaster m

        ON m.MeasureId =
           c.MeasureId



    /* =============================================================
       10. สรุปแผนผ่อนชำระ
       ============================================================= */

    LEFT JOIN
    (
        SELECT

            p.CompromiseContractId,

            p.LGNo,


            COUNT(*)
                AS TotalInstallments,


            MIN(
                p.DueDate
            )
                AS FirstDueDate,


            MAX(
                p.DueDate
            )
                AS LastDueDate


        FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlan p


        WHERE

            ISNULL(
                p.IsUpfront,
                0
            ) <> 1


            AND ISNULL(
                    p.IsActive,
                    1
                ) = 1


        GROUP BY

            p.CompromiseContractId,

            p.LGNo

    ) plan_


        ON plan_.CompromiseContractId =
           clg.CompromiseContractId


       AND plan_.LGNo =
           r.LGNo



    /* =============================================================
       11. งวดผ่อนชำระ

       คง logic เดิมของ SP ไว้
       ============================================================= */

    LEFT JOIN dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlan cur

        ON cur.CompromiseContractId =
           clg.CompromiseContractId


       AND cur.LGNo =
           r.LGNo


       AND ISNULL(
               cur.IsUpfront,
               0
           ) <> 1


       AND ISNULL(
               cur.IsActive,
               1
           ) = 1



    /* =============================================================
       12. Assignment
       ============================================================= */

    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataAssignment a

        ON a.DebtorRelateId =
           r.DebtorRelateId



    /* =============================================================
       13. Personal Information
       ============================================================= */

    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataPersonalInfo pi

        ON pi.UserId =
            CASE

                /* Collector */

                WHEN a.TypeAssignId = 1

                    THEN NULLIF(
                        a.CollectorUserId,
                        0
                    )


                /* Collector OA */

                WHEN a.TypeAssignId = 2

                    THEN NULLIF(
                        a.CollectorOAUserId,
                        0
                    )

            END



    /* =============================================================
       14. Section
       ============================================================= */

    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemOrgSectionMaster sec

        ON sec.OrgSectionId =
           pi.OrgSectionId



    /* =============================================================
       15. Organization
       ============================================================= */

    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemOrgStructure org

        ON org.OrgStructureId =
           pi.OrgStructureId



    /* =============================================================
       16. Filter
       ============================================================= */

    WHERE


        /* =========================================================
           LG No
           ========================================================= */

        (
            @LGNo = N'null'

            OR r.LGNo = @LGNo
        )



        /* =========================================================
           Debtor Status
           ========================================================= */

        AND
        (
            @DebtorStatusId = 0

            OR dr.DebtorTypeId =
               @DebtorStatusId
        )



        /* =========================================================
           ชื่อลูกหนี้
           ========================================================= */

        AND
        (
            @DebtorName = N'null'

            OR
            dbo.FN_DCS_16_GetDebtorName(
                dr.DebtorId
            )
            LIKE
            N'%' + @DebtorName + N'%'
        )



        /* =========================================================
           วันที่

           SP เดิมใช้ ApproveTRRDate

           คง logic เดิมไว้
           ========================================================= */

        AND r.ApproveTRRDate
            >= CAST(
                @StartDate
                AS DATETIME
            )


        AND r.ApproveTRRDate
            <
            DATEADD(
                DAY,
                1,
                CAST(
                    @EndDate
                    AS DATETIME
                )
            )



        /* =========================================================
           Barcode
           ========================================================= */

        AND r.BarcodeNo IS NOT NULL

        AND r.BarcodeNo = '0'



    /* =============================================================
       17. Order
       ============================================================= */

    ORDER BY

        DebtorCode,

        LGCode



    OPTION (RECOMPILE);

END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].SP_RP_DEB_23_OverdueDebtorReminder_2 @StartDate DATE,
@EndDate DATE AS
BEGIN
  SET @StartDate =
  CASE
    WHEN YEAR(@StartDate) > 2400 THEN
      DATEADD(YEAR, - 543, @StartDate)
    ELSE
      @StartDate
  END;
  SET @EndDate =
  CASE
    WHEN YEAR(@EndDate) > 2400 THEN
      DATEADD(YEAR, - 543, @EndDate)
    ELSE
      @EndDate
  END SELECT DISTINCT
    eod.EndOfDayId,
    r.RequestPaymentDebtId,
    r.CIFNo AS DebtorCode,
    r.LGNo AS LGCode,
    dbo.FN_DCS_16_GetDebtorName (dr.DebtorId) AS FullName,
    r.RequestPaymentDebtNo AS RequestPaymentDebtNo ,
    dbo.Fn_FormatDateAD(
            CAST(
                NULLIF(
                    r.RequestPaymentDebtDate,
                    '19000101'
                )
                AS DATE
            )
        ) AS BookReceivedDate, -- วันที่รับหนังสือ


        dbo.Fn_FormatDateAD(
            CAST(
                NULLIF(
                    r.ApproveTRRDate,
                    '19000101'
                )
                AS DATE
            )
        ) AS ApprovalDate --วันที่อนุมัติ 
        ,r.ClaimPay AS  DebtAmount
--         , plan_.TotalInstallments
 ,eod.TDRInstallments AS  TotalInstallments
  FROM
    dbo.DEBDataRequestPaymentDebt r
    LEFT JOIN DataEndOfDay eod ON eod.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId
    AND eod.LGNo = r.LGNo
    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataDebtorRelate dr ON dr.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId
   
  WHERE
    --          r.BarcodeNo IS NOT NULL
    --         AND r.BarcodeNo = '0'
    --         AND
    CAST (r.ApproveTRRDate AS DATE) >= @StartDate
    AND CAST (r.ApproveTRRDate AS DATE) < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @EndDate);
END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_DEB_24_TDRRequestSLA]
    @StartDate DATE = '2026-07-01',
    @EndDate DATE = '2026-07-30',
    @LGNo NVARCHAR(20) = 'null',
    @DebtorName NVARCHAR(400) = 'null',
    @DebtorStatusId INT = 0,
    @PrintUserId INT = 1
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SET @StartDate = CASE WHEN YEAR(@StartDate) > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @StartDate) ELSE @StartDate END;
    SET @EndDate = CASE WHEN YEAR(@EndDate) > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @EndDate) ELSE @EndDate END;
    SET @LGNo = ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@LGNo)), N''), N'null');
    SET @DebtorName = ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@DebtorName)), N''), N'null');

    SELECT
        lg.CIFNo AS CIF_Code,
        dbo.[Fn_FormatDateAD](tdr.DebtRequestDate) as DebtRequestDate,
        tdrlg.LGNo AS LG_Code,
        dbo.FN_DCS_16_GetDebtorName(dr.DebtorId) AS BorrowerName,
        dbo.FN_DCS_10_GetOfficerUserNameTH(tdr.CompoundUserId) AS Officer,
        dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG(tdr.CompoundUserId, 2) AS DebtFollowDept,
        dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG(tdr.CompoundUserId, 3) AS DebtFollowTeam,
        COALESCE(tdrlg.TotalDebtBalance, tdrlg.PrincipalTotal) AS DebtBalanceOnTDRDate, -- OS TDR fallback เป็น PrincipalTotal ตาม confirm
        tdr.ContractNo AS RestructureNo,
        dbo.[Fn_FormatDateAD](tdr.CreateDate) AS RequestSubmissionDate,
        dbo.[Fn_FormatDateAD](tdr.DebtRequestDate) AS DebtStatusLetterDate,
        dbo.[Fn_FormatDateAD](COALESCE(
            NULLIF(CONVERT(DATE, tdr.ApproveDate), '1900-01-01'),
            NULLIF(CONVERT(DATE, tdr.TDRDate), '1900-01-01'),
            tdr.DebtRequestDate
        )) AS ApprovalDate,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(m.MeasureCode, N''), CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), tdr.MeasureId)) AS CampaignCode,
        m.MeasureName AS CampaignName,
        ct.ClaimTypeName AS ProjectName,
        dbo.FN_DCS_16_GetDebtorName(dr.DebtorId) AS DebtorName,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(
                NULLIF(CONVERT(DATE, tdr.ApproveDate), '1900-01-01'),
                NULLIF(CONVERT(DATE, tdr.TDRDate), '1900-01-01'),
                tdr.DebtRequestDate
            ) IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN CONVERT(DATE, COALESCE(
                NULLIF(CONVERT(DATE, tdr.ApproveDate), '1900-01-01'),
                NULLIF(CONVERT(DATE, tdr.TDRDate), '1900-01-01'),
                tdr.DebtRequestDate
            )) < CONVERT(DATE, tdr.DebtRequestDate) THEN NULL
            ELSE DATEDIFF(DAY, tdr.DebtRequestDate, COALESCE(
                NULLIF(CONVERT(DATE, tdr.ApproveDate), '1900-01-01'),
                NULLIF(CONVERT(DATE, tdr.TDRDate), '1900-01-01'),
                tdr.DebtRequestDate
            ))
        END AS SLA_Days,
        N'วันที่พิมพ์ : ' + dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(GETDATE()) AS PrintDate,
        N'ผู้สั่งพิมพ์ : ' + dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(@PrintUserId) AS PrintName
    FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractLG tdrlg
    LEFT JOIN dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContract tdr
        ON tdr.CompromiseContractId = tdrlg.CompromiseContractId
    -- ไม่ join TDRDataCompromiseContractDebtor ตรง เพราะ IsMain = 1 มีหลาย row ต่อ contract ได้
    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataDebtorRelate dr
        ON dr.DebtorRelateId = tdrlg.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemMeasureMaster m
        ON m.MeasureId = tdr.MeasureId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataLG lg
        ON lg.LGNo = tdrlg.LGNo
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemClaimTypeMaster ct
        ON ct.ClaimTypeId = lg.ClaimTypeId
    WHERE cast(tdr.ApproveDate as date) between @StartDate AND @EndDate
        AND (@LGNo = N'null' OR tdrlg.LGNo = @LGNo)
		and tdrlg.Grade = 'F1'
        AND (
            @DebtorName = N'null'
            OR dbo.FN_DCS_16_GetDebtorName(dr.DebtorId) LIKE N'%' + @DebtorName + N'%'
        )
		order by dr.LGNo
END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_DEB_25_CancelTDR]
    -- บังคับ
    @StartDate date = '2026-07-01',
    @EndDate   date = '2026-07-31',

    -- ไม่บังคับ: คง order เดิมไว้กัน caller ที่ส่งตามตำแหน่ง
    @LGNo           nvarchar(20)  = 'null',
    @DebtorName     nvarchar(400) = 'null',
    @DebtorStatusId int           = 0,
    @PrintUserId    int           = 0,

    -- ไม่บังคับ: filter ตาม TOR แต่ front เดิมอาจยังไม่ส่ง
    @DebtorCode     nvarchar(20)  = 'null',
    @CardStatusId   int           = 0,
    @DebtStatusId   int           = 0
as
begin
    set nocount on;

    -- null safety สำหรับ report URL
    set @LGNo           = nullif(ltrim(rtrim(isnull(@LGNo, N''))), N'');
    set @DebtorName     = nullif(ltrim(rtrim(isnull(@DebtorName, N''))), N'');
    set @DebtorCode     = nullif(ltrim(rtrim(isnull(@DebtorCode, N''))), N'');
    set @DebtorStatusId = isnull(@DebtorStatusId, 0);
    set @CardStatusId   = isnull(@CardStatusId, 0);
    set @DebtStatusId   = isnull(@DebtStatusId, 0);
    set @PrintUserId    = isnull(@PrintUserId, 0);

    if @LGNo = N'null' set @LGNo = null;
    if @DebtorName = N'null' set @DebtorName = null;
    if @DebtorCode = N'null' set @DebtorCode = null;

    -- รองรับวันที่ พ.ศ.
    set @StartDate = case when year(@StartDate) > 2400 then dateadd(year, -543, @StartDate) else @StartDate end;
    set @EndDate   = case when year(@EndDate)   > 2400 then dateadd(year, -543, @EndDate)   else @EndDate   end;

    select
        coalesce(
            case
                when a.TypeAssignId = 1 then dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(a.CollectorUserId)
                when a.TypeAssignId = 2 and isnull(a.CollectorOAUserId, 0) <> 0 then dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(a.CollectorOAUserId)
                when a.TypeAssignId = 2 and isnull(a.CollectorOAUserId, 0) = 0 then N'รอจ่ายงาน OA'
            end,
            dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(nullif(nullif(t.CompoundUserId, 0), 1)),
            dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(nullif(nullif(a.CompromiseUserId, 0), 1))
        ) as OfficerName,   
		t.ApproveDate,-- ชื่อเจ้าหน้าที่
--         coalesce(
--             case
--                 when a.TypeAssignId = 1 then dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG(a.CollectorUserId, 2)
--                 when a.TypeAssignId = 2 and isnull(a.CollectorOAUserId, 0) <> 0 then dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG(a.CollectorOAUserId, 2)
--                 when a.TypeAssignId = 2 and isnull(a.CollectorOAUserId, 0) = 0 then N'OA'
--             end,
--             dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG(nullif(nullif(t.CompoundUserId, 0), 1), 2),
--             dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG(nullif(nullif(a.CompromiseUserId, 0), 1), 2)
--         ) as Department,                                                               -- ฝ่าย
--         coalesce(
--             case
--                 when a.TypeAssignId = 1 then dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG(a.CollectorUserId, 3)
--                 when a.TypeAssignId = 2 and isnull(a.CollectorOAUserId, 0) <> 0 then dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG(a.CollectorOAUserId, 3)
--                 when a.TypeAssignId = 2 and isnull(a.CollectorOAUserId, 0) = 0 then N'OA'
--             end,
--             dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG(nullif(nullif(t.CompoundUserId, 0), 1), 3),
--             dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG(nullif(nullif(a.CompromiseUserId, 0), 1), 3)
--         ) as Team,                                                                     -- ทีม
        case
            when a.TypeAssignId = 2 and isnull(a.CollectorOAUserId, 0) = 0 then N'OA'
            when p.OrgStructureId in (5, 18) then N'ฝ่ายกิจการสาขา'
            when p.OrgStructureId = 47 then N'OA'
            else dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG(p.UserId, 2)
        end as Department,                                                    -- BU สำหรับ MIS
        case
            when a.TypeAssignId = 2 and isnull(a.CollectorOAUserId, 0) = 0 then N'OA'
            when p.OrgStructureId = 47 then N'OA'
            when p.OrgStructureId = 5 then N'ฝ่ายกิจการสาขา 1'
            when p.OrgStructureId = 18 then N'ฝ่ายกิจการสาขา 2'
            else dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG(p.UserId, 3)
        end as Team,                                                      -- Team สำหรับ MIS
        coalesce(nullif(lg.CIFNo, N''), r.CIFNo, ds.CIFNo, dc.CIFNo) as CIFCode,       -- รหัส CIF
        coalesce(nullif(lg.CIFNo, N''), r.CIFNo, ds.CIFNo, dc.CIFNo) as DupCIF,        -- Dup
        case
            when row_number() over (
                partition by coalesce(nullif(lg.CIFNo, N''), r.CIFNo, ds.CIFNo, dc.CIFNo)
                order by coalesce(ds.CompromiseUpdateDate, t.UpdateDate, t.CreateDate) desc,
                         lg.LGNo,
                         coalesce(t.ContractNo, t.RequestNo),
                         lg.CompromiseContractLGId
            ) = 1 then N'1รหัส CIF'
            else null
        end as OneCIF,                                                                 -- 1รหัส CIF
        lg.LGNo as LGNo,                                                               -- lgno
        dbo.FN_DCS_16_GetDebtorName(r.DebtorId) as DebtorName,          -- ชื่อผู้กู้
		
        case
            when dc.CardStatusId is null then null
            else convert(nvarchar(20), (dc.CardStatusId)) + N' = ' + dbo.FN_DCS_26_GetStatusName(dc.CardStatusId)
        end as CardStatus,                                                             -- CardStatus
        dbo.FN_DCS_26_GetStatusName(ds.StatusCollectorId) as DebtStatus,               -- สถานะ 2 สถานะติดตามหนี้
        coalesce(sl.LookUpValue, dbo.FN_DCS_26_GetStatusName(ds.StatusCompromiseId), N'ปิดแผน') as RestructureStatus, -- สถานะ TDR จาก contract
        dbo.Fn_FormatDateAD(coalesce(ds.CompromiseUpdateDate, t.UpdateDate, t.CreateDate)) as RestructureStatusDate, -- วันที่บันทึกสถานะ TDR
        coalesce(t.ContractNo, t.RequestNo) as RestructureNo,                          -- เลขที่ประนอมหนี้
        dbo.Fn_FormatDateAD(case when t.DebtRequestDate <= '1900-01-01' then null else t.DebtRequestDate end) as DebtStatusLetterDate, -- วันที่หนังสือสภาพหนี้
        dbo.Fn_FormatDateAD(case when t.ApproveDate <= '1900-01-01' then null else t.ApproveDate end) as TDRApproveDate, -- TDR Approve
        case when t.ApproveDate is null or t.ApproveDate <= '1900-01-01' then null else year(t.ApproveDate) + 543 end as YearApprove, -- Y-Approve
        case when t.ApproveDate is null or t.ApproveDate <= '1900-01-01' then null else month(t.ApproveDate) end as MonthApprove, -- M-Approve
        coalesce(m.MeasureCode, convert(nvarchar(20), t.MeasureId)) as CampaignCode,   -- รหัสแคมเปญ
        m.MeasureName as CampaignName,                                                 -- ชื่อแคมเปญ
        dbo.FN_DCS_16_GetDebtorName(r.DebtorId) as ProjectName, -- ชื่อโครงการ ### ไม่มั่นใจ source
        coalesce(nullif(d.DebtorName, N''), dc.DebtorCardName) as DebtorFullName,      -- ชื่อลูกหนี้
        case when r.DebtorTypeId != 1 then N'Y' else N'N' end as OnlyPart,       -- เฉพาะส่วน ### ไม่มั่นใจ source
        coalesce(sl.LookUpValue, dbo.FN_DCS_26_GetStatusName(ds.StatusCompromiseId), N'ปิดแผน') as CIFRestructureStatus, -- สถานะ TDR by CIF
        case when dc.DFDDate is null or cast(dc.DFDDate as date) <= '1900-01-01' then null
             else datediff(day, cast(dc.DFDDate as date), cast(coalesce(ds.CompromiseUpdateDate, t.UpdateDate, t.CreateDate) as date)) end as PastDueDays, -- Past_Due_Days ### ไม่มั่นใจสูตร
        case when dc.DFDDate is null or cast(dc.DFDDate as date) <= '1900-01-01' then null
             else convert(char(8), cast(dc.DFDDate as date), 112) end as DefaultDateRaw, -- Defaultdate
        dbo.Fn_FormatDateAD(case when dc.DFDDate is null or cast(dc.DFDDate as date) <= '1900-01-01' then null else cast(dc.DFDDate as date) end) as DefaultDate, -- แปลง Defaultdate
        case when dc.CurrentPaymentDate is null or cast(dc.CurrentPaymentDate as date) <= '1900-01-01' then null
             else convert(char(8), cast(dc.CurrentPaymentDate as date), 112) end as LastPaymentRaw, -- Date Of Last Payment
			 dc.DataDebtorCardId ,
        dbo.Fn_FormatDateAD(case when dc.CurrentPaymentDate is null or cast(dc.CurrentPaymentDate as date) <= '1900-01-01' then null else cast(dc.CurrentPaymentDate as date) end) as LastPaymentDate, -- แปลง Date Of Last Payment
        case when dc.DFDDate is null or cast(dc.DFDDate as date) <= '1900-01-01' then null
             else datediff(day, cast(dc.DFDDate as date), cast(coalesce(ds.CompromiseUpdateDate, t.UpdateDate, t.CreateDate) as date)) end as DaysUntilDue_31_10_2024, -- ใช้วันที่ปิดแผน ### ไม่มั่นใจสูตร
        case when dc.CurrentPaymentDate is null or cast(dc.CurrentPaymentDate as date) <= '1900-01-01' then null
             else datediff(day, cast(dc.CurrentPaymentDate as date), cast(coalesce(ds.CompromiseUpdateDate, t.UpdateDate, t.CreateDate) as date)) end as DaysFromLastPaymentTo_31_10_2024, -- ใช้วันที่ปิดแผน ### ไม่มั่นใจสูตร
        case when dc.DFDDate is not null and cast(dc.DFDDate as date) > '1900-01-01' then N'Y' else null end as Remark_Default, -- Remark-ผิดนัด ### ไม่มั่นใจเงื่อนไข
        case when dc.CurrentPaymentDate is not null and cast(dc.CurrentPaymentDate as date) > '1900-01-01' then N'Y' else null end as Remark_LastPay, -- Remark-LastPay ### ไม่มั่นใจเงื่อนไข
        N'Y' as PlanCloseFlag,                                                         -- ส่งปิดแผน
        dbo.Fn_FormatDateAD(coalesce(ds.CompromiseUpdateDate, t.UpdateDate, t.CreateDate)) as PlanCloseDate, -- วันที่ปิดแผน ### ไม่มั่นใจ
        coalesce(t.Remark, dc.Remark) as Remark,                                       -- Remark
        N'วันที่พิมพ์ : ' + dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(getdate()) as PrintDate,
        N'ผู้สั่งพิมพ์ : ' + dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(@PrintUserId) as PrintName
    from dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContract t
    inner join dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractLG lg
        on lg.CompromiseContractId = t.CompromiseContractId
    left join dbo.DataDebtorRelate r
        on r.DebtorRelateId = lg.DebtorRelateId
    left join dbo.DataDebtor d
        on d.DebtorId = r.DebtorId
    left join dbo.DataDebtorStatusUpdate ds
        on ds.DebtorRelateId = lg.DebtorRelateId
    left join dbo.DataAssignment a
        on a.DebtorRelateId = lg.DebtorRelateId
    left join dbo.DataDebtorCard dc
        on dc.DebtorRelateId = lg.DebtorRelateId
       and dc.LGNo = lg.LGNo
       and isnull(dc.IsDelete, 0) = 0
    outer apply (
        select coalesce(
            nullif(nullif(t.CompoundUserId, 0), 1),
            nullif(nullif(a.CompromiseUserId, 0), 1),
            case
                when a.TypeAssignId = 1 then nullif(a.CollectorUserId, 0)
                when a.TypeAssignId = 2 and isnull(a.CollectorOAUserId, 0) <> 0 then nullif(a.CollectorOAUserId, 0)
            end
        ) as UserId
    ) ownerUser
    outer apply (
        select top 1
            pi.UserId,
            pi.OrgStructureId,
            pi.OrgSectionId
        from dbo.DataPersonalInfo pi
        where pi.UserId = ownerUser.UserId
        
    ) p
    left join dbo.SystemLookupMaster sl
        on sl.LookupId = t.CompromiseContractStatusId
    left join dbo.SystemMeasureMaster m
        on m.MeasureId = t.MeasureId
    where t.CompromiseContractStatusId = 62
	and lg.Grade = 'F1'
      and r.DebtorTypeId = 1
      and cast(t.DebtRequestDate as date) >= @StartDate
      and cast(t.DebtRequestDate as date) < @EndDate
      and (@DebtorCode is null or d.DebtorCode = @DebtorCode or r.DebtorCode = @DebtorCode or lg.CIFNo = @DebtorCode or r.CIFNo = @DebtorCode)
      and (@LGNo is null or lg.LGNo = @LGNo or r.LGNo = @LGNo)
      and (@DebtorName is null or d.DebtorName like N'%' + @DebtorName + N'%' or dc.DebtorCardName like N'%' + @DebtorName + N'%')
      and (@DebtorStatusId = 0 or ds.StatusDebtorId = @DebtorStatusId)
      and (@CardStatusId = 0 or coalesce(dc.CardStatusId, ds.StatusCardId) = @CardStatusId)
      and (@DebtStatusId = 0 or ds.StatusCollectorId = @DebtStatusId)
	  and cast(t.ApproveDate as date) != '1900-01-01'
    order by coalesce(ds.CompromiseUpdateDate, t.UpdateDate, t.CreateDate) desc,
             coalesce(nullif(lg.CIFNo, N''), r.CIFNo, ds.CIFNo, dc.CIFNo),
             lg.LGNo,
             t.ContractNo;
end
