                + N' คดี'
                + ISNULL(ct.CaseTypeName, '')
                + N' โครงการ'
                + ISNULL(cm.ProjectName, '')
                + N' '
                + ISNULL(dbo.Fn_31_GetClaimTypeName(cmr.LGNo), '')
                + N' '
                + ISNULL(lg.CIFNo, '') AS Description,

            '1-000000-000-231160-000-00-0000000-0000000-000000-00'
                AS LiabilityAccount,

--             CAST
--             (
--                 ROUND
--                 (
--                     CAST(es.Amount AS decimal(18,4))
--                     / CAST
--                     (
--                         ISNULL(
--                             NULLIF(lgcnt.LGCount, 0),
--                             1
--                         ) AS decimal(18,4)
--                     ),
--                     2
--                 )
--                 AS decimal(18,2)
--             ) AS LineAmount,
CAST
(
    CASE
        /* รายการสุดท้าย = ยอดทั้งหมด - ยอดของรายการก่อนหน้า */
        WHEN accountItem.LineAccountSeq =
             ISNULL(NULLIF(lgcnt.LGCount, 0), 1)
        THEN
            CAST(es.Amount AS decimal(18,2))
            -
            (
                ROUND(
                    CAST(es.Amount AS decimal(18,4))
                    /
                    CAST(
                        ISNULL(NULLIF(lgcnt.LGCount, 0), 1)
                        AS decimal(18,4)
                    ),
                    2
                )
                *
                (
                    ISNULL(NULLIF(lgcnt.LGCount, 0), 1) - 1
                )
            )

        /* รายการปกติ */
        ELSE
            ROUND(
                CAST(es.Amount AS decimal(18,4))
                /
                CAST(
                    ISNULL(NULLIF(lgcnt.LGCount, 0), 1)
                    AS decimal(18,4)
                ),
                2
            )
    END
    AS decimal(18,2)
) AS LineAmount,

            N'จ่าย'
                + ISNULL(agg.CaseExpenseList, '')
                + N' คดี'
                + ISNULL(ct.CaseTypeName, '')
                + N' โครงการ'
                + ISNULL(cm.ProjectName, '')
                + N' '
                + ISNULL(dbo.Fn_31_GetClaimTypeName(cmr.LGNo), '')
                + N' '
                + ISNULL(lg.CIFNo, '') AS LineDescription,

            cmr.LGNo,

            /* นำแต่ละส่วนของเลขบัญชีมาต่อกัน */
            CONCAT
            (
                accountPart.Part01, N'-',
                accountPart.Part02, N'-',
                accountPart.Part03, N'-',
                accountPart.Part04, N'-',
                accountPart.Part05, N'-',
                accountPart.Part06, N'-',
                accountPart.Part07, N'-',
                accountItem.Part08, N'-',
                accountPart.Part09, N'-',
                accountPart.Part10
            ) AS LineAccount,

            'INPUT_NONVAT' AS TaxCode,
--             '1%-ภงด53' AS WithholdingTaxCode,
'-' AS WithholdingTaxCode,
            s.ERPCodeLT AS Code,
            '' AS Messages,

            agg.CaseExpenseList AS CaseExpenseNameList,
            s.CaseExpenseName,
            dbo.Fn_GetClaimType(cmr.LGNo) AS ClaimType,
            es.CaseExpenseSubId,
            p.EmployeeCode AS LawOfficeCode

        FROM LTDataCaseExpenseSub es

        LEFT JOIN LTDataCaseExpense e
            ON e.CaseExpenseId = es.CaseExpenseId

        LEFT JOIN DataPersonalInfo p
            ON p.UserId = e.LawOfficeUserId

        LEFT JOIN SystemCaseExpenseMaster s
            ON s.CaseExpenseId = es.CaseExpenseMasterId

        LEFT JOIN LTDataCaseMain cm
            ON cm.CaseMainId = e.CaseMainId

        LEFT JOIN SystemCaseTypeMaster ct
            ON ct.CaseTypeId = cm.CaseTypeId

        LEFT JOIN LTDataCaseMainDebtorRelate cmr
            ON cmr.CaseMainId = cm.CaseMainId

        LEFT JOIN DataLG lg
            ON lg.LGNo = cmr.LGNo

        LEFT JOIN SystemLawOfficeMaster l
            ON l.OrgSectionId = e.LawOfficeSectionId

        CROSS APPLY
        (
            SELECT
                STRING_AGG(s2.CaseExpenseName, N',') AS CaseExpenseList
            FROM LTDataCaseExpenseSub es2

            INNER JOIN SystemCaseExpenseMaster s2
                ON s2.CaseExpenseId = es2.CaseExpenseMasterId

            WHERE es2.CaseExpenseId = e.CaseExpenseId
        ) agg

        OUTER APPLY
        (
            SELECT
                COUNT(DISTINCT cmr2.LGNo) AS LGCount
            FROM LTDataCaseMainDebtorRelate cmr2
            WHERE cmr2.CaseMainId = cm.CaseMainId
        ) lgcnt

        /*
            ส่วนประกอบเลขบัญชีที่ใช้ร่วมกัน

            ภายหลังสามารถเปลี่ยนค่าฟิกเป็นข้อมูลจากตารางได้ เช่น

            Part02 =
                COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(AccountConfig.OrgCode, ''),
                    N'AC3099'
                )

            โดยต้อง LEFT JOIN ตาราง AccountConfig เข้ามาก่อน
        */
        CROSS APPLY
        (
            SELECT
                N'1'       AS Part01,  -- ฟิก
                N'AC3099'  AS Part02,  -- อาจเปลี่ยนไปดึงจากตาราง
                N'000'     AS Part03,  -- ฟิก
                N'524121'  AS Part04,  -- อาจเปลี่ยนไปดึงจากตาราง
                N'000'     AS Part05,  -- ฟิก
                N'20'      AS Part06,  -- อาจเปลี่ยนไปดึงจากตาราง
                N'0000000' AS Part07,  -- ฟิก
                N'000000'  AS Part09,  -- ฟิก
                N'00'      AS Part10   -- ฟิก
        ) accountPart

        /*
            ส่วนที่ทำให้ 1 รายการแตกเป็น 3 แถว
        */
        CROSS APPLY
        (
            VALUES
                (1, N'3100521'),
                (2, N'3100522'),
                (3, N'3100523')
        ) accountItem
        (
            LineAccountSeq,
            Part08
        )

        WHERE 
		CAST(e.ApproverDate AS date)
              BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate

          AND
          (
              e.LawOfficeSectionId = @LawOfficerId
              OR @LawOfficerId = 0
          )

          AND (s.CaseExpenseName LIKE N'%ค่าวางเงินประกัน%'
          or s.CaseExpenseName LIKE N'%ค่าธรรมเนียมศาล%')
    )

    SELECT
        Upl,
        ExpenseDate,
        StartDate,
        InvoiceType,
        LawOfficeUserId,
        VendorName,
        VendorSiteCode,
        InvoiceNumber,
        InvoiceDate,
        GLDate,
        PaymentDueDate,
        InvoiceAmount,
        Description,
        LiabilityAccount,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER
        (
            PARTITION BY PartitionCaseExpenseId
            ORDER BY
                ISNULL(SortSeqNo, 0),
                SortCaseExpenseSubId,
                SortLGNo,
                SortCIFNo,
                SortLineAccountSeq
        ) AS LineNumber,

        LineAmount,
        LineDescription,
        LGNo,
        LineAccount,
        TaxCode,
        WithholdingTaxCode,
        Code,
        Messages,
        CaseExpenseNameList,
        CaseExpenseName,
        ClaimType,
        CaseExpenseSubId,
        LawOfficeCode

    FROM BaseData

    ORDER BY
        PartitionCaseExpenseId,
        LineNumber;

END;

-- 5.8.1.1 รายงานการจ่ายงาน
CREATE   procedure [dbo].[SP_RP_MIS_01__AssignTasks]
    -- บังคับ
    @StartDate date,
    @EndDate date,

    -- ไม่บังคับ
    @DebtorCode nvarchar(20) = 'null',
    @LGNo nvarchar(20) = 'null',
    @DebtorStatusId int = 0,
    @CompanyName nvarchar(200) = 'null',
    @StatusPortId int = 0,
    @ClaimPayTypeId int = 0,
    @PrintUserId int = 1,
    @AssignDate date = '1900-01-01',
    @DueDate date = '1900-01-01'
as
begin
    set nocount on;

    set @DebtorCode = isnull(@DebtorCode, 'null');
    set @LGNo = isnull(@LGNo, 'null');
    set @DebtorStatusId = isnull(@DebtorStatusId, 0);
    set @CompanyName = isnull(@CompanyName, 'null');
    set @StatusPortId = isnull(@StatusPortId, 0);
    set @ClaimPayTypeId = isnull(@ClaimPayTypeId, 0);
    set @PrintUserId = isnull(@PrintUserId, 1);
    set @AssignDate = isnull(@AssignDate, '1900-01-01');
    set @DueDate = isnull(@DueDate, '1900-01-01');

    set @StartDate = case when year(@StartDate) > 2400 then dateadd(year, -543, @StartDate) else @StartDate end;
    set @EndDate = case when year(@EndDate) > 2400 then dateadd(year, -543, @EndDate) else @EndDate end;
    set @AssignDate = case when year(@AssignDate) > 2400 then dateadd(year, -543, @AssignDate) else @AssignDate end;
    set @DueDate = case when year(@DueDate) > 2400 then dateadd(year, -543, @DueDate) else @DueDate end;

    -- Report Server อาจส่ง DateTime.MinValue สำหรับ optional date
    set @AssignDate = case
        when @AssignDate < '1900-01-01' then cast('1900-01-01' as date)
        else @AssignDate
    end;
    set @DueDate = case
        when @DueDate < '1900-01-01' then cast('1900-01-01' as date)
        else @DueDate
    end;

    declare @EndDateNext date = dateadd(day, 1, @EndDate);

    -- จำกัด address เฉพาะ debtor ในช่วงรายงานก่อน
    ;with AddressDefault as (
        select
            d.DebtorCode,
            min(da.DebtorAddressId) as DebtorAddressId
        from dbo.DEBDataAssignOA oa
        left join dbo.DataDebtorRelate r on r.DebtorRelateId = oa.DebtorRelateId
        left join dbo.DataDebtor d on d.DebtorId = r.DebtorId
        left join dbo.DataDebtorAddress da
            on da.DebtorCode = d.DebtorCode
           and da.DebtorAddressTypeId = 7
           and da.IsDefault = 1
        where oa.CreateDate >= @StartDate
          and oa.CreateDate < @EndDateNext
          and (@LGNo = 'null' or oa.LGNo = @LGNo)
          and (@AssignDate = '1900-01-01' or (
              oa.CreateDate >= @AssignDate
              and oa.CreateDate < dateadd(day, 1, @AssignDate)
          ))
          and (@DueDate = '1900-01-01' or (
              oa.DueDate >= @DueDate
              and oa.DueDate < dateadd(day, 1, @DueDate)
          ))
        group by d.DebtorCode
    )
    select
        oa.RoudAssign as Port,                                               -- port / รอบจ่ายงาน ### wording จริงอาจมีชั้นแปลงเพิ่ม
        cast(
            cast(day(oa.CreateDate) as nvarchar(2))
            + case month(oa.CreateDate)
                when 1 then N'ม.ค.'
                when 2 then N'ก.พ.'
                when 3 then N'มี.ค.'
                when 4 then N'เม.ย.'
                when 5 then N'พ.ค.'
                when 6 then N'มิ.ย.'
                when 7 then N'ก.ค.'
                when 8 then N'ส.ค.'
                when 9 then N'ก.ย.'
                when 10 then N'ต.ค.'
                when 11 then N'พ.ย.'
                when 12 then N'ธ.ค.'
              end
            + N'-'
            + cast(day(oa.DueDate) as nvarchar(2))
            + case month(oa.DueDate)
                when 1 then N'ม.ค.'
                when 2 then N'ก.พ.'
                when 3 then N'มี.ค.'
                when 4 then N'เม.ย.'
                when 5 then N'พ.ค.'
                when 6 then N'มิ.ย.'
                when 7 then N'ก.ค.'
                when 8 then N'ส.ค.'
                when 9 then N'ก.ย.'
                when 10 then N'ต.ค.'
                when 11 then N'พ.ย.'
                when 12 then N'ธ.ค.'
              end
            + right(cast(year(oa.DueDate) + 543 as nvarchar(4)), 2)
            as nvarchar(100)
        ) as Port_M,                                                        -- ช่วงวันจ่ายงาน-วันครบกำหนด ### UAT ชุด 23/05/2569 DueDate เป็น 1900 ทุกแถว ต้องถาม source/สูตร
        row_number() over (order by oa.CreateDate, isnull(oa.LGNo, r.LGNo), isnull(oa.CIFNo, r.CIFNo)) as SequenceNumber, -- ลำดับรายการ
        dbo.Fn_FormatDateAD(oa.CreateDate) as WorkIssuedDate,               -- วันที่จ่ายงาน
        dbo.Fn_FormatDateAD(oa.CreateDate) as WorkReceivedDate,             -- วันที่รับงาน
        dbo.Fn_FormatDateAD(oa.DueDate) as FirstReturnDueDate,              -- วันที่ครบกำหนดส่งคืนครั้งแรก ### UAT 113,388 แถว DueDate เป็น 1900 ทั้งหมด ต้องถาม source/สูตร
        isnull(oa.CIFNo, r.CIFNo) as CIFCode,                               -- รหัส CIF
        isnull(r.DebtorCode, d.DebtorCode) as DebtorCode,                   -- รหัสลูกหนี้
        isnull(
            case
                when d.PersonGroupId = 117 then debtorTitle.TitleName + d.FirstName + N' ' + isnull(d.LastName, N'')
                else d.DebtorName
            end,
            isnull(d.DebtorName, oa.DebtorName)
        ) as DebtorFullName,                                                -- ชื่อลูกหนี้
        isnull(oa.LGNo, r.LGNo) as LGNumber,                                -- เลขที่ LG
        dbo.Fn_FormatDateAD(isnull(oa.ClaimPayDate, dc.ClaimPayDate)) as CompensationPaymentDate,                                  -- วันที่จ่ายค่าประกันชดเชย
        isnull(oa.ClaimPay, isnull(lg.ClaimPayAmount, dc.ClaimPay)) as ClaimPaymentAmount, -- ยอดจ่ายค่าประกันชดเชย
        isnull(dc.PrincipalTotal, 0) as PrincipalAmount,                    -- เงินต้นคงเหลือ
        debtorStatus.StatusName as DebtorStatus,                            -- สถานะลูกหนี้
        isnull(regionalOffice.SectionNameTH, N'-') as RegionalOffice,       -- สำนักงาน/หน่วยงานสังกัด OA ### เดิม function เลือก top 1 โดยไม่ order
        og.OAGroupName as PaymentGroup,                                     -- กลุ่มจ่ายงาน
        og.OAGroupName as PaymentGroupCode,                                 -- ### ยังไม่เจอ OA group code ชัด
        cast(null as decimal(18, 2)) as CommissionRate,                     -- ### source ยังไม่ชัด
        officerTitle.TitleName + upi.FirstName + N' ' + isnull(upi.LastName, N'') as AccountOfficerName, -- ชื่อเจ้าหน้าที่ OA
        sdt.DebtorTypeName as DebtorType,                                   -- ประเภทลูกหนี้
        d.CntMobileNumber as DebtorPhoneNumber1,                            -- เบอร์โทรศัพท์ลูกหนี้ 1
        d.IDCard as IDCardNumber,                                           -- เลขบัตรประชาชน / เลขทะเบียน
        dbo.Fn_FormatDateAD(lg.LGDate) as LGIssueDate,                                               -- วันที่ออกหนังสือค้ำประกัน
        dc.DebtorCardCode as DebtorCardCode,                                -- เลขการ์ดลูกหนี้
        isnull(lg.ClaimAmount, dc.AmountDuty) as GuaranteeLimit,            -- วงเงินค้ำประกัน
        d.CntPhoneNumber as DebtorPhoneNumber2,                             -- เบอร์โทรศัพท์ลูกหนี้ 2
        isnull(oa.ClaimPay, isnull(lg.ClaimPayAmount, dc.ClaimPay)) as ClaimPaymentAmount2, -- ยอดจ่ายค่าประกันชดเชยชุดที่ 2
        isnull(dc.PrincipalTotal, 0) as RemainingPrincipalAmount,           -- เงินต้นคงเหลือชุดที่ 2
        lgStatus.StatusName as Status,                                      -- สถานะ LG
        null as RegionalOffice2,                                            -- ### source ยังไม่ชัด
        null as PaymentGroup2,                                              -- ### source ยังไม่ชัด
        null as CommissionRate2,                                            -- ### source ยังไม่ชัด
        null as AccountOfficerName2,                                        -- ### source ยังไม่ชัด
        bk.BankName as BankName,                                            -- ชื่อธนาคาร
        null as BankBranch,                                                 -- 
        null as BranchPhoneNumber,                                          -- 
        ct.ClaimTypeName as GuaranteeType,                                  -- ประเภทการค้ำ
        d.ISICCode as BusinessCode,                                         -- รหัสประเภทธุรกิจ
        d.BusinessTypeName as BusinessType,                                 -- ประเภทธุรกิจ
        d.CompanyTypeDescription as IndustryType,                           -- ประเภทอุตสาหกรรม
        d.BusinessDescription as BusinessNature,                            -- ลักษณะธุรกิจ
        ltrim(rtrim(isnull(da.AddressNumber, '') + ' ' + isnull(da.Moo, '') + ' ' + isnull(da.Road, ''))) as Address, -- ที่อยู่
        isnull(subDistrict.Name, N'-') as SubDistrict,                      -- ตำบล/แขวง
        isnull(district.Name, N'-') as District,                            -- อำเภอ/เขต
        isnull(province.Name, N'-') as Province,                            -- จังหวัด
        da.PostalCode as PostalCode,                                        -- รหัสไปรษณีย์
        s.SectionNameTH as OA_Code,                  -- รหัส OA / OrgSection
        upi.EmployeeCode as Code,                                           -- รหัสพนักงาน
        dbo.FN_GetOrgSectionName(upi.OrgStructureId) as BusinessUnit,           -- รหัส business unit / OrgStructure
        case
            when s.OrgStructureId in (5, 18) then N'ฝ่ายกิจการสาขา'
            when s.OrgStructureId = 47 then N'OA'
            else dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG(upi.UserId, 2)
        end as MISOrgStructureName,
        case
            when s.OrgStructureId = 47 then N'OA'
            when s.OrgStructureId = 5 then N'ฝ่ายกิจการสาขา 1'
            when s.OrgStructureId = 18 then N'ฝ่ายกิจการสาขา 2'
            else dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG(upi.UserId, 3)
        end as MISOrgSectionName,
        ct.ClaimTypeName as ProjectCode,                                    -- โปรเจค
        case
            when d.BirthDate is null or d.BirthDate < '1753-01-01' then null
            else dbo.Fn_FormatDateAD(d.BirthDate)
        end as DateOfBirth,                                                 -- วันเกิด / วันที่จดทะเบียน
        N'วันที่พิมพ์ : ' + dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(getdate()) as PrintDate, -- วันที่พิมพ์
        N'ผู้สั่งพิมพ์ : ' + isnull(printTitle.TitleName + printUser.FirstName + N' ' + isnull(printUser.LastName, N''), N'') as PrintName -- ผู้สั่งพิมพ์
    from dbo.DEBDataAssignOA oa
    left join dbo.DataDebtorRelate r on r.DebtorRelateId = oa.DebtorRelateId
    left join dbo.DataDebtor d on d.DebtorId = r.DebtorId
    left join dbo.SystemTitleMaster debtorTitle on debtorTitle.TitleId = d.TitleId
    left join dbo.DataLG lg on lg.LGNo = isnull(oa.LGNo, r.LGNo)
    left join dbo.DataDebtorCard dc on dc.DebtorRelateId = oa.DebtorRelateId
    left join dbo.DataDebtorStatusUpdate su on su.DebtorRelateId = oa.DebtorRelateId
    left join dbo.SystemStatusMaster debtorStatus on debtorStatus.SystemStatusId = su.StatusDebtorId
    left join dbo.SystemStatusMaster lgStatus on lgStatus.SystemStatusId = lg.StatusId
    left join AddressDefault addressDefault on addressDefault.DebtorCode = d.DebtorCode
    left join dbo.DataDebtorAddress da on da.DebtorAddressId = addressDefault.DebtorAddressId
    left join dbo.SystemSubDistrictMaster subDistrict on subDistrict.SubDistrictId = da.SubDistrictId
    left join dbo.SystemDistrictMaster district on district.DistrictId = da.DistrictId
    left join dbo.SystemProvinceMaster province on province.ProvinceId = da.ProvinceId
    left join dbo.DataPersonalInfo upi on upi.UserId = oa.CollectorOAUserId
    left join dbo.SystemTitleMaster officerTitle on officerTitle.TitleId = upi.TitleId
    left join dbo.SystemOrgSectionMaster s on s.OrgSectionId = upi.OrgSectionId
    left join (

        select 

            som.OrgSectionId,

            som.SectionNameTH,
            
            srm.ProvinceId

        from dbo.SystemOrgSectionMaster som

        left join dbo.SystemResponsibleAreaMaster srm on srm.OrgSectionId = som.OrgSectionId

    ) regionalOffice on regionalOffice.ProvinceId = da.ProvinceId
    left join dbo.SystemOAGroupMaster og on og.OAGroupId = oa.OAGroupId
    left join dbo.SystemClaimTypeMaster ct on ct.ClaimTypeId = lg.ClaimTypeId
    left join dbo.SystemBankMaster bk on bk.BankId = dc.SystemBankId
    left join dbo.SystemDebtorType sdt on sdt.DebtorTypeId = d.DebtorTypeId
    left join dbo.DataPersonalInfo printUser on printUser.UserId = @PrintUserId
    left join dbo.SystemTitleMaster printTitle on printTitle.TitleId = printUser.TitleId
    where oa.CreateDate >= @StartDate
      and oa.CreateDate < @EndDateNext
      and (@LGNo = 'null' or oa.LGNo = @LGNo)
--       and (@AssignDate = '1900-01-01' or (
--           oa.CreateDate >= @AssignDate
--           and oa.CreateDate < dateadd(day, 1, @AssignDate)
--       ))
      and (@DueDate = '1900-01-01' or (
          oa.DueDate >= @DueDate
          and oa.DueDate < dateadd(day, 1, @DueDate)
      ))
      and (@DebtorCode = 'null' or isnull(r.DebtorCode, d.DebtorCode) = @DebtorCode or oa.CIFNo = @DebtorCode)
      and (@DebtorStatusId = 0 or su.StatusDebtorId = @DebtorStatusId)
      and (@CompanyName = 'null' or isnull(d.DebtorName, oa.DebtorName) like N'%' + @CompanyName + N'%')
      and (@StatusPortId = 0 or su.StatusPortId = @StatusPortId)
      and (@ClaimPayTypeId = 0 or lg.ClaimTypeId = @ClaimPayTypeId)
    order by oa.CreateDate, isnull(r.DebtorCode, d.DebtorCode) desc
    option (recompile);
end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_MIS_01__AssignTasks_backup]
	    -- 🟥 บังคับ
    @StartDate DATE,       -- วันที่เริ่มต้น
    @EndDate   DATE,       -- วันที่สิ้นสุด

    -- 🟩 ไม่บังคับ
    @DebtorCode     NVARCHAR(20)  = NULL,
    @LGNo           NVARCHAR(20)  = NULL,
    @DebtorStatusId INT           = NULL,
    @CompanyName    NVARCHAR(200) = NULL,  -- บริษัท
    @StatusPortId   INT           = NULL,  -- ประเภท Port
    @ClaimPayTypeId INT           = NULL,  -- ประเภทการค้ำ
    @AssignDate     DATETIME      = NULL,  -- วันที่จ่ายงาน
    @DueDate        DATETIME      = NULL   -- วันครบกำหนดคืน

	
	
AS
BEGIN

SELECT
    N'จ่ายใหม่ เม.ย.67 พรก.' AS Port,
    N'30เม.ย.-30ก.ย.67' AS Port_M,
    1 AS SequenceNumber,
    CAST('2024-04-30' AS DATE) AS WorkIssuedDate,
    CAST('2024-04-30' AS DATE) AS WorkReceivedDate,
    CAST('2024-09-30' AS DATE) AS FirstReturnDueDate,
    NULL AS CIFCode,
    '64842053' AS DebtorCode,
    N'นายไอศวรรย์ คำล้า' AS DebtorFullName,
    '64865856' AS LGNumber,
    CAST('2024-03-15' AS DATE) AS CompensationPaymentDate,
    CAST(8000000.00 AS MONEY) AS ClaimPaymentAmount,
    CAST(8000000.00 AS MONEY) AS PrincipalAmount,
    N'อยู่ระหว่างติดตามหนี้' AS DebtorStatus,
    N'สำนักงานสาขานครราชสีมา (สำนักงานเขตภาคตะวันออกเฉียงเหนือตอนล่าง2)' AS RegionalOffice,

-- ==========================================================================================
-- 5.8.1.55 รายงานวิเคราะห์ลูกหนี้ (2.3)
-- Stored Procedure: SP_RP_MIS_01_DebtorAnalytics
-- Description: รายงานวิเคราะห์ลูกหนี้ (ใช้ IsTDR จาก DataDebtorCard โดยตรง)
-- Filter: StartDate - EndDate (บังคับ)
-- ==========================================================================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_MIS_01_DebtorAnalytics]
    -- 🟥 บังคับ (กรองตามวันที่สร้างการ์ด)
    @StartDate DATE = '2000-01-01',
    @EndDate   DATE = '2026-02-02'
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    -- จัดการวันที่ (ป้องกันกรณีส่งปี พ.ศ. มา)
    SET @StartDate = CASE WHEN YEAR(@StartDate) > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @StartDate) ELSE @StartDate END;
    SET @EndDate   = CASE WHEN YEAR(@EndDate)   > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @EndDate)   ELSE @EndDate   END;

    -- 1. เตรียมข้อมูลดิบ (Raw Data) และจัดกลุ่มช่วงวงเงิน (Range)
    WITH RawData AS (
        SELECT 
            DC.DebtorCode,
            ISNULL(DC.PrincipalTotal, 0) AS Outstanding, -- ยอดหนี้คงเหลือ (เงินต้น)
            ISNULL(DC.AmountDuty, 0)     AS CreditLimit, -- วงเงินสินเชื่อ (ภาระค้ำประกัน)
            ISNULL(DC.DPD, 0)            AS DPD,         -- จำนวนวันค้างชำระ
            
            -- จัดกลุ่มช่วงวงเงิน (Credit Limit Ranges)
            CASE 
                WHEN ISNULL(DC.AmountDuty, 0) <= 50000 THEN 1
                WHEN DC.AmountDuty > 50000 AND DC.AmountDuty <= 100000 THEN 2
                WHEN DC.AmountDuty > 100000 AND DC.AmountDuty <= 200000 THEN 3
                WHEN DC.AmountDuty > 200000 AND DC.AmountDuty <= 500000 THEN 4
                WHEN DC.AmountDuty > 500000 AND DC.AmountDuty <= 1000000 THEN 5
                WHEN DC.AmountDuty > 1000000 AND DC.AmountDuty <= 5000000 THEN 6
                WHEN DC.AmountDuty > 5000000 AND DC.AmountDuty <= 10000000 THEN 7
                WHEN DC.AmountDuty > 10000000 THEN 8
                ELSE 9 
            END AS RangeId,

            -- ชื่อช่วงวงเงิน (Display Name)
            CASE 
                WHEN ISNULL(DC.AmountDuty, 0) <= 50000 THEN '<=50,000.00'
                WHEN DC.AmountDuty > 50000 AND DC.AmountDuty <= 100000 THEN '50,000.01 - 100,000.00'
                WHEN DC.AmountDuty > 100000 AND DC.AmountDuty <= 200000 THEN '100,000.01 - 200,000.00'
                WHEN DC.AmountDuty > 200000 AND DC.AmountDuty <= 500000 THEN '200,000.01 - 500,000.00'
                WHEN DC.AmountDuty > 500000 AND DC.AmountDuty <= 1000000 THEN '500,000.01 - 1,000,000.00'
                WHEN DC.AmountDuty > 1000000 AND DC.AmountDuty <= 5000000 THEN '1,000,000.01 - 5,000,000.00'
                WHEN DC.AmountDuty > 5000000 AND DC.AmountDuty <= 10000000 THEN '5,000,000.01 - 10,000,000.00'
                WHEN DC.AmountDuty > 10000000 THEN '> 10,000,000.00'
                ELSE 'Unknown'
            END AS RangeName,

            -- ตรวจสอบสถานะ TDR (ใช้คอลัมน์ IsTDR จากตารางโดยตรง)
            ISNULL(DC.IsTDR, 0) AS IsTDR,

            -- ตรวจสอบสถานะหนี้สูญ (Bad Debt)
            CASE WHEN DC.BadDebtDate IS NOT NULL OR DC.CardStatusId IN (999) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsBadDebt

        FROM [dbo].[DataDebtorCard] DC WITH(NOLOCK)
        
        -- กรองตามวันที่สร้างการ์ด (หรือใช้วันที่อื่นตาม Business Logic)
        WHERE CAST(DC.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
    )

    -- 2. ประมวลผลและจัดรูปแบบรายงาน (Pivoting / Aggregation)
    SELECT 
        -- วงเงินสินเชื่อ (CreditLimit)
        RangeName AS [CreditLimit],

        -- 1. ลูกหนี้ทั้งหมด
        COUNT(DebtorCode) AS [TotalDebtorsCount],
        SUM(Outstanding) AS [TotalDebtorsOutstanding],

        -- 2. ลูกหนี้ประนอมหนี้
        SUM(CASE WHEN IsTDR = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [RestructureDebtorsCount],
        SUM(CASE WHEN IsTDR = 1 THEN Outstanding ELSE 0 END) AS [RestructureDebtorsOutstanding],

        -- 3. ลูกหนี้ผิดนัดชำระ (แยกตาม DPD)
        -- 1-3 เดือน (31-90 วัน)
        SUM(CASE WHEN DPD > 30 AND DPD <= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Delinquent1_3MonthsCount],
        SUM(CASE WHEN DPD > 30 AND DPD <= 90 THEN Outstanding ELSE 0 END) AS [Delinquent1_3MonthsOutstanding],

        -- 3-6 เดือน (91-180 วัน)
        SUM(CASE WHEN DPD > 90 AND DPD <= 180 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Delinquent3_6MonthsCount],
        SUM(CASE WHEN DPD > 90 AND DPD <= 180 THEN Outstanding ELSE 0 END) AS [Delinquent3_6MonthsOutstanding],

        -- 6-12 เดือน (181-365 วัน)
        SUM(CASE WHEN DPD > 180 AND DPD <= 365 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Delinquent6_12MonthsCount],
        SUM(CASE WHEN DPD > 180 AND DPD <= 365 THEN Outstanding ELSE 0 END) AS [Delinquent6_12MonthsOutstanding],

        -- เกิน 12 เดือน (> 365 วัน)
        SUM(CASE WHEN DPD > 365 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [DelinquentOver12MonthsCount],
        SUM(CASE WHEN DPD > 365 THEN Outstanding ELSE 0 END) AS [DelinquentOver12MonthsOutstanding],

        -- 4. การตัดหนี้สูญ (OverdueDebtors)
        SUM(CASE WHEN IsBadDebt = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [OverdueDebtorsCount],
        SUM(CASE WHEN IsBadDebt = 1 THEN Outstanding ELSE 0 END) AS [OverdueDebtorsOutstanding],

        N'วันที่พิมพ์ : ' + dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(GETDATE()) AS PrintDate,
        N'ผู้สั่งพิมพ์ : ' + CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) AS PrintName

    FROM RawData
    GROUP BY RangeId, RangeName
    ORDER BY RangeId;

END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_MIS_01_Tacking]
    -- บังคับ
    @StartDate DATE = '2000-01-01',  -- วันที่เริ่มต้น
    @EndDate   DATE = '2025-12-31',  -- วันที่สิ้นสุด
    @UserId    INT  = 0,             -- ผู้ดูแล
    @PrintUserId INT = 1
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SET @UserId = ISNULL(@UserId, 0);
    SET @PrintUserId = ISNULL(@PrintUserId, 1);

    -- รองรับวันที่ พ.ศ. จากหน้า report
    SET @StartDate = CASE WHEN YEAR(@StartDate) > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @StartDate) ELSE @StartDate END;
    SET @EndDate   = CASE WHEN YEAR(@EndDate)   > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @EndDate)   ELSE @EndDate   END;

    SELECT DISTINCT
        CASE
            WHEN A.TypeAssignId = 1 AND ISNULL(A.CollectorUserId, 0) <> 0 THEN dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG(A.CollectorUserId, 2)
            WHEN A.TypeAssignId = 2 AND ISNULL(A.CollectorOAUserId, 0) <> 0 THEN dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG(A.CollectorOAUserId, 2)
            WHEN A.TypeAssignId = 2 AND ISNULL(A.CollectorOAUserId, 0) = 0 THEN N'OA'
            ELSE N'รอจ่ายงาน'
        END AS Department,                                                        -- ฝ่ายงาน

        CASE
            WHEN A.TypeAssignId = 1 AND ISNULL(A.CollectorUserId, 0) <> 0 THEN dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(A.CollectorUserId)
            WHEN A.TypeAssignId = 2 AND ISNULL(A.CollectorOAUserId, 0) <> 0 THEN dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(A.CollectorOAUserId)
            WHEN A.TypeAssignId = 2 AND ISNULL(A.CollectorOAUserId, 0) = 0 THEN N'รอจ่ายงาน OA'
            ELSE N'รอจ่ายงาน'
        END AS StaffName,                                                         -- ชื่อเจ้าหน้าที่

        COALESCE(R.CIFNo, DC.CIFNo, LG.CIFNo) AS CIFCode,                         -- cif
        COALESCE(R.LGNo, DC.LGNo, LG.LGNo) AS LGNo,                               -- lgno
        ISNULL(DC.PrincipalTotal, 0.00) AS RemainingPrincipal,                    -- เงินต้นคงเหลือ
        dbo.Fn_FormatDate(LastTrack.LastContactDate) AS LastFollowUpDate,          -- วันที่ติดตามล่าสุด

        dbo.FN_DCS_26_GetStatusName(L.StatusDebtorId) AS DebtorStatus1,            -- สถานะ 1 สถานะลูกหนี้
        dbo.Fn_FormatDate(L.StatusDebtorDate) AS DebtorStatus1Date,                -- วันที่บันทึก_สถานะ 1 สถานะลูกหนี้

        dbo.FN_DCS_26_GetStatusName(L.StatusCardId) AS DebtFollowUpStatus2,        -- สถานะ 2 สถานะติดตามหนี้
        dbo.Fn_FormatDate(L.StatusCardDate) AS DebtFollowUpStatus2Date,            -- วันที่บันทึก_สถานะ 2 สถานะติดตามหนี้

        dbo.FN_DCS_26_GetStatusName(L.StatusLGId) AS DebtRestructureStatus3ByLG,   -- สถานะ 3 สถานะประนอมหนี้ By LG
        dbo.Fn_FormatDate(L.StatusLGDate) AS DebtRestructureStatus3ByLGDate,       -- วันที่บันทึกสถานะ 3 สถานะประนอมหนี้ By LG

        dbo.FN_DCS_26_GetStatusName(L.StatusLegalId) AS CaseStatus4,               -- สถานะ 4 สถานะคดี
        dbo.Fn_FormatDate(L.StatusLegalDate) AS CaseStatus4Date,                   -- วันที่บันทึกสถานะ 4 สถานะคดี

        COALESCE(TDR.ContractNo, DC.RequestNoTDR, TDR.RequestNo) AS DebtRestructureNo, -- เลขที่ประนอมหนี้
        TDR.SeqNo AS DebtRestructureTimes,                                         -- ครั้งที่ประนอมหนี้
        dbo.Fn_FormatDate(COALESCE(TDR.DebtRequestDate, DC.RequestDebtorApproveDate)) AS DebtAcknowledgementDate, -- วันที่หนังสือสภาพหนี้
        dbo.Fn_FormatDate(COALESCE(TDR.TDRDate, DC.CompromiseContracApproveDate)) AS DebtRestructureApprovalDate, -- วันที่อนุมัติปรับปรุงโครงสร้างหนี้

        COALESCE(DC.MeasureCode, M.MeasureCode) AS CampaignCode,                   -- รหัสแคมเปญ
        COALESCE(DC.MeasureName, M.MeasureName) AS CampaignName,                   -- ชื่อแคมเปญ
        CT.ClaimTypeName AS ProjectName,                                           -- ชื่อโครงการ

        COALESCE(dbo.FN_DCS_16_GetDebtorName(D.DebtorId), D.DebtorName, DC.DebtorCardName) AS DebtorName, -- ชื่อลูกหนี้
        dbo.FN_DCS_26_GetStatusName(L.StatusLGId) AS DebtRestructureStatus3ByCIF,  -- สถานะ 3 สถานะประนอมหนี้ By CIF ### ไม่มั่นใจ ใช้สถานะ By LG ก่อน
        COALESCE(dbo.FN_DCS_16_GetDebtorName(D.DebtorId), D.DebtorName, DC.DebtorCardName) AS BorrowerName, -- ชื่อผู้กู้

        dbo.FN_DCS_26_GetStatusName(LG.StatusId) AS GuaranteeLetterStatus,          -- สถานะหนังสือค้ำประกัน
        dbo.FN_DCS_26_GetStatusName(DC.CardStatusId) AS CardStatus,                 -- Card Status
        dbo.FN_DCS_26_GetStatusName(DC.CardStatusId) AS CardStatus_CIF,             -- Card Status_CIF ### ไม่มั่นใจ ใช้ Card Status ราย LG ก่อน

        dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(COALESCE(LC.LegalUserId, A.LegalUserId, L.LegalUserId)) AS LegalOfficer, -- ชื่อเจ้าหน้าที่ดำเนินคดี
        SCT.CaseTypeName AS CaseType,                                               -- ประเภทคดี
        LO.LawOfficeName AS LawyerOffice,                                           -- สำนักงานทนาย
        COALESCE(NULLIF(D.BusinessStatus, N''), BSL.LookUpValue) AS BusinessStatus, -- สถานภาพกิจการ
        dbo.Fn_FormatDate(D.BusinessStatusDate) AS BusinessStatusDate,              -- วันที่สถานภาพกิจการ

        N'วันที่พิมพ์ : ' + dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(GETDATE()) AS PrintDate,
        N'ผู้สั่งพิมพ์ : ' + ISNULL(dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(@PrintUserId), N'') AS PrintName
    FROM dbo.DataAssignment A
    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataDebtorRelate R ON A.DebtorRelateId = R.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataDebtorStatusUpdate L ON L.DebtorRelateId = R.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataLG LG ON R.LGNo = LG.LGNo
    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataDebtor D ON R.DebtorId = D.DebtorId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataDebtorCard DC ON DC.DebtorRelateId = R.DebtorRelateId AND DC.LGNo = R.LGNo AND ISNULL(DC.IsDelete, 0) = 0
    LEFT JOIN dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContract TDR ON TDR.CompromiseContractId = DC.CompromiseContractId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemMeasureMaster M ON M.MeasureId = COALESCE(DC.MeasureId, TDR.MeasureId)
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemClaimTypeMaster CT ON CT.ClaimTypeId = LG.ClaimTypeId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.LTDataCaseMainDebtor LC ON LC.DebtorRelateId = R.DebtorRelateId AND ISNULL(LC.IsCancel, 0) = 0
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemCaseTypeMaster SCT ON SCT.CaseTypeId = LC.CaseTypeId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemLawOfficeMaster LO ON LO.LawOfficeId = COALESCE(LC.LawOfficeUserId, A.LawOfficeUserId, L.LawOfficeUserId)
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemLookupMaster BSL ON BSL.LookupId = D.BusinessStatusId AND BSL.GroupName IN (N'BusinessStatus', N'StatusBusiness')
    OUTER APPLY (
        -- วันที่ติดตามล่าสุดของลูกหนี้
        SELECT TOP 1
            TR.CreateDate AS LastContactDate
        FROM dbo.DEBDataTransactionTracking TR
        WHERE TR.DebtorId = D.DebtorId
        ORDER BY TR.CreateDate DESC
    ) LastTrack
    WHERE R.DebtorTypeId = 1
      AND LG.ClaimDate >= @StartDate
      AND LG.ClaimDate < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @EndDate)
      AND (
            @UserId = 0
         OR (A.TypeAssignId = 1 AND A.CollectorUserId = @UserId)
         OR (A.TypeAssignId = 2 AND A.CollectorOAUserId = @UserId)
      );
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_MIS_01_Tacking_backup]
	  -- 🟥 บังคับ
    @StartDate DATE,     -- วันที่เริ่มต้น
    @EndDate   DATE,     -- วันที่สิ้นสุด
    @UserId    INT       -- ผู้ดูแล
	
AS
BEGIN


SELECT
    N'สำนักงานสาขาเชียงใหม่  (สำนักงานเขตภาคเหนือตอนบน)' AS Department,          -- ฝ่ายงาน
    N'นัฑเดช รงคุต' AS StaffName,                                                   -- ชื่อเจ้าหน้าที่
    '2900001' AS CIFCode,                                                             -- รหัส CIF
    '2900014' AS LGNo,                                                                -- lgno
    474554.49 AS RemainingPrincipal,                                                 -- เงินต้นคงเหลือ
    CONVERT(DATE, '2024-01-06', 111) AS LastFollowUpDate,                            -- วันที่ติดตามล่าสุด
    N'หนี้สูญ' AS DebtorStatus1,                                                     -- สถานะ 1 สถานะลูกหนี้
    CONVERT(DATE, '2019-09-17', 111) AS DebtorStatus1Date,                           -- วันที่บันทึก_สถานะ 1 สถานะลูกหนี้
    N'4. บน. ส่งเรื่องให้ บค. ดำเนินคดี' AS DebtFollowUpStatus2,                    -- สถานะ 2 สถานะติดตามหนี้
    CONVERT(DATE, '2019-01-01', 111) AS DebtFollowUpStatus2Date,                     -- วันที่บันทึก_สถานะ 2 สถานะติดตามหนี้
    NULL AS DebtRestructureStatus3ByLG,                                              -- สถานะ 3 สถานะประนอมหนี้ By LG (ไม่มีข้อมูล)
    NULL AS DebtRestructureStatus3ByLGDate,                                          -- วันที่บันทึกสถานะ 3 สถานะประนอมหนี้ By LG (ไม่มีข้อมูล)
    N'โครงการที่จำหน่ายหนี้สูญ (ยังมีสิทธิทางกฏหมาย)' AS CaseStatus4,             -- สถานะ 4 สถานะคดี
    CONVERT(DATE, '2019-01-01', 111) AS CaseStatus4Date,                             -- วันที่บันทึกสถานะ 4 สถานะคดี
    NULL AS DebtRestructureNo,                                                       -- เลขที่ประนอมหนี้ (ไม่มีข้อมูล)
    NULL AS DebtAcknowledgementDate,                                                 -- วันที่หนังสือสภาพหนี้ (ไม่มีข้อมูล)
    NULL AS DebtRestructureApprovalDate,                                            -- วันที่อนุมัติปรับปรุงโครงสร้างหนี้ (ไม่มีข้อมูล)
    NULL AS CampaignCode,                                                            -- รหัสแคมเปญ (ไม่มีข้อมูล)

-- 5.8.1.70 รายงานภาระค้ำประกันสะสม
CREATE   procedure [dbo].[SP_RP_MIS_02__AccumulatedGuaranteeLiability]
    @StartDate date = '2026-06-01',
    @EndDate date = '2026-06-30',
    @PrintUserId int = 1
as
begin
    set nocount on;

    set @PrintUserId = isnull(@PrintUserId, 1);
    set @StartDate = case when year(@StartDate) > 2400 then dateadd(year, -543, @StartDate) else @StartDate end;
    set @EndDate = case when year(@EndDate) > 2400 then dateadd(year, -543, @EndDate) else @EndDate end;

    select distinct
        1 as RowNo,
        dbo.[Fn_FormatDateAD](dc.ClaimPayDate) as ClaimPayDate,
        dbo.[Fn_FormatDateAD](dc.CreateDate) as WorkPaidDate,
        case
            when a.TypeAssignId = 1 and isnull(a.CollectorUserId, 0) != 0 then dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG(a.CollectorUserId, 2)
            when a.TypeAssignId in (0, 2) and isnull(a.CollectorOAUserId, 0) = 0 then N'ติดตามหนี้ OA'
            else dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG(a.CollectorOAUserId, 2)
        end as BU,
        coalesce(dc.CIFNo, r.CIFNo) as CIFCode,
				lg.ClaimAmountCurrent,
				dc.PrincipalTotal,
        lg.LGNo as LGNo,
        dc.DebtorCardCode as DebtorCardCode,
        d.DebtorCode as DebtorCode,
        isnull(dbo.FN_DCS_16_GetDebtorName(d.DebtorId), d.DebtorName) as DebtorName,
        isnull(sdt.DebtorTypeName, cast(r.DebtorTypeId as nvarchar(20))) as DebtorTypeName,
        dc.AmountDuty as GuaranteeLiability,
        dc.DebtBalance as OS,
        dc.ClaimPay as ClaimPayAmount,
        case
            when a.TypeAssignId = 1 and isnull(a.CollectorUserId, 0) != 0 then dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(a.CollectorUserId)
            when a.TypeAssignId in (0, 2) and isnull(a.CollectorOAUserId, 0) = 0 then N'OA'
            else dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(a.CollectorOAUserId)
        end as OfficerName,
        dbo.FN_DCS_39_GetDebtorAddressComponent(dc.DebtorId, 7, 6) as ProvinceName,
        dbo.FN_DCS_26_GetStatusName(dc.CardStatusId) as Status,
        N'วันที่พิมพ์ : ' + dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(getdate()) as PrintDate,
        N'ผู้สั่งพิมพ์ : ' + isnull(dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(@PrintUserId), N'') as PrintName
    from dbo.DataAssignment a
    left join dbo.DataDebtorRelate r on a.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId
    left join dbo.DataLG lg on r.LGNo = lg.LGNo
    left join dbo.DataDebtor d on r.DebtorId = d.DebtorId
    left join dbo.DataDebtorCard dc on r.DebtorRelateId = dc.DebtorRelateId
    left join dbo.DataDebtorAddress addr
        on d.DebtorId = addr.DebtorId
        and addr.DebtorAddressTypeId = 7
        and isnull(addr.IsDefault, 0) = 1
    left join dbo.SystemDebtorType sdt on r.DebtorTypeId = sdt.DebtorTypeId
    left join dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractLG tdr_lg on lg.LGNo = tdr_lg.LGNo
    where cast(lg.ClaimDate as date) >= @StartDate
      and cast(lg.ClaimDate as date) < dateadd(day, 1, @EndDate)
      and r.DebtorTypeId = 1 -- ผู้กู้หลัก
      and tdr_lg.LGNo is null -- ไม่มี TDR
    --order by a.CreateDate, lg.LGNo;
end

-- ==========================================================================================
-- 5.8.1.54 รายงานแสดงสัดส่วนทางการเงิน (2.1)
-- Stored Procedure: SP_RP_MIS_02__FinancialRatio
-- Description: รายงานสัดส่วนทางการเงิน (Financial Ratio)
-- ==========================================================================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_MIS_02__FinancialRatio]
    -- ไม่บังคับ
    @LGNo        NVARCHAR(40)  = '65081941',
    @CIFNo       NVARCHAR(40)  = 'null',
    @DebtorName  NVARCHAR(800) = 'null', -- ชื่อ-นามสกุลลูกหนี้
    @PrintUserId INT          = 1,

    -- บังคับ
    @StartDate   DATE         = '2568-01-01', -- วันที่จ่ายเคลมเริ่มต้น
    @EndDate     DATE         = '2569-10-01'  -- วันที่จ่ายเคลมสิ้นสุด
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- รับวันที่ได้ทั้ง พ.ศ. และ ค.ศ.
    SET @StartDate = CASE WHEN YEAR(@StartDate) > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @StartDate) ELSE @StartDate END;
    SET @EndDate   = CASE WHEN YEAR(@EndDate)   > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @EndDate)   ELSE @EndDate END;

    -- รับ null/ค่าว่างจากหน้า report ให้เป็น sentinel เดียวกัน
    SET @LGNo       = ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@LGNo)), N''), N'null');
    SET @CIFNo      = ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@CIFNo)), N''), N'null');
    SET @DebtorName = ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@DebtorName)), N''), N'null');

    SELECT
        dc.CIFNo AS DebtorCode, -- รหัสลูกหนี้
        COALESCE(dbo.FN_DCS_16_GetDebtorName(dc.DebtorId), d.DebtorName) AS DebtorName, -- ผู้กู้
        dc.DebtorCardName AS DebtorCardName, -- ชื่อบนบัตร
        d.IDCard AS IDCard, -- เลขที่บัตรประชาชน/นิติบุคคล
        dc.LGNo AS LGNo, -- รหัส LG
        ISNULL(lg.ClaimAmountCurrent, 0.00) AS GuaranteeAmount, -- ภาระค้ำประกัน
        ISNULL(lg.ClaimPayAmount, 0.00) AS InsuranceCompensation, -- ค่าประกันชดเชย
        ISNULL(dc.PrincipalTotal, 0.00) AS PrincipalOutstanding, -- เงินต้นคงเหลือ
        ISNULL(dc.InterestRate, 0.00) AS InterestRate, -- อัตราดอกเบี้ย
        ISNULL(dc.AccruedInterestTotal, 0.00) AS AccruedInterest, -- ดอกเบี้ยค้างรับ
        CAST(dc.DeferredInterest AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS HangingInterest, -- ดอกเบี้ยตั้งพัก/ดอกเบี้ยแขวน
        CAST(dc.DeferredInterestTotal AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS HangingInterestBalance, -- ดอกเบี้ยตั้งพัก/ดอกเบี้ยแขวนคงเหลือ
        dbo.[Fn_FormatDateAD](dc.CreateDate) AS CreateDate, -- CreateDate
        dbo.[Fn_FormatDateAD](dc.CloseDate) AS CloseAccountDate, -- วันที่ปิดบัญชี
        dbo.[Fn_FormatDateAD](dc.BadDebtDate) AS BadDebtWriteOffDate, -- วันที่ปิดบัญชีตัดหนี้สูญ
        dbo.[Fn_FormatDateAD](dc.ClaimPayDate) AS PaymentDate, -- วันที่จ่ายเคลม
        dbo.FN_DCS_26_GetStatusName(dc.CardStatusId) AS CardStatus, -- CardStatus
        lg.Grade AS Grade, -- เกรด
        dc.MeasureName AS CampaignName, -- แคมเปญ
        ISNULL(dc.InterestDefaultRate, 0.00) AS InterestRate1, -- อัตราดอกเบี้ย1
        N'วันที่พิมพ์ : ' + dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(GETDATE()) AS PrintDate,
        N'ผู้สั่งพิมพ์ : ' + dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(@PrintUserId) AS PrintName
    FROM dbo.DataDebtorCard dc
    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataLG lg
        ON lg.LGNo = dc.LGNo
    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataDebtor d
        ON d.DebtorId = dc.DebtorId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataDebtorRelate r
        ON r.DebtorRelateId = dc.DebtorRelateId
    WHERE dc.ClaimPayDate >= @StartDate
      AND dc.ClaimPayDate < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @EndDate)
      AND r.DebtorTypeId = 1
      AND lg.Grade = N'F1'
      -- หน้า report มี keyword ช่องเดียว แต่เลือกได้หลายหัวข้อ จึงต้อง OR ตามหัวข้อที่ส่งมา
      AND (
            (@LGNo = N'null' AND @CIFNo = N'null' AND @DebtorName = N'null')
         OR (@LGNo <> N'null' AND dc.LGNo LIKE N'%' + @LGNo + N'%')
         OR (@CIFNo <> N'null' AND dc.CIFNo LIKE N'%' + @CIFNo + N'%')
         OR (
                @DebtorName <> N'null'
            AND (
                   d.DebtorName LIKE N'%' + @DebtorName + N'%'
                OR dc.DebtorCardName LIKE N'%' + @DebtorName + N'%'
            )
         )
      )
    ORDER BY dc.CIFNo, dc.LGNo;
END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_MIS_02_DebtorByAccountManager]
    -- 🟥 บังคับ
    @StartDate DATE = '2569-06-01',
    @EndDate     DATE = '2569-06-30',
    @UserId      INT  = 0, -- ผู้ดูแล
    @PrintUserId INT  = 1
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- รับวันที่ พ.ศ. จากหน้า report แล้วแปลงเป็น ค.ศ.
    SET @StartDate = CASE WHEN YEAR(@StartDate) > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @StartDate) ELSE @StartDate END;
    SET @EndDate   = CASE WHEN YEAR(@EndDate)   > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @EndDate)   ELSE @EndDate   END;
    SET @UserId = ISNULL(@UserId, 0);
    SET @PrintUserId = ISNULL(@PrintUserId, 1);

    SELECT distinct
        r.CIFNo AS DebtorCode,                         -- รหัสลูกหนี้
        r.LGNo AS LGCode,                              -- รหัส LG
        a.CollectorUserId,
        dbo.FN_DCS_16_GetDebtorName(r.DebtorId) AS DebtorName, -- ชื่อลูกหนี้
        dbo.[Fn_FormatDateAD](lg.ClaimDate) AS CompensationPaidDate, -- วันที่จ่ายประกันชดเชย
        lg.ClaimAmount AS CompensationAmount,          -- ยอดจ่ายประกันชดเชย
        ISNULL(cd.DebtBalance, 0) AS RemainingAmount,  -- คงเหลือ
        dbo.[Fn_FormatDateAD](a.UpdateDate) AS WorkPaidDate, -- วันที่จ่ายงาน
        CASE
            WHEN a.TypeAssignId = 1 THEN dbo.FN_DCS_10_GetOfficerUserNameTH(a.CollectorUserId)
            WHEN a.TypeAssignId = 2 AND a.CollectorOAUserId != 0 THEN dbo.FN_DCS_10_GetOfficerUserNameTH(a.CollectorOAUserId)
            ELSE N'รอจ่ายงาน OA'
        END AS ResponsibleOfficer,                     -- ผู้ดูแล
        debtorStatus.StatusName AS DebtorStatus,        -- สถานะลูกหนี้
        cardStatus.StatusName AS CardStatus,            -- สถานะ card
        N'วันที่พิมพ์ : ' + dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(GETDATE()) AS PrintDate,
        N'ผู้สั่งพิมพ์ : ' + ISNULL(dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(@PrintUserId), N'') AS PrintName
    FROM DataAssignment a
    LEFT JOIN DataDebtorRelate r ON r.DebtorRelateId = a.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN DataLG lg ON lg.LGNo = r.LGNo
    LEFT JOIN DataDebtorCard cd ON cd.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN DataDebtorStatusUpdate ds ON ds.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN SystemStatusMaster debtorStatus ON debtorStatus.SystemStatusId = ds.StatusDebtorId
    LEFT JOIN SystemStatusMaster cardStatus ON cardStatus.SystemStatusId = ds.StatusCardId
    WHERE lg.ClaimDate >= @StartDate
      AND lg.ClaimDate < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @EndDate)
	  and r.DebtorTypeId = 1
      AND (
          @UserId = 0
          OR CASE
                WHEN a.TypeAssignId = 1 THEN a.CollectorUserId
                WHEN a.TypeAssignId = 2 THEN a.CollectorOAUserId
             END = @UserId
      )
    --ORDER BY
    --    lg.ClaimDate ASC,
    --    lg.CIFNo,
    --    lg.LGNo ASC;
END

create   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_MIS_03_PersonalInfo]
    @OrgGroupId INT = 0,     -- 0=ทั้งหมด
    @OrgStructureId INT = 0, -- 0=ทั้งหมด
    @OrgSectionId INT = 0,   -- 0=ทั้งหมด
    @IsActive INT = 0,       -- 0=ทั้งหมด
    @Name NVARCHAR(400) = 'null'
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT 
	r.NameTH
      ,p.EmployeeCode 
	  ,dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(p.UserId) as OfficerName
	  ,dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG(p.UserId,2) ORGLV2
	  ,dbo.FN_DCS_30_GetORG(p.UserId,3) ORGLV3
	  ,case when u.IsActive = 0 then N'ไม่ใช้งาน' else N'ใช้งาน' end as IsActive
	  ,dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(u.LastestLogin) as LastestLogin
	  ,p.OrgStructureId
	  ,p.OrgSectionId 
	  
	, N'วันที่พิมพ์ : ' + dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(getdate()) as PrintDate
	, N'ผู้สั่งพิมพ์ : '+ null as PrintName
    FROM DataUserRoles ur
		LEFT JOIN DataPersonalInfo p  on ur.UserId = p.UserId
    LEFT JOIN DataUsers u ON p.UserId = u.UserId -- Join for UserName
    -- LEFT JOIN SystemOrgGroup g ON p.OrgGroupId = g.OrgGroupId -- Verify Table Name
    LEFT JOIN SystemOrgStructure s ON p.OrgStructureId = s.OrgStructureId
    LEFT JOIN SystemOrgSectionMaster sec ON p.OrgSectionId = sec.OrgSectionId
    LEFT JOIN SystemPositionMaster pos ON p.PositionId = pos.PositionId

	LEFT JOIN DataRoles r on r.RoleId = ur.RoleId
    
    WHERE 
        (@OrgGroupId = 0 OR p.OrgGroupId = @OrgGroupId)
        AND (@OrgStructureId = 0 OR p.OrgStructureId = @OrgStructureId)
        AND (@OrgSectionId = 0 OR p.OrgSectionId = @OrgSectionId)
        AND ( p.IsActive = @IsActive or 2 = @IsActive)
        AND (@Name = 'null' OR p.FirstName LIKE '%' + @Name + '%' OR p.LastName LIKE '%' + @Name + '%' OR u.UserName LIKE '%' + @Name + '%')
		AND (p.UserId !=0 or p.UserId != null)
		--AND ur.RoleId 
END

create   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_MIS_03_Role]
    @UserId int = 2
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

   ;WITH MenuTree AS
(
    -- Root (Level 1)
    SELECT 
        m.MenuId,
        m.MenuName,
        m.ParentId,
        m.[Level],
        m.Position,
        CAST(RIGHT('0000' + CAST(m.Position AS VARCHAR),4) AS VARCHAR(MAX)) AS SortPath
    FROM SystemMenu m
    WHERE m.ParentId =0

    UNION ALL

    -- Child
    SELECT 
        c.MenuId,
        c.MenuName,
        c.ParentId,
        c.[Level],
        c.Position,
        CAST(p.SortPath + '.' + RIGHT('0000' + CAST(c.Position AS VARCHAR),4) AS VARCHAR(MAX))
    FROM SystemMenu c
    INNER JOIN MenuTree p ON c.ParentId = p.MenuId
)

SELECT 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY og.OrgGroupName, r.NameTH, mt.SortPath) AS RowNumber,
    --og.OrgGroupId,
    --ISNULL(og.OrgGroupName, N'-') AS OrgGroupName,
    --r.RoleId,
	dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(ur.UserId) as OfficerName,
    r.NameTH AS RoleName,
    mt.MenuId,
    case when mt.[Level] = 1 then mt.MenuName
	when mt.[Level] = 2 then '  ' + mt.MenuName
	when mt.[Level] = 3 then '    ' + mt.MenuName
	else '        ' + mt.MenuName end as MenuName,
    mt.[Level],
    CASE WHEN rm.IsView = 1 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS IsView,
    CASE WHEN rm.IsInsert = 1 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS IsInsert,
    CASE WHEN rm.IsUpdate = 1 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS IsUpdate,
    CASE WHEN rm.IsDelete = 1 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS IsDelete,
    CASE WHEN rm.IsApprove = 1 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS IsApprove,
    CASE WHEN r.IsActive = 1 THEN N'ใช้งาน' ELSE N'ไม่ใช้งาน' END AS StatusName,
    mt.Position,
    N'วันที่พิมพ์ : ' + dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(GETDATE()) AS PrintDate,
	N'ผู้สั่งพิมพ์ : ' + NULL AS PrintName
FROM DataUserRoles ur
INNER JOIN DataRoles r on r.RoleId = ur.RoleId 
INNER JOIN DataRoleMenu rm ON r.RoleId = rm.RoleId
INNER JOIN MenuTree mt ON rm.MenuId = mt.MenuId
LEFT JOIN SystemOrgGroup og ON r.OrgGroupId = og.OrgGroupId

where ur.UserId = @UserId
ORDER BY og.OrgGroupName, r.NameTH, mt.SortPath


END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_MIS_04_UserRole]
    @RoleId INT = 0           -- 0=ทั้งหมด
    --,@Name NVARCHAR(400) = NULL -- ค้นหาชื่อพนักงาน / UserName
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
	;WITH MenuTree AS
(
    -- Root (Level 1)
    SELECT 
        m.MenuId,
        m.MenuName,
        m.ParentId,
        m.[Level],
        m.Position,
        CAST(RIGHT('0000' + CAST(m.Position AS VARCHAR),4) AS VARCHAR(MAX)) AS SortPath
    FROM SystemMenu m
    WHERE m.ParentId =0

    UNION ALL

    -- Child
    SELECT 
        c.MenuId,
        c.MenuName,
        c.ParentId,
        c.[Level],
        c.Position,
        CAST(p.SortPath + '.' + RIGHT('0000' + CAST(c.Position AS VARCHAR),4) AS VARCHAR(MAX))
    FROM SystemMenu c
    INNER JOIN MenuTree p ON c.ParentId = p.MenuId
)

SELECT 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY og.OrgGroupName, r.NameTH, mt.SortPath) AS RowNumber,
    --og.OrgGroupId,
    --ISNULL(og.OrgGroupName, N'-') AS OrgGroupName,
    --r.RoleId,

    r.NameTH AS RoleName,
    mt.MenuId,
    case when mt.[Level] = 1 then mt.MenuName
	when mt.[Level] = 2 then '  ' + mt.MenuName
	when mt.[Level] = 3 then '    ' + mt.MenuName
	else '        ' + mt.MenuName end as MenuName,
    mt.[Level],
    CASE WHEN rm.IsView = 1 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS IsView,
    CASE WHEN rm.IsInsert = 1 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS IsInsert,
    CASE WHEN rm.IsUpdate = 1 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS IsUpdate,
    CASE WHEN rm.IsDelete = 1 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS IsDelete,
    CASE WHEN rm.IsApprove = 1 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS IsApprove,
    CASE WHEN r.IsActive = 1 THEN N'ใช้งาน' ELSE N'ไม่ใช้งาน' END AS StatusName,
    mt.Position,
    N'วันที่พิมพ์ : ' + dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(GETDATE()) AS PrintDate,
	N'ผู้สั่งพิมพ์ : ' + NULL AS PrintName
FROM DataRoles r 
INNER JOIN DataRoleMenu rm ON r.RoleId = rm.RoleId
INNER JOIN MenuTree mt ON rm.MenuId = mt.MenuId
LEFT JOIN SystemOrgGroup og ON r.OrgGroupId = og.OrgGroupId

where r.RoleId = @RoleId
ORDER BY og.OrgGroupName, r.NameTH, mt.SortPath


END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_NCB_01_CommercialCreditData_Insert]
    @StartDate DATETIME = '2025-05-01',
    @EndDate   DATETIME = '2025-05-31',
    @CIFNo  NVARCHAR(50) = 'null',
    @LGNo   NVARCHAR(50) = 'null'
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET @StartDate = CASE WHEN YEAR(@StartDate) > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR,-543,@StartDate) ELSE @StartDate END;
    SET @EndDate   = CASE WHEN YEAR(@EndDate)   > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR,-543,@EndDate)   ELSE @EndDate   END;
    SET @CIFNo = ISNULL(@CIFNo, 'null');
    SET @LGNo = ISNULL(@LGNo, 'null');
    -- Staging uses one Period for every inserted row; reject mixed-month calls.
    IF @StartDate IS NULL OR @EndDate IS NULL OR @StartDate > @EndDate
       OR YEAR(@StartDate) <> YEAR(@EndDate) OR MONTH(@StartDate) <> MONTH(@EndDate)
        THROW 50001, 'NCB report requires a valid date range within one reporting month.', 1;
    DECLARE @Period NVARCHAR(7) = CONVERT(char(7), @EndDate, 126);
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    DECLARE @DirectOwn bit=CASE WHEN @@TRANCOUNT=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
    DECLARE @DirectLock int,@DirectResource nvarchar(255)=N'NCB.StrictPdf.'+@Period;
    BEGIN TRY
    IF @DirectOwn=1 BEGIN TRANSACTION; ELSE SAVE TRANSACTION DirectNCB01;
    EXEC @DirectLock=sys.sp_getapplock @Resource=@DirectResource,@LockMode='Exclusive',@LockOwner='Transaction',@LockTimeout=30000;
    IF @DirectLock<0 THROW 51301,'Another NCB report is running for this month.',1;


    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 1. Pre-load NCB dynamic conditions (small table — fast)
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#NCBCond01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #NCBCond01;
    SELECT nm.NCBStatusCode, CAST(nm.CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) AS CatalogId, sp.ColumnName, sl.KeyName AS Operator,
           CASE WHEN nm.NCBStatusCode = 12 AND sp.ColumnName = 'MeasureName' AND ne.ValueConditionExcute = 'มาตรการ%'
                THEN '%พัก%หนี้%'
                ELSE ne.ValueConditionExcute END AS ValueConditionExcute
    INTO #NCBCond01
    FROM NCBStatusExcuteMaster ne
    JOIN NCBStatusMaster nm        ON nm.NCBStatusId  = ne.NCBStatusId AND nm.PersonType=2 AND nm.IsActive=1
    JOIN SystemParameterMaster sp  ON sp.ParameterId  = ne.ParameterId
    LEFT JOIN SystemLookupMaster sl ON sl.LookupId    = ne.OparatorId;

    DECLARE @S11_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=11),1,0);
    DECLARE @S12_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=12),1,0);
    DECLARE @S13_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=13),1,0);
    DECLARE @S14_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=14),1,0);
    DECLARE @S20_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=20),1,0);
    DECLARE @S21_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=21),1,0);
    DECLARE @S30_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=30),1,0);
    DECLARE @S31_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=31),1,0);
    DECLARE @S32_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=32),1,0);
    DECLARE @S33_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=33),1,0);
    DECLARE @S42_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=42),1,0);
    DECLARE @S43_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=43),1,0);
    DECLARE @S44_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=44),1,0);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 2. Load NCB status/DPD catalog codes
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    DECLARE @S10  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=10  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);
    DECLARE @S11  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=11  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);
    DECLARE @S12  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=12  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);
    DECLARE @S13  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=13  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);
    DECLARE @S14  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=14  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);
    DECLARE @S20  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=20  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);
    DECLARE @S21  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=21  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);
    DECLARE @S30  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=30  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);
    DECLARE @S31  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=31  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);
    DECLARE @S33  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=33  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);
    DECLARE @S42  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=42  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);
    DECLARE @S43  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=43  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);
    DECLARE @S44  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=44  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);

    -- Dynamic DPD mapping from website configuration.
    -- NCBDPDMaster stores the output code; NCBDPDExcuteMaster stores numeric DPD rules.
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dpd_rule01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dpd_rule01;

    SELECT
        dm.DPDId,
        dm.DPDCode,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(dm.CatalogCode, ''), dm.DPDCode) AS DPDOutputCode,
        MAX(CASE WHEN sl.KeyName = 'Equal' OR sl.LookUpValue = '=' OR de.OparatorId = 5
                 THEN TRY_CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(de.ValueConditionExcute, N' วัน', N'')) END) AS ExactValue,
        MAX(CASE WHEN sl.KeyName = 'LessThanEqual' OR sl.LookUpValue = '>=' OR de.OparatorId = 3
                 THEN TRY_CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(de.ValueConditionExcute, N' วัน', N'')) END) AS MinInclusive,
        MAX(CASE WHEN sl.KeyName = 'MoreThanEqual' OR sl.LookUpValue = '<=' OR de.OparatorId = 4
                 THEN TRY_CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(de.ValueConditionExcute, N' วัน', N'')) END) AS MaxInclusive,
        MAX(CASE WHEN sl.KeyName = 'MoreThan' OR sl.LookUpValue = '>' OR de.OparatorId = 1
                 THEN TRY_CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(de.ValueConditionExcute, N' วัน', N'')) END) AS MinExclusive,
        MAX(CASE WHEN sl.KeyName = 'LessThan' OR sl.LookUpValue = '<' OR de.OparatorId = 2
                 THEN TRY_CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(de.ValueConditionExcute, N' วัน', N'')) END) AS MaxExclusive
    INTO #dpd_rule01
    FROM NCBDPDMaster dm
    LEFT JOIN NCBDPDExcuteMaster de ON de.DPDId = dm.DPDId
    LEFT JOIN SystemLookupMaster sl ON sl.LookupId = de.OparatorId
    WHERE dm.PersonType = 2
      AND dm.IsActive = 1
    GROUP BY dm.DPDId, dm.DPDCode, COALESCE(NULLIF(dm.CatalogCode, ''), dm.DPDCode);

    DECLARE @D0 NVARCHAR(20) = (
        SELECT TOP 1 DPDOutputCode
        FROM #dpd_rule01
        WHERE (ExactValue   IS NULL OR 0 =  ExactValue)
          AND (MinInclusive IS NULL OR 0 >= MinInclusive)
          AND (MaxInclusive IS NULL OR 0 <= MaxInclusive)
          AND (MinExclusive IS NULL OR 0 >  MinExclusive)
          AND (MaxExclusive IS NULL OR 0 <  MaxExclusive)
        ORDER BY
            CASE WHEN ExactValue IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
            ISNULL(MinInclusive, MinExclusive + 1) DESC,
            ISNULL(MaxInclusive, MaxExclusive - 1) ASC,
            DPDCode
    );
    DECLARE @D11 NVARCHAR(20) = (
        SELECT TOP 1 DPDOutputCode
        FROM #dpd_rule01
        WHERE (ExactValue   IS NULL OR 100000 =  ExactValue)
          AND (MinInclusive IS NULL OR 100000 >= MinInclusive)
          AND (MaxInclusive IS NULL OR 100000 <= MaxInclusive)
          AND (MinExclusive IS NULL OR 100000 >  MinExclusive)
          AND (MaxExclusive IS NULL OR 100000 <  MaxExclusive)
        ORDER BY
            CASE WHEN ExactValue IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
            ISNULL(MinInclusive, MinExclusive + 1) DESC,
            ISNULL(MaxInclusive, MaxExclusive - 1) ASC,
            DPDCode
    );

    -- Dynamic TDR restructuring code from website configuration.
    -- SystemTDRRestructureCode stores output code; SystemRestructureExcuteMaster stores matching rules.
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tdr_rule01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tdr_rule01;
    SELECT
        rc.RestructureCodeId,
        rc.RestructureCode,
        rc.Oparators,
        re.Seq,
        sp.ColumnName,
        sl.KeyName AS Operator,
        re.ValueConditionExcute
    INTO #tdr_rule01
    FROM SystemTDRRestructureCode rc
    LEFT JOIN SystemRestructureExcuteMaster re ON re.RestructureCodeId = rc.RestructureCodeId
    LEFT JOIN SystemParameterMaster sp ON sp.ParameterId = re.ParameterId
    LEFT JOIN SystemLookupMaster sl ON sl.LookupId = re.OparatorId
    WHERE rc.IsActive = 1;

    DECLARE @TDRDefaultCode01 NVARCHAR(20) = (
        SELECT TOP 1 RestructureCode
        FROM SystemTDRRestructureCode
        WHERE IsActive = 1
        ORDER BY CASE WHEN RestructureCode = '00' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, RestructureCode
    );

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 3. Pre-filter qualifying DebtorRelateIds
    --    [OPTIMIZED] Drive from DataEndOfDay with JOIN instead of correlated EXISTS
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#qualifying01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #qualifying01;
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId
    INTO #qualifying01
    FROM dbo.DataEndOfDay e
    JOIN DataDebtorRelate ddr ON ddr.DebtorRelateId = e.DebtorRelateId
    WHERE e.AsOfDate BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
      AND (e.IsDelete = 0 OR e.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND ddr.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
      AND (ddr.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (@CIFNo = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM DataDebtorRelate WHERE CIFNo=@CIFNo))
      AND (@LGNo  = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo  = @LGNo)

    UNION

    -- LG cancelled case: no DataDebtorCard, StatusDate in range
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId
    FROM DataDebtorRelate ddr
    JOIN DataLG dlg ON dlg.LGNo = ddr.LGNo
    WHERE dlg.StatusDate BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM DataDebtorCard dc2
          WHERE dc2.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
            AND (dc2.IsDelete = 0 OR dc2.IsDelete IS NULL)
      )
      AND ddr.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
      AND (ddr.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (@CIFNo = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM DataDebtorRelate WHERE CIFNo=@CIFNo))
      AND (@LGNo  = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo  = @LGNo)

    UNION

    -- TDR case: TDR approved up to @EndDate (catches active TDR without EOD in month)
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId
    FROM (
        SELECT CompromiseContractId, LGNo FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractRelated
        UNION
        SELECT CompromiseContractId, LGNo FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractLG
    ) rtdr
    JOIN TDRDataCompromiseContract cc ON cc.CompromiseContractId = rtdr.CompromiseContractId
    JOIN DataDebtorRelate ddr ON ddr.LGNo = rtdr.LGNo
    WHERE cc.ApproveDate <= @EndDate
      AND ddr.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
      AND (ddr.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (@CIFNo = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM DataDebtorRelate WHERE CIFNo=@CIFNo))
      AND (@LGNo  = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo  = @LGNo)

    UNION

    -- Closed account case: include closure events in the requested month only
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId
    FROM DataDebtorRelate ddr
    JOIN DataDebtorCard dc ON dc.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    WHERE CAST(dc.CloseDate AS DATE) <= CAST(@EndDate AS DATE)
      AND CAST(dc.CloseDate AS DATE) >= CAST(@StartDate AS DATE)
      AND (dc.DebtBalance = 0 OR dc.PrincipalTotal = 0)
      AND (dc.IsDelete = 0 OR dc.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND ddr.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
      AND (ddr.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (@CIFNo = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM DataDebtorRelate WHERE CIFNo=@CIFNo))
      AND (@LGNo  = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo  = @LGNo)

    UNION

    -- Closed account case: co-borrowers/guarantors inheriting from primary debtor
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId
    FROM DataDebtorRelate ddr
    JOIN DataDebtorRelate ddr_p ON ddr_p.LGNo = ddr.LGNo AND ddr_p.DebtorTypeId = 1 AND (ddr_p.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr_p.IsDelete IS NULL)
    JOIN DataDebtorCard dc_p ON dc_p.DebtorRelateId = ddr_p.DebtorRelateId
    WHERE CAST(dc_p.CloseDate AS DATE) <= CAST(@EndDate AS DATE)
      AND CAST(dc_p.CloseDate AS DATE) >= CAST(@StartDate AS DATE)
      AND (dc_p.DebtBalance = 0 OR dc_p.PrincipalTotal = 0)
      AND (dc_p.IsDelete = 0 OR dc_p.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND ddr.DebtorTypeId = 2
      AND (ddr.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (@CIFNo = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM DataDebtorRelate WHERE CIFNo=@CIFNo))
      AND (@LGNo  = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo  = @LGNo)

    UNION

    -- Accounts with active card balance
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId
    FROM DataDebtorRelate ddr
    JOIN DataDebtorCard dc ON dc.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    WHERE (dc.IsDelete = 0 OR dc.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance, 0) > 0 OR ISNULL(dc.PrincipalTotal, 0) > 0)
      AND ddr.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
      AND (ddr.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (@CIFNo = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM DataDebtorRelate WHERE CIFNo=@CIFNo))
      AND (@LGNo  = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo  = @LGNo)

    UNION

    -- Accounts with litigation
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId
    FROM DataDebtorRelate ddr
    JOIN LTDataCaseMainDebtor lt ON lt.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    WHERE (lt.IsCancel = 0 OR lt.IsCancel IS NULL)
      AND lt.FilingDate <= @EndDate
      AND ddr.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
      AND (ddr.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (@CIFNo = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM DataDebtorRelate WHERE CIFNo=@CIFNo))
      AND (@LGNo  = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo  = @LGNo)
    OPTION (RECOMPILE);

    INSERT INTO #qualifying01(DebtorRelateId)
    SELECT DISTINCT r.DebtorRelateId
    FROM DataDebtorRelate r
    JOIN DataLG g ON g.LGNo=r.LGNo AND g.Grade IN ('A','B','C','D','E','E1','E2')
    JOIN dbo.TEMPDWHCBS d ON d.accountnumber=r.LGNo AND d.customercode=r.CIFNo
    WHERE r.DebtorTypeId IN (1,2) AND (r.IsDelete=0 OR r.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (@CIFNo='null' OR r.CIFNo=@CIFNo)
      AND (@LGNo='null' OR r.LGNo=@LGNo)
      AND TRY_CONVERT(date,d.eff_date)>=DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@EndDate),MONTH(@EndDate),1)
      AND TRY_CONVERT(date,d.eff_date)<DATEADD(month,1,DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@EndDate),MONTH(@EndDate),1))
      AND (NULLIF(CONVERT(nvarchar(50),d.asofdate),N'') IS NULL
           OR TRY_CONVERT(date,d.asofdate)=TRY_CONVERT(date,d.eff_date))
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #qualifying01 q WHERE q.DebtorRelateId=r.DebtorRelateId);

    -- Resolve exact person before applying the Commercial group restriction.
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dd01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dd01;
    SELECT di.DebtorRelateId, resolved.DebtorId, resolved.DebtorCode,
           CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(resolved.IDCard)), '') IS NULL
                     OR resolved.IDCard LIKE N'%ไม่พบ%' OR resolved.IDCard LIKE N'%ไมพบ%'
                THEN NULL ELSE LTRIM(RTRIM(resolved.IDCard)) END AS IDCard,
           resolved.CardNumber
    INTO #dd01
    FROM #qualifying01 q
    JOIN DataDebtorRelate di ON di.DebtorRelateId=q.DebtorRelateId
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) d.DebtorId,d.DebtorCode,d.PersonGroupId,d.IDCard,d.CardNumber
        FROM DataDebtor d
        WHERE d.DebtorId=di.DebtorId OR d.DebtorCode=di.DebtorCode
        ORDER BY CASE WHEN d.DebtorId=di.DebtorId THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                 d.CreateDate DESC,d.DebtorId DESC
    ) resolved
    WHERE resolved.PersonGroupId=118;
    CREATE INDEX IX_dd01 ON #dd01 (DebtorRelateId);
    DELETE q FROM #qualifying01 q WHERE NOT EXISTS
        (SELECT 1 FROM #dd01 d WHERE d.DebtorRelateId=q.DebtorRelateId);

    -- PDF p14: one row per LG and identity; prefer the main role when duplicated.
    -- Collapse duplicate DebtorCode rows only when they resolve to the same IDCard/CardNumber.
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#qualifying01_dedup') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #qualifying01_dedup;
    SELECT DebtorRelateId
    INTO #qualifying01_dedup
    FROM (
        SELECT
            q.DebtorRelateId,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY ddr.LGNo,
                             COALESCE(dd.IDCard, ddr.DebtorRelateId)
                ORDER BY CASE WHEN ddr.DebtorTypeId = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                         ISNULL(ddr.CreateDate, '1900-01-01') DESC, q.DebtorRelateId DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM #qualifying01 q
        JOIN DataDebtorRelate ddr ON ddr.DebtorRelateId = q.DebtorRelateId
        LEFT JOIN #dd01 dd ON dd.DebtorRelateId=ddr.DebtorRelateId
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1;

    TRUNCATE TABLE #qualifying01;
    INSERT INTO #qualifying01 (DebtorRelateId)
    SELECT DebtorRelateId
    FROM #qualifying01_dedup;

    DELETE q FROM #qualifying01 q JOIN DataDebtorRelate r ON r.DebtorRelateId=q.DebtorRelateId
    WHERE @CIFNo<>'null' AND (r.CIFNo<>@CIFNo OR r.CIFNo IS NULL);
    CREATE INDEX IX_qualifying01 ON #qualifying01 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 3b. DataDebtorRelate details (reused by dwh/s21/sc)
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ddr_info01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ddr_info01;
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr3.DebtorRelateId, ddr3.LGNo, ddr3.CIFNo, ddr3.DebtorId, ddr3.DebtorCode, ddr3.DebtorTypeId
    INTO #ddr_info01
    FROM DataDebtorRelate ddr3
    WHERE ddr3.DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying01);
    CREATE INDEX IX_ddr_info01 ON #ddr_info01 (DebtorRelateId);
    CREATE INDEX IX_ddr_info01_lg ON #ddr_info01 (LGNo, DebtorTypeId);

    -- NCB Deep Detail: borrower count is LG-wide and identity-based.
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#borrower_count01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #borrower_count01;
    ;WITH BorrowerIdentity AS (
        SELECT LGNo, DebtorRelateId, IdentityNo
        FROM (
            SELECT r.LGNo, r.DebtorRelateId,
                   CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.IDCard)), '') IS NOT NULL
                             AND d.IDCard NOT LIKE N'%ไม่พบ%' AND d.IDCard NOT LIKE N'%ไมพบ%'
                        THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(d.IDCard))
 ELSE NULL END AS IdentityNo,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                       PARTITION BY r.DebtorRelateId
                       ORDER BY CASE WHEN d.DebtorId = r.DebtorId THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                                d.CreateDate DESC, d.DebtorId DESC
                   ) AS rn
            FROM DataDebtorRelate r
            -- Disjoint equality branches preserve the original OR match set.
            -- Exclude an ID match from the code branch so it appears exactly once.
            LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT br.DebtorRelateId AS MatchRelateId,
                       person.DebtorId, person.IDCard, person.CreateDate
                FROM DataDebtorRelate br
                JOIN DataDebtor person ON person.DebtorId = br.DebtorId
                WHERE br.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
                  AND (br.IsDelete = 0 OR br.IsDelete IS NULL)
                  AND br.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM #ddr_info01)
                UNION ALL
                SELECT br.DebtorRelateId AS MatchRelateId,
                       person.DebtorId, person.IDCard, person.CreateDate
                FROM DataDebtorRelate br
                JOIN DataDebtor person ON person.DebtorCode = br.DebtorCode
                WHERE br.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
                  AND (br.IsDelete = 0 OR br.IsDelete IS NULL)
                  AND br.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM #ddr_info01)
                  AND (br.DebtorId IS NULL OR person.DebtorId IS NULL
                       OR person.DebtorId <> br.DebtorId)
            ) d ON d.MatchRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId
            WHERE r.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
              AND (r.IsDelete = 0 OR r.IsDelete IS NULL)
              AND r.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM #ddr_info01)
        ) ranked
        WHERE rn = 1
    )
    SELECT LGNo,
           CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN IdentityNo IS NULL OR IdentityNo LIKE N'%ไม่พบ%'
                                   OR IdentityNo LIKE N'%ไมพบ%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
                THEN COUNT(DISTINCT IdentityNo) ELSE NULL END AS BorrowerCount
    INTO #borrower_count01
    FROM BorrowerIdentity
    GROUP BY LGNo;
    CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IX_borrower_count01 ON #borrower_count01 (LGNo);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 3c. DataDebtor TOP 1 per DebtorCode with PersonGroupId = 118
    --     Prevent duplicate output when DataDebtor has multiple rows for the same code.
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- A-E2 source selection uses the DWH business date, not ImportDate.
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dwh01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dwh01;
    SELECT di.DebtorRelateId,d.*
    INTO #dwh01
    FROM #ddr_info01 di
    JOIN DataLG grade_lg ON grade_lg.LGNo=di.LGNo
         AND grade_lg.Grade IN ('A','B','C','D','E','E1','E2')
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) d2.eff_date,d2.asofdate,d2.customercode,d2.accountnumber,
            d2.idnumber,d2.idtype,d2.data_type,d2.dateaccountopend,
            d2.dateaccountclosed,d2.creditlimited,d2.statuslg,d2.bankbranchcode,
            d2.ImportDate
        FROM dbo.TEMPDWHCBS d2
        WHERE d2.accountnumber=di.LGNo AND d2.customercode=di.CIFNo
          AND TRY_CONVERT(date,d2.eff_date)>=DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@EndDate),MONTH(@EndDate),1)
          AND TRY_CONVERT(date,d2.eff_date)<DATEADD(month,1,DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@EndDate),MONTH(@EndDate),1))
          AND (NULLIF(CONVERT(nvarchar(50),d2.asofdate),N'') IS NULL
               OR TRY_CONVERT(date,d2.asofdate)=TRY_CONVERT(date,d2.eff_date))
        ORDER BY TRY_CONVERT(date,d2.eff_date) DESC,d2.ImportDate DESC,d2.TEMPId DESC
    ) d;
    CREATE INDEX IX_dwh01 ON #dwh01(DebtorRelateId);

    -- 4. Monthly snapshot: last EOD per account per month
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#monthly01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #monthly01;
    SELECT e.DebtorRelateId, YEAR(e.AsOfDate) AS yr, MONTH(e.AsOfDate) AS mn, MAX(e.AsOfDate) AS MonthEndDate
    INTO #monthly01
    FROM dbo.DataEndOfDay e
    JOIN DataDebtorRelate source_rel ON source_rel.DebtorRelateId=e.DebtorRelateId
    JOIN DataLG source_lg ON source_lg.LGNo=source_rel.LGNo AND source_lg.Grade IN ('F','F1')
    WHERE e.DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying01)
      AND (e.IsDelete=0 OR e.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND e.AsOfDate BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
    GROUP BY e.DebtorRelateId, YEAR(e.AsOfDate), MONTH(e.AsOfDate);

    INSERT INTO #monthly01 (DebtorRelateId,yr,mn,MonthEndDate)
    SELECT d.DebtorRelateId,YEAR(@EndDate),MONTH(@EndDate),EOMONTH(@EndDate)
    FROM #dwh01 d WHERE d.accountnumber IS NOT NULL;

    -- Fallback is retained for existing status evaluation; the final identity
    -- guard excludes it when no approved source row exists.
    INSERT INTO #monthly01 (DebtorRelateId, yr, mn, MonthEndDate)
    SELECT q.DebtorRelateId, YEAR(@EndDate), MONTH(@EndDate), @EndDate
    FROM #qualifying01 q
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #monthly01 m WHERE m.DebtorRelateId = q.DebtorRelateId);

    CREATE INDEX IX_monthly01 ON #monthly01 (DebtorRelateId, MonthEndDate);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 5. [NEW] Pre-materialize legal cases — replaces per-row OUTER APPLY
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#lt01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #lt01;
    SELECT DebtorRelateId,
           FilingDate, RedCaseNo, BlackCaseNo, BankFilingDate,
           WithdrawDate, JudgmentBankruptcyDate, JmTrialDate,
           WarrantDate, FilingAmount, ReqRepayDate,
           FrozenAssetDate, OtherFrozenAssDate, PetitionDate, BankruptcyDate,
           BadDebtDate
    INTO #lt01
    FROM (
        SELECT DebtorRelateId, FilingDate, RedCaseNo, BlackCaseNo, BankFilingDate,
               WithdrawDate, JudgmentBankruptcyDate, JmTrialDate, WarrantDate, FilingAmount, ReqRepayDate,
               FrozenAssetDate, OtherFrozenAssDate, PetitionDate, BankruptcyDate,
               BadDebtDate,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DebtorRelateId ORDER BY CreateDate DESC) AS rn
        FROM LTDataCaseMainDebtor
        WHERE (IsCancel = 0 OR IsCancel IS NULL)  -- [แก้ 2026-07-15] NULL = 0 is NULL in SQL, not TRUE — was silently dropping non-cancelled rows with IsCancel unset
          AND DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying01)
    ) x WHERE rn = 1;

    CREATE INDEX IX_lt01 ON #lt01 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 6. [NEW] Pre-materialize latest StatusLegalId as of each report month.
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ssu01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ssu01;
    SELECT
        m.DebtorRelateId,
        m.MonthEndDate,
        ssu.StatusLegalId,
        ssu.StatusPortId,
        ssu.StatusPortDate,
        ssu.UpdateDate
    INTO #ssu01
    FROM #monthly01 m
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            s.StatusLegalId,
            s.StatusPortId,
            s.StatusPortDate,
            s.UpdateDate
        FROM DataDebtorStatusUpdate s
        WHERE s.DebtorRelateId = m.DebtorRelateId
          AND s.UpdateDate < DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(m.MonthEndDate), MONTH(m.MonthEndDate), 1))
        ORDER BY s.UpdateDate DESC
    ) ssu;

    CREATE INDEX IX_ssu01 ON #ssu01 (DebtorRelateId, MonthEndDate);

    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#s32_event01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #s32_event01;
    ;WITH S32Ids AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT TRY_CAST(v.value AS INT) AS StatusLegalId
        FROM #NCBCond01 c
        CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(REPLACE(c.ValueConditionExcute, N' ', N''), ',') v
        WHERE c.NCBStatusCode = 32
          AND c.ColumnName = 'StatusLegalId'
          AND TRY_CAST(v.value AS INT) IS NOT NULL
    )
    SELECT
        m.DebtorRelateId,
        m.MonthEndDate,
