        MIN(s.UpdateDate) AS S32EventDate
    INTO #s32_event01
    FROM #monthly01 m
    JOIN DataDebtorStatusUpdate s
        ON s.DebtorRelateId = m.DebtorRelateId
       AND s.UpdateDate < DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(m.MonthEndDate), MONTH(m.MonthEndDate), 1))
    JOIN S32Ids ids
        ON ids.StatusLegalId = s.StatusLegalId
    GROUP BY m.DebtorRelateId, m.MonthEndDate;
    CREATE INDEX IX_s32_event01 ON #s32_event01 (DebtorRelateId, MonthEndDate);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- DWH source for the report month is materialized before #monthly01.

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 7b. Pre-materialize latest TDR contract per LGNo
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tdr_latest01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tdr_latest01;
    SELECT LGNo, CompromiseContractId, CompromiseContractStatusId, ApproveDate, TDRDate, InstallmentDueDate, MeasureName
    INTO #tdr_latest01
    FROM (
        SELECT
            rtdr.LGNo, cc.CompromiseContractId, cc.CompromiseContractStatusId, cc.ApproveDate, cc.TDRDate, CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), cc.InstallmentDueDate) AS InstallmentDueDate, m.MeasureName,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rtdr.LGNo ORDER BY cc.ApproveDate DESC, cc.CompromiseContractId DESC) AS rn
        FROM (
            SELECT CompromiseContractId, LGNo FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractRelated
            UNION
            SELECT CompromiseContractId, LGNo FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractLG
        ) rtdr
        JOIN TDRDataCompromiseContract cc ON cc.CompromiseContractId = rtdr.CompromiseContractId
        LEFT JOIN SystemMeasureMaster m ON m.MeasureId = cc.MeasureId
        WHERE cc.ApproveDate <= @EndDate
          AND rtdr.LGNo IN (SELECT DISTINCT LGNo FROM #ddr_info01)
    ) x WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_tdr_latest01 ON #tdr_latest01 (LGNo);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 7c. Pre-materialize latest DataDebtorCard per DebtorRelateId (Card fallback)
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dc01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dc01;
    SELECT DebtorRelateId, DataDebtorCardId, CloseDate, DFDDate, DPD, ClaimPayDate, IsTDR, CompromiseContracApproveDate, DebtBalance, PrincipalTotal
    INTO #dc01
    FROM (
        SELECT DebtorRelateId, DataDebtorCardId, CloseDate, DFDDate, DPD, ClaimPayDate, IsTDR, CompromiseContracApproveDate, DebtBalance, PrincipalTotal,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DebtorRelateId ORDER BY CreateDate DESC, DataDebtorCardId DESC) AS rn
        FROM DataDebtorCard
        WHERE DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying01)
          AND (IsDelete = 0 OR IsDelete IS NULL)
    ) x WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_dc01 ON #dc01 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- Rank EOD rows only for monthly snapshots, then keep rn = 1.
    -- This prevents duplicate output when multiple EOD rows share the same CreateDate.
    -- PDF pp4/11/16: display latest dated TDR, including closed/unapproved plans.
     -- This reporting history is separate from the active-plan calculation above.
     IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tdr_report01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tdr_report01;
     ;WITH ReportingTDR AS (
         SELECT rel.LGNo, m.MonthEndDate, cc.TDRDate, cc.InstallmentsEndDate,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rel.LGNo, m.MonthEndDate
                                   ORDER BY cc.TDRDate DESC, cc.CompromiseContractId DESC) AS rn
         FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MonthEndDate FROM #monthly01) m
         JOIN TDRDataCompromiseContract cc
           ON CAST(cc.TDRDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(m.MonthEndDate)
          AND cc.TDRDate > '1900-01-01'
         JOIN (
             SELECT CompromiseContractId, LGNo FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractRelated
             UNION
             SELECT CompromiseContractId, LGNo FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractLG
         ) rel ON rel.CompromiseContractId = cc.CompromiseContractId
         WHERE rel.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM #ddr_info01)
     )
     SELECT LGNo, MonthEndDate, TDRDate, InstallmentsEndDate
     INTO #tdr_report01
     FROM ReportingTDR
     WHERE rn = 1;
     CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IX_tdr_report01 ON #tdr_report01 (LGNo, MonthEndDate);

     IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#eom_source01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #eom_source01;
    SELECT
        ms.DebtorRelateId,
        ms.yr,
        ms.mn,
        ms.MonthEndDate,
        eom.CIFNo AS SnapshotCIFNo,
        eom.LGNo AS SnapshotLGNo,
        eom.DataDebtorCardId,
        eom.CurrentPaymentDate,
        eom.CloseDate,
        eom.PrincipalTotal,
        eom.DebtBalance,
        eom.AccruedInterest,
        eom.ClaimPayDate,
        eom.DFDDate,
        eom.DPD,
        eom.IsTDR,
        eom.InstallmentsAmount,
        eom.TDRInstallments,
        eom.InstallmentOutstanding,
        eom.CaseTypeId,
        eom.FilingDate,
        eom.BlackCaseNo,
        eom.JmTrialDate,
        eom.RedCaseNo,
        eom.FrozenAssetDate,
        eom.OtherFrozenAssDate,
        eom.ReqRepayDate,
        eom.FilingAmount,
        eom.BankruptcyDate,
        eom.PetitionDate,
        eom.WithdrawDate,
        eom.WarrantDate,
        eom.JudgmentBankruptcyDate,
        eom.StatusLGId,
        eom.AmountDuty,
        eom.DebtAmount,
        eom.CompromiseContracApproveDate,
        eom.DebtorRelateTypeId,
        eom.SystemBankId,
        eom.MeasureName,
        eom.BankCode,
        eom.ExpirationDate,
        eom.PrincipalPay,
        eom.BadDebtDate,
        eom.CardType,
        eom.ProportionLiability,
        eom.StatusPortId,
        eom.StatusPortDate,
        CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), eom.TDRInstallmentDueDate) AS TDRInstallmentDueDate,
        eom.AcknowDebtDate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY ms.DebtorRelateId, ms.MonthEndDate
            ORDER BY ISNULL(eom.CreateDate, '1900-01-01') DESC,
                     ISNULL(eom.DataDebtorCardId, 0) DESC
        ) AS rn
    INTO #eom_source01
    FROM #monthly01 ms
    JOIN #ddr_info01 source_rel ON source_rel.DebtorRelateId=ms.DebtorRelateId
    JOIN DataLG source_lg ON source_lg.LGNo=source_rel.LGNo AND source_lg.Grade IN ('F','F1')
    JOIN dbo.DataEndOfDay eom ON eom.DebtorRelateId = ms.DebtorRelateId
        AND eom.AsOfDate = ms.MonthEndDate
        AND (eom.IsDelete = 0 OR eom.IsDelete IS NULL);
    -- PDF pp10-12 supplies zero DPD/balances for A-E2. The missing DFD is
    -- kept NULL; no EOD value is carried into the DWH branch.
    INSERT INTO #eom_source01
        (DebtorRelateId,yr,mn,MonthEndDate,SnapshotCIFNo,SnapshotLGNo,
         DataDebtorCardId,CloseDate,PrincipalTotal,DebtBalance,AccruedInterest,
         DFDDate,DPD,IsTDR,InstallmentsAmount,TDRInstallments,InstallmentOutstanding,
         FilingDate,BlackCaseNo,JmTrialDate,RedCaseNo,FrozenAssetDate,
         OtherFrozenAssDate,ReqRepayDate,FilingAmount,BankruptcyDate,PetitionDate,
         WithdrawDate,WarrantDate,JudgmentBankruptcyDate,StatusLGId,AmountDuty,
         DebtAmount,DebtorRelateTypeId,SystemBankId,PrincipalPay,BadDebtDate,rn)
    SELECT d.DebtorRelateId,YEAR(@EndDate),MONTH(@EndDate),EOMONTH(@EndDate),
           d.customercode,d.accountnumber,dc.DataDebtorCardId,
           TRY_CONVERT(datetime,d.dateaccountclosed),0,0,0,
           NULL,0,0,0,0,0,
           legal.FilingDate,legal.BlackCaseNo,legal.JmTrialDate,legal.RedCaseNo,
           legal.FrozenAssetDate,legal.OtherFrozenAssDate,legal.ReqRepayDate,
           legal.FilingAmount,legal.BankruptcyDate,legal.PetitionDate,
           legal.WithdrawDate,legal.WarrantDate,legal.JudgmentBankruptcyDate,
           TRY_CONVERT(int,d.statuslg),TRY_CONVERT(decimal(18,2),d.creditlimited),
           0,di.DebtorTypeId,dlg.BankId,TRY_CONVERT(decimal(18,2),d.creditlimited),
           legal.BadDebtDate,1
    FROM #dwh01 d
    JOIN #ddr_info01 di ON di.DebtorRelateId=d.DebtorRelateId
    JOIN DataLG dlg ON dlg.LGNo=di.LGNo
    LEFT JOIN #dc01 dc ON dc.DebtorRelateId=d.DebtorRelateId
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) cm.FilingDate,cm.BlackCaseNo,cm.JmTrialDate,
            cm.RedCaseNo,cm.FrozenAssetDate,cm.OtherFrozenAssDate,
            cm.ReqRepayDate,cm.FilingAmount,cm.BankruptcyDate,
            cm.PetitionDate,cm.WithdrawDate,cm.WarrantDate,
            cm.JudgmentBankruptcyDate,cm.BadDebtDate
        FROM dbo.LTDataCaseMainDebtor ltd
        JOIN dbo.LTDataCaseMain cm ON cm.CaseMainId=ltd.CaseMainId
        WHERE ltd.DebtorRelateId=d.DebtorRelateId
          AND (ltd.IsCancel=0 OR ltd.IsCancel IS NULL)
          AND COALESCE(cm.FilingDate,cm.CreateDate)<DATEADD(day,1,EOMONTH(@EndDate))
        ORDER BY COALESCE(cm.FilingDate,cm.CreateDate) DESC,
                 cm.CreateDate DESC,cm.CaseMainId DESC
    ) legal
    WHERE d.accountnumber IS NOT NULL;
    CREATE INDEX IX_eom_source01 ON #eom_source01 (DebtorRelateId, MonthEndDate, rn);

    -- ── STEP E: Materialize end-of-month DataEndOfDay snapshot (read DataEndOfDay only once)
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#eom01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #eom01;
    SELECT
        ms.DebtorRelateId,
        report_tdr.TDRDate AS ReportTDRDate,
        report_tdr.InstallmentsEndDate AS ReportMaturityDate,
        ms.yr,
        ms.mn,
        ms.MonthEndDate,
        eom.SnapshotCIFNo,
        eom.SnapshotLGNo,
        COALESCE(eom.DataDebtorCardId, dc.DataDebtorCardId) AS DataDebtorCardId,
        eom.CurrentPaymentDate,
        eom.CloseDate AS CloseDate,
        eom.PrincipalTotal AS PrincipalTotal,
        eom.DebtBalance AS DebtBalance,
        eom.AccruedInterest,
        dlg_source.ClaimDate AS ClaimPayDate,
        eom.DFDDate AS DFDDate,
        eom.DPD AS DPD,
        CASE
            WHEN tdr_rel.ApproveDate IS NOT NULL AND tdr_rel.ApproveDate > '1900-01-01'
                 AND ISNULL(tdr_rel.CompromiseContractStatusId, 0) NOT IN (60, 61) THEN 1
            ELSE ISNULL(COALESCE(eom.IsTDR, dc.IsTDR), 0)
        END AS IsTDR,
        eom.InstallmentsAmount,
        eom.TDRInstallments,
        eom.InstallmentOutstanding,
        eom.CaseTypeId,
        eom.FilingDate,
        eom.BlackCaseNo,
        eom.JmTrialDate,
        eom.RedCaseNo,
        eom.FrozenAssetDate,
        eom.OtherFrozenAssDate,
        eom.ReqRepayDate,
        eom.FilingAmount,
        eom.BankruptcyDate,
        eom.PetitionDate,
        eom.WithdrawDate,
        eom.WarrantDate,
        eom.JudgmentBankruptcyDate,
        eom.StatusLGId,
        eom.AmountDuty,
        eom.DebtAmount,
        CASE
            WHEN tdr_rel.ApproveDate IS NOT NULL AND tdr_rel.ApproveDate > '1900-01-01' THEN tdr_rel.ApproveDate
            ELSE COALESCE(eom.CompromiseContracApproveDate, dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate, '1900-01-01')
        END AS CompromiseContracApproveDate,
        eom.DebtorRelateTypeId,
        eom.SystemBankId,
        report_measure.MeasureName AS MeasureName,
        report_measure.CompromiseContractMeasureId AS ReportMeasureId,
        eom.BankCode,
        eom.ExpirationDate,
        eom.PrincipalPay,
        eom.BadDebtDate,
        eom.CardType,
        eom.ProportionLiability,
        eom.StatusPortId AS StatusPortId,
        eom.StatusPortDate AS StatusPortDate,
        eom.TDRInstallmentDueDate AS TDRInstallmentDueDate,
        eom.AcknowDebtDate,
        CASE WHEN dlg_source.ClaimDate > '1900-01-01'
                   AND CAST(dlg_source.ClaimDate AS DATE)<=EOMONTH(ms.MonthEndDate)
                   AND ((eom.FrozenAssetDate>'1900-01-01' AND eom.FrozenAssetDate<dlg_source.ClaimDate)
                     OR (eom.OtherFrozenAssDate>'1900-01-01' AND eom.OtherFrozenAssDate<dlg_source.ClaimDate)
                     OR (eom.JudgmentBankruptcyDate>'1900-01-01' AND eom.JudgmentBankruptcyDate<dlg_source.ClaimDate
                         AND eom.ReqRepayDate>'1900-01-01' AND eom.ReqRepayDate<dlg_source.ClaimDate))
             THEN dlg_source.ClaimDate ELSE eom.DFDDate END AS DerivedDFD,
        eom.DPD AS DerivedDPD
    INTO #eom01
    FROM #monthly01 ms
    JOIN #ddr_info01 di ON di.DebtorRelateId = ms.DebtorRelateId
    JOIN DataLG dlg_source ON dlg_source.LGNo = di.LGNo
    LEFT JOIN #tdr_report01 report_tdr ON report_tdr.LGNo = di.LGNo AND report_tdr.MonthEndDate = ms.MonthEndDate
    LEFT JOIN #eom_source01 eom ON eom.DebtorRelateId = ms.DebtorRelateId AND eom.MonthEndDate = ms.MonthEndDate AND eom.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN #dc01 dc ON dc.DebtorRelateId = ms.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #lt01 lt ON lt.DebtorRelateId = ms.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #tdr_latest01 tdr_rel ON tdr_rel.LGNo = di.LGNo
    LEFT JOIN #ssu01 ssu ON ssu.DebtorRelateId = ms.DebtorRelateId AND ssu.MonthEndDate = ms.MonthEndDate
    OUTER APPLY (
        -- PDF borrower measure interval: period belongs to this LG's measure.
        SELECT TOP (1) m.MeasureName,cm.CompromiseContractMeasureId
        FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractMeasure cm
        JOIN SystemMeasureMaster m ON m.MeasureId=cm.MeasureId
        WHERE cm.StartDate > '1900-01-01'
          AND CAST(cm.StartDate AS date)<=CAST(ms.MonthEndDate AS date)
          AND cm.EndDate > '1900-01-01'
          AND CAST(cm.EndDate AS date)>=CAST(ms.MonthEndDate AS date)
          AND (cm.CompromiseContractLGId IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractLG cl
                WHERE cl.CompromiseContractLGId=cm.CompromiseContractLGId
                  AND cl.CompromiseContractId=cm.CompromiseContractId AND cl.LGNo=di.LGNo)
            OR cm.CompromiseContractLGId IS NULL AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractRelated rel
                WHERE rel.CompromiseContractId=cm.CompromiseContractId AND rel.LGNo=di.LGNo
                UNION ALL
                SELECT 1 FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractLG cl
                WHERE cl.CompromiseContractId=cm.CompromiseContractId AND cl.LGNo=di.LGNo))
        ORDER BY cm.StartDate DESC,cm.Seq DESC,cm.CreateDate DESC,cm.CompromiseContractMeasureId DESC
    ) report_measure
;
    CREATE INDEX IX_eom01 ON #eom01 (DebtorRelateId, MonthEndDate);

    -- [NEW] Pre-compute s12/s13/s14/s21 conditions per (DebtorRelateId, MonthEndDate)
    -- Replaces 4 per-row OUTER APPLY NOT EXISTS in Main SELECT → eliminates worktable spooling
    -- PDF p27: use the last report BEFORE this month; reruns cannot self-qualify.
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#previous_report01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #previous_report01;
    ;WITH PreviousPeriod AS (
        SELECT di.LGNo, di.CIFNo, eom.MonthEndDate, MAX(h.period) AS PreviousPeriod
        FROM #eom01 eom
        JOIN #ddr_info01 di ON di.DebtorRelateId = eom.DebtorRelateId
        LEFT JOIN NCBCommercialCreditData h ON h.account_number = di.LGNo AND h.customer_code = di.CIFNo
             AND h.period < CONVERT(char(7), eom.MonthEndDate, 126)
        GROUP BY di.LGNo, di.CIFNo, eom.MonthEndDate
    )
    SELECT p.LGNo, p.CIFNo, p.MonthEndDate,
           CASE WHEN COUNT(h.account_status) > 0
                     AND MIN(CASE WHEN h.account_status = @S21 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
                THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Was21
    INTO #previous_report01
    FROM PreviousPeriod p
    LEFT JOIN NCBCommercialCreditData h ON h.account_number = p.LGNo AND h.customer_code = p.CIFNo
         AND h.period = p.PreviousPeriod
    GROUP BY p.LGNo, p.CIFNo, p.MonthEndDate;
    -- END previous report
    CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IX_previous_report01 ON #previous_report01 (LGNo, CIFNo, MonthEndDate);

    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#cond01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #cond01;
    SELECT
        eom.DebtorRelateId,
        eom.MonthEndDate,
        CASE WHEN eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01'
                   AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
                   AND ((eom.FrozenAssetDate > '1900-01-01' AND eom.FrozenAssetDate < eom.ClaimPayDate)
                     OR (eom.OtherFrozenAssDate > '1900-01-01' AND eom.OtherFrozenAssDate < eom.ClaimPayDate)
                     OR (eom.JudgmentBankruptcyDate > '1900-01-01' AND eom.JudgmentBankruptcyDate < eom.ClaimPayDate
                         AND eom.ReqRepayDate > '1900-01-01' AND eom.ReqRepayDate < eom.ClaimPayDate))
             THEN eom.ClaimPayDate ELSE eom.DerivedDFD END AS ReportDFD,
        CASE WHEN eom.ReportTDRDate > '1900-01-01'
                    AND YEAR(eom.ReportTDRDate) = YEAR(eom.MonthEndDate)
                    AND MONTH(eom.ReportTDRDate) = MONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
                    AND eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01'
                    AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
                    AND dlg_rule.Grade IN ('E1', 'E2', 'F', 'F1')
              THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsTDRReset,
        CASE WHEN eom.CloseDate > '1900-01-01'
                   AND CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
                   AND ((eom.DebtBalance = 0 AND eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01'
                         AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) AND dlg_rule.Grade IN ('F', 'F1'))
                     OR ((eom.ClaimPayDate IS NULL OR eom.ClaimPayDate <= '1900-01-01'
                          OR CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) > EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate))
                         AND dlg_rule.Grade IN ('A','B','C','D','E','E1','E2') AND eom.StatusLGId=500))
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsS11,
        CASE WHEN eom.ReportMeasureId IS NOT NULL AND eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) AND dlg_rule.Grade IN ('F', 'F1') AND eom.ReportTDRDate > '1900-01-01' AND eom.DerivedDFD > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.DerivedDFD AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) AND eom.DerivedDPD > 0 AND (eom.CloseDate IS NULL OR eom.CloseDate <= '1900-01-01' OR CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE)>EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate))
             THEN CASE WHEN 1=1
              AND (eom.MeasureName LIKE N'%พักหนี้%' OR eom.MeasureName LIKE N'%พักชำระหนี้%' OR eom.MeasureName LIKE N'%ตั้งพัก%')
              AND eom.MeasureName NOT LIKE N'%เปราะบาง%'
              AND eom.MeasureName NOT LIKE N'%เกษตร%'
              AND (
                  @S12_HasCond = 0 OR NOT EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 c WHERE c.NCBStatusCode = 12
                      AND CASE
                          WHEN c.ColumnName='MeasureName' THEN
                              CASE WHEN c.Operator='LIKE'         THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.MeasureName,'') LIKE c.ValueConditionExcute,1,0)
                                   WHEN c.Operator='contains'     THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.MeasureName,'') LIKE '%'+c.ValueConditionExcute+'%',1,0)
                                   WHEN c.Operator='='            THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.MeasureName,'')=c.ValueConditionExcute,1,0)
                                   WHEN c.Operator IN('<>','!=')  THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.MeasureName,'')<>c.ValueConditionExcute,1,0)
                                   ELSE 0 END
                          WHEN c.ColumnName='DPD' THEN
                              CASE WHEN c.Operator='>=' THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DPD,0)>=TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                   WHEN c.Operator='<=' THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DPD,0)<=TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                   WHEN c.Operator='>'  THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DPD,0)> TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                   WHEN c.Operator='<'  THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DPD,0)< TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                   WHEN c.Operator='='  THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DPD,0)= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                   ELSE 0 END
                          WHEN c.ColumnName='IsTDR' THEN
                              CASE WHEN c.Operator='='           THEN IIF(ISNULL(CAST(eom.IsTDR AS INT),0)= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                   WHEN c.Operator IN('<>','!=') THEN IIF(ISNULL(CAST(eom.IsTDR AS INT),0)<>TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                   ELSE 0 END
                          WHEN c.ColumnName='DebtBalance' THEN
                              CASE WHEN c.Operator IN('>=','>') THEN IIF(eom.DebtBalance>=TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT,c.ValueConditionExcute),1,0)
                                   WHEN c.Operator IN('<=','<') THEN IIF(eom.DebtBalance<=TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT,c.ValueConditionExcute),1,0)
                                   WHEN c.Operator='='          THEN IIF(eom.DebtBalance= TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT,c.ValueConditionExcute),1,0)
                                   ELSE 0 END
                          ELSE 0 END = 0)
              )
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS IsS12,
        CASE WHEN eom.ReportMeasureId IS NOT NULL AND eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) AND dlg_rule.Grade IN ('F', 'F1') AND eom.ReportTDRDate > '1900-01-01' AND eom.DerivedDFD > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.DerivedDFD AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) AND eom.DerivedDPD > 0 AND (eom.CloseDate IS NULL OR eom.CloseDate <= '1900-01-01' OR CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE)>EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate))
             THEN CASE WHEN @S13_HasCond = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 c WHERE c.NCBStatusCode = 13
            AND CASE
                WHEN c.ColumnName='MeasureName' THEN
                    CASE WHEN c.Operator='LIKE'         THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.MeasureName,'') LIKE c.ValueConditionExcute,1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator='contains'     THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.MeasureName,'') LIKE '%'+c.ValueConditionExcute+'%',1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator='='            THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.MeasureName,'')=c.ValueConditionExcute,1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator IN('<>','!=')  THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.MeasureName,'')<>c.ValueConditionExcute,1,0)
                         ELSE 0 END
                WHEN c.ColumnName='DPD' THEN
                    CASE WHEN c.Operator='>=' THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DPD,0)>=TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator='<=' THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DPD,0)<=TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator='>'  THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DPD,0)> TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator='<'  THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DPD,0)< TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator='='  THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DPD,0)= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                         ELSE 0 END
                WHEN c.ColumnName='IsTDR' THEN
                    CASE WHEN c.Operator='='           THEN IIF(ISNULL(CAST(eom.IsTDR AS INT),0)= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator IN('<>','!=') THEN IIF(ISNULL(CAST(eom.IsTDR AS INT),0)<>TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                         ELSE 0 END
                WHEN c.ColumnName='DebtBalance' THEN
                    CASE WHEN c.Operator IN('>=','>') THEN IIF(eom.DebtBalance>=TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT,c.ValueConditionExcute),1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator IN('<=','<') THEN IIF(eom.DebtBalance<=TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT,c.ValueConditionExcute),1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator='='          THEN IIF(eom.DebtBalance= TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT,c.ValueConditionExcute),1,0)
                         ELSE 0 END
                ELSE 0 END = 0)
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS IsS13,
        CASE WHEN eom.ReportMeasureId IS NOT NULL AND eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) AND dlg_rule.Grade IN ('F', 'F1') AND eom.ReportTDRDate > '1900-01-01' AND eom.DerivedDFD > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.DerivedDFD AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) AND eom.DerivedDPD > 0 AND (eom.CloseDate IS NULL OR eom.CloseDate <= '1900-01-01' OR CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE)>EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate))
             THEN CASE WHEN eom.ClaimPayDate>'1900-01-01'
             AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS date)<=EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
             AND dlg_rule.Grade IN ('F', 'F1') AND eom.ReportTDRDate>'1900-01-01'
             AND (dbo.Fn_NCBFarmerMoratorium(eom.MeasureName)=1
                  OR (@S14_HasCond = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 c WHERE c.NCBStatusCode = 14
            AND CASE
                WHEN c.ColumnName='MeasureName' THEN
                    CASE WHEN c.Operator='LIKE'         THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.MeasureName,'') LIKE c.ValueConditionExcute,1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator='contains'     THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.MeasureName,'') LIKE '%'+c.ValueConditionExcute+'%',1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator='='            THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.MeasureName,'')=c.ValueConditionExcute,1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator IN('<>','!=')  THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.MeasureName,'')<>c.ValueConditionExcute,1,0)
                         ELSE 0 END
                WHEN c.ColumnName='DPD' THEN
                    CASE WHEN c.Operator='>=' THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DPD,0)>=TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator='<=' THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DPD,0)<=TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator='>'  THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DPD,0)> TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator='<'  THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DPD,0)< TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator='='  THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DPD,0)= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                         ELSE 0 END
                WHEN c.ColumnName='IsTDR' THEN
                    CASE WHEN c.Operator='='           THEN IIF(ISNULL(CAST(eom.IsTDR AS INT),0)= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator IN('<>','!=') THEN IIF(ISNULL(CAST(eom.IsTDR AS INT),0)<>TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                         ELSE 0 END
                WHEN c.ColumnName='DebtBalance' THEN
                    CASE WHEN c.Operator IN('>=','>') THEN IIF(eom.DebtBalance>=TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT,c.ValueConditionExcute),1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator IN('<=','<') THEN IIF(eom.DebtBalance<=TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT,c.ValueConditionExcute),1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator='='          THEN IIF(eom.DebtBalance= TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT,c.ValueConditionExcute),1,0)
                         ELSE 0 END
                ELSE 0 END = 0)
        )) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS IsS14,
        CASE WHEN eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) AND dlg_rule.Grade IN ('F', 'F1') AND (eom.CloseDate IS NULL OR eom.CloseDate <= '1900-01-01' OR CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE)>EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)) AND eom.DerivedDFD > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.DerivedDFD AS DATE)<=EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) AND eom.DerivedDPD>90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsS20,
        CASE WHEN eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
              AND (eom.CloseDate IS NULL OR eom.CloseDate <= '1900-01-01' OR CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE) > EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate))
              AND (
                  (eom.FrozenAssetDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.FrozenAssetDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate))
                  OR (eom.OtherFrozenAssDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.OtherFrozenAssDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate))
                  OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SystemCaseTypeMaster ct WHERE ct.CaseTypeId = eom.CaseTypeId AND ct.CaseTypeName = N'แพ่ง')
                      AND eom.FilingDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.FilingDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
                      AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(eom.BlackCaseNo)), '') IS NOT NULL
                      AND (eom.ReportTDRDate IS NULL OR eom.ReportTDRDate <= '1900-01-01')
                      AND (eom.WithdrawDate IS NULL OR eom.WithdrawDate <= '1900-01-01' OR CAST(eom.WithdrawDate AS DATE) > EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) OR eom.WithdrawDate < eom.FilingDate))
              ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsS30,
        CASE WHEN eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
              AND (eom.CloseDate IS NULL OR eom.CloseDate <= '1900-01-01' OR CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE) > EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate))
              AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SystemCaseTypeMaster ct WHERE ct.CaseTypeId = eom.CaseTypeId AND ct.CaseTypeName = N'แพ่ง')
              AND eom.FilingDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.FilingDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
              AND eom.JmTrialDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.JmTrialDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
              AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(eom.RedCaseNo)), '') IS NOT NULL
              AND eom.ReportTDRDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.ReportTDRDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
              AND (eom.WithdrawDate IS NULL OR eom.WithdrawDate <= '1900-01-01' OR CAST(eom.WithdrawDate AS DATE) > EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) OR eom.WithdrawDate < eom.FilingDate)
              THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsS31,
        0 AS IsS32,
        CASE WHEN eom.BadDebtDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.BadDebtDate AS DATE)<=EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsS33,
        CASE WHEN eom.DerivedDPD>90 AND eom.StatusPortDate>'1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.StatusPortDate AS DATE)<=EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) THEN CASE WHEN @S42_HasCond = 1 AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 c WHERE c.NCBStatusCode = 42 AND c.ColumnName='StatusPortId'
              AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM STRING_SPLIT(REPLACE(c.ValueConditionExcute,N' ',N''), ',') v WHERE TRY_CAST(v.value AS INT) = ISNULL(eom.StatusPortId,0))
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS IsS42,
        0 AS IsS43,
        0 AS IsS44,
        CASE WHEN previous_report.Was21 = 1
                   AND eom.ReportTDRDate > '1900-01-01'
                   AND CAST(eom.ReportTDRDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
                   AND eom.DerivedDPD > 90
                   AND eom.DerivedDFD > '1900-01-01'
                   AND CAST(eom.DerivedDFD AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
                   AND eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01'
                   AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
                   AND dlg_rule.Grade IN ('F', 'F1')
                   AND (eom.CloseDate IS NULL OR eom.CloseDate <= '1900-01-01'
                        OR eom.CloseDate > EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate))
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsS21
    INTO #cond01
    FROM #eom01 eom
    JOIN #ddr_info01 di ON di.DebtorRelateId = eom.DebtorRelateId
    JOIN DataLG dlg_rule ON dlg_rule.LGNo = di.LGNo
    LEFT JOIN #previous_report01 previous_report ON previous_report.LGNo = di.LGNo
         AND previous_report.CIFNo = di.CIFNo AND previous_report.MonthEndDate = eom.MonthEndDate
    LEFT JOIN #lt01 lt ON lt.DebtorRelateId = eom.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #tdr_latest01 tdr_rel ON tdr_rel.LGNo = di.LGNo
    LEFT JOIN #ssu01 ssu
        ON ssu.DebtorRelateId = eom.DebtorRelateId
       AND ssu.MonthEndDate = eom.MonthEndDate;
    CREATE INDEX IX_cond01 ON #cond01 (DebtorRelateId, MonthEndDate);
    UPDATE #cond01 SET IsS12=0, IsS13=0 WHERE IsS14=1;

    -- Build dynamic status match from precomputed flags.
    -- Avoids CROSS JOIN #eom01 x #NCBCond01, which is too expensive for monthly volume.
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#status_match01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #status_match01;
    ;WITH Candidate AS (
        SELECT
            cond.DebtorRelateId,
            cond.MonthEndDate,
            v.NCBStatusCode
        FROM #cond01 cond
        CROSS APPLY (VALUES
            (42, cond.IsS42),
            (33, cond.IsS33),
            (11, cond.IsS11),
            (31, cond.IsS31),
            (30, cond.IsS30),
            (13, cond.IsS13),
            (14, cond.IsS14),
            (12, cond.IsS12),
            (21, cond.IsS21),
            (20, cond.IsS20)
        ) v(NCBStatusCode, IsMatch)
        WHERE v.IsMatch = 1
    )
    SELECT DebtorRelateId, MonthEndDate, NCBStatusCode, AccountStatus
    INTO #status_match01
    FROM (
        SELECT
            c.DebtorRelateId,
            c.MonthEndDate,
            c.NCBStatusCode,
            CAST(nsm.CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) AS AccountStatus,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY c.DebtorRelateId, c.MonthEndDate
                ORDER BY CASE c.NCBStatusCode
                    WHEN 42 THEN 10 WHEN 43 THEN 11 WHEN 44 THEN 12
                    WHEN 32 THEN 13 WHEN 33 THEN 20 WHEN 11 THEN 30 WHEN 31 THEN 40 WHEN 30 THEN 50
                    WHEN 13 THEN 60 WHEN 14 THEN 70 WHEN 12 THEN 80 WHEN 21 THEN 90
                    WHEN 20 THEN 100 WHEN 10 THEN 999 ELSE 500 END,
                    c.NCBStatusCode
            ) AS rn
        FROM Candidate c
        JOIN NCBStatusMaster nsm ON nsm.NCBStatusCode = c.NCBStatusCode
                                AND nsm.PersonType = 2
                                AND nsm.IsActive = 1
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_status_match01 ON #status_match01 (DebtorRelateId, MonthEndDate);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 7b. [OPTIMIZED] Pre-materialize NCBStopCondition — replaces per-row NOT EXISTS
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#sc01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #sc01;
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr2.DebtorRelateId
    INTO #sc01
    FROM #ddr_info01 ddr2
    JOIN NCBStopConditionMaster sc ON (sc.CIFNo = ddr2.CIFNo OR sc.LGNo = ddr2.LGNo) AND sc.IsActive = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_sc01 ON #sc01 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 8. Main SELECT
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
        eom.SnapshotCIFNo                                           AS customer_code,
        dbo.Fn_NCBEffectiveDate_BE(mo.CutOff)                        AS eff_date,
        CASE WHEN dlg.Grade IN ('A','B','C','D','E','E1','E2')
             THEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(dwh.idnumber)),N'') ELSE card.CardId END AS card_id,
        '1'                                                         AS customer_type,
        '0400'                                                      AS branch_code,
        eom.SnapshotLGNo                                                    AS account_number,
        '1120001'                                                   AS purpose_loan1,
        ''                                                          AS purpose_loan2,
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(datetime,dwh.dateaccountopend),dlg.LGDate) > '1900-01-01'
             THEN dbo.[Fn_NCBDate_CE](COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(datetime,dwh.dateaccountopend),dlg.LGDate)) ELSE '19000101' END AS account_open_date,
        CASE WHEN latest_contract.InstallmentsEndDate > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.Fn_NCBDate_CE(latest_contract.InstallmentsEndDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS maturity_date,
        CASE WHEN eom.CloseDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.CloseDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE) <= mo.CutOff
                  THEN dbo.[Fn_NCBDate_CE](eom.CloseDate)
             ELSE '19000101'
        END                                                         AS account_close_date,
        CASE WHEN dlg.Grade IN ('F', 'F1') THEN '30'
             WHEN dlg.Grade IN ('A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E', 'E1', 'E2') THEN '0'
             ELSE NULL END                                         AS payment_terms,
        '1060035'                                                   AS credit_type,
        eom.PrincipalPay                                                         AS initial_amount_loan,
        CASE WHEN dwh.accountnumber IS NOT NULL THEN '1070151' ELSE 'THB' END AS currency_code,
        eom.TDRInstallments                                         AS number_of_installments,
        eom.InstallmentsAmount AS payment_amount,
        CASE WHEN eom.CurrentPaymentDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.CurrentPaymentDate > '1900-01-01'
                  AND CAST(eom.CurrentPaymentDate AS DATE) <= mo.CutOff
                  THEN dbo.[Fn_NCBDate_CE](eom.CurrentPaymentDate)
             ELSE '19000101'
        END                                                         AS last_payment_date,
        CASE WHEN eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) <= mo.CutOff AND dlg.Grade IN ('E1', 'E2', 'F', 'F1')
             THEN CASE
            WHEN eom.CloseDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE) <= mo.CutOff
                 THEN CASE WHEN eom.ReportTDRDate > '1900-01-01'
                                AND eom.ReportTDRDate < '2024-04-01'
                                AND CAST(eom.ReportTDRDate AS DATE) <= mo.CutOff
                           THEN dbo.[Fn_NCBDate_CE](eom.ReportTDRDate)
                           ELSE '19000101' END
            WHEN eom.ReportTDRDate IS NOT NULL
                 AND eom.ReportTDRDate > '1900-01-01'
                 AND CAST(eom.ReportTDRDate AS DATE) <= mo.CutOff
                 THEN dbo.[Fn_NCBDate_CE](eom.ReportTDRDate)
            ELSE '19000101'
        END
             ELSE '19000101' END                                                         AS restructuring_date,
        CASE WHEN eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) <= mo.CutOff
                  AND dlg.Grade IN ('E1', 'E2', 'F', 'F1')
                  AND eom.ReportTDRDate >= '2024-04-01' AND CAST(eom.ReportTDRDate AS DATE) <= mo.CutOff
                  AND (eom.CloseDate IS NULL OR eom.CloseDate <= '1900-01-01' OR CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE) > mo.CutOff)
             THEN '02' ELSE '00' END                                                         AS code_of_restructuring,
        CASE WHEN dwh.accountnumber IS NOT NULL THEN NULL ELSE eom.PrincipalPay END AS close_payment_amount,
        ''                                                          AS write_of_amount,
        CASE WHEN (cond.IsTDRReset = 1 AND COALESCE(status_match.AccountStatus,@S10) IN (@S10,@S20,@S21,@S30) AND COALESCE(cond.IsS11,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS12,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS13,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS14,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS31,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS33,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS42,0)=0) AND COALESCE(cond.IsS30,0)=0 AND COALESCE(status_match.AccountStatus,@S10) NOT IN (@S12,@S13,@S14,@S31,@S33,@S42) THEN @S10 ELSE CASE WHEN cond.IsS42=1 THEN @S42 WHEN cond.IsS33=1 THEN @S33 WHEN cond.IsS11=1 THEN @S11 WHEN cond.IsS31=1 THEN @S31 WHEN cond.IsS30=1 THEN @S30 WHEN cond.IsS14=1 THEN @S14 WHEN cond.IsS13=1 THEN @S13 WHEN cond.IsS12=1 THEN @S12 WHEN cond.IsS21=1 THEN @S21 WHEN cond.IsS20=1 THEN @S20 WHEN status_match.AccountStatus IN (@S10,@S11,@S12,@S13,@S14,@S20,@S21,@S30,@S31,@S33,@S42) THEN status_match.AccountStatus ELSE @S10 END END AS account_status,
        CASE WHEN (cond.IsTDRReset = 1 AND COALESCE(status_match.AccountStatus,@S10) IN (@S10,@S20,@S21,@S30) AND COALESCE(cond.IsS11,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS12,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS13,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS14,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS31,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS33,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS42,0)=0) OR cond.IsS11=1 OR cond.IsS33=1 OR status_match.AccountStatus IN (@S11,@S33) THEN '19000101' WHEN cond.ReportDFD > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(cond.ReportDFD AS DATE)<=mo.CutOff THEN dbo.Fn_NCBDate_CE(cond.ReportDFD) ELSE '19000101' END AS default_date,
        ''                                                          AS delinquent_status,
        NULL                                                        AS credit_limit_type,
        TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, eom.ProportionLiability)                 AS percent_payment,
        CASE WHEN dwh.accountnumber IS NOT NULL THEN dwh.idtype ELSE eom.CardType END AS credit_card_type,
        CASE WHEN (cond.IsTDRReset = 1 AND COALESCE(status_match.AccountStatus,@S10) IN (@S10,@S20,@S21,@S30) AND COALESCE(cond.IsS11,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS12,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS13,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS14,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS31,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS33,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS42,0)=0) OR cond.IsS11=1 OR cond.IsS33=1 OR status_match.AccountStatus IN (@S11,@S33) OR ((cond.IsS30=1 OR cond.IsS31=1) AND (cond.ReportDFD IS NULL OR cond.ReportDFD<='1900-01-01') AND (eom.FrozenAssetDate IS NULL OR eom.FrozenAssetDate<='1900-01-01') AND (eom.OtherFrozenAssDate IS NULL OR eom.OtherFrozenAssDate<='1900-01-01')) OR eom.DerivedDPD=0 THEN @D0 WHEN eom.DerivedDPD IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE dpd_cfg.DPDOutputCode END AS past_due_days,
        CASE WHEN (cond.IsTDRReset = 1 AND COALESCE(status_match.AccountStatus,@S10) IN (@S10,@S20,@S21,@S30) AND COALESCE(cond.IsS11,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS12,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS13,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS14,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS31,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS33,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS42,0)=0) OR cond.IsS11=1 OR cond.IsS33=1 OR status_match.AccountStatus IN (@S11,@S33) OR ((cond.IsS30=1 OR cond.IsS31=1) AND (cond.ReportDFD IS NULL OR cond.ReportDFD<='1900-01-01') AND (eom.FrozenAssetDate IS NULL OR eom.FrozenAssetDate<='1900-01-01') AND (eom.OtherFrozenAssDate IS NULL OR eom.OtherFrozenAssDate<='1900-01-01')) THEN 0 ELSE eom.DerivedDPD END AS past_due_days_2,
        CASE WHEN (cond.IsTDRReset = 1 AND COALESCE(status_match.AccountStatus,@S10) IN (@S10,@S20,@S21,@S30) AND COALESCE(cond.IsS11,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS12,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS13,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS14,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS31,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS33,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS42,0)=0) OR cond.IsS11=1 OR cond.IsS33=1 OR status_match.AccountStatus IN (@S11,@S33) THEN 0 WHEN eom.DerivedDPD IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN eom.DerivedDPD=0 OR cond.ReportDFD IS NULL OR cond.ReportDFD<='1900-01-01' THEN 0 WHEN eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE)<=mo.CutOff THEN CASE WHEN eom.ReportTDRDate > '1900-01-01' THEN CASE WHEN eom.DerivedDPD BETWEEN 1 AND 90 THEN eom.InstallmentOutstanding WHEN eom.DerivedDPD>90 THEN eom.DebtBalance ELSE 0 END WHEN eom.DerivedDPD>30 THEN eom.DebtBalance ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS past_due_amount,
        CASE WHEN cond.IsS11=1 OR cond.IsS33=1 THEN 0 ELSE eom.DebtBalance END AS outstanding_amount,
        CASE WHEN (eom.CloseDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.CloseDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE) <= mo.CutOff) THEN 0.0
             ELSE ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT,eom.PrincipalTotal),0.0) END AS principal_balance,
        CASE WHEN (eom.CloseDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.CloseDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE) <= mo.CutOff) THEN 0.0
             ELSE ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT,eom.AccruedInterest),0.0) END AS interest_balance,
        CASE WHEN dwh.accountnumber IS NOT NULL THEN dwh.data_type
             ELSE CASE ddr.DebtorTypeId WHEN 1 THEN '01' WHEN 2 THEN '04'
             ELSE CAST(ISNULL(eom.DebtorRelateTypeId, ddr.DebtorTypeId) AS VARCHAR(10)) END END AS ownership_indicator,
        borrower_count.BorrowerCount                                AS number_of_coborrower,
        ''                                                          AS unit_make,
        NULL                                                        AS unit_model,
        eom.StatusLGId                                                AS status_lg,
        dlg.Grade                                                   AS status_grade,
        CASE WHEN dlg.ClaimDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(dlg.ClaimDate AS DATE) <= mo.CutOff THEN dbo.Fn_NCBDate_CE(dlg.ClaimDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS claim_pay_date,
        CASE WHEN eom.ReqRepayDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.ReqRepayDate > '1900-01-01'
             THEN dbo.[Fn_NCBDate_CE](eom.ReqRepayDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS bkr_filing_date,
        TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT,eom.FilingAmount)                          AS filing_amount,
        CASE WHEN eom.FrozenAssetDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.FrozenAssetDate > '1900-01-01'
             THEN dbo.[Fn_NCBDate_CE](eom.FrozenAssetDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS frozenassetdate,
        CASE WHEN eom.OtherFrozenAssDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.OtherFrozenAssDate > '1900-01-01'
             THEN dbo.[Fn_NCBDate_CE](eom.OtherFrozenAssDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS otherfrozenassdate,
        CASE WHEN eom.PetitionDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.PetitionDate > '1900-01-01'
             THEN dbo.[Fn_NCBDate_CE](eom.PetitionDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS petition_date,
        CASE WHEN eom.BankruptcyDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.BankruptcyDate > '1900-01-01'
             THEN dbo.[Fn_NCBDate_CE](eom.BankruptcyDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS bankruptcy_date,
        CASE WHEN eom.BadDebtDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.BadDebtDate > '1900-01-01'
             THEN dbo.[Fn_NCBDate_CE](eom.BadDebtDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS bad_debt_date,
        CASE WHEN eom.FilingDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.FilingDate > '1900-01-01'
             THEN dbo.[Fn_NCBDate_CE](eom.FilingDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS file_date_temp,
        eom.BlackCaseNo                                              AS black_case_no,
        CASE WHEN eom.WithdrawDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.WithdrawDate > '1900-01-01'
             THEN dbo.[Fn_NCBDate_CE](eom.WithdrawDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS withdraw_date,
        CASE WHEN eom.WarrantDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.WarrantDate > '1900-01-01'
             THEN dbo.[Fn_NCBDate_CE](eom.WarrantDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS warrant_date,
        CASE WHEN eom.JmTrialDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.JmTrialDate > '1900-01-01'
             THEN dbo.[Fn_NCBDate_CE](eom.JmTrialDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS jm_trial_date,
        eom.RedCaseNo                                                AS red_case_no,
        sb.BankName                                                 AS bank,
        CASE WHEN dwh.accountnumber IS NOT NULL THEN dwh.bankbranchcode ELSE sbb.BankBranchName END AS branch,
        ct.ClaimTypeName                                            AS project,
        cst.ClaimSubTypeName                                        AS sub_project,
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(datetime,dwh.dateaccountopend),dlg.LGDate) > '1900-01-01'
             THEN dbo.[Fn_NCBDate_CE](COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(datetime,dwh.dateaccountopend),dlg.LGDate)) ELSE '19000101' END AS open_date_old,
        N'วันที่พิมพ์ : ' + dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(GETDATE())     AS PrintDate,
        N'ผู้สั่งพิมพ์ : ' + NULL                                  AS PrintName,
        dbo.Fn_NCBEffectiveDate_BE(mo.CutOff) AS as_of_date,
        active_contract.ContractNo AS contract_number,
        latest_contract.ContractNo AS last_contract_number,
        CAST(ddr.DebtorRelateId AS nvarchar(300)) AS ReportDebtorRelateId,
        CAST(dd.DebtorId AS nvarchar(300)) AS ReportDebtorId,
        CASE WHEN eom.SnapshotCIFNo=ddr.CIFNo AND eom.SnapshotLGNo=ddr.LGNo AND CAST(eom.MonthEndDate AS DATE)=EOMONTH(mo.CutOff) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ReportSourceIdentityValid,
        CAST(3 AS tinyint) AS ReportSchemaVersion
    INTO #ncbresult01
    FROM #qualifying01 q
    -- [CHANGED] drive from #qualifying01 (indexed, filtered) instead of full DataDebtorRelate scan
    JOIN DataDebtorRelate ddr ON ddr.DebtorRelateId = q.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #borrower_count01 borrower_count ON borrower_count.LGNo = ddr.LGNo
    JOIN DataLG dlg ON dlg.LGNo = ddr.LGNo
    LEFT JOIN #dc01 dc ON dc.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #eom01 eom ON eom.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #tdr_latest01 tdr_rel ON tdr_rel.LGNo = ddr.LGNo

    CROSS APPLY (SELECT ISNULL(EOMONTH(DATEFROMPARTS(eom.yr, eom.mn, 1)), @EndDate) AS CutOff) mo

    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 dr.DPDOutputCode
        FROM #dpd_rule01 dr
        WHERE (dr.ExactValue   IS NULL OR eom.DerivedDPD =  dr.ExactValue)
          AND (dr.MinInclusive IS NULL OR eom.DerivedDPD >= dr.MinInclusive)
          AND (dr.MaxInclusive IS NULL OR eom.DerivedDPD <= dr.MaxInclusive)
          AND (dr.MinExclusive IS NULL OR eom.DerivedDPD >  dr.MinExclusive)
          AND (dr.MaxExclusive IS NULL OR eom.DerivedDPD <  dr.MaxExclusive)
        ORDER BY
            CASE WHEN dr.ExactValue IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
            ISNULL(dr.MinInclusive, dr.MinExclusive + 1) DESC,
            ISNULL(dr.MaxInclusive, dr.MaxExclusive - 1) ASC,
            dr.DPDCode
    ) dpd_cfg

    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 tr.RestructureCode
        FROM (SELECT DISTINCT RestructureCodeId, RestructureCode, Oparators FROM #tdr_rule01) tr
        WHERE
            (
                ISNULL(tr.Oparators, 'AND') <> 'OR'
                AND NOT EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM #tdr_rule01 c
                    WHERE c.RestructureCodeId = tr.RestructureCodeId
                      AND c.ColumnName IS NOT NULL
                      AND (
                          CASE
                              WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('IsTDR') THEN
                                  CASE WHEN c.Operator IN ('=','Equal') THEN IIF(ISNULL(CAST(eom.IsTDR AS INT),0) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('<>','!=') THEN IIF(ISNULL(CAST(eom.IsTDR AS INT),0) <> TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                       ELSE 0 END
                              WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('CloseDate') THEN
                                  CASE WHEN c.Operator IN ('>','MoreThan') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') > TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('>=','MoreThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('<','LessThan') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') < TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('<=','LessThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('=','Equal') THEN IIF(CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(eom.CloseDate,'1900-01-01')) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATE),1,0)
                                       ELSE 0 END
                              WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('CompromiseContracApproveDate','CompromiseContractApproveDate','TDRDate') THEN
                                  CASE WHEN c.Operator IN ('>','MoreThan') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.CompromiseContracApproveDate,'1900-01-01') > TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('>=','MoreThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.CompromiseContracApproveDate,'1900-01-01') >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('<','LessThan') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.CompromiseContracApproveDate,'1900-01-01') < TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('<=','LessThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.CompromiseContracApproveDate,'1900-01-01') <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('=','Equal') THEN IIF(CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(eom.CompromiseContracApproveDate,'1900-01-01')) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATE),1,0)
                                       ELSE 0 END
                              ELSE 0
                          END
                      ) = 0
                )
            )
            OR
            (
                ISNULL(tr.Oparators, 'AND') = 'OR'
                AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM #tdr_rule01 c
                    WHERE c.RestructureCodeId = tr.RestructureCodeId
                      AND c.ColumnName IS NOT NULL
                      AND (
                          CASE
                              WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('IsTDR') THEN
                                  CASE WHEN c.Operator IN ('=','Equal') THEN IIF(ISNULL(CAST(eom.IsTDR AS INT),0) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('<>','!=') THEN IIF(ISNULL(CAST(eom.IsTDR AS INT),0) <> TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                       ELSE 0 END
                              WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('CloseDate') THEN
                                  CASE WHEN c.Operator IN ('>','MoreThan') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') > TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('>=','MoreThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('<','LessThan') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') < TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('<=','LessThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('=','Equal') THEN IIF(CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(eom.CloseDate,'1900-01-01')) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATE),1,0)
                                       ELSE 0 END
                              WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('CompromiseContracApproveDate','CompromiseContractApproveDate','TDRDate') THEN
                                  CASE WHEN c.Operator IN ('>','MoreThan') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.CompromiseContracApproveDate,'1900-01-01') > TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('>=','MoreThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.CompromiseContracApproveDate,'1900-01-01') >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('<','LessThan') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.CompromiseContracApproveDate,'1900-01-01') < TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('<=','LessThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.CompromiseContracApproveDate,'1900-01-01') <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('=','Equal') THEN IIF(CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(eom.CompromiseContracApproveDate,'1900-01-01')) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATE),1,0)
                                       ELSE 0 END
                              ELSE 0
                          END
                      ) = 1
                )
            )
        ORDER BY CASE WHEN tr.RestructureCode = @TDRDefaultCode01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, tr.RestructureCode
    ) tdr_cfg

    -- [CHANGED] DataDebtor is pre-deduped to TOP 1 per DebtorCode to avoid duplicate output rows.
    JOIN #dd01 dd ON dd.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId

    -- [CHANGED] OUTER APPLY → LEFT JOIN pre-materialized temp table
    LEFT JOIN #lt01  lt  ON lt.DebtorRelateId  = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #ssu01 ssu
        ON ssu.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
       AND ssu.MonthEndDate = eom.MonthEndDate
    LEFT JOIN #dwh01 dwh ON dwh.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId

    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT
            CASE
                WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(dd.IDCard)), '') IS NOT NULL
                  AND LTRIM(RTRIM(dd.IDCard)) NOT LIKE N'%ไม่พบ%'
                  AND LTRIM(RTRIM(dd.IDCard)) NOT LIKE N'%ไมพบ%'
                    THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(dd.IDCard))
                ELSE NULL
            END AS CardId
    ) card
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) cc.ContractNo, cc.InstallmentsEndDate
        FROM TDRDataCompromiseContract cc
        WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractRelated rel
            WHERE rel.CompromiseContractId=cc.CompromiseContractId AND rel.LGNo=ddr.LGNo
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 1 FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractLG rel
            WHERE rel.CompromiseContractId=cc.CompromiseContractId AND rel.LGNo=ddr.LGNo
        )
          AND CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(cc.TDRDate,'1900-01-01'), cc.CreateDate) AS date) <= mo.CutOff
        ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(cc.TDRDate,'1900-01-01'),cc.CreateDate) DESC, cc.CompromiseContractId DESC
    ) latest_contract

    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) cc.ContractNo, cc.InstallmentsEndDate
        FROM TDRDataCompromiseContract cc
        WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractRelated rel
            WHERE rel.CompromiseContractId=cc.CompromiseContractId AND rel.LGNo=ddr.LGNo
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 1 FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractLG rel
            WHERE rel.CompromiseContractId=cc.CompromiseContractId AND rel.LGNo=ddr.LGNo
        )
          AND CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(cc.TDRDate,'1900-01-01'), cc.CreateDate) AS date) <= mo.CutOff
          AND (cc.CompromiseContractStatusId=58 OR (cc.CompromiseContractStatusId=61 AND CAST(cc.ClosedDate AS date)>mo.CutOff))
          AND cc.ApproveDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(cc.ApproveDate AS date)<=mo.CutOff
          AND (cc.ClosedDate IS NULL OR cc.ClosedDate<='1900-01-01' OR CAST(cc.ClosedDate AS date)>mo.CutOff)
        ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(cc.TDRDate,'1900-01-01'),cc.CreateDate) DESC, cc.CompromiseContractId DESC
    ) active_contract


    -- [REMOVED] DataDebtorAddress OUTER APPLY + prov/dist/sub_dist JOINs
    --   (ไม่มี column จาก dda/prov/dist/sub_dist ใน SELECT — dead code)

    LEFT JOIN SystemBankMaster          sb  ON sb.BankId          = dlg.BankId
    LEFT JOIN SystemBankBranchMaster    sbb ON sbb.BankBranchId   = dlg.BankBranchId
    LEFT JOIN SystemClaimTypeMaster     ct  ON ct.ClaimTypeId     = dlg.ClaimTypeId
    LEFT JOIN SystemClaimSubTypeMaster  cst ON cst.ClaimSubTypeId = dlg.ClaimSubTypeId

    LEFT JOIN #cond01 cond ON cond.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId AND cond.MonthEndDate = eom.MonthEndDate
    LEFT JOIN #status_match01 status_match ON status_match.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId AND status_match.MonthEndDate = eom.MonthEndDate
    LEFT JOIN #s32_event01 s32_event ON s32_event.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId AND s32_event.MonthEndDate = eom.MonthEndDate

    LEFT JOIN #sc01 sc ON sc.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId

    WHERE 1=1
      -- PDF bankruptcy two-year boundary
      AND (eom.BankruptcyDate IS NULL OR eom.BankruptcyDate <= '1900-01-01'
           OR mo.CutOff <= DATEADD(YEAR, 2, eom.BankruptcyDate))
      -- END bankruptcy boundary
      -- Stop sending terminal/event statuses: report the event month only, exclude from following months.
      AND (eom.CloseDate IS NULL OR eom.CloseDate <= '1900-01-01' OR CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE) >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(eom.MonthEndDate), MONTH(eom.MonthEndDate), 1))                              -- 11 ปิดบัญชี
      AND (eom.BadDebtDate IS NULL OR eom.BadDebtDate <= '1900-01-01' OR eom.BadDebtDate >= @StartDate)                        -- 33 ตัดหนี้สูญ
      AND (COALESCE(cond.IsS42,0) = 0
           OR eom.StatusPortDate IS NULL OR eom.StatusPortDate <= '1900-01-01' OR eom.StatusPortDate >= @StartDate)             -- 42/43/44 ขายหนี้/โอนหนี้
      -- Calendar years from DFD, measured against recorded DPD.
      -- PDF five-year DPD boundary
      AND (eom.DerivedDPD IS NULL OR ((cond.ReportDFD IS NULL OR cond.ReportDFD <= '1900-01-01') AND eom.DerivedDPD <= 1917)
           OR CASE WHEN cond.IsTDRReset = 1
                  AND (eom.CloseDate IS NULL OR eom.CloseDate <= '1900-01-01' OR CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE) > mo.CutOff)
                  AND COALESCE(cond.IsS11, 0) + COALESCE(cond.IsS12, 0) + COALESCE(cond.IsS13, 0) + COALESCE(cond.IsS14, 0) + COALESCE(cond.IsS31, 0) + COALESCE(cond.IsS33, 0) + COALESCE(cond.IsS42, 0) = 0
                  AND COALESCE(status_match.AccountStatus, @S10) IN (@S10, @S20, @S21, @S30) THEN 0 ELSE eom.DerivedDPD END
                <= DATEDIFF(DAY, cond.ReportDFD, DATEADD(YEAR, 5, cond.ReportDFD)) + 90)
      -- END five-year boundary

    OPTION (RECOMPILE);

    -- Fixed A-E2 report values from SA PDF pp10-13. Keep the existing
    -- condition engine's account_status, including legal/closure outcomes.
    UPDATE r SET past_due_days='1160001',past_due_days_2=0,
        past_due_amount=0,outstanding_amount=0,number_of_installments=0,
        payment_amount=0,default_date='19000101',last_payment_date='19000101',
        restructuring_date='19000101',code_of_restructuring='00',
        close_payment_amount=NULL,write_of_amount='',claim_pay_date='19000101',
        maturity_date='19000101',contract_number='',last_contract_number=''
    FROM #ncbresult01 r
    WHERE r.status_grade IN ('A','B','C','D','E','E1','E2')
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #dwh01 d WHERE d.accountnumber=r.account_number
                  AND d.customercode=r.customer_code);

    -- Authorized partial reporting: exclude unavailable source rows; preserve PDF output columns.
    DELETE FROM #ncbresult01 WHERE ReportSourceIdentityValid=0;
    PRINT CONCAT('NCB 01 skipped rows (50005): ', @@ROWCOUNT);

    DELETE FROM #ncbresult01 WHERE card_id IS NULL;
    PRINT CONCAT('NCB 01 skipped rows (50006): ', @@ROWCOUNT);

    DELETE FROM #ncbresult01 WHERE past_due_days_2 IS NULL OR past_due_days_2<0 OR past_due_days IS NULL
                  OR (past_due_days_2>0 AND (default_date IS NULL OR default_date='19000101'));
    PRINT CONCAT('NCB 01 skipped rows (50008): ', @@ROWCOUNT);

    IF (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.NCBMemberMaster WHERE ReportType=2 AND IsActive=1)<>1
        THROW 51527,'NCBMemberMaster needs one active Commercial (ReportType=2) code.',1;

    DELETE FROM dbo.NCBCommercialCreditData
    WHERE [period]=@Period AND (@LGNo='null' OR account_number=@LGNo)
      AND (@CIFNo='null' OR customer_code=@CIFNo);
    INSERT INTO dbo.NCBCommercialCreditData([period],[customer_code],[eff_date],[card_id],[branch_code],[account_number],[purpose_loan1],[purpose_loan2],[date_account_opend],[maturity_date],[date_account_closed],[as_of_date],[installment_frequency],[credit_type],[initial_amount_loan],[currency_code],[installment_number_of_payments],[installment_amount],[date_of_last_payment],[date_of_restructuring],[code_of_restructuring],[close_payment_amount],[write_of_amount],[account_status],[default_date],[delinquent_status],[credit_limit_type],[percent_payment],[credit_card_type],[number_of_days_past],[number_of_days_past_2],[past_due_amount],[outstanding_amount],[owneship_indicator],[number_of_borrower],[unit_make],[unit_model],[status_lg],[status_grade],[claim_pay_date],[bkr_filling_date],[filling_amount],[frozenasset_date],[other_frozenasset_date],[petition_date],[bankruptcy_date],[bad_dept_date],[file_date_temp],[black_case_no],[withdraw_date],[warrant_date],[jm_trial_date],[red_case_no],[bank],[branch],[project],[sub_project],[open_date_original],[contract_number],[last_contract_number],[account_type],[member_code],[member_name])
    SELECT CAST(@Period AS nvarchar(7)) AS [period],
        CAST(s.[customer_code] AS nvarchar(50)) AS [customer_code],
        CAST(s.[eff_date] AS nvarchar(8)) AS [eff_date],
        CAST(s.[card_id] AS nvarchar(50)) AS [card_id],
        CAST(s.[branch_code] AS nvarchar(50)) AS [branch_code],
        CAST(s.[account_number] AS nvarchar(50)) AS [account_number],
        CAST(s.[purpose_loan1] AS nvarchar(20)) AS [purpose_loan1],
        CAST(s.[purpose_loan2] AS nvarchar(20)) AS [purpose_loan2],
        CAST(s.[account_open_date] AS nvarchar(8)) AS [date_account_opend],
        CAST(s.[maturity_date] AS nvarchar(8)) AS [maturity_date],
        CAST(s.[account_close_date] AS nvarchar(8)) AS [date_account_closed],
        CAST(s.[as_of_date] AS nvarchar(8)) AS [as_of_date],
        CAST(s.[payment_terms] AS nvarchar(5)) AS [installment_frequency],
        CAST(s.[credit_type] AS nvarchar(20)) AS [credit_type],
        CAST(s.[initial_amount_loan] AS decimal(18,2)) AS [initial_amount_loan],
        CAST(s.[currency_code] AS nvarchar(5)) AS [currency_code],
        CAST(s.[number_of_installments] AS decimal(18,2)) AS [installment_number_of_payments],
        CAST(s.[payment_amount] AS decimal(18,2)) AS [installment_amount],
        CAST(s.[last_payment_date] AS nvarchar(8)) AS [date_of_last_payment],
        CAST(s.[restructuring_date] AS nvarchar(8)) AS [date_of_restructuring],
        CAST(s.[code_of_restructuring] AS nvarchar(5)) AS [code_of_restructuring],
        CAST(s.[close_payment_amount] AS decimal(18,2)) AS [close_payment_amount],
        CAST(s.[write_of_amount] AS nvarchar(50)) AS [write_of_amount],
        CAST(s.[account_status] AS nvarchar(20)) AS [account_status],
        CAST(s.[default_date] AS nvarchar(8)) AS [default_date],
        CAST(s.[delinquent_status] AS nvarchar(20)) AS [delinquent_status],
        CAST(s.[credit_limit_type] AS nvarchar(20)) AS [credit_limit_type],
        CAST(s.[percent_payment] AS decimal(18,4)) AS [percent_payment],
        CAST(s.[credit_card_type] AS nvarchar(50)) AS [credit_card_type],
        CAST(s.[past_due_days] AS nvarchar(20)) AS [number_of_days_past],
        CAST(s.[past_due_days_2] AS int) AS [number_of_days_past_2],
        CAST(s.[past_due_amount] AS decimal(18,2)) AS [past_due_amount],
        CAST(s.[outstanding_amount] AS decimal(18,2)) AS [outstanding_amount],
        CAST(CASE s.ownership_indicator WHEN 1 THEN '01' WHEN 4 THEN '04' ELSE NULL END AS nvarchar(2)) AS [owneship_indicator],
        CAST(s.[number_of_coborrower] AS int) AS [number_of_borrower],
        CAST(s.[unit_make] AS nvarchar(50)) AS [unit_make],
        CAST(s.[unit_model] AS nvarchar(50)) AS [unit_model],
        CAST(s.[status_lg] AS int) AS [status_lg],
        CAST(s.[status_grade] AS nvarchar(50)) AS [status_grade],
        CAST(s.[claim_pay_date] AS nvarchar(8)) AS [claim_pay_date],
        CAST(s.[bkr_filing_date] AS nvarchar(8)) AS [bkr_filling_date],
        CAST(s.[filing_amount] AS decimal(18,2)) AS [filling_amount],
        CAST(s.[frozenassetdate] AS nvarchar(8)) AS [frozenasset_date],
        CAST(s.[otherfrozenassdate] AS nvarchar(8)) AS [other_frozenasset_date],
        CAST(s.[petition_date] AS nvarchar(8)) AS [petition_date],
        CAST(s.[bankruptcy_date] AS nvarchar(8)) AS [bankruptcy_date],
        CAST(s.[bad_debt_date] AS nvarchar(8)) AS [bad_dept_date],
        CAST(s.[file_date_temp] AS nvarchar(8)) AS [file_date_temp],
        CAST(s.[black_case_no] AS nvarchar(50)) AS [black_case_no],
        CAST(s.[withdraw_date] AS nvarchar(8)) AS [withdraw_date],
        CAST(s.[warrant_date] AS nvarchar(8)) AS [warrant_date],
        CAST(s.[jm_trial_date] AS nvarchar(8)) AS [jm_trial_date],
        CAST(s.[red_case_no] AS nvarchar(50)) AS [red_case_no],
        CAST(s.[bank] AS nvarchar(200)) AS [bank],
        CAST(s.[branch] AS nvarchar(200)) AS [branch],
        CAST(s.[project] AS nvarchar(200)) AS [project],
        CAST(s.[sub_project] AS nvarchar(200)) AS [sub_project],
        CAST(s.[open_date_old] AS nvarchar(8)) AS [open_date_original],
        CAST(s.[contract_number] AS nvarchar(20)) AS [contract_number],
        CAST(s.[last_contract_number] AS nvarchar(20)) AS [last_contract_number],
        CAST(38 AS int) AS [account_type],
        member.MemberCode AS [member_code],
        member.MemberName AS [member_name]
    FROM #ncbresult01 s
    CROSS JOIN dbo.NCBMemberMaster member
    WHERE member.ReportType=2 AND member.IsActive=1;

    IF @DirectOwn=1 COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
      IF @DirectOwn=1 AND XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
      ELSE IF @DirectOwn=0 AND XACT_STATE()=1 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION DirectNCB01;
      THROW;
    END CATCH;
END

modules.name: SP_RP_NCB_01_CommercialCreditData_Insert_EOM
modules.definition:
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_NCB_01_CommercialCreditData_Insert_EOM]
    @StartDate DATETIME = '2025-05-01',
    @EndDate   DATETIME = '2025-05-31',
    @CIFNo  NVARCHAR(50) = 'null',
    @LGNo   NVARCHAR(50) = 'null'
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET @StartDate = CASE WHEN YEAR(@StartDate) > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR,-543,@StartDate) ELSE @StartDate END;
    SET @EndDate   = CASE WHEN YEAR(@EndDate)   > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR,-543,@EndDate)   ELSE @EndDate   END;
    SET @CIFNo = ISNULL(@CIFNo, 'null');
    SET @LGNo = ISNULL(@LGNo, 'null');
    -- Staging uses one Period for every inserted row; reject mixed-month calls.
    IF @StartDate IS NULL OR @EndDate IS NULL OR @StartDate > @EndDate
       OR YEAR(@StartDate) <> YEAR(@EndDate) OR MONTH(@StartDate) <> MONTH(@EndDate)
        THROW 50001, 'NCB report requires a valid date range within one reporting month.', 1;
    DECLARE @Period NVARCHAR(7) = CONVERT(char(7), @EndDate, 126);
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    DECLARE @DirectOwn bit=CASE WHEN @@TRANCOUNT=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
    DECLARE @DirectLock int,@DirectResource nvarchar(255)=N'NCB.StrictPdf.'+@Period;
    BEGIN TRY
    IF @DirectOwn=1 BEGIN TRANSACTION; ELSE SAVE TRANSACTION DirectNCB01;
    EXEC @DirectLock=sys.sp_getapplock @Resource=@DirectResource,@LockMode='Exclusive',@LockOwner='Transaction',@LockTimeout=30000;
    IF @DirectLock<0 THROW 51301,'Another NCB report is running for this month.',1;


    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 1. Pre-load NCB dynamic conditions (small table — fast)
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#NCBCond01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #NCBCond01;
    SELECT nm.NCBStatusCode, CAST(nm.CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) AS CatalogId, sp.ColumnName, sl.KeyName AS Operator,
           CASE WHEN nm.NCBStatusCode = 12 AND sp.ColumnName = 'MeasureName' AND ne.ValueConditionExcute = 'มาตรการ%'
                THEN '%พัก%หนี้%'
                ELSE ne.ValueConditionExcute END AS ValueConditionExcute
    INTO #NCBCond01
    FROM NCBStatusExcuteMaster ne
    JOIN NCBStatusMaster nm        ON nm.NCBStatusId  = ne.NCBStatusId AND nm.PersonType=2 AND nm.IsActive=1
    JOIN SystemParameterMaster sp  ON sp.ParameterId  = ne.ParameterId
    LEFT JOIN SystemLookupMaster sl ON sl.LookupId    = ne.OparatorId;

    DECLARE @S11_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=11),1,0);
    DECLARE @S12_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=12),1,0);
    DECLARE @S13_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=13),1,0);
    DECLARE @S14_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=14),1,0);
    DECLARE @S20_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=20),1,0);
    DECLARE @S21_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=21),1,0);
    DECLARE @S30_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=30),1,0);
    DECLARE @S31_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=31),1,0);
    DECLARE @S32_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=32),1,0);
    DECLARE @S33_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=33),1,0);
    DECLARE @S42_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=42),1,0);
    DECLARE @S43_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=43),1,0);
    DECLARE @S44_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=44),1,0);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 2. Load NCB status/DPD catalog codes
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    DECLARE @S10  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=10  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);
    DECLARE @S11  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=11  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);
    DECLARE @S12  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=12  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);
    DECLARE @S13  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=13  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);
    DECLARE @S14  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=14  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);
    DECLARE @S20  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=20  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);
    DECLARE @S21  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=21  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);
    DECLARE @S30  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=30  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);
    DECLARE @S31  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=31  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);
    DECLARE @S33  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=33  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);
    DECLARE @S42  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=42  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);
    DECLARE @S43  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=43  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);
    DECLARE @S44  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=44  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);

    -- Dynamic DPD mapping from website configuration.
    -- NCBDPDMaster stores the output code; NCBDPDExcuteMaster stores numeric DPD rules.
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dpd_rule01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dpd_rule01;

    SELECT
        dm.DPDId,
        dm.DPDCode,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(dm.CatalogCode, ''), dm.DPDCode) AS DPDOutputCode,
        MAX(CASE WHEN sl.KeyName = 'Equal' OR sl.LookUpValue = '=' OR de.OparatorId = 5
                 THEN TRY_CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(de.ValueConditionExcute, N' วัน', N'')) END) AS ExactValue,
        MAX(CASE WHEN sl.KeyName = 'LessThanEqual' OR sl.LookUpValue = '>=' OR de.OparatorId = 3
                 THEN TRY_CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(de.ValueConditionExcute, N' วัน', N'')) END) AS MinInclusive,
        MAX(CASE WHEN sl.KeyName = 'MoreThanEqual' OR sl.LookUpValue = '<=' OR de.OparatorId = 4
                 THEN TRY_CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(de.ValueConditionExcute, N' วัน', N'')) END) AS MaxInclusive,
        MAX(CASE WHEN sl.KeyName = 'MoreThan' OR sl.LookUpValue = '>' OR de.OparatorId = 1
                 THEN TRY_CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(de.ValueConditionExcute, N' วัน', N'')) END) AS MinExclusive,
        MAX(CASE WHEN sl.KeyName = 'LessThan' OR sl.LookUpValue = '<' OR de.OparatorId = 2
                 THEN TRY_CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(de.ValueConditionExcute, N' วัน', N'')) END) AS MaxExclusive
    INTO #dpd_rule01
    FROM NCBDPDMaster dm
    LEFT JOIN NCBDPDExcuteMaster de ON de.DPDId = dm.DPDId
    LEFT JOIN SystemLookupMaster sl ON sl.LookupId = de.OparatorId
    WHERE dm.PersonType = 2
      AND dm.IsActive = 1
    GROUP BY dm.DPDId, dm.DPDCode, COALESCE(NULLIF(dm.CatalogCode, ''), dm.DPDCode);

    DECLARE @D0 NVARCHAR(20) = (
        SELECT TOP 1 DPDOutputCode
        FROM #dpd_rule01
        WHERE (ExactValue   IS NULL OR 0 =  ExactValue)
          AND (MinInclusive IS NULL OR 0 >= MinInclusive)
          AND (MaxInclusive IS NULL OR 0 <= MaxInclusive)
          AND (MinExclusive IS NULL OR 0 >  MinExclusive)
          AND (MaxExclusive IS NULL OR 0 <  MaxExclusive)
        ORDER BY
            CASE WHEN ExactValue IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
            ISNULL(MinInclusive, MinExclusive + 1) DESC,
            ISNULL(MaxInclusive, MaxExclusive - 1) ASC,
            DPDCode
    );
    DECLARE @D11 NVARCHAR(20) = (
        SELECT TOP 1 DPDOutputCode
        FROM #dpd_rule01
        WHERE (ExactValue   IS NULL OR 100000 =  ExactValue)
          AND (MinInclusive IS NULL OR 100000 >= MinInclusive)
          AND (MaxInclusive IS NULL OR 100000 <= MaxInclusive)
          AND (MinExclusive IS NULL OR 100000 >  MinExclusive)
          AND (MaxExclusive IS NULL OR 100000 <  MaxExclusive)
        ORDER BY
            CASE WHEN ExactValue IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
            ISNULL(MinInclusive, MinExclusive + 1) DESC,
            ISNULL(MaxInclusive, MaxExclusive - 1) ASC,
            DPDCode
    );

    -- Dynamic TDR restructuring code from website configuration.
    -- SystemTDRRestructureCode stores output code; SystemRestructureExcuteMaster stores matching rules.
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tdr_rule01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tdr_rule01;
    SELECT
        rc.RestructureCodeId,
        rc.RestructureCode,
        rc.Oparators,
        re.Seq,
        sp.ColumnName,
        sl.KeyName AS Operator,
        re.ValueConditionExcute
    INTO #tdr_rule01
    FROM SystemTDRRestructureCode rc
    LEFT JOIN SystemRestructureExcuteMaster re ON re.RestructureCodeId = rc.RestructureCodeId
    LEFT JOIN SystemParameterMaster sp ON sp.ParameterId = re.ParameterId
    LEFT JOIN SystemLookupMaster sl ON sl.LookupId = re.OparatorId
    WHERE rc.IsActive = 1;

    DECLARE @TDRDefaultCode01 NVARCHAR(20) = (
        SELECT TOP 1 RestructureCode
        FROM SystemTDRRestructureCode
        WHERE IsActive = 1
        ORDER BY CASE WHEN RestructureCode = '00' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, RestructureCode
    );

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 3. Pre-filter qualifying DebtorRelateIds
    --    [OPTIMIZED] Drive from DataEndOfMonth with JOIN instead of correlated EXISTS
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#qualifying01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #qualifying01;
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId
    INTO #qualifying01
    FROM dbo.DataEndOfMonth e
    JOIN DataDebtorRelate ddr ON ddr.DebtorRelateId = e.DebtorRelateId
    WHERE e.AsOfMonth BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
      AND (e.IsDelete = 0 OR e.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND ddr.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
      AND (ddr.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (@CIFNo = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM DataDebtorRelate WHERE CIFNo=@CIFNo))
      AND (@LGNo  = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo  = @LGNo)

    UNION

    -- LG cancelled case: no DataDebtorCard, StatusDate in range
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId
    FROM DataDebtorRelate ddr
    JOIN DataLG dlg ON dlg.LGNo = ddr.LGNo
    WHERE dlg.StatusDate BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM DataDebtorCard dc2
          WHERE dc2.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
            AND (dc2.IsDelete = 0 OR dc2.IsDelete IS NULL)
      )
      AND ddr.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
      AND (ddr.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (@CIFNo = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM DataDebtorRelate WHERE CIFNo=@CIFNo))
      AND (@LGNo  = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo  = @LGNo)

    UNION

    -- TDR case: TDR approved up to @EndDate (catches active TDR without EOD in month)
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId
    FROM (
        SELECT CompromiseContractId, LGNo FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractRelated
        UNION
        SELECT CompromiseContractId, LGNo FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractLG
    ) rtdr
    JOIN TDRDataCompromiseContract cc ON cc.CompromiseContractId = rtdr.CompromiseContractId
    JOIN DataDebtorRelate ddr ON ddr.LGNo = rtdr.LGNo
    WHERE cc.ApproveDate <= @EndDate
      AND ddr.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
      AND (ddr.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (@CIFNo = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM DataDebtorRelate WHERE CIFNo=@CIFNo))
      AND (@LGNo  = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo  = @LGNo)

    UNION

    -- Closed account case: include closure events in the requested month only
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId
    FROM DataDebtorRelate ddr
    JOIN DataDebtorCard dc ON dc.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    WHERE CAST(dc.CloseDate AS DATE) <= CAST(@EndDate AS DATE)
      AND CAST(dc.CloseDate AS DATE) >= CAST(@StartDate AS DATE)
      AND (dc.DebtBalance = 0 OR dc.PrincipalTotal = 0)
      AND (dc.IsDelete = 0 OR dc.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND ddr.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
