CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_NCB_04_CommercialYearlyLettersField_Insert]
    @StartDate   DATETIME      = '2025-09-01',
    @EndDate     DATETIME      = '2025-12-17',
    @CIFNo       NVARCHAR(50)  = 'null',
    @LGNo        NVARCHAR(20)  = 'null',
    @DebtorName  NVARCHAR(200) = 'null'
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET @StartDate = CASE WHEN YEAR(@StartDate) > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @StartDate) ELSE @StartDate END;
    SET @EndDate   = CASE WHEN YEAR(@EndDate)   > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @EndDate)   ELSE @EndDate   END;
    DECLARE @Period NVARCHAR(7) = FORMAT(@EndDate, 'yyyy-MM');

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 1. Pre-load NCB dynamic conditions (small table — fast)
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#NCBCond04') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #NCBCond04;
    SELECT nm.NCBStatusCode, CAST(nm.CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) AS CatalogId, sp.ColumnName, sl.KeyName AS Operator, ne.ValueConditionExcute
    INTO #NCBCond04
    FROM NCBStatusExcuteMaster ne
    JOIN NCBStatusMaster nm        ON nm.NCBStatusId  = ne.NCBStatusId AND nm.PersonType = 2 AND nm.IsActive = 1
    JOIN SystemParameterMaster sp  ON sp.ParameterId  = ne.ParameterId
    LEFT JOIN SystemLookupMaster sl ON sl.LookupId    = ne.OparatorId;

    DECLARE @S12_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond04 WHERE NCBStatusCode=12),1,0);
    DECLARE @S13_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond04 WHERE NCBStatusCode=13),1,0);
    DECLARE @S14_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond04 WHERE NCBStatusCode=14),1,0);
    DECLARE @S21_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond04 WHERE NCBStatusCode=21),1,0);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 2. Load NCB status codes
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    DECLARE @S10  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 10 AND PersonType = 2 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S11  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 11 AND PersonType = 2 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S12  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 12 AND PersonType = 2 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S20  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 20 AND PersonType = 2 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S30  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 30 AND PersonType = 2 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S31  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 31 AND PersonType = 2 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S33  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 33 AND PersonType = 2 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S13  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 13 AND PersonType = 2 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S14  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 14 AND PersonType = 2 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S21  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 21 AND PersonType = 2 AND IsActive = 1);

    -- Dynamic TDR restructuring code from website configuration.
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tdr_rule04') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tdr_rule04;
    SELECT
        rc.RestructureCodeId,
        rc.RestructureCode,
        rc.Oparators,
        re.Seq,
        sp.ColumnName,
        sl.KeyName AS Operator,
        re.ValueConditionExcute
    INTO #tdr_rule04
    FROM SystemTDRRestructureCode rc
    LEFT JOIN SystemRestructureExcuteMaster re ON re.RestructureCodeId = rc.RestructureCodeId
    LEFT JOIN SystemParameterMaster sp ON sp.ParameterId = re.ParameterId
    LEFT JOIN SystemLookupMaster sl ON sl.LookupId = re.OparatorId
    WHERE rc.IsActive = 1;

    DECLARE @TDRDefaultCode04 NVARCHAR(20) = (
        SELECT TOP 1 RestructureCode
        FROM SystemTDRRestructureCode
        WHERE IsActive = 1
        ORDER BY CASE WHEN RestructureCode = '00' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, RestructureCode
    );

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 3. Pre-filter qualifying DebtorRelateIds
    --    Two cases: DataDebtorCardId IS NOT NULL OR DataLG.Grade = 'F1'
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#qualifying04') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #qualifying04;
    -- Case 1: Has DataDebtorCard
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId
    INTO #qualifying04
    FROM DataDebtorCard c
    JOIN DataDebtorRelate ddr ON ddr.DebtorRelateId = c.DebtorRelateId
        AND ddr.DebtorTypeId IN (1,2,4,6)
        AND (ddr.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr.IsDelete IS NULL)
    JOIN DataDebtor dd ON dd.DebtorCode = ddr.DebtorCode AND dd.PersonGroupId = 118
    WHERE (c.IsDelete = 0 OR c.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (@CIFNo = 'null' OR ddr.CIFNo = @CIFNo)
      AND (@LGNo  = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo  = @LGNo)

    UNION

    -- Case 2: DataLG Grade = 'F1' (no card required)
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId
    FROM DataDebtorRelate ddr
    JOIN DataLG dlg ON dlg.LGNo = ddr.LGNo AND dlg.Grade = 'F1'
    JOIN DataDebtor dd ON dd.DebtorCode = ddr.DebtorCode AND dd.PersonGroupId = 118
    WHERE ddr.DebtorTypeId IN (1,2,4,6)
      AND (ddr.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (@CIFNo = 'null' OR ddr.CIFNo = @CIFNo)
      AND (@LGNo  = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo  = @LGNo);

    CREATE INDEX IX_qualifying04 ON #qualifying04 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 4. DataDebtorRelate details
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ddr_info04') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ddr_info04;
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId, ddr.LGNo, ddr.CIFNo, ddr.DebtorId, ddr.DebtorCode
    INTO #ddr_info04
    FROM DataDebtorRelate ddr
    WHERE ddr.DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying04);
    CREATE INDEX IX_ddr_info04 ON #ddr_info04 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 5. Latest EOD record per DebtorRelateId for dynamic status fields
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#eod_cp04') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #eod_cp04;
    SELECT DebtorRelateId, StatusPortId, StatusPortDate
    INTO #eod_cp04
    FROM (
        SELECT e.DebtorRelateId, e.StatusPortId, e.StatusPortDate,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.DebtorRelateId ORDER BY e.AsOfDate DESC, e.CreateDate DESC) AS rn
        FROM DataEndOfDay e
        WHERE e.DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying04)
          AND (e.IsDelete = 0 OR e.IsDelete IS NULL)
    ) x WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_eod_cp04 ON #eod_cp04 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 6. DataDebtorCard TOP 1 per DebtorRelateId
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dc04') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dc04;
    SELECT DebtorRelateId,
           DebtorCardCode, DebtorCardName, DebtBalance, CurrentPaymentDate, DFDDate,
           CompromiseContracApproveDate, IsTDR, CloseDate, BadDebtDate, DPD, InstallmentsAmount,
           DebtAmount, DebtorRelateTypeId, SystemBankId, DataDebtorCardId, MeasureName
    INTO #dc04
    FROM (
        SELECT c.DebtorRelateId,
               c.DebtorCardCode, c.DebtorCardName, c.DebtBalance, c.CurrentPaymentDate, c.DFDDate,
               c.CompromiseContracApproveDate, c.IsTDR, c.CloseDate, c.BadDebtDate, c.DPD, c.InstallmentsAmount,
               c.DebtAmount, c.DebtorRelateTypeId, c.SystemBankId, c.DataDebtorCardId, c.MeasureName,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.DebtorRelateId ORDER BY c.CreateDate DESC) AS rn
        FROM DataDebtorCard c
        WHERE c.DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying04)
          AND (c.IsDelete = 0 OR c.IsDelete IS NULL)
    ) x WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_dc04 ON #dc04 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 6. DataDebtor TOP 1 per DebtorCode with PersonGroupId = 118
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dd04') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dd04;
    SELECT DebtorCode, IDCard, CardNumber, DebtorName, BirthDate
    INTO #dd04
    FROM (
        SELECT d.DebtorCode, d.IDCard, d.CardNumber, d.DebtorName, d.BirthDate,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DebtorCode ORDER BY d.CreateDate DESC) AS rn
        FROM DataDebtor d
        WHERE d.DebtorCode IN (SELECT DebtorCode FROM #ddr_info04)
          AND d.PersonGroupId = 118
    ) x WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_dd04 ON #dd04 (DebtorCode);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 7. DataDebtorAddress TOP 1 per DebtorRelateId (UNION ALL approach)
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dda04') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dda04;
    SELECT ddr2.DebtorRelateId,
           a.AddressNumber, a.PlaceName, a.ProvinceId, a.DistrictId, a.SubDistrictId, a.PostalCode,
           a.Moo, a.Soi, a.Road
    INTO #dda04
    FROM #ddr_info04 ddr2
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1
            a2.AddressNumber, a2.PlaceName, a2.ProvinceId, a2.DistrictId, a2.SubDistrictId, a2.PostalCode,
            a2.Moo, a2.Soi, a2.Road
        FROM (
            -- Branch 1: match by DebtorId
            SELECT a3.AddressNumber, a3.PlaceName, a3.ProvinceId, a3.DistrictId, a3.SubDistrictId, a3.PostalCode,
                   a3.Moo, a3.Soi, a3.Road,
                   a3.IsDefault, a3.CreateDate, a3.DebtorAddressId,
                   0 AS src_priority
            FROM DataDebtorAddress a3
            WHERE a3.DebtorId = ddr2.DebtorId
            UNION ALL
            -- Branch 2: match by DebtorCode (exclude duplicates from branch 1)
            SELECT a3.AddressNumber, a3.PlaceName, a3.ProvinceId, a3.DistrictId, a3.SubDistrictId, a3.PostalCode,
                   a3.Moo, a3.Soi, a3.Road,
                   a3.IsDefault, a3.CreateDate, a3.DebtorAddressId,
                   1 AS src_priority
            FROM DataDebtorAddress a3
            WHERE a3.DebtorCode = ddr2.DebtorCode
              AND a3.DebtorId <> ddr2.DebtorId
        ) a2
        ORDER BY CASE WHEN a2.IsDefault = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                 a2.src_priority,
                 a2.CreateDate DESC,
                 a2.DebtorAddressId DESC
    ) a;
    CREATE INDEX IX_dda04 ON #dda04 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 8. DataDebtorStatusUpdate TOP 1 per DebtorRelateId
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ssu04') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ssu04;
    SELECT DebtorRelateId, StatusLegalId
    INTO #ssu04
    FROM (
        SELECT DebtorRelateId, StatusLegalId,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DebtorRelateId ORDER BY UpdateDate DESC) AS rn
        FROM DataDebtorStatusUpdate
        WHERE DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying04)
    ) x WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_ssu04 ON #ssu04 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 9. LTDataCaseMainDebtor TOP 1 per DebtorRelateId
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#lt04') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #lt04;
    SELECT DebtorRelateId, FilingDate, BankFilingDate, BlackCaseNo, RedCaseNo, JmTrialDate, WithdrawDate, JudgmentBankruptcyDate
    INTO #lt04
    FROM (
        SELECT DebtorRelateId, FilingDate, BankFilingDate, BlackCaseNo, RedCaseNo, JmTrialDate, WithdrawDate, JudgmentBankruptcyDate,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DebtorRelateId ORDER BY CreateDate DESC) AS rn
        FROM LTDataCaseMainDebtor
        WHERE DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying04)
          AND IsCancel = 0
    ) x WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_lt04 ON #lt04 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 10. TEMPDWHCBS TOP 1 per LGNo+CIFNo
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dwh04') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dwh04;
    SELECT ddr2.DebtorRelateId,
           d.idnumber, d.companythainame, d.dateofbirth
    INTO #dwh04
    FROM #ddr_info04 ddr2
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 d2.idnumber, d2.companythainame, d2.dateofbirth
        FROM TEMPDWHCBS d2
        WHERE d2.accountnumber = ddr2.LGNo AND d2.customercode = ddr2.CIFNo
          AND d2.ImportDate < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @EndDate)
        ORDER BY d2.ImportDate DESC
    ) d;
    CREATE INDEX IX_dwh04 ON #dwh04 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 11. NCBStopConditionMaster — pre-materialize blocked accounts
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#sc04') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #sc04;
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr2.DebtorRelateId
    INTO #sc04
    FROM #ddr_info04 ddr2
    JOIN NCBStopConditionMaster sc ON (sc.CIFNo = ddr2.CIFNo OR sc.LGNo = ddr2.LGNo) AND sc.IsActive = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_sc04 ON #sc04 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- S21 historical-only: pre-materialize legacy CIFNos (clean in 2019, DFD <= 2024-03-31)
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#s21_cif04') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #s21_cif04;
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr2.CIFNo
    INTO #s21_cif04
    FROM #ddr_info04 ddr2
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM DataEndOfDay eod
        JOIN DataDebtorRelate ddr3 ON ddr3.DebtorRelateId = eod.DebtorRelateId
        WHERE ddr3.CIFNo = ddr2.CIFNo
          AND eod.AsOfDate BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31'
          AND (eod.IsDelete = 0 OR eod.IsDelete IS NULL)
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM DataEndOfDay eod
        JOIN DataDebtorRelate ddr3 ON ddr3.DebtorRelateId = eod.DebtorRelateId
        WHERE ddr3.CIFNo = ddr2.CIFNo
          AND eod.AsOfDate BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31'
          AND (eod.IsDelete = 0 OR eod.IsDelete IS NULL)
          AND ISNULL(eod.DPD, 0) > 30
    );
    CREATE INDEX IX_s21_cif04 ON #s21_cif04 (CIFNo);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 12. Main SELECT
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
        ddr.CIFNo                                                       AS customer_code,
        ISNULL(NULLIF(dwh.idnumber,''), ISNULL(NULLIF(dd.IDCard,''), dd.CardNumber)) + ddr.CIFNo + dbo.[Fn_FormatDateNCB_EN](@EndDate) AS Barcode,
        dbo.[Fn_FormatDateNCB_EN](@EndDate)                             AS Effdate,
        ISNULL(NULLIF(dwh.idnumber,''), ISNULL(NULLIF(dd.IDCard,''), dd.CardNumber)) AS Card_Id,
        ISNULL(NULLIF(dwh.companythainame,''), ISNULL(NULLIF(dc.DebtorCardName,''), dd.DebtorName)) AS Name,
        ''                                                              AS Surname,
        CASE WHEN dwh.dateofbirth IS NOT NULL AND dwh.dateofbirth > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.[Fn_FormatDateNCB_EN](dwh.dateofbirth)
             WHEN dd.BirthDate IS NOT NULL AND dd.BirthDate > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.[Fn_FormatDateNCB_EN](dd.BirthDate)
             ELSE '19000101' END AS Date_Of_Birth,
        CONCAT_WS(' ',
            dda.AddressNumber,
            dda.PlaceName,
            CASE WHEN dda.Moo  IS NOT NULL THEN 'ม.' + CAST(dda.Moo AS NVARCHAR) ELSE '' END,
            CASE WHEN dda.Soi  IS NOT NULL THEN 'ซ.' + dda.Soi  ELSE '' END,
            CASE WHEN dda.Road IS NOT NULL THEN 'ถ.' + dda.Road ELSE '' END
        )                                                               AS Address,
        sub_dist.Name                                                   AS Sub_District,
        dist.Name                                                       AS District,
        prov.Name                                                       AS Province,
        dda.PostalCode                                                  AS Postal_Code,
        dbo.[Fn_FormatDateNCB_EN](dlg.LGDate)                          AS Open_Date,
        ''                                                              AS Account_Type,
        'I'                                                             AS Ownership_Indicator,
        ddr.LGNo                                                        AS Account_Number,
        ''                                                              AS Credit_Limit,
        ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance, 0)                                       AS Amount_Owned,
        CASE WHEN dc.CurrentPaymentDate IS NOT NULL AND dc.CurrentPaymentDate > '1900-01-01'
             THEN dbo.[Fn_FormatDateNCB_EN](dc.CurrentPaymentDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS Date_Of_Last_Payment,
        CASE WHEN dc.DFDDate IS NOT NULL AND dc.DFDDate > '1900-01-01'
             THEN dbo.[Fn_FormatDateNCB_EN](dc.DFDDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS Default_Date,
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(tdr_cfg.RestructureCode, @TDRDefaultCode04) = @TDRDefaultCode04
             THEN '19000101'
             WHEN dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate IS NOT NULL AND dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate > '1900-01-01'
             THEN dbo.[Fn_FormatDateNCB_EN](dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate)
             ELSE '19000101'
        END                                                             AS Date_Of_Restructuring,
        CASE
            WHEN dc.InstallmentsAmount > 0 AND dc.DebtAmount > 0
            THEN CEILING(dc.DebtAmount / dc.InstallmentsAmount)
            ELSE 0
        END                                                             AS Installment_Number_Of_Payments,
        RIGHT('000' + CAST(ISNULL(dc.DPD, 0) AS VARCHAR(3)), 3)        AS Number_Of_Days_Past,
        CASE WHEN ISNULL(dc.DPD, 0) = 0
                  OR (dc.CloseDate IS NOT NULL AND dc.CloseDate > '1900-01-01')
             THEN 0
             WHEN dc.IsTDR = 1 AND dc.DPD BETWEEN 1 AND 90
             THEN ISNULL(dc.InstallmentsAmount, 0) * CEILING(CAST(dc.DPD AS FLOAT) / 30.0)
             ELSE ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance, 0)
        END                                                             AS Past_Due_Amount,
        CASE WHEN status_match.AccountStatus IS NOT NULL THEN status_match.AccountStatus
             WHEN (dc.CloseDate IS NOT NULL AND dc.CloseDate > '1900-01-01')
             THEN @S11
             WHEN lt.FilingDate IS NOT NULL AND lt.FilingDate > '1900-01-01'
                  AND lt.RedCaseNo IS NOT NULL
                  AND dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate IS NOT NULL AND dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate > '1900-01-01'
                  AND dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate <= lt.JmTrialDate
             THEN @S31
             WHEN (
                  -- [แก้] 79-99=ฟ้อง→บังคับคดี→ล้มฯ, 68-71=ชะลอบังคับคดี, 73=ปรับโครงสร้างหลังฟ้อง (ไม่รวม 74,77 ที่ยังไม่ฟ้อง)
                  ssu.StatusLegalId IN (68,69,70,71,73,79,80,81,82,83,84,85,86,87,88,90,91,92,93,94,95,96,97,98,99)
               OR (lt.FilingDate IS NOT NULL AND lt.FilingDate > '1900-01-01' AND lt.BlackCaseNo IS NOT NULL)
               OR (lt.BankFilingDate IS NOT NULL AND lt.BankFilingDate >= '2000-01-01')  -- [แก้] กัน garbage 1905
                 ) AND (lt.WithdrawDate IS NULL OR lt.WithdrawDate <= '1900-01-01')  THEN @S30
             WHEN s13_cond.IsMatch = 1 THEN @S13
             WHEN s14_cond.IsMatch = 1 THEN @S14
             WHEN s12_cond.IsMatch = 1 THEN @S12
             WHEN s21_cond.IsMatch = 1 THEN @S21
             WHEN ISNULL(dc.DPD, 0) >= 91
             THEN @S20
             ELSE @S10
        END                                                             AS Account_Status,
        sb.BankName                                                     AS Bankname,
        sbb.BankBranchName                                              AS Branchname,
        ''                                                              AS monthly1,
        ''                                                              AS monthly4,
        N'วันที่พิมพ์ : ' + dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(GETDATE())          AS PrintDate,
        N'ผู้สั่งพิมพ์ : ' + NULL                                       AS PrintName
    INTO #ncbresult04
    FROM #qualifying04 q
    JOIN DataDebtorRelate ddr ON ddr.DebtorRelateId = q.DebtorRelateId
    JOIN DataLG dlg ON dlg.LGNo = ddr.LGNo

    -- [CHANGED] use pre-materialized #dd04 (PersonGroupId=118, TOP 1 by CreateDate)
    JOIN #dd04 dd ON dd.DebtorCode = ddr.DebtorCode

    LEFT JOIN #dc04  dc  ON dc.DebtorRelateId  = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #dda04 dda ON dda.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #ssu04 ssu ON ssu.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #lt04  lt  ON lt.DebtorRelateId  = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #dwh04 dwh ON dwh.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #eod_cp04 eod_cp ON eod_cp.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId

    LEFT JOIN SystemProvinceMaster      prov ON prov.ProvinceId        = dda.ProvinceId
    LEFT JOIN SystemDistrictMaster      dist ON dist.DistrictId        = dda.DistrictId
    LEFT JOIN SystemSubDistrictMaster sub_dist ON sub_dist.SubDistrictId = dda.SubDistrictId
    LEFT JOIN SystemBankMaster           sb ON sb.BankId               = dc.SystemBankId
    LEFT JOIN SystemBankBranchMaster    sbb ON sbb.BankBranchId        = dlg.BankBranchId

    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 tr.RestructureCode
        FROM (SELECT DISTINCT RestructureCodeId, RestructureCode, Oparators FROM #tdr_rule04) tr
        WHERE
            (
                ISNULL(tr.Oparators, 'AND') <> 'OR'
                AND NOT EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM #tdr_rule04 c
                    WHERE c.RestructureCodeId = tr.RestructureCodeId
                      AND c.ColumnName IS NOT NULL
                      AND (
                          CASE
                              WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('IsTDR') THEN
                                  CASE WHEN c.Operator = '=' THEN IIF(ISNULL(CAST(dc.IsTDR AS INT),0) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('<>','!=') THEN IIF(ISNULL(CAST(dc.IsTDR AS INT),0) <> TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                       ELSE 0 END
                              WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('CloseDate') THEN
                                  CASE WHEN c.Operator IN ('>','>=','MoreThan','MoreThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('<','<=','LessThan','LessThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator = '=' THEN IIF(CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(dc.CloseDate,'1900-01-01')) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATE),1,0)
                                       ELSE 0 END
                              WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('CompromiseContracApproveDate','CompromiseContractApproveDate','TDRDate') THEN
                                  CASE WHEN c.Operator IN ('>','>=','MoreThan','MoreThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate,'1900-01-01') >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('<','<=','LessThan','LessThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate,'1900-01-01') <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator = '=' THEN IIF(CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate,'1900-01-01')) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATE),1,0)
                                       ELSE 0 END
                              ELSE 0
                          END
                      ) = 0
                )
            )
            OR
            (
                ISNULL(tr.Oparators, 'AND') = 'OR'
                AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM #tdr_rule04 c
                    WHERE c.RestructureCodeId = tr.RestructureCodeId
                      AND c.ColumnName IS NOT NULL
                      AND (
                          CASE
                              WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('IsTDR') THEN
                                  CASE WHEN c.Operator = '=' THEN IIF(ISNULL(CAST(dc.IsTDR AS INT),0) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('<>','!=') THEN IIF(ISNULL(CAST(dc.IsTDR AS INT),0) <> TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                       ELSE 0 END
                              WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('CloseDate') THEN
                                  CASE WHEN c.Operator IN ('>','>=','MoreThan','MoreThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('<','<=','LessThan','LessThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator = '=' THEN IIF(CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(dc.CloseDate,'1900-01-01')) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATE),1,0)
                                       ELSE 0 END
                              WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('CompromiseContracApproveDate','CompromiseContractApproveDate','TDRDate') THEN
                                  CASE WHEN c.Operator IN ('>','>=','MoreThan','MoreThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate,'1900-01-01') >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('<','<=','LessThan','LessThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate,'1900-01-01') <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator = '=' THEN IIF(CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate,'1900-01-01')) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATE),1,0)
                                       ELSE 0 END
                              ELSE 0
                          END
                      ) = 1
                )
            )
        ORDER BY CASE WHEN tr.RestructureCode = @TDRDefaultCode04 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, tr.RestructureCode
    ) tdr_cfg

    -- Generic dynamic status matcher. Config can add new statuses without changing this CASE fallback.
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 x.CatalogId AS AccountStatus
        FROM (
            SELECT
                r.NCBStatusCode,
                r.CatalogId,
                CASE WHEN r.NCBStatusCode IN (30,32,33,42,43,44) THEN MAX(r.IsRuleMatch) ELSE MIN(r.IsRuleMatch) END AS IsStatusMatch
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    c.NCBStatusCode,
                    c.CatalogId,
                    CASE
                        WHEN c.ColumnName='MeasureName' THEN
                            CASE WHEN c.Operator='LIKE' THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') LIKE c.ValueConditionExcute,1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator='contains' THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') LIKE '%'+c.ValueConditionExcute+'%',1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('=','Equal') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'')=c.ValueConditionExcute,1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('<>','!=') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'')<>c.ValueConditionExcute,1,0)
                                 ELSE 0 END
                        WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('DPD','DerivedDPD','StatusLegalId','StatusPortId') THEN
                            CASE WHEN c.Operator IN('=','Equal') THEN IIF(EXISTS (
                                      SELECT 1 FROM STRING_SPLIT(REPLACE(c.ValueConditionExcute,N' ',N''), ',') v
                                      WHERE TRY_CAST(v.value AS INT) = CASE c.ColumnName
                                          WHEN 'DPD' THEN ISNULL(dc.DPD,0)
                                          WHEN 'DerivedDPD' THEN ISNULL(dc.DPD,0)
                                          WHEN 'StatusLegalId' THEN ISNULL(ssu.StatusLegalId,0)
                                          WHEN 'StatusPortId' THEN ISNULL(eod_cp.StatusPortId,0)
                                      END
                                  ),1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('>=','LessThanEqual') THEN IIF(CASE c.ColumnName WHEN 'DPD' THEN ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) WHEN 'DerivedDPD' THEN ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) WHEN 'StatusLegalId' THEN ISNULL(ssu.StatusLegalId,0) WHEN 'StatusPortId' THEN ISNULL(eod_cp.StatusPortId,0) END >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('<=','MoreThanEqual') THEN IIF(CASE c.ColumnName WHEN 'DPD' THEN ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) WHEN 'DerivedDPD' THEN ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) WHEN 'StatusLegalId' THEN ISNULL(ssu.StatusLegalId,0) WHEN 'StatusPortId' THEN ISNULL(eod_cp.StatusPortId,0) END <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('>','MoreThan') THEN IIF(CASE c.ColumnName WHEN 'DPD' THEN ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) WHEN 'DerivedDPD' THEN ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) WHEN 'StatusLegalId' THEN ISNULL(ssu.StatusLegalId,0) WHEN 'StatusPortId' THEN ISNULL(eod_cp.StatusPortId,0) END > TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('<','LessThan') THEN IIF(CASE c.ColumnName WHEN 'DPD' THEN ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) WHEN 'DerivedDPD' THEN ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) WHEN 'StatusLegalId' THEN ISNULL(ssu.StatusLegalId,0) WHEN 'StatusPortId' THEN ISNULL(eod_cp.StatusPortId,0) END < TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                 ELSE 0 END
                        WHEN c.ColumnName='IsTDR' THEN
                            CASE WHEN c.Operator IN('=','Equal') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.IsTDR,0)=TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('<>','!=') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.IsTDR,0)<>TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                 ELSE 0 END
                        WHEN c.ColumnName='DebtBalance' THEN
                            CASE WHEN c.Operator IN('>=','>','LessThanEqual','MoreThan') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0)>=TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)),1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('<=','<','MoreThanEqual','LessThan') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0)<=TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)),1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('=','Equal') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0)=TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)),1,0)
                                 ELSE 0 END
                        WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('CloseDate','FilingDate','BankFilingDate','BadDebtDate','JudgmentBankruptcyDate') THEN
                            CASE WHEN c.Operator IN('>','MoreThan') THEN IIF(CASE c.ColumnName WHEN 'CloseDate' THEN ISNULL(dc.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'FilingDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.FilingDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'BankFilingDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.BankFilingDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'BadDebtDate' THEN ISNULL(dc.BadDebtDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'JudgmentBankruptcyDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.JudgmentBankruptcyDate,'1900-01-01') END > TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('>=','LessThanEqual') THEN IIF(CASE c.ColumnName WHEN 'CloseDate' THEN ISNULL(dc.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'FilingDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.FilingDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'BankFilingDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.BankFilingDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'BadDebtDate' THEN ISNULL(dc.BadDebtDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'JudgmentBankruptcyDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.JudgmentBankruptcyDate,'1900-01-01') END >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('<','LessThan') THEN IIF(CASE c.ColumnName WHEN 'CloseDate' THEN ISNULL(dc.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'FilingDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.FilingDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'BankFilingDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.BankFilingDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'BadDebtDate' THEN ISNULL(dc.BadDebtDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'JudgmentBankruptcyDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.JudgmentBankruptcyDate,'1900-01-01') END < TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('<=','MoreThanEqual') THEN IIF(CASE c.ColumnName WHEN 'CloseDate' THEN ISNULL(dc.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'FilingDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.FilingDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'BankFilingDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.BankFilingDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'BadDebtDate' THEN ISNULL(dc.BadDebtDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'JudgmentBankruptcyDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.JudgmentBankruptcyDate,'1900-01-01') END <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('=','Equal') THEN IIF(CONVERT(DATE, CASE c.ColumnName WHEN 'CloseDate' THEN ISNULL(dc.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'FilingDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.FilingDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'BankFilingDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.BankFilingDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'BadDebtDate' THEN ISNULL(dc.BadDebtDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'JudgmentBankruptcyDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.JudgmentBankruptcyDate,'1900-01-01') END) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATE),1,0)
                                 ELSE 0 END
                        WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('BlackCaseNo','RedCaseNo') THEN
                            CASE WHEN c.Operator IN('=','Equal') THEN IIF(NULLIF(CASE c.ColumnName WHEN 'BlackCaseNo' THEN lt.BlackCaseNo WHEN 'RedCaseNo' THEN lt.RedCaseNo END,'') IS NOT NULL,1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('<>','!=') THEN IIF(NULLIF(CASE c.ColumnName WHEN 'BlackCaseNo' THEN lt.BlackCaseNo WHEN 'RedCaseNo' THEN lt.RedCaseNo END,'') IS NULL,1,0)
                                 ELSE 0 END
                        ELSE 0
                    END AS IsRuleMatch
                FROM #NCBCond04 c
            ) r
            GROUP BY r.NCBStatusCode, r.CatalogId
        ) x
        WHERE x.IsStatusMatch = 1
        ORDER BY CASE x.NCBStatusCode
            WHEN 42 THEN 10 WHEN 43 THEN 11 WHEN 44 THEN 12
                    WHEN 32 THEN 13 WHEN 33 THEN 20 WHEN 11 THEN 30 WHEN 31 THEN 40 WHEN 30 THEN 50
            WHEN 13 THEN 60 WHEN 14 THEN 70 WHEN 12 THEN 80 WHEN 21 THEN 90
            WHEN 20 THEN 100 WHEN 10 THEN 999 ELSE 500 END,
            x.NCBStatusCode
    ) status_match

    -- Dynamic status condition checks
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT CASE
            WHEN @S12_HasCond = 1
                 AND NOT EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond04 c WHERE c.NCBStatusCode = 12
                     AND CASE
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='MeasureName' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator='LIKE'            THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') LIKE c.ValueConditionExcute, 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='contains'        THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') LIKE '%'+c.ValueConditionExcute+'%', 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='='               THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') = c.ValueConditionExcute, 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator IN ('<>','!=')    THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') <> c.ValueConditionExcute, 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='DPD' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator='>='  THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='<='  THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='>'   THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) >  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='<'   THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) <  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='='   THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) =  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='IsTDR' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator='='            THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.IsTDR,0) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator IN ('<>','!=') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.IsTDR,0) <> TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='DebtBalance' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator IN ('>=','>') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0) >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator IN ('<=','<') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0) <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='='           THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0) =  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         ELSE 0 END = 0)
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsMatch
    ) s12_cond

    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT CASE
            WHEN @S13_HasCond = 1
                 AND NOT EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond04 c WHERE c.NCBStatusCode = 13
                     AND CASE
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='MeasureName' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator='LIKE'            THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') LIKE c.ValueConditionExcute, 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='contains'        THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') LIKE '%'+c.ValueConditionExcute+'%', 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='='               THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') = c.ValueConditionExcute, 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator IN ('<>','!=')    THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') <> c.ValueConditionExcute, 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='DPD' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator='>='  THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='<='  THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='>'   THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) >  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='<'   THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) <  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='='   THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) =  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='IsTDR' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator='='            THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.IsTDR,0) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator IN ('<>','!=') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.IsTDR,0) <> TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='DebtBalance' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator IN ('>=','>') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0) >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator IN ('<=','<') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0) <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='='           THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0) =  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         ELSE 0 END = 0)
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsMatch
    ) s13_cond

    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT CASE
            WHEN @S14_HasCond = 1
                 AND NOT EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond04 c WHERE c.NCBStatusCode = 14
                     AND CASE
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='MeasureName' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator='LIKE'            THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') LIKE c.ValueConditionExcute, 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='contains'        THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') LIKE '%'+c.ValueConditionExcute+'%', 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='='               THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') = c.ValueConditionExcute, 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator IN ('<>','!=')    THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') <> c.ValueConditionExcute, 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='DPD' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator='>='  THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='<='  THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='>'   THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) >  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='<'   THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) <  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='='   THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) =  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='IsTDR' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator='='            THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.IsTDR,0) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator IN ('<>','!=') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.IsTDR,0) <> TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='DebtBalance' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator IN ('>=','>') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0) >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator IN ('<=','<') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0) <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='='           THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0) =  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         ELSE 0 END = 0)
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsMatch
    ) s14_cond

    -- S21 historical-only logic (NCBStatusExcuteMaster not used for S21)
    -- Legacy condition: DFDDate <= 2024-03-31 cutoff AND CIF was clean in 2019
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT CASE
            WHEN dc.DFDDate IS NOT NULL
                 AND dc.DFDDate > '1900-01-01'
                 AND dc.DFDDate <= '2024-03-31'
                 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #s21_cif04 s21c WHERE s21c.CIFNo = ddr.CIFNo)
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsMatch
    ) s21_cond

    -- [CHANGED] pre-materialized #sc04 replaces LEFT JOIN NCBStopConditionMaster + WHERE IS NULL
    LEFT JOIN #sc04 sc ON sc.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId

    WHERE sc.DebtorRelateId IS NULL
      AND (dc.DataDebtorCardId IS NOT NULL OR dlg.Grade = 'F1')
      AND (@DebtorName = 'null' OR dd.DebtorName LIKE '%' + @DebtorName + '%')

    OPTION (RECOMPILE);

    -- ── Auto-create staging table จาก schema ของ #ncbresult04 (ครั้งแรกครั้งเดียว) ──
    IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.NCBCommercialYearlyLetters') IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(7)) AS Period, *
        INTO dbo.NCBCommercialYearlyLetters
        FROM #ncbresult04 WHERE 1 = 0;

        ALTER TABLE dbo.NCBCommercialYearlyLetters ALTER COLUMN Period NVARCHAR(7) NOT NULL;
        ALTER TABLE dbo.NCBCommercialYearlyLetters ADD Id BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL;
        CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_NCBCommercialYearlyLetters_Period
            ON dbo.NCBCommercialYearlyLetters (Period, customer_code, Account_Number);
    END

    DELETE FROM dbo.NCBCommercialYearlyLetters WHERE Period = @Period;
    INSERT INTO dbo.NCBCommercialYearlyLetters
    SELECT @Period, * FROM #ncbresult04;
END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_NCB_05_ConsumerDataField_Insert]
    @StartDate DATETIME = '2025-09-01',
    @EndDate   DATETIME = '2025-09-30',
    @CIFNo  NVARCHAR(50) = 'null',
    @LGNo   NVARCHAR(20) = 'null'
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET @StartDate = CASE WHEN YEAR(@StartDate) > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @StartDate) ELSE @StartDate END;
    SET @EndDate   = CASE WHEN YEAR(@EndDate)   > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @EndDate)   ELSE @EndDate   END;
    SET @CIFNo     = ISNULL(@CIFNo, 'null');
    SET @LGNo      = ISNULL(@LGNo, 'null');
    -- Staging uses one Period for every inserted row; reject mixed-month calls.
    IF @StartDate IS NULL OR @EndDate IS NULL OR @StartDate > @EndDate
       OR YEAR(@StartDate) <> YEAR(@EndDate) OR MONTH(@StartDate) <> MONTH(@EndDate)
        THROW 50001, 'NCB report requires a valid date range within one reporting month.', 1;
    DECLARE @Period NVARCHAR(7) = CONVERT(char(7), @EndDate, 126);
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    DECLARE @DirectOwn bit=CASE WHEN @@TRANCOUNT=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
    DECLARE @DirectLock int,@DirectResource nvarchar(255)=N'NCB.StrictPdf.'+@Period;
    BEGIN TRY
    IF @DirectOwn=1 BEGIN TRANSACTION; ELSE SAVE TRANSACTION DirectNCB05;
    EXEC @DirectLock=sys.sp_getapplock @Resource=@DirectResource,@LockMode='Exclusive',@LockOwner='Transaction',@LockTimeout=30000;
    IF @DirectLock<0 THROW 51301,'Another NCB report is running for this month.',1;


    -- Pre-load NCB dynamic conditions once (PersonType=1 Consumer)
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#NCBCond05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #NCBCond05;
    SELECT nm.NCBStatusCode, CAST(nm.CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) AS CatalogId, sp.ColumnName, sl.KeyName AS Operator,
           CASE WHEN nm.NCBStatusCode = 12 AND sp.ColumnName = 'MeasureName' AND ne.ValueConditionExcute = 'มาตรการ%'
                THEN '%พัก%หนี้%'
                ELSE ne.ValueConditionExcute END AS ValueConditionExcute
    INTO #NCBCond05
    FROM NCBStatusExcuteMaster ne
    JOIN NCBStatusMaster nm        ON nm.NCBStatusId  = ne.NCBStatusId AND nm.PersonType = 1 AND nm.IsActive = 1
    JOIN SystemParameterMaster sp  ON sp.ParameterId  = ne.ParameterId
    LEFT JOIN SystemLookupMaster sl ON sl.LookupId    = ne.OparatorId;

    DECLARE @S11_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond05 WHERE NCBStatusCode=11),1,0);
    DECLARE @S12_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond05 WHERE NCBStatusCode=12),1,0);
    DECLARE @S13_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond05 WHERE NCBStatusCode=13),1,0);
    DECLARE @S14_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond05 WHERE NCBStatusCode=14),1,0);
    DECLARE @S20_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond05 WHERE NCBStatusCode=20),1,0);
    DECLARE @S21_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond05 WHERE NCBStatusCode=21),1,0);
    DECLARE @S30_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond05 WHERE NCBStatusCode=30),1,0);
    DECLARE @S31_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond05 WHERE NCBStatusCode=31),1,0);
    DECLARE @S32_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond05 WHERE NCBStatusCode=32),1,0);
    DECLARE @S33_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond05 WHERE NCBStatusCode=33),1,0);
    DECLARE @S42_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond05 WHERE NCBStatusCode=42),1,0);
    DECLARE @S43_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond05 WHERE NCBStatusCode=43),1,0);
    DECLARE @S44_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond05 WHERE NCBStatusCode=44),1,0);

    -- Load account status codes from NCBStatusMaster (PersonType=1 = Consumer)
    DECLARE @S10  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 10 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S11  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 11 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S12  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 12 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S20  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 20 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S30  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 30 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S31  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 31 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S33  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 33 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S13  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 13 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S14  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 14 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S21  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 21 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S42  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 42 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S43  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 43 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S44  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 44 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);

    -- Dynamic DPD mapping from website configuration.
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dpd_rule05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dpd_rule05;
    SELECT
        dm.DPDId,
        dm.DPDCode,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(dm.CatalogCode, ''), dm.DPDCode) AS DPDOutputCode,
        MAX(CASE WHEN sl.KeyName = 'Equal' OR sl.LookUpValue = '=' OR de.OparatorId = 5
                 THEN TRY_CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(de.ValueConditionExcute, N' วัน', N'')) END) AS ExactValue,
        MAX(CASE WHEN sl.KeyName = 'LessThanEqual' OR sl.LookUpValue = '>=' OR de.OparatorId = 3
                 THEN TRY_CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(de.ValueConditionExcute, N' วัน', N'')) END) AS MinInclusive,
        MAX(CASE WHEN sl.KeyName = 'MoreThanEqual' OR sl.LookUpValue = '<=' OR de.OparatorId = 4
                 THEN TRY_CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(de.ValueConditionExcute, N' วัน', N'')) END) AS MaxInclusive,
        MAX(CASE WHEN sl.KeyName = 'MoreThan' OR sl.LookUpValue = '>' OR de.OparatorId = 1
                 THEN TRY_CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(de.ValueConditionExcute, N' วัน', N'')) END) AS MinExclusive,
        MAX(CASE WHEN sl.KeyName = 'LessThan' OR sl.LookUpValue = '<' OR de.OparatorId = 2
                 THEN TRY_CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(de.ValueConditionExcute, N' วัน', N'')) END) AS MaxExclusive
    INTO #dpd_rule05
    FROM NCBDPDMaster dm
    LEFT JOIN NCBDPDExcuteMaster de ON de.DPDId = dm.DPDId
    LEFT JOIN SystemLookupMaster sl ON sl.LookupId = de.OparatorId
    WHERE dm.PersonType = 1
      AND dm.IsActive = 1
    GROUP BY dm.DPDId, dm.DPDCode, COALESCE(NULLIF(dm.CatalogCode, ''), dm.DPDCode);

    DECLARE @D0 NVARCHAR(10) = (
        SELECT TOP 1 DPDOutputCode
        FROM #dpd_rule05
        WHERE (ExactValue   IS NULL OR 0 =  ExactValue)
          AND (MinInclusive IS NULL OR 0 >= MinInclusive)
          AND (MaxInclusive IS NULL OR 0 <= MaxInclusive)
          AND (MinExclusive IS NULL OR 0 >  MinExclusive)
          AND (MaxExclusive IS NULL OR 0 <  MaxExclusive)
        ORDER BY
            CASE WHEN ExactValue IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
            ISNULL(MinInclusive, MinExclusive + 1) DESC,
            ISNULL(MaxInclusive, MaxExclusive - 1) ASC,
            DPDCode
    );
    DECLARE @DF NVARCHAR(10) = (
        SELECT TOP 1 DPDOutputCode
        FROM #dpd_rule05
        WHERE (ExactValue   IS NULL OR 100000 =  ExactValue)
          AND (MinInclusive IS NULL OR 100000 >= MinInclusive)
          AND (MaxInclusive IS NULL OR 100000 <= MaxInclusive)
          AND (MinExclusive IS NULL OR 100000 >  MinExclusive)
          AND (MaxExclusive IS NULL OR 100000 <  MaxExclusive)
        ORDER BY
            CASE WHEN ExactValue IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
            ISNULL(MinInclusive, MinExclusive + 1) DESC,
            ISNULL(MaxInclusive, MaxExclusive - 1) ASC,
            DPDCode
    );

    -- Dynamic TDR restructuring code from website configuration.
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tdr_rule05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tdr_rule05;
    SELECT
        rc.RestructureCodeId,
        rc.RestructureCode,
        rc.Oparators,
        re.Seq,
        sp.ColumnName,
        sl.KeyName AS Operator,
        re.ValueConditionExcute
    INTO #tdr_rule05
    FROM SystemTDRRestructureCode rc
    LEFT JOIN SystemRestructureExcuteMaster re ON re.RestructureCodeId = rc.RestructureCodeId
    LEFT JOIN SystemParameterMaster sp ON sp.ParameterId = re.ParameterId
    LEFT JOIN SystemLookupMaster sl ON sl.LookupId = re.OparatorId
    WHERE rc.IsActive = 1;

    DECLARE @TDRDefaultCode05 NVARCHAR(10) = (
        SELECT TOP 1 RestructureCode
        FROM SystemTDRRestructureCode
        WHERE IsActive = 1
        ORDER BY CASE WHEN RestructureCode = '00' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, RestructureCode
    );

    -- ── STEP 1: qualifying DebtorRelateIds ───────────────────────────────────
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#qualifying05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #qualifying05;
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId
    INTO #qualifying05
    FROM DataDebtorRelate ddr
    JOIN dbo.DataEndOfDay e ON e.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    WHERE (@CIFNo = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM DataDebtorRelate WHERE CIFNo=@CIFNo))
      AND (@LGNo  = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo  = @LGNo)
      AND e.AsOfDate BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
      AND (e.IsDelete = 0 OR e.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND ddr.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
      AND (ddr.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr.IsDelete IS NULL)

    UNION

    -- LG cancelled case: no DataDebtorCard, StatusDate in range
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId
    FROM DataDebtorRelate ddr
    JOIN DataLG dlg ON dlg.LGNo = ddr.LGNo
    WHERE dlg.StatusDate BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM DataDebtorCard dc2
          WHERE dc2.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
            AND (dc2.IsDelete = 0 OR dc2.IsDelete IS NULL)
      )
      AND ddr.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
      AND (ddr.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (@CIFNo = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM DataDebtorRelate WHERE CIFNo=@CIFNo))
      AND (@LGNo  = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo  = @LGNo)

    UNION

    -- TDR case: TDR approved up to @EndDate (catches active TDR without EOD in month, e.g. LG 5923243)
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId
    FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractRelated rtdr
    JOIN TDRDataCompromiseContract cc ON cc.CompromiseContractId = rtdr.CompromiseContractId
    JOIN DataDebtorRelate ddr ON ddr.LGNo = rtdr.LGNo
    WHERE cc.ApproveDate <= @EndDate
      AND ddr.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
      AND (ddr.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (@CIFNo = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM DataDebtorRelate WHERE CIFNo=@CIFNo))
      AND (@LGNo  = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo  = @LGNo)

    UNION

    -- Closed account case: include closure events in the requested month only
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId
    FROM DataDebtorRelate ddr
    JOIN DataDebtorCard dc ON dc.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    WHERE CAST(dc.CloseDate AS DATE) <= CAST(@EndDate AS DATE)
      AND CAST(dc.CloseDate AS DATE) >= CAST(@StartDate AS DATE)
      AND (dc.DebtBalance = 0 OR dc.PrincipalTotal = 0)
      AND (dc.IsDelete = 0 OR dc.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND ddr.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
      AND (ddr.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (@CIFNo = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM DataDebtorRelate WHERE CIFNo=@CIFNo))
      AND (@LGNo  = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo  = @LGNo)

    UNION

    -- Closed account case: co-borrowers/guarantors inheriting from primary debtor
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId
    FROM DataDebtorRelate ddr
    JOIN DataDebtorRelate ddr_p ON ddr_p.LGNo = ddr.LGNo AND ddr_p.DebtorTypeId = 1 AND (ddr_p.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr_p.IsDelete IS NULL)
    JOIN DataDebtorCard dc_p ON dc_p.DebtorRelateId = ddr_p.DebtorRelateId
    WHERE CAST(dc_p.CloseDate AS DATE) <= CAST(@EndDate AS DATE)
      AND CAST(dc_p.CloseDate AS DATE) >= CAST(@StartDate AS DATE)
      AND (dc_p.DebtBalance = 0 OR dc_p.PrincipalTotal = 0)
      AND (dc_p.IsDelete = 0 OR dc_p.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND ddr.DebtorTypeId = 2
      AND (ddr.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (@CIFNo = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM DataDebtorRelate WHERE CIFNo=@CIFNo))
      AND (@LGNo  = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo  = @LGNo)

    UNION

    -- Accounts with active card balance:
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId
    FROM DataDebtorRelate ddr
    JOIN DataDebtorCard dc ON dc.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    WHERE (dc.IsDelete = 0 OR dc.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance, 0) > 0 OR ISNULL(dc.PrincipalTotal, 0) > 0)
      AND ddr.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
      AND (ddr.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (@CIFNo = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM DataDebtorRelate WHERE CIFNo=@CIFNo))
      AND (@LGNo  = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo  = @LGNo)

    UNION

    -- Accounts with litigation:
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId
    FROM DataDebtorRelate ddr
    JOIN LTDataCaseMainDebtor lt ON lt.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    WHERE (lt.IsCancel = 0 OR lt.IsCancel IS NULL)
      AND lt.FilingDate <= @EndDate
      AND ddr.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
      AND (ddr.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (@CIFNo = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM DataDebtorRelate WHERE CIFNo=@CIFNo))
      AND (@LGNo  = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo  = @LGNo)
    OPTION (RECOMPILE);

    INSERT INTO #qualifying05(DebtorRelateId)
    SELECT DISTINCT r.DebtorRelateId
    FROM DataDebtorRelate r
    JOIN DataLG g ON g.LGNo=r.LGNo AND g.Grade IN ('A','B','C','D','E','E1','E2')
    JOIN dbo.TEMPDWHCBS d ON d.accountnumber=r.LGNo AND d.customercode=r.CIFNo
    WHERE r.DebtorTypeId IN (1,2) AND (r.IsDelete=0 OR r.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (@CIFNo='null' OR r.CIFNo=@CIFNo)
      AND (@LGNo='null' OR r.LGNo=@LGNo)
      AND TRY_CONVERT(date,d.eff_date)>=DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@EndDate),MONTH(@EndDate),1)
      AND TRY_CONVERT(date,d.eff_date)<DATEADD(month,1,DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@EndDate),MONTH(@EndDate),1))
      AND (NULLIF(CONVERT(nvarchar(50),d.asofdate),N'') IS NULL
           OR TRY_CONVERT(date,d.asofdate)=TRY_CONVERT(date,d.eff_date))
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #qualifying05 q WHERE q.DebtorRelateId=r.DebtorRelateId);

    CREATE INDEX IX_qualifying05 ON #qualifying05 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ── STEP 2: DataDebtorRelate details ─────────────────────────────────────
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ddr_info05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ddr_info05;
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr3.DebtorRelateId, ddr3.LGNo, ddr3.CIFNo, ddr3.DebtorId, ddr3.DebtorCode, ddr3.DebtorTypeId, ddr3.CreateDate
    INTO #ddr_info05
    FROM DataDebtorRelate ddr3
    WHERE ddr3.DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying05);
    CREATE INDEX IX_ddr_info05 ON #ddr_info05 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ── STEP 2b: DataDebtor per DebtorRelateId (PersonGroupId = 117) ───────
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dd05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dd05;
    SELECT di.DebtorRelateId, resolved.DebtorId, resolved.DebtorCode,
           resolved.IDCard, resolved.CardNumber, resolved.TitleId,
           resolved.DebtorCodeType AS SourceIdType, resolved.FirstName,
           resolved.LastName, resolved.BirthDate
    INTO #dd05
    FROM #ddr_info05 di
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) d.DebtorId,d.DebtorCode,d.PersonGroupId,
            CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.IDCard)),'') IS NOT NULL
                       AND d.IDCard NOT LIKE N'%ไม่พบ%' AND d.IDCard NOT LIKE N'%ไมพบ%'
                 THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(d.IDCard)) END AS IDCard,
            d.CardNumber,d.TitleId,d.DebtorCodeType,d.FirstName,d.LastName,d.BirthDate
        FROM DataDebtor d
        WHERE (d.DebtorId=di.DebtorId OR d.DebtorCode=di.DebtorCode)
        ORDER BY CASE WHEN d.DebtorId=di.DebtorId THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                 d.CreateDate DESC,d.DebtorId DESC
    ) resolved
    WHERE resolved.PersonGroupId=117;

    CREATE INDEX IX_dd05 ON #dd05 (DebtorRelateId);
    DELETE q FROM #qualifying05 q WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #dd05 d WHERE d.DebtorRelateId=q.DebtorRelateId);
    DELETE FROM #ddr_info05 WHERE DebtorRelateId NOT IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying05);
    UPDATE di SET DebtorId=d.DebtorId FROM #ddr_info05 di JOIN #dd05 d ON d.DebtorRelateId=di.DebtorRelateId;

    -- PDF p14: one row per LG and identity; prefer the main role when duplicated
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#qualifying05_dedup') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #qualifying05_dedup;
    SELECT DebtorRelateId
    INTO #qualifying05_dedup
    FROM (
        SELECT
            di.DebtorRelateId,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY di.LGNo,
                             COALESCE(dd.IDCard, di.DebtorRelateId)
                ORDER BY CASE WHEN di.DebtorTypeId = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                         ISNULL(di.CreateDate, '1900-01-01') DESC, di.DebtorRelateId DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM #ddr_info05 di
        LEFT JOIN #dd05 dd ON dd.DebtorRelateId = di.DebtorRelateId
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1;

    DELETE FROM #qualifying05 WHERE DebtorRelateId NOT IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying05_dedup);
    DELETE FROM #ddr_info05 WHERE DebtorRelateId NOT IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying05_dedup);

    DELETE q FROM #qualifying05 q JOIN DataDebtorRelate r ON r.DebtorRelateId=q.DebtorRelateId
    WHERE @CIFNo<>'null' AND (r.CIFNo<>@CIFNo OR r.CIFNo IS NULL);
    DELETE FROM #ddr_info05 WHERE DebtorRelateId NOT IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying05);

    -- NCB Deep Detail: borrower count is LG-wide and identity-based.
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#borrower_count05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #borrower_count05;
    ;WITH BorrowerIdentity AS (
        SELECT LGNo, DebtorRelateId, IdentityNo
        FROM (
            SELECT r.LGNo, r.DebtorRelateId,
                   CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.IDCard)), '') IS NOT NULL
                             AND d.IDCard NOT LIKE N'%ไม่พบ%' AND d.IDCard NOT LIKE N'%ไมพบ%'
                        THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(d.IDCard))
 ELSE NULL END AS IdentityNo,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                       PARTITION BY r.DebtorRelateId
                       ORDER BY CASE WHEN d.DebtorId = r.DebtorId THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                                d.CreateDate DESC, d.DebtorId DESC
                   ) AS rn
            FROM DataDebtorRelate r
            -- Disjoint equality branches preserve the original OR match set.
            -- Exclude an ID match from the code branch so it appears exactly once.
            LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT br.DebtorRelateId AS MatchRelateId,
                       person.DebtorId, person.IDCard, person.CreateDate
                FROM DataDebtorRelate br
                JOIN DataDebtor person ON person.DebtorId = br.DebtorId
                WHERE br.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
                  AND (br.IsDelete = 0 OR br.IsDelete IS NULL)
                  AND br.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM #ddr_info05)
                UNION ALL
                SELECT br.DebtorRelateId AS MatchRelateId,
                       person.DebtorId, person.IDCard, person.CreateDate
                FROM DataDebtorRelate br
                JOIN DataDebtor person ON person.DebtorCode = br.DebtorCode
                WHERE br.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
                  AND (br.IsDelete = 0 OR br.IsDelete IS NULL)
                  AND br.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM #ddr_info05)
                  AND (br.DebtorId IS NULL OR person.DebtorId IS NULL
                       OR person.DebtorId <> br.DebtorId)
            ) d ON d.MatchRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId
            WHERE r.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
              AND (r.IsDelete = 0 OR r.IsDelete IS NULL)
              AND r.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM #ddr_info05)
        ) ranked
        WHERE rn = 1
    )
    SELECT LGNo,
           CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN IdentityNo IS NULL OR IdentityNo LIKE N'%ไม่พบ%'
                                   OR IdentityNo LIKE N'%ไมพบ%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
                THEN COUNT(DISTINCT IdentityNo) ELSE NULL END AS BorrowerCount
    INTO #borrower_count05
    FROM BorrowerIdentity
    GROUP BY LGNo;
    CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IX_borrower_count05 ON #borrower_count05 (LGNo);

    -- A-E2 uses the business date carried by TEMPDWHCBS; ImportDate only
    -- breaks ties between loads of the same business month.
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dwh05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dwh05;
    SELECT di.DebtorRelateId, d.*
    INTO #dwh05
    FROM #ddr_info05 di
    JOIN DataLG grade_lg ON grade_lg.LGNo=di.LGNo
         AND grade_lg.Grade IN ('A','B','C','D','E','E1','E2')
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) d2.eff_date,d2.asofdate,d2.customercode,d2.accountnumber,
            d2.idnumber,d2.idtype,d2.titlename,d2.firstname,d2.familyname,
            d2.dateofbirth,d2.address1,d2.sub_district,d2.district,d2.province,
            d2.postalcode,d2.data_type,d2.dateaccountopend,d2.dateaccountclosed,
            d2.creditlimited,d2.statuslg,d2.bankbranchcode,d2.ImportDate
        FROM dbo.TEMPDWHCBS d2
        WHERE d2.accountnumber=di.LGNo AND d2.customercode=di.CIFNo
          AND TRY_CONVERT(date,d2.eff_date)>=DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@EndDate),MONTH(@EndDate),1)
          AND TRY_CONVERT(date,d2.eff_date)<DATEADD(month,1,DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@EndDate),MONTH(@EndDate),1))
          AND (NULLIF(CONVERT(nvarchar(50),d2.asofdate),N'') IS NULL
               OR TRY_CONVERT(date,d2.asofdate)=TRY_CONVERT(date,d2.eff_date))
        ORDER BY TRY_CONVERT(date,d2.eff_date) DESC,d2.ImportDate DESC,d2.TEMPId DESC
    ) d;
    CREATE INDEX IX_dwh05 ON #dwh05(DebtorRelateId);

    -- ── STEP 3: Monthly snapshot (last AsOfDate per account per month) ────────
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#monthly05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #monthly05;
    SELECT
        e.DebtorRelateId,
        YEAR(e.AsOfDate)  AS yr,
        MONTH(e.AsOfDate) AS mn,
        MAX(e.AsOfDate)   AS MonthEndDate
    INTO #monthly05
    FROM dbo.DataEndOfDay e
    JOIN DataDebtorRelate source_rel ON source_rel.DebtorRelateId=e.DebtorRelateId
    JOIN DataLG source_lg ON source_lg.LGNo=source_rel.LGNo AND source_lg.Grade IN ('F','F1')
    WHERE e.DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying05)
      AND (e.IsDelete = 0 OR e.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND e.AsOfDate BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
    GROUP BY e.DebtorRelateId, YEAR(e.AsOfDate), MONTH(e.AsOfDate);

    INSERT INTO #monthly05 (DebtorRelateId,yr,mn,MonthEndDate)
    SELECT d.DebtorRelateId,YEAR(@EndDate),MONTH(@EndDate),EOMONTH(@EndDate)
    FROM #dwh05 d WHERE d.accountnumber IS NOT NULL;

    -- Existing fallback remains for diagnostic/status work. The final identity
    -- guard excludes it when neither approved source exists.
    INSERT INTO #monthly05 (DebtorRelateId, yr, mn, MonthEndDate)
    SELECT q.DebtorRelateId, YEAR(@EndDate), MONTH(@EndDate), @EndDate
    FROM #qualifying05 q
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #monthly05 m WHERE m.DebtorRelateId = q.DebtorRelateId);

    CREATE INDEX IX_monthly05 ON #monthly05 (DebtorRelateId, MonthEndDate);

    -- ── STEP 4: DataDebtorStatusUpdate TOP 1 per DebtorRelateId/report month ─
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ssu05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ssu05;
    SELECT
        m.DebtorRelateId,
        m.MonthEndDate,
        ssu.StatusLegalId,
        ssu.StatusDebtorId,
        ssu.StatusPortId,
        ssu.StatusPortDate,
        ssu.UpdateDate
    INTO #ssu05
    FROM #monthly05 m
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            s.StatusLegalId,
            s.StatusDebtorId,
            s.StatusPortId,
            s.StatusPortDate,
            s.UpdateDate
        FROM DataDebtorStatusUpdate s
        WHERE s.DebtorRelateId = m.DebtorRelateId
          AND s.UpdateDate < DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(m.MonthEndDate), MONTH(m.MonthEndDate), 1))
        ORDER BY s.UpdateDate DESC
    ) ssu;
    CREATE INDEX IX_ssu05 ON #ssu05 (DebtorRelateId, MonthEndDate);

    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#s32_event05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #s32_event05;
    ;WITH S32Ids AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT TRY_CAST(v.value AS INT) AS StatusLegalId
        FROM #NCBCond05 c
        CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(REPLACE(c.ValueConditionExcute, N' ', N''), ',') v
        WHERE c.NCBStatusCode = 32
          AND c.ColumnName = 'StatusLegalId'
          AND TRY_CAST(v.value AS INT) IS NOT NULL
    )
    SELECT
        m.DebtorRelateId,
        m.MonthEndDate,
        MIN(s.UpdateDate) AS S32EventDate
    INTO #s32_event05
    FROM #monthly05 m
    JOIN DataDebtorStatusUpdate s
        ON s.DebtorRelateId = m.DebtorRelateId
       AND s.UpdateDate < DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(m.MonthEndDate), MONTH(m.MonthEndDate), 1))
    JOIN S32Ids ids
        ON ids.StatusLegalId = s.StatusLegalId
    GROUP BY m.DebtorRelateId, m.MonthEndDate;
    CREATE INDEX IX_s32_event05 ON #s32_event05 (DebtorRelateId, MonthEndDate);

    -- ── STEP 5: LTDataCaseMainDebtor TOP 1 per DebtorRelateId ────────────────
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#lt05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #lt05;
    SELECT DebtorRelateId, FilingDate, RedCaseNo, BlackCaseNo, JmTrialDate, WarrantDate,
           WithdrawDate, BankFilingDate, FilingAmount, DocumentDate, JudgmentBankruptcyDate,
           FrozenAssetDate, OtherFrozenAssDate, PetitionDate, BankruptcyDate,
           ReqRepayDate, BadDebtDate
    INTO #lt05
    FROM (
        SELECT DebtorRelateId, FilingDate, RedCaseNo, BlackCaseNo, JmTrialDate, WarrantDate,
               WithdrawDate, BankFilingDate, FilingAmount, DocumentDate, JudgmentBankruptcyDate,
               FrozenAssetDate, OtherFrozenAssDate, PetitionDate, BankruptcyDate,
               ReqRepayDate, BadDebtDate,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DebtorRelateId ORDER BY CreateDate DESC) AS rn
        FROM LTDataCaseMainDebtor
        WHERE DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying05)
          AND (IsCancel = 0 OR IsCancel IS NULL)
    ) x WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_lt05 ON #lt05 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- DWH source for the report month is materialized before #monthly05.

    -- ── STEP 7: DataDebtorAddress TOP 1 per DebtorRelateId ───────────────────
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dda05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dda05;
    SELECT ddr2.DebtorRelateId,
           a.AddressNumber, a.PlaceName, a.Soi, a.Road, a.ProvinceId, a.DistrictId, a.SubDistrictId, a.PostalCode
    INTO #dda05
    FROM #ddr_info05 ddr2
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1
            a2.AddressNumber, a2.PlaceName, a2.Soi, a2.Road, a2.ProvinceId, a2.DistrictId, a2.SubDistrictId, a2.PostalCode
        FROM (
            SELECT a3.AddressNumber, a3.PlaceName, a3.Soi, a3.Road, a3.ProvinceId, a3.DistrictId, a3.SubDistrictId, a3.PostalCode,
                   a3.IsDefault, a3.CreateDate, a3.DebtorAddressId,
                   0 AS src_priority
            FROM DataDebtorAddress a3
            WHERE a3.DebtorId = ddr2.DebtorId
            UNION ALL
            SELECT a3.AddressNumber, a3.PlaceName, a3.Soi, a3.Road, a3.ProvinceId, a3.DistrictId, a3.SubDistrictId, a3.PostalCode,
                   a3.IsDefault, a3.CreateDate, a3.DebtorAddressId,
                   1 AS src_priority
            FROM DataDebtorAddress a3
            WHERE a3.DebtorCode = ddr2.DebtorCode
              AND a3.DebtorId <> ddr2.DebtorId
        ) a2
        ORDER BY CASE WHEN a2.IsDefault = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                 CASE WHEN a2.ProvinceId IS NOT NULL OR a2.DistrictId IS NOT NULL OR a2.SubDistrictId IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                 a2.src_priority,
                 a2.CreateDate DESC,
                 a2.DebtorAddressId DESC
    ) a;
    CREATE INDEX IX_dda05 ON #dda05 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ── STEP 8: DataDebtorCard fallback per DebtorRelateId ───────────────────
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dc05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dc05;
    SELECT *
    INTO #dc05
    FROM (
        SELECT
            dc2.DebtorRelateId,
            dc2.DataDebtorCardId,
            dc2.CurrentPaymentDate,
            dc2.CloseDate,
            dc2.PrincipalTotal,
            dc2.DebtBalance,
            dc2.AccruedInterestTotal,
            dc2.ClaimPayDate,
            dc2.DFDDate,
            dc2.DPD,
            dc2.IsTDR,
            dc2.InstallmentsAmount,
            dc2.InstallmentPrincipal,
            dc2.DebtAmount,
            dc2.CompromiseContracApproveDate,
            dc2.SystemBankId,
            dc2.BadDebtDate,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.DebtorRelateId ORDER BY dc2.CreateDate DESC, dc2.DataDebtorCardId DESC) AS rn
        FROM DataDebtorCard dc2
        WHERE dc2.DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying05)
          AND (dc2.IsDelete = 0 OR dc2.IsDelete IS NULL)
    ) x WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_dc05 ON #dc05 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ── STEP 9: NCBStopConditionMaster ───────────────────────────────────────
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#sc05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #sc05;
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr2.DebtorRelateId
    INTO #sc05
    FROM #ddr_info05 ddr2
    JOIN NCBStopConditionMaster sc ON (sc.CIFNo = ddr2.CIFNo OR sc.LGNo = ddr2.LGNo) AND sc.IsActive = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_sc05 ON #sc05 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ── STEP 11a: TDR Latest Contract per LGNo and MonthEndDate ─────────────
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tdr_latest05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tdr_latest05;
    SELECT LGNo, MonthEndDate, CompromiseContractId, CompromiseContractStatusId, ApproveDate, TDRDate, ContractNo, InstallmentDueDate, MeasureId, MeasureName
    INTO #tdr_latest05
    FROM (
        SELECT
            rtdr.LGNo,
            m_snap.MonthEndDate,
            cc.CompromiseContractId,
            cc.CompromiseContractStatusId,
            cc.ApproveDate,
            cc.TDRDate,
            cc.ContractNo,
            cc.InstallmentDueDate,
            cc.MeasureId,
            m.MeasureName,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY rtdr.LGNo, m_snap.MonthEndDate
                ORDER BY cc.ApproveDate DESC, cc.CompromiseContractId DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MonthEndDate FROM #monthly05) m_snap
        JOIN TDRDataCompromiseContract cc ON cc.ApproveDate <= m_snap.MonthEndDate
        JOIN TDRDataCompromiseContractRelated rtdr ON rtdr.CompromiseContractId = cc.CompromiseContractId
        LEFT JOIN SystemMeasureMaster m ON m.MeasureId = cc.MeasureId
        WHERE (cc.ClosedDate IS NULL OR cc.ClosedDate > m_snap.MonthEndDate)
          AND rtdr.LGNo IN (SELECT DISTINCT LGNo FROM #ddr_info05)
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_tdr_latest05 ON #tdr_latest05 (LGNo, MonthEndDate);
    CREATE INDEX IX_tdr_latest05_lg ON #tdr_latest05 (LGNo);

    -- ── STEP 11b: Rank EOD rows only for monthly snapshots ───────────────────
    -- PDF pp4/11/16: display latest dated TDR, including closed/unapproved plans.
    -- This reporting history is separate from the active-plan calculation above.
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tdr_report05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tdr_report05;
    ;WITH ReportingTDR AS (
        SELECT rel.LGNo, m.MonthEndDate, cc.TDRDate,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rel.LGNo, m.MonthEndDate
                                  ORDER BY cc.TDRDate DESC, cc.CompromiseContractId DESC) AS rn
        FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MonthEndDate FROM #monthly05) m
        JOIN TDRDataCompromiseContract cc
          ON CAST(cc.TDRDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(m.MonthEndDate)
         AND cc.TDRDate > '1900-01-01'
        JOIN (
            SELECT CompromiseContractId, LGNo FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractRelated
            UNION
            SELECT CompromiseContractId, LGNo FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractLG
        ) rel ON rel.CompromiseContractId = cc.CompromiseContractId
        WHERE rel.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM #ddr_info05)
    )
    SELECT LGNo, MonthEndDate, TDRDate
    INTO #tdr_report05
    FROM ReportingTDR
    WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IX_tdr_report05 ON #tdr_report05 (LGNo, MonthEndDate);

    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#eom_source05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #eom_source05;
    SELECT
        ms.DebtorRelateId,
        ms.yr,
        ms.mn,
        ms.MonthEndDate,
        eom.CIFNo AS SnapshotCIFNo,
        eom.LGNo AS SnapshotLGNo,
        eom.DataDebtorCardId,
        eom.CurrentPaymentDate,
        eom.CloseDate,
        eom.PrincipalTotal,
        eom.DebtBalance,
        eom.AccruedInterestTotal,
        eom.ClaimPayDate,
        eom.DFDDate,
        eom.DPD,
        eom.IsTDR,
        eom.InstallmentsAmount,
        eom.TDRInstallments,
        eom.InstallmentOutstanding,
        eom.CaseTypeId,
        eom.FilingDate,
        eom.BlackCaseNo,
        eom.JmTrialDate,
        eom.RedCaseNo,
        eom.FrozenAssetDate,
        eom.OtherFrozenAssDate,
        eom.ReqRepayDate,
        eom.FilingAmount,
        eom.BankruptcyDate,
        eom.PetitionDate,
        eom.WithdrawDate,
        eom.WarrantDate,
        eom.JudgmentBankruptcyDate,
        eom.StatusLGId,
        eom.AmountDuty,
        eom.InstallmentPrincipal,
        eom.DebtAmount,
        eom.CompromiseContracApproveDate,
        eom.DebtorRelateTypeId,
        eom.SystemBankId,
        eom.MeasureName,
        eom.StatusPortId,
        eom.StatusPortDate,
        eom.TDRInstallmentDueDate,
        eom.AcknowDebtDate,
        eom.BadDebtDate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY ms.DebtorRelateId, ms.MonthEndDate
            ORDER BY ISNULL(eom.CreateDate, '1900-01-01') DESC,
                     ISNULL(eom.DataDebtorCardId, 0) DESC
        ) AS rn
    INTO #eom_source05
    FROM #monthly05 ms
    JOIN #ddr_info05 source_rel ON source_rel.DebtorRelateId=ms.DebtorRelateId
    JOIN DataLG source_lg ON source_lg.LGNo=source_rel.LGNo AND source_lg.Grade IN ('F','F1')
    JOIN dbo.DataEndOfDay eom WITH (INDEX(IX_EOD_DebtorRelate_AsOfDate))
      ON eom.DebtorRelateId = ms.DebtorRelateId
     AND eom.AsOfDate = ms.MonthEndDate
     AND (eom.IsDelete = 0 OR eom.IsDelete IS NULL);
    -- PDF p3 explicitly supplies zero DPD and balances for A-E2. No EOD
    -- balance or DFD is borrowed for these rows.
    INSERT INTO #eom_source05
