    DELETE FROM #ddr_info05 WHERE DebtorRelateId NOT IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying05);
    UPDATE di SET DebtorId=d.DebtorId FROM #ddr_info05 di JOIN #dd05 d ON d.DebtorRelateId=di.DebtorRelateId;

    -- PDF p14: one row per LG and identity; prefer the main role when duplicated
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#qualifying05_dedup') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #qualifying05_dedup;
    SELECT DebtorRelateId
    INTO #qualifying05_dedup
    FROM (
        SELECT
            di.DebtorRelateId,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY di.LGNo,
                             COALESCE(dd.IDCard, di.DebtorRelateId)
                ORDER BY CASE WHEN di.DebtorTypeId = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                         ISNULL(di.CreateDate, '1900-01-01') DESC, di.DebtorRelateId DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM #ddr_info05 di
        LEFT JOIN #dd05 dd ON dd.DebtorRelateId = di.DebtorRelateId
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1;

    DELETE FROM #qualifying05 WHERE DebtorRelateId NOT IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying05_dedup);
    DELETE FROM #ddr_info05 WHERE DebtorRelateId NOT IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying05_dedup);

    DELETE q FROM #qualifying05 q JOIN DataDebtorRelate r ON r.DebtorRelateId=q.DebtorRelateId
    WHERE @CIFNo<>'null' AND (r.CIFNo<>@CIFNo OR r.CIFNo IS NULL);
    DELETE FROM #ddr_info05 WHERE DebtorRelateId NOT IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying05);

    -- NCB Deep Detail: borrower count is LG-wide and identity-based.
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#borrower_count05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #borrower_count05;
    ;WITH BorrowerIdentity AS (
        SELECT LGNo, DebtorRelateId, IdentityNo
        FROM (
            SELECT r.LGNo, r.DebtorRelateId,
                   CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.IDCard)), '') IS NOT NULL
                             AND d.IDCard NOT LIKE N'%ไม่พบ%' AND d.IDCard NOT LIKE N'%ไมพบ%'
                        THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(d.IDCard))
 ELSE NULL END AS IdentityNo,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                       PARTITION BY r.DebtorRelateId
                       ORDER BY CASE WHEN d.DebtorId = r.DebtorId THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                                d.CreateDate DESC, d.DebtorId DESC
                   ) AS rn
            FROM DataDebtorRelate r
            -- Disjoint equality branches preserve the original OR match set.
            -- Exclude an ID match from the code branch so it appears exactly once.
            LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT br.DebtorRelateId AS MatchRelateId,
                       person.DebtorId, person.IDCard, person.CreateDate
                FROM DataDebtorRelate br
                JOIN DataDebtor person ON person.DebtorId = br.DebtorId
                WHERE br.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
                  AND (br.IsDelete = 0 OR br.IsDelete IS NULL)
                  AND br.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM #ddr_info05)
                UNION ALL
                SELECT br.DebtorRelateId AS MatchRelateId,
                       person.DebtorId, person.IDCard, person.CreateDate
                FROM DataDebtorRelate br
                JOIN DataDebtor person ON person.DebtorCode = br.DebtorCode
                WHERE br.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
                  AND (br.IsDelete = 0 OR br.IsDelete IS NULL)
                  AND br.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM #ddr_info05)
                  AND (br.DebtorId IS NULL OR person.DebtorId IS NULL
                       OR person.DebtorId <> br.DebtorId)
            ) d ON d.MatchRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId
            WHERE r.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
              AND (r.IsDelete = 0 OR r.IsDelete IS NULL)
              AND r.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM #ddr_info05)
        ) ranked
        WHERE rn = 1
    )
    SELECT LGNo,
           CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN IdentityNo IS NULL OR IdentityNo LIKE N'%ไม่พบ%'
                                   OR IdentityNo LIKE N'%ไมพบ%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
                THEN COUNT(DISTINCT IdentityNo) ELSE NULL END AS BorrowerCount
    INTO #borrower_count05
    FROM BorrowerIdentity
    GROUP BY LGNo;
    CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IX_borrower_count05 ON #borrower_count05 (LGNo);

    -- A-E2 uses the business date carried by TEMPDWHCBS; ImportDate only
    -- breaks ties between loads of the same business month.
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dwh05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dwh05;
    SELECT di.DebtorRelateId, d.*
    INTO #dwh05
    FROM #ddr_info05 di
    JOIN DataLG grade_lg ON grade_lg.LGNo=di.LGNo
         AND grade_lg.Grade IN ('A','B','C','D','E','E1','E2')
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) d2.eff_date,d2.asofdate,d2.customercode,d2.accountnumber,
            d2.idnumber,d2.idtype,d2.titlename,d2.firstname,d2.familyname,
            d2.dateofbirth,d2.address1,d2.sub_district,d2.district,d2.province,
            d2.postalcode,d2.data_type,d2.dateaccountopend,d2.dateaccountclosed,
            d2.creditlimited,d2.statuslg,d2.bankbranchcode,d2.ImportDate
        FROM dbo.TEMPDWHCBS d2
        WHERE d2.accountnumber=di.LGNo AND d2.customercode=di.CIFNo
          AND TRY_CONVERT(date,d2.eff_date)>=DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@EndDate),MONTH(@EndDate),1)
          AND TRY_CONVERT(date,d2.eff_date)<DATEADD(month,1,DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(@EndDate),MONTH(@EndDate),1))
          AND (NULLIF(CONVERT(nvarchar(50),d2.asofdate),N'') IS NULL
               OR TRY_CONVERT(date,d2.asofdate)=TRY_CONVERT(date,d2.eff_date))
        ORDER BY TRY_CONVERT(date,d2.eff_date) DESC,d2.ImportDate DESC,d2.TEMPId DESC
    ) d;
    CREATE INDEX IX_dwh05 ON #dwh05(DebtorRelateId);

    -- ── STEP 3: Monthly snapshot (last AsOfMonth per account per month) ──────
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#monthly05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #monthly05;
    SELECT
        e.DebtorRelateId,
        YEAR(e.AsOfMonth)  AS yr,
        MONTH(e.AsOfMonth) AS mn,
        MAX(e.AsOfMonth)   AS MonthEndDate
    INTO #monthly05
    FROM dbo.DataEndOfMonth e
    JOIN DataDebtorRelate source_rel ON source_rel.DebtorRelateId=e.DebtorRelateId
    JOIN DataLG source_lg ON source_lg.LGNo=source_rel.LGNo AND source_lg.Grade IN ('F','F1')
    WHERE e.DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying05)
      AND (e.IsDelete = 0 OR e.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND e.AsOfMonth BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
    GROUP BY e.DebtorRelateId, YEAR(e.AsOfMonth), MONTH(e.AsOfMonth);

    INSERT INTO #monthly05 (DebtorRelateId,yr,mn,MonthEndDate)
    SELECT d.DebtorRelateId,YEAR(@EndDate),MONTH(@EndDate),EOMONTH(@EndDate)
    FROM #dwh05 d WHERE d.accountnumber IS NOT NULL;

    -- Existing fallback remains for diagnostic/status work. The final identity
    -- guard excludes it when neither approved source exists.
    INSERT INTO #monthly05 (DebtorRelateId, yr, mn, MonthEndDate)
    SELECT q.DebtorRelateId, YEAR(@EndDate), MONTH(@EndDate), @EndDate
    FROM #qualifying05 q
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #monthly05 m WHERE m.DebtorRelateId = q.DebtorRelateId);

    CREATE INDEX IX_monthly05 ON #monthly05 (DebtorRelateId, MonthEndDate);

    -- ── STEP 4: DataDebtorStatusUpdate TOP 1 per DebtorRelateId/report month ─
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ssu05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ssu05;
    SELECT
        m.DebtorRelateId,
        m.MonthEndDate,
        ssu.StatusLegalId,
        ssu.StatusDebtorId,
        ssu.StatusPortId,
        ssu.StatusPortDate,
        ssu.UpdateDate
    INTO #ssu05
    FROM #monthly05 m
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            s.StatusLegalId,
            s.StatusDebtorId,
            s.StatusPortId,
            s.StatusPortDate,
            s.UpdateDate
        FROM DataDebtorStatusUpdate s
        WHERE s.DebtorRelateId = m.DebtorRelateId
          AND s.UpdateDate < DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(m.MonthEndDate), MONTH(m.MonthEndDate), 1))
        ORDER BY s.UpdateDate DESC
    ) ssu;
    CREATE INDEX IX_ssu05 ON #ssu05 (DebtorRelateId, MonthEndDate);

    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#s32_event05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #s32_event05;
    ;WITH S32Ids AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT TRY_CAST(v.value AS INT) AS StatusLegalId
        FROM #NCBCond05 c
        CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(REPLACE(c.ValueConditionExcute, N' ', N''), ',') v
        WHERE c.NCBStatusCode = 32
          AND c.ColumnName = 'StatusLegalId'
          AND TRY_CAST(v.value AS INT) IS NOT NULL
    )
    SELECT
        m.DebtorRelateId,
        m.MonthEndDate,
        MIN(s.UpdateDate) AS S32EventDate
    INTO #s32_event05
    FROM #monthly05 m
    JOIN DataDebtorStatusUpdate s
        ON s.DebtorRelateId = m.DebtorRelateId
       AND s.UpdateDate < DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(m.MonthEndDate), MONTH(m.MonthEndDate), 1))
    JOIN S32Ids ids
        ON ids.StatusLegalId = s.StatusLegalId
    GROUP BY m.DebtorRelateId, m.MonthEndDate;
    CREATE INDEX IX_s32_event05 ON #s32_event05 (DebtorRelateId, MonthEndDate);

    -- ── STEP 5: LTDataCaseMainDebtor TOP 1 per DebtorRelateId ────────────────
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#lt05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #lt05;
    SELECT DebtorRelateId, FilingDate, RedCaseNo, BlackCaseNo, JmTrialDate, WarrantDate,
           WithdrawDate, BankFilingDate, FilingAmount, DocumentDate, JudgmentBankruptcyDate,
           FrozenAssetDate, OtherFrozenAssDate, PetitionDate, BankruptcyDate,
           ReqRepayDate, BadDebtDate
    INTO #lt05
    FROM (
        SELECT DebtorRelateId, FilingDate, RedCaseNo, BlackCaseNo, JmTrialDate, WarrantDate,
               WithdrawDate, BankFilingDate, FilingAmount, DocumentDate, JudgmentBankruptcyDate,
               FrozenAssetDate, OtherFrozenAssDate, PetitionDate, BankruptcyDate,
               ReqRepayDate, BadDebtDate,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DebtorRelateId ORDER BY CreateDate DESC) AS rn
        FROM LTDataCaseMainDebtor
        WHERE DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying05)
          AND (IsCancel = 0 OR IsCancel IS NULL)
    ) x WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_lt05 ON #lt05 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- DWH source for the report month is materialized before #monthly05.

    -- ── STEP 7: DataDebtorAddress TOP 1 per DebtorRelateId ───────────────────
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dda05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dda05;
    SELECT ddr2.DebtorRelateId,
           a.AddressNumber, a.PlaceName, a.Soi, a.Road, a.ProvinceId, a.DistrictId, a.SubDistrictId, a.PostalCode
    INTO #dda05
    FROM #ddr_info05 ddr2
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1
            a2.AddressNumber, a2.PlaceName, a2.Soi, a2.Road, a2.ProvinceId, a2.DistrictId, a2.SubDistrictId, a2.PostalCode
        FROM (
            SELECT a3.AddressNumber, a3.PlaceName, a3.Soi, a3.Road, a3.ProvinceId, a3.DistrictId, a3.SubDistrictId, a3.PostalCode,
                   a3.IsDefault, a3.CreateDate, a3.DebtorAddressId,
                   0 AS src_priority
            FROM DataDebtorAddress a3
            WHERE a3.DebtorId = ddr2.DebtorId
            UNION ALL
            SELECT a3.AddressNumber, a3.PlaceName, a3.Soi, a3.Road, a3.ProvinceId, a3.DistrictId, a3.SubDistrictId, a3.PostalCode,
                   a3.IsDefault, a3.CreateDate, a3.DebtorAddressId,
                   1 AS src_priority
            FROM DataDebtorAddress a3
            WHERE a3.DebtorCode = ddr2.DebtorCode
              AND a3.DebtorId <> ddr2.DebtorId
        ) a2
        ORDER BY CASE WHEN a2.IsDefault = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                 CASE WHEN a2.ProvinceId IS NOT NULL OR a2.DistrictId IS NOT NULL OR a2.SubDistrictId IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                 a2.src_priority,
                 a2.CreateDate DESC,
                 a2.DebtorAddressId DESC
    ) a;
    CREATE INDEX IX_dda05 ON #dda05 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ── STEP 8: DataDebtorCard fallback per DebtorRelateId ───────────────────
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dc05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dc05;
    SELECT *
    INTO #dc05
    FROM (
        SELECT
            dc2.DebtorRelateId,
            dc2.DataDebtorCardId,
            dc2.CurrentPaymentDate,
            dc2.CloseDate,
            dc2.PrincipalTotal,
            dc2.DebtBalance,
            dc2.AccruedInterestTotal,
            dc2.ClaimPayDate,
            dc2.DFDDate,
            dc2.DPD,
            dc2.IsTDR,
            dc2.InstallmentsAmount,
            dc2.InstallmentPrincipal,
            dc2.DebtAmount,
            dc2.CompromiseContracApproveDate,
            dc2.SystemBankId,
            dc2.BadDebtDate,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.DebtorRelateId ORDER BY dc2.CreateDate DESC, dc2.DataDebtorCardId DESC) AS rn
        FROM DataDebtorCard dc2
        WHERE dc2.DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying05)
          AND (dc2.IsDelete = 0 OR dc2.IsDelete IS NULL)
    ) x WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_dc05 ON #dc05 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ── STEP 9: NCBStopConditionMaster ───────────────────────────────────────
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#sc05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #sc05;
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr2.DebtorRelateId
    INTO #sc05
    FROM #ddr_info05 ddr2
    JOIN NCBStopConditionMaster sc ON (sc.CIFNo = ddr2.CIFNo OR sc.LGNo = ddr2.LGNo) AND sc.IsActive = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_sc05 ON #sc05 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ── STEP 11a: TDR Latest Contract per LGNo and MonthEndDate ─────────────
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tdr_latest05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tdr_latest05;
    SELECT LGNo, MonthEndDate, CompromiseContractId, CompromiseContractStatusId, ApproveDate, TDRDate, ContractNo, InstallmentDueDate, MeasureId, MeasureName
    INTO #tdr_latest05
    FROM (
        SELECT
            rtdr.LGNo,
            m_snap.MonthEndDate,
            cc.CompromiseContractId,
            cc.CompromiseContractStatusId,
            cc.ApproveDate,
            cc.TDRDate,
            cc.ContractNo,
            cc.InstallmentDueDate,
            cc.MeasureId,
            m.MeasureName,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY rtdr.LGNo, m_snap.MonthEndDate
                ORDER BY cc.ApproveDate DESC, cc.CompromiseContractId DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MonthEndDate FROM #monthly05) m_snap
        JOIN TDRDataCompromiseContract cc ON cc.ApproveDate <= m_snap.MonthEndDate
        JOIN TDRDataCompromiseContractRelated rtdr ON rtdr.CompromiseContractId = cc.CompromiseContractId
        LEFT JOIN SystemMeasureMaster m ON m.MeasureId = cc.MeasureId
        WHERE (cc.ClosedDate IS NULL OR cc.ClosedDate > m_snap.MonthEndDate)
          AND rtdr.LGNo IN (SELECT DISTINCT LGNo FROM #ddr_info05)
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_tdr_latest05 ON #tdr_latest05 (LGNo, MonthEndDate);
    CREATE INDEX IX_tdr_latest05_lg ON #tdr_latest05 (LGNo);

    -- ── STEP 11b: Rank EOD rows only for monthly snapshots ───────────────────
    -- PDF pp4/11/16: display latest dated TDR, including closed/unapproved plans.
    -- This reporting history is separate from the active-plan calculation above.
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tdr_report05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tdr_report05;
    ;WITH ReportingTDR AS (
        SELECT rel.LGNo, m.MonthEndDate, cc.TDRDate,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rel.LGNo, m.MonthEndDate
                                  ORDER BY cc.TDRDate DESC, cc.CompromiseContractId DESC) AS rn
        FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MonthEndDate FROM #monthly05) m
        JOIN TDRDataCompromiseContract cc
          ON CAST(cc.TDRDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(m.MonthEndDate)
         AND cc.TDRDate > '1900-01-01'
        JOIN (
            SELECT CompromiseContractId, LGNo FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractRelated
            UNION
            SELECT CompromiseContractId, LGNo FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractLG
        ) rel ON rel.CompromiseContractId = cc.CompromiseContractId
        WHERE rel.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM #ddr_info05)
    )
    SELECT LGNo, MonthEndDate, TDRDate
    INTO #tdr_report05
    FROM ReportingTDR
    WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IX_tdr_report05 ON #tdr_report05 (LGNo, MonthEndDate);

    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#eom_source05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #eom_source05;
    SELECT
        ms.DebtorRelateId,
        ms.yr,
        ms.mn,
        ms.MonthEndDate,
        eom.CIFNo AS SnapshotCIFNo,
        eom.LGNo AS SnapshotLGNo,
        eom.DataDebtorCardId,
        eom.FirstName,
        eom.LastName,
        eom.BirthDate,
        eom.CurrentPaymentDate,
        eom.CloseDate,
        eom.PrincipalTotal,
        eom.DebtBalance,
        eom.AccruedInterestTotal,
        eom.ClaimPayDate,
        eom.DFDDate,
        eom.DPD,
        eom.IsTDR,
        eom.InstallmentsAmount,
        eom.TDRInstallments,
        eom.InstallmentOutstanding,
        eom.CaseTypeId,
        eom.FilingDate,
        eom.BlackCaseNo,
        eom.JmTrialDate,
        eom.RedCaseNo,
        eom.FrozenAssetDate,
        eom.OtherFrozenAssDate,
        eom.ReqRepayDate,
        eom.FilingAmount,
        eom.BankruptcyDate,
        eom.PetitionDate,
        eom.WithdrawDate,
        eom.WarrantDate,
        eom.JudgmentBankruptcyDate,
        eom.StatusLGId,
        eom.AmountDuty,
        eom.InstallmentPrincipal,
        eom.DebtAmount,
        eom.CompromiseContracApproveDate,
        eom.DebtorRelateTypeId,
        eom.SystemBankId,
        eom.MeasureName,
        eom.StatusPortId,
        eom.StatusPortDate,
        eom.TDRInstallmentDueDate,
        eom.AcknowDebtDate,
        eom.BadDebtDate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY ms.DebtorRelateId, ms.MonthEndDate
            ORDER BY ISNULL(eom.CreateDate, '1900-01-01') DESC,
                     ISNULL(eom.DataDebtorCardId, 0) DESC
        ) AS rn
    INTO #eom_source05
    FROM #monthly05 ms
    JOIN #ddr_info05 source_rel ON source_rel.DebtorRelateId=ms.DebtorRelateId
    JOIN DataLG source_lg ON source_lg.LGNo=source_rel.LGNo AND source_lg.Grade IN ('F','F1')
    JOIN dbo.DataEndOfMonth eom
      ON eom.DebtorRelateId = ms.DebtorRelateId
     AND eom.AsOfMonth = ms.MonthEndDate
     AND (eom.IsDelete = 0 OR eom.IsDelete IS NULL);
    -- PDF p3 explicitly supplies zero DPD and balances for A-E2. No EOD
    -- balance or DFD is borrowed for these rows.
    INSERT INTO #eom_source05
        (DebtorRelateId,yr,mn,MonthEndDate,SnapshotCIFNo,SnapshotLGNo,
         DataDebtorCardId,CloseDate,PrincipalTotal,DebtBalance,AccruedInterestTotal,
         DFDDate,DPD,IsTDR,InstallmentsAmount,TDRInstallments,InstallmentOutstanding,
         FilingDate,BlackCaseNo,JmTrialDate,RedCaseNo,FrozenAssetDate,
         OtherFrozenAssDate,ReqRepayDate,FilingAmount,BankruptcyDate,PetitionDate,
         WithdrawDate,WarrantDate,JudgmentBankruptcyDate,StatusLGId,AmountDuty,
         InstallmentPrincipal,DebtAmount,DebtorRelateTypeId,SystemBankId,BadDebtDate,rn)
    SELECT d.DebtorRelateId,YEAR(@EndDate),MONTH(@EndDate),EOMONTH(@EndDate),
           d.customercode,d.accountnumber,dc.DataDebtorCardId,
           TRY_CONVERT(datetime,d.dateaccountclosed),0,0,0,
           NULL,0,0,0,0,0,
           legal.FilingDate,legal.BlackCaseNo,legal.JmTrialDate,legal.RedCaseNo,
           legal.FrozenAssetDate,legal.OtherFrozenAssDate,legal.ReqRepayDate,legal.FilingAmount,
           legal.BankruptcyDate,legal.PetitionDate,legal.WithdrawDate,legal.WarrantDate,
           legal.JudgmentBankruptcyDate,TRY_CONVERT(int,d.statuslg),
           TRY_CONVERT(decimal(18,2),d.creditlimited),0,0,di.DebtorTypeId,
           dlg.BankId,legal.BadDebtDate,1
    FROM #dwh05 d
    JOIN #ddr_info05 di ON di.DebtorRelateId=d.DebtorRelateId
    JOIN DataLG dlg ON dlg.LGNo=di.LGNo
    LEFT JOIN #dc05 dc ON dc.DebtorRelateId=d.DebtorRelateId
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) cm.FilingDate,cm.BlackCaseNo,cm.JmTrialDate,
            cm.RedCaseNo,cm.FrozenAssetDate,cm.OtherFrozenAssDate,
            cm.ReqRepayDate,cm.FilingAmount,cm.BankruptcyDate,
            cm.PetitionDate,cm.WithdrawDate,cm.WarrantDate,
            cm.JudgmentBankruptcyDate,cm.BadDebtDate
        FROM dbo.LTDataCaseMainDebtor ltd
        JOIN dbo.LTDataCaseMain cm ON cm.CaseMainId=ltd.CaseMainId
        WHERE ltd.DebtorRelateId=d.DebtorRelateId
          AND (ltd.IsCancel=0 OR ltd.IsCancel IS NULL)
          AND COALESCE(cm.FilingDate,cm.CreateDate)<DATEADD(day,1,EOMONTH(@EndDate))
        ORDER BY COALESCE(cm.FilingDate,cm.CreateDate) DESC,
                 cm.CreateDate DESC,cm.CaseMainId DESC
    ) legal
    WHERE d.accountnumber IS NOT NULL;
    CREATE INDEX IX_eom_source05 ON #eom_source05 (DebtorRelateId, MonthEndDate, rn);

    -- ── STEP 11b2: Previous month snapshot fallback for DFD/DPD ───────────────
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#eom_prev05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #eom_prev05;
    SELECT
        ms.DebtorRelateId,
        ms.MonthEndDate,
        e_prev.DFDDate AS PrevDFDDate,
        e_prev.DPD AS PrevDPD
    INTO #eom_prev05
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT ms1.DebtorRelateId, ms1.MonthEndDate
        FROM #monthly05 ms1
        JOIN #eom_source05 eom1 ON eom1.DebtorRelateId = ms1.DebtorRelateId AND eom1.MonthEndDate = ms1.MonthEndDate AND eom1.rn = 1
        WHERE (eom1.DFDDate IS NULL OR eom1.DFDDate <= '1900-01-01')
          -- A month-end source's empty DFD is not replaced by last month's DFD.
          AND CONVERT(date, eom1.MonthEndDate) <> EOMONTH(ms1.MonthEndDate)
    ) ms
    JOIN dbo.DataEndOfMonth e_prev
      ON e_prev.DebtorRelateId = ms.DebtorRelateId
     AND e_prev.AsOfMonth = EOMONTH(DATEADD(MONTH, -1, ms.MonthEndDate))
     AND e_prev.DFDDate > '1900-01-01'
     AND (e_prev.IsDelete = 0 OR e_prev.IsDelete IS NULL);
    CREATE INDEX IX_eom_prev05 ON #eom_prev05 (DebtorRelateId, MonthEndDate);

    -- ── STEP 11c: Materialize #eom05 with fallbacks ──────────────────────────
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#eom05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #eom05;
    SELECT
        ms.DebtorRelateId,
        report_tdr.TDRDate AS ReportTDRDate,
        ms.yr,
        ms.mn,
        ms.MonthEndDate,
        eom.SnapshotCIFNo,
        eom.SnapshotLGNo,
        COALESCE(eom.DataDebtorCardId, dc.DataDebtorCardId) AS DataDebtorCardId,
        eom.FirstName,
        eom.LastName,
        eom.BirthDate,
        eom.CurrentPaymentDate AS CurrentPaymentDate,
        eom.CloseDate AS CloseDate,
        eom.PrincipalTotal AS PrincipalTotal,
        eom.DebtBalance AS DebtBalance,
        eom.AccruedInterestTotal AS AccruedInterestTotal,
        eom.ClaimPayDate AS ClaimPayDate,
        eom.DFDDate AS DFDDate,
        eom.DPD AS DPD,
        -- Effective TDR
        CASE
            WHEN tdr_rel.ApproveDate IS NOT NULL AND tdr_rel.ApproveDate > '1900-01-01'
                 AND ISNULL(tdr_rel.CompromiseContractStatusId, 0) NOT IN (60, 61) THEN 1
            ELSE ISNULL(COALESCE(eom.IsTDR, dc.IsTDR), 0)
        END AS IsTDR,
        eom.InstallmentsAmount AS InstallmentsAmount,
        eom.TDRInstallments,
        eom.InstallmentOutstanding,
        eom.CaseTypeId,
        eom.FilingDate,
        eom.BlackCaseNo,
        eom.JmTrialDate,
        eom.RedCaseNo,
        eom.FrozenAssetDate,
        eom.OtherFrozenAssDate,
        eom.ReqRepayDate,
        eom.FilingAmount,
        eom.BankruptcyDate,
        eom.PetitionDate,
        eom.WithdrawDate,
        eom.WarrantDate,
        eom.JudgmentBankruptcyDate,
        eom.StatusLGId,
        eom.AmountDuty,
        eom.InstallmentPrincipal AS InstallmentPrincipal,
        eom.DebtAmount AS DebtAmount,
        -- Effective TDR Approve Date
        CASE
            WHEN tdr_rel.ApproveDate IS NOT NULL AND tdr_rel.ApproveDate > '1900-01-01' THEN tdr_rel.ApproveDate
            ELSE COALESCE(eom.CompromiseContracApproveDate, dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate, '1900-01-01')
        END AS CompromiseContracApproveDate,
        COALESCE(eom.DebtorRelateTypeId, di.DebtorTypeId) AS DebtorRelateTypeId,
        eom.SystemBankId AS SystemBankId,
        report_measure.MeasureName AS MeasureName,
        report_measure.CompromiseContractMeasureId AS ReportMeasureId,
        eom.StatusPortId AS StatusPortId,
        eom.StatusPortDate AS StatusPortDate,
        eom.TDRInstallmentDueDate AS TDRInstallmentDueDate,
        ISNULL(eom.AcknowDebtDate, '1900-01-01') AS AcknowDebtDate,
        -- Derived DFD
        CASE WHEN dlg_source.ClaimDate > '1900-01-01'
                   AND CAST(dlg_source.ClaimDate AS DATE)<=EOMONTH(ms.MonthEndDate)
                   AND ((eom.FrozenAssetDate>'1900-01-01' AND eom.FrozenAssetDate<dlg_source.ClaimDate)
                     OR (eom.OtherFrozenAssDate>'1900-01-01' AND eom.OtherFrozenAssDate<dlg_source.ClaimDate)
                     OR (eom.JudgmentBankruptcyDate>'1900-01-01' AND eom.JudgmentBankruptcyDate<dlg_source.ClaimDate
                         AND eom.ReqRepayDate>'1900-01-01' AND eom.ReqRepayDate<dlg_source.ClaimDate))
             THEN dlg_source.ClaimDate ELSE eom.DFDDate END AS DerivedDFD,
        -- Derived DPD
        eom.DPD AS DerivedDPD,
        eom.BadDebtDate AS BadDebtDate
    INTO #eom05
    FROM #monthly05 ms
    JOIN #ddr_info05 di ON di.DebtorRelateId = ms.DebtorRelateId
    JOIN DataLG dlg_source ON dlg_source.LGNo = di.LGNo
    LEFT JOIN #tdr_report05 report_tdr ON report_tdr.LGNo = di.LGNo AND report_tdr.MonthEndDate = ms.MonthEndDate
    LEFT JOIN #eom_source05 eom ON eom.DebtorRelateId = ms.DebtorRelateId AND eom.MonthEndDate = ms.MonthEndDate AND eom.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN #eom_prev05 prev_eod ON prev_eod.DebtorRelateId = ms.DebtorRelateId AND prev_eod.MonthEndDate = ms.MonthEndDate
    LEFT JOIN #dc05 dc ON dc.DebtorRelateId = ms.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #tdr_latest05 tdr_rel ON tdr_rel.LGNo = di.LGNo AND tdr_rel.MonthEndDate = ms.MonthEndDate
    LEFT JOIN #ssu05 ssu ON ssu.DebtorRelateId = ms.DebtorRelateId AND ssu.MonthEndDate = ms.MonthEndDate
    OUTER APPLY (
        -- PDF borrower measure interval: period belongs to this LG's measure.
        SELECT TOP (1) m.MeasureName,cm.CompromiseContractMeasureId
        FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractMeasure cm
        JOIN SystemMeasureMaster m ON m.MeasureId=cm.MeasureId
        WHERE cm.StartDate > '1900-01-01'
          AND CAST(cm.StartDate AS date)<=CAST(ms.MonthEndDate AS date)
          AND cm.EndDate > '1900-01-01'
          AND CAST(cm.EndDate AS date)>=CAST(ms.MonthEndDate AS date)
          AND (cm.CompromiseContractLGId IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractLG cl
                WHERE cl.CompromiseContractLGId=cm.CompromiseContractLGId
                  AND cl.CompromiseContractId=cm.CompromiseContractId AND cl.LGNo=di.LGNo)
            OR cm.CompromiseContractLGId IS NULL AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractRelated rel
                WHERE rel.CompromiseContractId=cm.CompromiseContractId AND rel.LGNo=di.LGNo
                UNION ALL
                SELECT 1 FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractLG cl
                WHERE cl.CompromiseContractId=cm.CompromiseContractId AND cl.LGNo=di.LGNo))
        ORDER BY cm.StartDate DESC,cm.Seq DESC,cm.CreateDate DESC,cm.CompromiseContractMeasureId DESC
    ) report_measure
;
    CREATE INDEX IX_eom05 ON #eom05 (DebtorRelateId, MonthEndDate);

    -- ── STEP 12: Pre-compute Conditions ──────────────────────────────────────
    -- PDF p27: use the last report BEFORE this month; reruns cannot self-qualify.
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#previous_report05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #previous_report05;
    ;WITH PreviousPeriod AS (
        SELECT di.LGNo, di.CIFNo, eom.MonthEndDate, MAX(h.period) AS PreviousPeriod
        FROM #eom05 eom
        JOIN #ddr_info05 di ON di.DebtorRelateId = eom.DebtorRelateId
        LEFT JOIN ncb_internal.NCBConsumerData h ON h.account_number = di.LGNo AND h.customer_code = di.CIFNo
             AND h.period < CONVERT(char(7), eom.MonthEndDate, 126)
        GROUP BY di.LGNo, di.CIFNo, eom.MonthEndDate
    )
    SELECT p.LGNo, p.CIFNo, p.MonthEndDate,
           CASE WHEN COUNT(h.account_status) > 0
                     AND MIN(CASE WHEN h.account_status = @S21 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
                THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Was21
    INTO #previous_report05
    FROM PreviousPeriod p
    LEFT JOIN ncb_internal.NCBConsumerData h ON h.account_number = p.LGNo AND h.customer_code = p.CIFNo
         AND h.period = p.PreviousPeriod
    GROUP BY p.LGNo, p.CIFNo, p.MonthEndDate;
    -- END previous report
    CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IX_previous_report05 ON #previous_report05 (LGNo, CIFNo, MonthEndDate);

    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#cond05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #cond05;
    SELECT
        eom.DebtorRelateId,
        eom.MonthEndDate,
        CASE WHEN eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01'
                   AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
                   AND ((eom.FrozenAssetDate > '1900-01-01' AND eom.FrozenAssetDate < eom.ClaimPayDate)
                     OR (eom.OtherFrozenAssDate > '1900-01-01' AND eom.OtherFrozenAssDate < eom.ClaimPayDate)
                     OR (eom.JudgmentBankruptcyDate > '1900-01-01' AND eom.JudgmentBankruptcyDate < eom.ClaimPayDate
                         AND eom.ReqRepayDate > '1900-01-01' AND eom.ReqRepayDate < eom.ClaimPayDate))
             THEN eom.ClaimPayDate ELSE eom.DerivedDFD END AS ReportDFD,
        CASE WHEN eom.ReportTDRDate > '1900-01-01'
                   AND YEAR(eom.ReportTDRDate) = YEAR(eom.MonthEndDate)
                   AND MONTH(eom.ReportTDRDate) = MONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
                   AND eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01'
                   AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
                   AND dlg_rule.Grade IN ('E1', 'E2', 'F', 'F1')
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsTDRReset,
        CASE WHEN eom.CloseDate > '1900-01-01'
                   AND CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
                   AND ((eom.DebtBalance = 0 AND eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01'
                         AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) AND dlg_rule.Grade IN ('F', 'F1'))
                     OR ((eom.ClaimPayDate IS NULL OR eom.ClaimPayDate <= '1900-01-01'
                          OR CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) > EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate))
                         AND dlg_rule.Grade IN ('A','B','C','D','E','E1','E2') AND eom.StatusLGId=500))
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsS11,
        CASE WHEN eom.ReportMeasureId IS NOT NULL AND eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) AND dlg_rule.Grade IN ('F', 'F1') AND eom.ReportTDRDate > '1900-01-01' AND eom.DerivedDFD > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.DerivedDFD AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) AND eom.DerivedDPD > 0 AND (eom.CloseDate IS NULL OR eom.CloseDate <= '1900-01-01' OR CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE)>EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate))
             THEN CASE WHEN 1=1
              AND (eom.MeasureName LIKE N'%พักหนี้%' OR eom.MeasureName LIKE N'%พักชำระหนี้%' OR eom.MeasureName LIKE N'%ตั้งพัก%')
              AND eom.MeasureName NOT LIKE N'%เปราะบาง%'
              AND eom.MeasureName NOT LIKE N'%เกษตร%'
              AND (
                  @S12_HasCond = 0 OR NOT EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond05 c WHERE c.NCBStatusCode = 12
                      AND CASE
                          WHEN c.ColumnName='MeasureName' THEN
                              CASE WHEN c.Operator='LIKE'         THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.MeasureName,'') LIKE c.ValueConditionExcute,1,0)
                                   WHEN c.Operator='contains'     THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.MeasureName,'') LIKE '%'+c.ValueConditionExcute+'%',1,0)
                                   WHEN c.Operator='='            THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.MeasureName,'')=c.ValueConditionExcute,1,0)
                                   WHEN c.Operator IN('<>','!=')  THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.MeasureName,'')<>c.ValueConditionExcute,1,0)
                                   ELSE 0 END
                          WHEN c.ColumnName='DPD' THEN
                              CASE WHEN c.Operator='>=' THEN IIF(eom.DerivedDPD>=TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                   WHEN c.Operator='<=' THEN IIF(eom.DerivedDPD<=TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                   WHEN c.Operator='>'  THEN IIF(eom.DerivedDPD> TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                   WHEN c.Operator='<'  THEN IIF(eom.DerivedDPD< TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                   WHEN c.Operator='='  THEN IIF(eom.DerivedDPD= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                   ELSE 0 END
                          WHEN c.ColumnName='IsTDR' THEN
                              CASE WHEN c.Operator='='           THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.IsTDR,0)= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                   WHEN c.Operator IN('<>','!=') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.IsTDR,0)<>TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                   ELSE 0 END
                          WHEN c.ColumnName='DebtBalance' THEN
                              CASE WHEN c.Operator IN('>=','>') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DebtBalance,0)>=TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)),1,0)
                                   WHEN c.Operator IN('<=','<') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DebtBalance,0)<=TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)),1,0)
                                   WHEN c.Operator='='          THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DebtBalance,0)= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)),1,0)
                                   ELSE 0 END
                          ELSE 0 END = 0)
              )
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS IsS12,
        CASE WHEN eom.ReportMeasureId IS NOT NULL AND eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) AND dlg_rule.Grade IN ('F', 'F1') AND eom.ReportTDRDate > '1900-01-01' AND eom.DerivedDFD > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.DerivedDFD AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) AND eom.DerivedDPD > 0 AND (eom.CloseDate IS NULL OR eom.CloseDate <= '1900-01-01' OR CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE)>EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate))
             THEN CASE WHEN (
            (@S13_HasCond = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond05 c WHERE c.NCBStatusCode = 13
                AND CASE
                    WHEN c.ColumnName='MeasureName' THEN
                        CASE WHEN c.Operator='LIKE'         THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.MeasureName,'') LIKE c.ValueConditionExcute,1,0)
                             WHEN c.Operator='contains'     THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.MeasureName,'') LIKE '%'+c.ValueConditionExcute+'%',1,0)
                             WHEN c.Operator='='            THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.MeasureName,'')=c.ValueConditionExcute,1,0)
                             WHEN c.Operator IN('<>','!=')  THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.MeasureName,'')<>c.ValueConditionExcute,1,0)
                             ELSE 0 END
                    WHEN c.ColumnName='DPD' THEN
                        CASE WHEN c.Operator='>=' THEN IIF(eom.DerivedDPD>=TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                             WHEN c.Operator='<=' THEN IIF(eom.DerivedDPD<=TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                             WHEN c.Operator='>'  THEN IIF(eom.DerivedDPD> TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                             WHEN c.Operator='<'  THEN IIF(eom.DerivedDPD< TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                             WHEN c.Operator='='  THEN IIF(eom.DerivedDPD= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                             ELSE 0 END
                    WHEN c.ColumnName='IsTDR' THEN
                        CASE WHEN c.Operator='='           THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.IsTDR,0)= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                             WHEN c.Operator IN('<>','!=') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.IsTDR,0)<>TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                             ELSE 0 END
                    WHEN c.ColumnName='DebtBalance' THEN
                        CASE WHEN c.Operator IN('>=','>') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DebtBalance,0)>=TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)),1,0)
                             WHEN c.Operator IN('<=','<') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DebtBalance,0)<=TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)),1,0)
                             WHEN c.Operator='='          THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DebtBalance,0)= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)),1,0)
                             ELSE 0 END
                    ELSE 0 END = 0))
            OR eom.MeasureName LIKE N'%พักชำระหนี้ตามนโยบายรัฐ%'
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS IsS13,
        CASE WHEN eom.ReportMeasureId IS NOT NULL AND eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) AND dlg_rule.Grade IN ('F', 'F1') AND eom.ReportTDRDate > '1900-01-01' AND eom.DerivedDFD > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.DerivedDFD AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) AND eom.DerivedDPD > 0 AND (eom.CloseDate IS NULL OR eom.CloseDate <= '1900-01-01' OR CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE)>EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate))
             THEN CASE WHEN eom.ClaimPayDate>'1900-01-01'
             AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS date)<=EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
             AND dlg_rule.Grade IN ('F', 'F1') AND eom.ReportTDRDate>'1900-01-01'
             AND (dbo.Fn_NCBFarmerMoratorium(eom.MeasureName)=1
                  OR (@S14_HasCond = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond05 c WHERE c.NCBStatusCode = 14
            AND CASE
                WHEN c.ColumnName='MeasureName' THEN
                    CASE WHEN c.Operator='LIKE'         THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.MeasureName,'') LIKE c.ValueConditionExcute,1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator='contains'     THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.MeasureName,'') LIKE '%'+c.ValueConditionExcute+'%',1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator='='            THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.MeasureName,'')=c.ValueConditionExcute,1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator IN('<>','!=')  THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.MeasureName,'')<>c.ValueConditionExcute,1,0)
                         ELSE 0 END
                WHEN c.ColumnName='DPD' THEN
                    CASE WHEN c.Operator='>=' THEN IIF(eom.DerivedDPD>=TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator='<=' THEN IIF(eom.DerivedDPD<=TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator='>'  THEN IIF(eom.DerivedDPD> TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator='<'  THEN IIF(eom.DerivedDPD< TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator='='  THEN IIF(eom.DerivedDPD= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                         ELSE 0 END
                WHEN c.ColumnName='IsTDR' THEN
                    CASE WHEN c.Operator='='           THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.IsTDR,0)= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator IN('<>','!=') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.IsTDR,0)<>TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                         ELSE 0 END
                WHEN c.ColumnName='DebtBalance' THEN
                    CASE WHEN c.Operator IN('>=','>') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DebtBalance,0)>=TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)),1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator IN('<=','<') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DebtBalance,0)<=TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)),1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator='='          THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DebtBalance,0)= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)),1,0)
                         ELSE 0 END
                ELSE 0 END = 0)
        )) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS IsS14,
        CASE WHEN eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) AND dlg_rule.Grade IN ('F', 'F1') AND (eom.CloseDate IS NULL OR eom.CloseDate <= '1900-01-01' OR CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE)>EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)) AND eom.DerivedDFD > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.DerivedDFD AS DATE)<=EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) AND eom.DerivedDPD>90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsS20,
        CASE WHEN eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
              AND (eom.CloseDate IS NULL OR eom.CloseDate <= '1900-01-01' OR CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE) > EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate))
              AND (
                  (eom.FrozenAssetDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.FrozenAssetDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate))
                  OR (eom.OtherFrozenAssDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.OtherFrozenAssDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate))
                  OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SystemCaseTypeMaster ct WHERE ct.CaseTypeId = eom.CaseTypeId AND ct.CaseTypeName = N'แพ่ง')
                      AND eom.FilingDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.FilingDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
                      AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(eom.BlackCaseNo)), '') IS NOT NULL
                      AND (eom.ReportTDRDate IS NULL OR eom.ReportTDRDate <= '1900-01-01')
                      AND (eom.WithdrawDate IS NULL OR eom.WithdrawDate <= '1900-01-01' OR CAST(eom.WithdrawDate AS DATE) > EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) OR eom.WithdrawDate < eom.FilingDate))
              ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsS30,
        CASE WHEN eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
              AND (eom.CloseDate IS NULL OR eom.CloseDate <= '1900-01-01' OR CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE) > EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate))
              AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SystemCaseTypeMaster ct WHERE ct.CaseTypeId = eom.CaseTypeId AND ct.CaseTypeName = N'แพ่ง')
              AND eom.FilingDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.FilingDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
              AND eom.JmTrialDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.JmTrialDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
              AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(eom.RedCaseNo)), '') IS NOT NULL
              AND eom.ReportTDRDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.ReportTDRDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
              AND (eom.WithdrawDate IS NULL OR eom.WithdrawDate <= '1900-01-01' OR CAST(eom.WithdrawDate AS DATE) > EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) OR eom.WithdrawDate < eom.FilingDate)
              THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsS31,
        0 AS IsS32,
        CASE WHEN eom.BadDebtDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.BadDebtDate AS DATE)<=EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsS33,
        CASE WHEN eom.DerivedDPD>90 AND eom.StatusPortDate>'1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.StatusPortDate AS DATE)<=EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) THEN CASE WHEN (
            @S42_HasCond = 1 AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond05 c WHERE c.NCBStatusCode = 42 AND c.ColumnName='StatusPortId'
                  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM STRING_SPLIT(REPLACE(c.ValueConditionExcute,N' ',N''), ',') v WHERE TRY_CAST(v.value AS INT) = ISNULL(eom.StatusPortId,0))
            )
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS IsS42,
        0 AS IsS43,
        0 AS IsS44,
        CASE WHEN previous_report.Was21 = 1
                   AND eom.ReportTDRDate > '1900-01-01'
                   AND CAST(eom.ReportTDRDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
                   AND eom.DerivedDPD > 90
                   AND eom.DerivedDFD > '1900-01-01'
                   AND CAST(eom.DerivedDFD AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
                   AND eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01'
                   AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
                   AND dlg_rule.Grade IN ('F', 'F1')
                   AND (eom.CloseDate IS NULL OR eom.CloseDate <= '1900-01-01'
                        OR eom.CloseDate > EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate))
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsS21
    INTO #cond05
    FROM #eom05 eom
    JOIN #ddr_info05 di ON di.DebtorRelateId = eom.DebtorRelateId
    JOIN DataLG dlg_rule ON dlg_rule.LGNo = di.LGNo
    LEFT JOIN #previous_report05 previous_report ON previous_report.LGNo = di.LGNo
         AND previous_report.CIFNo = di.CIFNo AND previous_report.MonthEndDate = eom.MonthEndDate
    LEFT JOIN #dc05 dc ON dc.DebtorRelateId = eom.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #lt05 lt ON lt.DebtorRelateId = eom.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #ssu05 ssu
        ON ssu.DebtorRelateId = eom.DebtorRelateId
       AND ssu.MonthEndDate = eom.MonthEndDate;
    CREATE INDEX IX_cond05 ON #cond05 (DebtorRelateId, MonthEndDate);
    UPDATE #cond05 SET IsS12=0, IsS13=0 WHERE IsS14=1;

    -- ── STEP 13: Build dynamic status match ──────────────────────────────────
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#status_match05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #status_match05;
    ;WITH Candidate AS (
        SELECT
            cond.DebtorRelateId,
            cond.MonthEndDate,
            v.NCBStatusCode
        FROM #cond05 cond
        CROSS APPLY (VALUES
            (42, cond.IsS42),
            (33, cond.IsS33),
            (11, cond.IsS11),
            (31, cond.IsS31),
            (30, cond.IsS30),
            (13, cond.IsS13),
            (14, cond.IsS14),
            (12, cond.IsS12),
            (21, cond.IsS21),
            (20, cond.IsS20)
        ) v(NCBStatusCode, IsMatch)
        WHERE v.IsMatch = 1
    )
    SELECT DebtorRelateId, MonthEndDate, NCBStatusCode, AccountStatus
    INTO #status_match05
    FROM (
        SELECT
            c.DebtorRelateId,
            c.MonthEndDate,
            c.NCBStatusCode,
            CAST(nsm.CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) AS AccountStatus,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY c.DebtorRelateId, c.MonthEndDate
                ORDER BY CASE c.NCBStatusCode
                    WHEN 42 THEN 10 WHEN 43 THEN 11 WHEN 44 THEN 12
                    WHEN 32 THEN 13 WHEN 33 THEN 20 WHEN 11 THEN 30 WHEN 31 THEN 40 WHEN 30 THEN 50
                    WHEN 13 THEN 60 WHEN 14 THEN 70 WHEN 12 THEN 80 WHEN 21 THEN 90
                    WHEN 20 THEN 100 WHEN 10 THEN 999 ELSE 500 END,
                    c.NCBStatusCode
            ) AS rn
        FROM Candidate c
        JOIN NCBStatusMaster nsm ON nsm.NCBStatusCode = c.NCBStatusCode
                                AND nsm.PersonType = 1
                                AND nsm.IsActive = 1
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_status_match05 ON #status_match05 (DebtorRelateId, MonthEndDate);

    IF (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.NCBMemberMaster WHERE ReportType=1 AND IsActive=1)<>1
        THROW 51527,'NCBMemberMaster needs one active Consumer (ReportType=1) code.',1;

    -- ── STEP 14: Final Assemble into #ncbresult05 ────────────────────────────
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ncbresult05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ncbresult05;
    SELECT
        eom.SnapshotCIFNo                                               AS customer_code,
        CASE WHEN dlg.Grade IN ('A','B','C','D','E','E1','E2')
             THEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(dwh.idnumber)),N'') ELSE card.CardId END AS card_id,
        dbo.Fn_NCBEffectiveDate_BE(mo.CutOff)                             AS eff_date,
        CASE WHEN dwh.accountnumber IS NOT NULL THEN dwh.firstname ELSE eom.FirstName END AS first_name,
        CASE WHEN dwh.accountnumber IS NOT NULL THEN dwh.familyname ELSE eom.LastName END AS family_name1,
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(datetime,dwh.dateofbirth),eom.BirthDate) > '1900-01-01'
                  THEN dbo.Fn_NCBDate_CE(CASE WHEN YEAR(COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(datetime,dwh.dateofbirth),eom.BirthDate))>2400
                       THEN DATEADD(YEAR,-543,COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(datetime,dwh.dateofbirth),eom.BirthDate))
                       ELSE COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(datetime,dwh.dateofbirth),eom.BirthDate) END)
             ELSE '19000101'
        END                                                             AS date_of_birth,
        '1'                                                            AS customer_type,
        CASE WHEN dwh.accountnumber IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(dwh.idtype,N''),'00')
             ELSE COALESCE(id_map.NCBIdType,'00') END AS DebtorCodeType,
        CASE WHEN dwh.accountnumber IS NOT NULL THEN dwh.address1 ELSE ISNULL(CONCAT_WS(' ', NULLIF(dda.AddressNumber, ''), NULLIF(dda.PlaceName, ''), NULLIF(dda.Soi, ''), NULLIF(dda.Road, '')), '') END AS address1,
        CASE WHEN dwh.accountnumber IS NOT NULL THEN dwh.sub_district ELSE ISNULL(sub_dist.Name, '') END AS sub_district,
        CASE WHEN dwh.accountnumber IS NOT NULL THEN dwh.district ELSE ISNULL(dist.Name, '') END AS district,
        ISNULL(COALESCE(prov.Code, dist.ProvinceCode), '')              AS province_code,
        CASE WHEN dwh.accountnumber IS NOT NULL THEN dwh.province ELSE ISNULL(prov.Name, '') END AS province,
        'TH'                                                            AS country,
        CASE WHEN dwh.accountnumber IS NOT NULL THEN dwh.postalcode ELSE ISNULL(COALESCE(dda.PostalCode, sub_dist.PostCode), '') END AS pstal_code,
        member.MemberCode                                                AS member_code,
        member.MemberName                                                AS member_name,
        eom.SnapshotLGNo                                                        AS account_number,
        38                                                              AS account_type,
        CASE WHEN dwh.accountnumber IS NOT NULL THEN dwh.data_type
             ELSE CASE ddr.DebtorTypeId WHEN 1 THEN '01' WHEN 2 THEN '04'
             ELSE CAST(ISNULL(eom.DebtorRelateTypeId, ddr.DebtorTypeId) AS VARCHAR(10)) END END AS ownership_indicator,
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(datetime,dwh.dateaccountopend),dlg.LGDate) > '1900-01-01'
             THEN dbo.Fn_NCBDate_CE(COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(datetime,dwh.dateaccountopend),dlg.LGDate)) ELSE '19000101' END AS date_account_opened,
        CASE WHEN eom.CurrentPaymentDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.CurrentPaymentDate > '1900-01-01'
                  AND CAST(eom.CurrentPaymentDate AS DATE) <= mo.CutOff
             THEN dbo.Fn_NCBDate_CE(eom.CurrentPaymentDate)
             ELSE '19000101' END                                        AS date_of_last_payment,
        CASE WHEN eom.CloseDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.CloseDate > '1900-01-01'
                  AND CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE) <= mo.CutOff
             THEN dbo.Fn_NCBDate_CE(eom.CloseDate)
             ELSE '19000101'
        END                                                             AS date_account_closed,
        eom.AmountDuty                                                             AS credit_limit,
        CASE WHEN cond.IsS11=1 OR cond.IsS33=1 THEN 0 ELSE eom.DebtBalance END AS amount_owned,
        CASE WHEN (eom.CloseDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.CloseDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE) <= mo.CutOff) THEN 0
             ELSE ISNULL(eom.PrincipalTotal, 0) END                     AS principal_outstanding,
        CASE WHEN (eom.CloseDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.CloseDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE) <= mo.CutOff) THEN 0
             ELSE ISNULL(eom.AccruedInterestTotal, 0) END               AS accrued_interest,
        CASE WHEN (cond.IsTDRReset = 1 AND COALESCE(status_match.AccountStatus,@S10) IN (@S10,@S20,@S21,@S30) AND COALESCE(cond.IsS11,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS12,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS13,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS14,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS31,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS33,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS42,0)=0) OR cond.IsS11=1 OR cond.IsS33=1 OR status_match.AccountStatus IN (@S11,@S33) THEN 0 WHEN eom.DerivedDPD IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN eom.DerivedDPD=0 OR cond.ReportDFD IS NULL OR cond.ReportDFD<='1900-01-01' THEN 0 WHEN eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE)<=mo.CutOff THEN CASE WHEN eom.ReportTDRDate > '1900-01-01' THEN CASE WHEN eom.DerivedDPD BETWEEN 1 AND 90 THEN eom.InstallmentOutstanding WHEN eom.DerivedDPD>90 THEN eom.DebtBalance ELSE 0 END WHEN eom.DerivedDPD>30 THEN eom.DebtBalance ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS amount_past_due,
        CASE WHEN ((eom.BadDebtDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.BadDebtDate > '1900-01-01') OR (eom.BankruptcyDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.BankruptcyDate > '1900-01-01')) THEN CAST(ISNULL(eom.DebtBalance, 0) AS NVARCHAR(50))
             ELSE ''
        END                                                             AS write_of_amount,
        ''                                                              AS unit_make,
        NULL                                                            AS unit_model,
        CASE WHEN (cond.IsTDRReset = 1 AND COALESCE(status_match.AccountStatus,@S10) IN (@S10,@S20,@S21,@S30) AND COALESCE(cond.IsS11,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS12,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS13,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS14,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS31,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS33,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS42,0)=0) OR cond.IsS11=1 OR cond.IsS33=1 OR status_match.AccountStatus IN (@S11,@S33) OR ((cond.IsS30=1 OR cond.IsS31=1) AND (cond.ReportDFD IS NULL OR cond.ReportDFD<='1900-01-01') AND (eom.FrozenAssetDate IS NULL OR eom.FrozenAssetDate<='1900-01-01') AND (eom.OtherFrozenAssDate IS NULL OR eom.OtherFrozenAssDate<='1900-01-01')) OR eom.DerivedDPD=0 THEN @D0 WHEN eom.DerivedDPD IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE dpd_cfg.DPDOutputCode END AS number_of_days_past,
        CASE WHEN (cond.IsTDRReset = 1 AND COALESCE(status_match.AccountStatus,@S10) IN (@S10,@S20,@S21,@S30) AND COALESCE(cond.IsS11,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS12,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS13,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS14,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS31,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS33,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS42,0)=0) OR cond.IsS11=1 OR cond.IsS33=1 OR status_match.AccountStatus IN (@S11,@S33) OR ((cond.IsS30=1 OR cond.IsS31=1) AND (cond.ReportDFD IS NULL OR cond.ReportDFD<='1900-01-01') AND (eom.FrozenAssetDate IS NULL OR eom.FrozenAssetDate<='1900-01-01') AND (eom.OtherFrozenAssDate IS NULL OR eom.OtherFrozenAssDate<='1900-01-01')) THEN 0 ELSE eom.DerivedDPD END AS number_of_days_past_2,
        CASE WHEN (cond.IsTDRReset = 1 AND COALESCE(status_match.AccountStatus,@S10) IN (@S10,@S20,@S21,@S30) AND COALESCE(cond.IsS11,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS12,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS13,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS14,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS31,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS33,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS42,0)=0) OR cond.IsS11=1 OR cond.IsS33=1 OR status_match.AccountStatus IN (@S11,@S33) THEN '19000101' WHEN cond.ReportDFD > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(cond.ReportDFD AS DATE)<=mo.CutOff THEN dbo.Fn_NCBDate_CE(cond.ReportDFD) ELSE '19000101' END AS default_date,
        eom.InstallmentsAmount AS installment_amount,
        CASE WHEN (eom.CloseDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.CloseDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE) <= mo.CutOff) THEN 0
             ELSE ISNULL(eom.InstallmentPrincipal, 0) END               AS installment_principal,
        CASE WHEN (eom.CloseDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.CloseDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE) <= mo.CutOff) THEN 0
             ELSE eom.TDRInstallments
        END                                                             AS installment_number_of_payments,
        CASE WHEN (cond.IsTDRReset = 1 AND COALESCE(status_match.AccountStatus,@S10) IN (@S10,@S20,@S21,@S30) AND COALESCE(cond.IsS11,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS12,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS13,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS14,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS31,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS33,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS42,0)=0) AND COALESCE(cond.IsS30,0)=0 AND COALESCE(status_match.AccountStatus,@S10) NOT IN (@S12,@S13,@S14,@S31,@S33,@S42) THEN @S10 ELSE CASE WHEN cond.IsS42=1 THEN @S42 WHEN cond.IsS33=1 THEN @S33 WHEN cond.IsS11=1 THEN @S11 WHEN cond.IsS31=1 THEN @S31 WHEN cond.IsS30=1 THEN @S30 WHEN cond.IsS14=1 THEN @S14 WHEN cond.IsS13=1 THEN @S13 WHEN cond.IsS12=1 THEN @S12 WHEN cond.IsS21=1 THEN @S21 WHEN cond.IsS20=1 THEN @S20 WHEN status_match.AccountStatus IN (@S10,@S11,@S12,@S13,@S14,@S20,@S21,@S30,@S31,@S33,@S42) THEN status_match.AccountStatus ELSE @S10 END END AS account_status,
        CASE WHEN eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) <= mo.CutOff AND dlg.Grade IN ('E1', 'E2', 'F', 'F1')
             THEN CASE WHEN (eom.CloseDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.CloseDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE) <= mo.CutOff)
             THEN CASE WHEN eom.ReportTDRDate IS NOT NULL
                            AND eom.ReportTDRDate > '1900-01-01'
                            AND eom.ReportTDRDate < '2024-04-01'
                            AND CAST(eom.ReportTDRDate AS DATE) <= mo.CutOff
                       THEN dbo.Fn_NCBDate_CE(eom.ReportTDRDate)
                       ELSE '19000101' END
             WHEN eom.ReportTDRDate IS NOT NULL
                  AND eom.ReportTDRDate > '1900-01-01'
                  AND CAST(eom.ReportTDRDate AS DATE) <= mo.CutOff
             THEN dbo.Fn_NCBDate_CE(eom.ReportTDRDate)
             ELSE '19000101'
        END
             ELSE '19000101' END                                                             AS date_of_restructuring,
        CASE WHEN eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) <= mo.CutOff
                  AND dlg.Grade IN ('E1', 'E2', 'F', 'F1')
                  AND eom.ReportTDRDate >= '2024-04-01' AND CAST(eom.ReportTDRDate AS DATE) <= mo.CutOff
                  AND (eom.CloseDate IS NULL OR eom.CloseDate <= '1900-01-01' OR CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE) > mo.CutOff)
             THEN '02' ELSE '00' END                                                             AS code_of_restructuring,
        borrower_count.BorrowerCount                                    AS number_of_borrower,
        eom.StatusLGId                                                    AS status_lg,
        ''                                                              AS status_description_th,
        dlg.Grade                                                       AS status_grade,
        ssm.StatusName                                                  AS status,
        ssu.StatusDebtorId                                              AS status_id,
        CASE WHEN ssu.UpdateDate IS NOT NULL AND ssu.UpdateDate > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.Fn_NCBDate_CE(ssu.UpdateDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS status_update_date,
        CASE WHEN eom.FilingDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.FilingDate > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.Fn_NCBDate_CE(eom.FilingDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS case_filing_date,
        CASE WHEN lt.DocumentDate IS NOT NULL AND lt.DocumentDate > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.Fn_NCBDate_CE(lt.DocumentDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS case_register_date,
        CASE WHEN eom.JudgmentBankruptcyDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.JudgmentBankruptcyDate > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.Fn_NCBDate_CE(eom.JudgmentBankruptcyDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS case_judgement_date,
        CASE WHEN dlg.ClaimDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(dlg.ClaimDate AS DATE) <= mo.CutOff THEN dbo.Fn_NCBDate_CE(dlg.ClaimDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS claim_pay_date,
        CASE WHEN eom.ReqRepayDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.ReqRepayDate > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.Fn_NCBDate_CE(eom.ReqRepayDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS bkr_filing_date,
        eom.FilingAmount                                                 AS filing_amount,
        CASE WHEN eom.FrozenAssetDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.FrozenAssetDate > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.Fn_NCBDate_CE(eom.FrozenAssetDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS frozenassetdate,
        CASE WHEN eom.OtherFrozenAssDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.OtherFrozenAssDate > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.Fn_NCBDate_CE(eom.OtherFrozenAssDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS otherfrozenassdate,
        CASE WHEN eom.PetitionDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.PetitionDate > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.Fn_NCBDate_CE(eom.PetitionDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS petition_date,
        CASE WHEN eom.BankruptcyDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.BankruptcyDate > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.Fn_NCBDate_CE(eom.BankruptcyDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS bankruptcy_date,
        CASE WHEN eom.BadDebtDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.BadDebtDate > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.Fn_NCBDate_CE(eom.BadDebtDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS bad_debt_date,
        CASE WHEN eom.FilingDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.FilingDate > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.Fn_NCBDate_CE(eom.FilingDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS file_date_temp,
        eom.BlackCaseNo                                                  AS black_case_no,
        CASE WHEN eom.WithdrawDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.WithdrawDate > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.Fn_NCBDate_CE(eom.WithdrawDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS withdraw_date,
        CASE WHEN eom.WarrantDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.WarrantDate > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.Fn_NCBDate_CE(eom.WarrantDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS warrant_date,
        CASE WHEN eom.JmTrialDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.JmTrialDate > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.Fn_NCBDate_CE(eom.JmTrialDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS jm_trial_date,
        eom.RedCaseNo                                                    AS red_case_no,
        sb.BankName                                                     AS bank,
        CASE WHEN dwh.accountnumber IS NOT NULL THEN dwh.bankbranchcode ELSE sbb.BankBranchName END AS branch,
        ct.ClaimTypeName                                                AS project,
        cst.ClaimSubTypeName                                            AS sub_project,
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(datetime,dwh.dateaccountopend),dlg.LGDate) > '1900-01-01'
             THEN dbo.Fn_NCBDate_CE(COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(datetime,dwh.dateaccountopend),dlg.LGDate)) ELSE '19000101' END AS open_date_original,
        N'วันที่พิมพ์ : ' + dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(GETDATE())         AS PrintDate,
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR)                                          AS PrintName,
        dbo.Fn_NCBEffectiveDate_BE(mo.CutOff) AS as_of_date,
        active_contract.ContractNo AS contract_number,
        latest_contract.ContractNo AS last_contract_number,
        CASE WHEN dwh.accountnumber IS NOT NULL THEN dwh.titlename ELSE title.TitleName END AS thai_prefix,
        CASE WHEN latest_contract.InstallmentsEndDate > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.Fn_NCBDate_CE(latest_contract.InstallmentsEndDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS maturity_date,
        CASE WHEN dwh.accountnumber IS NOT NULL THEN
                  CASE WHEN dwh.idtype IN ('00','01','02','03','04','05','06','07','09') THEN 'MAPPED' ELSE 'UNMAPPED' END
             WHEN dd.SourceIdType IS NULL THEN 'UNSPECIFIED'
             WHEN id_map.NCBIdType IS NULL THEN 'UNMAPPED' ELSE 'MAPPED' END AS id_type_mapping_status,
        CASE WHEN eom.SnapshotCIFNo=ddr.CIFNo AND eom.SnapshotLGNo=ddr.LGNo AND CAST(eom.MonthEndDate AS DATE)=EOMONTH(mo.CutOff) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ReportSourceIdentityValid,
        CAST(3 AS tinyint) AS ReportSchemaVersion
    INTO #ncbresult05
    FROM #qualifying05 q
    JOIN DataDebtorRelate ddr ON ddr.DebtorRelateId = q.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #borrower_count05 borrower_count ON borrower_count.LGNo = ddr.LGNo
    JOIN DataLG dlg ON dlg.LGNo = ddr.LGNo
    OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP (1) m.MemberCode,m.MemberName
                 FROM dbo.NCBMemberMaster m WHERE m.ReportType=1 AND m.IsActive=1
                 ORDER BY m.NCBMemberId) member
    LEFT JOIN #eom05 eom ON eom.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    CROSS APPLY (SELECT ISNULL(EOMONTH(DATEFROMPARTS(eom.yr, eom.mn, 1)), @EndDate) AS CutOff) mo
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 dr.DPDOutputCode
        FROM #dpd_rule05 dr
        WHERE (dr.ExactValue   IS NULL OR eom.DerivedDPD =  dr.ExactValue)
          AND (dr.MinInclusive IS NULL OR eom.DerivedDPD >= dr.MinInclusive)
          AND (dr.MaxInclusive IS NULL OR eom.DerivedDPD <= dr.MaxInclusive)
          AND (dr.MinExclusive IS NULL OR eom.DerivedDPD >  dr.MinExclusive)
          AND (dr.MaxExclusive IS NULL OR eom.DerivedDPD <  dr.MaxExclusive)
        ORDER BY
            CASE WHEN dr.ExactValue IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
            ISNULL(dr.MinInclusive, dr.MinExclusive + 1) DESC,
            ISNULL(dr.MaxInclusive, dr.MaxExclusive - 1) ASC,
            dr.DPDCode
    ) dpd_cfg
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 tr.RestructureCode
        FROM (SELECT DISTINCT RestructureCodeId, RestructureCode, Oparators FROM #tdr_rule05) tr
        WHERE
            (
                ISNULL(tr.Oparators, 'AND') <> 'OR'
                AND NOT EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM #tdr_rule05 c
                    WHERE c.RestructureCodeId = tr.RestructureCodeId
                      AND c.ColumnName IS NOT NULL
                      AND (
                          CASE
                              WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('IsTDR') THEN
                                  CASE
                                      WHEN c.Operator IN ('=', 'Equal')
                                          THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.IsTDR, 0) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                      WHEN c.Operator IN ('<>', '!=')
                                          THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.IsTDR, 0) <> TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                      ELSE 0
                                  END
                              WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('CompromiseContracApproveDate') THEN
                                  CASE
                                      WHEN c.Operator IN ('>', 'MoreThan')
                                          THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.CompromiseContracApproveDate, '1900-01-01') > TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME), 1, 0)
                                      WHEN c.Operator IN ('<', 'LessThan')
                                          THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.CompromiseContracApproveDate, '1900-01-01') < TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME), 1, 0)
                                      WHEN c.Operator IN ('<=', 'MoreThanEqual')
                                          THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.CompromiseContracApproveDate, '1900-01-01') <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME), 1, 0)
                                      WHEN c.Operator IN ('=', 'Equal')
                                          THEN IIF(CONVERT(DATE, ISNULL(eom.CompromiseContracApproveDate, '1900-01-01')) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATE), 1, 0)
                                      ELSE 0
                                  END
                              ELSE 0
                          END
                      ) = 0
                )
            )
            OR
            (
                tr.Oparators = 'OR'
                AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM #tdr_rule05 c
                    WHERE c.RestructureCodeId = tr.RestructureCodeId
                      AND c.ColumnName IS NOT NULL
                      AND (
                          CASE
                              WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('IsTDR') THEN
                                  CASE
                                      WHEN c.Operator IN ('=', 'Equal')
                                          THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.IsTDR, 0) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                      WHEN c.Operator IN ('<>', '!=')
                                          THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.IsTDR, 0) <> TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                      ELSE 0
                                  END
                              WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('CompromiseContracApproveDate') THEN
                                  CASE
                                      WHEN c.Operator IN ('>', 'MoreThan')
                                          THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.CompromiseContracApproveDate, '1900-01-01') > TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME), 1, 0)
                                      WHEN c.Operator IN ('<', 'LessThan')
                                          THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.CompromiseContracApproveDate, '1900-01-01') < TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME), 1, 0)
                                      WHEN c.Operator IN ('<=', 'MoreThanEqual')
                                          THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.CompromiseContracApproveDate, '1900-01-01') <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME), 1, 0)
                                      WHEN c.Operator IN ('=', 'Equal')
                                          THEN IIF(CONVERT(DATE, ISNULL(eom.CompromiseContracApproveDate, '1900-01-01')) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATE), 1, 0)
                                      ELSE 0
                                  END
                              ELSE 0
                          END
                      ) = 1
                )
            )
        ORDER BY CASE WHEN tr.RestructureCode = @TDRDefaultCode05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, tr.RestructureCode
    ) tdr_cfg

    LEFT JOIN #dd05 dd ON dd.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN SystemTitleMaster title ON title.TitleId = dd.TitleId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.NCBReportIdTypeMap id_map ON id_map.SourceIdType=dd.SourceIdType
    LEFT JOIN #dda05 dda ON dda.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN SystemSubDistrictMaster sub_dist ON sub_dist.SubDistrictId = dda.SubDistrictId
    LEFT JOIN SystemDistrictMaster    dist     ON dist.DistrictId        = COALESCE(dda.DistrictId, sub_dist.DistrictId)
    LEFT JOIN SystemProvinceMaster    prov     ON prov.ProvinceId        = COALESCE(dda.ProvinceId, dist.ProvinceId, sub_dist.ProvinceId)
    LEFT JOIN #ssu05 ssu
        ON ssu.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
       AND ssu.MonthEndDate = eom.MonthEndDate

    LEFT JOIN SystemStatusMaster        ssm ON ssm.SystemStatusId      = ssu.StatusDebtorId
    LEFT JOIN SystemBankMaster           sb ON sb.BankId               = dlg.BankId
    LEFT JOIN SystemBankBranchMaster    sbb ON sbb.BankBranchId        = dlg.BankBranchId
    LEFT JOIN SystemClaimTypeMaster      ct ON ct.ClaimTypeId          = dlg.ClaimTypeId
    LEFT JOIN SystemClaimSubTypeMaster  cst ON cst.ClaimSubTypeId      = dlg.ClaimSubTypeId

    LEFT JOIN #lt05  lt  ON lt.DebtorRelateId  = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #dwh05 dwh ON dwh.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #dc05  dc  ON dc.DebtorRelateId  = ddr.DebtorRelateId

    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT
            CASE
                WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(dd.IDCard)), '') IS NOT NULL
                  AND LTRIM(RTRIM(dd.IDCard)) NOT LIKE N'%ไม่พบ%'
                  AND LTRIM(RTRIM(dd.IDCard)) NOT LIKE N'%ไมพบ%'
                    THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(dd.IDCard))
                ELSE NULL
            END AS CardId
    ) card
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) cc.ContractNo, cc.InstallmentsEndDate
        FROM TDRDataCompromiseContract cc
        WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractRelated rel
            WHERE rel.CompromiseContractId=cc.CompromiseContractId AND rel.LGNo=ddr.LGNo
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 1 FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractLG rel
            WHERE rel.CompromiseContractId=cc.CompromiseContractId AND rel.LGNo=ddr.LGNo
        )
          AND CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(cc.TDRDate,'1900-01-01'), cc.CreateDate) AS date) <= mo.CutOff
        ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(cc.TDRDate,'1900-01-01'),cc.CreateDate) DESC, cc.CompromiseContractId DESC
    ) latest_contract

    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) cc.ContractNo, cc.InstallmentsEndDate
        FROM TDRDataCompromiseContract cc
        WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractRelated rel
            WHERE rel.CompromiseContractId=cc.CompromiseContractId AND rel.LGNo=ddr.LGNo
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 1 FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractLG rel
            WHERE rel.CompromiseContractId=cc.CompromiseContractId AND rel.LGNo=ddr.LGNo
        )
          AND CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(cc.TDRDate,'1900-01-01'), cc.CreateDate) AS date) <= mo.CutOff
          AND (cc.CompromiseContractStatusId=58 OR (cc.CompromiseContractStatusId=61 AND CAST(cc.ClosedDate AS date)>mo.CutOff))
          AND cc.ApproveDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(cc.ApproveDate AS date)<=mo.CutOff
          AND (cc.ClosedDate IS NULL OR cc.ClosedDate<='1900-01-01' OR CAST(cc.ClosedDate AS date)>mo.CutOff)
        ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(cc.TDRDate,'1900-01-01'),cc.CreateDate) DESC, cc.CompromiseContractId DESC
    ) active_contract


    LEFT JOIN #cond05 cond ON cond.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId AND cond.MonthEndDate = eom.MonthEndDate
    LEFT JOIN #status_match05 status_match ON status_match.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId AND status_match.MonthEndDate = eom.MonthEndDate
    LEFT JOIN #s32_event05 s32_event ON s32_event.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId AND s32_event.MonthEndDate = eom.MonthEndDate

    LEFT JOIN #sc05 sc ON sc.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId

    WHERE 1=1
      -- PDF bankruptcy two-year boundary
      AND (eom.BankruptcyDate IS NULL OR eom.BankruptcyDate <= '1900-01-01'
           OR mo.CutOff <= DATEADD(YEAR, 2, eom.BankruptcyDate))
      -- END bankruptcy boundary
      -- Stop sending terminal/event statuses: report the event month only, exclude from following months.
      AND (eom.CloseDate IS NULL OR eom.CloseDate <= '1900-01-01' OR CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE) >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(eom.MonthEndDate), MONTH(eom.MonthEndDate), 1))        -- 11 ปิดบัญชี
      AND (COALESCE(cond.IsS33, 0) = 0 OR eom.BadDebtDate IS NULL OR eom.BadDebtDate <= '1900-01-01' OR eom.BadDebtDate >= @StartDate)                        -- 33 ตัดหนี้สูญ

      AND (COALESCE(cond.IsS42,0) = 0
           OR eom.StatusPortDate IS NULL OR eom.StatusPortDate <= '1900-01-01' OR eom.StatusPortDate >= @StartDate)             -- 42/43/44 ขายหนี้/โอนหนี้
      -- Calendar years from DFD, measured against recorded DPD.
      -- PDF five-year DPD boundary
      AND (eom.DerivedDPD IS NULL OR ((cond.ReportDFD IS NULL OR cond.ReportDFD <= '1900-01-01') AND eom.DerivedDPD <= 1917)
           OR CASE WHEN cond.IsTDRReset = 1
                  AND (eom.CloseDate IS NULL OR eom.CloseDate <= '1900-01-01' OR CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE) > mo.CutOff)
                  AND COALESCE(cond.IsS11, 0) + COALESCE(cond.IsS12, 0) + COALESCE(cond.IsS13, 0) + COALESCE(cond.IsS14, 0) + COALESCE(cond.IsS31, 0) + COALESCE(cond.IsS33, 0) + COALESCE(cond.IsS42, 0) = 0
                  AND COALESCE(status_match.AccountStatus, @S10) IN (@S10, @S20, @S21, @S30) THEN 0 ELSE eom.DerivedDPD END
                <= DATEDIFF(DAY, cond.ReportDFD, DATEADD(YEAR, 5, cond.ReportDFD)) + 90)
      -- END five-year boundary

    OPTION (RECOMPILE);

    -- Fixed A-E2 report values explicitly stated on SA PDF pp2-5. The
    -- account_status above still comes from the existing condition engine.
    UPDATE r SET amount_owned=0,amount_past_due=0,
        number_of_days_past='000',number_of_days_past_2=0,
        default_date='19000101',installment_amount=0,
        installment_number_of_payments=0,date_of_last_payment='19000101',
        date_of_restructuring='19000101',code_of_restructuring='00',
        claim_pay_date='19000101',maturity_date='19000101',
        contract_number='',last_contract_number=''
    FROM #ncbresult05 r
    WHERE r.status_grade IN ('A','B','C','D','E','E1','E2')
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #dwh05 d WHERE d.accountnumber=r.account_number
                  AND d.customercode=r.customer_code);

    -- Authorized partial reporting: exclude unavailable source rows; preserve PDF output columns.
    DELETE FROM #ncbresult05 WHERE ReportSourceIdentityValid=0;
    PRINT CONCAT('NCB 05 skipped rows (50005): ', @@ROWCOUNT);

    DELETE FROM #ncbresult05 WHERE card_id IS NULL;
    PRINT CONCAT('NCB 05 skipped rows (50006): ', @@ROWCOUNT);

    DELETE FROM #ncbresult05 WHERE number_of_days_past_2 IS NULL OR number_of_days_past_2<0 OR number_of_days_past IS NULL
                  OR (number_of_days_past_2>0 AND (default_date IS NULL OR default_date='19000101'));
    PRINT CONCAT('NCB 05 skipped rows (50008): ', @@ROWCOUNT);

    DELETE FROM #ncbresult05 WHERE id_type_mapping_status='UNMAPPED';
    PRINT CONCAT('NCB 05 skipped rows (50009): ', @@ROWCOUNT);

    DELETE FROM ncb_internal.NCBConsumerData_EOM
    WHERE [period]=@Period AND (@LGNo='null' OR account_number=@LGNo)
      AND (@CIFNo='null' OR customer_code=@CIFNo);
    INSERT INTO ncb_internal.NCBConsumerData_EOM([period],[customer_code],[card_id],[eff_date],[thai_prefix],[first_name],[family_name1],[date_of_birth],[customer_type],[id_type],[address1],[sub_district],[district],[province],[country],[pstal_code],[member_code],[member_name],[branch_code],[account_number],[account_type],[owneship_indicator],[date_account_opend],[date_of_last_payment],[date_account_closed],[as_of_date],[credit_limit],[amount_owned],[amount_past_due],[number_of_days_past],[number_of_days_past_2],[default_date],[installment_frequency],[installment_amount],[installment_number_of_payments],[account_status],[date_of_restructuring],[code_of_restructuring],[number_of_borrower],[minimum_payment],[status_lg],[status_grade],[claim_pay_date],[bkr_filling_date],[filing_amount],[frozenasset_date],[other_frozenasset_date],[petition_date],[bankruptcy_date],[bad_dept_date],[file_date_temp],[black_case_no],[withdraw_date],[warrant_date],[jm_trial_date],[red_case_no],[bank],[branch],[project],[sub_project],[open_date_original],[maturity_date],[contract_number],[last_contract_number])
    SELECT CAST(@Period AS nvarchar(7)) AS [period],
        CAST(s.[customer_code] AS nvarchar(50)) AS [customer_code],
        CAST(s.[card_id] AS nvarchar(50)) AS [card_id],
        CAST(s.[eff_date] AS nvarchar(8)) AS [eff_date],
        CAST(s.[thai_prefix] AS nvarchar(200)) AS [thai_prefix],
        CAST(s.[first_name] AS nvarchar(200)) AS [first_name],
        CAST(s.[family_name1] AS nvarchar(200)) AS [family_name1],
        CAST(s.[date_of_birth] AS nvarchar(8)) AS [date_of_birth],
        CAST(s.[customer_type] AS nvarchar(5)) AS [customer_type],
        CAST(s.[DebtorCodeType] AS nvarchar(5)) AS [id_type],
        CAST(s.[address1] AS nvarchar(500)) AS [address1],
        CAST(s.[sub_district] AS nvarchar(200)) AS [sub_district],
        CAST(s.[district] AS nvarchar(200)) AS [district],
        CAST(s.[province] AS nvarchar(200)) AS [province],
        CAST(s.[country] AS nvarchar(5)) AS [country],
        CAST(s.[pstal_code] AS nvarchar(20)) AS [pstal_code],
        CAST(s.[member_code] AS nvarchar(50)) AS [member_code],
        CAST(s.[member_name] AS nvarchar(50)) AS [member_name],
        CAST(N'0400' AS nvarchar(4)) AS [branch_code],
        CAST(s.[account_number] AS nvarchar(50)) AS [account_number],
        CAST(s.[account_type] AS int) AS [account_type],
        CAST(CASE s.ownership_indicator WHEN 1 THEN '01' WHEN 4 THEN '04' ELSE NULL END AS nvarchar(2)) AS [owneship_indicator],
        CAST(s.[date_account_opened] AS nvarchar(8)) AS [date_account_opend],
        CAST(s.[date_of_last_payment] AS nvarchar(8)) AS [date_of_last_payment],
        CAST(s.[date_account_closed] AS nvarchar(8)) AS [date_account_closed],
        CAST(s.[as_of_date] AS nvarchar(8)) AS [as_of_date],
        CAST(s.[credit_limit] AS decimal(18,2)) AS [credit_limit],
        CAST(s.[amount_owned] AS decimal(18,2)) AS [amount_owned],
        CAST(s.[amount_past_due] AS decimal(18,2)) AS [amount_past_due],
        CAST(s.[number_of_days_past] AS nvarchar(20)) AS [number_of_days_past],
        CAST(s.[number_of_days_past_2] AS int) AS [number_of_days_past_2],
        CAST(s.[default_date] AS nvarchar(8)) AS [default_date],
        CAST(CASE WHEN s.status_grade IN ('F','F1') THEN '30' WHEN s.status_grade IN ('A','B','C','D','E','E1','E2') THEN '0' ELSE NULL END AS nvarchar(2)) AS [installment_frequency],
        CAST(s.[installment_amount] AS decimal(18,2)) AS [installment_amount],
        CAST(s.[installment_number_of_payments] AS decimal(18,2)) AS [installment_number_of_payments],
        CAST(s.[account_status] AS nvarchar(20)) AS [account_status],
        CAST(s.[date_of_restructuring] AS nvarchar(8)) AS [date_of_restructuring],
        CAST(s.[code_of_restructuring] AS nvarchar(5)) AS [code_of_restructuring],
        CAST(s.[number_of_borrower] AS int) AS [number_of_borrower],
        CAST(NULL AS decimal(18,2)) AS [minimum_payment],
        CAST(s.[status_lg] AS int) AS [status_lg],
        CAST(s.[status_grade] AS nvarchar(50)) AS [status_grade],
        CAST(s.[claim_pay_date] AS nvarchar(8)) AS [claim_pay_date],
        CAST(s.[bkr_filing_date] AS nvarchar(8)) AS [bkr_filling_date],
        CAST(s.[filing_amount] AS decimal(18,2)) AS [filing_amount],
        CAST(s.[frozenassetdate] AS nvarchar(8)) AS [frozenasset_date],
