CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_NCB_06_ConsumerMonthlyLettersField_Insert]
    @StartDate DATETIME = '2025-09-01',
    @EndDate   DATETIME = '2025-09-30',
    @CIFNo     NVARCHAR(50) = 'null',
    @LGNo      NVARCHAR(20) = 'null'
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET @StartDate = CASE WHEN YEAR(@StartDate) > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @StartDate) ELSE @StartDate END;
    SET @EndDate   = CASE WHEN YEAR(@EndDate)   > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @EndDate)   ELSE @EndDate   END;
    DECLARE @Period NVARCHAR(7) = FORMAT(@EndDate, 'yyyy-MM');

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 1. Pre-load NCB dynamic conditions (small table — fast)
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#NCBCond06') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #NCBCond06;
    SELECT nm.NCBStatusCode, CAST(nm.CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) AS CatalogId, sp.ColumnName, sl.KeyName AS Operator, ne.ValueConditionExcute
    INTO #NCBCond06
    FROM NCBStatusExcuteMaster ne
    JOIN NCBStatusMaster nm        ON nm.NCBStatusId  = ne.NCBStatusId AND nm.PersonType = 1 AND nm.IsActive = 1
    JOIN SystemParameterMaster sp  ON sp.ParameterId  = ne.ParameterId
    LEFT JOIN SystemLookupMaster sl ON sl.LookupId    = ne.OparatorId;

    DECLARE @S12_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond06 WHERE NCBStatusCode=12),1,0);
    DECLARE @S13_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond06 WHERE NCBStatusCode=13),1,0);
    DECLARE @S14_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond06 WHERE NCBStatusCode=14),1,0);
    DECLARE @S21_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond06 WHERE NCBStatusCode=21),1,0);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 2. Load NCB status codes
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    DECLARE @S10  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 10 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S11  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 11 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S12  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 12 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S20  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 20 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S30  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 30 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S31  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 31 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S33  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 33 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S13  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 13 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S14  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 14 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S21  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 21 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);

    -- Dynamic TDR restructuring code from website configuration.
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tdr_rule06') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tdr_rule06;
    SELECT
        rc.RestructureCodeId,
        rc.RestructureCode,
        rc.Oparators,
        re.Seq,
        sp.ColumnName,
        sl.KeyName AS Operator,
        re.ValueConditionExcute
    INTO #tdr_rule06
    FROM SystemTDRRestructureCode rc
    LEFT JOIN SystemRestructureExcuteMaster re ON re.RestructureCodeId = rc.RestructureCodeId
    LEFT JOIN SystemParameterMaster sp ON sp.ParameterId = re.ParameterId
    LEFT JOIN SystemLookupMaster sl ON sl.LookupId = re.OparatorId
    WHERE rc.IsActive = 1;

    DECLARE @TDRDefaultCode06 NVARCHAR(10) = (
        SELECT TOP 1 RestructureCode
        FROM SystemTDRRestructureCode
        WHERE IsActive = 1
        ORDER BY CASE WHEN RestructureCode = '00' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, RestructureCode
    );

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 3. Pre-filter: qualifying DebtorRelateIds via ClaimPayDate range
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#qualifying06') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #qualifying06;
    SELECT DISTINCT e.DebtorRelateId
    INTO #qualifying06
    FROM DataEndOfDay e
    JOIN DataDebtorRelate ddr ON ddr.DebtorRelateId = e.DebtorRelateId
    JOIN DataDebtor dd ON dd.DebtorCode = ddr.DebtorCode AND dd.PersonGroupId = 117
    WHERE e.ClaimPayDate BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
      AND (e.IsDelete = 0 OR e.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND ddr.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2, 4, 6)
      AND (ddr.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (@CIFNo = 'null' OR ddr.CIFNo = @CIFNo)
      AND (@LGNo  = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo  = @LGNo);

    CREATE INDEX IX_qualifying06 ON #qualifying06 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 4. DataDebtorRelate details
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ddr_info06') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ddr_info06;
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId, ddr.LGNo, ddr.CIFNo, ddr.DebtorId, ddr.DebtorCode
    INTO #ddr_info06
    FROM DataDebtorRelate ddr
    WHERE ddr.DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying06);
    CREATE INDEX IX_ddr_info06 ON #ddr_info06 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 5. Latest EOD record per DebtorRelateId (for ClaimPayDate)
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#eod_cp06') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #eod_cp06;
    SELECT DebtorRelateId, ClaimPayDate, StatusPortId, StatusPortDate
    INTO #eod_cp06
    FROM (
        SELECT e.DebtorRelateId, e.ClaimPayDate, e.StatusPortId, e.StatusPortDate,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.DebtorRelateId ORDER BY e.AsOfDate DESC, e.CreateDate DESC) AS rn
        FROM DataEndOfDay e
        WHERE e.DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying06)
          AND (e.IsDelete = 0 OR e.IsDelete IS NULL)
    ) x WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_eod_cp06 ON #eod_cp06 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 6. DataDebtorCard TOP 1 per DebtorRelateId
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dc06') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dc06;
    SELECT DebtorRelateId,
           DebtorCardCode, DebtorCardName, DebtBalance, CurrentPaymentDate, DFDDate,
           CompromiseContracApproveDate, IsTDR, CloseDate, BadDebtDate, DPD, InstallmentsAmount,
           DebtAmount, DebtorRelateTypeId, SystemBankId, DataDebtorCardId, MeasureName
    INTO #dc06
    FROM (
        SELECT c.DebtorRelateId,
               c.DebtorCardCode, c.DebtorCardName, c.DebtBalance, c.CurrentPaymentDate, c.DFDDate,
               c.CompromiseContracApproveDate, c.IsTDR, c.CloseDate, c.BadDebtDate, c.DPD, c.InstallmentsAmount,
               c.DebtAmount, c.DebtorRelateTypeId, c.SystemBankId, c.DataDebtorCardId, c.MeasureName,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.DebtorRelateId ORDER BY c.CreateDate DESC) AS rn
        FROM DataDebtorCard c
        WHERE c.DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying06)
          AND (c.IsDelete = 0 OR c.IsDelete IS NULL)
    ) x WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_dc06 ON #dc06 (DebtorRelateId);
    CREATE INDEX IX_dc06_code ON #dc06 (DebtorCardCode);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 7. DataDebtor TOP 1 per DebtorCode with PersonGroupId = 117
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dd06') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dd06;
    SELECT DebtorCode, IDCard, CardNumber, DebtorName, FirstName, LastName, BirthDate, TitleId
    INTO #dd06
    FROM (
        SELECT d.DebtorCode, d.IDCard, d.CardNumber, d.DebtorName, d.FirstName, d.LastName, d.BirthDate, d.TitleId,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DebtorCode ORDER BY d.CreateDate DESC) AS rn
        FROM DataDebtor d
        WHERE d.DebtorCode IN (SELECT DebtorCode FROM #ddr_info06)
          AND d.PersonGroupId = 117
    ) x WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_dd06 ON #dd06 (DebtorCode);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 8. DataDebtorAddress TOP 1 per DebtorRelateId (UNION ALL approach)
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dda06') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dda06;
    SELECT ddr2.DebtorRelateId,
           a.AddressNumber, a.PlaceName, a.ProvinceId, a.DistrictId, a.SubDistrictId, a.PostalCode
    INTO #dda06
    FROM #ddr_info06 ddr2
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1
            a2.AddressNumber, a2.PlaceName, a2.ProvinceId, a2.DistrictId, a2.SubDistrictId, a2.PostalCode
        FROM (
            -- Branch 1: match by DebtorId
            SELECT a3.AddressNumber, a3.PlaceName, a3.ProvinceId, a3.DistrictId, a3.SubDistrictId, a3.PostalCode,
                   a3.IsDefault, a3.CreateDate, a3.DebtorAddressId,
                   0 AS src_priority
            FROM DataDebtorAddress a3
            WHERE a3.DebtorId = ddr2.DebtorId
            UNION ALL
            -- Branch 2: match by DebtorCode (exclude duplicates from branch 1)
            SELECT a3.AddressNumber, a3.PlaceName, a3.ProvinceId, a3.DistrictId, a3.SubDistrictId, a3.PostalCode,
                   a3.IsDefault, a3.CreateDate, a3.DebtorAddressId,
                   1 AS src_priority
            FROM DataDebtorAddress a3
            WHERE a3.DebtorCode = ddr2.DebtorCode
              AND a3.DebtorId <> ddr2.DebtorId
        ) a2
        ORDER BY CASE WHEN a2.IsDefault = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                 a2.src_priority,
                 a2.CreateDate DESC,
                 a2.DebtorAddressId DESC
    ) a;
    CREATE INDEX IX_dda06 ON #dda06 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 8. DataDebtorStatusUpdate TOP 1 per DebtorRelateId
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ssu06') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ssu06;
    SELECT DebtorRelateId, StatusLegalId
    INTO #ssu06
    FROM (
        SELECT DebtorRelateId, StatusLegalId,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DebtorRelateId ORDER BY UpdateDate DESC) AS rn
        FROM DataDebtorStatusUpdate
        WHERE DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying06)
    ) x WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_ssu06 ON #ssu06 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 9. LTDataCaseMainDebtor TOP 1 per DebtorRelateId
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#lt06') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #lt06;
    SELECT DebtorRelateId, FilingDate, BankFilingDate, BlackCaseNo, RedCaseNo, JmTrialDate, WithdrawDate, JudgmentBankruptcyDate
    INTO #lt06
    FROM (
        SELECT DebtorRelateId, FilingDate, BankFilingDate, BlackCaseNo, RedCaseNo, JmTrialDate, WithdrawDate, JudgmentBankruptcyDate,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DebtorRelateId ORDER BY CreateDate DESC) AS rn
        FROM LTDataCaseMainDebtor
        WHERE DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying06)
          AND IsCancel = 0
    ) x WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_lt06 ON #lt06 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 10. TEMPDWHCBS TOP 1 per LGNo+CIFNo
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dwh06') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dwh06;
    SELECT ddr2.DebtorRelateId,
           d.idnumber, d.firstname, d.familyname, d.dateofbirth
    INTO #dwh06
    FROM #ddr_info06 ddr2
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 d2.idnumber, d2.firstname, d2.familyname, d2.dateofbirth
        FROM TEMPDWHCBS d2
        WHERE d2.accountnumber = ddr2.LGNo AND d2.customercode = ddr2.CIFNo
          AND d2.ImportDate < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @EndDate)
        ORDER BY d2.ImportDate DESC
    ) d;
    CREATE INDEX IX_dwh06 ON #dwh06 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 11. DataDebtorCardMovement: rn=2 (PrevMonth) and rn=3 (TwoMonthsAgo)
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dcm06') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dcm06;
    SELECT DebtorCardCode,
           MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN CreateDate END) AS PrevMonthDate,
           MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN CreateDate END) AS TwoMonthsAgoDate
    INTO #dcm06
    FROM (
        SELECT m.DebtorCardCode, m.CreateDate,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.DebtorCardCode ORDER BY m.CreateDate DESC) AS rn
        FROM DataDebtorCardMovement m
        WHERE m.IsDelete = 0
          AND m.DebtorCardCode IN (SELECT DebtorCardCode FROM #dc06 WHERE DebtorCardCode IS NOT NULL)
    ) x WHERE rn IN (2, 3)
    GROUP BY DebtorCardCode;
    CREATE INDEX IX_dcm06 ON #dcm06 (DebtorCardCode);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 12. NCBStopConditionMaster — pre-materialize blocked accounts
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#sc06') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #sc06;
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr2.DebtorRelateId
    INTO #sc06
    FROM #ddr_info06 ddr2
    JOIN NCBStopConditionMaster sc ON (sc.CIFNo = ddr2.CIFNo OR sc.LGNo = ddr2.LGNo) AND sc.IsActive = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_sc06 ON #sc06 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- S21 historical-only: pre-materialize legacy CIFNos (clean in 2019, DFD <= 2024-03-31)
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#s21_cif06') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #s21_cif06;
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr2.CIFNo
    INTO #s21_cif06
    FROM #ddr_info06 ddr2
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM DataEndOfDay eod
        JOIN DataDebtorRelate ddr3 ON ddr3.DebtorRelateId = eod.DebtorRelateId
        WHERE ddr3.CIFNo = ddr2.CIFNo
          AND eod.AsOfDate BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31'
          AND (eod.IsDelete = 0 OR eod.IsDelete IS NULL)
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM DataEndOfDay eod
        JOIN DataDebtorRelate ddr3 ON ddr3.DebtorRelateId = eod.DebtorRelateId
        WHERE ddr3.CIFNo = ddr2.CIFNo
          AND eod.AsOfDate BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31'
          AND (eod.IsDelete = 0 OR eod.IsDelete IS NULL)
          AND ISNULL(eod.DPD, 0) > 30
    );
    CREATE INDEX IX_s21_cif06 ON #s21_cif06 (CIFNo);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 13. Main SELECT
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
        ISNULL(NULLIF(dd.IDCard,''), dd.CardNumber)                     AS Barcode,
        ddr.CIFNo                                                       AS Customer_Code,
        dbo.Fn_FormatDateNCB_EN(@EndDate)                               AS Eff_Date,
        ISNULL(NULLIF(dwh.idnumber,''), ISNULL(NULLIF(dd.IDCard,''), dd.CardNumber)) AS Card_Id,
        ISNULL(NULLIF(dwh.firstname,''), dd.FirstName)                  AS First_Name,
        ISNULL(NULLIF(dwh.familyname,''), dd.LastName)                  AS Family_Name1,
        CASE WHEN dwh.dateofbirth IS NOT NULL AND dwh.dateofbirth > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.Fn_FormatDateNCB_EN(dwh.dateofbirth)
             WHEN dd.BirthDate IS NOT NULL AND dd.BirthDate > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.Fn_FormatDateNCB_EN(dd.BirthDate)
             ELSE '19000101' END AS Date_Of_Birth,
        CONCAT_WS(' ', dda.AddressNumber, dda.PlaceName)               AS Address1,
        sub_dist.Name                                                   AS Sub_District,
        dist.Name                                                       AS District,
        prov.Name                                                       AS Province,
        dda.PostalCode                                                  AS Postal_Code,
        CASE WHEN dlg.LGDate IS NOT NULL AND dlg.LGDate > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.Fn_FormatDateNCB_EN(dlg.LGDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS Date_Account_Opened,
        38                                                              AS Account_Type,
        ISNULL(dc.DebtorRelateTypeId, ddr.DebtorTypeId)                AS Ownership_Indicator,
        ddr.LGNo                                                        AS Account_Number,
        dc.DebtAmount                                                   AS Credit_Limit,
        ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance, 0)                                       AS Amount_Owned,
        CASE WHEN dc.CurrentPaymentDate IS NOT NULL AND dc.CurrentPaymentDate > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.Fn_FormatDateNCB_EN(dc.CurrentPaymentDate)
             WHEN dc.CloseDate IS NOT NULL AND dc.CloseDate > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.Fn_FormatDateNCB_EN(dc.CloseDate)
             ELSE '19000101' END                                        AS Date_Of_Last_Payment,
        CASE WHEN dc.DFDDate IS NOT NULL AND dc.DFDDate > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.Fn_FormatDateNCB_EN(dc.DFDDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS Default_Date,
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(tdr_cfg.RestructureCode, @TDRDefaultCode06) = @TDRDefaultCode06
             THEN '19000101'
             WHEN dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate IS NOT NULL AND dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate > '1900-01-01'
             THEN dbo.Fn_FormatDateNCB_EN(dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate)
             ELSE '19000101'
        END                                                             AS Date_Of_Restructuring,
        ISNULL(dc.InstallmentsAmount, 0)                                AS Installment_Amount,
        CASE WHEN status_match.AccountStatus IS NOT NULL                  THEN status_match.AccountStatus
             WHEN (dc.CloseDate IS NOT NULL AND dc.CloseDate > '1900-01-01') THEN @S11
             WHEN lt.FilingDate IS NOT NULL AND lt.FilingDate > '1900-01-01'
                  AND lt.RedCaseNo IS NOT NULL
                  AND dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate IS NOT NULL AND dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate > '1900-01-01'
                  AND dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate <= lt.JmTrialDate  THEN @S31
             WHEN (
                  -- [แก้] 79-99=ฟ้อง→บังคับคดี→ล้มฯ, 68-71=ชะลอบังคับคดี, 73=ปรับโครงสร้างหลังฟ้อง (ไม่รวม 74,77 ที่ยังไม่ฟ้อง)
                  ssu.StatusLegalId IN (68,69,70,71,73,79,80,81,82,83,84,85,86,87,88,90,91,92,93,94,95,96,97,98,99)
               OR (lt.FilingDate IS NOT NULL AND lt.FilingDate > '1900-01-01' AND lt.BlackCaseNo IS NOT NULL)
               OR (lt.BankFilingDate IS NOT NULL AND lt.BankFilingDate >= '2000-01-01')  -- [แก้] กัน garbage 1905
                 ) AND (lt.WithdrawDate IS NULL OR lt.WithdrawDate <= '1900-01-01')  THEN @S30
             WHEN s13_cond.IsMatch = 1                                   THEN @S13
             WHEN s14_cond.IsMatch = 1                                   THEN @S14
             WHEN s12_cond.IsMatch = 1                                   THEN @S12
             WHEN s21_cond.IsMatch = 1                                   THEN @S21
             WHEN ISNULL(dc.DPD, 0) >= 91                               THEN @S20
             ELSE @S10
        END                                                             AS Account_Status,
        sb.BankName                                                     AS Bankname,
        sbb.BankBranchName                                              AS Branchname,
        ''                                                              AS monthly1,
        CASE
            WHEN dcm.PrevMonthDate IS NOT NULL THEN
                CASE DATEPART(MONTH, dcm.PrevMonthDate)
                    WHEN 1 THEN 'มกราคม' WHEN 2 THEN 'กุมภาพันธ์' WHEN 3 THEN 'มีนาคม'
                    WHEN 4 THEN 'เมษายน' WHEN 5 THEN 'พฤษภาคม' WHEN 6 THEN 'มิถุนายน'
                    WHEN 7 THEN 'กรกฎาคม' WHEN 8 THEN 'สิงหาคม' WHEN 9 THEN 'กันยายน'
                    WHEN 10 THEN 'ตุลาคม' WHEN 11 THEN 'พฤศจิกายน' WHEN 12 THEN 'ธันวาคม'
                END + ' ' + CAST(YEAR(dcm.PrevMonthDate) + 543 AS NVARCHAR)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS monthly2,
        CASE
            WHEN dcm.TwoMonthsAgoDate IS NOT NULL THEN
                CASE DATEPART(MONTH, dcm.TwoMonthsAgoDate)
                    WHEN 1 THEN 'มกราคม' WHEN 2 THEN 'กุมภาพันธ์' WHEN 3 THEN 'มีนาคม'
                    WHEN 4 THEN 'เมษายน' WHEN 5 THEN 'พฤษภาคม' WHEN 6 THEN 'มิถุนายน'
                    WHEN 7 THEN 'กรกฎาคม' WHEN 8 THEN 'สิงหาคม' WHEN 9 THEN 'กันยายน'
                    WHEN 10 THEN 'ตุลาคม' WHEN 11 THEN 'พฤศจิกายน' WHEN 12 THEN 'ธันวาคม'
                END + ' ' + CAST(YEAR(dcm.TwoMonthsAgoDate) + 543 AS NVARCHAR)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS monthly3,
        N'วันที่พิมพ์ : ' + dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(GETDATE())         AS PrintDate,
        N'ผู้สั่งพิมพ์ : ' + NULL                                      AS PrintName,
        ''                                                              AS Installment_Number_Of_Payments,
        ''                                                              AS Number_Of_Days_Past,
        CASE WHEN (dc.CloseDate IS NOT NULL AND dc.CloseDate > '1900-01-01')
             THEN 0
             WHEN ISNULL(dc.DPD, 0) = 0
             THEN NULL
             WHEN dc.IsTDR = 1 AND dc.DPD BETWEEN 1 AND 90
             THEN ISNULL(dc.InstallmentsAmount, 0) * CEILING(CAST(dc.DPD AS FLOAT) / 30.0)
             ELSE dc.DebtBalance
        END                                                             AS Past_Due_Amount
    INTO #ncbresult06
    FROM #qualifying06 q
    JOIN DataDebtorRelate ddr ON ddr.DebtorRelateId = q.DebtorRelateId
    JOIN DataLG dlg ON dlg.LGNo = ddr.LGNo

    -- [CHANGED] use pre-materialized #dd06 (PersonGroupId=117, TOP 1 by CreateDate)
    JOIN #dd06 dd ON dd.DebtorCode = ddr.DebtorCode

    LEFT JOIN #dc06  dc  ON dc.DebtorRelateId  = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #dda06 dda ON dda.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #ssu06 ssu ON ssu.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #lt06  lt  ON lt.DebtorRelateId  = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #dwh06 dwh ON dwh.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #eod_cp06 eod_cp ON eod_cp.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #dcm06 dcm ON dcm.DebtorCardCode = dc.DebtorCardCode

    LEFT JOIN SystemProvinceMaster      prov ON prov.ProvinceId        = dda.ProvinceId
    LEFT JOIN SystemDistrictMaster      dist ON dist.DistrictId        = dda.DistrictId
    LEFT JOIN SystemSubDistrictMaster sub_dist ON sub_dist.SubDistrictId = dda.SubDistrictId
    LEFT JOIN SystemBankMaster           sb ON sb.BankId               = dc.SystemBankId
    LEFT JOIN SystemBankBranchMaster    sbb ON sbb.BankBranchId        = dlg.BankBranchId

    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 tr.RestructureCode
        FROM (SELECT DISTINCT RestructureCodeId, RestructureCode, Oparators FROM #tdr_rule06) tr
        WHERE
            (
                ISNULL(tr.Oparators, 'AND') <> 'OR'
                AND NOT EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM #tdr_rule06 c
                    WHERE c.RestructureCodeId = tr.RestructureCodeId
                      AND c.ColumnName IS NOT NULL
                      AND (
                          CASE
                              WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('IsTDR') THEN
                                  CASE WHEN c.Operator = '=' THEN IIF(ISNULL(CAST(dc.IsTDR AS INT),0) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('<>','!=') THEN IIF(ISNULL(CAST(dc.IsTDR AS INT),0) <> TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                       ELSE 0 END
                              WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('CloseDate') THEN
                                  CASE WHEN c.Operator IN ('>','>=','MoreThan','MoreThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('<','<=','LessThan','LessThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator = '=' THEN IIF(CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(dc.CloseDate,'1900-01-01')) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATE),1,0)
                                       ELSE 0 END
                              WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('CompromiseContracApproveDate','CompromiseContractApproveDate','TDRDate') THEN
                                  CASE WHEN c.Operator IN ('>','>=','MoreThan','MoreThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate,'1900-01-01') >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('<','<=','LessThan','LessThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate,'1900-01-01') <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator = '=' THEN IIF(CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate,'1900-01-01')) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATE),1,0)
                                       ELSE 0 END
                              ELSE 0
                          END
                      ) = 0
                )
            )
            OR
            (
                ISNULL(tr.Oparators, 'AND') = 'OR'
                AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM #tdr_rule06 c
                    WHERE c.RestructureCodeId = tr.RestructureCodeId
                      AND c.ColumnName IS NOT NULL
                      AND (
                          CASE
                              WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('IsTDR') THEN
                                  CASE WHEN c.Operator = '=' THEN IIF(ISNULL(CAST(dc.IsTDR AS INT),0) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('<>','!=') THEN IIF(ISNULL(CAST(dc.IsTDR AS INT),0) <> TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                       ELSE 0 END
                              WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('CloseDate') THEN
                                  CASE WHEN c.Operator IN ('>','>=','MoreThan','MoreThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('<','<=','LessThan','LessThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator = '=' THEN IIF(CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(dc.CloseDate,'1900-01-01')) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATE),1,0)
                                       ELSE 0 END
                              WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('CompromiseContracApproveDate','CompromiseContractApproveDate','TDRDate') THEN
                                  CASE WHEN c.Operator IN ('>','>=','MoreThan','MoreThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate,'1900-01-01') >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('<','<=','LessThan','LessThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate,'1900-01-01') <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator = '=' THEN IIF(CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate,'1900-01-01')) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATE),1,0)
                                       ELSE 0 END
                              ELSE 0
                          END
                      ) = 1
                )
            )
        ORDER BY CASE WHEN tr.RestructureCode = @TDRDefaultCode06 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, tr.RestructureCode
    ) tdr_cfg

    -- Generic dynamic status matcher. Config can add new statuses without changing this CASE fallback.
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 x.CatalogId AS AccountStatus
        FROM (
            SELECT
                r.NCBStatusCode,
                r.CatalogId,
                CASE WHEN r.NCBStatusCode IN (30,32,33,42,43,44) THEN MAX(r.IsRuleMatch) ELSE MIN(r.IsRuleMatch) END AS IsStatusMatch
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    c.NCBStatusCode,
                    c.CatalogId,
                    CASE
                        WHEN c.ColumnName='MeasureName' THEN
                            CASE WHEN c.Operator='LIKE' THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') LIKE c.ValueConditionExcute,1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator='contains' THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') LIKE '%'+c.ValueConditionExcute+'%',1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('=','Equal') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'')=c.ValueConditionExcute,1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('<>','!=') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'')<>c.ValueConditionExcute,1,0)
                                 ELSE 0 END
                        WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('DPD','DerivedDPD','StatusLegalId','StatusPortId') THEN
                            CASE WHEN c.Operator IN('=','Equal') THEN IIF(EXISTS (
                                      SELECT 1 FROM STRING_SPLIT(REPLACE(c.ValueConditionExcute,N' ',N''), ',') v
                                      WHERE TRY_CAST(v.value AS INT) = CASE c.ColumnName
                                          WHEN 'DPD' THEN ISNULL(dc.DPD,0)
                                          WHEN 'DerivedDPD' THEN ISNULL(dc.DPD,0)
                                          WHEN 'StatusLegalId' THEN ISNULL(ssu.StatusLegalId,0)
                                          WHEN 'StatusPortId' THEN ISNULL(eod_cp.StatusPortId,0)
                                      END
                                  ),1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('>=','LessThanEqual') THEN IIF(CASE c.ColumnName WHEN 'DPD' THEN ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) WHEN 'DerivedDPD' THEN ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) WHEN 'StatusLegalId' THEN ISNULL(ssu.StatusLegalId,0) WHEN 'StatusPortId' THEN ISNULL(eod_cp.StatusPortId,0) END >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('<=','MoreThanEqual') THEN IIF(CASE c.ColumnName WHEN 'DPD' THEN ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) WHEN 'DerivedDPD' THEN ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) WHEN 'StatusLegalId' THEN ISNULL(ssu.StatusLegalId,0) WHEN 'StatusPortId' THEN ISNULL(eod_cp.StatusPortId,0) END <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('>','MoreThan') THEN IIF(CASE c.ColumnName WHEN 'DPD' THEN ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) WHEN 'DerivedDPD' THEN ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) WHEN 'StatusLegalId' THEN ISNULL(ssu.StatusLegalId,0) WHEN 'StatusPortId' THEN ISNULL(eod_cp.StatusPortId,0) END > TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('<','LessThan') THEN IIF(CASE c.ColumnName WHEN 'DPD' THEN ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) WHEN 'DerivedDPD' THEN ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) WHEN 'StatusLegalId' THEN ISNULL(ssu.StatusLegalId,0) WHEN 'StatusPortId' THEN ISNULL(eod_cp.StatusPortId,0) END < TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                 ELSE 0 END
                        WHEN c.ColumnName='IsTDR' THEN
                            CASE WHEN c.Operator IN('=','Equal') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.IsTDR,0)=TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('<>','!=') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.IsTDR,0)<>TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                 ELSE 0 END
                        WHEN c.ColumnName='DebtBalance' THEN
                            CASE WHEN c.Operator IN('>=','>','LessThanEqual','MoreThan') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0)>=TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)),1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('<=','<','MoreThanEqual','LessThan') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0)<=TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)),1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('=','Equal') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0)=TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)),1,0)
                                 ELSE 0 END
                        WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('CloseDate','FilingDate','BankFilingDate','BadDebtDate','JudgmentBankruptcyDate') THEN
                            CASE WHEN c.Operator IN('>','MoreThan') THEN IIF(CASE c.ColumnName WHEN 'CloseDate' THEN ISNULL(dc.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'FilingDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.FilingDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'BankFilingDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.BankFilingDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'BadDebtDate' THEN ISNULL(dc.BadDebtDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'JudgmentBankruptcyDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.JudgmentBankruptcyDate,'1900-01-01') END > TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('>=','LessThanEqual') THEN IIF(CASE c.ColumnName WHEN 'CloseDate' THEN ISNULL(dc.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'FilingDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.FilingDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'BankFilingDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.BankFilingDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'BadDebtDate' THEN ISNULL(dc.BadDebtDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'JudgmentBankruptcyDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.JudgmentBankruptcyDate,'1900-01-01') END >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('<','LessThan') THEN IIF(CASE c.ColumnName WHEN 'CloseDate' THEN ISNULL(dc.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'FilingDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.FilingDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'BankFilingDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.BankFilingDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'BadDebtDate' THEN ISNULL(dc.BadDebtDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'JudgmentBankruptcyDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.JudgmentBankruptcyDate,'1900-01-01') END < TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('<=','MoreThanEqual') THEN IIF(CASE c.ColumnName WHEN 'CloseDate' THEN ISNULL(dc.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'FilingDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.FilingDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'BankFilingDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.BankFilingDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'BadDebtDate' THEN ISNULL(dc.BadDebtDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'JudgmentBankruptcyDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.JudgmentBankruptcyDate,'1900-01-01') END <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('=','Equal') THEN IIF(CONVERT(DATE, CASE c.ColumnName WHEN 'CloseDate' THEN ISNULL(dc.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'FilingDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.FilingDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'BankFilingDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.BankFilingDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'BadDebtDate' THEN ISNULL(dc.BadDebtDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'JudgmentBankruptcyDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.JudgmentBankruptcyDate,'1900-01-01') END) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATE),1,0)
                                 ELSE 0 END
                        WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('BlackCaseNo','RedCaseNo') THEN
                            CASE WHEN c.Operator IN('=','Equal') THEN IIF(NULLIF(CASE c.ColumnName WHEN 'BlackCaseNo' THEN lt.BlackCaseNo WHEN 'RedCaseNo' THEN lt.RedCaseNo END,'') IS NOT NULL,1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('<>','!=') THEN IIF(NULLIF(CASE c.ColumnName WHEN 'BlackCaseNo' THEN lt.BlackCaseNo WHEN 'RedCaseNo' THEN lt.RedCaseNo END,'') IS NULL,1,0)
                                 ELSE 0 END
                        ELSE 0
                    END AS IsRuleMatch
                FROM #NCBCond06 c
            ) r
            GROUP BY r.NCBStatusCode, r.CatalogId
        ) x
        WHERE x.IsStatusMatch = 1
        ORDER BY CASE x.NCBStatusCode
            WHEN 42 THEN 10 WHEN 43 THEN 11 WHEN 44 THEN 12
                    WHEN 32 THEN 13 WHEN 33 THEN 20 WHEN 11 THEN 30 WHEN 31 THEN 40 WHEN 30 THEN 50
            WHEN 13 THEN 60 WHEN 14 THEN 70 WHEN 12 THEN 80 WHEN 21 THEN 90
            WHEN 20 THEN 100 WHEN 10 THEN 999 ELSE 500 END,
            x.NCBStatusCode
    ) status_match

    -- Dynamic status condition checks
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT CASE
            WHEN @S12_HasCond = 1
                 AND NOT EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond06 c WHERE c.NCBStatusCode = 12
                     AND CASE
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='MeasureName' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator='LIKE'            THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') LIKE c.ValueConditionExcute, 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='contains'        THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') LIKE '%'+c.ValueConditionExcute+'%', 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='='               THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') = c.ValueConditionExcute, 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator IN ('<>','!=')    THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') <> c.ValueConditionExcute, 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='DPD' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator='>='  THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='<='  THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='>'   THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) >  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='<'   THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) <  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='='   THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) =  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='IsTDR' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator='='            THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.IsTDR,0) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator IN ('<>','!=') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.IsTDR,0) <> TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='DebtBalance' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator IN ('>=','>') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0) >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator IN ('<=','<') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0) <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='='           THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0) =  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         ELSE 0 END = 0)
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsMatch
    ) s12_cond

    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT CASE
            WHEN @S13_HasCond = 1
                 AND NOT EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond06 c WHERE c.NCBStatusCode = 13
                     AND CASE
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='MeasureName' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator='LIKE'            THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') LIKE c.ValueConditionExcute, 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='contains'        THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') LIKE '%'+c.ValueConditionExcute+'%', 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='='               THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') = c.ValueConditionExcute, 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator IN ('<>','!=')    THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') <> c.ValueConditionExcute, 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='DPD' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator='>='  THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='<='  THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='>'   THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) >  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='<'   THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) <  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='='   THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) =  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='IsTDR' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator='='            THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.IsTDR,0) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator IN ('<>','!=') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.IsTDR,0) <> TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='DebtBalance' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator IN ('>=','>') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0) >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator IN ('<=','<') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0) <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='='           THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0) =  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         ELSE 0 END = 0)
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsMatch
    ) s13_cond

    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT CASE
            WHEN @S14_HasCond = 1
                 AND NOT EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond06 c WHERE c.NCBStatusCode = 14
                     AND CASE
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='MeasureName' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator='LIKE'            THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') LIKE c.ValueConditionExcute, 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='contains'        THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') LIKE '%'+c.ValueConditionExcute+'%', 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='='               THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') = c.ValueConditionExcute, 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator IN ('<>','!=')    THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') <> c.ValueConditionExcute, 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='DPD' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator='>='  THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='<='  THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='>'   THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) >  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='<'   THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) <  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='='   THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) =  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='IsTDR' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator='='            THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.IsTDR,0) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator IN ('<>','!=') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.IsTDR,0) <> TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='DebtBalance' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator IN ('>=','>') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0) >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator IN ('<=','<') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0) <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='='           THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0) =  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         ELSE 0 END = 0)
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsMatch
    ) s14_cond

    -- S21 historical-only logic (NCBStatusExcuteMaster not used for S21)
    -- Legacy condition: DFDDate <= 2024-03-31 cutoff AND CIF was clean in 2019
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT CASE
            WHEN dc.DFDDate IS NOT NULL
                 AND dc.DFDDate > '1900-01-01'
                 AND dc.DFDDate <= '2024-03-31'
                 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #s21_cif06 s21c WHERE s21c.CIFNo = ddr.CIFNo)
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsMatch
    ) s21_cond

    -- [CHANGED] pre-materialized #sc06 replaces LEFT JOIN NCBStopConditionMaster + WHERE IS NULL
    LEFT JOIN #sc06 sc ON sc.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId

    WHERE eod_cp.ClaimPayDate BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
      AND sc.DebtorRelateId IS NULL

    OPTION (RECOMPILE);

    -- ── Auto-create staging table จาก schema ของ #ncbresult06 (ครั้งแรกครั้งเดียว) ──
    IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.NCBConsumerMonthlyLetters') IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(7)) AS Period, *
        INTO dbo.NCBConsumerMonthlyLetters
        FROM #ncbresult06 WHERE 1 = 0;

        ALTER TABLE dbo.NCBConsumerMonthlyLetters ALTER COLUMN Period NVARCHAR(7) NOT NULL;
        ALTER TABLE dbo.NCBConsumerMonthlyLetters ADD Id BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL;
        CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_NCBConsumerMonthlyLetters_Period
            ON dbo.NCBConsumerMonthlyLetters (Period, Customer_Code, Account_Number);
    END

    DELETE FROM dbo.NCBConsumerMonthlyLetters WHERE Period = @Period;
    INSERT INTO dbo.NCBConsumerMonthlyLetters
    SELECT @Period, * FROM #ncbresult06;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_NCB_07_ConsumerYearlyLettersField]
    @StartDate DATETIME = '2025-09-01',
    @EndDate   DATETIME = '2025-09-30',
    @CIFNo     NVARCHAR(50) = 'null',
    @LGNo      NVARCHAR(20) = 'null'
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET @StartDate = CASE WHEN YEAR(@StartDate) > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @StartDate) ELSE @StartDate END;
    SET @EndDate   = CASE WHEN YEAR(@EndDate)   > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @EndDate)   ELSE @EndDate   END;

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 1. Pre-load NCB dynamic conditions (small table — fast)
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#NCBCond07') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #NCBCond07;
    SELECT nm.NCBStatusCode, sp.ColumnName, sl.KeyName AS Operator, ne.ValueConditionExcute
    INTO #NCBCond07
    FROM NCBStatusExcuteMaster ne
    JOIN NCBStatusMaster nm        ON nm.NCBStatusId  = ne.NCBStatusId AND nm.PersonType = 1 AND nm.IsActive = 1 AND nm.NCBStatusCode IN (12,13,14,21)
    JOIN SystemParameterMaster sp  ON sp.ParameterId  = ne.ParameterId
    LEFT JOIN SystemLookupMaster sl ON sl.LookupId    = ne.OparatorId;

    DECLARE @S12_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond07 WHERE NCBStatusCode=12),1,0);
    DECLARE @S13_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond07 WHERE NCBStatusCode=13),1,0);
    DECLARE @S14_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond07 WHERE NCBStatusCode=14),1,0);
    DECLARE @S21_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond07 WHERE NCBStatusCode=21),1,0);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 2. Load NCB status codes
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    DECLARE @S10  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 10 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S11  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 11 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S12  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 12 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S20  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 20 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S30  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 30 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S31  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 31 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S33  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 33 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S13  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 13 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S14  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 14 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S21  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 21 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 3. Pre-filter: qualifying DebtorRelateIds via ClaimPayDate range
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#qualifying07') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #qualifying07;
    SELECT DISTINCT e.DebtorRelateId
    INTO #qualifying07
    FROM DataEndOfDay e
    JOIN DataDebtorRelate ddr ON ddr.DebtorRelateId = e.DebtorRelateId
    JOIN DataDebtor dd ON dd.DebtorCode = ddr.DebtorCode AND dd.PersonGroupId = 117
    WHERE e.ClaimPayDate BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
      AND (e.IsDelete = 0 OR e.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND ddr.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2, 4, 6)
      AND (ddr.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (@CIFNo = 'null' OR ddr.CIFNo = @CIFNo)
      AND (@LGNo  = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo  = @LGNo);

    CREATE INDEX IX_qualifying07 ON #qualifying07 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 4. DataDebtorRelate details
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ddr_info07') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ddr_info07;
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId, ddr.LGNo, ddr.CIFNo, ddr.DebtorId, ddr.DebtorCode, ddr.CreateDate
    INTO #ddr_info07
    FROM DataDebtorRelate ddr
    WHERE ddr.DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying07);
    CREATE INDEX IX_ddr_info07 ON #ddr_info07 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 5. Latest EOD record per DebtorRelateId (for ClaimPayDate column and filter)
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#eod_cp07') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #eod_cp07;
    SELECT DebtorRelateId, ClaimPayDate
    INTO #eod_cp07
    FROM (
        SELECT e.DebtorRelateId, e.ClaimPayDate,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.DebtorRelateId ORDER BY e.AsOfDate DESC, e.CreateDate DESC) AS rn
        FROM DataEndOfDay e
        WHERE e.DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying07)
          AND (e.IsDelete = 0 OR e.IsDelete IS NULL)
    ) x WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_eod_cp07 ON #eod_cp07 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 6. DataDebtorCard TOP 1 per DebtorRelateId
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dc07') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dc07;
    SELECT DebtorRelateId,
           DebtorCardCode, DebtorCardName, DebtBalance, CurrentPaymentDate, DFDDate,
           CompromiseContracApproveDate, IsTDR, CloseDate, DPD, InstallmentsAmount,
           DebtAmount, DebtorRelateTypeId, SystemBankId, DataDebtorCardId, MeasureName
    INTO #dc07
    FROM (
        SELECT c.DebtorRelateId,
               c.DebtorCardCode, c.DebtorCardName, c.DebtBalance, c.CurrentPaymentDate, c.DFDDate,
               c.CompromiseContracApproveDate, c.IsTDR, c.CloseDate, c.DPD, c.InstallmentsAmount,
               c.DebtAmount, c.DebtorRelateTypeId, c.SystemBankId, c.DataDebtorCardId, c.MeasureName,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.DebtorRelateId ORDER BY c.CreateDate DESC) AS rn
        FROM DataDebtorCard c
        WHERE c.DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying07)
          AND (c.IsDelete = 0 OR c.IsDelete IS NULL)
    ) x WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_dc07 ON #dc07 (DebtorRelateId);
    CREATE INDEX IX_dc07_code ON #dc07 (DebtorCardCode);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 7. DataDebtor TOP 1 per DebtorCode with PersonGroupId = 117
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dd07') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dd07;
    SELECT DebtorCode, IDCard, CardNumber, DebtorName, FirstName, LastName, BirthDate, TitleId
    INTO #dd07
    FROM (
        SELECT d.DebtorCode, d.IDCard, d.CardNumber, d.DebtorName, d.FirstName, d.LastName, d.BirthDate, d.TitleId,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DebtorCode ORDER BY d.CreateDate DESC) AS rn
        FROM DataDebtor d
        WHERE d.DebtorCode IN (SELECT DebtorCode FROM #ddr_info07)
          AND d.PersonGroupId = 117
    ) x WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_dd07 ON #dd07 (DebtorCode);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 8. DataDebtorAddress TOP 1 per DebtorRelateId (UNION ALL approach)
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dda07') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dda07;
    SELECT ddr2.DebtorRelateId,
           a.AddressNumber, a.PlaceName, a.ProvinceId, a.DistrictId, a.SubDistrictId, a.PostalCode,
           a.Moo, a.Soi, a.Road
    INTO #dda07
    FROM #ddr_info07 ddr2
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1
            a2.AddressNumber, a2.PlaceName, a2.ProvinceId, a2.DistrictId, a2.SubDistrictId, a2.PostalCode,
            a2.Moo, a2.Soi, a2.Road
        FROM (
            -- Branch 1: match by DebtorId
            SELECT a3.AddressNumber, a3.PlaceName, a3.ProvinceId, a3.DistrictId, a3.SubDistrictId, a3.PostalCode,
                   a3.Moo, a3.Soi, a3.Road,
                   a3.IsDefault, a3.CreateDate, a3.DebtorAddressId,
                   0 AS src_priority
            FROM DataDebtorAddress a3
            WHERE a3.DebtorId = ddr2.DebtorId
            UNION ALL
            -- Branch 2: match by DebtorCode (exclude duplicates from branch 1)
            SELECT a3.AddressNumber, a3.PlaceName, a3.ProvinceId, a3.DistrictId, a3.SubDistrictId, a3.PostalCode,
                   a3.Moo, a3.Soi, a3.Road,
                   a3.IsDefault, a3.CreateDate, a3.DebtorAddressId,
                   1 AS src_priority
            FROM DataDebtorAddress a3
            WHERE a3.DebtorCode = ddr2.DebtorCode
              AND a3.DebtorId <> ddr2.DebtorId
        ) a2
        ORDER BY CASE WHEN a2.IsDefault = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                 a2.src_priority,
                 a2.CreateDate DESC,
                 a2.DebtorAddressId DESC
    ) a;
    CREATE INDEX IX_dda07 ON #dda07 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 8. DataDebtorStatusUpdate TOP 1 per DebtorRelateId
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ssu07') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ssu07;
    SELECT DebtorRelateId, StatusLegalId
    INTO #ssu07
    FROM (
        SELECT DebtorRelateId, StatusLegalId,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DebtorRelateId ORDER BY UpdateDate DESC) AS rn
        FROM DataDebtorStatusUpdate
        WHERE DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying07)
    ) x WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_ssu07 ON #ssu07 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 9. LTDataCaseMainDebtor TOP 1 per DebtorRelateId
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#lt07') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #lt07;
    SELECT DebtorRelateId, FilingDate, BankFilingDate, BlackCaseNo, RedCaseNo, JmTrialDate
    INTO #lt07
    FROM (
        SELECT DebtorRelateId, FilingDate, BankFilingDate, BlackCaseNo, RedCaseNo, JmTrialDate,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DebtorRelateId ORDER BY CreateDate DESC) AS rn
        FROM LTDataCaseMainDebtor
        WHERE DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying07)
          AND IsCancel = 0
    ) x WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_lt07 ON #lt07 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 10. TEMPDWHCBS TOP 1 per LGNo+CIFNo
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dwh07') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dwh07;
    SELECT ddr2.DebtorRelateId,
           d.idnumber, d.firstname, d.familyname, d.dateofbirth
    INTO #dwh07
    FROM #ddr_info07 ddr2
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 d2.idnumber, d2.firstname, d2.familyname, d2.dateofbirth
        FROM TEMPDWHCBS d2
        WHERE d2.accountnumber = ddr2.LGNo AND d2.customercode = ddr2.CIFNo
          AND d2.ImportDate < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @EndDate)
        ORDER BY d2.ImportDate DESC
    ) d;
    CREATE INDEX IX_dwh07 ON #dwh07 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 11. DataDebtorCardMovement: SUM(TotalOverdue) + MAX(CreateDate) per DebtorCardCode
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dcm07') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dcm07;
    SELECT m.DebtorCardCode,
           SUM(m.TotalOverdue) AS past_due_amount,
           MAX(m.CreateDate)   AS RecentDate
    INTO #dcm07
    FROM DataDebtorCardMovement m
    WHERE m.IsDelete = 0
      AND m.DebtorCardCode IN (SELECT DebtorCardCode FROM #dc07 WHERE DebtorCardCode IS NOT NULL)
    GROUP BY m.DebtorCardCode;
    CREATE INDEX IX_dcm07 ON #dcm07 (DebtorCardCode);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 12. NCBStopConditionMaster — pre-materialize blocked accounts
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#sc07') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #sc07;
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr2.DebtorRelateId
    INTO #sc07
    FROM #ddr_info07 ddr2
    JOIN NCBStopConditionMaster sc ON (sc.CIFNo = ddr2.CIFNo OR sc.LGNo = ddr2.LGNo) AND sc.IsActive = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_sc07 ON #sc07 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- S21: pre-materialize qualifying CIFNos (clean in 2019, DFD <= 2024-03-31)
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#s21_cif07') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #s21_cif07;
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr2.CIFNo
    INTO #s21_cif07
    FROM #ddr_info07 ddr2
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM DataEndOfDay eod
        JOIN DataDebtorRelate ddr3 ON ddr3.DebtorRelateId = eod.DebtorRelateId
        WHERE ddr3.CIFNo = ddr2.CIFNo
          AND eod.AsOfDate BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31'
          AND (eod.IsDelete = 0 OR eod.IsDelete IS NULL)
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM DataEndOfDay eod
        JOIN DataDebtorRelate ddr3 ON ddr3.DebtorRelateId = eod.DebtorRelateId
        WHERE ddr3.CIFNo = ddr2.CIFNo
          AND eod.AsOfDate BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31'
          AND (eod.IsDelete = 0 OR eod.IsDelete IS NULL)
          AND ISNULL(eod.DPD, 0) > 30
    );
    CREATE INDEX IX_s21_cif07 ON #s21_cif07 (CIFNo);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 13. Main SELECT
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
        ISNULL(NULLIF(dwh.idnumber,''), ISNULL(NULLIF(dd.IDCard,''), dd.CardNumber)) AS Barcode,
        ddr.CIFNo                                                       AS Customer_Code,
        dbo.Fn_FormatDateNCB_EN(@EndDate)                               AS Eff_Date,
        ISNULL(NULLIF(dwh.idnumber,''), ISNULL(NULLIF(dd.IDCard,''), dd.CardNumber)) AS Card_Id,
        ISNULL(NULLIF(dwh.firstname,''), dd.FirstName)                  AS First_Name,
        ISNULL(NULLIF(dwh.familyname,''), dd.LastName)                  AS Family_Name,
        CASE WHEN dwh.dateofbirth IS NOT NULL AND dwh.dateofbirth > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.Fn_FormatDateNCB_EN(dwh.dateofbirth)
             WHEN dd.BirthDate IS NOT NULL AND dd.BirthDate > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.Fn_FormatDateNCB_EN(dd.BirthDate)
             ELSE '19000101' END AS Date_Of_Birth,
        CONCAT_WS(' ',
            dda.AddressNumber, dda.PlaceName,
            CASE WHEN dda.Moo IS NOT NULL THEN 'ม.' + CAST(dda.Moo AS NVARCHAR) ELSE '' END,
            CASE WHEN dda.Soi IS NOT NULL THEN 'ซ.' + dda.Soi ELSE '' END,
            CASE WHEN dda.Road IS NOT NULL THEN 'ถ.' + dda.Road ELSE '' END
        )                                                               AS Address,
        sub_dist.Name                                                   AS Sub_District,
        dist.Name                                                       AS District,
        prov.Name                                                       AS Province,
        dda.PostalCode                                                  AS Postal_Code,
        CASE WHEN dlg.LGDate IS NOT NULL AND dlg.LGDate > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.Fn_FormatDateNCB_EN(dlg.LGDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS Open_Date,
        38                                                              AS Account_Type,
        ISNULL(dc.DebtorRelateTypeId, ddr.DebtorTypeId)                AS Ownership_Indicator,
        ddr.LGNo                                                        AS Account_Number,
        dc.DebtAmount                                                   AS Credit_Limit,
        ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance, 0)                                       AS Amount_Owned,
        CASE WHEN dc.CurrentPaymentDate IS NOT NULL AND dc.CurrentPaymentDate > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.Fn_FormatDateNCB_EN(dc.CurrentPaymentDate)
             WHEN dc.CloseDate IS NOT NULL AND dc.CloseDate > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.Fn_FormatDateNCB_EN(dc.CloseDate)
             ELSE '19000101' END                                        AS Date_Of_Last_Payment,
        CASE WHEN dc.DFDDate IS NOT NULL AND dc.DFDDate > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.Fn_FormatDateNCB_EN(dc.DFDDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS Default_Date,
        CASE WHEN (dc.CloseDate IS NOT NULL AND dc.CloseDate > '1900-01-01')
                  AND dc.IsTDR = 1 AND dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate >= '2024-04-01'
             THEN '19000101'
             WHEN dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate IS NOT NULL AND dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate > '1900-01-01'
             THEN dbo.Fn_FormatDateNCB_EN(dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate)
             ELSE '19000101'
        END                                                             AS Date_Of_Restructuring,
        ISNULL(dc.InstallmentsAmount, 0)                                AS Installment_Amount,
        CASE WHEN dc.InstallmentsAmount > 0 AND dc.DebtAmount > 0
             THEN CEILING(dc.DebtAmount / dc.InstallmentsAmount)
             ELSE 0
        END                                                             AS Installment_Number_Of_Payments,
        RIGHT('000' + CAST(ISNULL(dc.DPD, 0) AS VARCHAR(3)), 3)        AS Number_Of_Days_Past,
        CASE WHEN (dc.CloseDate IS NOT NULL AND dc.CloseDate > '1900-01-01') THEN 0
             ELSE ISNULL(dcm.past_due_amount, 0)
        END                                                             AS Past_Due_Amount,
        CASE WHEN (dc.CloseDate IS NOT NULL AND dc.CloseDate > '1900-01-01') THEN @S11
             WHEN lt.FilingDate IS NOT NULL AND lt.FilingDate > '1900-01-01'
                  AND lt.RedCaseNo IS NOT NULL
                  AND dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate IS NOT NULL AND dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate > '1900-01-01'
                  AND dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate <= lt.JmTrialDate  THEN @S31
             WHEN ssu.StatusLegalId IN (74, 77)
               OR (lt.FilingDate IS NOT NULL AND lt.FilingDate > '1900-01-01' AND lt.BlackCaseNo IS NOT NULL)
               OR (lt.BankFilingDate IS NOT NULL AND lt.BankFilingDate > '1900-01-01')
                                                                         THEN @S30
             WHEN s13_cond.IsMatch = 1                                   THEN @S13
             WHEN s14_cond.IsMatch = 1                                   THEN @S14
             WHEN s12_cond.IsMatch = 1                                   THEN @S12
             WHEN s21_cond.IsMatch = 1                                   THEN @S21
             WHEN ISNULL(dc.DPD, 0) >= 91                               THEN @S20
             ELSE @S10
        END                                                             AS Account_Status,
        sb.BankName                                                     AS Bankname,
        sbb.BankBranchName                                              AS Branchname,
        CASE
            WHEN dcm.RecentDate IS NOT NULL THEN
                FORMAT(dcm.RecentDate, 'dd', 'th-TH') + ' ' +
                CASE DATEPART(MONTH, dcm.RecentDate)
                    WHEN 1 THEN 'มกราคม' WHEN 2 THEN 'กุมภาพันธ์' WHEN 3 THEN 'มีนาคม'
                    WHEN 4 THEN 'เมษายน' WHEN 5 THEN 'พฤษภาคม' WHEN 6 THEN 'มิถุนายน'
                    WHEN 7 THEN 'กรกฎาคม' WHEN 8 THEN 'สิงหาคม' WHEN 9 THEN 'กันยายน'
                    WHEN 10 THEN 'ตุลาคม' WHEN 11 THEN 'พฤศจิกายน' WHEN 12 THEN 'ธันวาคม'
                END + ' ' + CAST(YEAR(dcm.RecentDate) + 543 AS NVARCHAR)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS monthly1,
        CASE WHEN eod_cp.ClaimPayDate IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(YEAR(eod_cp.ClaimPayDate) + 543 AS NVARCHAR)
             WHEN ddr.CreateDate IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(YEAR(ddr.CreateDate) + 543 AS NVARCHAR)
             ELSE NULL
        END AS monthly4,
        N'วันที่พิมพ์ : ' + dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(GETDATE())         AS PrintDate,
        N'ผู้สั่งพิมพ์ : ' + NULL                                      AS PrintName

    FROM #qualifying07 q
    JOIN DataDebtorRelate ddr ON ddr.DebtorRelateId = q.DebtorRelateId
    JOIN DataLG dlg ON dlg.LGNo = ddr.LGNo

    -- [CHANGED] use pre-materialized #dd07 (PersonGroupId=117, TOP 1 by CreateDate)
    JOIN #dd07 dd ON dd.DebtorCode = ddr.DebtorCode

    LEFT JOIN #dc07  dc  ON dc.DebtorRelateId  = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #dda07 dda ON dda.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #ssu07 ssu ON ssu.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #lt07  lt  ON lt.DebtorRelateId  = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #dwh07 dwh ON dwh.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #eod_cp07 eod_cp ON eod_cp.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #dcm07 dcm ON dcm.DebtorCardCode = dc.DebtorCardCode

    LEFT JOIN SystemProvinceMaster      prov ON prov.ProvinceId        = dda.ProvinceId
    LEFT JOIN SystemDistrictMaster      dist ON dist.DistrictId        = dda.DistrictId
    LEFT JOIN SystemSubDistrictMaster sub_dist ON sub_dist.SubDistrictId = dda.SubDistrictId
    LEFT JOIN SystemBankMaster           sb ON sb.BankId               = dc.SystemBankId
    LEFT JOIN SystemBankBranchMaster    sbb ON sbb.BankBranchId        = dlg.BankBranchId

    -- Dynamic status condition checks
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT CASE
            WHEN @S12_HasCond = 1
                 AND NOT EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond07 c WHERE c.NCBStatusCode = 12
                     AND CASE
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='MeasureName' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator='LIKE'            THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') LIKE c.ValueConditionExcute, 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='contains'        THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') LIKE '%'+c.ValueConditionExcute+'%', 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='='               THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') = c.ValueConditionExcute, 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator IN ('<>','!=')    THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') <> c.ValueConditionExcute, 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='DPD' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator='>='  THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='<='  THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='>'   THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) >  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='<'   THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) <  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='='   THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) =  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='IsTDR' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator='='            THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.IsTDR,0) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator IN ('<>','!=') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.IsTDR,0) <> TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='DebtBalance' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator IN ('>=','>') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0) >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator IN ('<=','<') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0) <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='='           THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0) =  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         ELSE 0 END = 0)
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsMatch
    ) s12_cond

    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT CASE
            WHEN @S13_HasCond = 1
                 AND NOT EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond07 c WHERE c.NCBStatusCode = 13
                     AND CASE
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='MeasureName' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator='LIKE'            THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') LIKE c.ValueConditionExcute, 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='contains'        THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') LIKE '%'+c.ValueConditionExcute+'%', 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='='               THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') = c.ValueConditionExcute, 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator IN ('<>','!=')    THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') <> c.ValueConditionExcute, 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='DPD' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator='>='  THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='<='  THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='>'   THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) >  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='<'   THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) <  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='='   THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) =  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='IsTDR' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator='='            THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.IsTDR,0) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator IN ('<>','!=') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.IsTDR,0) <> TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='DebtBalance' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator IN ('>=','>') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0) >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator IN ('<=','<') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0) <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='='           THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0) =  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         ELSE 0 END = 0)
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsMatch
    ) s13_cond

    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT CASE
            WHEN @S14_HasCond = 1
                 AND NOT EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond07 c WHERE c.NCBStatusCode = 14
                     AND CASE
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='MeasureName' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator='LIKE'            THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') LIKE c.ValueConditionExcute, 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='contains'        THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') LIKE '%'+c.ValueConditionExcute+'%', 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='='               THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') = c.ValueConditionExcute, 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator IN ('<>','!=')    THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') <> c.ValueConditionExcute, 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='DPD' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator='>='  THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='<='  THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='>'   THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) >  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='<'   THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) <  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='='   THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) =  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='IsTDR' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator='='            THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.IsTDR,0) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator IN ('<>','!=') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.IsTDR,0) <> TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='DebtBalance' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator IN ('>=','>') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0) >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator IN ('<=','<') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0) <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='='           THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0) =  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         ELSE 0 END = 0)
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsMatch
    ) s14_cond

    -- S21: hard-coded logic (NCBStatusExcuteMaster not used for S21)
    -- Condition: DFDDate <= 2024-03-31 (cutoff) AND CIF was clean in 2019
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT CASE
            WHEN dc.DFDDate IS NOT NULL
                 AND dc.DFDDate > '1900-01-01'
                 AND dc.DFDDate <= '2024-03-31'
                 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #s21_cif07 s21c WHERE s21c.CIFNo = ddr.CIFNo)
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsMatch
    ) s21_cond

    -- [CHANGED] pre-materialized #sc07 replaces LEFT JOIN NCBStopConditionMaster + WHERE IS NULL
    LEFT JOIN #sc07 sc ON sc.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId

    WHERE eod_cp.ClaimPayDate BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
      AND sc.DebtorRelateId IS NULL

    OPTION (RECOMPILE);
END
