CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_NCB_07_ConsumerYearlyLettersField_Backup]
    @StartDate DATETIME = NULL,
    @EndDate DATETIME = NULL,
    @CIFNo NVARCHAR(50) = '',
    @LGNo NVARCHAR(20) = '',
    @DebtorName NVARCHAR(200) = ''
AS
BEGIN
set @StartDate = case when year(@StartDate) > 2400 then dateadd(year, -543, @StartDate) else @StartDate end
set @EndDate =  case when year(@EndDate) > 2400 then dateadd(year, -543, @EndDate) else @EndDate end
	
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN dd.IDCard IS NOT NULL AND dd.IDCard != '' THEN dd.IDCard
            ELSE CAST(dd.DebtorCode AS NVARCHAR(50))
        END AS Barcode,
        dd.DebtorCode AS Customer_Code,
        CASE
            WHEN ddc.ClaimPayDate IS NOT NULL THEN FORMAT(ddc.ClaimPayDate, 'yyyyMMdd')
            ELSE NULL
        END AS Eff_date,
        ddc.CIFNo AS Card_Id,
        dd.FirstName AS First_Name,
        dd.LastName AS Family_Name,
        CASE
            WHEN dd.RegistrationDate IS NOT NULL THEN FORMAT(dd.RegistrationDate, 'yyyyMMdd')
            ELSE NULL
        END AS Date_Of_Birth,
        CONCAT_WS(' ',
            dda.AddressNumber,
            dda.PlaceName,
            CASE WHEN dda.Moo IS NOT NULL THEN 'ม.' + CAST(dda.Moo AS NVARCHAR) ELSE '' END,
            CASE WHEN dda.Soi IS NOT NULL THEN 'ซ.' + dda.Soi ELSE '' END,
            CASE WHEN dda.Road IS NOT NULL THEN 'ถ.' + dda.Road ELSE '' END
        ) AS Address,
        sub_dist.Name AS Sub_District,
        dist.Name AS District,
        prov.Name AS Province,
        dda.PostalCode AS Postal_Code,
        CASE
            WHEN ddc.CreateDate IS NOT NULL THEN FORMAT(ddc.CreateDate, 'yyyyMMdd')
            ELSE NULL
        END AS Open_Date,
        ddc.CardType AS Account_Type,
        CASE
            WHEN ddr.ProportionLiabilityTypeId IS NOT NULL THEN ddr.ProportionLiabilityTypeId
            ELSE '4'
        END AS Ownership_Indicator,
        ddc.DebtorCardCode AS Account_Number,
        ddc.DebtAmount AS Credit_Limit,
        ISNULL(ddc.DebtBalance, 0) AS Amount_Owned,
        CASE
            WHEN ddc.CurrentPaymentDate IS NOT NULL THEN FORMAT(ddc.CurrentPaymentDate, 'yyyyMMdd')
            ELSE NULL
        END AS Date_Of_Last_Payment,
        CASE
            WHEN ddc.DFDDate IS NOT NULL THEN FORMAT(ddc.DFDDate, 'yyyyMMdd')
            ELSE NULL
        END AS Default_Date,
        CASE
            WHEN ddc.CompromiseContracApproveDate IS NOT NULL THEN FORMAT(ddc.CompromiseContracApproveDate, 'yyyyMMdd')
            ELSE NULL
        END AS Date_Of_Restructuring,
        ISNULL(ddc.InstallmentsAmount, 0) AS Installment_Amount,
        CASE
            WHEN ddc.InstallmentsAmount > 0 AND ddc.DebtAmount > 0
            THEN CEILING(ddc.DebtAmount / ddc.InstallmentsAmount)
            ELSE 0
        END AS Installment_Number_Of_Payments,
        RIGHT('000' + CAST(ISNULL(ddc.DPD, 0) AS VARCHAR(3)), 3) AS Number_Of_Days_Past,
        ISNULL(pdm.past_due_amount, 0) AS Past_Due_Amount,
        CASE
            WHEN sg.LookUpValue IS NOT NULL THEN sg.LookUpValue
            WHEN ddc.DPD > 0 THEN 'I'
            ELSE '10'
        END AS Account_Status,
        sb.BankName AS Bankname,
        sbb.BankBranchName AS Branchname,
        CASE
            WHEN monthly1.RecentDate IS NOT NULL THEN
                FORMAT(monthly1.RecentDate, 'dd', 'th-TH') + ' ' +
                CASE DATEPART(MONTH, monthly1.RecentDate)
                    WHEN 1 THEN 'มกราคม'
                    WHEN 2 THEN 'กุมภาพันธ์'
                    WHEN 3 THEN 'มีนาคม'
                    WHEN 4 THEN 'เมษายน'
                    WHEN 5 THEN 'พฤษภาคม'
                    WHEN 6 THEN 'มิถุนายน'
                    WHEN 7 THEN 'กรกฎาคม'
                    WHEN 8 THEN 'สิงหาคม'
                    WHEN 9 THEN 'กันยายน'
                    WHEN 10 THEN 'ตุลาคม'
                    WHEN 11 THEN 'พฤศจิกายน'
                    WHEN 12 THEN 'ธันวาคม'
                END + ' ' +
                CAST(YEAR(monthly1.RecentDate) + 543 AS NVARCHAR)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS monthly1,
        CASE
            WHEN ddc.ClaimPayDate IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(YEAR(ddc.ClaimPayDate) + 543 AS NVARCHAR)
            WHEN ddc.CreateDate IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(YEAR(ddc.CreateDate) + 543 AS NVARCHAR)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS monthly4
	, N'วันที่พิมพ์ : ' + dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(getdate()) as PrintDate
	, N'ผู้สั่งพิมพ์ : '+ null as PrintName
    FROM DataDebtorRelate ddr
    INNER JOIN DataDebtor dd ON ddr.DebtorCode = dd.DebtorCode
    LEFT JOIN DataDebtorCard ddc ON ddc.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId AND ddc.IsDelete = 0
    LEFT JOIN SystemLookupMaster title ON dd.TitleId = title.LookupId
        AND title.GroupName LIKE '%Title%'
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 *
        FROM DataDebtorAddress a
        WHERE (a.DebtorId = ddr.DebtorId OR a.DebtorCode = dd.DebtorCode)
        ORDER BY CASE WHEN a.IsDefault = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                 CASE WHEN a.DebtorId = ddr.DebtorId THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                 a.CreateDate DESC, a.DebtorAddressId DESC
    ) dda
    LEFT JOIN SystemProvinceMaster prov ON prov.ProvinceId = dda.ProvinceId
    LEFT JOIN SystemDistrictMaster dist ON dda.DistrictId = dist.DistrictId
    LEFT JOIN SystemSubDistrictMaster sub_dist ON dda.SubDistrictId = sub_dist.SubDistrictId
    LEFT JOIN LTDataCaseMainDebtor cm ON cm.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId AND cm.IsCancel = 0
    LEFT JOIN SystemLookupMaster sg ON ddc.CardStatusId = sg.LookupId
        AND sg.GroupName LIKE '%Status%'
    LEFT JOIN SystemBankMaster sb ON sb.BankId = ddc.SystemBankId
    LEFT JOIN DataLG dlg ON ddr.LGNo = dlg.LGNo
    LEFT JOIN SystemBankBranchMaster sbb ON sbb.BankBranchId = dlg.BankBranchId
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT SUM(TotalOverdue) AS past_due_amount
        FROM DataDebtorCardMovement m
        WHERE m.DebtorCardCode = ddc.DebtorCardCode AND m.IsDelete = 0
    ) pdm
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 m.CreateDate AS RecentDate
        FROM DataDebtorCardMovement m
        WHERE m.DebtorCardCode = ddc.DebtorCardCode
            AND m.IsDelete = 0
        ORDER BY m.CreateDate DESC
    ) monthly1

    WHERE
        (ddc.ClaimPayDate between @StartDate and @EndDate)
        AND (@CIFNo = 'null' OR ddc.CIFNo = @CIFNo)
        AND (@LGNo = 'null' OR ddc.LGNo = @LGNo)
        AND (@DebtorName = 'null' OR dd.DebtorName LIKE '%' + @DebtorName + '%')

    ORDER BY ddc.DebtorCardCode;
END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_NCB_07_ConsumerYearlyLettersField_Insert]
    @StartDate DATETIME = '2025-09-01',
    @EndDate   DATETIME = '2025-09-30',
    @CIFNo     NVARCHAR(50) = 'null',
    @LGNo      NVARCHAR(20) = 'null'
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET @StartDate = CASE WHEN YEAR(@StartDate) > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @StartDate) ELSE @StartDate END;
    SET @EndDate   = CASE WHEN YEAR(@EndDate)   > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @EndDate)   ELSE @EndDate   END;
    DECLARE @Period NVARCHAR(7) = FORMAT(@EndDate, 'yyyy-MM');

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 1. Pre-load NCB dynamic conditions (small table — fast)
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#NCBCond07') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #NCBCond07;
    SELECT nm.NCBStatusCode, CAST(nm.CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) AS CatalogId, sp.ColumnName, sl.KeyName AS Operator, ne.ValueConditionExcute
    INTO #NCBCond07
    FROM NCBStatusExcuteMaster ne
    JOIN NCBStatusMaster nm        ON nm.NCBStatusId  = ne.NCBStatusId AND nm.PersonType = 1 AND nm.IsActive = 1
    JOIN SystemParameterMaster sp  ON sp.ParameterId  = ne.ParameterId
    LEFT JOIN SystemLookupMaster sl ON sl.LookupId    = ne.OparatorId;

    DECLARE @S12_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond07 WHERE NCBStatusCode=12),1,0);
    DECLARE @S13_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond07 WHERE NCBStatusCode=13),1,0);
    DECLARE @S14_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond07 WHERE NCBStatusCode=14),1,0);
    DECLARE @S21_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond07 WHERE NCBStatusCode=21),1,0);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 2. Load NCB status codes
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    DECLARE @S10  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 10 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S11  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 11 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S12  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 12 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S20  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 20 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S30  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 30 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S31  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 31 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S33  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 33 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S13  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 13 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S14  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 14 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S21  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 21 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);

    -- Dynamic TDR restructuring code from website configuration.
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tdr_rule07') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tdr_rule07;
    SELECT
        rc.RestructureCodeId,
        rc.RestructureCode,
        rc.Oparators,
        re.Seq,
        sp.ColumnName,
        sl.KeyName AS Operator,
        re.ValueConditionExcute
    INTO #tdr_rule07
    FROM SystemTDRRestructureCode rc
    LEFT JOIN SystemRestructureExcuteMaster re ON re.RestructureCodeId = rc.RestructureCodeId
    LEFT JOIN SystemParameterMaster sp ON sp.ParameterId = re.ParameterId
    LEFT JOIN SystemLookupMaster sl ON sl.LookupId = re.OparatorId
    WHERE rc.IsActive = 1;

    DECLARE @TDRDefaultCode07 NVARCHAR(10) = (
        SELECT TOP 1 RestructureCode
        FROM SystemTDRRestructureCode
        WHERE IsActive = 1
        ORDER BY CASE WHEN RestructureCode = '00' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, RestructureCode
    );

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 3. Pre-filter: qualifying DebtorRelateIds via ClaimPayDate range
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#qualifying07') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #qualifying07;
    SELECT DISTINCT e.DebtorRelateId
    INTO #qualifying07
    FROM DataEndOfDay e
    JOIN DataDebtorRelate ddr ON ddr.DebtorRelateId = e.DebtorRelateId
    JOIN DataDebtor dd ON dd.DebtorCode = ddr.DebtorCode AND dd.PersonGroupId = 117
    WHERE e.ClaimPayDate BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
      AND (e.IsDelete = 0 OR e.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND ddr.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2, 4, 6)
      AND (ddr.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (@CIFNo = 'null' OR ddr.CIFNo = @CIFNo)
      AND (@LGNo  = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo  = @LGNo);

    CREATE INDEX IX_qualifying07 ON #qualifying07 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 4. DataDebtorRelate details
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ddr_info07') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ddr_info07;
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId, ddr.LGNo, ddr.CIFNo, ddr.DebtorId, ddr.DebtorCode, ddr.CreateDate
    INTO #ddr_info07
    FROM DataDebtorRelate ddr
    WHERE ddr.DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying07);
    CREATE INDEX IX_ddr_info07 ON #ddr_info07 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 5. Latest EOD record per DebtorRelateId (for ClaimPayDate column and filter)
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#eod_cp07') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #eod_cp07;
    SELECT DebtorRelateId, ClaimPayDate, StatusPortId, StatusPortDate
    INTO #eod_cp07
    FROM (
        SELECT e.DebtorRelateId, e.ClaimPayDate, e.StatusPortId, e.StatusPortDate,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.DebtorRelateId ORDER BY e.AsOfDate DESC, e.CreateDate DESC) AS rn
        FROM DataEndOfDay e
        WHERE e.DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying07)
          AND (e.IsDelete = 0 OR e.IsDelete IS NULL)
    ) x WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_eod_cp07 ON #eod_cp07 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 6. DataDebtorCard TOP 1 per DebtorRelateId
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dc07') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dc07;
    SELECT DebtorRelateId,
           DebtorCardCode, DebtorCardName, DebtBalance, CurrentPaymentDate, DFDDate,
           CompromiseContracApproveDate, IsTDR, CloseDate, BadDebtDate, DPD, InstallmentsAmount,
           DebtAmount, DebtorRelateTypeId, SystemBankId, DataDebtorCardId, MeasureName
    INTO #dc07
    FROM (
        SELECT c.DebtorRelateId,
               c.DebtorCardCode, c.DebtorCardName, c.DebtBalance, c.CurrentPaymentDate, c.DFDDate,
               c.CompromiseContracApproveDate, c.IsTDR, c.CloseDate, c.BadDebtDate, c.DPD, c.InstallmentsAmount,
               c.DebtAmount, c.DebtorRelateTypeId, c.SystemBankId, c.DataDebtorCardId, c.MeasureName,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.DebtorRelateId ORDER BY c.CreateDate DESC) AS rn
        FROM DataDebtorCard c
        WHERE c.DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying07)
          AND (c.IsDelete = 0 OR c.IsDelete IS NULL)
    ) x WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_dc07 ON #dc07 (DebtorRelateId);
    CREATE INDEX IX_dc07_code ON #dc07 (DebtorCardCode);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 7. DataDebtor TOP 1 per DebtorCode with PersonGroupId = 117
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dd07') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dd07;
    SELECT DebtorCode, IDCard, CardNumber, DebtorName, FirstName, LastName, BirthDate, TitleId
    INTO #dd07
    FROM (
        SELECT d.DebtorCode, d.IDCard, d.CardNumber, d.DebtorName, d.FirstName, d.LastName, d.BirthDate, d.TitleId,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DebtorCode ORDER BY d.CreateDate DESC) AS rn
        FROM DataDebtor d
        WHERE d.DebtorCode IN (SELECT DebtorCode FROM #ddr_info07)
          AND d.PersonGroupId = 117
    ) x WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_dd07 ON #dd07 (DebtorCode);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 8. DataDebtorAddress TOP 1 per DebtorRelateId (UNION ALL approach)
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dda07') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dda07;
    SELECT ddr2.DebtorRelateId,
           a.AddressNumber, a.PlaceName, a.ProvinceId, a.DistrictId, a.SubDistrictId, a.PostalCode,
           a.Moo, a.Soi, a.Road
    INTO #dda07
    FROM #ddr_info07 ddr2
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1
            a2.AddressNumber, a2.PlaceName, a2.ProvinceId, a2.DistrictId, a2.SubDistrictId, a2.PostalCode,
            a2.Moo, a2.Soi, a2.Road
        FROM (
            -- Branch 1: match by DebtorId
            SELECT a3.AddressNumber, a3.PlaceName, a3.ProvinceId, a3.DistrictId, a3.SubDistrictId, a3.PostalCode,
                   a3.Moo, a3.Soi, a3.Road,
                   a3.IsDefault, a3.CreateDate, a3.DebtorAddressId,
                   0 AS src_priority
            FROM DataDebtorAddress a3
            WHERE a3.DebtorId = ddr2.DebtorId
            UNION ALL
            -- Branch 2: match by DebtorCode (exclude duplicates from branch 1)
            SELECT a3.AddressNumber, a3.PlaceName, a3.ProvinceId, a3.DistrictId, a3.SubDistrictId, a3.PostalCode,
                   a3.Moo, a3.Soi, a3.Road,
                   a3.IsDefault, a3.CreateDate, a3.DebtorAddressId,
                   1 AS src_priority
            FROM DataDebtorAddress a3
            WHERE a3.DebtorCode = ddr2.DebtorCode
              AND a3.DebtorId <> ddr2.DebtorId
        ) a2
        ORDER BY CASE WHEN a2.IsDefault = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                 a2.src_priority,
                 a2.CreateDate DESC,
                 a2.DebtorAddressId DESC
    ) a;
    CREATE INDEX IX_dda07 ON #dda07 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 8. DataDebtorStatusUpdate TOP 1 per DebtorRelateId
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ssu07') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ssu07;
    SELECT DebtorRelateId, StatusLegalId
    INTO #ssu07
    FROM (
        SELECT DebtorRelateId, StatusLegalId,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DebtorRelateId ORDER BY UpdateDate DESC) AS rn
        FROM DataDebtorStatusUpdate
        WHERE DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying07)
    ) x WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_ssu07 ON #ssu07 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 9. LTDataCaseMainDebtor TOP 1 per DebtorRelateId
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#lt07') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #lt07;
    SELECT DebtorRelateId, FilingDate, BankFilingDate, BlackCaseNo, RedCaseNo, JmTrialDate, WithdrawDate, JudgmentBankruptcyDate
    INTO #lt07
    FROM (
        SELECT DebtorRelateId, FilingDate, BankFilingDate, BlackCaseNo, RedCaseNo, JmTrialDate, WithdrawDate, JudgmentBankruptcyDate,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DebtorRelateId ORDER BY CreateDate DESC) AS rn
        FROM LTDataCaseMainDebtor
        WHERE DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying07)
          AND IsCancel = 0
    ) x WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_lt07 ON #lt07 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 10. TEMPDWHCBS TOP 1 per LGNo+CIFNo
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dwh07') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dwh07;
    SELECT ddr2.DebtorRelateId,
           d.idnumber, d.firstname, d.familyname, d.dateofbirth
    INTO #dwh07
    FROM #ddr_info07 ddr2
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 d2.idnumber, d2.firstname, d2.familyname, d2.dateofbirth
        FROM TEMPDWHCBS d2
        WHERE d2.accountnumber = ddr2.LGNo AND d2.customercode = ddr2.CIFNo
          AND d2.ImportDate < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @EndDate)
        ORDER BY d2.ImportDate DESC
    ) d;
    CREATE INDEX IX_dwh07 ON #dwh07 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 11. DataDebtorCardMovement: SUM(TotalOverdue) + MAX(CreateDate) per DebtorCardCode
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dcm07') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dcm07;
    SELECT m.DebtorCardCode,
           SUM(m.TotalOverdue) AS past_due_amount,
           MAX(m.CreateDate)   AS RecentDate
    INTO #dcm07
    FROM DataDebtorCardMovement m
    WHERE m.IsDelete = 0
      AND m.DebtorCardCode IN (SELECT DebtorCardCode FROM #dc07 WHERE DebtorCardCode IS NOT NULL)
    GROUP BY m.DebtorCardCode;
    CREATE INDEX IX_dcm07 ON #dcm07 (DebtorCardCode);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 12. NCBStopConditionMaster — pre-materialize blocked accounts
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#sc07') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #sc07;
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr2.DebtorRelateId
    INTO #sc07
    FROM #ddr_info07 ddr2
    JOIN NCBStopConditionMaster sc ON (sc.CIFNo = ddr2.CIFNo OR sc.LGNo = ddr2.LGNo) AND sc.IsActive = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_sc07 ON #sc07 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- S21 historical-only: pre-materialize legacy CIFNos (clean in 2019, DFD <= 2024-03-31)
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#s21_cif07') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #s21_cif07;
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr2.CIFNo
    INTO #s21_cif07
    FROM #ddr_info07 ddr2
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM DataEndOfDay eod
        JOIN DataDebtorRelate ddr3 ON ddr3.DebtorRelateId = eod.DebtorRelateId
        WHERE ddr3.CIFNo = ddr2.CIFNo
          AND eod.AsOfDate BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31'
          AND (eod.IsDelete = 0 OR eod.IsDelete IS NULL)
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM DataEndOfDay eod
        JOIN DataDebtorRelate ddr3 ON ddr3.DebtorRelateId = eod.DebtorRelateId
        WHERE ddr3.CIFNo = ddr2.CIFNo
          AND eod.AsOfDate BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31'
          AND (eod.IsDelete = 0 OR eod.IsDelete IS NULL)
          AND ISNULL(eod.DPD, 0) > 30
    );
    CREATE INDEX IX_s21_cif07 ON #s21_cif07 (CIFNo);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 13. Main SELECT
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
        ISNULL(NULLIF(dwh.idnumber,''), ISNULL(NULLIF(dd.IDCard,''), dd.CardNumber)) AS Barcode,
        ddr.CIFNo                                                       AS Customer_Code,
        dbo.Fn_FormatDateNCB_EN(@EndDate)                               AS Eff_Date,
        ISNULL(NULLIF(dwh.idnumber,''), ISNULL(NULLIF(dd.IDCard,''), dd.CardNumber)) AS Card_Id,
        ISNULL(NULLIF(dwh.firstname,''), dd.FirstName)                  AS First_Name,
        ISNULL(NULLIF(dwh.familyname,''), dd.LastName)                  AS Family_Name,
        CASE WHEN dwh.dateofbirth IS NOT NULL AND dwh.dateofbirth > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.Fn_FormatDateNCB_EN(dwh.dateofbirth)
             WHEN dd.BirthDate IS NOT NULL AND dd.BirthDate > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.Fn_FormatDateNCB_EN(dd.BirthDate)
             ELSE '19000101' END AS Date_Of_Birth,
        CONCAT_WS(' ',
            dda.AddressNumber, dda.PlaceName,
            CASE WHEN dda.Moo IS NOT NULL THEN 'ม.' + CAST(dda.Moo AS NVARCHAR) ELSE '' END,
            CASE WHEN dda.Soi IS NOT NULL THEN 'ซ.' + dda.Soi ELSE '' END,
            CASE WHEN dda.Road IS NOT NULL THEN 'ถ.' + dda.Road ELSE '' END
        )                                                               AS Address,
        sub_dist.Name                                                   AS Sub_District,
        dist.Name                                                       AS District,
        prov.Name                                                       AS Province,
        dda.PostalCode                                                  AS Postal_Code,
        CASE WHEN dlg.LGDate IS NOT NULL AND dlg.LGDate > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.Fn_FormatDateNCB_EN(dlg.LGDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS Open_Date,
        38                                                              AS Account_Type,
        ISNULL(dc.DebtorRelateTypeId, ddr.DebtorTypeId)                AS Ownership_Indicator,
        ddr.LGNo                                                        AS Account_Number,
        dc.DebtAmount                                                   AS Credit_Limit,
        ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance, 0)                                       AS Amount_Owned,
        CASE WHEN dc.CurrentPaymentDate IS NOT NULL AND dc.CurrentPaymentDate > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.Fn_FormatDateNCB_EN(dc.CurrentPaymentDate)
             WHEN dc.CloseDate IS NOT NULL AND dc.CloseDate > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.Fn_FormatDateNCB_EN(dc.CloseDate)
             ELSE '19000101' END                                        AS Date_Of_Last_Payment,
        CASE WHEN dc.DFDDate IS NOT NULL AND dc.DFDDate > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.Fn_FormatDateNCB_EN(dc.DFDDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS Default_Date,
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(tdr_cfg.RestructureCode, @TDRDefaultCode07) = @TDRDefaultCode07
             THEN '19000101'
             WHEN dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate IS NOT NULL AND dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate > '1900-01-01'
             THEN dbo.Fn_FormatDateNCB_EN(dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate)
             ELSE '19000101'
        END                                                             AS Date_Of_Restructuring,
        ISNULL(dc.InstallmentsAmount, 0)                                AS Installment_Amount,
        CASE WHEN dc.InstallmentsAmount > 0 AND dc.DebtAmount > 0
             THEN CEILING(dc.DebtAmount / dc.InstallmentsAmount)
             ELSE 0
        END                                                             AS Installment_Number_Of_Payments,
        RIGHT('000' + CAST(ISNULL(dc.DPD, 0) AS VARCHAR(3)), 3)        AS Number_Of_Days_Past,
        CASE WHEN (dc.CloseDate IS NOT NULL AND dc.CloseDate > '1900-01-01') THEN 0
             ELSE ISNULL(dcm.past_due_amount, 0)
        END                                                             AS Past_Due_Amount,
        CASE WHEN status_match.AccountStatus IS NOT NULL                  THEN status_match.AccountStatus
             WHEN (dc.CloseDate IS NOT NULL AND dc.CloseDate > '1900-01-01') THEN @S11
             WHEN lt.FilingDate IS NOT NULL AND lt.FilingDate > '1900-01-01'
                  AND lt.RedCaseNo IS NOT NULL
                  AND dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate IS NOT NULL AND dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate > '1900-01-01'
                  AND dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate <= lt.JmTrialDate  THEN @S31
             WHEN (
                  -- [แก้] 79-99=ฟ้อง→บังคับคดี→ล้มฯ, 68-71=ชะลอบังคับคดี, 73=ปรับโครงสร้างหลังฟ้อง (ไม่รวม 74,77 ที่ยังไม่ฟ้อง)
                  ssu.StatusLegalId IN (68,69,70,71,73,79,80,81,82,83,84,85,86,87,88,90,91,92,93,94,95,96,97,98,99)
               OR (lt.FilingDate IS NOT NULL AND lt.FilingDate > '1900-01-01' AND lt.BlackCaseNo IS NOT NULL)
               OR (lt.BankFilingDate IS NOT NULL AND lt.BankFilingDate >= '2000-01-01')  -- [แก้] กัน garbage 1905
                 ) AND (lt.WithdrawDate IS NULL OR lt.WithdrawDate <= '1900-01-01')  THEN @S30
             WHEN s13_cond.IsMatch = 1                                   THEN @S13
             WHEN s14_cond.IsMatch = 1                                   THEN @S14
             WHEN s12_cond.IsMatch = 1                                   THEN @S12
             WHEN s21_cond.IsMatch = 1                                   THEN @S21
             WHEN ISNULL(dc.DPD, 0) >= 91                               THEN @S20
             ELSE @S10
        END                                                             AS Account_Status,
        sb.BankName                                                     AS Bankname,
        sbb.BankBranchName                                              AS Branchname,
        CASE
            WHEN dcm.RecentDate IS NOT NULL THEN
                FORMAT(dcm.RecentDate, 'dd', 'th-TH') + ' ' +
                CASE DATEPART(MONTH, dcm.RecentDate)
                    WHEN 1 THEN 'มกราคม' WHEN 2 THEN 'กุมภาพันธ์' WHEN 3 THEN 'มีนาคม'
                    WHEN 4 THEN 'เมษายน' WHEN 5 THEN 'พฤษภาคม' WHEN 6 THEN 'มิถุนายน'
                    WHEN 7 THEN 'กรกฎาคม' WHEN 8 THEN 'สิงหาคม' WHEN 9 THEN 'กันยายน'
                    WHEN 10 THEN 'ตุลาคม' WHEN 11 THEN 'พฤศจิกายน' WHEN 12 THEN 'ธันวาคม'
                END + ' ' + CAST(YEAR(dcm.RecentDate) + 543 AS NVARCHAR)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS monthly1,
        CASE WHEN eod_cp.ClaimPayDate IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(YEAR(eod_cp.ClaimPayDate) + 543 AS NVARCHAR)
             WHEN ddr.CreateDate IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(YEAR(ddr.CreateDate) + 543 AS NVARCHAR)
             ELSE NULL
        END AS monthly4,
        N'วันที่พิมพ์ : ' + dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(GETDATE())         AS PrintDate,
        N'ผู้สั่งพิมพ์ : ' + NULL                                      AS PrintName
    INTO #ncbresult07
    FROM #qualifying07 q
    JOIN DataDebtorRelate ddr ON ddr.DebtorRelateId = q.DebtorRelateId
    JOIN DataLG dlg ON dlg.LGNo = ddr.LGNo

    -- [CHANGED] use pre-materialized #dd07 (PersonGroupId=117, TOP 1 by CreateDate)
    JOIN #dd07 dd ON dd.DebtorCode = ddr.DebtorCode

    LEFT JOIN #dc07  dc  ON dc.DebtorRelateId  = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #dda07 dda ON dda.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #ssu07 ssu ON ssu.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #lt07  lt  ON lt.DebtorRelateId  = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #dwh07 dwh ON dwh.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #eod_cp07 eod_cp ON eod_cp.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #dcm07 dcm ON dcm.DebtorCardCode = dc.DebtorCardCode

    LEFT JOIN SystemProvinceMaster      prov ON prov.ProvinceId        = dda.ProvinceId
    LEFT JOIN SystemDistrictMaster      dist ON dist.DistrictId        = dda.DistrictId
    LEFT JOIN SystemSubDistrictMaster sub_dist ON sub_dist.SubDistrictId = dda.SubDistrictId
    LEFT JOIN SystemBankMaster           sb ON sb.BankId               = dc.SystemBankId
    LEFT JOIN SystemBankBranchMaster    sbb ON sbb.BankBranchId        = dlg.BankBranchId

    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 tr.RestructureCode
        FROM (SELECT DISTINCT RestructureCodeId, RestructureCode, Oparators FROM #tdr_rule07) tr
        WHERE
            (
                ISNULL(tr.Oparators, 'AND') <> 'OR'
                AND NOT EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM #tdr_rule07 c
                    WHERE c.RestructureCodeId = tr.RestructureCodeId
                      AND c.ColumnName IS NOT NULL
                      AND (
                          CASE
                              WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('IsTDR') THEN
                                  CASE WHEN c.Operator = '=' THEN IIF(ISNULL(CAST(dc.IsTDR AS INT),0) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('<>','!=') THEN IIF(ISNULL(CAST(dc.IsTDR AS INT),0) <> TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                       ELSE 0 END
                              WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('CloseDate') THEN
                                  CASE WHEN c.Operator IN ('>','>=','MoreThan','MoreThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('<','<=','LessThan','LessThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator = '=' THEN IIF(CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(dc.CloseDate,'1900-01-01')) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATE),1,0)
                                       ELSE 0 END
                              WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('CompromiseContracApproveDate','CompromiseContractApproveDate','TDRDate') THEN
                                  CASE WHEN c.Operator IN ('>','>=','MoreThan','MoreThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate,'1900-01-01') >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('<','<=','LessThan','LessThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate,'1900-01-01') <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator = '=' THEN IIF(CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate,'1900-01-01')) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATE),1,0)
                                       ELSE 0 END
                              ELSE 0
                          END
                      ) = 0
                )
            )
            OR
            (
                ISNULL(tr.Oparators, 'AND') = 'OR'
                AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM #tdr_rule07 c
                    WHERE c.RestructureCodeId = tr.RestructureCodeId
                      AND c.ColumnName IS NOT NULL
                      AND (
                          CASE
                              WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('IsTDR') THEN
                                  CASE WHEN c.Operator = '=' THEN IIF(ISNULL(CAST(dc.IsTDR AS INT),0) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('<>','!=') THEN IIF(ISNULL(CAST(dc.IsTDR AS INT),0) <> TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                       ELSE 0 END
                              WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('CloseDate') THEN
                                  CASE WHEN c.Operator IN ('>','>=','MoreThan','MoreThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('<','<=','LessThan','LessThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator = '=' THEN IIF(CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(dc.CloseDate,'1900-01-01')) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATE),1,0)
                                       ELSE 0 END
                              WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('CompromiseContracApproveDate','CompromiseContractApproveDate','TDRDate') THEN
                                  CASE WHEN c.Operator IN ('>','>=','MoreThan','MoreThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate,'1900-01-01') >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('<','<=','LessThan','LessThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate,'1900-01-01') <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator = '=' THEN IIF(CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate,'1900-01-01')) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATE),1,0)
                                       ELSE 0 END
                              ELSE 0
                          END
                      ) = 1
                )
            )
        ORDER BY CASE WHEN tr.RestructureCode = @TDRDefaultCode07 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, tr.RestructureCode
    ) tdr_cfg

    -- Generic dynamic status matcher. Config can add new statuses without changing this CASE fallback.
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 x.CatalogId AS AccountStatus
        FROM (
            SELECT
                r.NCBStatusCode,
                r.CatalogId,
                CASE WHEN r.NCBStatusCode IN (30,32,33,42,43,44) THEN MAX(r.IsRuleMatch) ELSE MIN(r.IsRuleMatch) END AS IsStatusMatch
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    c.NCBStatusCode,
                    c.CatalogId,
                    CASE
                        WHEN c.ColumnName='MeasureName' THEN
                            CASE WHEN c.Operator='LIKE' THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') LIKE c.ValueConditionExcute,1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator='contains' THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') LIKE '%'+c.ValueConditionExcute+'%',1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('=','Equal') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'')=c.ValueConditionExcute,1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('<>','!=') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'')<>c.ValueConditionExcute,1,0)
                                 ELSE 0 END
                        WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('DPD','DerivedDPD','StatusLegalId','StatusPortId') THEN
                            CASE WHEN c.Operator IN('=','Equal') THEN IIF(EXISTS (
                                      SELECT 1 FROM STRING_SPLIT(REPLACE(c.ValueConditionExcute,N' ',N''), ',') v
                                      WHERE TRY_CAST(v.value AS INT) = CASE c.ColumnName
                                          WHEN 'DPD' THEN ISNULL(dc.DPD,0)
                                          WHEN 'DerivedDPD' THEN ISNULL(dc.DPD,0)
                                          WHEN 'StatusLegalId' THEN ISNULL(ssu.StatusLegalId,0)
                                          WHEN 'StatusPortId' THEN ISNULL(eod_cp.StatusPortId,0)
                                      END
                                  ),1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('>=','LessThanEqual') THEN IIF(CASE c.ColumnName WHEN 'DPD' THEN ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) WHEN 'DerivedDPD' THEN ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) WHEN 'StatusLegalId' THEN ISNULL(ssu.StatusLegalId,0) WHEN 'StatusPortId' THEN ISNULL(eod_cp.StatusPortId,0) END >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('<=','MoreThanEqual') THEN IIF(CASE c.ColumnName WHEN 'DPD' THEN ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) WHEN 'DerivedDPD' THEN ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) WHEN 'StatusLegalId' THEN ISNULL(ssu.StatusLegalId,0) WHEN 'StatusPortId' THEN ISNULL(eod_cp.StatusPortId,0) END <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('>','MoreThan') THEN IIF(CASE c.ColumnName WHEN 'DPD' THEN ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) WHEN 'DerivedDPD' THEN ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) WHEN 'StatusLegalId' THEN ISNULL(ssu.StatusLegalId,0) WHEN 'StatusPortId' THEN ISNULL(eod_cp.StatusPortId,0) END > TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('<','LessThan') THEN IIF(CASE c.ColumnName WHEN 'DPD' THEN ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) WHEN 'DerivedDPD' THEN ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) WHEN 'StatusLegalId' THEN ISNULL(ssu.StatusLegalId,0) WHEN 'StatusPortId' THEN ISNULL(eod_cp.StatusPortId,0) END < TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                 ELSE 0 END
                        WHEN c.ColumnName='IsTDR' THEN
                            CASE WHEN c.Operator IN('=','Equal') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.IsTDR,0)=TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('<>','!=') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.IsTDR,0)<>TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                 ELSE 0 END
                        WHEN c.ColumnName='DebtBalance' THEN
                            CASE WHEN c.Operator IN('>=','>','LessThanEqual','MoreThan') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0)>=TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)),1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('<=','<','MoreThanEqual','LessThan') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0)<=TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)),1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('=','Equal') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0)=TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)),1,0)
                                 ELSE 0 END
                        WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('CloseDate','FilingDate','BankFilingDate','BadDebtDate','JudgmentBankruptcyDate') THEN
                            CASE WHEN c.Operator IN('>','MoreThan') THEN IIF(CASE c.ColumnName WHEN 'CloseDate' THEN ISNULL(dc.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'FilingDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.FilingDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'BankFilingDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.BankFilingDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'BadDebtDate' THEN ISNULL(dc.BadDebtDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'JudgmentBankruptcyDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.JudgmentBankruptcyDate,'1900-01-01') END > TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('>=','LessThanEqual') THEN IIF(CASE c.ColumnName WHEN 'CloseDate' THEN ISNULL(dc.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'FilingDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.FilingDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'BankFilingDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.BankFilingDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'BadDebtDate' THEN ISNULL(dc.BadDebtDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'JudgmentBankruptcyDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.JudgmentBankruptcyDate,'1900-01-01') END >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('<','LessThan') THEN IIF(CASE c.ColumnName WHEN 'CloseDate' THEN ISNULL(dc.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'FilingDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.FilingDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'BankFilingDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.BankFilingDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'BadDebtDate' THEN ISNULL(dc.BadDebtDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'JudgmentBankruptcyDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.JudgmentBankruptcyDate,'1900-01-01') END < TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('<=','MoreThanEqual') THEN IIF(CASE c.ColumnName WHEN 'CloseDate' THEN ISNULL(dc.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'FilingDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.FilingDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'BankFilingDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.BankFilingDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'BadDebtDate' THEN ISNULL(dc.BadDebtDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'JudgmentBankruptcyDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.JudgmentBankruptcyDate,'1900-01-01') END <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('=','Equal') THEN IIF(CONVERT(DATE, CASE c.ColumnName WHEN 'CloseDate' THEN ISNULL(dc.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'FilingDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.FilingDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'BankFilingDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.BankFilingDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'BadDebtDate' THEN ISNULL(dc.BadDebtDate,'1900-01-01') WHEN 'JudgmentBankruptcyDate' THEN ISNULL(lt.JudgmentBankruptcyDate,'1900-01-01') END) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATE),1,0)
                                 ELSE 0 END
                        WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('BlackCaseNo','RedCaseNo') THEN
                            CASE WHEN c.Operator IN('=','Equal') THEN IIF(NULLIF(CASE c.ColumnName WHEN 'BlackCaseNo' THEN lt.BlackCaseNo WHEN 'RedCaseNo' THEN lt.RedCaseNo END,'') IS NOT NULL,1,0)
                                 WHEN c.Operator IN('<>','!=') THEN IIF(NULLIF(CASE c.ColumnName WHEN 'BlackCaseNo' THEN lt.BlackCaseNo WHEN 'RedCaseNo' THEN lt.RedCaseNo END,'') IS NULL,1,0)
                                 ELSE 0 END
                        ELSE 0
                    END AS IsRuleMatch
                FROM #NCBCond07 c
            ) r
            GROUP BY r.NCBStatusCode, r.CatalogId
        ) x
        WHERE x.IsStatusMatch = 1
        ORDER BY CASE x.NCBStatusCode
            WHEN 42 THEN 10 WHEN 43 THEN 11 WHEN 44 THEN 12
                    WHEN 32 THEN 13 WHEN 33 THEN 20 WHEN 11 THEN 30 WHEN 31 THEN 40 WHEN 30 THEN 50
            WHEN 13 THEN 60 WHEN 14 THEN 70 WHEN 12 THEN 80 WHEN 21 THEN 90
            WHEN 20 THEN 100 WHEN 10 THEN 999 ELSE 500 END,
            x.NCBStatusCode
    ) status_match

    -- Dynamic status condition checks
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT CASE
            WHEN @S12_HasCond = 1
                 AND NOT EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond07 c WHERE c.NCBStatusCode = 12
                     AND CASE
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='MeasureName' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator='LIKE'            THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') LIKE c.ValueConditionExcute, 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='contains'        THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') LIKE '%'+c.ValueConditionExcute+'%', 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='='               THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') = c.ValueConditionExcute, 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator IN ('<>','!=')    THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') <> c.ValueConditionExcute, 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='DPD' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator='>='  THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='<='  THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='>'   THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) >  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='<'   THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) <  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='='   THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) =  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='IsTDR' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator='='            THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.IsTDR,0) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator IN ('<>','!=') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.IsTDR,0) <> TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='DebtBalance' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator IN ('>=','>') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0) >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator IN ('<=','<') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0) <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='='           THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0) =  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         ELSE 0 END = 0)
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsMatch
    ) s12_cond

    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT CASE
            WHEN @S13_HasCond = 1
                 AND NOT EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond07 c WHERE c.NCBStatusCode = 13
                     AND CASE
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='MeasureName' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator='LIKE'            THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') LIKE c.ValueConditionExcute, 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='contains'        THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') LIKE '%'+c.ValueConditionExcute+'%', 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='='               THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') = c.ValueConditionExcute, 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator IN ('<>','!=')    THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') <> c.ValueConditionExcute, 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='DPD' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator='>='  THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='<='  THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='>'   THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) >  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='<'   THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) <  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='='   THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) =  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='IsTDR' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator='='            THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.IsTDR,0) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator IN ('<>','!=') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.IsTDR,0) <> TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='DebtBalance' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator IN ('>=','>') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0) >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator IN ('<=','<') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0) <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='='           THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0) =  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         ELSE 0 END = 0)
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsMatch
    ) s13_cond

    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT CASE
            WHEN @S14_HasCond = 1
                 AND NOT EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond07 c WHERE c.NCBStatusCode = 14
                     AND CASE
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='MeasureName' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator='LIKE'            THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') LIKE c.ValueConditionExcute, 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='contains'        THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') LIKE '%'+c.ValueConditionExcute+'%', 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='='               THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') = c.ValueConditionExcute, 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator IN ('<>','!=')    THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.MeasureName,'') <> c.ValueConditionExcute, 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='DPD' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator='>='  THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='<='  THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='>'   THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) >  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='<'   THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) <  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='='   THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DPD,0) =  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='IsTDR' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator='='            THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.IsTDR,0) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator IN ('<>','!=') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.IsTDR,0) <> TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT), 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         WHEN c.ColumnName='DebtBalance' THEN
                             CASE WHEN c.Operator IN ('>=','>') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0) >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator IN ('<=','<') THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0) <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 1, 0)
                                  WHEN c.Operator='='           THEN IIF(ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance,0) =  TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 1, 0)
                                  ELSE 0 END
                         ELSE 0 END = 0)
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsMatch
    ) s14_cond

    -- S21 historical-only logic (NCBStatusExcuteMaster not used for S21)
    -- Legacy condition: DFDDate <= 2024-03-31 cutoff AND CIF was clean in 2019
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT CASE
            WHEN dc.DFDDate IS NOT NULL
                 AND dc.DFDDate > '1900-01-01'
                 AND dc.DFDDate <= '2024-03-31'
                 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #s21_cif07 s21c WHERE s21c.CIFNo = ddr.CIFNo)
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsMatch
    ) s21_cond

    -- [CHANGED] pre-materialized #sc07 replaces LEFT JOIN NCBStopConditionMaster + WHERE IS NULL
    LEFT JOIN #sc07 sc ON sc.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId

    WHERE eod_cp.ClaimPayDate BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
      AND sc.DebtorRelateId IS NULL

    OPTION (RECOMPILE);

    -- ── Auto-create staging table จาก schema ของ #ncbresult07 (ครั้งแรกครั้งเดียว) ──
    IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.NCBConsumerYearlyLetters') IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(7)) AS Period, *
        INTO dbo.NCBConsumerYearlyLetters
        FROM #ncbresult07 WHERE 1 = 0;

        ALTER TABLE dbo.NCBConsumerYearlyLetters ALTER COLUMN Period NVARCHAR(7) NOT NULL;
        ALTER TABLE dbo.NCBConsumerYearlyLetters ADD Id BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL;
        CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_NCBConsumerYearlyLetters_Period
            ON dbo.NCBConsumerYearlyLetters (Period, Customer_Code, Account_Number);
    END

    DELETE FROM dbo.NCBConsumerYearlyLetters WHERE Period = @Period;
    INSERT INTO dbo.NCBConsumerYearlyLetters
    SELECT @Period, * FROM #ncbresult07;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_TDR_01_CompromiseContract_01] -- นำเข้าข้อมูลลูกหนี้ DataDebtor @ID nvarchar(150) = '7095ee89-6073-4e75-a793-c10ed790c357' AS BEGIN Select distinct dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(c.RequestDate) AS contract_start_date , case when r.DebtorTypeId = 1 then dbo.FN_DCS_16_GetDebtorName(cd.DebtorId) else r.ProjectName + '

contract_bank_name ,clg.LGNo AS guarantee_no ,dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(c.RequestDate) AS contract_date ,CAST('28 มกราคม 2558' AS VARCHAR(20)) AS payment_date ,CAST(845600.75 AS Money) AS payment_amount ,c.CompromiseContractId ,lg.CIFNo as CIFNo ,bs.BusinessName as BusinessDescription ,c.Installments as Installments ,dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(c.DebtRequestDate) as DebtRequestDate ,dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(c.BurdenDate) as BurdenDate ,sm.MeasureName as MeasureName ,c.Background as Background ,ap.GroupApproverName as ApproverLevel ,cd.BusinessName as BusinessDescriptionOld , case ' + -- dbo.FN_DCS_25_GetPosition(dbo.FN_TDR_01_GetApproverTDR(@ID, 271, 1)) + '

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_TDR_01_CompromiseContract_Approver_TDR] @CompromiseContractId NVARCHAR(150) = 'dfca7e19-bc54-43b6-b1da-12e833465054' AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; DECLARE @BlankSign NVARCHAR(400) = ( SELECT TOP 1 URLConfigReport + '/blank_sign_forReport.png' FROM dbo.SystemConfigReportMaster ); declare @LastApprover int = (SELECT top 1 ApproverUserId From TDRDataCompromiseContractApprover WHERE CompromiseContractId = @CompromiseContractId and ApproverTypeId in (271) order by Seq desc) declare @LastApproveDate nvarchar(50) = (SELECT top 1 CASE WHEN ApproverStatusId = 40 THEN + '
' + dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(ApproverDate) ELSE '' END From TDRDataCompromiseContractApprover WHERE CompromiseContractId = @CompromiseContractId and ApproverTypeId in (271) order by Seq desc) declare @LastApproveSign nvarchar(50) = (SELECT top 1 CASE WHEN ApproverStatusId = 40 THEN dbo.FN_DCS_43_GetSignature(ApproverUserId) ELSE @BlankSign END From TDRDataCompromiseContractApprover WHERE CompromiseContractId = @CompromiseContractId and ApproverTypeId in (271) order by Seq desc) declare @IsApprove nvarchar(50) = (SELECT TOP 1 CASE WHEN ApproverStatusId = 40 THEN '1' WHEN ApproverStatusId = 42 THEN '2' ELSE '0' END AS ApproverStatus FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractApprover WHERE CompromiseContractId = @CompromiseContractId AND ApproverTypeId = 271 ORDER BY Seq DESC) ;WITH ApproverRaw AS ( /* ===================================================== 1. ผู้จัดทำ ===================================================== */ SELECT dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(c.CompoundUserId) + '
' + dbo.FN_DCS_25_GetPosition_Short(c.CompoundUserId) + '
' + dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(c.CreateDate) AS Approver, ISNULL( dbo.FN_DCS_21_GetSignDocumentOfficer( c.CompoundUserId, 11 ), @BlankSign ) AS ApproverSign, N'ผู้จัดทำ' AS ApproverType, 1 AS ApproverTypeId, 0 AS Seq, c.MeetingNo, c.MeetingDate FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContract AS c WHERE c.CompromiseContractId = @CompromiseContractId UNION ALL /* ===================================================== 2. ผู้ตรวจ / ผู้พิจารณา / ผู้อนุมัติ ===================================================== */ SELECT dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(ap.ApproverUserId) + '
' + dbo.FN_DCS_25_GetPosition_Short(ap.ApproverUserId) + '
' + CASE WHEN ap.ApproverStatusId = 40 THEN dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(ap.ApproverDate) ELSE '' END AS Approver, CASE WHEN ap.ApproverStatusId = 40 THEN ISNULL( dbo.FN_DCS_21_GetSignDocumentOfficer( ap.ApproverUserId, 11 ), @BlankSign ) ELSE @BlankSign END AS ApproverSign, dbo.Fn_ValueLookup(ap.ApproverTypeId) AS ApproverType, ap.ApproverTypeId, ap.Seq, c.MeetingNo, c.MeetingDate FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractApprover AS ap LEFT JOIN dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContract AS c ON c.CompromiseContractId = ap.CompromiseContractId WHERE ap.CompromiseContractId = @CompromiseContractId -- ไม่เอาประเภทที่ไม่ต้องการแสดง AND ap.ApproverTypeId NOT IN (283, 282, 271) ), /* ===================================================== 3. จัดลำดับรายการที่ไม่ใช่ 271 - ผู้จัดทำ = ช่อง 1 - ผู้ตรวจ 269 สามารถมีหลายคน - รายการอื่นเรียงตาม Seq ===================================================== */ ApproverWithRunning AS ( SELECT r.*, SUM( CASE WHEN r.ApproverTypeId <> 271 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) OVER ( ORDER BY CASE WHEN r.ApproverTypeId = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, r.Seq, r.ApproverTypeId ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS RunningSeq FROM ApproverRaw AS r ), /* ===================================================== 4. สร้าง DisplaySeq สำหรับ Report 271 จะถูกย้ายไปช่องท้ายของชุดละ 4 ช่อง ตัวอย่าง: ผู้จัดทำ -> 1 ผู้ตรวจ 269 -> 2 ผู้อนุมัติ 271 -> 4 ถ้ามีผู้ตรวจ 2 คน: ผู้จัดทำ -> 1 ผู้ตรวจ 269 -> 2 ผู้ตรวจ 269 -> 3 ผู้อนุมัติ 271 -> 4 ===================================================== */ FinalData AS ( SELECT Approver, ApproverSign, ApproverType, ApproverTypeId, Seq, MeetingNo, MeetingDate, CASE WHEN ApproverTypeId = 271 THEN 4 ELSE RunningSeq END AS DisplaySeq FROM ApproverWithRunning ) SELECT Approver, ApproverSign, ApproverType, ApproverTypeId, Seq, DisplaySeq, MeetingNo, dbo.Fn_FormatDate(MeetingDate) as MeetingDate, dbo.FN_DCS_20_GetOfficerName(@LastApprover) + '
' + dbo.FN_DCS_25_GetPosition_Short(@LastApprover) + @LastApproveDate as LastApprover, @LastApproveSign as LastApproveSign, @IsApprove as IsApprove FROM FinalData ORDER BY DisplaySeq, Seq, ApproverTypeId; END

-- ============================================= -- Author: -- Create date: -- Description: -- ============================================= CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_TDR_01_CompromiseContract_Section2_T1] -- นำเข้าข้อมูลลูกหนี้ DataDebtor @ID nvarchar(150) ='69d9e3ff-a260-4d78-8cb5-6b87cafe608f' AS BEGIN declare @IsHairCut int = (select m.IsHairCut from TDRDataCompromiseContract c left join SystemMeasureMaster m on m.MeasureId = c.MeasureId where c.CompromiseContractId = @ID) if(@IsHairCut = 0) begin select distinct CAST(5 AS int) AS Seq ,b.BankAbbrName AS Bank ,clg.LGNo AS LG_Number ,c.ClaimTypeName AS Project_Type ,lg.ClaimPayAmount AS Compensation_Payment_Amount ,clg.PrincipalTotal AS Principal_Balance ,clg.TotalAccruedInterest AS Accrued_Interest ,clg.UpfrontAmount AS Upfront ,FORMAT(clg.UpfrontPercent, 'N2') AS Rate ,case when clg.Grade = 'F1'then dbo.Fn_FormatDateShort(dbo.[FN_DCS_38_GetUpfontInstallments](tdr.DebtRequestId, 1, clg.LGNo)) + ' -
' + dbo.Fn_FormatDateShort(dbo.[FN_DCS_38_GetUpfontInstallments](tdr.DebtRequestId, 2, clg.LGNo)) else '' end AS Repayment_Period --,case when clg.Grade = 'F1'then -- dbo.Fn_FormatDate(clg.StartInstallmentPeriod) + ' -
' -- + dbo.Fn_FormatDate(clg.EndInstallmentPeriod) --else '' end AS Repayment_Period --,dbo.[FN_DCS_38_GetUpfontInstallments](tdr.DebtRequestId, 1) --,case when clg.Grade = 'F1'then -- case when isnull(r.UpfrontAmount,1) = 0 then 1 else isnull(r.UpfrontAmount,1) end / -- case when isnull(r.UpfrontInstallments,1) = 0 then 1 else isnull(r.UpfrontInstallments,1) end --else 0 end AS Monthly_Installment , case when clg.Grade = 'F1'then InstallmentAmountPayment else 0 end AS Monthly_Installment , case when clg.Grade = 'F1' then dbo.Fn_FormatDateShort(lg.ClaimDate) else N' ภาระค้ำ ' + dbo.FN_FormatMillionBaht(lg.ClaimAmountCurrent) + N'เกรด ' + clg.Grade + '(' + dbo.Fn_FormatDateShort(clg.GradeKnowDate) + ')' end AS Payment_Date ,clg.Grade -- , case when isnull(r.UpfrontAmount,1) = 0 then 1 else isnull(r.UpfrontAmount,1) end / --case when isnull(r.UpfrontInstallments,1) = 0 then 1 else isnull(r.UpfrontInstallments,1) end as InstallmentsUpfrontAmount ,clg.RemarkCA ,clg.TotalInstallment ,clg.PercentCondition ,case when clg.Grade = 'F1' then '1' else clg.Grade end as Grade from TDRDataCompromiseContractLG clg left join TDRDataCompromiseContract tdr on tdr.CompromiseContractId = clg.CompromiseContractId left join DEBDataDebtRequest r on r.DebtRequestId = tdr.DebtRequestId left join DataLG lg on lg.LGNo = clg.LGNo left join SystemBankMaster b on b.BankId = lg.BankId left join SystemClaimTypeMaster c on c.ClaimTypeId = lg.ClaimTypeId where clg.CompromiseContractId = @ID and lg.StatusId != 500 end else if(@IsHairCut = 1) begin select distinct CAST(5 AS int) AS Seq ,b.BankAbbrName AS Bank ,clg.LGNo AS LG_Number ,c.ClaimTypeName AS Project_Type ,lg.ClaimPayAmount AS Compensation_Payment_Amount ,clg.PrincipalTotal AS Principal_Balance ,clg.TotalAccruedInterest AS Accrued_Interest ,clg.HaircutAmount AS Upfront ,clg.HaircutPercent AS Rate ,case when clg.Grade = 'F1'then dbo.Fn_FormatDateShort(dbo.[FN_DCS_38_GetUpfontInstallments](tdr.DebtRequestId, 1, clg.LGNo)) + ' -
' + dbo.Fn_FormatDateShort(dbo.[FN_DCS_38_GetUpfontInstallments](tdr.DebtRequestId, 2, clg.LGNo)) else '' end AS Repayment_Period --,case when clg.Grade = 'F1'then -- dbo.Fn_FormatDate(clg.StartInstallmentPeriod) + ' -
' -- + dbo.Fn_FormatDate(clg.EndInstallmentPeriod) --else '' end AS Repayment_Period --,dbo.[FN_DCS_38_GetUpfontInstallments](tdr.DebtRequestId, 1) --,case when clg.Grade = 'F1'then -- case when isnull(r.UpfrontAmount,1) = 0 then 1 else isnull(r.UpfrontAmount,1) end / -- case when isnull(r.UpfrontInstallments,1) = 0 then 1 else isnull(r.UpfrontInstallments,1) end --else 0 end AS Monthly_Installment , clg.PrincipalTotal - clg.HaircutAmount AS Monthly_Installment , case when clg.Grade = 'F1' then dbo.Fn_FormatDateShort(lg.ClaimDate) else N' ภาระค้ำ ' + dbo.FN_FormatMillionBaht(lg.ClaimAmountCurrent) + N'เกรด ' + clg.Grade + '(' + dbo.Fn_FormatDateShort(clg.GradeKnowDate) + ')' end AS Payment_Date ,clg.Grade -- , case when isnull(r.UpfrontAmount,1) = 0 then 1 else isnull(r.UpfrontAmount,1) end / --case when isnull(r.UpfrontInstallments,1) = 0 then 1 else isnull(r.UpfrontInstallments,1) end as InstallmentsUpfrontAmount ,clg.RemarkCA ,clg.TotalInstallment ,clg.PercentCondition ,case when clg.Grade = 'F1' then '1' else clg.Grade end as Grade from TDRDataCompromiseContractLG clg left join TDRDataCompromiseContract tdr on tdr.CompromiseContractId = clg.CompromiseContractId left join DEBDataDebtRequest r on r.DebtRequestId = tdr.DebtRequestId left join DataLG lg on lg.LGNo = clg.LGNo left join SystemBankMaster b on b.BankId = lg.BankId left join SystemClaimTypeMaster c on c.ClaimTypeId = lg.ClaimTypeId where clg.CompromiseContractId = @ID and lg.StatusId != 500 end END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_TDR_01_CompromiseContract_Section2_T2]
	-- นำเข้าข้อมูลลูกหนี้ DataDebtor

	@ID nvarchar(150) = '33484332-8be4-4d87-b1e7-e40b84d36071'
	
AS
BEGIN

 declare @IsHairCut int = (select m.IsHairCut
 from TDRDataCompromiseContract c
 left join SystemMeasureMaster m on m.MeasureId = c.MeasureId
 where c.CompromiseContractId = @ID)
 
   --SELECT 
   --     YearNo = Y.YearNo,
   --     InterestRate = CAST(4.05 AS DECIMAL(5,2)),  -- สมมุติว่าคงที่ทุกปี
   --     LGNo = LG.LGNo,
   --     InstallmentAmount = 
   --         CASE Y.YearNo
   --             WHEN 'ปี 1' THEN LG.Y1
   --             WHEN 'ปี 2' THEN LG.Y2
   --             WHEN 'ปี 3' THEN LG.Y3
   --             WHEN 'ปี 4' THEN LG.Y4
   --             WHEN 'ปี 5' THEN LG.Y5
   --             WHEN 'ปี 6' THEN LG.Y6
   --             WHEN 'ปี 7' THEN LG.Y7
   --         END 
   -- FROM 
   --     (VALUES ('ปี 1'),('ปี 2'),('ปี 3'),('ปี 4'),('ปี 5'),('ปี 6'),('ปี 7')) AS Y(YearNo)
   -- CROSS JOIN
   --     (
   --         VALUES
   --         ('60058015', 7100, 7100, 8100,11300, 32400, 48500, 80900),
   --         ('60085869', 6100, 6100, 6900, 9700, 27600, 41400, 69000),
   --         ('60077168', 5900, 5900, 6700, 9400, 26800, 40200, 67000),
   --         ('61055621', 2500, 2500, 2900, 4000, 11500, 17400, 28900),
   --         ('61050235',22400,22400,25400,35600,101700,152500,254200)
   --     ) AS LG(LGNo, Y1, Y2, Y3, Y4, Y5, Y6, Y7)
   --   --  Where YearNo <= 1
   -- ORDER BY Y.YearNo, LG.LGNo
if(@IsHairCut = 0)
begin
	select s.Year as YearNo
	, case when s.PaymentAmount = 0 then format(0,'N2') else format(c.InterestRate,'N2') end as InterestRate
	, s.LGNo
	, s.PaymentAmount as InstallmentAmount
	from TDRDataCompromiseContractPeriodSummary s
	left join TDRDataCompromiseContract c on c.CompromiseContractId = s.CompromiseContractId
	where s.CompromiseContractId = @ID
	ORDER BY s.Year , s.LGNo
end
else if(@IsHairCut = 1)
begin
select dbo.Fn_FormatDate(s.DueDate) as YearNo
	, format(c.InterestRate,'N2') as InterestRate
	, s.LGNo
	, s.Instament as InstallmentAmount
	from TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlan s
	left join TDRDataCompromiseContract c on c.CompromiseContractId = s.CompromiseContractId
	where s.CompromiseContractId = @ID
	
	ORDER BY s.DueDate , s.LGNo
end


		
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_TDR_01_CompromiseContract_Section2_T4]
	-- นำเข้าข้อมูลลูกหนี้ DataDebtor

	@ID nvarchar(150) = '64895471-80bb-45ea-b785-499ee292534d'
	
AS
BEGIN


    DECLARE @LGNo NVARCHAR(20);
	DECLARE @CountLG NVARCHAR(20);


    set @CountLG = (SELECT count(distinct LGNo)
        
       
    FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractLG
    WHERE CompromiseContractId = @ID)
	
		
  declare @Counts int =
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)/@CountLG
        FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlan
        WHERE CompromiseContractId = @ID
--           AND LGNo = @LGNo
    );
		
		declare @CountsName nvarchar(100) = case when @CountLG > 1 then  '3' + ' งวด' 
		when @Counts = 1 or @Counts = 0 then '7 วัน'
		 else '3' + ' งวด' end

 
--select r.TDRDataCompromiseRulesName, Seq+4 as Seq
--from TDRDataCompromiseRules r
--where r.CompromiseContractId = @ID
--order by Seq

select distinct replace(m.MeasureConditionName,'[Unit]', @CountsName) AS TDRDataCompromiseRulesName
, c.Seq
FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractDetail c
left join SystemMeasureConditionMaster m on m.MeasureConditionId = c.ContractDetailId
where c.CompromiseContractId = @ID

union all

select distinct replace(r.TDRDataCompromiseRulesName,'[Unit]', @CountsName) AS TDRDataCompromiseRulesName
, r.Seq + 3 as Seq
FROM TDRDataCompromiseRules r
left join TDRDataCompromiseContract c on r.CompromiseContractId = c.CompromiseContractId
where c.CompromiseContractId = @ID



--select @Counts
		
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_TDR_02_CompromiseContractApprove]
	-- นำเข้าข้อมูลลูกหนี้ DataDebtor
	@ID nvarchar(150) = 'b96dec43-08e2-4512-874b-956d74229845'
	--https://dcs-uat-report.sbcg.or.th:44383/ReportViewer?report=RP_TDR_02_CompromiseContractApprove&ID=25677c5b-d860-4f2f-8557-8f36ddd863b7
	
AS
BEGIN
declare @LGNo nvarchar(150) = (select LGNo from TDRDataCompromiseContractLG where CompromiseContractLGId = @ID)

declare @CompromiseContractId nvarchar(150) = (select CompromiseContractId from TDRDataCompromiseContractLG where CompromiseContractLGId = @ID)

declare @IsHairCut int = (select c.IsHairCut
 from TDRDataCompromiseContract c
 left join SystemMeasureMaster m on m.MeasureId = c.MeasureId
 where c.CompromiseContractId = @CompromiseContractId)
 --select @IsHairCut, @CompromiseContractId
 if(@IsHairCut = 0)
 begin

 select distinct
 dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(tdr.DebtRequestDate) as DebtRequestDate
 ,dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(tdr.BurdenDate) as DebtBurdenDate
 ,tdr_lg.CompromiseContractId
 , tdr_lg.DocumentApproveNo + ' ครั้งที่ ' + cast(tdr.SeqNo as nvarchar) as DocumentApproveNo
 , cast(pr.[Year] as nvarchar) as Year
 , pr.[Year] as SortOderYear
 , case when pr.PaymentAmount = 0 then '' else FORMAT(pr.PaymentAmount, 'N2') end as PaymentAmount
 , case when pr.PaymentAmount = 0 then '' else cast(tdr.InterestRate as nvarchar) end as InterestRate
 , tdr_lg.LGNo
 , tdr_lg.TotalDebtBalance
 , tdr_lg.ClaimPay
 , tdr_lg.TotalAccruedInterest
 , dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(lg.ClaimDate) as ClaimDate
 ,  case when  r.DebtorTypeId !=1 then ' ' +r.ProjectName + ' ' else '' end as  ProjectName
 , case when  r.DebtorTypeId !=1 then 'เฉพาะส่วนของท่าน' else '' end as DebtorTypeTeax 

 --, case when pr.[Year] >1 then  dateadd(month, 12, tdr_lg.StartInstallmentPeriod)
 --else  tdr_lg.StartInstallmentPeriod end
 --as StartInstallmentPeriod
 --,year(tdr_lg.StartInstallmentPeriod) + (pr.[Year] -1)
 --,pr.[Year] 
   , case when pr.PaymentAmount = 0 then '' else
		   case when pr.[Year] >1 then  dbo.[Fn_FormatDateMonth](dateadd(year, (pr.[Year]-1), tdr_lg.StartInstallmentPeriod))

		 else dbo.[Fn_FormatDateMonth](tdr_lg.StartInstallmentPeriod) end
		 + ' - ' +
 
		 case when pr.[Year] >1 then  dbo.[Fn_FormatDateMonth](dateadd(year, (pr.[Year]-1), dateadd(month, 11, tdr_lg.StartInstallmentPeriod)))
		 else dbo.[Fn_FormatDateMonth](dateadd(month, 11, tdr_lg.StartInstallmentPeriod)) end
	end
		 as StartInstallmentPeriod

 --, dbo.[FN_TDR_01_GetApproverTDR](@ID, 271) as Approver
 , tdr.CompoundUserId as Approver
 , dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(tdr.ApproveDate) as ApproveDate
 , dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(tdr.DebtRequestDate) as DebtDate
 from TDRDataCompromiseContractPeriodSummary pr
 left join TDRDataCompromiseContractLG tdr_lg on pr.CompromiseContractId = tdr_lg.CompromiseContractId
 left join DataLG lg on lg.LGNo = tdr_lg.LGNo
 left join TDRDataCompromiseContract tdr on tdr.CompromiseContractId = tdr_lg.CompromiseContractId
 left join TDRDataCompromiseContractDebtor cd on cd.CompromiseContractId = cd.CompromiseContractId and IsMain = 1
 left join DEBDataDebtRequest rr on rr.DebtRequestId = tdr.DebtRequestId
 left join DataDebtorRelate r on r.DebtorRelateId = tdr_lg.DebtorRelateId
 where tdr_lg.CompromiseContractLGId = @ID
 and pr.LGNo = @LGNo
 and lg.Grade = 'F1'
 and lg.ClaimDate <= tdr.ApproveDate
 --and pr.PaymentAmount >0
 --order by pr.[Year]
 end
 
 if(@IsHairCut = 1)
 begin

 select distinct
 dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(tdr.DebtRequestDate) as DebtRequestDate
 ,dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(tdr.BurdenDate) as DebtBurdenDate
 ,tdr_lg.CompromiseContractId
 , tdr_lg.DocumentApproveNo + ' ครั้งที่ ' + cast(tdr.SeqNo as nvarchar) as DocumentApproveNo
 , cast(pr.[Year] as nvarchar) as Year
 , pr.[Year] as SortOderYear
 , case when pr.PaymentAmount = 0 then '' else FORMAT(pr.PaymentAmount, 'N2') end as PaymentAmount
 , case when pr.PaymentAmount = 0 then '' else cast(tdr.InterestRate as nvarchar) end as InterestRate
 , tdr_lg.LGNo
 , tdr_lg.TotalDebtBalance
 , tdr_lg.ClaimPay
 , tdr_lg.TotalAccruedInterest
 , dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(tdr.ApproveDate) as ClaimDate
 ,  case when  r.DebtorTypeId !=1 then ' ' +r.ProjectName + ' ' else '' end as  ProjectName
 , case when  r.DebtorTypeId !=1 then 'เฉพาะส่วนของท่าน' else '' end as DebtorTypeTeax 

 --, case when pr.[Year] >1 then  dateadd(month, 12, tdr_lg.StartInstallmentPeriod)
 --else  tdr_lg.StartInstallmentPeriod end
 --as StartInstallmentPeriod
 --,year(tdr_lg.StartInstallmentPeriod) + (pr.[Year] -1)
 --,pr.[Year] 
   , case when pr.PaymentAmount = 0 then '' else
		   case when pr.[Year] >1 then  dbo.[Fn_FormatDateMonth](dateadd(year, (pr.[Year]-1), tdr_lg.StartInstallmentPeriod))

		 else dbo.[Fn_FormatDateMonth](tdr_lg.StartInstallmentPeriod) end
		 + ' - ' +
 
		 case when pr.[Year] >1 then  dbo.[Fn_FormatDateMonth](dateadd(year, (pr.[Year]-1), dateadd(month, 11, tdr_lg.StartInstallmentPeriod)))
		 else dbo.[Fn_FormatDateMonth](dateadd(month, 11, tdr_lg.StartInstallmentPeriod)) end
	end
		 as StartInstallmentPeriod

 --, dbo.[FN_TDR_01_GetApproverTDR](@ID, 271) as Approver
 , tdr.CompoundUserId as Approver
 , dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(tdr.ApproveDate) as ApproveDate
 , dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(tdr.DebtRequestDate) as DebtDate
 from TDRDataCompromiseContractPeriodSummary pr
 left join TDRDataCompromiseContractLG tdr_lg on pr.CompromiseContractId = tdr_lg.CompromiseContractId
 left join DataLG lg on lg.LGNo = tdr_lg.LGNo
 left join TDRDataCompromiseContract tdr on tdr.CompromiseContractId = tdr_lg.CompromiseContractId
 left join TDRDataCompromiseContractDebtor cd on cd.CompromiseContractId = cd.CompromiseContractId and IsMain = 1
 left join DEBDataDebtRequest rr on rr.DebtRequestId = tdr.DebtRequestId
 left join DataDebtorRelate r on r.DebtorRelateId = tdr_lg.DebtorRelateId
 where tdr_lg.CompromiseContractLGId = @ID
 and pr.LGNo = @LGNo
 and lg.Grade = 'F1'
 and lg.ClaimDate <= tdr.ApproveDate

 --order by pr.[Year]
 end
		
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_TDR_02_CompromiseContractApprove_2] @ID NVARCHAR(150) = '4b0ace51-b16f-4dcd-b286-ebc8d11911e0' AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; ;WITH DebtorData AS ( SELECT cd.CompromiseContractId, cd.DebtorRelateId, cd.IsMain, r.DebtorId, r.DebtorTypeId, r.ProjectName, dt.DebtorTypeName, tdr_lg.PathBarcode FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractDebtor cd LEFT JOIN dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContract c ON c.CompromiseContractId = cd.CompromiseContractId LEFT JOIN dbo.DataDebtorRelate r ON r.DebtorRelateId = cd.DebtorRelateId LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemDebtorType dt ON dt.DebtorTypeId = r.DebtorTypeId LEFT JOIN dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractLG tdr_lg ON tdr_lg.CompromiseContractId = c.CompromiseContractId WHERE tdr_lg.CompromiseContractLGId = @ID ), MainDebtor AS ( SELECT TOP (1) CompromiseContractId, DebtorRelateId, DebtorTypeId FROM DebtorData WHERE IsMain = 1 ORDER BY DebtorRelateId ) SELECT STRING_AGG(DebtorName, '
') WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY SortOrder, DebtorName ) AS DebtorName, MAX(DebtorAddress) AS DebtorAddress, dbo.FN_GetURLConfig() + MAX(PathBarcode) AS PathBarcode FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN dd.DebtorTypeId IN (2, 6) and dd.IsMain = 1 THEN dbo.FN_DCS_16_GetDebtorName(dd.DebtorId) + N' (ในฐานะ' + ISNULL(dd.DebtorTypeName, N'') + N' ลูกหนี้ราย' + ISNULL(dd.ProjectName, N'') + N')' ELSE dbo.FN_DCS_16_GetDebtorName(dd.DebtorId) + N' (ในฐานะ' + ISNULL(dd.DebtorTypeName, N'') + N')' END AS DebtorName, CASE dd.DebtorTypeId WHEN 1 THEN 1 WHEN 4 THEN 2 WHEN 2 THEN 3 WHEN 6 THEN 4 ELSE 999 END AS SortOrder, dbo.FN_DCS_12_GetDebtorAddressLetter( dd.DebtorId, 7 ) AS DebtorAddress, dd.PathBarcode FROM DebtorData dd LEFT JOIN MainDebtor md ON md.CompromiseContractId = dd.CompromiseContractId WHERE /* คนทำเป็นประเภท 2 หรือ 6 แสดงเฉพาะคนทำ */ ( md.DebtorTypeId IN (2, 6) AND dd.IsMain = 1 AND dd.DebtorRelateId = md.DebtorRelateId ) /* คนทำเป็นประเภทอื่น หรือไม่พบคนทำ แสดงทั้งหมด */ OR ISNULL(md.DebtorTypeId, 0) NOT IN (2, 6) ) x; END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_TDR_02_CompromiseContractDocument]

	@ID nvarchar(150) = 'b96dec43-08e2-4512-874b-956d74229845'
	
	
AS
BEGIN
declare @ApproveDate date = (select ApproveDate 
from TDRDataCompromiseContractLG lg
left join TDRDataCompromiseContract c on c.CompromiseContractId = lg.CompromiseContractId
where CompromiseContractLGId =  @ID)

declare @IntRate decimal(20,2) = (select top 1 IntRate from SystemInterateMaster where @ApproveDate between StartDate and EndDate and InterateTypeId = 111)

 select 
 replace(
 replace(
 replace(
 replace(
 replace(
 replace(dc.MeasureDocumentApproveName,'[UpfrontAmount]', FORMAT(tdr_lg.UpfrontAmount,'N2'))
 ,'[StartMonth]'
			,case when tdr.UpfrontInstallments >0 and tdr.Installments >0  then dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(EOMONTH(dateadd(month, -tdr.UpfrontInstallments , tdr.InstallmentsStartDate))) 
			when tdr.Installments =0 and tdr.UpfrontInstallments>0 then dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(EOMONTH(tdr.InstallmentsStartDate)) 
			end)
 ,'[EndMonth]'
			,case when tdr.UpfrontInstallments >0 and tdr.Installments >0 then dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(EOMONTH(dateadd(month, -1, tdr.InstallmentsStartDate))) 
			when tdr.Installments =0 and tdr.UpfrontInstallments>0 then dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(EOMONTH(tdr.InstallmentsStartDate)) 
			end)
 ,'[InterateRate]',@IntRate)
 ,'[ApproveDate]', dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(tdr.ApproveDate))
 ,'[DebtRequestDate]', dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(tdr.DebtRequestDate))as Document
 , dc.Seq
 from TDRDataCompromiseContract tdr 
 left join SystemMeasureDocumentApproveMaster dc on dc.MeasureId = tdr.MeasureId
 left join TDRDataCompromiseContractLG tdr_lg on tdr_lg.CompromiseContractId = tdr.CompromiseContractId

 where tdr_lg.CompromiseContractLGId = @ID
 order by dc.Seq

END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_TDR_03_GuaranteeContract]

	@ID nvarchar(150) = '3cdc8697-e53e-4af5-87be-3f17672297a7'
	
AS
BEGIN

   Select
	     dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(c.RequestDate) AS  contract_start_date
		,dbo.FN_DCS_16_GetDebtorName(d.DebtorId) AS  contractor_name
		,d.BirthDate

		,case when cast(d.BirthDate as date) = cast('1900-01-01' as date) then '' else DATEDIFF(YEAR, d.BirthDate, c.CreateDate) end AS  age

		,d.IDCard AS	citizen_id

		,g.GuaranteeContractNo
		,sdt.Name								AS	subdistrict
		,dt.Name								AS	district
		,p.Name								AS	province
		,ad.PostalCode								AS	postal_code
		,r.ProjectName				AS	contract_company_name
		,b.BankName AS	contract_bank_name
		,r.LGNo AS	guarantee_no
		,dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(c.RequestDate) AS	contract_date
		,dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(lg.ClaimDate) AS	payment_date
		,lg.ClaimPayAmount AS	payment_amount
		,dbo.Fn_ThaiBaht(lg.ClaimPayAmount) AS	payment_amount_text
		,r.DebtorRelateId
		,ad.DebtorAddressId
		from TDRDataGuaranteeContract g
		left join TDRDataCompromiseContract c on c.CompromiseContractId = g.CompromiseContractId
		left join DataDebtorRelate r on r.DebtorRelateId = g.DebtorRelateId
		
		left join DataLG lg on lg.LGNo = r.LGNo
		left join SystemBankMaster b on b.BankId = lg.BankId
		left join DataDebtor d on d.DebtorId = r.DebtorId
		left join DataDebtorAddress ad on ad.DebtorId = d.DebtorId and ad.DebtorAddressTypeId = 1
		left join SystemProvinceMaster p on ad.ProvinceId = p.ProvinceId
		left join SystemDistrictMaster dt on ad.DistrictId = dt.DistrictId 
		left join SystemSubDistrictMaster sdt on sdt.SubDistrictId = ad.SubDistrictId
		where g.GuaranteeContractId = @ID
		
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_TDR_05_TDRSummeryPercent]
	

	@LGNo nvarchar(20) = '',
	@DebtorRelateId nvarchar(150) = ''
	
AS
BEGIN

   ;WITH x AS
(
    SELECT
        p.*,
        MAX(p.Seq) OVER (PARTITION BY p.LGNo) AS MaxSeq,
        LAG(p.Instament) OVER (PARTITION BY p.LGNo ORDER BY p.Seq) AS PrevInstament
    FROM TEMPDEBDataDebtRequestInstallmentPlan p
    WHERE p.LGNo = @LGNo AND p.DebtorRelateId =@DebtorRelateId
),
y AS
(
    SELECT *,
        CASE  WHEN IsUpfront = 1 THEN 0
              WHEN Seq = MaxSeq THEN ISNULL(PrevInstament, 0)
              ELSE ISNULL(Instament, 0)
        END AS CalInstament
    FROM x
)
SELECT 
    LGNo,
    MAX(Balance) AS Balance,
    SUM(CalInstament) AS Instament,
    CAST(
        (SUM(CalInstament) / NULLIF(MAX(Balance), 0)) * 100
        AS DECIMAL(20,2)
    ) AS Percents
FROM y
GROUP BY LGNo;

		
END
