CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_TDR_07_CompromiseContractDocumentHaircut]
    @ID NVARCHAR(150) = 'cdcddca4-1392-4113-91db-2c3ab106781b'
AS
BEGIN

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    /* =========================================================
       0. ข้อมูล Compromise Contract
       ========================================================= */
    DECLARE @CompromiseContractId NVARCHAR(150);
    DECLARE @LGNo NVARCHAR(20);
    DECLARE @COUNT INT;

    SELECT
          @CompromiseContractId = CompromiseContractId
        , @LGNo = LGNo
    FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractLG
    WHERE CompromiseContractLGId = @ID;


    DECLARE @DueDateTDR DATE =
    (
        SELECT MAX(DueDate)
        FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlan
        WHERE CompromiseContractId = @CompromiseContractId
    );


    /* =========================================================
       จำนวนงวด

       @COUNT = 1 -> 7 วัน
       @COUNT > 1 -> X งวด
       ========================================================= */
    SET @COUNT =
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlan
        WHERE CompromiseContractId = @CompromiseContractId
          AND LGNo = @LGNo
          AND ISNULL(IsActive, 1) = 1
    );


    /* =========================================================
       1. วันที่อนุมัติ
       ========================================================= */
    DECLARE @ApproveDate DATE;

    SELECT TOP 1
        @ApproveDate = c.ApproveDate
    FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractLG lg

    LEFT JOIN dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContract c
        ON c.CompromiseContractId = lg.CompromiseContractId

    WHERE lg.CompromiseContractLGId = @ID;


    /* =========================================================
       2. อัตราดอกเบี้ย
       ========================================================= */
    DECLARE @IntRate DECIMAL(20, 2);

    SELECT TOP 1
        @IntRate = IntRate
    FROM dbo.SystemInterateMaster
    WHERE @ApproveDate BETWEEN StartDate AND EndDate
      AND InterateTypeId = 111;


    DECLARE @DueDate DATE;

    SET @DueDate =
    (
        SELECT MAX(DueDate)
        FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlan
        WHERE CompromiseContractId = @CompromiseContractId
    );


    /* =========================================================
       3. Payment Header

       ตัวอย่าง:
       2. ชำระเงิน จำนวน 767,800.00 บาท ภายใน 3 งวด
       นับจากวันอนุมัติ
       (ครบกำหนดวันที่ 31 ธันวาคม 2569)
       ========================================================= */
    DECLARE @PaymentHeader NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'';
    DECLARE @HeaderAmount DECIMAL(20, 2);
    DECLARE @HeaderDueDate DATE;


    SELECT TOP 1
          @HeaderAmount = tdr_lg.UpfrontAmount
        , @HeaderDueDate =
            dbo.FN_DCS_38_GetUpfontInstallments
            (
                tdr.DebtRequestId,
                2,
                tdr_lg.LGNo
            )
    FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContract tdr

    INNER JOIN dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractLG tdr_lg
        ON tdr_lg.CompromiseContractId = tdr.CompromiseContractId

    WHERE tdr_lg.CompromiseContractLGId = @ID;


    /* บังคับให้เป็น NVARCHAR(MAX) ตั้งแต่ต้น */
    SET @PaymentHeader =
        CONCAT
        (
            CAST(N'' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),

            N'2. ชำระเงิน จำนวน ',

            ISNULL
            (
                FORMAT(@HeaderAmount, 'N2'),
                N'0.00'
            ),

            N' บาท ภายใน ',

            CASE
                WHEN @COUNT = 1
                    THEN N'7 วัน'
                ELSE
                    CAST(ISNULL(@COUNT, 0) AS NVARCHAR(20))
                    + N' งวด'
            END,

            N' นับจากวันอนุมัติ ',

            N' (ครบกำหนดวันที่ ',

            ISNULL
            (
                CAST
                (
                    dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(@DueDateTDR)
                    AS NVARCHAR(MAX)
                ),
                N''
            ),

            N')',

            N' ให้จัดสรรเข้าชำระเงินต้นทั้งจำนวน โดยแบ่งชำระดังนี้'
        );


    /* =========================================================
       4. Payment Detail

       แก้ไข:
       1. เรียง DueDate จากน้อย -> มาก
       2. รันเลขใหม่ตาม DueDate
          วันที่น้อยสุด = 2.1
          วันที่ถัดไป   = 2.2
          วันที่ถัดไป   = 2.3
          ...
       ========================================================= */
    DECLARE @PaymentDetail NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'';
    DECLARE @Separator NVARCHAR(2) = N'';


    SELECT
        @PaymentDetail =
            STRING_AGG
            (
                CAST
                (
                      NCHAR(13) + NCHAR(10)

                    + N'   2.'
                    + CAST(x.RowNo AS NVARCHAR(10))

                    + N' ชำระเงิน จำนวน '
                    + FORMAT(x.Instament, 'N2')

                    + N' บาท'

                    + N' (ครบกำหนดวันที่ '

                    + ISNULL
                      (
                          CAST
                          (
                              dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(x.DueDate)
                              AS NVARCHAR(MAX)
                          ),
                          N''
                      )

                    + N')'

--                     + N' ให้จัดสรรเข้าชำระเงินต้นทั้งจำนวน'

                AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),

                @Separator
            )
            WITHIN GROUP
            (
                ORDER BY x.RowNo
            )

    FROM
    (
        SELECT
              ip.InstallmentSeq
            , ip.Instament
            , ip.DueDate

            /* =============================================
               รันเลขใหม่ตาม DueDate
               ============================================= */
            , ROW_NUMBER() OVER
              (
                  ORDER BY
                      ip.DueDate ASC,
                      ip.InstallmentSeq ASC
              ) AS RowNo

        FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlan ip

        INNER JOIN dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractLG lg
            ON lg.CompromiseContractId = ip.CompromiseContractId
           AND lg.LGNo = ip.LGNo

        WHERE lg.CompromiseContractLGId = @ID
          AND ISNULL(ip.IsActive, 1) = 1

    ) x;


    SET @PaymentDetail = ISNULL(@PaymentDetail, N'');


    /* =========================================================
       5. Replace ข้อมูลใน Template
       ========================================================= */
    SELECT

        REPLACE
        (
            REPLACE
            (
                REPLACE
                (
                    REPLACE
                    (
                        REPLACE
                        (
                            REPLACE
                            (
                                REPLACE
                                (
                                    REPLACE
                                    (
                                        REPLACE
                                        (
                                            CAST
                                            (
                                                dc.MeasureDocumentApproveName
                                                AS NVARCHAR(MAX)
                                            ),

                                            /* =============================================
                                               [PaymentHeader]
                                               ============================================= */
                                            N'[PaymentHeader]',
                                            @PaymentHeader
                                        ),

                                        /* =============================================
                                           [UpfrontAmount]
                                           ============================================= */
                                        N'[UpfrontAmount]',

                                        ISNULL
                                        (
                                            FORMAT
                                            (
                                                tdr_lg.UpfrontAmount,
                                                'N2'
                                            ),
                                            N'0.00'
                                        )
                                    ),

                                    /* =============================================
                                       [StartMonth]
                                       ============================================= */
                                    N'[StartMonth]',

                                    ISNULL
                                    (
                                        CAST
                                        (
                                            dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate
                                            (
                                                dbo.FN_DCS_38_GetUpfontInstallments
                                                (
                                                    tdr.DebtRequestId,
                                                    1,
                                                    tdr_lg.LGNo
                                                )
                                            )
                                            AS NVARCHAR(MAX)
                                        ),
                                        N''
                                    )
                                ),

                                /* =============================================
                                   [EndMonth]
                                   ============================================= */
                                N'[EndMonth]',

                                ISNULL
                                (
                                    CAST
                                    (
                                        dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate(@DueDateTDR)
                                        AS NVARCHAR(MAX)
                                    ),
                                    N''
                                )
                            ),

                            /* =============================================
                               [InterateRate]
                               ============================================= */
                            N'[InterateRate]',

                            ISNULL
                            (
                                CAST
                                (
                                    @IntRate
                                    AS NVARCHAR(MAX)
                                ),
                                N''
                            )
                        ),

                        /* =============================================
                           [ApproveDate]
                           ============================================= */
                        N'[ApproveDate]',

                        ISNULL
                        (
                            CAST
                            (
                                dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate
                                (
                                    tdr.ApproveDate
                                )
                                AS NVARCHAR(MAX)
                            ),
                            N''
                        )
                    ),

                    /* =============================================
                       [DebtRequestDate]
                       ============================================= */
                    N'[DebtRequestDate]',

                    ISNULL
                    (
                        CAST
                        (
                            dbo.Fn_FormatFullDate
                            (
                                tdr.DebtRequestDate
                            )
                            AS NVARCHAR(MAX)
                        ),
                        N''
                    )
                ),

                /* =============================================
                   [PaymentDetail]
                   ============================================= */
                N'[PaymentDetail]',
                @PaymentDetail
            ),

            /* =============================================
               [DateCountOrMont]

               @COUNT = 1 -> 7 วัน
               @COUNT > 1 -> X งวด
               ============================================= */
            N'[DateCountOrMont]',

            CASE
                WHEN @COUNT = 1
                    THEN N'7 วัน'

                ELSE
                    CAST
                    (
                        ISNULL(@COUNT, 0)
                        AS NVARCHAR(20)
                    )
                    + N' งวด'
            END

        ) AS Document,

        dc.Seq

    FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContract tdr

    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemMeasureDocumentApproveMaster dc
        ON dc.MeasureId = tdr.MeasureId

    LEFT JOIN dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractLG tdr_lg
        ON tdr_lg.CompromiseContractId = tdr.CompromiseContractId

    WHERE tdr_lg.CompromiseContractLGId = @ID

    ORDER BY dc.Seq;


    /* =========================================================
       Debug DueDate
       ========================================================= */
    SELECT @DueDateTDR;

END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_RP_TDR_ApprovedMeasures]
    @CompromiseContractId nvarchar(150) = '7095ee89-6073-4e75-a793-c10ed790c357'
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.CompromiseContractId,

        -- CIFNo จาก DataDebtorRelate
        dr.CIFNo AS DebtorCode,

        clg.LGNo,
        debtor.DebtorName,

        m.MeasureRemark AS MeasureName,
        m.MeasureDetail,

        dbo.FN_DCS_12_GetDebtorAddressLetter(
            debtor.DebtorId,
            7
        ) AS DebtorAddress,

        /* =====================================================
           ยอดจาก Contract เดิม
           ===================================================== */
        ccdlg.PrincipalTotal,
        ccdlg.TotalAccruedInterest AS AccruedInterestTotal,

        /* =====================================================
           งวดของ Contract เดิมในเดือนปัจจุบัน
           ===================================================== */
        ccip.Instament AS AmountperiodOut,
        dbo.Fn_FormatDate(ccip.DueDate) AS DueDate,

        /* =====================================================
           Measure เดิม
           ===================================================== */
        md.MeasureName AS MeasureNameOlg,

        /* =====================================================
           วันภาระหนี้
           ===================================================== */
        dbo.Fn_FormatDate(c.BurdenDate) AS BurdenDate,

        /* =====================================================
           ช่วงงวด
           ===================================================== */
        CASE
            WHEN c.InstallmentsStartDate IS NULL
                 AND c.InstallmentsEndDate IS NULL
                THEN '-'

            WHEN c.InstallmentsStartDate IS NULL
                THEN '- - '
                     + RIGHT(
                         '0' + CAST(MONTH(c.InstallmentsEndDate) AS varchar(2)),
                         2
                     )
                     + '/'
                     + CAST(
                         YEAR(c.InstallmentsEndDate) + 543
                         AS varchar(4)
                     )

            WHEN c.InstallmentsEndDate IS NULL
                THEN RIGHT(
                         '0' + CAST(MONTH(c.InstallmentsStartDate) AS varchar(2)),
                         2
                     )
                     + '/'
                     + CAST(
                         YEAR(c.InstallmentsStartDate) + 543
                         AS varchar(4)
                     )
                     + ' -'

            ELSE
                RIGHT(
                    '0' + CAST(MONTH(c.InstallmentsStartDate) AS varchar(2)),
                    2
                )
                + '/'
                + CAST(
                    YEAR(c.InstallmentsStartDate) + 543
                    AS varchar(4)
                )
                + ' - '
                + RIGHT(
                    '0' + CAST(MONTH(c.InstallmentsEndDate) AS varchar(2)),
                    2
                )
                + '/'
                + CAST(
                    YEAR(c.InstallmentsEndDate) + 543
                    AS varchar(4)
                )
        END AS InstallmentPeriod,

        c.Remark3,
        c.MeetingNo,
        c.MeetingDate

    FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContract AS c

    /* =====================================================
       ลูกหนี้หลักของ Contract
       ===================================================== */
    LEFT JOIN
    (
        SELECT
            cd.CompromiseContractId,

            MIN(cd.DebtorId) AS DebtorId,

            MIN(
                LTRIM(
                    RTRIM(
                        ISNULL(title.TitleShortName, '')
                        + ISNULL(d.FirstName, '')
                        + ' '
                        + ISNULL(d.LastName, '')
                    )
                )
            ) AS DebtorName,

            MIN(cd.DebtorRelateId) AS DebtorRelateId

        FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractDebtor AS cd

        INNER JOIN dbo.DataDebtorRelate AS dr0
            ON cd.DebtorRelateId = dr0.DebtorRelateId

        LEFT JOIN dbo.DataDebtor AS d
            ON cd.DebtorId = d.DebtorId

        INNER JOIN dbo.SystemTitleMaster AS title
            ON d.TitleId = title.TitleId

        WHERE cd.IsMain = 1

        GROUP BY
            cd.CompromiseContractId

    ) AS debtor
        ON c.CompromiseContractId = debtor.CompromiseContractId


    /* =====================================================
       เอา CIFNo จาก DataDebtorRelate
       ===================================================== */
    LEFT JOIN dbo.DataDebtorRelate AS dr
        ON debtor.DebtorRelateId = dr.DebtorRelateId


    /* =====================================================
       Measure ปัจจุบัน
       ===================================================== */
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemMeasureMaster AS m
        ON c.MeasureId = m.MeasureId


    /* =====================================================
       LG ของ Contract ปัจจุบัน

       สำคัญ:
       ต้อง JOIN ตัวนี้ก่อน ccdlg
       เพื่อให้เอา clg.LGNo ไปจับกับ LG ของ Contract เดิมได้
       ===================================================== */
    INNER JOIN dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractLG AS clg
        ON c.CompromiseContractId = clg.CompromiseContractId
       AND clg.Grade = 'F1'


    /* =====================================================
       Contract เดิม จาก RefId
       ===================================================== */
    LEFT JOIN dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContract AS ccd
        ON ccd.CompromiseContractId = c.RefId


    /* =====================================================
       LG ของ Contract เดิม

       ต้องจับ:
       Contract เดิม + LG เดียวกับ Contract ปัจจุบัน

       ไม่งั้นถ้ามี 2 LG
       จะกลายเป็น 2 x 2 = 4 แถว
       ===================================================== */
    LEFT JOIN dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractLG AS ccdlg
        ON ccdlg.CompromiseContractId = ccd.CompromiseContractId
       AND ccdlg.LGNo = clg.LGNo
       AND ccdlg.Seq IS NOT NULL
       AND ccdlg.Grade = 'F1'


    /* =====================================================
       Measure ของ Contract เดิม
       ===================================================== */
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemMeasureMaster AS md
        ON ccd.MeasureId = md.MeasureId


    /* =====================================================
       งวด Contract เดิม
       เฉพาะเดือน/ปีปัจจุบัน

       และต้องเป็น LG เดียวกัน
       ===================================================== */
    LEFT JOIN dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlan AS ccip
        ON ccip.CompromiseContractId = ccd.CompromiseContractId

       AND ccip.LGNo = clg.LGNo

       AND ccip.DueDate >= DATEFROMPARTS(
            YEAR(GETDATE()),
            MONTH(GETDATE()),
            1
       )

       AND ccip.DueDate < DATEADD(
            MONTH,
            1,
            DATEFROMPARTS(
                YEAR(GETDATE()),
                MONTH(GETDATE()),
                1
            )
       )


    /* =====================================================
       Filter
       ===================================================== */
    WHERE c.CompromiseContractId = @CompromiseContractId

      AND clg.Grade = 'F1'

      AND clg.Installments <> 0
      AND clg.Installments IS NOT NULL

      AND clg.Seq IS NOT NULL


    ORDER BY
        clg.LGNo;

END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_Run_Card]
	-- ดึงข้อมูลจาก CBS ทุกวัน
	@StartDate date = '2025-06-25'
	,@EndDate date = '2025-12-23'
	,@DataDebtorCardId nvarchar(150) = 'BC8E80F9-BA1D-492A-9A87-60EA92E9DBD0'
	
	
AS
BEGIN

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    
	set @StartDate = (select ClaimPayDate from DataDebtorCard where  DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId)
	DECLARE @CurrentDate DATE = @StartDate;
	declare @DFDDate date = (select DFDDate from DataDebtorCard where  DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId)
	declare @InterestRate decimal(20,2) = (select top 1 IntRate from SystemInterateMaster where InterateTypeId = 111 and IsActive = 1 )
	declare @InterestDefaultRate decimal(20,2) = (select top 1 IntRate from SystemInterateMaster where InterateTypeId = 112 and IsActive = 1 )
	declare @Date date = cast('1900-01-01' as date)
    WHILE @CurrentDate <= @EndDate
    BEGIN
        -- รันสโตเดิม (เปลี่ยนชื่อเป็นของคุณ เช่น SP_OldProcedure)
		if(day(@CurrentDate) = 1)
		BEGIN
			EXEC [SP_DCS_Card_003_InsertBalance] @CurrentDate, @DataDebtorCardId, 0, @Date;

		END

		if(@CurrentDate = dateadd(day, 1, @DFDDate))
		BEGIN

		Update DataDebtorCard
		set InterestRate = InterestPlannedRate + @InterestDefaultRate
		, InterestDefaultRate = @InterestDefaultRate
		where DataDebtorCard.DataDebtorCardId = @DataDebtorCardId;

			EXEC dbo.[SP_DCS_Card_024_InsertInterestRate]@DataDebtorCardId, @CurrentDate, @InterestDefaultRate

			EXEC [SP_DCS_Card_003_InsertBalance] @CurrentDate, @DataDebtorCardId, 0, @Date;

		END

			EXEC [SP_DCS_Card_002_UpdateInterestEveryDay] @CurrentDate, @DataDebtorCardId;
        -- ขยับไปวันถัดไป
        SET @CurrentDate = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @CurrentDate);
    END
END

CREATE   PROCEDURE dbo.SP_SaveCommissionOA
(
    @ReceiptIds NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,
    @CreateBy INT
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    BEGIN TRY

        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        /* ============================================================
           1. ตรวจสอบ Receipt Filter

           NULL / '' / [] = ไม่ Filter ReceiptId
           ============================================================ */
        DECLARE @HasReceiptFilter BIT =
            CASE
                WHEN @ReceiptIds IS NULL
                  OR LTRIM(RTRIM(@ReceiptIds)) = ''
                  OR LTRIM(RTRIM(@ReceiptIds)) = '[]'
                THEN 0
                ELSE 1
            END;


        /* ============================================================
           2. ลบ Temp Table เผื่อมีการ Run ซ้ำใน Session
           ============================================================ */
        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #CommissionDetail;
        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TotalCommission;


        /* ============================================================
           3. คำนวณ Detail
           ============================================================ */
        ;WITH ReceiptFilter AS
        (
            SELECT
                LTRIM(RTRIM([value])) AS ReceiptId

            FROM OPENJSON
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN @HasReceiptFilter = 1
                        THEN @ReceiptIds
                    ELSE N'[]'
                END
            )
        ),

        CommissionConfig AS
        (
            SELECT
                map.CommissionOAMappingId,
                map.CommissionOAId,
                map.OAGroupId,

                oa.OAGroupName,

                TRY_CAST(
                    condition.ParameterValue AS DECIMAL(18,2)
                ) AS ParameterValue,

                lookup.LookUpValue,

                com_d.StartAmount,
                com_d.EndAmount,
                com_d.[Percent]

            FROM SystemCommissionOAMappingMaster map

            INNER JOIN SystemCommissionOAMaster com
                ON map.CommissionOAId = com.CommissionOAId

            INNER JOIN SystemCommissionOADetailMaster com_d
                ON com.CommissionOAId = com_d.CommissionOAId

            INNER JOIN SystemOAGroupMaster oa
                ON map.OAGroupId = oa.OAGroupId

            LEFT JOIN SystemConditionCommissionOAMaster condition
                ON map.CommissionOAId = condition.ConditionCommissionOAId

            LEFT JOIN SystemLookupMaster lookup
                ON condition.OperatorsId = lookup.LookupId

            WHERE com.IsActive = 1
        ),

        BaseData AS
        (
            SELECT DISTINCT
                a.ReceiptId,

                b.AssignOAId,
                a.DebtorRelateId,
                b.LGNo,

                c.PrincipalTotal,
                a.PaymentAmount,

                b.CollectorOAUserId,

                c.DebtorCardName AS DebtorName,

                dr.DebtorTypeId,

                a.ReceiptDate AS EffectiveDate,

                d.OrgSectionId,
                f.SectionNameTH

            FROM ACCDataReceipt a

            INNER JOIN DEBDataAssignOA b
                ON a.DebtorRelateId = b.DebtorRelateId

            INNER JOIN DataDebtorCard c
                ON a.DebtorRelateId = c.DebtorRelateId

            INNER JOIN DataDebtorRelate dr
                ON a.DebtorRelateId = dr.DebtorRelateId

            INNER JOIN DataPersonalInfo d
                ON b.CollectorOAUserId = d.UserId

            INNER JOIN SystemOrgSectionMaster f
                ON d.OrgSectionId = f.OrgSectionId

            WHERE
                a.IsCommission = 1

                AND
                (
                    @HasReceiptFilter = 0

                    OR EXISTS
                    (
                        SELECT 1
                        FROM ReceiptFilter rf

                        WHERE
                            CAST(a.ReceiptId AS NVARCHAR(150))
                            = rf.ReceiptId
                    )
                )
        ),

        LGSummary AS
        (
            SELECT
                AssignOAId,
                DebtorRelateId,

                CollectorOAUserId,
                EffectiveDate,

                DebtorName,
                DebtorTypeId,

                SectionNameTH,
                LGNo,

                MAX(
                    ISNULL(PrincipalTotal, 0)
                ) AS PrincipalTotal,

                SUM(
                    ISNULL(PaymentAmount, 0)
                ) AS PaymentAmount

            FROM BaseData

            GROUP BY
                AssignOAId,
                DebtorRelateId,
                CollectorOAUserId,
                EffectiveDate,
                DebtorName,
                DebtorTypeId,
                SectionNameTH,
                LGNo
        ),

        LGCommissionGroup AS
        (
            SELECT
                l.*,

                c.CommissionOAId,
                c.OAGroupId,
                c.OAGroupName,

                c.ParameterValue,
                c.LookUpValue

            FROM LGSummary l

            INNER JOIN
            (
                SELECT DISTINCT
                    CommissionOAId,
                    OAGroupId,
                    OAGroupName,
                    ParameterValue,
                    LookUpValue

                FROM CommissionConfig
            ) c
                ON
                (
                       (
                           c.LookUpValue = '<='
                           AND l.PrincipalTotal <= c.ParameterValue
                       )

                    OR (
                           c.LookUpValue = '<'
                           AND l.PrincipalTotal < c.ParameterValue
                       )

                    OR (
                           c.LookUpValue = '>='
                           AND l.PrincipalTotal >= c.ParameterValue
                       )

                    OR (
                           c.LookUpValue = '>'
                           AND l.PrincipalTotal > c.ParameterValue
                       )

                    OR (
                           c.LookUpValue = '='
                           AND l.PrincipalTotal = c.ParameterValue
                       )
                )
        ),

        CalculateStep AS
        (
            SELECT
                l.*,

                c.StartAmount,
                c.EndAmount,
                c.[Percent],

                CASE

                    WHEN l.PaymentAmount <= ISNULL(c.StartAmount, 0)
                        THEN 0

                    WHEN c.EndAmount IS NULL
                        THEN
                            l.PaymentAmount
                            - ISNULL(c.StartAmount, 0)

                    WHEN l.PaymentAmount > c.EndAmount
                        THEN
                            c.EndAmount
                            - ISNULL(c.StartAmount, 0)

                    ELSE
                        l.PaymentAmount
                        - ISNULL(c.StartAmount, 0)

                END AS AmountInRange

            FROM LGCommissionGroup l

            INNER JOIN CommissionConfig c
                ON l.CommissionOAId = c.CommissionOAId
               AND l.OAGroupId = c.OAGroupId
        ),

        CalculateResult AS
        (
            SELECT
                AssignOAId,
                DebtorRelateId,

                CollectorOAUserId,
                EffectiveDate,

                DebtorName,
                DebtorTypeId,

                LGNo,
                OAGroupId,

                PaymentAmount,

                /* ============================================
                   STEP 1 %
                   ============================================ */
                MAX
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN ISNULL(StartAmount, 0) = 0
                            THEN [Percent]
                    END
                ) AS Commission,

                /* ============================================
                   STEP 1 Amount
                   ============================================ */
                SUM
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN ISNULL(StartAmount, 0) = 0
                         AND AmountInRange > 0
                            THEN
                                AmountInRange
                                * ([Percent] / 100.0)

                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ) AS CommissionAmount,

                /* ============================================
                   STEP 2 %
                   ============================================ */
                MAX
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN ISNULL(StartAmount, 0) > 0
                            THEN [Percent]
                    END
                ) AS CommissionStepUp,

                /* ============================================
                   STEP 2 Amount
                   ============================================ */
                SUM
                (
                    CASE
                        WHEN ISNULL(StartAmount, 0) > 0
                         AND AmountInRange > 0
                            THEN
                                AmountInRange
                                * ([Percent] / 100.0)

                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ) AS CommissionStepUpAmount

            FROM CalculateStep

            GROUP BY
                AssignOAId,
                DebtorRelateId,
                CollectorOAUserId,
                EffectiveDate,
                DebtorName,
                DebtorTypeId,
                LGNo,
                OAGroupId,
                PaymentAmount
        )

        /* ============================================================
           4. เก็บ Detail ลง Temp
           ============================================================ */
        SELECT
            AssignOAId,
            DebtorRelateId,

            EffectiveDate,

            CollectorOAUserId,

            DebtorName,
            DebtorTypeId,

            LGNo,

            OAGroupId AS CommissionGroupId,

            CAST(
                ISNULL(Commission, 0)
                AS DECIMAL(20,2)
            ) AS Commission,

            CAST(
                ISNULL(CommissionAmount, 0)
                AS DECIMAL(20,2)
            ) AS CommissionAmount,

            CAST(
                ISNULL(CommissionStepUp, 0)
                AS DECIMAL(20,2)
            ) AS CommissionStepUp,

            CAST(
                ISNULL(CommissionStepUpAmount, 0)
                AS DECIMAL(20,2)
            ) AS CommissionStepUpAmount,

            CAST(
                ISNULL(PaymentAmount, 0)
                AS DECIMAL(20,2)
            ) AS PaymentAmount,

            CAST
            (
                ISNULL(CommissionAmount, 0)
                + ISNULL(CommissionStepUpAmount, 0)

                AS DECIMAL(20,2)
            ) AS CommissionTotalAmount

        INTO #CommissionDetail

        FROM CalculateResult;


        /* ============================================================
           5. ถ้าไม่มีข้อมูล ไม่ต้องบันทึก
           ============================================================ */
        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM #CommissionDetail
        )
        BEGIN

            COMMIT TRANSACTION;

            SELECT
                CAST(0 AS INT) AS TotalInserted,
                CAST(0 AS INT) AS DetailInserted,
                N'ไม่พบข้อมูลสำหรับคำนวณค่าคอมมิชชั่น' AS Message;

            RETURN;
        END;


        /* ============================================================
           6. สร้าง Total

           TotalCommissionOAId สร้างไว้ตรงนี้เลย
           เพื่อให้ Detail เอา ID ตัวเดียวกันไปอ้างอิงได้
           ============================================================ */
        SELECT
            CONVERT(
                NVARCHAR(150),
                NEWID()
            ) AS TotalCommissionOAId,

            AssignOAId,

            MAX(EffectiveDate) AS EffectiveDate,

            CollectorOAUserId,

            MAX(DebtorName) AS DebtorName,

            MAX(DebtorTypeId) AS DebtorTypeId,

            CommissionGroupId,

            CAST
            (
                SUM(CommissionAmount)
                AS DECIMAL(20,2)
            ) AS CommissionAmount,

            CAST
            (
                SUM(CommissionStepUpAmount)
                AS DECIMAL(20,2)
            ) AS CommissionStepUpAmount,

            CAST
            (
                SUM(CommissionTotalAmount)
                AS DECIMAL(20,2)
            ) AS CommissionTotalAmount,

            CAST
            (
                SUM(PaymentAmount)
                AS DECIMAL(20,2)
            ) AS PaymentTotalAmount

        INTO #TotalCommission

        FROM #CommissionDetail

        GROUP BY
            AssignOAId,
            CollectorOAUserId,
            CommissionGroupId;


        /* ============================================================
           7. INSERT Total ก่อน
              DEBDataTotalCommissionOA
           ============================================================ */

        INSERT INTO DEBDataTotalCommissionOA
        (
            TotalCommissionOAId,
            AssignOAId,

            EffectiveDate,

            CollectorOAUserId,

            DebtorName,
            DebtorTypeId,

            Seq,

            CommissionAmount,

            CommissionGroupId,

            CommissionStepUpAmount,

            CommissionTotalAmount,

            PaymentTotalAmount,

            CreateDate,
            CreateBy,

            UpdateDate,
            UpdateBy
        )
        SELECT
            t.TotalCommissionOAId,
            t.AssignOAId,

            t.EffectiveDate,

            t.CollectorOAUserId,

            t.DebtorName,
            t.DebtorTypeId,

            ROW_NUMBER() OVER
            (
                PARTITION BY t.AssignOAId
                ORDER BY
                    t.CommissionGroupId
            ) AS Seq,

            t.CommissionAmount,

            t.CommissionGroupId,

            t.CommissionStepUpAmount,

            t.CommissionTotalAmount,

            t.PaymentTotalAmount,

            GETDATE(),
            @CreateBy,

            NULL,
            NULL

        FROM #TotalCommission t;


        DECLARE @TotalInserted INT = @@ROWCOUNT;


        /* ============================================================
           8. INSERT Detail
              DEBDataCommissionOA
           ============================================================ */

        INSERT INTO DEBDataCommissionOA
        (
            CommissionOAId,
            TotalCommissionOAId,

            AssignOAId,
            DebtorRelateId,

            EffectiveDate,

            CollectorOAUserId,

            DebtorName,
            DebtorTypeId,

            Seq,

            Commission,
            CommissionAmount,

            CommissionGroupId,

            CommissionStepUp,
            CommissionStepUpAmount,

            PaymentAmount,

            CommissionTotalAmount,

            CreateDate,
            CreateBy,

            UpdateDate,
            UpdateBy
        )

        SELECT
            /* Detail PK */
            CONVERT(
                NVARCHAR(150),
                NEWID()
            ) AS CommissionOAId,

            /* FK ไป Total */
            t.TotalCommissionOAId,

            d.AssignOAId,
            d.DebtorRelateId,

            d.EffectiveDate,

            d.CollectorOAUserId,

            d.DebtorName,
            d.DebtorTypeId,

            ROW_NUMBER() OVER
            (
                PARTITION BY
                    d.AssignOAId,
                    d.CollectorOAUserId,
                    d.CommissionGroupId

                ORDER BY
                    d.LGNo,
                    d.DebtorRelateId
            ) AS Seq,

            d.Commission,
            d.CommissionAmount,

            d.CommissionGroupId,

            d.CommissionStepUp,
            d.CommissionStepUpAmount,

            d.PaymentAmount,

            d.CommissionTotalAmount,

            GETDATE(),
            @CreateBy,

            NULL,
            NULL

        FROM #CommissionDetail d

        INNER JOIN #TotalCommission t
            ON t.AssignOAId = d.AssignOAId

           AND t.CollectorOAUserId
               = d.CollectorOAUserId

           AND t.CommissionGroupId
               = d.CommissionGroupId;


        DECLARE @DetailInserted INT = @@ROWCOUNT;


        /* ============================================================
           9. Commit
           ============================================================ */
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;


        /* ============================================================
           10. Return Result
           ============================================================ */
        SELECT
            @TotalInserted AS TotalInserted,
            @DetailInserted AS DetailInserted,

            N'บันทึกค่าคอมมิชชั่นเรียบร้อย' AS Message;


        /* ============================================================
           11. Result รายการ Total ที่สร้าง
           ============================================================ */
        SELECT
            TotalCommissionOAId,
            AssignOAId,
            EffectiveDate,
            CollectorOAUserId,
            DebtorName,
            DebtorTypeId,
            CommissionGroupId,
            CommissionAmount,
            CommissionStepUpAmount,
            CommissionTotalAmount,
            PaymentTotalAmount

        FROM #TotalCommission

        ORDER BY
            CollectorOAUserId,
            CommissionGroupId;


    END TRY

    BEGIN CATCH

        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

        DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(4000)
            = ERROR_MESSAGE();

        DECLARE @ErrorLine INT
            = ERROR_LINE();

        DECLARE @ErrorProcedure NVARCHAR(200)
            = ERROR_PROCEDURE();

        THROW;

    END CATCH;

END;

modules.name: SP_TDR_002_UpdatePeriod

create   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_TDR_002_UpdatePeriod]
 



	
AS
BEGIN
  SET NOCOUNT ON;
----Update ปี ---------------------------------------------	
;WITH MaxPeriodYear AS
(
    SELECT
        p.CompromiseContractId,
        p.LGNo,
        MAX(p.[Year]) AS MaxYear
    FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractPeriodSummary p
    WHERE ISNULL(p.PaymentAmount, 0) > 0
    GROUP BY
        p.CompromiseContractId,
        p.LGNo
)
UPDATE clg
SET clg.PeriodYear = m.MaxYear
FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractLG clg
INNER JOIN MaxPeriodYear m
    ON m.CompromiseContractId = clg.CompromiseContractId
   AND m.LGNo = clg.LGNo
WHERE clg.PeriodYear IS NULL
  AND clg.Grade = N'F1';

----Update งวด ---------------------------------------------	
;WITH PeriodMonthSummary AS
(
    SELECT
        p.CompromiseContractId,
        p.LGNo,
        COUNT(*) AS PeriodMonth
    FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlan p
    WHERE ISNULL(p.IsUpfront, 0) = 0
      AND (ISNULL(p.Balance, 0) > 0 )
	  and p.Principal>0
	  
    GROUP BY
        p.CompromiseContractId,
        p.LGNo
)
UPDATE clg
SET clg.PeriodMonth = s.PeriodMonth
FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractLG clg
INNER JOIN PeriodMonthSummary s
    ON s.CompromiseContractId = clg.CompromiseContractId
   AND s.LGNo = clg.LGNo
   and clg.PeriodMonth is null
WHERE clg.Grade = N'F1';


	
	


END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_Test_Params_Echo]
    -- 1. Date Params (Common)
    @StartDate    DATE = NULL,
    @EndDate      DATE = NULL,

    -- 2. Filter Params (Common in DCS/DEB)
    @DebtorCode   NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,
    @LGNo         NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,
    @StartYear    INT = NULL,
    @EndYear      INT = NULL,
    
    -- 3. Dynamic/Optional Flags (To test if boolean/int flags are passed)
    @IsActive     BIT = NULL,
    @UserRole     INT = NULL,
    
    -- 4. Catch-all for testing text injection
    @SearchText   NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL

AS
BEGIN
    -- Return a table showing the received values for debugging
    SELECT 
        'StartDate' AS ParamName, CAST(@StartDate AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS ReceivedValue, CASE WHEN @StartDate IS NULL THEN 'MISSING' ELSE 'OK' END AS Status
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        'EndDate', CAST(@EndDate AS NVARCHAR(50)), CASE WHEN @EndDate IS NULL THEN 'MISSING' ELSE 'OK' END
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        'DebtorCode', ISNULL(@DebtorCode, 'NULL'), CASE WHEN @DebtorCode IS NULL THEN 'MISSING' ELSE 'OK' END
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        'LGNo', ISNULL(@LGNo, 'NULL'), CASE WHEN @LGNo IS NULL THEN 'MISSING' ELSE 'OK' END
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        'StartYear', CAST(@StartYear AS NVARCHAR(50)), CASE WHEN @StartYear IS NULL THEN 'MISSING' ELSE 'OK' END
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        'EndYear', CAST(@EndYear AS NVARCHAR(50)), CASE WHEN @EndYear IS NULL THEN 'MISSING' ELSE 'OK' END
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        'IsActive', CAST(@IsActive AS NVARCHAR(50)), CASE WHEN @IsActive IS NULL THEN 'MISSING' ELSE 'OK' END
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        'UserRole', CAST(@UserRole AS NVARCHAR(50)), CASE WHEN @UserRole IS NULL THEN 'MISSING' ELSE 'OK' END
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        'SearchText', ISNULL(@SearchText, 'NULL'), CASE WHEN @SearchText IS NULL THEN 'MISSING' ELSE 'OK' END;

END

		IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.sysdiagram_properties') IS NULL

			CREATE TABLE dbo.sysdiagram_properties
			(

				name sysname,

			)

			(
				[name],
				[principal_id],
				[version],

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_WonderData_GetBatchOutbound]
    @AsOfDate DATE
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    ;WITH LatestAssignment AS (
        SELECT
            DebtorRelateId,
            CollectorUserId,
            CompromiseUserId,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY DebtorRelateId
                ORDER BY
                    CASE WHEN ISNULL(CollectorUserId, 0) <> 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                    ISNULL(UpdateDate, CreateDate) DESC,
                    CreateDate DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM DataAssignment
    ),
    LatestPersonalInfo AS (
        SELECT
            UserId,
            FirstName,
            LastName,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY UserId
                ORDER BY
                    ISNULL(UpdateDate, CreateDate) DESC,
                    CreateDate DESC,
                    PersonalInfoId DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM DataPersonalInfo
        WHERE ISNULL(UserId, 0) <> 0
    ),
    LatestContractRelated AS (
        SELECT
            DebtorRelateId,
            CompromiseContractId,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY DebtorRelateId
                ORDER BY CreateDate DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractRelated
    ),
    LatestStatusPort AS (
        SELECT
            DebtorRelateId,
            StatusPortId,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY DebtorRelateId
                ORDER BY ISNULL(UpdateDate, CreateDate) DESC, CreateDate DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM DataDebtorStatusUpdate
    ),
    Raw AS (
        SELECT
            dr.CIFNo,
            dr.LGNo,
            db.IDCard,
            t.TitleCode,
            db.FirstName,
            db.LastName,
            ISNULL(pc.FirstName + ' ' + pc.LastName, '') AS CollectorName,
            ISNULL(pm.FirstName + ' ' + pm.LastName, '') AS CompromiseName,
            RIGHT('0' + CAST(ISNULL(c.CompromiseContractStatusId, 0) AS VARCHAR(10)), 2) AS StatusCodeTDR,
            sl.LookUpValue AS StatusNameTDR,
            FORMAT(c.UpdateDate, 'yyyyMMdd') AS StatusDate,
            FORMAT(c.UpdateDate, 'HHmmss') AS StatusTime,
            COALESCE(db.UID, wd.UID) AS UID,
            sp.StatusPortId,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY dr.LGNo, db.IDCard, COALESCE(db.UID, wd.UID)
                ORDER BY
                    CASE WHEN ISNULL(pc.FirstName + ' ' + pc.LastName, '') = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
                    dr.LGNo
            ) AS dedup_rn
        FROM DataDebtorRelate dr
        JOIN DataDebtor db
            ON dr.DebtorId = db.DebtorId
        LEFT JOIN SystemTitleMaster t
            ON db.TitleId = t.TitleId
        LEFT JOIN TEMPRegisterWonderData wd
            ON dr.LGNo = wd.TCG_LGNumber
        LEFT JOIN LatestAssignment a
            ON dr.DebtorRelateId = a.DebtorRelateId
           AND a.rn = 1
        LEFT JOIN LatestPersonalInfo pc
            ON a.CollectorUserId = pc.UserId
           AND pc.rn = 1
        LEFT JOIN LatestPersonalInfo pm
            ON a.CompromiseUserId = pm.UserId
           AND pm.rn = 1
        LEFT JOIN LatestContractRelated r
            ON dr.DebtorRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId
           AND r.rn = 1
        LEFT JOIN TDRDataCompromiseContract c
            ON r.CompromiseContractId = c.CompromiseContractId
           AND CAST(c.UpdateDate AS DATE) = @AsOfDate
        LEFT JOIN SystemLookupMaster sl
            ON c.CompromiseContractStatusId = sl.LookupId
        LEFT JOIN LatestStatusPort sp
            ON dr.DebtorRelateId = sp.DebtorRelateId
           AND sp.rn = 1
        WHERE (db.UID IS NOT NULL OR wd.UID IS NOT NULL)
          AND (dr.IsDelete IS NULL OR dr.IsDelete = 0)
    )
    SELECT
        CIFNo,
        LGNo,
        IDCard,
        TitleCode,
        FirstName,
        LastName,
        CollectorName,
        CompromiseName,
        StatusCodeTDR,
        StatusNameTDR,
        StatusDate,
        StatusTime,
        UID,
        StatusPortId
    FROM Raw
    WHERE dedup_rn = 1
    ORDER BY LGNo;
END;

create   PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_WonderData_GetDebtSaleOutbound]
    @AsOfDate DATE = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF @AsOfDate IS NULL
        SET @AsOfDate = CAST(DATEADD(DAY, -1, GETDATE()) AS DATE);

    DECLARE @WaitSaleId INT = (SELECT TOP 1 LookupId FROM SystemLookupMaster WHERE GroupName = 'DebtSaleStatus' AND LookUpValue = N'รอขายหนี้');
    DECLARE @SoldId     INT = (SELECT TOP 1 LookupId FROM SystemLookupMaster WHERE GroupName = 'DebtSaleStatus' AND LookUpValue = N'ขายหนี้');

    ;WITH LatestAddr AS (
        SELECT *,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DebtorId, DebtorAddressTypeId ORDER BY UpdateDate DESC) AS RN
        FROM   DataDebtorAddress
        WHERE  IsDefault = 1
    ),
    LatestCard AS (
        SELECT *,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DebtorRelateId ORDER BY UpdateDate DESC) AS RN
        FROM   DataDebtorCard
    ),
    LatestCase AS (
        SELECT *,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DebtorRelateId ORDER BY UpdateDate DESC) AS RN
        FROM   LTDataAssignCase
        WHERE  (IsCancel IS NULL OR IsCancel = 0)
    ),
    LatestBankrupcy AS (
        SELECT *,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DebtorRelateId ORDER BY UpdateDate DESC) AS RN
        FROM   LTDataAssignCaseBankrupcy
    ),
    DebtSaleLookup AS (
        SELECT LookupId, LookUpValue AS DebtSaleStatusName
        FROM   SystemLookupMaster
        WHERE  GroupName = 'DebtSaleStatus'
    ),
    LGStatusLookup AS (
        SELECT SystemStatusId, StatusName
        FROM   SystemStatusMaster
        WHERE  SystemId = 1
    ),
    CaseTypeLookup AS (
        SELECT LookupId, LookUpValue AS CaseTypeName
        FROM   SystemLookupMaster
        WHERE  GroupName = 'CaseType'
    ),
    CaseStatusLookup AS (
        SELECT SystemStatusId, StatusName AS CaseStatusName
        FROM   SystemStatusMaster
        WHERE  SystemId = 3
    ),
    BOTProcedureLookup AS (
        SELECT LookupId, LookUpValue AS BOTCaseProcedureName
        FROM   SystemLookupMaster
        WHERE  GroupName = 'BOTCaseProcedure'
    ),
    DebtorTypeLookup AS (
        SELECT LookupId, LookUpValue AS DebtorTypeName
        FROM   SystemLookupMaster
        WHERE  GroupName = 'DebtorType'
    )

    SELECT
        -- 1. ข้อมูลหลัก
        dr.LGNo                                                             AS LGNo,
        dr.DebtorCode                                                       AS DebtorCode,
        d.IDCard                                                            AS IDCard,
        ISNULL(d.DebtorName,
            LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(d.FirstName,'') + ' ' + ISNULL(d.LastName,''))))
                                                                            AS DebtorName,

        -- 2. ช่องทางติดต่อหลัก
        d.CntMobileNumber                                                   AS MobilePhone,
        d.CntPhoneNumber                                                    AS WorkPhone,
        d.Email                                                             AS Email,
        NULL                                                                AS LineId,
        d.UID                                                               AS UUID,

        -- 3. ประเภท/เกรด/สถานะ
        dtl.DebtorTypeName                                                  AS DebtorType,
        lg.Grade                                                            AS DebtorGrade,
        lgsl.StatusName                                                     AS LGStatus,

        -- 4. ประเภทโครงการ/ลักษณะกิจการ
        NULL                                                                AS ProjectType,
        NULL                                                                AS ProjectSubType,
        d.BusinessDescription                                               AS BusinessCharacter,
        d.BusinessTypeName                                                  AS BusinessType,
        (SELECT TOP 1 p.Name
         FROM   SystemProvinceMaster p
         WHERE  p.ProvinceId = addrBiz.ProvinceId)                         AS FactoryProvince,
        lg.Grade                                                            AS LGGrade,

        -- 5. ที่อยู่ 3 ชุด
        ISNULL(addrCnt.AddressNumber,'') + ' ' +
        ISNULL(addrCnt.Moo,'')          + ' ' +
        ISNULL(addrCnt.Soi,'')          + ' ' +
        ISNULL(addrCnt.Road,'')                                             AS ContactAddress,
        addrCnt.Telephone                                                   AS ContactAddressPhone,

        ISNULL(addrBiz.AddressNumber,'') + ' ' +
        ISNULL(addrBiz.Moo,'')           + ' ' +
        ISNULL(addrBiz.Soi,'')           + ' ' +
        ISNULL(addrBiz.Road,'')                                             AS BusinessAddress,
        addrBiz.Telephone                                                   AS BusinessAddressPhone,

        ISNULL(addrDoc.AddressNumber,'') + ' ' +
        ISNULL(addrDoc.Moo,'')           + ' ' +
        ISNULL(addrDoc.Soi,'')           + ' ' +
        ISNULL(addrDoc.Road,'')                                             AS DocumentDeliveryAddress,
        addrDoc.Telephone                                                   AS DocumentDeliveryPhone,

        -- 6. ข้อมูลการเงิน
        lg.ClaimPayAmount                                                   AS ClaimPaymentAmount,
        CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), lg.ClaimDate,       23)                        AS ClaimPaymentDate,
        CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), @AsOfDate,          23)                        AS DebtBurdenAsOfDate,
        card.Principal                                                      AS Principal,
        card.AccruedInterest                                                AS Interest,
        card.DPD                                                            AS DPD,
        ISNULL(card.Principal, 0) + ISNULL(card.AccruedInterest, 0)        AS TotalPrincipalInterest,
        ac.DebtBalance                                                      AS LitigationAmount,

        -- 7. ข้อมูลคดี
        CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ac.ClaimPayDate,    23)                        AS DebtClaimSubmitDate,
        ac.DebtBalance                                                      AS DebtClaimAmount,
        CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), ac.ExpirationDate,  23)                        AS DebtClaimDueDate,
        CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), card.CloseDate,     23)                        AS DebtSettlementDate,
        CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), card.BadDebtDate,   23)                        AS BadDebtDate,
        CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), card.CloseDate,     23)                        AS AccountClosureDate,
        ac.Seq                                                              AS LitigationOrder,
        ac.AssignCaseId                                                     AS CaseNo,
        NULL                                                                AS BlackCaseNo,  -- TODO: ยืนยันแหล่งข้อมูลกับ SA
        bk.RedCaseNo                                                        AS RedCaseNo,
        ctl.CaseTypeName                                                    AS CaseType,
        csl.CaseStatusName                                                  AS CaseStatus,
        botl.BOTCaseProcedureName                                           AS BOTCaseProcedure,

        -- 8. วันที่อัปเดตและสถานะขายหนี้
        CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), su.UpdateDate,      23)                        AS UpdateDate,
        dsl.DebtSaleStatusName                                              AS DebtSaleStatus

    FROM   DataDebtorStatusUpdate  su
    JOIN   DataDebtorRelate        dr     ON dr.DebtorRelateId = su.DebtorRelateId
                                         AND (dr.IsActive = 1  OR dr.IsActive IS NULL)
                                         AND (dr.IsDelete = 0  OR dr.IsDelete IS NULL)
    JOIN   DataDebtor              d      ON d.DebtorId        = dr.DebtorId
    LEFT JOIN DataLG               lg     ON lg.LGNo           = dr.LGNo
                                         AND lg.CIFNo          = dr.CIFNo
    LEFT JOIN DebtSaleLookup       dsl    ON dsl.LookupId      = su.StatusPortId
    LEFT JOIN DebtorTypeLookup     dtl    ON dtl.LookupId      = d.DebtorTypeId
    LEFT JOIN LGStatusLookup       lgsl   ON lgsl.SystemStatusId = lg.StatusId
    LEFT JOIN LatestAddr           addrCnt ON addrCnt.DebtorId = d.DebtorId AND addrCnt.DebtorAddressTypeId = 1 AND addrCnt.RN = 1
    LEFT JOIN LatestAddr           addrBiz ON addrBiz.DebtorId = d.DebtorId AND addrBiz.DebtorAddressTypeId = 2 AND addrBiz.RN = 1
    LEFT JOIN LatestAddr           addrDoc ON addrDoc.DebtorId = d.DebtorId AND addrDoc.DebtorAddressTypeId = 3 AND addrDoc.RN = 1
    LEFT JOIN LatestCard           card    ON card.DebtorRelateId = su.DebtorRelateId AND card.RN = 1
    LEFT JOIN LatestCase           ac      ON ac.DebtorRelateId   = su.DebtorRelateId AND ac.RN   = 1
    LEFT JOIN LatestBankrupcy      bk      ON bk.DebtorRelateId   = su.DebtorRelateId AND bk.RN   = 1
    LEFT JOIN CaseTypeLookup       ctl     ON ctl.LookupId        = ac.CaseTypeId
    LEFT JOIN CaseStatusLookup     csl     ON csl.SystemStatusId  = ac.StatusId
    LEFT JOIN BOTProcedureLookup   botl    ON botl.LookupId       = ac.StatusId

    WHERE  su.StatusPortId IN (@WaitSaleId, @SoldId)

    ORDER BY dr.CIFNo, dr.LGNo;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_WonderData_GetOutputWonderData]
AS BEGIN

  SELECT

    wd.CardId,
    wd.UserFirstName,
    wd.UserLastName,
    COALESCE(db.UID, wd.UID) AS UID,

    CONVERT(varchar(19), wd.StatusDateTime, 120) AS WonderStatusDateTime,
    eod.CardStatusId AS DCSCardStatusId,
    CONVERT(varchar(19), eod.CardStatusDate, 120) AS DCSCardStatusDate,
    eod.DebtAmount AS DCSDebtAmount,
    wd.ResultOfBank,
    CONVERT(varchar(19), wd.ResultOfBank_Date, 120) AS ResultOfBankDate,
    CONVERT(varchar(19), wd.ImportDate, 120) AS ImportDate,
    trackSt.LookUpValue AS TrackStatus,
    CONVERT(varchar(19), s.StatusTrackingDate, 120) AS TrackStatusDate,
    tdrSt.LookUpValue AS TDRStatus,
    CONVERT(varchar(19), s.StatusCompromiseDate, 120) AS TDRStatusDate,
    CONVERT(varchar(19), lt.ApproveDate, 120) AS ApprovedDate,
    CONVERT(varchar(19), lt.RejectedDate, 120) AS RejectedDate,
    ISNULL(tp.FirstName + ' ' + tp.LastName, '') AS TrackOfficer,
    ISNULL(cp.FirstName + ' ' + cp.LastName, '') AS TDROfficer,
    CASE WHEN lt.ApproveDate IS NOT NULL OR lt.RejectedDate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsTerminal
  FROM TEMPRegisterWonderData wd

  -- ล่าสุดของ DataEndOfDay ต่อ LGNo (แทน CTE LatestEOD)
  OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP 1 e.CardStatusId, e.CardStatusDate, e.DebtAmount
    FROM DataEndOfDay e
    WHERE e.LGNo = wd.TCG_LGNumber
      AND (e.IsDelete = 0 OR e.IsDelete IS NULL)
    ORDER BY e.AsOfDate DESC, e.CreateDate DESC
  ) eod

  LEFT JOIN DataDebtor db ON wd.CardId = db.IDCard

  -- ล่าสุดของ DataDebtorStatusUpdate ต่อ LGNo (แทน CTE LatestStatus)
  OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP 1 su.StatusTrackingId, su.StatusTrackingDate,
                 su.StatusCompromiseId, su.StatusCompromiseDate,
                 su.DebtorRelateId, su.CollectorUserId, su.CompromiseUserId
    FROM DataDebtorStatusUpdate su
    WHERE su.LGNo = wd.TCG_LGNumber
    ORDER BY su.UpdateDate DESC
  ) s

  LEFT JOIN SystemLookupMaster trackSt ON s.StatusTrackingId  = trackSt.LookupId
  LEFT JOIN SystemLookupMaster tdrSt   ON s.StatusCompromiseId = tdrSt.LookupId

  -- ล่าสุดของ TDR ต่อ DebtorRelateId (แทน CTE LatestTDR)
  OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP 1 c.ApproveDate, cc.EndDate AS RejectedDate
    FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractRelated r
    JOIN TDRDataCompromiseContract c ON r.CompromiseContractId = c.CompromiseContractId
    LEFT JOIN TDRDataCompromiseContractCancel cc ON c.CompromiseContractId = cc.CompromiseContractId
    WHERE r.DebtorRelateId = s.DebtorRelateId
    ORDER BY c.UpdateDate DESC
  ) lt

  LEFT JOIN DataPersonalInfo tp ON s.CollectorUserId  = tp.UserId
  LEFT JOIN DataPersonalInfo cp ON s.CompromiseUserId = cp.UserId

  ORDER BY wd.ImportDate DESC;
END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_WonderData_GetTriggerPayload]
    @DebtorRelateId NVARCHAR(100)
AS BEGIN
  SET NOCOUNT ON;
  SELECT TOP 1
    dr.LGNo, dr.CIFNo, db.IDCard AS CardId,
    ISNULL(db.FirstName + ' ' + db.LastName, db.DebtorName) AS NameSurname,
    COALESCE(db.UID, wd.UID) AS UUID,
    trackSt.LookUpValue AS TrackStatus, s.StatusTrackingDate AS TrackStatusDate,
    tdrSt.LookUpValue AS TDRStatus, s.StatusCompromiseDate AS TDRStatusDate,
    tdr.ApproveDate, tdrCancel.EndDate AS RejectedDate,
    ISNULL(tp.FirstName + ' ' + tp.LastName, '') AS TrackOfficer,
    ISNULL(cp.FirstName + ' ' + cp.LastName, '') AS TDROfficer,
    CASE WHEN tdr.ApproveDate IS NOT NULL OR tdrCancel.EndDate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsTerminal
  FROM DataDebtorRelate dr
  JOIN DataDebtor db ON dr.DebtorId = db.DebtorId
  LEFT JOIN TEMPRegisterWonderData wd ON dr.LGNo = wd.TCG_LGNumber
  LEFT JOIN DataDebtorStatusUpdate s ON dr.DebtorRelateId = s.DebtorRelateId
  LEFT JOIN SystemLookupMaster trackSt ON s.StatusTrackingId = trackSt.LookupId
  LEFT JOIN SystemLookupMaster tdrSt ON s.StatusCompromiseId = tdrSt.LookupId
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT r.DebtorRelateId, c.ApproveDate,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.DebtorRelateId ORDER BY c.UpdateDate DESC) AS RN
    FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractRelated r
    JOIN TDRDataCompromiseContract c ON r.CompromiseContractId = c.CompromiseContractId
  ) tdr ON dr.DebtorRelateId = tdr.DebtorRelateId AND tdr.RN = 1
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT cc.DebtorRelateId, cc.EndDate,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cc.DebtorRelateId ORDER BY cc.CreateDate DESC) AS RN
    FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractCancel cc
  ) tdrCancel ON dr.DebtorRelateId = tdrCancel.DebtorRelateId AND tdrCancel.RN = 1
  LEFT JOIN DataPersonalInfo tp ON s.CollectorUserId = tp.UserId
  LEFT JOIN DataPersonalInfo cp ON s.CompromiseUserId = cp.UserId
  WHERE dr.DebtorRelateId = @DebtorRelateId
  ORDER BY s.UpdateDate DESC;
END;

--Check Duplicate Record 

--1. สร้าง Store ใน ฺbase
Create Procedure tmpCheckDuplicateRecord
(@TableName SYSNAME = 'DataDebtor')
as
DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX);

SELECT @SQL = '
SELECT ' + STRING_AGG(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX), QUOTENAME(c.name)), ', ') + ',
       COUNT(*) AS DuplicateCount
FROM ' + QUOTENAME(s.name) + '.' + QUOTENAME(t.name) + '
GROUP BY ' + STRING_AGG(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX), QUOTENAME(c.name)), ', ') + '
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;'
FROM sys.tables t
JOIN sys.schemas s 
    ON t.schema_id = s.schema_id
JOIN sys.columns c 
    ON t.object_id = c.object_id
WHERE 
    t.name = @TableName
    AND t.is_ms_shipped = 0
    AND c.is_computed = 0
    AND c.column_id NOT IN (
        SELECT ic.column_id
        FROM sys.indexes i
        JOIN sys.index_columns ic 
            ON i.object_id = ic.object_id 
           AND i.index_id = ic.index_id
        WHERE i.is_primary_key = 1
          AND i.object_id = t.object_id
    )
GROUP BY
    s.name,
    t.name;

PRINT @SQL;

EXEC sp_executesql @SQL;

CREATE   PROCEDURE [eod].[SP_EOD_InsertDailySnapshot]
    @AsOfDate DATE = NULL,
    @Overwrite BIT = 1
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    IF @AsOfDate IS NULL
        SET @AsOfDate = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE);

    DECLARE @TargetDate DATETIME = CAST(@AsOfDate AS DATETIME);
    DECLARE @RunAt DATETIME = GETDATE();
    IF @Overwrite = 1
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [eod].[DataEndOfDay]
        WHERE [AsOfDate] >= @TargetDate AND [AsOfDate] < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @TargetDate);
    END;

    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 1. Temp Table: Ranked CIF
    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    CREATE TABLE #RankedCIF (
        CIFNo nvarchar(50) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT PRIMARY KEY,
        CardStatusId int,
        DPD int
    );

    INSERT INTO #RankedCIF (CIFNo, CardStatusId, DPD)
    SELECT CIFNo, CardStatusId, DPD
    FROM (
        SELECT
            g.CIFNo,
            c.CardStatusId,
            c.DPD,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY g.CIFNo ORDER BY ISNULL(c.DPD, 0) ASC, c.LGNo ASC, c.DataDebtorCardId DESC) AS RowNo
        FROM dbo.DataDebtorCard c WITH (NOLOCK)
        INNER JOIN dbo.DataDebtorRelate r WITH (NOLOCK) ON r.DebtorRelateId = c.DebtorRelateId
        INNER JOIN dbo.DataLG g WITH (NOLOCK) ON g.LGNo = c.LGNo
        WHERE r.DebtorTypeId = 1 AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(g.CIFNo)), N'') IS NOT NULL
    ) x
    WHERE RowNo = 1;

    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 2. Temp Table: Movement Pre-aggregations
    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    CREATE TABLE #MovementAgg (
        DebtorCardId nvarchar(150) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT PRIMARY KEY,
        FirstPayDate datetime,
        LastPayDate datetime,
        LastPaymentCreateBy nvarchar(150) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
        LastReceiptNo nvarchar(150) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
        SuspendedInterestAmount decimal(20,2),
        SuspendedInterestDiscountAmount decimal(20,2)
    );

    SELECT
        DebtorCardId, PayDate, UpdateDate, DebtorCardMovementId,
        ReceiptNo,
        CreateBy, FlagAutoPay, IsAdjust,
        TypeId, PrincipalPay, AccruedInterestPay, DeferredInterestPay, TotalPay, ReceivePayment
    INTO #FilteredMovement
    FROM dbo.DataDebtorCardMovement WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE IsDelete = 0;

    ;WITH RankedPayment AS (
        SELECT DebtorCardId,
               CASE WHEN FlagAutoPay = 1 AND ISNULL(IsAdjust, 0) = 0
                    THEN N'SYSTEM' ELSE CAST(CreateBy AS nvarchar(150)) END AS CreateBy,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DebtorCardId ORDER BY PayDate DESC, UpdateDate DESC, DebtorCardMovementId DESC) AS rn
        FROM #FilteredMovement
        WHERE TypeId = 2 AND PayDate >= @TargetDate AND PayDate < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @TargetDate)
    ),
    RankedReceipt AS (
        SELECT DebtorCardId, ReceiptNo,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DebtorCardId ORDER BY PayDate DESC, UpdateDate DESC, DebtorCardMovementId DESC) AS rn
        FROM #FilteredMovement
        WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ReceiptNo)), N'') IS NOT NULL
    ),
    AggPay AS (
        SELECT DebtorCardId,
               MIN(CASE WHEN TypeId = 2 OR TotalPay > 0 OR ReceivePayment > 0 THEN PayDate END) AS FirstPayDate,
               MAX(CASE WHEN TypeId = 2 OR TotalPay > 0 OR ReceivePayment > 0 THEN PayDate END) AS LastPayDate,
               SUM(CASE WHEN TypeId = 25 THEN ISNULL(DeferredInterestPay, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS SuspendedInterestAmount,
               SUM(CASE WHEN TypeId = 25 THEN ISNULL(PrincipalPay, 0) + ISNULL(AccruedInterestPay, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS SuspendedDiscount
        FROM #FilteredMovement
        GROUP BY DebtorCardId
    )
    INSERT INTO #MovementAgg (DebtorCardId, FirstPayDate, LastPayDate, LastPaymentCreateBy, LastReceiptNo, SuspendedInterestAmount, SuspendedInterestDiscountAmount)
    SELECT
        a.DebtorCardId,
        a.FirstPayDate,
        a.LastPayDate,
        rp.CreateBy,
        rr.ReceiptNo,
        a.SuspendedInterestAmount,
        a.SuspendedDiscount
    FROM AggPay a
    LEFT JOIN RankedPayment rp ON rp.DebtorCardId = a.DebtorCardId AND rp.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN RankedReceipt rr ON rr.DebtorCardId = a.DebtorCardId AND rr.rn = 1;

    DROP TABLE #FilteredMovement;

    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 4. Temp Table: Overdue Installment Plans
    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    CREATE TABLE #OverduePlan (
        CompromiseContractId nvarchar(150) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT PRIMARY KEY,
        CountOverdue int
    );

    INSERT INTO #OverduePlan (CompromiseContractId, CountOverdue)
    SELECT CompromiseContractId, COUNT_BIG(*)
    FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE IsPayment = 0 AND DueDate < GETDATE() AND CompromiseContractId IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY CompromiseContractId;

    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 5. Temp Table: TDR Plan Pay
    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    CREATE TABLE #TDRPlanPay (
        CompromiseContractId nvarchar(150) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT PRIMARY KEY,
        PaymentAmount decimal(20,2),
        PrincipalPay decimal(20,2),
        AccruedInterestPay decimal(20,2)
    );

    INSERT INTO #TDRPlanPay (CompromiseContractId, PaymentAmount, PrincipalPay, AccruedInterestPay)
    SELECT
        CompromiseContractId,
        PaymentAmount,
        PrincipalPay,
        AccruedInterestPay
    FROM (
        SELECT
            CompromiseContractId,
            PaymentAmount,
            PrincipalPay,
            AccruedInterestPay,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CompromiseContractId ORDER BY DueDate DESC, Seq DESC, CompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPaymentId DESC) AS rn
        FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractInstallmentPlanPayment WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE CompromiseContractId IS NOT NULL
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1;

    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 6. Temp Table: Total LG Count
    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    CREATE TABLE #TotalLG (
        CIFNo nvarchar(50) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT PRIMARY KEY,
        TotalLG int
    );

    INSERT INTO #TotalLG (CIFNo, TotalLG)
    SELECT CIFNo, COUNT(LGNo)
    FROM dbo.DataLG WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE CIFNo IS NOT NULL AND CIFNo != N''
    GROUP BY CIFNo;

    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 7. Temp Table: Latest Assignment
    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    CREATE TABLE #LatestAssignment (
        DebtorRelateId nvarchar(150) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT PRIMARY KEY,
        TypeAssignId int,
        CollectorUserId int,
        CollectorOAUserId int,
        CompromiseUserId int,
        LegalUserId int,
        AccountUserId int,
        MISUserId int,
        AssignmentId nvarchar(150) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
        OrgCode nvarchar(50) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
        OrgStructureName nvarchar(200) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
        SectionNameTH nvarchar(200) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT
    );

    INSERT INTO #LatestAssignment (DebtorRelateId, TypeAssignId, CollectorUserId, CollectorOAUserId, CompromiseUserId, LegalUserId, AccountUserId, MISUserId, AssignmentId, OrgCode, OrgStructureName, SectionNameTH)
    SELECT
        x.DebtorRelateId,
        x.TypeAssignId,
        x.CollectorUserId,
        x.CollectorOAUserId,
        x.CompromiseUserId,
        x.LegalUserId,
        x.AccountUserId,
        x.MISUserId,
        CONVERT(nvarchar(150), x.AssignmentId),
        s.OrgCode,
        s.OrgStructureName,
        sec.SectionNameTH
    FROM (
        SELECT
            DebtorRelateId,
            TypeAssignId,
            CollectorUserId,
            CollectorOAUserId,
            CompromiseUserId,
            LegalUserId,
            AccountUserId,
            MISUserId,
            AssignmentId,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DebtorRelateId ORDER BY UpdateDate DESC, AssignmentId DESC) AS rn
        FROM dbo.DataAssignment WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE DebtorRelateId IS NOT NULL
    ) x
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT UserId, OrgStructureId, OrgSectionId,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserId ORDER BY PersonalInfoId DESC) AS rn
        FROM dbo.DataPersonalInfo WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE UserId > 0
    ) p ON p.UserId = CASE WHEN x.TypeAssignId = 1 THEN x.CollectorUserId ELSE x.CollectorOAUserId END AND p.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemOrgStructure s WITH (NOLOCK) ON s.OrgStructureId = p.OrgStructureId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemOrgSectionMaster sec WITH (NOLOCK) ON sec.OrgSectionId = p.OrgSectionId
    WHERE x.rn = 1;

    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 8. Temp Table: Latest Status Update
    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    CREATE TABLE #LatestStatusUpdate (
        DebtorRelateId nvarchar(150) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT PRIMARY KEY,
        StatusCollectorId nvarchar(10) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
        StatusCollectorDate datetime,
        StatusCardId nvarchar(100) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
        StatusCardDate datetime,
        StatusLGId nvarchar(128) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
        StatusLGDate datetime,
        StatusPortId nvarchar(10) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
        StatusPortDate datetime,
        StatusCompromiseId nvarchar(10) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
        StatusCompromiseDate datetime,
        StatusDebtRequestId nvarchar(10) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
        StatusDebtRequestDate datetime,
        StatusConfirmPaymentId nvarchar(10) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
        StatusConfirmPaymentDate datetime,
        StatusBadDebtId nvarchar(10) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
        StatusBadDebtDate datetime,
        StatusLegalId nvarchar(10) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
        StatusLegalDate datetime,
        StatusTrackingId nvarchar(10) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
        StatusTrackingDate datetime,
        StatusDebtorId nvarchar(10) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
        StatusDebtorDate datetime,
        StatusAssignId nvarchar(150) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
        StatusAssignDate datetime,
        CollectorUserId int,
        CollectorUpdateDate datetime,
        CollectorOAUserId int,
        CollectorOAUpdateDate datetime,
        CompromiseUserId int,
        CompromiseUpdateDate datetime,
        LegalUserId int,
        LegalUpdateDate datetime,
        AccountUserId int,
        AccountUpdateDate datetime,
        LawOfficeUserId int,
        LawOfficeUpdateDate datetime,
        MISUpdateDate datetime,
        SystemUserId int,
        SystemUpdateDate datetime
    );

    INSERT INTO #LatestStatusUpdate
    SELECT
        DebtorRelateId,
        StatusCollectorId,
        StatusCollectorDate,
        StatusCardId,
        StatusCardDate,
        StatusLGId,
        StatusLGDate,
        StatusPortId,
        StatusPortDate,
        StatusCompromiseId,
        StatusCompromiseDate,
        StatusDebtRequestId,
        StatusDebtRequestDate,
        StatusConfirmPaymentId,
        StatusConfirmPaymentDate,
        StatusBadDebtId,
        StatusBadDebtDate,
        StatusLegalId,
        StatusLegalDate,
        StatusTrackingId,
        StatusTrackingDate,
        StatusDebtorId,
        StatusDebtorDate,
        StatusAssignId,
        StatusAssignDate,
        CollectorUserId,
        CollectorUpdateDate,
        CollectorOAUserId,
        CollectorOAUpdateDate,
        CompromiseUserId,
        CompromiseUpdateDate,
        LegalUserId,
        LegalUpdateDate,
        AccountUserId,
        AccountUpdateDate,
        LawOfficeUserId,
        LawOfficeUpdateDate,
        MISUpdateDate,
        SystemUserId,
        SystemUpdateDate
    FROM (
        SELECT
            DebtorRelateId,
            StatusCollectorId,
            StatusCollectorDate,
            StatusCardId,
            StatusCardDate,
            StatusLGId,
            StatusLGDate,
            StatusPortId,
            StatusPortDate,
            StatusCompromiseId,
            StatusCompromiseDate,
            StatusDebtRequestId,
            StatusDebtRequestDate,
            StatusConfirmPaymentId,
            StatusConfirmPaymentDate,
            StatusBadDebtId,
            StatusBadDebtDate,
            StatusLegalId,
            StatusLegalDate,
            StatusTrackingId,
            StatusTrackingDate,
            StatusDebtorId,
            StatusDebtorDate,
            StatusAssignId,
            StatusAssignDate,
            CollectorUserId,
            CollectorUpdateDate,
            CollectorOAUserId,
            CollectorOAUpdateDate,
            CompromiseUserId,
            CompromiseUpdateDate,
            LegalUserId,
            LegalUpdateDate,
            AccountUserId,
            AccountUpdateDate,
            LawOfficeUserId,
            LawOfficeUpdateDate,
            MISUpdateDate,
            SystemUserId,
            SystemUpdateDate,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DebtorRelateId ORDER BY UpdateDate DESC, DebtorStatusUpdateId DESC) AS rn
        FROM dbo.DataDebtorStatusUpdate WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE DebtorRelateId IS NOT NULL
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1;

    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 8.1 Temp Table: Status Mapping Lookup Cache (38 rows with PK on StatusId)
    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    CREATE TABLE #StatusMappingLookup (
        StatusId int NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
        StatusCard nvarchar(150) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,

        StatusPort nvarchar(150) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
        StatusCompromise nvarchar(150) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
        StatusDebtRequest nvarchar(150) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
        StatusConfirmPayment nvarchar(150) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
        StatusBadDebt nvarchar(150) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
        StatusLegal nvarchar(150) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
        StatusTracking nvarchar(150) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
