    );

    INSERT INTO #StatusMappingLookup (
        StatusId, StatusCard, StatusLG, StatusPort, StatusCompromise,
        StatusDebtRequest, StatusConfirmPayment, StatusBadDebt, StatusLegal,
        StatusTracking, StatusDebtor
    )
    SELECT
        StatusId, StatusCard, StatusLG, StatusPort, StatusCompromise,
        StatusDebtRequest, StatusConfirmPayment, StatusBadDebt, StatusLegal,
        StatusTracking, StatusDebtor
    FROM dbo.SystemStatusMappingMaster WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE StatusId IS NOT NULL;

    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 9. Temp Table: Latest Case Main
    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    CREATE TABLE #LatestCaseMain (
        DebtorRelateId nvarchar(150) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT PRIMARY KEY,
        CaseMainId nvarchar(150) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
        CaseMainNo nvarchar(150) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
        CaseTypeId int,
        AccuserBank nvarchar(255) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
        AcknowDebtDate datetime,
        AlertDate datetime,
        AppRedeemDate datetime,
        AppealDate datetime,
        AppealDueDate datetime,
        ApproveDate datetime,
        BankruptcyDate datetime,
        BlackCaseDate datetime,
        BlackCaseNo nvarchar(150) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
        CapitalAppeal decimal(20,2),
        CapitalFile decimal(20,2),
        CapitalSupreme decimal(20,2),
        DebtSettlementDate datetime,
        DueDiligenceDate datetime,
        EnforcemetApplyDate datetime,
        EnforcemetApproveDate datetime,
        FilingAmount decimal(20,2),
        FilingDate datetime,
        FirstTrialDate datetime,
        FrozenAssetDate datetime,
        IntToFileAmount decimal(20,2),
        Investigate nvarchar(255) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
        InvestigationDate datetime,
        JmAppealDate datetime,
        JmSupremeDate datetime,
        JmTrialDate datetime,
        JudgementNote nvarchar(MAX) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
        JudgementNoteBlack nvarchar(MAX) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
        JudgementNoteRed nvarchar(MAX) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
        JudgmentBankruptcyDate datetime,
        NotLegalApproveDate datetime,
        NoticeAssetDate datetime,
        NoticeSeizePropertyDate datetime,
        OtherFrozenAssDate datetime,
        PayOffDate datetime,
        PetitionDate datetime,
        RedCaseDate datetime,
        RedCaseNo nvarchar(150) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,

    );

    INSERT INTO #LatestCaseMain (

        AppealDate, AppealDueDate, ApproveDate, BankruptcyDate, BlackCaseDate, BlackCaseNo, CapitalAppeal,
        CapitalFile, CapitalSupreme, DebtSettlementDate, DueDiligenceDate, EnforcemetApplyDate, EnforcemetApproveDate,
        FilingAmount, FilingDate, FirstTrialDate, FrozenAssetDate, IntToFileAmount, Investigate, InvestigationDate,
        JmAppealDate, JmSupremeDate, JmTrialDate, JudgementNote, JudgementNoteBlack, JudgementNoteRed,
        JudgmentBankruptcyDate, NotLegalApproveDate, NoticeAssetDate, NoticeSeizePropertyDate, OtherFrozenAssDate,
        PayOffDate, PetitionDate, RedCaseDate, RedCaseNo, RedCaseNoBank, RoyalDecreeDate, SaleAssetDate,
        SeizePropertyDate, SellingAmount, SendLawyerDate, StatusProsecutionId, SupremeDate, SupremeDueDate,
        SuspendDate, WarrantDate, WithdrawDate, ProjectName
    )
    SELECT
        DebtorRelateId,
        CONVERT(nvarchar(150), CaseMainId),
        CaseMainNo,
        CaseTypeId,
        AccuserBank,
        AcknowDebtDate,
        AlertDate,
        AppRedeemDate,
        AppealDate,
        AppealDueDate,
        ApproveDate,
        BankruptcyDate,
        BlackCaseDate,
        BlackCaseNo,
        CapitalAppeal,
        CapitalFile,
        CapitalSupreme,
        DebtSettlementDate,
        DueDiligenceDate,
        EnforcemetApplyDate,
        EnforcemetApproveDate,
        FilingAmount,
        FilingDate,
        FirstTrialDate,
        FrozenAssetDate,
        IntToFileAmount,
        Investigate,
        InvestigationDate,
        JmAppealDate,
        JmSupremeDate,
        JmTrialDate,
        JudgementNote,
        JudgementNoteBlack,
        JudgementNoteRed,
        JudgmentBankruptcyDate,
        NotLegalApproveDate,
        NoticeAssetDate,
        NoticeSeizePropertyDate,
        OtherFrozenAssDate,
        PayOffDate,
        PetitionDate,
        RedCaseDate,
        RedCaseNo,
        RedCaseNoBank,
        RoyalDecreeDate,
        SaleAssetDate,
        SeizePropertyDate,
        SellingAmount,
        SendLawyerDate,
        StatusProsecutionId,
        SupremeDate,
        SupremeDueDate,
        SuspendDate,
        WarrantDate,
        WithdrawDate,
        ProjectName
    FROM (
        SELECT
            cmd.DebtorRelateId,
            cm.CaseMainId,
            cm.CaseMainNo,
            cm.CaseTypeId,
            cm.AccuserBank,
            cm.AcknowDebtDate,
            cm.AlertDate,
            cm.AppRedeemDate,
            cm.AppealDate,
            cm.AppealDueDate,
            cm.ApproveDate,
            cm.BankruptcyDate,
            cm.BlackCaseDate,
            cm.BlackCaseNo,

    INSERT INTO #DebtorAddress (DebtorId, District, SubDistrict, Province, PostalCode, FullAddress)
    SELECT
        DebtorId,
        District,
        SubDistrict,
        Province,
        PostalCode,
        FullAddress
    FROM (
        SELECT
            a.DebtorId,
            dis.Name AS District,
            sub.Name AS SubDistrict,
            prov.Name AS Province,
            a.PostalCode,
            RTRIM(LTRIM(CONCAT(
                ISNULL(a.AddressNumber, N''),
                CASE WHEN NULLIF(a.PlaceName, N'') IS NOT NULL THEN N' ' + a.PlaceName ELSE N'' END,
                CASE WHEN NULLIF(a.Moo, N'') IS NOT NULL AND a.Moo != N'-' THEN N' หมู่ที่ ' + a.Moo ELSE N'' END,
                CASE WHEN NULLIF(a.Soi, N'') IS NOT NULL AND a.Soi != N'-' THEN N' ซอย' + a.Soi ELSE N'' END,
                CASE WHEN NULLIF(a.Road, N'') IS NOT NULL AND a.Road != N'-' THEN N' ถนน' + a.Road ELSE N'' END,
                CASE WHEN NULLIF(sub.Name, N'') IS NOT NULL AND sub.Name != N'-' THEN N' ตำบล' + sub.Name ELSE N'' END,
                CASE WHEN NULLIF(dis.Name, N'') IS NOT NULL AND dis.Name != N'-' THEN N' อำเภอ' + dis.Name ELSE N'' END,
                CASE WHEN NULLIF(prov.Name, N'') IS NOT NULL AND prov.Name != N'-' THEN N' จังหวัด' + prov.Name ELSE N'' END,
                CASE WHEN NULLIF(a.PostalCode, N'') IS NOT NULL AND a.PostalCode != N'-' THEN N' ' + a.PostalCode ELSE N'' END
            ))) AS FullAddress,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.DebtorId ORDER BY a.DebtorAddressId DESC) AS rn
        FROM dbo.DataDebtorAddress a WITH (NOLOCK)
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemProvinceMaster prov WITH (NOLOCK) ON prov.ProvinceId = a.ProvinceId
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemDistrictMaster dis WITH (NOLOCK) ON dis.DistrictId = a.DistrictId
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemSubDistrictMaster sub WITH (NOLOCK) ON sub.SubDistrictId = a.SubDistrictId
        WHERE a.DebtorId IS NOT NULL
          AND a.IsDefault = 1
          AND a.DebtorAddressTypeId = 7
    ) x

    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- Excel R47: อัตราผิดนัดของ Measure ผ่าน ConditionItemId=32
    -- TRY_CONVERT ป้องกันค่าประเภทอื่นใน mapping ทำให้ implicit conversion ล้ม
    -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT MeasureId, IntRate, MappingError
    INTO #CampaignDefaultRate
    FROM (
        SELECT mm.MeasureId, i.IntRate,
               CASE WHEN m.ConditionItemMapingValue IS NOT NULL
                          AND TRY_CONVERT(int, m.ConditionItemMapingValue) IS NULL
                    THEN N'ConditionItemMapingValue ของ ConditionItemId=32 แปลงเป็น InterateId ไม่ได้'
               END AS MappingError,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY mm.MeasureId
                   ORDER BY m.UpdateDate DESC, m.ConditionItemMapingValueId DESC,
                            cc.CampaignConditionId DESC, cm.MeasureCampaignId DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM dbo.SystemConditionItemMappingValueMaster m
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemConditionMaster c ON m.ConditionId = c.ConditionId
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemCampaignConditionMaster cc ON cc.ConditionId = c.ConditionId
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemMeasureCampaignMaster cm ON cm.CampaignId = cc.CampaignId
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemMeasureMaster mm ON mm.MeasureId = cm.MeasureId
        LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemInterateMaster i ON i.InterateId = TRY_CONVERT(int, m.ConditionItemMapingValue)
        WHERE m.ConditionItemId = 32 AND mm.MeasureId IS NOT NULL
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1;

    OUTER APPLY (

    LEFT JOIN #LatestBadDebt latestBadDebt ON latestBadDebt.DebtorRelateId = relation.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #LatestBadDebtLG latestBadDebtLG ON latestBadDebtLG.DebtorRelateId = relation.DebtorRelateId AND latestBadDebtLG.LGNo = relation.LGNo
    LEFT JOIN #LatestDebtRequest latestDebtRequest ON latestDebtRequest.DebtorRelateId = relation.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #LatestTDR latestTdr ON latestTdr.DebtorRelateId = relation.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #CampaignDefaultRate campaignRate ON campaignRate.MeasureId = latestTdr.MeasureId
    LEFT JOIN #LatestApprovedTDR latestApprovedTdr ON latestApprovedTdr.DebtorRelateId = relation.DebtorRelateId
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) p.FirstName, p.LastName
        FROM dbo.DataPersonalInfo p WITH (NOLOCK)
        WHERE p.UserId = latestTdr.CompoundUserId
        ORDER BY p.PersonalInfoId DESC
    ) compoundPerson
    LEFT JOIN #OverduePlan overduePlan ON overduePlan.CompromiseContractId = latestTdr.CompromiseContractId
    LEFT JOIN #TDRPlanPay tdrPlanPay ON tdrPlanPay.CompromiseContractId = latestTdr.CompromiseContractId
    LEFT JOIN #CompromiseApprover compApprover ON compApprover.CompromiseContractId = latestTdr.CompromiseContractId
    LEFT JOIN #DebtorAddress debtorAddr ON debtorAddr.DebtorId = relation.DebtorId
    LEFT JOIN #DebtorContact debtorContact ON debtorContact.DebtorId = relation.DebtorId
    LEFT JOIN #ReceiptAggregate receiptAgg ON receiptAgg.DebtorRelateId = relation.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #LatestInformPayment latestInformPayment ON latestInformPayment.DebtorRelateId = relation.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #LatestReceipt latestReceipt ON latestReceipt.DebtorRelateId = relation.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemBankMaster bank WITH (NOLOCK) ON bank.BankId = lg.BankId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemBankBranchMaster bankBranch WITH (NOLOCK) ON bankBranch.BankBranchId = lg.BankBranchId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemClaimTypeMaster claimType WITH (NOLOCK) ON claimType.ClaimTypeId = lg.ClaimTypeId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemClaimSubTypeMaster claimSubType WITH (NOLOCK) ON claimSubType.ClaimSubTypeId = lg.ClaimSubTypeId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemTitleMaster title WITH (NOLOCK) ON title.TitleId = debtor.TitleId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemMeasureMaster measureMaster WITH (NOLOCK) ON measureMaster.MeasureId = latestTdr.MeasureId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemMeasureMaster cardMeasureMaster ON cardMeasureMaster.MeasureId = card.MeasureId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemOrgStructure orgStructure WITH (NOLOCK) ON orgStructure.OrgStructureId = TRY_CAST(lg.BusinessSize AS int)
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemCaseTypeMaster caseTypeMaster WITH (NOLOCK) ON caseTypeMaster.CaseTypeId = caseMain.CaseTypeId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.NCBCommercialCreditDataFields ncb WITH (NOLOCK) ON ncb.CardId = card.DataDebtorCardId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemDebtorType debtorType WITH (NOLOCK) ON debtorType.DebtorTypeId = relation.DebtorTypeId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemStatusMaster statAssign WITH (NOLOCK) ON statAssign.SystemStatusId = TRY_CAST(statusUpdate.StatusAssignId AS int)
    LEFT JOIN #StatusMappingLookup mapCard ON mapCard.StatusId = TRY_CAST(statusUpdate.StatusCardId AS int)
    LEFT JOIN #StatusMappingLookup mapLG ON mapLG.StatusId = TRY_CAST(statusUpdate.StatusLGId AS int)
    LEFT JOIN #StatusMappingLookup mapPort ON mapPort.StatusId = TRY_CAST(statusUpdate.StatusPortId AS int)
    LEFT JOIN #StatusMappingLookup mapCompromise ON mapCompromise.StatusId = TRY_CAST(statusUpdate.StatusCompromiseId AS int)
    LEFT JOIN #StatusMappingLookup mapDebtReq ON mapDebtReq.StatusId = TRY_CAST(statusUpdate.StatusDebtRequestId AS int)
    LEFT JOIN #StatusMappingLookup mapConfirmPay ON mapConfirmPay.StatusId = TRY_CAST(statusUpdate.StatusConfirmPaymentId AS int)
    LEFT JOIN #StatusMappingLookup mapBadDebt ON mapBadDebt.StatusId = TRY_CAST(statusUpdate.StatusBadDebtId AS int)
    LEFT JOIN #StatusMappingLookup mapLegal ON mapLegal.StatusId = TRY_CAST(statusUpdate.StatusLegalId AS int)
    LEFT JOIN #StatusMappingLookup mapTracking ON mapTracking.StatusId = TRY_CAST(statusUpdate.StatusTrackingId AS int)
    LEFT JOIN #StatusMappingLookup mapDebtor ON mapDebtor.StatusId = TRY_CAST(statusUpdate.StatusDebtorId AS int)
    WHERE relation.DebtorTypeId = 1;

END;

/*
  Read-only validation for the 22 EOD fields approved as ready.
  Compares the current eod snapshot with the exact source-selection rules
  used by eod.SP_EOD_InsertDailySnapshot.  No dbo or eod data is changed.
*/
CREATE   PROCEDURE eod.SP_EOD_ValidateReady22
  @AsOfDate date
AS
BEGIN
  SET NOCOUNT ON;

  IF @AsOfDate IS NULL
    THROW 52140, N'ต้องกำหนด @AsOfDate แบบ YYYY-MM-DD ก่อนตรวจ', 1;

  SELECT
    comparison.FieldName,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS CheckedRows,
    SUM(CASE
      WHEN comparison.ActualValue IS NULL AND comparison.ExpectedValue IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN comparison.ActualValue = comparison.ExpectedValue THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END) AS MismatchRows,
    SUM(CASE WHEN comparison.ActualValue IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ActualNullRows,
    SUM(CASE WHEN comparison.ExpectedValue IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ExpectedNullRows,
    CASE WHEN SUM(CASE
      WHEN comparison.ActualValue IS NULL AND comparison.ExpectedValue IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN comparison.ActualValue = comparison.ExpectedValue THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END) = 0 THEN N'PASS' ELSE N'FAIL' END AS ValidationStatus
  FROM eod.DataEndOfDay AS snapshot
  INNER JOIN dbo.DataDebtorRelate AS relation
    ON relation.DebtorRelateId = snapshot.DebtorRelateId
  OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP (1)
      card.DataDebtorCardId,
      card.UpdateDate,
      card.IsActive,
      card.CurrentPaymentDate,
      card.DFDDate
    FROM dbo.DataDebtorCard AS card
    WHERE card.DebtorRelateId = relation.DebtorRelateId
    ORDER BY card.UpdateDate DESC, card.DataDebtorCardId DESC
  ) AS card
  OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP (1)
      cardMeasure.MeasureId
    FROM dbo.DataDebtorCardInterate AS cardMeasure
    WHERE cardMeasure.DebtorCardId = card.DataDebtorCardId
    ORDER BY cardMeasure.UpdateDate DESC, cardMeasure.DebtorCardInterateId DESC
  ) AS cardMeasure
  OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP (1)
      measure.MeasureId,
      measure.MeasureCode,
      measure.MeasureName
    FROM dbo.SystemMeasureMaster AS measure
    WHERE measure.MeasureId = cardMeasure.MeasureId
    ORDER BY measure.UpdateDate DESC, measure.MeasureId DESC
  ) AS measure
  OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP (1)
      contract.InterestRate,
      contractLg.OutstandingDebt
    FROM dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContractLG AS contractLg
    INNER JOIN dbo.TDRDataCompromiseContract AS contract
      ON contract.CompromiseContractId = contractLg.CompromiseContractId
    WHERE contractLg.DebtorRelateId = relation.DebtorRelateId
      AND contractLg.LGNo = relation.LGNo
    ORDER BY contract.UpdateDate DESC, contractLg.UpdateDate DESC,
             contract.CompromiseContractId DESC, contractLg.CompromiseContractLGId DESC
  ) AS tdr
  OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP (1)
      ncb.AccountStatus
    FROM dbo.NCBCommercialCreditDataFields AS ncb
    WHERE ncb.CardId = card.DataDebtorCardId
    ORDER BY ncb.EffDate DESC, ncb.CommercialCreditDataId DESC
  ) AS ncb
  OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP (1)
      movement.ReceiptNo
    FROM dbo.DataDebtorCardMovement AS movement
    WHERE movement.DebtorCardId = card.DataDebtorCardId
    ORDER BY movement.PayDate DESC, movement.UpdateDate DESC, movement.DebtorCardMovementId DESC
  ) AS lastReceipt
  OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP (1)
      CONVERT(nvarchar(1000), CONCAT(
        ISNULL(address.AddressNumber, N''),
        ISNULL(N' ' + NULLIF(address.PlaceName, N''), N''),
        ISNULL(N' หมู่ที่ ' + NULLIF(address.Moo, N''), N''),
        ISNULL(N' ซอย ' + NULLIF(address.Soi, N''), N''),
        ISNULL(N' ถนน ' + NULLIF(address.Road, N''), N''),
        ISNULL(N' ตำบล' + NULLIF(subDistrict.Name, N''), N''),
        ISNULL(N' อำเภอ' + NULLIF(district.Name, N''), N''),
        ISNULL(N' จังหวัด' + NULLIF(province.Name, N''), N''),
        ISNULL(N' ' + NULLIF(address.PostalCode, N''), N'')
      )) AS DebtorAddress
    FROM dbo.DataDebtorAddress AS address
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemProvinceMaster AS province
      ON province.ProvinceId = address.ProvinceId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemDistrictMaster AS district
      ON district.DistrictId = address.DistrictId
    LEFT JOIN dbo.SystemSubDistrictMaster AS subDistrict
      ON subDistrict.SubDistrictId = address.SubDistrictId
    WHERE address.DebtorId = relation.DebtorId
      AND address.IsDefault = 1
      AND address.DebtorAddressTypeId = 1
    ORDER BY address.UpdateDate DESC, address.DebtorAddressId DESC
  ) AS debtorAddress
  OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP (1)
      contact.DebtorContactValue
    FROM dbo.DataDebtorContact AS contact
    WHERE contact.DebtorId = relation.DebtorId
      AND contact.IsDefault = 1
      AND contact.DebtorContactTypeId = 1
    ORDER BY contact.UpdateDate DESC, contact.DebtorContactId DESC
  ) AS debtorContact
  OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP (1)
      statusUpdate.StatusPortId,
      statusUpdate.StatusCollectorId,
      statusUpdate.StatusCardId,
      statusUpdate.StatusLGId
    FROM dbo.DataDebtorStatusUpdate AS statusUpdate
    WHERE statusUpdate.DebtorRelateId = relation.DebtorRelateId
    ORDER BY statusUpdate.UpdateDate DESC, statusUpdate.DebtorStatusUpdateId DESC
  ) AS statusUpdate
  OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP (1) mapping.StatusPort
    FROM dbo.SystemStatusMappingMaster AS mapping
    WHERE mapping.StatusPortId = statusUpdate.StatusPortId
    ORDER BY mapping.UpdateDate DESC, mapping.StatusMappingId DESC
  ) AS statusPort
  OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP (1) mapping.StatusCollector
    FROM dbo.SystemStatusMappingMaster AS mapping
    WHERE mapping.StatusCollectorId = statusUpdate.StatusCollectorId
    ORDER BY mapping.UpdateDate DESC, mapping.StatusMappingId DESC
  ) AS statusCollector
  OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP (1) mapping.StatusCard
    FROM dbo.SystemStatusMappingMaster AS mapping
    WHERE mapping.StatusCardId = statusUpdate.StatusCardId
    ORDER BY mapping.UpdateDate DESC, mapping.StatusMappingId DESC
  ) AS statusCard
  OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP (1) mapping.StatusLG
    FROM dbo.SystemStatusMappingMaster AS mapping
    WHERE mapping.StatusLGId = statusUpdate.StatusLGId
    ORDER BY mapping.UpdateDate DESC, mapping.StatusMappingId DESC
  ) AS statusLG
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      receiptSource.DebtorRelateId,
      receiptSource.LGNo,
      SUM(receiptSource.PrincipalPay) AS PrincipalPayAll,
      SUM(receiptSource.PaymentAmount) AS TotalPayAll
    FROM dbo.ACCDataReceipt AS receiptSource
    WHERE receiptSource.IsCancel = 0
    GROUP BY receiptSource.DebtorRelateId, receiptSource.LGNo
  ) AS receiptAggregate
    ON receiptAggregate.DebtorRelateId = relation.DebtorRelateId
    AND receiptAggregate.LGNo = relation.LGNo
  CROSS APPLY (VALUES
    (N'AccountStatus', CONVERT(nvarchar(max), snapshot.AccountStatus), CONVERT(nvarchar(max), ncb.AccountStatus)),
    (N'TDROutstandingDebt', CONVERT(nvarchar(max), snapshot.TDROutstandingDebt), CONVERT(nvarchar(max), tdr.OutstandingDebt)),
    (N'IsActive', CONVERT(nvarchar(max), snapshot.IsActive), CONVERT(nvarchar(max), card.IsActive)),
    (N'CreateDate', CONVERT(nvarchar(max), snapshot.CreateDate, 126), CONVERT(nvarchar(max), snapshot.UpdateDate, 126)),
    (N'CreateBy', CONVERT(nvarchar(max), snapshot.CreateBy), N'1'),
    (N'UpdateDate', CONVERT(nvarchar(max), snapshot.UpdateDate, 126), CONVERT(nvarchar(max), snapshot.CreateDate, 126)),
    (N'UpdateBy', CONVERT(nvarchar(max), snapshot.UpdateBy), N'1'),
    (N'MeasureId', CONVERT(nvarchar(max), snapshot.MeasureId), CONVERT(nvarchar(max), measure.MeasureId)),
    (N'MeasureCode', CONVERT(nvarchar(max), snapshot.MeasureCode), CONVERT(nvarchar(max), measure.MeasureCode)),
    (N'MeasureName', CONVERT(nvarchar(max), snapshot.MeasureName), CONVERT(nvarchar(max), measure.MeasureName)),
    (N'TDRInterestRate', CONVERT(nvarchar(max), snapshot.TDRInterestRate), CONVERT(nvarchar(max), tdr.InterestRate)),
    (N'TDRPayAmount', CONVERT(nvarchar(max), snapshot.TDRPayAmount), CONVERT(nvarchar(max), receiptAggregate.TotalPayAll)),
    (N'TDRPrincipalPay', CONVERT(nvarchar(max), snapshot.TDRPrincipalPay), CONVERT(nvarchar(max), receiptAggregate.PrincipalPayAll)),
    (N'PayOffDate', CONVERT(nvarchar(max), snapshot.PayOffDate, 126), CONVERT(nvarchar(max), card.DFDDate, 126)),
    (N'LastReceiptNo', CONVERT(nvarchar(max), snapshot.LastReceiptNo), CONVERT(nvarchar(max), lastReceipt.ReceiptNo)),
    (N'LastPaymentDate', CONVERT(nvarchar(max), snapshot.LastPaymentDate, 126), CONVERT(nvarchar(max), card.CurrentPaymentDate, 126)),
    (N'DebtorAddress', CONVERT(nvarchar(max), snapshot.DebtorAddress), CONVERT(nvarchar(max), debtorAddress.DebtorAddress)),
    (N'DebtorContactNumber', CONVERT(nvarchar(max), snapshot.DebtorContactNumber), CONVERT(nvarchar(max), debtorContact.DebtorContactValue)),
    (N'StatusPort', CONVERT(nvarchar(max), snapshot.StatusPort), CONVERT(nvarchar(max), statusPort.StatusPort)),
    (N'StatusCollector', CONVERT(nvarchar(max), snapshot.StatusCollector), CONVERT(nvarchar(max), statusCollector.StatusCollector)),
    (N'StatusCard', CONVERT(nvarchar(max), snapshot.StatusCard), CONVERT(nvarchar(max), statusCard.StatusCard)),
    (N'StatusLG', CONVERT(nvarchar(max), snapshot.StatusLG), CONVERT(nvarchar(max), statusLG.StatusLG))
  ) AS comparison(FieldName, ActualValue, ExpectedValue)
  WHERE snapshot.AsOfDate >= CAST(@AsOfDate AS datetime)
    AND snapshot.AsOfDate < DATEADD(day, 1, CAST(@AsOfDate AS datetime))
  GROUP BY comparison.FieldName
  ORDER BY comparison.FieldName;
END;

modules.name: SP_RP_NCB_01_CommercialCreditData_Insert_Core
modules.definition:
CREATE   PROCEDURE [ncb_internal].[SP_RP_NCB_01_CommercialCreditData_Insert_Core]
    @StartDate DATETIME = '2025-05-01',
    @EndDate   DATETIME = '2025-05-31',
    @CIFNo  NVARCHAR(50) = 'null',
    @LGNo   NVARCHAR(50) = 'null'
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET @StartDate = CASE WHEN YEAR(@StartDate) > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR,-543,@StartDate) ELSE @StartDate END;
    SET @EndDate   = CASE WHEN YEAR(@EndDate)   > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR,-543,@EndDate)   ELSE @EndDate   END;
    SET @CIFNo = ISNULL(@CIFNo, 'null');
    SET @LGNo = ISNULL(@LGNo, 'null');
    -- Staging uses one Period for every inserted row; reject mixed-month calls.
    IF @StartDate IS NULL OR @EndDate IS NULL OR @StartDate > @EndDate
       OR YEAR(@StartDate) <> YEAR(@EndDate) OR MONTH(@StartDate) <> MONTH(@EndDate)
        THROW 50001, 'NCB report requires a valid date range within one reporting month.', 1;
    DECLARE @Period NVARCHAR(7) = CONVERT(char(7), @EndDate, 126);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 1. Pre-load NCB dynamic conditions (small table — fast)
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#NCBCond01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #NCBCond01;
    SELECT nm.NCBStatusCode, CAST(nm.CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) AS CatalogId, sp.ColumnName, sl.KeyName AS Operator,
           CASE WHEN nm.NCBStatusCode = 12 AND sp.ColumnName = 'MeasureName' AND ne.ValueConditionExcute = 'มาตรการ%'
                THEN '%พัก%หนี้%'
                ELSE ne.ValueConditionExcute END AS ValueConditionExcute
    INTO #NCBCond01
    FROM NCBStatusExcuteMaster ne
    JOIN NCBStatusMaster nm        ON nm.NCBStatusId  = ne.NCBStatusId AND nm.PersonType=2 AND nm.IsActive=1
    JOIN SystemParameterMaster sp  ON sp.ParameterId  = ne.ParameterId
    LEFT JOIN SystemLookupMaster sl ON sl.LookupId    = ne.OparatorId;

    DECLARE @S11_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=11),1,0);
    DECLARE @S12_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=12),1,0);
    DECLARE @S13_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=13),1,0);
    DECLARE @S14_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=14),1,0);
    DECLARE @S20_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=20),1,0);
    DECLARE @S21_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=21),1,0);
    DECLARE @S30_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=30),1,0);
    DECLARE @S31_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=31),1,0);
    DECLARE @S32_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=32),1,0);
    DECLARE @S33_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=33),1,0);
    DECLARE @S42_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=42),1,0);
    DECLARE @S43_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=43),1,0);
    DECLARE @S44_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 WHERE NCBStatusCode=44),1,0);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 2. Load NCB status/DPD catalog codes
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    DECLARE @S10  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=10  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);
    DECLARE @S11  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=11  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);
    DECLARE @S12  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=12  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);
    DECLARE @S13  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=13  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);
    DECLARE @S14  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=14  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);
    DECLARE @S20  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=20  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);
    DECLARE @S21  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=21  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);
    DECLARE @S30  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=30  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);
    DECLARE @S31  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=31  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);
    DECLARE @S33  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=33  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);
    DECLARE @S42  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=42  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);
    DECLARE @S43  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=43  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);
    DECLARE @S44  NVARCHAR(20) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode=44  AND PersonType=2 AND IsActive=1);

    -- Dynamic DPD mapping from website configuration.
    -- NCBDPDMaster stores the output code; NCBDPDExcuteMaster stores numeric DPD rules.
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dpd_rule01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dpd_rule01;

    SELECT
        dm.DPDId,
        dm.DPDCode,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(dm.CatalogCode, ''), dm.DPDCode) AS DPDOutputCode,
        MAX(CASE WHEN sl.KeyName = 'Equal' OR sl.LookUpValue = '=' OR de.OparatorId = 5
                 THEN TRY_CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(de.ValueConditionExcute, N' วัน', N'')) END) AS ExactValue,
        MAX(CASE WHEN sl.KeyName = 'LessThanEqual' OR sl.LookUpValue = '>=' OR de.OparatorId = 3
                 THEN TRY_CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(de.ValueConditionExcute, N' วัน', N'')) END) AS MinInclusive,
        MAX(CASE WHEN sl.KeyName = 'MoreThanEqual' OR sl.LookUpValue = '<=' OR de.OparatorId = 4
                 THEN TRY_CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(de.ValueConditionExcute, N' วัน', N'')) END) AS MaxInclusive,
        MAX(CASE WHEN sl.KeyName = 'MoreThan' OR sl.LookUpValue = '>' OR de.OparatorId = 1
                 THEN TRY_CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(de.ValueConditionExcute, N' วัน', N'')) END) AS MinExclusive,
        MAX(CASE WHEN sl.KeyName = 'LessThan' OR sl.LookUpValue = '<' OR de.OparatorId = 2
                 THEN TRY_CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(de.ValueConditionExcute, N' วัน', N'')) END) AS MaxExclusive
    INTO #dpd_rule01
    FROM NCBDPDMaster dm
    LEFT JOIN NCBDPDExcuteMaster de ON de.DPDId = dm.DPDId
    LEFT JOIN SystemLookupMaster sl ON sl.LookupId = de.OparatorId
    WHERE dm.PersonType = 2
      AND dm.IsActive = 1
    GROUP BY dm.DPDId, dm.DPDCode, COALESCE(NULLIF(dm.CatalogCode, ''), dm.DPDCode);

    DECLARE @D0 NVARCHAR(20) = (
        SELECT TOP 1 DPDOutputCode
        FROM #dpd_rule01
        WHERE (ExactValue   IS NULL OR 0 =  ExactValue)
          AND (MinInclusive IS NULL OR 0 >= MinInclusive)
          AND (MaxInclusive IS NULL OR 0 <= MaxInclusive)
          AND (MinExclusive IS NULL OR 0 >  MinExclusive)
          AND (MaxExclusive IS NULL OR 0 <  MaxExclusive)
        ORDER BY
            CASE WHEN ExactValue IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
            ISNULL(MinInclusive, MinExclusive + 1) DESC,
            ISNULL(MaxInclusive, MaxExclusive - 1) ASC,
            DPDCode
    );
    DECLARE @D11 NVARCHAR(20) = (
        SELECT TOP 1 DPDOutputCode
        FROM #dpd_rule01
        WHERE (ExactValue   IS NULL OR 100000 =  ExactValue)
          AND (MinInclusive IS NULL OR 100000 >= MinInclusive)
          AND (MaxInclusive IS NULL OR 100000 <= MaxInclusive)
          AND (MinExclusive IS NULL OR 100000 >  MinExclusive)
          AND (MaxExclusive IS NULL OR 100000 <  MaxExclusive)
        ORDER BY
            CASE WHEN ExactValue IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
            ISNULL(MinInclusive, MinExclusive + 1) DESC,
            ISNULL(MaxInclusive, MaxExclusive - 1) ASC,
            DPDCode
    );

    -- Dynamic TDR restructuring code from website configuration.
    -- SystemTDRRestructureCode stores output code; SystemRestructureExcuteMaster stores matching rules.
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tdr_rule01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tdr_rule01;
    SELECT
        rc.RestructureCodeId,
        rc.RestructureCode,
        rc.Oparators,
        re.Seq,
        sp.ColumnName,
        sl.KeyName AS Operator,
        re.ValueConditionExcute
    INTO #tdr_rule01
    FROM SystemTDRRestructureCode rc
    LEFT JOIN SystemRestructureExcuteMaster re ON re.RestructureCodeId = rc.RestructureCodeId
    LEFT JOIN SystemParameterMaster sp ON sp.ParameterId = re.ParameterId
    LEFT JOIN SystemLookupMaster sl ON sl.LookupId = re.OparatorId
    WHERE rc.IsActive = 1;

    DECLARE @TDRDefaultCode01 NVARCHAR(20) = (
        SELECT TOP 1 RestructureCode
        FROM SystemTDRRestructureCode
        WHERE IsActive = 1
        ORDER BY CASE WHEN RestructureCode = '00' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, RestructureCode
    );

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 3. Pre-filter qualifying DebtorRelateIds
    --    [OPTIMIZED] Drive from DataEndOfDay with JOIN instead of correlated EXISTS
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#qualifying01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #qualifying01;
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId
    INTO #qualifying01
    FROM dbo.DataEndOfDay e
    JOIN DataDebtorRelate ddr ON ddr.DebtorRelateId = e.DebtorRelateId
    WHERE e.AsOfDate BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
      AND (e.IsDelete = 0 OR e.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND ddr.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
      AND (ddr.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (@CIFNo = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM DataDebtorRelate WHERE CIFNo=@CIFNo))
      AND (@LGNo  = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo  = @LGNo)

    UNION

    -- LG cancelled case: no DataDebtorCard, StatusDate in range
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId
    FROM DataDebtorRelate ddr
    JOIN DataLG dlg ON dlg.LGNo = ddr.LGNo
    WHERE dlg.StatusDate BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM DataDebtorCard dc2
          WHERE dc2.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
            AND (dc2.IsDelete = 0 OR dc2.IsDelete IS NULL)
      )
      AND ddr.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
      AND (ddr.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (@CIFNo = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM DataDebtorRelate WHERE CIFNo=@CIFNo))
      AND (@LGNo  = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo  = @LGNo)

    UNION

    -- TDR case: TDR approved up to @EndDate (catches active TDR without EOD in month)
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId
    FROM (
        SELECT CompromiseContractId, LGNo FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractRelated
        UNION
        SELECT CompromiseContractId, LGNo FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractLG
    ) rtdr
    JOIN TDRDataCompromiseContract cc ON cc.CompromiseContractId = rtdr.CompromiseContractId
    JOIN DataDebtorRelate ddr ON ddr.LGNo = rtdr.LGNo
    WHERE cc.ApproveDate <= @EndDate
      AND ddr.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
      AND (ddr.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (@CIFNo = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM DataDebtorRelate WHERE CIFNo=@CIFNo))
      AND (@LGNo  = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo  = @LGNo)

    UNION

    -- Closed account case: include closure events in the requested month only
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId
    FROM DataDebtorRelate ddr
    JOIN DataDebtorCard dc ON dc.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    WHERE CAST(dc.CloseDate AS DATE) <= CAST(@EndDate AS DATE)
      AND CAST(dc.CloseDate AS DATE) >= CAST(@StartDate AS DATE)
      AND (dc.DebtBalance = 0 OR dc.PrincipalTotal = 0)
      AND (dc.IsDelete = 0 OR dc.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND ddr.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
      AND (ddr.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (@CIFNo = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM DataDebtorRelate WHERE CIFNo=@CIFNo))
      AND (@LGNo  = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo  = @LGNo)

    UNION

    -- Closed account case: co-borrowers/guarantors inheriting from primary debtor
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId
    FROM DataDebtorRelate ddr
    JOIN DataDebtorRelate ddr_p ON ddr_p.LGNo = ddr.LGNo AND ddr_p.DebtorTypeId = 1 AND (ddr_p.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr_p.IsDelete IS NULL)
    JOIN DataDebtorCard dc_p ON dc_p.DebtorRelateId = ddr_p.DebtorRelateId
    WHERE CAST(dc_p.CloseDate AS DATE) <= CAST(@EndDate AS DATE)
      AND CAST(dc_p.CloseDate AS DATE) >= CAST(@StartDate AS DATE)
      AND (dc_p.DebtBalance = 0 OR dc_p.PrincipalTotal = 0)
      AND (dc_p.IsDelete = 0 OR dc_p.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND ddr.DebtorTypeId = 2
      AND (ddr.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (@CIFNo = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM DataDebtorRelate WHERE CIFNo=@CIFNo))
      AND (@LGNo  = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo  = @LGNo)

    UNION

    -- Accounts with active card balance
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId
    FROM DataDebtorRelate ddr
    JOIN DataDebtorCard dc ON dc.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    WHERE (dc.IsDelete = 0 OR dc.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance, 0) > 0 OR ISNULL(dc.PrincipalTotal, 0) > 0)
      AND ddr.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
      AND (ddr.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (@CIFNo = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM DataDebtorRelate WHERE CIFNo=@CIFNo))
      AND (@LGNo  = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo  = @LGNo)

    UNION

    -- Accounts with litigation
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId
    FROM DataDebtorRelate ddr
    JOIN LTDataCaseMainDebtor lt ON lt.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    WHERE (lt.IsCancel = 0 OR lt.IsCancel IS NULL)
      AND lt.FilingDate <= @EndDate
      AND ddr.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
      AND (ddr.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (@CIFNo = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM DataDebtorRelate WHERE CIFNo=@CIFNo))
      AND (@LGNo  = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo  = @LGNo)
    OPTION (RECOMPILE);

    -- Resolve exact person before applying the Commercial group restriction.
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dd01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dd01;
    SELECT di.DebtorRelateId, resolved.DebtorId, resolved.DebtorCode,
           CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(resolved.IDCard)), '') IS NULL
                     OR resolved.IDCard LIKE N'%ไม่พบ%' OR resolved.IDCard LIKE N'%ไมพบ%'
                THEN NULL ELSE LTRIM(RTRIM(resolved.IDCard)) END AS IDCard,
           resolved.CardNumber
    INTO #dd01
    FROM #qualifying01 q
    JOIN DataDebtorRelate di ON di.DebtorRelateId=q.DebtorRelateId
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) d.DebtorId,d.DebtorCode,d.PersonGroupId,d.IDCard,d.CardNumber
        FROM DataDebtor d
        WHERE d.DebtorId=di.DebtorId OR d.DebtorCode=di.DebtorCode
        ORDER BY CASE WHEN d.DebtorId=di.DebtorId THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                 d.CreateDate DESC,d.DebtorId DESC
    ) resolved
    WHERE resolved.PersonGroupId=118;
    CREATE INDEX IX_dd01 ON #dd01 (DebtorRelateId);
    DELETE q FROM #qualifying01 q WHERE NOT EXISTS
        (SELECT 1 FROM #dd01 d WHERE d.DebtorRelateId=q.DebtorRelateId);

    -- PDF p14: one row per LG and identity; prefer the main role when duplicated.
    -- Collapse duplicate DebtorCode rows only when they resolve to the same IDCard/CardNumber.
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#qualifying01_dedup') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #qualifying01_dedup;
    SELECT DebtorRelateId
    INTO #qualifying01_dedup
    FROM (
        SELECT
            q.DebtorRelateId,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY ddr.LGNo,
                             COALESCE(dd.IDCard, ddr.DebtorRelateId)
                ORDER BY CASE WHEN ddr.DebtorTypeId = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                         ISNULL(ddr.CreateDate, '1900-01-01') DESC, q.DebtorRelateId DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM #qualifying01 q
        JOIN DataDebtorRelate ddr ON ddr.DebtorRelateId = q.DebtorRelateId
        LEFT JOIN #dd01 dd ON dd.DebtorRelateId=ddr.DebtorRelateId
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1;

    TRUNCATE TABLE #qualifying01;
    INSERT INTO #qualifying01 (DebtorRelateId)
    SELECT DebtorRelateId
    FROM #qualifying01_dedup;

    DELETE q FROM #qualifying01 q JOIN DataDebtorRelate r ON r.DebtorRelateId=q.DebtorRelateId
    WHERE @CIFNo<>'null' AND (r.CIFNo<>@CIFNo OR r.CIFNo IS NULL);
    CREATE INDEX IX_qualifying01 ON #qualifying01 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 3b. DataDebtorRelate details (reused by dwh/s21/sc)
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ddr_info01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ddr_info01;
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr3.DebtorRelateId, ddr3.LGNo, ddr3.CIFNo, ddr3.DebtorId, ddr3.DebtorCode, ddr3.DebtorTypeId
    INTO #ddr_info01
    FROM DataDebtorRelate ddr3
    WHERE ddr3.DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying01);
    CREATE INDEX IX_ddr_info01 ON #ddr_info01 (DebtorRelateId);
    CREATE INDEX IX_ddr_info01_lg ON #ddr_info01 (LGNo, DebtorTypeId);

    -- NCB Deep Detail: borrower count is LG-wide and identity-based.
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#borrower_count01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #borrower_count01;
    ;WITH BorrowerIdentity AS (
        SELECT LGNo, DebtorRelateId, IdentityNo
        FROM (
            SELECT r.LGNo, r.DebtorRelateId,
                   CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.IDCard)), '') IS NOT NULL
                             AND d.IDCard NOT LIKE N'%ไม่พบ%' AND d.IDCard NOT LIKE N'%ไมพบ%'
                        THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(d.IDCard))
 ELSE NULL END AS IdentityNo,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                       PARTITION BY r.DebtorRelateId
                       ORDER BY CASE WHEN d.DebtorId = r.DebtorId THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                                d.CreateDate DESC, d.DebtorId DESC
                   ) AS rn
            FROM DataDebtorRelate r
            -- Disjoint equality branches preserve the original OR match set.
            -- Exclude an ID match from the code branch so it appears exactly once.
            LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT br.DebtorRelateId AS MatchRelateId,
                       person.DebtorId, person.IDCard, person.CreateDate
                FROM DataDebtorRelate br
                JOIN DataDebtor person ON person.DebtorId = br.DebtorId
                WHERE br.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
                  AND (br.IsDelete = 0 OR br.IsDelete IS NULL)
                  AND br.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM #ddr_info01)
                UNION ALL
                SELECT br.DebtorRelateId AS MatchRelateId,
                       person.DebtorId, person.IDCard, person.CreateDate
                FROM DataDebtorRelate br
                JOIN DataDebtor person ON person.DebtorCode = br.DebtorCode
                WHERE br.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
                  AND (br.IsDelete = 0 OR br.IsDelete IS NULL)
                  AND br.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM #ddr_info01)
                  AND (br.DebtorId IS NULL OR person.DebtorId IS NULL
                       OR person.DebtorId <> br.DebtorId)
            ) d ON d.MatchRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId
            WHERE r.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
              AND (r.IsDelete = 0 OR r.IsDelete IS NULL)
              AND r.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM #ddr_info01)
        ) ranked
        WHERE rn = 1
    )
    SELECT LGNo,
           CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN IdentityNo IS NULL OR IdentityNo LIKE N'%ไม่พบ%'
                                   OR IdentityNo LIKE N'%ไมพบ%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
                THEN COUNT(DISTINCT IdentityNo) ELSE NULL END AS BorrowerCount
    INTO #borrower_count01
    FROM BorrowerIdentity
    GROUP BY LGNo;
    CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IX_borrower_count01 ON #borrower_count01 (LGNo);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 3c. DataDebtor TOP 1 per DebtorCode with PersonGroupId = 118
    --     Prevent duplicate output when DataDebtor has multiple rows for the same code.
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 4. Monthly snapshot: last EOD per account per month
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#monthly01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #monthly01;
    SELECT e.DebtorRelateId, YEAR(e.AsOfDate) AS yr, MONTH(e.AsOfDate) AS mn, MAX(e.AsOfDate) AS MonthEndDate
    INTO #monthly01
    FROM dbo.DataEndOfDay e
    WHERE e.DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying01)
      AND (e.IsDelete=0 OR e.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND e.AsOfDate BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
    GROUP BY e.DebtorRelateId, YEAR(e.AsOfDate), MONTH(e.AsOfDate);

    -- Fallback for accounts missing EOD in the current month (e.g. closed accounts or inactive cards)
    INSERT INTO #monthly01 (DebtorRelateId, yr, mn, MonthEndDate)
    SELECT q.DebtorRelateId, YEAR(@EndDate), MONTH(@EndDate), @EndDate
    FROM #qualifying01 q
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #monthly01 m WHERE m.DebtorRelateId = q.DebtorRelateId);

    CREATE INDEX IX_monthly01 ON #monthly01 (DebtorRelateId, MonthEndDate);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 5. [NEW] Pre-materialize legal cases — replaces per-row OUTER APPLY
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#lt01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #lt01;
    SELECT DebtorRelateId,
           FilingDate, RedCaseNo, BlackCaseNo, BankFilingDate,
           WithdrawDate, JudgmentBankruptcyDate, JmTrialDate,
           WarrantDate, FilingAmount, ReqRepayDate,
           FrozenAssetDate, OtherFrozenAssDate, PetitionDate, BankruptcyDate
    INTO #lt01
    FROM (
        SELECT DebtorRelateId, FilingDate, RedCaseNo, BlackCaseNo, BankFilingDate,
               WithdrawDate, JudgmentBankruptcyDate, JmTrialDate, WarrantDate, FilingAmount, ReqRepayDate,
               FrozenAssetDate, OtherFrozenAssDate, PetitionDate, BankruptcyDate,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DebtorRelateId ORDER BY CreateDate DESC) AS rn
        FROM LTDataCaseMainDebtor
        WHERE (IsCancel = 0 OR IsCancel IS NULL)  -- [แก้ 2026-07-15] NULL = 0 is NULL in SQL, not TRUE — was silently dropping non-cancelled rows with IsCancel unset
          AND DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying01)
    ) x WHERE rn = 1;

    CREATE INDEX IX_lt01 ON #lt01 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 6. [NEW] Pre-materialize latest StatusLegalId as of each report month.
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ssu01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ssu01;
    SELECT
        m.DebtorRelateId,
        m.MonthEndDate,
        ssu.StatusLegalId,
        ssu.StatusPortId,
        ssu.StatusPortDate,
        ssu.UpdateDate
    INTO #ssu01
    FROM #monthly01 m
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            s.StatusLegalId,
            s.StatusPortId,
            s.StatusPortDate,
            s.UpdateDate
        FROM DataDebtorStatusUpdate s
        WHERE s.DebtorRelateId = m.DebtorRelateId
          AND s.UpdateDate < DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(m.MonthEndDate), MONTH(m.MonthEndDate), 1))
        ORDER BY s.UpdateDate DESC
    ) ssu;

    CREATE INDEX IX_ssu01 ON #ssu01 (DebtorRelateId, MonthEndDate);

    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#s32_event01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #s32_event01;
    ;WITH S32Ids AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT TRY_CAST(v.value AS INT) AS StatusLegalId
        FROM #NCBCond01 c
        CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(REPLACE(c.ValueConditionExcute, N' ', N''), ',') v
        WHERE c.NCBStatusCode = 32
          AND c.ColumnName = 'StatusLegalId'
          AND TRY_CAST(v.value AS INT) IS NOT NULL
    )
    SELECT
        m.DebtorRelateId,
        m.MonthEndDate,
        MIN(s.UpdateDate) AS S32EventDate
    INTO #s32_event01
    FROM #monthly01 m
    JOIN DataDebtorStatusUpdate s
        ON s.DebtorRelateId = m.DebtorRelateId
       AND s.UpdateDate < DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(m.MonthEndDate), MONTH(m.MonthEndDate), 1))
    JOIN S32Ids ids
        ON ids.StatusLegalId = s.StatusLegalId
    GROUP BY m.DebtorRelateId, m.MonthEndDate;
    CREATE INDEX IX_s32_event01 ON #s32_event01 (DebtorRelateId, MonthEndDate);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 7. [NEW] Pre-materialize CBS (DWH) data — replaces per-row OUTER APPLY
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dwh01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dwh01;
    SELECT x.accountnumber, x.customercode, x.idnumber
    INTO #dwh01
    FROM (
        SELECT d.accountnumber, d.customercode, d.idnumber,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.accountnumber, d.customercode ORDER BY d.ImportDate DESC) AS rn
        FROM TEMPDWHCBS d
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT DISTINCT LGNo, CIFNo
            FROM #ddr_info01
        ) q ON q.LGNo = d.accountnumber AND q.CIFNo = d.customercode
        WHERE d.ImportDate < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @EndDate)
    ) x WHERE x.rn = 1;

    CREATE INDEX IX_dwh01 ON #dwh01 (accountnumber, customercode);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 7b. Pre-materialize latest TDR contract per LGNo
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tdr_latest01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tdr_latest01;
    SELECT LGNo, CompromiseContractId, CompromiseContractStatusId, ApproveDate, TDRDate, InstallmentDueDate, MeasureName
    INTO #tdr_latest01
    FROM (
        SELECT
            rtdr.LGNo, cc.CompromiseContractId, cc.CompromiseContractStatusId, cc.ApproveDate, cc.TDRDate, CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), cc.InstallmentDueDate) AS InstallmentDueDate, m.MeasureName,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rtdr.LGNo ORDER BY cc.ApproveDate DESC, cc.CompromiseContractId DESC) AS rn
        FROM (
            SELECT CompromiseContractId, LGNo FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractRelated
            UNION
            SELECT CompromiseContractId, LGNo FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractLG
        ) rtdr
        JOIN TDRDataCompromiseContract cc ON cc.CompromiseContractId = rtdr.CompromiseContractId
        LEFT JOIN SystemMeasureMaster m ON m.MeasureId = cc.MeasureId
        WHERE cc.ApproveDate <= @EndDate
          AND rtdr.LGNo IN (SELECT DISTINCT LGNo FROM #ddr_info01)
    ) x WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_tdr_latest01 ON #tdr_latest01 (LGNo);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 7c. Pre-materialize latest DataDebtorCard per DebtorRelateId (Card fallback)
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dc01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dc01;
    SELECT DebtorRelateId, DataDebtorCardId, CloseDate, DFDDate, DPD, ClaimPayDate, IsTDR, CompromiseContracApproveDate, DebtBalance, PrincipalTotal
    INTO #dc01
    FROM (
        SELECT DebtorRelateId, DataDebtorCardId, CloseDate, DFDDate, DPD, ClaimPayDate, IsTDR, CompromiseContracApproveDate, DebtBalance, PrincipalTotal,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DebtorRelateId ORDER BY CreateDate DESC, DataDebtorCardId DESC) AS rn
        FROM DataDebtorCard
        WHERE DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying01)
          AND (IsDelete = 0 OR IsDelete IS NULL)
    ) x WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_dc01 ON #dc01 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- Rank EOD rows only for monthly snapshots, then keep rn = 1.
    -- This prevents duplicate output when multiple EOD rows share the same CreateDate.
    -- PDF pp4/11/16: display latest dated TDR, including closed/unapproved plans.
     -- This reporting history is separate from the active-plan calculation above.
     IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tdr_report01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tdr_report01;
     ;WITH ReportingTDR AS (
         SELECT rel.LGNo, m.MonthEndDate, cc.TDRDate, cc.InstallmentsEndDate,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rel.LGNo, m.MonthEndDate
                                   ORDER BY cc.TDRDate DESC, cc.CompromiseContractId DESC) AS rn
         FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MonthEndDate FROM #monthly01) m
         JOIN TDRDataCompromiseContract cc
           ON CAST(cc.TDRDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(m.MonthEndDate)
          AND cc.TDRDate > '1900-01-01'
         JOIN (
             SELECT CompromiseContractId, LGNo FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractRelated
             UNION
             SELECT CompromiseContractId, LGNo FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractLG
         ) rel ON rel.CompromiseContractId = cc.CompromiseContractId
         WHERE rel.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM #ddr_info01)
     )
     SELECT LGNo, MonthEndDate, TDRDate, InstallmentsEndDate
     INTO #tdr_report01
     FROM ReportingTDR
     WHERE rn = 1;
     CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IX_tdr_report01 ON #tdr_report01 (LGNo, MonthEndDate);

     IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#eom_source01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #eom_source01;
    SELECT
        ms.DebtorRelateId,
        ms.yr,
        ms.mn,
        ms.MonthEndDate,
        eom.CIFNo AS SnapshotCIFNo,
        eom.LGNo AS SnapshotLGNo,
        eom.DataDebtorCardId,
        eom.CurrentPaymentDate,
        eom.CloseDate,
        eom.PrincipalTotal,
        eom.DebtBalance,
        eom.AccruedInterest,
        eom.ClaimPayDate,
        eom.DFDDate,
        eom.DPD,
        eom.IsTDR,
        eom.InstallmentsAmount,
        eom.TDRInstallments,
        eom.InstallmentOutstanding,
        eom.CaseTypeId,
        eom.FilingDate,
        eom.BlackCaseNo,
        eom.JmTrialDate,
        eom.RedCaseNo,
        eom.FrozenAssetDate,
        eom.OtherFrozenAssDate,
        eom.ReqRepayDate,
        eom.FilingAmount,
        eom.BankruptcyDate,
        eom.PetitionDate,
        eom.WithdrawDate,
        eom.WarrantDate,
        eom.JudgmentBankruptcyDate,
        eom.StatusLGId,
        eom.AmountDuty,
        eom.DebtAmount,
        eom.CompromiseContracApproveDate,
        eom.DebtorRelateTypeId,
        eom.SystemBankId,
        eom.MeasureName,
        eom.BankCode,
        eom.ExpirationDate,
        eom.PrincipalPay,
        eom.BadDebtDate,
        eom.CardType,
        eom.ProportionLiability,
        eom.StatusPortId,
        eom.StatusPortDate,
        CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), eom.TDRInstallmentDueDate) AS TDRInstallmentDueDate,
        eom.AcknowDebtDate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY ms.DebtorRelateId, ms.MonthEndDate
            ORDER BY ISNULL(eom.CreateDate, '1900-01-01') DESC,
                     ISNULL(eom.DataDebtorCardId, 0) DESC
        ) AS rn
    INTO #eom_source01
    FROM #monthly01 ms
    JOIN dbo.DataEndOfDay eom ON eom.DebtorRelateId = ms.DebtorRelateId
        AND eom.AsOfDate = ms.MonthEndDate
        AND (eom.IsDelete = 0 OR eom.IsDelete IS NULL);
    CREATE INDEX IX_eom_source01 ON #eom_source01 (DebtorRelateId, MonthEndDate, rn);

    -- ── STEP E: Materialize end-of-month DataEndOfDay snapshot (read DataEndOfDay only once)
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#eom01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #eom01;
    SELECT
        ms.DebtorRelateId,
        report_tdr.TDRDate AS ReportTDRDate,
        report_tdr.InstallmentsEndDate AS ReportMaturityDate,
        ms.yr,
        ms.mn,
        ms.MonthEndDate,
        eom.SnapshotCIFNo,
        eom.SnapshotLGNo,
        COALESCE(eom.DataDebtorCardId, dc.DataDebtorCardId) AS DataDebtorCardId,
        eom.CurrentPaymentDate,
        eom.CloseDate AS CloseDate,
        eom.PrincipalTotal AS PrincipalTotal,
        eom.DebtBalance AS DebtBalance,
        eom.AccruedInterest,
        dlg_source.ClaimDate AS ClaimPayDate,
        eom.DFDDate AS DFDDate,
        eom.DPD AS DPD,
        CASE
            WHEN tdr_rel.ApproveDate IS NOT NULL AND tdr_rel.ApproveDate > '1900-01-01'
                 AND ISNULL(tdr_rel.CompromiseContractStatusId, 0) NOT IN (60, 61) THEN 1
            ELSE ISNULL(COALESCE(eom.IsTDR, dc.IsTDR), 0)
        END AS IsTDR,
        eom.InstallmentsAmount,
        eom.TDRInstallments,
        eom.InstallmentOutstanding,
        eom.CaseTypeId,
        eom.FilingDate,
        eom.BlackCaseNo,
        eom.JmTrialDate,
        eom.RedCaseNo,
        eom.FrozenAssetDate,
        eom.OtherFrozenAssDate,
        eom.ReqRepayDate,
        eom.FilingAmount,
        eom.BankruptcyDate,
        eom.PetitionDate,
        eom.WithdrawDate,
        eom.WarrantDate,
        eom.JudgmentBankruptcyDate,
        eom.StatusLGId,
        eom.AmountDuty,
        eom.DebtAmount,
        CASE
            WHEN tdr_rel.ApproveDate IS NOT NULL AND tdr_rel.ApproveDate > '1900-01-01' THEN tdr_rel.ApproveDate
            ELSE COALESCE(eom.CompromiseContracApproveDate, dc.CompromiseContracApproveDate, '1900-01-01')
        END AS CompromiseContracApproveDate,
        eom.DebtorRelateTypeId,
        eom.SystemBankId,
        report_measure.MeasureName AS MeasureName,
        report_measure.CompromiseContractMeasureId AS ReportMeasureId,
        eom.BankCode,
        eom.ExpirationDate,
        eom.PrincipalPay,
        eom.BadDebtDate,
        eom.CardType,
        eom.ProportionLiability,
        eom.StatusPortId AS StatusPortId,
        eom.StatusPortDate AS StatusPortDate,
        eom.TDRInstallmentDueDate AS TDRInstallmentDueDate,
        eom.AcknowDebtDate,
        CASE WHEN dlg_source.ClaimDate > '1900-01-01'
                   AND CAST(dlg_source.ClaimDate AS DATE)<=EOMONTH(ms.MonthEndDate)
                   AND ((eom.FrozenAssetDate>'1900-01-01' AND eom.FrozenAssetDate<dlg_source.ClaimDate)
                     OR (eom.OtherFrozenAssDate>'1900-01-01' AND eom.OtherFrozenAssDate<dlg_source.ClaimDate)
                     OR (eom.JudgmentBankruptcyDate>'1900-01-01' AND eom.JudgmentBankruptcyDate<dlg_source.ClaimDate
                         AND eom.ReqRepayDate>'1900-01-01' AND eom.ReqRepayDate<dlg_source.ClaimDate))
             THEN dlg_source.ClaimDate ELSE eom.DFDDate END AS DerivedDFD,
        eom.DPD AS DerivedDPD
    INTO #eom01
    FROM #monthly01 ms
    JOIN #ddr_info01 di ON di.DebtorRelateId = ms.DebtorRelateId
    JOIN DataLG dlg_source ON dlg_source.LGNo = di.LGNo
    LEFT JOIN #tdr_report01 report_tdr ON report_tdr.LGNo = di.LGNo AND report_tdr.MonthEndDate = ms.MonthEndDate
    LEFT JOIN #eom_source01 eom ON eom.DebtorRelateId = ms.DebtorRelateId AND eom.MonthEndDate = ms.MonthEndDate AND eom.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN #dc01 dc ON dc.DebtorRelateId = ms.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #lt01 lt ON lt.DebtorRelateId = ms.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #tdr_latest01 tdr_rel ON tdr_rel.LGNo = di.LGNo
    LEFT JOIN #ssu01 ssu ON ssu.DebtorRelateId = ms.DebtorRelateId AND ssu.MonthEndDate = ms.MonthEndDate
    OUTER APPLY (
        -- PDF borrower measure interval: period belongs to this LG's measure.
        SELECT TOP (1) m.MeasureName,cm.CompromiseContractMeasureId
        FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractMeasure cm
        JOIN SystemMeasureMaster m ON m.MeasureId=cm.MeasureId
        WHERE cm.StartDate > '1900-01-01'
          AND CAST(cm.StartDate AS date)<=CAST(ms.MonthEndDate AS date)
          AND cm.EndDate > '1900-01-01'
          AND CAST(cm.EndDate AS date)>=CAST(ms.MonthEndDate AS date)
          AND (cm.CompromiseContractLGId IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractLG cl
                WHERE cl.CompromiseContractLGId=cm.CompromiseContractLGId
                  AND cl.CompromiseContractId=cm.CompromiseContractId AND cl.LGNo=di.LGNo)
            OR cm.CompromiseContractLGId IS NULL AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractRelated rel
                WHERE rel.CompromiseContractId=cm.CompromiseContractId AND rel.LGNo=di.LGNo
                UNION ALL
                SELECT 1 FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractLG cl
                WHERE cl.CompromiseContractId=cm.CompromiseContractId AND cl.LGNo=di.LGNo))
        ORDER BY cm.StartDate DESC,cm.Seq DESC,cm.CreateDate DESC,cm.CompromiseContractMeasureId DESC
    ) report_measure
;
    CREATE INDEX IX_eom01 ON #eom01 (DebtorRelateId, MonthEndDate);

    -- [NEW] Pre-compute s12/s13/s14/s21 conditions per (DebtorRelateId, MonthEndDate)
    -- Replaces 4 per-row OUTER APPLY NOT EXISTS in Main SELECT → eliminates worktable spooling
    -- PDF p27: use the last report BEFORE this month; reruns cannot self-qualify.
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#previous_report01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #previous_report01;
    ;WITH PreviousPeriod AS (
        SELECT di.LGNo, di.CIFNo, eom.MonthEndDate, MAX(h.Period) AS PreviousPeriod
        FROM #eom01 eom
        JOIN #ddr_info01 di ON di.DebtorRelateId = eom.DebtorRelateId
        LEFT JOIN ncb_internal.NCBCommercialCreditData h ON h.account_number = di.LGNo AND h.customer_code = di.CIFNo
             AND h.Period < CONVERT(char(7), eom.MonthEndDate, 126)
        GROUP BY di.LGNo, di.CIFNo, eom.MonthEndDate
    )
    SELECT p.LGNo, p.CIFNo, p.MonthEndDate,
           CASE WHEN COUNT(h.account_status) > 0
                     AND MIN(CASE WHEN h.account_status = @S21 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
                THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Was21
    INTO #previous_report01
    FROM PreviousPeriod p
    LEFT JOIN ncb_internal.NCBCommercialCreditData h ON h.account_number = p.LGNo AND h.customer_code = p.CIFNo
         AND h.Period = p.PreviousPeriod
    GROUP BY p.LGNo, p.CIFNo, p.MonthEndDate;
    -- END previous report
    CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IX_previous_report01 ON #previous_report01 (LGNo, CIFNo, MonthEndDate);

    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#cond01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #cond01;
    SELECT
        eom.DebtorRelateId,
        eom.MonthEndDate,
        CASE WHEN eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01'
                   AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
                   AND ((eom.FrozenAssetDate > '1900-01-01' AND eom.FrozenAssetDate < eom.ClaimPayDate)
                     OR (eom.OtherFrozenAssDate > '1900-01-01' AND eom.OtherFrozenAssDate < eom.ClaimPayDate)
                     OR (eom.JudgmentBankruptcyDate > '1900-01-01' AND eom.JudgmentBankruptcyDate < eom.ClaimPayDate
                         AND eom.ReqRepayDate > '1900-01-01' AND eom.ReqRepayDate < eom.ClaimPayDate))
             THEN eom.ClaimPayDate ELSE eom.DerivedDFD END AS ReportDFD,
        CASE WHEN eom.ReportTDRDate > '1900-01-01'
                    AND YEAR(eom.ReportTDRDate) = YEAR(eom.MonthEndDate)
                    AND MONTH(eom.ReportTDRDate) = MONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
                    AND eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01'
                    AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
                    AND dlg_rule.Grade IN ('E1', 'E2', 'F')
              THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsTDRReset,
        CASE WHEN eom.CloseDate > '1900-01-01'
                   AND CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
                   AND ((eom.DebtBalance = 0 AND eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01'
                         AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) AND dlg_rule.Grade='F')
                     OR ((eom.ClaimPayDate IS NULL OR eom.ClaimPayDate <= '1900-01-01'
                          OR CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) > EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate))
                         AND dlg_rule.Grade IN ('A','B','C','D','E','E1','E2') AND eom.StatusLGId=500))
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsS11,
        CASE WHEN eom.ReportMeasureId IS NOT NULL AND eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) AND dlg_rule.Grade='F' AND eom.ReportTDRDate > '1900-01-01' AND eom.DerivedDFD > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.DerivedDFD AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) AND eom.DerivedDPD > 0 AND (eom.CloseDate IS NULL OR eom.CloseDate <= '1900-01-01' OR CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE)>EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate))
             THEN CASE WHEN 1=1
              AND (eom.MeasureName LIKE N'%พักหนี้%' OR eom.MeasureName LIKE N'%พักชำระหนี้%' OR eom.MeasureName LIKE N'%ตั้งพัก%')
              AND eom.MeasureName NOT LIKE N'%เปราะบาง%'
              AND eom.MeasureName NOT LIKE N'%เกษตร%'
              AND (
                  @S12_HasCond = 0 OR NOT EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 c WHERE c.NCBStatusCode = 12
                      AND CASE
                          WHEN c.ColumnName='MeasureName' THEN
                              CASE WHEN c.Operator='LIKE'         THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.MeasureName,'') LIKE c.ValueConditionExcute,1,0)
                                   WHEN c.Operator='contains'     THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.MeasureName,'') LIKE '%'+c.ValueConditionExcute+'%',1,0)
                                   WHEN c.Operator='='            THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.MeasureName,'')=c.ValueConditionExcute,1,0)
                                   WHEN c.Operator IN('<>','!=')  THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.MeasureName,'')<>c.ValueConditionExcute,1,0)
                                   ELSE 0 END
                          WHEN c.ColumnName='DPD' THEN
                              CASE WHEN c.Operator='>=' THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DPD,0)>=TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                   WHEN c.Operator='<=' THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DPD,0)<=TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                   WHEN c.Operator='>'  THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DPD,0)> TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                   WHEN c.Operator='<'  THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DPD,0)< TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                   WHEN c.Operator='='  THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DPD,0)= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                   ELSE 0 END
                          WHEN c.ColumnName='IsTDR' THEN
                              CASE WHEN c.Operator='='           THEN IIF(ISNULL(CAST(eom.IsTDR AS INT),0)= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                   WHEN c.Operator IN('<>','!=') THEN IIF(ISNULL(CAST(eom.IsTDR AS INT),0)<>TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                   ELSE 0 END
                          WHEN c.ColumnName='DebtBalance' THEN
                              CASE WHEN c.Operator IN('>=','>') THEN IIF(eom.DebtBalance>=TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT,c.ValueConditionExcute),1,0)
                                   WHEN c.Operator IN('<=','<') THEN IIF(eom.DebtBalance<=TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT,c.ValueConditionExcute),1,0)
                                   WHEN c.Operator='='          THEN IIF(eom.DebtBalance= TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT,c.ValueConditionExcute),1,0)
                                   ELSE 0 END
                          ELSE 0 END = 0)
              )
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS IsS12,
        CASE WHEN eom.ReportMeasureId IS NOT NULL AND eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) AND dlg_rule.Grade='F' AND eom.ReportTDRDate > '1900-01-01' AND eom.DerivedDFD > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.DerivedDFD AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) AND eom.DerivedDPD > 0 AND (eom.CloseDate IS NULL OR eom.CloseDate <= '1900-01-01' OR CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE)>EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate))
             THEN CASE WHEN @S13_HasCond = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 c WHERE c.NCBStatusCode = 13
            AND CASE
                WHEN c.ColumnName='MeasureName' THEN
                    CASE WHEN c.Operator='LIKE'         THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.MeasureName,'') LIKE c.ValueConditionExcute,1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator='contains'     THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.MeasureName,'') LIKE '%'+c.ValueConditionExcute+'%',1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator='='            THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.MeasureName,'')=c.ValueConditionExcute,1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator IN('<>','!=')  THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.MeasureName,'')<>c.ValueConditionExcute,1,0)
                         ELSE 0 END
                WHEN c.ColumnName='DPD' THEN
                    CASE WHEN c.Operator='>=' THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DPD,0)>=TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator='<=' THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DPD,0)<=TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator='>'  THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DPD,0)> TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator='<'  THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DPD,0)< TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator='='  THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DPD,0)= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                         ELSE 0 END
                WHEN c.ColumnName='IsTDR' THEN
                    CASE WHEN c.Operator='='           THEN IIF(ISNULL(CAST(eom.IsTDR AS INT),0)= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator IN('<>','!=') THEN IIF(ISNULL(CAST(eom.IsTDR AS INT),0)<>TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                         ELSE 0 END
                WHEN c.ColumnName='DebtBalance' THEN
                    CASE WHEN c.Operator IN('>=','>') THEN IIF(eom.DebtBalance>=TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT,c.ValueConditionExcute),1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator IN('<=','<') THEN IIF(eom.DebtBalance<=TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT,c.ValueConditionExcute),1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator='='          THEN IIF(eom.DebtBalance= TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT,c.ValueConditionExcute),1,0)
                         ELSE 0 END
                ELSE 0 END = 0)
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS IsS13,
        CASE WHEN eom.ReportMeasureId IS NOT NULL AND eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) AND dlg_rule.Grade='F' AND eom.ReportTDRDate > '1900-01-01' AND eom.DerivedDFD > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.DerivedDFD AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) AND eom.DerivedDPD > 0 AND (eom.CloseDate IS NULL OR eom.CloseDate <= '1900-01-01' OR CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE)>EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate))
             THEN CASE WHEN eom.ClaimPayDate>'1900-01-01'
             AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS date)<=EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
             AND dlg_rule.Grade='F' AND eom.ReportTDRDate>'1900-01-01'
             AND (dbo.Fn_NCBFarmerMoratorium(eom.MeasureName)=1
                  OR (@S14_HasCond = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 c WHERE c.NCBStatusCode = 14
            AND CASE
                WHEN c.ColumnName='MeasureName' THEN
                    CASE WHEN c.Operator='LIKE'         THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.MeasureName,'') LIKE c.ValueConditionExcute,1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator='contains'     THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.MeasureName,'') LIKE '%'+c.ValueConditionExcute+'%',1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator='='            THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.MeasureName,'')=c.ValueConditionExcute,1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator IN('<>','!=')  THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.MeasureName,'')<>c.ValueConditionExcute,1,0)
                         ELSE 0 END
                WHEN c.ColumnName='DPD' THEN
                    CASE WHEN c.Operator='>=' THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DPD,0)>=TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator='<=' THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DPD,0)<=TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator='>'  THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DPD,0)> TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator='<'  THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DPD,0)< TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator='='  THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.DPD,0)= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                         ELSE 0 END
                WHEN c.ColumnName='IsTDR' THEN
                    CASE WHEN c.Operator='='           THEN IIF(ISNULL(CAST(eom.IsTDR AS INT),0)= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator IN('<>','!=') THEN IIF(ISNULL(CAST(eom.IsTDR AS INT),0)<>TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                         ELSE 0 END
                WHEN c.ColumnName='DebtBalance' THEN
                    CASE WHEN c.Operator IN('>=','>') THEN IIF(eom.DebtBalance>=TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT,c.ValueConditionExcute),1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator IN('<=','<') THEN IIF(eom.DebtBalance<=TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT,c.ValueConditionExcute),1,0)
                         WHEN c.Operator='='          THEN IIF(eom.DebtBalance= TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT,c.ValueConditionExcute),1,0)
                         ELSE 0 END
                ELSE 0 END = 0)
        )) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS IsS14,
        CASE WHEN eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) AND dlg_rule.Grade='F' AND (eom.CloseDate IS NULL OR eom.CloseDate <= '1900-01-01' OR CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE)>EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)) AND eom.DerivedDFD > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.DerivedDFD AS DATE)<=EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) AND eom.DerivedDPD>90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsS20,
        CASE WHEN eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
              AND (eom.CloseDate IS NULL OR eom.CloseDate <= '1900-01-01' OR CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE) > EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate))
              AND (
                  (eom.FrozenAssetDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.FrozenAssetDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate))
                  OR (eom.OtherFrozenAssDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.OtherFrozenAssDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate))
                  OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SystemCaseTypeMaster ct WHERE ct.CaseTypeId = eom.CaseTypeId AND ct.CaseTypeName = N'แพ่ง')
                      AND eom.FilingDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.FilingDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
                      AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(eom.BlackCaseNo)), '') IS NOT NULL
                      AND (eom.ReportTDRDate IS NULL OR eom.ReportTDRDate <= '1900-01-01')
                      AND (eom.WithdrawDate IS NULL OR eom.WithdrawDate <= '1900-01-01' OR CAST(eom.WithdrawDate AS DATE) > EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) OR eom.WithdrawDate < eom.FilingDate))
              ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsS30,
        CASE WHEN eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
              AND (eom.CloseDate IS NULL OR eom.CloseDate <= '1900-01-01' OR CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE) > EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate))
              AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SystemCaseTypeMaster ct WHERE ct.CaseTypeId = eom.CaseTypeId AND ct.CaseTypeName = N'แพ่ง')
              AND eom.FilingDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.FilingDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
              AND eom.JmTrialDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.JmTrialDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
              AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(eom.RedCaseNo)), '') IS NOT NULL
              AND eom.ReportTDRDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.ReportTDRDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
              AND (eom.WithdrawDate IS NULL OR eom.WithdrawDate <= '1900-01-01' OR CAST(eom.WithdrawDate AS DATE) > EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) OR eom.WithdrawDate < eom.FilingDate)
              THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsS31,
        0 AS IsS32,
        CASE WHEN eom.BadDebtDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.BadDebtDate AS DATE)<=EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsS33,
        CASE WHEN eom.DerivedDPD>90 AND eom.StatusPortDate>'1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.StatusPortDate AS DATE)<=EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate) THEN CASE WHEN @S42_HasCond = 1 AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond01 c WHERE c.NCBStatusCode = 42 AND c.ColumnName='StatusPortId'
              AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM STRING_SPLIT(REPLACE(c.ValueConditionExcute,N' ',N''), ',') v WHERE TRY_CAST(v.value AS INT) = ISNULL(eom.StatusPortId,0))
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS IsS42,
        0 AS IsS43,
        0 AS IsS44,
        CASE WHEN previous_report.Was21 = 1
                   AND eom.ReportTDRDate > '1900-01-01'
                   AND CAST(eom.ReportTDRDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
                   AND eom.DerivedDPD > 90
                   AND eom.DerivedDFD > '1900-01-01'
                   AND CAST(eom.DerivedDFD AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
                   AND eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01'
                   AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate)
                   AND dlg_rule.Grade = 'F'
                   AND (eom.CloseDate IS NULL OR eom.CloseDate <= '1900-01-01'
                        OR eom.CloseDate > EOMONTH(eom.MonthEndDate))
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsS21
    INTO #cond01
    FROM #eom01 eom
    JOIN #ddr_info01 di ON di.DebtorRelateId = eom.DebtorRelateId
    JOIN DataLG dlg_rule ON dlg_rule.LGNo = di.LGNo
    LEFT JOIN #previous_report01 previous_report ON previous_report.LGNo = di.LGNo
         AND previous_report.CIFNo = di.CIFNo AND previous_report.MonthEndDate = eom.MonthEndDate
    LEFT JOIN #lt01 lt ON lt.DebtorRelateId = eom.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #tdr_latest01 tdr_rel ON tdr_rel.LGNo = di.LGNo
    LEFT JOIN #ssu01 ssu
        ON ssu.DebtorRelateId = eom.DebtorRelateId
       AND ssu.MonthEndDate = eom.MonthEndDate;
    CREATE INDEX IX_cond01 ON #cond01 (DebtorRelateId, MonthEndDate);
    UPDATE #cond01 SET IsS12=0, IsS13=0 WHERE IsS14=1;

    -- Build dynamic status match from precomputed flags.
    -- Avoids CROSS JOIN #eom01 x #NCBCond01, which is too expensive for monthly volume.
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#status_match01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #status_match01;
    ;WITH Candidate AS (
        SELECT
            cond.DebtorRelateId,
            cond.MonthEndDate,
            v.NCBStatusCode
        FROM #cond01 cond
        CROSS APPLY (VALUES
            (42, cond.IsS42),
            (33, cond.IsS33),
            (11, cond.IsS11),
            (31, cond.IsS31),
            (30, cond.IsS30),
            (13, cond.IsS13),
            (14, cond.IsS14),
            (12, cond.IsS12),
            (21, cond.IsS21),
            (20, cond.IsS20)
        ) v(NCBStatusCode, IsMatch)
        WHERE v.IsMatch = 1
    )
    SELECT DebtorRelateId, MonthEndDate, NCBStatusCode, AccountStatus
    INTO #status_match01
    FROM (
        SELECT
            c.DebtorRelateId,
            c.MonthEndDate,
            c.NCBStatusCode,
            CAST(nsm.CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) AS AccountStatus,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY c.DebtorRelateId, c.MonthEndDate
                ORDER BY CASE c.NCBStatusCode
                    WHEN 42 THEN 10 WHEN 43 THEN 11 WHEN 44 THEN 12
                    WHEN 32 THEN 13 WHEN 33 THEN 20 WHEN 11 THEN 30 WHEN 31 THEN 40 WHEN 30 THEN 50
                    WHEN 13 THEN 60 WHEN 14 THEN 70 WHEN 12 THEN 80 WHEN 21 THEN 90
                    WHEN 20 THEN 100 WHEN 10 THEN 999 ELSE 500 END,
                    c.NCBStatusCode
            ) AS rn
        FROM Candidate c
        JOIN NCBStatusMaster nsm ON nsm.NCBStatusCode = c.NCBStatusCode
                                AND nsm.PersonType = 2
                                AND nsm.IsActive = 1
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_status_match01 ON #status_match01 (DebtorRelateId, MonthEndDate);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 7b. [OPTIMIZED] Pre-materialize NCBStopCondition — replaces per-row NOT EXISTS
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#sc01') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #sc01;
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr2.DebtorRelateId
    INTO #sc01
    FROM #ddr_info01 ddr2
    JOIN NCBStopConditionMaster sc ON (sc.CIFNo = ddr2.CIFNo OR sc.LGNo = ddr2.LGNo) AND sc.IsActive = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_sc01 ON #sc01 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 8. Main SELECT
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
        eom.SnapshotCIFNo                                           AS customer_code,
        dbo.Fn_NCBEffectiveDate_BE(mo.CutOff)                        AS eff_date,
        card.CardId                                                 AS card_id,
        '1'                                                         AS customer_type,
        '0400'                                                      AS branch_code,
        eom.SnapshotLGNo                                                    AS account_number,
