        '1120001'                                                   AS purpose_loan1,
        ''                                                          AS purpose_loan2,
        CASE WHEN dlg.LGDate IS NOT NULL AND dlg.LGDate > '1900-01-01'
             THEN dbo.[Fn_NCBDate_CE](dlg.LGDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS account_open_date,
        CASE WHEN latest_contract.InstallmentsEndDate > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.Fn_NCBDate_CE(latest_contract.InstallmentsEndDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS maturity_date,
        CASE WHEN eom.CloseDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.CloseDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE) <= mo.CutOff
                  THEN dbo.[Fn_NCBDate_CE](eom.CloseDate)
             ELSE '19000101'
        END                                                         AS account_close_date,
        CASE WHEN dlg.Grade = 'F' THEN '30'
             WHEN dlg.Grade IN ('A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E', 'E1', 'E2') THEN '0'
             ELSE NULL END                                         AS payment_terms,
        '1060035'                                                   AS credit_type,
        eom.PrincipalPay                                                         AS initial_amount_loan,
        'THB'                                                       AS currency_code,
        eom.TDRInstallments                                         AS number_of_installments,
        eom.InstallmentsAmount AS payment_amount,
        CASE WHEN eom.CurrentPaymentDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.CurrentPaymentDate > '1900-01-01'
                  AND CAST(eom.CurrentPaymentDate AS DATE) <= mo.CutOff
                  THEN dbo.[Fn_NCBDate_CE](eom.CurrentPaymentDate)
             ELSE '19000101'
        END                                                         AS last_payment_date,
        CASE WHEN eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) <= mo.CutOff AND dlg.Grade IN ('E1', 'E2', 'F')
             THEN CASE
            WHEN eom.CloseDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE) <= mo.CutOff
                 THEN CASE WHEN eom.ReportTDRDate > '1900-01-01'
                                AND eom.ReportTDRDate < '2024-04-01'
                                AND CAST(eom.ReportTDRDate AS DATE) <= mo.CutOff
                           THEN dbo.[Fn_NCBDate_CE](eom.ReportTDRDate)
                           ELSE '19000101' END
            WHEN eom.ReportTDRDate IS NOT NULL
                 AND eom.ReportTDRDate > '1900-01-01'
                 AND CAST(eom.ReportTDRDate AS DATE) <= mo.CutOff
                 THEN dbo.[Fn_NCBDate_CE](eom.ReportTDRDate)
            ELSE '19000101'
        END
             ELSE '19000101' END                                                         AS restructuring_date,
        CASE WHEN eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE) <= mo.CutOff
                  AND dlg.Grade IN ('E1', 'E2', 'F')
                  AND eom.ReportTDRDate >= '2024-04-01' AND CAST(eom.ReportTDRDate AS DATE) <= mo.CutOff
                  AND (eom.CloseDate IS NULL OR eom.CloseDate <= '1900-01-01' OR CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE) > mo.CutOff)
             THEN '02' ELSE '00' END                                                         AS code_of_restructuring,
        eom.PrincipalPay           AS close_payment_amount,
        ''                                                          AS write_of_amount,
        CASE WHEN (cond.IsTDRReset = 1 AND COALESCE(status_match.AccountStatus,@S10) IN (@S10,@S20,@S21,@S30) AND COALESCE(cond.IsS11,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS12,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS13,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS14,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS31,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS33,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS42,0)=0) AND COALESCE(cond.IsS30,0)=0 AND COALESCE(status_match.AccountStatus,@S10) NOT IN (@S12,@S13,@S14,@S31,@S33,@S42) THEN @S10 ELSE CASE WHEN cond.IsS42=1 THEN @S42 WHEN cond.IsS33=1 THEN @S33 WHEN cond.IsS11=1 THEN @S11 WHEN cond.IsS31=1 THEN @S31 WHEN cond.IsS30=1 THEN @S30 WHEN cond.IsS14=1 THEN @S14 WHEN cond.IsS13=1 THEN @S13 WHEN cond.IsS12=1 THEN @S12 WHEN cond.IsS21=1 THEN @S21 WHEN cond.IsS20=1 THEN @S20 WHEN status_match.AccountStatus IN (@S10,@S11,@S12,@S13,@S14,@S20,@S21,@S30,@S31,@S33,@S42) THEN status_match.AccountStatus ELSE @S10 END END AS account_status,
        CASE WHEN (cond.IsTDRReset = 1 AND COALESCE(status_match.AccountStatus,@S10) IN (@S10,@S20,@S21,@S30) AND COALESCE(cond.IsS11,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS12,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS13,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS14,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS31,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS33,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS42,0)=0) OR cond.IsS11=1 OR cond.IsS33=1 OR status_match.AccountStatus IN (@S11,@S33) THEN '19000101' WHEN cond.ReportDFD > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(cond.ReportDFD AS DATE)<=mo.CutOff THEN dbo.Fn_NCBDate_CE(cond.ReportDFD) ELSE '19000101' END AS default_date,
        ''                                                          AS delinquent_status,
        NULL                                                        AS credit_limit_type,
        TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT, eom.ProportionLiability)                 AS percent_payment,
        eom.CardType                                                AS credit_card_type,
        CASE WHEN (cond.IsTDRReset = 1 AND COALESCE(status_match.AccountStatus,@S10) IN (@S10,@S20,@S21,@S30) AND COALESCE(cond.IsS11,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS12,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS13,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS14,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS31,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS33,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS42,0)=0) OR cond.IsS11=1 OR cond.IsS33=1 OR status_match.AccountStatus IN (@S11,@S33) OR ((cond.IsS30=1 OR cond.IsS31=1) AND (cond.ReportDFD IS NULL OR cond.ReportDFD<='1900-01-01') AND (eom.FrozenAssetDate IS NULL OR eom.FrozenAssetDate<='1900-01-01') AND (eom.OtherFrozenAssDate IS NULL OR eom.OtherFrozenAssDate<='1900-01-01')) OR eom.DerivedDPD=0 THEN @D0 WHEN eom.DerivedDPD IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE dpd_cfg.DPDOutputCode END AS past_due_days,
        CASE WHEN (cond.IsTDRReset = 1 AND COALESCE(status_match.AccountStatus,@S10) IN (@S10,@S20,@S21,@S30) AND COALESCE(cond.IsS11,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS12,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS13,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS14,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS31,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS33,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS42,0)=0) OR cond.IsS11=1 OR cond.IsS33=1 OR status_match.AccountStatus IN (@S11,@S33) OR ((cond.IsS30=1 OR cond.IsS31=1) AND (cond.ReportDFD IS NULL OR cond.ReportDFD<='1900-01-01') AND (eom.FrozenAssetDate IS NULL OR eom.FrozenAssetDate<='1900-01-01') AND (eom.OtherFrozenAssDate IS NULL OR eom.OtherFrozenAssDate<='1900-01-01')) THEN 0 ELSE eom.DerivedDPD END AS past_due_days_2,
        CASE WHEN (cond.IsTDRReset = 1 AND COALESCE(status_match.AccountStatus,@S10) IN (@S10,@S20,@S21,@S30) AND COALESCE(cond.IsS11,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS12,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS13,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS14,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS31,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS33,0)+COALESCE(cond.IsS42,0)=0) OR cond.IsS11=1 OR cond.IsS33=1 OR status_match.AccountStatus IN (@S11,@S33) THEN 0 WHEN eom.DerivedDPD IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN eom.DerivedDPD=0 OR cond.ReportDFD IS NULL OR cond.ReportDFD<='1900-01-01' THEN 0 WHEN eom.ClaimPayDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.ClaimPayDate AS DATE)<=mo.CutOff THEN CASE WHEN eom.ReportTDRDate > '1900-01-01' THEN CASE WHEN eom.DerivedDPD BETWEEN 1 AND 90 THEN eom.InstallmentOutstanding WHEN eom.DerivedDPD>90 THEN eom.DebtBalance ELSE 0 END WHEN eom.DerivedDPD>30 THEN eom.DebtBalance ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS past_due_amount,
        CASE WHEN cond.IsS11=1 OR cond.IsS33=1 THEN 0 ELSE eom.DebtBalance END AS outstanding_amount,
        CASE WHEN (eom.CloseDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.CloseDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE) <= mo.CutOff) THEN 0.0
             ELSE ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT,eom.PrincipalTotal),0.0) END AS principal_balance,
        CASE WHEN (eom.CloseDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.CloseDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE) <= mo.CutOff) THEN 0.0
             ELSE ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT,eom.AccruedInterest),0.0) END AS interest_balance,
        CASE ddr.DebtorTypeId WHEN 1 THEN '01' WHEN 2 THEN '04'
             ELSE CAST(ISNULL(eom.DebtorRelateTypeId, ddr.DebtorTypeId) AS VARCHAR(10)) END AS ownership_indicator,
        borrower_count.BorrowerCount                                AS number_of_coborrower,
        ''                                                          AS unit_make,
        NULL                                                        AS unit_model,
        eom.StatusLGId                                                AS status_lg,
        dlg.Grade                                                   AS status_grade,
        CASE WHEN dlg.ClaimDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(dlg.ClaimDate AS DATE) <= mo.CutOff THEN dbo.Fn_NCBDate_CE(dlg.ClaimDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS claim_pay_date,
        CASE WHEN eom.ReqRepayDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.ReqRepayDate > '1900-01-01'
             THEN dbo.[Fn_NCBDate_CE](eom.ReqRepayDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS bkr_filing_date,
        TRY_CONVERT(FLOAT,eom.FilingAmount)                          AS filing_amount,
        CASE WHEN eom.FrozenAssetDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.FrozenAssetDate > '1900-01-01'
             THEN dbo.[Fn_NCBDate_CE](eom.FrozenAssetDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS frozenassetdate,
        CASE WHEN eom.OtherFrozenAssDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.OtherFrozenAssDate > '1900-01-01'
             THEN dbo.[Fn_NCBDate_CE](eom.OtherFrozenAssDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS otherfrozenassdate,
        CASE WHEN eom.PetitionDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.PetitionDate > '1900-01-01'
             THEN dbo.[Fn_NCBDate_CE](eom.PetitionDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS petition_date,
        CASE WHEN eom.BankruptcyDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.BankruptcyDate > '1900-01-01'
             THEN dbo.[Fn_NCBDate_CE](eom.BankruptcyDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS bankruptcy_date,
        CASE WHEN eom.BadDebtDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.BadDebtDate > '1900-01-01'
             THEN dbo.[Fn_NCBDate_CE](eom.BadDebtDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS bad_debt_date,
        CASE WHEN eom.FilingDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.FilingDate > '1900-01-01'
             THEN dbo.[Fn_NCBDate_CE](eom.FilingDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS file_date_temp,
        eom.BlackCaseNo                                              AS black_case_no,
        CASE WHEN eom.WithdrawDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.WithdrawDate > '1900-01-01'
             THEN dbo.[Fn_NCBDate_CE](eom.WithdrawDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS withdraw_date,
        CASE WHEN eom.WarrantDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.WarrantDate > '1900-01-01'
             THEN dbo.[Fn_NCBDate_CE](eom.WarrantDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS warrant_date,
        CASE WHEN eom.JmTrialDate IS NOT NULL AND eom.JmTrialDate > '1900-01-01'
             THEN dbo.[Fn_NCBDate_CE](eom.JmTrialDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS jm_trial_date,
        eom.RedCaseNo                                                AS red_case_no,
        sb.BankName                                                 AS bank,
        sbb.BankBranchName                                         AS branch,
        ct.ClaimTypeName                                            AS project,
        cst.ClaimSubTypeName                                        AS sub_project,
        CASE WHEN dlg.LGDate IS NOT NULL AND dlg.LGDate > '1900-01-01'
             THEN dbo.[Fn_NCBDate_CE](dlg.LGDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS open_date_old,
        N'วันที่พิมพ์ : ' + dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(GETDATE())     AS PrintDate,
        N'ผู้สั่งพิมพ์ : ' + NULL                                  AS PrintName,
        dbo.Fn_NCBEffectiveDate_BE(mo.CutOff) AS as_of_date,
        active_contract.ContractNo AS contract_number,
        latest_contract.ContractNo AS last_contract_number,
        CAST(ddr.DebtorRelateId AS nvarchar(300)) AS ReportDebtorRelateId,
        CAST(dd.DebtorId AS nvarchar(300)) AS ReportDebtorId,
        CASE WHEN eom.SnapshotCIFNo=ddr.CIFNo AND eom.SnapshotLGNo=ddr.LGNo AND CAST(eom.MonthEndDate AS DATE)=EOMONTH(mo.CutOff) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ReportSourceIdentityValid,
        CAST(3 AS tinyint) AS ReportSchemaVersion
    INTO #ncbresult01
    FROM #qualifying01 q
    -- [CHANGED] drive from #qualifying01 (indexed, filtered) instead of full DataDebtorRelate scan
    JOIN DataDebtorRelate ddr ON ddr.DebtorRelateId = q.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #borrower_count01 borrower_count ON borrower_count.LGNo = ddr.LGNo
    JOIN DataLG dlg ON dlg.LGNo = ddr.LGNo
    LEFT JOIN #dc01 dc ON dc.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #eom01 eom ON eom.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #tdr_latest01 tdr_rel ON tdr_rel.LGNo = ddr.LGNo

    CROSS APPLY (SELECT ISNULL(EOMONTH(DATEFROMPARTS(eom.yr, eom.mn, 1)), @EndDate) AS CutOff) mo

    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 dr.DPDOutputCode
        FROM #dpd_rule01 dr
        WHERE (dr.ExactValue   IS NULL OR eom.DerivedDPD =  dr.ExactValue)
          AND (dr.MinInclusive IS NULL OR eom.DerivedDPD >= dr.MinInclusive)
          AND (dr.MaxInclusive IS NULL OR eom.DerivedDPD <= dr.MaxInclusive)
          AND (dr.MinExclusive IS NULL OR eom.DerivedDPD >  dr.MinExclusive)
          AND (dr.MaxExclusive IS NULL OR eom.DerivedDPD <  dr.MaxExclusive)
        ORDER BY
            CASE WHEN dr.ExactValue IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
            ISNULL(dr.MinInclusive, dr.MinExclusive + 1) DESC,
            ISNULL(dr.MaxInclusive, dr.MaxExclusive - 1) ASC,
            dr.DPDCode
    ) dpd_cfg

    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 tr.RestructureCode
        FROM (SELECT DISTINCT RestructureCodeId, RestructureCode, Oparators FROM #tdr_rule01) tr
        WHERE
            (
                ISNULL(tr.Oparators, 'AND') <> 'OR'
                AND NOT EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM #tdr_rule01 c
                    WHERE c.RestructureCodeId = tr.RestructureCodeId
                      AND c.ColumnName IS NOT NULL
                      AND (
                          CASE
                              WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('IsTDR') THEN
                                  CASE WHEN c.Operator IN ('=','Equal') THEN IIF(ISNULL(CAST(eom.IsTDR AS INT),0) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('<>','!=') THEN IIF(ISNULL(CAST(eom.IsTDR AS INT),0) <> TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                       ELSE 0 END
                              WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('CloseDate') THEN
                                  CASE WHEN c.Operator IN ('>','MoreThan') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') > TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('>=','MoreThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('<','LessThan') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') < TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('<=','LessThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('=','Equal') THEN IIF(CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(eom.CloseDate,'1900-01-01')) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATE),1,0)
                                       ELSE 0 END
                              WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('CompromiseContracApproveDate','CompromiseContractApproveDate','TDRDate') THEN
                                  CASE WHEN c.Operator IN ('>','MoreThan') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.CompromiseContracApproveDate,'1900-01-01') > TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('>=','MoreThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.CompromiseContracApproveDate,'1900-01-01') >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('<','LessThan') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.CompromiseContracApproveDate,'1900-01-01') < TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('<=','LessThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.CompromiseContracApproveDate,'1900-01-01') <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('=','Equal') THEN IIF(CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(eom.CompromiseContracApproveDate,'1900-01-01')) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATE),1,0)
                                       ELSE 0 END
                              ELSE 0
                          END
                      ) = 0
                )
            )
            OR
            (
                ISNULL(tr.Oparators, 'AND') = 'OR'
                AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM #tdr_rule01 c
                    WHERE c.RestructureCodeId = tr.RestructureCodeId
                      AND c.ColumnName IS NOT NULL
                      AND (
                          CASE
                              WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('IsTDR') THEN
                                  CASE WHEN c.Operator IN ('=','Equal') THEN IIF(ISNULL(CAST(eom.IsTDR AS INT),0) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('<>','!=') THEN IIF(ISNULL(CAST(eom.IsTDR AS INT),0) <> TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS INT),1,0)
                                       ELSE 0 END
                              WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('CloseDate') THEN
                                  CASE WHEN c.Operator IN ('>','MoreThan') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') > TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('>=','MoreThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('<','LessThan') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') < TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('<=','LessThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.CloseDate,'1900-01-01') <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('=','Equal') THEN IIF(CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(eom.CloseDate,'1900-01-01')) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATE),1,0)
                                       ELSE 0 END
                              WHEN c.ColumnName IN ('CompromiseContracApproveDate','CompromiseContractApproveDate','TDRDate') THEN
                                  CASE WHEN c.Operator IN ('>','MoreThan') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.CompromiseContracApproveDate,'1900-01-01') > TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('>=','MoreThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.CompromiseContracApproveDate,'1900-01-01') >= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('<','LessThan') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.CompromiseContracApproveDate,'1900-01-01') < TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('<=','LessThanEqual') THEN IIF(ISNULL(eom.CompromiseContracApproveDate,'1900-01-01') <= TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATETIME),1,0)
                                       WHEN c.Operator IN ('=','Equal') THEN IIF(CONVERT(DATE,ISNULL(eom.CompromiseContracApproveDate,'1900-01-01')) = TRY_CAST(c.ValueConditionExcute AS DATE),1,0)
                                       ELSE 0 END
                              ELSE 0
                          END
                      ) = 1
                )
            )
        ORDER BY CASE WHEN tr.RestructureCode = @TDRDefaultCode01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, tr.RestructureCode
    ) tdr_cfg

    -- [CHANGED] DataDebtor is pre-deduped to TOP 1 per DebtorCode to avoid duplicate output rows.
    JOIN #dd01 dd ON dd.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId

    -- [CHANGED] OUTER APPLY → LEFT JOIN pre-materialized temp table
    LEFT JOIN #lt01  lt  ON lt.DebtorRelateId  = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    LEFT JOIN #ssu01 ssu
        ON ssu.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
       AND ssu.MonthEndDate = eom.MonthEndDate
    LEFT JOIN #dwh01 dwh ON dwh.accountnumber  = ddr.LGNo AND dwh.customercode = ddr.CIFNo

    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT
            CASE
                WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(dd.IDCard)), '') IS NOT NULL
                  AND LTRIM(RTRIM(dd.IDCard)) NOT LIKE N'%ไม่พบ%'
                  AND LTRIM(RTRIM(dd.IDCard)) NOT LIKE N'%ไมพบ%'
                    THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(dd.IDCard))
                ELSE NULL
            END AS CardId
    ) card
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) cc.ContractNo, cc.InstallmentsEndDate
        FROM TDRDataCompromiseContract cc
        WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractRelated rel
            WHERE rel.CompromiseContractId=cc.CompromiseContractId AND rel.LGNo=ddr.LGNo
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 1 FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractLG rel
            WHERE rel.CompromiseContractId=cc.CompromiseContractId AND rel.LGNo=ddr.LGNo
        )
          AND CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(cc.TDRDate,'1900-01-01'), cc.CreateDate) AS date) <= mo.CutOff
        ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(cc.TDRDate,'1900-01-01'),cc.CreateDate) DESC, cc.CompromiseContractId DESC
    ) latest_contract

    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) cc.ContractNo, cc.InstallmentsEndDate
        FROM TDRDataCompromiseContract cc
        WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractRelated rel
            WHERE rel.CompromiseContractId=cc.CompromiseContractId AND rel.LGNo=ddr.LGNo
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 1 FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractLG rel
            WHERE rel.CompromiseContractId=cc.CompromiseContractId AND rel.LGNo=ddr.LGNo
        )
          AND CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(cc.TDRDate,'1900-01-01'), cc.CreateDate) AS date) <= mo.CutOff
          AND (cc.CompromiseContractStatusId=58 OR (cc.CompromiseContractStatusId=61 AND CAST(cc.ClosedDate AS date)>mo.CutOff))
          AND cc.ApproveDate > '1900-01-01' AND CAST(cc.ApproveDate AS date)<=mo.CutOff
          AND (cc.ClosedDate IS NULL OR cc.ClosedDate<='1900-01-01' OR CAST(cc.ClosedDate AS date)>mo.CutOff)
        ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(cc.TDRDate,'1900-01-01'),cc.CreateDate) DESC, cc.CompromiseContractId DESC
    ) active_contract


    -- [REMOVED] DataDebtorAddress OUTER APPLY + prov/dist/sub_dist JOINs
    --   (ไม่มี column จาก dda/prov/dist/sub_dist ใน SELECT — dead code)

    LEFT JOIN SystemBankMaster          sb  ON sb.BankId          = dlg.BankId
    LEFT JOIN SystemBankBranchMaster    sbb ON sbb.BankBranchId   = dlg.BankBranchId
    LEFT JOIN SystemClaimTypeMaster     ct  ON ct.ClaimTypeId     = dlg.ClaimTypeId
    LEFT JOIN SystemClaimSubTypeMaster  cst ON cst.ClaimSubTypeId = dlg.ClaimSubTypeId

    LEFT JOIN #cond01 cond ON cond.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId AND cond.MonthEndDate = eom.MonthEndDate
    LEFT JOIN #status_match01 status_match ON status_match.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId AND status_match.MonthEndDate = eom.MonthEndDate
    LEFT JOIN #s32_event01 s32_event ON s32_event.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId AND s32_event.MonthEndDate = eom.MonthEndDate

    LEFT JOIN #sc01 sc ON sc.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId

    WHERE 1=1
      -- PDF bankruptcy two-year boundary
      AND (eom.BankruptcyDate IS NULL OR eom.BankruptcyDate <= '1900-01-01'
           OR mo.CutOff <= DATEADD(YEAR, 2, eom.BankruptcyDate))
      -- END bankruptcy boundary
      -- Stop sending terminal/event statuses: report the event month only, exclude from following months.
      AND (eom.CloseDate IS NULL OR eom.CloseDate <= '1900-01-01' OR CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE) >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(eom.MonthEndDate), MONTH(eom.MonthEndDate), 1))                              -- 11 ปิดบัญชี
      AND (eom.BadDebtDate IS NULL OR eom.BadDebtDate <= '1900-01-01' OR eom.BadDebtDate >= @StartDate)                        -- 33 ตัดหนี้สูญ
      AND (COALESCE(cond.IsS42,0) = 0
           OR eom.StatusPortDate IS NULL OR eom.StatusPortDate <= '1900-01-01' OR eom.StatusPortDate >= @StartDate)             -- 42/43/44 ขายหนี้/โอนหนี้
      -- Calendar years from DFD, measured against recorded DPD.
      -- PDF five-year DPD boundary
      AND (eom.DerivedDPD IS NULL OR ((cond.ReportDFD IS NULL OR cond.ReportDFD <= '1900-01-01') AND eom.DerivedDPD <= 1917)
           OR CASE WHEN cond.IsTDRReset = 1
                  AND (eom.CloseDate IS NULL OR eom.CloseDate <= '1900-01-01' OR CAST(eom.CloseDate AS DATE) > mo.CutOff)
                  AND COALESCE(cond.IsS11, 0) + COALESCE(cond.IsS12, 0) + COALESCE(cond.IsS13, 0) + COALESCE(cond.IsS14, 0) + COALESCE(cond.IsS31, 0) + COALESCE(cond.IsS33, 0) + COALESCE(cond.IsS42, 0) = 0
                  AND COALESCE(status_match.AccountStatus, @S10) IN (@S10, @S20, @S21, @S30) THEN 0 ELSE eom.DerivedDPD END
                <= DATEDIFF(DAY, cond.ReportDFD, DATEADD(YEAR, 5, cond.ReportDFD)) + 90)
      -- END five-year boundary

    OPTION (RECOMPILE);

    -- Authorized partial reporting: exclude unavailable source rows; preserve PDF output columns.
    DELETE FROM #ncbresult01 WHERE ReportSourceIdentityValid=0;
    PRINT CONCAT('NCB 01 skipped rows (50005): ', @@ROWCOUNT);

    DELETE FROM #ncbresult01 WHERE card_id IS NULL;
    PRINT CONCAT('NCB 01 skipped rows (50006): ', @@ROWCOUNT);

    DELETE FROM #ncbresult01 WHERE past_due_days_2 IS NULL OR past_due_days_2<0 OR past_due_days IS NULL
                  OR (past_due_days_2>0 AND (default_date IS NULL OR default_date='19000101'));
    PRINT CONCAT('NCB 01 skipped rows (50008): ', @@ROWCOUNT);

    DECLARE @OwnReportTransaction bit=CASE WHEN @@TRANCOUNT=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
    BEGIN TRY
        IF @OwnReportTransaction=1 BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        ELSE SAVE TRANSACTION NCBReplace01;
    DELETE FROM ncb_internal.NCBCommercialCreditData
    WHERE Period = @Period
      AND (@LGNo  = 'null' OR account_number = @LGNo)
      AND (@CIFNo = 'null' OR customer_code  = @CIFNo);

    INSERT INTO ncb_internal.NCBCommercialCreditData
        (Period,
         customer_code, eff_date, card_id, customer_type, branch_code,
         account_number, purpose_loan1, purpose_loan2, account_open_date,
         maturity_date, account_close_date, payment_terms, credit_type,
         initial_amount_loan, currency_code, number_of_installments,
         payment_amount, last_payment_date, restructuring_date,
         code_of_restructuring, close_payment_amount, write_of_amount,
         account_status, default_date, delinquent_status, credit_limit_type,
         percent_payment, credit_card_type, past_due_days, past_due_days_2,
         past_due_amount, outstanding_amount, principal_balance, interest_balance,
         ownership_indicator, number_of_coborrower, unit_make, unit_model,
         status_lg, status_grade, claim_pay_date, bkr_filing_date,
         filing_amount, frozenassetdate, otherfrozenassdate, petition_date,
         bankruptcy_date, bad_debt_date, file_date_temp, black_case_no, withdraw_date,
         warrant_date, jm_trial_date, red_case_no, bank, branch,
         project, sub_project, open_date_old, PrintDate, PrintName, as_of_date, contract_number, last_contract_number, ReportDebtorRelateId, ReportDebtorId, ReportSourceIdentityValid, ReportSchemaVersion)
    SELECT @Period, customer_code, eff_date, card_id, customer_type, branch_code,
         account_number, purpose_loan1, purpose_loan2, account_open_date,
         maturity_date, account_close_date, payment_terms, credit_type,
         initial_amount_loan, currency_code, number_of_installments,
         payment_amount, last_payment_date, restructuring_date,
         code_of_restructuring, close_payment_amount, write_of_amount,
         account_status, default_date, delinquent_status, credit_limit_type,
         percent_payment, credit_card_type, past_due_days, past_due_days_2,
         past_due_amount, outstanding_amount, principal_balance, interest_balance,
         ownership_indicator, number_of_coborrower, unit_make, unit_model,
         status_lg, status_grade, claim_pay_date, bkr_filing_date,
         filing_amount, frozenassetdate, otherfrozenassdate, petition_date,
         bankruptcy_date, bad_debt_date, file_date_temp, black_case_no, withdraw_date,
         warrant_date, jm_trial_date, red_case_no, bank, branch,
         project, sub_project, open_date_old, PrintDate, PrintName, as_of_date, contract_number, last_contract_number, ReportDebtorRelateId, ReportDebtorId, ReportSourceIdentityValid, ReportSchemaVersion FROM #ncbresult01;
        DELETE FROM dbo.NCBReportBuildScope
        WHERE Period=@Period AND ReportName='Credit' AND CIFScope=@CIFNo AND LGScope=@LGNo;
        INSERT dbo.NCBReportBuildScope(Period,ReportName,CIFScope,LGScope,SchemaVersion,CompletedUtc)
        VALUES(@Period,'Credit',@CIFNo,@LGNo,3,SYSUTCDATETIME());
        IF @OwnReportTransaction=1 COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @OwnReportTransaction=1 AND XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        ELSE IF @OwnReportTransaction=0 AND XACT_STATE()=1 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION NCBReplace01;
        THROW;
    END CATCH;

END

modules.name: SP_RP_NCB_03_CommercialProfileData_Insert_Core
modules.definition:
CREATE   PROCEDURE [ncb_internal].[SP_RP_NCB_03_CommercialProfileData_Insert_Core]
@StartDate DATETIME = '2025-05-01',
@EndDate   DATETIME = '2025-05-31',
@CIFNo     NVARCHAR(50) = 'null',
@LGNo
NVARCHAR(50) = 'null'  AS  BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON;
SET @StartDate = CASE WHEN YEAR(@StartDate) > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @StartDate) ELSE @StartDate END;
SET @EndDate   = CASE WHEN YEAR(@EndDate)   > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @EndDate)   ELSE @EndDate   END;
    SET @CIFNo = ISNULL(@CIFNo, 'null');
    SET @LGNo = ISNULL(@LGNo, 'null');
IF @StartDate IS NULL OR @EndDate IS NULL OR @StartDate > @EndDate
   OR YEAR(@StartDate) <> YEAR(@EndDate) OR MONTH(@StartDate) <> MONTH(@EndDate)
    THROW 50001, 'NCB Profile Insert requires a valid range within one reporting month.', 1;
DECLARE @Period NVARCHAR(7) = CONVERT(char(7), @EndDate, 126);
  -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. Pre-filter qualifying DebtorRelateIds
--    Condition: DataDebtorCardId IS NOT NULL + PersonGroupId=118
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#qualifying03') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #qualifying03;
-- Credit Insert must run first for the identical scope. Use its accepted population.
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.NCBReportBuildScope
               WHERE Period=@Period AND ReportName='Credit' AND SchemaVersion=3
                 AND (CIFScope='null' OR CIFScope=@CIFNo)
                 AND (LGScope='null' OR LGScope=@LGNo))
    THROW 50003, 'Credit has not successfully built a covering v3 scope for this period.', 1;
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ncb_internal.NCBCommercialCreditData
           WHERE Period=@Period AND (@CIFNo='null' OR customer_code=@CIFNo)
             AND (@LGNo='null' OR account_number=@LGNo)
             AND (ISNULL(ReportSchemaVersion,0)<>3 OR ReportDebtorRelateId IS NULL))
    THROW 50002, 'Regenerate this Credit scope with the PDF v3 Insert before Profile.', 1;
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#credit03') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #credit03;
SELECT * INTO #credit03 FROM ncb_internal.NCBCommercialCreditData
WHERE Period=@Period AND (@CIFNo='null' OR customer_code=@CIFNo)
  AND (@LGNo='null' OR account_number=@LGNo)
OPTION (RECOMPILE);
CREATE INDEX IX_credit03_Relate ON #credit03 (ReportDebtorRelateId);
SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId
INTO #qualifying03
FROM DataDebtorRelate ddr
JOIN #credit03 c ON c.ReportDebtorRelateId=ddr.DebtorRelateId
WHERE ddr.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2);
  CREATE INDEX IX_qualifying03 ON #qualifying03 (DebtorRelateId);
  -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. DataDebtorRelate details
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ddr_info03') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ddr_info03;
SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId, ddr.LGNo, ddr.CIFNo, credit.ReportDebtorId AS DebtorId, ddr.DebtorCode
INTO #ddr_info03
FROM DataDebtorRelate ddr
JOIN #credit03 credit ON credit.ReportDebtorRelateId=ddr.DebtorRelateId
WHERE ddr.DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying03);
CREATE INDEX IX_ddr_info03 ON #ddr_info03 (DebtorRelateId);
  -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. DataDebtorCard TOP 1 per DebtorRelateId
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dc03') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dc03;
SELECT DebtorRelateId,
 DebtorCardCode, DebtorCardName, DebtBalance, DebtorRelateTypeId, DataDebtorCardId
INTO #dc03
FROM (
    SELECT c.DebtorRelateId,
     c.DebtorCardCode, c.DebtorCardName, c.DebtBalance, c.DebtorRelateTypeId, c.DataDebtorCardId,
     ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.DebtorRelateId ORDER BY c.CreateDate DESC) AS rn
    FROM DataDebtorCard c
    WHERE c.DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying03)
AND (c.IsDelete = 0 OR c.IsDelete IS NULL)
) x WHERE rn = 1;
CREATE INDEX IX_dc03 ON #dc03 (DebtorRelateId);
  -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4. DataDebtor TOP 1 per DebtorCode with PersonGroupId = 118
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dd03') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dd03;
SELECT di.DebtorRelateId,d.DebtorId,d.DebtorCode,d.IDCard,d.CardNumber,d.DebtorName,
       d.BirthDate,d.TitleId,d.CompanyNameEN,d.CompanyEngName,d.RegistrationDate
INTO #dd03
FROM #ddr_info03 di
JOIN DataDebtor d ON d.DebtorId=di.DebtorId;
CREATE INDEX IX_dd03 ON #dd03 (DebtorRelateId);
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #ddr_info03 di WHERE NOT EXISTS
           (SELECT 1 FROM #dd03 d WHERE d.DebtorRelateId=di.DebtorRelateId))
    PRINT 'NCB Profile: rows without a person master are excluded by the person join.';
  -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
-- 5. DataDebtorAddress TOP 1 per DebtorRelateId (UNION ALL approach)
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dda03') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dda03;
SELECT ddr2.DebtorRelateId,
 a.AddressNumber, a.PlaceName, a.ProvinceId, a.DistrictId, a.SubDistrictId, a.PostalCode,
 a.Moo, a.Soi, a.Road, a.DebtorAddressTypeId
INTO #dda03
FROM #ddr_info03 ddr2
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP 1
  a2.AddressNumber, a2.PlaceName, a2.ProvinceId, a2.DistrictId, a2.SubDistrictId, a2.PostalCode,
  a2.Moo, a2.Soi, a2.Road, a2.DebtorAddressTypeId
    FROM (
  -- Branch 1: match by DebtorId
  SELECT a3.AddressNumber, a3.PlaceName, a3.ProvinceId, a3.DistrictId, a3.SubDistrictId, a3.PostalCode,
   a3.Moo, a3.Soi, a3.Road, a3.DebtorAddressTypeId,
   a3.IsDefault, a3.CreateDate, a3.DebtorAddressId,
   0 AS src_priority
  FROM DataDebtorAddress a3
  WHERE a3.DebtorId = ddr2.DebtorId
  UNION ALL
  -- Branch 2: match by DebtorCode (exclude duplicates from branch 1)
  SELECT a3.AddressNumber, a3.PlaceName, a3.ProvinceId, a3.DistrictId, a3.SubDistrictId, a3.PostalCode,
   a3.Moo, a3.Soi, a3.Road, a3.DebtorAddressTypeId,
   a3.IsDefault, a3.CreateDate, a3.DebtorAddressId,
   1 AS src_priority
  FROM DataDebtorAddress a3
  WHERE a3.DebtorCode = ddr2.DebtorCode
    AND a3.DebtorId <> ddr2.DebtorId
    ) a2
    ORDER BY CASE WHEN a2.IsDefault = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
 a2.src_priority,
 a2.CreateDate DESC,
 a2.DebtorAddressId DESC
) a;
CREATE INDEX IX_dda03 ON #dda03 (DebtorRelateId);
  -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
-- 6. TEMPDWHCBS TOP 1 per LGNo+CIFNo
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dwh03') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dwh03;
SELECT ddr2.DebtorRelateId,
 d.idnumber, d.titlecode, d.titlename, d.titledescname, d.companythainame
INTO #dwh03
FROM #ddr_info03 ddr2
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP 1 d2.idnumber, d2.titlecode, d2.titlename, d2.titledescname, d2.companythainame
    FROM TEMPDWHCBS d2
    WHERE d2.accountnumber = ddr2.LGNo AND d2.customercode = ddr2.CIFNo
AND d2.ImportDate < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @EndDate)
    ORDER BY d2.ImportDate DESC
) d;
CREATE INDEX IX_dwh03 ON #dwh03 (DebtorRelateId);
  -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
-- 7. DataDebtorContact TOP 1 per DebtorId
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dcontact03') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dcontact03;
SELECT ddr2.DebtorRelateId,
 dc2.DebtorContactValue, dc2.DebtorContactTypeId
INTO #dcontact03
FROM #ddr_info03 ddr2
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP 1 c2.DebtorContactValue, c2.DebtorContactTypeId
    FROM DataDebtorContact c2
    -- Join via dd03 to get DebtorId from DebtorCode
    WHERE c2.DebtorId = ddr2.DebtorId
    ORDER BY CASE WHEN c2.IsDefault = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, c2.CreateDate DESC, c2.DebtorContactId DESC
) dc2;
CREATE INDEX IX_dcontact03 ON #dcontact03 (DebtorRelateId);
  -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
-- 8. NCBStopConditionMaster — pre-materialize blocked accounts
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#sc03') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #sc03;
SELECT DISTINCT ddr2.DebtorRelateId
INTO #sc03
FROM #ddr_info03 ddr2
JOIN NCBStopConditionMaster sc ON (sc.CIFNo = ddr2.CIFNo OR sc.LGNo = ddr2.LGNo) AND sc.IsActive = 1;
CREATE INDEX IX_sc03 ON #sc03 (DebtorRelateId);
  -- ----------------------------------------------------------------
-- 9. Main SELECT
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------
SELECT
    credit.customer_code AS customer_code,
    credit.eff_date AS eff_date,
    credit.card_id AS card_id,
    '1' AS customer_type,
    CASE WHEN title.TitleName IN (N'บจก.',N'บริษัทจำกัด',N'บริษัท จำกัด') THEN '1140001'
         WHEN title.TitleName IN (N'หจก.',N'ห้างหุ้นส่วนจำกัด',N'ห้างหุ้นส่วน จำกัด') THEN '1140002'
         WHEN title.TitleName IN (N'หสน.',N'ห้างหุ้นส่วนสามัญนิติบุคคล') THEN '1140003'
         WHEN title.TitleName IN (N'บมจ.',N'บริษัทมหาชนจำกัด',N'บริษัทมหาชน จำกัด') THEN '1140004'
         WHEN title.TitleName IN (N'หสม.',N'กิจการร่วมค้า',N'โรงเรียน',N'มหาวิทยาลัย') THEN '1140005'
         WHEN title.TitleCode IN ('004','005','006','007','010','067','077','085','143','155','159','164','232','257','260','261') THEN NULL
         ELSE NULL END AS registration_type,
    title.TitleNameEn AS english_prefix,
    title.TitleName AS thai_prefix,
    dd.CompanyNameEN AS company_english_name,
    dd.DebtorName AS company_thai_name,
    NULL AS old_company_name,
    NULL AS english_first_name,
    NULL AS thai_first_name,
    NULL AS english_middle_name,
    NULL AS thai_middle_name,
    NULL AS english_last_name,
    NULL AS thai_last_name,
    CASE WHEN dd.RegistrationDate IS NOT NULL AND dd.RegistrationDate > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.[Fn_NCBDate_CE](dd.RegistrationDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS registration_date,
    NULL AS nationality,
    NULL AS purpose_of_business1,
    NULL AS purpose_of_business2,
    NULL AS purpose_of_business3,
    '1150001' AS id_type,
    credit.card_id AS id_number,
    '1010003' AS address_type,
    CONCAT_WS(' ', NULLIF(dda.AddressNumber, ''), NULLIF(dda.PlaceName, ''),
        CASE WHEN NULLIF(CAST(dda.Moo AS NVARCHAR(50)), '') IS NOT NULL
             THEN N'ม.' + CAST(dda.Moo AS NVARCHAR(50)) END,
        CASE WHEN NULLIF(dda.Soi, '') IS NOT NULL THEN N'ซ.' + dda.Soi END,
        CASE WHEN NULLIF(dda.Road, '') IS NOT NULL THEN N'ถ.' + dda.Road END) AS address1,
    NULL AS address2,
    sub_dist.Name AS sub_district,
    dist.Name AS district,
    prov.CatalogId AS province_code,
    prov.Name AS province,
    dda.PostalCode AS post_code,
    '' AS write_of_amount,
    '' AS past_due_amount,
    '' AS unit_make,
    NULL AS unit_model,
    credit.ownership_indicator AS ownership_indicator,
    dcontact.DebtorContactValue AS telephone,
    dcontact.DebtorContactTypeId AS telephone_type,
    credit.status_lg AS [Status LG],
    credit.status_grade AS [Status Grade],
    dlg.Grade AS status,
    CASE WHEN dlg.LGDate IS NOT NULL AND dlg.LGDate > '1900-01-01' THEN dbo.[Fn_NCBDate_CE](dlg.LGDate) ELSE '19000101' END AS status_update_date,
    N'วันที่พิมพ์ : ' + dbo.Fn_FormatPrintDate(GETDATE()) AS PrintDate,
    N'ผู้สั่งพิมพ์ : ' + NULL AS PrintName,
    credit.account_number AS account_number,
    CAST(3 AS tinyint) AS ReportSchemaVersion
INTO #ncbresult03
FROM #qualifying03 q
JOIN DataDebtorRelate ddr ON ddr.DebtorRelateId = q.DebtorRelateId
JOIN DataLG dlg ON dlg.LGNo = ddr.LGNo
JOIN #credit03 credit ON credit.ReportDebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
  -- Reuse the resolved PersonGroupId=118 master instead of rejoining all versions.
JOIN #dd03 dd ON dd.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
  LEFT JOIN #dc03  dc  ON dc.DebtorRelateId  = ddr.DebtorRelateId
LEFT JOIN #dda03 dda ON dda.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
LEFT JOIN #dwh03 dwh ON dwh.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
LEFT JOIN #dcontact03 dcontact ON dcontact.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
  LEFT JOIN SystemProvinceMaster
prov ON prov.ProvinceId
  = dda.ProvinceId
LEFT JOIN SystemDistrictMaster
dist ON dist.DistrictId
  = dda.DistrictId
LEFT JOIN SystemSubDistrictMaster sub_dist ON sub_dist.SubDistrictId = dda.SubDistrictId
LEFT JOIN SystemTitleMaster
  title ON title.TitleId
     = dd.TitleId
LEFT JOIN SystemDebtorAddressTypeMaster att ON att.DebtorAddressTypeId = dda.DebtorAddressTypeId
  -- [CHANGED] pre-materialized #sc03 replaces LEFT JOIN NCBStopConditionMaster + WHERE IS NULL
LEFT JOIN #sc03 sc ON sc.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
OPTION (RECOMPILE);

DELETE FROM #ncbresult03 WHERE registration_type IS NULL;
    PRINT CONCAT('NCB 03 skipped rows (50010): ', @@ROWCOUNT);

-- Replace only the selected scope; preserve an enclosing caller transaction.
DECLARE @OwnTransaction BIT = CASE WHEN @@TRANCOUNT = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
BEGIN TRY
    IF @OwnTransaction = 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION;
    ELSE SAVE TRANSACTION NCBProfileReplace;
    DELETE FROM ncb_internal.NCBCommercialProfileData
    WHERE Period = @Period
      AND (@CIFNo = 'null' OR customer_code = @CIFNo)
      AND (@LGNo = 'null' OR account_number = @LGNo);

    INSERT INTO ncb_internal.NCBCommercialProfileData
        (Period, customer_code, eff_date, card_id, customer_type, registration_type, english_prefix, thai_prefix, company_english_name, company_thai_name, old_company_name, english_first_name, thai_first_name, english_middle_name, thai_middle_name, english_last_name, thai_last_name, registration_date, nationality, purpose_of_business1, purpose_of_business2, purpose_of_business3, id_type, id_number, address_type, address1, address2, sub_district, district, province_code, province, post_code, write_of_amount, past_due_amount, unit_make, unit_model, ownership_indicator, telephone, telephone_type, [Status LG], [Status Grade], status, status_update_date, PrintDate, PrintName, account_number, ReportSchemaVersion)
    SELECT @Period, customer_code, eff_date, card_id, customer_type, registration_type, english_prefix, thai_prefix, company_english_name, company_thai_name, old_company_name, english_first_name, thai_first_name, english_middle_name, thai_middle_name, english_last_name, thai_last_name, registration_date, nationality, purpose_of_business1, purpose_of_business2, purpose_of_business3, id_type, id_number, address_type, address1, address2, sub_district, district, province_code, province, post_code, write_of_amount, past_due_amount, unit_make, unit_model, ownership_indicator, telephone, telephone_type, [Status LG], [Status Grade], status, status_update_date, PrintDate, PrintName, account_number, ReportSchemaVersion FROM #ncbresult03;

    IF @OwnTransaction = 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION;
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
    IF @OwnTransaction = 1 AND XACT_STATE() <> 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
    ELSE IF @OwnTransaction = 0 AND XACT_STATE() = 1 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION NCBProfileReplace;
    THROW;
END CATCH;
END

modules.name: SP_RP_NCB_05_ConsumerDataField_Insert_Core
modules.definition:
CREATE   PROCEDURE [ncb_internal].[SP_RP_NCB_05_ConsumerDataField_Insert_Core]
    @StartDate DATETIME = '2025-09-01',
    @EndDate   DATETIME = '2025-09-30',
    @CIFNo  NVARCHAR(50) = 'null',
    @LGNo   NVARCHAR(20) = 'null'
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET @StartDate = CASE WHEN YEAR(@StartDate) > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @StartDate) ELSE @StartDate END;
    SET @EndDate   = CASE WHEN YEAR(@EndDate)   > 2400 THEN DATEADD(YEAR, -543, @EndDate)   ELSE @EndDate   END;
    SET @CIFNo     = ISNULL(@CIFNo, 'null');
    SET @LGNo      = ISNULL(@LGNo, 'null');
    -- Staging uses one Period for every inserted row; reject mixed-month calls.
    IF @StartDate IS NULL OR @EndDate IS NULL OR @StartDate > @EndDate
       OR YEAR(@StartDate) <> YEAR(@EndDate) OR MONTH(@StartDate) <> MONTH(@EndDate)
        THROW 50001, 'NCB report requires a valid date range within one reporting month.', 1;
    DECLARE @Period NVARCHAR(7) = CONVERT(char(7), @EndDate, 126);

    -- Pre-load NCB dynamic conditions once (PersonType=1 Consumer)
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#NCBCond05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #NCBCond05;
    SELECT nm.NCBStatusCode, CAST(nm.CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(20)) AS CatalogId, sp.ColumnName, sl.KeyName AS Operator,
           CASE WHEN nm.NCBStatusCode = 12 AND sp.ColumnName = 'MeasureName' AND ne.ValueConditionExcute = 'มาตรการ%'
                THEN '%พัก%หนี้%'
                ELSE ne.ValueConditionExcute END AS ValueConditionExcute
    INTO #NCBCond05
    FROM NCBStatusExcuteMaster ne
    JOIN NCBStatusMaster nm        ON nm.NCBStatusId  = ne.NCBStatusId AND nm.PersonType = 1 AND nm.IsActive = 1
    JOIN SystemParameterMaster sp  ON sp.ParameterId  = ne.ParameterId
    LEFT JOIN SystemLookupMaster sl ON sl.LookupId    = ne.OparatorId;

    DECLARE @S11_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond05 WHERE NCBStatusCode=11),1,0);
    DECLARE @S12_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond05 WHERE NCBStatusCode=12),1,0);
    DECLARE @S13_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond05 WHERE NCBStatusCode=13),1,0);
    DECLARE @S14_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond05 WHERE NCBStatusCode=14),1,0);
    DECLARE @S20_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond05 WHERE NCBStatusCode=20),1,0);
    DECLARE @S21_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond05 WHERE NCBStatusCode=21),1,0);
    DECLARE @S30_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond05 WHERE NCBStatusCode=30),1,0);
    DECLARE @S31_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond05 WHERE NCBStatusCode=31),1,0);
    DECLARE @S32_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond05 WHERE NCBStatusCode=32),1,0);
    DECLARE @S33_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond05 WHERE NCBStatusCode=33),1,0);
    DECLARE @S42_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond05 WHERE NCBStatusCode=42),1,0);
    DECLARE @S43_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond05 WHERE NCBStatusCode=43),1,0);
    DECLARE @S44_HasCond BIT = IIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #NCBCond05 WHERE NCBStatusCode=44),1,0);

    -- Load account status codes from NCBStatusMaster (PersonType=1 = Consumer)
    DECLARE @S10  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 10 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S11  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 11 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S12  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 12 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S20  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 20 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S30  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 30 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S31  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 31 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S33  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 33 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S13  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 13 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S14  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 14 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S21  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 21 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S42  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 42 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S43  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 43 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);
    DECLARE @S44  NVARCHAR(10) = (SELECT CAST(CatalogId AS NVARCHAR(10)) FROM NCBStatusMaster WHERE NCBStatusCode = 44 AND PersonType = 1 AND IsActive = 1);

    -- Dynamic DPD mapping from website configuration.
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dpd_rule05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dpd_rule05;
    SELECT
        dm.DPDId,
        dm.DPDCode,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(dm.CatalogCode, ''), dm.DPDCode) AS DPDOutputCode,
        MAX(CASE WHEN sl.KeyName = 'Equal' OR sl.LookUpValue = '=' OR de.OparatorId = 5
                 THEN TRY_CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(de.ValueConditionExcute, N' วัน', N'')) END) AS ExactValue,
        MAX(CASE WHEN sl.KeyName = 'LessThanEqual' OR sl.LookUpValue = '>=' OR de.OparatorId = 3
                 THEN TRY_CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(de.ValueConditionExcute, N' วัน', N'')) END) AS MinInclusive,
        MAX(CASE WHEN sl.KeyName = 'MoreThanEqual' OR sl.LookUpValue = '<=' OR de.OparatorId = 4
                 THEN TRY_CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(de.ValueConditionExcute, N' วัน', N'')) END) AS MaxInclusive,
        MAX(CASE WHEN sl.KeyName = 'MoreThan' OR sl.LookUpValue = '>' OR de.OparatorId = 1
                 THEN TRY_CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(de.ValueConditionExcute, N' วัน', N'')) END) AS MinExclusive,
        MAX(CASE WHEN sl.KeyName = 'LessThan' OR sl.LookUpValue = '<' OR de.OparatorId = 2
                 THEN TRY_CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(de.ValueConditionExcute, N' วัน', N'')) END) AS MaxExclusive
    INTO #dpd_rule05
    FROM NCBDPDMaster dm
    LEFT JOIN NCBDPDExcuteMaster de ON de.DPDId = dm.DPDId
    LEFT JOIN SystemLookupMaster sl ON sl.LookupId = de.OparatorId
    WHERE dm.PersonType = 1
      AND dm.IsActive = 1
    GROUP BY dm.DPDId, dm.DPDCode, COALESCE(NULLIF(dm.CatalogCode, ''), dm.DPDCode);

    DECLARE @D0 NVARCHAR(10) = (
        SELECT TOP 1 DPDOutputCode
        FROM #dpd_rule05
        WHERE (ExactValue   IS NULL OR 0 =  ExactValue)
          AND (MinInclusive IS NULL OR 0 >= MinInclusive)
          AND (MaxInclusive IS NULL OR 0 <= MaxInclusive)
          AND (MinExclusive IS NULL OR 0 >  MinExclusive)
          AND (MaxExclusive IS NULL OR 0 <  MaxExclusive)
        ORDER BY
            CASE WHEN ExactValue IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
            ISNULL(MinInclusive, MinExclusive + 1) DESC,
            ISNULL(MaxInclusive, MaxExclusive - 1) ASC,
            DPDCode
    );
    DECLARE @DF NVARCHAR(10) = (
        SELECT TOP 1 DPDOutputCode
        FROM #dpd_rule05
        WHERE (ExactValue   IS NULL OR 100000 =  ExactValue)
          AND (MinInclusive IS NULL OR 100000 >= MinInclusive)
          AND (MaxInclusive IS NULL OR 100000 <= MaxInclusive)
          AND (MinExclusive IS NULL OR 100000 >  MinExclusive)
          AND (MaxExclusive IS NULL OR 100000 <  MaxExclusive)
        ORDER BY
            CASE WHEN ExactValue IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
            ISNULL(MinInclusive, MinExclusive + 1) DESC,
            ISNULL(MaxInclusive, MaxExclusive - 1) ASC,
            DPDCode
    );

    -- Dynamic TDR restructuring code from website configuration.
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tdr_rule05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tdr_rule05;
    SELECT
        rc.RestructureCodeId,
        rc.RestructureCode,
        rc.Oparators,
        re.Seq,
        sp.ColumnName,
        sl.KeyName AS Operator,
        re.ValueConditionExcute
    INTO #tdr_rule05
    FROM SystemTDRRestructureCode rc
    LEFT JOIN SystemRestructureExcuteMaster re ON re.RestructureCodeId = rc.RestructureCodeId
    LEFT JOIN SystemParameterMaster sp ON sp.ParameterId = re.ParameterId
    LEFT JOIN SystemLookupMaster sl ON sl.LookupId = re.OparatorId
    WHERE rc.IsActive = 1;

    DECLARE @TDRDefaultCode05 NVARCHAR(10) = (
        SELECT TOP 1 RestructureCode
        FROM SystemTDRRestructureCode
        WHERE IsActive = 1
        ORDER BY CASE WHEN RestructureCode = '00' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, RestructureCode
    );

    -- ── STEP 1: qualifying DebtorRelateIds ───────────────────────────────────
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#qualifying05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #qualifying05;
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId
    INTO #qualifying05
    FROM DataDebtorRelate ddr
    JOIN dbo.DataEndOfDay e ON e.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    WHERE (@CIFNo = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM DataDebtorRelate WHERE CIFNo=@CIFNo))
      AND (@LGNo  = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo  = @LGNo)
      AND e.AsOfDate BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
      AND (e.IsDelete = 0 OR e.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND ddr.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
      AND (ddr.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr.IsDelete IS NULL)

    UNION

    -- LG cancelled case: no DataDebtorCard, StatusDate in range
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId
    FROM DataDebtorRelate ddr
    JOIN DataLG dlg ON dlg.LGNo = ddr.LGNo
    WHERE dlg.StatusDate BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM DataDebtorCard dc2
          WHERE dc2.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
            AND (dc2.IsDelete = 0 OR dc2.IsDelete IS NULL)
      )
      AND ddr.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
      AND (ddr.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (@CIFNo = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM DataDebtorRelate WHERE CIFNo=@CIFNo))
      AND (@LGNo  = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo  = @LGNo)

    UNION

    -- TDR case: TDR approved up to @EndDate (catches active TDR without EOD in month, e.g. LG 5923243)
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId
    FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractRelated rtdr
    JOIN TDRDataCompromiseContract cc ON cc.CompromiseContractId = rtdr.CompromiseContractId
    JOIN DataDebtorRelate ddr ON ddr.LGNo = rtdr.LGNo
    WHERE cc.ApproveDate <= @EndDate
      AND ddr.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
      AND (ddr.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (@CIFNo = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM DataDebtorRelate WHERE CIFNo=@CIFNo))
      AND (@LGNo  = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo  = @LGNo)

    UNION

    -- Closed account case: include closure events in the requested month only
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId
    FROM DataDebtorRelate ddr
    JOIN DataDebtorCard dc ON dc.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    WHERE CAST(dc.CloseDate AS DATE) <= CAST(@EndDate AS DATE)
      AND CAST(dc.CloseDate AS DATE) >= CAST(@StartDate AS DATE)
      AND (dc.DebtBalance = 0 OR dc.PrincipalTotal = 0)
      AND (dc.IsDelete = 0 OR dc.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND ddr.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
      AND (ddr.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (@CIFNo = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM DataDebtorRelate WHERE CIFNo=@CIFNo))
      AND (@LGNo  = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo  = @LGNo)

    UNION

    -- Closed account case: co-borrowers/guarantors inheriting from primary debtor
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId
    FROM DataDebtorRelate ddr
    JOIN DataDebtorRelate ddr_p ON ddr_p.LGNo = ddr.LGNo AND ddr_p.DebtorTypeId = 1 AND (ddr_p.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr_p.IsDelete IS NULL)
    JOIN DataDebtorCard dc_p ON dc_p.DebtorRelateId = ddr_p.DebtorRelateId
    WHERE CAST(dc_p.CloseDate AS DATE) <= CAST(@EndDate AS DATE)
      AND CAST(dc_p.CloseDate AS DATE) >= CAST(@StartDate AS DATE)
      AND (dc_p.DebtBalance = 0 OR dc_p.PrincipalTotal = 0)
      AND (dc_p.IsDelete = 0 OR dc_p.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND ddr.DebtorTypeId = 2
      AND (ddr.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (@CIFNo = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM DataDebtorRelate WHERE CIFNo=@CIFNo))
      AND (@LGNo  = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo  = @LGNo)

    UNION

    -- Accounts with active card balance:
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId
    FROM DataDebtorRelate ddr
    JOIN DataDebtorCard dc ON dc.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    WHERE (dc.IsDelete = 0 OR dc.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (ISNULL(dc.DebtBalance, 0) > 0 OR ISNULL(dc.PrincipalTotal, 0) > 0)
      AND ddr.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
      AND (ddr.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (@CIFNo = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM DataDebtorRelate WHERE CIFNo=@CIFNo))
      AND (@LGNo  = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo  = @LGNo)

    UNION

    -- Accounts with litigation:
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr.DebtorRelateId
    FROM DataDebtorRelate ddr
    JOIN LTDataCaseMainDebtor lt ON lt.DebtorRelateId = ddr.DebtorRelateId
    WHERE (lt.IsCancel = 0 OR lt.IsCancel IS NULL)
      AND lt.FilingDate <= @EndDate
      AND ddr.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
      AND (ddr.IsDelete = 0 OR ddr.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND (@CIFNo = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM DataDebtorRelate WHERE CIFNo=@CIFNo))
      AND (@LGNo  = 'null' OR ddr.LGNo  = @LGNo)
    OPTION (RECOMPILE);

    CREATE INDEX IX_qualifying05 ON #qualifying05 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ── STEP 2: DataDebtorRelate details ─────────────────────────────────────
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ddr_info05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ddr_info05;
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr3.DebtorRelateId, ddr3.LGNo, ddr3.CIFNo, ddr3.DebtorId, ddr3.DebtorCode, ddr3.DebtorTypeId, ddr3.CreateDate
    INTO #ddr_info05
    FROM DataDebtorRelate ddr3
    WHERE ddr3.DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying05);
    CREATE INDEX IX_ddr_info05 ON #ddr_info05 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ── STEP 2b: DataDebtor per DebtorRelateId (PersonGroupId = 117) ───────
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dd05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dd05;
    SELECT di.DebtorRelateId, resolved.DebtorId, resolved.DebtorCode,
           resolved.IDCard, resolved.CardNumber, resolved.TitleId,
           resolved.DebtorCodeType AS SourceIdType, resolved.FirstName,
           resolved.LastName, resolved.BirthDate
    INTO #dd05
    FROM #ddr_info05 di
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) d.DebtorId,d.DebtorCode,d.PersonGroupId,
            CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.IDCard)),'') IS NOT NULL
                       AND d.IDCard NOT LIKE N'%ไม่พบ%' AND d.IDCard NOT LIKE N'%ไมพบ%'
                 THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(d.IDCard)) END AS IDCard,
            d.CardNumber,d.TitleId,d.DebtorCodeType,d.FirstName,d.LastName,d.BirthDate
        FROM DataDebtor d
        WHERE (d.DebtorId=di.DebtorId OR d.DebtorCode=di.DebtorCode)
        ORDER BY CASE WHEN d.DebtorId=di.DebtorId THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                 d.CreateDate DESC,d.DebtorId DESC
    ) resolved
    WHERE resolved.PersonGroupId=117;

    CREATE INDEX IX_dd05 ON #dd05 (DebtorRelateId);
    DELETE q FROM #qualifying05 q WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #dd05 d WHERE d.DebtorRelateId=q.DebtorRelateId);
    DELETE FROM #ddr_info05 WHERE DebtorRelateId NOT IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying05);
    UPDATE di SET DebtorId=d.DebtorId FROM #ddr_info05 di JOIN #dd05 d ON d.DebtorRelateId=di.DebtorRelateId;

    -- PDF p14: one row per LG and identity; prefer the main role when duplicated
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#qualifying05_dedup') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #qualifying05_dedup;
    SELECT DebtorRelateId
    INTO #qualifying05_dedup
    FROM (
        SELECT
            di.DebtorRelateId,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY di.LGNo,
                             COALESCE(dd.IDCard, di.DebtorRelateId)
                ORDER BY CASE WHEN di.DebtorTypeId = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                         ISNULL(di.CreateDate, '1900-01-01') DESC, di.DebtorRelateId DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM #ddr_info05 di
        LEFT JOIN #dd05 dd ON dd.DebtorRelateId = di.DebtorRelateId
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1;

    DELETE FROM #qualifying05 WHERE DebtorRelateId NOT IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying05_dedup);
    DELETE FROM #ddr_info05 WHERE DebtorRelateId NOT IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying05_dedup);

    DELETE q FROM #qualifying05 q JOIN DataDebtorRelate r ON r.DebtorRelateId=q.DebtorRelateId
    WHERE @CIFNo<>'null' AND (r.CIFNo<>@CIFNo OR r.CIFNo IS NULL);
    DELETE FROM #ddr_info05 WHERE DebtorRelateId NOT IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying05);

    -- NCB Deep Detail: borrower count is LG-wide and identity-based.
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#borrower_count05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #borrower_count05;
    ;WITH BorrowerIdentity AS (
        SELECT LGNo, DebtorRelateId, IdentityNo
        FROM (
            SELECT r.LGNo, r.DebtorRelateId,
                   CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.IDCard)), '') IS NOT NULL
                             AND d.IDCard NOT LIKE N'%ไม่พบ%' AND d.IDCard NOT LIKE N'%ไมพบ%'
                        THEN LTRIM(RTRIM(d.IDCard))
 ELSE NULL END AS IdentityNo,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                       PARTITION BY r.DebtorRelateId
                       ORDER BY CASE WHEN d.DebtorId = r.DebtorId THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                                d.CreateDate DESC, d.DebtorId DESC
                   ) AS rn
            FROM DataDebtorRelate r
            -- Disjoint equality branches preserve the original OR match set.
            -- Exclude an ID match from the code branch so it appears exactly once.
            LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT br.DebtorRelateId AS MatchRelateId,
                       person.DebtorId, person.IDCard, person.CreateDate
                FROM DataDebtorRelate br
                JOIN DataDebtor person ON person.DebtorId = br.DebtorId
                WHERE br.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
                  AND (br.IsDelete = 0 OR br.IsDelete IS NULL)
                  AND br.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM #ddr_info05)
                UNION ALL
                SELECT br.DebtorRelateId AS MatchRelateId,
                       person.DebtorId, person.IDCard, person.CreateDate
                FROM DataDebtorRelate br
                JOIN DataDebtor person ON person.DebtorCode = br.DebtorCode
                WHERE br.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
                  AND (br.IsDelete = 0 OR br.IsDelete IS NULL)
                  AND br.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM #ddr_info05)
                  AND (br.DebtorId IS NULL OR person.DebtorId IS NULL
                       OR person.DebtorId <> br.DebtorId)
            ) d ON d.MatchRelateId = r.DebtorRelateId
            WHERE r.DebtorTypeId IN (1, 2)
              AND (r.IsDelete = 0 OR r.IsDelete IS NULL)
              AND r.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM #ddr_info05)
        ) ranked
        WHERE rn = 1
    )
    SELECT LGNo,
           CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN IdentityNo IS NULL OR IdentityNo LIKE N'%ไม่พบ%'
                                   OR IdentityNo LIKE N'%ไมพบ%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
                THEN COUNT(DISTINCT IdentityNo) ELSE NULL END AS BorrowerCount
    INTO #borrower_count05
    FROM BorrowerIdentity
    GROUP BY LGNo;
    CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IX_borrower_count05 ON #borrower_count05 (LGNo);

    -- ── STEP 3: Monthly snapshot (last AsOfDate per account per month) ────────
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#monthly05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #monthly05;
    SELECT
        e.DebtorRelateId,
        YEAR(e.AsOfDate)  AS yr,
        MONTH(e.AsOfDate) AS mn,
        MAX(e.AsOfDate)   AS MonthEndDate
    INTO #monthly05
    FROM dbo.DataEndOfDay e
    WHERE e.DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying05)
      AND (e.IsDelete = 0 OR e.IsDelete IS NULL)
      AND e.AsOfDate BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
    GROUP BY e.DebtorRelateId, YEAR(e.AsOfDate), MONTH(e.AsOfDate);

    -- Fallback for qualifying accounts missing in DataEndOfDay
    INSERT INTO #monthly05 (DebtorRelateId, yr, mn, MonthEndDate)
    SELECT q.DebtorRelateId, YEAR(@EndDate), MONTH(@EndDate), @EndDate
    FROM #qualifying05 q
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #monthly05 m WHERE m.DebtorRelateId = q.DebtorRelateId);

    CREATE INDEX IX_monthly05 ON #monthly05 (DebtorRelateId, MonthEndDate);

    -- ── STEP 4: DataDebtorStatusUpdate TOP 1 per DebtorRelateId/report month ─
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ssu05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ssu05;
    SELECT
m.DebtorRelateId,
        m.MonthEndDate,
        ssu.StatusLegalId,
        ssu.StatusDebtorId,
        ssu.StatusPortId,
        ssu.StatusPortDate,
        ssu.UpdateDate
    INTO #ssu05
    FROM #monthly05 m
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1)
            s.StatusLegalId,
            s.StatusDebtorId,
            s.StatusPortId,
            s.StatusPortDate,
            s.UpdateDate
        FROM DataDebtorStatusUpdate s
        WHERE s.DebtorRelateId = m.DebtorRelateId
          AND s.UpdateDate < DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(m.MonthEndDate), MONTH(m.MonthEndDate), 1))
        ORDER BY s.UpdateDate DESC
    ) ssu;
    CREATE INDEX IX_ssu05 ON #ssu05 (DebtorRelateId, MonthEndDate);

    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#s32_event05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #s32_event05;
    ;WITH S32Ids AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT TRY_CAST(v.value AS INT) AS StatusLegalId
        FROM #NCBCond05 c
        CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(REPLACE(c.ValueConditionExcute, N' ', N''), ',') v
        WHERE c.NCBStatusCode = 32
          AND c.ColumnName = 'StatusLegalId'
          AND TRY_CAST(v.value AS INT) IS NOT NULL
    )
    SELECT
        m.DebtorRelateId,
        m.MonthEndDate,
        MIN(s.UpdateDate) AS S32EventDate
    INTO #s32_event05
    FROM #monthly05 m
    JOIN DataDebtorStatusUpdate s
        ON s.DebtorRelateId = m.DebtorRelateId
       AND s.UpdateDate < DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(m.MonthEndDate), MONTH(m.MonthEndDate), 1))
    JOIN S32Ids ids
        ON ids.StatusLegalId = s.StatusLegalId
    GROUP BY m.DebtorRelateId, m.MonthEndDate;
    CREATE INDEX IX_s32_event05 ON #s32_event05 (DebtorRelateId, MonthEndDate);

    -- ── STEP 5: LTDataCaseMainDebtor TOP 1 per DebtorRelateId ────────────────
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#lt05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #lt05;
    SELECT DebtorRelateId, FilingDate, RedCaseNo, BlackCaseNo, JmTrialDate, WarrantDate,
           WithdrawDate, BankFilingDate, FilingAmount, DocumentDate, JudgmentBankruptcyDate,
           FrozenAssetDate, OtherFrozenAssDate, PetitionDate, BankruptcyDate
    INTO #lt05
    FROM (
        SELECT DebtorRelateId, FilingDate, RedCaseNo, BlackCaseNo, JmTrialDate, WarrantDate,
               WithdrawDate, BankFilingDate, FilingAmount, DocumentDate, JudgmentBankruptcyDate,
               FrozenAssetDate, OtherFrozenAssDate, PetitionDate, BankruptcyDate,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DebtorRelateId ORDER BY CreateDate DESC) AS rn
        FROM LTDataCaseMainDebtor
        WHERE DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying05)
          AND (IsCancel = 0 OR IsCancel IS NULL)
    ) x WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_lt05 ON #lt05 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ── STEP 6: TEMPDWHCBS TOP 1 per LGNo+CIFNo ──────────────────────────────
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dwh05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dwh05;
    SELECT ddr2.DebtorRelateId,
           d.idnumber, d.firstname, d.familyname, d.dateofbirth
    INTO #dwh05
    FROM #ddr_info05 ddr2
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1 d2.idnumber, d2.firstname, d2.familyname, d2.dateofbirth
        FROM TEMPDWHCBS d2
        WHERE d2.accountnumber = ddr2.LGNo AND d2.customercode = ddr2.CIFNo
          AND d2.ImportDate < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @EndDate)
        ORDER BY d2.ImportDate DESC
    ) d;
    CREATE INDEX IX_dwh05 ON #dwh05 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ── STEP 7: DataDebtorAddress TOP 1 per DebtorRelateId ───────────────────
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dda05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dda05;
    SELECT ddr2.DebtorRelateId,
           a.AddressNumber, a.PlaceName, a.Soi, a.Road, a.ProvinceId, a.DistrictId, a.SubDistrictId, a.PostalCode
    INTO #dda05
    FROM #ddr_info05 ddr2
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP 1
            a2.AddressNumber, a2.PlaceName, a2.Soi, a2.Road, a2.ProvinceId, a2.DistrictId, a2.SubDistrictId, a2.PostalCode
        FROM (
            SELECT a3.AddressNumber, a3.PlaceName, a3.Soi, a3.Road, a3.ProvinceId, a3.DistrictId, a3.SubDistrictId, a3.PostalCode,
                   a3.IsDefault, a3.CreateDate, a3.DebtorAddressId,
                   0 AS src_priority
            FROM DataDebtorAddress a3
            WHERE a3.DebtorId = ddr2.DebtorId
            UNION ALL
            SELECT a3.AddressNumber, a3.PlaceName, a3.Soi, a3.Road, a3.ProvinceId, a3.DistrictId, a3.SubDistrictId, a3.PostalCode,
                   a3.IsDefault, a3.CreateDate, a3.DebtorAddressId,
                   1 AS src_priority
            FROM DataDebtorAddress a3
            WHERE a3.DebtorCode = ddr2.DebtorCode
              AND a3.DebtorId <> ddr2.DebtorId
        ) a2
        ORDER BY CASE WHEN a2.IsDefault = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                 CASE WHEN a2.ProvinceId IS NOT NULL OR a2.DistrictId IS NOT NULL OR a2.SubDistrictId IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                 a2.src_priority,
                 a2.CreateDate DESC,
                 a2.DebtorAddressId DESC
    ) a;
    CREATE INDEX IX_dda05 ON #dda05 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ── STEP 8: DataDebtorCard fallback per DebtorRelateId ───────────────────
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#dc05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #dc05;
    SELECT *
    INTO #dc05
    FROM (
        SELECT
            dc2.DebtorRelateId,
            dc2.DataDebtorCardId,
            dc2.CurrentPaymentDate,
            dc2.CloseDate,
            dc2.PrincipalTotal,
            dc2.DebtBalance,
            dc2.AccruedInterestTotal,
            dc2.ClaimPayDate,
            dc2.DFDDate,
            dc2.DPD,
            dc2.IsTDR,
            dc2.InstallmentsAmount,
            dc2.InstallmentPrincipal,
            dc2.DebtAmount,
            dc2.CompromiseContracApproveDate,
            dc2.SystemBankId,
            dc2.BadDebtDate,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dc2.DebtorRelateId ORDER BY dc2.CreateDate DESC, dc2.DataDebtorCardId DESC) AS rn
        FROM DataDebtorCard dc2
        WHERE dc2.DebtorRelateId IN (SELECT DebtorRelateId FROM #qualifying05)
          AND (dc2.IsDelete = 0 OR dc2.IsDelete IS NULL)
    ) x WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_dc05 ON #dc05 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ── STEP 9: NCBStopConditionMaster ───────────────────────────────────────
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#sc05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #sc05;
    SELECT DISTINCT ddr2.DebtorRelateId
    INTO #sc05
    FROM #ddr_info05 ddr2
    JOIN NCBStopConditionMaster sc ON (sc.CIFNo = ddr2.CIFNo OR sc.LGNo = ddr2.LGNo) AND sc.IsActive = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_sc05 ON #sc05 (DebtorRelateId);

    -- ── STEP 11a: TDR Latest Contract per LGNo and MonthEndDate ─────────────
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tdr_latest05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tdr_latest05;
    SELECT LGNo, MonthEndDate, CompromiseContractId, CompromiseContractStatusId, ApproveDate, TDRDate, ContractNo, InstallmentDueDate, MeasureId, MeasureName
    INTO #tdr_latest05
    FROM (
        SELECT
            rtdr.LGNo,
            m_snap.MonthEndDate,
            cc.CompromiseContractId,
            cc.CompromiseContractStatusId,
            cc.ApproveDate,
            cc.TDRDate,
            cc.ContractNo,
            cc.InstallmentDueDate,
            cc.MeasureId,
            m.MeasureName,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY rtdr.LGNo, m_snap.MonthEndDate
                ORDER BY cc.ApproveDate DESC, cc.CompromiseContractId DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MonthEndDate FROM #monthly05) m_snap
        JOIN TDRDataCompromiseContract cc ON cc.ApproveDate <= m_snap.MonthEndDate
        JOIN TDRDataCompromiseContractRelated rtdr ON rtdr.CompromiseContractId = cc.CompromiseContractId
        LEFT JOIN SystemMeasureMaster m ON m.MeasureId = cc.MeasureId
        WHERE (cc.ClosedDate IS NULL OR cc.ClosedDate > m_snap.MonthEndDate)
          AND rtdr.LGNo IN (SELECT DISTINCT LGNo FROM #ddr_info05)
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE INDEX IX_tdr_latest05 ON #tdr_latest05 (LGNo, MonthEndDate);
    CREATE INDEX IX_tdr_latest05_lg ON #tdr_latest05 (LGNo);

    -- ── STEP 11b: Rank EOD rows only for monthly snapshots ───────────────────
    -- PDF pp4/11/16: display latest dated TDR, including closed/unapproved plans.
    -- This reporting history is separate from the active-plan calculation above.
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tdr_report05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tdr_report05;
    ;WITH ReportingTDR AS (
        SELECT rel.LGNo, m.MonthEndDate, cc.TDRDate,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rel.LGNo, m.MonthEndDate
                                  ORDER BY cc.TDRDate DESC, cc.CompromiseContractId DESC) AS rn
        FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MonthEndDate FROM #monthly05) m
        JOIN TDRDataCompromiseContract cc
          ON CAST(cc.TDRDate AS DATE) <= EOMONTH(m.MonthEndDate)
         AND cc.TDRDate > '1900-01-01'
        JOIN (
            SELECT CompromiseContractId, LGNo FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractRelated
            UNION
            SELECT CompromiseContractId, LGNo FROM TDRDataCompromiseContractLG
        ) rel ON rel.CompromiseContractId = cc.CompromiseContractId
        WHERE rel.LGNo IN (SELECT LGNo FROM #ddr_info05)
    )
    SELECT LGNo, MonthEndDate, TDRDate
    INTO #tdr_report05
    FROM ReportingTDR
    WHERE rn = 1;
    CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IX_tdr_report05 ON #tdr_report05 (LGNo, MonthEndDate);

    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#eom_source05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #eom_source05;
    SELECT
        ms.DebtorRelateId,
        ms.yr,
        ms.mn,
        ms.MonthEndDate,
        eom.CIFNo AS SnapshotCIFNo,
        eom.LGNo AS SnapshotLGNo,
        eom.DataDebtorCardId,
        eom.CurrentPaymentDate,
        eom.CloseDate,
        eom.PrincipalTotal,
        eom.DebtBalance,
        eom.AccruedInterestTotal,
        eom.ClaimPayDate,
        eom.DFDDate,
        eom.DPD,
        eom.IsTDR,
        eom.InstallmentsAmount,
        eom.TDRInstallments,
        eom.InstallmentOutstanding,
        eom.CaseTypeId,
        eom.FilingDate,
        eom.BlackCaseNo,
        eom.JmTrialDate,
        eom.RedCaseNo,
        eom.FrozenAssetDate,
        eom.OtherFrozenAssDate,
        eom.ReqRepayDate,
        eom.FilingAmount,
        eom.BankruptcyDate,
        eom.PetitionDate,
        eom.WithdrawDate,
        eom.WarrantDate,
        eom.JudgmentBankruptcyDate,
        eom.StatusLGId,
        eom.AmountDuty,
        eom.InstallmentPrincipal,
        eom.DebtAmount,
        eom.CompromiseContracApproveDate,
        eom.DebtorRelateTypeId,
        eom.SystemBankId,
        eom.MeasureName,
        eom.StatusPortId,
        eom.StatusPortDate,
        eom.TDRInstallmentDueDate,
        eom.AcknowDebtDate,
        eom.BadDebtDate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY ms.DebtorRelateId, ms.MonthEndDate
            ORDER BY ISNULL(eom.CreateDate, '1900-01-01') DESC,
                     ISNULL(eom.DataDebtorCardId, 0) DESC
        ) AS rn
    INTO #eom_source05
    FROM #monthly05 ms
    JOIN dbo.DataEndOfDay eom WITH (INDEX(IX_EOD_DebtorRelate_AsOfDate))
      ON eom.DebtorRelateId = ms.DebtorRelateId
     AND eom.AsOfDate = ms.MonthEndDate
     AND (eom.IsDelete = 0 OR eom.IsDelete IS NULL);
    CREATE INDEX IX_eom_source05 ON #eom_source05 (DebtorRelateId, MonthEndDate, rn);

    -- ── STEP 11b2: Previous month snapshot fallback for DFD/DPD ───────────────
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#eom_prev05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #eom_prev05;
    SELECT
        ms.DebtorRelateId,
        ms.MonthEndDate,
        e_prev.DFDDate AS PrevDFDDate,
        e_prev.DPD AS PrevDPD
    INTO #eom_prev05
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT ms1.DebtorRelateId, ms1.MonthEndDate
        FROM #monthly05 ms1
        JOIN #eom_source05 eom1 ON eom1.DebtorRelateId = ms1.DebtorRelateId AND eom1.MonthEndDate = ms1.MonthEndDate AND eom1.rn = 1
        WHERE (eom1.DFDDate IS NULL OR eom1.DFDDate <= '1900-01-01')
          -- A month-end source's empty DFD is not replaced by last month's DFD.
          AND CONVERT(date, eom1.MonthEndDate) <> EOMONTH(ms1.MonthEndDate)
    ) ms
    JOIN dbo.DataEndOfDay e_prev WITH (INDEX(IX_EOD_DebtorRelate_AsOfDate))
      ON e_prev.DebtorRelateId = ms.DebtorRelateId
     AND e_prev.AsOfDate = EOMONTH(DATEADD(MONTH, -1, ms.MonthEndDate))
     AND e_prev.DFDDate > '1900-01-01'
     AND (e_prev.IsDelete = 0 OR e_prev.IsDelete IS NULL);
    CREATE INDEX IX_eom_prev05 ON #eom_prev05 (DebtorRelateId, MonthEndDate);

    -- ── STEP 11c: Materialize #eom05 with fallbacks ──────────────────────────
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#eom05') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #eom05;
    SELECT
        ms.DebtorRelateId,
        report_tdr.TDRDate AS ReportTDRDate,
        ms.yr,
        ms.mn,
        ms.MonthEndDate,
        eom.SnapshotCIFNo,
        eom.SnapshotLGNo,
        COALESCE(eom.DataDebtorCardId, dc.DataDebtorCardId) AS DataDebtorCardId,
        eom.CurrentPaymentDate AS CurrentPaymentDate,
        eom.CloseDate AS CloseDate,
        eom.PrincipalTotal AS PrincipalTotal,
        eom.DebtBalance AS DebtBalance,
        eom.AccruedInterestTotal AS AccruedInterestTotal,
        dlg_source.ClaimDate AS ClaimPayDate,
        eom.DFDDate AS DFDDate,
        eom.DPD AS DPD,
        -- Effective TDR
        CASE
            WHEN tdr_rel.ApproveDate IS NOT NULL AND tdr_rel.ApproveDate > '1900-01-01'
                 AND ISNULL(tdr_rel.CompromiseContractStatusId, 0) NOT IN (60, 61) THEN 1
            ELSE ISNULL(COALESCE(eom.IsTDR, dc.IsTDR), 0)
        END AS IsTDR,
        eom.InstallmentsAmount AS InstallmentsAmount,
        eom.TDRInstallments,
        eom.InstallmentOutstanding,
        eom.CaseTypeId,
        eom.FilingDate,
        eom.BlackCaseNo,
        eom.JmTrialDate,
        eom.RedCaseNo,
        eom.FrozenAssetDate,
        eom.OtherFrozenAssDate,
        eom.ReqRepayDate,
        eom.FilingAmount,
        eom.BankruptcyDate,
        eom.PetitionDate,
        eom.WithdrawDate,
        eom.WarrantDate,
        eom.JudgmentBankruptcyDate,
        eom.StatusLGId,
        eom.AmountDuty,
        eom.InstallmentPrincipal AS InstallmentPrincipal,
        eom.DebtAmount AS DebtAmount,
        -- Effective TDR Approve Date
        CASE
